recipes.title: Plattar(Swedish Pancakes)
directions: Sift flour into bowl.
Add sugar and salt.
Add eggs and milk gradually, stirring until well blended let stand 2 hours.
Heat Swedish pancake pan (or ordinary pancake pan) and butter well. Beat batter again.
Pour by tablespoonfuls into sections of pan and fry on both sides until nicely browned.
Place on very hot platter; serve immediately with Lingonberries.
recipes.text: Plattar(Swedish Pancakes). Sift flour into bowl. Add sugar and salt. Add eggs and milk gradually, stirring until well blended let stand 2 hours. Heat Swedish pancake pan (or ordinary pancake pan) and butter well. Beat batter again. Pour by tablespoonfuls into sections of pan and fry on both sides until nicely browned. Place on very hot platter; serve immediately with Lingonberries.

recipes.title: Fried Apple Pies
ingredients: 4 cups of peeled and slice apples
directions: In a saucepan, combine apples and water. Simmer until tender, then cool. Mash apples, stir in sugar and cinnamon. Chill; combine flour, salt and baking powder. Cut in shortening until well blended. Add milk, a little at a time to form dough. Chill for 1 hour. Roll dough out to 1/4 inch thick. Cut into 4 inch rounds. Place about 2 tablespoons of the apple filling in the center of each circle. Moisten the edges with water then fold the pastry in half, pressing the edges together. Heat oil to 370u00b0 and fry the pies until brown.
recipes.text: Fried Apple Pies. In a saucepan, combine apples and water. Simmer until tender, then cool. Mash apples, stir in sugar and cinnamon. Chill; combine flour, salt and baking powder. Cut in shortening until well blended. Add milk, a little at a time to form dough. Chill for 1 hour. Roll dough out to 1/4 inch thick. Cut into 4 inch rounds. Place about 2 tablespoons of the apple filling in the center of each circle. Moisten the edges with water then fold the pastry in half, pressing the edges together. Heat oil to 370u00b0 and fry the pies until brown.

recipes.title: Nikki'S No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients in pot and bring to a rolling boil for 2 minutes. Add 3 cups quick oats, 1/2 tsp. vanilla, and pinch of salt. Beat and stir until all oats are mixed in and coated. Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper and cool.
recipes.text: Nikki'S No Bake Cookies. Mix all ingredients in pot and bring to a rolling boil for 2 minutes. Add 3 cups quick oats, 1/2 tsp. vanilla, and pinch of salt. Beat and stir until all oats are mixed in and coated. Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper and cool.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook zucchini, onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, salt and pepper in water until tender.
Drain.
Add slices of cheese and oleo. Put into casserole dish.
Top with croutons and grated cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook zucchini, onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, salt and pepper in water until tender. Drain. Add slices of cheese and oleo. Put into casserole dish. Top with croutons and grated cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Press rolls in 9 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Spread mixture of cream cheese, mayonnaise and Ranch dressing onto cool crust.
Press chopped vegetables and cheese onto mixture. Cut into squares.
This dish freezes well.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Press rolls in 9 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Spread mixture of cream cheese, mayonnaise and Ranch dressing onto cool crust. Press chopped vegetables and cheese onto mixture. Cut into squares. This dish freezes well.

recipes.title: Cherry Digest Cake
ingredients: 1 can cherry pie filling or any fruit
directions: Spread in 13-inch loaf pan.
Sprinkle 1 cake mix on top.
Put oleo dribbles over top.
Put nuts on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Cherry Digest Cake. Spread in 13-inch loaf pan. Sprinkle 1 cake mix on top. Put oleo dribbles over top. Put nuts on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Huevos
directions: Saute onion, green pepper, garlic and olives in 1 tablespoon oil in skillet over medium heat.
Combine eggs, turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper in bowl; beat until smooth.
Add to skillet.
Cook until eggs are set, stirring constantly.
Heat tortillas in 2 cups hot oil in skillet for 5 seconds on each side or until softened. Spoon egg mixture onto tortillas; fold to enclose filling.
Place on ovenproof plate.
Top with taco sauce and cheese.
Broil until cheese melts; serve immediately.
Yield:
2 servings.
recipes.text: Huevos. Saute onion, green pepper, garlic and olives in 1 tablespoon oil in skillet over medium heat. Combine eggs, turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper in bowl; beat until smooth. Add to skillet. Cook until eggs are set, stirring constantly. Heat tortillas in 2 cups hot oil in skillet for 5 seconds on each side or until softened. Spoon egg mixture onto tortillas; fold to enclose filling. Place on ovenproof plate. Top with taco sauce and cheese. Broil until cheese melts; serve immediately. Yield: 2 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
ingredients: Pepperidge Farm dressing with 3 Tbsp. butter, melted
directions: Cook broccoli and drain.
Make white sauce with butter, flour and milk; add salt.
Place layer of broccoli in baking dish, then layer of white sauce and layer of cheese.
Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing.
Drizzle melted butter over dressing.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole. Cook broccoli and drain. Make white sauce with butter, flour and milk; add salt. Place layer of broccoli in baking dish, then layer of white sauce and layer of cheese. Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing. Drizzle melted butter over dressing. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheese Pie
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. and 2 tsp. reduced calorie oleo
1 (eight 1/2 c. serving size) envelope low calorie lemon gelatin
directions: Combine crumbs and oleo.
Spray 9-inch pie plate with Pam and press crumb mixture over back and sides of plate.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes or until crisp.
Cool.
Pour milk in medium size bowl, cover and freeze until partially frozen (15 to 20 minutes). Meanwhile in a small mixing bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Set aside.
With electric mixer beat milk until thick and foamy. Gradually beat in dissolved gelatin.
Add 1/2 cup Ricotta cheese to gelatin mix and beat.
Add remaining cheese, beating until smooth. Pour mix into cooled crust.
Cover and refrigerate until set (3 hours).
ner: serving size) envelope low calorie lemon gelatin
recipes.text: Lemon Cheese Pie. Combine crumbs and oleo. Spray 9-inch pie plate with Pam and press crumb mixture over back and sides of plate. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes or until crisp. Cool. Pour milk in medium size bowl, cover and freeze until partially frozen (15 to 20 minutes). Meanwhile in a small mixing bowl dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Set aside. With electric mixer beat milk until thick and foamy. Gradually beat in dissolved gelatin. Add 1/2 cup Ricotta cheese to gelatin mix and beat. Add remaining cheese, beating until smooth. Pour mix into cooled crust. Cover and refrigerate until set (3 hours).

recipes.title: Steak Butter
directions: Cook onion and wine in a small saucepan until the liquid is reduced to 1/4 cup.
Remove from heat and cool.
With beater, cream butter and parsley.
Gradually beat in the wine mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Makes 3/4 cup butter.
recipes.text: Steak Butter. Cook onion and wine in a small saucepan until the liquid is reduced to 1/4 cup. Remove from heat and cool. With beater, cream butter and parsley. Gradually beat in the wine mixture. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Makes 3/4 cup butter.

recipes.title: Milk Eggnog
directions: Blend all ingredients in blender until smooth.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Add ice cream.
recipes.text: Milk Eggnog. Blend all ingredients in blender until smooth. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Add ice cream.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 10 oz. bag grated sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Mix soup and water.
Blend with hash browns, butter, sour cream, onions and Cheddar cheese in large bowl with salt and pepper.
Top with crushed cornflakes.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch baking dish for 1 1/4 hours at 350u00b0, uncovered.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix soup and water. Blend with hash browns, butter, sour cream, onions and Cheddar cheese in large bowl with salt and pepper. Top with crushed cornflakes. Bake in 9 x 13-inch baking dish for 1 1/4 hours at 350u00b0, uncovered.

recipes.title: Ugly Duckling Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, fruit cocktail, 1 cup of coconut and eggs in a large bowl.
Blend; then beat on medium for 2 minutes.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with brown sugar.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Ugly Duckling Cake. Combine cake mix, fruit cocktail, 1 cup of coconut and eggs in a large bowl. Blend; then beat on medium for 2 minutes. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Favorite Doughnuts
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Chill for 2 hours.
Roll out and cut doughnuts.
Fry in hot oil.
recipes.text: Favorite Doughnuts. Mix all ingredients. Chill for 2 hours. Roll out and cut doughnuts. Fry in hot oil.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix flour, soda, sugar, baking powder and cocoa in bowl.
Stir thoroughly, then add water, mayonnaise and vanilla.
Stir enough to mix.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes in two 9-inch layer pans or 1 hour in tube pan.
Pans should be greased and floured.
Cool cake.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Chocolate Cake. Mix flour, soda, sugar, baking powder and cocoa in bowl. Stir thoroughly, then add water, mayonnaise and vanilla. Stir enough to mix. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes in two 9-inch layer pans or 1 hour in tube pan. Pans should be greased and floured. Cool cake.

recipes.title: Minestrone
directions: In large kettle, brown pork until crisp.
Add onions and garlic and saute until onions are tender.
Add zucchini, cabbage, bay leaf and water.
Bring to boil.
Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Stir in beans, tomatoes, spaghetti, salt and pepper.
Cook 15 minutes until spaghetti is tender.
Discard bay leaf.
Serve with cheese.
recipes.text: Minestrone. In large kettle, brown pork until crisp. Add onions and garlic and saute until onions are tender. Add zucchini, cabbage, bay leaf and water. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Stir in beans, tomatoes, spaghetti, salt and pepper. Cook 15 minutes until spaghetti is tender. Discard bay leaf. Serve with cheese.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
directions: Cook cake according to directions on box.
Heat pineapple and sugar until boiling.
Spread pineapple and sugar on cake while still hot.
Let cool.
Fix pudding according to directions on box and spread on cake.
Spread Cool Whip on pudding.
Sprinkle chopped nuts on cake.
Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Cake. Cook cake according to directions on box. Heat pineapple and sugar until boiling. Spread pineapple and sugar on cake while still hot. Let cool. Fix pudding according to directions on box and spread on cake. Spread Cool Whip on pudding. Sprinkle chopped nuts on cake. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shake
directions: Put milk and berries in blender for 8 to 10 seconds.
Add ice milk and blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Strawberry Shake. Put milk and berries in blender for 8 to 10 seconds. Add ice milk and blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Microwave butter for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.
Stir until blended and well melted.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well (I knead with my hands).
Microwave until soft, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.
Stir and pour into 9 x 9-inch pan.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge. Microwave butter for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Stir until blended and well melted. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well (I knead with my hands). Microwave until soft, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Stir and pour into 9 x 9-inch pan. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Aunt Lillian'S Kraut Salad
ingredients: 1 c. chopped celery or 2 tsp. celery seed
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.
Bring sugar and vinegar to boil and pour over mixture of kraut and vegetables.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Will keep in refrigerator for 4 to 5 weeks.
recipes.text: Aunt Lillian'S Kraut Salad. Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Bring sugar and vinegar to boil and pour over mixture of kraut and vegetables. Chill several hours or overnight. Will keep in refrigerator for 4 to 5 weeks.

egg
yolk,
one at a time, add sour cream (optional),
add

fold in egg white (do not overbeat, only beat

Cook in cake pan that has been wiped

bake
hour at 350u00b0 or until toothpick comes out clean, cool on rack (about 10 minutes) covered with clean dish towel. Remove and allow to cool completely covered with towel.
Use your favorite icing.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Pound Cake. In mixer or by hand, beat sugar and butter/Crisco until smooth and lemon colored.tAdd egg yolk, one at a time, add sour cream (optional), add flour, fold in egg white (do not overbeat, only beat for about 1 minute). Cook in cake pan that has been wiped with small amount of Crisco or floured, line with wax paper, bake 1 hour at 350u00b0 or until toothpick comes out clean, cool on rack (about 10 minutes) covered with clean dish towel. Remove and allow to cool completely covered with towel. Use your favorite icing.

recipes.title: Potato Carrot Soup
directions: Dice potatoes, carrots and onions and cook in the boiling water with salt until tender, about 15 minutes.
Drain.
Save the water, then rice or mash the vegetables thoroughly.
There should be 1 3/4 cups of cooking water.
If not, add fresh water.
Combine with milk; scald and slowly stir in mashed vegetables.
Add cayenne and celery salt; reheat and serve.
recipes.text: Potato Carrot Soup. Dice potatoes, carrots and onions and cook in the boiling water with salt until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain. Save the water, then rice or mash the vegetables thoroughly. There should be 1 3/4 cups of cooking water. If not, add fresh water. Combine with milk; scald and slowly stir in mashed vegetables. Add cayenne and celery salt; reheat and serve.

recipes.title: Company Coming Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add cream of tartar.
Beat until stiff.
Add sugar gradually.
Fold in vanilla, soda crackers and nuts.
Bake in greased 12 x 6-inch pan at 350u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until top is light golden brown.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Company Coming Pie. Beat egg whites until foamy. Add cream of tartar. Beat until stiff. Add sugar gradually. Fold in vanilla, soda crackers and nuts. Bake in greased 12 x 6-inch pan at 350u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until top is light golden brown. Let cool.

recipes.title: Beef Patties With Mushrooms And Potatoes
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients and 1/2 of the envelope of soup mix; mix lightly, but well.
Shape into 4 patties; set aside. Grease shiny side of four 18 x 18-inch sheets of heavy-duty foil. Spread out 1 potato (sliced) in center of each sheet.
Sprinkle potatoes with remaining soup mix.
Place meat on potatoes and top with mushrooms.
Close both ends of foil tightly.
Put on cookie sheet.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Beef Patties With Mushrooms And Potatoes. Combine first 5 ingredients and 1/2 of the envelope of soup mix; mix lightly, but well. Shape into 4 patties; set aside. Grease shiny side of four 18 x 18-inch sheets of heavy-duty foil. Spread out 1 potato (sliced) in center of each sheet. Sprinkle potatoes with remaining soup mix. Place meat on potatoes and top with mushrooms. Close both ends of foil tightly. Put on cookie sheet. Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Balls
directions: In large mixer bowl, mix ingredients in order.
Form into balls and roll in shredded coconut.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Orange Balls. In large mixer bowl, mix ingredients in order. Form into balls and roll in shredded coconut. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Brown ground beef; drain fat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until tender.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chili. Brown ground beef; drain fat. Add onion and garlic; cook until tender. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Heat brown sugar, corn syrup, margarine and salt to simmer in a 4-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring constantly.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Heat brown sugar, corn syrup, margarine and salt to simmer in a 4-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring constantly.

recipes.title: Colorado Marble
directions: Melt German sweet chocolate in 6 tablespoons hot water.
Add egg yolks to hot mixture, one at a time, stirring quickly so they don't curdle.
Add powdered sugar.
Set aside in pan of cool water to cool.
Beat egg whites; whip whipping cream.
Fold together. Combine with chocolate mixture.
recipes.text: Colorado Marble. Melt German sweet chocolate in 6 tablespoons hot water. Add egg yolks to hot mixture, one at a time, stirring quickly so they don't curdle. Add powdered sugar. Set aside in pan of cool water to cool. Beat egg whites; whip whipping cream. Fold together. Combine with chocolate mixture.

recipes.title: Herbed Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
3 large, skinless and boneless chicken breasts, halved lengthwise
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Prepare rice using package directions. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Place in skillet with butter and cook slowly until brown. Spoon rice into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with chicken. Add soup to skillet. Slowly add wine, stirring until smooth. Add mushrooms. Bring to boil and pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Herbed Chicken Bake. Prepare rice using package directions. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Place in skillet with butter and cook slowly until brown. Spoon rice into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with chicken. Add soup to skillet. Slowly add wine, stirring until smooth. Add mushrooms. Bring to boil and pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cream-style corn or 1 can creamed corn and 1 can whole kernel corn
directions: Mix all ingredients together well.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Mix all ingredients together well. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Gourmet Potatoes
ingredients: 8 large baking potatoes, boiled in jackets, cooked and grated
directions: Melt margarine.
Cook onions until soft.
Mix together Cheddar cheese and sour cream.
Add onions, salt, pepper and potatoes. Mixture will be stiff.
Place into large casserole dish.
Bake for 45 minutes at 400u00b0 or until top is brown.
This is best made ahead of time and let set, then cool.
Good warmed over and easily halved for smaller families.
recipes.text: Gourmet Potatoes. Melt margarine. Cook onions until soft. Mix together Cheddar cheese and sour cream. Add onions, salt, pepper and potatoes. Mixture will be stiff. Place into large casserole dish. Bake for 45 minutes at 400u00b0 or until top is brown. This is best made ahead of time and let set, then cool. Good warmed over and easily halved for smaller families.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
ingredients: 3 shakes garlic salt and little paprika for color
1/2 c. grated Cheddar cheese (1/4 c. goes into mix, 1/4 c. saved for after all ingredients are mixed and put on top)
directions: Mix sour cream, cream cheese, mayonnaise, lemon, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and garlic together.
Then mix in crab meat.
Mix well.
Then mix in Cheddar cheese.
Put in baking dish.
Top with remainder of Cheddar cheese and paprika.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Let cool for firmness.
Serve with Sociable crackers, etc.
recipes.text: Hot Crab Dip. Mix sour cream, cream cheese, mayonnaise, lemon, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and garlic together. Then mix in crab meat. Mix well. Then mix in Cheddar cheese. Put in baking dish. Top with remainder of Cheddar cheese and paprika. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let cool for firmness. Serve with Sociable crackers, etc.

recipes.text: Peanut Butter Loaf. Spray 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray; set aside. On paper plate or sheet of wax paper combine dry ingredients; set aside. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In medium bowl, using a wire whisk or fork, combine remaining ingredients, beating until egg is blended (peanut butter and margarine will be lumpy). Stir in dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Pour into sprayed pan and bake for 45 to 50 minutes (until loaf is golden and a cake tester, inserted in center, comes out dry). Set loaf in pan on wire rack for 5 minutes to cool slightly, then invert onto rack for 5 minutes to cool slightly, then invert onto rack. Remove pan and let cool completely. To serve, cut into 12 equal slices.

recipes.title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) bag broccoli (frozen), cooked and drained
4 to 6 chicken breasts, cooked and boned
directions: Put cooked broccoli in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Mix onion with chicken and put on top of broccoli.
Mix mayonnaise, soup and lemon juice.
Put on top of chicken.
Prepare stuffing mix as directed.
Put on top of soup.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. During the last 5 to 10 minutes, add cheese.
Serves 8 to 10.
May be divided into 2 small casseroles.
Freeze one.
recipes.text: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole. Put cooked broccoli in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Mix onion with chicken and put on top of broccoli. Mix mayonnaise, soup and lemon juice. Put on top of chicken. Prepare stuffing mix as directed. Put on top of soup. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. During the last 5 to 10 minutes, add cheese. Serves 8 to 10. May be divided into 2 small casseroles. Freeze one.

recipes.title: Pineapple Sherbet Punch
directions: Mix lemonade, orange juice and water in punch bowl.
Spoon in ice cream and sherbet.
Serve.
recipes.text: Pineapple Sherbet Punch. Mix lemonade, orange juice and water in punch bowl. Spoon in ice cream and sherbet. Serve.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Melt margarine in 9 x 11-inch pan.
Add pecans and coconut. Mix cake mix as directed on box.
Add to the top of butter, pecans and coconut mixture.
Bake as directed on box.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cake. Melt margarine in 9 x 11-inch pan. Add pecans and coconut. Mix cake mix as directed on box. Add to the top of butter, pecans and coconut mixture. Bake as directed on box.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Drain corn, beans and peas.
Mix with peppers, onions, celery and cucumbers.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad. Drain corn, beans and peas. Mix with peppers, onions, celery and cucumbers.

recipes.title: Praline Cookies(Servings:  48)
directions: Put 1 layer whole graham crackers in jelly roll pan (approximately 24).
Boil and stir sugar and margarine for 2 minutes.
Stir in pecans.
Pour over crackers.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
Cool in pan for 2 minutes.
Finish cooling on rack and break into halves.
recipes.text: Praline Cookies(Servings:  48). Put 1 layer whole graham crackers in jelly roll pan (approximately 24). Boil and stir sugar and margarine for 2 minutes. Stir in pecans. Pour over crackers. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool in pan for 2 minutes. Finish cooling on rack and break into halves.

recipes.title: Banana Energy Bars
directions: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg, salt and bananas.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Banana Energy Bars. Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg, salt and bananas. Stir in remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Italian Cake With Chocolate Icing
directions: Beat egg whites at high speed with an electric mixer until stiff peak forms.
Set aside.
Beat butter and shortening until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well.
Add egg yolks, 1 at a time, beating until blended after each addition.
Combine flour, cocoa and baking soda; add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture.
Beat at low speed until blended after each addition.
Stir in coconut, chopped pecans and vanilla.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8 inch cake pans.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes our clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes.
Remove cake layers to wire rack and cool completely.
recipes.text: Italian Cake With Chocolate Icing. Beat egg whites at high speed with an electric mixer until stiff peak forms. Set aside. Beat butter and shortening until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well. Add egg yolks, 1 at a time, beating until blended after each addition. Combine flour, cocoa and baking soda; add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Beat at low speed until blended after each addition. Stir in coconut, chopped pecans and vanilla. Fold in egg whites. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8 inch cake pans. Bake at 325u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes our clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove cake layers to wire rack and cool completely.

recipes.title: Low Cholesterol Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Sift baking powder and flour together.
Add to sugar mixture with milk.
Fold in egg whites, vanilla and lemon flavoring.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.
recipes.text: Low Cholesterol Pound Cake. Cream margarine and sugar. Sift baking powder and flour together. Add to sugar mixture with milk. Fold in egg whites, vanilla and lemon flavoring. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni; drain and cool.
Add tomatoes, onion, peppers, cheese and pickle juice.
Mix.
Add remaining ingredients.
Add celery seed and seasoned peppers to taste.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni; drain and cool. Add tomatoes, onion, peppers, cheese and pickle juice. Mix. Add remaining ingredients. Add celery seed and seasoned peppers to taste.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf # 1
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a buttered loaf pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is crispy.
(Mixture will look sloppy.)
Good cold, too.
recipes.text: Salmon Loaf # 1. Mix all ingredients and pour into a buttered loaf pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until top is crispy. (Mixture will look sloppy.) Good cold, too.

recipes.title: Beaufort Stew
directions: Note:
May increase potatoes, corn or shrimp.
recipes.text: Beaufort Stew. Note: May increase potatoes, corn or shrimp.

recipes.title: Tofu Casserole
ingredients: 3 to 4 shiitake (dried mushrooms), soaked and chopped
directions: Cut tofu into quarters and boil in salted water for 20 minutes.
Drain and crumble.
Combine with the other ingredients and bake for 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Tofu Casserole. Cut tofu into quarters and boil in salted water for 20 minutes. Drain and crumble. Combine with the other ingredients and bake for 40 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Festive Chicken Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, finely chopped (about 3 c.)
1 (1 1/4 oz.) pkg. dry taco seasoning mix, divided
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1 (2 1/4 oz.) can sliced black olives, drained and chopped
directions: Place chicken in a small bowl. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons lime juice, garlic, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Festive Chicken Dip. Place chicken in a small bowl. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons lime juice, garlic, salt and pepper. Mix well. Set aside.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0 and grease cookie sheet.
Place shortening, sugars, egg and vanilla in mixing bowl and beat thoroughly.
Sift together salt, flour and soda and add to shortening mixture.
Mix well.
Blend in oats and drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet.
If you wish, you may also add 1/3 cup chopped nuts, raisins or shredded coconut to the batter.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until slightly brown at the edges.
Makes 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies. Preheat oven to 350u00b0 and grease cookie sheet. Place shortening, sugars, egg and vanilla in mixing bowl and beat thoroughly. Sift together salt, flour and soda and add to shortening mixture. Mix well. Blend in oats and drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet. If you wish, you may also add 1/3 cup chopped nuts, raisins or shredded coconut to the batter. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until slightly brown at the edges. Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients and place in greased casserole. Combine brown sugar, flour, margarine and pecans and sprinkle on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Mix first 7 ingredients and place in greased casserole. Combine brown sugar, flour, margarine and pecans and sprinkle on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Tomato Aspic
directions: Mix all of the ingredients together.
Pour into individual molds.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Tomato Aspic. Mix all of the ingredients together. Pour into individual molds. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
ingredients: 6 to 7 c. cooking apples, pared and sliced
directions: Make pastry for 2-crust pie; line pie plate with pastry.
Fill with sliced apples. Mix sugar, flour and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples.
Dot with shortening.
Top with pastry.
Seal edges and flute.
Cover edge with aluminum foil, if desired.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Make pastry for 2-crust pie; line pie plate with pastry. Fill with sliced apples. Mix sugar, flour and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples. Dot with shortening. Top with pastry. Seal edges and flute. Cover edge with aluminum foil, if desired. Bake at 425u00b0 for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Pimento Cheese
directions: Heat in double boiler until melted, then mash up pimiento pepper real good.
Remove from boiler and stir for a few minutes longer.
recipes.text: Pimento Cheese. Heat in double boiler until melted, then mash up pimiento pepper real good. Remove from boiler and stir for a few minutes longer.

Simmer until done; may substitute chicken with shrimp or beef. Set aside.tChop and cook green onions in slightly greased pan (drain any excess oil); set aside. recipes.title: Pecan Pie(Easy)
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Place in uncooked pie shell.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.
Pecans will rise to top.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie(Easy). Mix all ingredients well. Place in uncooked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes. Pecans will rise to top.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Grate zucchini and combine with eggs, oil and vanilla.
Mix all dry ingredients together.
Combine all ingredients and put in two loaf pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Grate zucchini and combine with eggs, oil and vanilla. Mix all dry ingredients together. Combine all ingredients and put in two loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Breakfast Souffle
directions: Brown and drain sausage.
Beat eggs with milk, mustard and salt.
Cube bread and layer with sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Pour egg mixture over layers; cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
Bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0 (20 minutes with foil on and 25 minutes with foil off).
Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Breakfast Souffle. Brown and drain sausage. Beat eggs with milk, mustard and salt. Cube bread and layer with sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Pour egg mixture over layers; cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0 (20 minutes with foil on and 25 minutes with foil off). Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Pat crescent rolls onto pizza pan or cookie sheet to look like pizza crust.
Bake as directed on can.
Cool.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Pat crescent rolls onto pizza pan or cookie sheet to look like pizza crust. Bake as directed on can. Cool.

recipes.title: Trifle
directions: Mix pudding mix with milk.
Let set until thick.
Slice cake very thin.
In an attractive bowl, layer the following:
recipes.text: Trifle. Mix pudding mix with milk. Let set until thick. Slice cake very thin. In an attractive bowl, layer the following:

recipes.title: Chinese Marinated Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 (15 1/2 oz.) can French green beans, drained
1 (10 oz.) can white Shoe Peg corn, drained
1 (15 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1 purple onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings
directions: Combine vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
Blend well.
Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Pour marinade over vegetables.
Refrigerate at least 2 days before serving.
Drain marinade from vegetables to serve.
Yields 12 to 15 servings.
recipes.text: Chinese Marinated Vegetable Salad. Combine vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. Blend well. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Pour marinade over vegetables. Refrigerate at least 2 days before serving. Drain marinade from vegetables to serve. Yields 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
ingredients: 4 (3 oz.) boxes Jell-O, prepared as directed
directions: Mix all ingredients together until well blended.
Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Jello Salad. Mix all ingredients together until well blended. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Electric 4-Alarm Chili
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. each: salt, paprika, oregano and ground cumin
2 cans (16 oz. each) red kidney beans, drained
directions: In large, heavy pot, brown beef with onions, green pepper and garlic.
Drain off fat.
Add remaining ingredients, except kidney beans.
Simmer, uncovered, at least 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
When thickened, stir in drained beans.
Heat through and serve.
recipes.text: Electric 4-Alarm Chili. In large, heavy pot, brown beef with onions, green pepper and garlic. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients, except kidney beans. Simmer, uncovered, at least 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. When thickened, stir in drained beans. Heat through and serve.

recipes.title: Ham Cheese Ball
directions: Put your cream cheese in a large bowl.
Chop up your ham in a processor.
Pour your ham in another bowl.
Chop green onions in food processor.
Mix together.
Put about 5 or 6 handfuls of chopped ham in the cream cheese and onion mixture.
Add Accent. Roll into 2 balls, then roll in ham that is left over.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Ham Cheese Ball. Put your cream cheese in a large bowl. Chop up your ham in a processor. Pour your ham in another bowl. Chop green onions in food processor. Mix together. Put about 5 or 6 handfuls of chopped ham in the cream cheese and onion mixture. Add Accent. Roll into 2 balls, then roll in ham that is left over. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Black Bean And Rice Soup
directions: Place beans with liquid in blender; blend until smooth.
Pour into large saucepan.
Stir in water, oregano and garlic powder and bring to boil.
Stir in rice.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Serve with chopped onions if desired.
recipes.text: Black Bean And Rice Soup. Place beans with liquid in blender; blend until smooth. Pour into large saucepan. Stir in water, oregano and garlic powder and bring to boil. Stir in rice. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Serve with chopped onions if desired.

recipes.title: Stewed Pears
directions: Pare and core pears.
Place in cold water until ready to use. Make syrup.
Add fruit, cored side down.
Boil gently until soft. Add lemon juice before done.
recipes.text: Stewed Pears. Pare and core pears. Place in cold water until ready to use. Make syrup. Add fruit, cored side down. Boil gently until soft. Add lemon juice before done.

recipes.title: Three Layer Pie
directions: Combine ingredients and bake
in
a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
Cool.
recipes.text: Three Layer Pie. Combine ingredients and bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350u00b0. Cool.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Peach Crisp
ingredients: 1 (29 oz.) can sliced peaches, well drained
directions: Arrange peaches in an 8 x 8-inch pan.
In a small bowl, combine oats, sugar, flour and spices. Cut in butter until coarse crumbs form. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Peach Crisp. Arrange peaches in an 8 x 8-inch pan. In a small bowl, combine oats, sugar, flour and spices. Cut in butter until coarse crumbs form. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine and shortening.
Gradually add sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa. Add milk and flour alternately.
Add vanilla.
Place in greased and floured tube pan.
Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes in 325u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pound Cake. Cream margarine and shortening. Gradually add sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa. Add milk and flour alternately. Add vanilla. Place in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes in 325u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Slime
directions: Place 1/2 cup of cornstarch in a small bowl.
Gradually stir in 1/4 cup of water.
If mixture is too dry, add more water.
If too runny, add more cornstarch.
Food coloring may be added, if desired.
Slime will feel dry and solid to the touch, but if picked up, will dribble through your fingers.
If hit, it will be solid, but if finger is placed in the bowl gently, it will be liquid.
Have fun!
recipes.text: Slime. Place 1/2 cup of cornstarch in a small bowl. Gradually stir in 1/4 cup of water. If mixture is too dry, add more water. If too runny, add more cornstarch. Food coloring may be added, if desired. Slime will feel dry and solid to the touch, but if picked up, will dribble through your fingers. If hit, it will be solid, but if finger is placed in the bowl gently, it will be liquid. Have fun!

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl; pour into melted buttered pan.
Sprinkle Cheddar cheese to top.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cornbread. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl; pour into melted buttered pan. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese to top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken until real tender.
Save the broth to prepare the dressing except for 1/2 cup.
Pull all chicken meat from bone. Put 1 layer of dressing, then 2 chicken breasts and 1 can of soup. Repeat and sprinkle the top with dry mix.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken until real tender. Save the broth to prepare the dressing except for 1/2 cup. Pull all chicken meat from bone. Put 1 layer of dressing, then 2 chicken breasts and 1 can of soup. Repeat and sprinkle the top with dry mix. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix well.
Chill and serve with cut up fruit.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Mix well. Chill and serve with cut up fruit.

recipes.title: Sausage-Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients, stirring well.
Spoon into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Combine margarine and stuffing mix.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Sausage-Noodle Bake. Combine first 7 ingredients, stirring well. Spoon into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Combine margarine and stuffing mix. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Angel Food Delight
directions: Prepare angel food cake in tube pan; let cool.
Cut cake into 1/2-inch serving slices and arrange 1/2 of cake in an oblong pan. Mix together the Dream Whip, confectioners sugar and cream cheese until creamy.
Spread filling on layer of cake, then put another layer of cake on filling.
Cover with fruit pie filling.
Chill.
recipes.text: Angel Food Delight. Prepare angel food cake in tube pan; let cool. Cut cake into 1/2-inch serving slices and arrange 1/2 of cake in an oblong pan. Mix together the Dream Whip, confectioners sugar and cream cheese until creamy. Spread filling on layer of cake, then put another layer of cake on filling. Cover with fruit pie filling. Chill.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients. Bake at 250u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Combine all ingredients. Bake at 250u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Cut shortening into flour and salt.
Combine egg, water and vinegar.
Pour liquid into flour mixture all at once.
Blend with a spoon just until all is moistened.
This is an easy crust to make.
I roll the crust between wax paper and fold,
Put into pan. On the top crust I brush canned cream, then cut holes, sprinkle sugar on top and put little pieces of oleo on the holes.
I like to mix in a large tupperwear container and shape into balls.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Cut shortening into flour and salt. Combine egg, water and vinegar. Pour liquid into flour mixture all at once. Blend with a spoon just until all is moistened. This is an easy crust to make. I roll the crust between wax paper and fold, Put into pan. On the top crust I brush canned cream, then cut holes, sprinkle sugar on top and put little pieces of oleo on the holes. I like to mix in a large tupperwear container and shape into balls.

recipes.title: Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. meat, cooked and crumbled (bacon, ham, sausage or seafood)
directions: Pour into deep dish Pet Ritz pie crust.
Bake as directed on pie crust at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm in middle. Let set for a few minutes.
recipes.text: Quiche. Pour into deep dish Pet Ritz pie crust. Bake as directed on pie crust at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm in middle. Let set for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Chili Sauce
directions: Boil all ingredients until thick, stirring often.
Pour into quart jars and seal.
Process in hot water bath for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Chili Sauce. Boil all ingredients until thick, stirring often. Pour into quart jars and seal. Process in hot water bath for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cake
directions: Rub flour, shortening, sugar and salt to fine crumbs, saving 1/2 cup crumbs to sprinkle on top. Add baking powder, soda, nutmeg, cinnamon, sour milk and eggs to batter. Mix well. Bake in a square cake pan. Sprinkle crumbs on top before baking. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cowboy Cake. Rub flour, shortening, sugar and salt to fine crumbs, saving 1/2 cup crumbs to sprinkle on top. Add baking powder, soda, nutmeg, cinnamon, sour milk and eggs to batter. Mix well. Bake in a square cake pan. Sprinkle crumbs on top before baking. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Peaches
directions: Combine the vinegar, the juice from the peaches, sugar, cinnamon and cloves.
Boil until reduced by about half.
Remove the spices.
Stick the cloves into the peach halves and pour the syrup over peaches.
Let stand overnight in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Spiced Peaches. Combine the vinegar, the juice from the peaches, sugar, cinnamon and cloves. Boil until reduced by about half. Remove the spices. Stick the cloves into the peach halves and pour the syrup over peaches. Let stand overnight in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pudding Dessert(12 To 15 People)
ingredients: 2 small pkg. instant lemon pudding (approximately 3.5 oz. size)
directions: Beat the ingredients together and spread over cream cheese. Refrigerate until firm.
One-half hour before serving, spread whipped cream over the top.
recipes.text: Pudding Dessert(12 To 15 People). Beat the ingredients together and spread over cream cheese. Refrigerate until firm. One-half hour before serving, spread whipped cream over the top.

recipes.title: Never Fail Caramel Icing
directions: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add brown sugar.
Boil over low heat, stirring constantly.
Stir in milk and bring to a boil again, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm.
Gradually add powdered sugar until thick enough to spread.
recipes.text: Never Fail Caramel Icing. Melt butter in saucepan. Add brown sugar. Boil over low heat, stirring constantly. Stir in milk and bring to a boil again, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and cool to lukewarm. Gradually add powdered sugar until thick enough to spread.

recipes.title: Congealed Carrot Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Drain pineapple and reserve juice; add water to juice to make 2 cups.
Stir into Jell-O mixture.
Chill until the consistency of unbeaten egg whites is reached.
Stir in pineapple, carrots, cheese and pecans.
Pour into a lightly oiled 6 cup mold.
Cover and chill until firm. Unmold onto lettuce leaves, if desired.
Yields 16 servings.
recipes.text: Congealed Carrot Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Drain pineapple and reserve juice; add water to juice to make 2 cups. Stir into Jell-O mixture. Chill until the consistency of unbeaten egg whites is reached. Stir in pineapple, carrots, cheese and pecans. Pour into a lightly oiled 6 cup mold. Cover and chill until firm. Unmold onto lettuce leaves, if desired. Yields 16 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecue Buns
ingredients: 1/3 c. instant nonfat dry milk solids
2 c. very warm tap water (120~ to 130~)
directions: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix 2 cups flour, dry milk solids, sugar, salt and yeast.
Add oleo.
Gradually add tap water to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally.
Add 3/4 cup flour.
Beat at high speed 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally.
Stir in enough additional flour to make a stiff dough.
Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic (8 to 10 minutes).
Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top.
Cover; let rise in warm place, free from draft, until doubled in bulk, about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecue Buns. In a large bowl, thoroughly mix 2 cups flour, dry milk solids, sugar, salt and yeast. Add oleo. Gradually add tap water to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally. Add 3/4 cup flour. Beat at high speed 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in enough additional flour to make a stiff dough. Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic (8 to 10 minutes). Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm place, free from draft, until doubled in bulk, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wash and remove stems from mushrooms.
Chop stems.
Set aside. Cook sausage until done.
Drain well on paper towel.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Wash and remove stems from mushrooms. Chop stems. Set aside. Cook sausage until done. Drain well on paper towel.

recipes.title: Raisin Molasses Gems
directions: Beat shortening and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy.
Add molasses and egg; beat well.
Combine flour, soda, cinnamon, cloves, ginger and salt.
Add to molasses mixture; mix well.
Stir in raisins.
Cover.
Refrigerate until chilled.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll each in sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on oiled cookie sheet.
Bake in upper third of preheated 350u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Raisin Molasses Gems. Beat shortening and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy. Add molasses and egg; beat well. Combine flour, soda, cinnamon, cloves, ginger and salt. Add to molasses mixture; mix well. Stir in raisins. Cover. Refrigerate until chilled. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll each in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on oiled cookie sheet. Bake in upper third of preheated 350u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Martha Odom'S Cookies
directions: Cream sugar, margarine and Crisco.
Add egg and beat well.
Add vanilla with sifted flour to which soda and salt have been added. Pinch off pieces the size of walnuts and place one inch apart on cookie sheet; flatten with hand or glass which has been floured.
recipes.text: Martha Odom'S Cookies. Cream sugar, margarine and Crisco. Add egg and beat well. Add vanilla with sifted flour to which soda and salt have been added. Pinch off pieces the size of walnuts and place one inch apart on cookie sheet; flatten with hand or glass which has been floured.

recipes.title: Sourdough Biscuits
directions: Add all ingredients together.
Roll small balls together and pat.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Sourdough Biscuits. Add all ingredients together. Roll small balls together and pat. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Green Bean Surprise
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Open and drain green beans.
Spread out in 9 x 9-inch pan.
Spoon on cream of mushroom soup.
Melt butter in small saucepan.
Crumble up crackers; add to melted butter. Stir 2 or 3 minutes.
Layer crackers on top of mushroom soup in 9 x 9-inch pan.
Cover with grated cheese.
Cover dish with aluminum foil.
Cook 10 minutes; remove foil and cook 5 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Green Bean Surprise. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Open and drain green beans. Spread out in 9 x 9-inch pan. Spoon on cream of mushroom soup. Melt butter in small saucepan. Crumble up crackers; add to melted butter. Stir 2 or 3 minutes. Layer crackers on top of mushroom soup in 9 x 9-inch pan. Cover with grated cheese. Cover dish with aluminum foil. Cook 10 minutes; remove foil and cook 5 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Bark Candy
ingredients: 2 c. Cap'n Crunch peanut butter cereal
directions: Melt bark in double boiler or microwave.
Pour over all other ingredients and stir until coated.
Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.
Work quickly, as bark will begin to set.
If this occurs, set the bowl in warm water for a few minutes and stir again.
(It is easier to make this in 2 batches by halving the ingredients.) Allow to cool and set, then store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Bark Candy. Melt bark in double boiler or microwave. Pour over all other ingredients and stir until coated. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper. Work quickly, as bark will begin to set. If this occurs, set the bowl in warm water for a few minutes and stir again. (It is easier to make this in 2 batches by halving the ingredients.) Allow to cool and set, then store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Chili Beans
directions: Brown hamburger; add onion and other ingredients.
Simmer on low heat.
recipes.text: Chili Beans. Brown hamburger; add onion and other ingredients. Simmer on low heat.

recipes.title: Tuna Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine carrots, celery, onions and tuna.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Serve cold with raw vegetables or crackers.
recipes.text: Tuna Vegetable Dip. Combine carrots, celery, onions and tuna. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve cold with raw vegetables or crackers.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 c. chopped and drained plum tomatoes (from a can)
salt and freshly ground black pepper
sour cream and finely chopped fresh chives (as accompaniments)
directions: In a large heavy pot, heat olive oil over moderate heat and cook the onions until translucent. Add the minced garlic and crushed red pepper flakes and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Stir in the balsamic vinegar and the brown sugar; bring to a simmer. Add the cabbage and stir to combine. Add the tomatoes and the chicken stock and bring to a simmer. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Simmer the soup, uncovered, for 30 to 40 minutes until the cabbage is very tender. Taste soup and adjust seasoning with more balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, salt and/or pepper. Stir in parsley. Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream and chives.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Cabbage Soup. In a large heavy pot, heat olive oil over moderate heat and cook the onions until translucent. Add the minced garlic and crushed red pepper flakes and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Stir in the balsamic vinegar and the brown sugar; bring to a simmer. Add the cabbage and stir to combine. Add the tomatoes and the chicken stock and bring to a simmer. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Simmer the soup, uncovered, for 30 to 40 minutes until the cabbage is very tender. Taste soup and adjust seasoning with more balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, salt and/or pepper. Stir in parsley. Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream and chives.

recipes.title: Zucchini Crab Cakes
ingredients: 2 c. zucchini, peeled, grated and squeezed dry
directions: Mix and form into cakes.
Lightly flour and fry until brown. Can be served with tartar sauce.
recipes.text: Zucchini Crab Cakes. Mix and form into cakes. Lightly flour and fry until brown. Can be served with tartar sauce.

recipes.title: Walnut Coffee Cake
directions: Unroll dough. Separate into triangles. Spread each triangle with part of the butter or margarine. Combine brown sugar, cinnamon and walnuts in a small bowl. Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon of the mixture over each dough triangle.
Roll up as label directs.
Place rolls, point side down, in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan in two layers.
Brush top of loaf with remaining butter or margarine. Sprinkle with remaining topping. Bake at 375u00b0 for 35 minutes. Turn out onto wire rack. Cool.
recipes.text: Walnut Coffee Cake. Unroll dough. Separate into triangles. Spread each triangle with part of the butter or margarine. Combine brown sugar, cinnamon and walnuts in a small bowl. Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon of the mixture over each dough triangle. Roll up as label directs. Place rolls, point side down, in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan in two layers. Brush top of loaf with remaining butter or margarine. Sprinkle with remaining topping. Bake at 375u00b0 for 35 minutes. Turn out onto wire rack. Cool.

recipes.title: Tropical Ambrosia
directions: Drain pineapple and oranges, reserving liquid.
Add enough water to liquid to make 2 cups.
Bring liquid to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Add gelatin; stir until dissolved.
Remove from heat. Add sherbet, oranges and half the pineapple, stirring until sherbet is melted.
Pour into a 6-cup ring mold and chill until firm. Unmold onto serving platter.
Combine sour cream, coconut, marshmallows and remaining pineapple.
Spoon mixture into center of gelatin ring.
Enjoy!
Yields 10 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Tropical Ambrosia. Drain pineapple and oranges, reserving liquid. Add enough water to liquid to make 2 cups. Bring liquid to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add gelatin; stir until dissolved. Remove from heat. Add sherbet, oranges and half the pineapple, stirring until sherbet is melted. Pour into a 6-cup ring mold and chill until firm. Unmold onto serving platter. Combine sour cream, coconut, marshmallows and remaining pineapple. Spoon mixture into center of gelatin ring. Enjoy! Yields 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In a large bowl, combine the rice, sugar, milk, raisins, nutmeg, eggs and salt.
Mix well and pour into a buttered casserole.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until the top is browned.
Serve warm.
Yield: 8 servings.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In a large bowl, combine the rice, sugar, milk, raisins, nutmeg, eggs and salt. Mix well and pour into a buttered casserole. Bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until the top is browned. Serve warm. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Crab Mold
directions: Put cream cheese, tomato soup and unflavored gelatin in large saucepan; turn on low.
Let simmer and boil.
Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.
Mix; pour into oiled plastic molds and chill.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp And Crab Mold. Put cream cheese, tomato soup and unflavored gelatin in large saucepan; turn on low. Let simmer and boil. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Mix; pour into oiled plastic molds and chill. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Warm up caramel sauce.
Cream the cream cheese, brown sugar, Cool Whip and warmed caramel sauce.
Refrigerate in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Dip. Warm up caramel sauce. Cream the cream cheese, brown sugar, Cool Whip and warmed caramel sauce. Refrigerate in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Grapefruit Wine Jelly
ingredients: 1 c. Claret or ruby red Port wine
directions: You will need paraffin and 5 half pint glasses or jars.
recipes.text: Grapefruit Wine Jelly. You will need paraffin and 5 half pint glasses or jars.

recipes.title: Glazed Baked Ham
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can pineapple slices (juice pack), drained (reserve juice)
directions: Place ham on roasting rack in 10-inch square casserole.
Cover loosely with plastic wrap.
Microwave at Medium-high (70%) for 15 minutes; set aside.
Mix 3 tablespoons of reserved pineapple juice, brown sugar and mustard in small bowl; microwave at Medium-high (70%) until hot, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after half of the cooking time.
Place 4 cloves in each pineapple slice; arrange on top of ham.
Pour half of the glaze over ham.
Cover. Microwave at Medium-high (70%) until internal temperature reaches 130u00b0, 20 to 30 minutes, brushing with glaze 2 or 3 times.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Glazed Baked Ham. Place ham on roasting rack in 10-inch square casserole. Cover loosely with plastic wrap. Microwave at Medium-high (70%) for 15 minutes; set aside. Mix 3 tablespoons of reserved pineapple juice, brown sugar and mustard in small bowl; microwave at Medium-high (70%) until hot, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after half of the cooking time. Place 4 cloves in each pineapple slice; arrange on top of ham. Pour half of the glaze over ham. Cover. Microwave at Medium-high (70%) until internal temperature reaches 130u00b0, 20 to 30 minutes, brushing with glaze 2 or 3 times. Cover with aluminum foil. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Combine vanilla pudding with milk, and sour cream. Fold in half of cool whip. In a baking dish, layer vanilla wafers, bananas & pudding mixture. Put remaining half of cool whip on top.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Combine vanilla pudding with milk, and sour cream. Fold in half of cool whip. In a baking dish, layer vanilla wafers, bananas & pudding mixture. Put remaining half of cool whip on top.

recipes.title: Bay City Chicken And Rice Chowder
directions: Prepare chicken.
Remove skin and bone.
Lightly brown chicken in butter.
Remove chicken from pan; set aside.
Saute onions, carrots, celery, pepper, mushrooms and garlic.
Add chicken, rosemary, salt and chicken stock.
Simmer covered 1 hour.
Uncover and boil until liquid is not covering chicken (but not gone). Remove chicken and soup.
Whisk until smooth.
Add cooked rice and cut up chicken.
Heat until bubbling.
Stir in half and half. Salt and pepper to taste.
Serves 8 to 12.
recipes.text: Bay City Chicken And Rice Chowder. Prepare chicken. Remove skin and bone. Lightly brown chicken in butter. Remove chicken from pan; set aside. Saute onions, carrots, celery, pepper, mushrooms and garlic. Add chicken, rosemary, salt and chicken stock. Simmer covered 1 hour. Uncover and boil until liquid is not covering chicken (but not gone). Remove chicken and soup. Whisk until smooth. Add cooked rice and cut up chicken. Heat until bubbling. Stir in half and half. Salt and pepper to taste. Serves 8 to 12.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix cocoa, flour and sugar.
Add egg yolks, milk and butter. Cook until thick.
Put in baked pie shell.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Mix cocoa, flour and sugar. Add egg yolks, milk and butter. Cook until thick. Put in baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Holiday-After Chicken Pot
ingredients: 2 c. diced leftover chicken or turkey
1 small (8 oz.) can sweet peas, drained
1 small (8 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: After draining sweet peas, whole kernel corn and mushrooms, combine them with poultry, green onions and Swiss cheese.
Spread evenly in a 10-inch lightly greased pie pan.
Sprinkle salt evenly over mixture. Beat buttermilk mix, eggs and milk together in mixing bowl until smooth.
Pour over ingredients in pie pan.
Bake in preheated 400u00b0 oven until golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 6 people.
recipes.text: Holiday-After Chicken Pot. After draining sweet peas, whole kernel corn and mushrooms, combine them with poultry, green onions and Swiss cheese. Spread evenly in a 10-inch lightly greased pie pan. Sprinkle salt evenly over mixture. Beat buttermilk mix, eggs and milk together in mixing bowl until smooth. Pour over ingredients in pie pan. Bake in preheated 400u00b0 oven until golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6 people.

recipes.title: Wild Rice With Sausage
directions: Cook rice, water, bouillon according to directions on box. Saute sausage, celery, onion and mushrooms.
Drain grease.tAdd butter and seasoning.
Fold in wild rice and serve.
recipes.text: Wild Rice With Sausage. Cook rice, water, bouillon according to directions on box. Saute sausage, celery, onion and mushrooms. Drain grease.tAdd butter and seasoning. Fold in wild rice and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Strawberry Daiquiris
ingredients: 1/3 c. frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed
directions: Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender. Process until mixture is smooth.
Yield:
1 quart.
recipes.text: Creamy Strawberry Daiquiris. Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender. Process until mixture is smooth. Yield: 1 quart.

recipes.title: Coconut Dreams
directions: Blend salt with flour.
Cream together all ingredients, except honey and cherries or nuts.
Form into 2 rolls and refrigerate. Slice 1/4 inch thick on ungreased cookie sheet.
Brush top with honey and decorate with cherries or nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 minutes, until slightly browned.
recipes.text: Coconut Dreams. Blend salt with flour. Cream together all ingredients, except honey and cherries or nuts. Form into 2 rolls and refrigerate. Slice 1/4 inch thick on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush top with honey and decorate with cherries or nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 minutes, until slightly browned.

recipes.title: Blackberry Syrup
directions: Bring to boil, boil 6 to 8 minutes.
Seal.
recipes.text: Blackberry Syrup. Bring to boil, boil 6 to 8 minutes. Seal.

recipes.title: Easy Quiche
ingredients: 1 lb. sausage, scrambled and drained or 12 slices bacon, fried and crumbled
2 c. evaporated milk (1 can plus enough water to make 2 c.)
directions: Mix last 7 ingredients and pour into 2 deep dish pie crusts. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes, uncovered.
Reduce heat to 300u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Easy Quiche. Mix last 7 ingredients and pour into 2 deep dish pie crusts. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes, uncovered. Reduce heat to 300u00b0 and bake for 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pan Sauteed Spicy Shrimp
directions: Toss shrimp in the next 5 ingredients and coat with a little olive oil until moist.
Let marinate for a couple of hours or overnight.
When you are ready to cook the shrimp, add the salt, lemon juice and chopped scallions.
In a very hot skillet coated with oil, quickly saute the shrimp until firm.
Serve hot on a bed of greens as an appetizer, or deglaze the pan with some dry white wine and some butter to make a sauce and serve on pasta or rice.
recipes.text: Pan Sauteed Spicy Shrimp. Toss shrimp in the next 5 ingredients and coat with a little olive oil until moist. Let marinate for a couple of hours or overnight. When you are ready to cook the shrimp, add the salt, lemon juice and chopped scallions. In a very hot skillet coated with oil, quickly saute the shrimp until firm. Serve hot on a bed of greens as an appetizer, or deglaze the pan with some dry white wine and some butter to make a sauce and serve on pasta or rice.

recipes.title: Chuck Wagon Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. lean stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes
directions: Combine sugar and flour. Coat beef with mixture and brown in hot shortening.
Add seasonings, tomatoes and broth.
Cover and simmer over low heat about 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is almost tender (add up to 3/4 cup water as necessary).
Stir in vegetables except peas; cover and cook about 30 minutes.
Add peas. Cover and cook about 15 minutes more. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Chuck Wagon Stew. Combine sugar and flour. Coat beef with mixture and brown in hot shortening. Add seasonings, tomatoes and broth. Cover and simmer over low heat about 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is almost tender (add up to 3/4 cup water as necessary). Stir in vegetables except peas; cover and cook about 30 minutes. Add peas. Cover and cook about 15 minutes more. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix well and bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes and at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix well and bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes and at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: No-Fuss Baked Beans
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and pour into baking dish. Top with bacon slices.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: No-Fuss Baked Beans. Mix first 4 ingredients together and pour into baking dish. Top with bacon slices. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Ice Box Cookies
directions: Cream butter; add sugar, well beaten eggs, and vanilla; mix. Slowly add dry ingredients and nuts. Roll in 4 one inch rolls on wax paper. Chill 4 hours or place in freezer for more rapid chilling. Remove and slice into 1/8 inch slices. Bake on greased pan at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Ice Box Cookies. Cream butter; add sugar, well beaten eggs, and vanilla; mix. Slowly add dry ingredients and nuts. Roll in 4 one inch rolls on wax paper. Chill 4 hours or place in freezer for more rapid chilling. Remove and slice into 1/8 inch slices. Bake on greased pan at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Carrots
directions: Combine carrots and water in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and vent.
Microwave on High 5 to 10 minutes or until carrots are done, stirring once.

Combine onion, butter and nutmeg in a small bowl; microwave on High 30 seconds to 1 minute or until onion is tender and transparent. Add next 4 ingredients and stir well; microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes. Add onion mixture to carrots, tossing gently to coat.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Golden Carrots. Combine carrots and water in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap and vent. Microwave on High 5 to 10 minutes or until carrots are done, stirring once. Combine onion, butter and nutmeg in a small bowl; microwave on High 30 seconds to 1 minute or until onion is tender and transparent. Add next 4 ingredients and stir well; microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes. Add onion mixture to carrots, tossing gently to coat. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Beat together eggs, sour cream, water and oil.
Add chocolate cake mix and instant pudding.
Beat until smooth.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Pour into buttered Bundt pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
When completely cool, sift powdered sugar on top.
recipes.text: Death By Chocolate. Beat together eggs, sour cream, water and oil. Add chocolate cake mix and instant pudding. Beat until smooth. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into buttered Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0. When completely cool, sift powdered sugar on top.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine ingredients and pour into greased casserole dish. Cover with grated cheese and bake in 350u00b0 oven about 20 minutes. Serves 4 or 5.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Casserole. Combine ingredients and pour into greased casserole dish. Cover with grated cheese and bake in 350u00b0 oven about 20 minutes. Serves 4 or 5.

recipes.title: C. P. R.(Chili Pancake Rellenos)
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can Ortega whole green chilies
1 c. mixed pancake batter (follow recipe on pancake batter box, using egg and milk; do not use eggs listed before)
directions: Stuff chilies with cheese and place in a greased pan or Dutch oven.
Beat
eggs
until
fluffy
and
mix with pancake batter. Pour
over
chilies.
Top with grated cheese and bake at
350u00b0 for
about
30 minutes or until done.
Serve and top with salsa.
recipes.text: C. P. R.(Chili Pancake Rellenos). Stuff chilies with cheese and place in a greased pan or Dutch oven. Beat eggs until fluffy and mix with pancake batter. Pour over chilies. Top with grated cheese and bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until done. Serve and top with salsa.

recipes.title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Melt cranberries in double boiler over water.
Cool.
Add pineapple, sour cream and as many nuts as you like.
Freeze.
Cut in squares just before serving.
recipes.text: Frozen Cranberry Salad. Melt cranberries in double boiler over water. Cool. Add pineapple, sour cream and as many nuts as you like. Freeze. Cut in squares just before serving.

recipes.title: Sunflower Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 oz. bow tie or twist pasta
1 Tbsp. sunflower, olive or safflower oil
fresh ground black or white pepper to taste
1 c. cherry tomatoes or tomato wedges
2 Tbsp. dry roasted, unsalted sunflower seeds
1 Tbsp. fresh or 1 tsp. dried herb combination (your favorite)
directions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions, without the salt.
Meanwhile, combine the lemon juice, oil, garlic, salt and pepper in a jar.
Cover and shake.
Combine all other ingredients, including the cooked, drained pasta in a large bowl. Add the dressing and toss.
Refrigerate, covered for at least 1 hour before serving.
Yield:
2 servings (as a main course).
recipes.text: Sunflower Pasta Salad. Cook the pasta according to the package directions, without the salt. Meanwhile, combine the lemon juice, oil, garlic, salt and pepper in a jar. Cover and shake. Combine all other ingredients, including the cooked, drained pasta in a large bowl. Add the dressing and toss. Refrigerate, covered for at least 1 hour before serving. Yield: 2 servings (as a main course).

recipes.title: Red Cinnamon Popcorn
directions: Melt butter in medium saucepan.
Stir in sugar, syrup and candies.
Bring to boil; continue boiling, stirring constantly, until candy is dissolved completely.
Boil without stirring for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in soda.
Gradually pour over popcorn, mixing well.
Allow to cool completely.
Break apart; store in tightly covered container.
Makes 4 quarts.
recipes.text: Red Cinnamon Popcorn. Melt butter in medium saucepan. Stir in sugar, syrup and candies. Bring to boil; continue boiling, stirring constantly, until candy is dissolved completely. Boil without stirring for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in soda. Gradually pour over popcorn, mixing well. Allow to cool completely. Break apart; store in tightly covered container. Makes 4 quarts.

recipes.title: Summer Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Chill for at least 3 hours before serving with fresh vegetables or chips.
recipes.text: Summer Vegetable Dip. Mix all ingredients well. Chill for at least 3 hours before serving with fresh vegetables or chips.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Stir in milk.
Blend in vanilla and salt.
Shape into rolls 10-inches long.
Wrap in plastic and refrigerate until firm.
Cut roll into 1-inch slices and then quarter each slice.
Flatten each piece in palm of hand.
Place cherry in center and fold mixture around cherry.
Chill until firm.
Melt almond bark in microwave and dip cherry into almond bark.
Place on waxed paper to harden.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Cherries. Cream sugar and margarine. Stir in milk. Blend in vanilla and salt. Shape into rolls 10-inches long. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate until firm. Cut roll into 1-inch slices and then quarter each slice. Flatten each piece in palm of hand. Place cherry in center and fold mixture around cherry. Chill until firm. Melt almond bark in microwave and dip cherry into almond bark. Place on waxed paper to harden.

recipes.title: Flour Tortillas
directions: Mix flour and shortening by hand.
Then add water.
Knead dough.
Then pinch off size of biscuit and roll.
Place on hot griddle that has been greased with shortening.
recipes.text: Flour Tortillas. Mix flour and shortening by hand. Then add water. Knead dough. Then pinch off size of biscuit and roll. Place on hot griddle that has been greased with shortening.

recipes.title: Buns
directions: Mix all ingredients. Let rise till double in size, work it down, let rise again. Form balls and let double in size again. Bake 350u00b0 for 25-30 minutes.
recipes.text: Buns. Mix all ingredients. Let rise till double in size, work it down, let rise again. Form balls and let double in size again. Bake 350u00b0 for 25-30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: In large casserole dish, spread even 1/2 Pepperidge Farm mix. Melt oleo in water.
Pour over this, then mix chicken, onion, celery, mayonnaise, salt, pepper and spread over mix evenly.
Beat eggs well in milk.
Pour over chicken mixture.
Cover casserole with foil and refrigerate overnight.
Before cooking, remove casserole and let sit until room temperature.
Pour 1 can mushroom soup over top spreading even, then top with balance of Pepperidge Farm.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. In large casserole dish, spread even 1/2 Pepperidge Farm mix. Melt oleo in water. Pour over this, then mix chicken, onion, celery, mayonnaise, salt, pepper and spread over mix evenly. Beat eggs well in milk. Pour over chicken mixture. Cover casserole with foil and refrigerate overnight. Before cooking, remove casserole and let sit until room temperature. Pour 1 can mushroom soup over top spreading even, then top with balance of Pepperidge Farm. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Mom'S Banana Bread
directions: Mix all dry ingredients in large bowl.
Mash bananas on large plate with fork; put in bowl.
Add shortening, eggs, vanilla and nuts; mix well.
Add dry ingredients and mix well.
Grease and flour loaf pan.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Mom'S Banana Bread. Mix all dry ingredients in large bowl. Mash bananas on large plate with fork; put in bowl. Add shortening, eggs, vanilla and nuts; mix well. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Grease and flour loaf pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. dried dill weed or fresh
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.
Serve with raw vegetables.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Dill Dip. Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve with raw vegetables. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Egg-Cheese Dish(Breakfast - Brunch)
ingredients: 8 slices bread, crusts removed and cut into cubes
1/4 lb. bacon, partially cooked, drained, chopped (reserve)
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan generously.
Spread the bread cubes over bottom of pan.
Sprinkle cheese cubes over bread.
In bowl beat eggs.
Add milk and seasonings.
Mix well.
Pour over cheese-bread in pan carefully.
Cover with plastic or foil and place in fridge overnight.
Next morning sprinkle bacon bits over mixture and bake 1 hour at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Egg-Cheese Dish(Breakfast - Brunch). Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan generously. Spread the bread cubes over bottom of pan. Sprinkle cheese cubes over bread. In bowl beat eggs. Add milk and seasonings. Mix well. Pour over cheese-bread in pan carefully. Cover with plastic or foil and place in fridge overnight. Next morning sprinkle bacon bits over mixture and bake 1 hour at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Special Rum Cake
directions: Before you start, check the rum to make sure the quality is good.
Select a large measuring bowl, measuring cup, etc. and check the rum again.
With an electric mixer, beat 1 cup butter in the fuffy bowl.
Add 1 teaspoon sugar and beat.
Meanwhile check the rum again.
Add 3 large eggs, 2 cups fried druit and beat unitl very high.
If druit sticks in beaters, pry out with a screwdriver. Taste the rum again.
Add 3 cups baking powder, one pint of rum, one seaspoon of tada and one cup of pepper.
Stir in 1/2 pint lemon juice and fold in the chopped buttermilk and strained nuts.
Add one bablespoon of scrown sugar or whatever color you have.
Check the rum again.
Turn pan to 350 degrees, grease oven and pour the whole mess in.
Sample rum while waiting.
recipes.text: Special Rum Cake. Before you start, check the rum to make sure the quality is good. Select a large measuring bowl, measuring cup, etc. and check the rum again. With an electric mixer, beat 1 cup butter in the fuffy bowl. Add 1 teaspoon sugar and beat. Meanwhile check the rum again. Add 3 large eggs, 2 cups fried druit and beat unitl very high. If druit sticks in beaters, pry out with a screwdriver. Taste the rum again. Add 3 cups baking powder, one pint of rum, one seaspoon of tada and one cup of pepper. Stir in 1/2 pint lemon juice and fold in the chopped buttermilk and strained nuts. Add one bablespoon of scrown sugar or whatever color you have. Check the rum again. Turn pan to 350 degrees, grease oven and pour the whole mess in. Sample rum while waiting.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add the rest of the ingredients.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Cake. Cream margarine and sugar. Add the rest of the ingredients.

recipes.title: Susan'S Vegetable Toss
directions: Stir-fry zucchini and garlic in oil for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Reduce to low heat.
Add parsley, margarine and half and half.
Cook until butter melts.
Add cheeses, linguine and oregano.
Serve.
recipes.text: Susan'S Vegetable Toss. Stir-fry zucchini and garlic in oil for 3 to 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Reduce to low heat. Add parsley, margarine and half and half. Cook until butter melts. Add cheeses, linguine and oregano. Serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Melt butter.
Stir in peanut butter, graham crackers and powdered sugar.
Pat in cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bars. Melt butter. Stir in peanut butter, graham crackers and powdered sugar. Pat in cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Light Fruit Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add 2 1/2 cups flour (save 1/2 cup to flour fruit), vanilla flavoring, milk, raisins, 1 pound pineapple, cherries, mixed fruit, coconut and pecans.
Add crushed pineapple last.
Bake at 250u00b0 for approximately 3 to 3 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Light Fruit Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add 2 1/2 cups flour (save 1/2 cup to flour fruit), vanilla flavoring, milk, raisins, 1 pound pineapple, cherries, mixed fruit, coconut and pecans. Add crushed pineapple last. Bake at 250u00b0 for approximately 3 to 3 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Ranch Pretzels
