directions: Heat oven to 250u00b0.
Break pretzels into pieces.
Place in oven on cookie sheet for 20 minutes.
While pretzels are baking, mix dressing, oil and dill weed.
Remove pretzels and place into plastic bowl with lid; pour (well mixed) oil over pretzels, mix and shake.
Place pretzels back on cookie sheet and bake 20 more minutes.
Keep stored in plastic bowl.
recipes.text: Ranch Pretzels. Heat oven to 250u00b0. Break pretzels into pieces. Place in oven on cookie sheet for 20 minutes. While pretzels are baking, mix dressing, oil and dill weed. Remove pretzels and place into plastic bowl with lid; pour (well mixed) oil over pretzels, mix and shake. Place pretzels back on cookie sheet and bake 20 more minutes. Keep stored in plastic bowl.

recipes.title: Pork Chop And Potato Scallop
directions: Brown pork chops in skillet.
Season with salt and pepper. Blend soup, sour cream, water and parsley.
recipes.text: Pork Chop And Potato Scallop. Brown pork chops in skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Blend soup, sour cream, water and parsley.

recipes.title: Baked Broccoli Casserole
directions: Layer broccoli, soup, mushrooms and onion rings twice.
Top with cheese and bread cubes.
Bake for 30 minutes at 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Baked Broccoli Casserole. Layer broccoli, soup, mushrooms and onion rings twice. Top with cheese and bread cubes. Bake for 30 minutes at 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Hamburger Chili Dip
directions: Mix into crock-pot, set on low.
Cook about 1 hour until hot. Serve with chips.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Hamburger Chili Dip. Mix into crock-pot, set on low. Cook about 1 hour until hot. Serve with chips. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box.
Fill each greased cupcake cup 2/3 full.
Cream together the cheese, salt, sugar and egg until light and fluffy.
Stir in chocolate bits.
Drop a tablespoon of this mixture on top of each cupcake.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cream mixture will be in the center of each cake.
These may be frosted with chocolate icing, if desired.
recipes.text: Self-Filled Cupcakes. Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Fill each greased cupcake cup 2/3 full. Cream together the cheese, salt, sugar and egg until light and fluffy. Stir in chocolate bits. Drop a tablespoon of this mixture on top of each cupcake. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Cream mixture will be in the center of each cake. These may be frosted with chocolate icing, if desired.

recipes.title: Brownies From Heaven
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time,
beating well after each addition.
Beat in vanilla. Combine flour and cocoa; add to creamed mixture just until combined.
Stir in walnuts.
Spread into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 23-28 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
Cool on a wire rack.
recipes.text: Brownies From Heaven. In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Beat in vanilla. Combine flour and cocoa; add to creamed mixture just until combined. Stir in walnuts. Spread into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 23-28 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Deviled Ham Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Serve with snack crackers.
Makes 1 2/3 cups.
recipes.text: Deviled Ham Dip. Combine all ingredients. Serve with snack crackers. Makes 1 2/3 cups.

recipes.title: My Favorite Apple Pie
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. tart apples, peeled and sliced (8 c.)
directions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Add apples, mix well. Line a 10 or 12-inch baking dish with pastry, add apple mixture. Pour apple juice around edge (not on apples).
Cover with top pastry, sealing edges.
Cut slits in top.
Brush with margarine, sprinkle with white sugar.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 40 minutes or until juice bubbles through slits.
This is a deep-dish pie.
Pan must be at least two inches deep.
recipes.text: My Favorite Apple Pie. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add apples, mix well. Line a 10 or 12-inch baking dish with pastry, add apple mixture. Pour apple juice around edge (not on apples). Cover with top pastry, sealing edges. Cut slits in top. Brush with margarine, sprinkle with white sugar. Bake at 425u00b0 for 40 minutes or until juice bubbles through slits. This is a deep-dish pie. Pan must be at least two inches deep.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Nut Bread
directions: Cream butter, shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Blend in sweet potatoes.
Sift together dry ingredients; add nuts.
Stir into creamed mixture alternately with cold coffee.
Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans and 8 greased muffin pan cups.
Bake in moderate oven (375u00b0) for 1 hour for loaves and 25 minutes for muffins, or until they test done in center.
Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely.
Makes 2 loaves, plus 8 muffins.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Nut Bread. Cream butter, shortening and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Blend in sweet potatoes. Sift together dry ingredients; add nuts. Stir into creamed mixture alternately with cold coffee. Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans and 8 greased muffin pan cups. Bake in moderate oven (375u00b0) for 1 hour for loaves and 25 minutes for muffins, or until they test done in center. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely. Makes 2 loaves, plus 8 muffins.

recipes.title: Grandmother Skupin'S Molasses Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add molasses and eggs.
Beat well.
Sift all dry ingredients together (flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and ginger).
Add dry ingredients to mixture and mix well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls about 1-inch apart on greased cookie sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350u00b0.
Makes about 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Grandmother Skupin'S Molasses Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar. Add molasses and eggs. Beat well. Sift all dry ingredients together (flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and ginger). Add dry ingredients to mixture and mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls about 1-inch apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350u00b0. Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies I
directions: Beat Crisco and sugars in a large mixing bowl.
Add eggs and vanilla, mixing well.
Add flour, salt and soda.
Mix well.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies I. Beat Crisco and sugars in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and vanilla, mixing well. Add flour, salt and soda. Mix well. Fold in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pudding
ingredients: 1 large carton Cool Whip (reserve half for top)
directions: Heat strawberries, sugar and jello and cool.
Mix milk, vanilla pudding, sour cream and Cool Whip (reserve half for top). Line your bowl with vanilla wafers, then alternate strawberry mixture and wafers.
Then top with jello mixture while still runny.
Chill.
Top with remaining Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pudding. Heat strawberries, sugar and jello and cool. Mix milk, vanilla pudding, sour cream and Cool Whip (reserve half for top). Line your bowl with vanilla wafers, then alternate strawberry mixture and wafers. Then top with jello mixture while still runny. Chill. Top with remaining Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Meat And Rice
directions: Cook meat and onion until almost done.
Add soups, rice and salt to taste.
Put in baking dish and cook 20 minutes, uncovered. Put lid on and cook 20 minutes longer in a 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Meat And Rice. Cook meat and onion until almost done. Add soups, rice and salt to taste. Put in baking dish and cook 20 minutes, uncovered. Put lid on and cook 20 minutes longer in a 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Bev'S Super Squash
directions: Wash zucchini and cut in 1-inch slices.
Put in a large pot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and let boil for 5 minutes only.
Drain squash very well.
Cut scallions into very small pieces (use the green and white part).
Put the squash into a long baking dish, sprinkle scallions on top of squash.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Slice cheese and place on top.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven until cheese is melted, about 15 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Bev'S Super Squash. Wash zucchini and cut in 1-inch slices. Put in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and let boil for 5 minutes only. Drain squash very well. Cut scallions into very small pieces (use the green and white part). Put the squash into a long baking dish, sprinkle scallions on top of squash. Salt and pepper to taste. Slice cheese and place on top. Bake in 350u00b0 oven until cheese is melted, about 15 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Applesauce Doughnuts
directions: Blend butter and sugar. Add eggs.
Mix applesauce and soda and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Roll out and cut.
Fry in deep fat (350u00b0 to 375u00b0).
Drain.
May coat with granulated sugar or powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Applesauce Doughnuts. Blend butter and sugar. Add eggs. Mix applesauce and soda and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Roll out and cut. Fry in deep fat (350u00b0 to 375u00b0). Drain. May coat with granulated sugar or powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Zucchini Drop Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and butter together.
Add eggs and zucchini.
Add flour, soda, baking powder and cinnamon, sifted together.
Add zucchini mixture, blending well.
Add nuts and raisins.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Drop Cookies. Cream sugar and butter together. Add eggs and zucchini. Add flour, soda, baking powder and cinnamon, sifted together. Add zucchini mixture, blending well. Add nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Uncooked Relish
directions: Put each vegetable through food chopper, using coarse blade. If vegetables are covered with liquid, drain off and discard liquid.
Measure each vegetable after chopping.
recipes.text: Uncooked Relish. Put each vegetable through food chopper, using coarse blade. If vegetables are covered with liquid, drain off and discard liquid. Measure each vegetable after chopping.

recipes.title: Chess Squares
directions: Mix cake mix with 1 egg and butter.
Spread into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Combine remaining eggs, sugar and cream cheese together, mixing well.
Pour over cake mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 55 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Chess Squares. Mix cake mix with 1 egg and butter. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Combine remaining eggs, sugar and cream cheese together, mixing well. Pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Mushroom Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Combine soup, 1/2 cup cheese, pepper, salt, mushrooms and onion in a bowl.
Gradually add milk.
Stir in potatoes.
Place in a greased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and butter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Mushroom Scalloped Potatoes. Combine soup, 1/2 cup cheese, pepper, salt, mushrooms and onion in a bowl. Gradually add milk. Stir in potatoes. Place in a greased shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Artichoke And Basil Hero
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and sliced
directions: In a blender or food processor, combine basil, oil, Parmesan cheese, capers, vinegar, mustard and garlic.
Cover; blend until nearly smooth.
Set aside.
Cut bread in half lengthwise.
Hollow out each half, leaving a 1-inch shell.
Spread basil mixture over each half of bread.
On bottom half, layer artichoke hearts, Provolone cheese, tomato and spinach.
Cover with top bread.
Cut sandwich crosswise into 6 to 8 pieces.
recipes.text: Artichoke And Basil Hero. In a blender or food processor, combine basil, oil, Parmesan cheese, capers, vinegar, mustard and garlic. Cover; blend until nearly smooth. Set aside. Cut bread in half lengthwise. Hollow out each half, leaving a 1-inch shell. Spread basil mixture over each half of bread. On bottom half, layer artichoke hearts, Provolone cheese, tomato and spinach. Cover with top bread. Cut sandwich crosswise into 6 to 8 pieces.

recipes.title: Citrus Punch(Serves 40)
directions: Mix pineapple juice, lemonade, orange juice and sugar ahead of time and chill.
Right before serving, add chilled ginger ale.
recipes.text: Citrus Punch(Serves 40). Mix pineapple juice, lemonade, orange juice and sugar ahead of time and chill. Right before serving, add chilled ginger ale.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled and cut in 1-inch pieces
red and black pepper to taste
directions: Brown meat in olive oil and add finely chopped onions, celery, garlic and green peppers.
Cook until onions are soft.
Add eggplant, tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Add seasonings.
Cover and simmer until eggplant is tender.
Add bread crumbs to thicken and pour into a shallow baking pan.
Top with Swiss cheese slices and bake in a 350u00b0 oven until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Brown meat in olive oil and add finely chopped onions, celery, garlic and green peppers. Cook until onions are soft. Add eggplant, tomatoes and tomato sauce. Add seasonings. Cover and simmer until eggplant is tender. Add bread crumbs to thicken and pour into a shallow baking pan. Top with Swiss cheese slices and bake in a 350u00b0 oven until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. almond flavoring (put it in the cream)
directions: Cream margarine, shortening
and
sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time and beat.
Alternate
adding flour and cream (divide into thirds).
Cook at 300u00b0
at
least 2 hours or until brown. Start in a cold oven!
"Makes a crusty, delicious cake."
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream margarine, shortening and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time and beat. Alternate adding flour and cream (divide into thirds). Cook at 300u00b0 at least 2 hours or until brown. Start in a cold oven! "Makes a crusty, delicious cake."

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown meats, garlic and salt, add next 5 ingred. Then add 1 tsp each of chili powder, thyme, tarragon, basil, marjorum, oregano, celery salt, 1-2 bay leaves, sugar to taste, seasoning salt romano or parmesan. Simmer for 2-3 hrs.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Brown meats, garlic and salt, add next 5 ingred. Then add 1 tsp each of chili powder, thyme, tarragon, basil, marjorum, oregano, celery salt, 1-2 bay leaves, sugar to taste, seasoning salt romano or parmesan. Simmer for 2-3 hrs.

recipes.title: Chicken And Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 cut up chicken (or 4 or 5 chicken breasts)
directions: Season chicken to taste.
Place in ovensafe pan.
Mix soup, milk and mushrooms.
Pour over chicken.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken And Mushroom Sauce. Season chicken to taste. Place in ovensafe pan. Mix soup, milk and mushrooms. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Choco Peanut Butter Dreams
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Beat together sugar, peanut butter and margarine until light and fluffy. Blend in water, egg and vanilla. Add combined dry ingredients.
Mix well. Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness with bottom of glass dipped in sugar.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are golden brown.
Remove to wire rack and cool completely.
recipes.text: Choco Peanut Butter Dreams. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Beat together sugar, peanut butter and margarine until light and fluffy. Blend in water, egg and vanilla. Add combined dry ingredients. Mix well. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten to 1/4-inch thickness with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Remove to wire rack and cool completely.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: In large mixing bowl, mix sugar and butter together.
Add flour and eggs alternately, beginning and ending with flour (example: flour, 2 eggs, flour, 2 eggs, flour and etc.).
recipes.text: Pound Cake. In large mixing bowl, mix sugar and butter together. Add flour and eggs alternately, beginning and ending with flour (example: flour, 2 eggs, flour, 2 eggs, flour and etc.).

recipes.title: Homemade Pimento And Cheese Spread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and use on bread, crackers or as a dip for raw vegetables.
recipes.text: Homemade Pimento And Cheese Spread. Mix all ingredients together and use on bread, crackers or as a dip for raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 6 to 8 chicken breasts, cooked and pulled
directions: Place chicken in pan.
Mix soup and sour cream and then mix in with chicken.
Crumble crackers over this and pour butter on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Place chicken in pan. Mix soup and sour cream and then mix in with chicken. Crumble crackers over this and pour butter on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Deer Steak
directions: Trim deer steak of all fat, etc.
Soak in combination of milk and Worcestershire sauce for 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Fried Deer Steak. Trim deer steak of all fat, etc. Soak in combination of milk and Worcestershire sauce for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Kahlua Kreme Torte
directions: Bake cake according to directions, adding 1 tablespoon Kahlua to batter.
Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans and cool.
Split layers into 4.
Melt chocolate bits over water.
In large bowl, combine cream, milk and 2 tablespoons Kahlua.
Slowly add instant pudding until thickened.
Lay cake, cut side up.
Spread 1/2 raspberry preserves.
Cover 1/4 pudding.
Next, add 2nd layer of cake and 1/2 chocolate.
Next, 1/4 pudding mix.
Repeat layers, ending with chocolate layer on top.
Decorate with fresh raspberries and chocolate curls.
recipes.text: Kahlua Kreme Torte. Bake cake according to directions, adding 1 tablespoon Kahlua to batter. Bake in 2 (9-inch) pans and cool. Split layers into 4. Melt chocolate bits over water. In large bowl, combine cream, milk and 2 tablespoons Kahlua. Slowly add instant pudding until thickened. Lay cake, cut side up. Spread 1/2 raspberry preserves. Cover 1/4 pudding. Next, add 2nd layer of cake and 1/2 chocolate. Next, 1/4 pudding mix. Repeat layers, ending with chocolate layer on top. Decorate with fresh raspberries and chocolate curls.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Grate cheese and mix with the oleo.
Add flour, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
I mix with hands as this is a stiff mixture. Form in 1-inch balls.
Bake about 10 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven. Cool.
Store in airtight container.
Keeps well.
recipes.text: Cheese Biscuits. Grate cheese and mix with the oleo. Add flour, salt and pepper. Mix well. I mix with hands as this is a stiff mixture. Form in 1-inch balls. Bake about 10 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven. Cool. Store in airtight container. Keeps well.

recipes.title: California Dip
ingredients: 2 lb. box Velveeta cheese, cut in cubes
directions: In saucepan, saute the onion and garlic in the butter. Add the tomatoes and simmer for at least 1 hour. Add the chiles and simmer for another hour. Add the cheese. Blend while still on low fire. Serve Hot!
recipes.text: California Dip. In saucepan, saute the onion and garlic in the butter. Add the tomatoes and simmer for at least 1 hour. Add the chiles and simmer for another hour. Add the cheese. Blend while still on low fire. Serve Hot!

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients. Add buttermilk, oil and eggs. Bake in well-greased pans in moderate oven (350u00b0 to 375u00b0). Makes 2 pans.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Mix dry ingredients. Add buttermilk, oil and eggs. Bake in well-greased pans in moderate oven (350u00b0 to 375u00b0). Makes 2 pans.

recipes.title: French Dip Sandwiches
directions: Remove all fat from roast and put roast in slow cooker. Combine all remaining ingredients except bread and pour over roast. Add water to almost cover roast.
Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or until tender.
Remove meat from broth; reserve broth. Shred meat with a fork.
Cut rolls in halves, spread with butter and grill until brown.
Place meat on rolls; dip in reserved broth while eating.
recipes.text: French Dip Sandwiches. Remove all fat from roast and put roast in slow cooker. Combine all remaining ingredients except bread and pour over roast. Add water to almost cover roast. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or until tender. Remove meat from broth; reserve broth. Shred meat with a fork. Cut rolls in halves, spread with butter and grill until brown. Place meat on rolls; dip in reserved broth while eating.

recipes.title: Western Hash
directions: Brown beef and onions.
Add rest of the ingredients.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Western Hash. Brown beef and onions. Add rest of the ingredients. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix, prepared according to directions
directions: Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bring to a boil the sugar, milk and coconut.
Punch holes in hot cake with handle of wooden spoon or fork.
Pour hot mixture over hot cake.
Cool.
Top with whipped topping.
Sprinkle with coconut.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bring to a boil the sugar, milk and coconut. Punch holes in hot cake with handle of wooden spoon or fork. Pour hot mixture over hot cake. Cool. Top with whipped topping. Sprinkle with coconut.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly in bottom.
Arrange pineapple halves on top of sugar.
Drain cherries and slice in half.
Put cherry slices on top of each pineapple slice.
Mix cake according to directions.
Pour over fruit fruit and spread evenly.
Bake for 45 to 48 minutes.
Loosen cake from pan and turn onto platter.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly in bottom. Arrange pineapple halves on top of sugar. Drain cherries and slice in half. Put cherry slices on top of each pineapple slice. Mix cake according to directions. Pour over fruit fruit and spread evenly. Bake for 45 to 48 minutes. Loosen cake from pan and turn onto platter.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Strata
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded 100% natural Kraft mild Cheddar cheese
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and well drained
1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia Brand cream cheese
directions: Place 6 slices bread on bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with 1 cup Cheddar cheese, broccoli, ham and remaining bread slices, cut in half diagonally.
Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Blend in milk and mustard; pour over bread.
Top with remaining Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until set. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Strata. Place 6 slices bread on bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with 1 cup Cheddar cheese, broccoli, ham and remaining bread slices, cut in half diagonally. Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Blend in milk and mustard; pour over bread. Top with remaining Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until set. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cherry Crunch
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 5 oz.) can cherry pie filling
directions: Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan.
Sprinkle with lemon juice.
Combine cake mix, nuts and melted butter. Crumble mixture over pie filling.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Crunch. Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine cake mix, nuts and melted butter. Crumble mixture over pie filling. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Chris' Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, margarine and milk in a heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan. Bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat; stir in chocolate until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme and nuts. Mix until well blended. Pour into 8 x 8 foil pans lined with wax paper and let set to cool. Will take 2 pans. After cooled, cut into squares.
recipes.text: Aunt Chris' Fudge. Combine sugar, margarine and milk in a heavy 2 1/2-quart saucepan. Bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly to prevent scorching. Remove from heat; stir in chocolate until melted. Add Marshmallow Creme and nuts. Mix until well blended. Pour into 8 x 8 foil pans lined with wax paper and let set to cool. Will take 2 pans. After cooled, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding (Large)
directions: Mix flour with sugar.
Add all other ingredients.
Spray dish with Pam so it will come out easy.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding (Large). Mix flour with sugar. Add all other ingredients. Spray dish with Pam so it will come out easy. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Cook at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix all ingredients. Cook at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Boiled Cookies
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients for 1 1/2 minutes; remove from heat and add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla.
Drop with a spoon onto waxed paper to cool.
recipes.text: Boiled Cookies. Cook first 4 ingredients for 1 1/2 minutes; remove from heat and add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla. Drop with a spoon onto waxed paper to cool.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Peel and cut potatoes into cubes wash and drain. Put into a large pot. Add water, milk, salt, pepper and butter. Cook until done or tender. Add cheese and soups, stir until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Peel and cut potatoes into cubes wash and drain. Put into a large pot. Add water, milk, salt, pepper and butter. Cook until done or tender. Add cheese and soups, stir until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Cups
ingredients: canned biscuits (the amount of biscuits is according to the amount of leftover meat loaf)
directions: Take canned biscuits and press them thinly into a cupcake pan. Take meat loaf and put a nice size spoon in each biscuit.
Cook in oven for 5 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf Cups. Take canned biscuits and press them thinly into a cupcake pan. Take meat loaf and put a nice size spoon in each biscuit. Cook in oven for 5 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Corn Bread Dressing
directions: Mix cornmeal, baking powder, soda and 1 teaspoon salt in large mixer bowl.
Add 2 eggs, buttermilk and bacon drippings; mix well. Pour into hot greased 10-inch baking pan.
Bake at 450u00b0 for 35 minutes or until light brown.
Cool.
Crumble corn bread into large bowl.
Saute celery and onion in butter in skillet until tender.
Add to crumbled corn bread.
Add crumbled bread slices, chicken broth, milk, 2 eggs, 1 teaspoon salt, poultry seasoning and pepper; mix well.
Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 450u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.
Yield:
12 servings.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Corn Bread Dressing. Mix cornmeal, baking powder, soda and 1 teaspoon salt in large mixer bowl. Add 2 eggs, buttermilk and bacon drippings; mix well. Pour into hot greased 10-inch baking pan. Bake at 450u00b0 for 35 minutes or until light brown. Cool. Crumble corn bread into large bowl. Saute celery and onion in butter in skillet until tender. Add to crumbled corn bread. Add crumbled bread slices, chicken broth, milk, 2 eggs, 1 teaspoon salt, poultry seasoning and pepper; mix well. Spoon into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 450u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown. Yield: 12 servings.

recipes.title: Cherry Pie Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in a baking dish.
Combine sugar, flour and milk. Beat until smooth.
Pour over melted butter in a baking dish.
Add fruit.
Do not stir.
Bake at about 400u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Cherry Pie Cobbler. Melt butter in a baking dish. Combine sugar, flour and milk. Beat until smooth. Pour over melted butter in a baking dish. Add fruit. Do not stir. Bake at about 400u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. beef or 4 to 6 steaks
1 small onion or large, if preferred
directions: Shape beef into patties.
Dust with flour on both sides.
Brown in large skillet until done.
Add water (about 1/2 cup) and simmer until water becomes like gravy.
Saute onion and bell pepper in about 1/2 stick butter and then add to beef and gravy.
Ready to serve.
Also good made with any steak cuts.
Gravy is good over mashed potatoes.
recipes.text: Salisbury Steak. Shape beef into patties. Dust with flour on both sides. Brown in large skillet until done. Add water (about 1/2 cup) and simmer until water becomes like gravy. Saute onion and bell pepper in about 1/2 stick butter and then add to beef and gravy. Ready to serve. Also good made with any steak cuts. Gravy is good over mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Blackberry Cobbler
directions: Stir together first 5 ingredients in a large bowl.
Gently stir in blackberries until sugar mixture is crumbly.
Spoon fruit mixture into a lightly greased 11-inch by 17-inch baking dish. Cut 1 piecrust into 1/2-inch wide strips, and arrange strips diagonally over blackberry mixture.
Sprinkle top with 1 tablespoon sugar.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown and center is bubbly.
Serve with ice cream if desired.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Blackberry Cobbler. Stir together first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Gently stir in blackberries until sugar mixture is crumbly. Spoon fruit mixture into a lightly greased 11-inch by 17-inch baking dish. Cut 1 piecrust into 1/2-inch wide strips, and arrange strips diagonally over blackberry mixture. Sprinkle top with 1 tablespoon sugar. Bake at 425u00b0 for 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown and center is bubbly. Serve with ice cream if desired. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Homestead Garden'S Holiday Mulled Cider
directions: Bring to a boil to dissolve sugar.
Simmer 15 minutes or put in crock-pot on low.
recipes.text: Homestead Garden'S Holiday Mulled Cider. Bring to a boil to dissolve sugar. Simmer 15 minutes or put in crock-pot on low.

recipes.title: Gram'S Donuts
directions: Boil and mash potatoes.
Add hot to additional ingredients. Roll out dough.
Cut.
Drop into hot oil until golden brown. Place on paper towel.
Drop donuts in cinnamon/sugar or powdered sugar for variation.
recipes.text: Gram'S Donuts. Boil and mash potatoes. Add hot to additional ingredients. Roll out dough. Cut. Drop into hot oil until golden brown. Place on paper towel. Drop donuts in cinnamon/sugar or powdered sugar for variation.

recipes.title: Caramel Candy Popcorn
directions: Over medium heat, melt oleo.
Stir in sugar, syrup and salt. Stir until mixture comes to a boil.
Boil 5 minutes without stirring.
Remove from heat.
Stir in baking soda and vanilla. Put corn in large pan and pour syrup over it.
Stir until well mixed.
recipes.text: Caramel Candy Popcorn. Over medium heat, melt oleo. Stir in sugar, syrup and salt. Stir until mixture comes to a boil. Boil 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda and vanilla. Put corn in large pan and pour syrup over it. Stir until well mixed.

recipes.title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
ingredients: 1 (8 3/4 oz.) can crushed pineapple or 1 c., drained (keep juice)
directions: Use mixer on medium speed to mix Crisco and brown sugar.
Add egg and vanilla.
Continue to mix until well blended.
Add drained pineapple to mixture; then add flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 400u00b0 on lightly greased cookie sheets.
While cookies are warm, glaze with confectioners sugar and pineapple juice, mixed together to make thin glaze.
Makes approximately four dozen.
recipes.text: Pineapple Drop Cookies. Use mixer on medium speed to mix Crisco and brown sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Continue to mix until well blended. Add drained pineapple to mixture; then add flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 400u00b0 on lightly greased cookie sheets. While cookies are warm, glaze with confectioners sugar and pineapple juice, mixed together to make thin glaze. Makes approximately four dozen.

recipes.title: Pat'S Great Easy Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 2 boxes of Jiffy Yellow Cake mix
directions: Layer ingredients in a 13 1/2 x 9-inch disposable dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Pat'S Great Easy Peach Cobbler. Layer ingredients in a 13 1/2 x 9-inch disposable dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can water packed artichoke hearts
directions: Drain and chop artichoke hearts.
Add mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese and chopped green chilies.
Mix thoroughly and put into baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until brown around the sides. Serve hot or cold.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Drain and chop artichoke hearts. Add mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese and chopped green chilies. Mix thoroughly and put into baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes until brown around the sides. Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; chill until it starts to jell.
Mix together cream cheese and confectioners sugar until smooth.
Whip Milnot until it peaks; slowly add cream cheese mixture and gelatin.
Mix cracker crumbs with margarine, reserving 1/4 cup.
Line a cake pan with rest of crumbs.
Pour in cream cheese mixture.
Sprinkle with rest of crumbs.
Chill.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; chill until it starts to jell. Mix together cream cheese and confectioners sugar until smooth. Whip Milnot until it peaks; slowly add cream cheese mixture and gelatin. Mix cracker crumbs with margarine, reserving 1/4 cup. Line a cake pan with rest of crumbs. Pour in cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with rest of crumbs. Chill.

recipes.title: Herbed Tomato Soup
directions: In a medium saucepan, saute onion and garlic in butter until onion is soft.
Add tomatoes, basil, broth and parsley. Simmer 10 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes.
Place in blender container. Cover and blend thoroughly.
Return to saucepan.
Heat thoroughly. Garnish with additional parsley.
Makes about 5 cups.
recipes.text: Herbed Tomato Soup. In a medium saucepan, saute onion and garlic in butter until onion is soft. Add tomatoes, basil, broth and parsley. Simmer 10 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Place in blender container. Cover and blend thoroughly. Return to saucepan. Heat thoroughly. Garnish with additional parsley. Makes about 5 cups.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Mix together sugar, shortening and salt.
Pour 1 cup boiling water over mixture.
Stir and cool.
Beat eggs slightly.
Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water.
Add flour.
Mix all together and refrigerate (up to one week).
Dough will be sticky.
Roll out and cut into shape.
Let rise 2 hours.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Rolls. Mix together sugar, shortening and salt. Pour 1 cup boiling water over mixture. Stir and cool. Beat eggs slightly. Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water. Add flour. Mix all together and refrigerate (up to one week). Dough will be sticky. Roll out and cut into shape. Let rise 2 hours. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 c. coconut milk or pasteurized milk
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Combine flour and baking powder.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with coconut milk and vanilla.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool cake completely and split cake layers.
Spread Sour Cream Coconut Filling between layers and on top of cake.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine flour and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternately with coconut milk and vanilla. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool cake completely and split cake layers. Spread Sour Cream Coconut Filling between layers and on top of cake.

recipes.title: Happiness
ingredients: sprinkel some sugar on top to get it a little more sweet
directions: Cook it for 3 minutes. Pop it in the oven then Boom!
you are happy.
recipes.text: Happiness. Cook it for 3 minutes. Pop it in the oven then Boom! you are happy.

recipes.title: Graham Bars
ingredients: 1/2 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips or raisins
directions: Spread in a well-greased 9 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Graham Bars. Spread in a well-greased 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 2 bunches green onions or 1/2 c. grated onion
directions: Cream the cream cheese and chop the onions fine.
Mix together remaining ingredients with mixer.
Chill several hours and serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Cream the cream cheese and chop the onions fine. Mix together remaining ingredients with mixer. Chill several hours and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Hamburg Gravy
directions: Brown hamburg, add mushroom soup mix.
Pour over potatoes or noodles.
Can use deer meat, cut up, in place of hamburg also.
recipes.text: Hamburg Gravy. Brown hamburg, add mushroom soup mix. Pour over potatoes or noodles. Can use deer meat, cut up, in place of hamburg also.

recipes.title: Beans And Onions
directions: Place 1/2 of beans in a 2-quart casserole. Top with 1/2 of onions; repeat. Combine catsup with sugar and pour over onions. Sprinkle bacon over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Beans And Onions. Place 1/2 of beans in a 2-quart casserole. Top with 1/2 of onions; repeat. Combine catsup with sugar and pour over onions. Sprinkle bacon over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Freezer Pickles
ingredients: 1 c. green pepper, cut in small chunks
directions: Put all in glass dish, crock or enamel pan.
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon salt.
Let sit 2 hours.
Bring syrup to boil, then let cool.
recipes.text: Freezer Pickles. Put all in glass dish, crock or enamel pan. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon salt. Let sit 2 hours. Bring syrup to boil, then let cool.

recipes.title: Praline Pie
directions: In small saucepan, cook and stir butter and brown sugar over low heat until brown sugar melts and mixture bubbles.
Remove from heat and add pecans.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Prepare pudding mix according to package directions for pie filling.
Cool slightly.
Pour over butter and brown sugar mixture.
Chill 4 hours or until firm.
Just before serving, garnish with whipped topping.
recipes.text: Praline Pie. In small saucepan, cook and stir butter and brown sugar over low heat until brown sugar melts and mixture bubbles. Remove from heat and add pecans. Pour into graham cracker crust. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions for pie filling. Cool slightly. Pour over butter and brown sugar mixture. Chill 4 hours or until firm. Just before serving, garnish with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti and combine all ingredients, except part of cheese.
Place in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese. Heat in 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Cook spaghetti and combine all ingredients, except part of cheese. Place in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese. Heat in 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Cream margarine and sugar, blend in eggs.
Add flour; mix well.
Spread on bottom and 2 inches high around sides of 9-inch cheesecake spring-form pan.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 5 minutes.
Reduce oven to 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cheesecake. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Cream margarine and sugar, blend in eggs. Add flour; mix well. Spread on bottom and 2 inches high around sides of 9-inch cheesecake spring-form pan. Bake at 400u00b0 for 5 minutes. Reduce oven to 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Hungry Jack Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 (9.5 oz.) can Hungry Jack flaky biscuits
1 c. shredded Cracker Barrel Cheddar cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Brown ground beef; drain.
Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly; pour into 2-quart casserole dish.
Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles.
Place cut side down around edge of casserole.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes, until biscuits are golden brown. Refrigerate any leftovers.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Hungry Jack Beef Casserole. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in next 5 ingredients; heat until bubbly; pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Cut biscuits in half to form 20 half circles. Place cut side down around edge of casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes, until biscuits are golden brown. Refrigerate any leftovers. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp Dip
directions: Cook, peel and chop shrimp into small bite size pieces, enough to make 2 cups; set aside.
Mix chili sauce, Worcestershire sauce, horseradish (found in the dairy products at most grocers) and lemon juice.
Place cream cheese on platter.
Mix shrimp into sauce and pour over cream cheese.
Chill.
Serve with your favorite crackers.
recipes.text: Spicy Shrimp Dip. Cook, peel and chop shrimp into small bite size pieces, enough to make 2 cups; set aside. Mix chili sauce, Worcestershire sauce, horseradish (found in the dairy products at most grocers) and lemon juice. Place cream cheese on platter. Mix shrimp into sauce and pour over cream cheese. Chill. Serve with your favorite crackers.

recipes.title: Barbecued Meatballs
directions: Mix the ingredients and form into balls a little larger than a walnuts.
recipes.text: Barbecued Meatballs. Mix the ingredients and form into balls a little larger than a walnuts.

recipes.title: Bacon, Tomato And Herb Dip
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) carton (2 c.) Land O Lakes light sour cream
1 1/2 tsp. Spice Islands Beau Monde seasoning
directions: In medium bowl, stir together ingredients until well blended.
recipes.text: Bacon, Tomato And Herb Dip. In medium bowl, stir together ingredients until well blended.

recipes.title: Orange Pineapple Punch
directions: Mix Kool-Aid, sugar and water, stirring well. Then add pineapple juice, frozen orange juice and ginger ale, stirring well. Put in refrigerator and chill.
recipes.text: Orange Pineapple Punch. Mix Kool-Aid, sugar and water, stirring well. Then add pineapple juice, frozen orange juice and ginger ale, stirring well. Put in refrigerator and chill.

recipes.title: Zucchini Butter Fried
directions: Cut zucchini in 1/4-inch slices. Dip in eggs and flour. Put 1/2 cup butter in skillet over medium. Turn over when browned. Sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning. Add butter as needed to skillet.
recipes.text: Zucchini Butter Fried. Cut zucchini in 1/4-inch slices. Dip in eggs and flour. Put 1/2 cup butter in skillet over medium. Turn over when browned. Sprinkle with lemon pepper seasoning. Add butter as needed to skillet.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Combine the oats and buttermilk to soften for 1/2 hour.
Mix slightly beaten eggs with oatmeal and buttermilk after softening. Add to dry ingredients.
Add oil last.
Bake in greased muffin pans for 15 minutes at 400u00b0.
Dough will keep in refrigerator for 5 weeks.
(Bake a little longer if taken from refrigerator.)
recipes.text: Oatmeal Muffins. Combine the oats and buttermilk to soften for 1/2 hour. Mix slightly beaten eggs with oatmeal and buttermilk after softening. Add to dry ingredients. Add oil last. Bake in greased muffin pans for 15 minutes at 400u00b0. Dough will keep in refrigerator for 5 weeks. (Bake a little longer if taken from refrigerator.)

recipes.title: Phyl'S Famous Egg Rolls
directions: Saute pork and onions.
Add celery, cabbage and salt.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Drain.
Add bean sprouts.
Cook 3 to 5 minutes. Drain.
Fill wrappers as directed on package.
Deep-fry, may cook in wok or deep skillet (peanut oil works best).
recipes.text: Phyl'S Famous Egg Rolls. Saute pork and onions. Add celery, cabbage and salt. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Drain. Add bean sprouts. Cook 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. Fill wrappers as directed on package. Deep-fry, may cook in wok or deep skillet (peanut oil works best).

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sift flour with sugar, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.
Add apples, nuts, margarine and eggs.
Beat until just combined (it will be thick).
Turn into pan.
Bake for 1 hour or until top springs back when lightly pressed with fingertip.
Serve warm. Top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sift flour with sugar, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Add apples, nuts, margarine and eggs. Beat until just combined (it will be thick). Turn into pan. Bake for 1 hour or until top springs back when lightly pressed with fingertip. Serve warm. Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Zucchini Stuffing Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of celery (undiluted)
directions: Cook or steam zucchini in boiling salted water, until just tender.
Drain.
In microwave casserole dish (1-quart size), melt 4 tablespoons of butter or margarine.
Add carrot and onion and cook until tender.
Stir in 2 1/4 cups stuffing cubes, soup and carrot/onion.
Mix into zucchini dish, stirring gently.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter or margarine.
Add remaining 1 1/4 cups stuffing cubes to butter and toss gently.
Sprinkle cubes on casserole.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes, uncovered. Makes 6 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Zucchini Stuffing Casserole. Cook or steam zucchini in boiling salted water, until just tender. Drain. In microwave casserole dish (1-quart size), melt 4 tablespoons of butter or margarine. Add carrot and onion and cook until tender. Stir in 2 1/4 cups stuffing cubes, soup and carrot/onion. Mix into zucchini dish, stirring gently. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter or margarine. Add remaining 1 1/4 cups stuffing cubes to butter and toss gently. Sprinkle cubes on casserole. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes, uncovered. Makes 6 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Light Yeast Biscuits
directions: In a small bowl, dissolve 1 tablespoon sugar in the warm water, then add yeast.

In a large bowl, combine the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar, flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Using a pastry blender or two knives, cut butter into dry ingredients until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal.
Add buttermilk and yeast mixture to dry ingredients and stir until a soft dough forms.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead 4 minutes or until dough becomes smooth and elastic.
Place in a large bowl; spray with cooking spray, turning once to coat top of dough.
recipes.text: Light Yeast Biscuits. In a small bowl, dissolve 1 tablespoon sugar in the warm water, then add yeast. In a large bowl, combine the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar, flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Using a pastry blender or two knives, cut butter into dry ingredients until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal. Add buttermilk and yeast mixture to dry ingredients and stir until a soft dough forms. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead 4 minutes or until dough becomes smooth and elastic. Place in a large bowl; spray with cooking spray, turning once to coat top of dough.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer in serving dishes as follows:

First layer, bean dip; second layer, mayonnaise and sour cream mixed with the taco seasoning; third layer, diced onion; fourth layer, chunk tomatoes; fifth layer, shredded Cheddar cheese, olives on top (optional).
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Layer in serving dishes as follows: First layer, bean dip; second layer, mayonnaise and sour cream mixed with the taco seasoning; third layer, diced onion; fourth layer, chunk tomatoes; fifth layer, shredded Cheddar cheese, olives on top (optional).

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole Chinese
ingredients: 1 c. diced onion, cut in 1/2-inch chunks
directions: Mix all together.
Save some noodles to put on top, or use 1/3 cup cashews on top.
Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 hour.
You want vegetables crisp.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole Chinese. Mix all together. Save some noodles to put on top, or use 1/3 cup cashews on top. Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 hour. You want vegetables crisp.

recipes.title: Camellia Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1/4 c. white part only orange rind, cut in small bits (tears like tissue paper)
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans.
In a large mixer bowl, beat the sugar, butter, eggs and vanilla for about 5 minutes.
Add water, whole wheat flour, cocoa, baking soda, salt, ginger and white of orange rind.
Beat until blended.
Pour into pans.
Bake 28 to 33 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 5 minutes.
Remove from pan. Cool completely.
Can be eaten plain or with a white frosting. The more adventurous might try a coconut frosting.
recipes.text: Camellia Chocolate Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans. In a large mixer bowl, beat the sugar, butter, eggs and vanilla for about 5 minutes. Add water, whole wheat flour, cocoa, baking soda, salt, ginger and white of orange rind. Beat until blended. Pour into pans. Bake 28 to 33 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool completely. Can be eaten plain or with a white frosting. The more adventurous might try a coconut frosting.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
directions: Saute celery and onion until tender.
Mix with other ingredients, adding broth until desired consistency is reached. Bake, uncovered, 45 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Chicken Pie. Saute celery and onion until tender. Mix with other ingredients, adding broth until desired consistency is reached. Bake, uncovered, 45 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Butter
directions: Blend well and put into refrigerator.
Do not eat until chilled.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Butter. Blend well and put into refrigerator. Do not eat until chilled.

recipes.title: Mango Ice Cream
directions: Start with a good portion of love, stir in a few smiles and one or two good belly laughs.
Add a pinch of each: understanding, cheerfulness, compassion, a prayer or two or three and honesty.
recipes.text: Mango Ice Cream. Start with a good portion of love, stir in a few smiles and one or two good belly laughs. Add a pinch of each: understanding, cheerfulness, compassion, a prayer or two or three and honesty.

recipes.title: Plain Pastry Or Pie Shell
directions: For pie shell add 1/2 cup sugar and 1 egg.
recipes.text: Plain Pastry Or Pie Shell. For pie shell add 1/2 cup sugar and 1 egg.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Cheese Soup
directions: Combine water, cauliflower, potatoes, celery, carrots and onion in a large pan; boil for 5 to 10 minutes or until tender.
Set aside.
Melt butter in separate pan over medium heat.
Stir in flour.
Cook for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and slowly stir in milk.
Return to heat and cook until thickened.
Stir in vegetables with cooking liquid, then stir in cheese until melted.
Use salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Cheese Soup. Combine water, cauliflower, potatoes, celery, carrots and onion in a large pan; boil for 5 to 10 minutes or until tender. Set aside. Melt butter in separate pan over medium heat. Stir in flour. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and slowly stir in milk. Return to heat and cook until thickened. Stir in vegetables with cooking liquid, then stir in cheese until melted. Use salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Applesauce Raisins Drops
directions: Cream the margarine until fluffy.
Blend in brown sugar and egg.
Alternately add
sifted dry ingredients and applesauce. Blend well.
Stir in vanilla, oats and raisins.
Drop by tablespoons on nonstick cookie pan.
Flatten dough.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.
Cookies stay moist.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Applesauce Raisins Drops. Cream the margarine until fluffy. Blend in brown sugar and egg. Alternately add sifted dry ingredients and applesauce. Blend well. Stir in vanilla, oats and raisins. Drop by tablespoons on nonstick cookie pan. Flatten dough. Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen. Cookies stay moist.

recipes.title: Enchiladas Acapulco
ingredients: 1/2 lb. Velveeta Mexican cheese, cubed (mild or hot)
directions: Brown meat; drain.
Add tomato sauce and 1/2 cup green peppers.
Cook over medium heat 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add beans and 1/4 pound cheese cubes.
Cook until cheese melts. Remove from heat.
Dip tortillas in hot oil; drain on paper towels.
Fill each tortilla with a 1/4 cup meat mixture, then roll up.
Place seam side down in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Pour remaining mixture over tortillas.
Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 5 additional minutes to melt cheese.
Remove and top with remaining peppers, cheese and tomatoes.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Enchiladas Acapulco. Brown meat; drain. Add tomato sauce and 1/2 cup green peppers. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Add beans and 1/4 pound cheese cubes. Cook until cheese melts. Remove from heat. Dip tortillas in hot oil; drain on paper towels. Fill each tortilla with a 1/4 cup meat mixture, then roll up. Place seam side down in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Pour remaining mixture over tortillas. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake 5 additional minutes to melt cheese. Remove and top with remaining peppers, cheese and tomatoes. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Shantell'S Favorite Snack
directions: Mix the onion soup mix into the sour cream.
Stir well.
Place on crackers and eat.
recipes.text: Shantell'S Favorite Snack. Mix the onion soup mix into the sour cream. Stir well. Place on crackers and eat.

recipes.title: Poi Puff
directions: Blend all ingredients together.
Spoon poi mixture.
Drop into oil.
recipes.text: Poi Puff. Blend all ingredients together. Spoon poi mixture. Drop into oil.

recipes.title: Hot Hominy Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except Fritos.
Put in large casserole dish or 9 x 13-inch pan.
Crush Fritos and put on top of mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Hominy Casserole. Mix all ingredients together, except Fritos. Put in large casserole dish or 9 x 13-inch pan. Crush Fritos and put on top of mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lasagna
directions: Brown meat with onion and garlic; drain fat.
Add salt, oregano, marjoram, pepper, bay leaf, tomato paste, water and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer at least 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Brown meat with onion and garlic; drain fat. Add salt, oregano, marjoram, pepper, bay leaf, tomato paste, water and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer at least 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake
directions: Soften butter.
Add sugar and eggs.
Beat well.
Add flour, flavorings, nuts and fruit.
Mix well.
Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 45 minutes.
If desired, you may add 1 teaspoon lemon flavoring and an additional 1 teaspoon vanilla.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake. Soften butter. Add sugar and eggs. Beat well. Add flour, flavorings, nuts and fruit. Mix well. Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 45 minutes. If desired, you may add 1 teaspoon lemon flavoring and an additional 1 teaspoon vanilla.

recipes.title: Pastry (8 Or 9-Inch)(Double Crust)
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Roll out on floured board.
recipes.text: Pastry (8 Or 9-Inch)(Double Crust). Mix all ingredients together. Roll out on floured board.

recipes.title: Tropical Dump Cake
directions: Spread cherries evenly over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Pour in pineapple, but do not mix.
Sift cake mix on top.
Pour butter on evenly.
Sprinkle with coconut and pecans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and coconut is toasted.
recipes.text: Tropical Dump Cake. Spread cherries evenly over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Pour in pineapple, but do not mix. Sift cake mix on top. Pour butter on evenly. Sprinkle with coconut and pecans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown and coconut is toasted.

recipes.title: Scripture Bars
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients in large mixing bowl.
In another large bowl, sift together next 3 ingredients.
Chop next 2 ingredients; add with last ingredient to sifted mixture.
If entirely too thick to spread, add a little bit more of second ingredient.
Spread in buttered and lightly floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Cool on rack before cutting into small bars.
Makes about 50.
recipes.text: Scripture Bars. Mix first 3 ingredients in large mixing bowl. In another large bowl, sift together next 3 ingredients. Chop next 2 ingredients; add with last ingredient to sifted mixture. If entirely too thick to spread, add a little bit more of second ingredient. Spread in buttered and lightly floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool on rack before cutting into small bars. Makes about 50.

recipes.title: Mini Hamburger Loaves
directions: Combine ingredients and form into mini loaves.
Put loaves in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with sauce.
Bake.
recipes.text: Mini Hamburger Loaves. Combine ingredients and form into mini loaves. Put loaves in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with sauce. Bake.

recipes.title: Ambrosia Bavarian Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O, sugar and salt in boiling water. Stir in orange juice. Chill until slightly thickened.
Beat until fluffy and light. Stir in whipped topping until well blended. Fold in undrained pineapple and coconut.
Pour into a large serving bowl. Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Ambrosia Bavarian Salad. Dissolve Jell-O, sugar and salt in boiling water. Stir in orange juice. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat until fluffy and light. Stir in whipped topping until well blended. Fold in undrained pineapple and coconut. Pour into a large serving bowl. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Chicken Sopa
directions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and place in a large, greased casserole dish or 2 smaller ones.
Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Sopa. Mix all ingredients except cheese and place in a large, greased casserole dish or 2 smaller ones. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter, eggs and flour until smooth.
Add lemon extract and 7-Up, a little bit at a time, until it is all mixed in and smooth.
Bake at 300u00b0 to 325u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: 7-Up Cake. Cream sugar, butter, eggs and flour until smooth. Add lemon extract and 7-Up, a little bit at a time, until it is all mixed in and smooth. Bake at 300u00b0 to 325u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Stella Adamek'S Rye Bread
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl.
Combine next 3 ingredients in a cup and add to dry ingredients.
Work in 9 cups white flour.
Place on floured board and knead for 8 to 10 minutes.
Place in greased container and let raise to double the size.
recipes.text: Stella Adamek'S Rye Bread. Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Combine next 3 ingredients in a cup and add to dry ingredients. Work in 9 cups white flour. Place on floured board and knead for 8 to 10 minutes. Place in greased container and let raise to double the size.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Relish Patties
directions: Mix the ground beef with the salt, pepper and parsley.
Shape mixture into 8 patties, 4-inch diameter.

On each of 4 patties, arrange an onion ring, a tomato slice and a slice of cheese. Cover with the other 4 patties and press edges together to seal. Broil on both sides for a total of about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Relish Patties. Mix the ground beef with the salt, pepper and parsley. Shape mixture into 8 patties, 4-inch diameter. On each of 4 patties, arrange an onion ring, a tomato slice and a slice of cheese. Cover with the other 4 patties and press edges together to seal. Broil on both sides for a total of about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Tossed Salad
ingredients: 1 small head of lettuce, broken into bite size pieces
directions: Cook beef until done.
Drain.
Stir in taco sauce.
Toss lettuce, green pepper, tomato, olives, kidney beans, cheese and chips; stir in meat mixture.
Stir in salad dressing.
Serve with more taco chips.
recipes.text: Taco Tossed Salad. Cook beef until done. Drain. Stir in taco sauce. Toss lettuce, green pepper, tomato, olives, kidney beans, cheese and chips; stir in meat mixture. Stir in salad dressing. Serve with more taco chips.

recipes.title: Caramel Sauce(This Sauce Is Good On Ice Cream Or Cobbler.)
ingredients: 4 c. cream (you can use evaporated milk)
directions: In a double boiler, mix sugar, cornstarch, salt and milk; cook until well blended.
Stir in eggs and cook for 3 or 4 minutes longer.
Chill, then add vanilla and chilled cream.
Fill ice cream freezer container no more than 2/3 full.
Start cranking!
recipes.text: Caramel Sauce(This Sauce Is Good On Ice Cream Or Cobbler.). In a double boiler, mix sugar, cornstarch, salt and milk; cook until well blended. Stir in eggs and cook for 3 or 4 minutes longer. Chill, then add vanilla and chilled cream. Fill ice cream freezer container no more than 2/3 full. Start cranking!

recipes.title: Corn Pone Pie
ingredients: 1 c. canned or stewed tomatoes or tomato paste
1 (15 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained or pinto beans
directions: Combine meat, onion, sugar and chili sauce and saute in butter until meat changes color.
Add tomatoes and beans and simmer for 15 minutes.
Place meat mixture in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Spread cornbread batter on top of meat mixture.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Corn Pone Pie. Combine meat, onion, sugar and chili sauce and saute in butter until meat changes color. Add tomatoes and beans and simmer for 15 minutes. Place meat mixture in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spread cornbread batter on top of meat mixture. Bake at 425u00b0 for 25 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Red Wedding Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Freeze.
Just before serving, maybe 1 hour, add 2 quarts ginger ale.
Makes 2 gallons.
recipes.text: Red Wedding Punch. Mix all ingredients. Freeze. Just before serving, maybe 1 hour, add 2 quarts ginger ale. Makes 2 gallons.

recipes.title: Cheese Spread
directions: Mix all together and chill.
Serve with any kind of crackers as an appetizer or snack.
recipes.text: Cheese Spread. Mix all together and chill. Serve with any kind of crackers as an appetizer or snack.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bran Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Grease 12 to 15 (2 1/2-inch) muffin pan cups.
In medium mixing bowl, combine flour, brown sugar, baking powder, salt and soda.
In small bowl, blend egg, milk and oil; stir in 100% bran.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Add zucchini, walnuts and cinnamon; mix until well combined.
Stir into flour mixture just until blended.
Do not overmix.
Fill baking cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bran Muffins. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Grease 12 to 15 (2 1/2-inch) muffin pan cups. In medium mixing bowl, combine flour, brown sugar, baking powder, salt and soda. In small bowl, blend egg, milk and oil; stir in 100% bran. Let stand 5 minutes. Add zucchini, walnuts and cinnamon; mix until well combined. Stir into flour mixture just until blended. Do not overmix. Fill baking cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Almond Joy Cake
directions: Mix and bake cake as usual in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Heat to boiling 1 cup Pet milk and sugar.
Add marshmallows; when melted, add coconut.
Pour over hot cake.
Melt 1/2 cup Pet milk with butter and chocolate chips.
Spread on top of coconut.
Sprinkle with almonds.
recipes.text: Almond Joy Cake. Mix and bake cake as usual in 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat to boiling 1 cup Pet milk and sugar. Add marshmallows; when melted, add coconut. Pour over hot cake. Melt 1/2 cup Pet milk with butter and chocolate chips. Spread on top of coconut. Sprinkle with almonds.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Hors D'0Euvres
ingredients: 1 can drained crabmeat or 1/2 c. fresh
directions: Mix all together.
Spread on split English muffins.
Freeze, then cut into quarters.
Broil (still frozen) until browned. Serve while still warm.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Hors D'0Euvres. Mix all together. Spread on split English muffins. Freeze, then cut into quarters. Broil (still frozen) until browned. Serve while still warm.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix all ingredients together. Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Bake until golden brown, approximately 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pie. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix all ingredients together. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Bake until golden brown, approximately 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Cook cranberries, sugar and water 5 minutes and chill. Dissolve jello in boiling water then add cold water.When it begins to congeal add nuts, celery and pineapple. Chill cranberry mixture and let congeal.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Cook cranberries, sugar and water 5 minutes and chill. Dissolve jello in boiling water then add cold water.When it begins to congeal add nuts, celery and pineapple. Chill cranberry mixture and let congeal.

recipes.title: Lazy Woman'S Fruit Cobbler
directions: Melt butter.
Pour in an 8 x 11-inch baking dish.
Mix dry ingredients and milk.
Mix well.
Pour over melted butter in baking dish.
Pour fruit over mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Lazy Woman'S Fruit Cobbler. Melt butter. Pour in an 8 x 11-inch baking dish. Mix dry ingredients and milk. Mix well. Pour over melted butter in baking dish. Pour fruit over mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecued Shrimp
ingredients: 24 large or jumbo shrimp, shelled and deveined
directions: Melt butter in a medium saucepan. Add onion; saute until soft and transparent. Stir in ketchup, water, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, vinegar, tomato paste, dry mustard and red pepper. Stirring occasionally, simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Immediately stir shrimp into sauce, covering completely. Let stand 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecued Shrimp. Melt butter in a medium saucepan. Add onion; saute until soft and transparent. Stir in ketchup, water, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, vinegar, tomato paste, dry mustard and red pepper. Stirring occasionally, simmer uncovered 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Immediately stir shrimp into sauce, covering completely. Let stand 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vermont Cheddar Cheese Bread
ingredients: 4 c. (1 lb.) good quality aged shredded Vermont cheddar cheese
directions: Combine milk, cheese, salt, sugar and shortening in saucepan. Heat slowly, stir until bubbles appear around edge and cheese is melted.
Cool to lukewarm.
Measure water into large bowl, dissolve yeast.
Add lukewarm mixture to yeast along with eggs and 8 c. flour. Beat until smooth. Add enough remaining flour to make stiff dough.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Place in greased bowl; cover & let rise in warm place until doubled.
Punch down.
recipes.text: Vermont Cheddar Cheese Bread. Combine milk, cheese, salt, sugar and shortening in saucepan. Heat slowly, stir until bubbles appear around edge and cheese is melted. Cool to lukewarm. Measure water into large bowl, dissolve yeast. Add lukewarm mixture to yeast along with eggs and 8 c. flour. Beat until smooth. Add enough remaining flour to make stiff dough. Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in greased bowl; cover & let rise in warm place until doubled. Punch down.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Mix in bowl the cottage cheese and dry jello.
Drain syrup from oranges.
Mix oranges with cottage cheese and jello.
Add coconut.
Chill.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Salad. Mix in bowl the cottage cheese and dry jello. Drain syrup from oranges. Mix oranges with cottage cheese and jello. Add coconut. Chill.

recipes.title: Carrot Bread
directions: Combine sugar and oil; blend thoroughly.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Mix flour, baking powder, soda and salt together; add to egg mixture.
Stir in carrots and nuts.
Spread batter in 2 greased 8 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Bread. Combine sugar and oil; blend thoroughly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix flour, baking powder, soda and salt together; add to egg mixture. Stir in carrots and nuts. Spread batter in 2 greased 8 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Calzones With Sun Dried Tomatoes And Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 lb. sausage, cut up and sauteed
directions: Oil cookie sheet or pizza pan.
With rolling pin, roll pizza dough on floured board as thick as pizza.
Arrange sausage and dried tomatoes over dough.
Top with basil, cheese and olive oil (no salt).
Fold dough to form a pocket (log).
Bake at 400u00b0 for about 3/4 hour.
recipes.text: Calzones With Sun Dried Tomatoes And Sausage. Oil cookie sheet or pizza pan. With rolling pin, roll pizza dough on floured board as thick as pizza. Arrange sausage and dried tomatoes over dough. Top with basil, cheese and olive oil (no salt). Fold dough to form a pocket (log). Bake at 400u00b0 for about 3/4 hour.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: pinch of garlic powder or salt
directions: Drain and quarter artichokes.
Mix ingredients together until well blended and place in a small casserole dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until mixture bubbles.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Drain and quarter artichokes. Mix ingredients together until well blended and place in a small casserole dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until mixture bubbles.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Rite Sandwich
directions: On one piece of bread, put the peanut butter.
Split the Ritz in half and spread on the bread.
Put it together and enjoy.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Rite Sandwich. On one piece of bread, put the peanut butter. Split the Ritz in half and spread on the bread. Put it together and enjoy.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 3 to 4 slices white bread or hash browns
directions: Cook meat and drain; butter 9 x 13 pan. Put in layer of white bread cubes or hash browns. Put meat on top of bread or hash browns. Add layer of Cheddar cheese. Pour over the mixture: 4 beaten eggs, 1 teaspoon salt and 2 cups milk. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour (covered). Add onion and green peppers to top. Also add microwaved Cheez Whiz on top. Also can add sour cream and salsa for topping.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Cook meat and drain; butter 9 x 13 pan. Put in layer of white bread cubes or hash browns. Put meat on top of bread or hash browns. Add layer of Cheddar cheese. Pour over the mixture: 4 beaten eggs, 1 teaspoon salt and 2 cups milk. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour (covered). Add onion and green peppers to top. Also add microwaved Cheez Whiz on top. Also can add sour cream and salsa for topping.

recipes.title: Sharon'S Famous Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Place oatmeal in blender or food processor and blend until a fine powder.
Combine oatmeal, flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda.
Mix well and set aside.
Cream butter and sugars until fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Mix butter mixture with flour mixture until completely combined.
Add chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by heaping tablespoon on an ungreased cookie sheet 2-inches apart.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes (12 minutes for soft and 15 minutes for crisp).
recipes.text: Sharon'S Famous Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies. Place oatmeal in blender or food processor and blend until a fine powder. Combine oatmeal, flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda. Mix well and set aside. Cream butter and sugars until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix butter mixture with flour mixture until completely combined. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by heaping tablespoon on an ungreased cookie sheet 2-inches apart. Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes (12 minutes for soft and 15 minutes for crisp).

recipes.title: Banana Fudge Walnut Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.

Grease bottom only of 8-inch square pan. Melt in 2-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, the butter and chocolate chips. Beat in thoroughly with spoon the flour, sugar, walnuts, banana, vanilla, baking powder, salt and egg. Spread batter evenly in pan. Bake about 30 minutes or until center is set.
recipes.text: Banana Fudge Walnut Brownies. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Grease bottom only of 8-inch square pan. Melt in 2-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, the butter and chocolate chips. Beat in thoroughly with spoon the flour, sugar, walnuts, banana, vanilla, baking powder, salt and egg. Spread batter evenly in pan. Bake about 30 minutes or until center is set.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese
directions: You will need a sandwich machine.
recipes.text: Grilled Cheese. You will need a sandwich machine.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut in strips
1 c. each: broccoli, cauliflower, red pepper strips and carrot strips
directions: Spray large skillet or wok with a nonstick cooking spray. Add chicken strips and garlic.
Stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add vegetables.
Stir-fry 3 more minutes.
Add chicken broth.
Reduce heat to medium.
Stir in mayonnaise, soy sauce and ginger.
Simmer until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Do not overcook.
(I you want a thick sauce, thicken it with cornstarch and cold water.)
Serve over hot rice.
recipes.text: Quick Chicken Stir-Fry. Spray large skillet or wok with a nonstick cooking spray. Add chicken strips and garlic. Stir-fry 3 minutes. Add vegetables. Stir-fry 3 more minutes. Add chicken broth. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in mayonnaise, soy sauce and ginger. Simmer until vegetables are tender-crisp. Do not overcook. (I you want a thick sauce, thicken it with cornstarch and cold water.) Serve over hot rice.

recipes.title: Tex Mex Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chilies, drained
1 (16 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
directions: Cook pasta, drain and rinse with cold water until completely cool.
In large salad bowl, blend mayonnaise, Italian dressing, green chilies, chili powder and cumin.
Toss with pasta and remaining ingredients.
Cover and chill.
Garnish with additional parsley.
recipes.text: Tex Mex Pasta Salad. Cook pasta, drain and rinse with cold water until completely cool. In large salad bowl, blend mayonnaise, Italian dressing, green chilies, chili powder and cumin. Toss with pasta and remaining ingredients. Cover and chill. Garnish with additional parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Wild Rice Casserole(Serves 8)
ingredients: 1 c. wild rice, cooked according to pkg. directions
1 (6 oz.) can broiled sliced mushrooms or regular canned mushrooms, browned in butter
directions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions.
Cook onion in butter until tender, but not brown.
Remove from heat and stir in flour.
Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid.
Add enough chicken broth to liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups.
Gradually stir into flour mixture.
Add cream; cook and stir until thick.
Add rice, mushrooms, chicken, pimento, parsley, salt and pepper.
Put into a 2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle top with almonds.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Can be made the day before, refrigerated, then baked just before serving, but will take longer to bake.
recipes.text: Chicken Wild Rice Casserole(Serves 8). Prepare wild rice according to package directions. Cook onion in butter until tender, but not brown. Remove from heat and stir in flour. Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid. Add enough chicken broth to liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups. Gradually stir into flour mixture. Add cream; cook and stir until thick. Add rice, mushrooms, chicken, pimento, parsley, salt and pepper. Put into a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle top with almonds. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be made the day before, refrigerated, then baked just before serving, but will take longer to bake.

recipes.title: Orange Jello Salad
directions: Melt marshmallows in milk; add jello.
Stir until dissolved. Add pineapple and oranges.
Cool for 1 hour.
Soften cheese; mix with salad dressing, Dream Whip and nuts.
Add to jello mixture.
recipes.text: Orange Jello Salad. Melt marshmallows in milk; add jello. Stir until dissolved. Add pineapple and oranges. Cool for 1 hour. Soften cheese; mix with salad dressing, Dream Whip and nuts. Add to jello mixture.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Brown deboned chicken breasts in pan on top of range in 2 tablespoons of oil.
Place chicken in a baking dish.
Top with cream of chicken soup and Cheddar cheese.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Cheesy Chicken. Brown deboned chicken breasts in pan on top of range in 2 tablespoons of oil. Place chicken in a baking dish. Top with cream of chicken soup and Cheddar cheese. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Best In The West B.B.Q. Baked Beans
directions: Brown beef, bacon, and onion.
Drain well. All all ingredients except beans.
Stir well.
Add beans.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
This is a main dish.
As a side dish reduce beef to 1/2 pound.
recipes.text: Best In The West B.B.Q. Baked Beans. Brown beef, bacon, and onion. Drain well. All all ingredients except beans. Stir well. Add beans. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0. This is a main dish. As a side dish reduce beef to 1/2 pound.

recipes.title: Hot Nectar Tea
ingredients: 1 can (6 oz.) frozen concentrate for orange juice
1 can (6 oz.) frozen lemon juice or lemonade
directions: Pour boiling water over tea bags in a kettle and cover.
Steep 5 minutes.
Remove tea bags.
Combine pineapple juice, apricot nectar, orange concentrate, lemon juice, sugar and water in a kettle; heat slowly, stirring several times, to simmering.
Stir in hot tea.
Very carefully pour into a large punch bowl.
Garnish with lime and lemon slices and maraschino cherries threaded onto a long skewer.
Ladle into punch cups.
Serve warm.
