recipes.text: Hot Nectar Tea. Pour boiling water over tea bags in a kettle and cover. Steep 5 minutes. Remove tea bags. Combine pineapple juice, apricot nectar, orange concentrate, lemon juice, sugar and water in a kettle; heat slowly, stirring several times, to simmering. Stir in hot tea. Very carefully pour into a large punch bowl. Garnish with lime and lemon slices and maraschino cherries threaded onto a long skewer. Ladle into punch cups. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Mix ingredients well.
Bake at 375u00b0 for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Muffins. Mix ingredients well. Bake at 375u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Meal-In-A-Mug
directions: In a large saucepan, brown ground beef; drain. Add water, beans, tomatoes and Sloppy Joe mix. Bring to a boil. Add macaroni and reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until macaroni is almost cooked. Pour into thermos for a hot lunch. Makes about 8 cups.
recipes.text: Meal-In-A-Mug. In a large saucepan, brown ground beef; drain. Add water, beans, tomatoes and Sloppy Joe mix. Bring to a boil. Add macaroni and reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until macaroni is almost cooked. Pour into thermos for a hot lunch. Makes about 8 cups.

recipes.title: Gingered Pork Chops
directions: Sprinkle pork chops evenly with salt, pepper and sage.
Saute chops in margarine in a large skillet about 10 minutes on each side, until browned.
Remove meat; set aside.
Add mushrooms and spices to skillet; saute until mushrooms are tender.
Stir in orange juice; cook 2 minutes longer.
Return meat to skillet; heat until piping hot.
recipes.text: Gingered Pork Chops. Sprinkle pork chops evenly with salt, pepper and sage. Saute chops in margarine in a large skillet about 10 minutes on each side, until browned. Remove meat; set aside. Add mushrooms and spices to skillet; saute until mushrooms are tender. Stir in orange juice; cook 2 minutes longer. Return meat to skillet; heat until piping hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Boil cut-up chicken.
Add celery.
Bring to boil.
Cook until done.
When chicken is done, debone chicken.
Bring broth to boil. Add tomato sauce and noodles.
Bring to boil.
Simmer 30 minutes. Add deboned chicken.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer 30 more minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Soup. Boil cut-up chicken. Add celery. Bring to boil. Cook until done. When chicken is done, debone chicken. Bring broth to boil. Add tomato sauce and noodles. Bring to boil. Simmer 30 minutes. Add deboned chicken. Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 30 more minutes.

recipes.title: Glazed Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 (16 to 18 oz.) cans sweet potatoes, drained
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Arrange sweet potatoes in 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish.
Spoon preserves over sweet potatoes.
Top with nuts, marshmallows and margarine.
Bake 25 minutes or microwave on High 6 to 7 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Glazed Sweet Potatoes. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Arrange sweet potatoes in 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Spoon preserves over sweet potatoes. Top with nuts, marshmallows and margarine. Bake 25 minutes or microwave on High 6 to 7 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Snackin' Cake
directions: Combine the cake mix, eggs, milk, oil and frosting in a mixing bowl. Beat until blended. Pour into Bundt pan that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Snackin' Cake. Combine the cake mix, eggs, milk, oil and frosting in a mixing bowl. Beat until blended. Pour into Bundt pan that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: 5 Minute Fudge
directions: Combine milk, sugar and salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Heat to boiling.
Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir 1 to 2 minutes or until marshmallows and chips melt.
Pour into buttered 9-inch square pan.
Allow to cool.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: 5 Minute Fudge. Combine milk, sugar and salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Heat to boiling. Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients. Stir 1 to 2 minutes or until marshmallows and chips melt. Pour into buttered 9-inch square pan. Allow to cool. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Drain cooked squash. Combine soup, mayonnaise, eggs, butter, stuffing mix and onion. Add to squash and stir. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour in casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 mins.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Drain cooked squash. Combine soup, mayonnaise, eggs, butter, stuffing mix and onion. Add to squash and stir. Salt and pepper to taste. Pour in casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 mins.

recipes.title: Ugly Duckling Cake
directions: Blend ingredients and beat by hand for 2 minutes.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan.
Sprinkle on top 1/2 cup brown sugar. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Cool and frost.
recipes.text: Ugly Duckling Cake. Blend ingredients and beat by hand for 2 minutes. Spread in 9 x 13-inch greased cake pan. Sprinkle on top 1/2 cup brown sugar. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Fruitcake Cookies
directions: Mix the first seven ingredients and stir in remaining ingredients.
Bake at 300u00b0 on a greased cookie sheet for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruitcake Cookies. Mix the first seven ingredients and stir in remaining ingredients. Bake at 300u00b0 on a greased cookie sheet for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma Mag'S Banana Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients, mix well.
Grease loaf pan.
Pour batter into pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Grandma Mag'S Banana Bread. Combine all ingredients, mix well. Grease loaf pan. Pour batter into pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: No Guilt Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Over very low heat, melt chocolate.
Cool slightly.
In food processor, puree all ingredients except powdered sugar and chocolate.
Blend well.
Add melted chocolate and mix well.
Pour into lightly greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until just set.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into squares.
Makes 16 squares.
recipes.text: No Guilt Brownies. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Over very low heat, melt chocolate. Cool slightly. In food processor, puree all ingredients except powdered sugar and chocolate. Blend well. Add melted chocolate and mix well. Pour into lightly greased 8-inch square pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until just set. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cut into squares. Makes 16 squares.

recipes.title: Soap Crayons
directions: Pour water into a 1-cup measuring cup.
Fill the rest of the cup to the top with Ivory Flakes.
With a spoon, mix the water and soap flakes together until mixture becomes a thick soapy paste without any big lumps.
Add about 30 or 40 drops of food coloring to the soap mixture and stir well until the soap has color.
Scoop out some of the mixture and put it in one of the cube spaces of an ice cube tray.
Press the soap paste down into the cube until it is filled to the top.
Fill 1 or 2 more cubes with the remaining soap mixture.
Dry cubes in a warm, dry place for 1 or 2 days until the soap paste gets hard (test by pressing with your finger).
Pop the soap crayons out of the tray.
Some colors will work better than others.
Soap crayons are made from pure soap and food coloring, so whatever is drawn with them can be wiped off bathtubs, sinks, floors, windows, hands and faces.
They are great for making disguises like a big moustache or a clown face.

Soap crayons are made from pure soap and food coloring, so whatever is drawn with them can be wiped off bathtubs, sinks, floors, windows, hands and faces. They are great for making disguises like a big moustache or a clown face.

recipes.title: Goat Cheese Torta
ingredients: 4 oz. cream cheese (soft or low-fat type is okay)
1/4 c. Pesto (store bought or use recipe following)
directions: Mix first five ingredients.
Line a small bowl with plastic wrap, leaving long ends (which will cover top when done).
Place 1/3 of cheese mixture in bowl.
Spoon Pesto on cheese.
Place 1/3 cheese on top of Pesto.
Spoon tomatoes on top.
Finish with rest of cheese.
Cover with plastic and refrigerate for 2 hours or up to 4 days.
Unmold onto plate and serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Goat Cheese Torta. Mix first five ingredients. Line a small bowl with plastic wrap, leaving long ends (which will cover top when done). Place 1/3 of cheese mixture in bowl. Spoon Pesto on cheese. Place 1/3 cheese on top of Pesto. Spoon tomatoes on top. Finish with rest of cheese. Cover with plastic and refrigerate for 2 hours or up to 4 days. Unmold onto plate and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 c. sour milk* or 1 c. water
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Remove 1/2 cup of mixture to sprinkle on top of cake before baking.
Add the baking powder, soda, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and nutmeg to remaining mixture.
Add eggs and sour milk; beat until smooth.
Pour into 2 (8-inch) greased cake pans.
recipes.text: Coffee Cake. Combine first 4 ingredients. Remove 1/2 cup of mixture to sprinkle on top of cake before baking. Add the baking powder, soda, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and nutmeg to remaining mixture. Add eggs and sour milk; beat until smooth. Pour into 2 (8-inch) greased cake pans.

recipes.title: Texas Monkey Bread
directions: Sprinkle chopped pecans in the bottom of well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan; set aside.
Combine sugar and cinnamon.
Cut biscuits into quarters and roll each piece in sugar mixture.
Layer in pan. Combine brown sugar and butter.
Pour over dough.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes in pan and invert.
recipes.text: Texas Monkey Bread. Sprinkle chopped pecans in the bottom of well-greased 10-inch Bundt pan; set aside. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Cut biscuits into quarters and roll each piece in sugar mixture. Layer in pan. Combine brown sugar and butter. Pour over dough. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan and invert.

recipes.title: Praline Bars
directions: Spray cookie sheet with Pam spray.
Place cookies in single layer on cookie sheet.
Melt margarine.
Add brown sugar and nuts. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Spread mixture over crackers.
Bake at 300u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes.
Cut or break into pieces.
recipes.text: Praline Bars. Spray cookie sheet with Pam spray. Place cookies in single layer on cookie sheet. Melt margarine. Add brown sugar and nuts. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Spread mixture over crackers. Bake at 300u00b0 for 15 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes. Cut or break into pieces.

recipes.title: Pecan Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Mix dough into balls; place 1 inch apart.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes, until cookies are set, not brown.
Remove; let stand to cool.
Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm.
recipes.text: Pecan Balls. Combine all ingredients. Mix dough into balls; place 1 inch apart. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes, until cookies are set, not brown. Remove; let stand to cool. Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm.

recipes.title: Twenty-Four Hour Salad
ingredients: 1 carton Cool Whip or whipping cream, whipped
directions: Mix jello in 2 cups of hot water and cool in refrigerator until partially set.
Beat cream cheese and sugar together.
Add jello and lemon juice and beat well.
Stir in Cool Whip until well blended.
Add marshmallows, oranges and crushed pineapple.
You may add one cup of white grape halves also, if you wish.
recipes.text: Twenty-Four Hour Salad. Mix jello in 2 cups of hot water and cool in refrigerator until partially set. Beat cream cheese and sugar together. Add jello and lemon juice and beat well. Stir in Cool Whip until well blended. Add marshmallows, oranges and crushed pineapple. You may add one cup of white grape halves also, if you wish.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake Topping
ingredients: 2 to 3 c. coconut (either flaked or Angel Flake)
directions: Bake any white cake mix.
When done, have already mixed the remaining ingredients.
Pour over warm cake and brown under broiler.
Watch closely.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake Topping. Bake any white cake mix. When done, have already mixed the remaining ingredients. Pour over warm cake and brown under broiler. Watch closely. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Creamy Parmesan Cheese Sauce
directions: Microwave cream cheese, milk and Parmesan cheese in 1 quart measure.
Microwave on Medium (50%) for 6 to 8 minutes or until sauce is smooth, stirring every 2 minutes.
Stir in seasonings. Toss with hot cooked pasta.
Can add diced turkey or crab.
recipes.text: Creamy Parmesan Cheese Sauce. Microwave cream cheese, milk and Parmesan cheese in 1 quart measure. Microwave on Medium (50%) for 6 to 8 minutes or until sauce is smooth, stirring every 2 minutes. Stir in seasonings. Toss with hot cooked pasta. Can add diced turkey or crab.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Cookies
directions: Cream together margarine and Jell-O.
Add egg and vanilla. Add flour and soda.
Drop on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Cookies. Cream together margarine and Jell-O. Add egg and vanilla. Add flour and soda. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 400u00b0 for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
directions: Mix all together.
Place into pastry-lined 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 400u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cream Pie. Mix all together. Place into pastry-lined 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 400u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pizza
directions: Stir together first 7 ingredients.
Press dough in a 12-inch pizza pan, forming a rim along the edge.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes.
Take out of oven.
Sprinkle with marshmallows and chocolate chips.
Bake for 5 to 8 minutes or until marshmallows are puffy and lightly browned.
Cool and cut.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pizza. Stir together first 7 ingredients. Press dough in a 12-inch pizza pan, forming a rim along the edge. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes. Take out of oven. Sprinkle with marshmallows and chocolate chips. Bake for 5 to 8 minutes or until marshmallows are puffy and lightly browned. Cool and cut.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease bottoms only of 1 loaf pan.
Combine flour, soda and sugar in medium mixing bowl.
In another bowl, lightly beat eggs.
Add oil and almond extract to eggs.
Add egg mixture to flour mixture and stir well.
Fold berries into batter. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Grease bottoms only of 1 loaf pan. Combine flour, soda and sugar in medium mixing bowl. In another bowl, lightly beat eggs. Add oil and almond extract to eggs. Add egg mixture to flour mixture and stir well. Fold berries into batter. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Cookie-N-Mint Chocolate Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Sift first four ingredients into a mixing bowl.
Add next three ingredients and mix.
Stir in crushed cookies.
Pour into greased and floured cake pan and bake for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Cookie-N-Mint Chocolate Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Sift first four ingredients into a mixing bowl. Add next three ingredients and mix. Stir in crushed cookies. Pour into greased and floured cake pan and bake for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Split Pie
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into a baking dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Banana Split Pie. Mix first 3 ingredients and press into a baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Coconut Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Cream margarine and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Add egg and coconut extract; beat well.
Stir in SpudFlakes and Bix-Mix.
Shape dough into 3/4-inch balls; arrange 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool on wire racks.
Makes about 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Coconut Cookies. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Cream margarine and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add egg and coconut extract; beat well. Stir in SpudFlakes and Bix-Mix. Shape dough into 3/4-inch balls; arrange 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on wire racks. Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Pico De Gallo(Rooster'S Beak)
ingredients: 1 to 2 Tbsp. fresh squeezed lemon or lime juice
directions: Cut tomatoes and cucumbers into small cubes.
Chop the onion and cilantro leaves.
Mince the jalapenos.
recipes.text: Pico De Gallo(Rooster'S Beak). Cut tomatoes and cucumbers into small cubes. Chop the onion and cilantro leaves. Mince the jalapenos.

recipes.title: Julie Moonan Dessert Pudding
directions: Cover bottom of 13 x 9-inch cooking dish with graham crackers. Put chocolate pudding on top of graham crackers.
Slice bananas, then next layer of graham crackers, the pudding (vanilla), then crushed graham crackers on top.
Chill for 1 hour, ready to serve.
recipes.text: Julie Moonan Dessert Pudding. Cover bottom of 13 x 9-inch cooking dish with graham crackers. Put chocolate pudding on top of graham crackers. Slice bananas, then next layer of graham crackers, the pudding (vanilla), then crushed graham crackers on top. Chill for 1 hour, ready to serve.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Bake crust.
Mix softened cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip.
Add strawberries. Pour into pie crust.
Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Pie. Bake crust. Mix softened cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Add strawberries. Pour into pie crust. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Coriander Pork
directions: Combine all ingredients except pork.
Marinate pork in mixture for 30 minutes. Grill over medium-hot coals for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once.
recipes.text: Coriander Pork. Combine all ingredients except pork. Marinate pork in mixture for 30 minutes. Grill over medium-hot coals for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Bonnie'S Beef Wellington
directions: Brown steaks on both sides.
Saute onion and mushrooms in butter and wine.
Defrost and roll out patty shells.
Place piece of meat on patty shell; add mixture of onion, mushrooms and wine to meat and wrap pastry around meat.
Bake for 20 minutes at 425u00b0. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Bonnie'S Beef Wellington. Brown steaks on both sides. Saute onion and mushrooms in butter and wine. Defrost and roll out patty shells. Place piece of meat on patty shell; add mixture of onion, mushrooms and wine to meat and wrap pastry around meat. Bake for 20 minutes at 425u00b0. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Low-Cal Sundae
ingredients: 1 small box cherry flavor sugarless Jell-O
1 small box sugarless no-cook vanilla pudding
low-fat whipped cream or Dream Whip (for garnish)
directions: Fills 5 or 6 cup-type dessert dishes.
recipes.text: Low-Cal Sundae. Fills 5 or 6 cup-type dessert dishes.

recipes.title: Butter Rum Rolls
directions: Roll frozen dough in melted margarine.
Let rise (2 1/2 hours).
Bake 12 to 15 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
Remove from oven and glaze with melted sugar, water and rum.
Drizzle mixture over top. Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Butter Rum Rolls. Roll frozen dough in melted margarine. Let rise (2 1/2 hours). Bake 12 to 15 minutes in 350u00b0 oven. Remove from oven and glaze with melted sugar, water and rum. Drizzle mixture over top. Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Funnel Cakes
directions: Mix egg and milk.
Sift together all other ingredients and gradually add to the milk mixture; beat until batter is smooth. Heat deep oil to 375u00b0.
Hold finger over the hole of a funnel, which has a hole dimension of 3/8 to 1/2-inch.
Fill funnel with batter.

Hold funnel as near surface of oil as possible, remove finger and drop batter into oil, using a circular movement from center outward to form a spiral cake, about 3-inches in diameter. It takes practice, remember to place finger on bottom of funnel as you form each cake.
Form as many in skillet as will float uncrowded.
Fry until cakes are puffy and golden brown, turning once.
Remove cakes with slotted spoon to a paper towel to drain. Sift lightly with powdered sugar with a little cinnamon added. Serve at once.
recipes.text: Funnel Cakes. Mix egg and milk. Sift together all other ingredients and gradually add to the milk mixture; beat until batter is smooth. Heat deep oil to 375u00b0. Hold finger over the hole of a funnel, which has a hole dimension of 3/8 to 1/2-inch. Fill funnel with batter. Hold funnel as near surface of oil as possible, remove finger and drop batter into oil, using a circular movement from center outward to form a spiral cake, about 3-inches in diameter. It takes practice, remember to place finger on bottom of funnel as you form each cake. Form as many in skillet as will float uncrowded. Fry until cakes are puffy and golden brown, turning once. Remove cakes with slotted spoon to a paper towel to drain. Sift lightly with powdered sugar with a little cinnamon added. Serve at once.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrot, Vicky
directions: Peel and slice carrots approximately 1/4-inch thick.
Place carrots in saucepan or straight sided saute pan.
Add enough water to barely cover carrots.
Add butter, sugar, salt and nutmeg. Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer.
Stir occasionally.
Simmer carrots until almost all water has evaporated and carrots are tender.
Toss carrots to coat with glaze.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
recipes.text: Glazed Carrot, Vicky. Peel and slice carrots approximately 1/4-inch thick. Place carrots in saucepan or straight sided saute pan. Add enough water to barely cover carrots. Add butter, sugar, salt and nutmeg. Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer. Stir occasionally. Simmer carrots until almost all water has evaporated and carrots are tender. Toss carrots to coat with glaze. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.

recipes.title: Raw Strawberry Pie
directions: Boil sugar, water and cornstarch until clear and add strawberry jello; cool slightly.
Pour over arranged berries pointed up in cooked pie crusts.
Serve with whipped cream.
Makes 3 pies.
recipes.text: Raw Strawberry Pie. Boil sugar, water and cornstarch until clear and add strawberry jello; cool slightly. Pour over arranged berries pointed up in cooked pie crusts. Serve with whipped cream. Makes 3 pies.

recipes.title: Sandra'S Very Rock Road Fudge
directions: In a 2-quart glass mixing bowl, cook sugar, 1 cup marshmallows, milk and butter in the microwave on High for 4 1/2 to 6 minutes until melted, stirring once during cooking. Stir; cook another 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in chocolate and vanilla until smooth. Fold in nuts and remaining marshmallows. Spread in a foil-lined pan. Size depends on how thick you want the fudge. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into pieces.
recipes.text: Sandra'S Very Rock Road Fudge. In a 2-quart glass mixing bowl, cook sugar, 1 cup marshmallows, milk and butter in the microwave on High for 4 1/2 to 6 minutes until melted, stirring once during cooking. Stir; cook another 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in chocolate and vanilla until smooth. Fold in nuts and remaining marshmallows. Spread in a foil-lined pan. Size depends on how thick you want the fudge. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Baked Corned Beef
directions: Beat eggs; add mustard, sugar, salt and vinegar.
Boil until thick, then spread this mixture on the fat side of corned beef. Place on rack in pan.
Cover with double fold foil wrap.
Pinch foil around sides of pan.
Bake for 7 hours at 260u00b0; cut thin to serve.
recipes.text: Baked Corned Beef. Beat eggs; add mustard, sugar, salt and vinegar. Boil until thick, then spread this mixture on the fat side of corned beef. Place on rack in pan. Cover with double fold foil wrap. Pinch foil around sides of pan. Bake for 7 hours at 260u00b0; cut thin to serve.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, place one layer cracker crumbs.
Add 1/2 can soup and place sliced boiled eggs on soup. Arrange asparagus and the remaining soup.
Top with cracker crumbs and butter. Bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, place one layer cracker crumbs. Add 1/2 can soup and place sliced boiled eggs on soup. Arrange asparagus and the remaining soup. Top with cracker crumbs and butter. Bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Yam Roll
directions: Beat eggs 5 minutes with electric mixer.
(This is an important step.)
Add all other ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into a 1 x 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan that has been well-greased and floured. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped nuts.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done.
When done, turn out on a tea towel that has been sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Cool. When cool, unroll and fill.
recipes.text: Yam Roll. Beat eggs 5 minutes with electric mixer. (This is an important step.) Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into a 1 x 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan that has been well-greased and floured. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes or until done. When done, turn out on a tea towel that has been sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll up like jelly roll. Cool. When cool, unroll and fill.

recipes.title: Mom'S Bread Pudding
directions: Heat milk to scalding (bubbles around edge of pan).
Pour milk over bread cubes.
Cool and add remaining ingredients.
Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Mom'S Bread Pudding. Heat milk to scalding (bubbles around edge of pan). Pour milk over bread cubes. Cool and add remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pain Perdu(Lost Bread)
directions: Beat eggs well.
Add sugar rapidly; continue to beat.
Add cornstarch and, when mixed, add milk, cinnamon and vanilla.
Dip bread slice in mixture, coating each side thoroughly.
Use just enough oil to cover bottom of skillet and fry over moderate heat. Fry each slice until golden brown.
Serve hot, sprinkled with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Pain Perdu(Lost Bread). Beat eggs well. Add sugar rapidly; continue to beat. Add cornstarch and, when mixed, add milk, cinnamon and vanilla. Dip bread slice in mixture, coating each side thoroughly. Use just enough oil to cover bottom of skillet and fry over moderate heat. Fry each slice until golden brown. Serve hot, sprinkled with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve strawberry Jell-O in boiling water.
Mix with electric mixer to the Jell-O mixture the cranberry sauce.
Lightly grease an 8 x 12-inch dish or 10 x 10-inch glass dish or a large bowl.
Pour 1/2 of mixture in dish; let set in refrigerator. Spread the sour cream over the set mixture.
Sprinkle the chopped pecans over the sour cream.
Carefully pour remaining Jell-O mixture over pecans; let set in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Dissolve strawberry Jell-O in boiling water. Mix with electric mixer to the Jell-O mixture the cranberry sauce. Lightly grease an 8 x 12-inch dish or 10 x 10-inch glass dish or a large bowl. Pour 1/2 of mixture in dish; let set in refrigerator. Spread the sour cream over the set mixture. Sprinkle the chopped pecans over the sour cream. Carefully pour remaining Jell-O mixture over pecans; let set in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter or margarine. Add and heat to boiling tomato sauce, mushrooms, olive, salt, pepper, garlic button, broth and chicken. Add cooked vermicelli and cheese. Heat at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Saute onion and celery in butter or margarine. Add and heat to boiling tomato sauce, mushrooms, olive, salt, pepper, garlic button, broth and chicken. Add cooked vermicelli and cheese. Heat at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
directions: Brown sausage and ground beef with onion in frying pan, crumbling into small pieces while cooking. Drain grease. Transfer beef/sausage mixture into crockpot. Add next four ingredients and mix well. Cook on low several hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Dip. Brown sausage and ground beef with onion in frying pan, crumbling into small pieces while cooking. Drain grease. Transfer beef/sausage mixture into crockpot. Add next four ingredients and mix well. Cook on low several hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Spanish Steak
directions: Cut meat into small pieces.
Brown in skillet with olive oil. Add chopped onions.
Cook until slightly brown.
Chop celery and green pepper fine.
Add to other ingredients and bring to a simmer.
Let simmer for 1 hour.
Serve over rice, noodles or macaroni that has been cooked separately.
recipes.text: Spanish Steak. Cut meat into small pieces. Brown in skillet with olive oil. Add chopped onions. Cook until slightly brown. Chop celery and green pepper fine. Add to other ingredients and bring to a simmer. Let simmer for 1 hour. Serve over rice, noodles or macaroni that has been cooked separately.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Bundt Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Generously grease and flour 12-cup Bundt cake pan.
Blend cake mix, sour cream, water and eggs on low speed until moistened.
Beat for 4 minutes on medium speed.
Fold in chocolate pieces; pour into pan.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center.
Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan.
Cool completely.
Spread cake with Caramel Glaze allowing some to drizzle down sides.
recipes.text: Double Chocolate Bundt Cake. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Generously grease and flour 12-cup Bundt cake pan. Blend cake mix, sour cream, water and eggs on low speed until moistened. Beat for 4 minutes on medium speed. Fold in chocolate pieces; pour into pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan. Cool completely. Spread cake with Caramel Glaze allowing some to drizzle down sides.

recipes.title: Pink Pina Colada Pie
directions: Spread coconut evenly in bottom of a 9-inch pie plate. Microwave on High for 4 to 6 minutes or golden brown.
Toss with fork every minute.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Pink Pina Colada Pie. Spread coconut evenly in bottom of a 9-inch pie plate. Microwave on High for 4 to 6 minutes or golden brown. Toss with fork every minute. Set aside.

recipes.title: Salmon Log
directions: Drain salmon. Combine next 6 ingredients with salmon. Shape into log and roll in nuts and parsley.
recipes.text: Salmon Log. Drain salmon. Combine next 6 ingredients with salmon. Shape into log and roll in nuts and parsley.

recipes.title: Scalloped Eggplant
directions: Peel eggplant; cube and cook until tender in salt water. Drain thoroughly.
Mash and season to taste.
Mash tomatoes and mix with eggplant, onion, eggs and cornbread crumbs.
Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole.
Add enough milk to cover well.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Scalloped Eggplant. Peel eggplant; cube and cook until tender in salt water. Drain thoroughly. Mash and season to taste. Mash tomatoes and mix with eggplant, onion, eggs and cornbread crumbs. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Add enough milk to cover well. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Southern Chicken Gumbo
directions: Saute onion in butter.
In large heavy pot, add all ingredients, except rice.
Bring to boil, stir in rice, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Southern Chicken Gumbo. Saute onion in butter. In large heavy pot, add all ingredients, except rice. Bring to boil, stir in rice, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Danish Apple Squares
ingredients: milk (add enough to egg to make 2/3 c.)
directions: Sift together flour and salt.
Cut in shortening until crumbly.
Add egg and milk mixture and blend.
Divide dough into 2 parts.
Roll half of the dough to fit 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan or an oblong baking pan.
Sprinkle bottom of crust of dough with corn flakes.
Combine apples, sugar and cinnamon. Spread mixture over corn flakes and put on top.
Pinch together to seal edges.
Beat egg white stiff and brush over top crust.
Bake in 400u00b0 or 375u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until golden.
Drizzle confectioners sugar over the cooked crust (1 cup confectioners sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and 1 to 2 tablespoons water).
recipes.text: Danish Apple Squares. Sift together flour and salt. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Add egg and milk mixture and blend. Divide dough into 2 parts. Roll half of the dough to fit 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan or an oblong baking pan. Sprinkle bottom of crust of dough with corn flakes. Combine apples, sugar and cinnamon. Spread mixture over corn flakes and put on top. Pinch together to seal edges. Beat egg white stiff and brush over top crust. Bake in 400u00b0 or 375u00b0 oven for 50 minutes or until golden. Drizzle confectioners sugar over the cooked crust (1 cup confectioners sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and 1 to 2 tablespoons water).

recipes.title: Tomato Sauce
directions: Cook cut up tomatoes, onions, green peppers and basil until vegetables are done.
Put through a colander.
Add salad oil, oregano, sugar, salt and tomato paste.
Cook until thick like sauce.
Put in jars, seal and process for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Tomato Sauce. Cook cut up tomatoes, onions, green peppers and basil until vegetables are done. Put through a colander. Add salad oil, oregano, sugar, salt and tomato paste. Cook until thick like sauce. Put in jars, seal and process for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Lazy Man'S Lasagna
directions: Brown green pepper, onion and hamburger in skillet.
Season to taste with garlic powder.
Cook macaroni as specified on box.
Mix hamburger mixture, spaghetti sauce, shredded cheese and macaroni in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan (add mushrooms, if desired).
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 to 3/4 hour, or until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Lazy Man'S Lasagna. Brown green pepper, onion and hamburger in skillet. Season to taste with garlic powder. Cook macaroni as specified on box. Mix hamburger mixture, spaghetti sauce, shredded cheese and macaroni in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan (add mushrooms, if desired). Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 to 3/4 hour, or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Broiled Feta Chicken
directions: Combine yogurt, garlic, rosemary and pepper in a shallow dish. Add chicken; turn to coat.
Refrigerate 1 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Broiled Feta Chicken. Combine yogurt, garlic, rosemary and pepper in a shallow dish. Add chicken; turn to coat. Refrigerate 1 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Burritos
directions: Soak tortillas in Pace.
Brown ground beef.
Drain off excess fat.
Stir in taco seasoning mix (no water) until meat is well coated.
Shake off picante from each tortilla.
Layer with beans, meat and sour cream.
Roll and place fold side down in baking dish.
Cover burritos with excess picante and grated cheese.
Bake until bubbly at 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Burritos. Soak tortillas in Pace. Brown ground beef. Drain off excess fat. Stir in taco seasoning mix (no water) until meat is well coated. Shake off picante from each tortilla. Layer with beans, meat and sour cream. Roll and place fold side down in baking dish. Cover burritos with excess picante and grated cheese. Bake until bubbly at 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Noodle Dish
ingredients: 3 c. finely shredded cabbage (1/2 small head)
directions: Peel and thinly slice onion.
You should have about 4 cups. Melt butter in a large skillet.
When it is hot, stir in onion, cabbage, sugar, salt and pepper.
Cook over very low heat, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes, or until onion and cabbage are softened.
Cook noodles as package directs.
Drain.
Sprinkle cabbage with a few drops vinegar to taste and toss to combine.
Add noodles to skillet and continue to cook until blended and all is heated through.
Serve.
recipes.text: Cabbage And Noodle Dish. Peel and thinly slice onion. You should have about 4 cups. Melt butter in a large skillet. When it is hot, stir in onion, cabbage, sugar, salt and pepper. Cook over very low heat, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes, or until onion and cabbage are softened. Cook noodles as package directs. Drain. Sprinkle cabbage with a few drops vinegar to taste and toss to combine. Add noodles to skillet and continue to cook until blended and all is heated through. Serve.

recipes.title: Old English Hot Spiced Cider
directions: Heat cider and sugar.
Combine together all the spices and wrap in a piece of cheesecloth.
(Will be easier to remove them after simmering.)
Simmer over low heat 15 to 20 minutes or until flavored to your liking.
Serve hot.
Great for holiday parties!
recipes.text: Old English Hot Spiced Cider. Heat cider and sugar. Combine together all the spices and wrap in a piece of cheesecloth. (Will be easier to remove them after simmering.) Simmer over low heat 15 to 20 minutes or until flavored to your liking. Serve hot. Great for holiday parties!

recipes.title: Italian Bow Knots
ingredients: about 4 c. flour (enough to make dough stiff and enough to roll dough out)
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients, kneading together with hands until smooth.
Divide into 3 portions.
Roll each portion out separately (about as thin as pastry).
Cut with pastry cutter or pizza wheel.
Tie into bows and drop carefully into hot oil; fry to light brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Dip in boiling honey or powder with confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Italian Bow Knots. Mix the first 4 ingredients, kneading together with hands until smooth. Divide into 3 portions. Roll each portion out separately (about as thin as pastry). Cut with pastry cutter or pizza wheel. Tie into bows and drop carefully into hot oil; fry to light brown. Drain on paper towels. Dip in boiling honey or powder with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Green Beans And Tomatoes
directions: Saute onion and green pepper in bacon grease.
Pour off excess grease.
Add tomatoes and all other ingredients, except bacon and beans. Cook, stirring, until veggies are soft. Add drained beans and bacon.
Serve hot. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Green Beans And Tomatoes. Saute onion and green pepper in bacon grease. Pour off excess grease. Add tomatoes and all other ingredients, except bacon and beans. Cook, stirring, until veggies are soft. Add drained beans and bacon. Serve hot. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each oregano, basil and black pepper
directions: Simmer 20 minutes.
Add tablespoon olive oil.
Simmer 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Marinara Sauce. Simmer 20 minutes. Add tablespoon olive oil. Simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake(Makes 12 Servings)
directions: Beat eggs.
Add sugar, oil, salt, soda, cinnamon and vanilla. Add flour, then carrots and nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake(Makes 12 Servings). Beat eggs. Add sugar, oil, salt, soda, cinnamon and vanilla. Add flour, then carrots and nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 2 c. warm water (105~ to 115~ or whatever that feels lukewarm on inside of wrist)
directions: Mix first three ingredients until fairly smooth.
(Use glass bowl or a crock, never metal.)
I cover crock of bread with a damp towel and place in a warm place for eight hours or overnight. Remove 1 cup of the mixture; store in refrigerator in a nonmetal container.
Do not cover too tightly as it is powerful.
To remainder of dough, add salt, sugar, baking soda and salad oil, mixing well.
Begin adding the flour with a wooden spoon until the mixture is no longer shiny and begins to leave the sides of the crock.
Begin mixing with the
hands on a bread board and knead for 8 to 10 minutes.
(May take longer.)
Also, the quantity of flour absorbed varies according to humidity.
Oil bowl and the top of the dough which has been shaped into a ball.
recipes.text: Sourdough Bread. Mix first three ingredients until fairly smooth. (Use glass bowl or a crock, never metal.) I cover crock of bread with a damp towel and place in a warm place for eight hours or overnight. Remove 1 cup of the mixture; store in refrigerator in a nonmetal container. Do not cover too tightly as it is powerful. To remainder of dough, add salt, sugar, baking soda and salad oil, mixing well. Begin adding the flour with a wooden spoon until the mixture is no longer shiny and begins to leave the sides of the crock. Begin mixing with the hands on a bread board and knead for 8 to 10 minutes. (May take longer.) Also, the quantity of flour absorbed varies according to humidity. Oil bowl and the top of the dough which has been shaped into a ball.

recipes.title: Turtles
directions: Removetwrappers
fromtcaramels.
Soften
slightly
in microwave.tFlatten
caramel
pieces.
In a double boiler melt chocolate chips and paraffin.
Stir.
Dip flattened caramel in chocolate to coat the bottom.
Layton wax paper.
Put 2 pecan halves on top of caramel.
Spoon melted chocolate on pecans to cover nuts and caramel.
recipes.text: Turtles. Removetwrappers fromtcaramels. Soften slightly in microwave.tFlatten caramel pieces. In a double boiler melt chocolate chips and paraffin. Stir. Dip flattened caramel in chocolate to coat the bottom. Layton wax paper. Put 2 pecan halves on top of caramel. Spoon melted chocolate on pecans to cover nuts and caramel.

recipes.title: Pancakes
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cut in butter; put in eggs and milk.
recipes.text: Pancakes. Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in butter; put in eggs and milk.

recipes.title: Cheese Rice Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook rice and broccoli as directed on package.
Blend all ingredients together in a Pyrex dish and sprinkle top with butter and cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350u00b0 until thoroughly heated.
recipes.text: Cheese Rice Broccoli Casserole. Cook rice and broccoli as directed on package. Blend all ingredients together in a Pyrex dish and sprinkle top with butter and cracker crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 until thoroughly heated.

recipes.title: Mary'S Irish Soda Bread
directions: Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder, sugar, salt, currants, raisins and caraway seed.
Add buttermilk and eggs.
Beat with a fork and stir into dry ingredients.
Bake 1 hour at 375u00b0.
Makes 2 large loaf cakes.
recipes.text: Mary'S Irish Soda Bread. Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder, sugar, salt, currants, raisins and caraway seed. Add buttermilk and eggs. Beat with a fork and stir into dry ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 375u00b0. Makes 2 large loaf cakes.

recipes.title: Billie'S Goodies
directions: Blend first 3 ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
Mix remaining ingredients; pour over hot crust.
Continue baking 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Billie'S Goodies. Blend first 3 ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over hot crust. Continue baking 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
directions: Layer apples in pie shell.
Mix together apple juice, cinnamon, nutmeg and cornstarch in a small saucepan.
Cook on low heat until thickened.
Pour over apples and place second pie crust on top.
Butter lightly and bake at 350u00b0 for 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Apple Pie. Layer apples in pie shell. Mix together apple juice, cinnamon, nutmeg and cornstarch in a small saucepan. Cook on low heat until thickened. Pour over apples and place second pie crust on top. Butter lightly and bake at 350u00b0 for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Coco Lopez Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 can Coco Lopez cream of coconut (8 oz.)
directions: Bake cake according to package instructions in 10 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0.
While still warm, poke holes in top with fork and pour Eagle Brand milk on top of cake.
Let cool.
After cooling, pour Coco Lopez over cake.
Refrigerate at least overnight.
Ice cake with Cool Whip and sprinkle coconut on top.
Keeps several days in refrigerator, if you can resist!
Serves 12 to 16 easily; it is very rich (and good!).
recipes.text: Coco Lopez Coconut Cake. Bake cake according to package instructions in 10 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0. While still warm, poke holes in top with fork and pour Eagle Brand milk on top of cake. Let cool. After cooling, pour Coco Lopez over cake. Refrigerate at least overnight. Ice cake with Cool Whip and sprinkle coconut on top. Keeps several days in refrigerator, if you can resist! Serves 12 to 16 easily; it is very rich (and good!).

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Melt cream cheese and margarine over low heat.
Add soup and onion; stir until smooth.
Mix with potatoes.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Melt cream cheese and margarine over low heat. Add soup and onion; stir until smooth. Mix with potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Meltaway Cookies
ingredients: almond and/or vanilla (to make soft dough)
directions: Mix the cornstarch, powdered sugar and flour.
Cut in the oleo.
To make a soft dough, add almond and/or vanilla.
Shape in small balls; roll in sugar.
Place on baking sheet.
Flatten with bottom of glass or cookie stamps.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Meltaway Cookies. Mix the cornstarch, powdered sugar and flour. Cut in the oleo. To make a soft dough, add almond and/or vanilla. Shape in small balls; roll in sugar. Place on baking sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass or cookie stamps. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes and enough water to cover in 4-quart saucepan; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium; cook 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
Drain well and mash potatoes, gradually stirring in salad dressing, cream cheese, onion powder, 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper until light and fluffy.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Casserole. Mix potatoes and enough water to cover in 4-quart saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium; cook 25 to 30 minutes or until tender. Drain well and mash potatoes, gradually stirring in salad dressing, cream cheese, onion powder, 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper until light and fluffy.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
directions: Toss chicken, celery, grapes, salt and mayonnaise.
Serve on lettuce.
Sprinkle with cashews.
Garnish with grapes.
Serve with Italian bread or crescent rolls.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad. Toss chicken, celery, grapes, salt and mayonnaise. Serve on lettuce. Sprinkle with cashews. Garnish with grapes. Serve with Italian bread or crescent rolls.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Roll in small balls and roll in powdered sugar.
Put on wax paper and put in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Candy. Mix all ingredients. Roll in small balls and roll in powdered sugar. Put on wax paper and put in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
directions: Brown meat; drain.
Add tomatoes, paste, water, onion and seasonings.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Fry tortillas in hot oil until softened; drain.
Place rounded tablespoonful of meat sauce and cheese on each tortilla.
Roll up tightly.
Place seam side down in an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish.
Top with remaining sauce and cheese.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Brown meat; drain. Add tomatoes, paste, water, onion and seasonings. Simmer 10 minutes. Fry tortillas in hot oil until softened; drain. Place rounded tablespoonful of meat sauce and cheese on each tortilla. Roll up tightly. Place seam side down in an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Top with remaining sauce and cheese. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttermilk (or add 1 tsp. vinegar to 1/2 c. milk)
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add one egg at a time, beating well after each.
Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and bananas.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 65 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Cream shortening and sugar. Add one egg at a time, beating well after each. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and bananas. Bake at 350u00b0 for 65 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine butter, sugar, and eggs. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients in order listed, one at a time. Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Combine butter, sugar, and eggs. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients in order listed, one at a time. Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Combine peanuts, sugar, Karo syrup and salt in a microwave safe dish and cook for 4 minutes on high.
Stir and cook 3 1/2 minutes more on high.
Stir and add butter and vanilla.
Cook for 1 1/2 minutes more.
Stir in baking soda.
Pour onto a greased cookie sheet and spread to desired thickness with a spatula.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Brittle. Combine peanuts, sugar, Karo syrup and salt in a microwave safe dish and cook for 4 minutes on high. Stir and cook 3 1/2 minutes more on high. Stir and add butter and vanilla. Cook for 1 1/2 minutes more. Stir in baking soda. Pour onto a greased cookie sheet and spread to desired thickness with a spatula.

recipes.title: Easy One Dish Ham Bake
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli cuts, rinsed and drained
3 c. cut up cooked ham, chicken, turkey or beef
directions: Heat oven to 450u00b0.
Mix broccoli, soups, 1 cup milk, the ham and onion powder in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix Bisquick mix and milk.
Pour evenly over soup mixture.
Sprinkle with parsley, if desired.
Bake 27 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Easy One Dish Ham Bake. Heat oven to 450u00b0. Mix broccoli, soups, 1 cup milk, the ham and onion powder in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix Bisquick mix and milk. Pour evenly over soup mixture. Sprinkle with parsley, if desired. Bake 27 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Dream Bars
directions: Sift together and set aside 1 cup flour, brown sugar and salt. Cut in until fine crumbled shortening.
Pat into greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Sift together and set aside 1/4 cup flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat until very thick eggs and brown sugar.
Add to flour mixture chocolate chips and vanilla.
Spread over baked mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Yield: 32 (2 x 1-inch) bars.
recipes.text: Dream Bars. Sift together and set aside 1 cup flour, brown sugar and salt. Cut in until fine crumbled shortening. Pat into greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sift together and set aside 1/4 cup flour, baking powder and salt. Beat until very thick eggs and brown sugar. Add to flour mixture chocolate chips and vanilla. Spread over baked mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yield: 32 (2 x 1-inch) bars.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: In a large skillet, put sugar, oleo and crushed pineapple and let bubble 5 minutes.
Place sliced pineapple around in skillet and add cherries for color.
Mix cake mix as directed on package and pour on top of pineapple.
Bake until cake is done.
Turn right side up on cake plate.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake. In a large skillet, put sugar, oleo and crushed pineapple and let bubble 5 minutes. Place sliced pineapple around in skillet and add cherries for color. Mix cake mix as directed on package and pour on top of pineapple. Bake until cake is done. Turn right side up on cake plate.

recipes.title: Ghostbuster Cake
directions: Follow directions on cake mix and bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Just before cake is done, mix rest of ingredients.
Cook in a pan on low heat until chocolate and marshmallows are melted; let come to a boil.
When cake is done, punch holes in it with a wooden spoon handle and pour icing over it while hot.
recipes.text: Ghostbuster Cake. Follow directions on cake mix and bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Just before cake is done, mix rest of ingredients. Cook in a pan on low heat until chocolate and marshmallows are melted; let come to a boil. When cake is done, punch holes in it with a wooden spoon handle and pour icing over it while hot.

recipes.title: Bobbie'S Fruit Compote
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks in its own juice
3/4 c. white wine or dry sherry
directions: Pour pineapple and juice over all fruit in baking pan.
Seal with double foil tightly.
Bake at 325u00b0 for one hour.
recipes.text: Bobbie'S Fruit Compote. Pour pineapple and juice over all fruit in baking pan. Seal with double foil tightly. Bake at 325u00b0 for one hour.

recipes.title: Prego Miracle Lasagne(Preparation:  5 Minutes.  Cook:  1 Hour.  Stand:  5 Minutes)
directions: In 2-quart baking dish (11 x 7-inch), spread 1 cup sauce. Top with 3 dry noodles, Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and 1 cup sauce. Top with remaining dry noodles and sauce; cover. Bake at 375u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Let stand 5 minutes. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Prego Miracle Lasagne(Preparation:  5 Minutes.  Cook:  1 Hour.  Stand:  5 Minutes). In 2-quart baking dish (11 x 7-inch), spread 1 cup sauce. Top with 3 dry noodles, Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and 1 cup sauce. Top with remaining dry noodles and sauce; cover. Bake at 375u00b0 for 1 hour. Top with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Let stand 5 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: German Skillet Supper
ingredients: 1/3 medium head cabbage, shredded or drained sauerkraut
directions: Brown beef in margarine.
Add other ingredients.
Cook, covered, over low heat 30 to 35 minutes without lifting the cover until rice is tender.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: German Skillet Supper. Brown beef in margarine. Add other ingredients. Cook, covered, over low heat 30 to 35 minutes without lifting the cover until rice is tender. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Slime(A Fat Free Dessert)
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
Chill and enjoy!
recipes.text: Slime(A Fat Free Dessert). Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Chill and enjoy!

recipes.title: Smoked Game Recipe
directions: The game soaks in the refrigerator 6 to 8 hours.
Then smoke as directed.
recipes.text: Smoked Game Recipe. The game soaks in the refrigerator 6 to 8 hours. Then smoke as directed.

recipes.title: 5 Cup Salad
ingredients: 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained and cut in half
1 can pineapple chunks, drained and cut in half
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: 5 Cup Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Quick Vichyssoise
ingredients: onion tops or chives, finely cut
1 (8 oz.) carton sour cream or low-fat yogurt
directions: Heat soup, milk and bouillon cubes over medium-low heat.
Add grated onion and blend.
Let cool and fold in sour cream.
Chill well.
Sprinkle with chives or onion tops prior to serving.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Quick Vichyssoise. Heat soup, milk and bouillon cubes over medium-low heat. Add grated onion and blend. Let cool and fold in sour cream. Chill well. Sprinkle with chives or onion tops prior to serving. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Cherry Sauce
directions: Bring mixture to a boil and thicken with cornstarch thickening.
Great to serve warm over gingerbread.
recipes.text: Cherry Sauce. Bring mixture to a boil and thicken with cornstarch thickening. Great to serve warm over gingerbread.

recipes.title: Hot Mocha Mix
directions: Combine all
ingredients and mix well.tStore mix in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Hot Mocha Mix. Combine all ingredients and mix well.tStore mix in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 small can Ortega green chili or 4 to 6 oz. salsa
1 1/2 c. each shredded Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheese
directions: Boil chicken.
When thoroughly cooked, shred meat.
Discard bones and skin.
In medium saucepan saute onion in margarine.
Add chicken, soups, chili or salsa and heat through.
In large glass baking dish, layer tortilla chips, chicken mixture and then cheese. Repeat layers.
Put in 350u00b0 oven and bake until top is slightly boiling and brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchilada Casserole. Boil chicken. When thoroughly cooked, shred meat. Discard bones and skin. In medium saucepan saute onion in margarine. Add chicken, soups, chili or salsa and heat through. In large glass baking dish, layer tortilla chips, chicken mixture and then cheese. Repeat layers. Put in 350u00b0 oven and bake until top is slightly boiling and brown.

recipes.title: Mom'S Rice Soup For Whatever Ailed You(Especially Good For Flu And Stomach Upsets)
ingredients: 1/2 c. river rice (not instant; Uncle Ben's is best)
several pinches salt (maybe a bit more)
directions: Brown
whole
onion
in
butter
and very little water. Some salt
may be added.
Add at least a quart more water and bring to a boil.
Add rice and cook about 15 minutes (not more or
less), then add macaroni and another pinch or so of salt; cook
about

Stir often.
Don't leave it.tAdd water if needed.
Now, add 2/3 quart of tomato juice. You

recipes.text: Mom'S Rice Soup For Whatever Ailed You(Especially Good For Flu And Stomach Upsets). Brown whole onion in butter and very little water. Some salt may be added. Add at least a quart more water and bring to a boil. Add rice and cook about 15 minutes (not more or less), then add macaroni and another pinch or so of salt; cook about 10 to 12 more minutes. Stir often. Don't leave it.tAdd water if needed. Now, add 2/3 quart of tomato juice. You cannot hurry Rice Soup. If you don't have 1/2 hour to stand near, don't start to make it.

recipes.title: Ground Meat Casserole
ingredients: 8 oz. frozen mixed vegetables, or 1 can mixed vegetables
directions: Spray Dutch oven or casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray. Crumble ground beef in bottom, then slice potatoes in 1/4 inch slices and spread over ground beef. Chop onions and sprinkle on top of potatoes. Add mixed vegetables. In a bowl, mix tomatoes, tomato sauce and vegetable soup. Stir and pour over all ingredients in Dutch oven. Bake at 375 or 400 degrees until potatoes are tender. If casserole starts to get dry, add a little water to finish baking.
recipes.text: Ground Meat Casserole. Spray Dutch oven or casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray. Crumble ground beef in bottom, then slice potatoes in 1/4 inch slices and spread over ground beef. Chop onions and sprinkle on top of potatoes. Add mixed vegetables. In a bowl, mix tomatoes, tomato sauce and vegetable soup. Stir and pour over all ingredients in Dutch oven. Bake at 375 or 400 degrees until potatoes are tender. If casserole starts to get dry, add a little water to finish baking.

recipes.title: Chicken Livers
directions: Heat 1/4 cup margarine in heavy saucepan.
Add onion and saute 2 to 3 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes.
Add rice and stir until rice just begins to brown.
Stir in boiling broth. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 10 minutes.
Add a little more broth if mixture is too dry.
Saute livers in remaining margarine, after dusting them with flour, until done.
Add seasoning.
Stir gently into rice mixture.
recipes.text: Chicken Livers. Heat 1/4 cup margarine in heavy saucepan. Add onion and saute 2 to 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes. Add rice and stir until rice just begins to brown. Stir in boiling broth. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Add a little more broth if mixture is too dry. Saute livers in remaining margarine, after dusting them with flour, until done. Add seasoning. Stir gently into rice mixture.

recipes.title: Betsy Goodie Bar
directions: In top of double boiler over simmering water melt chocolate with butter.
Remove from heat.
Beat in dry milk powder, peanut butter and vanilla with wire whisk or beater until fairly smooth. Stir in peanuts and raisins.
Spread in buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Chill until firm.
Cut into 48 2-inch bars.
recipes.text: Betsy Goodie Bar. In top of double boiler over simmering water melt chocolate with butter. Remove from heat. Beat in dry milk powder, peanut butter and vanilla with wire whisk or beater until fairly smooth. Stir in peanuts and raisins. Spread in buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into 48 2-inch bars.

recipes.title: Jello Pineapple Dessert
directions: Drain the juice from the crushed pineapple.
Heat juice until boiling, add jello to dissolved.
Add ice cream, stir until smooth.
Add crushed pineapple and refrigerate overnight.
Stir when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Jello Pineapple Dessert. Drain the juice from the crushed pineapple. Heat juice until boiling, add jello to dissolved. Add ice cream, stir until smooth. Add crushed pineapple and refrigerate overnight. Stir when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Scallop And Mushroom Pie
directions: Cut cleaned scallops into half, but do not cut the red coral. Simmer in milk with salt and pepper (to taste) for 15 minutes. Strain; reserve milk.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add flour and mix well.
Gradually stir in warm milk.
Avoid lumps.
Add mushrooms (cut in pieces).
Add the sherry and the scallops.
Place in ovenproof dish.
Cover top with mashed potato.
Dot with butter and bake at 350u00b0 until the top is lightly browned, about 20 to 30 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.
Soft rolls can be added to scallops, if available.
recipes.text: Scallop And Mushroom Pie. Cut cleaned scallops into half, but do not cut the red coral. Simmer in milk with salt and pepper (to taste) for 15 minutes. Strain; reserve milk. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and mix well. Gradually stir in warm milk. Avoid lumps. Add mushrooms (cut in pieces). Add the sherry and the scallops. Place in ovenproof dish. Cover top with mashed potato. Dot with butter and bake at 350u00b0 until the top is lightly browned, about 20 to 30 minutes. Garnish with parsley. Soft rolls can be added to scallops, if available.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Twists
directions: Bring cream to boil; add shortening, sugar, soda and salt. Mix well; cool.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix yeast with cream mixture.
Add flour; knead until smooth.
Cover with damp cloth 5 minutes.
Roll into rectangle 1/4-inch thick.
Spread with butter.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Twists. Bring cream to boil; add shortening, sugar, soda and salt. Mix well; cool. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix yeast with cream mixture. Add flour; knead until smooth. Cover with damp cloth 5 minutes. Roll into rectangle 1/4-inch thick. Spread with butter.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches broccoli, broken in bite size pieces
directions: Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
Pour over broccoli.
Add cheese; let set overnight in refrigerator.
Add bacon.
May add salt and pepper before serving.
Garnish with red onion slices (optional).
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar. Pour over broccoli. Add cheese; let set overnight in refrigerator. Add bacon. May add salt and pepper before serving. Garnish with red onion slices (optional). Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate
directions: Put all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Orange Julius. Put all ingredients in a blender. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Corned Beef And Chip Casserole
directions: Mix noodles, soup, milk, corned beef, cheese and onion. Pour into
a 1 1/2 quart greased baking dish.
Top with potato chips. Bake for 15 minutes in a 425u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Corned Beef And Chip Casserole. Mix noodles, soup, milk, corned beef, cheese and onion. Pour into a 1 1/2 quart greased baking dish. Top with potato chips. Bake for 15 minutes in a 425u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Sourdough Bread
directions: Mix in a clean bowl; let stand for 6 hours.
Add it and let stand for 3 hours; make sure the mixture bubbles up.
recipes.text: Sourdough Bread. Mix in a clean bowl; let stand for 6 hours. Add it and let stand for 3 hours; make sure the mixture bubbles up.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. milk (can sour with 1 tsp. vinegar)
directions: Cream oleo, oil and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and milk.
Blend well.
Mix dry ingredients together; add to creamed mixture.
Stir in zucchini.
Sprinkle with nuts and chips, after pouring batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 55 minutes.
(No need for frosting; zucchini makes cake moist, too.)
recipes.text: Zucchini Cake. Cream oleo, oil and sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and milk. Blend well. Mix dry ingredients together; add to creamed mixture. Stir in zucchini. Sprinkle with nuts and chips, after pouring batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 55 minutes. (No need for frosting; zucchini makes cake moist, too.)

recipes.title: Baked Potatoes
directions: Prick potatoes with fork and wrap in foil.
Fill the crock pot with potatoes.
Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or high 2 1/2 to 4 hours.
Do not add water.
No oven to heat up and they stay hot.
recipes.text: Baked Potatoes. Prick potatoes with fork and wrap in foil. Fill the crock pot with potatoes. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or high 2 1/2 to 4 hours. Do not add water. No oven to heat up and they stay hot.

recipes.title: M&M Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. M&M's plain chocolate candies (3/4 lb. pkg.)
directions: Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla thoroughly.
Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Add dry ingredients gradually to creamed mixture, mix well.
Stir in 1/2 cup M&M's candies; reserve remaining candies for decorating.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet.
Decorate tops of cookies with remaining M&M's candies.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. After baking some of the candies may be slightly cracked.
This adds texture and interest to your cookies, still the same delightful flavor.
Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.
recipes.text: M&M Cookies. Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla thoroughly. Sift together flour, soda and salt. Add dry ingredients gradually to creamed mixture, mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup M&M's candies; reserve remaining candies for decorating. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet. Decorate tops of cookies with remaining M&M's candies. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. After baking some of the candies may be slightly cracked. This adds texture and interest to your cookies, still the same delightful flavor. Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Orange Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Grate 1 1/2 teaspoons of the colored zest from the orange and squeeze 2 tablespoons juice.
Combine the flour, soda and salt. Beat butter, sugars and orange zest until fluffy.
Beat in egg yolk, vanilla and orange juice.
Beat in flour mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips with a spoon.
Drop by teaspoonfuls, about 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake until edges start to brown.
Let stand on baking sheets for 1 minute and remove to wire racks.
recipes.text: Orange Chocolate Chip Cookies. Grate 1 1/2 teaspoons of the colored zest from the orange and squeeze 2 tablespoons juice. Combine the flour, soda and salt. Beat butter, sugars and orange zest until fluffy. Beat in egg yolk, vanilla and orange juice. Beat in flour mixture. Stir in chocolate chips with a spoon. Drop by teaspoonfuls, about 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake until edges start to brown. Let stand on baking sheets for 1 minute and remove to wire racks.

recipes.title: Fresh Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 to 4 shakes Lea & Perrins Worcestershire sauce
directions: Remove stems and wash mushrooms thoroughly.
Melt margarine in heavy skillet with lid.
Place mushrooms in skillet, then add all ingredients.
Stir and cook on low with lid for approximately 30 minutes. Serve with grilled steaks.
Ingredients should be adjusted to satisfy individual taste.
recipes.text: Fresh Sauteed Mushrooms. Remove stems and wash mushrooms thoroughly. Melt margarine in heavy skillet with lid. Place mushrooms in skillet, then add all ingredients. Stir and cook on low with lid for approximately 30 minutes. Serve with grilled steaks. Ingredients should be adjusted to satisfy individual taste.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Mix water, oats and margarine and let stand 20 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients and pour into a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
When you remove from oven pour on topping and broil a few minutes until topping is bubbly.
Remove from oven and cool.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake. Mix water, oats and margarine and let stand 20 minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients and pour into a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. When you remove from oven pour on topping and broil a few minutes until topping is bubbly. Remove from oven and cool.

recipes.title: Lemon Velvet Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines lemon cake mix
directions: Beat all ingredients well.
Bake in a tube pan that has been greased and floured.
Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Lemon Velvet Cake. Beat all ingredients well. Bake in a tube pan that has been greased and floured. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Pecan Delight Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add vanilla, salt and sugar.
Beat until incorporated.
Add crackers and pecans.
Pour in greased pie plate and bake 30 minutes.
Let pie get completely cool.
Top with whipped topping.
Chopped pecans may be sprinkled on top.
recipes.text: Pecan Delight Pie. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add vanilla, salt and sugar. Beat until incorporated. Add crackers and pecans. Pour in greased pie plate and bake 30 minutes. Let pie get completely cool. Top with whipped topping. Chopped pecans may be sprinkled on top.

recipes.title: Basic Cream Sauce(Fat-Free)
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. cornstarch, dissolved in 2 Tbsp. cold water
directions: In medium-size saucepan over medium heat, bring milk, wine, pepper and nutmeg to a simmer, stirring to prevent scorching. Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook, stirring constantly, 3 to 4 minutes or until thickened and bubbly.
Makes 2 cups.
recipes.text: Basic Cream Sauce(Fat-Free). In medium-size saucepan over medium heat, bring milk, wine, pepper and nutmeg to a simmer, stirring to prevent scorching. Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook, stirring constantly, 3 to 4 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Easy All Occasion Punch
ingredients: 64 oz. Hawaiian Punch (may use lite punch)
directions: Put sherbet in a bowl approximately 30 minutes before serving. Just before serving, pour Hawaiian Punch over softened sherbet and fold.
recipes.text: Easy All Occasion Punch. Put sherbet in a bowl approximately 30 minutes before serving. Just before serving, pour Hawaiian Punch over softened sherbet and fold.

recipes.title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Place 4 or 5 noodles in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread 1/2 beef and bean mixture on top of noodles. Top with 4 or 5 noodles. Spread rest of beef and bean mixture on top.
Top with rest of noodles. Combine water and salsa. Pour on top of everything.
Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Combine sour cream, onion and olives. Spoon over casserole. Top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer, uncovered, or until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Mexican Lasagna. Combine first 4 ingredients. Place 4 or 5 noodles in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread 1/2 beef and bean mixture on top of noodles. Top with 4 or 5 noodles. Spread rest of beef and bean mixture on top. Top with rest of noodles. Combine water and salsa. Pour on top of everything. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Combine sour cream, onion and olives. Spoon over casserole. Top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes longer, uncovered, or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Biscuits
directions: Stir together flour, baking powder, sugar, cream of tartar and salt.
Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Make a well in center; add milk all at once.
Stir just until dough clings together.
On a lightly floured surface, knead gently 10 to 12 strokes.
Roll or pat to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut with a 2 1/2-inch cutter, dipping cutter into flour between cuts.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 450u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.
Serve warm.
Makes 10 (2 1/2-inch) biscuits.
recipes.text: Biscuits. Stir together flour, baking powder, sugar, cream of tartar and salt. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Make a well in center; add milk all at once. Stir just until dough clings together. On a lightly floured surface, knead gently 10 to 12 strokes. Roll or pat to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with a 2 1/2-inch cutter, dipping cutter into flour between cuts. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 450u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Serve warm. Makes 10 (2 1/2-inch) biscuits.

recipes.title: Haystacks
directions: Melt the butterscotch chips in a saucepan over medium heat. When the chips have melted, add the peanut butter and remove from heat.
Stir well.
Pour in chow mein noodles.
Mix thoroughly. Drop the mixture by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
These will form "haystacks".
Let the haystacks cool and harden for 1/2 hour in refrigerator.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Haystacks. Melt the butterscotch chips in a saucepan over medium heat. When the chips have melted, add the peanut butter and remove from heat. Stir well. Pour in chow mein noodles. Mix thoroughly. Drop the mixture by teaspoon onto waxed paper. These will form "haystacks". Let the haystacks cool and harden for 1/2 hour in refrigerator. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Kisses
directions: Mix well.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 12 minutes.
Roll in 4x sugar.
recipes.text: Chocolate Kisses. Mix well. Bake at 275u00b0 for 12 minutes. Roll in 4x sugar.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Place flour and salt in large bowl.
Cream sugar and margarine in separate bowl, then add boiling water.
Melt yeast in warm water.
Add cold water to bowl with sugar and margarine, then quickly add yeast mixture and eggs and beat until smooth.
Pour that mixture into flour mixture and mix well with wooden spoon. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to one week.
To make cloverleaf dinner rolls, pinch off three walnut sized pieces of dough and place in cupcake tin side by side.
Bake 15 minutes at 400u00b0 or until golden.
Excellent, quick and easy!
recipes.text: Refrigerator Rolls. Place flour and salt in large bowl. Cream sugar and margarine in separate bowl, then add boiling water. Melt yeast in warm water. Add cold water to bowl with sugar and margarine, then quickly add yeast mixture and eggs and beat until smooth. Pour that mixture into flour mixture and mix well with wooden spoon. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to one week. To make cloverleaf dinner rolls, pinch off three walnut sized pieces of dough and place in cupcake tin side by side. Bake 15 minutes at 400u00b0 or until golden. Excellent, quick and easy!

recipes.title: Salted Nut Roll
directions: Combine caramels and evaporated milk in top of double boiler. Heat until caramels are melted. Remove from heat.
Add 1/4 cup butter.
Mix well until melted.
Add 1 cup powdered sugar. Cool slightly.
Drop by teaspoonfuls into a dish of salted peanuts. Form into log. Roll until coated with nuts.
Place on waxed paper. Makes about 50.
recipes.text: Salted Nut Roll. Combine caramels and evaporated milk in top of double boiler. Heat until caramels are melted. Remove from heat. Add 1/4 cup butter. Mix well until melted. Add 1 cup powdered sugar. Cool slightly. Drop by teaspoonfuls into a dish of salted peanuts. Form into log. Roll until coated with nuts. Place on waxed paper. Makes about 50.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Pecan Pie
directions: Mix first three ingredients, heat until dissolved.
Add remaining ingredients, mix thoroughly.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Pecan Pie. Mix first three ingredients, heat until dissolved. Add remaining ingredients, mix thoroughly. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies From Old Oatmeal Box
directions: Beat shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla until creamy. Mix together flour, salt and soda.
Add to creamed mixture; blend well.
Stir in oats.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake in preheated oven (325u00b0 to 350u00b0) for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies From Old Oatmeal Box. Beat shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla until creamy. Mix together flour, salt and soda. Add to creamed mixture; blend well. Stir in oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated oven (325u00b0 to 350u00b0) for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Chocolate Philly Fudge
directions: Place cream cheese in a bowl and cream until soft and smooth. Slowly blend in sugar.
Add salt and melted chocolate; mix well. Add vanilla and cream and mix until well blended.
Fold in marshmallows.
Press into well greased pan.
Place in refrigerator until firm, about 15 minutes.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Marshmallow Chocolate Philly Fudge. Place cream cheese in a bowl and cream until soft and smooth. Slowly blend in sugar. Add salt and melted chocolate; mix well. Add vanilla and cream and mix until well blended. Fold in marshmallows. Press into well greased pan. Place in refrigerator until firm, about 15 minutes. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Chocolate Orange Torte
directions: Using a sharp knife, cut cake into 4 thin lengthwise layers. Place bottom cake layer on a platter; spread with 1/3 cup marmalade.
Place second layer on top; spread with 1/3 chocolate frosting.
Place next layer on top; spread with remaining marmalade.
Place final layer on top; frost top and sides of cake with chocolate frosting.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Cut into thin slices.
Delicious and simple to make.
recipes.text: Chocolate Orange Torte. Using a sharp knife, cut cake into 4 thin lengthwise layers. Place bottom cake layer on a platter; spread with 1/3 cup marmalade. Place second layer on top; spread with 1/3 chocolate frosting. Place next layer on top; spread with remaining marmalade. Place final layer on top; frost top and sides of cake with chocolate frosting.
