Refrigerate until ready to serve. Cut into thin slices. Delicious and simple to make.

recipes.title: Glaze Strawberry Pie
directions: Line baked shell with 3 cups berries.
Simmer 1 cup berries and water for 4 minutes.
Combine cornstarch and sugar; add to cooked fruit and cook until syrup is thick and clear, stirring constantly.
Add lemon juice; cool slightly and pour over berries in shell.
Chill thoroughly.
Serve with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Glaze Strawberry Pie. Line baked shell with 3 cups berries. Simmer 1 cup berries and water for 4 minutes. Combine cornstarch and sugar; add to cooked fruit and cook until syrup is thick and clear, stirring constantly. Add lemon juice; cool slightly and pour over berries in shell. Chill thoroughly. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Chinese Savory Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs. lean beef, cut in 1 1/2 in. squares (may use very tough meat)
directions: Heat oil in heavy skillet or Dutch oven.
Add the lean beef and quick-fry until brown.
Add and quick-fry a few minutes:
3 scallions or onion, cloves of garlic and ginger.
Add soy sauce, brown sugar, pepper and water.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 3 hours.
Add more liquid if needed.
Just before serving, thicken with small amount of flour, if desired.
Serve over rice or noodles.
recipes.text: Chinese Savory Beef. Heat oil in heavy skillet or Dutch oven. Add the lean beef and quick-fry until brown. Add and quick-fry a few minutes: 3 scallions or onion, cloves of garlic and ginger. Add soy sauce, brown sugar, pepper and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 3 hours. Add more liquid if needed. Just before serving, thicken with small amount of flour, if desired. Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 tsp. each cayenne pepper and paprika
directions: Heat oil in skillet or deep fryer.
Add pepper, salt, cayenne, paprika and garlic powder to chicken.
Cover chicken with flour.
recipes.text: Fried Chicken. Heat oil in skillet or deep fryer. Add pepper, salt, cayenne, paprika and garlic powder to chicken. Cover chicken with flour.

recipes.title: Edna'S Casserole
directions: Dice onion and add to ground beef.
Brown hamburger and onion. Drain.
Add Ranch Style beans (drain first) and Spanish rice. Slice green and black olives in half and arrange on top of casserole.
Tear or cut cheese in strips and arrange on top of casserole also.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven until the cheese is melted. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Edna'S Casserole. Dice onion and add to ground beef. Brown hamburger and onion. Drain. Add Ranch Style beans (drain first) and Spanish rice. Slice green and black olives in half and arrange on top of casserole. Tear or cut cheese in strips and arrange on top of casserole also. Bake in 350u00b0 oven until the cheese is melted. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Tiny Apple Cheesecakes
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Place paper liners in eight (1/3-cup) muffin cups.
Place a cookie in bottom of each; set aside.
In a small skillet, melt butter.
Add apples; cook and stir until tender, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon; spoon over cookies.
With an electric mixer beat cream cheese, egg, sour cream, vanilla and remaining 5 tablespoons sugar until smooth.
Spoon over apples. Bake until set, 25 to 28 minutes.
Cool on a rack; remove cakes.
Cover and refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours.
Garnish with sour cream, apple slices and crushed vanilla wafers.
recipes.text: Tiny Apple Cheesecakes. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Place paper liners in eight (1/3-cup) muffin cups. Place a cookie in bottom of each; set aside. In a small skillet, melt butter. Add apples; cook and stir until tender, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon; spoon over cookies. With an electric mixer beat cream cheese, egg, sour cream, vanilla and remaining 5 tablespoons sugar until smooth. Spoon over apples. Bake until set, 25 to 28 minutes. Cool on a rack; remove cakes. Cover and refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours. Garnish with sour cream, apple slices and crushed vanilla wafers.

recipes.title: Spanish Style Carrots And Celery
directions: Brown onion and green pepper in oil.
Add carrots, celery and seasonings.
Cover with tomato sauce and water.
Cover.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 1 hour.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Spanish Style Carrots And Celery. Brown onion and green pepper in oil. Add carrots, celery and seasonings. Cover with tomato sauce and water. Cover. Bake at 400u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Steak Sauce
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) bottle Major Grey's chutney (found in gourmet food section)
directions: Put chutney in blender and grind up all fruit.
Put this and remainder in large bowl and mix.
Save all bottles and put steak sauce back into these bottles.
recipes.text: Steak Sauce. Put chutney in blender and grind up all fruit. Put this and remainder in large bowl and mix. Save all bottles and put steak sauce back into these bottles.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Cream shortening, peanut butter and sugars.
Add egg, milk and vanilla.
Beat well.
Blend dry ingredients gradually; mix thoroughly.
Shape into round balls about 1-inch.
Roll in sugar and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 minutes.
Remove from oven and place a chocolate kiss on each cookie by pressing down.
Return to oven for a minute or two.
recipes.text: Peanut Blossom Cookies. Mix dry ingredients. Cream shortening, peanut butter and sugars. Add egg, milk and vanilla. Beat well. Blend dry ingredients gradually; mix thoroughly. Shape into round balls about 1-inch. Roll in sugar and place on cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 minutes. Remove from oven and place a chocolate kiss on each cookie by pressing down. Return to oven for a minute or two.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
directions: Mix together and put in 2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle top with stuffing mix or cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix together and put in 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle top with stuffing mix or cracker crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: "Easy" Mayonnaise Cake
ingredients: 1 c. chocolate cake mix with pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into lightly greased and floured pan.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: "Easy" Mayonnaise Cake. Mix all ingredients together. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour into lightly greased and floured pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Toll House Pan Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
In a small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt.
Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine oleo, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla.
Beat until creamy.
Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture; mix well.
Stir in bits and nuts. Spread into a greased 15 x 10-inch pan.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool; cut into squares.
recipes.text: Toll House Pan Cookies. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. In a small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt. Set aside. In a large bowl, combine oleo, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture; mix well. Stir in bits and nuts. Spread into a greased 15 x 10-inch pan. Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool; cut into squares.

recipes.title: Italian Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. sliced green onions with tops
directions: Cook macaroni; drain well.
While still hot, toss with Italian dressing; let stand 30 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and chill.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Italian Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni; drain well. While still hot, toss with Italian dressing; let stand 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and chill. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Real Good Bran Muffins
directions: Soak all bran in milk.tCream butter, brown sugar, eggs and salt.
Addtflour,tmolasses and baking soda in hot water. Add all bran
mixture and dates or raisins.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes
about 40 medium muffins.
Dough can be put in icebox a few days
to
bake
later.
Muffins
can
alsotbe frozen.
recipes.text: Real Good Bran Muffins. Soak all bran in milk.tCream butter, brown sugar, eggs and salt. Addtflour,tmolasses and baking soda in hot water. Add all bran mixture and dates or raisins. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes about 40 medium muffins. Dough can be put in icebox a few days to bake later. Muffins can alsotbe frozen.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix well. Dip your favorite fruit (strawberries, bananas, oranges, apples, etc.). Enjoy.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Mix well. Dip your favorite fruit (strawberries, bananas, oranges, apples, etc.). Enjoy.

recipes.title: Best Of All Fruitcakes(Really, It Will Make Your Grandmother Jealous!)
ingredients: 1/2 c. dark rum or brandy (I prefer cognac)
directions: Read completely before starting:
recipes.text: Best Of All Fruitcakes(Really, It Will Make Your Grandmother Jealous!). Read completely before starting:

recipes.title: Squash Croquettes
directions: Cook squash in small amount of water until tender.
Drain very well.
Mash squash; add other ingredients except meal.
Add more bread crumbs if necessary for easy handling.
Form into oblong croquettes and roll in meal.
Deep fat fry until golden brown.
recipes.text: Squash Croquettes. Cook squash in small amount of water until tender. Drain very well. Mash squash; add other ingredients except meal. Add more bread crumbs if necessary for easy handling. Form into oblong croquettes and roll in meal. Deep fat fry until golden brown.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
directions: In covered 2 1/2 quart casserole, cook onions and oleo on high for 10 minutes.
Stir in broth, Worcestershire sauce and salt. Cover.
Cook on high for 5 minutes and spoon into soup bowls suitable for microwave use.
Sprinkle toast with cheese and float on top of soup.
Microwave on high for 30 seconds.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. In covered 2 1/2 quart casserole, cook onions and oleo on high for 10 minutes. Stir in broth, Worcestershire sauce and salt. Cover. Cook on high for 5 minutes and spoon into soup bowls suitable for microwave use. Sprinkle toast with cheese and float on top of soup. Microwave on high for 30 seconds.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Mexican style beans or pinto beans
1 can chicken soup (or may use cream of mushroom soup)
1 can stewed tomatoes (or more green chilies)
directions: Line large baking dish with tortillas.
Brown hamburger and onion; drain.
Add beans, enchilada sauce and chicken or mushroom soup.
Add green chilies.
Pour over tortillas; add grated cheese over layered tortillas.
Top with stewed tomatoes or more green chilies.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350u00b0.
Delicious.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Line large baking dish with tortillas. Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add beans, enchilada sauce and chicken or mushroom soup. Add green chilies. Pour over tortillas; add grated cheese over layered tortillas. Top with stewed tomatoes or more green chilies. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350u00b0. Delicious.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Apple Cobbler
directions: Spread apples in two 9 x 13-inch pans.
Mix together 3/4 cup sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Sprinkle over apples.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Apple Cobbler. Spread apples in two 9 x 13-inch pans. Mix together 3/4 cup sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle over apples.

recipes.title: Chicken Or Fish Cooked In Wok(Serves 4)
ingredients: 4 (4 oz.) fish fillets or chicken breasts, cut up
directions: Preheat wok.
Add 2 tablespoons salad dressing and fish fillets or chicken.
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons chicken soup over fish or chicken.
Watch closely and stir often.
Just a few minutes before hot, add fresh or partially thawed frozen vegetables. Cover and let simmer until done.
recipes.text: Chicken Or Fish Cooked In Wok(Serves 4). Preheat wok. Add 2 tablespoons salad dressing and fish fillets or chicken. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons chicken soup over fish or chicken. Watch closely and stir often. Just a few minutes before hot, add fresh or partially thawed frozen vegetables. Cover and let simmer until done.

recipes.title: Key Lime Cake
directions: Mix cake mix and gelatin.
Add orange juice.
Mix thoroughly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add oil.
Stir in thoroughly.
Grease and flour three 9-inch layer pans or a 9 x 11-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until done.
Mix margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar thoroughly.
Add chopped pecans, if desired.
recipes.text: Key Lime Cake. Mix cake mix and gelatin. Add orange juice. Mix thoroughly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add oil. Stir in thoroughly. Grease and flour three 9-inch layer pans or a 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until done. Mix margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar thoroughly. Add chopped pecans, if desired.

recipes.title: Peaches And Cream Punch
ingredients: 2 c. (1 pt.) frozen low-fat vanilla yogurt
directions: In a teapot, pour boiling water over tea bags. Cover and brew for 5 minutes. Cool.
In a chilled 4-quart punch bowl, blend peach nectar with tea.
Add champagne or seltzer.
Top with scoops of yogurt and garnish, if desired, with fresh peach slices.
Serve immediately.
Makes 24 (4 ounce) servings.
recipes.text: Peaches And Cream Punch. In a teapot, pour boiling water over tea bags. Cover and brew for 5 minutes. Cool. In a chilled 4-quart punch bowl, blend peach nectar with tea. Add champagne or seltzer. Top with scoops of yogurt and garnish, if desired, with fresh peach slices. Serve immediately. Makes 24 (4 ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Unfried Fried Chicken(Serves 6)
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Spray a baking sheet with three coats of vegetable oil spray.
Combine chicken and ice water in large bowl. Put yogurt in a medium bowl, set bowl aside.
recipes.text: Unfried Fried Chicken(Serves 6). Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Spray a baking sheet with three coats of vegetable oil spray. Combine chicken and ice water in large bowl. Put yogurt in a medium bowl, set bowl aside.

recipes.title: Round Steak Sauerbraten
directions: Cut meat in 1-inch squares.
In a large skillet, brown meat on all sides in hot fat.
Remove meat from skillet.
Add gravy mix and water.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Stir in remaining ingredients, except noodles or rice.
recipes.text: Round Steak Sauerbraten. Cut meat in 1-inch squares. In a large skillet, brown meat on all sides in hot fat. Remove meat from skillet. Add gravy mix and water. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Stir in remaining ingredients, except noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Peppers Stuffed With Sausage
directions: Wash peppers and remove seeds.
Boil for 5 minutes in water to cover.
Remove from water and fill with the meat, rice, salt and strained tomatoes which have been mixed together.
Place in baking dish, add the boiling water and bake at 400u00b0 for 1 hour.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Peppers Stuffed With Sausage. Wash peppers and remove seeds. Boil for 5 minutes in water to cover. Remove from water and fill with the meat, rice, salt and strained tomatoes which have been mixed together. Place in baking dish, add the boiling water and bake at 400u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Noodles Ole
directions: Cook noodles.
While noodles cook, brown meat and onion in skillet.
Drain grease from meat and add the corn, tomato soup, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Simmer meat mixture. In a large casserole dish, alternate layers of noodles and meat mixture.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Noodles Ole. Cook noodles. While noodles cook, brown meat and onion in skillet. Drain grease from meat and add the corn, tomato soup, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt and pepper. Simmer meat mixture. In a large casserole dish, alternate layers of noodles and meat mixture. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and nuts.
Set aside.
Beat eggs slightly in a large mixing bowl.
Add sugar, oil and vanilla.
Beat until creamy.
Stir in zucchini and pineapple.
Add dry ingredients, stirring only until moistened. Spoon batter into two well-greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Cool 10 minutes.
Remove from pan.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Combine flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and nuts. Set aside. Beat eggs slightly in a large mixing bowl. Add sugar, oil and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients, stirring only until moistened. Spoon batter into two well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan.

recipes.title: Pickled Shrimp
directions: Place shrimp and onions in layers in a sealable container. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp.
seal. Refrigerate for 6 or more hours.
Shake occasionally.
This will keep for over a week.
recipes.text: Pickled Shrimp. Place shrimp and onions in layers in a sealable container. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp. seal. Refrigerate for 6 or more hours. Shake occasionally. This will keep for over a week.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb. pork and 1 lb. ham, ground together
directions: Mix and put in bread pan.
Use lid or aluminum foil.
recipes.text: Ham Loaf. Mix and put in bread pan. Use lid or aluminum foil.

recipes.title: Beef In Cheese Crescents
directions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.
Brown beef with onion, drain.
Stir in barbecue sauce, set aside.
Unroll dough into 4 long rectangles on ungreased cookie sheet.
Overlap long sides; firmly press perforations and edges to seal.
Form a 15 x 13 inch rectangle. Spread meat mixture lengthwise in a 4 inch wide strip, down center of dough to with in one inch of ends.
Top with cheese.
Fold shorter sides of dough 1 inch over filling.
Bring long sides of dough over filling, over lapping edges; pinch edges to seal. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 20- 25 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Beef In Cheese Crescents. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Brown beef with onion, drain. Stir in barbecue sauce, set aside. Unroll dough into 4 long rectangles on ungreased cookie sheet. Overlap long sides; firmly press perforations and edges to seal. Form a 15 x 13 inch rectangle. Spread meat mixture lengthwise in a 4 inch wide strip, down center of dough to with in one inch of ends. Top with cheese. Fold shorter sides of dough 1 inch over filling. Bring long sides of dough over filling, over lapping edges; pinch edges to seal. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake for 20- 25 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Ham Salad
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions.
Add celery, onion and pepper.
Cook and chill broccoli flowerets.
Add mayonnaise, sugar, Cheddar cheese and shredded ham.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Ham Salad. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Add celery, onion and pepper. Cook and chill broccoli flowerets. Add mayonnaise, sugar, Cheddar cheese and shredded ham. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pudding
directions: Drain liquid from potatoes; set aside.
Empty potatoes in medium size mixing bowl.
In separate bowl, add brown sugar and maple syrup.
Mix with mixer until creamy.
Add nuts and 1/2 cup of potato liquid.
Put potatoes in greased pan and pour liquid over them.
Bake at 350u00b0 about 45 minutes until knife comes out clean from center.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pudding. Drain liquid from potatoes; set aside. Empty potatoes in medium size mixing bowl. In separate bowl, add brown sugar and maple syrup. Mix with mixer until creamy. Add nuts and 1/2 cup of potato liquid. Put potatoes in greased pan and pour liquid over them. Bake at 350u00b0 about 45 minutes until knife comes out clean from center.

recipes.title: Cocoa
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together.
Gradually add the water.
Boil for 5 minutes, stirring all the time.
Add the evaporated milk.
Heat; do not boil.
Add the vanilla.
recipes.text: Cocoa. Mix the first 3 ingredients together. Gradually add the water. Boil for 5 minutes, stirring all the time. Add the evaporated milk. Heat; do not boil. Add the vanilla.

recipes.title: Baked Bean And Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion in a small amount of fat.
Drain. Combine remaining ingredients; add to meat mixture.
Pour into casserole dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Bean And Hamburger Casserole. Brown meat and onion in a small amount of fat. Drain. Combine remaining ingredients; add to meat mixture. Pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese Sauce
directions: Cook macaroni; drain.
Melt butter; add flour and seasonings. Stir until smooth and well blended.
Gradually add milk; cook until thick.
Add cheese; cook until melted.
Combine with macaroni.
Place in greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Macaroni And Cheese Sauce. Cook macaroni; drain. Melt butter; add flour and seasonings. Stir until smooth and well blended. Gradually add milk; cook until thick. Add cheese; cook until melted. Combine with macaroni. Place in greased casserole dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Navajo Fry Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add lard until mixture is like coarse crumbs.
Stir in water. Knead on floured surface. Divide dough into balls. Cover and let rest. Roll each ball into flat circle. Make hole in center.
Fry each one in hot fat until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Makes about 8.
recipes.text: Navajo Fry Bread. Sift dry ingredients together. Add lard until mixture is like coarse crumbs. Stir in water. Knead on floured surface. Divide dough into balls. Cover and let rest. Roll each ball into flat circle. Make hole in center. Fry each one in hot fat until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Makes about 8.

recipes.title: Chicken Caliente
ingredients: 1 can of cream of chicken soup
1 can rotel tomatoes, drained and chopped
directions: In 13 x 9 casserole, place layer of chicken (1/2) - sprinkle with half the chili powder and garlic salt, then 1/2 of soup mixture (soups, broth, tomatoes). Then layer of tortillas. Top with 1/2 the onion, green pepper and grated cheese. Repeat layers. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Serves 6 - 8.
recipes.text: Chicken Caliente. In 13 x 9 casserole, place layer of chicken (1/2) - sprinkle with half the chili powder and garlic salt, then 1/2 of soup mixture (soups, broth, tomatoes). Then layer of tortillas. Top with 1/2 the onion, green pepper and grated cheese. Repeat layers. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Serves 6 - 8.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
ingredients: 2 small boxes instant French vanilla pudding
1 small container ready-made milk chocolate icing
directions: Cover 9 x 13-inch rectangular dish with graham crackers. Combine pudding mix with milk.
Mix pudding and whipped topping. Pour half of the mixture on crackers.
Place another layer of crackers.
Pour in the rest of the mixture.
Place a layer of crackers on the top.
Microwave icing slightly, so to soften. Pour icing over crackers and spread evenly.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair Cake. Cover 9 x 13-inch rectangular dish with graham crackers. Combine pudding mix with milk. Mix pudding and whipped topping. Pour half of the mixture on crackers. Place another layer of crackers. Pour in the rest of the mixture. Place a layer of crackers on the top. Microwave icing slightly, so to soften. Pour icing over crackers and spread evenly. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Brown hamburger with 1/2 package of taco seasoning; drain. Warm refried beans and mix with remaining package of taco seasoning.
In your casserole dish, bottom layer of refried beans. Next, layer hamburger.
Then add sour cream and next salsa.
Final step, shredded cheese on top.
Put in oven at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts.
Serve warm with chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Brown hamburger with 1/2 package of taco seasoning; drain. Warm refried beans and mix with remaining package of taco seasoning. In your casserole dish, bottom layer of refried beans. Next, layer hamburger. Then add sour cream and next salsa. Final step, shredded cheese on top. Put in oven at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve warm with chips.

recipes.title: Grandma Annie'S Plain Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs.
Mix in flour and baking powder.
Add alternately with milk.
Add vanilla.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until done.
Serve with fruit and topping.
A great cake for serving with strawberries.
Serves 10.
recipes.text: Grandma Annie'S Plain Cake. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Mix in flour and baking powder. Add alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes until done. Serve with fruit and topping. A great cake for serving with strawberries. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Brownies By Pam Murphy
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan at 325u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Brownies By Pam Murphy. Combine all ingredients and bake in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan at 325u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Bread
directions: Place 1/2 cup warm water in large bowl.
Sprinkle in yeast; stir until dissolved.
Add remaining water, salt and 2 cups flour; blend well.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm, draft-free place until doubled in size, about 20 minutes.
Punch dough down.
Remove dough to lightly floured surface; divide in half.
Roll each half to 12 inch circle.
Roll each circle tightly as for jelly roll to make loaf. Pinch seams and ends to seal; taper ends by gently rolling.
Place loaves, seam side down, on greased baking sheet.
cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in size, about 20 to 40 minutes, lightly dust with flour.
With sharp knife, make diagonal slashes across top of each.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Italian Bread. Place 1/2 cup warm water in large bowl. Sprinkle in yeast; stir until dissolved. Add remaining water, salt and 2 cups flour; blend well. Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 6 to 8 minutes. Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm, draft-free place until doubled in size, about 20 minutes. Punch dough down. Remove dough to lightly floured surface; divide in half. Roll each half to 12 inch circle. Roll each circle tightly as for jelly roll to make loaf. Pinch seams and ends to seal; taper ends by gently rolling. Place loaves, seam side down, on greased baking sheet. cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in size, about 20 to 40 minutes, lightly dust with flour. With sharp knife, make diagonal slashes across top of each. Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Delight And Leeman'S Soup
directions: In a frying pan, with the oil, cook the stew meat.
When it's done put the meat and the drippings in a pot; add the can of soup and one can of water.
Add all of the other ingredients.
On medium heat, cook until potatoes and carrots are done.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Delight And Leeman'S Soup. In a frying pan, with the oil, cook the stew meat. When it's done put the meat and the drippings in a pot; add the can of soup and one can of water. Add all of the other ingredients. On medium heat, cook until potatoes and carrots are done. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Skillet Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 1 c. miniature marshmallows or 3 Tbsp. marshmallow cream
directions: In electric skillet, combine sugar, cream and butter; set control at 280u00b0.
Bring mixture to a boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Turn off.
Beat.
Stir marshmallows and peanut butter in until melted and blended.
Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan.
Makes about 2 pounds.
recipes.text: Skillet Peanut Butter Fudge. In electric skillet, combine sugar, cream and butter; set control at 280u00b0. Bring mixture to a boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Turn off. Beat. Stir marshmallows and peanut butter in until melted and blended. Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan. Makes about 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Chicken Spectacular
ingredients: 1 box Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice
directions: Cook rice according to directions on box.
(I use chicken broth instead of water.)
Mix all ingredients except chicken.
Mix well.
Fold in diced chicken.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until it bubbles.
This freezes well.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Chicken Spectacular. Cook rice according to directions on box. (I use chicken broth instead of water.) Mix all ingredients except chicken. Mix well. Fold in diced chicken. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes or until it bubbles. This freezes well. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Cake
directions: Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy.
Stir in pineapple.
Add flour which has been sifted with baking powder.
Mix well.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Yum Yum Cake. Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy. Stir in pineapple. Add flour which has been sifted with baking powder. Mix well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Great Peach Cobbler
directions: Put Bisquick in bowl.
Add cinnamon, nutmeg and butter.
Mix all and sprinkle over peaches that have been placed in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Drizzle glaze made from powdered sugar and water over cobbler while still hot.
recipes.text: Great Peach Cobbler. Put Bisquick in bowl. Add cinnamon, nutmeg and butter. Mix all and sprinkle over peaches that have been placed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Drizzle glaze made from powdered sugar and water over cobbler while still hot.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Cook Karo, butter, water and sugar to form soft ball stage. (When dropped in cold water, it will form a soft ball.)
Pour mixture over popcorn and mix.
Put butter on your hand and dip your hands in cold water.
Form popcorn into balls.
Food coloring may be added to cooked mixture to color for different seasons. Put balls on wax paper to cool.
recipes.text: Popcorn Balls. Cook Karo, butter, water and sugar to form soft ball stage. (When dropped in cold water, it will form a soft ball.) Pour mixture over popcorn and mix. Put butter on your hand and dip your hands in cold water. Form popcorn into balls. Food coloring may be added to cooked mixture to color for different seasons. Put balls on wax paper to cool.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients thoroughly.
Add the next 4 ingredients;
mix thoroughly.
Add nutmeg, cinnamon (optional) and vanilla
(optional).
Thetdough may be rolled and cut or made astbiscuits
by
hand.
Bake at
425u00b0 until as brown as desired.
recipes.text: Tea Cakes. Mix the first 4 ingredients thoroughly. Add the next 4 ingredients; mix thoroughly. Add nutmeg, cinnamon (optional) and vanilla (optional). Thetdough may be rolled and cut or made astbiscuits by hand. Bake at 425u00b0 until as brown as desired.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix together the first 4 ingredients.
Boil 2 minutes.
Remove and add the remaining ingredients.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.
Cool.
May be frozen in airtight container.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Mix together the first 4 ingredients. Boil 2 minutes. Remove and add the remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper. Cool. May be frozen in airtight container.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Cut off tops of green peppers and clean inside.
Mix rice, tomato sauce, ground beef, salt and pepper and Accent.
Fill peppers with mixture.
Put in large pot.
Pour can of tomatoes and 1 can of water over peppers.
Cook over medium heat for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Stuffed Green Peppers. Cut off tops of green peppers and clean inside. Mix rice, tomato sauce, ground beef, salt and pepper and Accent. Fill peppers with mixture. Put in large pot. Pour can of tomatoes and 1 can of water over peppers. Cook over medium heat for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
directions: Blend the avocados,
lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Set aside. Mix the mayonnaise,
sourtcream
and taco mix.
Layer bean dip on bottom of pan; continue to layer avocado mix, sour cream mixture, onions,
tomatoes,
olives
and Cheddar cheese. Chill and serve.
Serve with nacho chips, optional.
recipes.text: Mexican Salad. Blend the avocados, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Set aside. Mix the mayonnaise, sourtcream and taco mix. Layer bean dip on bottom of pan; continue to layer avocado mix, sour cream mixture, onions, tomatoes, olives and Cheddar cheese. Chill and serve. Serve with nacho chips, optional.

recipes.title: Tomato Aspic Salad
directions: Dilute soup with 3/4 can water.
Heat to boiling. Pour over gelatin and stir until dissolved thoroughly; cool. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into molds and chill. Serve on lettuce leaf and top with mayonnaise. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Tomato Aspic Salad. Dilute soup with 3/4 can water. Heat to boiling. Pour over gelatin and stir until dissolved thoroughly; cool. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into molds and chill. Serve on lettuce leaf and top with mayonnaise. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. lean beef, cut into cubes (round steak)
directions: Put raw, cubed beef into a 3-quart casserole.
(Do not brown.) Sprinkle with salt, pepper and basil. Top with celery, carrots, onions and potatoes. Combine tomato soup and water.
Pour over meat and vegetables.
Do not stir, leave in layers.
Cover tightly and bake for 3 hours at 300u00b0.
recipes.text: Easy Beef Stew. Put raw, cubed beef into a 3-quart casserole. (Do not brown.) Sprinkle with salt, pepper and basil. Top with celery, carrots, onions and potatoes. Combine tomato soup and water. Pour over meat and vegetables. Do not stir, leave in layers. Cover tightly and bake for 3 hours at 300u00b0.

recipes.title: Cheese Soup
directions: Saute onion in butter until golden.
Sprinkle with flour; add salt and pepper.
Stir and cook about 3 minutes.
Add hot milk slowly, stirring constantly.
Add cheese and stir until it melts. Simmer, covered, about 15 minutes.
Add tomato sauce and Tabasco sauce, then simmer 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Soup. Saute onion in butter until golden. Sprinkle with flour; add salt and pepper. Stir and cook about 3 minutes. Add hot milk slowly, stirring constantly. Add cheese and stir until it melts. Simmer, covered, about 15 minutes. Add tomato sauce and Tabasco sauce, then simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Nana'S Coffee Cake
directions: Cream the margarine with the sugar.
Add eggs and sour cream. Add flour, baking powder, baking soda, vanilla and lemon juice and mix thoroughly.
recipes.text: Nana'S Coffee Cake. Cream the margarine with the sugar. Add eggs and sour cream. Add flour, baking powder, baking soda, vanilla and lemon juice and mix thoroughly.

recipes.title: Coconut-Banana Cream Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 300u00b0; mix coconut, oats and 4 tablespoons butter by hand.
Pat coconut mixture onto bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate.
Bake crust 15 minutes, until golden; cool.
In saucepan, combine milk, cornstarch, salt, egg yolks, 1/2 cup sugar and remaining 2 tablespoons butter.
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens.
Boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla.
Line pie crust with bananas (sliced 1/4-inch thick); pour filling over bananas.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate until cold.
Mix whipping cream and 2 teaspoons sugar until stiff peaks.
Spread over pie; garnish with sliced toasted almonds.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Coconut-Banana Cream Pie. Preheat oven to 300u00b0; mix coconut, oats and 4 tablespoons butter by hand. Pat coconut mixture onto bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate. Bake crust 15 minutes, until golden; cool. In saucepan, combine milk, cornstarch, salt, egg yolks, 1/2 cup sugar and remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Line pie crust with bananas (sliced 1/4-inch thick); pour filling over bananas. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until cold. Mix whipping cream and 2 teaspoons sugar until stiff peaks. Spread over pie; garnish with sliced toasted almonds. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Roll into balls.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes on a baking sheet sprayed with Pam.
recipes.text: Ranger Cookies. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Roll into balls. Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes on a baking sheet sprayed with Pam.

recipes.title: Frosted Pecans
directions: Beat egg white, add sugar and vanilla.
Beat well.
Add 2 cups pecan halves.
Mix well with spoon.
With a teaspoon or your finger, put 1 pecan half at a time on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 250u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Frosted Pecans. Beat egg white, add sugar and vanilla. Beat well. Add 2 cups pecan halves. Mix well with spoon. With a teaspoon or your finger, put 1 pecan half at a time on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. raw rice, cooked and drained
directions: Cream sugar and cream cheese together.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Then add milk, vanilla and lemon.
Stir in rice and cinnamon.
Bake in greased 9 x 13 dish.
Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0. Check after 45 minutes.
When knife inserted in center comes out clean, it is done.
Rice stays on bottom and the top is like custard and creamy.
recipes.text: Creamy Rice Pudding. Cream sugar and cream cheese together. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Then add milk, vanilla and lemon. Stir in rice and cinnamon. Bake in greased 9 x 13 dish. Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0. Check after 45 minutes. When knife inserted in center comes out clean, it is done. Rice stays on bottom and the top is like custard and creamy.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Chip Salad
directions: Select cabbage that is neither too hard (shreds will be coarse) or too soft (it is difficult to shred).
Cut cabbage into quarters, cutting between where leaves are attached to core, so leaves will hold together.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Chip Salad. Select cabbage that is neither too hard (shreds will be coarse) or too soft (it is difficult to shred). Cut cabbage into quarters, cutting between where leaves are attached to core, so leaves will hold together.

recipes.title: Peppermint Candy Ice Cream Pie
ingredients: 8 oz. frozen whipped topping, partially thawed
directions: Combine chocolate wafer crumbs and butter in small bowl; mix well.
Press over bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate.
Combine ice cream and whipped topping in bowl; mix until smooth.
Spoon into pie shell.
Sprinkle with crushed candy.
Freeze until firm. Garnish with additional crushed peppermint candy, if desired. Yield:
6 servings.
recipes.text: Peppermint Candy Ice Cream Pie. Combine chocolate wafer crumbs and butter in small bowl; mix well. Press over bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate. Combine ice cream and whipped topping in bowl; mix until smooth. Spoon into pie shell. Sprinkle with crushed candy. Freeze until firm. Garnish with additional crushed peppermint candy, if desired. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Crumb Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines butter cake mix
directions: Mix ingredients and pour into a greased pan (11 x 17 x 1-inch).
Bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
Meanwhile prepare the Crumb Mixture (following).
recipes.text: Crumb Cake. Mix ingredients and pour into a greased pan (11 x 17 x 1-inch). Bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0. Meanwhile prepare the Crumb Mixture (following).

recipes.title: Helen'S Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp. dry Italian salad dressing mix
directions: Mix chicken broth and tomato juice and bring to a boil.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer for about 1/2 hour or until macaroni is done.
recipes.text: Helen'S Soup. Mix chicken broth and tomato juice and bring to a boil. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for about 1/2 hour or until macaroni is done.

recipes.title: Chicken Thighs Mozzarella
directions: Combine flour, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper.
Dip each thigh in egg, drain and dredge in flour mixture.
Heat oil in 4 tablespoons butter in skillet.
Add coated thighs and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until brown.
Remove thighs with slotted spoon and arrange in single layer in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter to skillet and saute mushrooms for 4 minutes.
Cut each slice of ham in half and place on each thigh.
Scatter mushrooms over all and top with Mozzarella.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until chicken is tender.
recipes.text: Chicken Thighs Mozzarella. Combine flour, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper. Dip each thigh in egg, drain and dredge in flour mixture. Heat oil in 4 tablespoons butter in skillet. Add coated thighs and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until brown. Remove thighs with slotted spoon and arrange in single layer in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter to skillet and saute mushrooms for 4 minutes. Cut each slice of ham in half and place on each thigh. Scatter mushrooms over all and top with Mozzarella. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Chewy Cheese
directions: Place cheese (either processed cheese slices or slices of Cheddar) between 2 slices of bread.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat.
Place the sandwiches on the pan, butter side down; cook 2 to 3 minutes, until golden brown.
Turn sandwich with lifter and repeat for the other side.
Remove from pan.
Cut into quarters and serve with crunchy pickles.
recipes.text: Chewy Cheese. Place cheese (either processed cheese slices or slices of Cheddar) between 2 slices of bread. Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Place the sandwiches on the pan, butter side down; cook 2 to 3 minutes, until golden brown. Turn sandwich with lifter and repeat for the other side. Remove from pan. Cut into quarters and serve with crunchy pickles.

recipes.title: Molasses Crinkles
directions: Cream together the first 4 ingredients. Sift together the remaining ingredients. Mix all of the above ingredients. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Dip tops in sugar. Place sugar side up 3-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle each cookie with 2 to 3 drops of water to produce a cracked surface. Bake just until set, but not hard. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields 4 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Molasses Crinkles. Cream together the first 4 ingredients. Sift together the remaining ingredients. Mix all of the above ingredients. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Dip tops in sugar. Place sugar side up 3-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle each cookie with 2 to 3 drops of water to produce a cracked surface. Bake just until set, but not hard. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes. Yields 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole fryer chicken, cooked and deboned (save broth)
directions: Melt margarine in saucepan and saute onions and peppers until tender.
Add soups and broth and
jalapenotpepper,
if desired. Add chopped chicken.
In a 9 x
13-inch
pan, spread 1/2 bag Doritos.
Spread half chicken and soup
mixture on top of chips. Top with 1 cup of cheese.
Repeat
layers.tBake at 425u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Melt margarine in saucepan and saute onions and peppers until tender. Add soups and broth and jalapenotpepper, if desired. Add chopped chicken. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spread 1/2 bag Doritos. Spread half chicken and soup mixture on top of chips. Top with 1 cup of cheese. Repeat layers.tBake at 425u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
directions: Clean carrots and slice.
Cook until tender.
Drain and add onions and peppers.
Mix soup, vinegar, oil, sugar, Worcestershire sauce and mustard.
Cook 15 minutes.
Pour over carrots, onions and peppers.
Serve either hot or cold.
recipes.text: Carrot Salad. Clean carrots and slice. Cook until tender. Drain and add onions and peppers. Mix soup, vinegar, oil, sugar, Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Cook 15 minutes. Pour over carrots, onions and peppers. Serve either hot or cold.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse Pie
ingredients: 2 (1 oz.) sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
directions: Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in cooled chocolate.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating 5 minutes after each addition. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon mixture into a cooled baked pastry shell. Chill until firm, about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mousse Pie. Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in cooled chocolate. Add eggs, one at a time, beating 5 minutes after each addition. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon mixture into a cooled baked pastry shell. Chill until firm, about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Caramel Icing
directions: Mix well; boil 5 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes.
Mix with 1 box powdered sugar.
Blend well.
Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.
recipes.text: Caramel Icing. Mix well; boil 5 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes. Mix with 1 box powdered sugar. Blend well. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
directions: First Layer:
In a 9 x 13-inch cake pan, layer chicken (cooked and cubed).
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Casserole. First Layer: In a 9 x 13-inch cake pan, layer chicken (cooked and cubed).

recipes.title: Ice Chocolate
directions: Cook in a double boiler.
Sweeten to taste and flavor with vanilla.
Cool and serve in tall glasses filled with ice. Decorate with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Ice Chocolate. Cook in a double boiler. Sweeten to taste and flavor with vanilla. Cool and serve in tall glasses filled with ice. Decorate with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Nutty Slaw Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. Ramen chicken noodles (save chicken flavor packet for dressing)
directions: Break up Ramen noodles before combining with chopped cabbage, onions, toasted almonds and sesame seeds.
recipes.text: Nutty Slaw Salad. Break up Ramen noodles before combining with chopped cabbage, onions, toasted almonds and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Cookie Brittle
ingredients: 1 (7.8 oz.) pkg. Heath Bits 'O Brickle candy
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Combine butter, vanilla and salt in medium bowl and beat with electric mixer until fluffy.
Add flour, sugar and candy and blend well.
Press mixture into 15 x 11-inch jelly roll pan.
Cover with waxed paper and flatten with rolling pin.
Discard paper.
Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Cut into squares or let cool and break into pieces.
Makes 48 cookies.
recipes.text: Cookie Brittle. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Combine butter, vanilla and salt in medium bowl and beat with electric mixer until fluffy. Add flour, sugar and candy and blend well. Press mixture into 15 x 11-inch jelly roll pan. Cover with waxed paper and flatten with rolling pin. Discard paper. Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Cut into squares or let cool and break into pieces. Makes 48 cookies.

recipes.title: Molasses Snaps
directions: Beat shortening and sugar until creamy.
Beat in eggs and molasses.
Mix dry ingredients and stir in raisins and nuts, if used.
Stir flour mixture into molasses mixture.
Drop dough from a teaspoon onto a lightly greased baking sheet, space cookies about 2 inches apart.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not hard.
Remove from baking sheet while warm.
recipes.text: Molasses Snaps. Beat shortening and sugar until creamy. Beat in eggs and molasses. Mix dry ingredients and stir in raisins and nuts, if used. Stir flour mixture into molasses mixture. Drop dough from a teaspoon onto a lightly greased baking sheet, space cookies about 2 inches apart. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not hard. Remove from baking sheet while warm.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Spectacular
directions: Mix flour, nuts and butter.
Put into 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown.
Let cool.
Blend cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip until smooth.
Pour this onto cooled crust. Mix pudding with milk.
Spread on top of cream cheese mixture.
Put remaining Cool Whip on top of this and sprinkle with nuts.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Spectacular. Mix flour, nuts and butter. Put into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Let cool. Blend cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip until smooth. Pour this onto cooled crust. Mix pudding with milk. Spread on top of cream cheese mixture. Put remaining Cool Whip on top of this and sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, browned, drained and crumbled
directions: Wash large head fresh broccoli and dry thoroughly.
Cut into very small pieces.
Peel stalks of broccoli and cut into small pieces also.
Slice 1 sweet onion and add 8 ounces grated Cheddar cheese.
Mix with dressing.
Refrigerate overnight.
Crumble bacon on top just before serving.
recipes.text: Fresh Broccoli Salad. Wash large head fresh broccoli and dry thoroughly. Cut into very small pieces. Peel stalks of broccoli and cut into small pieces also. Slice 1 sweet onion and add 8 ounces grated Cheddar cheese. Mix with dressing. Refrigerate overnight. Crumble bacon on top just before serving.

recipes.title: Oven Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. boneless beef chuck steak, (3/4-inch thick)
1 (16 oz.) can stewed tomatoes, cut up
1/4 c. shredded sharp process American cheese
directions: Cut meat into 4 portions. Combine flour and salt. Pound into meat.
Set aside remaining flour. Brown meat in a small amount of hot oil (2 tablespoons).
Place meat in a 10 x 6 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Oven Swiss Steak. Cut meat into 4 portions. Combine flour and salt. Pound into meat. Set aside remaining flour. Brown meat in a small amount of hot oil (2 tablespoons). Place meat in a 10 x 6 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: The "Now Famous" Cheese Ring
directions: Combine all ingredients (except preserves).
Mix well.
Chill. Mold into a ring.
Fill center of ring with preserves.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: The "Now Famous" Cheese Ring. Combine all ingredients (except preserves). Mix well. Chill. Mold into a ring. Fill center of ring with preserves. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Mexican Meat Loaf
directions: Combine turkey or beef, package of taco seasoning, 1/2 cup Mexican salsa, bread crumbs and egg whites.
Pour 1/2 cup salsa on top.
Cook at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Mexican Meat Loaf. Combine turkey or beef, package of taco seasoning, 1/2 cup Mexican salsa, bread crumbs and egg whites. Pour 1/2 cup salsa on top. Cook at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Mushroom Casserole
directions: Place mushrooms in casserole.
Melt butter with marjoram, scallion greens, salt and pepper.
Add bouillon and wine.
Stir and pour over mushrooms.
Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Mushroom Casserole. Place mushrooms in casserole. Melt butter with marjoram, scallion greens, salt and pepper. Add bouillon and wine. Stir and pour over mushrooms. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Tortilla Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch seasonings
crushed red pepper flakes to taste
directions: Mix all together. Refrigerate and serve with chips.
recipes.text: Tortilla Dip. Mix all together. Refrigerate and serve with chips.

recipes.title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
directions: Mix and spread on tortillas and roll up tight and cover well. Store in refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours.
Cut in small slices and serve with picante sauce.
recipes.text: Tortilla Roll-Ups. Mix and spread on tortillas and roll up tight and cover well. Store in refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours. Cut in small slices and serve with picante sauce.

recipes.title: Cheesy Spinach Pie
directions: Defrost and drain spinach.
Mix it in a bowl with egg and Ricotta.
Line bottom of 8 or 9-inch pie pan with Muenster cheese slices.
Spoon in spinach mixture.
Cover with remainder of Muenster slices.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour until brown and bubbly.
recipes.text: Cheesy Spinach Pie. Defrost and drain spinach. Mix it in a bowl with egg and Ricotta. Line bottom of 8 or 9-inch pie pan with Muenster cheese slices. Spoon in spinach mixture. Cover with remainder of Muenster slices. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. light or dark corn syrup
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Beat eggs, sugar and salt. Add butter and syrup. Mix in pecans. Bake in pie shell 40 to 45 minutes. If adding chocolate chips, mix in with pecans.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Beat eggs, sugar and salt. Add butter and syrup. Mix in pecans. Bake in pie shell 40 to 45 minutes. If adding chocolate chips, mix in with pecans.

recipes.title: Russian Salad
ingredients: 2 chopped bananas with 1 tsp. lemon juice
directions: Put water, jello, marshmallows and softened cream cheese over low heat and let dissolve. Remove from heat and cool till "milk warm". Add remaining ingredients congeal and joy!
recipes.text: Russian Salad. Put water, jello, marshmallows and softened cream cheese over low heat and let dissolve. Remove from heat and cool till "milk warm". Add remaining ingredients congeal and joy!

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Place cut
up
squash
and
onion in water to cover and boil for 5 minutes.
Drain well.
Combine soup, sour cream and carrots. Mix
well.
Add
squash and onions.
Mix well.
Melt margarine and
mix
in
croutons
or stuffing.
Put 1/2 of the croutons
in bottom of square casserole dish.
Pour in squash mixture.
Put remaining croutons on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Place cut up squash and onion in water to cover and boil for 5 minutes. Drain well. Combine soup, sour cream and carrots. Mix well. Add squash and onions. Mix well. Melt margarine and mix in croutons or stuffing. Put 1/2 of the croutons in bottom of square casserole dish. Pour in squash mixture. Put remaining croutons on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
directions: Heat oil in large skillet on medium heat.
Add chicken, onion and pepper.
Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through.
Add corn, salsa and broth; bring to a boil.
Stir in rice and cover. Remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes and fluff with fork. Sprinkle with cheese and let stand 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken And Rice. Heat oil in large skillet on medium heat. Add chicken, onion and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Add corn, salsa and broth; bring to a boil. Stir in rice and cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes and fluff with fork. Sprinkle with cheese and let stand 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken-Tomato Souffle
directions: Melt oleo in heavy pan.
Add flour and stir.
Add chicken stock and cook gently.
Add tomatoes; beat egg yolks until thick and stir in.
Add diced chicken; then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake in casserole about 40 minutes at 350u00b0, or until knife comes out reasonably clean.
Serves 4 to 5.
recipes.text: Chicken-Tomato Souffle. Melt oleo in heavy pan. Add flour and stir. Add chicken stock and cook gently. Add tomatoes; beat egg yolks until thick and stir in. Add diced chicken; then fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in casserole about 40 minutes at 350u00b0, or until knife comes out reasonably clean. Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Aunt Jane'S Pink Cloud
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well.
Chill in refrigerator or freeze if desired.
May substitute blueberry pie filling for cherry.
recipes.text: Aunt Jane'S Pink Cloud. Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well. Chill in refrigerator or freeze if desired. May substitute blueberry pie filling for cherry.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine pecans and coconut.
Sprinkle over bottom of pan.
Prepare cake mix per directions on box, then pour into pan.
Melt margarine and cream cheese together in saucepan.
Add powdered sugar; mix well.
Pour mixture over cake batter.
Bake 45 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool, then cut into squares.
Makes 16 squares.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine pecans and coconut. Sprinkle over bottom of pan. Prepare cake mix per directions on box, then pour into pan. Melt margarine and cream cheese together in saucepan. Add powdered sugar; mix well. Pour mixture over cake batter. Bake 45 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool, then cut into squares. Makes 16 squares.

recipes.title: Chicken Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 lb. Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Combine the soups, sour cream, mayo and garlic powder until well blended to make the sauce.
In a 13 x 9-inch pan, layer half the noodles, half the chicken, half the sauce and half the cheese.
Repeat the layers and bake for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Lasagna. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Combine the soups, sour cream, mayo and garlic powder until well blended to make the sauce. In a 13 x 9-inch pan, layer half the noodles, half the chicken, half the sauce and half the cheese. Repeat the layers and bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Beaufort Stew
ingredients: 1/4 lb. smoked sausage per person, cut in bite-sized pieces
directions: In large pot, combine water, Old Bay seasoning, sliced lemon and sliced onion.
Bring to a rolling boil.
Add sausage.
Boil 30 minutes.
Add corn; boil 10 minutes.
Add shrimp; boil 3 to 5 minutes until shrimp are pink.
Serve with baked or boiled potatoes.
recipes.text: Beaufort Stew. In large pot, combine water, Old Bay seasoning, sliced lemon and sliced onion. Bring to a rolling boil. Add sausage. Boil 30 minutes. Add corn; boil 10 minutes. Add shrimp; boil 3 to 5 minutes until shrimp are pink. Serve with baked or boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Butter the bread on one side.
Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix eggs, milk and salt thoroughly.
Pour over bread.
Top with ham.
Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Butter the bread on one side. Place in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix eggs, milk and salt thoroughly. Pour over bread. Top with ham. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Aunt Ethel'S Chicken And Rice
directions: Put rice in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Mix soup and milk together.
Pour over rice.
Put onion soup on top.
Put chicken on top. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0. Uncover to brown chicken.
recipes.text: Aunt Ethel'S Chicken And Rice. Put rice in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Mix soup and milk together. Pour over rice. Put onion soup on top. Put chicken on top. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0. Uncover to brown chicken.

recipes.title: Reception Punch
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen grapefruit juice concentrate, thawed
1 (5.5 oz.) pkg. raspberry flavored sugar-sweetened soft drink mix
1 (2 liter) lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage, chilled
directions: In 6-quart nonmetal container, combine all ingredients except carbonated beverage.
Blend well.
Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled.
Just before serving, combine juice mixture and carbonated in a large punch bowl.
Serve over ice or float ice ring in punch bowl.
Makes 40 (1/2 cup) servings.
recipes.text: Reception Punch. In 6-quart nonmetal container, combine all ingredients except carbonated beverage. Blend well. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled. Just before serving, combine juice mixture and carbonated in a large punch bowl. Serve over ice or float ice ring in punch bowl. Makes 40 (1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Apple Orchard Cake
directions: Mix this recipe by hand.
Mix oil, sugar, eggs, soda, salt and vanilla flavoring.
Add flour and mix.
Add apples, pecans and coconut.
Bake in a tin pan at 300u00b0 for 1 hour, then 30 more minutes at 325u00b0 to brown it.
recipes.text: Apple Orchard Cake. Mix this recipe by hand. Mix oil, sugar, eggs, soda, salt and vanilla flavoring. Add flour and mix. Add apples, pecans and coconut. Bake in a tin pan at 300u00b0 for 1 hour, then 30 more minutes at 325u00b0 to brown it.

recipes.title: Easy Jello Salad
directions: Mix together and chill.
recipes.text: Easy Jello Salad. Mix together and chill.

recipes.title: Cathy'S Honey-Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 1 baking chicken, cut up or chicken pieces
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix in honey, Dijon mustard and curry powder; add chicken pieces, turning to coat.
Bake 45 minutes at 375u00b0, turning once midway through baking.
recipes.text: Cathy'S Honey-Mustard Chicken. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix in honey, Dijon mustard and curry powder; add chicken pieces, turning to coat. Bake 45 minutes at 375u00b0, turning once midway through baking.

recipes.title: Golden Citrus Punch
ingredients: 1 (46 oz.) can unsweetened pineapple juice, chilled
1 (6 oz.) can frozen unsweetened grapefruit juice, thawed
1 (6 oz.) can frozen unsweetened orange juice, thawed
directions: In large punch bowl, combine juices, water and sugar; stir until sugar dissolves.
Just before serving; add club soda and ice.
Makes 3 3/4 quarts.
recipes.text: Golden Citrus Punch. In large punch bowl, combine juices, water and sugar; stir until sugar dissolves. Just before serving; add club soda and ice. Makes 3 3/4 quarts.

recipes.title: Watergate Cake
ingredients: 1 box white cake mix with pudding
directions: Beat well and bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.
Use 1/2 pound of country butter in place of oil.
This will make good cake.
recipes.text: Watergate Cake. Beat well and bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour. Use 1/2 pound of country butter in place of oil. This will make good cake.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Cream sugar and margarine or butter.
Add eggs, vanilla, buttermilk, salt and flour; mix thoroughly.
Pour into a deep pie shell.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Cream sugar and margarine or butter. Add eggs, vanilla, buttermilk, salt and flour; mix thoroughly. Pour into a deep pie shell. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Light'N Lean Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, boned and skinned
directions: Spray large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray.
Heat to medium and add chicken.
Season with 1/4 teaspoonful pepper.
Cook about 10 minutes, turning once, or until browned evenly.
Reduce temperature and add garlic.
Continue cooking 10 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Remove chicken to serving plate.
Add broth and wine to garlic cloves.
Bring to a boil and continue boiling 5 minutes.
Reduce heat.
Combine milk and seasonings, add to cooking juices in pan.
Heat and stir until slightly thickened. Return chicken to pan and sprinkle with chives.
Baste chicken with cooking juices.
Heat through.
Very good with rice.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Light'N Lean Chicken. Spray large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray. Heat to medium and add chicken. Season with 1/4 teaspoonful pepper. Cook about 10 minutes, turning once, or until browned evenly. Reduce temperature and add garlic. Continue cooking 10 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken to serving plate. Add broth and wine to garlic cloves. Bring to a boil and continue boiling 5 minutes. Reduce heat. Combine milk and seasonings, add to cooking juices in pan. Heat and stir until slightly thickened. Return chicken to pan and sprinkle with chives. Baste chicken with cooking juices. Heat through. Very good with rice. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients as listed and turn into 2 prepared pie shells.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes, then turn oven down to 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix all ingredients as listed and turn into 2 prepared pie shells. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes, then turn oven down to 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Sour Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 graham cracker pie crust, prepared in 9-inch pie plate
directions: Beat all ingredients until well-blended.
Pour into pie crust and chill at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Banana Sour Cream Pie. Beat all ingredients until well-blended. Pour into pie crust and chill at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and eggs.
Beat in milk, baking powder and flour.
Spread mixture in 8-inch square pan.
Peel and slice apples very thin.
Spread over batter.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
Top with Cool Whip to serve.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Cream together butter, sugar and eggs. Beat in milk, baking powder and flour. Spread mixture in 8-inch square pan. Peel and slice apples very thin. Spread over batter. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Top with Cool Whip to serve.

recipes.title: Sea Slaw
ingredients: 1 (1/6 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
directions: Combine vegetables and add seafood.
Prepare dressing and add to salad.
Mix thoroughly.
Refrigerate.
Serve cold.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Sea Slaw. Combine vegetables and add seafood. Prepare dressing and add to salad. Mix thoroughly. Refrigerate. Serve cold. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Stuff
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can pineapple chunks with juice
directions: Pour boiling water over jello and marshmallows.
Add the 1 cup cold water (thicken).
Add bananas and pineapple chunks.
Save the juice.
Chill.
recipes.text: Lemon Stuff. Pour boiling water over jello and marshmallows. Add the 1 cup cold water (thicken). Add bananas and pineapple chunks. Save the juice. Chill.

recipes.title: Rabbit Stew
ingredients: 3 c. beef broth (dissolve 2 beef bouillon cubes in 3 c. boiling water)
1/2 c. tomato sauce, or 1/2 c. strained stewed tomatoes
directions: Cover
rabbit pieces with cold salted water in a saucepan (2 tot3
tablespoons of salt to 6 to 8 cups water).
Let stand about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Rabbit Stew. Cover rabbit pieces with cold salted water in a saucepan (2 tot3 tablespoons of salt to 6 to 8 cups water). Let stand about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Frosting (For Brownies)
directions: Combine all above ingredients, except Sugar.
Boil 2 minutes, then add sugar.
recipes.text: Frosting (For Brownies). Combine all above ingredients, except Sugar. Boil 2 minutes, then add sugar.

recipes.title: Orange Balls
directions: Mix wafers, orange concentrate, coconut and nuts; make into small balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
For smoother balls, blend coconuts and nuts in blender.
recipes.text: Orange Balls. Mix wafers, orange concentrate, coconut and nuts; make into small balls. Roll in granulated sugar. For smoother balls, blend coconuts and nuts in blender.

recipes.title: Easy Oriental Soup
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until vegetables and tortellini are tender. Serve with egg rolls or other favorite Oriental dishes.
recipes.text: Easy Oriental Soup. Mix all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until vegetables and tortellini are tender. Serve with egg rolls or other favorite Oriental dishes.

recipes.title: White Clam Sauce
ingredients: 2 (6 1/2 oz.) cans clams, drain and save liquid
directions: Saute garlic in olive oil.
Stir in flour, salt, white pepper, oregano and parsley.
Stir constantly until mixture boils.
Add enough dairy cream to reserved clam juice to make 2 cups of liquid.
Slowly add liquid to flour mixture, stirring constantly, until it boils.
Stir in clams.
Keep warm until ready to serve. Use with any kind of spaghetti.
recipes.text: White Clam Sauce. Saute garlic in olive oil. Stir in flour, salt, white pepper, oregano and parsley. Stir constantly until mixture boils. Add enough dairy cream to reserved clam juice to make 2 cups of liquid. Slowly add liquid to flour mixture, stirring constantly, until it boils. Stir in clams. Keep warm until ready to serve. Use with any kind of spaghetti.

recipes.title: Chunk Style Applesauce
ingredients: 8 to 10 large cooking apples, peeled, cored and sliced or cut in chunks
directions: Put all ingredients into crock-pot.
Cover and cook on low overnight (8 to 10 hours).
Serve warm with or without cream.
recipes.text: Chunk Style Applesauce. Put all ingredients into crock-pot. Cover and cook on low overnight (8 to 10 hours). Serve warm with or without cream.

recipes.title: Fruity Cream Cheese Roll-Ups
directions: Mix cream cheese, honey and orange peel. Spread about 2 tablespoons cheese mixture over 1 tortilla. Spread 1/4 cup chopped fruit over cream mixture. Repeat with remaining tortillas, cheese mixture and chopped fruit. Garnish with grapes.
recipes.text: Fruity Cream Cheese Roll-Ups. Mix cream cheese, honey and orange peel. Spread about 2 tablespoons cheese mixture over 1 tortilla. Spread 1/4 cup chopped fruit over cream mixture. Repeat with remaining tortillas, cheese mixture and chopped fruit. Garnish with grapes.

recipes.title: Linda'S Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. lean ground beef or chicken
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain.
Add other ingredients; stir and simmer for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Linda'S Tortilla Soup. Brown meat and onion; drain. Add other ingredients; stir and simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham And Potato Scallop For Microwave
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced (about 1 1/2 c.)
directions: Pour milk into 2-cup glass measure and cook 2 minutes; set aside.
Put butter in 2-cup measure and cook 1 minute.
Stir in flour and cook 1 minute.
Briskly stir hot milk, prepared mustard, salt and pepper into butter; set aside.
recipes.text: Ham And Potato Scallop For Microwave. Pour milk into 2-cup glass measure and cook 2 minutes; set aside. Put butter in 2-cup measure and cook 1 minute. Stir in flour and cook 1 minute. Briskly stir hot milk, prepared mustard, salt and pepper into butter; set aside.

recipes.title: Vegetable-Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can whole stewed tomatoes or 16 oz. tomato sauce
1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen vegetable soup mix *
3 c. hot water or use hot clear chicken broth for part of this
1 1/2 tsp. Tony's Creole seasoning (don't add salt if you use this)
dash of each or add to taste: black pepper, garlic powder, thyme, basil and ground bay leaves
directions: Brown and drain ground beef, then place all ingredients listed into crock-pot.
Heat to boiling, then simmer all day or overnight.
Serve.
Makes approximately 6 1/2 large soup bowls. Diabetic exchanges:
1 cup = 1 starch, 1 ounce meat and 1 fat.
recipes.text: Vegetable-Beef Soup. Brown and drain ground beef, then place all ingredients listed into crock-pot. Heat to boiling, then simmer all day or overnight. Serve. Makes approximately 6 1/2 large soup bowls. Diabetic exchanges: 1 cup = 1 starch, 1 ounce meat and 1 fat.

recipes.title: Pear Cake
directions: Pour sugar over pears.
Mix and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour in tube pan.
recipes.text: Pear Cake. Pour sugar over pears. Mix and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour in tube pan.

recipes.title: Gail'S Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs well and stir in sugar, beating well.
Add condensed milk, evaporated milk and vanilla, then add the Cool Whip.
Pour into churn and add enough milk to finish filling churn.
Freeze.
recipes.text: Gail'S Vanilla Ice Cream. Beat eggs well and stir in sugar, beating well. Add condensed milk, evaporated milk and vanilla, then add the Cool Whip. Pour into churn and add enough milk to finish filling churn. Freeze.

recipes.title: Jan Hagel Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Lightly grease 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan.
Mix butter, sugar and egg yolk.
Blend flour and cinnamon and stir into butter mixture.
Pat into pan.
Beat water and egg white until frothy.
Brush over dough; sprinkle with nuts.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly brown.
Cut immediately into finger-like strips (around 3 x 1-inch).
Great served with ice cream desserts.
recipes.text: Jan Hagel Cookies. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Lightly grease 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan. Mix butter, sugar and egg yolk. Blend flour and cinnamon and stir into butter mixture. Pat into pan. Beat water and egg white until frothy. Brush over dough; sprinkle with nuts. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly brown. Cut immediately into finger-like strips (around 3 x 1-inch). Great served with ice cream desserts.

recipes.title: Red Hot Cinnamon Candy
directions: Mix sugar, water, and syrup in heavy pan.
Turn on the vent over stove; open window if possible.
The fumes are quite strong. Boil until hard crack stage.
Remove from heat and add oil and coloring.
Stir well; pour into cookie sheet which has been dusted with powdered sugar.
Cool; break into small pieces.
recipes.text: Red Hot Cinnamon Candy. Mix sugar, water, and syrup in heavy pan. Turn on the vent over stove; open window if possible. The fumes are quite strong. Boil until hard crack stage. Remove from heat and add oil and coloring. Stir well; pour into cookie sheet which has been dusted with powdered sugar. Cool; break into small pieces.

recipes.title: Frito Salad
directions: Brown hamburger meat, set aside and let cool.
Combine lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes and cheese.
When meat is cool, add to salad mixture.
Place in refrigerator until ready to serve. Add Catalina dressing and Fritos just before serving, then serve immediately.
recipes.text: Frito Salad. Brown hamburger meat, set aside and let cool. Combine lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes and cheese. When meat is cool, add to salad mixture. Place in refrigerator until ready to serve. Add Catalina dressing and Fritos just before serving, then serve immediately.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Boil the potatoes, cream, butter and salt to taste.
Brown ground beef and drain.
Add soup and milk.
Simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Pour mixture in bottom of casserole dish.
Make a layer of corn and layer of cheese.
Top with cream potatoes.
Bake at 400u00b0 until bubbly hot, for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Boil the potatoes, cream, butter and salt to taste. Brown ground beef and drain. Add soup and milk. Simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Pour mixture in bottom of casserole dish. Make a layer of corn and layer of cheese. Top with cream potatoes. Bake at 400u00b0 until bubbly hot, for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Clay'S Shrimp Mousse
directions: Mix soup and cream cheese over low heat.
Add gelatin and let cool. Mix rest of ingredients and chill in bowl or mold 4 to 6 hours.
recipes.text: Clay'S Shrimp Mousse. Mix soup and cream cheese over low heat. Add gelatin and let cool. Mix rest of ingredients and chill in bowl or mold 4 to 6 hours.

recipes.title: Meat Sauce For Meat Loaf
directions: Mix together and pour over meat loaf before baking.
recipes.text: Meat Sauce For Meat Loaf. Mix together and pour over meat loaf before baking.

recipes.title: French Bread(Makes 6 Loaves)
directions: Sprinkle yeast in 1/2 cup water in bowl.
Mix sugar and salt in 4 cups water.
Add shortening and yeast and mix well.
Add flour; mix well.
Knead until not sticky.
Place in greased bowl. Turn to grease top.
Cover.
Punch down well every 10 minutes for 5 times. Let rest, covered, 10 minutes.
Shape into loaves by rolling out in rectangular shape.
Roll into loaves.
Cut diagonal cuts across top.
Let rise until double.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: French Bread(Makes 6 Loaves). Sprinkle yeast in 1/2 cup water in bowl. Mix sugar and salt in 4 cups water. Add shortening and yeast and mix well. Add flour; mix well. Knead until not sticky. Place in greased bowl. Turn to grease top. Cover. Punch down well every 10 minutes for 5 times. Let rest, covered, 10 minutes. Shape into loaves by rolling out in rectangular shape. Roll into loaves. Cut diagonal cuts across top. Let rise until double. Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Medley Marinade(Vegetable Salad)
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can small early peas, drained
directions: Combine vegetables.
Mix vinegar, sugar and oil.
Pour over vegetable mixture.
Chill 24 hours.
Drain before serving.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Medley Marinade(Vegetable Salad). Combine vegetables. Mix vinegar, sugar and oil. Pour over vegetable mixture. Chill 24 hours. Drain before serving. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Chicken Roll-Ups
directions: Trim off loose pieces of breast.
Put in processor with cream, onion, salt and pepper.
Blend together.
Put on breast and fold over.
Prepare bread crumbs.
Beat egg in bowl.
Dip breast in crumbs and then dip in the egg (repeat).
Fry in butter and oil. Brown slightly.
recipes.text: Chicken Roll-Ups. Trim off loose pieces of breast. Put in processor with cream, onion, salt and pepper. Blend together. Put on breast and fold over. Prepare bread crumbs. Beat egg in bowl. Dip breast in crumbs and then dip in the egg (repeat). Fry in butter and oil. Brown slightly.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Relish
directions: Grind vegetables.
Sprinkle with salt.
Let stand overnight. Rinse and drain.
Combine with other ingredients and pour over vegetable mixture.
Seal in hot sterile jars.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Relish. Grind vegetables. Sprinkle with salt. Let stand overnight. Rinse and drain. Combine with other ingredients and pour over vegetable mixture. Seal in hot sterile jars.

recipes.title: Mexican Stuffed Pasta Shells
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bottle picante sauce (hot, medium or mild - you decide)
1 (4 oz.) can green chilies, chopped and drained (hot, medium or mild - you decide)
1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onion rings
1 small can sliced black olives, drained (optional)
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions, rinse and set aside.
In a bowl, combine picante sauce, water and tomato sauce. Put 1/2 tomato sauce mixture, chilies, black olives, 1/2 of all three cheese and 1/2 of the onion rings into the ground beef; mix well.
Pour 1/2 of the remaining tomato sauce mixture into the bottom of an 8 x 12-inch (or larger) casserole dish.
Stuff the pasta shells with beef mixture and place in the casserole dish. Pour the remaining tomato sauce over the stuffed shells.
Bake covered at 350u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining cheeses and onion rings over the top and bake, uncovered, for 5 more minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Mexican Stuffed Pasta Shells. Cook pasta according to package directions, rinse and set aside. In a bowl, combine picante sauce, water and tomato sauce. Put 1/2 tomato sauce mixture, chilies, black olives, 1/2 of all three cheese and 1/2 of the onion rings into the ground beef; mix well.
