Pour 1/2 of the remaining tomato sauce mixture into the bottom of an 8 x 12-inch (or larger) casserole dish. Stuff the pasta shells with beef mixture and place in the casserole dish. Pour the remaining tomato sauce over the stuffed shells. Bake covered at 350u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Sprinkle remaining cheeses and onion rings over the top and bake, uncovered, for 5 more minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cheesy Onion Pie
directions: Prepare pastry.
Chill, but do not bake.
Toss Swiss cheese and flour in pie shell.
Cover with sauteed onion slices and sliced tomatoes.
Sprinkle with basil and oregano.
Cover with remaining cheese.
Beat eggs in small bowl; add the half and half. Pour egg mixture into the pie plate.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Cheesy Onion Pie. Prepare pastry. Chill, but do not bake. Toss Swiss cheese and flour in pie shell. Cover with sauteed onion slices and sliced tomatoes. Sprinkle with basil and oregano. Cover with remaining cheese. Beat eggs in small bowl; add the half and half. Pour egg mixture into the pie plate. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Red Lobster Rolls
directions: Combine flour, milk and cheese with wooden spoon until soft dough forms, then beat 30 seconds.
Drop dough by heaping tablespoonfuls onto greased iron skillet.
Bake in preheated oven at 450u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
Mix butter, garlic and parsley together and brush on warm rolls.
recipes.text: Red Lobster Rolls. Combine flour, milk and cheese with wooden spoon until soft dough forms, then beat 30 seconds. Drop dough by heaping tablespoonfuls onto greased iron skillet. Bake in preheated oven at 450u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Mix butter, garlic and parsley together and brush on warm rolls.

recipes.title: Chicken Chili
directions: Remove skin from chicken; cut meat from bones and cut meat into 1-inch cubes.
Brown in kettle with 2 tablespoons salad oil. Stir in onions, green pepper and garlic; saute until tender.
Add chili powder, salt and pepper.
Stir in tomatoes; bring to boil. Cover; simmer 15 minutes.
Add kidney beans and Mexican style corn.
Cook until heated.
Cheese may be sprinkled on top of chili when serving.
Serves 4.
Use heavy kettle when cooking.
recipes.text: Chicken Chili. Remove skin from chicken; cut meat from bones and cut meat into 1-inch cubes. Brown in kettle with 2 tablespoons salad oil. Stir in onions, green pepper and garlic; saute until tender. Add chili powder, salt and pepper. Stir in tomatoes; bring to boil. Cover; simmer 15 minutes. Add kidney beans and Mexican style corn. Cook until heated. Cheese may be sprinkled on top of chili when serving. Serves 4. Use heavy kettle when cooking.

recipes.title: Slobbsville Stew
ingredients: 4 to 6 potatoes, not too finely chopped
directions: Put in big casserole and bake for 3 1/4 hours at 300u00b0.
For last 15 minutes, add 1 package frozen peas and parsley.
recipes.text: Slobbsville Stew. Put in big casserole and bake for 3 1/4 hours at 300u00b0. For last 15 minutes, add 1 package frozen peas and parsley.

recipes.title: Eggplant Patties
directions: In covered saucepan, cook eggplant in boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes.
Drain well and mash.
Stir in crumbs, cheese, onion, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper.
Shape into patties.
Cook in hot oil for 5 minutes on each side.
recipes.text: Eggplant Patties. In covered saucepan, cook eggplant in boiling water until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain well and mash. Stir in crumbs, cheese, onion, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper. Shape into patties. Cook in hot oil for 5 minutes on each side.

recipes.title: Apple Dip(Perfect For Kids!)
directions: In a bowl, mix all ingredients until brown sugar has blended into cream cheese and vanilla. If mixture is too thin, add brown sugar. If mixture is too thick, add vanilla. You can add peanut butter, nuts or use flavored cream cheese. Serve with apple slices.
recipes.text: Apple Dip(Perfect For Kids!). In a bowl, mix all ingredients until brown sugar has blended into cream cheese and vanilla. If mixture is too thin, add brown sugar. If mixture is too thick, add vanilla. You can add peanut butter, nuts or use flavored cream cheese. Serve with apple slices.

recipes.title: Fruity Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks or tidbits, drained
1 large navel orange or 11 oz. can Mandarin oranges, drained
1/2 c. green, yellow and/or sweet red pepper, diced
2 tsp. each lime juice and honey
directions: If using navel orange, peel and section it, then cut sections into bite-sized pieces.
Combine rice, fruit, peppers and almonds. In small bowl, whisk together salad oil, seasoned rice vinegar, cinnamon, lime juice and honey; pour over rice mixture and gently stir.
Chill.
Serve with honey-mustard dressing.
recipes.text: Fruity Rice Salad. If using navel orange, peel and section it, then cut sections into bite-sized pieces. Combine rice, fruit, peppers and almonds. In small bowl, whisk together salad oil, seasoned rice vinegar, cinnamon, lime juice and honey; pour over rice mixture and gently stir. Chill. Serve with honey-mustard dressing.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
ingredients: 1 tsp. Old Bay or other seafood seasoning
directions: Break bread in small pieces and moisten with a little milk. Mix together and shape into cakes.
Fry quickly, until brown.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Break bread in small pieces and moisten with a little milk. Mix together and shape into cakes. Fry quickly, until brown.

recipes.title: Aunt Dixie'S Company Best Pickles
directions: Cover whole cucumbers with boiling water; let stand overnight. Drain.
Repeat the procedure 4 more days.
On the fifth day, drain and slice in 1/2-inch pieces.
recipes.text: Aunt Dixie'S Company Best Pickles. Cover whole cucumbers with boiling water; let stand overnight. Drain. Repeat the procedure 4 more days. On the fifth day, drain and slice in 1/2-inch pieces.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Cook macaroni as package directs; drain.
Melt margarine in saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth. Gradually stir in milk and bring to a boil, stirring.

Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/2 cups cheese and the macaroni. Pour into 2-quart casserole and sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.
recipes.text: Baked Macaroni And Cheese. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Cook macaroni as package directs; drain. Melt margarine in saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth. Gradually stir in milk and bring to a boil, stirring. Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/2 cups cheese and the macaroni. Pour into 2-quart casserole and sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.

recipes.title: Pizza Dip
directions: Beat cream cheese and sour cream together.
Add spices and red pepper.
Layer that on bottom of ceramic casserole dish (preferably round).
Add pizza sauce, then pepperoni.
recipes.text: Pizza Dip. Beat cream cheese and sour cream together. Add spices and red pepper. Layer that on bottom of ceramic casserole dish (preferably round). Add pizza sauce, then pepperoni.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
ingredients: 1/2 c. apple butter (can be found in jams and jelly section)
directions: Place cream cheese, butter, sugar and vanilla in bowl.
Mix until smooth.
Stir in chopped nuts.
Chill before serving.
Serve with sliced apples.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Dip. Place cream cheese, butter, sugar and vanilla in bowl. Mix until smooth. Stir in chopped nuts. Chill before serving. Serve with sliced apples.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
directions: Prepare Dream Whip.
Set aside 1 cup for garnish.
Add pumpkin, milk, pudding and spices.
Mix slowly with rotary beater. Pour in pie shell.
Chill 2 hours.
Garnish with topping.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie. Prepare Dream Whip. Set aside 1 cup for garnish. Add pumpkin, milk, pudding and spices. Mix slowly with rotary beater. Pour in pie shell. Chill 2 hours. Garnish with topping.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients except baking soda and hot water.
Mix baking soda and hot water and add to rest of mixture; batter will be thin.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Mix all ingredients except baking soda and hot water. Mix baking soda and hot water and add to rest of mixture; batter will be thin. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Dressing
ingredients: 1 c. raw rice (less baking time if rice is cooked)
directions: Brown meat.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Rice Dressing. Brown meat. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
directions: Soften cream cheese.
Mix in Ranch dressing.
Add chilies, pimentos, Cheddar cheese, olives and green onions.
Spread on tortillas.
Roll "jelly roll" fashion and slice.
Serve with salsa. Looks great for Christmas with the red, white and green!
recipes.text: Tortilla Roll-Ups. Soften cream cheese. Mix in Ranch dressing. Add chilies, pimentos, Cheddar cheese, olives and green onions. Spread on tortillas. Roll "jelly roll" fashion and slice. Serve with salsa. Looks great for Christmas with the red, white and green!

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken until tender; take off bone and cut into small pieces.
Melt butter and pour over crumbs.
Put half of crumbs into baking dish, then add chicken.
Mix soup mixture with 2 cans of chicken broth.
Pour over chicken and top with remaining crumbs.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken until tender; take off bone and cut into small pieces. Melt butter and pour over crumbs. Put half of crumbs into baking dish, then add chicken. Mix soup mixture with 2 cans of chicken broth. Pour over chicken and top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans chunk chicken, drained (or 1 c. leftover chicken, chopped)
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain.
Stir in all ingredients except potato chips.
Put in casserole dish. If cheesier flavor is desired, layer mixture with sliced American cheese in the middle and more on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.
Add crushed potato chips on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole. Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain. Stir in all ingredients except potato chips. Put in casserole dish. If cheesier flavor is desired, layer mixture with sliced American cheese in the middle and more on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. Add crushed potato chips on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Punch
directions: Mix sugar, orange juice, pineapple juice and kool-aid together.
Put in large punch bowl.
Add ice ring and ginger ale. This is a fast punch that is really good.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix sugar, orange juice, pineapple juice and kool-aid together. Put in large punch bowl. Add ice ring and ginger ale. This is a fast punch that is really good.

recipes.title: Crunchy Potato Wedges
directions: Combine seasonings in a shallow dish.
Place butter in glass mixing bowl; microwave one minute until melted.
Cut potatoes in half, lengthwise into three wedges.
Dip in butter and then in cheese mixture.
Place cut-side up in baking dish.
Cover with wax paper.
Cook on High power for 10-12 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Crunchy Potato Wedges. Combine seasonings in a shallow dish. Place butter in glass mixing bowl; microwave one minute until melted. Cut potatoes in half, lengthwise into three wedges. Dip in butter and then in cheese mixture. Place cut-side up in baking dish. Cover with wax paper. Cook on High power for 10-12 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Everyday Easy Broccoli Bake
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's cream of broccoli soup
1 (1 1/2 lb.) bunch fresh broccoli, cut up, cooked and drained
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper.
Stir in broccoli and 1/2 can of onions.
recipes.text: Everyday Easy Broccoli Bake. In a 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper. Stir in broccoli and 1/2 can of onions.

recipes.title: Potato-Onion Piquante
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. buttermilk Ranch Style dressing
directions: Make several crosswise slices in each potato, not cutting quite all the way through bottom peel (each slice to be approximately 1/2 inch thickness).
Gently open cuts and place one onion slice in each.
Place in a shallow dish.
Cover and bake at 450u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are done.
Dot with margarine.
recipes.text: Potato-Onion Piquante. Make several crosswise slices in each potato, not cutting quite all the way through bottom peel (each slice to be approximately 1/2 inch thickness). Gently open cuts and place one onion slice in each. Place in a shallow dish. Cover and bake at 450u00b0 for 1 hour or until potatoes are done. Dot with margarine.

recipes.title: Carrot Tea Bread
directions: Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Beat eggs, sugar and oil in large mixing bowl.
Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon and add to egg mixture.
Stir in carrots.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until center springs back.
Cool 10 minutes in pan.
Remove and cool completely.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar or a cream cheese frosting.
recipes.text: Carrot Tea Bread. Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Beat eggs, sugar and oil in large mixing bowl. Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon and add to egg mixture. Stir in carrots. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until center springs back. Cool 10 minutes in pan. Remove and cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar or a cream cheese frosting.

recipes.title: Violet'S Chocolate Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients into an 8-inch square pan.
Make 3 holes in the mixture.
In the first one, add the vanilla.
In the second, add the vinegar.
In the third, add the cooking oil.
Add 1 cup of water to the whole mixture.
Stir with a fork until blended and bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Violet'S Chocolate Cake. Sift dry ingredients into an 8-inch square pan. Make 3 holes in the mixture. In the first one, add the vanilla. In the second, add the vinegar. In the third, add the cooking oil. Add 1 cup of water to the whole mixture. Stir with a fork until blended and bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Over Thats
directions: Melt butter in baking pan.
Add crushed crackers evenly over butter. Sprinkle chocolate bits over crackers.
Add coconut. Place pecans evenly over coconut. Drizzle condensed milk over top of the pecans.
Place in oven at 350u00b0 to 400u00b0 until coconut has a golden look.
Let cool and cut in squares.
recipes.text: Over Thats. Melt butter in baking pan. Add crushed crackers evenly over butter. Sprinkle chocolate bits over crackers. Add coconut. Place pecans evenly over coconut. Drizzle condensed milk over top of the pecans. Place in oven at 350u00b0 to 400u00b0 until coconut has a golden look. Let cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Lobster Newburgh
directions: Cut the lobster into 1-inch pieces.
In a large skillet, melt the butter.

Add lobster pieces; saute briefly 2 or 3 minutes. Set aside lobster, then stir in flour, salt, nutmeg and cayenne. In a bowl, beat the egg yolks; blend in light cream. Pour mixture into skillet; gradually stir in lobster, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens slightly.
Add sherry.
Serve bubbling hot over crisp toast.
Garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Lobster Newburgh. Cut the lobster into 1-inch pieces. In a large skillet, melt the butter. Add lobster pieces; saute briefly 2 or 3 minutes. Set aside lobster, then stir in flour, salt, nutmeg and cayenne. In a bowl, beat the egg yolks; blend in light cream. Pour mixture into skillet; gradually stir in lobster, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens slightly. Add sherry. Serve bubbling hot over crisp toast. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Cheese Souffles
ingredients: 6 slices buttered bread, cut in cubes
dash of cayenne, paprika or pepper
directions: Alternate bread and cheese in buttered casserole.
Beat eggs until light and mix with remaining ingredients.
Pour egg mixture over cheese and bread.
Let stand 4 hours in refrigerator or overnight.tBake
1 hour at 350u00b0.
Sprinkle with bacon bits. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Cheese Souffles. Alternate bread and cheese in buttered casserole. Beat eggs until light and mix with remaining ingredients. Pour egg mixture over cheese and bread. Let stand 4 hours in refrigerator or overnight.tBake 1 hour at 350u00b0. Sprinkle with bacon bits. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
directions: Soak lentils for 10 minutes; drain and rinse.
Combine all ingredients in a medium pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until tender, for about 2 hours.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add additional water if necessary.
Serve with a lemon wedge. Squeeze lemon over soup before eating.
recipes.text: Lentil Soup. Soak lentils for 10 minutes; drain and rinse. Combine all ingredients in a medium pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer until tender, for about 2 hours. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add additional water if necessary. Serve with a lemon wedge. Squeeze lemon over soup before eating.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Judgies
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa.
Add milk and butter and bring to boil for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter, vanilla, oatmeal and salt and mix well.
Drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls while hot.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Judgies. Mix sugar and cocoa. Add milk and butter and bring to boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, vanilla, oatmeal and salt and mix well. Drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls while hot. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in a tube pan for 45 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven.
Be sure to grease the pan before you put the batter in.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Cake. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a tube pan for 45 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven. Be sure to grease the pan before you put the batter in.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Salad
directions: Cook and drain mixed vegetables.
Rinse and drain kidney beans.
Mix all vegetables and macaroni together.
Mix remaining ingredients in saucepan.
Cook until thick.
Pour over vegetables while still hot.
Mix well.
Refrigerate overnight or longer.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Salad. Cook and drain mixed vegetables. Rinse and drain kidney beans. Mix all vegetables and macaroni together. Mix remaining ingredients in saucepan. Cook until thick. Pour over vegetables while still hot. Mix well. Refrigerate overnight or longer.

recipes.title: Cheese Soup
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and cook until veggies are tender. Make a paste of milk and flour; add to veggies and cook until smooth and thick, stirring often. Add cheese and stir until cheese is melted; do not add salt.
recipes.text: Cheese Soup. Mix first 6 ingredients together and cook until veggies are tender. Make a paste of milk and flour; add to veggies and cook until smooth and thick, stirring often. Add cheese and stir until cheese is melted; do not add salt.

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls
ingredients: 1 pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water
directions: Mix sugar and shortening by hand.
Pour warm milk overnight and stir.
Add beaten egg and dissolved yeast.
Add flour and salt. Let rise to double in size, covered for approximately 2 hours. Knead for about 5 minutes.
Roll and cut in desired shapes.
Let rise again, then bake at 400u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Yeast Rolls. Mix sugar and shortening by hand. Pour warm milk overnight and stir. Add beaten egg and dissolved yeast. Add flour and salt. Let rise to double in size, covered for approximately 2 hours. Knead for about 5 minutes. Roll and cut in desired shapes. Let rise again, then bake at 400u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Onion-Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. finely crushed butter-flavored crackers (about 45 crackers), divided
1/2 lb. pasteurized process cheese, cut into small pieces
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Spread 1 cup cracker crumbs in a greased 8 x 11-inch baking dish.
In a large skillet, melt 1/4 cup butter over medium heat.
Add onions; cook until tender.
Spoon onion over cracker crumbs.
recipes.text: Onion-Cheese Casserole. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Spread 1 cup cracker crumbs in a greased 8 x 11-inch baking dish. In a large skillet, melt 1/4 cup butter over medium heat. Add onions; cook until tender. Spoon onion over cracker crumbs.

recipes.title: Batter Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in water.
Add half of the flour (3 1/4 cups), sugar, salt and shortening.
Blend at low speed with mixer, then beat 2 minutes at medium speed.
Mix in remaining flour by hand. Cover and let rise until doubled (about 45 minutes).
Stir batter, beating hard about 30 seconds.
Spread in 2 greased loaf pans. Let rise about 20 minutes or until doubled.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Batter Bread. Dissolve yeast in water. Add half of the flour (3 1/4 cups), sugar, salt and shortening. Blend at low speed with mixer, then beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Mix in remaining flour by hand. Cover and let rise until doubled (about 45 minutes). Stir batter, beating hard about 30 seconds. Spread in 2 greased loaf pans. Let rise about 20 minutes or until doubled. Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1/4 c. good Castroville garlic sausage, minced
1 c. soft bread crumbs or smashed garlic croutons
4 whole chicken breasts (you can use partridges if you can afford them)
1/2 c. orange juice or 1/3 c. each: orange juice and cheap champagne
directions: Combine the first five ingredients.
Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Stuff the chicken breasts and tie with kitchen string.
Brush the outside of the breasts with the oil which has been blended with paprika and, optionally, 1 teaspoon salt.
Place in a shallow casserole.
Place stemmed while grapes around fowl.
Bake about 35 minutes, until delicately browned.
Brush with oil and baste frequently (at least 3 times) with orange juice or mixture.
recipes.text: Chicken Tetrazzini. Combine the first five ingredients. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Stuff the chicken breasts and tie with kitchen string. Brush the outside of the breasts with the oil which has been blended with paprika and, optionally, 1 teaspoon salt. Place in a shallow casserole. Place stemmed while grapes around fowl. Bake about 35 minutes, until delicately browned. Brush with oil and baste frequently (at least 3 times) with orange juice or mixture.

recipes.title: Spaghetti With Meat Sauce
directions: Put 2 quarts water in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Add a pinch of salt (vegetable oil, optional) and noodles.
Continue boiling about 12 minutes or until noodles are tender.
Brown ground beef and drain off excess fat.
Mix spaghetti sauce and ground beef and pour over noodles.
recipes.text: Spaghetti With Meat Sauce. Put 2 quarts water in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add a pinch of salt (vegetable oil, optional) and noodles. Continue boiling about 12 minutes or until noodles are tender. Brown ground beef and drain off excess fat. Mix spaghetti sauce and ground beef and pour over noodles.

recipes.title: Alabama Pecan Pie
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Pour into pie crusts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Alabama Pecan Pie. Mix ingredients together. Pour into pie crusts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients except pie shell and mix well.
Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Combine all ingredients except pie shell and mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spam Special
directions: Cut Spam into slices.
Place slices in an oblong baking dish. Mix brown sugar, mustard and pineapple juice; pour over Spam. Bake in a 380u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes.
Garnish with pineapple slices.
recipes.text: Spam Special. Cut Spam into slices. Place slices in an oblong baking dish. Mix brown sugar, mustard and pineapple juice; pour over Spam. Bake in a 380u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Garnish with pineapple slices.

recipes.title: Date Dainties
directions: Combine dates, margarine, sugar and egg in saucepan.
Cook for eight minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in pecans and cereal. Shape as desired.
Roll in coconut.
Let stand until cool.
Store in airtight container.
Yields 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Date Dainties. Combine dates, margarine, sugar and egg in saucepan. Cook for eight minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in pecans and cereal. Shape as desired. Roll in coconut. Let stand until cool. Store in airtight container. Yields 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Hamburg Chowder
directions: Brown hamburg and onion.
Add remaining ingredients and seasonings.
Simmer 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hamburg Chowder. Brown hamburg and onion. Add remaining ingredients and seasonings. Simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chuck Roast
directions: Rub butter over roast; add salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix onion mix with mushroom juice.
Spread mixture over roast and sprinkle mushrooms.
Roast for about 3 hours (pan covered with foil) at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chuck Roast. Rub butter over roast; add salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Mix onion mix with mushroom juice. Spread mixture over roast and sprinkle mushrooms. Roast for about 3 hours (pan covered with foil) at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Perfect Trio Salad
directions: Drain syrup from pineapple and add water to make 1/2 cup.
Heat to boiling.
Add Jell-O, stirring until dissolved.
Add lemon juice, vinegar and salt.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Stir in drained pineapple, carrots and green pepper.
Pour into mold; chill until firm.
Unmold onto lettuce leaves.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Perfect Trio Salad. Drain syrup from pineapple and add water to make 1/2 cup. Heat to boiling. Add Jell-O, stirring until dissolved. Add lemon juice, vinegar and salt. Chill until slightly thickened. Stir in drained pineapple, carrots and green pepper. Pour into mold; chill until firm. Unmold onto lettuce leaves. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Turkey Cobb Salad
ingredients: 4 cups cut (1 inch) tender inner Romaine lettuce leaves
8 strips bacon, cut into 1 inch pieces (fried 10 min.)
4 hard cooked eggs, quartered and halved
1/2 pound Roquefort Cheese, chilled & cut into 1/2 in. cubes
4 ripe plum tomatoes, each cut into 8 pieces
1 ripe avocados, peeled, pitted & cut into 1/2 in. pieces
directions: Prepare the first 7 ingredients.
Arrange decoratively in rows on a large platter.
Sprinkle with the parsley.
Present with vinaigrette and serving bowls along side.
recipes.text: Turkey Cobb Salad. Prepare the first 7 ingredients. Arrange decoratively in rows on a large platter. Sprinkle with the parsley. Present with vinaigrette and serving bowls along side.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Put the cornbread mix in a bowl, then mix with the ingredients.
Preheat oven to 350u00b0, then put the cornbread in a pan and cook for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Put the cornbread mix in a bowl, then mix with the ingredients. Preheat oven to 350u00b0, then put the cornbread in a pan and cook for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into strips
directions: In skillet, cook chicken in sauce.
When chicken is throughly cooked, remove from pan.
With vegetables make a large tossed salad.
Add any fresh salad vegetable you like.
Toss in pineapple and walnuts.
On individual dinner plates, place tossed salad. Top with chicken.
Use your favorite salad dressing.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Chicken Salad. In skillet, cook chicken in sauce. When chicken is throughly cooked, remove from pan. With vegetables make a large tossed salad. Add any fresh salad vegetable you like. Toss in pineapple and walnuts. On individual dinner plates, place tossed salad. Top with chicken. Use your favorite salad dressing.

recipes.title: Indian Cabbage
directions: Place shredded cabbage, corned beef and onion in 4-quart casserole.
Cover with bread crumbs.
Pour milk and butter over casserole.
Cover with lid or foil.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and cook 30 minutes more, or until brown and cabbage is tender.
Makes 4 servings.
Use more moister if needed.
recipes.text: Indian Cabbage. Place shredded cabbage, corned beef and onion in 4-quart casserole. Cover with bread crumbs. Pour milk and butter over casserole. Cover with lid or foil. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and cook 30 minutes more, or until brown and cabbage is tender. Makes 4 servings. Use more moister if needed.

recipes.title: Ritzy Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. finely shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/2 cup juice.
Place pineapple in baking dish.
Sprinkle with mixture of flour and sugar.
Pour reserved juice over top. Sprinkle with cheese and cracker crumbs. Drizzle with margarine.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Serve with ham.
Yield:
8 servings.
recipes.text: Ritzy Pineapple Casserole. Drain pineapple, reserving 1/2 cup juice. Place pineapple in baking dish. Sprinkle with mixture of flour and sugar. Pour reserved juice over top. Sprinkle with cheese and cracker crumbs. Drizzle with margarine. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serve with ham. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix and make into
1-inch
balls.
Freeze
on
a cookie sheet and then drop intotplastic bag.
Take out as needed and bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix and make into 1-inch balls. Freeze on a cookie sheet and then drop intotplastic bag. Take out as needed and bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Ham And Cabbage Soup
directions: Melt butter.
Saute onion and celery until tender.
Add flour, salt and pepper, blending until smooth.
Add water and cook until mixture comes to boil, stirring constantly.
Add cabbage.
Cover and simmer until cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in ham and cook until heated through.
Blend in sour cream. Heat but do not boil.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Ham And Cabbage Soup. Melt butter. Saute onion and celery until tender. Add flour, salt and pepper, blending until smooth. Add water and cook until mixture comes to boil, stirring constantly. Add cabbage. Cover and simmer until cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in ham and cook until heated through. Blend in sour cream. Heat but do not boil. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Quick Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 Kraft singles process cheese, cut diagonally
directions: Place tortilla on microwavable plate. Arrange cheese slices on tortilla without overlapping. Fold tortilla in half. Cover. Microwave on high 25 to 45 seconds or until cheese is melted. Let stand, covered one minute or until cool enough to eat. Fold in half again.
recipes.text: Quick Quesadillas. Place tortilla on microwavable plate. Arrange cheese slices on tortilla without overlapping. Fold tortilla in half. Cover. Microwave on high 25 to 45 seconds or until cheese is melted. Let stand, covered one minute or until cool enough to eat. Fold in half again.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Melt oleo and mix herb stuffing.
Divide in half and mix soup and sour cream with 1/2 of stuffing mix and all other ingredients. Place in buttered baking dish.
Spread the last half of the herb stuffing mix on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Melt oleo and mix herb stuffing. Divide in half and mix soup and sour cream with 1/2 of stuffing mix and all other ingredients. Place in buttered baking dish. Spread the last half of the herb stuffing mix on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Supreme
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farm Herb Season Mix
directions: Mash cooked squash then add soup, onion, carrots, sour cream, salt and pepper. Butter bottom of a baking dish. Sprinkle crumbs on bottom of bowl. Add squash mixture. Cover squash with crumbs and butter on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Supreme. Mash cooked squash then add soup, onion, carrots, sour cream, salt and pepper. Butter bottom of a baking dish. Sprinkle crumbs on bottom of bowl. Add squash mixture. Cover squash with crumbs and butter on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Cut in egg until crumbly.
Melt butter and add 1/4 cup hot water.
Put apples in a baking dish.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Cover apples with flour mixture.
Spoon butter mixture over until flour is dampened.
Bake at 400u00b0 until crust is golden brown and crispy.
Serve with ice cream.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Cut in egg until crumbly. Melt butter and add 1/4 cup hot water. Put apples in a baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Cover apples with flour mixture. Spoon butter mixture over until flour is dampened. Bake at 400u00b0 until crust is golden brown and crispy. Serve with ice cream.

recipes.title: Orange Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour a Bundt cake pan. Combine all ingredients; beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 2 minutes.
Pour into pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Orange Pound Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour a Bundt cake pan. Combine all ingredients; beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 2 minutes. Pour into pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Herbed Chicken Saute
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Brush over chicken.
Saute in nonstick skillet until lightly browned and thoroughly cooked.
recipes.text: Herbed Chicken Saute. Combine all ingredients. Brush over chicken. Saute in nonstick skillet until lightly browned and thoroughly cooked.

recipes.title: Cola Chops
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Place pork chops in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, mix together the cola and ketchup. Pour over chops and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake uncovered for about 1 hour, or until pork is cooked through and internal temperature has reached 160u00b0.
recipes.text: Cola Chops. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Place pork chops in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, mix together the cola and ketchup. Pour over chops and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake uncovered for about 1 hour, or until pork is cooked through and internal temperature has reached 160u00b0.

recipes.title: Chinese Beef
ingredients: 3/4 lb. round steak, cooked and cut in strips
directions: Mix together and heat well.
Serve over mixed rice.
recipes.text: Chinese Beef. Mix together and heat well. Serve over mixed rice.

recipes.title: Green Beans
ingredients: fresh green beans, cleaned and left whole
directions: Steam the beans until crisp or soft, your choice. Drizzle with olive oil, salt, pepper and garlic parsley blend. Toss together and serve.
recipes.text: Green Beans. Steam the beans until crisp or soft, your choice. Drizzle with olive oil, salt, pepper and garlic parsley blend. Toss together and serve.

recipes.title: Blueberry Buckle
directions: Mix sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla.
Stir in milk.
Sift and add flour, salt and baking powder. Blend in blueberries.
Pour into greased tube pan and top with crumb mixture.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Blueberry Buckle. Mix sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla. Stir in milk. Sift and add flour, salt and baking powder. Blend in blueberries. Pour into greased tube pan and top with crumb mixture. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Orange Fluff
ingredients: 1 small cottage cheese (same size as Cool Whip)
directions: Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese and add dry Jell-O; mix.
Add drained fruit, mix and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Orange Fluff. Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese and add dry Jell-O; mix. Add drained fruit, mix and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Dumplings
directions: Beat egg until smooth; add milk and melted shortening.
Pour this into the flour and sugar and mix a very soft dough.
Drop by spoonfuls into chicken, turkey or beef broth.
recipes.text: Dumplings. Beat egg until smooth; add milk and melted shortening. Pour this into the flour and sugar and mix a very soft dough. Drop by spoonfuls into chicken, turkey or beef broth.

recipes.title: Squash Pie
directions: Beat eggs.
Add next four ingredients and mix well.
Next, add squash and mix well, then add milk and mix well.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes, then at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Squash Pie. Beat eggs. Add next four ingredients and mix well. Next, add squash and mix well, then add milk and mix well. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes, then at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Oven Stew
directions: Place ingredients in layers in casserole dish or Dutch oven. Don't mix and don't brown meat.
Bake in 250u00b0 oven for 4 to 5 hours, covered.
recipes.text: Oven Stew. Place ingredients in layers in casserole dish or Dutch oven. Don't mix and don't brown meat. Bake in 250u00b0 oven for 4 to 5 hours, covered.

recipes.title: Apple Muffins
directions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl.
Cut in shortening.
Add apples, then egg and milk.
Fold gently, just enough to blend. Bake in greased and floured muffin tins at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 16 large muffins.
recipes.text: Apple Muffins. Sift dry ingredients into bowl. Cut in shortening. Add apples, then egg and milk. Fold gently, just enough to blend. Bake in greased and floured muffin tins at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 16 large muffins.

recipes.title: Beer Bread
directions: Blend altogether.
Put in greased pan.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Beer Bread. Blend altogether. Put in greased pan. Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Raspberry Yogurt And Fruit
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen raspberries in light syrup, thawed
2 oranges, peeled with pith removed and sectioned
1 medium papaya, pared, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch cubes
10 fresh strawberries, rinsed, hulled and sliced
directions: Puree raspberries with syrup in food processor or blender. Strain; discard seeds.
In a small saucepan over high heat, bring raspberry puree to boiling.
In a small bowl, combine cold water and cornstarch; add to boiling puree.
Cook over medium-high heat, whisking constantly, 2 to 4 minutes, or until slightly thickened. Transfer to mixing bowl.
Put in freezer for 15 minutes, or until cold, but not frozen.
recipes.text: Raspberry Yogurt And Fruit. Puree raspberries with syrup in food processor or blender. Strain; discard seeds. In a small saucepan over high heat, bring raspberry puree to boiling. In a small bowl, combine cold water and cornstarch; add to boiling puree. Cook over medium-high heat, whisking constantly, 2 to 4 minutes, or until slightly thickened. Transfer to mixing bowl. Put in freezer for 15 minutes, or until cold, but not frozen.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
directions: In saucepan, cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling, salted water for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in shredded carrots.
Fold in drained squash and onions. Combine stuffing mix and melted butter or oleo.
recipes.text: Summer Squash Casserole. In saucepan, cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling, salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in shredded carrots. Fold in drained squash and onions. Combine stuffing mix and melted butter or oleo.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light.
Add eggs, well beaten, then flour, salt, vanilla, syrup and pecans.
Put into an unbaked pie crust.
Bake in oven at 450u00b0 for 10 minutes, then reduce to 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Cream butter and sugar until light. Add eggs, well beaten, then flour, salt, vanilla, syrup and pecans. Put into an unbaked pie crust. Bake in oven at 450u00b0 for 10 minutes, then reduce to 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma Raszman'S Mayonnaise-Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 2 c. all-purpose flour (less 4 Tbsp.) or 2 c. cake flour
directions: Mix all together until blended and bake in two round tins or 9 x 13-inch pan or whatever.
Bake at 325u00b0 in glass pan or 350u00b0 in metal pan.
Bake until done.
recipes.text: Grandma Raszman'S Mayonnaise-Chocolate Cake. Mix all together until blended and bake in two round tins or 9 x 13-inch pan or whatever. Bake at 325u00b0 in glass pan or 350u00b0 in metal pan. Bake until done.

recipes.title: White Fruit Cake(For Those Who Hate Fruitcakes.)
ingredients: 6 egg whites, beaten until stiff (add last)
1/2 lb. coconut, red candied cherries and candied pineapple
directions: Mix dry ingredients, except fruit and nuts.
Cream butter and sugar. Combine with the dry ingredients. Add fruit and nuts. Mix. Fold in egg whites. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 275u00b0 and 1 hour at 300u00b0.
recipes.text: White Fruit Cake(For Those Who Hate Fruitcakes.). Mix dry ingredients, except fruit and nuts. Cream butter and sugar. Combine with the dry ingredients. Add fruit and nuts. Mix. Fold in egg whites. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 275u00b0 and 1 hour at 300u00b0.

recipes.title: Confetti Rice
ingredients: 1 pkg. vegetable soup and recipe mix
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan, bring water and soup mix to a boil over medium high heat.
Add margarine and rice.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is tender.
recipes.text: Confetti Rice. In a 2-quart saucepan, bring water and soup mix to a boil over medium high heat. Add margarine and rice. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Oven-Baked Chicken Kiev
ingredients: 6 large whole chicken breasts, skinned and boned (about 3 lb.)
directions: Cream butter until fluffy.
Add chives, lemon peel, lemon juice and pepper; mix.
Shape 3/4 cup of this mixture into six 2-inch sticks.
Freeze firm.
Place chicken between sheets of waxed paper; pound to flatten.
Salt lightly.
Place 1 butter stick on each.
Roll up; secure with wooden picks.
Combine egg and 1 tablespoon water.
Coat chicken with flour.
Dip in egg; coat with crumbs.
In skillet, heat remaining butter mixture.
Add chicken; cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, turning to brown all sides.
Bake in shallow baking pan at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Serve over hot cooked noodles, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Oven-Baked Chicken Kiev. Cream butter until fluffy. Add chives, lemon peel, lemon juice and pepper; mix. Shape 3/4 cup of this mixture into six 2-inch sticks. Freeze firm. Place chicken between sheets of waxed paper; pound to flatten. Salt lightly. Place 1 butter stick on each. Roll up; secure with wooden picks. Combine egg and 1 tablespoon water. Coat chicken with flour. Dip in egg; coat with crumbs. In skillet, heat remaining butter mixture. Add chicken; cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes, turning to brown all sides. Bake in shallow baking pan at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes. Serve over hot cooked noodles, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Drop Biscuits
directions: Mix flour, baking powder and salt.
Mix in fat with fork or two knives until crumbly.
Add milk.
Mix enough to wet dry ingredients.
Drop dough from a tablespoon on greased baking pan. Bake at 450u00b0 (very hot oven) 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned.
Makes 12 biscuits.
recipes.text: Drop Biscuits. Mix flour, baking powder and salt. Mix in fat with fork or two knives until crumbly. Add milk. Mix enough to wet dry ingredients. Drop dough from a tablespoon on greased baking pan. Bake at 450u00b0 (very hot oven) 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 12 biscuits.

recipes.title: English Trifle Or "Glutton'S Delight"
directions: Make in a large deep bowl.
Tear up cake in small pieces in bowl.
Dissolve dry jello in thawed strawberries and mix with cake. Slice 1 banana over cake.
Mix pudding according to package directions and pour half in.
Spread on 1/2 container of Cool Whip.
Add other sliced banana.
Pour on remaining pudding. Spread on remaining Cool Whip.
Sprinkle on chopped pecans. Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: English Trifle Or "Glutton'S Delight". Make in a large deep bowl. Tear up cake in small pieces in bowl. Dissolve dry jello in thawed strawberries and mix with cake. Slice 1 banana over cake. Mix pudding according to package directions and pour half in. Spread on 1/2 container of Cool Whip. Add other sliced banana. Pour on remaining pudding. Spread on remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle on chopped pecans. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Put pie filling on bottom of pan, then pineapple with juice, then cake mix.
Press nuts down into this.
Dot margarine on top or melt and pour over.
Cook at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Fresh blueberries could be cooked and thickened with cornstarch and sugar added.
recipes.text: Blueberry Pie. Put pie filling on bottom of pan, then pineapple with juice, then cake mix. Press nuts down into this. Dot margarine on top or melt and pour over. Cook at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Fresh blueberries could be cooked and thickened with cornstarch and sugar added.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (3 1/2 oz.) instant French vanilla pudding mix
directions: Pour juice from pineapple chunks into mixing bowl.
Add pudding mix and stir well.tAdd
pineappletchunkstand
stir. Drain mandarin oranges andtcherries,
then
add
oranges
and cherries to pudding mix.
Slice and add bananas.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Pour juice from pineapple chunks into mixing bowl. Add pudding mix and stir well.tAdd pineappletchunkstand stir. Drain mandarin oranges andtcherries, then add oranges and cherries to pudding mix. Slice and add bananas.

recipes.title: Devil Dogs(Chocolate Moons)
directions: Cream together first four ingredients.
Sift together flour with next four ingredients and combine all with 1 cup milk.
Drop by tablespoon or teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 7 minutes at 400u00b0.
Fill cookies with Devil Dog Filling and top with confectioners sugar.
Sure to be a hit.
recipes.text: Devil Dogs(Chocolate Moons). Cream together first four ingredients. Sift together flour with next four ingredients and combine all with 1 cup milk. Drop by tablespoon or teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 7 minutes at 400u00b0. Fill cookies with Devil Dog Filling and top with confectioners sugar. Sure to be a hit.

recipes.title: Crab Melt-Aways
ingredients: 1 - 6 pack English muffins (split muffins in half)
1 jar Old English Sharp cheddar cheese spread
7 oz crab meat (may use imitation crab meat)
directions: Mix all ingredients except muffins. Spread on open muffins and place in freezer for at least 30 minutes. Cut each open-faced muffin into fourths (this will make them bite sized). Broil for 5 minutes or until golden brown. You may also prepare these weeks ahead of time and freeze until ready to use - then just pull out of the freezer and broil!
recipes.text: Crab Melt-Aways. Mix all ingredients except muffins. Spread on open muffins and place in freezer for at least 30 minutes. Cut each open-faced muffin into fourths (this will make them bite sized). Broil for 5 minutes or until golden brown. You may also prepare these weeks ahead of time and freeze until ready to use - then just pull out of the freezer and broil!

recipes.title: Triple Fudge Cake
directions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Cook pudding according to directions on package.
Pour hot pudding into dry cake mix and beat until thoroughly mixed.
Pour batter into cake pan.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and walnuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 approximately 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Triple Fudge Cake. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cook pudding according to directions on package. Pour hot pudding into dry cake mix and beat until thoroughly mixed. Pour batter into cake pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and walnuts. Bake at 350u00b0 approximately 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Cookies
directions: Mix pecans and sugar thoroughly.
Add egg whites and vanilla; mix well.
Drop by scant teaspoonfuls on well-greased cookie sheet 1 inch apart.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Moisten confectioners sugar with water; dot top of each cookie with mixture.
Remove with spatula.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Pecan Cookies. Mix pecans and sugar thoroughly. Add egg whites and vanilla; mix well. Drop by scant teaspoonfuls on well-greased cookie sheet 1 inch apart. Bake at 325u00b0 for 25 minutes. Moisten confectioners sugar with water; dot top of each cookie with mixture. Remove with spatula. Makes 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients with mixer until smooth. Pour into pie shells.
Chill 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Lemonade Pie. Mix all ingredients with mixer until smooth. Pour into pie shells. Chill 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Sift together
and
set aside sugar and flour.
Combine in saucepan
margarine,
shortening
or
oil, cocoa and water. Bring to boil and remove from heat.
Add to 1st mixture.
Then add the following:
buttermilk,
eggs, soda and vanilla.
Mix well and bake 20 minutes at 400u00b0 in sheet pan.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sheet Cake. Sift together and set aside sugar and flour. Combine in saucepan margarine, shortening or oil, cocoa and water. Bring to boil and remove from heat. Add to 1st mixture. Then add the following: buttermilk, eggs, soda and vanilla. Mix well and bake 20 minutes at 400u00b0 in sheet pan.

recipes.title: Ham N' Cheese Roll-Ups
directions: Blend cream cheese, Worcestershire sauce, chives/parsley and powdered mustard.
Spread over ham; roll up like jelly roll. Cover and chill 2 hours.
Cut into 1/2-inch slices.
Place on bread.
Yields 25 to 30.
recipes.text: Ham N' Cheese Roll-Ups. Blend cream cheese, Worcestershire sauce, chives/parsley and powdered mustard. Spread over ham; roll up like jelly roll. Cover and chill 2 hours. Cut into 1/2-inch slices. Place on bread. Yields 25 to 30.

recipes.title: Bean And Cheese Chili
ingredients: 1 can pinto or red kidney beans, drained
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/4 c. loosely packed snipped fresh cilantro
directions: Heat oil in a 2 to 3-quart saucepan over medium heat.
Add onions and green pepper and, stirring often, cook 5 to 6 minutes until onions are clear.
Stir in tomatoes, cumin, oregano, garlic, salt and sugar.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium low and simmer uncovered about 15 minutes to blend flavors.
Stir in beans; simmer 15 minutes longer until beans are hot and chili has thickened slightly.
Stir in black pepper.
Ladle into bowls and sprinkle with cheese and cilantro.
Serve with sour cream, if desired.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Bean And Cheese Chili. Heat oil in a 2 to 3-quart saucepan over medium heat. Add onions and green pepper and, stirring often, cook 5 to 6 minutes until onions are clear. Stir in tomatoes, cumin, oregano, garlic, salt and sugar. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium low and simmer uncovered about 15 minutes to blend flavors. Stir in beans; simmer 15 minutes longer until beans are hot and chili has thickened slightly. Stir in black pepper. Ladle into bowls and sprinkle with cheese and cilantro. Serve with sour cream, if desired. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Waffles
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Separate eggs.
Add milk to egg yolks and dry ingredients.
Add melted butter.
Beat egg whites well.
Add.
recipes.text: Waffles. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Separate eggs. Add milk to egg yolks and dry ingredients. Add melted butter. Beat egg whites well. Add.

recipes.title: Dr. Cookie'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Coat 2 baking sheets with nonstick cooking spray.
Beat margarine and sugars with a mixer until smooth.
Add eggs; beat again.
Add milk and vanilla; beat again until smooth.
Add flour, baking soda and salt; beat until well mixed.
Add chocolate chips and stir.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls, 2 inches apart. Flatten with back of a spoon.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes, until light brown.
Cool on wire rack.
recipes.text: Dr. Cookie'S Chocolate Chip Cookies. Coat 2 baking sheets with nonstick cooking spray. Beat margarine and sugars with a mixer until smooth. Add eggs; beat again. Add milk and vanilla; beat again until smooth. Add flour, baking soda and salt; beat until well mixed. Add chocolate chips and stir. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls, 2 inches apart. Flatten with back of a spoon. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes, until light brown. Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
directions: Fry sausage and hamburger together, then drain oil.
Combine Velveeta, hot taco and medium taco sauce; add meat into a crock-pot.
Cook on low 2 to 3 hours.
Serve with chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Dip. Fry sausage and hamburger together, then drain oil. Combine Velveeta, hot taco and medium taco sauce; add meat into a crock-pot. Cook on low 2 to 3 hours. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Soften margarine and cream cheese; blend until smooth.
Add sugar gradually.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Sift flour and baking powder together and add to cream mixture, about 1/3 cup at a time.
Add flavorings.
Bake in a well-greased 10-inch tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes in a 325u00b0 oven.
Let stay in pan for 5 minutes, then turn out.
Cool on rack until cool.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Soften margarine and cream cheese; blend until smooth. Add sugar gradually. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift flour and baking powder together and add to cream mixture, about 1/3 cup at a time. Add flavorings. Bake in a well-greased 10-inch tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes in a 325u00b0 oven. Let stay in pan for 5 minutes, then turn out. Cool on rack until cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Combine and heat soups, seasonings, onions and broth, mixing well.
Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with chips, then layer of chicken, half the sauce and cheese on top.
Repeat, ending with cheese.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
May be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchiladas. Combine and heat soups, seasonings, onions and broth, mixing well. Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with chips, then layer of chicken, half the sauce and cheese on top. Repeat, ending with cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. May be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Rolls
directions: Add milk to corn meal slowly.
Cook until thick, remove from heat.
Add sugar, margarine, and salt.
Let cool.
Dissolve yeast in water and let stand 10 minutes.
Add yeast to beaten egg and corn meal.
Add flour and knead, will be very soft.
Let rise once.
Roll out 3/4 inch thick and cut with cookie cutter and let rise.
Use for hamburger buns or rolls.
Bake at 350u00b0 until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cornmeal Rolls. Add milk to corn meal slowly. Cook until thick, remove from heat. Add sugar, margarine, and salt. Let cool. Dissolve yeast in water and let stand 10 minutes. Add yeast to beaten egg and corn meal. Add flour and knead, will be very soft. Let rise once. Roll out 3/4 inch thick and cut with cookie cutter and let rise. Use for hamburger buns or rolls. Bake at 350u00b0 until golden brown.

recipes.title: Vegetable And Beef Soup
ingredients: 1/2 medium cabbage, cut in small pieces
directions: Cube beef and brown in large pot in small amount of oil.
Add tomatoes after putting them through blender.
Add onion, celery, zucchini, carrots, beans, butter beans, cabbage, potatoes and butter.
Cook slow for about 1 to 2 hours, the longer the better.
recipes.text: Vegetable And Beef Soup. Cube beef and brown in large pot in small amount of oil. Add tomatoes after putting them through blender. Add onion, celery, zucchini, carrots, beans, butter beans, cabbage, potatoes and butter. Cook slow for about 1 to 2 hours, the longer the better.

recipes.title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
directions: Mix together, then spoon on cookie sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Neiman-Marcus Cookies. Mix together, then spoon on cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Homemade Vegetable Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. red potatoes, finely cubed (about 2 1/2 cups cooked)
1 lb. sliced okra (frozen or fresh, but thaw if frozen)
directions: Clean and cut carrots crosswise in 2 inch pieces;
place in 5 quart cooking pan.
Wash roast, cut up in large pieces, season with salt, ground black pepper and garlic salt.
Transfer meat to 5 quart pan with carrots; add water to top of meat.
Cook covered for 2 hours or longer until very tender.
OR, cook in pressurized cooker (i.e., Presto cooker) with water up to top of meat for 40 minutes.
Remove meat to large bowl or rectangular pan, reserving broth.
Discard suet.
Trim fat from meat and cut into small pieces.
Remove carrots to a small bowl.
Set meat and carrots aside.
Strain beef broth into separate bowl, add water, if necessary, to make 2 cups; set broth aside.
recipes.text: Homemade Vegetable Beef Soup. Clean and cut carrots crosswise in 2 inch pieces; place in 5 quart cooking pan. Wash roast, cut up in large pieces, season with salt, ground black pepper and garlic salt. Transfer meat to 5 quart pan with carrots; add water to top of meat. Cook covered for 2 hours or longer until very tender. OR, cook in pressurized cooker (i.e., Presto cooker) with water up to top of meat for 40 minutes. Remove meat to large bowl or rectangular pan, reserving broth. Discard suet. Trim fat from meat and cut into small pieces. Remove carrots to a small bowl. Set meat and carrots aside. Strain beef broth into separate bowl, add water, if necessary, to make 2 cups; set broth aside.
