recipes.text: Southern Style Stuffed Yams(A Southern Style Favorite). Heat oven tot325u00b0. Bake yams until tender, approximately 1 hour. Cool slightly. Slice yams lengthwise. Scoop outtpulp, leaving a shell of potato pulp to protect the thin skin of the yams. Combine peanut butter, milk, cinnamon and allspice with the scooped-out pulp while still warm, and mash thoroughly. Fill hollowed-out potato skins with the mixture, mounding slightly. Mix the peanuts and bread crumbs and scatter evenly over tops of stuffed yams. Drizzle melted butter evenly over all, and place under broiler to brown. Serve immediately. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Bacon Bites(Pampered Chef Recipe)
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Unroll crescent rolls, leaving 2 rectangles together.
Pinch seams.
(You will have 4 rectangles.)
recipes.text: Cheese Bacon Bites(Pampered Chef Recipe). Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Unroll crescent rolls, leaving 2 rectangles together. Pinch seams. (You will have 4 rectangles.)

recipes.title: Green Bean Sandwich Roll-Up
directions: Marinate overnight in Italian dressing. Mix cream cheese and Italian seasoning together.
Spread on white sandwich size bread. Cut edges off.
Place 3 beans in a line on bread and roll over beans. Cut 3/4 inch rounds. Yields 25 to 30 servings.
recipes.text: Green Bean Sandwich Roll-Up. Marinate overnight in Italian dressing. Mix cream cheese and Italian seasoning together. Spread on white sandwich size bread. Cut edges off. Place 3 beans in a line on bread and roll over beans. Cut 3/4 inch rounds. Yields 25 to 30 servings.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add egg and applesauce.
Beat well.
Add dry ingredients to the applesauce mixture.
Drop by teaspoonful on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
Top with your favorite frosting.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar; add egg and applesauce. Beat well. Add dry ingredients to the applesauce mixture. Drop by teaspoonful on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Top with your favorite frosting.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. rice, cooked according to pkg.
directions: Mix together rice, corn, cheese and sugar.
Cook green pepper, celery, onion and jalapeno pepper in margarine until tender.
Add cooked mixture to first mixture and bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Jalapeno Corn Casserole. Mix together rice, corn, cheese and sugar. Cook green pepper, celery, onion and jalapeno pepper in margarine until tender. Add cooked mixture to first mixture and bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread 1 1/2 packages cookie dough in bottom of pan. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla with mixer. Add 1/2 cup chocolate chips in cream cheese mixture.
Spread over cookie dough.
Slice other half of cookie dough and put on top. Bake at 350u00b0 or until golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread 1 1/2 packages cookie dough in bottom of pan. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla with mixer. Add 1/2 cup chocolate chips in cream cheese mixture. Spread over cookie dough. Slice other half of cookie dough and put on top. Bake at 350u00b0 or until golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine oil and sugar; add well beaten eggs.
Sift together flour, cinnamon, allspice, salt and soda to first mixture.
Add vanilla, chopped apples and pecans.
Bake on sheet pan or tube pan for about 50 minutes or when toothpick comes out clean.
Bake at 300u00b0 or 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Combine oil and sugar; add well beaten eggs. Sift together flour, cinnamon, allspice, salt and soda to first mixture. Add vanilla, chopped apples and pecans. Bake on sheet pan or tube pan for about 50 minutes or when toothpick comes out clean. Bake at 300u00b0 or 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
directions: Cook spinach as directed.
Mix together all ingredients into well-drained spinach.
Spinach mixture needs to hold together, not runny.
Add more croutons if it seems to moist.
Chill 2 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Spinach Balls. Cook spinach as directed. Mix together all ingredients into well-drained spinach. Spinach mixture needs to hold together, not runny. Add more croutons if it seems to moist. Chill 2 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Apple Pineapple Salad
directions: Heat butter and lemon juice until butter is melted. In a bowl combine cornstarch and water until smooth. Stir in pineapple juice from can. Bring to boil. Add sugar; cool. Combine pineapple, apples, and grapes; add dressing. Cover and chill.
recipes.text: Apple Pineapple Salad. Heat butter and lemon juice until butter is melted. In a bowl combine cornstarch and water until smooth. Stir in pineapple juice from can. Bring to boil. Add sugar; cool. Combine pineapple, apples, and grapes; add dressing. Cover and chill.

recipes.title: Fluffy Meat Loaf
directions: Pack into greased loaf pan. Bake 1 - 1/2 hours at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Fluffy Meat Loaf. Pack into greased loaf pan. Bake 1 - 1/2 hours at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Caramel Layer Squares
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury German chocolate cake mix
1 (6 oz.) pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. In heavy saucepan, cook caramels and milk over low heat, stirring constantly, until caramels are melted.
Keep warm.
recipes.text: Caramel Layer Squares. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. In heavy saucepan, cook caramels and milk over low heat, stirring constantly, until caramels are melted. Keep warm.

recipes.title: Lemon Pepper Chicken
ingredients: 2/3 c. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate
2 tsp. Wyler's or Steero chicken flavor instant bouillon
directions: In shallow dish or plastic bag, combine all ingredients except chicken; add chicken.
Cover; marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight.
Remove chicken from marinade; heat marinade thoroughly.
Grill or broil chicken, basting frequently with marinade.
Refrigerate leftovers.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Lemon Pepper Chicken. In shallow dish or plastic bag, combine all ingredients except chicken; add chicken. Cover; marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight. Remove chicken from marinade; heat marinade thoroughly. Grill or broil chicken, basting frequently with marinade. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave-My Version Of Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 to 3 large green peppers, cut longways and seed removed
directions: Fry turkey with salt, pepper and onion until browned.
Add the creamed corn; mix.
Fill green peppers.
Put in microwave container.
Mix soup with water and pour over top.
Sprinkle on the sugar.
Cook on High for 15 to 20 minutes, covered.
recipes.text: Microwave-My Version Of Stuffed Peppers. Fry turkey with salt, pepper and onion until browned. Add the creamed corn; mix. Fill green peppers. Put in microwave container. Mix soup with water and pour over top. Sprinkle on the sugar. Cook on High for 15 to 20 minutes, covered.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Lasagne
directions: Brown meat.
Cook and drain noodles.
Combine all in crock-pot and mix thoroughly.
Cook on high for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Lasagne. Brown meat. Cook and drain noodles. Combine all in crock-pot and mix thoroughly. Cook on high for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pecan Tarts
directions: Mix and chill for 1 hour. Pinch small balls about size of walnut and put into tins rolled in flour and use tart tamper tool or press into tart pan.
recipes.text: Pecan Tarts. Mix and chill for 1 hour. Pinch small balls about size of walnut and put into tins rolled in flour and use tart tamper tool or press into tart pan.

recipes.title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in mixing bowl and beat with electric mixer 1 minute at Hi speed.
Sift flour, salt and soda over this and beat 1/2 minute at medium speed.
Stir in pineapple and blend thoroughly but quickly.
Spread evenly in buttered/floured 9x13-inch pan and bake in pre-heated oven at 350u00b0 for 25-30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Sheet Cake. Combine first 4 ingredients in mixing bowl and beat with electric mixer 1 minute at Hi speed. Sift flour, salt and soda over this and beat 1/2 minute at medium speed. Stir in pineapple and blend thoroughly but quickly. Spread evenly in buttered/floured 9x13-inch pan and bake in pre-heated oven at 350u00b0 for 25-30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Mix butter and sugar together, add eggs.
Mixing well, add flavoring.
Add flour, starting with flour and alternate with cream, beat well.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 to 50 minutes. Start in a cold oven.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Mix butter and sugar together, add eggs. Mixing well, add flavoring. Add flour, starting with flour and alternate with cream, beat well. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 40 to 50 minutes. Start in a cold oven.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs with oil until thoroughly blended.
Add sugar, vanilla, baking soda and water.
Beat with spoon until light and fluffy.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs with oil until thoroughly blended. Add sugar, vanilla, baking soda and water. Beat with spoon until light and fluffy.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. chopped pecans or walnuts, divided
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, 1/2 cup nuts and margarine until crumbly.
Stir in 1 egg and 1 teaspoon vanilla; mix well.
Press into bottom of a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, 1/2 cup nuts and margarine until crumbly. Stir in 1 egg and 1 teaspoon vanilla; mix well. Press into bottom of a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Bake for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Crazy Crunch
directions: Bring butter, sugar and syrup to boil, then simmer 10 minutes, until caramel colored.
Add coconut and vanilla.
Mix nuts with popped corn.
Pour mixture over corn and nuts.
Thinly spread on cookie sheet.
When cool, break and store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Crazy Crunch. Bring butter, sugar and syrup to boil, then simmer 10 minutes, until caramel colored. Add coconut and vanilla. Mix nuts with popped corn. Pour mixture over corn and nuts. Thinly spread on cookie sheet. When cool, break and store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Press biscuits into 9-inch pie pan.
Pour and press Rice Krispies into biscuits.
Lightly press the Cheddar cheese onto Rice Krispies. Dot with oleo.
Cook broccoli according to directions.
Drain and mix with chicken soup.
Add the drained chunks of chicken.
Pour over biscuit mixture in pie pan.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until edge of biscuit is golden brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Press biscuits into 9-inch pie pan. Pour and press Rice Krispies into biscuits. Lightly press the Cheddar cheese onto Rice Krispies. Dot with oleo. Cook broccoli according to directions. Drain and mix with chicken soup. Add the drained chunks of chicken. Pour over biscuit mixture in pie pan. Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until edge of biscuit is golden brown.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
directions: Mix all together.
Top with bread or cracker crumbs.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
Makes 6 large servings.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Casserole. Mix all together. Top with bread or cracker crumbs. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0. Makes 6 large servings.

recipes.title: Cajun Dirty Rice
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped (green will work)
2 green onions including tops, thinly sliced
directions: Remove hard membranes from giblets; chop or grind in food processor.
Put skillet over high heat.
When hot, add 2 tablespoons oil; add giblets and beef.
Cook, stirring, until no longer pink (approximately 4 minutes).
Using a slotted spoon, transfer to bowl and set aside.
Pour remaining oil in skillet. When oil is hot, add celery, red pepper and chopped onion.
Stir until vegetables are soft (approximately 7 minutes).
Sprinkle in flour, oregano and cayenne pepper.
Cook until flour is browned (approximately 2 to 3 minutes).
Pour in broth; bring to boil; stir in giblets and beef.
Add rice; stir until heated.
Add green onions.
Salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Cajun Dirty Rice. Remove hard membranes from giblets; chop or grind in food processor. Put skillet over high heat. When hot, add 2 tablespoons oil; add giblets and beef. Cook, stirring, until no longer pink (approximately 4 minutes). Using a slotted spoon, transfer to bowl and set aside. Pour remaining oil in skillet. When oil is hot, add celery, red pepper and chopped onion. Stir until vegetables are soft (approximately 7 minutes). Sprinkle in flour, oregano and cayenne pepper. Cook until flour is browned (approximately 2 to 3 minutes). Pour in broth; bring to boil; stir in giblets and beef. Add rice; stir until heated. Add green onions. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Vegetable Marinade
directions: Drain beans, peas, corn and pimento.
Combine all ingredients.
recipes.text: Vegetable Marinade. Drain beans, peas, corn and pimento. Combine all ingredients.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing
directions: Combine vinegar, egg, parsley, sugar, salt, oregano and onions in a blender.
Blend in oil.
Very good!
recipes.text: Salad Dressing. Combine vinegar, egg, parsley, sugar, salt, oregano and onions in a blender. Blend in oil. Very good!

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 (1 lb.) cans whole sweet potatoes, drained
directions: Turn the potatoes into a large bowl and mash smoothly.
Add the pineapple, nutmeg, salt, brown sugar and melted butter or margarine.
Mix with a fork until all are combined.
Turn into a shallow baking dish and spread evenly.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Turn the potatoes into a large bowl and mash smoothly. Add the pineapple, nutmeg, salt, brown sugar and melted butter or margarine. Mix with a fork until all are combined. Turn into a shallow baking dish and spread evenly.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or 2 round layer pans.
Beat all ingredients in large bowl on low, scraping bowl constantly for 30 seconds.
Beat on high, scraping occasionally for 3 minutes.
Pour into greased pans.
Bake oblong pan 60 to 65 minutes or layers 50 to 55 minutes; cool.
Frost with Butterscotch Meringue.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or 2 round layer pans. Beat all ingredients in large bowl on low, scraping bowl constantly for 30 seconds. Beat on high, scraping occasionally for 3 minutes. Pour into greased pans. Bake oblong pan 60 to 65 minutes or layers 50 to 55 minutes; cool. Frost with Butterscotch Meringue.

recipes.title: Chocolate Marshmallow Fudge
directions: Coat an 8x8 inch pan with Pam.
Stir together sugar, evaporated milk, and margarine.
Bring to a boil in saucepan and reduce heat to medium-law and cook three minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in chocolate and marshmallows.
Remove from heat and stir until smooth.
Pour into pan and refrigerate until firm (about two hours).
Cut into 36 squares and serve.
recipes.text: Chocolate Marshmallow Fudge. Coat an 8x8 inch pan with Pam. Stir together sugar, evaporated milk, and margarine. Bring to a boil in saucepan and reduce heat to medium-law and cook three minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in chocolate and marshmallows. Remove from heat and stir until smooth. Pour into pan and refrigerate until firm (about two hours). Cut into 36 squares and serve.

recipes.title: Marshmallow-Orange Fruit Dip
directions: Mix ingredients together well and refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Marshmallow-Orange Fruit Dip. Mix ingredients together well and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Lemon Lush
directions: Mix flour, melted butter, nuts and sugar.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cook at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
Cool.
Beat together cream cheese with 1/4 cup of sugar and the milk.
Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip.
Spread this mixture over cool crust.
Make lemon instant pudding according to directions.
Top over cream cheese mixture.
Chill, then spread remaining Cool Whip on top.
Decorate with nuts (if desired).
recipes.text: Lemon Lush. Mix flour, melted butter, nuts and sugar. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool. Beat together cream cheese with 1/4 cup of sugar and the milk. Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip. Spread this mixture over cool crust. Make lemon instant pudding according to directions. Top over cream cheese mixture. Chill, then spread remaining Cool Whip on top. Decorate with nuts (if desired).

recipes.title: Quick Custard Pie
directions: Put all ingredients, except coconut, into blender in the order given.
Blend about 1 minute.
Pour into buttered 9-inch pie tin. Coconut may be sprinkled on top, if desired. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick Custard Pie. Put all ingredients, except coconut, into blender in the order given. Blend about 1 minute. Pour into buttered 9-inch pie tin. Coconut may be sprinkled on top, if desired. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Best Sugar Cookies
directions: Let oleo soften; add sugar, cream of tartar, soda and salt. Add oil and egg. Add flour gradually. Add vanilla and nuts last. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until medium brown.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Best Sugar Cookies. Let oleo soften; add sugar, cream of tartar, soda and salt. Add oil and egg. Add flour gradually. Add vanilla and nuts last. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 15 minutes or until medium brown.

recipes.title: Texas Barbecue(Fow Slow Cooker)
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour over 2 1/2 to 3 pound roast in slow cooker.
Cook 8 to 10 hours on medium or low heat, until meat is tender.
Remove meat and allow to cool.
Slice thin, across the grain.
Skim off fat from sauce.
Heat sauce.
Mix 2 tablespoons flour and 1/4 cup water.
Stir into sauce and stir until thickened.
Return meat to sauce.
Heat through, about 30 minutes. Serve on split hard rolls, hamburger rolls or sandwich rolls. Makes enough for a small crowd.
recipes.text: Texas Barbecue(Fow Slow Cooker). Mix all ingredients and pour over 2 1/2 to 3 pound roast in slow cooker. Cook 8 to 10 hours on medium or low heat, until meat is tender. Remove meat and allow to cool. Slice thin, across the grain. Skim off fat from sauce. Heat sauce. Mix 2 tablespoons flour and 1/4 cup water. Stir into sauce and stir until thickened. Return meat to sauce. Heat through, about 30 minutes. Serve on split hard rolls, hamburger rolls or sandwich rolls. Makes enough for a small crowd.

recipes.title: Veal Oscar
directions: Clean and dry fish. Cut into pieces. Dip in 1 cup milk after having salted it. Then dredge in bread crumbs. Place in baking dish with a little olive oil and a little butter; no water. Brown quickly in very hot oven.
recipes.text: Veal Oscar. Clean and dry fish. Cut into pieces. Dip in 1 cup milk after having salted it. Then dredge in bread crumbs. Place in baking dish with a little olive oil and a little butter; no water. Brown quickly in very hot oven.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meat Loaf
directions: Mix together and make into loaf.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Meat Loaf. Mix together and make into loaf. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Add crackers, butter and 1 cup cheese; beat eggs lightly and add milk.
Mix with squash; sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Add crackers, butter and 1 cup cheese; beat eggs lightly and add milk. Mix with squash; sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top. Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
directions: Cream the cream cheese, sugar and milk together.
Add Cool Whip; mix well.
Tear angel food cake into small pieces and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Pour cream cheese mixture over the angel food cake.
Pour cans of pie filling over the cream cheese mixture.
Place in refrigerator.
Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Cherry Delight. Cream the cream cheese, sugar and milk together. Add Cool Whip; mix well. Tear angel food cake into small pieces and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Pour cream cheese mixture over the angel food cake. Pour cans of pie filling over the cream cheese mixture. Place in refrigerator. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: White Rolled Cookies
directions: Cut shortening into first 3 ingredients as for pie crust. Using rotary beater, beat eggs and add sugar gradually, continuing to beat thoroughly; add to first mixture.
Knead until smooth. Chill for several hours or overnight.
recipes.text: White Rolled Cookies. Cut shortening into first 3 ingredients as for pie crust. Using rotary beater, beat eggs and add sugar gradually, continuing to beat thoroughly; add to first mixture. Knead until smooth. Chill for several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together until mixed good.
You can put it on chicken, spareribs, make Sloppy Joes or whatever you want to put it on.
What you don't use can be kept in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients together until mixed good. You can put it on chicken, spareribs, make Sloppy Joes or whatever you want to put it on. What you don't use can be kept in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Garlic Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Cut the potatoes in half or quarters and place in a bowl with the olive oil, salt, pepper and garlic; toss until the potatoes are well coated. Transfer the potatoes to a sheet pan and spread out into one layer. Roast in the oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until browned and crisp. Flip twice during cooking with a spatula in order to ensure even browning. Remove from the oven; toss with the parsley. Season to taste and serve hot.
recipes.text: Garlic Roasted Potatoes. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Cut the potatoes in half or quarters and place in a bowl with the olive oil, salt, pepper and garlic; toss until the potatoes are well coated. Transfer the potatoes to a sheet pan and spread out into one layer. Roast in the oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until browned and crisp. Flip twice during cooking with a spatula in order to ensure even browning. Remove from the oven; toss with the parsley. Season to taste and serve hot.

recipes.title: Hot Apple Cider
directions: Heat and let simmer in pot on stove or in slow cooker and the aroma will fill the house.
Serve to guests when they arrive.
recipes.text: Hot Apple Cider. Heat and let simmer in pot on stove or in slow cooker and the aroma will fill the house. Serve to guests when they arrive.

recipes.title: French Apple Pie
directions: Fill pie shell with sliced apples, mixed with 1/2 cup sugar. To prepare crumb topping, cream butter and brown sugar, then cut in flour.
Add chopped pecans and cinnamon.
Sprinkle crumbly topping on top of apples.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: French Apple Pie. Fill pie shell with sliced apples, mixed with 1/2 cup sugar. To prepare crumb topping, cream butter and brown sugar, then cut in flour. Add chopped pecans and cinnamon. Sprinkle crumbly topping on top of apples. Bake at 425u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Kentucky Turkey Salad
ingredients: 4 c. smoked turkey, cut in small cubes
directions: Combine all ingredients, adding more mayonnaise if desired. Add fresh lemon juice to enhance flavor.
Makes 10 sandwiches.
recipes.text: Kentucky Turkey Salad. Combine all ingredients, adding more mayonnaise if desired. Add fresh lemon juice to enhance flavor. Makes 10 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Pie
ingredients: 4 oz. Swiss cheese, cut into strips
directions: Saute onion.
Beginning with cheese, alternate layers of cheese and ham in pie shell.
Beat the 2 eggs with the sour cream; add onion and pour over pie.
Bake for 30 minutes at 425u00b0.
Cool in oven 15 minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Pie. Saute onion. Beginning with cheese, alternate layers of cheese and ham in pie shell. Beat the 2 eggs with the sour cream; add onion and pour over pie. Bake for 30 minutes at 425u00b0. Cool in oven 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Spicy Rice And Beans
ingredients: 1 c. seeded cubed large green pepper
1 (16 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
directions: Spray a large saucepan with vegetable cooking spray. Add onion.
Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in garlic and green pepper. Cook 2 minutes longer, stirring frequently.
Add stewed tomatoes, broth, cumin and chili powder; bring to a boil. Add rice.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 18 minutes or until rice is almost done. Stir in beans. Cook until heated through.
recipes.text: Spicy Rice And Beans. Spray a large saucepan with vegetable cooking spray. Add onion. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in garlic and green pepper. Cook 2 minutes longer, stirring frequently. Add stewed tomatoes, broth, cumin and chili powder; bring to a boil. Add rice. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 18 minutes or until rice is almost done. Stir in beans. Cook until heated through.

recipes.title: Toffee Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Mix brown sugar, butter, egg yolk and vanilla.
Stir in flour and salt.
Press into greased oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.
recipes.text: Toffee Bars. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Mix brown sugar, butter, egg yolk and vanilla. Stir in flour and salt. Press into greased oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.

recipes.title: Anice Springer'S Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients except vinegar and Worcestershire sauce and bring to a boil.
Add vinegar and Worcestershire sauce and pour over chicken or other meat.
Bake 1 hour in a covered pan at 300u00b0; uncover and cook another hour.
recipes.text: Anice Springer'S Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients except vinegar and Worcestershire sauce and bring to a boil. Add vinegar and Worcestershire sauce and pour over chicken or other meat. Bake 1 hour in a covered pan at 300u00b0; uncover and cook another hour.

recipes.title: Snowball Cake
ingredients: 1 box or small can Angel Flake coconut
directions: Soften gelatine in cold water; add boiling water and stir until dissolved.
Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple.
Chill until partially set.
Fold half the Cool Whip into the gelatine mixture. Tear up the angel food cake in small pieces (not crumbs).
recipes.text: Snowball Cake. Soften gelatine in cold water; add boiling water and stir until dissolved. Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple. Chill until partially set. Fold half the Cool Whip into the gelatine mixture. Tear up the angel food cake in small pieces (not crumbs).

recipes.title: Cowboy Coffee Cake
directions: Combine flour, salt, sugar and shortening; mix until crumbly. Reserve 1/2 cup of mixture.
Chopped nuts can be added to this if desired.
recipes.text: Cowboy Coffee Cake. Combine flour, salt, sugar and shortening; mix until crumbly. Reserve 1/2 cup of mixture. Chopped nuts can be added to this if desired.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger meat.
Drain.
Season with onion powder. Drain peas and carrots.
Place in a casserole dish in this order: hamburger meat, peas and carrots, cream of celery soup and then Tater Tots.
Sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. Brown hamburger meat. Drain. Season with onion powder. Drain peas and carrots. Place in a casserole dish in this order: hamburger meat, peas and carrots, cream of celery soup and then Tater Tots. Sprinkle with salt. Bake for 45 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Apple Harvest Pudding
directions: Cream together sugar, shortening and egg.
Add dry ingredients and spices alternately with 1 cup milk.
Add fruit and nuts.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Harvest Pudding. Cream together sugar, shortening and egg. Add dry ingredients and spices alternately with 1 cup milk. Add fruit and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Cream together sugar, eggs and oil.
Sift together flour, salt and soda.
Mix together, then add fruit cocktail to batter.
Mix well.
Bake in long pan for 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Cream together sugar, eggs and oil. Sift together flour, salt and soda. Mix together, then add fruit cocktail to batter. Mix well. Bake in long pan for 45 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
ingredients: 1 c. grated Parmesan or any cheese
directions: Mix all together.
Put in square or rectangular pan. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pie. Mix all together. Put in square or rectangular pan. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 can French style green beans, drained
directions: Layer can of corn, then green beans, pour celery soup over top.
Mix sour cream with shredded cheese and pour over soup mixture.
Mix ritz crackers with melted margarine and pour over sour cream mixture.
Bake at 350 F for 30 minutes in a 9 x 9 ungreased pan.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Layer can of corn, then green beans, pour celery soup over top. Mix sour cream with shredded cheese and pour over soup mixture. Mix ritz crackers with melted margarine and pour over sour cream mixture. Bake at 350 F for 30 minutes in a 9 x 9 ungreased pan.

recipes.title: Pizza By The Scoop
directions: Spread cream cheese on 12-inch pizza pan.
Spread with chili sauce.
Sprinkle with ham, onion, green pepper, cheeses and tomato.
Serve with Scoop Fritos.
recipes.text: Pizza By The Scoop. Spread cream cheese on 12-inch pizza pan. Spread with chili sauce. Sprinkle with ham, onion, green pepper, cheeses and tomato. Serve with Scoop Fritos.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix well and shape into ball.
Roll ball in parsley flakes, chopped fresh parsley, finely chopped nuts or paprika.
Serve with assorted crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix well and shape into ball. Roll ball in parsley flakes, chopped fresh parsley, finely chopped nuts or paprika. Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Hermit Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks well beaten.
Sift flour with cinnamon twice, then add to creamed mixture.
Dissolve baking soda in lemon juice and add to mixture.
Beat well.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Stir in walnuts, dates and vanilla. Bake in a wax paper lined tube pan at 250u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until baked through.
recipes.text: Hermit Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks well beaten. Sift flour with cinnamon twice, then add to creamed mixture. Dissolve baking soda in lemon juice and add to mixture. Beat well. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Stir in walnuts, dates and vanilla. Bake in a wax paper lined tube pan at 250u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until baked through.

recipes.title: Peppermint Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Mix the crackers, nuts and melted butter together and pat on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat pudding with milk.
Fold in ice cream.
Freeze.
Top with Cool Whip.
Crush peppermint candy and spread on top.
recipes.text: Peppermint Ice Cream Dessert. Mix the crackers, nuts and melted butter together and pat on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat pudding with milk. Fold in ice cream. Freeze. Top with Cool Whip. Crush peppermint candy and spread on top.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Candy
directions: Cook all ingredients to hard crack stage (except for cinnamon oil).
Remove from heat; add cinnamon oil.
Pour onto oiled pan. Crack into pieces when hard.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Candy. Cook all ingredients to hard crack stage (except for cinnamon oil). Remove from heat; add cinnamon oil. Pour onto oiled pan. Crack into pieces when hard.

recipes.title: Cream Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in 9 x 12-inch pan for 25 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Cream Cake. Mix all ingredients and bake in 9 x 12-inch pan for 25 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix lemon juice, cream cheese, milk and flavoring. Pour into 2 pie crusts. Cover with glaze. Top with cool whip and garnish with berries.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Mix lemon juice, cream cheese, milk and flavoring. Pour into 2 pie crusts. Cover with glaze. Top with cool whip and garnish with berries.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl.
Cream shortening and sugar into dry mixture.
Add eggs, pumpkin and vanilla.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 10 minutes at 350u00b0, then decrease heat to 325u00b0 and bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Cream shortening and sugar into dry mixture. Add eggs, pumpkin and vanilla. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 10 minutes at 350u00b0, then decrease heat to 325u00b0 and bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Balls
directions: Cream butter; add sugar and beat until light.
Add vanilla. Add flour and mix well.
Fold in walnuts.
Shape into small balls (walnut size).
Bake at 350u00b0 until bottoms are lightly browned. Roll in powdered sugar while warm.
Yield:
about 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Butter Balls. Cream butter; add sugar and beat until light. Add vanilla. Add flour and mix well. Fold in walnuts. Shape into small balls (walnut size). Bake at 350u00b0 until bottoms are lightly browned. Roll in powdered sugar while warm. Yield: about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Grandpa'S Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 can drained and chopped water chestnuts
directions: Cook, drain and cool spinach.
Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and soup.
Chop onions and chestnuts and add to mayonnaise mixture. Squeeze water out of spinach and chop.
Add spinach to mayonnaise mixture.
Refrigerate overnight.
Cut off top of French bread; scoop out bread and put dip in crust.
Serve with bread crusts.
recipes.text: Grandpa'S Spinach Dip. Cook, drain and cool spinach. Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and soup. Chop onions and chestnuts and add to mayonnaise mixture. Squeeze water out of spinach and chop. Add spinach to mayonnaise mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Cut off top of French bread; scoop out bread and put dip in crust. Serve with bread crusts.

recipes.title: Microwave Hamburger Quiche
directions: Crumble beef into 9-inch pie plate.
Microwave at High 2 1/2 to 4 minutes or until meat loses its pink color.
Break up and drain. In medium bowl combine remaining ingredients except cheese.
Pour into pie plate.
Reduce power to 50% (Medium).
Microwave 4 minutes.
Push cooked portions to center of plate.
Microwave 4 1/2 to 8 minutes or until almost set, lifting edges of set egg after half the cooking time.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Microwave 1 to 2 1/2 minutes or until cheese melts.
Let stand several minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Microwave Hamburger Quiche. Crumble beef into 9-inch pie plate. Microwave at High 2 1/2 to 4 minutes or until meat loses its pink color. Break up and drain. In medium bowl combine remaining ingredients except cheese. Pour into pie plate. Reduce power to 50% (Medium). Microwave 4 minutes. Push cooked portions to center of plate. Microwave 4 1/2 to 8 minutes or until almost set, lifting edges of set egg after half the cooking time. Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave 1 to 2 1/2 minutes or until cheese melts. Let stand several minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Dried Apple Cake
directions: Cover
dried
apples with water (about 2 cups) and soak overnight.tChop
fine.
Add

and

hours. Cool.
Mixtsugar

Mix dry ingredients to sugar, oleo and egg mix along with cooled dried apple-molasses
mixture.
Add sour milk.
Bake in greased loaf pans.
This

for
tiny

or
1 1/2 hours for large loaves. Chopped
raisins
can be added to the apple-molasses mix.
