recipes.text: Dried Apple Cake. Cover dried apples with water (about 2 cups) and soak overnight.tChop fine. Add molasses and simmer 2 hours. Cool. Mixtsugar and oleo; add eggs and blend well. Mix dry ingredients to sugar, oleo and egg mix along with cooled dried apple-molasses mixture. Add sour milk. Bake in greased loaf pans. This is a large amount so it makes 2 to 3 large loaves or 6 to 7 tiny foil tins. Bake at 300u00b0 about 1 hour and 10 minutes, for tiny loaves or 1 1/2 hours for large loaves. Chopped raisins can be added to the apple-molasses mix. Add before simmering.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 large pkg. cherry Jell-O (diet or regular)
directions: Make Jell-O according to package directions minus 1/2 cup water.
Refrigerate.
When Jell-O is almost set, add cranberry-orange relish, crushed pineapple and pecans.
Stir several times before completely set.
Serves about 15.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Make Jell-O according to package directions minus 1/2 cup water. Refrigerate. When Jell-O is almost set, add cranberry-orange relish, crushed pineapple and pecans. Stir several times before completely set. Serves about 15.

recipes.title: Harvest Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. Wheat Chex cereal (bite size crispy wheat squares), crushed to 3/4 c.
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease
a
x
5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Sift together
flour,
baking
powder, salt, baking soda and spices.
Combine eggs, milk, oil, pumpkin and brown sugar. Stir in cereal and
raisins.
Add dry ingredients all at once. Stir just until moistened.
Turn
into
pan.
Bake
to
60 minutes or until tester
inserted
in
center comes out clean. Let cool 15 minutes before removing from pan.
Makes 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Harvest Pumpkin Bread. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and spices. Combine eggs, milk, oil, pumpkin and brown sugar. Stir in cereal and raisins. Add dry ingredients all at once. Stir just until moistened. Turn into pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out clean. Let cool 15 minutes before removing from pan. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Hoe Cake Corn Bread
directions: Mix ingredients with hot boiling water. Have iron hoe cake baker greased good and hot. Pour in hot baker. Brown and turn once.
recipes.text: Hoe Cake Corn Bread. Mix ingredients with hot boiling water. Have iron hoe cake baker greased good and hot. Pour in hot baker. Brown and turn once.

recipes.title: Oriental Catfish
directions: Make a marinade by mixing soy sauce, ginger, red pepper flakes and wine together. Marinate catfish for about 1 hour in the refrigerator. Broil the catfish for approximately 5 to 7 minutes until the flesh starts to flake easily. Baste often with marinade.
recipes.text: Oriental Catfish. Make a marinade by mixing soy sauce, ginger, red pepper flakes and wine together. Marinate catfish for about 1 hour in the refrigerator. Broil the catfish for approximately 5 to 7 minutes until the flesh starts to flake easily. Baste often with marinade.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 12 slices bread, cubed with crust removed
directions: Brown sausage; drain and cool.
Beat eggs with milk and add bread and salt.
Stir in cheese and sausage.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish (or pan) cover with fill and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before baking.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Brown sausage; drain and cool. Beat eggs with milk and add bread and salt. Stir in cheese and sausage. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish (or pan) cover with fill and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before baking. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Fruited Chicken
ingredients: salt and pepper, mixed with flour
directions: Dip chicken parts in flour mixture.
Saute in garlic and oil. When browned, add remaining ingredients.
Simmer until done.
Keep stirring.
recipes.text: Fruited Chicken. Dip chicken parts in flour mixture. Saute in garlic and oil. When browned, add remaining ingredients. Simmer until done. Keep stirring.

recipes.title: Pot Roast
directions: Flour both sides of roast.
Cook in large pot with a little grease.
Turn roast when gets brown on both sides.
Leave in pan. Cover with water and put in cut up onion.
Turn down; cook slow about 2 hours or until tender.
Take roast out.
Put in package onion soup mix and 2 tablespoons cornstarch that's been dissolved in water.
It will thicken, gravy.
recipes.text: Pot Roast. Flour both sides of roast. Cook in large pot with a little grease. Turn roast when gets brown on both sides. Leave in pan. Cover with water and put in cut up onion. Turn down; cook slow about 2 hours or until tender. Take roast out. Put in package onion soup mix and 2 tablespoons cornstarch that's been dissolved in water. It will thicken, gravy.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Fudge
directions: Blend sugar, butter, salt and milk.
Cook on medium heat, stirring constantly.
Boil about 6 minutes.
In large bowl, add chocolate bits, semi-sweet chocolate, which has been broken into small pieces, Marshmallow Creme and chopped nuts.
Add cooked mixture to bowl containing chocolate and stir until chocolate is melted and pour into 2 (8 x 8 x 2-inch) greased pans or 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Fudge. Blend sugar, butter, salt and milk. Cook on medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil about 6 minutes. In large bowl, add chocolate bits, semi-sweet chocolate, which has been broken into small pieces, Marshmallow Creme and chopped nuts. Add cooked mixture to bowl containing chocolate and stir until chocolate is melted and pour into 2 (8 x 8 x 2-inch) greased pans or 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan.

recipes.title: Party Meat Balls
directions: Soak bread in milk, add all other ingredients.
Roll into small balls, brown in 1 tablespoon of butter.
Add two cups beef broth (use bouillon cubes or soup) which has been thickened with 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
Simmer until thickened, then pour over meatballs.
Simmer about 1 hour, leaving lid on electric frypan or regular pan.
Serve direct from pan to table.
Keep meatballs warm all during the serving time.
recipes.text: Party Meat Balls. Soak bread in milk, add all other ingredients. Roll into small balls, brown in 1 tablespoon of butter. Add two cups beef broth (use bouillon cubes or soup) which has been thickened with 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Simmer until thickened, then pour over meatballs. Simmer about 1 hour, leaving lid on electric frypan or regular pan. Serve direct from pan to table. Keep meatballs warm all during the serving time.

recipes.title: Pull Apart Cinnamon Bread
directions: Cut
biscuits
in
Put
sugar and cinnamon in a bag. Shake
biscuit pieces a few at a time in the mixture and place
in Bundt
pan.
Heat
oleo
with leftover mixture plus enough sugar to fill one cup.
Boil sugar and oleo one minute. Pour over biscuits.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pull Apart Cinnamon Bread. Cut biscuits in 1/4's. Put sugar and cinnamon in a bag. Shake biscuit pieces a few at a time in the mixture and place in Bundt pan. Heat oleo with leftover mixture plus enough sugar to fill one cup. Boil sugar and oleo one minute. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Eggs And Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 small can tomatoes or 4 fresh tomatoes, quartered
sprinkle of onion or garlic powder
directions: Beat eggs lightly in a bowl; set aside.
In a large frypan, place oil and heat.
Cook tomatoes with rest of ingredients until tomatoes are cooked, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Stir in eggs and keep stirring until mixture thickens like scrambled eggs.
Serve over toast slices.
Serves 2 or 3 persons.
recipes.text: Fried Eggs And Tomatoes. Beat eggs lightly in a bowl; set aside. In a large frypan, place oil and heat. Cook tomatoes with rest of ingredients until tomatoes are cooked, about 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in eggs and keep stirring until mixture thickens like scrambled eggs. Serve over toast slices. Serves 2 or 3 persons.

recipes.title: German Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb. smoked sausage or kielbasa, sliced
directions: Combine sauerkraut, sausage, dressing and parsley in a 10 x 6-inch glass dish. Cover and microwave on High 6 to 8 minutes. Sprinkle cheese and pepper over top and microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes.
recipes.text: German Reuben Casserole. Combine sauerkraut, sausage, dressing and parsley in a 10 x 6-inch glass dish. Cover and microwave on High 6 to 8 minutes. Sprinkle cheese and pepper over top and microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad
directions: Combine and whisk mustard, sesame oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, pepper, honey, olive oil, Dijon mustard and salt.
Set aside.
Toss spinach, oranges, onion and almonds.
Combine just before serving.
recipes.text: Spinach Salad. Combine and whisk mustard, sesame oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, pepper, honey, olive oil, Dijon mustard and salt. Set aside. Toss spinach, oranges, onion and almonds. Combine just before serving.

recipes.title: Pear Salad
directions: Bring 1 cup of pear juice to boil; add gelatin, cream cheese, Dream Whip, mashed pears and nuts.
Chill until set.
recipes.text: Pear Salad. Bring 1 cup of pear juice to boil; add gelatin, cream cheese, Dream Whip, mashed pears and nuts. Chill until set.

recipes.title: Easy Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Dough will be stiff.
These can be bar cookies or rolled into walnut size balls for baking.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Cake Mix Cookies. Mix all ingredients. Dough will be stiff. These can be bar cookies or rolled into walnut size balls for baking. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in sugar and cinnamon. Combine the next 3 ingredients.
Heat to boil and then dip the biscuits in mixture; put in a greased, floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes; pour the remaining of the first mixture on top before you bake.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in sugar and cinnamon. Combine the next 3 ingredients. Heat to boil and then dip the biscuits in mixture; put in a greased, floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes; pour the remaining of the first mixture on top before you bake.

recipes.title: Cheese Pancakes(Latkahs)
ingredients: 1 c. dry pot cheese or dry curd cottage cheese
directions: Add eggs to milk and cheese and beat until smooth.
Add sifted dry ingredients and mix until batter is thick but can be poured. Again, cook like potato pancakes; drop onto hot oil and cook until brown on both sides.
Serve with sour cream, applesauce, fruit jams or just powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Cheese Pancakes(Latkahs). Add eggs to milk and cheese and beat until smooth. Add sifted dry ingredients and mix until batter is thick but can be poured. Again, cook like potato pancakes; drop onto hot oil and cook until brown on both sides. Serve with sour cream, applesauce, fruit jams or just powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Holly Cookies
directions: Melt together butter and marshmallows.
Add green food coloring.
Pour mixture over and coat the corn flakes.
Drop onto waxed paper with a teaspoon.
Add cinnamon candy or M&M's on top.
recipes.text: Holly Cookies. Melt together butter and marshmallows. Add green food coloring. Pour mixture over and coat the corn flakes. Drop onto waxed paper with a teaspoon. Add cinnamon candy or M&M's on top.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrot Packet
directions: You will need 1 sheet of heavy-duty aluminum foil (18 x 24-inches).
recipes.text: Glazed Carrot Packet. You will need 1 sheet of heavy-duty aluminum foil (18 x 24-inches).

recipes.title: Coconut Bombs-Bombs
directions: Melt oleo in double boiler.
Add coconut, the nuts, cherries, powdered sugar, vanilla and milk.
Shape into balls and let set in refrigerator overnight.
Dip in chocolate (melted) with paraffin.
recipes.text: Coconut Bombs-Bombs. Melt oleo in double boiler. Add coconut, the nuts, cherries, powdered sugar, vanilla and milk. Shape into balls and let set in refrigerator overnight. Dip in chocolate (melted) with paraffin.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Spread rice in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Blend together salt, soups, milk, celery and pimentos.
Pour mixture over rice. Season chicken to taste and put on top of rice.
Cover with foil and bake 2 1/2 hours. Remove foil to brown.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Spread rice in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Blend together salt, soups, milk, celery and pimentos. Pour mixture over rice. Season chicken to taste and put on top of rice. Cover with foil and bake 2 1/2 hours. Remove foil to brown.

recipes.title: Play Dough
directions: Fruit:
Peel, core and slice apples.
Puree in blender, mixing with apple juice.
Serve immediately or cook in a little boiling water 20 to 30 minutes, then puree into applesauce.
Freeze (cooked only).
recipes.text: Play Dough. Fruit: Peel, core and slice apples. Puree in blender, mixing with apple juice. Serve immediately or cook in a little boiling water 20 to 30 minutes, then puree into applesauce. Freeze (cooked only).

recipes.title: Raisin Banana Muffins
directions: Spray a 12-muffin pan with cooking spray.
Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Put bananas into a blender; blend until smooth.
Scrape bananas into a mixing bowl and combine with egg and oil.
In another bowl, combine the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Add banana mixture to the dry ingredients and blend.
Stir in the raisins.
Spoon 1/3 cup of batter into 10 to 12 muffin cups.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Raisin Banana Muffins. Spray a 12-muffin pan with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Put bananas into a blender; blend until smooth. Scrape bananas into a mixing bowl and combine with egg and oil. In another bowl, combine the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Add banana mixture to the dry ingredients and blend. Stir in the raisins. Spoon 1/3 cup of batter into 10 to 12 muffin cups. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Cup
ingredients: 1 small can sliced peaches, diced and drained (save juice)
directions: Mix fruit juices, Tang and pudding. Spread over fruit dish. Place strawberries on top.
recipes.text: Fruit Cup. Mix fruit juices, Tang and pudding. Spread over fruit dish. Place strawberries on top.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Mix cream cheese, sour cream and desired quantities of chopped onion and green pepper together.
Brown hamburger.
Stir in the tomato sauce.
Boil noodles.
Place 1/2 of the cooked noodles in the bottom of a casserole.
Add a layer of the cheese mixture. Add remaining noodles.
Top with hamburger-tomato sauce mixture. Top with butter as desired.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Mix cream cheese, sour cream and desired quantities of chopped onion and green pepper together. Brown hamburger. Stir in the tomato sauce. Boil noodles. Place 1/2 of the cooked noodles in the bottom of a casserole. Add a layer of the cheese mixture. Add remaining noodles. Top with hamburger-tomato sauce mixture. Top with butter as desired. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture.
Greased Bundt pan.
Place biscuit pieces in pan.
Melt butter; add brown sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.
Pour over biscuits.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
Serve while hot.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture. Greased Bundt pan. Place biscuit pieces in pan. Melt butter; add brown sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve while hot.

recipes.title: K.F.C.  Cole Slaw
directions: Cut cabbage and carrots into small pieces about the size of rice kernels. The food processor is great for this. In a salad bowl, combine the sugar, salt, pepper, milk, mayonnaise, vinegar and lemon juice. Beat until smooth. Add cabbage and carrots. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate.
recipes.text: K.F.C.  Cole Slaw. Cut cabbage and carrots into small pieces about the size of rice kernels. The food processor is great for this. In a salad bowl, combine the sugar, salt, pepper, milk, mayonnaise, vinegar and lemon juice. Beat until smooth. Add cabbage and carrots. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Truffle
directions: Break pound cake into pieces in a large bowl, saving some of the cake for the top.
Add 1 can cherry pie filling.
Slice 3 bananas on top of cherries.
Cover with instant pudding, mixed according to directions on box.
Then add the rest of the cake broken into pieces.
Top with 8 ounces Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with coconut if desired.
Let set in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Truffle. Break pound cake into pieces in a large bowl, saving some of the cake for the top. Add 1 can cherry pie filling. Slice 3 bananas on top of cherries. Cover with instant pudding, mixed according to directions on box. Then add the rest of the cake broken into pieces. Top with 8 ounces Cool Whip. Sprinkle with coconut if desired. Let set in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Lumberjack Salad
directions: Cut pimento, pepper, celery and onion up fine.
Mix with other ingredients.
Put in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Lumberjack Salad. Cut pimento, pepper, celery and onion up fine. Mix with other ingredients. Put in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 pkg. corn tortillas or can substitute tortilla chips
directions: Saute onion in oleo.
Add soup, Ro-Tel and chicken.
Mix well. In baking dish, place layers of tortillas, chicken mixture and cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Saute onion in oleo. Add soup, Ro-Tel and chicken. Mix well. In baking dish, place layers of tortillas, chicken mixture and cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple Stuffing
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, stirring well.
Add undrained pineapple and bread cubes.
Bake in a shallow casserole dish at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour, until golden brown.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple Stuffing. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, stirring well. Add undrained pineapple and bread cubes. Bake in a shallow casserole dish at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour, until golden brown.

recipes.title: Nutritious Poppin Fresh Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped nuts or sunflower seeds
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup. Level off.
recipes.text: Nutritious Poppin Fresh Cookies. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup. Level off.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Toast walnuts in 350u00b0 oven until golden (8 to 10 minutes). Blend cheeses.
Stir in garlic salt, pimiento and green pepper. Chill until firm.
Shape into ball and roll in toasted walnuts. Chill until serving time.
Serve with assorted crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Toast walnuts in 350u00b0 oven until golden (8 to 10 minutes). Blend cheeses. Stir in garlic salt, pimiento and green pepper. Chill until firm. Shape into ball and roll in toasted walnuts. Chill until serving time. Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Aunt Dot'S Sour Cream Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 c. self-rising white corn meal (only Yankees use yellow corn meal)
directions: Preheat oven to 425u00b0.
Mix ingredients. Bake in a 9-inch cast iron skillet for 35 minutes or more.
Green peppers, onions, cheese or any other ingredients can be added if you prefer.
recipes.text: Aunt Dot'S Sour Cream Corn Bread. Preheat oven to 425u00b0. Mix ingredients. Bake in a 9-inch cast iron skillet for 35 minutes or more. Green peppers, onions, cheese or any other ingredients can be added if you prefer.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
directions: Mix the apples, sugar, 1 tablespoon flour, cinnamon and lemon juice; put in unbaked pie crust.
Cover with the melted margarine, 1/2 cup flour and brown sugar.
Top with second crust.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Mix the apples, sugar, 1 tablespoon flour, cinnamon and lemon juice; put in unbaked pie crust. Cover with the melted margarine, 1/2 cup flour and brown sugar. Top with second crust. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Barley Pilaff
directions: Saute mushrooms and onions in half of the butter.
When tender, place in casserole.
Cook barley in remaining butter over low heat, stirring constantly, until almond colored.
Add to ingredients in casserole and mix together.
Pour broth over all and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0.
Cover for first half of cooking time.
recipes.text: Barley Pilaff. Saute mushrooms and onions in half of the butter. When tender, place in casserole. Cook barley in remaining butter over low heat, stirring constantly, until almond colored. Add to ingredients in casserole and mix together. Pour broth over all and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0. Cover for first half of cooking time.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
directions: Break bread into small pieces and moisten with milk.
Add remaining ingredients.
Shape into patties.
Broil or fry until golden brown on both sides.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Break bread into small pieces and moisten with milk. Add remaining ingredients. Shape into patties. Broil or fry until golden brown on both sides. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in warm water. Add butter, sugar, eggs, salt and 4 cups flour. Stir and then beat until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir in the remaining flour, working the last 2 cups in by hand. This dough will be very soft. Cover tightly and store in refrigerator overnight or until needed. Bake in 400u00b0 oven 15 to 20 minutes. Turn out on a wire rack. One third of this dough makes 12 pan rolls.
recipes.text: Hot Rolls. Soften yeast in warm water. Add butter, sugar, eggs, salt and 4 cups flour. Stir and then beat until smooth, about 1 minute. Stir in the remaining flour, working the last 2 cups in by hand. This dough will be very soft. Cover tightly and store in refrigerator overnight or until needed. Bake in 400u00b0 oven 15 to 20 minutes. Turn out on a wire rack. One third of this dough makes 12 pan rolls.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Egg Custard
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In medium bowl, combine egg, egg whites, Splenda, milk and vanilla extract.

With wire whisk, beat until smooth and well blended, approximately 1 minute. Pour mixture into four 6-ounce custard cups. Arrange cups in a large baking pan so they do not touch. Pour very hot water, not boiling, into the pan so the water is 1-inch deep. Place pan in middle of oven. Bake custard 40 minutes or until knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Transfer cups from pan to wire rack. Cool to room temperature. Chill in refrigerator for at least two hours.
recipes.text: Low Calorie Egg Custard. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In medium bowl, combine egg, egg whites, Splenda, milk and vanilla extract. With wire whisk, beat until smooth and well blended, approximately 1 minute. Pour mixture into four 6-ounce custard cups. Arrange cups in a large baking pan so they do not touch. Pour very hot water, not boiling, into the pan so the water is 1-inch deep. Place pan in middle of oven. Bake custard 40 minutes or until knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Transfer cups from pan to wire rack. Cool to room temperature. Chill in refrigerator for at least two hours.

recipes.title: Keebler Peach Crunch
ingredients: 2 cans (16 oz. each) sliced peaches, drained
2 c. Keebler cinnamon crisp crumbs (about 12 crackers)
directions: Arrange peaches in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly.
Sprinkle over peaches.
Bake in preheated 375u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes until topping is golden brown.
Serve with desired cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Keebler Peach Crunch. Arrange peaches in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake in preheated 375u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes until topping is golden brown. Serve with desired cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Beef And Broccoli
ingredients: 3/4 lb. boneless beef sirloin, cut into strips (or may substitute boneless pork)
1 can (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of broccoli soup
directions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, in hot oil, cook beef and garlic until beef is browned.
Add broccoli and onion. Cook 5 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in soup, water and soy sauce.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover; cook 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Serve over noodles. Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Beef And Broccoli. In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, in hot oil, cook beef and garlic until beef is browned. Add broccoli and onion. Cook 5 minutes, stirring often. Stir in soup, water and soy sauce. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve over noodles. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Make dough according to Bisquick package directions.
Roll dough into small balls.
Pour melted butter, sugar and cinnamon over dough.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Make dough according to Bisquick package directions. Roll dough into small balls. Pour melted butter, sugar and cinnamon over dough. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion.
Add rest of liquids to make sauce.
Put meat mix in bottom of casserole dish.
Use tortilla shells for next layer.
Alternate to the top of the dish with meat and tortillas.
Top with grated cheese.
Put in 350u00b0 to 400u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Brown meat and onion. Add rest of liquids to make sauce. Put meat mix in bottom of casserole dish. Use tortilla shells for next layer. Alternate to the top of the dish with meat and tortillas. Top with grated cheese. Put in 350u00b0 to 400u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

recipes.title: Donuts And Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Mix together oil, yeast, sugar and water.
Let rise at least 10 minutes. Mix eggs and salt together.
Add to yeast mix with flour.
recipes.text: Donuts And Cinnamon Rolls. Mix together oil, yeast, sugar and water. Let rise at least 10 minutes. Mix eggs and salt together. Add to yeast mix with flour.

recipes.title: Fluffy Frosting
directions: Place sugar, cream of tartar, salt, water and corn syrup in saucepan.
Stir over medium heat until sugar is completely dissolved, forming a syrup.
Place egg whites in bowl.
Beat on high until whites begin to hold shape, about 45 seconds.
Continue beating on high, slowly pour hot syrup into egg whites in a fine stream.
Add vanilla and continue whipping about 5 minutes, or until frosting loses gloss and stands in stiff peaks.
Frost cake immediately.
recipes.text: Fluffy Frosting. Place sugar, cream of tartar, salt, water and corn syrup in saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sugar is completely dissolved, forming a syrup. Place egg whites in bowl. Beat on high until whites begin to hold shape, about 45 seconds. Continue beating on high, slowly pour hot syrup into egg whites in a fine stream. Add vanilla and continue whipping about 5 minutes, or until frosting loses gloss and stands in stiff peaks. Frost cake immediately.

recipes.title: Freezer Strawberry-Rhubarb Jam
directions: Stem and thoroughly crush about 1 pint strawberries and measure 1 cup into large bowl.
Grind very fine (do not peel) about 1 pound rhubarb.
Measure 1 cup and add to berries.
Thoroughly mix sugar into fruit; let sit 10 minutes.
Mix water and pectin in small saucepan.
Bring to boil and boil 1 minute, stirring constantly. Stir into fruit and stir about 3 minutes.
Ladle quickly into containers.
Cover at once with tight lids.
Let stand at room temperature until set (may take up to 24 hours).
Store in freezer. Makes 5 cups.
recipes.text: Freezer Strawberry-Rhubarb Jam. Stem and thoroughly crush about 1 pint strawberries and measure 1 cup into large bowl. Grind very fine (do not peel) about 1 pound rhubarb. Measure 1 cup and add to berries. Thoroughly mix sugar into fruit; let sit 10 minutes. Mix water and pectin in small saucepan. Bring to boil and boil 1 minute, stirring constantly. Stir into fruit and stir about 3 minutes. Ladle quickly into containers. Cover at once with tight lids. Let stand at room temperature until set (may take up to 24 hours). Store in freezer. Makes 5 cups.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. cooked sausage or cubed ham
directions: Place bread cubes in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan; sprinkle with 1/2 cheese, then crumbled sausage or ham.
Beat eggs; add milk and spices.
Pour over ingredients in pan and sprinkle rest of cheese over.
Drizzle melted butter over all. Refrigerate overnight.
Cover loosely with foil and bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until eggs are set.
Serves 6 (x 4 for "Firehouse serving).
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Place bread cubes in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan; sprinkle with 1/2 cheese, then crumbled sausage or ham. Beat eggs; add milk and spices. Pour over ingredients in pan and sprinkle rest of cheese over. Drizzle melted butter over all. Refrigerate overnight. Cover loosely with foil and bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until eggs are set. Serves 6 (x 4 for "Firehouse serving).

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, diced and cooked with a little butter
1 can cream of mushroom or potato soup
directions: In a large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
Remove bacon; pour off drippings except for 2 to 3 tablespoons.
Add onion and cook until browned.
Add mushrooms and cook.
A dash of garlic may be added here.
Add cooked potatoes.
Mix well and add the rest of the ingredients.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer for a minute or two.
Crumble bacon over chowder.
Top each serving with a touch of butter.
recipes.text: Corn Chowder. In a large skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon; pour off drippings except for 2 to 3 tablespoons. Add onion and cook until browned. Add mushrooms and cook. A dash of garlic may be added here. Add cooked potatoes. Mix well and add the rest of the ingredients. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer for a minute or two. Crumble bacon over chowder. Top each serving with a touch of butter.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Topping(Use Instead Of Whipped Cream)
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. fresh, frozen or canned lemon juice
directions: In bowl, place water, lemon juice and vanilla.
Sprinkle dry milk on top.
With electric mixer, beat until stiff (about 10 minutes).
Beat in sugar.
Continue beating until stiff enough to hold soft peaks (about 5 minutes) more.
Use instead of whipped cream to top desserts.
Makes about 2 1/2 cups or 20 servings (2 tablespoons each).
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Topping(Use Instead Of Whipped Cream). In bowl, place water, lemon juice and vanilla. Sprinkle dry milk on top. With electric mixer, beat until stiff (about 10 minutes). Beat in sugar. Continue beating until stiff enough to hold soft peaks (about 5 minutes) more. Use instead of whipped cream to top desserts. Makes about 2 1/2 cups or 20 servings (2 tablespoons each).

recipes.title: Grandma'S Irish Soda Bread
directions: Soak raisins in water for 1/2 hour.
Drain.
Mix together soaked raisins and all other ingredients.
Knead and shape into round loaf.
Place in a warm, greased cast-iron pan.
Put a cross on top of bread with a butter knife.
Bake 45 to 60 minutes in a preheated 350u00b0 oven.
Eat with butter and hot tea!
recipes.text: Grandma'S Irish Soda Bread. Soak raisins in water for 1/2 hour. Drain. Mix together soaked raisins and all other ingredients. Knead and shape into round loaf. Place in a warm, greased cast-iron pan. Put a cross on top of bread with a butter knife. Bake 45 to 60 minutes in a preheated 350u00b0 oven. Eat with butter and hot tea!

recipes.title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. Cheerios or Rice Krispies cereal
directions: In glass bowl, combine sugar and syrup.
Microwave 2 1/2 to 3 minutes on High until mixture comes to a full boil.
Stir in peanut butter and cereal.
Shape into balls or drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies. In glass bowl, combine sugar and syrup. Microwave 2 1/2 to 3 minutes on High until mixture comes to a full boil. Stir in peanut butter and cereal. Shape into balls or drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Kahlua Home Brew
directions: Cook and simmer water, sugar and instant coffee for 45 minutes uncovered.
After completely cooled, add 1/5 vodka and vanilla. Store for 3 or 4 weeks before using.
recipes.text: Kahlua Home Brew. Cook and simmer water, sugar and instant coffee for 45 minutes uncovered. After completely cooled, add 1/5 vodka and vanilla. Store for 3 or 4 weeks before using.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Add sugar to oil, then eggs, pumpkin, spices, flour and other ingredients.
Pour into loaf pans, greased.
Fill pans halfway. Bake at 350u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Add sugar to oil, then eggs, pumpkin, spices, flour and other ingredients. Pour into loaf pans, greased. Fill pans halfway. Bake at 350u00b0 for 65 to 70 minutes.

recipes.title: Michael Marvil'S Mother'S Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
In a large mixing bowl, pour boiling water over the cornmeal.
Stir until smooth.
Cut margarine into small pieces and stir into hot mixture until melted.
Add sugar, salt and eggs.
Blend in the milk, 1/2 cup at a time.
Pour into a well greased glass baking dish, 8 x 12-inch.
Bake at 400u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until well browned. Let cool before cutting into 24 squares.
recipes.text: Michael Marvil'S Mother'S Cornbread. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. In a large mixing bowl, pour boiling water over the cornmeal. Stir until smooth. Cut margarine into small pieces and stir into hot mixture until melted. Add sugar, salt and eggs. Blend in the milk, 1/2 cup at a time. Pour into a well greased glass baking dish, 8 x 12-inch. Bake at 400u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until well browned. Let cool before cutting into 24 squares.

recipes.title: Apple Dip
directions: Mix first four ingredients until smooth and creamy.
Slice apples and serve with dip.
recipes.text: Apple Dip. Mix first four ingredients until smooth and creamy. Slice apples and serve with dip.

recipes.title: Onion Burgers
ingredients: 1 can onion soup (tomato or mushroom soup may be substituted)
directions: Brown beef in pan.
Add flour and soup.
Let simmer until slightly thickened.
recipes.text: Onion Burgers. Brown beef in pan. Add flour and soup. Let simmer until slightly thickened.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Loaf
directions: Dissolve gelatin in cold water.
Heat peas and liquid; add to gelatin.
Set aside.
Mix eggs, celery, green pepper and onion together and add mayonnaise, milk, salt, vinegar and Tabasco. Then add to peas and gelatin mixture; mix well and add corned beef.
Put into dish or pan lined with waxed paper.
Cover and chill for at least 2 hours.
Cut into squares and serve on lettuce as main dish.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Loaf. Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Heat peas and liquid; add to gelatin. Set aside. Mix eggs, celery, green pepper and onion together and add mayonnaise, milk, salt, vinegar and Tabasco. Then add to peas and gelatin mixture; mix well and add corned beef. Put into dish or pan lined with waxed paper. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Cut into squares and serve on lettuce as main dish. Serves 8.

recipes.title: "Dirt" Cake
ingredients: 2 small boxes French vanilla pudding mix
directions: Blend cookies in food processor until crumbly (or beat with a hammer).
Transfer to bowl and crush large pieces; set aside.
In large bowl combine margarine, cream cheese, powdered sugar and set aside.
Mix milk and pudding together.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Put top of Cool Whip cover in the bottom of an 8-inch flowerpot. Layer each beginning with 1 layer of crumbs and 1 layer of cream. Refrigerate several hours.
Serve with a shovel.
recipes.text: "Dirt" Cake. Blend cookies in food processor until crumbly (or beat with a hammer). Transfer to bowl and crush large pieces; set aside. In large bowl combine margarine, cream cheese, powdered sugar and set aside. Mix milk and pudding together. Fold in Cool Whip. Put top of Cool Whip cover in the bottom of an 8-inch flowerpot. Layer each beginning with 1 layer of crumbs and 1 layer of cream. Refrigerate several hours. Serve with a shovel.

recipes.title: Fruit Pie
directions: Mix all together and pour into a graham cracker crust.
Put in refrigerator for several hours or overnight until firm.
recipes.text: Fruit Pie. Mix all together and pour into a graham cracker crust. Put in refrigerator for several hours or overnight until firm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttermilk (do not use powdered buttermilk, it lumps)
directions: In a large saucepan, bring to boil the first 3 ingredients. Stir until well mixed.
Mix in next 7 ingredients.
Pour into a greased jelly roll pan and bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. In a large saucepan, bring to boil the first 3 ingredients. Stir until well mixed. Mix in next 7 ingredients. Pour into a greased jelly roll pan and bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes (2 c.), chopped or 1 pt. can tomatoes
2 large white potatoes, cut in chunks
1 (10 oz.) box frozen baby lima beans
directions: Bring chicken and water mixture to a boil.
Add onion, celery and carrots.
Cook 2 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Discard bay leaves.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Bring chicken and water mixture to a boil. Add onion, celery and carrots. Cook 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Discard bay leaves.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Place apples
in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together sugar, flour, cinnamon and oleo.
Sprinkle over apples.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Place apples in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together sugar, flour, cinnamon and oleo. Sprinkle over apples. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Barbecued Meatballs
directions: Mix eggs, milk, bread crumbs, onions and salt.
Add meat; mix well.
Shape into 72 one-inch balls.
Bake in two 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch baking pans at 375u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool meatballs and freeze, putting 24 meatballs in a package.
recipes.text: Barbecued Meatballs. Mix eggs, milk, bread crumbs, onions and salt. Add meat; mix well. Shape into 72 one-inch balls. Bake in two 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch baking pans at 375u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool meatballs and freeze, putting 24 meatballs in a package.

recipes.title: Cheese Quesadillas
directions: Place cheese and ham in center of tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border. Place another tortilla on top of mixture and press edges together as best you can to seal.
recipes.text: Cheese Quesadillas. Place cheese and ham in center of tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border. Place another tortilla on top of mixture and press edges together as best you can to seal.

recipes.title: Tea Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl and beat until batter is smooth. Drop cookies on cookie sheet (teaspoonful) and bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Tea Cookies. Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl and beat until batter is smooth. Drop cookies on cookie sheet (teaspoonful) and bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cool Whip Cookies
directions: Beat egg into Cool Whip.
Add cake mix and mix thoroughly. Chill overnight.
Roll into balls and then into confectioners sugar.
Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Cool Whip Cookies. Beat egg into Cool Whip. Add cake mix and mix thoroughly. Chill overnight. Roll into balls and then into confectioners sugar. Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Rabbit Salmi
directions: Place rabbit in baking pan and add onion, celery and bay leaves.
Brush with oil and roast in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Remove meat from pan, add fat and flour and stir until sauce becomes a rich brown.
Add hot water, stir well.
When smooth, add salt, Worcestershire sauce, capers and olives.
Replace meat, cover tightly and roast in 350u00b0 oven for an additional 80 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Rabbit Salmi. Place rabbit in baking pan and add onion, celery and bay leaves. Brush with oil and roast in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Remove meat from pan, add fat and flour and stir until sauce becomes a rich brown. Add hot water, stir well. When smooth, add salt, Worcestershire sauce, capers and olives. Replace meat, cover tightly and roast in 350u00b0 oven for an additional 80 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Kosher Dill Pickles
directions: Slice or quarter cucumbers and pack in 10 hot quart jars.
Add 1 clove of garlic and 1 teaspoon dill weed to each jar.
recipes.text: Kosher Dill Pickles. Slice or quarter cucumbers and pack in 10 hot quart jars. Add 1 clove of garlic and 1 teaspoon dill weed to each jar.

recipes.title: Marie'S Chicken Noodle Casserole(Excellent)
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, whole (4 pieces), cooked and diced
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Put in a buttered casserole.
Grate 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and put on top.
Put buttered bread crumbs on top of cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 about 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Marie'S Chicken Noodle Casserole(Excellent). Mix all ingredients. Put in a buttered casserole. Grate 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and put on top. Put buttered bread crumbs on top of cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 about 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Chili
ingredients: 16 oz. can whole, chopped or stewed tomatoes
directions: In skillet, crumble hamburger; add onion, celery and green pepper.
Cook until meat is no longer red.
Pour into large stew pot and add chopped tomatoes, 2 cans beans, salt, pepper and hot sauce to taste.
If desired, can add 2 cups of cooked brown rice when ready to eat.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Chili. In skillet, crumble hamburger; add onion, celery and green pepper. Cook until meat is no longer red. Pour into large stew pot and add chopped tomatoes, 2 cans beans, salt, pepper and hot sauce to taste. If desired, can add 2 cups of cooked brown rice when ready to eat.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Microwave sugar, Karo and salt in 1 1/2-quart bowl, 4 minutes. Remove and stir in peanuts.
Return to microwave and cook 4 minutes.
Remove; add oleo and vanilla.
Stir well.
Return to microwave 2 minutes.
Remove and stir in soda.
Stir well and pour into buttered pan (I use cookie sheet).
Spread thin; cool.
Break into pieces.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Brittle. Microwave sugar, Karo and salt in 1 1/2-quart bowl, 4 minutes. Remove and stir in peanuts. Return to microwave and cook 4 minutes. Remove; add oleo and vanilla. Stir well. Return to microwave 2 minutes. Remove and stir in soda. Stir well and pour into buttered pan (I use cookie sheet). Spread thin; cool. Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Easy Pumpkin Swirl
directions: Grease bottom and sides of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Line with wax paper and grease wax paper.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Easy Pumpkin Swirl. Grease bottom and sides of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Line with wax paper and grease wax paper. Set aside.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole Oriental
directions: Melt margarine in skillet.
Saute onion until clear (don't brown).
Stir in green pepper, celery, chicken broth and soy sauce.
Blend well.
Add chicken, mushrooms and chestnuts.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole Oriental. Melt margarine in skillet. Saute onion until clear (don't brown). Stir in green pepper, celery, chicken broth and soy sauce. Blend well. Add chicken, mushrooms and chestnuts.

recipes.title: Saucy Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup or 1 can tomato sauce
directions: Place onion slices in the bottom of a baking dish.
Break up the beef and cover the onion with it.
Sprinkle salt, basil and oregano over beef.
Pour sauce or soup over mixture.
Bake in preheated oven at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Saucy Meat Loaf. Place onion slices in the bottom of a baking dish. Break up the beef and cover the onion with it. Sprinkle salt, basil and oregano over beef. Pour sauce or soup over mixture. Bake in preheated oven at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: No Trot Chili Company Blue Ribbon Recipe
ingredients: 2 lb. trimmed brisket or round steak
directions: Cut beef into 1 cubes and mix with pork, onion and garlic and cook in 1 Tbsp. oil until brown and tender.
Add tomatoes; continue to cook on low heat.
Dissolve bouillon and brown sugar in two cups hot water and set aside.
Heat remainder of oil in a pan; add chili powder, flour and pepper.
Cook until flour is brown, then add bouillon mix, stirring constantly until blended. Add the Roux to the meat; blend and cook on low heat for one hour.
recipes.text: No Trot Chili Company Blue Ribbon Recipe. Cut beef into 1 cubes and mix with pork, onion and garlic and cook in 1 Tbsp. oil until brown and tender. Add tomatoes; continue to cook on low heat. Dissolve bouillon and brown sugar in two cups hot water and set aside. Heat remainder of oil in a pan; add chili powder, flour and pepper. Cook until flour is brown, then add bouillon mix, stirring constantly until blended. Add the Roux to the meat; blend and cook on low heat for one hour.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes wild strawberry sugar free Jell-O
directions: Make Jell-O with 3 cups hot water.
Add to Jell-O the strawberries.
Mix cake cubes with Jell-O and strawberries.
Just before serving fold in whipped topping.
recipes.text: Strawberry Shortcake Salad. Make Jell-O with 3 cups hot water. Add to Jell-O the strawberries. Mix cake cubes with Jell-O and strawberries. Just before serving fold in whipped topping.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon or orange jello (3 oz.)
directions: First Bowl:
Drain pineapple, saving liquid, and mix pineapple with cream cheese.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Salad. First Bowl: Drain pineapple, saving liquid, and mix pineapple with cream cheese.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream sugar, shortening and vanilla.
Add one egg at a time; beat well.
Make paste of food coloring and cocoa.
Add to sugar mixture.
Sift flour and salt.
Add flour and buttermilk alternately, a little at a time, mixing well after each addition. Begin and end with flour.
Combine vinegar and soda; add to batter. Pour into 2 (8-inch) pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cakes tests done.
Let cool and split layers.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream sugar, shortening and vanilla. Add one egg at a time; beat well. Make paste of food coloring and cocoa. Add to sugar mixture. Sift flour and salt. Add flour and buttermilk alternately, a little at a time, mixing well after each addition. Begin and end with flour. Combine vinegar and soda; add to batter. Pour into 2 (8-inch) pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until cakes tests done. Let cool and split layers.

recipes.title: Casa Blanca Stew(Heart Healthy)
directions: Heat oil and saut onion, garlic and leeks over moderate heat until soft. Add spices and cook another 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Add eggplant and squashes; cook another 5 minutes. Add remaining vegetables, currants, stock and seasonings. Cover and simmer until flavors are developed. Adjust seasonings. Serve with Cornmeal Dumplings. Yield: 6 portions.
recipes.text: Casa Blanca Stew(Heart Healthy). Heat oil and saut onion, garlic and leeks over moderate heat until soft. Add spices and cook another 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Add eggplant and squashes; cook another 5 minutes. Add remaining vegetables, currants, stock and seasonings. Cover and simmer until flavors are developed. Adjust seasonings. Serve with Cornmeal Dumplings. Yield: 6 portions.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, beaten after each egg. Add cream, then flour, baking powder and salt.
Add vanilla.
Mix well.
Chill 20 minutes.
Roll out on floured surface (very thin). Cut with cookie cutters.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 6 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs, beaten after each egg. Add cream, then flour, baking powder and salt. Add vanilla. Mix well. Chill 20 minutes. Roll out on floured surface (very thin). Cut with cookie cutters. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400u00b0 for 6 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Prehistoric Pudding
directions: You will need 8 to 10 plastic cups and prehistoric decorations.
recipes.text: Prehistoric Pudding. You will need 8 to 10 plastic cups and prehistoric decorations.

recipes.title: Party Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 (1 oz.) packet dry Ranch salad dressing mix
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towels. Sprinkle equal amounts of vegetables on top of cream cheese. Roll tortillas tightly. Chill at least 2 hours. Cut rolls into 1-inch pieces. Discard ends. Serve spirals facing up. (Can be prepared with diced veggies of choice!) Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Party Pinwheels. Mix first 3 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towels. Sprinkle equal amounts of vegetables on top of cream cheese. Roll tortillas tightly. Chill at least 2 hours. Cut rolls into 1-inch pieces. Discard ends. Serve spirals facing up. (Can be prepared with diced veggies of choice!) Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: California Cobb Salad
directions: Shred lettuce, watercress and romaine fine; place in a large salad bowl.
Arrange diced tomatoes, chicken, crumbled bacon, diced avocado, diced eggs and crumbled Blue cheese in strips across salad greens.
Just before serving, toss with enough vinagrette dressing to moisten salad and salt and pepper.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: California Cobb Salad. Shred lettuce, watercress and romaine fine; place in a large salad bowl. Arrange diced tomatoes, chicken, crumbled bacon, diced avocado, diced eggs and crumbled Blue cheese in strips across salad greens. Just before serving, toss with enough vinagrette dressing to moisten salad and salt and pepper. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Date Bars
directions: Blend first 3 ingredients well.
Add next 3 ingredients. Blend well.
Add dates.
Mix all well.
Place into well-greased and floured 13 x 9-inch roasting pan.
Bake in oven at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Date Bars. Blend first 3 ingredients well. Add next 3 ingredients. Blend well. Add dates. Mix all well. Place into well-greased and floured 13 x 9-inch roasting pan. Bake in oven at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. lean ground or cubed pork or beef
1 large can sauerkraut, washed and drained
directions: Boil and drain noodles al dente.
Set aside.
Brown meat and drain.
Add celery, soup mix and sauerkraut and simmer for 1 hour. Mix soup and water and heat.
Add to meat mixture and add noodles.
Pour into greased casserole and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Casserole. Boil and drain noodles al dente. Set aside. Brown meat and drain. Add celery, soup mix and sauerkraut and simmer for 1 hour. Mix soup and water and heat. Add to meat mixture and add noodles. Pour into greased casserole and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding(1930)
directions: Mix sugar, milk, water and eggs together.
Save three egg whites for topping.
Bring to boil, then add cornstarch, mixed with a little extra water.
Cook until thickened.
Add vanilla.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding(1930). Mix sugar, milk, water and eggs together. Save three egg whites for topping. Bring to boil, then add cornstarch, mixed with a little extra water. Cook until thickened. Add vanilla.

recipes.title: Tuna Tidbits
directions: If there is not enough juice from fish, add water to make 1/4 cup.
Beat egg.
Stir in
tuna and salt.
Stir with a fork.
Mix liquid with baking powder; stir into fish mixture.
Using 2 iced teaspoons, drop small bits into hot deep fat.
The tidbits will be lacy.
Brown one side; turn and brown other side.
Drain on paper towels.
Takes about 2 to 5 minutes to cook.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Tuna Tidbits. If there is not enough juice from fish, add water to make 1/4 cup. Beat egg. Stir in tuna and salt. Stir with a fork. Mix liquid with baking powder; stir into fish mixture. Using 2 iced teaspoons, drop small bits into hot deep fat. The tidbits will be lacy. Brown one side; turn and brown other side. Drain on paper towels. Takes about 2 to 5 minutes to cook. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Frito Salad
directions: Marinate tomatoes, onion, bell pepper and pinto beans in Catalina dressing until ready to use.
Chop lettuce.
Grate the cheese.
Add the lettuce, Cheddar cheese and Fritos to the salad fixings about 30 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Frito Salad. Marinate tomatoes, onion, bell pepper and pinto beans in Catalina dressing until ready to use. Chop lettuce. Grate the cheese. Add the lettuce, Cheddar cheese and Fritos to the salad fixings about 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
In a medium sized bowl, beat together the egg, milk and butter.
Add the egg mixture and the sour cream to the flour mixture.
Stir just until blended.
Pour the mixture into a greased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Cornbread. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. In a medium sized bowl, beat together the egg, milk and butter. Add the egg mixture and the sour cream to the flour mixture. Stir just until blended. Pour the mixture into a greased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Hello Dolly Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
In a long shallow Pyrex, melt 1 stick oleo.
Sprinkle vanilla wafers, then chocolate chips, coconut and pecans.
Over this, pour Eagle Brand milk.
Bake about 30 minutes. Cool.
Allow to set in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Hello Dolly Cookies. Heat oven to 350u00b0. In a long shallow Pyrex, melt 1 stick oleo. Sprinkle vanilla wafers, then chocolate chips, coconut and pecans. Over this, pour Eagle Brand milk. Bake about 30 minutes. Cool. Allow to set in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Roll into balls; flatten with a fork. Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix all ingredients. Roll into balls; flatten with a fork. Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

recipes.title: No Excuse Bread
directions: Put ingredients into large mixing bowl; beat for 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir and knead 5 to 10 minutes, until dough stiffens and isn't sticky.
Dough should be smooth and elastic.
Cover with folded towel; let rest for 20 minutes.
Roll out and place in greased pan.
Refrigerate 24 hours.
Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: No Excuse Bread. Put ingredients into large mixing bowl; beat for 8 to 10 minutes. Stir and knead 5 to 10 minutes, until dough stiffens and isn't sticky. Dough should be smooth and elastic. Cover with folded towel; let rest for 20 minutes. Roll out and place in greased pan. Refrigerate 24 hours. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Lemon Coconut Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Cream the margarine and 1/2 cup brown sugar.
Blend in 1 cup flour, oatmeal, salt and soda.
Press into bottom and sides of a greased 9-inch square baking pan.
Bake for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Mom'S Lemon Coconut Bars. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Cream the margarine and 1/2 cup brown sugar. Blend in 1 cup flour, oatmeal, salt and soda. Press into bottom and sides of a greased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Tartar Sauce. Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Bites
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Grease a cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Bites. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Grease a cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix dry ingredients; cut in shortening until blended.
Beat egg; add water and vinegar and add to dry ingredients.
Stir with a fork until moistened.
Divide into five balls of dough, slightly flatten, wrap in wax paper and chill.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Mix dry ingredients; cut in shortening until blended. Beat egg; add water and vinegar and add to dry ingredients. Stir with a fork until moistened. Divide into five balls of dough, slightly flatten, wrap in wax paper and chill.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer ingredients in Pyrex dish starting with cream cheese, refried beans, salsa and then shredded cheese.
Heat in microwave about 2 to 3 minutes on High; serve with nacho chips.
Instead of jalapeno peppers, you can use sliced black olives.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Layer ingredients in Pyrex dish starting with cream cheese, refried beans, salsa and then shredded cheese. Heat in microwave about 2 to 3 minutes on High; serve with nacho chips. Instead of jalapeno peppers, you can use sliced black olives.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
ingredients: 3 c. all-purpose flour, spooned into cup
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Sift flour, soda and salt onto a platter or waxed paper.
In a large bowl beat oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla at medium speed of electric mixer for 3 or 4 minutes until well blended.
Gradually add flour mixture; beat until smooth.
Fold in pecans and apples.
Pour batter into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for about 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until cake tests done.
Cool on wire rack 20 minutes. If desired, dribble Brown Sugar Topping over warm cake, however, the cake is marvelous plain.
Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Pound Cake. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Sift flour, soda and salt onto a platter or waxed paper. In a large bowl beat oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla at medium speed of electric mixer for 3 or 4 minutes until well blended. Gradually add flour mixture; beat until smooth. Fold in pecans and apples. Pour batter into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for about 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until cake tests done. Cool on wire rack 20 minutes. If desired, dribble Brown Sugar Topping over warm cake, however, the cake is marvelous plain. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Beef Loaf
directions: Mix all together.
Put in shallow loaf pan.
Bake about 45 minutes with cover at 400u00b0.
Uncover last few minutes.
recipes.text: Beef Loaf. Mix all together. Put in shallow loaf pan. Bake about 45 minutes with cover at 400u00b0. Uncover last few minutes.

recipes.title: Onion Bake Potatoes
ingredients: 2 or 3 lb. potatoes, cut in chunks (peel or unpeel)
directions: In plastic bag add all ingredients.
Shake.
Coat potatoes well.
Empty potatoes into baking pan.
Bake at 450u00b0 for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender or golden brown.
Good with barbecues.
recipes.text: Onion Bake Potatoes. In plastic bag add all ingredients. Shake. Coat potatoes well. Empty potatoes into baking pan. Bake at 450u00b0 for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender or golden brown. Good with barbecues.

recipes.title: Pineapple Dessert
ingredients: 1 large or 2 (8 oz.) containers Cool Whip
directions: Lightly grease a 13 x 9 x 2 pan with vegetable oil or cooking spray.
recipes.text: Pineapple Dessert. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 x 2 pan with vegetable oil or cooking spray.

recipes.title: Twinkie Delight
directions: Slice Twinkies longwise and lay filling side up in a 13 x 9-inch glass pan.
Cover with pie filling.
Slice bananas over the pie filling.
Cut the pineapple tidbits in pieces.
Pour the juice over the top.
Spread with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate until cold.
Cut in squares and serve.
recipes.text: Twinkie Delight. Slice Twinkies longwise and lay filling side up in a 13 x 9-inch glass pan. Cover with pie filling. Slice bananas over the pie filling. Cut the pineapple tidbits in pieces. Pour the juice over the top. Spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate until cold. Cut in squares and serve.

recipes.title: Kentucky Spoon Bread
ingredients: 1 can (8 oz.) whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Melt the butter and combine with the corn muffin mix, the cream ed corn, whole kernel corn, the sour cream and the eggs (slightly beaten).
Pour it into 2-quart casserole.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.
If it is a little soft in the center, bake 5 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Kentucky Spoon Bread. Melt the butter and combine with the corn muffin mix, the cream ed corn, whole kernel corn, the sour cream and the eggs (slightly beaten). Pour it into 2-quart casserole. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. If it is a little soft in the center, bake 5 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Tomato Cheeseburgers(Variation Of Sloppy Joes)
directions: Brown hamburger and chopped onion; drain meat.
Add small can tomatoes.
Cook (simmer) until juice is cooked down (15 minutes). Add 6 ounces chopped Cheddar cheese.
Simmer 1 minute.
Serve on buns.
recipes.text: Tomato Cheeseburgers(Variation Of Sloppy Joes). Brown hamburger and chopped onion; drain meat. Add small can tomatoes. Cook (simmer) until juice is cooked down (15 minutes). Add 6 ounces chopped Cheddar cheese. Simmer 1 minute. Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Country Breakfast Pie
directions: Cook sausage until done (crumbled); drain.
Mix cheese and sausage; sprinkle in pie shell.
Lightly beat eggs in a bowl. Combine rest of ingredients to eggs and pour in shell.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Cool on rack 10 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Country Breakfast Pie. Cook sausage until done (crumbled); drain. Mix cheese and sausage; sprinkle in pie shell. Lightly beat eggs in a bowl. Combine rest of ingredients to eggs and pour in shell. Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool on rack 10 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Pie
directions: Soak bananas in pineapple and lemon juice for 20 minutes. Drain and save juice. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on bananas. Toss lightly and put in pastry pie shell.
recipes.text: Banana Pie. Soak bananas in pineapple and lemon juice for 20 minutes. Drain and save juice. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on bananas. Toss lightly and put in pastry pie shell.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix well all ingredients. Add 3 tablespoons melted butter. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix well all ingredients. Add 3 tablespoons melted butter. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Turkey Dressing
directions: Cook onions, celery, butter and bouillon until celery is soft and tender.
May need to add a little more water but don't cook too fast as the water boils away.
Add all of this to the bread crumb mixture and toss lightly.
May also add juice from your turkey.
I like really moist.
Bake in casserole dish at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Turkey Dressing. Cook onions, celery, butter and bouillon until celery is soft and tender. May need to add a little more water but don't cook too fast as the water boils away. Add all of this to the bread crumb mixture and toss lightly. May also add juice from your turkey. I like really moist. Bake in casserole dish at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Veggies
directions: Melt
butter in saucepan; add teriyakitsauce
and
then spices.
Bring to quick boil, then pour
evenly
over
veggies. Cook 5 to 10 minutes on high before serving.
(Depends
onthow crisp you like vegetables.)
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Teriyaki Veggies. Melt butter in saucepan; add teriyakitsauce and then spices. Bring to quick boil, then pour evenly over veggies. Cook 5 to 10 minutes on high before serving. (Depends onthow crisp you like vegetables.) Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Baked Tomatoes
directions: Drain off 1/2 of each can of tomatoes and put in casserole dish and stir in bread crumbs, basil, garlic powder, salt, pepper and chopped onion.
Mix together.
Put in oven to warm 375u00b0 (about 15 minutes).
Mix together the cheese and more bread crumbs.
Put on top and dot with olive oil.
Bake 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Tomatoes. Drain off 1/2 of each can of tomatoes and put in casserole dish and stir in bread crumbs, basil, garlic powder, salt, pepper and chopped onion. Mix together. Put in oven to warm 375u00b0 (about 15 minutes). Mix together the cheese and more bread crumbs. Put on top and dot with olive oil. Bake 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Vegetable Toss
ingredients: 1 large yellow or red bell pepper, cut in 1/2-inch strips
directions: Cook fettuccine per directions.
In deep 12-inch skillet, heat butter and oil.
Add broccoli and onion; cook 3 minutes, stirring often.
Add pea pods, mushrooms, peppers, garlic, salt and pepper. Cook and stir until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Add cream and Parmesan cheese.
Cook for 3 minutes until blended and simmering. Drain fettuccine and add to skillet.
Stir until well mixed. Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Fettuccine Vegetable Toss. Cook fettuccine per directions. In deep 12-inch skillet, heat butter and oil. Add broccoli and onion; cook 3 minutes, stirring often. Add pea pods, mushrooms, peppers, garlic, salt and pepper. Cook and stir until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add cream and Parmesan cheese. Cook for 3 minutes until blended and simmering. Drain fettuccine and add to skillet. Stir until well mixed. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Glazed Strawberry Pie
directions: Place 1 quart fresh strawberries in cooled pie shell.
Crush remaining berries in saucepan.
Add sugar, cornstarch and water, blending well.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickens and boils.
Boil 2 minutes.
Add butter; stir until blended.
Strain mixture and cool.
Pour cooled glaze over berries in pie shell.
Chill about 3 hours.
Serve with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Glazed Strawberry Pie. Place 1 quart fresh strawberries in cooled pie shell. Crush remaining berries in saucepan. Add sugar, cornstarch and water, blending well. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickens and boils. Boil 2 minutes. Add butter; stir until blended. Strain mixture and cool. Pour cooled glaze over berries in pie shell. Chill about 3 hours. Serve with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Mary Jane'S Baked Asparagus
directions: Put asparagus in large jelly roll pan.
Drizzle oil and sprinkle with salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, garlic powder and bread crumbs.
Turn until evenly coated.
Then arrange in a single layer.
Bake at 425u00b0.
Roast for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender when pierced and tips start to brown.
Serve immediately or cool in pan.
Cover and refrigerate.
To reheat turn oven to 350u00b0 for 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges.
Can be made up to one day ahead of time.
recipes.text: Mary Jane'S Baked Asparagus. Put asparagus in large jelly roll pan. Drizzle oil and sprinkle with salt, pepper, parmesan cheese, garlic powder and bread crumbs. Turn until evenly coated. Then arrange in a single layer. Bake at 425u00b0. Roast for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender when pierced and tips start to brown. Serve immediately or cool in pan. Cover and refrigerate. To reheat turn oven to 350u00b0 for 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges. Can be made up to one day ahead of time.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Fudge Topping
directions: Mix brown sugar, cocoa and milk in a sauce pan. Cook and boil 5 minutes. Stir in butter and vanilla. Fold in marshmallows. Marshmallows will partially melt.
recipes.text: Marshmallow Fudge Topping. Mix brown sugar, cocoa and milk in a sauce pan. Cook and boil 5 minutes. Stir in butter and vanilla. Fold in marshmallows. Marshmallows will partially melt.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 1 tsp. minced fresh ginger root or 1/4 tsp. powdered ginger
directions: Mix all the liquid ingredients and the spices. Pour mixture over chicken pieces to marinate for several hours. You can marinate the chicken pieces either
in a shallow covered pan, turning them every few hours OR put the chicken and the seasoning mixture into a tightly sealed plastic bag.
recipes.text: Spicy Chicken Thighs. Mix all the liquid ingredients and the spices. Pour mixture over chicken pieces to marinate for several hours. You can marinate the chicken pieces either in a shallow covered pan, turning them every few hours OR put the chicken and the seasoning mixture into a tightly sealed plastic bag.

recipes.title: Glazed Grapefruit
directions: Mix brown sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle mixture evenly over halved grapefruit.
Broil 4 inches from heat for 5 minutes.
Check occasionally.
Garnish with a strawberry.
recipes.text: Glazed Grapefruit. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle mixture evenly over halved grapefruit. Broil 4 inches from heat for 5 minutes. Check occasionally. Garnish with a strawberry.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Bake 1 can of biscuits and cool.
Pour milk over torn apart biscuits.
Let set for 15 minutes.
Add sugar, eggs, melted butter and vanilla.
Pour into pan greased with butter.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 minutes.
Top with vanilla ice cream or fruit compote for a great dessert!
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Bake 1 can of biscuits and cool. Pour milk over torn apart biscuits. Let set for 15 minutes. Add sugar, eggs, melted butter and vanilla. Pour into pan greased with butter. Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 minutes. Top with vanilla ice cream or fruit compote for a great dessert!

recipes.title: Pork Loin Or Rib Chops
directions: Arrange chops in 9 x 13 pan. Place all ingredients on chops. Cover pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and cook about 30 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Pork Loin Or Rib Chops. Arrange chops in 9 x 13 pan. Place all ingredients on chops. Cover pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Uncover and cook about 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Popcorn
directions: Pop popcorn (either air popped or in a stir crazy popper with 2 tablespoons of oil).
Heat syrup and drizzle over popcorn.
recipes.text: Popcorn. Pop popcorn (either air popped or in a stir crazy popper with 2 tablespoons of oil). Heat syrup and drizzle over popcorn.

recipes.title: M&M Cookies
directions: Blend shortening and sugars.
Beat in vanilla and eggs.
Sift remaining dry ingredients together.
Add to the sugar and egg mixture; mix well.
Stir in 1/2 cup M&M's plain chocolate candies; reserve remaining candies for decorating.
Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Decorate tops of cookies with remaining M&M's.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown. Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.
recipes.text: M&M Cookies. Blend shortening and sugars. Beat in vanilla and eggs. Sift remaining dry ingredients together. Add to the sugar and egg mixture; mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup M&M's plain chocolate candies; reserve remaining candies for decorating. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate tops of cookies with remaining M&M's. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown. Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients and bring to a boil; stir constantly.
Cook to soft ball stage.
Blend in remaining ingredients.
Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Combine first 4 ingredients and bring to a boil; stir constantly. Cook to soft ball stage. Blend in remaining ingredients. Pour into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Redi-Burger Loaf
directions: Put into food processor or mash Redi-burger and tofu; blend until it is mixed together.
Place in mixing bowl with the other ingredients.
Mix well with fork or spoon.
Bake in baking dish 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Redi-Burger Loaf. Put into food processor or mash Redi-burger and tofu; blend until it is mixed together. Place in mixing bowl with the other ingredients. Mix well with fork or spoon. Bake in baking dish 40 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
directions: Dump pie filling into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Dump in pineapple. Spread dry cake mix over mixture.
Spread nuts and coconut over cake mix.
Drizzle melted margarine over nuts and coconut.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Dump pie filling into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Dump in pineapple. Spread dry cake mix over mixture. Spread nuts and coconut over cake mix. Drizzle melted margarine over nuts and coconut. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Greek Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients in pan.
Do not brown hamburg.
Simmer for 1 1/2 hours or more.
Salt to suit.
recipes.text: Greek Sauce. Mix all ingredients in pan. Do not brown hamburg. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours or more. Salt to suit.

recipes.title: Quick 'N Easy Fudge
directions: Melt chocolate.
Add rest of ingredients and stir until smooth.
Pour onto waxed paper in pan.
Chill for several hours.
recipes.text: Quick 'N Easy Fudge. Melt chocolate. Add rest of ingredients and stir until smooth. Pour onto waxed paper in pan. Chill for several hours.

recipes.title: Ritz Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all dry ingredients.
Add vanilla.
Fold in egg whites. Pour into greased pie pan.
Bake in preheated oven at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Cool on wire rack.
Slice pie and use whipped cream or Cool Whip for topping, if desired.
recipes.text: Ritz Pecan Pie. Mix all dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Fold in egg whites. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool on wire rack. Slice pie and use whipped cream or Cool Whip for topping, if desired.

recipes.title: Italian Beef
ingredients: 3 to 3 1/2 lb. boneless chuck, top or bottom round or rump roast (I use chuck)
directions: Wipe meat with a paper towel and brown in the olive oil in Dutch oven. Add remaining ingredients. Cook on top of stove, covered, over medium heat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until very tender. Add more broth or water as needed. When meat is done, shred into chunks and spoon out on hard rolls (hoagies) for delicious sandwiches.
recipes.text: Italian Beef. Wipe meat with a paper towel and brown in the olive oil in Dutch oven. Add remaining ingredients. Cook on top of stove, covered, over medium heat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until very tender. Add more broth or water as needed. When meat is done, shred into chunks and spoon out on hard rolls (hoagies) for delicious sandwiches.

recipes.title: Baked Cheese And Tomato Fondue
ingredients: 3 c. grated Swiss cheese (3/4 lb.) or 1 1/2 c. grated Cheddar cheese and 1 1/2 c. grated Swiss cheese
directions: Make fondue day before serving.
In small bowl, cream 1/3 cup margarine with the garlic and 1/2 teaspoon mustard until well blended.
Remove ends of bread; cut loaf into 1/2-inch thick slices.
Spread one side of each with butter mixture.
recipes.text: Baked Cheese And Tomato Fondue. Make fondue day before serving. In small bowl, cream 1/3 cup margarine with the garlic and 1/2 teaspoon mustard until well blended. Remove ends of bread; cut loaf into 1/2-inch thick slices. Spread one side of each with butter mixture.

recipes.title: Pineapple Slaw
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients; chill at least 1 hour.
Just before serving, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice and pepper; stir. Fold in whipped cream.
Pour over slaw; toss gently.
Garnish with chopped pecans.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Pineapple Slaw. Combine first 5 ingredients; chill at least 1 hour. Just before serving, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice and pepper; stir. Fold in whipped cream. Pour over slaw; toss gently. Garnish with chopped pecans. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together; put enough mayonnaise in it to make stick together.
recipes.text: Corn Bread Salad. Mix all ingredients together; put enough mayonnaise in it to make stick together.

recipes.title: Mashed Yam Casserole
ingredients: additional Marshmallow Creme and pecan halves
directions: Pierce yams all over with fork. Bake in microwave until cooked. Cut in half. Scoop pulp into a bowl. Add Marshmallow Creme, butter and syrup. Beat with mixer until smooth. Beat in eggs until blended. Season with salt and pepper (optional). This can be done one day ahead, covered and chilled.
recipes.text: Mashed Yam Casserole. Pierce yams all over with fork. Bake in microwave until cooked. Cut in half. Scoop pulp into a bowl. Add Marshmallow Creme, butter and syrup. Beat with mixer until smooth. Beat in eggs until blended. Season with salt and pepper (optional). This can be done one day ahead, covered and chilled.

recipes.title: Hot Pork Chops And Beans
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cooked pinto beans with juice
directions: In a large frying pan cook jalapenos and onion until soft and brown.
Remove from pan and set aside.
Fry pork chops until well done and crispy.
Over medium heat add beans, tomato sauce, jalapenos and onion, then add other ingredients.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Serve with warm corn tortillas.
recipes.text: Hot Pork Chops And Beans. In a large frying pan cook jalapenos and onion until soft and brown. Remove from pan and set aside. Fry pork chops until well done and crispy. Over medium heat add beans, tomato sauce, jalapenos and onion, then add other ingredients. Cook for 10 minutes. Serve with warm corn tortillas.

recipes.title: Stuffed Sole
ingredients: 2 (4 1/2 oz.) cans shrimp, rinsed and drained
8 sole or flounder fillets (2 to 2 1/2 lb.)
directions: Saute onion, shrimp and mushrooms in butter until onion is tender.
Add crabmeat and heat through.
Sprinkle fillets with salt, pepper and paprika.
Spoon crabmeat mixture on fillets.
Roll up and fasten with toothpick.
Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine soup, broth and water.
Blend until smooth. Pour over fillets.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Return to oven uncovered for 5 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Stuffed Sole. Saute onion, shrimp and mushrooms in butter until onion is tender. Add crabmeat and heat through. Sprinkle fillets with salt, pepper and paprika. Spoon crabmeat mixture on fillets. Roll up and fasten with toothpick. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine soup, broth and water. Blend until smooth. Pour over fillets. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Return to oven uncovered for 5 minutes. Serve over rice. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
