directions: Melt butter in baking dish.
Place pared and sliced potatoes, coated in flour and cheese, in buttered dish.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 1 hour.
Turn once.
recipes.text: Golden Parmesan Potatoes. Melt butter in baking dish. Place pared and sliced potatoes, coated in flour and cheese, in buttered dish. Bake at 375u00b0 for 1 hour. Turn once.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: milk (Use amount directed on pudding box)
directions: Mix sugar-free vanilla pudding with milk according to directions
in blender.
Add peanut butter.
Blend until smooth. Pour into a cooled crust. Top with Cool Whip.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Peanut Butter Pie. Mix sugar-free vanilla pudding with milk according to directions in blender. Add peanut butter. Blend until smooth. Pour into a cooled crust. Top with Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Amaretto Fudge
ingredients: 2 c. half and half or light cream
directions: In a large saucepan, combine all ingredients and brush sides of pan with butter or margarine.

Stir over moderate heat until sugar is dissolved, then bring to boil and cook without stirring until 238u00b0 is reached on candy thermometer or until a small amount forms a soft ball when dropped in water.
Remove from heat and let stand until 140u00b0 is reached.
Beat with spoon until mixture begins to thicken slightly (mixture will be shiny).
Pour quickly into a foil-lined 8-inch pan (square).
Let stand until hard and cool. Remove from pan, peeling foil away and cut with sharp knife into 1-inch squares.
Delicious!
recipes.text: Amaretto Fudge. In a large saucepan, combine all ingredients and brush sides of pan with butter or margarine. Stir over moderate heat until sugar is dissolved, then bring to boil and cook without stirring until 238u00b0 is reached on candy thermometer or until a small amount forms a soft ball when dropped in water. Remove from heat and let stand until 140u00b0 is reached. Beat with spoon until mixture begins to thicken slightly (mixture will be shiny). Pour quickly into a foil-lined 8-inch pan (square). Let stand until hard and cool. Remove from pan, peeling foil away and cut with sharp knife into 1-inch squares. Delicious!

recipes.title: Crab Imperial
directions: Melt 1 tablespoon margarine or butter.
Mix in flour.
Slowly add milk. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Add onions, Worcestershire sauce and bread cubes; let cool.
In a separate pan, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and crabmeat. Gently fold crabmeat into the sauce mixture. Spoon mixture into shells.
Make topping by stirring together mayonnaise, lemon juice, egg, salt and pepper. Spoon over filled shells.
Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 450u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until lightly brown on top.
recipes.text: Crab Imperial. Melt 1 tablespoon margarine or butter. Mix in flour. Slowly add milk. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and thickens. Add onions, Worcestershire sauce and bread cubes; let cool. In a separate pan, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and crabmeat. Gently fold crabmeat into the sauce mixture. Spoon mixture into shells. Make topping by stirring together mayonnaise, lemon juice, egg, salt and pepper. Spoon over filled shells. Sprinkle with paprika and bake at 450u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until lightly brown on top.

recipes.title: Jack Cheese Balls
directions: Melt cheese in a double boiler.
Crumble sausage into cheese, stirring constantly.
Add Bisquick mix and cayenne pepper.
Roll into small balls.
Freeze on cookie sheet for best results and cook as needed (if cooked right away, they will flatten some). Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes, depending on whether or not frozen.
recipes.text: Jack Cheese Balls. Melt cheese in a double boiler. Crumble sausage into cheese, stirring constantly. Add Bisquick mix and cayenne pepper. Roll into small balls. Freeze on cookie sheet for best results and cook as needed (if cooked right away, they will flatten some). Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes, depending on whether or not frozen.

recipes.title: Deluxe Strawberry French Toast
directions: Drain strawberries, reserving liquid.
Add water to reserved liquid to measure 1 cup.
Combine sugar and cornstarch in saucepan.
Gradually add liquid.
Cook, stirring constantly until mixture is clear and thickened.
Stir in strawberries and almonds.
recipes.text: Deluxe Strawberry French Toast. Drain strawberries, reserving liquid. Add water to reserved liquid to measure 1 cup. Combine sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Gradually add liquid. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture is clear and thickened. Stir in strawberries and almonds.

recipes.title: Boiled Cabbage
directions: Shred cabbage and add sugar and salt in saucepan. Add 1 cup of water and seasoning.
Cook over medium heat until tender.
recipes.text: Boiled Cabbage. Shred cabbage and add sugar and salt in saucepan. Add 1 cup of water and seasoning. Cook over medium heat until tender.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
4 to 6 oz. can jalapeno peppers, seeded and chopped
directions: In skillet, cook tortillas, one at a time, in hot oil for 5 seconds on each side.
Place 2 tablespoons of cheese and 1 tablespoon of onion on each tortilla.
Roll up.
Place seam side down in 11 x 17-inch baking dish.
In saucepan, melt butter; blend in flour.
Add chicken broth and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture bubbles and thickens.
Stir sour cream, chicken and peppers in.
Cook until heated through but do not boil.
Pour over tortillas.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining cheese over top; return to oven only to melt cheese.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas. In skillet, cook tortillas, one at a time, in hot oil for 5 seconds on each side. Place 2 tablespoons of cheese and 1 tablespoon of onion on each tortilla. Roll up. Place seam side down in 11 x 17-inch baking dish. In saucepan, melt butter; blend in flour. Add chicken broth and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture bubbles and thickens. Stir sour cream, chicken and peppers in. Cook until heated through but do not boil. Pour over tortillas. Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 minutes. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top; return to oven only to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Boiled Chocolate Delights
directions: Melt margarine over medium heat and remove.
Blend sugar, cocoa, milk and add to melted margarine.
Cook for 2 minutes after full boil begins.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and quick oats. Mix well.
Drop from spoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Refrigerate until ready to serve as refreshments.
recipes.text: Boiled Chocolate Delights. Melt margarine over medium heat and remove. Blend sugar, cocoa, milk and add to melted margarine. Cook for 2 minutes after full boil begins. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and quick oats. Mix well. Drop from spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Refrigerate until ready to serve as refreshments.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Chill about 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Combine all ingredients. Chill about 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Herb Chicken And Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 c. shredded reduced fat Swiss cheese
directions: Thaw, drain and cut broccoli spears into bite-size pieces and set aside.
Slice breasts into 1/2-inch strips.
Sprinkle with Italian seasoning and pound between sheets of plastic wrap.
Spray skillet with no-stick cooking spray and saute chicken until no longer pink.
Keep warm.
recipes.text: Herb Chicken And Broccoli. Thaw, drain and cut broccoli spears into bite-size pieces and set aside. Slice breasts into 1/2-inch strips. Sprinkle with Italian seasoning and pound between sheets of plastic wrap. Spray skillet with no-stick cooking spray and saute chicken until no longer pink. Keep warm.

recipes.title: Kentucky Butter Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add flour alternately with buttermilk.
Add vanilla.
Bake in well-greased and floured pan for 60 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven.
Remove from oven and punch full of holes with fork (do not remove from Bundt pan). Pour hot glaze into holes.
When cool, remove from pan.
recipes.text: Kentucky Butter Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla. Bake in well-greased and floured pan for 60 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven. Remove from oven and punch full of holes with fork (do not remove from Bundt pan). Pour hot glaze into holes. When cool, remove from pan.

recipes.title: Lemon Moons
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can unsweetened frozen pineapple juice
directions: In mixing bowl, beat eggs, oil, pineapple juice and lemon juice.
Add flour and baking powder; beat well.
Drop by teaspoon on oiled baking sheets and sprinkle with grated lemon rind.
recipes.text: Lemon Moons. In mixing bowl, beat eggs, oil, pineapple juice and lemon juice. Add flour and baking powder; beat well. Drop by teaspoon on oiled baking sheets and sprinkle with grated lemon rind.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Cut dry ingredients into shortening until crumbly.
Add water, egg and vinegar.
Form into a ball; roll out.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven.
Makes 2 large pie crusts.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Cut dry ingredients into shortening until crumbly. Add water, egg and vinegar. Form into a ball; roll out. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven. Makes 2 large pie crusts.

recipes.title: Green Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. grated ginger or 1/2 tsp. ground ginger
1 c. red or green pepper, diced
directions: Cut beef in 1/8-inch strips.
Combine soy sauce, garlic, ginger and beef strips, then toss; set aside.
Heat oil in large frypan or wok.
Add beef; fry until brown.
Add vegetables; stir-fry until tender-crisp, about 10 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with water; add to pan.
Stir until thickened and add tomatoes; heat through.
recipes.text: Green Pepper Steak. Cut beef in 1/8-inch strips. Combine soy sauce, garlic, ginger and beef strips, then toss; set aside. Heat oil in large frypan or wok. Add beef; fry until brown. Add vegetables; stir-fry until tender-crisp, about 10 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water; add to pan. Stir until thickened and add tomatoes; heat through.

recipes.title: Iron Skillet Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa in small mixing bowl.
Melt margarine in an iron skillet; add sugar mixture.
Beat egg yolks. Add milk; beat together.
Add a little at a time to mixture in skillet, stirring constantly.
Cook slowly until thick.
Add vanilla; cool.
Pour into 8-inch pie crust (cooked).
Top with meringue of egg whites.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 400u00b0.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Iron Skillet Chocolate Pie. Mix sugar, flour and cocoa in small mixing bowl. Melt margarine in an iron skillet; add sugar mixture. Beat egg yolks. Add milk; beat together. Add a little at a time to mixture in skillet, stirring constantly. Cook slowly until thick. Add vanilla; cool. Pour into 8-inch pie crust (cooked). Top with meringue of egg whites. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 400u00b0. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Quiche
directions: Cook.
Drain bacon.
Crush.
Sprinkle bacon, ham and onion over crust; add cheese.
Beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper together.
Pour into crust.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until knife in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Swiss Cheese Quiche. Cook. Drain bacon. Crush. Sprinkle bacon, ham and onion over crust; add cheese. Beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper together. Pour into crust. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes or until knife in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Velveeta Fudge
directions: Melt cheese and butter in double boiler or microwave.
Stir well after melted. While cheese and butter are melting, sift sugar and cocoa.
Pour cheese mixture over sugar and cocoa.
Add vanilla. Stir well.
Press into buttered casserole dish. Chill until set.
recipes.text: Velveeta Fudge. Melt cheese and butter in double boiler or microwave. Stir well after melted. While cheese and butter are melting, sift sugar and cocoa. Pour cheese mixture over sugar and cocoa. Add vanilla. Stir well. Press into buttered casserole dish. Chill until set.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Makes 2 regular pies or 1 deep dish pie.
Bake at 325u00b0 until firm.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Makes 2 regular pies or 1 deep dish pie. Bake at 325u00b0 until firm.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad Or Casserole
ingredients: 1 small macaroni and cheese dinner (follow pkg. directions)
1/2 c. mayonnaise (more or less to taste)
directions: When the macaroni and cheese dinner is done, add Veg-All, onion, tuna and mayonnaise.
Mix well and either heat in oven a few minutes until warm or chill and serve as either a casserole or salad.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad Or Casserole. When the macaroni and cheese dinner is done, add Veg-All, onion, tuna and mayonnaise. Mix well and either heat in oven a few minutes until warm or chill and serve as either a casserole or salad.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Fry sausage, then add cheese; cool.
Add egg.
Stuff mushrooms.
Bake about 10 to 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Fry sausage, then add cheese; cool. Add egg. Stuff mushrooms. Bake about 10 to 15 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix bananas and eggs in a bowl.
Sift together flour, sugar, salt and baking soda.
Add to the first mixture.
Add chopped nuts.
Stir well.
Stir in melted butter.
Put in buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Mix bananas and eggs in a bowl. Sift together flour, sugar, salt and baking soda. Add to the first mixture. Add chopped nuts. Stir well. Stir in melted butter. Put in buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Crab Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 lb. crab meat, cooked or crabmeat substitute
directions: Combine mayonnaise, flour, eggs and milk.
Mix thoroughly. Stir in crabmeat, cheeses and onion.
Spoon into a baked pie shell and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm in center.
I double the ingredients and bake in a 10-inch pie shell.
I like mine very full.
recipes.text: Crab Quiche. Combine mayonnaise, flour, eggs and milk. Mix thoroughly. Stir in crabmeat, cheeses and onion. Spoon into a baked pie shell and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm in center. I double the ingredients and bake in a 10-inch pie shell. I like mine very full.

recipes.title: Fritos Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. minced red onion or 4 cut green onions
crushed tortilla chips, Fritos or Doritos
directions: Cook hamburger meat until done; drain off excess grease and add taco seasoning and tomato sauce to the meat.
Cook until it has cooked down a little.
Cut up lettuce and tomatoes in a large bowl.
Add cheese, olives, onion and Fritos.
Pour hamburger mixture over salad and toss.
recipes.text: Fritos Salad. Cook hamburger meat until done; drain off excess grease and add taco seasoning and tomato sauce to the meat. Cook until it has cooked down a little. Cut up lettuce and tomatoes in a large bowl. Add cheese, olives, onion and Fritos. Pour hamburger mixture over salad and toss.

recipes.title: Cheesy Pretzels
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Grease cookie sheet.
Mix flour, milk, cheese, butter, baking powder, sugar and salt to a soft dough. Gently smooth the dough into a ball on floured board.
Knead 10 times.
Divide dough in half.
Roll half the dough into rectangle 12-inches long and 8-inches wide.
Mark and cut the rectangle lengthwise into 8 (1-inch) strips.
Fold each strip in half and seal.
Twist strip into pretzel shape.
recipes.text: Cheesy Pretzels. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Mix flour, milk, cheese, butter, baking powder, sugar and salt to a soft dough. Gently smooth the dough into a ball on floured board. Knead 10 times. Divide dough in half. Roll half the dough into rectangle 12-inches long and 8-inches wide. Mark and cut the rectangle lengthwise into 8 (1-inch) strips. Fold each strip in half and seal. Twist strip into pretzel shape.

recipes.title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 2 c. small curd cottage cheese, drained
1 c. grated Monterey Jack cheese with peppers
directions: Brown ground beef; drain thoroughly.
Add cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, red pepper, salt, pepper and tomatoes; heat through.
recipes.text: Mexican Lasagna. Brown ground beef; drain thoroughly. Add cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, red pepper, salt, pepper and tomatoes; heat through.

recipes.title: Crescent Rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Separate crescent rolls.
Place deboned chicken on each triangle and roll up, starting at large end. Place in a lightly buttered casserole dish and bake for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Crescent Rolls. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Separate crescent rolls. Place deboned chicken on each triangle and roll up, starting at large end. Place in a lightly buttered casserole dish and bake for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Crisp-Tart Cole Slaw
directions: Mix together cabbage, onion and green pepper.
Sprinkle with salt.
Pour 1 cup boiling water over all.
Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.
Drain and toss with pimento, celery seed, mustard seed, vinegar, oil and sugar.
recipes.text: Crisp-Tart Cole Slaw. Mix together cabbage, onion and green pepper. Sprinkle with salt. Pour 1 cup boiling water over all. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour. Drain and toss with pimento, celery seed, mustard seed, vinegar, oil and sugar.

recipes.title: Zucchini Soup
directions: Brown sausage in large pot.
Add celery and cook 10 minutes. Drain off fat.
Add remaining ingredients except green peppers. Cover and boil 20 minutes.
Add green pepper and cook until tender.
Serve with warm Italian bread.
recipes.text: Zucchini Soup. Brown sausage in large pot. Add celery and cook 10 minutes. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients except green peppers. Cover and boil 20 minutes. Add green pepper and cook until tender. Serve with warm Italian bread.

recipes.title: Meatballs Napoli
directions: Combine beef, bread crumbs, onion, celery, egg, seasoning and 3 tablespoons spaghetti sauce; mix thoroughly.
Form into 12 meatballs.
Place on greased shallow baking dish.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile blend cornstarch with broth and remaining spaghetti sauce.
Add green beans and simmer about 2 minutes.
Pour over meatballs; continue baking about 10 minutes longer.
Serve over rice.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Meatballs Napoli. Combine beef, bread crumbs, onion, celery, egg, seasoning and 3 tablespoons spaghetti sauce; mix thoroughly. Form into 12 meatballs. Place on greased shallow baking dish. Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 minutes. Meanwhile blend cornstarch with broth and remaining spaghetti sauce. Add green beans and simmer about 2 minutes. Pour over meatballs; continue baking about 10 minutes longer. Serve over rice. Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 c. brown sugar (I use sugar free)
directions: Cook ground chuck, bacon, and chopped onions until done.
Add soup, sugar and beans and pour into a 9x13 pan.
Cook for 1 1/2 hours at 325u00b0.
Serves 8-12.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Cook ground chuck, bacon, and chopped onions until done. Add soup, sugar and beans and pour into a 9x13 pan. Cook for 1 1/2 hours at 325u00b0. Serves 8-12.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix first four ingredients in a large bowl, sift all dry ingredients together.
Add to first four ingredients.
Mix in 3 cups of diced apples and 1 cup nuts.
Mix by hand.
Pour into tube pan.
Bake 1 1/2 hours in a 325u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Mix first four ingredients in a large bowl, sift all dry ingredients together. Add to first four ingredients. Mix in 3 cups of diced apples and 1 cup nuts. Mix by hand. Pour into tube pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours in a 325u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Chicken Parisienne
ingredients: 6 boneless chicken breasts, wrapped in bacon
directions: Pour liquid over breasts.
Cover with foil. Bake at 250u00b0 for 3 1/2 hours.
Remove foil the last 3/4 hour. Sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Chicken Parisienne. Pour liquid over breasts. Cover with foil. Bake at 250u00b0 for 3 1/2 hours. Remove foil the last 3/4 hour. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: 30 Day Cake
ingredients: 1 lg. can of pineapple chunks with juice
1 lg. can fruit cocktail with juice (16 oz.)**
directions: At the end of 30 days drain liquid from fruit.
Divide the liquid into 4 or 5 jars (1-1/2 cups) and give away.
Divide fruit into thirds.
recipes.text: 30 Day Cake. At the end of 30 days drain liquid from fruit. Divide the liquid into 4 or 5 jars (1-1/2 cups) and give away. Divide fruit into thirds.

recipes.title: Chicken Spectacular
ingredients: 1 pkg. Uncle Ben's wild and white rice, cooked
directions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 2 1/2 or 3-quart casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 16.
recipes.text: Chicken Spectacular. Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 2 1/2 or 3-quart casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 16.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Chess Pie
directions: Combine first four ingredients.
Beat eggs, add milk, butter, vinegar and vanilla.
Blend both mixtures; pour into unbaked pie shell and bake about 45 minutes at 350u00b0 or until set.
recipes.text: Brown Sugar Chess Pie. Combine first four ingredients. Beat eggs, add milk, butter, vinegar and vanilla. Blend both mixtures; pour into unbaked pie shell and bake about 45 minutes at 350u00b0 or until set.

recipes.title: Lime Yogurt Salad
directions: Drain pears.
Dissolve one jello package in 1 cup boiling water.
Add 1/2 cup cold water.
Mix and pour into 8 x 8-inch dish and let thicken.
Place pears on top, when jello is firm, then dissolve second jello in 1 cup boiling water.
Cool slightly and add 8 ounces yogurt.
Pour over first layer and chill until firm, about 3 hours.
Cut in 9 squares.
recipes.text: Lime Yogurt Salad. Drain pears. Dissolve one jello package in 1 cup boiling water. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Mix and pour into 8 x 8-inch dish and let thicken. Place pears on top, when jello is firm, then dissolve second jello in 1 cup boiling water. Cool slightly and add 8 ounces yogurt. Pour over first layer and chill until firm, about 3 hours. Cut in 9 squares.

recipes.title: Currant-Studded Bulgur
directions: Combine water, currants, honey, salt, black pepper, cinnamon and cumin in a medium-size saucepan.
Bring to simmering.
Stir in bulgur and green onions.
Remove from heat, cover and let stand for 10 minutes or until the bulgur is tender.
(Can be made up to a day ahead and refrigerated.)
recipes.text: Currant-Studded Bulgur. Combine water, currants, honey, salt, black pepper, cinnamon and cumin in a medium-size saucepan. Bring to simmering. Stir in bulgur and green onions. Remove from heat, cover and let stand for 10 minutes or until the bulgur is tender. (Can be made up to a day ahead and refrigerated.)

recipes.title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Mix all ingredients and soak overnight.
Bag in Ziploc bags and freeze.
recipes.text: Freezer Pickles. Mix all ingredients and soak overnight. Bag in Ziploc bags and freeze.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
ingredients: 2 pkg. instant vanilla pie filling and pudding
directions: Bring water and oleo to a boil.
Stir in flour until smooth; remove from heat.
Beat eggs in, one at a time.
Spread on an ungreased jelly roll pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes (golden brown).
Mix the cream cheese with milk.
Add pudding mix; beat until thick.
Spread over crust.
Cover with Cool Whip; drizzle with chocolate syrup.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cream Puffs. Bring water and oleo to a boil. Stir in flour until smooth; remove from heat. Beat eggs in, one at a time. Spread on an ungreased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes (golden brown). Mix the cream cheese with milk. Add pudding mix; beat until thick. Spread over crust. Cover with Cool Whip; drizzle with chocolate syrup. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pudding
directions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender.
Drain and mash well.
Add all remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into a greased iron skillet and bake at 400u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until edge of pudding is crusty.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pudding. Boil sweet potatoes until tender. Drain and mash well. Add all remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into a greased iron skillet and bake at 400u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until edge of pudding is crusty.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Beat eggs, then add sugar and vanilla; mixing well.
Stir in butter and flour.
Chill 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Beat eggs, then add sugar and vanilla; mixing well. Stir in butter and flour. Chill 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Garden Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
1 c. shredded cheese (1/2 Mozzarella and 1/2 Cheddar)
directions: Chop broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces.
Add carrots, bacon, onion and cheese.
In small bowl, mix Miracle Whip, sugar, vinegar and bacon drippings.
Pour over vegetables and stir to coat.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Creamy Garden Salad. Chop broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces. Add carrots, bacon, onion and cheese. In small bowl, mix Miracle Whip, sugar, vinegar and bacon drippings. Pour over vegetables and stir to coat. Refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Wieners In Sauce
directions: Mix and heat thoroughly until wieners swell.
recipes.text: Wieners In Sauce. Mix and heat thoroughly until wieners swell.

recipes.title: Hot Cider
directions: Mix water, cider, orange juice, lemonade and sugar together. Place spices in the coffee basket.
Pour the mixture into the coffeemaker and brew until done.
recipes.text: Hot Cider. Mix water, cider, orange juice, lemonade and sugar together. Place spices in the coffee basket. Pour the mixture into the coffeemaker and brew until done.

recipes.title: Caramel Frosting
directions: Mix butter and brown sugar.
Let bubble 2 minutes.
Stirring constantly.
Add 1/2 c. water and milk.
Bring to a boil.
Remove from heat, beat in sugar.
Add vanilla.
recipes.text: Caramel Frosting. Mix butter and brown sugar. Let bubble 2 minutes. Stirring constantly. Add 1/2 c. water and milk. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat, beat in sugar. Add vanilla.

recipes.title: Coffee Bars
directions: Mix sugar and eggs.
Beat well.
Mix in the rest of the ingredients and stir up.
Put in large cookie sheet (11 x 17 x 1-inch).
Line top with one 16 ounce package of chocolate morsels and one cup of chopped walnuts.
recipes.text: Coffee Bars. Mix sugar and eggs. Beat well. Mix in the rest of the ingredients and stir up. Put in large cookie sheet (11 x 17 x 1-inch). Line top with one 16 ounce package of chocolate morsels and one cup of chopped walnuts.

recipes.title: Crispy Marble Bars
directions: In 2 1/2-quart casserole dish, microwave on High corn syrup and sugar for 4 minutes, stirring twice.
Stir in peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies, stirring until coated well.
Add chocolate chips, stirring until they start to melt.
Press into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.
recipes.text: Crispy Marble Bars. In 2 1/2-quart casserole dish, microwave on High corn syrup and sugar for 4 minutes, stirring twice. Stir in peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies, stirring until coated well. Add chocolate chips, stirring until they start to melt. Press into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.

recipes.title: Boiled Dinner
directions: Cut meat into serving sized pieces, cover with water and bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer for 3 hours. Remove meat and keep warm.
Scrub the vegetables and cut into quarters or cubes. Cut the cabbage into 6 wedges.
Bring the broth to a boil.
Add carrots, turnips, onions and potatoes.
Cook for 15 minutes.
Add cabbage and cook for 15 to 20 minutes longer.
Arrange meat on serving platter and place vegetables around the meat in an attractive pattern.
Sprinkle well with fresh ground black pepper. Yield: 6 servings.
Carbohydrate 36 g, protein 38 g, fat 34 g, calories 606.
recipes.text: Boiled Dinner. Cut meat into serving sized pieces, cover with water and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 3 hours. Remove meat and keep warm. Scrub the vegetables and cut into quarters or cubes. Cut the cabbage into 6 wedges. Bring the broth to a boil. Add carrots, turnips, onions and potatoes. Cook for 15 minutes. Add cabbage and cook for 15 to 20 minutes longer. Arrange meat on serving platter and place vegetables around the meat in an attractive pattern. Sprinkle well with fresh ground black pepper. Yield: 6 servings. Carbohydrate 36 g, protein 38 g, fat 34 g, calories 606.

recipes.title: Spiced Wassail
directions: Heat in large pan for 10 minutes sugar, water, cloves and cinnamon.
Add apple cider, orange juice and lemon juice.
Heat 10 more minutes.
(I put this beverage on low in a crock-pot and keep it serving temperature.)
recipes.text: Spiced Wassail. Heat in large pan for 10 minutes sugar, water, cloves and cinnamon. Add apple cider, orange juice and lemon juice. Heat 10 more minutes. (I put this beverage on low in a crock-pot and keep it serving temperature.)

recipes.title: Christmas Aroma(Not For Consumption)
directions: Place all ingredients in a large kettle and bring to a boil for several minutes.
Turn down to a simmer and allow house to fill with a wonderful Christmas aroma.
Keep mixture for days, adding water and stirring as needed.
recipes.text: Christmas Aroma(Not For Consumption). Place all ingredients in a large kettle and bring to a boil for several minutes. Turn down to a simmer and allow house to fill with a wonderful Christmas aroma. Keep mixture for days, adding water and stirring as needed.

recipes.title: No Peeky Chicky
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
directions: Preheat oven to 275u00b0. Remove the skin from the chicken.
Place the chicken in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine soups, rice and water in a large mixing bowl. Mix well, then pour mixture over the chicken. Cover the pan with aluminum foil; bake for 2 hours. Do not peek until done.
recipes.text: No Peeky Chicky. Preheat oven to 275u00b0. Remove the skin from the chicken. Place the chicken in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine soups, rice and water in a large mixing bowl. Mix well, then pour mixture over the chicken. Cover the pan with aluminum foil; bake for 2 hours. Do not peek until done.

recipes.title: Decorators Icing
directions: Using mixer, mix Crisco, syrup, almond flavoring, salt and butter flavoring together.
Gradually add sifted powdered sugar and water to mixture and beat well.
recipes.text: Decorators Icing. Using mixer, mix Crisco, syrup, almond flavoring, salt and butter flavoring together. Gradually add sifted powdered sugar and water to mixture and beat well.

recipes.title: Ricotta Cheese Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.
Pour into ungreased 12 x 9-inch pan.
Mix together Ricotta cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Pour over batter in cake pan.
Do not mix! Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes.
Cut into squares and serve.
recipes.text: Ricotta Cheese Cake. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Pour into ungreased 12 x 9-inch pan. Mix together Ricotta cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla. Pour over batter in cake pan. Do not mix! Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 50 to 55 minutes. Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Anacuchos
ingredients: 2 to 3 fresh Serrano chilies (depends on how hot you like it)
pinch of ground cumin or tsp. crushed comino seed
oil for basting (recommend olive or peanut oil)
directions: Place all ingredients, except meat and basting oil in blender; process until well mixed.
Pour marinade over meat in a glass or ceramic bowl (not plastic).
Cover; refrigerate for 48 hours.
recipes.text: Anacuchos. Place all ingredients, except meat and basting oil in blender; process until well mixed. Pour marinade over meat in a glass or ceramic bowl (not plastic). Cover; refrigerate for 48 hours.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 large jar chunky picante sauce or salsa
directions: Brown ground beef and drain.
Add rice, taco seasoning and the amount of water called for on the seasoning packet.
Cook until liquid is absorbed.
Add picante sauce or salsa.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Brown ground beef and drain. Add rice, taco seasoning and the amount of water called for on the seasoning packet. Cook until liquid is absorbed. Add picante sauce or salsa. Mix well.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until partly tender.
Layer baking dish with broccoli and crackers.
Place cheese on top to melt, then pour milk over the casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 until cheese melts and milk thickens.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli until partly tender. Layer baking dish with broccoli and crackers. Place cheese on top to melt, then pour milk over the casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 until cheese melts and milk thickens.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Ring Roll(Christmas Coffee Cake)
directions: Let milk cool to lukewarm and add yeast.
Stir with plastic spoon until dissolved.
Cream shortening and 2 tablespoons sugar. Add eggs.
Add milk mixture, salt and flour.
Mix.
Let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk.
Punch down.
Pinch off pieces and roll in walnut size balls.
Dip in melted butter and roll in cinnamon and sugar mix.
Layer balls in a greased 10-inch tube pan.
Let rise about 1 hour.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Turn onto tray.
Decorate with maraschino cherries and pecan halves.
(May freeze and reheat at a later date.)
recipes.text: Cinnamon Ring Roll(Christmas Coffee Cake). Let milk cool to lukewarm and add yeast. Stir with plastic spoon until dissolved. Cream shortening and 2 tablespoons sugar. Add eggs. Add milk mixture, salt and flour. Mix. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk. Punch down. Pinch off pieces and roll in walnut size balls. Dip in melted butter and roll in cinnamon and sugar mix. Layer balls in a greased 10-inch tube pan. Let rise about 1 hour. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Turn onto tray. Decorate with maraschino cherries and pecan halves. (May freeze and reheat at a later date.)

recipes.title: Fudge Pie
directions: Melt butter in medium saucepan; remove from heat.
Add cocoa, sugar, eggs, flour, salt and vanilla.
Beat well.
Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Walnuts or pecans can be added, 1/2 cup chopped.
recipes.text: Fudge Pie. Melt butter in medium saucepan; remove from heat. Add cocoa, sugar, eggs, flour, salt and vanilla. Beat well. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Walnuts or pecans can be added, 1/2 cup chopped.

recipes.title: Mock Caesar Salad
directions: Put garlic, soy sauce and lemon juice in a salad bowl and whisk thoroughly.
Add endive and romaine; toss to coat.
Sprinkle with pepper and Parmesan cheese.
Garnish with chopped tomato.
recipes.text: Mock Caesar Salad. Put garlic, soy sauce and lemon juice in a salad bowl and whisk thoroughly. Add endive and romaine; toss to coat. Sprinkle with pepper and Parmesan cheese. Garnish with chopped tomato.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1/2 lb. beef boneless bottom round steak, cut into 2 pieces
directions: Pound meat to 1/4-inch thickness.
In paper or plastic bag, mix flour, salt and pepper.
Shake meat in bag until coated. Place meat in 2-quart square casserole.
Mix tomatoes, onion, dressing and rosemary; pour over meat.
Place green pepper rings on top of meat and cover.
Microwave at 50% (Medium) for 25 minutes.
Turn meat over; spoon sauce over meat and microwave, covered, at 50% (Medium) for 15 to 25 minutes or until meat is tender.
Let stand, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serves 2.
recipes.text: Swiss Steak. Pound meat to 1/4-inch thickness. In paper or plastic bag, mix flour, salt and pepper. Shake meat in bag until coated. Place meat in 2-quart square casserole. Mix tomatoes, onion, dressing and rosemary; pour over meat. Place green pepper rings on top of meat and cover. Microwave at 50% (Medium) for 25 minutes. Turn meat over; spoon sauce over meat and microwave, covered, at 50% (Medium) for 15 to 25 minutes or until meat is tender. Let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix together the margarine, 1 egg and cake mix.
Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with Pam.
recipes.text: Gooey Butter Cake. Mix together the margarine, 1 egg and cake mix. Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with Pam.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Combine Jell-O, cottage cheese and Cool Whip; fold in drained canned fruit.
(Refrigerate.)
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Combine Jell-O, cottage cheese and Cool Whip; fold in drained canned fruit. (Refrigerate.)

recipes.title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together, then add butter and rest of liquids.
Pour in pie shell and bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chess Pie. Mix all dry ingredients together, then add butter and rest of liquids. Pour in pie shell and bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Penuche Fudge
ingredients: 1/2 jar Marshmallow Fluff (7 1/2 oz. size jar)
directions: Put sugar, cream and butter into heavy saucepan and cook until it forms a soft ball when tried in cold water (or use candy thermometer and cook to soft ball stage, 236u00b0 to 238u00b0).
recipes.text: Penuche Fudge. Put sugar, cream and butter into heavy saucepan and cook until it forms a soft ball when tried in cold water (or use candy thermometer and cook to soft ball stage, 236u00b0 to 238u00b0).

recipes.title: Layered Potatoes
ingredients: 2 boxes or 1 sack frozen hash browns
1 c. onion, sauteed in 1/2 c. margarine
directions: Mix soup with onion and butter.
Layer hash browns and alternate with the rest of the ingredients.
Top with bread crumbs and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Uncover dish and brown the top.
recipes.text: Layered Potatoes. Mix soup with onion and butter. Layer hash browns and alternate with the rest of the ingredients. Top with bread crumbs and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Uncover dish and brown the top.

recipes.title: Cornflake Candy
directions: Bring the sugar and syrup to a boil.
Remove from heat; add the peanut butter.
Blend in cornflakes and mix well.
After all is mixed, drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.
Allow to cool.
recipes.text: Cornflake Candy. Bring the sugar and syrup to a boil. Remove from heat; add the peanut butter. Blend in cornflakes and mix well. After all is mixed, drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Allow to cool.

recipes.title: Soft Tea Cakes
directions: Cream together oleo and sugar.
Add remaining ingredients. Mix and drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 approximately 8 minutes.
Cool and store in tightly covered container.
recipes.text: Soft Tea Cakes. Cream together oleo and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 approximately 8 minutes. Cool and store in tightly covered container.

recipes.title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups chicken breast, cooked and chopped
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients.
Pour into baking dish.
Top with crushed Ritz crackers and oleo.
Cook 45 minutes at 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Chicken-Rice Casserole. Mix first 6 ingredients. Pour into baking dish. Top with crushed Ritz crackers and oleo. Cook 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Place rice in greased casserole dish.
Add chicken.
Sprinkle with dry onion soup.
Add condensed mushroom soup and water.
Bake 50 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. Place rice in greased casserole dish. Add chicken. Sprinkle with dry onion soup. Add condensed mushroom soup and water. Bake 50 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Rice Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together and cook in covered double boiler until thickened and rice is done (approximately 2 1/2 to 3 hours).
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Rice Pudding. Mix all ingredients together and cook in covered double boiler until thickened and rice is done (approximately 2 1/2 to 3 hours).

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake and let cool.
Crumble half of cake in bottom of clear punch bowl.
Mix pudding with 5 cups milk.
Layer half of pudding on top of crumbled cake.
Add a layer of 1 can pie filling, 1 can pineapple, 1 container Cool Whip and 1/2 cup nuts. Repeat until all ingredients are used.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Bake cake and let cool. Crumble half of cake in bottom of clear punch bowl. Mix pudding with 5 cups milk. Layer half of pudding on top of crumbled cake. Add a layer of 1 can pie filling, 1 can pineapple, 1 container Cool Whip and 1/2 cup nuts. Repeat until all ingredients are used.

recipes.title: Marinated Slaw
directions: Place grated cabbage in bowl; add grated bell pepper and onion.
Do not stir.
Place remaining ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Pour mixture over cabbage.
Don't stir.
Cover the bowl and place in refrigerator overnight.
Stir just before serving.
Will keep 2 weeks.
recipes.text: Marinated Slaw. Place grated cabbage in bowl; add grated bell pepper and onion. Do not stir. Place remaining ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour mixture over cabbage. Don't stir. Cover the bowl and place in refrigerator overnight. Stir just before serving. Will keep 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Crawfish Etouffee(Serves 6)
ingredients: 1/2 c. each: chopped green onions and celery
1 (6 oz.) can spicy hot V-8 juice
directions: Saute vegetables in oleo.
Add tails and saute for 5 minutes. Add soup and V-8 juice.
Season to taste with Tabasco, pepper and salt or Tony Chachere seasoning).
Cook for 20 minutes on low. Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Crawfish Etouffee(Serves 6). Saute vegetables in oleo. Add tails and saute for 5 minutes. Add soup and V-8 juice. Season to taste with Tabasco, pepper and salt or Tony Chachere seasoning). Cook for 20 minutes on low. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Hamburger Pie
ingredients: 28 to 32 oz. bag frozen vegetables (corn, green beans, peas and carrots)
directions: Brown ground beef in oil.
Add tomato sauce and vegetables. Bring to a boil.
Then lower to simmer.
Cook 10 to 15 minutes. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch square pan.
Place biscuits on top.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 minutes or until biscuits are browned.
recipes.text: Hamburger Pie. Brown ground beef in oil. Add tomato sauce and vegetables. Bring to a boil. Then lower to simmer. Cook 10 to 15 minutes. Pour into a 9 x 9-inch square pan. Place biscuits on top. Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 minutes or until biscuits are browned.

recipes.title: Granny Horton'S Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix molasses, margarine, sugar and egg.
Beat well.
Combine spices, soda and flour, then add to molasses mixture.
Mix. Chill.
Roll in 1-inch balls and roll in sugar.
Place on greased cookie sheet two inches apart.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Granny Horton'S Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies. Mix molasses, margarine, sugar and egg. Beat well. Combine spices, soda and flour, then add to molasses mixture. Mix. Chill. Roll in 1-inch balls and roll in sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet two inches apart. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Glazed Ginger Pork
directions: To prepare the marinade, combine soy sauce, wine, honey, ginger and garlic, mix well.
Place roast in marinade, cover and let stand for about 8 hours, turning occasionally.
When ready to cook remove roast from the marinade, place on a rack in a shallow baking pan.
Reserve 8 Tbsp of marinade for glaze, and the rest use for basting.
Bake at 300u00b0F for about 2 1/2 hours or until done, basting several times.
Meat is ready when you insert a meat thermometer and it reads 175u00b0.
For making the glaze combine 8 Tbsp marinade with currant jelly in a small saucepan.
Boil it over medium heat, for about 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Set aside to cool.
After roast is cooked, spoon glaze over meat until completely coated.
Let cool.
Serve over mashed potatoes.
recipes.text: Glazed Ginger Pork. To prepare the marinade, combine soy sauce, wine, honey, ginger and garlic, mix well. Place roast in marinade, cover and let stand for about 8 hours, turning occasionally. When ready to cook remove roast from the marinade, place on a rack in a shallow baking pan. Reserve 8 Tbsp of marinade for glaze, and the rest use for basting. Bake at 300u00b0F for about 2 1/2 hours or until done, basting several times. Meat is ready when you insert a meat thermometer and it reads 175u00b0. For making the glaze combine 8 Tbsp marinade with currant jelly in a small saucepan. Boil it over medium heat, for about 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Set aside to cool. After roast is cooked, spoon glaze over meat until completely coated. Let cool. Serve over mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Salad Seasoning Blend
directions: Combine together and spoon into shaker or tightly covered container.
Makes 1 cup.
Sprinkle over salad greens, sliced tomatoes, cold vegetables or cottage cheese.
recipes.text: Salad Seasoning Blend. Combine together and spoon into shaker or tightly covered container. Makes 1 cup. Sprinkle over salad greens, sliced tomatoes, cold vegetables or cottage cheese.

recipes.title: Cake That Won'T Last
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice
directions: Beat eggs well with fork.
Add remaining ingredients using fork or hand mixer.
Do not use electric mixer.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 300u00b0 until center is firm.
recipes.text: Cake That Won'T Last. Beat eggs well with fork. Add remaining ingredients using fork or hand mixer. Do not use electric mixer. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 300u00b0 until center is firm.

recipes.title: Microwave Tea
directions: Heat water in microwave for 7 minutes on High (small Tupperware pitcher works well).
Place tea bags in water to steep. Remove bags; add sugar to taste.
recipes.text: Microwave Tea. Heat water in microwave for 7 minutes on High (small Tupperware pitcher works well). Place tea bags in water to steep. Remove bags; add sugar to taste.

recipes.title: Best Ever Banana Pudding
directions: Combine all ingredients in pan; cook until thick.
Pour over cookies and bananas.
recipes.text: Best Ever Banana Pudding. Combine all ingredients in pan; cook until thick. Pour over cookies and bananas.

recipes.title: Salmon Party Log
directions: Drain and flake salmon, remove skin
and bones.
Combine salmon with remaining ingredients (except
nuts
and
parsley). Mix thoroughly.
Chill several hours.
Shape into
ball or log. Combine nuts and parsley and cover salmon
shape.
Chill
well. Serve with crackers or small rye rounds.
recipes.text: Salmon Party Log. Drain and flake salmon, remove skin and bones. Combine salmon with remaining ingredients (except nuts and parsley). Mix thoroughly. Chill several hours. Shape into ball or log. Combine nuts and parsley and cover salmon shape. Chill well. Serve with crackers or small rye rounds.

recipes.title: Pink Pineapple Salad
directions: Sprinkle Jell-O over pineapple and juice. Heat until dissolved. Cool. Combine Cool Whip and milk. Mix thoroughly and add to Jell-O-pineapple mixture. Add nuts, if desired.
recipes.text: Pink Pineapple Salad. Sprinkle Jell-O over pineapple and juice. Heat until dissolved. Cool. Combine Cool Whip and milk. Mix thoroughly and add to Jell-O-pineapple mixture. Add nuts, if desired.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
directions: Mix all ingredients well and serve, preferably with dip style Fritos.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix all ingredients well and serve, preferably with dip style Fritos.

recipes.title: Frosted Date Balls
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add milk, vanilla, flour and salt. Blend in dates and nuts.
Roll in 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Roll in additional confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Frosted Date Balls. Cream butter and sugar. Add milk, vanilla, flour and salt. Blend in dates and nuts. Roll in 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Roll in additional confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Sombrero Spread
directions: Brown meat and 1/2 cup onion in skillet. Stir in catsup, Tabasco sauce, chili powder and salt.
Mash in beans. Heat through.
Garnish with the cheese around the edge, onions next and olives in the center.
Serve hot from
a chafing dish with corn chips.
recipes.text: Sombrero Spread. Brown meat and 1/2 cup onion in skillet. Stir in catsup, Tabasco sauce, chili powder and salt. Mash in beans. Heat through. Garnish with the cheese around the edge, onions next and olives in the center. Serve hot from a chafing dish with corn chips.

recipes.title: 24 Hour Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in glass bowl and store in fridge for 24 hours.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 2 hours at 225u00b0.
Serve with sauce.
recipes.text: 24 Hour Casserole. Mix all ingredients in glass bowl and store in fridge for 24 hours. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 2 hours at 225u00b0. Serve with sauce.

recipes.title: Vegetable Rice Soup
ingredients: 4 (13 3/4 oz.) cans College Inn chicken broth
directions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, heat all ingredients to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer for 25 minutes, or until rice is done.
recipes.text: Vegetable Rice Soup. In a large saucepan over medium heat, heat all ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer for 25 minutes, or until rice is done.

recipes.title: Cracker Jacks
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, molasses and margarine in saucepan. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add soda. Pour mixture over popcorn and peanuts. Mix well. Bake at 250u00b0 for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Cracker Jacks. Combine sugar, syrup, molasses and margarine in saucepan. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add soda. Pour mixture over popcorn and peanuts. Mix well. Bake at 250u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Fruit And Cabbage Salad
directions: Place oranges, apples, cabbage and grapes in bowl. Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff. Fold whipped cream, sugar, lemon juice and salt into mayonnaise. Stir into fruit mixture.
recipes.text: Fruit And Cabbage Salad. Place oranges, apples, cabbage and grapes in bowl. Beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff. Fold whipped cream, sugar, lemon juice and salt into mayonnaise. Stir into fruit mixture.

recipes.title: Peach Custard Pie
ingredients: 4 or 5 fresh large peaches, peeled, halved and pitted
directions: Place
peaches,
roundtside
up, in pie shell. Mix the sugar, butter
and eggs.tPour this mixture over the peaches. Sprinkle with
cinnamon
and
nuts.tBake 15 minutes in a hot oven of 425u00b0. Reduce the heat to 325u00b0 and continue baking for another 45 minutes until the custard is done.
recipes.text: Peach Custard Pie. Place peaches, roundtside up, in pie shell. Mix the sugar, butter and eggs.tPour this mixture over the peaches. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nuts.tBake 15 minutes in a hot oven of 425u00b0. Reduce the heat to 325u00b0 and continue baking for another 45 minutes until the custard is done.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Cake
ingredients: 3 c. chopped and peeled Granny Smith apples
directions: Beat eggs and add sugar. Bake in tube pan at 350u00b0 (do not preheat) for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Cake. Beat eggs and add sugar. Bake in tube pan at 350u00b0 (do not preheat) for 1 hour.

recipes.title: To The Moon Chili
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. red hot cayenne pepper sauce
directions: In a Dutch oven, brown ground beef; drain.
Stir in seasoning mix, water, tomatoes, beans and red hot sauce.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped red pepper, green onion and cheese, if desired.
recipes.text: To The Moon Chili. In a Dutch oven, brown ground beef; drain. Stir in seasoning mix, water, tomatoes, beans and red hot sauce. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, 10 minutes. Garnish with chopped red pepper, green onion and cheese, if desired.

recipes.title: Les Grives A La Broche(Spit Roasted Thrushes)
directions: Six hours before cooking is to begin, pluck, singe, lard and truss the thrushes.
They should not be drawn. Put the birds into a deep dish just big enough to hold them in one layer.
Cover with the white wine, juniper berries, sliced onion, garlic cut in half, thyme and cayenne pepper.

Leave to marinate for 6 hours at room temperature, turning the birds every hour. Toast 6 slices of bread lightly and arrange in a dripping pan so they will catch the cooking juices of the thrushes. Dab the thrushes dry with the kitchen paper.
Smear with olive oil.
Put them on a skewer and grill for 10 to 15 minutes, ideally in front of a blaze of vine branches.
Scoop out the insides of each bird and spread on the pieces of toast.
Put the thrushes on top and serve.
recipes.text: Les Grives A La Broche(Spit Roasted Thrushes). Six hours before cooking is to begin, pluck, singe, lard and truss the thrushes. They should not be drawn. Put the birds into a deep dish just big enough to hold them in one layer. Cover with the white wine, juniper berries, sliced onion, garlic cut in half, thyme and cayenne pepper. Leave to marinate for 6 hours at room temperature, turning the birds every hour. Toast 6 slices of bread lightly and arrange in a dripping pan so they will catch the cooking juices of the thrushes. Dab the thrushes dry with the kitchen paper. Smear with olive oil. Put them on a skewer and grill for 10 to 15 minutes, ideally in front of a blaze of vine branches. Scoop out the insides of each bird and spread on the pieces of toast. Put the thrushes on top and serve.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Pie
directions: Crush crackers; add melted margarine and press to bottom of pie pan.
Saute onions and put over crust.
Mix milk, eggs, salt and pepper and pour over onions.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Vidalia Onion Pie. Crush crackers; add melted margarine and press to bottom of pie pan. Saute onions and put over crust. Mix milk, eggs, salt and pepper and pour over onions. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Company French Toast
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan; add sugar and cinnamon. Place 12 slices of bread in a pan (2 slices deep).
Beat eggs and milk.
Pour over bread.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Company French Toast. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan; add sugar and cinnamon. Place 12 slices of bread in a pan (2 slices deep). Beat eggs and milk. Pour over bread. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Baked Garlic For 4
directions: Peel loose skins off garlic bunch, slice top to a flat surface. Drizzle with olive oil; mound basil paste onto bunch.
Place on baking sheet, in 400u00b0 oven for approximately 40 minutes or until soft, with fork.
recipes.text: Baked Garlic For 4. Peel loose skins off garlic bunch, slice top to a flat surface. Drizzle with olive oil; mound basil paste onto bunch. Place on baking sheet, in 400u00b0 oven for approximately 40 minutes or until soft, with fork.

recipes.title: Taco-Filled Peppers
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
directions: In a large skillet, brown ground beef; drain.
Stir in the taco seasoning, kidney beans and salsa; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Taco-Filled Peppers. In a large skillet, brown ground beef; drain. Stir in the taco seasoning, kidney beans and salsa; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Raisin Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Raisin Pecan Pie. Mix all ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Russian Tea Cakes
directions: Mix butter, sugar and vanilla thoroughly.
Sift together flour and salt; stir in.
Mix in nuts.
Chill dough.
Heat oven to 400u00b0. Roll dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased baking sheet (cookies do not spread).
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not brown.
While still warm, roll in confectioners sugar.
Cool. Roll in sugar again.
Makes about 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Russian Tea Cakes. Mix butter, sugar and vanilla thoroughly. Sift together flour and salt; stir in. Mix in nuts. Chill dough. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet (cookies do not spread). Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not brown. While still warm, roll in confectioners sugar. Cool. Roll in sugar again. Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: 12 Hour Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb. sliced bacon, cooked and crumbled
directions: Place salad greens in the bottom of a 3-quart bowl or 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Top with layers of celery, green peppers, onion and peas.
Do not toss.
Combine salad dressing, sour cream and sugar; spread over salad.
Sprinkle with cheese and bacon; cover and refrigerate overnight.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: 12 Hour Salad. Place salad greens in the bottom of a 3-quart bowl or 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Top with layers of celery, green peppers, onion and peas. Do not toss. Combine salad dressing, sour cream and sugar; spread over salad. Sprinkle with cheese and bacon; cover and refrigerate overnight. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Choctaw Chuck
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0. Saute beef and onions; drain. Crunch Doritos; cover bottom of casserole dish about 1-inch. Layer beef, beans, mushroom/milk mixed, Ro-Tel, olives and cheese. Bake until bubbly, approximately 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Choctaw Chuck. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Saute beef and onions; drain. Crunch Doritos; cover bottom of casserole dish about 1-inch. Layer beef, beans, mushroom/milk mixed, Ro-Tel, olives and cheese. Bake until bubbly, approximately 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Delights
directions: In large saucepan, combine first four ingredients.
Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved.
Gradually add milk and stir well.
Continue cooking until candy thermometer reads 248u00b0 (firm ball stage).
Remove from heat; stir in vanilla.
Fold in pecans. Drop by tablespoon on well buttered cookie sheet.
Chill until firm.
Melt chocolate chips and shortening in a microwave-safe bowl or double boiler.
Dip each cluster.
Cool.
Makes about 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Pecan Delights. In large saucepan, combine first four ingredients. Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved. Gradually add milk and stir well. Continue cooking until candy thermometer reads 248u00b0 (firm ball stage). Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Fold in pecans. Drop by tablespoon on well buttered cookie sheet. Chill until firm. Melt chocolate chips and shortening in a microwave-safe bowl or double boiler. Dip each cluster. Cool. Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Fancy Fruit And Dip
ingredients: 1 smallest size can frozen orange juice
directions: To make the fruit dip:
Mix in a bowl the sour cream, frozen orange juice, milk (use orange juice container to measure milk amount) and vanilla pudding mix.
Blend until firm and smooth.
recipes.text: Fancy Fruit And Dip. To make the fruit dip: Mix in a bowl the sour cream, frozen orange juice, milk (use orange juice container to measure milk amount) and vanilla pudding mix. Blend until firm and smooth.

recipes.title: Beer Fish Batter
directions: Combine all ingredients.
If batter is too thick, use water to thin.
Dip fish in batter and deep fry in hot oil.
Delicious with all vegetables:
broccoli, peppers, parsley, mushrooms, onions, etc.
recipes.text: Beer Fish Batter. Combine all ingredients. If batter is too thick, use water to thin. Dip fish in batter and deep fry in hot oil. Delicious with all vegetables: broccoli, peppers, parsley, mushrooms, onions, etc.

recipes.title: New Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes until fork-tender; drain.
Cut in bite size pieces; do not peel.
recipes.text: New Potato Salad. Cook potatoes until fork-tender; drain. Cut in bite size pieces; do not peel.

recipes.title: Casey'S Chicken Dried Beef Casserole
ingredients: 6 boneless chicken breasts, cut in 1-inch strips
uncooked bacon to wrap around each piece of chicken
directions: Line Pyrex baking dish with slices of dried beef.
Wrap each piece of chicken in a strip of bacon and place on top of the dried beef.
Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken.
Cover tightly and bake at 350u00b0 for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Casey'S Chicken Dried Beef Casserole. Line Pyrex baking dish with slices of dried beef. Wrap each piece of chicken in a strip of bacon and place on top of the dried beef. Mix soup and sour cream; pour over chicken. Cover tightly and bake at 350u00b0 for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Cranberry Raisin Pie
directions: Mix sugar, water, flour and then raisins.
Beat smooth and stir in remaining ingredients.
Put into an unbaked pie shell and cover with a lattice top.
Bake in a 425u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350u00b0 and bake 30 to 40 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Cranberry Raisin Pie. Mix sugar, water, flour and then raisins. Beat smooth and stir in remaining ingredients. Put into an unbaked pie shell and cover with a lattice top. Bake in a 425u00b0 oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350u00b0 and bake 30 to 40 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Beans
directions: Brown and drain sausage.
Crumble.
Add all other ingredients. Place in crock-pot on low 10 to 12 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Beans. Brown and drain sausage. Crumble. Add all other ingredients. Place in crock-pot on low 10 to 12 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas and carrots, cooked and drained
directions: Cook onion in butter until tender.
Blend in flour and salt. Add broth all at once.
Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
Add remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Chicken Pie. Cook onion in butter until tender. Blend in flour and salt. Add broth all at once. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Add remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Margaret'S Homemade Beef Stew
directions: Season your meat with the salt, pepper and garlic salt.
Add water to a 1-quart pan.
Add seasoned meat.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 3 hours.
After 3 hours, add raw vegetables and bring to a boil until tender.
Add green beans, corn, peas, etc., about 10 minutes before finished.
recipes.text: Margaret'S Homemade Beef Stew. Season your meat with the salt, pepper and garlic salt. Add water to a 1-quart pan. Add seasoned meat. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 3 hours. After 3 hours, add raw vegetables and bring to a boil until tender. Add green beans, corn, peas, etc., about 10 minutes before finished.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Cream together the first 4 ingredients.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Chill.
Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Cream together the first 4 ingredients. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf With Almonds
directions: Saute onion in margarine for about 5 minutes.
Add rice; saute 3 minutes.
Add broth, salt and raisins and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 5 minutes.
Stir in almonds and parsley; fluff with fork.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Rice Pilaf With Almonds. Saute onion in margarine for about 5 minutes. Add rice; saute 3 minutes. Add broth, salt and raisins and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in almonds and parsley; fluff with fork. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Spice Tea
directions: Boil tea bags, cinnamon sticks, whole cloves and water for 30 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients to pitcher and fill with water. Makes a gallon.
recipes.text: Spice Tea. Boil tea bags, cinnamon sticks, whole cloves and water for 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients to pitcher and fill with water. Makes a gallon.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown the ground beef.
Drain well.
Add taco seasoning to meat.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Chop lettuce, tomato and onion. Put in separate container as well as grated cheese.
Put all ingredients on table and create your own salad with the Fritos and meat.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Brown the ground beef. Drain well. Add taco seasoning to meat. Simmer for 15 minutes. Chop lettuce, tomato and onion. Put in separate container as well as grated cheese. Put all ingredients on table and create your own salad with the Fritos and meat.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 c. cooked rice or whole kernel corn
directions: Brown meat and onion until almost dry.
Add tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce and salt.
Simmer until hot (about 5 minutes).
Add cheese; stir until melted.
Stir in rice.
Stuff peppers; sprinkle tops with bread crumbs.
Fill baking dish with 1/2 inch water.
Place peppers in dish; bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes, or until hot through.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Brown meat and onion until almost dry. Add tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce and salt. Simmer until hot (about 5 minutes). Add cheese; stir until melted. Stir in rice. Stuff peppers; sprinkle tops with bread crumbs. Fill baking dish with 1/2 inch water. Place peppers in dish; bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes, or until hot through. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients and place in airtight storage container. Add 2 teaspoons of mix to 1 cup hot water for tea.
(May substitute 5 packages Sweet 'N Low for sugar.)
recipes.text: Russian Tea. Mix all ingredients and place in airtight storage container. Add 2 teaspoons of mix to 1 cup hot water for tea. (May substitute 5 packages Sweet 'N Low for sugar.)

recipes.title: French Breakfast Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease 15 muffin cups.
Mix thoroughly shortening, 1/2 cup sugar and egg.
Stir in flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
Alternate with milk.
Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: French Breakfast Muffins. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Grease 15 muffin cups. Mix thoroughly shortening, 1/2 cup sugar and egg. Stir in flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg. Alternate with milk. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Frilly Dilly'S
directions: Cut hot dogs into small pieces.
Mix with mustard and grape jelly.
Simmer for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Frilly Dilly'S. Cut hot dogs into small pieces. Mix with mustard and grape jelly. Simmer for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Cucumber Dip
directions: Shred and grate a cucumber (pour off the water).
Add 2 squirts of Worcestershire sauce.
Mix rest of the ingredients in the bowl and chill.
recipes.text: Cucumber Dip. Shred and grate a cucumber (pour off the water). Add 2 squirts of Worcestershire sauce. Mix rest of the ingredients in the bowl and chill.

recipes.title: I-45 Cake
directions: Combine butter, 1 egg and cake mix; spread in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: I-45 Cake. Combine butter, 1 egg and cake mix; spread in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Pineapple Lime Salad
ingredients: 1 envelope lime flavored artificially sweetened gelatin
directions: Dissolve the gelatin in hot water.
When it begins to set, add the fruit, celery and pimentos which have been marinated in the vinegar and salt.
Put into two individual molds and let stand until set.
Unmold and serve on crisp lettuce leaf.
Yield:
2 servings.
Carbohydrate 5 g, protein 0 g, fat 0 g, calories 20. One serving = 1/2 fruit exchange.
recipes.text: Pineapple Lime Salad. Dissolve the gelatin in hot water. When it begins to set, add the fruit, celery and pimentos which have been marinated in the vinegar and salt. Put into two individual molds and let stand until set. Unmold and serve on crisp lettuce leaf. Yield: 2 servings. Carbohydrate 5 g, protein 0 g, fat 0 g, calories 20. One serving = 1/2 fruit exchange.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix beans, onion, mustard, ketchup and brown sugar in a pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Mix beans, onion, mustard, ketchup and brown sugar in a pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Harvest Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 c. light cream, scalded until hot
directions: Combine apple butter, pumpkin, brown sugar, salt and spices; add eggs and beat well.
Gradually add cream and mix thoroughly. Pour into an unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 375u00b0 and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Harvest Pumpkin Pie. Combine apple butter, pumpkin, brown sugar, salt and spices; add eggs and beat well. Gradually add cream and mix thoroughly. Pour into an unbaked pie crust. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 375u00b0 and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Cream
the
margarine, sugar and vanilla together.
Add flour and
mix
thoroughly.
Addtchips
and
nuts; mix again. Drop by teaspoon
on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15tminutes, until they are a soft honey color.
It is important not to overbake.
recipes.text: Potato Chip Cookies. Cream the margarine, sugar and vanilla together. Add flour and mix thoroughly. Addtchips and nuts; mix again. Drop by teaspoon on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15tminutes, until they are a soft honey color. It is important not to overbake.

recipes.title: Honey Baked Chicken
directions: Place chicken in a single layer, skin side up in a shallow roasting pan.
Mix all remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Honey Baked Chicken. Place chicken in a single layer, skin side up in a shallow roasting pan. Mix all remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Mix rice and butter; let melt, then mix all of the above.
Mix well; top with nutmeg.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Mix rice and butter; let melt, then mix all of the above. Mix well; top with nutmeg. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. ground veal, beef or pork
directions: Heat oil in skillet; add onion and green pepper.
Cook until wilted.
Add meat and, using edge of a heavy kitchen spoon, stir and chop meat to break up any lumps.
Sprinkle meat with garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano.
Stir to blend.
Add bay leaf, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and crushed hot pepper.
Bring to boil and cook for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Chili. Heat oil in skillet; add onion and green pepper. Cook until wilted. Add meat and, using edge of a heavy kitchen spoon, stir and chop meat to break up any lumps. Sprinkle meat with garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano. Stir to blend. Add bay leaf, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and crushed hot pepper. Bring to boil and cook for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Caramel Bars(Microwave)
ingredients: 2 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (12 oz. bag)
directions: Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.
Combine chocolate chips and Crisco in a large bowl.
Microwave on High for 1 minute.
Stir vigorously. Make sure all chips are melted.
Pour cereal into melted chip mixture.
Stir until thoroughly coated.
recipes.text: No-Bake Chocolate Caramel Bars(Microwave). Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine chocolate chips and Crisco in a large bowl. Microwave on High for 1 minute. Stir vigorously. Make sure all chips are melted. Pour cereal into melted chip mixture. Stir until thoroughly coated.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies With Onions
directions: Combine dry ingredients, onion and egg.
Add boiling water, stirring constantly until mixture is smooth.
Add more water if necessary.
Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil.
Cook until golden brown.
Drain on paper towel.
Makes 10 servings.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies With Onions. Combine dry ingredients, onion and egg. Add boiling water, stirring constantly until mixture is smooth. Add more water if necessary. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil. Cook until golden brown. Drain on paper towel. Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Stuffed Eggplant Rolls
directions: Skin eggplant and cut lengthwise slices about 1/8-inch thick. Dip slices in egg batter and then in bread crumbs.
Fry and cool slices in refrigerator for a couple of hours.
Place a slice of Prosciutto on each slice of eggplant.
Chop hard-boiled eggs.
Mix in grated cheese and place on top of Prosciutto.
Add grated Mozzarella on top of this, then roll each slice and secure with toothpick.
Place in baking dish.
Pour sauce and Mozzarella on top. Bake until cheese is all melted at 350u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Eggplant Rolls. Skin eggplant and cut lengthwise slices about 1/8-inch thick. Dip slices in egg batter and then in bread crumbs. Fry and cool slices in refrigerator for a couple of hours. Place a slice of Prosciutto on each slice of eggplant. Chop hard-boiled eggs. Mix in grated cheese and place on top of Prosciutto. Add grated Mozzarella on top of this, then roll each slice and secure with toothpick. Place in baking dish. Pour sauce and Mozzarella on top. Bake until cheese is all melted at 350u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Asparagus Soup
directions: Saute onion in butter.
Add asparagus and paprika; cook until asparagus turns bright green.
Stir in chicken broth and cream. Heat to boiling.
Combine cornstarch and water; stir into soup. Cook until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Fresh Asparagus Soup. Saute onion in butter. Add asparagus and paprika; cook until asparagus turns bright green. Stir in chicken broth and cream. Heat to boiling. Combine cornstarch and water; stir into soup. Cook until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Pie Crust (Single)
directions: Mix flour, salt and Crisco until crumbly.
Add water and mix into ball.
Roll and line pie plate.
May double for 2 crust pie. Easy enough for a child to make.
recipes.text: Pie Crust (Single). Mix flour, salt and Crisco until crumbly. Add water and mix into ball. Roll and line pie plate. May double for 2 crust pie. Easy enough for a child to make.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Microwave Directions:
In a shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole, cook potatoes in 2 tablespoons of water, covered, on High for 11 to 13 minutes until tender.
Turn potatoes halfway through cooking.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Microwave Directions: In a shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole, cook potatoes in 2 tablespoons of water, covered, on High for 11 to 13 minutes until tender. Turn potatoes halfway through cooking.

recipes.title: Company Chicken
ingredients: Heinz chicken gravy or 1 can cream of chicken soup
directions: Place boneless chicken breasts in casserole (size of pan depends on how much you want to make).
Place 1/2 slice Swiss cheese on each breast.
Prepare Stove Top stuffing according to directions.
Place at least 2 tablespoons on each breast.
Mix jar of gravy or soup with white wine and pour over the chicken and stuffing.
Bake 1 1/4 hours or until done in a 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Company Chicken. Place boneless chicken breasts in casserole (size of pan depends on how much you want to make). Place 1/2 slice Swiss cheese on each breast. Prepare Stove Top stuffing according to directions. Place at least 2 tablespoons on each breast. Mix jar of gravy or soup with white wine and pour over the chicken and stuffing. Bake 1 1/4 hours or until done in a 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Mexican Or Chinese Supreme(You Choose!)
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef OR 4-6 boneless chicken breasts
directions: Measurements for this recipe depend on taste and the number of people to be served.
recipes.text: Mexican Or Chinese Supreme(You Choose!). Measurements for this recipe depend on taste and the number of people to be served.

recipes.title: Freezer Cole Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage; mix with salt and let stand 1 hour.
Add carrot and green pepper.
Combine vinegar, water, sugar, mustard seed and celery seed; boil 1 minute.
Cool to lukewarm; pour over slaw. Put into containers and freeze.
Slaw will thaw in a short time. Can be refrozen.
recipes.text: Freezer Cole Slaw. Shred cabbage; mix with salt and let stand 1 hour. Add carrot and green pepper. Combine vinegar, water, sugar, mustard seed and celery seed; boil 1 minute. Cool to lukewarm; pour over slaw. Put into containers and freeze. Slaw will thaw in a short time. Can be refrozen.

recipes.title: Raisin Pumpkin Crisps
directions: Rinse and drain raisins.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add unbeaten egg and beat well.
Stir in pumpkin.
Sift together flour, salt, soda and spices and add to creamed mixture.
Stir in vanilla, raisins and nuts.
Drop by small spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Raisin Pumpkin Crisps. Rinse and drain raisins. Cream butter and sugar. Add unbeaten egg and beat well. Stir in pumpkin. Sift together flour, salt, soda and spices and add to creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla, raisins and nuts. Drop by small spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, boiled and cubed small
directions: Scald 2 cups milk.
Add potatoes; beat well.
Add seasonings; blend butter and flour.
Add egg and remaining milk.
Drop from teaspoon into hot soup.
Cover pan and cook for about 10 minutes. Serves 2.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Scald 2 cups milk. Add potatoes; beat well. Add seasonings; blend butter and flour. Add egg and remaining milk. Drop from teaspoon into hot soup. Cover pan and cook for about 10 minutes. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Wafer Cake
ingredients: 1 small pkg. vanilla wafers (approximately 2 1/2 c. crushed)
directions: Crush wafers and set aside.
Mix remaining ingredients well. Add wafers.
Cook at 350u00b0 in a loaf or layer pan.
recipes.text: Wafer Cake. Crush wafers and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients well. Add wafers. Cook at 350u00b0 in a loaf or layer pan.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Rhubarb Crumble(Low-Fat, Low-Salt, Low-Sugar, High Fiber)
ingredients: 1/4 c. sugar plus 2 packets bakeable sugar substitute
directions: Place rhubarb in sprayed baking dish.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Add water.
Sprinkle with topping.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Rhubarb Crumble(Low-Fat, Low-Salt, Low-Sugar, High Fiber). Place rhubarb in sprayed baking dish. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Add water. Sprinkle with topping. Bake at 325u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Delight
directions: Brown beef, onion and garlic in a large skillet.
Remove excess fat, add corn, olives, mushrooms and tomato sauce; simmer for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Italian Delight. Brown beef, onion and garlic in a large skillet. Remove excess fat, add corn, olives, mushrooms and tomato sauce; simmer for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Salsa Sauce
directions: Combine ingredients, bring to boil for 30 minutes in open kettle.
Simmer 20 minutes. Put in jars and process for 20 minutes in boiling water.
recipes.text: Salsa Sauce. Combine ingredients, bring to boil for 30 minutes in open kettle. Simmer 20 minutes. Put in jars and process for 20 minutes in boiling water.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
