directions: Cream margarine; add sugar and beat until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add vanilla wafers which have been crushed, alternately with milk.
Add coconut and pecans.
Pour into a greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Vanilla Wafer Cake. Cream margarine; add sugar and beat until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add vanilla wafers which have been crushed, alternately with milk. Add coconut and pecans. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 275u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: No-Fail Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. lemon extract (or any flavor you prefer)
directions: Cream in mixer, sugar and butter slowly until mixed; beat at high speed 4 to 5 minutes.
Add eggs and beat well. Add salt, flour and lemon flavoring. Beat until well mixed, beat at high speed for 5 to 10 minutes.
Place in cold oven.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325u00b0 or until golden brown.
recipes.text: No-Fail Pound Cake. Cream in mixer, sugar and butter slowly until mixed; beat at high speed 4 to 5 minutes. Add eggs and beat well. Add salt, flour and lemon flavoring. Beat until well mixed, beat at high speed for 5 to 10 minutes. Place in cold oven. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325u00b0 or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix
pudding,
milk,
sour cream, Cool Whip and vanilla until smooth.
Layer
this
with a box of vanilla wafers and 8 bananas. Yields 10 servings.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Mix pudding, milk, sour cream, Cool Whip and vanilla until smooth. Layer this with a box of vanilla wafers and 8 bananas. Yields 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cream Of Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 cans Campbell's cream of chicken soup
directions: Mix soup, chiles, sour cream and cheese, stirring over medium heat.
Cook tortillas and dip into mixture.
Put 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken into each tortilla and roll each one.
Pour rest of mixture over enchiladas.
Sprinkle the cheese over top and put in oven 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 2 to 6.
recipes.text: Cream Of Chicken Enchiladas. Mix soup, chiles, sour cream and cheese, stirring over medium heat. Cook tortillas and dip into mixture. Put 1 1/2 tablespoons chicken into each tortilla and roll each one. Pour rest of mixture over enchiladas. Sprinkle the cheese over top and put in oven 15 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 2 to 6.

recipes.title: Apricot Bread
directions: Cover apricots with warm water and soak 30 minutes.
Drain and cut into 1/4-inch pieces.
Blend sugar, butter and egg.
Add water and orange juice.
Sift dry ingredients together and add to liquids.
Beat until smooth.
Add apricots and nuts.
Blend thoroughly.
Pour into greased loaf pan which has been lined with wax paper.
Let mixture stand for 20 minutes.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 55 to 65 minutes.
Cool and remove from pan.
This recipe doubles easily to make 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Apricot Bread. Cover apricots with warm water and soak 30 minutes. Drain and cut into 1/4-inch pieces. Blend sugar, butter and egg. Add water and orange juice. Sift dry ingredients together and add to liquids. Beat until smooth. Add apricots and nuts. Blend thoroughly. Pour into greased loaf pan which has been lined with wax paper. Let mixture stand for 20 minutes. Bake at 350u00b0 for 55 to 65 minutes. Cool and remove from pan. This recipe doubles easily to make 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Taffy Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
directions: Mix pineapple with marshmallows; set aside.
Blend together flour, vinegar, egg, sugar and juice.
Cook over medium heat until thickened; cool.
Core and chop apples; add to pineapple and marshmallows.
Add sauce and nuts.
Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate for several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Taffy Apple Salad. Mix pineapple with marshmallows; set aside. Blend together flour, vinegar, egg, sugar and juice. Cook over medium heat until thickened; cool. Core and chop apples; add to pineapple and marshmallows. Add sauce and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate for several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dip mix
1 c. each chopped broccoli and carrots
directions: Unroll rolls; press together on baking sheet and bake.
Let cool.
Mix cream cheese, mayo and dip mix together.
Spread on cooled crust (may not need entire mix).
Sprinkle broccoli, carrots, cauliflower and cheeses over mix.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Unroll rolls; press together on baking sheet and bake. Let cool. Mix cream cheese, mayo and dip mix together. Spread on cooled crust (may not need entire mix). Sprinkle broccoli, carrots, cauliflower and cheeses over mix. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in blender for 30 seconds on blend. Sift last 3 ingredients together.
Combine both solutions and mix with spoon.
(Add walnuts, raisins or fruit, if you want.)
Bake in greased loaf pan for 45 minutes or until top is brown in a 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix first 4 ingredients in blender for 30 seconds on blend. Sift last 3 ingredients together. Combine both solutions and mix with spoon. (Add walnuts, raisins or fruit, if you want.) Bake in greased loaf pan for 45 minutes or until top is brown in a 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Potato And Carrot Casserole
directions: Peel and slice both potatoes and carrots.
Cook in a separate saucepan until done.
Mix ham, onions and garlic together; brown until done.
Place in a casserole dish a layer each of potatoes, carrots and ham.
Mix cream of mushroom soup with 1 cup of juice from cooked carrots.
Pour this over casserole.
Slice cheese and place over top of casserole.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Yield:
4 servings.
recipes.text: Potato And Carrot Casserole. Peel and slice both potatoes and carrots. Cook in a separate saucepan until done. Mix ham, onions and garlic together; brown until done. Place in a casserole dish a layer each of potatoes, carrots and ham. Mix cream of mushroom soup with 1 cup of juice from cooked carrots. Pour this over casserole. Slice cheese and place over top of casserole. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Methier Molasses Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, butter and sugars. Add eggs and blend. Add molasses and vinegar. Mix all spices with flour. Add gradually. Roll out. Cut and bake at 375u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Methier Molasses Cookies. Cream shortening, butter and sugars. Add eggs and blend. Add molasses and vinegar. Mix all spices with flour. Add gradually. Roll out. Cut and bake at 375u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Kev'S Famous Double Meat Chili
directions: In 2 pans brown and drain the meat.
Cube sirloin first.
In a large pot over low flame, combine chopped onion, green pepper and minced garlic.
Add meat, spices, beer and tomatoes.
Simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until thick.
Add beans for 20 minutes to warm them and serve.
Enjoy!!
recipes.text: Kev'S Famous Double Meat Chili. In 2 pans brown and drain the meat. Cube sirloin first. In a large pot over low flame, combine chopped onion, green pepper and minced garlic. Add meat, spices, beer and tomatoes. Simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until thick. Add beans for 20 minutes to warm them and serve. Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak
directions: Mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup, beef, crumbs, egg, onion, pepper and salt.
Shape into 6 patties.
Brown patties in a small amount of shortening in skillet.
Pour fat off.
Stir in remaining soup and water.
Cover and cook over low heat about 20 minutes or until done.
Stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Salisbury Steak. Mix thoroughly 1/4 cup soup, beef, crumbs, egg, onion, pepper and salt. Shape into 6 patties. Brown patties in a small amount of shortening in skillet. Pour fat off. Stir in remaining soup and water. Cover and cook over low heat about 20 minutes or until done. Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Tropical Delight
directions: Mix all ingredients in a blender and add ice. Sprinkle with coconut if desired.
recipes.text: Tropical Delight. Mix all ingredients in a blender and add ice. Sprinkle with coconut if desired.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
ingredients: 1 small bell pepper, sliced in rings
directions: Slice and boil carrots in salt water until fork tender (do not overcook). Drain and cool. Alternate layers of carrots, bell pepper rings and onion slices. Beat remaining ingredients and pour over mixture. Cover and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Marinated Carrots. Slice and boil carrots in salt water until fork tender (do not overcook). Drain and cool. Alternate layers of carrots, bell pepper rings and onion slices. Beat remaining ingredients and pour over mixture. Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Zucchini Frittata
directions: Saute mushrooms and onion; add to squash, flour, salt and herb. Beat eggs lightly; add sour cream and add to squash mixture. Add cheeses.
Top with bread crumbs mixed with extra Parmesan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Frittata. Saute mushrooms and onion; add to squash, flour, salt and herb. Beat eggs lightly; add sour cream and add to squash mixture. Add cheeses. Top with bread crumbs mixed with extra Parmesan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix everything together with mixer.
Buy graham cracker crusts. Makes 2 pies.
Keep frozen until ready to eat.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix everything together with mixer. Buy graham cracker crusts. Makes 2 pies. Keep frozen until ready to eat.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
6-8 oz. Cheddar cheese, grated plus, extra for topping
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Melt butter in a large skillet.
Add onions and cook 12 to 15 minutes or until tender and transparent. Saving some for topping. Sprinkle cracker crumbs in a greased 9x13 inch casserole dish to line bottom and sides.
Layer cooked onions, soup and cheese in dish.
Lightly season onion layer with salt. Beat together eggs, milk, salt and pepper
and pour over layers.
Sprinkle with reserved crumbs and extra cheese.
Bake 30 to 45 minutes or until browned and bubbly.
Serves 6-8.
recipes.text: Vidalia Onion Casserole. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Melt butter in a large skillet. Add onions and cook 12 to 15 minutes or until tender and transparent. Saving some for topping. Sprinkle cracker crumbs in a greased 9x13 inch casserole dish to line bottom and sides. Layer cooked onions, soup and cheese in dish. Lightly season onion layer with salt. Beat together eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour over layers. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs and extra cheese. Bake 30 to 45 minutes or until browned and bubbly. Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except chips.
Pour into casserole dish. Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
After all is in dish, sprinkle chips over top of casserole and bake for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Mix all ingredients except chips. Pour into casserole dish. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. After all is in dish, sprinkle chips over top of casserole and bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cream Cheese Brownies
directions: Mix cake mix, margarine, eggs and pecans together.
This will be thick.
Spread or pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been well-greased, then combine cream cheese, eggs and powdered sugar. Beat until smooth.
Pour over cake mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Cream Cheese Brownies. Mix cake mix, margarine, eggs and pecans together. This will be thick. Spread or pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been well-greased, then combine cream cheese, eggs and powdered sugar. Beat until smooth. Pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Sausy Strawberry Shake
ingredients: 2 c. ice cream or frozen yogurt
directions: Put strawberries in blender container.
Blend until smooth; add milk.
Cover and blend.
Add ice cream and process.
Pour into glasses.
recipes.text: Sausy Strawberry Shake. Put strawberries in blender container. Blend until smooth; add milk. Cover and blend. Add ice cream and process. Pour into glasses.

recipes.title: Black Walnut Cake
directions: Cream the sugar and oil.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add remaining ingredients.
Beat.
Pour into greased and floured pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Put on your favorite icing.
recipes.text: Black Walnut Cake. Cream the sugar and oil. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add remaining ingredients. Beat. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Put on your favorite icing.

recipes.title: Citrus Salad
ingredients: 1 can pineapple chunks, cut in half
12 to 15 maraschino cherries, cut in half
approximately 1/2 c. sugar (omit if pineapple is in heavy syrup)
directions: Peel grapefruit and oranges, removing peeling and skin.
Mix all ingredients.
This keeps well for many days.
If pineapple in heavy syrup is used, sugar can be omitted.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Citrus Salad. Peel grapefruit and oranges, removing peeling and skin. Mix all ingredients. This keeps well for many days. If pineapple in heavy syrup is used, sugar can be omitted. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Mexican Style
directions: Cut corn from cob; discard cobs.
In pot, combine butter and onion.
Cook until tender.
Add squash, corn, tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Cover, cook slowly, stirring occasionally, for 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Summer Squash Mexican Style. Cut corn from cob; discard cobs. In pot, combine butter and onion. Cook until tender. Add squash, corn, tomatoes, salt and pepper. Cover, cook slowly, stirring occasionally, for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 lb. chicken breast, boned and skinned
directions: Cut chicken breasts by enough to stuff and roll.
Make stuffing according to package.
Place equal amounts of stuffing in each breast.
Roll up jelly roll fashion.
Wrap with bacon.
Bake in pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Serve with baked potatoes and salad.
recipes.text: Easy Stuffed Chicken Breasts. Cut chicken breasts by enough to stuff and roll. Make stuffing according to package. Place equal amounts of stuffing in each breast. Roll up jelly roll fashion. Wrap with bacon. Bake in pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with baked potatoes and salad.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Combine dry ingredients.
Add all remaining ingredients; mix until smooth. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Place in 350u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Bread. Combine dry ingredients. Add all remaining ingredients; mix until smooth. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Place in 350u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
directions: Stir and pour in graham cracker pie shell.
recipes.text: Lemon Pie. Stir and pour in graham cracker pie shell.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheesecake
directions: Crush chocolate wafers and mix with butter. Then spread the mixture into the bottom of a spring-form pan.
Beat eggs, cream cheese
and vanilla until smooth.
Add melted chocolate squares bytswirling
into the cream cheese mix.
After it is poured into the pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 40 minutes. Cool.
Melt chocolate
chips and add sour cream to them.
Ice the cool cheese cake.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cheesecake. Crush chocolate wafers and mix with butter. Then spread the mixture into the bottom of a spring-form pan. Beat eggs, cream cheese and vanilla until smooth. Add melted chocolate squares bytswirling into the cream cheese mix. After it is poured into the pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour to 40 minutes. Cool. Melt chocolate chips and add sour cream to them. Ice the cool cheese cake.

recipes.title: Zucchini Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. zucchini, cut in 1/4 inch slices
1/4 c. grated Romano or Parmesan cheese
directions: Boil zucchini 10 to 15 minutes; drain.
Mix zucchini, onions, parsley, cheese, garlic, salt, pepper, bread crumbs and eggs. Heat 1/2 inch olive oil in skillet.
Drop zucchini mixture by large spoonfuls into oil; cook until browned on both sides. Drain.
Yields 6 to 8 fritters.
recipes.text: Zucchini Fritters. Boil zucchini 10 to 15 minutes; drain. Mix zucchini, onions, parsley, cheese, garlic, salt, pepper, bread crumbs and eggs. Heat 1/2 inch olive oil in skillet. Drop zucchini mixture by large spoonfuls into oil; cook until browned on both sides. Drain. Yields 6 to 8 fritters.

recipes.title: Minestrone
ingredients: 1 stalk celery with leaves, finely chopped
directions: Heat the oil and saute the onion, garlic, carrot and celery for five minutes.
Transfer these ingredients to a large pot.
Add the beef broth, oregano and cabbage.
Simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes.
Add the juice from the tomatoes.
Cut tomatoes into small pieces and add to the soup.
Add beans, peas and macaroni.
Simmer for 10 minutes until macaroni and all the vegetables are cooked. Serve with Parmesan cheese and bread or crackers of your choice.
recipes.text: Minestrone. Heat the oil and saute the onion, garlic, carrot and celery for five minutes. Transfer these ingredients to a large pot. Add the beef broth, oregano and cabbage. Simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Add the juice from the tomatoes. Cut tomatoes into small pieces and add to the soup. Add beans, peas and macaroni. Simmer for 10 minutes until macaroni and all the vegetables are cooked. Serve with Parmesan cheese and bread or crackers of your choice.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: Sprinkle sugar over chopped vegetables.
Mix vinegar, oil, salt, celery seed and mustard.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer 3 minutes.
Cool.
Pour over cabbage mixture.
Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. Sprinkle sugar over chopped vegetables. Mix vinegar, oil, salt, celery seed and mustard. Bring to a boil. Simmer 3 minutes. Cool. Pour over cabbage mixture. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Shoe Peg corn (regular corn may be substituted)
directions: Drain water off corn and green beans.
Mix corn, green beans, soup, sour cream and cheese in a large bowl.
Be sure to mix well. Pour mixture in a casserole dish.
Crumble crackers into fine crumbs.
If you don't have a food processor, a blender works great (or your hands).
Spread crumbs on top of casserole.
Pour melted butter on top of cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350u00b0 until it shakes like jello and is warm throughout, about 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Shoe Peg Corn Casserole. Drain water off corn and green beans. Mix corn, green beans, soup, sour cream and cheese in a large bowl. Be sure to mix well. Pour mixture in a casserole dish. Crumble crackers into fine crumbs. If you don't have a food processor, a blender works great (or your hands). Spread crumbs on top of casserole. Pour melted butter on top of cracker crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 until it shakes like jello and is warm throughout, about 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pies
directions: Put pie crusts on cookie sheet.
Mix ingredients and pour into pie shells.
Bake in 325u00b0 oven until knife comes out clean from center of pie.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pies. Put pie crusts on cookie sheet. Mix ingredients and pour into pie shells. Bake in 325u00b0 oven until knife comes out clean from center of pie.

recipes.title: Waldorf Astoria Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs.
Sift flour, salt and cocoa; add alternately with vanilla and food color to creamed mixture.
Mix soda and vinegar; add with buttermilk to batter.
Do not beat. Pour into two (9-inch) pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done (25 to 30 minutes might do it).
recipes.text: Waldorf Astoria Cake. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs. Sift flour, salt and cocoa; add alternately with vanilla and food color to creamed mixture. Mix soda and vinegar; add with buttermilk to batter. Do not beat. Pour into two (9-inch) pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done (25 to 30 minutes might do it).

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Cream butter, peanut butter and sugar.
Add egg and vanilla and beat well.
Add dry ingredients.
Shape dough into small balls.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cups. Cream butter, peanut butter and sugar. Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Add dry ingredients. Shape dough into small balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Mammaw'S Jelly Roll
ingredients: 4 eggs (room temperature), beaten with mixer 10 minutes
directions: Beat eggs 10 minutes.
Add sugar and water.
Combine baking powder with sifted flour and add.
Bake in greased jelly pan (10 x 14-inch).
When done, cut crust from the edges.
Spread with jelly.
Roll gently from long end.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Put into a dish towel.
Serve anytime.
recipes.text: Mammaw'S Jelly Roll. Beat eggs 10 minutes. Add sugar and water. Combine baking powder with sifted flour and add. Bake in greased jelly pan (10 x 14-inch). When done, cut crust from the edges. Spread with jelly. Roll gently from long end. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Put into a dish towel. Serve anytime.

recipes.title: Great-Grandma Atkinson'S Corn Pie
ingredients: 2 c. corn (fresh, frozen or 1 lb. can of creamed corn)
directions: Combine all dry ingredients and add milk.
Stir in beaten eggs and add butter and corn.
Bake in a buttered casserole until slightly browned, 30 to 40 minutes, at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Great-Grandma Atkinson'S Corn Pie. Combine all dry ingredients and add milk. Stir in beaten eggs and add butter and corn. Bake in a buttered casserole until slightly browned, 30 to 40 minutes, at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Snowman Sandwiches
directions: Spread a thin layer of cream cheese on 1 slice of bread. Cover the cream cheese with another slice of bread to make a cream cheese sandwich.
Cut the bread in the shape of a snowman.
Spread another thin layer of cream cheese over the top of your snowman. Decorate your snowman sandwich using the raisins and walnuts to make eyes, a nose, a mouth and buttons.
Makes one sandwich.
recipes.text: Snowman Sandwiches. Spread a thin layer of cream cheese on 1 slice of bread. Cover the cream cheese with another slice of bread to make a cream cheese sandwich. Cut the bread in the shape of a snowman. Spread another thin layer of cream cheese over the top of your snowman. Decorate your snowman sandwich using the raisins and walnuts to make eyes, a nose, a mouth and buttons. Makes one sandwich.

recipes.title: Gay'S Vegetable Soup With Meat
ingredients: 6 c. beef broth from bouillon cubes
directions: Cook together ground meat and onion.
Drain meat.
Add sliced carrots, potatoes, tomatoes, tomato sauce and broth.
Cook until vegetables are done, then add other vegetables of your choice. Slightly salt and add black pepper.
recipes.text: Gay'S Vegetable Soup With Meat. Cook together ground meat and onion. Drain meat. Add sliced carrots, potatoes, tomatoes, tomato sauce and broth. Cook until vegetables are done, then add other vegetables of your choice. Slightly salt and add black pepper.

recipes.title: Popover Pizza
directions: Brown beef and onions; drain.
Stir in sauce mix, tomato sauce and water.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Top with cheese.
Beat eggs, milk and oil until foamy.
Beat in flour and salt until batter is smooth.
Pour over filling and cover.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: Popover Pizza. Brown beef and onions; drain. Stir in sauce mix, tomato sauce and water. Simmer 10 minutes. Spoon into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Top with cheese. Beat eggs, milk and oil until foamy. Beat in flour and salt until batter is smooth. Pour over filling and cover. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Use no milk.
Combine creamed corn, slightly beaten eggs and salt.
Add Rice Krispies and the butter.
Pour into well-greased casserole or baking dish and bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Use no milk. Combine creamed corn, slightly beaten eggs and salt. Add Rice Krispies and the butter. Pour into well-greased casserole or baking dish and bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Mix together and pour into crust made of vanilla wafers crushed very fine and combined with melted butter.
Beat egg whites and sugar for meringue.
recipes.text: Lemon Icebox Pie. Mix together and pour into crust made of vanilla wafers crushed very fine and combined with melted butter. Beat egg whites and sugar for meringue.

recipes.title: Crab Meat Hors D'Oeuvres Loaf
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. gelatin dissolved in 3 Tbsp. cold water
directions: Heat soup.
Dissolve gelatin and water in hot soup.
Cool slightly.
Combine with other ingredients.
Put in loaf or fish mold.
Chill in refrigerator at least overnight.
Decorate with olive slices (optional), lemon, parsley, etc.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Crab Meat Hors D'Oeuvres Loaf. Heat soup. Dissolve gelatin and water in hot soup. Cool slightly. Combine with other ingredients. Put in loaf or fish mold. Chill in refrigerator at least overnight. Decorate with olive slices (optional), lemon, parsley, etc. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Cookies
directions: Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a small bowl. Beat butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in a large bowl until creamy.
Beat in eggs.
Gradually beat in flour mixture.
Stir in white chips.
Drop well rounded teaspoonfuls (balls) onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes.
Makes about 5 dozen.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Cookies. Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a small bowl. Beat butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in a large bowl until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in white chips. Drop well rounded teaspoonfuls (balls) onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350u00b0 for 9 to 11 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Hot Sausage Dip
directions: Fry crumbled sausage and beef until cooked; drain well.
Add onion, green chilies and tomatoes.
If mixture is thin, add a tablespoon of flour.
Add Velveeta cheese to cooked mixture and melt.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Hot Sausage Dip. Fry crumbled sausage and beef until cooked; drain well. Add onion, green chilies and tomatoes. If mixture is thin, add a tablespoon of flour. Add Velveeta cheese to cooked mixture and melt. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Clusters
directions: Melt peanut butter with butterscotch chips and chocolate chips with peanut butter in heavy saucepan, stirring constantly.
Fold in peanuts until well coated.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper-lined tray.
Chill in refrigerator until firm.
Store in airtight container in refrigerator.
Yield:
36 servings.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Clusters. Melt peanut butter with butterscotch chips and chocolate chips with peanut butter in heavy saucepan, stirring constantly. Fold in peanuts until well coated. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper-lined tray. Chill in refrigerator until firm. Store in airtight container in refrigerator. Yield: 36 servings.

recipes.title: Friendship Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients well and store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Friendship Tea. Mix all ingredients well and store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake No. 2
directions: In a large bowl, add the boiling water to the jello and dissolve
well.
Add
frozen
strawberries, stirring gently to separate
berries.
Put
in
freezer.
In
a bowl, break angel food
cake
into small pieces. Combine one Cool Whip, powdered sugar and
vanilla.
Mix
well.
Add nuts to jello mixture and pour over
cake.
Make
sure
each
piece
of cake is covered. Pour mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Leave in refrigerator 8 to 10 hours.
Ice with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cake No. 2. In a large bowl, add the boiling water to the jello and dissolve well. Add frozen strawberries, stirring gently to separate berries. Put in freezer. In a bowl, break angel food cake into small pieces. Combine one Cool Whip, powdered sugar and vanilla. Mix well. Add nuts to jello mixture and pour over cake. Make sure each piece of cake is covered. Pour mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Leave in refrigerator 8 to 10 hours. Ice with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Beef And Bean Stew
directions: Fry beef and onion.
Drain fat away.
Add soup, water and beans.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Beef And Bean Stew. Fry beef and onion. Drain fat away. Add soup, water and beans. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Cut cauliflower into florets.
Place in bowl, pour on dressing, mix and serve.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Salad. Cut cauliflower into florets. Place in bowl, pour on dressing, mix and serve.

recipes.title: Brown Rice Pizza
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. sage, oregano or Bell's seasoning
directions: Crust:
Beat egg. Add herb seasonings.
Add rice and mix thoroughly.
Oil pizza pan or pie plate.
Press mixture into pan thinly.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes (can be stored in refrigerator/freezer at this stage).
recipes.text: Brown Rice Pizza. Crust: Beat egg. Add herb seasonings. Add rice and mix thoroughly. Oil pizza pan or pie plate. Press mixture into pan thinly. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes (can be stored in refrigerator/freezer at this stage).

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 3 3/4 lb. peaches, peeled and sliced 3/4-inch thick (real ripe peaches)
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Mix all these ingredients together and pour into casserole dish.
recipes.text: Fresh Peach Cobbler. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Mix all these ingredients together and pour into casserole dish.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cake
directions: With electric mixer; cream butter well.
Gradually add 1/2 cup confectioners sugar and cream until fluffy.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pinch off small pieces of dough and roll with hands into finger shapes (if too soft to handle, chill about 15 minutes).
Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Put on ungreased cookie sheets and bake about 10 minutes.
While hot, roll in confectioners sugar.
Cool on rack.
Makes about 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Mexican Wedding Cake. With electric mixer; cream butter well. Gradually add 1/2 cup confectioners sugar and cream until fluffy. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pinch off small pieces of dough and roll with hands into finger shapes (if too soft to handle, chill about 15 minutes). Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Put on ungreased cookie sheets and bake about 10 minutes. While hot, roll in confectioners sugar. Cool on rack. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Spectacular
ingredients: 3 c. cooked chicken, cut in small pieces
1 box Uncle Ben's wild and white rice, cooked
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into a 2 1/2 to 3 cup casserole. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chicken Spectacular. Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 2 1/2 to 3 cup casserole. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Prepare cake as directed on package. Mix Eagle Brand milk and cream of coconut in a bowl. Pour mix over cake as soon as it comes from the oven. Let cake cool completely. Spread Cool Whip on top and sides of cake. Sprinkle with coconut. Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Prepare cake as directed on package. Mix Eagle Brand milk and cream of coconut in a bowl. Pour mix over cake as soon as it comes from the oven. Let cake cool completely. Spread Cool Whip on top and sides of cake. Sprinkle with coconut. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Sift cornmeal and flour together.
Mix in buttermilk; add egg. Melt your oil unless Crisco oil is used.
Let your oil heat in pan.
Mix into your bread mixture.
Pour in pan and bake at 450u00b0 until done.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Sift cornmeal and flour together. Mix in buttermilk; add egg. Melt your oil unless Crisco oil is used. Let your oil heat in pan. Mix into your bread mixture. Pour in pan and bake at 450u00b0 until done.

recipes.title: Hot Cheese Dip
directions: This recipe is usually doubled, because it goes fast.
recipes.text: Hot Cheese Dip. This recipe is usually doubled, because it goes fast.

recipes.title: Chicken Chutney Salad
ingredients: 1 (13 1/4 oz.) can pineapple tidbits, drained (1 c.)
directions: Toss together first 5 ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir into chicken mixture. Serve on greens.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken Chutney Salad. Toss together first 5 ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients. Stir into chicken mixture. Serve on greens. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Lazy Fruit Pie
directions: Melt a stick of oleo in a Pyrex dish.
Make batter with sugar, flour, milk, baking powder and salt.
Pour batter on top of butter.
Then pour on can of fruit.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Batter will rise to form a crust over fruit.
Serve warm with dip of vanilla ice cream.
recipes.text: Lazy Fruit Pie. Melt a stick of oleo in a Pyrex dish. Make batter with sugar, flour, milk, baking powder and salt. Pour batter on top of butter. Then pour on can of fruit. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Batter will rise to form a crust over fruit. Serve warm with dip of vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: No Knead Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Combine milk, shortening, sugar and salt.
Dissolve yeast in water.
Blend in egg.
Add flour; mix until well blended.
Cover and let stand 15 minutes.
Roll out dough on floured surface into rectangle.
Spread with butter, 1/4 to 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Roll as for jellyroll.
Cut into 1-inch slices.
Put in greased pan.
Let rise 1 hour.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: No Knead Cinnamon Rolls. Combine milk, shortening, sugar and salt. Dissolve yeast in water. Blend in egg. Add flour; mix until well blended. Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Roll out dough on floured surface into rectangle. Spread with butter, 1/4 to 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Roll as for jellyroll. Cut into 1-inch slices. Put in greased pan. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Pepper Pecans
directions: Melt butter in a shallow pan.
Spread pecans evenly in one layer.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or just until nuts begin to brown.
Do not overcook!
Stir several times during baking.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over toasted pecans.
Mix well. Spread on paper towels to cool.
Store in jars with tight fitting lids.
recipes.text: Hot Pepper Pecans. Melt butter in a shallow pan. Spread pecans evenly in one layer. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or just until nuts begin to brown. Do not overcook! Stir several times during baking. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over toasted pecans. Mix well. Spread on paper towels to cool. Store in jars with tight fitting lids.

recipes.title: Orange Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 2 - 3 oz. or 1 - 6 oz. box of orange jello
directions: Drain pineapple.
Drain oranges, cut into small pieces.
Mix well.
Add cottage cheese and stir well.
Pour dry jello over mixture and stir well.
Add Cool Whip and mix well.
Pour into salad bowl and refrigerate.
Sets fast and is delicious with any meal.
recipes.text: Orange Pineapple Salad. Drain pineapple. Drain oranges, cut into small pieces. Mix well. Add cottage cheese and stir well. Pour dry jello over mixture and stir well. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Pour into salad bowl and refrigerate. Sets fast and is delicious with any meal.

recipes.title: Braised Shrimp With Vegetables(China)
ingredients: 2 (4 oz. each) cans whole button mushrooms
1 (8 oz.) can whole or sliced bamboo shoots
1/2 tsp. grated, pared, fresh ginger root
directions: Remove shells and back veins from shrimp.
Cut broccoli into pieces.
Drain
mushrooms.tCut whole bamboo shoots into thin slices.
Heat oil in wok over high heat.
Stir-fry shrimp in oil until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add broccoli to shrimp; stir-fry 1 minute.
Add mushrooms and bamboo shoots.
Stir-fry 1 minute longer.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour mixture over shrimp-vegetable
mixture.tCook
and
stir until liquid boils. Cook and stir 1 minute longer.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Braised Shrimp With Vegetables(China). Remove shells and back veins from shrimp. Cut broccoli into pieces. Drain mushrooms.tCut whole bamboo shoots into thin slices. Heat oil in wok over high heat. Stir-fry shrimp in oil until tender, about 3 minutes. Add broccoli to shrimp; stir-fry 1 minute. Add mushrooms and bamboo shoots. Stir-fry 1 minute longer. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over shrimp-vegetable mixture.tCook and stir until liquid boils. Cook and stir 1 minute longer. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Easy 7-Layer Dip
ingredients: chopped tomatoes (amount to suit your taste)
chopped black olives (amount to suit your taste)
shredded Cheddar cheese (amount to suit your taste)
chopped green onion (amount to suit your taste)
directions: In serving dish, layer the ingredients in the following order: bean dip, guacamole, sour cream, chopped tomatoes, chopped black olives, shredded Cheddar cheese and chopped green onion.
Chill and serve with corn chips (Fritos Scoops are good).
recipes.text: Easy 7-Layer Dip. In serving dish, layer the ingredients in the following order: bean dip, guacamole, sour cream, chopped tomatoes, chopped black olives, shredded Cheddar cheese and chopped green onion. Chill and serve with corn chips (Fritos Scoops are good).

recipes.title: Fresh Corn Pudding
directions: Scald milk.
Beat eggs slightly and add all ingredients together.
Bake 1 hour in water at 350u00b0.
Pour corn mixture into one casserole and place that casserole in a pan of hot water; place in the oven and bake.
recipes.text: Fresh Corn Pudding. Scald milk. Beat eggs slightly and add all ingredients together. Bake 1 hour in water at 350u00b0. Pour corn mixture into one casserole and place that casserole in a pan of hot water; place in the oven and bake.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon
directions: Wipe the 6 pieces of salmon dry and arrange in a well buttered baking dish.
Sprinkle the grated onion and other seasonings over the top of the fish.
Pour all the cream over the fish.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with chopped parsley and lemon wedges.
recipes.text: Baked Salmon. Wipe the 6 pieces of salmon dry and arrange in a well buttered baking dish. Sprinkle the grated onion and other seasonings over the top of the fish. Pour all the cream over the fish. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Serve sprinkled with chopped parsley and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
directions: Blend together first 5 ingredients.
When well blended, fold in last 3 ingredients.
Makes 1 3/4 cups.
Serve cold with crackers.
recipes.text: Crab Dip. Blend together first 5 ingredients. When well blended, fold in last 3 ingredients. Makes 1 3/4 cups. Serve cold with crackers.

recipes.title: Lil' Bitty Burger Bundles
ingredients: 3/4 lb. Velveeta, cut into 1/4-inch slices or substitute sliced American cheese
2 pkg. (8 oz. each) dinner rolls, split in half
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Mix meat, soup mix, egg, pepper, water and bread crumbs.
Press onto 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
Prick mixture with fork.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until meat is done. Drain.
Place cheese slices over meat.
Bake 1 minute or until cheese begins to melt.
Cut into 24 squares.
For each sandwich, cover bottom half of dinner roll with burger square, pickle slice and remaining dinner roll half.
Makes cute little burgers for your cute little rascals!
recipes.text: Lil' Bitty Burger Bundles. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Mix meat, soup mix, egg, pepper, water and bread crumbs. Press onto 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Prick mixture with fork. Bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until meat is done. Drain. Place cheese slices over meat. Bake 1 minute or until cheese begins to melt. Cut into 24 squares. For each sandwich, cover bottom half of dinner roll with burger square, pickle slice and remaining dinner roll half. Makes cute little burgers for your cute little rascals!

recipes.title: Hot Water Gingerbread
directions: Add water to molasses and then add dry ingredients.
Add oleo and beat well.
Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 325u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes.
Serve plain or top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Hot Water Gingerbread. Add water to molasses and then add dry ingredients. Add oleo and beat well. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 325u00b0 for 25 to 35 minutes. Serve plain or top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Carob-Banana Malt
directions: Blend in blender until creamy.
Makes 1 serving.
recipes.text: Carob-Banana Malt. Blend in blender until creamy. Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Smoked Turkey
directions: Pour Morton Tender Quick salt and Morton canning salt in a 5 gallon bucket with a lid.
Add your turkey, then fill with water above turkey.
Soak for 24 hours.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0, then turn down to 250u00b0 for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Smoked Turkey. Pour Morton Tender Quick salt and Morton canning salt in a 5 gallon bucket with a lid. Add your turkey, then fill with water above turkey. Soak for 24 hours. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0, then turn down to 250u00b0 for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Cornbread Dressing
ingredients: 6 slices of toast or you can use biscuits
directions: Saut onion and celery in butter. Add to broth. Mix sage and pepper with bread mixture, crumble. Add to broth mixture. Add salt and eggs. Mix well. Bake in 400 degree oven 45-55 minutes. You can add more sage if you like. Also add a can of cream of chicken soup to make richer and moister. Can also add milk if you don't have enough broth.
recipes.text: Cornbread Dressing. Saut onion and celery in butter. Add to broth. Mix sage and pepper with bread mixture, crumble. Add to broth mixture. Add salt and eggs. Mix well. Bake in 400 degree oven 45-55 minutes. You can add more sage if you like. Also add a can of cream of chicken soup to make richer and moister. Can also add milk if you don't have enough broth.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Cut the lettuce into very thin pieces.
Chop tomatoes into medium pieces.
Cut the slices of American cheese into thin strips. Add the red kidney beans and onions, then mix in a large bowl. Brown the hamburger.
Drain and add salt.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Cut the lettuce into very thin pieces. Chop tomatoes into medium pieces. Cut the slices of American cheese into thin strips. Add the red kidney beans and onions, then mix in a large bowl. Brown the hamburger. Drain and add salt. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Pat out onto cookie sheets (usually 2).
Refrigerate overnight.
Cut into squares.
Fry until brown. Place browned meat in layers in a casserole dish or in a crock-pot.
Cover each layer with mushroom soup.
Bake for 2 to 2 1/2 hours at 275u00b0.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Steak. Mix all ingredients well. Pat out onto cookie sheets (usually 2). Refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares. Fry until brown. Place browned meat in layers in a casserole dish or in a crock-pot. Cover each layer with mushroom soup. Bake for 2 to 2 1/2 hours at 275u00b0.

recipes.title: Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (11 oz.) can corn, packed without water
1/2 bottle S & W vintage lites oil free dressing "Red Wine Vinegar and Herb Dressing"*
1 to 3 Tbsp. chopped cilantro (depending your taste for cilantro)
directions: *The dressing comes in a 10 fluid ounce bottle, can use more or less, depending on taste.
recipes.text: Bean Salsa. *The dressing comes in a 10 fluid ounce bottle, can use more or less, depending on taste.

recipes.title: Celery Almond Casserole
directions: Cut up celery in small pieces.
Cook until tender.
Add dash of salt.
Put in casserole and add chestnuts, toast almonds and layer also pimentos.
Pour soup, undiluted, over top.
Pour bread crumbs over top.
Put few pats of butter on top.
Sprinkle with cheese, if desired.
recipes.text: Celery Almond Casserole. Cut up celery in small pieces. Cook until tender. Add dash of salt. Put in casserole and add chestnuts, toast almonds and layer also pimentos. Pour soup, undiluted, over top. Pour bread crumbs over top. Put few pats of butter on top. Sprinkle with cheese, if desired.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf(Prize Winning Recipe)
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Combine all ingredients except ground beef.
Mix well.
Add beef.
Mix lightly but thoroughly.
Shape and press in 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.
Bake 1 hour.
Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf(Prize Winning Recipe). Heat oven to 350u00b0. Combine all ingredients except ground beef. Mix well. Add beef. Mix lightly but thoroughly. Shape and press in 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Golden Carrot Souffle
directions: Cook carrots with 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small amount of water until tender; drain.
Combine carrots and oleo in blender and blend until smooth.
Add eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder and vanilla; blend well.
Spoon mixture into a greased casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Golden Carrot Souffle. Cook carrots with 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small amount of water until tender; drain. Combine carrots and oleo in blender and blend until smooth. Add eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder and vanilla; blend well. Spoon mixture into a greased casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Rotel Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. chicken (8 breasts), stewed, deboned and cut into bite-size pieces
directions: Cook chicken until cooked thoroughly.
Retain chicken broth. Boil spaghetti in chicken broth until tender.
Do not rinse. Saute onion and pepper in margarine.
recipes.text: Rotel Chicken Spaghetti. Cook chicken until cooked thoroughly. Retain chicken broth. Boil spaghetti in chicken broth until tender. Do not rinse. Saute onion and pepper in margarine.

recipes.title: Christmas Cutout Cookies
directions: Melt butter; beat in eggs and add sugar.
Add flour.
Chill dough.
Roll out the dough and use cookie cutters.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 5 to 9 minutes.
Watch them!
The bottoms should be light brown and they do burn easily.
Decorate as desired.
recipes.text: Christmas Cutout Cookies. Melt butter; beat in eggs and add sugar. Add flour. Chill dough. Roll out the dough and use cookie cutters. Bake at 350u00b0 for 5 to 9 minutes. Watch them! The bottoms should be light brown and they do burn easily. Decorate as desired.

recipes.title: Slaw
directions: Chop cabbage, onion and green pepper. On this, put 3/4 cup sugar.
In a saucepan, bring to boil the Wesson oil, vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, dry mustard, salt and celery seed.
Pour hot mixture over cabbage mixture. Cover and keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Slaw. Chop cabbage, onion and green pepper. On this, put 3/4 cup sugar. In a saucepan, bring to boil the Wesson oil, vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, dry mustard, salt and celery seed. Pour hot mixture over cabbage mixture. Cover and keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken And Pasta
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
1 chicken fryer, cooked, deboned and cut into pieces
directions: Mix margarine, soup and cheese, then add tomatoes, onion, Worcestershire and chicken.
Add cooked vermicelli.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Spicy Chicken And Pasta. Mix margarine, soup and cheese, then add tomatoes, onion, Worcestershire and chicken. Add cooked vermicelli. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Five Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. can each (2 c. drained): kidney beans, cut green beans, green lima beans and cut wax beans
directions: In large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
Drain, reserving 1/4 cup drippings.
Salt and pepper; blend into drippings.
Stir in vinegar and water; cook and stir until boiling.
Stir in all beans.
Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
Turn into serving dish.
Crumble bacon on top.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Hot Five Bean Salad. In large skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup drippings. Salt and pepper; blend into drippings. Stir in vinegar and water; cook and stir until boiling. Stir in all beans. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Turn into serving dish. Crumble bacon on top. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. American or Cheddar cheese, grated
directions: Melt 3 tablespoons margarine.
Add cracker crumbs and dill seed; saute until brown.
Slice cabbage coarsely.
Boil until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain.
(Do not overcook.)
Place cabbage in 8 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Melt 3 tablespoons margarine. Add cracker crumbs and dill seed; saute until brown. Slice cabbage coarsely. Boil until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. (Do not overcook.) Place cabbage in 8 x 12 x 2-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Roasted Red Peppers
ingredients: 2 to 3 cloves garlic, crushed or diced finely
1/2 c. canola or extra virgin olive oil
directions: Slice peppers into halves and remove the seeds.
Place peppers onto a lightly greased pan and put them into the oven.
Roast the peppers until the skins feel dry and are all puckered, then let cool and peel the skins off.
Place the peppers, garlic and portions of oil into a jar, making sure the peppers are covered. Allow this to marinate for at least 3 hours, after which they will be ready to use.
recipes.text: Roasted Red Peppers. Slice peppers into halves and remove the seeds. Place peppers onto a lightly greased pan and put them into the oven. Roast the peppers until the skins feel dry and are all puckered, then let cool and peel the skins off. Place the peppers, garlic and portions of oil into a jar, making sure the peppers are covered. Allow this to marinate for at least 3 hours, after which they will be ready to use.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken And Biscuits
directions: On wax paper, mix potato flakes, seasonings and cheese.
In pie plate, mix egg with 1 teaspoon water.
Dip chicken in egg mixture, then roll in potato flake mixture.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Chicken And Biscuits. On wax paper, mix potato flakes, seasonings and cheese. In pie plate, mix egg with 1 teaspoon water. Dip chicken in egg mixture, then roll in potato flake mixture.

recipes.title: Peas, Corn And Cream
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. whipping cream or half and half
directions: In large saucepan, combine peas, corn, salt, sugar and nutmeg. Add cream and cover.
Cook over medium heat until vegetables are desired tenderness, stirring occasionally.
Thicken by combine cornstarch and water.
Stir into vegetable mixture, bring to boil, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Peas, Corn And Cream. In large saucepan, combine peas, corn, salt, sugar and nutmeg. Add cream and cover. Cook over medium heat until vegetables are desired tenderness, stirring occasionally. Thicken by combine cornstarch and water. Stir into vegetable mixture, bring to boil, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Bavarian Delight(Pork Fillets In Natural Gravy)
ingredients: 1 pkg. green vegetable of your choice
directions: Cut pork fillets in half so you end up with 8 pieces.
Dip fillets in flour one side only.
Melt the butter in a frying pan; let pan get hot and add pork fillets with flour side down.
Let brown until they are dark brown, then turn fillets over and brown other side.
Sprinkle salt onto fillets and into the pan.
Spread garlic onto fillets and let some garlic drop into the pan as well. When garlic starts browning, add enough water to cover the fillets halfway.
Turn heat down, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
While fillets are simmering, boil noodles and prepare vegetables.
recipes.text: Bavarian Delight(Pork Fillets In Natural Gravy). Cut pork fillets in half so you end up with 8 pieces. Dip fillets in flour one side only. Melt the butter in a frying pan; let pan get hot and add pork fillets with flour side down. Let brown until they are dark brown, then turn fillets over and brown other side. Sprinkle salt onto fillets and into the pan. Spread garlic onto fillets and let some garlic drop into the pan as well. When garlic starts browning, add enough water to cover the fillets halfway. Turn heat down, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. While fillets are simmering, boil noodles and prepare vegetables.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 onion (the size of a large lemon), chopped
1 can cream of mushroom soup or celery soup
directions: Saut the onion, celery and bell pepper in skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Cook on medium heat until tender. May have to add a little water. Brown ground beef and drain. Add onion, celery and pepper to ground beef. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix and put in casserole dish. Top with sliced cheese. Mix cream of mushroom soup or celery soup with milk. Add mixed vegetables. Pour over cheese. Cook in oven at 350u00b0 until soup is hot.
ner: cream of mushroom soup or celery soup
recipes.text: Ground Beef Casserole. Saut the onion, celery and bell pepper in skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Cook on medium heat until tender. May have to add a little water. Brown ground beef and drain. Add onion, celery and pepper to ground beef. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix and put in casserole dish. Top with sliced cheese. Mix cream of mushroom soup or celery soup with milk. Add mixed vegetables. Pour over cheese. Cook in oven at 350u00b0 until soup is hot.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Smelly Ornaments
directions: You will need a spoon, bowl, rolling pin, cookie cutters, toothpicks, metal cake drying racks and narrow racks.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Smelly Ornaments. You will need a spoon, bowl, rolling pin, cookie cutters, toothpicks, metal cake drying racks and narrow racks.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken And Dumplings
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cooked, deboned and cut up
directions: Cook chicken; remove from broth.
Debone and cut.
Add soup; bring to low boil, blending soup with broth well.
Add cut up chicken to broth.
Cut flour tortillas in half, then each half into several small pieces.
Drop tortilla pieces into boiling broth.
Cook on medium heat, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Reduce to simmer and cover.
recipes.text: Quick Chicken And Dumplings. Cook chicken; remove from broth. Debone and cut. Add soup; bring to low boil, blending soup with broth well. Add cut up chicken to broth. Cut flour tortillas in half, then each half into several small pieces. Drop tortilla pieces into boiling broth. Cook on medium heat, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Reduce to simmer and cover.

recipes.title: Yum-Yum Cake
directions: Measure the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt right into the cake pan and mix it.
Make 3 holes in the dry cake mix. Measure the vegetable oil into one hole, the vinegar into the second hole and the vanilla into the third hole.
Pour the water over all of the mixture and mix it in.
It looks just like you're mixing a mud pie, but you aren't.
Be sure that you stir all the flour in so that there aren't any lumps.
recipes.text: Yum-Yum Cake. Measure the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt right into the cake pan and mix it. Make 3 holes in the dry cake mix. Measure the vegetable oil into one hole, the vinegar into the second hole and the vanilla into the third hole. Pour the water over all of the mixture and mix it in. It looks just like you're mixing a mud pie, but you aren't. Be sure that you stir all the flour in so that there aren't any lumps.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cheese Crumbs
directions: Melt margarine, mix together margarine, flour and pecans.
Pat in greased 9 x 12-inch casserole dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Blueberry Cheese Crumbs. Melt margarine, mix together margarine, flour and pecans. Pat in greased 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Saucy Cheese Bits
directions: Mix and roll into balls.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown.
Can be frozen.
recipes.text: Saucy Cheese Bits. Mix and roll into balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes or until brown. Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Minestrone
directions: Peel and cube potatoes.
Scrape and thickly slice carrots. Slice zucchini.
If using fresh tomatoes, peel and chop, or chop canned tomatoes.
recipes.text: Minestrone. Peel and cube potatoes. Scrape and thickly slice carrots. Slice zucchini. If using fresh tomatoes, peel and chop, or chop canned tomatoes.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together for 2 minutes. Add 6 ounces chocolate chips. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chocolate-Chocolate Chip Pound Cake. Mix all ingredients together for 2 minutes. Add 6 ounces chocolate chips. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Crackers -- Cookies
directions: Line cookie sheet or 9 x 13 pan with saltine crackers. On a stove, boil the margarine or butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes. Drizzle over crackers. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 7 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips. Spread when melted.
recipes.text: Crackers -- Cookies. Line cookie sheet or 9 x 13 pan with saltine crackers. On a stove, boil the margarine or butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes. Drizzle over crackers. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 7 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips. Spread when melted.

recipes.title: Cranberry Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. spinach, rinsed and torn into bite-sized pieces (I like to use red tipped leaf lettuce and spinach mixed)
directions: In medium saucepan, saut almonds in butter until lightly toasted. Remove and drain on paper towels. Toast sesame seeds in same pan. Remove and drain on paper towels. In large bowl, toss salad greens (washed and drained) with toasted almonds and cranberries. In a medium bowl, whisk together sesame seeds, poppy seeds, sugar, onion, vinegars and oil together. Top with greens just before serving.
recipes.text: Cranberry Spinach Salad. In medium saucepan, saut almonds in butter until lightly toasted. Remove and drain on paper towels. Toast sesame seeds in same pan. Remove and drain on paper towels. In large bowl, toss salad greens (washed and drained) with toasted almonds and cranberries. In a medium bowl, whisk together sesame seeds, poppy seeds, sugar, onion, vinegars and oil together. Top with greens just before serving.

recipes.title: Lunchtime Tuna Or Chicken Casserole
ingredients: garlic salt, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce to taste
1/4 c. each onion and celery, chopped
directions: Cook onion and celery in broth in microwave on High. Add seasonings. Crumble toast. Add with chicken to broth.
Mix well. Top with cheese.
Microwave for 5 minutes or can put in oven for 15 minutes at 375u00b0.
Serves 1.
recipes.text: Lunchtime Tuna Or Chicken Casserole. Cook onion and celery in broth in microwave on High. Add seasonings. Crumble toast. Add with chicken to broth. Mix well. Top with cheese. Microwave for 5 minutes or can put in oven for 15 minutes at 375u00b0. Serves 1.

recipes.title: Apple Butter
directions: Core and slicetapples; add enough water to cook apples until soft.
Press
through
sieve
and
measure.
Combine all ingredients and cook aboutt1
to
1 1/2 hours or until thick. Stir oftentto
prevent
scorching.
Pour into sterilized jars within 1/2-inch ofttop.
Process in boiling water bath for 10 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 pints.
recipes.text: Apple Butter. Core and slicetapples; add enough water to cook apples until soft. Press through sieve and measure. Combine all ingredients and cook aboutt1 to 1 1/2 hours or until thick. Stir oftentto prevent scorching. Pour into sterilized jars within 1/2-inch ofttop. Process in boiling water bath for 10 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 pints.

recipes.title: Jeff Davis Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients well.
Add eggs, butter and milk.
Bake in unbaked pie shell in slow oven at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Jeff Davis Pie. Mix dry ingredients well. Add eggs, butter and milk. Bake in unbaked pie shell in slow oven at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Slaw
directions: Crumble uncooked Ramen noodles and add to broccoli slaw. Add almonds and sunflower nuts. Mix oil, sugar, vinegar and seasoning mix together and pour over slaw. Mix well and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Broccoli Slaw. Crumble uncooked Ramen noodles and add to broccoli slaw. Add almonds and sunflower nuts. Mix oil, sugar, vinegar and seasoning mix together and pour over slaw. Mix well and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Savory Dried Lima Beans
directions: Wash and pick over beans.
Cover with cold water; let stand for awhile or overnight.
Drain; put into a pan.
Add 3 cups water, tomatoes, green peppers, onion and syrup.
Mix paprika, salt and mustard; stir into mixture.
Cook until almost tender. Render bacon; add and cook until beans are done.
Add more water as needed.
May also be baked in the oven.
recipes.text: Savory Dried Lima Beans. Wash and pick over beans. Cover with cold water; let stand for awhile or overnight. Drain; put into a pan. Add 3 cups water, tomatoes, green peppers, onion and syrup. Mix paprika, salt and mustard; stir into mixture. Cook until almost tender. Render bacon; add and cook until beans are done. Add more water as needed. May also be baked in the oven.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
directions: Cream butter, 1 cup sugar and eggs.
Add vanilla and sour cream; mix.
Add salt, baking powder, baking soda and flour; beat until smooth.
Spoon half of batter into tube pan.
recipes.text: Coffee Cake. Cream butter, 1 cup sugar and eggs. Add vanilla and sour cream; mix. Add salt, baking powder, baking soda and flour; beat until smooth. Spoon half of batter into tube pan.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Thoroughly blend all ingredients.
Keep refrigerated in closed container.
Will keep up to 1 month in refrigerator.
Serve with crisp crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Thoroughly blend all ingredients. Keep refrigerated in closed container. Will keep up to 1 month in refrigerator. Serve with crisp crackers.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
directions: Cut bacon in small pieces and brown. Remove from drippings. Blend sugar, flour, salt and pepper together.
Add to drippings. Stir to make a smooth paste. Add vinegar and water.
Boil 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Combine sauce, sliced potatoes and onions.
Let stand at room temperature for 3 to 4 hours.
Sprinkle with bacon bits just before serving.
recipes.text: German Potato Salad. Cut bacon in small pieces and brown. Remove from drippings. Blend sugar, flour, salt and pepper together. Add to drippings. Stir to make a smooth paste. Add vinegar and water. Boil 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Combine sauce, sliced potatoes and onions. Let stand at room temperature for 3 to 4 hours. Sprinkle with bacon bits just before serving.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Beat until fluffy.
Mix chocolate syrup, flour and nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes in a jelly roll pan.
recipes.text: Brownies. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat until fluffy. Mix chocolate syrup, flour and nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes in a jelly roll pan.

recipes.title: Broccoli Puff
directions: Cook and drain broccoli; stir together soup and cheese. Gradually add milk, egg and mayonnaise.
Add mixture to drained broccoli; mix lightly and pour into buttered casserole pan (8 x 8-inches or 10 x 10-inches).
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0 approximately.
recipes.text: Broccoli Puff. Cook and drain broccoli; stir together soup and cheese. Gradually add milk, egg and mayonnaise. Add mixture to drained broccoli; mix lightly and pour into buttered casserole pan (8 x 8-inches or 10 x 10-inches). Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0 approximately.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Dip
directions: Put ingredients into a blender and mix on high for 6 to 10 seconds.
Spoon into a dipping bowl and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Added spice:
Sprinkle paprika on top just before serving.
Sprinkle dill weed on top just before serving.
This is a great lo-cal dip that even tastes fattening.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Cottage Cheese Dip. Put ingredients into a blender and mix on high for 6 to 10 seconds. Spoon into a dipping bowl and chill for at least 30 minutes. Added spice: Sprinkle paprika on top just before serving. Sprinkle dill weed on top just before serving. This is a great lo-cal dip that even tastes fattening. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Ritzy Pie
ingredients: top and bottom crust (your choice; double pie crust)
directions: Bring water, cream of tartar and sugar to boil.
Add Ritz crackers.
(Do not break, keep whole.
The secret; individual squares, approximately 1 1/2 inches square.)
Cook for 2 minutes; do not stir.
Pour mixture on bottom pie crust.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Dot with dabs of butter.
Put on top crust.
Bake 10 minutes at 425u00b0.
Reduce heat to 325u00b0 and bake 20 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Ritzy Pie. Bring water, cream of tartar and sugar to boil. Add Ritz crackers. (Do not break, keep whole. The secret; individual squares, approximately 1 1/2 inches square.) Cook for 2 minutes; do not stir. Pour mixture on bottom pie crust. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Dot with dabs of butter. Put on top crust. Bake 10 minutes at 425u00b0. Reduce heat to 325u00b0 and bake 20 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Graham Squares
directions: Mix milk and vanilla in an 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish.
Add crumbs and chips.
Blend.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Graham Squares. Mix milk and vanilla in an 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish. Add crumbs and chips. Blend. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cheese Bake
directions: Cook broccoli florets according to package directions and place in 2-quart casserole.
Melt butter in medium saucepan.
Stir in flour and simmer 2 or 3 minutes.
Gradually add milk and continue to heat, stirring constantly, until sauce has thickened. Add cream cheese and blend until smooth.
Remove from heat and add onions.
Pour mixture over broccoli.
Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Cheese Bake. Cook broccoli florets according to package directions and place in 2-quart casserole. Melt butter in medium saucepan. Stir in flour and simmer 2 or 3 minutes. Gradually add milk and continue to heat, stirring constantly, until sauce has thickened. Add cream cheese and blend until smooth. Remove from heat and add onions. Pour mixture over broccoli. Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Bake 40 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Danish Apple Cake
directions: *Crush zwieback with a rolling pin to make fine crumbs.
Makes 2 cups crumbs.
recipes.text: Danish Apple Cake. *Crush zwieback with a rolling pin to make fine crumbs. Makes 2 cups crumbs.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Place a layer of waxed paper over a cookie sheet.
Set aside. Over medium heat, melt down milk and chocolate chips.
When thoroughly melted, add peanut butter chips.
Stir until mixed (not melted).
Put on waxed paper and spread.
Cool in refrigerator 15 minutes.
Cut into squares and put back into refrigerator until completely cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge. Place a layer of waxed paper over a cookie sheet. Set aside. Over medium heat, melt down milk and chocolate chips. When thoroughly melted, add peanut butter chips. Stir until mixed (not melted). Put on waxed paper and spread. Cool in refrigerator 15 minutes. Cut into squares and put back into refrigerator until completely cool.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Icebox Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla.
Sift together flour, baking soda and salt and add to creamed mixture. Mix in oatmeal, nuts and coconut.
Shape in rolls and refrigerate a couple of hours.
Slice and bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes on lightly greased cookie sheets.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Icebox Cookies. Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour, baking soda and salt and add to creamed mixture. Mix in oatmeal, nuts and coconut. Shape in rolls and refrigerate a couple of hours. Slice and bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes on lightly greased cookie sheets.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar, Crisco and butter together until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one. Stir in food coloring and vanilla.
Combine flour, salt and cocoa to creamed mixture alternately with milk, beating well.
Pour batter into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Frost with Cream Cheese Icing when cake is completely cool.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Pound Cake. Cream sugar, Crisco and butter together until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one. Stir in food coloring and vanilla. Combine flour, salt and cocoa to creamed mixture alternately with milk, beating well. Pour batter into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Frost with Cream Cheese Icing when cake is completely cool.

recipes.title: Pecan Fizz
directions: In 3-quart pitcher, prepare limeade concentrate as directed. Measure 1 cup reconstituted limeade into 1-quart saucepan; over high heat, heat to boiling.
Remove saucepan from heat.
Stir in peach gelatin into hot limeade, stirring until the gelatin completely dissolves.
Stir mixture into limeade in pitcher.
Place half the peaches and their syrup in blender; blend at high speed until pureed.
Repeat with remaining peaches and syrup.
Stir puree and lime juice into limeade mixture.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until well chilled.
To serve, stir in tonic water into limeade mixture.
Garnish with lime slices.
recipes.text: Pecan Fizz. In 3-quart pitcher, prepare limeade concentrate as directed. Measure 1 cup reconstituted limeade into 1-quart saucepan; over high heat, heat to boiling. Remove saucepan from heat. Stir in peach gelatin into hot limeade, stirring until the gelatin completely dissolves. Stir mixture into limeade in pitcher. Place half the peaches and their syrup in blender; blend at high speed until pureed. Repeat with remaining peaches and syrup. Stir puree and lime juice into limeade mixture. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until well chilled. To serve, stir in tonic water into limeade mixture. Garnish with lime slices.

recipes.title: Creamy Double Decker Fudge
directions: Line 8-inch square pan with foil.

In small microwave bowl, place peanut butter chips and 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk. Microwave at High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute, until chips are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla; spread into pan.
In small microwave bowl, add remaining sweetened condensed milk and semi-sweet chocolate chips and microwave 1 to 1 1/2 minutes and stir after
1 minute or until chips are melted and mixture is smooth.
Stir in vanilla and spread over your peanut butter layer.
Cover and refrigerate until firm.
Cut into squares and store in a tightly covered container.
Makes about 4 dozen pieces.
recipes.text: Creamy Double Decker Fudge. Line 8-inch square pan with foil. In small microwave bowl, place peanut butter chips and 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk. Microwave at High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, stirring after 1 minute, until chips are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla; spread into pan. In small microwave bowl, add remaining sweetened condensed milk and semi-sweet chocolate chips and microwave 1 to 1 1/2 minutes and stir after 1 minute or until chips are melted and mixture is smooth. Stir in vanilla and spread over your peanut butter layer. Cover and refrigerate until firm. Cut into squares and store in a tightly covered container. Makes about 4 dozen pieces.

recipes.title: Low Country Cocktail Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
recipes.text: Low Country Cocktail Sauce. Combine all ingredients and mix well.

recipes.title: Maple Carrots
directions: Place peeled carrots in a saucepan with about an inch of water plus salt and sugar.
Cover and cook 10 minutes, or until crisp-tender.
Remove carrots from the pan and keep warm.
Cook carrot water until it is reduced to about 1/2 cup.
Add syrup, butter and mustard.
Cook until a heavy syrup is formed, about 7 minutes.
Add carrots and pepper.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Maple Carrots. Place peeled carrots in a saucepan with about an inch of water plus salt and sugar. Cover and cook 10 minutes, or until crisp-tender. Remove carrots from the pan and keep warm. Cook carrot water until it is reduced to about 1/2 cup. Add syrup, butter and mustard. Cook until a heavy syrup is formed, about 7 minutes. Add carrots and pepper. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Diabetic Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. honey or fructose or 12 pkg. Sweet 'N Low
directions: Mix dry ingredients, then mix the liquid.
You can also use crushed pineapple instead of the raisins.
Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Diabetic Oatmeal Cookies. Mix dry ingredients, then mix the liquid. You can also use crushed pineapple instead of the raisins. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Dressing
directions: Brown ground meat with white and green onions, garlic and 1 tablespoon cayenne and bell pepper and seasons of salt or your choice.
Drain grease if necessary after browning.
Add chicken broth and Kitchen Bouquet and bring to a boil.
Simmer on low heat for about 45 minutes.
During simmering, stir occasionally.
Then add cooked rice, mixing in thoroughly and more salt, pepper and Accent to taste, if needed.
recipes.text: Rice Dressing. Brown ground meat with white and green onions, garlic and 1 tablespoon cayenne and bell pepper and seasons of salt or your choice. Drain grease if necessary after browning. Add chicken broth and Kitchen Bouquet and bring to a boil. Simmer on low heat for about 45 minutes. During simmering, stir occasionally. Then add cooked rice, mixing in thoroughly and more salt, pepper and Accent to taste, if needed.

recipes.title: No Bake Brownies
ingredients: 3 c. finely crushed graham crackers (about 18 crackers)
directions: In medium saucepan, combine milk and chocolate bits. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth. Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: No Bake Brownies. In medium saucepan, combine milk and chocolate bits. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth. Spread in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil.
This sauce is good on chicken and ribs.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Sauce. Mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil. This sauce is good on chicken and ribs.

recipes.title: Italian Anise Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Use ungreased pans.
Makes 6 dozen. Mix first 4 ingredients together then add flour and baking powder. Batter will be loose and sticky.
Spoon onto a cookie sheet.
I put 2 strips to 1 pan; they spread out.
When light brown on bottom, remove from oven with knife.
Make slices and put back in oven.
Brown on each side.
recipes.text: Italian Anise Cookies. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Use ungreased pans. Makes 6 dozen. Mix first 4 ingredients together then add flour and baking powder. Batter will be loose and sticky. Spoon onto a cookie sheet. I put 2 strips to 1 pan; they spread out. When light brown on bottom, remove from oven with knife. Make slices and put back in oven. Brown on each side.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream oil and sugar; add eggs and beat.
In small bowl, combine coloring, cocoa and vinegar.
Add to egg mixture. Alternate flour and buttermilk, starting and ending with flour. Add vanilla.
Bake in greased and floured 8-inch pans in a 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream oil and sugar; add eggs and beat. In small bowl, combine coloring, cocoa and vinegar. Add to egg mixture. Alternate flour and buttermilk, starting and ending with flour. Add vanilla. Bake in greased and floured 8-inch pans in a 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Curried Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours for flavors to blend.
recipes.text: Curried Vegetable Dip. Mix all ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours for flavors to blend.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: chicken (1 whole chicken or 4 chicken breasts)
directions: Boil, debone and cut chicken into small chunks.
(Save broth.) Cook spaghetti in chicken broth.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Boil, debone and cut chicken into small chunks. (Save broth.) Cook spaghetti in chicken broth.

recipes.title: Boston Clam Chowder
directions: Spray a saucepan with Pam.
Saute vegetables for 5 minutes. Add 3 cups water; stir well.
Add spices and bouillon and boil. Mix cornstarch and 1/2 cup water.
Add to soup, stirring.
Add Butter Buds and lemon juice.
Blend well.
Simmer 20 minutes, stirring often.
Add milk, dry milk, clams and liquid.
Blend well.
Simmer 10 minutes, stirring often.
recipes.text: Boston Clam Chowder. Spray a saucepan with Pam. Saute vegetables for 5 minutes. Add 3 cups water; stir well. Add spices and bouillon and boil. Mix cornstarch and 1/2 cup water. Add to soup, stirring. Add Butter Buds and lemon juice. Blend well. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring often. Add milk, dry milk, clams and liquid. Blend well. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring often.

recipes.title: 2 Yogurt Pies
ingredients: 3 pkg. your favorite yogurt (such as lemon)
directions: Mix yogurt and Cool Whip and fill crusts; chill and serve. Low-fat but tasty.
recipes.text: 2 Yogurt Pies. Mix yogurt and Cool Whip and fill crusts; chill and serve. Low-fat but tasty.

recipes.title: Homemade Liver Mush
directions: Put all items, except corn meal, in a pot and cover with water.
Cook until done.
Cool.
Remove all bones and skin. Grind all meat.
Place back in pot with the juice and heat, adding the corn meal to the mixture while it is cooking until it becomes a consistent mixture.
You may need to add more water.
When mixture is thick and smooth, pour into loaf pans and let cool.
recipes.text: Homemade Liver Mush. Put all items, except corn meal, in a pot and cover with water. Cook until done. Cool. Remove all bones and skin. Grind all meat. Place back in pot with the juice and heat, adding the corn meal to the mixture while it is cooking until it becomes a consistent mixture. You may need to add more water. When mixture is thick and smooth, pour into loaf pans and let cool.

recipes.title: Fried Bananas
directions: Peel and cut banana into 1/4-inch slices.
