Melt the shortening over medium heat.
Fry banana until brown and crispy.
Turn and fry the other side.
recipes.text: Fried Bananas. Peel and cut banana into 1/4-inch slices. Melt the shortening over medium heat. Fry banana until brown and crispy. Turn and fry the other side.

recipes.title: Grilled Lemon Salmon
ingredients: 1 cube chicken bouillon, mixed with 3 Tbsp. water
directions: Sprinkle dill, salt, pepper and garlic powder over salmon and place in shallow pan. Mix sugar, bouillon, oil, soy sauce and green onions. Pour over salmon. Cover and chill for 1 hour; turn once. Drain and discard marinade. Put on grill over medium heat; place lemon and onion on top. Cover and cook for 15 minutes or until fish is done.
recipes.text: Grilled Lemon Salmon. Sprinkle dill, salt, pepper and garlic powder over salmon and place in shallow pan. Mix sugar, bouillon, oil, soy sauce and green onions. Pour over salmon. Cover and chill for 1 hour; turn once. Drain and discard marinade. Put on grill over medium heat; place lemon and onion on top. Cover and cook for 15 minutes or until fish is done.

recipes.title: Baked Custard
directions: Beat eggs slightly; add milk, sugar, salt and vanilla.
Pour into custard cups.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Bake in pan of hot water 45 minutes or until knife is clear after inserted.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Baked Custard. Beat eggs slightly; add milk, sugar, salt and vanilla. Pour into custard cups. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake in pan of hot water 45 minutes or until knife is clear after inserted. Bake in 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Potatoes 'N Cheese
directions: Cool the boiled potatoes and grate.
Mix cheese and grated potatoes.
Add the sour cream and salt; mix.
Add the onion. Place mixture in a baking dish and dot with butter on top.
Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until a brown crust starts to appear.
recipes.text: Potatoes 'N Cheese. Cool the boiled potatoes and grate. Mix cheese and grated potatoes. Add the sour cream and salt; mix. Add the onion. Place mixture in a baking dish and dot with butter on top. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour or until a brown crust starts to appear.

recipes.title: Cheese Strata
directions: Place 8 slices of bread in bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch dish.
Spread with ham and grated cheese.
Top with remaining bread slices.
Beat eggs; add milk, dry mustard and salt.
Pour over bread and allow to set overnight, in refrigerator, covered.
recipes.text: Cheese Strata. Place 8 slices of bread in bottom of buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Spread with ham and grated cheese. Top with remaining bread slices. Beat eggs; add milk, dry mustard and salt. Pour over bread and allow to set overnight, in refrigerator, covered.

recipes.title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
directions: Add potatoes and garlic to boiling water.
Cover and boil slowly about 30 minutes or until tender.
Drain, reserving cooking liquid.
Put hot potatoes and garlic through food ricer.
Add salt, pepper, butter and cream.
Stir to blend ingredients.
Add reserved potato cooking water to desired consistency.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Garlic Mashed Potatoes. Add potatoes and garlic to boiling water. Cover and boil slowly about 30 minutes or until tender. Drain, reserving cooking liquid. Put hot potatoes and garlic through food ricer. Add salt, pepper, butter and cream. Stir to blend ingredients. Add reserved potato cooking water to desired consistency. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Paprika Cream Schnitzel
directions: Fry bacon until done, then add veal, which has been cut into portions and brown in hot bacon fat.
Add onions and brown, then season well with paprika and salt.
Stir in sour cream and tomato sauce.
Cover pan and cook about 20 minutes.
Serve cutlets covered with the sauce.
recipes.text: Paprika Cream Schnitzel. Fry bacon until done, then add veal, which has been cut into portions and brown in hot bacon fat. Add onions and brown, then season well with paprika and salt. Stir in sour cream and tomato sauce. Cover pan and cook about 20 minutes. Serve cutlets covered with the sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Roulades
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, skinned and pounded to 1/4-inch thickness
1/4 c. dry white wine or water
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in glass casserole dish. Microwave on High, uncovered, for 6 to 7 minutes.
Add bread crumbs and seasonings.
Spread stuffing on chicken and roll up. Hold ends closed with toothpicks.
Arrange in dish; pour combined wine and soup over chicken.
Cover with wax paper and microwave on High 11 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Roulades. Combine first 5 ingredients in glass casserole dish. Microwave on High, uncovered, for 6 to 7 minutes. Add bread crumbs and seasonings. Spread stuffing on chicken and roll up. Hold ends closed with toothpicks. Arrange in dish; pour combined wine and soup over chicken. Cover with wax paper and microwave on High 11 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury sugar cookie dough roll
fruit (kiwi, papaya, mandarin oranges, bananas or fruits of choice)
directions: Overlap 1/8-inch slices of dough roll on 14-inch pizza pan. Bake in a 375u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool.
Mix the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Spread over cooled cookie shell. Arrange fruit on top and drizzle with mixture of preserves and water. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Overlap 1/8-inch slices of dough roll on 14-inch pizza pan. Bake in a 375u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Mix the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Spread over cooled cookie shell. Arrange fruit on top and drizzle with mixture of preserves and water. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Egg Custard Pie
directions: Do not use mixer!
Add eggs and milk.
Mix well with a fork. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350u00b0 approximately 45 minutes.
Your favorite flavoring may be added.
recipes.text: Egg Custard Pie. Do not use mixer! Add eggs and milk. Mix well with a fork. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 approximately 45 minutes. Your favorite flavoring may be added.

recipes.title: Baked Apple
directions: Place cored apple in a shallow baking dish.
Pour soda and lemon juice over apple.
Sprinkle with sugar substitute and cinnamon.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes or until apple is done.
recipes.text: Baked Apple. Place cored apple in a shallow baking dish. Pour soda and lemon juice over apple. Sprinkle with sugar substitute and cinnamon. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes or until apple is done.

recipes.title: Laura'S No Fat Strawberry Cake
ingredients: egg substitute equivalent to 2 eggs (for example, Egg Beaters)
directions: Set strawberries aside.
Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Lightly grease and flour Pyrex 23 x 18 x 4-inch glass dish.
recipes.text: Laura'S No Fat Strawberry Cake. Set strawberries aside. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Lightly grease and flour Pyrex 23 x 18 x 4-inch glass dish.

recipes.title: Neapolitan Beef Roll-Up
ingredients: 2 lb. top round beef steak, 1/2-inch thick
1 c. Italian seasoned bread crumbs, reserve 1/4 c.
directions: Pound steak until flattened.
Mix bread crumbs, Provolone cheese, pine nuts and garlic.
Spread evenly over 1/2 of round steak.
Flip other half over bread crumb mixture.
Place in nonstick baking dish.
Top with stewed tomatoes.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and reserved bread crumbs over steak.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serves 6.
Approximate preparation time, 15 minutes. Cooking time, 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Neapolitan Beef Roll-Up. Pound steak until flattened. Mix bread crumbs, Provolone cheese, pine nuts and garlic. Spread evenly over 1/2 of round steak. Flip other half over bread crumb mixture. Place in nonstick baking dish. Top with stewed tomatoes. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and reserved bread crumbs over steak. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 6. Approximate preparation time, 15 minutes. Cooking time, 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb. sausage (hot or mild breakfast sausage)
directions: Brown sausage and set aside.
Beat eggs with fork (add 2 tablespoons milk) until mixed well.
Cube cheese (for easier melting).
Add peppers, eggs, jalapenos (optional), onion, cheese and sausage back into skillet.
Over medium heat, cook and fold (frequently).
Remove from heat when eggs are fluffy and completely melted cheese.
With large spoon, place 2 heaping spoonfuls onto one burrito tortilla shell.
Fold shell over egg mixture; fold in each end and roll.
Serves 5.
recipes.text: Breakfast Burritos. Brown sausage and set aside. Beat eggs with fork (add 2 tablespoons milk) until mixed well. Cube cheese (for easier melting). Add peppers, eggs, jalapenos (optional), onion, cheese and sausage back into skillet. Over medium heat, cook and fold (frequently). Remove from heat when eggs are fluffy and completely melted cheese. With large spoon, place 2 heaping spoonfuls onto one burrito tortilla shell. Fold shell over egg mixture; fold in each end and roll. Serves 5.

recipes.title: Barbecued Hamburger
directions: Saute onions and green peppers in cooking oil for 3 minutes. Add hamburger and cook until red color disappears.
Drain and add mustard, catsup, salt and pepper.
Simmer for 10 minutes and serve in toasted, buttered buns with a thin slice of onion.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Barbecued Hamburger. Saute onions and green peppers in cooking oil for 3 minutes. Add hamburger and cook until red color disappears. Drain and add mustard, catsup, salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes and serve in toasted, buttered buns with a thin slice of onion. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Potato Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Cover bottom of pan with margarine.
Layer onions, potatoes and pork chops.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0, covered with tinfoil.
Uncover and bake until brown.
recipes.text: Potato Pork Chop Casserole. Cover bottom of pan with margarine. Layer onions, potatoes and pork chops. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0, covered with tinfoil. Uncover and bake until brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Chili Stew
ingredients: 1 whole chicken breast, boned and skinned
directions: Cut chicken into 1 inch pieces and cook in the oil with onion, garlic and green pepper until chicken is done (about 6 minutes).
recipes.text: Chicken Chili Stew. Cut chicken into 1 inch pieces and cook in the oil with onion, garlic and green pepper until chicken is done (about 6 minutes).

recipes.title: Calico Beans
ingredients: 1 medium onion, diced and cooked with bacon
directions: Reserve most of grease, and add vinegar, brown sugar, dry mustard, salt, catsup and dash of garlic salt.
Stir together and mix with all the cans of beans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Calico Beans. Reserve most of grease, and add vinegar, brown sugar, dry mustard, salt, catsup and dash of garlic salt. Stir together and mix with all the cans of beans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Oven-Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 450u00b0.
Scrub potatoes with vegetable brush. Cut potatoes into large chunks.
In large plastic bag or bowl, add all ingredients.
Close bag and shake or toss in bowl until potatoes are evenly coated.
Empty potatoes into shallow baking pan.
Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Oven-Roasted Potatoes. Preheat oven to 450u00b0. Scrub potatoes with vegetable brush. Cut potatoes into large chunks. In large plastic bag or bowl, add all ingredients. Close bag and shake or toss in bowl until potatoes are evenly coated. Empty potatoes into shallow baking pan. Bake, stirring occasionally, 40 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Rainbow Trout With Lemon And Capers
directions: Saute trout in 1/2 tablespoon butter and oil.
Remove from pan; reserve warm.
Melt 1/2 tablespoon butter in pan.
Add remaining ingredients, stirring to deglaze.
Pour over trout and serve immediately.
recipes.text: Rainbow Trout With Lemon And Capers. Saute trout in 1/2 tablespoon butter and oil. Remove from pan; reserve warm. Melt 1/2 tablespoon butter in pan. Add remaining ingredients, stirring to deglaze. Pour over trout and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook vegetables.
Place in casserole.
Melt butter.
Mix well with cream cheese and soup.
Pour over vegetables.
Bake at 350u00b0 uncovered for 30 minutes or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Cauliflower And Broccoli Casserole. Cook vegetables. Place in casserole. Melt butter. Mix well with cream cheese and soup. Pour over vegetables. Bake at 350u00b0 uncovered for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Five Cup Salad
directions: Mix all and chill well before serving.
recipes.text: Five Cup Salad. Mix all and chill well before serving.

recipes.title: Orange Glaze
directions: In medium size saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch.
Add juices slowly and stir until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat until thick and glossy (mixture will be thin). Cool.
Spread on any type of pound cake.
If desired, split cake into 3 layers.
Pour glaze between the layers and over the top and sides of the cake.
(Very good on Carrot Pound Cake.) Makes about 1 1/4 cups.
recipes.text: Orange Glaze. In medium size saucepan, combine sugar and cornstarch. Add juices slowly and stir until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat until thick and glossy (mixture will be thin). Cool. Spread on any type of pound cake. If desired, split cake into 3 layers. Pour glaze between the layers and over the top and sides of the cake. (Very good on Carrot Pound Cake.) Makes about 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Tuna Cashew Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except noodles.
Bake 15 minutes at 375u00b0. Sprinkle noodles on top.
recipes.text: Tuna Cashew Casserole. Mix all ingredients except noodles. Bake 15 minutes at 375u00b0. Sprinkle noodles on top.

recipes.title: Sheet Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp. baking soda, dissolved in 1 c. boiling water
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Glaze with powdered sugar and milk icing while still hot.
recipes.text: Sheet Cookies. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes. Glaze with powdered sugar and milk icing while still hot.

recipes.title: Country Breakfast Pie
directions: Mix cheese with sausage.
Combine remaining ingredients; mix well.
Add to sausage and cheese.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375u00b0.
Cool 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Country Breakfast Pie. Mix cheese with sausage. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Add to sausage and cheese. Pour into pie shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375u00b0. Cool 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Penthouse Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Kraft Deluxe macaroni and cheese dinner
directions: Prepare Kraft dinner as directed on package.
Add soup, tuna fish, mushrooms, milk and onion; mix well.
Pour into a 2-quart casserole.
recipes.text: Penthouse Casserole. Prepare Kraft dinner as directed on package. Add soup, tuna fish, mushrooms, milk and onion; mix well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole.

recipes.title: Maple Pumpkin Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 300u00b0.
Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.
In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
Add pumpkin, eggs, 1/4 cup maple syrup, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Mix well.
Pour into prepared crust. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes (center will be slightly soft).
Cool. Chill 3 to 4 hours.
Garnish each slice with remaining maple syrup and chopped pecans.
Refrigerate any leftovers.
This cheesecake also freezes well.
recipes.text: Maple Pumpkin Cheesecake. Preheat oven to 300u00b0. Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add pumpkin, eggs, 1/4 cup maple syrup, cinnamon and nutmeg. Mix well. Pour into prepared crust. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes (center will be slightly soft). Cool. Chill 3 to 4 hours. Garnish each slice with remaining maple syrup and chopped pecans. Refrigerate any leftovers. This cheesecake also freezes well.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Drain oranges well.
Beat eggs.
Add oranges and dry ingredients, sifted together.
Beat 4 minutes with electric beater on slow speed so some flakes of orange are showing.
Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Cake. Drain oranges well. Beat eggs. Add oranges and dry ingredients, sifted together. Beat 4 minutes with electric beater on slow speed so some flakes of orange are showing. Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Squares
directions: Cream together butter and
brown
sugar.
Add
flour and nuts, mix with hands to make
crumb
mixture.
Reserve
one cup for topping.
Press remainder into bottom of 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to
minutes
until
light brown.
Cool. Blend together granulated sugar
and cream cheese until smooth. Add milk.
Add
egg, lemon
juice
and
vanilla.
Beat
well. Spread over baked crust.
Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cut into squares after baking for
25 minutes at 350u00b0.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Cheese Squares. Cream together butter and brown sugar. Add flour and nuts, mix with hands to make crumb mixture. Reserve one cup for topping. Press remainder into bottom of 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until light brown. Cool. Blend together granulated sugar and cream cheese until smooth. Add milk. Add egg, lemon juice and vanilla. Beat well. Spread over baked crust. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cut into squares after baking for 25 minutes at 350u00b0. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Glorious Taco Mess
ingredients: 1 medium onion, chopped or 1/3 c. minced dried onions
directions: Put all in a large crock-pot and simmer for 2 hours.
It can be cooked all day in a crock-pot on low.
recipes.text: Glorious Taco Mess. Put all in a large crock-pot and simmer for 2 hours. It can be cooked all day in a crock-pot on low.

recipes.title: Overnight Dinner Rolls
directions: Mix yeast and warm water.
Add eggs, sugar, warm water, oil, salt and flour.
Cover overnight.
Next morning divide into 3 sections and roll in circles.
Cut like pie into 8ths.
Roll into crescent shape.
Raise on greased cookie sheet until church is out.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Overnight Dinner Rolls. Mix yeast and warm water. Add eggs, sugar, warm water, oil, salt and flour. Cover overnight. Next morning divide into 3 sections and roll in circles. Cut like pie into 8ths. Roll into crescent shape. Raise on greased cookie sheet until church is out. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Cooked Play Dough(For Kiddies)
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Add oil and water.
Cook in a large pan until it pulls away from the sides.
Knead a little.
Knead in powdered tempera and mint extract.
Form into balls and store in plastic bags.
This keeps quite a while.
recipes.text: Cooked Play Dough(For Kiddies). Mix dry ingredients. Add oil and water. Cook in a large pan until it pulls away from the sides. Knead a little. Knead in powdered tempera and mint extract. Form into balls and store in plastic bags. This keeps quite a while.

recipes.title: Pink Or Green Punch
directions: Mix sugar, Kool-Aid and water.
Can be done at night before refrigerated.
Pour Kool-Aid in the punch bowl.
Add frozen lemonade, partially thawed, and pineapple juice.
Mix all together and add ginger ale.
If punch taste is strong, add more ginger ale.
recipes.text: Pink Or Green Punch. Mix sugar, Kool-Aid and water. Can be done at night before refrigerated. Pour Kool-Aid in the punch bowl. Add frozen lemonade, partially thawed, and pineapple juice. Mix all together and add ginger ale. If punch taste is strong, add more ginger ale.

recipes.title: Chicken Livers Paste
directions: Put oil in pan.
Add livers, onions and add spices to pan. Season to taste.
Grind up livers when cooked, add ground eggs to livers and mix.
This recipe is for 30 livers, 8 eggs and 6 large onions.
recipes.text: Chicken Livers Paste. Put oil in pan. Add livers, onions and add spices to pan. Season to taste. Grind up livers when cooked, add ground eggs to livers and mix. This recipe is for 30 livers, 8 eggs and 6 large onions.

recipes.title: Polish Christmas Eve Soup
ingredients: 3 cans beef broth as part of 3 qt. water *
directions: Slice fresh mushrooms.
Add with imported mushrooms to water; boil approximately 45 minutes.
Add noodles; boil another 20 minutes.
Add drained lima beans.
Cook another 20 minutes.
Brown flour in iron skillet and add enough water to make paste.
Add to soup and stir.
Cook another 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Polish Christmas Eve Soup. Slice fresh mushrooms. Add with imported mushrooms to water; boil approximately 45 minutes. Add noodles; boil another 20 minutes. Add drained lima beans. Cook another 20 minutes. Brown flour in iron skillet and add enough water to make paste. Add to soup and stir. Cook another 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Salad Dip
ingredients: 1/2 c. each: chopped tomato and onion
directions: Line dish (round or pie pan) with beans.
Spread avocado on top of beans.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and taco sauce together; spread over avocado.
Spread salsa sauce over mixture.
Sprinkle tomato, onion and then the cheese on top.
Serve with taco or corn chips.
recipes.text: Taco Salad Dip. Line dish (round or pie pan) with beans. Spread avocado on top of beans. Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and taco sauce together; spread over avocado. Spread salsa sauce over mixture. Sprinkle tomato, onion and then the cheese on top. Serve with taco or corn chips.

recipes.title: Baked (Or Grilled) Vidalia Onions
directions: Peel onion.
Pare onion, leaving 1/4-inch on bottom of onion. Fill with bouillon cube and butter.
Wrap in foil, sealing tightly.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or grill for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked (Or Grilled) Vidalia Onions. Peel onion. Pare onion, leaving 1/4-inch on bottom of onion. Fill with bouillon cube and butter. Wrap in foil, sealing tightly. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or grill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Crush graham crackers and mix sugar and melted butter.
Pour into casserole dish.
Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar, & cool whip.
After mixing, pour over top of graham crackers.
Then spread blueberry filling on top.
Put in refrigerator and let set.
recipes.text: Blueberry Pie. Crush graham crackers and mix sugar and melted butter. Pour into casserole dish. Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar, & cool whip. After mixing, pour over top of graham crackers. Then spread blueberry filling on top. Put in refrigerator and let set.

recipes.title: Almond Cookies
directions: Use stack pack plus 4 crackers.
Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil.
Place single layer of Club crackers on foil.
In heavy saucepan combine sugar and butter; heat until sugar melts. Pour over crackers.
recipes.text: Almond Cookies. Use stack pack plus 4 crackers. Line cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Place single layer of Club crackers on foil. In heavy saucepan combine sugar and butter; heat until sugar melts. Pour over crackers.

recipes.title: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford
directions: Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
Cool.
recipes.text: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford. Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350u00b0. Cool.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. strawberry jello (regular or sugar-free)
directions: In double boiler, mix the water and cornstarch; cook until clear.
Put in bowl.
Add the jello.
Add the strawberries; stir together.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Chill; add whipped cream. May add sugar to jello and berries while mixing.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. In double boiler, mix the water and cornstarch; cook until clear. Put in bowl. Add the jello. Add the strawberries; stir together. Pour into baked pie shell. Chill; add whipped cream. May add sugar to jello and berries while mixing.

recipes.title: Tuna Loaf
ingredients: onion, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Melt margarine in hot milk.
Add fish, crumbs and seasonings. Add eggs, sour cream, grated carrots and frozen peas.
Mix well and put in greased 8 x 8-inch or 5 x 7-inch pan.
Sprinkle lightly with cornflake crumbs and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Loaf. Melt margarine in hot milk. Add fish, crumbs and seasonings. Add eggs, sour cream, grated carrots and frozen peas. Mix well and put in greased 8 x 8-inch or 5 x 7-inch pan. Sprinkle lightly with cornflake crumbs and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Melt
margarine, sugar and milk and boil for 8 minutes. Set aside
andtadd
chocolatetnuggets and Hip-O-Lite.
Beat until smooth, then add nuts.
Pour in greased Pyrex dish.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge. Melt margarine, sugar and milk and boil for 8 minutes. Set aside andtadd chocolatetnuggets and Hip-O-Lite. Beat until smooth, then add nuts. Pour in greased Pyrex dish.

recipes.title: Peppered Flank Steak
directions: Mix 1st
four ingredients and rub on steak, both sides. Let stand 5 minutes.
Broil or grill.
Slice thinly.
recipes.text: Peppered Flank Steak. Mix 1st four ingredients and rub on steak, both sides. Let stand 5 minutes. Broil or grill. Slice thinly.

recipes.title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Mix shortening, sugar, eggs, rum flavoring, flour, baking soda and unsweetened pineapple juice together.
Mix the mixed fruit, candied cherries, pineapple, dates, raisins and flour together.
Combine the two mixtures together and add the coconut and walnuts.
Mix all together.
Pour into greased bread loaf pans.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.
Makes approximately 3 to 4 loaves.
recipes.text: White Fruit Cake. Mix shortening, sugar, eggs, rum flavoring, flour, baking soda and unsweetened pineapple juice together. Mix the mixed fruit, candied cherries, pineapple, dates, raisins and flour together. Combine the two mixtures together and add the coconut and walnuts. Mix all together. Pour into greased bread loaf pans. Bake at 275u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours. Makes approximately 3 to 4 loaves.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. rice or pkg. of Near East rice pilaf
1 pkg. frozen broccoli or 1 head fresh
1 can Durkee French fried onion rings
directions: Cook rice according to directions.
Cook broccoli until tender.
In a large pan, melt together Cheez Whiz and cream of mushroom soup.
Stir until well blended.
Add rice and broccoli; mix together.
Put in an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish.
Heat in 350u00b0 oven until sides bubble (approximately 15 minutes).
Sprinkle with French fried onion rings.
Brown for 5 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Rice Casserole. Cook rice according to directions. Cook broccoli until tender. In a large pan, melt together Cheez Whiz and cream of mushroom soup. Stir until well blended. Add rice and broccoli; mix together. Put in an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Heat in 350u00b0 oven until sides bubble (approximately 15 minutes). Sprinkle with French fried onion rings. Brown for 5 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Instant Cocoa
directions: Mix and store in airtight container.
Put 1/4 cup in mug; add hot water.
recipes.text: Instant Cocoa. Mix and store in airtight container. Put 1/4 cup in mug; add hot water.

recipes.title: Easy Apple Dumplings
ingredients: 5 medium cooking apples, peeled and quartered
directions: Pull biscuits apart,
making
thinner
biscuits
(20 pieces).
Wrap apple quarters in biscuit dough, pinching dough together
around edges.
Place dumplings in 9 x 13-inch pan or large
baking
dish.
Melttbutter; stir in sugar and let dissolve.
Add
water.
Let come to a boil.
Pour over dumplings. Bake
at
350u00b0 (covered) for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender. Uncover and bake until golden brown.
recipes.text: Easy Apple Dumplings. Pull biscuits apart, making 2 thinner biscuits (20 pieces). Wrap apple quarters in biscuit dough, pinching dough together around edges. Place dumplings in 9 x 13-inch pan or large baking dish. Melttbutter; stir in sugar and let dissolve. Add water. Let come to a boil. Pour over dumplings. Bake at 350u00b0 (covered) for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender. Uncover and bake until golden brown.

recipes.title: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
directions: Wrap water chestnuts with bacon; insert toothpick.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.
Drain fat.
Combine ketchup, sugar and soy sauce.
Pour over top and bake for 30 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts. Wrap water chestnuts with bacon; insert toothpick. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour. Drain fat. Combine ketchup, sugar and soy sauce. Pour over top and bake for 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Mix all ingredients together except corn meal.
When well mixed, add corn meal.
Pour into greased cast-iron skillet.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Bread. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Mix all ingredients together except corn meal. When well mixed, add corn meal. Pour into greased cast-iron skillet. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Bacon Chowder
directions: Fry bacon until crisp in a 3-quart saucepan.
Add onions and saute 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour off fat.
Add potatoes and water. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Stir in soup and sour cream; gradually add milk.
Add salt, pepper and parsley.
Heat to serving temperature. Do not boil.
Makes 7 cups.
recipes.text: Potato Bacon Chowder. Fry bacon until crisp in a 3-quart saucepan. Add onions and saute 2 to 3 minutes. Pour off fat. Add potatoes and water. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir in soup and sour cream; gradually add milk. Add salt, pepper and parsley. Heat to serving temperature. Do not boil. Makes 7 cups.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Raisin Cookies
directions: In a small bowl, using a mixer, beat eggs until fluffy.
Set aside.
In another large bowl, cream butter and brown sugar.
When fluffy, gradually add beaten egg, vanilla and water.
In another bowl, sift together flour, baking soda and salt.
Pour half of sifted ingredients into creamed mixture.
Stir together. Gradually add rest of batter.
Add cinnamon and raisins.
Place 1 heaping teaspoon 1 1/2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Raisin Cookies. In a small bowl, using a mixer, beat eggs until fluffy. Set aside. In another large bowl, cream butter and brown sugar. When fluffy, gradually add beaten egg, vanilla and water. In another bowl, sift together flour, baking soda and salt. Pour half of sifted ingredients into creamed mixture. Stir together. Gradually add rest of batter. Add cinnamon and raisins. Place 1 heaping teaspoon 1 1/2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Mix flour, sugar and blueberries to coat fruit.
Combine shortening, milk and egg.
Add this to the dry mixture.
Stir until mixed thoroughly.
Spoon into muffin pans.
Bake about 12 to 15 minutes at 450u00b0.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins. Mix flour, sugar and blueberries to coat fruit. Combine shortening, milk and egg. Add this to the dry mixture. Stir until mixed thoroughly. Spoon into muffin pans. Bake about 12 to 15 minutes at 450u00b0. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
ingredients: 1 tsp. baking soda, dissolved in hot water
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour, ginger, cinnamon and soda together.
Add alternately with buttermilk.
Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Gingerbread. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour, ginger, cinnamon and soda together. Add alternately with buttermilk. Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots
directions: Cut carrots in half crosswise, then lengthwise into 2 or 3 sticks.
Simmer, covered, in a small amount of boiling, salted water, about 10 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Drain.
recipes.text: Glazed Carrots. Cut carrots in half crosswise, then lengthwise into 2 or 3 sticks. Simmer, covered, in a small amount of boiling, salted water, about 10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Wash and dry chicken thoroughly and rub with pepper.
Puncture 2 lemons 20 times each and place inside chicken.
Skewer and tie legs loosely.
Place breast side down in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.
Turn breast side up and cook for another 20 minutes. Raise temperature to 400u00b0 and cook for another 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Chicken. Wash and dry chicken thoroughly and rub with pepper. Puncture 2 lemons 20 times each and place inside chicken. Skewer and tie legs loosely. Place breast side down in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Turn breast side up and cook for another 20 minutes. Raise temperature to 400u00b0 and cook for another 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chiles Rellenos With Cheese
directions: You will need 6 toothpicks.
recipes.text: Chiles Rellenos With Cheese. You will need 6 toothpicks.

recipes.title: Eggnog
directions: Beat egg whites separately; set aside.
Beat egg yolks until thick, then fold in egg whites.
Add 1 cup of sugar, milk and rum. Beat heavy cream until thick and add to mixture.
Add the store-bought eggnog.
recipes.text: Eggnog. Beat egg whites separately; set aside. Beat egg yolks until thick, then fold in egg whites. Add 1 cup of sugar, milk and rum. Beat heavy cream until thick and add to mixture. Add the store-bought eggnog.

recipes.title: Cherry Fluff
directions: Mix wafers, sugar and butter.
Press half of mixture into 9 x 11-inch pan; chill.
Melt marshmallows with milk; cool.
Whip Dream Whip and mix with marshmallow and milk mixture.
Pour half on crumbs; chill.
Add cherry pie mix over this; cover with other half of marshmallow mixture.
Use remaining crumbs on top; chill.
recipes.text: Cherry Fluff. Mix wafers, sugar and butter. Press half of mixture into 9 x 11-inch pan; chill. Melt marshmallows with milk; cool. Whip Dream Whip and mix with marshmallow and milk mixture. Pour half on crumbs; chill. Add cherry pie mix over this; cover with other half of marshmallow mixture. Use remaining crumbs on top; chill.

recipes.title: Instant Rice Pudding
directions: Make any flavor instant pudding.
Mix in cooked rice. Refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Instant Rice Pudding. Make any flavor instant pudding. Mix in cooked rice. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Turkey Dressing
directions: Cook onions and celery until tender.
Mix with other ingredients.
Bake 30 minutes at 300u00b0.
recipes.text: Turkey Dressing. Cook onions and celery until tender. Mix with other ingredients. Bake 30 minutes at 300u00b0.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1 small container small curd cottage cheese
directions: Drain pineapple well.
Mix Cool Whip, strawberry Jell-O, cottage cheese and drained pineapple in a large bowl.
Cut strawberries in small chunks and fold into mixture carefully. Chill for about 1 hour.
Serve cold.
recipes.text: Strawberry Delight. Drain pineapple well. Mix Cool Whip, strawberry Jell-O, cottage cheese and drained pineapple in a large bowl. Cut strawberries in small chunks and fold into mixture carefully. Chill for about 1 hour. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: In heavy saucepan, stir cream and butter and melt to barely a boil; stir in sugar until dissolved.
Reduce heat; with wire whisk, stir in salt and cocoa until smooth.
Serve over ice cream and store in glass jar.
Reheat 1 to 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Sauce. In heavy saucepan, stir cream and butter and melt to barely a boil; stir in sugar until dissolved. Reduce heat; with wire whisk, stir in salt and cocoa until smooth. Serve over ice cream and store in glass jar. Reheat 1 to 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Carrots
directions: Place carrots in casserole.
Cream butter, sugar, salt and cinnamon together.
Add water.
Blend well.
Pour over carrots. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Baked Carrots. Place carrots in casserole. Cream butter, sugar, salt and cinnamon together. Add water. Blend well. Pour over carrots. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Alabama Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Alabama Cornbread. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can Green Giant tender peas
directions: Mix cooled, drained macaroni with sandwich spread.
Add onion, celery seed and drained peas.
Toss well, but gently.
If not sour enough, add more sandwich spread.
Place in covered plastic or glass container and chill.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Mix cooled, drained macaroni with sandwich spread. Add onion, celery seed and drained peas. Toss well, but gently. If not sour enough, add more sandwich spread. Place in covered plastic or glass container and chill.

recipes.title: Peach Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 package sour cream or white cake mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan.
Mix 2/3 c. dry cake mix, brown sugar, pecans and margarine until crumbly, set aside.
Beat eggs slightly with fork.
Blend in sour cream.
Mix in remaining cake mix.
Batter will be thick and slightly lumpy.
Spread 1/2 batter into pan.
Top with 1/2 of the peaches and sprinkle with 1/2 the brown sugar mixture.
Spoon and gently spread remaining batter over brown sugar layer.
Top with peaches and sprinkle remaining brown sugar mixture on top.
Bake for 55-60 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Coffee Cake. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan. Mix 2/3 c. dry cake mix, brown sugar, pecans and margarine until crumbly, set aside. Beat eggs slightly with fork. Blend in sour cream. Mix in remaining cake mix. Batter will be thick and slightly lumpy. Spread 1/2 batter into pan. Top with 1/2 of the peaches and sprinkle with 1/2 the brown sugar mixture. Spoon and gently spread remaining batter over brown sugar layer. Top with peaches and sprinkle remaining brown sugar mixture on top. Bake for 55-60 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork And Cabbage Oriental
directions: Saute onion in 3 tablespoons oil until clear; remove. Add meat to oil and brown.
Add soy sauce and simmer for 30 to 60 minutes. Add cabbage and cover.
Stir occasionally and simmer until cabbage is soft, about 30 minutes.
Serve with rice noodles.
recipes.text: Pork And Cabbage Oriental. Saute onion in 3 tablespoons oil until clear; remove. Add meat to oil and brown. Add soy sauce and simmer for 30 to 60 minutes. Add cabbage and cover. Stir occasionally and simmer until cabbage is soft, about 30 minutes. Serve with rice noodles.

recipes.title: Betty'S Raisin Bread
directions: Bake in 2 loaf pans.
recipes.text: Betty'S Raisin Bread. Bake in 2 loaf pans.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine and mix first 5 ingredients.
Spread half of mixture in a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Cover with chilies and cheese. Spread remaining batter over top.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Combine and mix first 5 ingredients. Spread half of mixture in a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cover with chilies and cheese. Spread remaining batter over top. Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Syrup
directions: In a heavy-bottomed 2-quart pan, combine first 6 ingredients. Set over medium-low heat and stir frequently with a wire whisk. Boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool. Add remaining ingredients. Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Chocolate Syrup. In a heavy-bottomed 2-quart pan, combine first 6 ingredients. Set over medium-low heat and stir frequently with a wire whisk. Boil for 3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool. Add remaining ingredients. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Easy And Quick Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in an average size dish.
Add milk to flour and sugar.
Mix these 3 ingredients thoroughly and add to butter; add fruit.
Do not stir.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Easy And Quick Cobbler. Melt butter in an average size dish. Add milk to flour and sugar. Mix these 3 ingredients thoroughly and add to butter; add fruit. Do not stir. Bake at 375u00b0 for 40 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Jewish Apple Cake
directions: Peel and slice apples thin.
Add sugar and cinnamon; mix and set aside.
recipes.text: Jewish Apple Cake. Peel and slice apples thin. Add sugar and cinnamon; mix and set aside.

recipes.title: Mama'S Tea Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 3 Tbsp. buttermilk
directions: Use flour enough to make a soft dough.
Roll thin and cut into desired shapes.
Dough will roll better if it sits awhile.
Bake on well-greased cookie sheet at 325u00b0 to 350u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Mama'S Tea Cakes. Use flour enough to make a soft dough. Roll thin and cut into desired shapes. Dough will roll better if it sits awhile. Bake on well-greased cookie sheet at 325u00b0 to 350u00b0 for 6 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Cone Cake
ingredients: your favorite two layer cake batter
directions: You will need aluminum foil, in strips 9 inches wide by 9 1/2 inches long (one per cone).
recipes.text: Ice Cream Cone Cake. You will need aluminum foil, in strips 9 inches wide by 9 1/2 inches long (one per cone).

recipes.title: Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 cans cream soup (celery, mushroom or chicken)
directions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot, except croutons. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours.
Serve in warm bowls.
Top each serving with crisp croutons.
recipes.text: Cheese Soup. Put all ingredients in crock-pot, except croutons. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours. Serve in warm bowls. Top each serving with crisp croutons.

recipes.title: Snow Ice Cream
directions: Whip milk, eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla together with egg beater.
Stir in enough snow to get ice cream consistency.
Serve.
recipes.text: Snow Ice Cream. Whip milk, eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla together with egg beater. Stir in enough snow to get ice cream consistency. Serve.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Cobbler
directions: Peel potatoes and cut in thin slices.
Put in deep casserole dish.
Combine sugar, flour, salt and nutmeg.
Add to potatoes, along with water.
Cut butter in small pieces and layer over ingredients.
Cover with favorite pastry.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Cobbler. Peel potatoes and cut in thin slices. Put in deep casserole dish. Combine sugar, flour, salt and nutmeg. Add to potatoes, along with water. Cut butter in small pieces and layer over ingredients. Cover with favorite pastry. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Crunchy Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 10 1/2 oz. can condensed cream of chicken soup
10 1/2 oz. can cream of mushroom soup
1 1/2 c. crackers, coarsely crushed or 1 can onion rings for topping
directions: Simmer chicken in 1/4 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon salt 45 minutes or until tender.
Remove meat in large pieces from bone. Also remove skin.
Blend soups and mayonnaise.
Add remaining ingredients except topping.
Place mixture in 2-quart baking dish. Top with crushed crackers or other topping.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Crunchy Chicken Casserole. Simmer chicken in 1/4 cup water and 1/2 teaspoon salt 45 minutes or until tender. Remove meat in large pieces from bone. Also remove skin. Blend soups and mayonnaise. Add remaining ingredients except topping. Place mixture in 2-quart baking dish. Top with crushed crackers or other topping. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together with enough mayonnaise to moisten. (Maybe enough pickle juice to taste.) Salt and pepper to taste. Serve on lettuce leaf or with crackers.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad. Mix ingredients together with enough mayonnaise to moisten. (Maybe enough pickle juice to taste.) Salt and pepper to taste. Serve on lettuce leaf or with crackers.

recipes.title: Apple And Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 1/4 c. heavy cream (I've used canned milk in a pinch)
directions: Cut squash in half, seed and peel.
Peel, core and coarsely chop the apples.

Peel and coarsely chop the onion or put all in blender and chop. Combine all ingredients with herbs, broth, water, bread, salt and pepper in heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil and simmer 45 minutes. Puree in blender, filling only 1/4 full at a time. Return soup to saucepan and bring just to a boil. Add cream and serve at once.
recipes.text: Apple And Butternut Squash Soup. Cut squash in half, seed and peel. Peel, core and coarsely chop the apples. Peel and coarsely chop the onion or put all in blender and chop. Combine all ingredients with herbs, broth, water, bread, salt and pepper in heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil and simmer 45 minutes. Puree in blender, filling only 1/4 full at a time. Return soup to saucepan and bring just to a boil. Add cream and serve at once.

recipes.title: Oscar'S Kitty Cookies
directions: Allow cheese and margarine to become room temperature.
Mix together adding garlic and flour.
Add enough milk to help form into a ball.
Chill 1 hour.
recipes.text: Oscar'S Kitty Cookies. Allow cheese and margarine to become room temperature. Mix together adding garlic and flour. Add enough milk to help form into a ball. Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. each: frozen spinach and frozen broccoli, thawed
directions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions; drain. Saute mushrooms and onion in skillet until tender.
Add Italian seasoning; mix well.
Melt margarine over low heat in large saucepan.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper gradually until smooth; stir in milk.
Bring to a boil.
Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly; remove from heat.
Stir in 1/4 cup Mozzarella cheese. Squeeze spinach dry.
Chop spinach and broccoli.
Combine with carrots in bowl; mix well.
Combine Ricotta cheese and egg in bowl; mix well.
Layer 1 cup white sauce, vegetables, noodles, Ricotta cheese mixture, mushroom mixture and remaining white sauce in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Yield: 8 servings.
recipes.text: Vegetable Lasagna. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions; drain. Saute mushrooms and onion in skillet until tender. Add Italian seasoning; mix well. Melt margarine over low heat in large saucepan. Stir in flour, salt and pepper gradually until smooth; stir in milk. Bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly; remove from heat. Stir in 1/4 cup Mozzarella cheese. Squeeze spinach dry. Chop spinach and broccoli. Combine with carrots in bowl; mix well. Combine Ricotta cheese and egg in bowl; mix well. Layer 1 cup white sauce, vegetables, noodles, Ricotta cheese mixture, mushroom mixture and remaining white sauce in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Flaky Pie Crust
directions: Combine flour, sugar and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Blend vinegar, egg and water.
Stir in flour until it forms a ball. Chill 15 minutes and then divide into fourths.
Makes four 9-inch crusts.
recipes.text: Flaky Pie Crust. Combine flour, sugar and salt. Cut in shortening. Blend vinegar, egg and water. Stir in flour until it forms a ball. Chill 15 minutes and then divide into fourths. Makes four 9-inch crusts.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Sift flour and soda and add to the butter mixture alternately with sour cream and vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan or 10-inch Bundt pan.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes (or until cake tests done).
Cool 15 minutes, then remove from pan.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Pound Cake. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Sift flour and soda and add to the butter mixture alternately with sour cream and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan or 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes (or until cake tests done). Cool 15 minutes, then remove from pan.

recipes.title: Onion-Mushroom Gravy
directions: In a medium saucepan, mix soup mix and flour. Stir in water. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes, or until gravy is thickened. Makes about 2 cups of gravy.
recipes.text: Onion-Mushroom Gravy. In a medium saucepan, mix soup mix and flour. Stir in water. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes, or until gravy is thickened. Makes about 2 cups of gravy.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 2 (9-inch) deep dish pie shells, baked and cooled
1 (20 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
1/4 c. ReaLemon concentrate (comes in green bottle)
directions: Mix Cool Whip, Eagle Brand milk and food coloring.
Add pineapple, strawberries and nuts.
Mix well.
Add lemon concentrate last; mix.
This makes the mixture stiff.
Put into 2 pie shells and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Mix Cool Whip, Eagle Brand milk and food coloring. Add pineapple, strawberries and nuts. Mix well. Add lemon concentrate last; mix. This makes the mixture stiff. Put into 2 pie shells and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Place the apples in a greased 9 inch pie dish.
In a bowl, combine sugar, flour, oats, cinnamon, and allspice; cut in butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle over apples.
Bake at 375 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Place the apples in a greased 9 inch pie dish. In a bowl, combine sugar, flour, oats, cinnamon, and allspice; cut in butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Pasta Salad
directions: Cook and cool macaroni shells.
Combine Italian dressing and milk.
Pour over macaroni, chicken and vegetables.
This is great as a meal in itself.
recipes.text: Chicken Pasta Salad. Cook and cool macaroni shells. Combine Italian dressing and milk. Pour over macaroni, chicken and vegetables. This is great as a meal in itself.

recipes.title: Date Nut Cake
directions: Dissolve soda in hot water and pour over dates.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Add chopped nuts to cake mixture.
Make a stiff batter. Pour in loaf pan and bake in slow oven at 300u00b0 to 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Date Nut Cake. Dissolve soda in hot water and pour over dates. Let stand 10 minutes. Add chopped nuts to cake mixture. Make a stiff batter. Pour in loaf pan and bake in slow oven at 300u00b0 to 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except crumbs and margarine. Pour into a baking dish.
Top with bread crumbs which have been mixed with margarine.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Oriental Chicken Casserole. Mix together all ingredients, except crumbs and margarine. Pour into a baking dish. Top with bread crumbs which have been mixed with margarine. Bake for 45 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix brownie mix with egg and water.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool.
Mix pudding with 2 cups milk, then fold in 8 ounces of Cool Whip.
Top with the rest of Cool Whip and break Heath bars up.
Top off with the candy.
recipes.text: Death By Chocolate Cake. Mix brownie mix with egg and water. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Mix pudding with 2 cups milk, then fold in 8 ounces of Cool Whip. Top with the rest of Cool Whip and break Heath bars up. Top off with the candy.

recipes.title: Texas Caviar
directions: Brown meats; add other ingredients and simmer until fairly thick.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Texas Caviar. Brown meats; add other ingredients and simmer until fairly thick. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Mix all but rice with fork.
Mix 2 cups cold milk and 4 tablespoons cornstarch.
Dissolve.
Boil, stirring constantly. Mix all ingredients together.
Beat served at room temperature. Does keep but not well.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Mix all but rice with fork. Mix 2 cups cold milk and 4 tablespoons cornstarch. Dissolve. Boil, stirring constantly. Mix all ingredients together. Beat served at room temperature. Does keep but not well.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Rice Krispies Bars
directions: Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter and stir until mixed.
Pour over Rice Krispies. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread mixture in pan and let cool.
May frost with chocolate icing.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Rice Krispies Bars. Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and stir until mixed. Pour over Rice Krispies. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread mixture in pan and let cool. May frost with chocolate icing.

recipes.title: Ham-And-Corn Chowder
ingredients: 3 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen cream-style corn, thawed
directions: Saute ham, celery and onion in butter in a Dutch oven.
Stir in the next 5 ingredients; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Ham-And-Corn Chowder. Saute ham, celery and onion in butter in a Dutch oven. Stir in the next 5 ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Quickie Pie
directions: Mix first four ingredients.
It will become a thin batter. Melt 1 stick of butter in a 9 x 14 pan.
Pour batter over melted butter.
Don't mix - just pour.
Choose your fruit.
If fresh, add enough sugar to your taste and cook 15 minutes slowly.
Pour fruit (and juice) on top of butter and batter.
If canned fruit, pour entire can (fruit & juice) on top of the butter and batter.
Do not stir or mix.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 30 minutes (until brown).
Delicious and so easy and quick.
recipes.text: Quickie Pie. Mix first four ingredients. It will become a thin batter. Melt 1 stick of butter in a 9 x 14 pan. Pour batter over melted butter. Don't mix - just pour. Choose your fruit. If fresh, add enough sugar to your taste and cook 15 minutes slowly. Pour fruit (and juice) on top of butter and batter. If canned fruit, pour entire can (fruit & juice) on top of the butter and batter. Do not stir or mix. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 - 30 minutes (until brown). Delicious and so easy and quick.

recipes.title: Carnival Candy Apples
directions: Butter cookie sheet generously.
Mix sugar, water, syrup and coloring in heavy saucepan.
Boil, without stirring, until reaching hard-crack stage.
Push sticks in apples through stem side.
Dip apples quickly in syrup, twirling until completely covered.
Stand on cookie sheet.
Chill in refrigerator until hardened.
recipes.text: Carnival Candy Apples. Butter cookie sheet generously. Mix sugar, water, syrup and coloring in heavy saucepan. Boil, without stirring, until reaching hard-crack stage. Push sticks in apples through stem side. Dip apples quickly in syrup, twirling until completely covered. Stand on cookie sheet. Chill in refrigerator until hardened.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Put in an oblong pan.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix all ingredients together. Salt and pepper to taste. Put in an oblong pan.

recipes.title: No Bake Cheesecake
directions: Beat ingredients together until smooth.
Pour into baked and cooled 8 inch graham cracker crust.
Top with pie filling.
Chill or freeze.
recipes.text: No Bake Cheesecake. Beat ingredients together until smooth. Pour into baked and cooled 8 inch graham cracker crust. Top with pie filling. Chill or freeze.

recipes.title: Simple Brownies
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines Butter Recipe fudge or yellow cake
directions: Mix cake mix, eggs and oil until it cleans the sides of bowl. Press in greased 9 x 12-inch pan.
Cover with chocolate chips and nuts.
Press in.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
Test with toothpick.
Cut when cool.
recipes.text: Simple Brownies. Mix cake mix, eggs and oil until it cleans the sides of bowl. Press in greased 9 x 12-inch pan. Cover with chocolate chips and nuts. Press in. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0. Test with toothpick. Cut when cool.

recipes.title: Cucumber Dip
ingredients: 2 8 oz. pks. of cream cheese soften
directions: Blend cream cheese add all other ingredients mix well. Cover and chill.
recipes.text: Cucumber Dip. Blend cream cheese add all other ingredients mix well. Cover and chill.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell.
Cook for 40 to 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
Makes 1 pie.
Double for 2 pies.
recipes.text: Japanese Fruit Pie. Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Cook for 40 to 45 minutes at 350u00b0. Makes 1 pie. Double for 2 pies.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, heat oil.
Add onions and saute for 3 minutes.
Add water and bouillon cubes.
Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally until cubes dissolve.
Gradually add noodles and salt so that bouillon mixture continues to boil.
Cook, uncovered, for 3 minutes.
Stir in broccoli and garlic powder.
Cook. Add milk and cheese.
Cook until cheese melts.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Broccoli Soup. In a large saucepan, heat oil. Add onions and saute for 3 minutes. Add water and bouillon cubes. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally until cubes dissolve. Gradually add noodles and salt so that bouillon mixture continues to boil. Cook, uncovered, for 3 minutes. Stir in broccoli and garlic powder. Cook. Add milk and cheese. Cook until cheese melts. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Boiled Cookies
directions: In large saucepan, mix sugar, cocoa, butter and milk.
Bring to rolling boil and cook for one minute (until a drop forms soft ball in cold water).
Remove from heat and add oatmeal, peanut butter and vanilla.
Mix well.
Drop by spoonful on wax paper. Let cool.
recipes.text: Boiled Cookies. In large saucepan, mix sugar, cocoa, butter and milk. Bring to rolling boil and cook for one minute (until a drop forms soft ball in cold water). Remove from heat and add oatmeal, peanut butter and vanilla. Mix well. Drop by spoonful on wax paper. Let cool.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix well.
Cut up fruit, what you like and dip as you eat.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Mix well. Cut up fruit, what you like and dip as you eat.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute celery and onion in margarine until tender.
In bowl mix and set aside both cans of soup, Cheez Whiz and rice.
Cook broccoli and add to soup mixture.
Mix in celery and onion.
Pour into pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Saute celery and onion in margarine until tender. In bowl mix and set aside both cans of soup, Cheez Whiz and rice. Cook broccoli and add to soup mixture. Mix in celery and onion. Pour into pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Okra
ingredients: small fresh picked okra (about 4-inches is best)
2 (about 1 lb.) large sweet onions, cut 1-inch thick
directions: Separate onion slices into rings.
Place rings in large bowl of ice water and let soak for 5 minutes.
In large bowl, combine 1 cup flour, buttermilk, egg, vegetable oil, paprika and ground red pepper to form batter.
recipes.text: Southern Fried Okra. Separate onion slices into rings. Place rings in large bowl of ice water and let soak for 5 minutes. In large bowl, combine 1 cup flour, buttermilk, egg, vegetable oil, paprika and ground red pepper to form batter.

recipes.title: Shrimp Party Ring
directions: Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup consomme.
Heat remaining consomme; add softened gelatin to dissolve.
Cool.
In a bowl, beat cream cheese and mayonnaise with a wooden spoon until well blended.
Add cooled consomme and all other ingredients.
Place in a lightly greased 2-quart ring mold or fish mold.
Chill.
Serve on lettuce with French dressing.
Can be prepared the day before serving.
recipes.text: Shrimp Party Ring. Soften gelatin in 1/4 cup consomme. Heat remaining consomme; add softened gelatin to dissolve. Cool. In a bowl, beat cream cheese and mayonnaise with a wooden spoon until well blended. Add cooled consomme and all other ingredients. Place in a lightly greased 2-quart ring mold or fish mold. Chill. Serve on lettuce with French dressing. Can be prepared the day before serving.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Preheat the oven 350u00b0.
In a large mixing bowl, cream the shortening and sugar together.
Add in the eggs and mix thoroughly.
Make a paste of the cocoa and food coloring.
Add into the creamed mixture.
Mix the salt and vanilla with the buttermilk in a small bowl.
Alternately add this and the flour into the creamed mixture.
Mix well.
Mix the baking soda and vinegar together.
Gently fold into the batter mixture.
Bake for 40 minutes.
Remove from oven and allow to cool completely before frosting (recipe to follow).
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Preheat the oven 350u00b0. In a large mixing bowl, cream the shortening and sugar together. Add in the eggs and mix thoroughly. Make a paste of the cocoa and food coloring. Add into the creamed mixture. Mix the salt and vanilla with the buttermilk in a small bowl. Alternately add this and the flour into the creamed mixture. Mix well. Mix the baking soda and vinegar together. Gently fold into the batter mixture. Bake for 40 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely before frosting (recipe to follow).

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
directions: Saute meat about 20 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients, except tomato, and simmer until tender.
Add tomato 5 minutes before serving.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Pepper Steak. Saute meat about 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients, except tomato, and simmer until tender. Add tomato 5 minutes before serving. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush Oreo cookies very fine.
Set aside.
Cream together the cream cheese and butter.
Set aside.
Mix pudding with milk.
Add the Cool Whip and cream cheese mixture to the pudding mixture. Alternate layers of pudding mixture and cookies and end with cookies on top layer.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Crush Oreo cookies very fine. Set aside. Cream together the cream cheese and butter. Set aside. Mix pudding with milk. Add the Cool Whip and cream cheese mixture to the pudding mixture. Alternate layers of pudding mixture and cookies and end with cookies on top layer.

recipes.title: Sloppy Franks
directions: Cover and microwave onion, green peppers and margarine in a 1-quart casserole on High until tender, 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in barbecue sauce, ketchup and franks.
Cover and microwave on High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes.
Stir.
Cover and microwave until mixture boils.
Spoon mixture onto buns on serving plate.
Microwave, uncovered, until buns are hot.
recipes.text: Sloppy Franks. Cover and microwave onion, green peppers and margarine in a 1-quart casserole on High until tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in barbecue sauce, ketchup and franks. Cover and microwave on High for 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Stir. Cover and microwave until mixture boils. Spoon mixture onto buns on serving plate. Microwave, uncovered, until buns are hot.

recipes.title: Mrs. Field'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream together butter and sugars, then add eggs and vanilla. Mix well.
Mix soda, baking powder, salt, flour and oatmeal flour together.
Add it to butter-sugar mix.
Mix all together.
Add chocolate and nuts.
Bake in oven on cookie sheet (greased) at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
(Drop dough on cookie sheet by teaspoonful size.)
Done if when flipped over, bottom is slightly tan.
Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Mrs. Field'S Chocolate Chip Cookies. Cream together butter and sugars, then add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Mix soda, baking powder, salt, flour and oatmeal flour together. Add it to butter-sugar mix. Mix all together. Add chocolate and nuts. Bake in oven on cookie sheet (greased) at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. (Drop dough on cookie sheet by teaspoonful size.) Done if when flipped over, bottom is slightly tan. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Dena'S Oklahoma Slaw
directions: Sprinkle onion on cabbage.
Sprinkle sugar on cabbage and onion.
Do not stir.
Heat to boiling the remaining ingredients. Pour over cabbage mixture, cover quickly and refrigerate at least 4 hours.
recipes.text: Dena'S Oklahoma Slaw. Sprinkle onion on cabbage. Sprinkle sugar on cabbage and onion. Do not stir. Heat to boiling the remaining ingredients. Pour over cabbage mixture, cover quickly and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown ground beef.
Drain grease.
Mix in rest of ingredients. Simmer about 45 minutes on medium to low heat until sauce thickens.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Brown ground beef. Drain grease. Mix in rest of ingredients. Simmer about 45 minutes on medium to low heat until sauce thickens.

recipes.title: Sticky Buns
directions: Make sauce of first 3 ingredients.
Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
When thickened, pour into well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Sticky Buns. Make sauce of first 3 ingredients. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. When thickened, pour into well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Set aside.

recipes.title: Peach Salad
directions: Pour gelatin in pan.
Pour pineapple over this and heat to dissolve.
Cool in refrigerator until begins to congeal.
Add buttermilk and stir.
Congeal a little more, then add nuts and whipped topping.
Stir well and congeal firm.
recipes.text: Peach Salad. Pour gelatin in pan. Pour pineapple over this and heat to dissolve. Cool in refrigerator until begins to congeal. Add buttermilk and stir. Congeal a little more, then add nuts and whipped topping. Stir well and congeal firm.

recipes.title: Old Settler Beans
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Brown hamburger, bacon and onion in skillet. In large pot, add all the beans with juice (do not drain beans). Add meat mixture to beans. In bowl, mix together next 6 ingredients; add to meat and bean mixture.
Bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: Old Settler Beans. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Brown hamburger, bacon and onion in skillet. In large pot, add all the beans with juice (do not drain beans). Add meat mixture to beans. In bowl, mix together next 6 ingredients; add to meat and bean mixture. Bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Amaretto Truffles
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. vanilla or 3 Tbsp. Amaretto liqueur plus 1/2 tsp. almond flavoring or any other favorite flavoring
directions: Melt all together, then add flavorings.
Chill for 2 hours or until firm.
Shape into small balls.
Roll in ground nutmeal, coconut, powdered cocoa, powdered sugar, etc.
recipes.text: Amaretto Truffles. Melt all together, then add flavorings. Chill for 2 hours or until firm. Shape into small balls. Roll in ground nutmeal, coconut, powdered cocoa, powdered sugar, etc.

recipes.title: Super Sunday Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
directions: In bowl, combine Ricotta, spinach, 1/2 of Mozzarella, Parmesan and eggs; mix well.
In 15 x 9-inch dish, layer sauce, lasagna and mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 40 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake an additional 10 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Super Sunday Lasagna. In bowl, combine Ricotta, spinach, 1/2 of Mozzarella, Parmesan and eggs; mix well. In 15 x 9-inch dish, layer sauce, lasagna and mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake an additional 10 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Christmas Beets
ingredients: chopped green onions (include green tops on top for garnish)
directions: Drain and chop beets.
Heat in microwave or on top of stove until warm.
Stir in French dressing.
Place in bowl.
Top with sour cream.
Sprinkle chopped green onions (include green tops) on top for garnish.
recipes.text: Christmas Beets. Drain and chop beets. Heat in microwave or on top of stove until warm. Stir in French dressing. Place in bowl. Top with sour cream. Sprinkle chopped green onions (include green tops) on top for garnish.

recipes.title: Kansas Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 4 medium cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced
directions: In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar and dill; mix well.
Add cucumbers and onions; toss.
Cover and chill for at least 1 hour.
Yield:
8 servings.
recipes.text: Kansas Cucumber Salad. In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar and dill; mix well. Add cucumbers and onions; toss. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Carrots Hawaiian(From Overrock Inn)
ingredients: grated rind and juice of 1 lemon
directions: Cook all ingredients together and thicken with cornstarch.
recipes.text: Carrots Hawaiian(From Overrock Inn). Cook all ingredients together and thicken with cornstarch.

recipes.title: Frosty Cranberry Mold
ingredients: 1 c. heavy cream or 1 (2 oz.) pkg. Dream Whip
1 tart apple, peeled and chopped or diced
directions: Drain pineapple and cranberry sauce.
Save liquid and add enough water to make 2 cups.
Bring to a boil.
Dissolve jello in it and let set slightly.
Beat softened cream cheese and mayonnaise until fluffy.
Gradually add jello mixture.
Fold into whipped cream.
Add fruit, nuts and apples and pour into mold.
recipes.text: Frosty Cranberry Mold. Drain pineapple and cranberry sauce. Save liquid and add enough water to make 2 cups. Bring to a boil. Dissolve jello in it and let set slightly. Beat softened cream cheese and mayonnaise until fluffy. Gradually add jello mixture. Fold into whipped cream. Add fruit, nuts and apples and pour into mold.

recipes.title: Apple Tart
directions: Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl.
Cut in butter until crumbly.
Add 3 tablespoons water, mixing to form ball.
Let stand in lightly floured cloth for 1 hour.
Roll until thin on floured surface.
Line buttered and floured 10-inch pie pan with dough. Cut to fit and prick bottom with fork.
Arrange apples slightly, overlapping on dough.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown.
Spread jelly over hot apples.
recipes.text: Apple Tart. Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl. Cut in butter until crumbly. Add 3 tablespoons water, mixing to form ball. Let stand in lightly floured cloth for 1 hour. Roll until thin on floured surface. Line buttered and floured 10-inch pie pan with dough. Cut to fit and prick bottom with fork. Arrange apples slightly, overlapping on dough. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown. Spread jelly over hot apples.

recipes.title: Creamy Banana Pie
ingredients: juice and grated peel of 1 lemon
directions: Soften gelatine in cold water; set aside.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Blend in the milk and egg yolks.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly, about 20 to 25 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in softened gelatine until dissolved.
Stir in butter and vanilla. Cover the surface of custard with plastic wrap and chill until no longer warm.
Slice 3 bananas.
Fold into custard with whipped cream.
Spoon into pie shell.
Chill until set, about 4 to 5 hours.
recipes.text: Creamy Banana Pie. Soften gelatine in cold water; set aside. In a saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch and salt. Blend in the milk and egg yolks. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly, about 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in softened gelatine until dissolved. Stir in butter and vanilla. Cover the surface of custard with plastic wrap and chill until no longer warm. Slice 3 bananas. Fold into custard with whipped cream. Spoon into pie shell. Chill until set, about 4 to 5 hours.

recipes.title: Neiman-Marcus Cake
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients well and pat into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix and pour over cake mixture the next 4 ingredients.
Bake at 300u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Neiman-Marcus Cake. Mix first 4 ingredients well and pat into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix and pour over cake mixture the next 4 ingredients. Bake at 300u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Slop(A Messy Appetizer)
directions: Blend in blender or food processor by pulsing so there is a texture.
Add vinegar and oil to taste.
Serve with slices of French bread.
recipes.text: Slop(A Messy Appetizer). Blend in blender or food processor by pulsing so there is a texture. Add vinegar and oil to taste. Serve with slices of French bread.

recipes.title: Monterey Rolls
directions: Shred cheese and blend with sherry wine.
Add egg, onion, mustard and salt.
Butter bread and spread with the cheese mixture.
Sprinkle with poppy seed.
Bake at 450u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Monterey Rolls. Shred cheese and blend with sherry wine. Add egg, onion, mustard and salt. Butter bread and spread with the cheese mixture. Sprinkle with poppy seed. Bake at 450u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Muffins
ingredients: 3 ripe bananas, mash with fork and a dash of lemon juice
directions: In medium mixing bowl, combine butter and sugar, mix together until smooth and creamy.
Add eggs, mixing well after each.
Stir in mashed bananas.
Gradually stir in dry ingredients, just until moistened.
Add nuts, mixing gently.
recipes.text: Banana Muffins. In medium mixing bowl, combine butter and sugar, mix together until smooth and creamy. Add eggs, mixing well after each. Stir in mashed bananas. Gradually stir in dry ingredients, just until moistened. Add nuts, mixing gently.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Heat 2 cups milk in double boiler.
Stir in rest of the items and cook until thick.
Beat egg whites and add to cooked mixture. Pour into pie crust.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Heat 2 cups milk in double boiler. Stir in rest of the items and cook until thick. Beat egg whites and add to cooked mixture. Pour into pie crust.

recipes.title: Cavatappi Pompilio
directions: Cook cavatappi according to package directions.
Meanwhile, in a large pot, heat cream and add garlic, onions and mushrooms.
Cook three minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in butter, capicolla ham and basil.
Stir until butter melts.
Add hot pasta, pea pods and sauce, Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Let thicken.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Cavatappi Pompilio. Cook cavatappi according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large pot, heat cream and add garlic, onions and mushrooms. Cook three minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in butter, capicolla ham and basil. Stir until butter melts. Add hot pasta, pea pods and sauce, Parmesan, salt and pepper. Let thicken. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Super Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water.
Add remaining ingredients.
Make biscuits; place on greased pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 until light brown.
recipes.text: Super Biscuits. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Add remaining ingredients. Make biscuits; place on greased pan. Bake at 350u00b0 until light brown.

recipes.title: Raspberry Swirls
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together, work in the flour. Refrigerate for 2 hours.
Mix ingredients for filling & set aside. Roll out the dough (1/2 at a time) as for jelly roll.
Spread 1/2 the filling on and roll up.
Refrigerate overnight.
Slice 1/2 inch thick and bake on greased sheet at 350u00b0.
Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Raspberry Swirls. Mix the first 6 ingredients together, work in the flour. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Mix ingredients for filling & set aside. Roll out the dough (1/2 at a time) as for jelly roll. Spread 1/2 the filling on and roll up. Refrigerate overnight. Slice 1/2 inch thick and bake on greased sheet at 350u00b0. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Mix together and bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 1 hour.
Brown 3 cups
onions
in
Crisco.
Add 1 clove garlic and 1 small can mushroomtpiecestand
stems.
Pour into sauce and cook 2 hours longer.
A little water may be added if sauce gets too thick.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Mix together and bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 1 hour. Brown 3 cups onions in Crisco. Add 1 clove garlic and 1 small can mushroomtpiecestand stems. Pour into sauce and cook 2 hours longer. A little water may be added if sauce gets too thick.

recipes.title: Brunch Eggs
ingredients: fine bread crumbs, sauteed in butter
directions: Fry bacon until done but not crisp. Spray Teflon muffin tin with nonstick spray.
Cover bottom of each muffin receptacle with sauteed bread crumbs. Add spoonful of grated cheese. Circle slice of bacon inside each receptacle.
You can do this the night before having guests for brunch.
recipes.text: Brunch Eggs. Fry bacon until done but not crisp. Spray Teflon muffin tin with nonstick spray. Cover bottom of each muffin receptacle with sauteed bread crumbs. Add spoonful of grated cheese. Circle slice of bacon inside each receptacle. You can do this the night before having guests for brunch.

recipes.title: Cheddar Ham Chowder
directions: In large saucepan, bring water, potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, salt and pepper to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, or until veggies are just tender.
Remove from heat; do not drain.
recipes.text: Cheddar Ham Chowder. In large saucepan, bring water, potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, salt and pepper to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, or until veggies are just tender. Remove from heat; do not drain.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Place chicken, water, 2 teaspoons salt, onion salt and celery salt in Dutch oven.
Simmer, covered, until tender (1 to 1 1/4 hours).
Add water as needed.
Remove chicken to bowl.
Cool, then remove meat from bones in medium-size pieces.
Remove 2 1/2 cups broth from pan; reserve.
To rest of broth, add 3 quarts of water and 2 tablespoons salt.
Bring to boil.
Slowly add spaghettini. Cook 6 minutes or until tender-crisp, stirring occasionally. Drain well and place in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Chicken Tetrazzini. Place chicken, water, 2 teaspoons salt, onion salt and celery salt in Dutch oven. Simmer, covered, until tender (1 to 1 1/4 hours). Add water as needed. Remove chicken to bowl. Cool, then remove meat from bones in medium-size pieces. Remove 2 1/2 cups broth from pan; reserve. To rest of broth, add 3 quarts of water and 2 tablespoons salt. Bring to boil. Slowly add spaghettini. Cook 6 minutes or until tender-crisp, stirring occasionally. Drain well and place in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Coleslaw Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients in blender and blend well.
Mix with grated cabbage.
May also add grated carrot and minced celery.
