recipes.text: Coleslaw Dressing. Combine all ingredients in blender and blend well. Mix with grated cabbage. May also add grated carrot and minced celery.

recipes.title: Chop Suey Hot Dish
directions: Brown meat, onion and celery.
Add Oriental vegetables, soup and chow mein noodles.
Mix well and put in casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chop Suey Hot Dish. Brown meat, onion and celery. Add Oriental vegetables, soup and chow mein noodles. Mix well and put in casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Flakes Pancakes
ingredients: 1 c. regular or complete pancake mix
1 c. Bran Flakes cereal, 1 c. Post Grape-Nuts flakes or Post fortified oat flakes
1/2 c. milk, water or reconstituted nonfat dry milk
directions: Prepare pancake mix as directed on package using the amount of milk or water specified.
Add crushed cereal and 1/2 cup milk or water.
Using 1/4 cup batter for each pancake, bake on hot griddle until bubbly on top.
Turn to brown other side.
Makes about 8 to 10 pancakes.
recipes.text: Flakes Pancakes. Prepare pancake mix as directed on package using the amount of milk or water specified. Add crushed cereal and 1/2 cup milk or water. Using 1/4 cup batter for each pancake, bake on hot griddle until bubbly on top. Turn to brown other side. Makes about 8 to 10 pancakes.

recipes.title: Fruit Filled Crumb Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together except pie filling.
Spread 3/4 dough on a cookie sheet.
Cover dough with choice of canned pie filling (2 cans).
Grate remaining 1/4 dough over the fruit.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes, then reduce to 325u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
Sift powdered sugar over the top when cool.
recipes.text: Fruit Filled Crumb Cake. Mix all ingredients together except pie filling. Spread 3/4 dough on a cookie sheet. Cover dough with choice of canned pie filling (2 cans). Grate remaining 1/4 dough over the fruit. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes, then reduce to 325u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Sift powdered sugar over the top when cool.

recipes.title: Fried Eggplant Or Zucchini
directions: In large bowl, combine bread crumbs and spices.
In another bowl, beat eggs and milk.
Slice eggplant or zucchini about 1/8 inch thick.
Dip in egg mixture; dredge through bread crumbs.
recipes.text: Fried Eggplant Or Zucchini. In large bowl, combine bread crumbs and spices. In another bowl, beat eggs and milk. Slice eggplant or zucchini about 1/8 inch thick. Dip in egg mixture; dredge through bread crumbs.

recipes.title: Chili-Potato Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Empty potatoes into ungreased 2-quart casserole.
Cook and stir ground beef, green peppers, onion and salt in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain.
Stir in sauce mix, chili powder, water and beans.
Add to potatoes.
Cook for about 40 minutes (until potatoes are tender).
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Chili-Potato Casserole. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Empty potatoes into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Cook and stir ground beef, green peppers, onion and salt in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain. Stir in sauce mix, chili powder, water and beans. Add to potatoes. Cook for about 40 minutes (until potatoes are tender). Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Kahlua
directions: Boil sugar and water for 10 minutes.
When cool, add Espresso coffee and vodka.
Chop dry vanilla bean in pieces and divide between bottles.
Pour liquid in bottles and shake every day for 3 weeks.
recipes.text: Kahlua. Boil sugar and water for 10 minutes. When cool, add Espresso coffee and vodka. Chop dry vanilla bean in pieces and divide between bottles. Pour liquid in bottles and shake every day for 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Hamburg Soup
directions: Brown hamburger and onion.
Add soup broth and vegetables and cook about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburg Soup. Brown hamburger and onion. Add soup broth and vegetables and cook about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix ingredients and bake in greased and floured muffin pans or loaf pans at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Test with toothpick to see if done.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix ingredients and bake in greased and floured muffin pans or loaf pans at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Test with toothpick to see if done.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Dinner For 200 People (Plus)
directions: Mix all of the ingredients together; bake in a 300u00b0 oven, in a large roasting pan, for 3 to 4 hours.
Stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Dinner For 200 People (Plus). Mix all of the ingredients together; bake in a 300u00b0 oven, in a large roasting pan, for 3 to 4 hours. Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Creamed Potato Soup
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients until tender in 2 cups of water.
Add mushrooms, salt and garlic salt.
Let simmer 1 minute.
Dissolve cornstarch in milk and stir into hot ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Add butter and cheese.
Simmer until butter and cheese are melted.
Makes 6 cups.
recipes.text: Creamed Potato Soup. Cook first 4 ingredients until tender in 2 cups of water. Add mushrooms, salt and garlic salt. Let simmer 1 minute. Dissolve cornstarch in milk and stir into hot ingredients. Bring to a boil. Add butter and cheese. Simmer until butter and cheese are melted. Makes 6 cups.

recipes.title: Broccoli With Cashews
ingredients: 1 large bunch broccoli, broken into flowerets and cooked
directions: Saute onion in butter until soft and pale yellow.
Remove from heat and stir in sour cream, sugar, vinegar and seasonings.
Pour over cooked broccoli and sprinkle with cashews. Serve hot. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Broccoli With Cashews. Saute onion in butter until soft and pale yellow. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream, sugar, vinegar and seasonings. Pour over cooked broccoli and sprinkle with cashews. Serve hot. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Easy Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream first 3 ingredients; add sugar.
Beat.
Alternately add flour and eggs to creamed mixture, blending after each addition. Begin and end with flour.
Add vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan; bake at 300u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done. Delicious with ice cream or your favorite sauce.
recipes.text: Easy Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Cream first 3 ingredients; add sugar. Beat. Alternately add flour and eggs to creamed mixture, blending after each addition. Begin and end with flour. Add vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan; bake at 300u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done. Delicious with ice cream or your favorite sauce.

recipes.title: Tomato Chow Chow
ingredients: 3 to 5 lb. tomatoes, cored, chopped chunky
directions: Add to tomatoes, chopped: green onions, black olives, green onions, jalapenos, garlic, vinegar, oil, salt and sugar.
Put in clean jars.
Seal and keep in refrigerator.
Will keep several weeks.
Very good with chips.
recipes.text: Tomato Chow Chow. Add to tomatoes, chopped: green onions, black olives, green onions, jalapenos, garlic, vinegar, oil, salt and sugar. Put in clean jars. Seal and keep in refrigerator. Will keep several weeks. Very good with chips.

recipes.title: Holiday Punch
directions: Chill all ingredients.
Add ginger ale when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Holiday Punch. Chill all ingredients. Add ginger ale when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder With Fresh Herbs And Smoked Ham
ingredients: 1 sprig each fresh thyme and tarragon
2 (16 oz. each) cans whole potatoes, drained
2 (16 or 17 oz. each) cans corn, drained
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, combine broth, onion and carrot.
Tie together bay leaf and fresh herbs to make bouquet garni.
Add to saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Remove herbs.
recipes.text: Corn Chowder With Fresh Herbs And Smoked Ham. In a 3-quart saucepan, combine broth, onion and carrot. Tie together bay leaf and fresh herbs to make bouquet garni. Add to saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Remove herbs.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Icing
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Boil slightly until a soft ball stage. Remove from heat and beat until thick enough to spread on cake. This icing gets softer after it is on cake for awhile.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Icing. Mix all ingredients. Boil slightly until a soft ball stage. Remove from heat and beat until thick enough to spread on cake. This icing gets softer after it is on cake for awhile.

recipes.title: Swiss Potato Torte
directions: Grease 1 1/2-quart baking dish with cooking spray.
Pare and thinly slice potatoes in bowl.
Toss potatoes.
Add parsley, garlic, salt and spices in prepared dish.
Alternating with layers of potatoes, add broth.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 30 minutes longer.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Swiss Potato Torte. Grease 1 1/2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Pare and thinly slice potatoes in bowl. Toss potatoes. Add parsley, garlic, salt and spices in prepared dish. Alternating with layers of potatoes, add broth. Cover with foil. Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake 30 minutes longer. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Brown Country Gravy
directions: In
a
frypan
pour in cooking oil.
Heat over a medium fire. Add flour
slowly, stirring constantly.
Let cook until the mixture is a
golden
brown.
Add
water gradually until a medium thick gravy is
made.
Add the salt, pepper, Accent and the beef base.
Cook over
a
low
fire
for
another
5 to 10 minutes. Makes enough to serve 8 to 12.
recipes.text: Brown Country Gravy. In a frypan pour in cooking oil. Heat over a medium fire. Add flour slowly, stirring constantly. Let cook until the mixture is a golden brown. Add water gradually until a medium thick gravy is made. Add the salt, pepper, Accent and the beef base. Cook over a low fire for another 5 to 10 minutes. Makes enough to serve 8 to 12.

recipes.title: Perfect Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Pour milk over shortening and sugar.
Add 1/2 of the flour and mix, then add remaining flour and yeast.
Mix thoroughly.
Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes, then use as much of the dough as needed.
Store remaining dough in refrigerator.
Bake at 375u00b0 until brown.
recipes.text: Perfect Rolls. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Pour milk over shortening and sugar. Add 1/2 of the flour and mix, then add remaining flour and yeast. Mix thoroughly. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes, then use as much of the dough as needed. Store remaining dough in refrigerator. Bake at 375u00b0 until brown.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 14 to 15 slices bread (white or whole wheat)
3 c. or 1 lb. pkg. ham, bacon or sausage
1/2 lb. or more shredded Cheddar cheese
directions: Trim crusts from bread slices, if desired. Lightly butter bread on both sides and cut into cubes. Brown chopped ham, bacon or sausage and place on bottom of lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Place the cubed bread on top of the meat. Put the shredded cheese on top of the bread. Beat the eggs until foamy. Add the pepper, dry mustard and milk. Stir well and pour over the meat, bread and cheese. Add some extra shredded cheese on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cook at 350u00b0 for 30 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Trim crusts from bread slices, if desired. Lightly butter bread on both sides and cut into cubes. Brown chopped ham, bacon or sausage and place on bottom of lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Place the cubed bread on top of the meat. Put the shredded cheese on top of the bread. Beat the eggs until foamy. Add the pepper, dry mustard and milk. Stir well and pour over the meat, bread and cheese. Add some extra shredded cheese on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cook at 350u00b0 for 30 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Place in microwave for 10 minutes until mixture has cheese melted well.
recipes.text: Microwave Broccoli Casserole. Mix all ingredients well. Place in microwave for 10 minutes until mixture has cheese melted well.

recipes.title: 7-Up Mistletoe Punch
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) cans or 1 (12 oz.) can frozen lemonade, thawed
directions: Place berries in blender and blend until smooth.
Place in punch bowl.
Add remaining ingredients.
Serves 36.
recipes.text: 7-Up Mistletoe Punch. Place berries in blender and blend until smooth. Place in punch bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Serves 36.

recipes.title: Lasagne
directions: Brown beef in a skillet with olive oil and garlic.
After browning, add tomato sauce, salt, oregano and pepper.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Cook noodles according to package in salted water for about 15 minutes.
Drain and rinse.
Fill a casserole dish with alternate layers of noodles, sauce and cheese, ending with a layer of sauce and topping with Mozzarella cheese and some Parmesan cheese.
Bake in oven at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly.
Serves 4 to 5.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Brown beef in a skillet with olive oil and garlic. After browning, add tomato sauce, salt, oregano and pepper. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Cook noodles according to package in salted water for about 15 minutes. Drain and rinse. Fill a casserole dish with alternate layers of noodles, sauce and cheese, ending with a layer of sauce and topping with Mozzarella cheese and some Parmesan cheese. Bake in oven at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly. Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins
ingredients: artificial sweetener to equal 2 Tbsp. sugar
directions: Mix eggs, baking soda, pumpkin and vanilla together.
Put rest of ingredients in separate bowl.
Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients a little at a time and beat on low speed with mixer. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Makes 12 cupcakes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Muffins. Mix eggs, baking soda, pumpkin and vanilla together. Put rest of ingredients in separate bowl. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients a little at a time and beat on low speed with mixer. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Makes 12 cupcakes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Tuna Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and use as a dip or spread on crackers.
Sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Tuna Dip. Combine all ingredients and use as a dip or spread on crackers. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Jerry'S Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and let set for 24 hours.
recipes.text: Jerry'S Salad. Mix all ingredients together and let set for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Ruth'S Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix with pudding
directions: Mix together all of the ingredients.
recipes.text: Ruth'S Coffee Cake. Mix together all of the ingredients.

recipes.title: Wedding Punch
directions: Dissolve sugar, Kool-Aid and water.
Mix everything together and freeze until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Wedding Punch. Dissolve sugar, Kool-Aid and water. Mix everything together and freeze until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Mexican Pie
directions: Cook beef and onion; drain.
Stir in season mix.
Spread beef into plate.
Sprinkle with cheese and chillies.
Beat rest of ingredients until smooth in blender or hand mixer.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown and knife comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Mexican Pie. Cook beef and onion; drain. Stir in season mix. Spread beef into plate. Sprinkle with cheese and chillies. Beat rest of ingredients until smooth in blender or hand mixer. Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown and knife comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Manicotti
directions: Crumble ground beef; cook and drain.
Stir in spaghetti sauce, water and 1 Tbsp. salt.
In another bowl, combine Ricotta cheese, Parmesan, eggs, pepper, 1 1/2 cup Mozzarella and 1/2 tsp. salt. Stuff uncooked manicotti with cheese filling.
In a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, pour 1/2 of meat sauce, arrange manicotti in single layer.
Add remainder of meat sauce to cover.
Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella.
Cover and cook 1 and 1/2 hours at 325u00b0. (Check at 1 hour.)
recipes.text: Manicotti. Crumble ground beef; cook and drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce, water and 1 Tbsp. salt. In another bowl, combine Ricotta cheese, Parmesan, eggs, pepper, 1 1/2 cup Mozzarella and 1/2 tsp. salt. Stuff uncooked manicotti with cheese filling. In a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, pour 1/2 of meat sauce, arrange manicotti in single layer. Add remainder of meat sauce to cover. Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella. Cover and cook 1 and 1/2 hours at 325u00b0. (Check at 1 hour.)

recipes.title: Bisquick Mix
directions: Mix dry ingredients together in large bowl.
Add Crisco and blend by hand or pastry blender
until
mixture looks like cornmeal.
Store
in glass, plastic
or
can
container
with tight-fitting lid.
recipes.text: Bisquick Mix. Mix dry ingredients together in large bowl. Add Crisco and blend by hand or pastry blender until mixture looks like cornmeal. Store in glass, plastic or can container with tight-fitting lid.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Stew and debone chicken breasts.
Add melted margarine, celery soup, peas and carrots and chicken broth from chicken.
Mix together and pour in baking dish.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Stew and debone chicken breasts. Add melted margarine, celery soup, peas and carrots and chicken broth from chicken. Mix together and pour in baking dish.

recipes.title: Campside Bean Scramble
directions: Brown hamburger meat, put in ketchup, sugar, mustard and beans.
Add meat.
Heat to serve.
recipes.text: Campside Bean Scramble. Brown hamburger meat, put in ketchup, sugar, mustard and beans. Add meat. Heat to serve.

recipes.title: Huntington Chicken
ingredients: 1 good sized chicken, cook and cut in pieces
4 c. broth, thickened with 1/2 c. flour
2 c. macaroni, boiled in salt water (drain)
1/2 lb. Velveeta cheese (melt in hot macaroni)
directions: Mix
all
ingredients
together.
Place in buttered baking dish. Top with potato chip crumbs.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Huntington Chicken. Mix all ingredients together. Place in buttered baking dish. Top with potato chip crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Venison Chili
directions: Brown bacon and drain browned venison in bacon grease with onion and garlic.
Combine all ingredients except the fresh and pickled peppers in a large pot and bring to simmer.
Chop peppers and saute in bacon grease until tender; drain and add to meat. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Refrigerate overnight.
Serve next day.
recipes.text: Hot Venison Chili. Brown bacon and drain browned venison in bacon grease with onion and garlic. Combine all ingredients except the fresh and pickled peppers in a large pot and bring to simmer. Chop peppers and saute in bacon grease until tender; drain and add to meat. Simmer for 30 minutes. Refrigerate overnight. Serve next day.

recipes.title: Delightful Crab Salad
directions: Combine crabmeat, celery, olives, onion, mayonnaise, mustard, salt and pepper.
Toss to mix.
Cover and chill until serving time.
Serve on lettuce leaves.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Delightful Crab Salad. Combine crabmeat, celery, olives, onion, mayonnaise, mustard, salt and pepper. Toss to mix. Cover and chill until serving time. Serve on lettuce leaves. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Sticks
directions: Sift flour and salt together. Cut or rub in shortening until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle with water, mixing lightly until dough begins to stick together. Turn out on a lightly-floured board or pastry cloth. Press dough together and roll to a 12 x 18-inch rectangle. Brush with butter; sprinkle with cheese. Carefully fold 1/3 of the pastry over the center 1/3, then fold remaining 1/3 of pastry over center portion, making a 4 x 18-inch rectangle. Cut into strips about 3/4-inch wide. Arrange on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in 400u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Sticks. Sift flour and salt together. Cut or rub in shortening until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle with water, mixing lightly until dough begins to stick together. Turn out on a lightly-floured board or pastry cloth. Press dough together and roll to a 12 x 18-inch rectangle. Brush with butter; sprinkle with cheese. Carefully fold 1/3 of the pastry over the center 1/3, then fold remaining 1/3 of pastry over center portion, making a 4 x 18-inch rectangle. Cut into strips about 3/4-inch wide. Arrange on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in 400u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Raisin Cookies
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar.
Beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir in zucchini.
recipes.text: Zucchini Raisin Cookies. Cream together margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir in zucchini.

recipes.title: Ozark Pudding
directions: Beat eggs.
Add sugar gradually, beating after each egg.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Blend with sugar-egg mixture. Stir in vanilla.
Add nuts and apples; stir well.
Bake in a 9-inch square pan at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Ozark Pudding. Beat eggs. Add sugar gradually, beating after each egg. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Blend with sugar-egg mixture. Stir in vanilla. Add nuts and apples; stir well. Bake in a 9-inch square pan at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Hobo Dinner
directions: Cover baking sheet with aluminum foil as if you were fixing to wrap a present.
Smash ground beef in the bottom of the pan.
Top with potatoes, carrots, onions, bell pepper, salt, pepper and other spices (if desired) to taste.
Seal the foil so it will be airtight.
recipes.text: Hobo Dinner. Cover baking sheet with aluminum foil as if you were fixing to wrap a present. Smash ground beef in the bottom of the pan. Top with potatoes, carrots, onions, bell pepper, salt, pepper and other spices (if desired) to taste. Seal the foil so it will be airtight.

recipes.title: Preacher Cookies
directions: Boil butter, milk, sugar and cocoa for 3 minutes.
Set off stove.
Add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla to the boiled mixture.
Mix thoroughly and drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper. Let cool.
recipes.text: Preacher Cookies. Boil butter, milk, sugar and cocoa for 3 minutes. Set off stove. Add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla to the boiled mixture. Mix thoroughly and drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper. Let cool.

recipes.title: Twinkie Treat
directions: Cut Twinkies in half; line medium deep cake pan.
Top with Cool Whip.
Put a layer of the cut strawberries on the Cool Whip. Drizzle with the strawberry glaze.
Put another layer of Twinkies, topped with Cool Whip, more cut strawberries and another drizzle of strawberry glaze.
recipes.text: Twinkie Treat. Cut Twinkies in half; line medium deep cake pan. Top with Cool Whip. Put a layer of the cut strawberries on the Cool Whip. Drizzle with the strawberry glaze. Put another layer of Twinkies, topped with Cool Whip, more cut strawberries and another drizzle of strawberry glaze.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: salt, pepper and flour to taste
directions: Cut beef in thinnest possible slices.
Pound in flour, salt and pepper.
Cut into strips, about 3 x 1/2-inch.
Dice onions and fry slowly until soft and just turning yellow.
Then add meat and saute until well seared.
Add tomato paste and enough consomme to just cover.
Add soy sauce to taste.
Simmer until tender.
Transfer to top of double boiler and add sour cream and mushrooms.
Reheat in double boiler when ready to serve.
Serve on rice.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Cut beef in thinnest possible slices. Pound in flour, salt and pepper. Cut into strips, about 3 x 1/2-inch. Dice onions and fry slowly until soft and just turning yellow. Then add meat and saute until well seared. Add tomato paste and enough consomme to just cover. Add soy sauce to taste. Simmer until tender. Transfer to top of double boiler and add sour cream and mushrooms. Reheat in double boiler when ready to serve. Serve on rice.

recipes.title: Weight Watchers Snickers Pie
ingredients: 2 qt. vanilla Weight Watchers ice cream
directions: Soften ice cream in bowl.
Combine peanut butter, Cool Whip and pudding.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour in quiche dish and freeze. Cut in eight pieces.
Each piece has 30 calories.
recipes.text: Weight Watchers Snickers Pie. Soften ice cream in bowl. Combine peanut butter, Cool Whip and pudding. Mix thoroughly. Pour in quiche dish and freeze. Cut in eight pieces. Each piece has 30 calories.

recipes.title: Tropical Sweet Potato Salad
directions: Boil, peel and mash potatoes.
Add ingredients except marshmallows to potatoes.
Put in a baking dish (6 x 8-inch). Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Add marshmallows the last 5 minutes of baking.
recipes.text: Tropical Sweet Potato Salad. Boil, peel and mash potatoes. Add ingredients except marshmallows to potatoes. Put in a baking dish (6 x 8-inch). Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 minutes. Add marshmallows the last 5 minutes of baking.

recipes.title: Ham Quiche Lorraine
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0. Sprinkle bacon and onion on bottom of crust. Add half of ham, 4 slices of cheese, rest of ham and then cheese. Beat eggs and mustard. Add hot cream; beat. Pour over ham and cheese. Let stand 10 minutes. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until custard is set.
recipes.text: Ham Quiche Lorraine. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Sprinkle bacon and onion on bottom of crust. Add half of ham, 4 slices of cheese, rest of ham and then cheese. Beat eggs and mustard. Add hot cream; beat. Pour over ham and cheese. Let stand 10 minutes. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until custard is set.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
ingredients: 5 c. apples, peeled, thinly sliced and cored
directions: Preheat oven at 325u00b0 for 1 hour or more.
Beat sugar, oil and eggs together.
Add flour, salt, soda and cinnamon slowly.
Mix well with mixer until creamy.
Add apples and nuts and mix with spoon until everything is mixed well.
Bake; serve warm.
Good cold, too.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Preheat oven at 325u00b0 for 1 hour or more. Beat sugar, oil and eggs together. Add flour, salt, soda and cinnamon slowly. Mix well with mixer until creamy. Add apples and nuts and mix with spoon until everything is mixed well. Bake; serve warm. Good cold, too.

recipes.title: Chicken Veronique
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, slivered
directions: Saute chicken and onions with thyme in melted oleo in large skillet until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add cornstarch and stir until blended.
Stir in broth, milk, green beans, carrots, salt and pepper.
Bring to a full boil, stirring frequently.
Stir in rice.
Cover and remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Fluff with fork.
Serve.
recipes.text: Chicken Veronique. Saute chicken and onions with thyme in melted oleo in large skillet until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add cornstarch and stir until blended. Stir in broth, milk, green beans, carrots, salt and pepper. Bring to a full boil, stirring frequently. Stir in rice. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Serve.

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash
directions: Place meat in slow cooking pot.
Cover with sliced onion. Combine garlic, catsup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, salt, paprika and mustard.
Stir in water.
Pour over meat.
Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours.
recipes.text: Hungarian Goulash. Place meat in slow cooking pot. Cover with sliced onion. Combine garlic, catsup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, salt, paprika and mustard. Stir in water. Pour over meat. Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours.

recipes.title: Nacho Pie
directions: Place rolls in 9-inch round pie plate.
All points should go toward center.
Press into plate.
Sprinkle chips over crust (half).
Top with mixture.
Sprinkle with cheese and remaining chips.
recipes.text: Nacho Pie. Place rolls in 9-inch round pie plate. All points should go toward center. Press into plate. Sprinkle chips over crust (half). Top with mixture. Sprinkle with cheese and remaining chips.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla to beaten eggs. Add dry ingredients.
Mix well.
Place in 2 greased and floured 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla to beaten eggs. Add dry ingredients. Mix well. Place in 2 greased and floured 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Porketta
directions: Place roast on heavy duty foil.
Smear with the garlic, then sprinkle with remaining seasonings.
Seal the roast in the foil, making a tent on top.
Place in a pan and bake for 3 hours in a 300u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Porketta. Place roast on heavy duty foil. Smear with the garlic, then sprinkle with remaining seasonings. Seal the roast in the foil, making a tent on top. Place in a pan and bake for 3 hours in a 300u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Shortcake
directions: Sift flour with baking powder.
Beat eggs until mixed.
Add slowly in order listed.
Add hot water slowly.
Bake approximately 20 minutes in 9 x 9-inch pan in 350u00b0 oven.
Serve with crushed sweetened strawberries.
recipes.text: Shortcake. Sift flour with baking powder. Beat eggs until mixed. Add slowly in order listed. Add hot water slowly. Bake approximately 20 minutes in 9 x 9-inch pan in 350u00b0 oven. Serve with crushed sweetened strawberries.

recipes.title: Meatballs
ingredients: 1 small onion, chopped or 1/4 c. dried minced onion flakes
directions: Combine ingredients and make meatballs. Make your sauce separately by combining ingredients until smooth in a separate bowl. Put your meatballs in a large broiler pan or cookie sheet; pour half of your sauce mixture over them and bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until lightly brown.
Cover meatballs with remaining sauce when you put them in a crock-pot on low.
recipes.text: Meatballs. Combine ingredients and make meatballs. Make your sauce separately by combining ingredients until smooth in a separate bowl. Put your meatballs in a large broiler pan or cookie sheet; pour half of your sauce mixture over them and bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Cover meatballs with remaining sauce when you put them in a crock-pot on low.

recipes.title: Banana Walnut Bread
directions: Preheat oven
to 350u00b0.tIn a small bowl, smash bananas. Stir intbakingtsoda.
In
a
large bowl, cream margarine and sugar together.
Mix
integgs.
Stir
in flour and banana and soda mixture.
Stir in walnuts.tPour into loaf pan.
Bake for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Banana Walnut Bread. Preheat oven to 350u00b0.tIn a small bowl, smash bananas. Stir intbakingtsoda. In a large bowl, cream margarine and sugar together. Mix integgs. Stir in flour and banana and soda mixture. Stir in walnuts.tPour into loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Drop Dumplings
directions: Note:
Omit baking powder and salt if using self-rising flour.
recipes.text: Drop Dumplings. Note: Omit baking powder and salt if using self-rising flour.

recipes.title: Morning Glory Muffins
directions: Sift together flour, soda, salt and cinnamon into a large bowl.
In another bowl, beat eggs; add sugar, oil and vanilla. Make a well in the flour mixture.
Pour in oil and eggs.
Stir until all is
moistened.
Fold in carrots, dates, walnuts, coconut and apple.
Don't overmix.
recipes.text: Morning Glory Muffins. Sift together flour, soda, salt and cinnamon into a large bowl. In another bowl, beat eggs; add sugar, oil and vanilla. Make a well in the flour mixture. Pour in oil and eggs. Stir until all is moistened. Fold in carrots, dates, walnuts, coconut and apple. Don't overmix.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia brand cream cheese, softened
directions: Combine sugar, cream cheese and margarine, mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Blend in pumpkin.
Add combined dry ingredients, mixing just until moistened.
Fold in nuts.
Pour into two greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool 5 minutes; remove from pans.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cheese Bread. Combine sugar, cream cheese and margarine, mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Blend in pumpkin. Add combined dry ingredients, mixing just until moistened. Fold in nuts. Pour into two greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes; remove from pans.

recipes.title: Orange Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese or light cream cheese
chives or thinly sliced green onions
directions: In 3 to 4-quart pan, stir oil, onion, coriander and 1/4 cup water over high heat until liquid evaporates and onion is very limp, 5 to 7 minutes.
Add pumpkin, broth, juice and wine.
Stir to blend; bring to a boil; reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Cut cheese into 1/2-inch chunks and whirl in blender or processor with about 1 cup soup. Return to soup in pan.
Serve hot or chilled.
Garnish with chives.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Orange Pumpkin Soup. In 3 to 4-quart pan, stir oil, onion, coriander and 1/4 cup water over high heat until liquid evaporates and onion is very limp, 5 to 7 minutes. Add pumpkin, broth, juice and wine. Stir to blend; bring to a boil; reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Cut cheese into 1/2-inch chunks and whirl in blender or processor with about 1 cup soup. Return to soup in pan. Serve hot or chilled. Garnish with chives. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Potato-Cheese Soup
directions: Cook the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Reserve cooking water.
Saute onion in oil.
Put potatoes, water, onion and seasonings in blender and puree in several batches.
Return to large pot and add warm milk.
Stir continuously, add the cheese, margarine and seasonings.
Heat just until cheese melts, do not boil.
Makes 3 quarts.
recipes.text: Potato-Cheese Soup. Cook the potatoes in salted water until tender. Reserve cooking water. Saute onion in oil. Put potatoes, water, onion and seasonings in blender and puree in several batches. Return to large pot and add warm milk. Stir continuously, add the cheese, margarine and seasonings. Heat just until cheese melts, do not boil. Makes 3 quarts.

recipes.title: Diamond Peanut Cookies
ingredients: grated peel from half a lemon
grated peel from half an orange
directions: In a large pan, with a wooden spoon, beat eggs all together, then add sugar, lemon and orange peel and oil. Set aside.
In another bowl, put all the dry ingredients and then add to egg mixture.
Knead into a soft dough, adding more flour if necessary. Roll out into a thin log and flatten with your hand, cut into angles like a diamond shape.
Put on greased tins.
Bake at 350-375u00b0 for 18 - 20 minutes to a light golden color.
Cool and frost.
Can also add sprinkles on top.
recipes.text: Diamond Peanut Cookies. In a large pan, with a wooden spoon, beat eggs all together, then add sugar, lemon and orange peel and oil. Set aside. In another bowl, put all the dry ingredients and then add to egg mixture. Knead into a soft dough, adding more flour if necessary. Roll out into a thin log and flatten with your hand, cut into angles like a diamond shape. Put on greased tins. Bake at 350-375u00b0 for 18 - 20 minutes to a light golden color. Cool and frost. Can also add sprinkles on top.

recipes.title: Pineapple Pie
directions: Mix together milk and lemon juice; set this aside.
recipes.text: Pineapple Pie. Mix together milk and lemon juice; set this aside.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Wash broccoli and cut into bite size pieces including stems. Combine with onion, raisins and bacon, crumbled.
Mix with dressing.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Wash broccoli and cut into bite size pieces including stems. Combine with onion, raisins and bacon, crumbled. Mix with dressing.

recipes.title: Country Chicken And Dumplings
directions: In large pot, simmer cut up stewing hen.
When hen is fully cooked, remove from pot (about 40 minutes).
Set aside until cooled enough to handle; debone hen and dispose of bones.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Country Chicken And Dumplings. In large pot, simmer cut up stewing hen. When hen is fully cooked, remove from pot (about 40 minutes). Set aside until cooled enough to handle; debone hen and dispose of bones. Set aside.

recipes.title: Millionaires
ingredients: 1 bag vanilla caramels plus 10 more caramels
1 large Hershey bar or 1 bag semi-sweet chocolate chips
directions: Melt caramels and milk in double boiler.
Add pecans and mix well.
Drop and shape on wax paper and let harden.
Melt chocolate and paraffin in double boiler.
Dip candies in chocolate with toothpick and piece on wax paper to harden.
recipes.text: Millionaires. Melt caramels and milk in double boiler. Add pecans and mix well. Drop and shape on wax paper and let harden. Melt chocolate and paraffin in double boiler. Dip candies in chocolate with toothpick and piece on wax paper to harden.

recipes.title: Yuletide Punch(Non-Alcoholic Wassail)
directions: In a large saucepan, combine apple juice, cranberry juice cocktail, honey, lemon juice, lemon peel, allspice and cinnamon stick.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Remove and discard lemon peel, allspice and cinnamon.
Let cool slightly.
Carefully pour into a heat-proof punch bowl or slow cooker.
Garnish with slices of star fruit.
recipes.text: Yuletide Punch(Non-Alcoholic Wassail). In a large saucepan, combine apple juice, cranberry juice cocktail, honey, lemon juice, lemon peel, allspice and cinnamon stick. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Remove and discard lemon peel, allspice and cinnamon. Let cool slightly. Carefully pour into a heat-proof punch bowl or slow cooker. Garnish with slices of star fruit.

recipes.title: Chili Con Carne
ingredients: chili powder to taste (1 tsp. to 1 Tbsp.)
directions: Brown celery and onion in oleo.
Add hamburger and fry until done, stirring often.
Drain.
Heat kidney beans, tomato juice and soup.
Add hamburger mixture and chili powder.
Cook altogether well, until celery is tender.
recipes.text: Chili Con Carne. Brown celery and onion in oleo. Add hamburger and fry until done, stirring often. Drain. Heat kidney beans, tomato juice and soup. Add hamburger mixture and chili powder. Cook altogether well, until celery is tender.

recipes.title: Mule Ear Stir-Fry Or Prickly Pear Cactus(Tohono O'Odham)
ingredients: 1 fresh or 2 canned jalapeno peppers, chopped
1/4 tsp. cayenne pepper (omit if you're chicken)
directions: This recipe is revised for more modern taste.
Nobody is sure what was originally used.
Each family had their own taste.
recipes.text: Mule Ear Stir-Fry Or Prickly Pear Cactus(Tohono O'Odham). This recipe is revised for more modern taste. Nobody is sure what was originally used. Each family had their own taste.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned in oil
1 medium pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Alternate meat, sauce and cottage cheese with noodles and top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake 15 minutes until cheese melts.
Works well in crock-pot.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Alternate meat, sauce and cottage cheese with noodles and top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 15 minutes until cheese melts. Works well in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Pretzel Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries (include juice), thawed
directions: Combine pretzels, margarine and 3 teaspoons sugar.
Press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 8 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Strawberry-Pretzel Salad. Combine pretzels, margarine and 3 teaspoons sugar. Press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Bake at 400u00b0 for 8 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Chicken And Wine Sauce
ingredients: 4 whole chicken breasts, halved and boned
directions: Dip chicken in egg, roll in bread crumbs, fry until brown on each side and arrange in shallow baking pan.
Saute mushrooms; add pepper, broth and wine.
Thicken with cornstarch (dissolve cornstarch in a little water before adding the mixture.)
Don't add salt.
Sprinkle 3/4 cup of Parmesan cheese over chicken; cover with 3/4 of the Mozzarella.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Sprinkle rest of 2 cheeses on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.
Serve with wild or white rice.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken And Wine Sauce. Dip chicken in egg, roll in bread crumbs, fry until brown on each side and arrange in shallow baking pan. Saute mushrooms; add pepper, broth and wine. Thicken with cornstarch (dissolve cornstarch in a little water before adding the mixture.) Don't add salt. Sprinkle 3/4 cup of Parmesan cheese over chicken; cover with 3/4 of the Mozzarella. Pour sauce over chicken. Sprinkle rest of 2 cheeses on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve with wild or white rice. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Texas Potatoes
ingredients: 1 c. crushed corn flakes, mixed with 1/4 c. butter
directions: Thaw potatoes.
Combine sour cream, soup and butter.
Mix well.
Add salt, pepper, onion and Cheddar cheese.
Mix well. Blend in potatoes.
Place the mixture in a greased shallow 2-quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle buttered corn flake crumbs on top.
Bake uncovered in oven at 350u00b0 about 50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Texas Potatoes. Thaw potatoes. Combine sour cream, soup and butter. Mix well. Add salt, pepper, onion and Cheddar cheese. Mix well. Blend in potatoes. Place the mixture in a greased shallow 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle buttered corn flake crumbs on top. Bake uncovered in oven at 350u00b0 about 50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
directions: Preheat oven 375u00b0.
Before making cake batter prepare cake topping.
In a 13-inch by 9-inch baking pan place butter.
Place pan in oven until butter melts.
Sprinkle brown sugar over butter. Drain pineapple chunks.
Use pineapple in sugar mixture.
Prepare cake batter as recipe directs, and carefully spoon over design in baking pan.
Bake 35-40 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes.
Then loosen cake from side of pan; place platter on top of pan, and invert both lift off pan.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside Down Cake. Preheat oven 375u00b0. Before making cake batter prepare cake topping. In a 13-inch by 9-inch baking pan place butter. Place pan in oven until butter melts. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter. Drain pineapple chunks. Use pineapple in sugar mixture. Prepare cake batter as recipe directs, and carefully spoon over design in baking pan. Bake 35-40 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes. Then loosen cake from side of pan; place platter on top of pan, and invert both lift off pan.

recipes.title: Poached Trout
directions: Melt margarine in frying pan over medium heat.
Add fish. Sprinkle with lemon juice and sherry.
Add onion, mushrooms, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Garnish with parsley.
Let simmer, covered, until fish turns white (about 8 to 10 minutes).
Do not brown.
This should steam in its own juices.
recipes.text: Poached Trout. Melt margarine in frying pan over medium heat. Add fish. Sprinkle with lemon juice and sherry. Add onion, mushrooms, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Garnish with parsley. Let simmer, covered, until fish turns white (about 8 to 10 minutes). Do not brown. This should steam in its own juices.

recipes.title: "Almost Better Than Sex" Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on box.
When cake is done, poke holes on top with straw.
Cook the sugar and crushed pineapple.
Simmer until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over cake.
Let the cake cool!!
recipes.text: "Almost Better Than Sex" Cake. Bake cake according to directions on box. When cake is done, poke holes on top with straw. Cook the sugar and crushed pineapple. Simmer until sugar is dissolved. Pour over cake. Let the cake cool!!

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 loaf brown bread (round like Hawaiian wedding bread)
directions: Thaw spinach and squeeze dry.
Stir in soup mix, sour cream and mayonnaise until blended.
Stir in spinach, chestnuts and onions.
Cover; chill 2 hours.
Stir before serving.
Makes 4 cups.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Thaw spinach and squeeze dry. Stir in soup mix, sour cream and mayonnaise until blended. Stir in spinach, chestnuts and onions. Cover; chill 2 hours. Stir before serving. Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Beef Or Pork Barbecue
ingredients: 2 c. cooked, diced or sliced beef or pork
directions: Simmer all together for 1/2 hour.
Serve on hamburg buns.
recipes.text: Beef Or Pork Barbecue. Simmer all together for 1/2 hour. Serve on hamburg buns.

recipes.title: Nut And Poppy Seed Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water with sugar.
Let stand while you mix margarine and flour as for pie crust.
Make a well, then add egg yolks, salt and yeast mixture.
Mix until smooth and dough leaves the sides of the bowl.
Cut into 4 pieces and roll out as thin as possible.
Spread filling and roll.
Place on greased pans.
Let raise for 1 hour, then brush with egg whites.
Bake in 350u00b0
oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
When baked, cover rolls with dampened cloth for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Nut And Poppy Seed Rolls. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water with sugar. Let stand while you mix margarine and flour as for pie crust. Make a well, then add egg yolks, salt and yeast mixture. Mix until smooth and dough leaves the sides of the bowl. Cut into 4 pieces and roll out as thin as possible. Spread filling and roll. Place on greased pans. Let raise for 1 hour, then brush with egg whites. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes. When baked, cover rolls with dampened cloth for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: In saucepan, cook potatoes and onions until tender, leaving enough water to cover potatoes.
Add cream, celery soup, butter and mushrooms.
Cook on low heat 20 minutes.
Top with grated cheese.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. In saucepan, cook potatoes and onions until tender, leaving enough water to cover potatoes. Add cream, celery soup, butter and mushrooms. Cook on low heat 20 minutes. Top with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Busy Day Dessert
ingredients: 1 can fruit pie filling (any you like)
directions: Coat small cake pan with butter or margarine.
Do not flour. Put in can of pie filling, spreading over bottom.
Add dry cake mix.
Dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
Fruity good and easy.
recipes.text: Busy Day Dessert. Coat small cake pan with butter or margarine. Do not flour. Put in can of pie filling, spreading over bottom. Add dry cake mix. Dot with butter or margarine. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Fruity good and easy.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Put butter, water and cocoa in pan.
Bring to boil.
Remove from heat and add flour, sugar and soda.
Stir into hot mixture the eggs, buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour into oblong pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sheet Cake. Put butter, water and cocoa in pan. Bring to boil. Remove from heat and add flour, sugar and soda. Stir into hot mixture the eggs, buttermilk and vanilla. Pour into oblong pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: German Pork Chops
directions: Sprinkle skillet with salt and brown chops.
Arrange potato slices in baking dish.
Sprinkle with salt.
Top with kraut. Sprinkle caraway over.
Put chops on top.
Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: German Pork Chops. Sprinkle skillet with salt and brown chops. Arrange potato slices in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt. Top with kraut. Sprinkle caraway over. Put chops on top. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hot Mustard
directions: Mix mustard and vinegar in a small pan and let stand overnight.
Next day, stir in sugar.
Add eggs and salt.
Cook until thickened.
This is very hot; use sparingly.
Good on any kind of meat sandwiches.
recipes.text: Hot Mustard. Mix mustard and vinegar in a small pan and let stand overnight. Next day, stir in sugar. Add eggs and salt. Cook until thickened. This is very hot; use sparingly. Good on any kind of meat sandwiches.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Squares
directions: Microwave 3/4 cup (1 1/2 sticks) margarine and 2 squares chocolate on High 1 to 2 minutes or until melted when stirred, stirring every 30 seconds.
Stir in crumbs, coconut and peanuts. Press onto bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Chill 30 minutes. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until well blended.
Spread over crust.
Chill 30 minutes.
Microwave remaining margarine and chocolate squares on High 1 to 2 minutes or until melted when stirred, stirring every 30 seconds.
Spread over cream cheese layer.
Chill.
Cut into about 4 dozen squares, small squares.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Squares. Microwave 3/4 cup (1 1/2 sticks) margarine and 2 squares chocolate on High 1 to 2 minutes or until melted when stirred, stirring every 30 seconds. Stir in crumbs, coconut and peanuts. Press onto bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Chill 30 minutes. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until well blended. Spread over crust. Chill 30 minutes. Microwave remaining margarine and chocolate squares on High 1 to 2 minutes or until melted when stirred, stirring every 30 seconds. Spread over cream cheese layer. Chill. Cut into about 4 dozen squares, small squares.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix well.
Use 1/4 cup to 1 cup water.
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa Mix. Mix well. Use 1/4 cup to 1 cup water.

recipes.title: French Dressing
directions: Combine in blender. Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: French Dressing. Combine in blender. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Mix margarine, flour and nuts together until moist. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Allow to cool.
recipes.text: Cherry Crunch. Mix margarine, flour and nuts together until moist. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Allow to cool.

recipes.title: Sock-It-To-Me-Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, eggs, sour cream and water together.
Place 1/2 in Bundt pan.
Sprinkle 3/4 of the brown sugar and cinnamon on top.
Swirl with a knife.
Place remainder of batter next, then the remainder of the brown sugar and cinnamon.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 35 minutes.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Punch holes in sides and top with a knife.
Mix powdered sugar and milk together to make a glaze, then pour over cake.
recipes.text: Sock-It-To-Me-Cake. Mix cake mix, eggs, sour cream and water together. Place 1/2 in Bundt pan. Sprinkle 3/4 of the brown sugar and cinnamon on top. Swirl with a knife. Place remainder of batter next, then the remainder of the brown sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 325u00b0 for 35 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes. Punch holes in sides and top with a knife. Mix powdered sugar and milk together to make a glaze, then pour over cake.

recipes.title: Phoney Abalone
ingredients: fresh garlic, minced or garlic powder to taste
directions: Place chicken between waxed paper and pound thin.
Pour clam juice and garlic over chicken and marinate 36 hours.
Drain chicken and dip in egg, then in flour-bread crumb mixture.
Fry quickly in hot pan with butter or oil.
recipes.text: Phoney Abalone. Place chicken between waxed paper and pound thin. Pour clam juice and garlic over chicken and marinate 36 hours. Drain chicken and dip in egg, then in flour-bread crumb mixture. Fry quickly in hot pan with butter or oil.

recipes.title: Chicken Manicotti
directions: Boil chicken until done; mince chicken. Cook manicotti shells.
recipes.text: Chicken Manicotti. Boil chicken until done; mince chicken. Cook manicotti shells.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
directions: Layer ingredients in order in 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Pour margarine evenly over cake.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Cool. Serve plain, with Cool Whip or with ice cream.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Layer ingredients in order in 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Pour margarine evenly over cake. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool. Serve plain, with Cool Whip or with ice cream.

recipes.title: Lobster-Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 12 to 14 oz. lobster (lagostini, shrimp or crab), thawed and picked
directions: Thaw and pick lobster.
Squeeze lemon juice over lobster meat. Then add onion and celery.
Marinate 4 hours.
recipes.text: Lobster-Macaroni Salad. Thaw and pick lobster. Squeeze lemon juice over lobster meat. Then add onion and celery. Marinate 4 hours.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Yum-Yum
directions: Combine boiling water, granulated sugar and cornstarch; cook until thick and clear.
Cool.
Melt oleo and mix with brown sugar, flour, oatmeal and cinnamon.
Put 1/2 crumbs in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Put diced rhubarb over crumbs.
Pour cornstarch mixture over crumbs and rhubarb.
Sprinkle remainder of crumbs over and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Yum-Yum. Combine boiling water, granulated sugar and cornstarch; cook until thick and clear. Cool. Melt oleo and mix with brown sugar, flour, oatmeal and cinnamon. Put 1/2 crumbs in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Put diced rhubarb over crumbs. Pour cornstarch mixture over crumbs and rhubarb. Sprinkle remainder of crumbs over and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Cook spaghetti; drain and run cold water over until cool.
Add other ingredients and mix well.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Salad. Cook spaghetti; drain and run cold water over until cool. Add other ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Melt the butter in a large frying pan.
Add the brown sugar; spread evenly over bottom of pan.
Lay complete wheel of pineapple in center.
Put cherry in center; place half wheels around.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake. Melt the butter in a large frying pan. Add the brown sugar; spread evenly over bottom of pan. Lay complete wheel of pineapple in center. Put cherry in center; place half wheels around.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Breakfast Casserole
directions: Tear up bread and place pieces in greased baking dish (13 x 9-inch).
Brown and drain bulk sausage; drain off fat.
Spoon over bread.
Sprinkle with grated sharp cheese.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Breakfast Casserole. Tear up bread and place pieces in greased baking dish (13 x 9-inch). Brown and drain bulk sausage; drain off fat. Spoon over bread. Sprinkle with grated sharp cheese.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Turkey Divan
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions.
Drain.
Place in an 8-inch square baking pan (spray with Pam).
Place turkey slices on top of broccoli.
Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Low Calorie Turkey Divan. Cook broccoli according to package directions. Drain. Place in an 8-inch square baking pan (spray with Pam). Place turkey slices on top of broccoli. Preheat oven to 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad *
directions: Chop tomatoes (approximately 6 cups) in large bowl.
Add seasonings and oil.
Let stand several hours or overnight; return to room temperature.
Cook pasta.
Add 1/4 cup oil from tomatoes and Parmesan to hot pasta and toss.
Add 1/2 tomatoes; toss. Grate white cheese; add to pasta with rest of tomatoes.
Toss and serve.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad *. Chop tomatoes (approximately 6 cups) in large bowl. Add seasonings and oil. Let stand several hours or overnight; return to room temperature. Cook pasta. Add 1/4 cup oil from tomatoes and Parmesan to hot pasta and toss. Add 1/2 tomatoes; toss. Grate white cheese; add to pasta with rest of tomatoes. Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Baked Brie Spread
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Set cheese in ovenproof serving dish; spread butter over top.
Arrange sliced almonds on butter; bake until softened and heated through, about 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve with bread and fruit.
Yield: 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Brie Spread. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Set cheese in ovenproof serving dish; spread butter over top. Arrange sliced almonds on butter; bake until softened and heated through, about 12 to 15 minutes. Serve with bread and fruit. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Warm Coconut Icing
directions: In a large skillet, melt butter in sugar, then pour in milk, stirring slowly until mixed well. Bring to boil and maintain a rolling boil, stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in coconut, then cool to desired consistency. Then pour over cake.
recipes.text: Warm Coconut Icing. In a large skillet, melt butter in sugar, then pour in milk, stirring slowly until mixed well. Bring to boil and maintain a rolling boil, stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in coconut, then cool to desired consistency. Then pour over cake.

recipes.title: Deluxe Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly.
Mix with the next 5 ingredients, then add the nuts.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Turn oven temperature to 350u00b0 and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes.
Filling should be slightly less set in the center than at the edges.
recipes.text: Deluxe Pecan Pie. Beat eggs slightly. Mix with the next 5 ingredients, then add the nuts. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes. Turn oven temperature to 350u00b0 and continue baking for 30 to 35 minutes. Filling should be slightly less set in the center than at the edges.

recipes.title: Pickles - Sweet And Sour
directions: Put pickles in jars.
Mix water, sugar, vinegar and salt. Heat until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over jars and water bath until the pickles begin to change color.
This makes 3 1/2 quarts.
recipes.text: Pickles - Sweet And Sour. Put pickles in jars. Mix water, sugar, vinegar and salt. Heat until sugar is dissolved. Pour over jars and water bath until the pickles begin to change color. This makes 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken
directions: Combine soy sauce, water, sugar and ginger.
Marinate chicken in sauce for 1 hour.
Simmer for 45 minutes.
Serve with rice and sauce.
recipes.text: Oriental Chicken. Combine soy sauce, water, sugar and ginger. Marinate chicken in sauce for 1 hour. Simmer for 45 minutes. Serve with rice and sauce.

recipes.title: Squash Pie
directions: Mix sugar, salt and spices.
Blend well into squash.
Beat 2 eggs separately; add milk and stir well.
Blend into squash mixture.
Pour into 9-inch pie plate lined with crust.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 minutes, then 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Pie. Mix sugar, salt and spices. Blend well into squash. Beat 2 eggs separately; add milk and stir well. Blend into squash mixture. Pour into 9-inch pie plate lined with crust. Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 minutes, then 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Jambalaya
directions: The rice must be boiled before you start; boil 1 3/4 cups rice and have ready cooling.
Then put in iron skillet 2 tablespoons bacon grease; fry chopped onions until edges begin to brown.
Add tomato paste or canned tomatoes, chopped green pepper, sausage and ham.
Fry, stirring well, for 15 to 20 minutes, then add boiled rice and cook slowly for almost 1 hour; stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Jambalaya. The rice must be boiled before you start; boil 1 3/4 cups rice and have ready cooling. Then put in iron skillet 2 tablespoons bacon grease; fry chopped onions until edges begin to brown. Add tomato paste or canned tomatoes, chopped green pepper, sausage and ham. Fry, stirring well, for 15 to 20 minutes, then add boiled rice and cook slowly for almost 1 hour; stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
directions: Salt and pepper meat to taste; coat with flour, then brown in oil, turning as needed.
Add bay leaf, onion, garlic powder and water; cover and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking.
Add rest of ingredients including remainder of flour. Cover and continue cooking until vegetables are tender.
Use heavy stew pan or roaster.
recipes.text: Beef Stew. Salt and pepper meat to taste; coat with flour, then brown in oil, turning as needed. Add bay leaf, onion, garlic powder and water; cover and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking. Add rest of ingredients including remainder of flour. Cover and continue cooking until vegetables are tender. Use heavy stew pan or roaster.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Bread
directions: In a large mixing bowl place 2 cups boiling water and 1 cup rolled oats.
Let stand 1 hour.
Add molasses, brown sugar, salt and butter.
Put into small bowl the lukewarm water and yeast. When dissolved, add the oatmeal.
Stir in flour.
Beat well and let rise until double in bulk.
Add enough flour to knead dough.
Shape into loaves.
Let rise until almost double in bulk.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350u00b0.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Bread. In a large mixing bowl place 2 cups boiling water and 1 cup rolled oats. Let stand 1 hour. Add molasses, brown sugar, salt and butter. Put into small bowl the lukewarm water and yeast. When dissolved, add the oatmeal. Stir in flour. Beat well and let rise until double in bulk. Add enough flour to knead dough. Shape into loaves. Let rise until almost double in bulk. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350u00b0. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Freezer Slaw
directions: Mix cabbage and salt together; let stand 1 hour.
Squeeze out by hand and set aside.
Boil together the vinegar, sugar, water, celery seed and mustard seed for 1 minute.
Add onion and carrot to cabbage mixture.
Pour boiled mixture over and freeze in containers.
recipes.text: Freezer Slaw. Mix cabbage and salt together; let stand 1 hour. Squeeze out by hand and set aside. Boil together the vinegar, sugar, water, celery seed and mustard seed for 1 minute. Add onion and carrot to cabbage mixture. Pour boiled mixture over and freeze in containers.

recipes.title: Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, cooked, boned and cubed
directions: Saute green pepper, onion and garlic in margarine until tender. Add 2 of the cans of soup and sour cream to pan.
Slowly add the grated pepper and Monterey Jack cheeses to pan, stirring and melting cheeses into mixture over moderate heat.
Add chicken and chiles.
Fill tortilla wrappers and roll.
Place in a lightly greased pan, side by side, snugly.
Take remaining can of soup. Add milk and 1/2 cup of leftover filling; mix well.
Pour over tortillas in pan.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes, until cheese melts.
May be frozen before baking step and used at a later time.
recipes.text: Chicken Burritos. Saute green pepper, onion and garlic in margarine until tender. Add 2 of the cans of soup and sour cream to pan. Slowly add the grated pepper and Monterey Jack cheeses to pan, stirring and melting cheeses into mixture over moderate heat. Add chicken and chiles. Fill tortilla wrappers and roll. Place in a lightly greased pan, side by side, snugly. Take remaining can of soup. Add milk and 1/2 cup of leftover filling; mix well. Pour over tortillas in pan. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes, until cheese melts. May be frozen before baking step and used at a later time.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Mix well and bake in a greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes (or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean).
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bars. Mix well and bake in a greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch pan at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes (or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean).

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Place marshmallows and milk in double boiler and melt, set aside and cool, can put in pan of cold water to cool. When cool add: pineapple and cool whip. Can add crushed graham crackers for garnish.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Place marshmallows and milk in double boiler and melt, set aside and cool, can put in pan of cold water to cool. When cool add: pineapple and cool whip. Can add crushed graham crackers for garnish.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert
directions: Make jello according to directions on box.
Chill until partially set up.
Tear angel food cake into bite size pieces. Mix jello, Cool Whip and strawberries together and stir in angel food cake.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish.
Chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Strawberry Dessert. Make jello according to directions on box. Chill until partially set up. Tear angel food cake into bite size pieces. Mix jello, Cool Whip and strawberries together and stir in angel food cake. Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Collard Greens
directions: Place bacon in large heavy kettle.
Brown carefully.
Add 1 cup water to hot kettle.
Put in collards (that have been washed and torn from large stems).
Turn burner to lowest heat (not simmer).
Cook 1 hour.
Add about 1 1/2 cups water before putting lid on to cook.
recipes.text: Collard Greens. Place bacon in large heavy kettle. Brown carefully. Add 1 cup water to hot kettle. Put in collards (that have been washed and torn from large stems). Turn burner to lowest heat (not simmer). Cook 1 hour. Add about 1 1/2 cups water before putting lid on to cook.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Strain macaroni; run cold water on, then drain.
Mix all ingredients together.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Strain macaroni; run cold water on, then drain. Mix all ingredients together.

recipes.title: Porcupines
directions: Mix meat, rice, 1/2 cup water, spices and onion.
Shape into 12 to 16 meatballs.
Stir together wet ingredients.
Pour over raw meatballs.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes, covered and 15 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Porcupines. Mix meat, rice, 1/2 cup water, spices and onion. Shape into 12 to 16 meatballs. Stir together wet ingredients. Pour over raw meatballs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes, covered and 15 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Zucchini
directions: Cook zucchini in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain.
Saute onion and green pepper in oil.
Add the beef; cook until beef is done.
Layer squash, veggies, meat and bread cubes in a greased casserole.
Season each layer with salt, pepper and paprika.
Top with the cheese; pour tomato sauce over cheese.
Bake, uncovered, at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hamburger-Zucchini. Cook zucchini in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain. Saute onion and green pepper in oil. Add the beef; cook until beef is done. Layer squash, veggies, meat and bread cubes in a greased casserole. Season each layer with salt, pepper and paprika. Top with the cheese; pour tomato sauce over cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
directions: Brown sausage.
Drain grease.
Layer 1/2 of corn in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Next, layer sausage and white sauce. Repeat with remainder of corn, sausage and white sauce.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Corn. Brown sausage. Drain grease. Layer 1/2 of corn in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Next, layer sausage and white sauce. Repeat with remainder of corn, sausage and white sauce. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Custard Pie
directions: Beat eggs; add sugar and milk that has been heated.
Add vanilla.
Spread a little of egg white over crust and pour in egg and sugar mixture.
Bake at 300u00b0 for about 30 minutes, until brown. Will make 1 deep-dish pie or 2 small pies.
recipes.text: Egg Custard Pie. Beat eggs; add sugar and milk that has been heated. Add vanilla. Spread a little of egg white over crust and pour in egg and sugar mixture. Bake at 300u00b0 for about 30 minutes, until brown. Will make 1 deep-dish pie or 2 small pies.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple And Orange Bread
directions: Sift flour, soda, baking powder and salt together into a bowl. In a blender, place shortening, orange juice, eggs and sugar; blend well.
Add apples and the orange.
Blend only until the fruit is chopped.
Add the raisins and nut meats and stir into the flour mixture.
Bake in a loaf pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple And Orange Bread. Sift flour, soda, baking powder and salt together into a bowl. In a blender, place shortening, orange juice, eggs and sugar; blend well. Add apples and the orange. Blend only until the fruit is chopped. Add the raisins and nut meats and stir into the flour mixture. Bake in a loaf pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bran Muffins
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Stir in bran.
Combine egg, banana, milk and salad oil.
Add liquid ingredients all at once to dry ingredients, stirring just till flour mixture is moistened.
Fill well-greased muffin pans 2/3 full.
Bake muffins in hot oven 400u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or till done. Makes about 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Banana Bran Muffins. Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir in bran. Combine egg, banana, milk and salad oil. Add liquid ingredients all at once to dry ingredients, stirring just till flour mixture is moistened. Fill well-greased muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake muffins in hot oven 400u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or till done. Makes about 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Delicious Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 box frozen spinach, chopped and thawed
directions: Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and soup mix together.
Let chill 3 hours before serving.
When ready to serve, squeeze all of the water out of spinach and add to mixture.
Cut a big hole in the center of the bread and fill with mixture.
Cube the piece of bread that you took out of the loaf to use to spoon the mixture onto the pieces of bread.
recipes.text: Delicious Spinach Dip. Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and soup mix together. Let chill 3 hours before serving. When ready to serve, squeeze all of the water out of spinach and add to mixture. Cut a big hole in the center of the bread and fill with mixture. Cube the piece of bread that you took out of the loaf to use to spoon the mixture onto the pieces of bread.

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein
directions: Cook ingredients until tender.
Cook 1/2 fryer.
When cool, cut into pieces to make 2 cups.
recipes.text: Chicken Chow Mein. Cook ingredients until tender. Cook 1/2 fryer. When cool, cut into pieces to make 2 cups.

recipes.title: Twinkie Dessert
directions: Break Twinkies in half and cover bottom of a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Drain pineapple and spread on Twinkies.
Prepare pudding as directed.
Spread over pineapple.
Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Twinkie Dessert. Break Twinkies in half and cover bottom of a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Drain pineapple and spread on Twinkies. Prepare pudding as directed. Spread over pineapple. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine the ingredients and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in a greased and floured Bundt pan or angel food cake pan.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Combine the ingredients and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in a greased and floured Bundt pan or angel food cake pan.

recipes.title: Punch
directions: Heat the first 4 ingredients until dissolved. Cool and add remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Punch. Heat the first 4 ingredients until dissolved. Cool and add remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Squash Dressing. Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Snacks
directions: Combine 3/4 cup of each cheese, chopped ham, light cream and the spices in top of a double boiler.
Heat until the cheeses melt.
Spread the warm mixture on the cocktail bread slices. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and broil lightly.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Snacks. Combine 3/4 cup of each cheese, chopped ham, light cream and the spices in top of a double boiler. Heat until the cheeses melt. Spread the warm mixture on the cocktail bread slices. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and broil lightly.

recipes.title: Larson'S 3-Bean Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Thoroughly brown hamburger.
Fry bacon to crisp stage.
Break into pieces.
Combine pork and beans, partially drained lima beans and partially drained kidney beans in a small roaster or large casserole.
Add ketchup, brown sugar and vinegar to bean mixture.
Add cooked meats and stir.
Bake for 40 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Larson'S 3-Bean Casserole. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Thoroughly brown hamburger. Fry bacon to crisp stage. Break into pieces. Combine pork and beans, partially drained lima beans and partially drained kidney beans in a small roaster or large casserole. Add ketchup, brown sugar and vinegar to bean mixture. Add cooked meats and stir. Bake for 40 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Rumaki Appetizer
ingredients: 36 pieces bacon, sliced and cut into 3-inch pieces
directions: Wrap pineapple chunks and water chestnuts with bacon and secure with wooden picks.
Place wrapped rumaki in bowl and pour dressing over. Toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Place on broiler pan and broil (or) bake at high temperature until bacon is crispy. Serve hot with extra dressing.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Rumaki Appetizer. Wrap pineapple chunks and water chestnuts with bacon and secure with wooden picks. Place wrapped rumaki in bowl and pour dressing over. Toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours. Place on broiler pan and broil (or) bake at high temperature until bacon is crispy. Serve hot with extra dressing.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix together eggs, sugar and baby food.
Add pineapple, raisins, oil, flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt, vanilla and walnuts; mix well.
Pour into 2 round cake pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Cool.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Mix together eggs, sugar and baby food. Add pineapple, raisins, oil, flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt, vanilla and walnuts; mix well. Pour into 2 round cake pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix together vegetables, cheese, mayonnaise and onion.
Pour into a 2-quart baking dish.
recipes.text: Mixed Vegetable Casserole. Mix together vegetables, cheese, mayonnaise and onion. Pour into a 2-quart baking dish.

recipes.title: Carl'S Marinated Shrimp
directions: Boil shrimp 3 minutes and peel.
Mix celery, pepper, onion, pimentos, oil, vinegar, cloves, water and brown sugar.
Mix thoroughly and pour over shrimp.
Mix well and marinate for 24 hours.
recipes.text: Carl'S Marinated Shrimp. Boil shrimp 3 minutes and peel. Mix celery, pepper, onion, pimentos, oil, vinegar, cloves, water and brown sugar. Mix thoroughly and pour over shrimp. Mix well and marinate for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Pork Pie
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for 9-inch double crust, deep dish pie
directions: Bake potato until done, 30 to 45 minutes in 400 degrees preheated oven. Peel and mash the potato. Place potato, ground pork, onion, spices and water in large frying pan. Simmer until very thick, for about 1 hour. Meanwhile, prepare your pastry. Line a deep-dish pie plate with pastry. Spoon in filling, spread evenly. Cover with top crust. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with paprika, if desired. Cut steam vent. Bake for 50 minutes at 350 degrees. If edges brown too fast, cover with a strip of foil. Serve warm.
recipes.text: Pork Pie. Bake potato until done, 30 to 45 minutes in 400 degrees preheated oven. Peel and mash the potato. Place potato, ground pork, onion, spices and water in large frying pan. Simmer until very thick, for about 1 hour. Meanwhile, prepare your pastry. Line a deep-dish pie plate with pastry. Spoon in filling, spread evenly. Cover with top crust. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with paprika, if desired. Cut steam vent. Bake for 50 minutes at 350 degrees. If edges brown too fast, cover with a strip of foil. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak With Mushroom-Onion Gravy
ingredients: 1 envelope onion soup mix, from a 2-ounce box of 2
directions: Mix 2 tablespoons soup mix and 1/4 cup water in large bowl. Add beef and parsley and mix until blended.
Shape into 4 oval patties, about 5 inches long and 2/3 inch thick. Coat patties with 1 1/2 tablespoon flour.
Melt butter in large skillet over medium. heat.
Add patties and cook about 10 minutes, turning once, until crusty and no longer pink in the middle.
Remove to a plate and keep warm.
Add onion, mushrooms and 1/4 cup water to the drippings in skillet.
Deglaze pan with wooden spoon.
Turn heat to medium-low, cover and cook, stirring occasionally until onion and mushrooms are soft. Mix remaining soup mix, 1 1/2 cup water and 2 1/2 tablespoons flour in a small bowl.
Stir into mushroom mixture, add bouillon cube and bring to a boil.
Cook, stirring often, until thickened.
Return patties to skillet and turn to coat with gravy. Remove to plates and serve with remaining gravy.
recipes.text: Salisbury Steak With Mushroom-Onion Gravy. Mix 2 tablespoons soup mix and 1/4 cup water in large bowl. Add beef and parsley and mix until blended. Shape into 4 oval patties, about 5 inches long and 2/3 inch thick. Coat patties with 1 1/2 tablespoon flour. Melt butter in large skillet over medium. heat. Add patties and cook about 10 minutes, turning once, until crusty and no longer pink in the middle. Remove to a plate and keep warm. Add onion, mushrooms and 1/4 cup water to the drippings in skillet. Deglaze pan with wooden spoon. Turn heat to medium-low, cover and cook, stirring occasionally until onion and mushrooms are soft. Mix remaining soup mix, 1 1/2 cup water and 2 1/2 tablespoons flour in a small bowl. Stir into mushroom mixture, add bouillon cube and bring to a boil. Cook, stirring often, until thickened. Return patties to skillet and turn to coat with gravy. Remove to plates and serve with remaining gravy.

recipes.title: Tropical Trail Mix
directions: Combine the ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Makes about 2 pounds.
recipes.text: Tropical Trail Mix. Combine the ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Makes about 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. chopped celery (we usually omit this)
directions: Cook broccoli.
Saute onions and celery.
Add margarine until soft.
Drain broccoli and chop.
Add onions and celery to Minute rice, cheese and soup.
(I saute the onions and celery in the margarine that the recipe calls for.)
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes, or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli. Saute onions and celery. Add margarine until soft. Drain broccoli and chop. Add onions and celery to Minute rice, cheese and soup. (I saute the onions and celery in the margarine that the recipe calls for.) Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes, or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 c. red hots or Cinnamon Imperials, crushed in blender
directions: Mix together and store in container with a tight lid.
