Use 2 1/2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea. Mix together and store in container with a tight lid. Use 2 1/2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

recipes.title: Chitlens
ingredients: 1 pepper pod or 1/2 tsp. crushed red pepper
directions: Fill a large basin with cold water.
Drop in chitlens and soak for 30 minutes.
Drain off water.

With a sharp paring knife, pull off fat under running water and discard the fat from the chitlens. Rinse the meat again with cold running water and let soak for 1 hour, changing the water several times.
Rinse the meat again under cold running water and place in a large Dutch oven or crockpot. (Chitlens should be thoroughly clean.)
Cover with water; add onion, vinegar, hot pepper pod, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil and reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 3 hours or until chitlens are fork-tender.
Cut into small pieces.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Chitlens. Fill a large basin with cold water. Drop in chitlens and soak for 30 minutes. Drain off water. With a sharp paring knife, pull off fat under running water and discard the fat from the chitlens. Rinse the meat again with cold running water and let soak for 1 hour, changing the water several times. Rinse the meat again under cold running water and place in a large Dutch oven or crockpot. (Chitlens should be thoroughly clean.) Cover with water; add onion, vinegar, hot pepper pod, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Cover and simmer 3 hours or until chitlens are fork-tender. Cut into small pieces. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Cream together sugar, salad oil and eggs.
Add flour, soda, cinnamon and salt.
Mix into creamed mixture.
Add grated carrots, pecan nuts and coconut.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until when toothpick is placed into cake it comes out clean.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Cream together sugar, salad oil and eggs. Add flour, soda, cinnamon and salt. Mix into creamed mixture. Add grated carrots, pecan nuts and coconut. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until when toothpick is placed into cake it comes out clean.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 lb. round steak, cut into strips
directions: Brown meat in oil; add next 7 ingredients.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Combine soy sauce, water and cornstarch.
Stir well.
Add to meat mixture.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Pepper Steak. Brown meat in oil; add next 7 ingredients. Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Combine soy sauce, water and cornstarch. Stir well. Add to meat mixture. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Meat And Potato Casserole
directions: Brown the ground meat. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add the uncooked onion. Slice the potatoes and add, uncooked.
Place in layers in casserole dish and top with the mushroom soup.
Cook 30 minutes at 350u00b0 or until potatoes are done.
recipes.text: Meat And Potato Casserole. Brown the ground meat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add the uncooked onion. Slice the potatoes and add, uncooked. Place in layers in casserole dish and top with the mushroom soup. Cook 30 minutes at 350u00b0 or until potatoes are done.

recipes.title: Easy Lemon Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks.
Add condensed milk and lemon juice.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
Let cool. Refrigerate.
Top with Cool Whip when serving.
recipes.text: Easy Lemon Pie. Beat egg yolks. Add condensed milk and lemon juice. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Let cool. Refrigerate. Top with Cool Whip when serving.

recipes.title: Cry Baby Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs, milk, molasses and soda. Add dry ingredients sifted together.
Add nuts and raisins.
Drop on cookie sheet.
Bake 12 minutes at 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Cry Baby Cookies. Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs, milk, molasses and soda. Add dry ingredients sifted together. Add nuts and raisins. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake 12 minutes at 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Quick Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Refrigerate until serving. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Quick Fruit Salad. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate until serving. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Potato Pierogi
directions: Combine flour, eggs, 1/2 teaspoon salt and water in a mixing bowl.
Mix well to make a medium soft dough.
Knead well until dough is firm.
Cover with a warm towel and let rest 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Pierogi. Combine flour, eggs, 1/2 teaspoon salt and water in a mixing bowl. Mix well to make a medium soft dough. Knead well until dough is firm. Cover with a warm towel and let rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Ramen Salad
ingredients: 2 pkg. Ramen Oriental noodles (any flavor), crushed very fine
1 small pkg. sunflower kernels (not dry roasted)*
directions: *About 1/2 cup each.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Ramen Salad. *About 1/2 cup each.

recipes.title: Eileen'S Chicken
directions: Clean chicken; set aside.
In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, empty the can of cream of celery soup and add 1 1/2 cans of water plus salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Add the stuffing mix; stir until the stuffing is even in the dish.
Add only the heads of the broccoli to the mixture.
Add the chicken to the dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes, or until chicken is done.
Remove the dish; sprinkle the grated Cheddar cheese on top.
Return to the oven for 10 minutes, or until the cheese has melted.
recipes.text: Eileen'S Chicken. Clean chicken; set aside. In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, empty the can of cream of celery soup and add 1 1/2 cans of water plus salt and pepper. Mix well. Add the stuffing mix; stir until the stuffing is even in the dish. Add only the heads of the broccoli to the mixture. Add the chicken to the dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes, or until chicken is done. Remove the dish; sprinkle the grated Cheddar cheese on top. Return to the oven for 10 minutes, or until the cheese has melted.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown ground meat; drain and rinse.
Mix in soup, cheese and green beans.
Cook until cheese is melted and mixed well.
Pour into casserole dish; place Tater Tots on top and cook in oven at 350u00b0 until Tater Tots are brown.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. Brown ground meat; drain and rinse. Mix in soup, cheese and green beans. Cook until cheese is melted and mixed well. Pour into casserole dish; place Tater Tots on top and cook in oven at 350u00b0 until Tater Tots are brown.

recipes.title: Frosty Fruit Punch
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen orange juice, thawed
1 (6 oz.) can frozen pineapple juice, thawed
1 1/2 qt. ginger ale or lemon-lime beverage, chilled
directions: Prepare orange juice and pineapple juice according to package directions.
Prepare lemonade using 3 cans of water.
Combine juices; chill at least 2 hours.
When ready to serve, pour mixture into punch bowl.
Add ginger ale, stirring gently to combine.
Add sherbets to mixture in small scoops.
Yields about 1 1/4 gallons.
recipes.text: Frosty Fruit Punch. Prepare orange juice and pineapple juice according to package directions. Prepare lemonade using 3 cans of water. Combine juices; chill at least 2 hours. When ready to serve, pour mixture into punch bowl. Add ginger ale, stirring gently to combine. Add sherbets to mixture in small scoops. Yields about 1 1/4 gallons.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
ingredients: 1 box (12 oz.) vanilla wafers, crushed (approximately 4 cups)
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add 6 eggs one at a time, beat well after each addition.
Add to above; vanilla wafers, crushed, 1/2 cup milk, Flaked coconut, chopped pecans.
Pour into greased and floured tube.
Bake at 275 for 1 1/2 hours or till done.
recipes.text: Vanilla Wafer Cake. Cream margarine and sugar. Add 6 eggs one at a time, beat well after each addition. Add to above; vanilla wafers, crushed, 1/2 cup milk, Flaked coconut, chopped pecans. Pour into greased and floured tube. Bake at 275 for 1 1/2 hours or till done.

recipes.title: Shrimp Ball
ingredients: 8 oz. cooked shrimp (save a few to decorate top)
directions: Let cream cheese soften until workable.
Mix all ingredients together well by hand.
Shape into ball.
Decorate top with whole shrimp.
Chill at least 2 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Shrimp Ball. Let cream cheese soften until workable. Mix all ingredients together well by hand. Shape into ball. Decorate top with whole shrimp. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Layered Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh spinach, washed and torn
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, rinsed with hot water
directions: Layer vegetables in a colorful way, using a clear bowl.
Start with spinach, then sprinkle salt, pepper and sugar.
Add layers as you like.
Layer 1/2 cup of bacon bits somewhere between layers. End with shredded cheese.
Cover with Miracle Whip; spread to edges of salad.
Sprinkle the other bacon bits over top.
Cover with clear wrap tightly.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Layered Spinach Salad. Layer vegetables in a colorful way, using a clear bowl. Start with spinach, then sprinkle salt, pepper and sugar. Add layers as you like. Layer 1/2 cup of bacon bits somewhere between layers. End with shredded cheese. Cover with Miracle Whip; spread to edges of salad. Sprinkle the other bacon bits over top. Cover with clear wrap tightly. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Oh Henry Bars
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add oats, Karo and vanilla.
Pat dough in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
While baking, melt chocolate chips with crunchy peanut butter.
Spread on dough after cooling slightly.
Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Oh Henry Bars. Cream butter and sugar. Add oats, Karo and vanilla. Pat dough in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350u00b0. While baking, melt chocolate chips with crunchy peanut butter. Spread on dough after cooling slightly. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Seasoned Salt
directions: Mix all ingredients and store in covered container.
recipes.text: Seasoned Salt. Mix all ingredients and store in covered container.

recipes.title: Congo Bars
directions: Cream together the margarine and brown sugar.
Add eggs and beat well.
Sift plain flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream this with eggs, chocolate bits and chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Congo Bars. Cream together the margarine and brown sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Sift plain flour, baking powder and salt. Cream this with eggs, chocolate bits and chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Parish Cake
directions: Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan; line the bottom with waxed paper.
Combine eggs and sugar; beat until light and lemon colored.
Sift the dry ingredients together.
Chop the chocolate pieces the size of lima beans.
Add the chocolate with the dates, nuts and cherries to the dry ingredients, then fold in egg mixture.
Pour into the pan and bake at 325u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours.
It's not exactly like a sponge cake; it's more like a fruit cake.
Delicious!
recipes.text: Parish Cake. Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan; line the bottom with waxed paper. Combine eggs and sugar; beat until light and lemon colored. Sift the dry ingredients together. Chop the chocolate pieces the size of lima beans. Add the chocolate with the dates, nuts and cherries to the dry ingredients, then fold in egg mixture. Pour into the pan and bake at 325u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours. It's not exactly like a sponge cake; it's more like a fruit cake. Delicious!

recipes.title: Pineapple Coleslaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients well and pour over coleslaw mix.
recipes.text: Pineapple Coleslaw. Mix dressing ingredients well and pour over coleslaw mix.

recipes.title: Mandarin Dijon Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 (4 oz.) boneless chicken breast halves, skinned
directions: Sprinkle chicken breasts generously with Dijon pepper and chicken soup mix.
Coat a large skillet with cooking spray.
Add vegetable oil.
Place skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add chicken to skillet and cook 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Mandarin Dijon Chicken Breasts. Sprinkle chicken breasts generously with Dijon pepper and chicken soup mix. Coat a large skillet with cooking spray. Add vegetable oil. Place skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add chicken to skillet and cook 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together; except coconut or nuts.
Then pour in coconut or nuts.
Mix well and pour into 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Mix all ingredients together; except coconut or nuts. Then pour in coconut or nuts. Mix well and pour into 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Spice Ornaments
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients.
Blend well.
Stir in applesauce.
It will be thick.
Roll out 1/4-inch thick.
Cut with cookie cutter and lay on brown paper.
Let dry for 4 to 5 days, uncovered.
While wet, take a toothpick and cut hole for ribbon. Smaller cookie cutters work best.
Use spatula to place on brown paper.
recipes.text: Spice Ornaments. Combine the first 4 ingredients. Blend well. Stir in applesauce. It will be thick. Roll out 1/4-inch thick. Cut with cookie cutter and lay on brown paper. Let dry for 4 to 5 days, uncovered. While wet, take a toothpick and cut hole for ribbon. Smaller cookie cutters work best. Use spatula to place on brown paper.

recipes.title: Meal-In-One
directions: Brown bacon and round steak in skillet, stirring to brown all sides.
Add next 5 ingredients, mixing well.
Simmer for 45 minutes or until meat is tender.
Stir in spaghetti and heat through.
Serve sprinkled with Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Meal-In-One. Brown bacon and round steak in skillet, stirring to brown all sides. Add next 5 ingredients, mixing well. Simmer for 45 minutes or until meat is tender. Stir in spaghetti and heat through. Serve sprinkled with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: "A" Quickie
directions: Brown sausage until crumbly, stirring occasionally to break it up.
While it is frying, combine corn and eggs (slightly beaten). Season with salt and green pepper.
recipes.text: "A" Quickie. Brown sausage until crumbly, stirring occasionally to break it up. While it is frying, combine corn and eggs (slightly beaten). Season with salt and green pepper.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Scald milk with bread crumbs, sugar, salt and oleo.
Pour some of hot mixture into beaten egg yolks.
Combine with other ingredients and pour in baking dish.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for about an hour or until pudding is firm.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Scald milk with bread crumbs, sugar, salt and oleo. Pour some of hot mixture into beaten egg yolks. Combine with other ingredients and pour in baking dish. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for about an hour or until pudding is firm.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole With Meatballs
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Arrange meatballs in bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Combine beans, milk, soup, pepper, French-fried onions and pimentos.
Blend gently.
Pour over meatballs in casserole. Bake, uncovered, in 350u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole With Meatballs. Arrange meatballs in bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Combine beans, milk, soup, pepper, French-fried onions and pimentos. Blend gently. Pour over meatballs in casserole. Bake, uncovered, in 350u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato Surprise("A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.")
directions: Peel and chill rounded tomatoes of even size.
Cut in halves, scoop out centers and drop into each a raw egg.
Dust with salt and pepper.
Cover each with a spoonful of white sauce and then with grated cheese.
Bake at 325u00b0 until egg is set.
recipes.text: Tomato Surprise("A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook."). Peel and chill rounded tomatoes of even size. Cut in halves, scoop out centers and drop into each a raw egg. Dust with salt and pepper. Cover each with a spoonful of white sauce and then with grated cheese. Bake at 325u00b0 until egg is set.

recipes.title: Cherry Whip
ingredients: 1 large size can crushed pineapple, drained well
directions: Mix together in large bowl pineapple and milk.
Add Cool Whip and mix well.
Fold in cherry pie filling; mix in nuts. Refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Cherry Whip. Mix together in large bowl pineapple and milk. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Fold in cherry pie filling; mix in nuts. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Lunch For A Bunch
ingredients: 1 small pkg. Hidden Valley original salad dressing mix
directions: Prepare roll mix according to package directions.
When ready to shape, on a well floured surface, knead the dough about 10 times.
Roll dough to form rectangles about 12 x 18 inches.
Mix 1 teaspoon dressing mix with butter; spread on dough.
Sprinkle on cheese and place ham slices on cheese.
Use the longer side and roll up, jelly roll fashion.
Pinch the raw edges into the dough and form a big circle (zero) on a greased pizza pan.
Pinch ends together.
Cover; let rise until double in size (about 45 to 60 minutes).
Slit top using kitchen shears every 3 inches.
Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes, or until top is golden brown. Cool on rack completely.
recipes.text: Lunch For A Bunch. Prepare roll mix according to package directions. When ready to shape, on a well floured surface, knead the dough about 10 times. Roll dough to form rectangles about 12 x 18 inches. Mix 1 teaspoon dressing mix with butter; spread on dough. Sprinkle on cheese and place ham slices on cheese. Use the longer side and roll up, jelly roll fashion. Pinch the raw edges into the dough and form a big circle (zero) on a greased pizza pan. Pinch ends together. Cover; let rise until double in size (about 45 to 60 minutes). Slit top using kitchen shears every 3 inches. Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes, or until top is golden brown. Cool on rack completely.

recipes.title: Chicken Marengo
ingredients: 4 to 6 Tbsp. olive or Canola oil
5 to 6 lb. broiler-fryer chickens, cut up
3 (16 oz.) cans whole tomatoes, drained and chopped
directions: In large skillet, heat 4 tablespoons oil over medium heat. Brown chicken, a few pieces at a time, about 5 to 8 minutes on each side.
Add more oil if necessary.
Remove chicken to heavy 8-quart Dutch oven with cover.
In same skillet saute mushrooms 2 minutes. Add garlic, thyme, basil and parsley and saute 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Transfer to Dutch oven.
Pour brandy and wine into same skillet.
Scraping up brown bits, cook over high heat until reduced by half.
Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes.
Baste chicken with sauce every 10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Chicken Marengo. In large skillet, heat 4 tablespoons oil over medium heat. Brown chicken, a few pieces at a time, about 5 to 8 minutes on each side. Add more oil if necessary. Remove chicken to heavy 8-quart Dutch oven with cover. In same skillet saute mushrooms 2 minutes. Add garlic, thyme, basil and parsley and saute 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Transfer to Dutch oven. Pour brandy and wine into same skillet. Scraping up brown bits, cook over high heat until reduced by half. Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Pour sauce over chicken. Cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. Baste chicken with sauce every 10 minutes. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Mix milk, egg yolks and lime juice until creamy.
Fold in stiffened egg white.
Pour in pie crust.
Beat remaining egg whites; gradually add sugar and cream of tartar until stiff peaks form.
Spread on pie and seal edges.
Bake at 350u00b0 until golden brown.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. Mix milk, egg yolks and lime juice until creamy. Fold in stiffened egg white. Pour in pie crust. Beat remaining egg whites; gradually add sugar and cream of tartar until stiff peaks form. Spread on pie and seal edges. Bake at 350u00b0 until golden brown.

recipes.title: Egg Sausage Brunch
ingredients: 6 slices white bread without crusts, cubed
1 1/2 lb. ground sausage, crumbled, browned and drained
directions: Combine eggs, salt and mustard. Beat together. Add milk, bread, cheese and sausage. Stir to blend. Pour into 8 x 12 Pyrex baking dish (buttered). Refrigerate overnight.
Place dish in pan of water (1/2 to 1-inch) in preheated 350u00b0 oven. Bake 45 to 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Egg Sausage Brunch. Combine eggs, salt and mustard. Beat together. Add milk, bread, cheese and sausage. Stir to blend. Pour into 8 x 12 Pyrex baking dish (buttered). Refrigerate overnight. Place dish in pan of water (1/2 to 1-inch) in preheated 350u00b0 oven. Bake 45 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Pie
directions: Cook all ingredients.
Pour in the two pie shells.
recipes.text: Butternut Squash Pie. Cook all ingredients. Pour in the two pie shells.

recipes.title: Quickie Chocolate Cake
directions: Heat margarine and Dr. Pepper until margarine melts.
Do not boil.
Sift together flour, sugar, cinnamon, salt and cocoa into mixing bowl.
Combine egg, buttermilk, soda and vanilla.
Add the hot Dr. Pepper mixture to the dry ingredients and blend well. Lastly add the egg mixture, mixing well.
Pour into a sheet cake pan and bake at 350u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes or until cake tests done.
recipes.text: Quickie Chocolate Cake. Heat margarine and Dr. Pepper until margarine melts. Do not boil. Sift together flour, sugar, cinnamon, salt and cocoa into mixing bowl. Combine egg, buttermilk, soda and vanilla. Add the hot Dr. Pepper mixture to the dry ingredients and blend well. Lastly add the egg mixture, mixing well. Pour into a sheet cake pan and bake at 350u00b0 for approximately 25 minutes or until cake tests done.

recipes.title: Marion'S Sittin' On A Ritz
directions: In a heavy saucepan, mix together dates, nuts and Eagle Brand milk over low heat and stirring constantly, cook until dates have melted.
Remove from heat and spoon topping onto a Ritz cracker. Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 minutes.
Remove from cookie sheet and cool. Cream together powdered sugar, butter and enough cream to make a smooth icing.
Top each Ritz with a dollop of icing.
recipes.text: Marion'S Sittin' On A Ritz. In a heavy saucepan, mix together dates, nuts and Eagle Brand milk over low heat and stirring constantly, cook until dates have melted. Remove from heat and spoon topping onto a Ritz cracker. Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet and cool. Cream together powdered sugar, butter and enough cream to make a smooth icing. Top each Ritz with a dollop of icing.

recipes.title: French Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients with beater until well mixed.
Store in chili sauce or salad dressing bottles in refrigerator at least 24 hours before using.
A clove of garlic may be grated and used in place of onion.
recipes.text: French Dressing. Mix all ingredients with beater until well mixed. Store in chili sauce or salad dressing bottles in refrigerator at least 24 hours before using. A clove of garlic may be grated and used in place of onion.

recipes.title: Pork Sausage Ring
directions: Mix all ingredients together and shape into ring in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Fill center with scrambled eggs, if desired.
Garnish with parsley and crabapples.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Pork Sausage Ring. Mix all ingredients together and shape into ring in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Fill center with scrambled eggs, if desired. Garnish with parsley and crabapples. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Taco Chili Dip
directions: Mix together and bake for 20 minutes to 1/2 hour at 250u00b0.
recipes.text: Taco Chili Dip. Mix together and bake for 20 minutes to 1/2 hour at 250u00b0.

recipes.title: Tuna And Macaroni Casserole(8 Servings)
directions: Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender.
Rinse in cold water and drain.
Combine with tuna, salt, green pepper, cheese, pepper and pimento.
Add Cream Sauce and mix well.
Pour into individual casseroles.
Top with buttered bread crumbs. Sprinkle lightly with paprika.
Bake at 350u00b0 until brown and bubbly (about 20 minutes).
recipes.text: Tuna And Macaroni Casserole(8 Servings). Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender. Rinse in cold water and drain. Combine with tuna, salt, green pepper, cheese, pepper and pimento. Add Cream Sauce and mix well. Pour into individual casseroles. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Bake at 350u00b0 until brown and bubbly (about 20 minutes).

recipes.title: Futti
directions: Boil chicken until tender.
Cool, debone, strain and reserve broth.
Brown ground beef, drain fat, wash rice, add to meat.
Add seasonings and pine nuts.
Add chicken broth to saucepan until mixture is just covered.
Cover and simmer approximately 30 minutes.
In separate bowl, mash 1 to 2 cloves garlic with salt to make a paste.
Add 1 cup vinegar and 2 cups chicken broth.
Toast bread and tear into bite size pieces.
In large bowl, combine chicken, meat and rice and toast.
Heat broth mixture, pour over and toss.
Season to taste.
recipes.text: Futti. Boil chicken until tender. Cool, debone, strain and reserve broth. Brown ground beef, drain fat, wash rice, add to meat. Add seasonings and pine nuts. Add chicken broth to saucepan until mixture is just covered. Cover and simmer approximately 30 minutes. In separate bowl, mash 1 to 2 cloves garlic with salt to make a paste. Add 1 cup vinegar and 2 cups chicken broth. Toast bread and tear into bite size pieces. In large bowl, combine chicken, meat and rice and toast. Heat broth mixture, pour over and toss. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Funnel Cakes
directions: Mix eggs and milk.
Sift together flour, salt, sugar and baking powder and add to egg mixture.
Beat smooth.
Adjust batter thickness with additional milk or flour.
Heat oil in 8-inch skillet.
Heat oil to 360u00b0.
Cover bottom of funnel with finger. Pour in 1/2 cup of batter and release into hot oil in spiral movement.
Fry golden about 3 minutes.
Turn carefully.
Cook 1 minute more, then drain on paper.
Sprinkle with sugar or serve with syrup.
They are best hot!
Microwave leftovers.
recipes.text: Funnel Cakes. Mix eggs and milk. Sift together flour, salt, sugar and baking powder and add to egg mixture. Beat smooth. Adjust batter thickness with additional milk or flour. Heat oil in 8-inch skillet. Heat oil to 360u00b0. Cover bottom of funnel with finger. Pour in 1/2 cup of batter and release into hot oil in spiral movement. Fry golden about 3 minutes. Turn carefully. Cook 1 minute more, then drain on paper. Sprinkle with sugar or serve with syrup. They are best hot! Microwave leftovers.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Roll into balls.
Cover with powdered sugar.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cookies. Mix all ingredients well. Roll into balls. Cover with powdered sugar. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Evelyn'S Fruit Cake
directions: Grease large loaf pans.
Line with foil and grease again. Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in large mixing bowl, adding fruit and pecans.
Mix well.
Beat eggs and rum.
Pour over mixture.
Pour into loaf pans.
Bake in 300u00b0 oven for 1 3/4 hours. Cool in loaf pan 15 minutes.
Brush top with corn syrup while warm.
recipes.text: Evelyn'S Fruit Cake. Grease large loaf pans. Line with foil and grease again. Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in large mixing bowl, adding fruit and pecans. Mix well. Beat eggs and rum. Pour over mixture. Pour into loaf pans. Bake in 300u00b0 oven for 1 3/4 hours. Cool in loaf pan 15 minutes. Brush top with corn syrup while warm.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheesecake
directions: Mix first four ingredients together, then pour into a greased 9-inch pie dish.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.
Then mix the next three ingredients and spread on top of pie.
Bake for 15 minutes more.
Let cool in oven with door open.
Top cooled pie with a can of cherry pie filling and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheesecake. Mix first four ingredients together, then pour into a greased 9-inch pie dish. Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes. Then mix the next three ingredients and spread on top of pie. Bake for 15 minutes more. Let cool in oven with door open. Top cooled pie with a can of cherry pie filling and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Baked Chuck Roast
directions: Place chuck roast in baking dish.
Pour over the tomato soup. Sprinkle the dry onion soup.
Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.
Cut into 1-inch pieces and serve.
recipes.text: Baked Chuck Roast. Place chuck roast in baking dish. Pour over the tomato soup. Sprinkle the dry onion soup. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for approximately 1 hour. Cut into 1-inch pieces and serve.

recipes.title: Cran-Orange Pickup
directions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth and frothy.
Serve immediately.
Good lunch substitute.
Contains 198 calories!
recipes.text: Cran-Orange Pickup. Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth and frothy. Serve immediately. Good lunch substitute. Contains 198 calories!

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: Cook rice. Add 12 cabbage leaves to 1 teaspoon salt/boiling water; let stand 5 minutes. Drain. Combine onions, garlic, meat, rice, eggs, pepper and 1 teaspoon salt. Place mound of meat mixture (1/2 cup) in hollow leaf; roll up, placing seam side down, single layer in lightly greased 13 x 9 pan. Combine, then pour sauce, tomatoes, lemon juice, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and sugar over cabbage rolls. Cover and bake at 375u00b0 for 50 minutes and uncovered for 10 minutes. Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Stuffed Cabbage. Cook rice. Add 12 cabbage leaves to 1 teaspoon salt/boiling water; let stand 5 minutes. Drain. Combine onions, garlic, meat, rice, eggs, pepper and 1 teaspoon salt. Place mound of meat mixture (1/2 cup) in hollow leaf; roll up, placing seam side down, single layer in lightly greased 13 x 9 pan. Combine, then pour sauce, tomatoes, lemon juice, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and sugar over cabbage rolls. Cover and bake at 375u00b0 for 50 minutes and uncovered for 10 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Brown sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
Drain. Line bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish with bread.
Layer cheese and sausage over bread.
Pour eggs over layers.
Chill, covered, overnight.
Bake for 30 minutes or until center is set in a preheated 350u00b0 oven.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Brown sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly. Drain. Line bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish with bread. Layer cheese and sausage over bread. Pour eggs over layers. Chill, covered, overnight. Bake for 30 minutes or until center is set in a preheated 350u00b0 oven. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Company Potatoes
ingredients: 6 or 7 medium potatoes, boiled with skins
directions: Slice
and
layer
potatoes
with
other ingredients in large casserole dish.
Blend mayonnaise and cheese for sauce. Pour over mixture.
Bake 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Company Potatoes. Slice and layer potatoes with other ingredients in large casserole dish. Blend mayonnaise and cheese for sauce. Pour over mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Cake
directions: Mix apples, 5 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients; beat until smooth.
Thoroughly grease and flour large tube pan.
(It helps to line the pan with paper.
Grease pan, then grease and flour paper.
Turn out and remove paper while still warm.)
recipes.text: Apple Pie Cake. Mix apples, 5 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients; beat until smooth. Thoroughly grease and flour large tube pan. (It helps to line the pan with paper. Grease pan, then grease and flour paper. Turn out and remove paper while still warm.)

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Use two bowls to mix this cake.
In one bowl, mix together the flour and butter and work until it is creamy.
In second bowl, mix eggs and sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
Then mix the two together, beating well.
Add baking powder, salt, butter flavoring, and lemon extract and vanilla extract.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour into a very large tube pan (or use 2 pans).
Bake 1 hour in 300u00b0 oven. Increase heat to 325u00b0 and bake 15 to 20 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Use two bowls to mix this cake. In one bowl, mix together the flour and butter and work until it is creamy. In second bowl, mix eggs and sugar, beating until light and fluffy. Then mix the two together, beating well. Add baking powder, salt, butter flavoring, and lemon extract and vanilla extract. Mix thoroughly. Pour into a very large tube pan (or use 2 pans). Bake 1 hour in 300u00b0 oven. Increase heat to 325u00b0 and bake 15 to 20 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. extra lemon juice, grate rind
directions: Mix together and pour into crusts; may be frozen.
Orange juice and rind may be substituted in place of lemon, if desired.
recipes.text: Lemon Pie. Mix together and pour into crusts; may be frozen. Orange juice and rind may be substituted in place of lemon, if desired.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and cook over low heat until mixture thickens.
Put in vanilla and margarine.
Pour into baked pie crust.
Top with meringue made from 3 egg whites and brown.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Mix first 5 ingredients and cook over low heat until mixture thickens. Put in vanilla and margarine. Pour into baked pie crust. Top with meringue made from 3 egg whites and brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Crescent
directions: Roll out rolls and coat with a thin layer of mayonnaise. Place cubed chicken in rolls and roll up. Mix soups and pour over rolls. Dot with butter. Bake at 350u00b0 until rolls are golden brown, approximately 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Crescent. Roll out rolls and coat with a thin layer of mayonnaise. Place cubed chicken in rolls and roll up. Mix soups and pour over rolls. Dot with butter. Bake at 350u00b0 until rolls are golden brown, approximately 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix taco seasoning, sour cream and mayonnaise together and let stand in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours or overnight.
Pour mixture into large serving dish; spread evenly.
Top with one layer shredded lettuce, one layer chopped tomatoes, one layer shredded cheese and one layer sliced black olives.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Mix taco seasoning, sour cream and mayonnaise together and let stand in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours or overnight. Pour mixture into large serving dish; spread evenly. Top with one layer shredded lettuce, one layer chopped tomatoes, one layer shredded cheese and one layer sliced black olives.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Nut Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy; add sugar, oil, vanilla, rhubarb and nuts.
Sift together dry ingredients and mix with creamed mixture.
Bake in two loaf pans for 50 minutes at 350u00b0. Chill 10 minutes and remove from pan.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Nut Bread. Beat eggs until light and fluffy; add sugar, oil, vanilla, rhubarb and nuts. Sift together dry ingredients and mix with creamed mixture. Bake in two loaf pans for 50 minutes at 350u00b0. Chill 10 minutes and remove from pan.

recipes.title: French Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
directions: In large mixer bowl, cream margarine and sugar.
Blend in chocolate and vanilla.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Beat 5 minutes after each at medium speed.
Do not underbeat.
Pour into baked pie shell and chill at least 2 hours.
recipes.text: French Chocolate Pie. In large mixer bowl, cream margarine and sugar. Blend in chocolate and vanilla. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat 5 minutes after each at medium speed. Do not underbeat. Pour into baked pie shell and chill at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: Holiday Fudge
directions: Place sugar, evaporated milk and butter in saucepan; bring to boil for 9 minutes, stirring constantly.
In large bowl mix German sweet chocolate, chocolate chips, Marshmallow Creme and vanilla. Pour milk mixture over chocolate and Marshmallow Creme.
Mix until chocolate is completely melted.
Add nuts.
Pour into greased pans and chill 12 to 24 hours.
recipes.text: Holiday Fudge. Place sugar, evaporated milk and butter in saucepan; bring to boil for 9 minutes, stirring constantly. In large bowl mix German sweet chocolate, chocolate chips, Marshmallow Creme and vanilla. Pour milk mixture over chocolate and Marshmallow Creme. Mix until chocolate is completely melted. Add nuts. Pour into greased pans and chill 12 to 24 hours.

recipes.title: Sausage Ring
directions: Mix all ingredients and press in ring mold to shape.
Bake on a pie plate or in pan for 1 hour at 350u00b0.
Serve on platter with broiled peaches around mold and scrambled eggs in the center of the ring.
recipes.text: Sausage Ring. Mix all ingredients and press in ring mold to shape. Bake on a pie plate or in pan for 1 hour at 350u00b0. Serve on platter with broiled peaches around mold and scrambled eggs in the center of the ring.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into small pieces
1 lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
directions: Layer first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Mix last 3 ingredients well and spread on top of layered salad, covering completely to the end of the bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Toss immediately before serving.
recipes.text: Layered Salad. Layer first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Mix last 3 ingredients well and spread on top of layered salad, covering completely to the end of the bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Toss immediately before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Put milk in mixing bowl and slowly pour lemon juice into milk while stirring.
Whip the cream and fold 2/3 of it into the lemon mixture.
Pour into pie shell.
Spread remainder of whipped cream on top.
Sprinkle generously with fresh grated lemon rind.
Place in freezer.
Serve partially frozen.
recipes.text: Lemon Icebox Pie. Put milk in mixing bowl and slowly pour lemon juice into milk while stirring. Whip the cream and fold 2/3 of it into the lemon mixture. Pour into pie shell. Spread remainder of whipped cream on top. Sprinkle generously with fresh grated lemon rind. Place in freezer. Serve partially frozen.

recipes.title: "No-Bake" Cookie Crumble Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. each cream cheese, softened
extra serving size prepared graham cracker crust
directions: In blender, sprinkle Knox gelatine over cold milk.
Let stand 2 minutes.
Add hot milk and process at low until dissolved, about 2 minutes.
Add cream cheese, sugar and vanilla and process until blended.
Arrange chocolate in bottom of crust.
Pour in gelatine mixture.
Sprinkle with crushed cookies.
Chill until firm, about 2 hours.
Makes 10 servings.
recipes.text: "No-Bake" Cookie Crumble Cheesecake. In blender, sprinkle Knox gelatine over cold milk. Let stand 2 minutes. Add hot milk and process at low until dissolved, about 2 minutes. Add cream cheese, sugar and vanilla and process until blended. Arrange chocolate in bottom of crust. Pour in gelatine mixture. Sprinkle with crushed cookies. Chill until firm, about 2 hours. Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Chicken And Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. sliced mushrooms or 1 large can sliced mushrooms
1/2 c. shredded, reduced-fat Monterey Jack cheese
1/4 c. + 2 Tbsp. Parmesan fat-free cheese alternative
directions: Saute onions and mushrooms in 1 tablespoon margarine in nonstick skillet for 5 minutes.
Place chicken in saucepan. Cover with 3 1/2 cups water.
Bring to boil and simmer for 30 minutes.
Let cool and shred chicken.
Save broth.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Chicken And Pasta Casserole. Saute onions and mushrooms in 1 tablespoon margarine in nonstick skillet for 5 minutes. Place chicken in saucepan. Cover with 3 1/2 cups water. Bring to boil and simmer for 30 minutes. Let cool and shred chicken. Save broth.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix soups and water together.
Add Cheez Whiz and mix well. Add onion, rice and broccoli.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased baking pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix soups and water together. Add Cheez Whiz and mix well. Add onion, rice and broccoli. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased baking pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Dip
ingredients: 1 large Velveeta, cut up in chunks
directions: Brown meat with bell pepper and onions.
Drain, then put in cut up cheese along with rest of ingredients.
Heat until melted or cook slowly in crock-pot, but keep warm!
recipes.text: Jalapeno Dip. Brown meat with bell pepper and onions. Drain, then put in cut up cheese along with rest of ingredients. Heat until melted or cook slowly in crock-pot, but keep warm!

recipes.title: Pizza Chicken Italiano
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, split, boned and skinned
1/2 tsp. each: garlic salt, onion powder and sugar
1 (2 1/4 oz.) can sliced ripe olives, drained
directions: Place chicken in 2-quart baking dish.
Combine tomato sauce, oregano, chopped parsley, garlic salt, onion powder and sugar. Pour over chicken.
Cover and bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Top with olives and Mozzarella cheese and continue to bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Pizza Chicken Italiano. Place chicken in 2-quart baking dish. Combine tomato sauce, oregano, chopped parsley, garlic salt, onion powder and sugar. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes. Top with olives and Mozzarella cheese and continue to bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sweet Party Mix
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and heat in microwave 2 minutes, stir. Microwave on High 2 minutes.
Add vanilla and soda and stir.
recipes.text: Sweet Party Mix. Mix first 3 ingredients and heat in microwave 2 minutes, stir. Microwave on High 2 minutes. Add vanilla and soda and stir.

recipes.title: Baked Potatoes
directions: Wash and dry potatoes.
Poke some holes in them.
Bake in microwave for 10 minutes.
Turn potatoes over; bake for 10 more minutes.
Take out and cut in half.
Melt butter in microwave.
In a baking pan place the potato halves.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour melted butter over potatoes.
Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered in oven at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Baked Potatoes. Wash and dry potatoes. Poke some holes in them. Bake in microwave for 10 minutes. Turn potatoes over; bake for 10 more minutes. Take out and cut in half. Melt butter in microwave. In a baking pan place the potato halves. Season with salt and pepper. Pour melted butter over potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake uncovered in oven at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Snickers Bar Salad
directions: Mix pudding as directed on box. Add Cool Whip and place in refrigerator.
Cut up the apples and Snickers bars.
Add to pudding mixture. Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Snickers Bar Salad. Mix pudding as directed on box. Add Cool Whip and place in refrigerator. Cut up the apples and Snickers bars. Add to pudding mixture. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Apple And Carrot Casserole
ingredients: 5 large red Delicious or York apples
directions: Slice carrots thinly and cook in salted water for 5 minutes. Drain.
Slice apples and cook in clear water 5 minutes; drain. Layer carrots and apples in casserole.
Mix sugar, flour and nutmeg and sprinkle over top.
Dot with butter.
Pour orange juice over all.
(Can be made ahead and baked just before serving.) Bake 30 to 40 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Apple And Carrot Casserole. Slice carrots thinly and cook in salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Slice apples and cook in clear water 5 minutes; drain. Layer carrots and apples in casserole. Mix sugar, flour and nutmeg and sprinkle over top. Dot with butter. Pour orange juice over all. (Can be made ahead and baked just before serving.) Bake 30 to 40 minutes in 350u00b0 oven. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Raisin Carrot Muffins
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and ginger; stir in carrots, raisins and nuts.
Separately combine undrained pineapple, eggs, butter and vanilla; stir into dry ingredients until just blended.
Spoon into greased muffin tins.
Bake in 375u00b0 oven 20 to 25 minutes.
Turn out onto rack to cool.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Raisin Carrot Muffins. Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and ginger; stir in carrots, raisins and nuts. Separately combine undrained pineapple, eggs, butter and vanilla; stir into dry ingredients until just blended. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake in 375u00b0 oven 20 to 25 minutes. Turn out onto rack to cool. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Fudge Candy
directions: Combine milk and cocoa in a saucepan.
Cook and beat over low heat until cocoa is dissolved.
Add butter, fructose, salt and vanilla.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat; add cereal crumbs and work in with wooden spoon. Cool 15 minutes.
Divide dough in half; roll each half into an 8-inch long tube.
Roll each tube in the finely chopped nuts. Wrap in waxed paper and chill overnight.
Cut into 1/4-inch slices.
recipes.text: Fudge Candy. Combine milk and cocoa in a saucepan. Cook and beat over low heat until cocoa is dissolved. Add butter, fructose, salt and vanilla. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat; add cereal crumbs and work in with wooden spoon. Cool 15 minutes. Divide dough in half; roll each half into an 8-inch long tube. Roll each tube in the finely chopped nuts. Wrap in waxed paper and chill overnight. Cut into 1/4-inch slices.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease a floured 8-inch loaf pan or two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Measure all ingredients, scraping sides and bottom of bowl.
Constantly pour into pans.
Bake for 55 to 65 minutes, or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from pan; cool thoroughly before slicing.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Grease a floured 8-inch loaf pan or two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Measure all ingredients, scraping sides and bottom of bowl. Constantly pour into pans. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes, or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from pan; cool thoroughly before slicing.

recipes.title: Crunchy Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1-inch balls.
Bake in a 375u00b0 oven about 10 to 20 minutes on cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Crunchy Meatballs. Mix all ingredients together and form into 1-inch balls. Bake in a 375u00b0 oven about 10 to 20 minutes on cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Panic
ingredients: 1 can apple pie filling or cherry
1 box Jiffy cake mix (spice is favorite)
directions: In buttered 9-inch square
Pyrex dish, spread pie filling. Spread cake mix over filling.
Pour margarine over cake mix. Sprinkle with pecans.
Bake in moderate oven until nuts are brown. Serve hot or cold with ice cream or whipped cream.
recipes.text: Panic. In buttered 9-inch square Pyrex dish, spread pie filling. Spread cake mix over filling. Pour margarine over cake mix. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake in moderate oven until nuts are brown. Serve hot or cold with ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Pork Chop Meal
ingredients: carrots, cut in strips, 3 to 4-inches long
directions: In Dutch oven, brown pork chops 2 to 3 at a time.
After all are browned, return them to Dutch oven.
Place potatoes, carrots, onions on top of chops.
Add tomato soup and 1 can water.
Add pepper and approximately 1 tablespoon parsley.
Simmer over medium heat approximately 30 minutes.
Add peppers and simmer another 30 minutes or until vegetables are cooked.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Pork Chop Meal. In Dutch oven, brown pork chops 2 to 3 at a time. After all are browned, return them to Dutch oven. Place potatoes, carrots, onions on top of chops. Add tomato soup and 1 can water. Add pepper and approximately 1 tablespoon parsley. Simmer over medium heat approximately 30 minutes. Add peppers and simmer another 30 minutes or until vegetables are cooked.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Taco Casserole
directions: Toss potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and salt. Press in bottom and up the sides of baking dish.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Taco Casserole. Toss potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese, 1/4 teaspoon pepper and salt. Press in bottom and up the sides of baking dish. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Bake, uncovered, in a 325u00b0 oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole. Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake, uncovered, in a 325u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Crescent Cookies
directions: Blend cottage cheese and 2 sticks margarine.
Sift in flour; blend until dough forms a ball (may be done in food processor). Divide dough into fourths.
If dough seems too soft to handle, refrigerate until firm enough to roll out.
On floured cloth, roll one quarter into a circle about 10 to 12 inches in diameter.
Brush with melted margarine; sprinkle with cinnamon, 1/4 of nuts and brown sugar.
Cut circle into 16 wedges.
Starting with wide end of each piece, roll up like crescent rolls.
Mix egg yolk with water; brush on each cookie.
Bake for about 20 minutes at 400u00b0.
Repeat with each section of dough.
While still warm, drizzle with confectioners sugar glaze, if desired.
Makes 64 cookies.
recipes.text: Crescent Cookies. Blend cottage cheese and 2 sticks margarine. Sift in flour; blend until dough forms a ball (may be done in food processor). Divide dough into fourths. If dough seems too soft to handle, refrigerate until firm enough to roll out. On floured cloth, roll one quarter into a circle about 10 to 12 inches in diameter. Brush with melted margarine; sprinkle with cinnamon, 1/4 of nuts and brown sugar. Cut circle into 16 wedges. Starting with wide end of each piece, roll up like crescent rolls. Mix egg yolk with water; brush on each cookie. Bake for about 20 minutes at 400u00b0. Repeat with each section of dough. While still warm, drizzle with confectioners sugar glaze, if desired. Makes 64 cookies.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine in a large warm mixing bowl the Marshmallow Creme, peanut butter and vanilla.
Combine sugar and milk in heavy saucepan.
Cook sugar mixture to soft ball stage or until candy thermometer registers 235u00b0.
Pour over the peanut butter mixture. Stir until mixed.
Spread in a buttered 8 x 8-inch square pan. Cool; cut into squares.
Makes 64 (1-inch) squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Combine in a large warm mixing bowl the Marshmallow Creme, peanut butter and vanilla. Combine sugar and milk in heavy saucepan. Cook sugar mixture to soft ball stage or until candy thermometer registers 235u00b0. Pour over the peanut butter mixture. Stir until mixed. Spread in a buttered 8 x 8-inch square pan. Cool; cut into squares. Makes 64 (1-inch) squares.

recipes.title: Oven Baked French Fries
directions: Dip potatoes in Butter Buds.
Arrange on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
Turn and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Oven Baked French Fries. Dip potatoes in Butter Buds. Arrange on a lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Turn and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cooked and diced small
2 c. Delicious apples (with skins on), diced small
directions: Mix all ingredients, except mayonnaise, in a large bowl.
Set aside.
Chop 3 heads of lettuce and 2 heads of Romaine lettuce. Place in separate bowl.
Do not mix with ingredients until ready to serve.
When ready to serve, mix all ingredients, including mayonnaise, and mix well.
Serve.
Serves 10 or more.
recipes.text: Waldorf Salad. Mix all ingredients, except mayonnaise, in a large bowl. Set aside. Chop 3 heads of lettuce and 2 heads of Romaine lettuce. Place in separate bowl. Do not mix with ingredients until ready to serve. When ready to serve, mix all ingredients, including mayonnaise, and mix well. Serve. Serves 10 or more.

recipes.title: Dilly Salmon Loaf
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can salmon, drained and flaked
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In a large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well.
Shape into loaf.
Place in greased, shallow baking dish.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with Lemony Dill Sauce.
Garnish as desired.
Refrigerate leftovers.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Dilly Salmon Loaf. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well. Shape into loaf. Place in greased, shallow baking dish. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Serve with Lemony Dill Sauce. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tuna Buns
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. sweet pickles (pickle relish may be used)
1 pkg. onion buns (hamburger buns may be used)
directions: Mix all
ingredients
together.
Split
buns and spread mixture on the bun.
Wrap
in
foil and bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
May be frozen.
A good Lenten meal.
recipes.text: Tuna Buns. Mix all ingredients together. Split buns and spread mixture on the bun. Wrap in foil and bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. May be frozen. A good Lenten meal.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Place apples in a greased 8-inch pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon, salt and water.
Rub together flour, sugar and butter.
Drop over apples and bake for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Place apples in a greased 8-inch pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon, salt and water. Rub together flour, sugar and butter. Drop over apples and bake for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese(Microwave)
directions: Place butter in a 2-quart casserole dish and melt.
Add salt and pepper.
Add milk slowly, stirring constantly.
Microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes or until thick.
Stir several times during last half of cooking time to prevent lumping.
Stir in cheese. Add cooked macaroni.
Cover with tight fitting lid or plastic wrap.
Microwave on Medium for 12 to 15 minutes or until heated throughout, stirring halfway through cooking time.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese(Microwave). Place butter in a 2-quart casserole dish and melt. Add salt and pepper. Add milk slowly, stirring constantly. Microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes or until thick. Stir several times during last half of cooking time to prevent lumping. Stir in cheese. Add cooked macaroni. Cover with tight fitting lid or plastic wrap. Microwave on Medium for 12 to 15 minutes or until heated throughout, stirring halfway through cooking time.

recipes.title: Scrumptious Croutons
directions: Take the
loaf of bread and set slices out to dry.
Cut into cubes. Combine the melted stick of margarine with the Italian dressing.
Mix until it does not separate.
Pour over bread and stir.
Bake a single layer of croutons on a cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until they start to get golden brown around the edges. Stir croutons a couple of times while baking.
recipes.text: Scrumptious Croutons. Take the loaf of bread and set slices out to dry. Cut into cubes. Combine the melted stick of margarine with the Italian dressing. Mix until it does not separate. Pour over bread and stir. Bake a single layer of croutons on a cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until they start to get golden brown around the edges. Stir croutons a couple of times while baking.

recipes.title: Pork Chops Parmesan(Low-Fat)
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. cornmeal, whole wheat flour or bread crumbs
directions: Combine the cornmeal, Parmesan cheese, black pepper, salt and basil.
Trim the pork chops of all visible fat, pat them dry and dredge in the cornmeal mixture.
Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the oil.
When the oil is hot, place the chops in the skillet. Reduce the heat to low.
Fry the chops for 10 minutes on each side, then add the onions, garlic and fennel; continue frying for another 10 minutes, turning as necessary to keep from sticking. Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Pork Chops Parmesan(Low-Fat). Combine the cornmeal, Parmesan cheese, black pepper, salt and basil. Trim the pork chops of all visible fat, pat them dry and dredge in the cornmeal mixture. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the oil. When the oil is hot, place the chops in the skillet. Reduce the heat to low. Fry the chops for 10 minutes on each side, then add the onions, garlic and fennel; continue frying for another 10 minutes, turning as necessary to keep from sticking. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Fruit Strudel
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. apples, peeled, cored and diced
1 1/2 c. pears, peeled, cored and diced
1 c. fresh apricots, cored, diced, drained and rinsed
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Spray cookie sheet with nonstick spray. In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients except phyllo sheets. Spread mixture on prepared cookie sheets.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until fruit is tender.
Cool completely.
Increase oven temperature to 400u00b0.
Layer three phyllo sheets on top of one another.
Spoon one-half mixture along the edge of the phyllo. Roll phyllo jelly roll fashion and place on cookie sheet prepared with nonstick spray.
Spray strudel with spray to prevent drying. Score top of strudel with 7 diagonal cuts.
Do not cut all the way through.
Repeat process for second strudel.
Bake for about 10 minutes.
Yields 2 strudels, 8 servings.
recipes.text: Fruit Strudel. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Spray cookie sheet with nonstick spray. In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients except phyllo sheets. Spread mixture on prepared cookie sheets. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes until fruit is tender. Cool completely. Increase oven temperature to 400u00b0. Layer three phyllo sheets on top of one another. Spoon one-half mixture along the edge of the phyllo. Roll phyllo jelly roll fashion and place on cookie sheet prepared with nonstick spray. Spray strudel with spray to prevent drying. Score top of strudel with 7 diagonal cuts. Do not cut all the way through. Repeat process for second strudel. Bake for about 10 minutes. Yields 2 strudels, 8 servings.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix sour cream, cream cheese and taco mix.
Spread on large platter or plate.
Layer lettuce, tomato and cheese.
Serve with Tostitos, Doritos or nacho chips.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Mix sour cream, cream cheese and taco mix. Spread on large platter or plate. Layer lettuce, tomato and cheese. Serve with Tostitos, Doritos or nacho chips.

recipes.title: Date Bars
directions: Beat eggs with sugar until very thick.
Add sifted dry ingredients; beat smooth.
Add dates, vanilla extract and nuts. Bake in waxed paper-lined 9 x 13-inch pan in moderate oven at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.
While warm, cut in 1 x 4-inch bars.
Roll in confectioners sugar.
Makes 2 dozen bars.
recipes.text: Date Bars. Beat eggs with sugar until very thick. Add sifted dry ingredients; beat smooth. Add dates, vanilla extract and nuts. Bake in waxed paper-lined 9 x 13-inch pan in moderate oven at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes. While warm, cut in 1 x 4-inch bars. Roll in confectioners sugar. Makes 2 dozen bars.

recipes.title: Green Beans
directions: Put bacon in iron skillet.
Cook until just hot.
Pour two cans of green beans with liquid into the skillet.
Drain the other two cans and pour beans in skillet.
Cook until all juice cooks out.
You can add garlic salt, thin onion rings, new potatoes.
recipes.text: Green Beans. Put bacon in iron skillet. Cook until just hot. Pour two cans of green beans with liquid into the skillet. Drain the other two cans and pour beans in skillet. Cook until all juice cooks out. You can add garlic salt, thin onion rings, new potatoes.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and mix until well blended.
recipes.text: Waldorf Salad. Mix all ingredients and mix until well blended.

recipes.title: Cucumber Cooly
ingredients: 1 onion, sliced and separated into rings
directions: Toss all ingredients together and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Cucumber Cooly. Toss all ingredients together and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Sliced Cookies
directions: Beat eggs and then put in sugar.
Add oil.
Add flour mixed with baking powder.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon to form loaf on each side of pans.
Cook at 375u00b0 until they are brown.
Slice and toast.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Sliced Cookies. Beat eggs and then put in sugar. Add oil. Add flour mixed with baking powder. Add vanilla and nuts. Drop by teaspoon to form loaf on each side of pans. Cook at 375u00b0 until they are brown. Slice and toast. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Never Fail Roast
directions: Chop garlic; mix with salt and pepper.
Cut several holes in roast and stuff with garlic.
Place roast in Dutch oven size pot. Heat oven to 450u00b0 to 475u00b0.
Roast without lid on 30 minutes to brown.
Add 2-inches water to bottom of pot.
Cover with lid and lower oven to 275u00b0 to 300u00b0 for 2 1/2 undisturbed hours.
recipes.text: Never Fail Roast. Chop garlic; mix with salt and pepper. Cut several holes in roast and stuff with garlic. Place roast in Dutch oven size pot. Heat oven to 450u00b0 to 475u00b0. Roast without lid on 30 minutes to brown. Add 2-inches water to bottom of pot. Cover with lid and lower oven to 275u00b0 to 300u00b0 for 2 1/2 undisturbed hours.

recipes.title: Fresh Blueberry Pie
directions: Combine 1 cup blueberries, sugar and water in saucepan.
Mix cornstarch with a little of the water; stir until a smooth paste. Add to pan.
Stir until slightly thickened.
Remove from heat; add lemon juice, butter and jello.
Stir; let cool.
Pour over remaining 3 cups of berries in baked pie shell.
Chill several hours and garnish with whipped topping.
recipes.text: Fresh Blueberry Pie. Combine 1 cup blueberries, sugar and water in saucepan. Mix cornstarch with a little of the water; stir until a smooth paste. Add to pan. Stir until slightly thickened. Remove from heat; add lemon juice, butter and jello. Stir; let cool. Pour over remaining 3 cups of berries in baked pie shell. Chill several hours and garnish with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Weekend Candy
directions: Boil sugar, syrup and creamer in a saucepan to soft ball stage.
Cool to lukewarm, about 30 minutes.
Add vanilla.
Stir until begins to thicken.
Add fruit and nuts.
Press into buttered pan.
Work quickly.
When cool, cut in squares.
recipes.text: Weekend Candy. Boil sugar, syrup and creamer in a saucepan to soft ball stage. Cool to lukewarm, about 30 minutes. Add vanilla. Stir until begins to thicken. Add fruit and nuts. Press into buttered pan. Work quickly. When cool, cut in squares.

recipes.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Grease a Bundt pan well.
Beat eggs; add sugar.
Pour in sour cream and oil.
Mix well.
Add poppy seed.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about an hour.
Let cool. Sift powdered sugar over cake.
recipes.text: Lemon Poppy Seed Cake. Grease a Bundt pan well. Beat eggs; add sugar. Pour in sour cream and oil. Mix well. Add poppy seed. Bake at 350u00b0 for about an hour. Let cool. Sift powdered sugar over cake.

recipes.title: Egg Pastry For Deep Dish Pie
directions: Combine flour and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Combine water, egg and vinegar and add to flour mixture. Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened.
Shape dough into a ball and chill.
Divide dough into 2 equal portions.
Roll each portion to 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface. Use for making a 2-crust deep dish pie (such as Upside-Down Apple Pie) or for 2 single crust, deep dish pie shells.
recipes.text: Egg Pastry For Deep Dish Pie. Combine flour and salt in a large mixing bowl. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Combine water, egg and vinegar and add to flour mixture. Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Shape dough into a ball and chill. Divide dough into 2 equal portions. Roll each portion to 1/8-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface. Use for making a 2-crust deep dish pie (such as Upside-Down Apple Pie) or for 2 single crust, deep dish pie shells.

recipes.title: Divinity Fudge
ingredients: 2 egg whites, beaten stiff but not dry
directions: Cook the first 4 ingredients until hard ball stage, 250u00b0 on thermometer.
Slowly pour onto the stiffly beaten egg whites.
Keep beating until set and add the vanilla.
Spoon onto waxed paper to make individual pieces of candy.
recipes.text: Divinity Fudge. Cook the first 4 ingredients until hard ball stage, 250u00b0 on thermometer. Slowly pour onto the stiffly beaten egg whites. Keep beating until set and add the vanilla. Spoon onto waxed paper to make individual pieces of candy.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 6 toasted bread slices, cubed and buttered
directions: Put 6 bread slices, toasted, cubed and buttered in a baking dish.
Mix pineapple, egg, sugar, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon and lemon juice.
Pour over bread cubes and dot with butter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for one hour, uncovered.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Put 6 bread slices, toasted, cubed and buttered in a baking dish. Mix pineapple, egg, sugar, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon and lemon juice. Pour over bread cubes and dot with butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for one hour, uncovered.

recipes.title: Puffy Potato Doughnuts
directions: Scald milk.
Stir in butter, 1 cup sugar and salt.
Cool to lukewarm.
Sprinkle yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar on lukewarm water; stir to dissolve.
Add yeast, baking powder, baking soda, mashed potatoes, egg yolks and 2 cups flour to milk mixture.
Beat with electric mixer at medium speed until smooth, about 2 minutes, scraping bowl.
Or, beat with spoon until batter is smooth. Gradually add remaining flour, blending well.
(Dough will be soft.) Place in lightly greased bowl.
Turn dough over to grease top.
Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled, about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Puffy Potato Doughnuts. Scald milk. Stir in butter, 1 cup sugar and salt. Cool to lukewarm. Sprinkle yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar on lukewarm water; stir to dissolve. Add yeast, baking powder, baking soda, mashed potatoes, egg yolks and 2 cups flour to milk mixture. Beat with electric mixer at medium speed until smooth, about 2 minutes, scraping bowl. Or, beat with spoon until batter is smooth. Gradually add remaining flour, blending well. (Dough will be soft.) Place in lightly greased bowl. Turn dough over to grease top. Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled, about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw spinach and wring out water.
Mix all ingredients together.
Hollow out bread and fill with dip.
Use the bread from the center of the loaf for dipping.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Thaw spinach and wring out water. Mix all ingredients together. Hollow out bread and fill with dip. Use the bread from the center of the loaf for dipping.

recipes.title: Short Ribs And Zucchini
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. short ribs, sliced (4 to 6)
directions: Brown ribs on both sides, drain grease.
Pour tomatoes and Italian seasoning over ribs.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cover, bring to boil for 5 minutes, then simmer until ribs are tender. Slice zucchini and place over ribs.
Simmer until zucchini is tender.
Serve on platter with zucchini and tomatoes around ribs.
recipes.text: Short Ribs And Zucchini. Brown ribs on both sides, drain grease. Pour tomatoes and Italian seasoning over ribs. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover, bring to boil for 5 minutes, then simmer until ribs are tender. Slice zucchini and place over ribs. Simmer until zucchini is tender. Serve on platter with zucchini and tomatoes around ribs.

recipes.title: Southern Red Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. sliced Rogerwood smoked sausage (can use less sausage, if desired)
2 c. tomato juice or canned tomatoes
directions: Brown sliced Rogerwood smoked sausage in bacon drippings. Combine with remaining ingredients. Crumble fried bacon into ingredients.
Mix well. Place in casserole dish. Cover and bake in a 350u00b0 oven for one hour.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Southern Red Rice Casserole. Brown sliced Rogerwood smoked sausage in bacon drippings. Combine with remaining ingredients. Crumble fried bacon into ingredients. Mix well. Place in casserole dish. Cover and bake in a 350u00b0 oven for one hour. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Party Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 250u00b0.
Heat butter in roasting pan.
Stir in salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Add cereal and nuts, mix well. Heat in oven 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.
Spread on absorbent paper to cool.
recipes.text: Party Mix. Preheat oven to 250u00b0. Heat butter in roasting pan. Stir in salt and Worcestershire sauce. Add cereal and nuts, mix well. Heat in oven 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Spread on absorbent paper to cool.

recipes.title: Two By Four Stew
directions: Cook ground meat until well done.
Pour all other ingredients into drained ground meat.
Let simmer for about 20 minutes and eat.
recipes.text: Two By Four Stew. Cook ground meat until well done. Pour all other ingredients into drained ground meat. Let simmer for about 20 minutes and eat.

recipes.title: Giant Crisp Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix flour, soda and salt.
Cream butter, sugar, egg and vanilla until blended.
Mix with flour mixture, chocolate and nuts.
Shape into 2-inch balls and place 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 23 minutes. Yields 21 (4-inch) cookies.
recipes.text: Giant Crisp Chocolate Chip Cookies. Mix flour, soda and salt. Cream butter, sugar, egg and vanilla until blended. Mix with flour mixture, chocolate and nuts. Shape into 2-inch balls and place 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 23 minutes. Yields 21 (4-inch) cookies.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves, skin removed
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Shake flour in large oven bag.
Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Add spaghetti sauce to bag. Squeeze bag to blend.
Add chicken and green pepper; turn bag to coat chicken.
Arrange chicken in an even layer.
Close bag with tie.
Cut six 1/2-inch slits in top.
Bake about 35 to 40 minutes. Serve over hot pasta.
recipes.text: Italian Chicken. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Shake flour in large oven bag. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Add spaghetti sauce to bag. Squeeze bag to blend. Add chicken and green pepper; turn bag to coat chicken. Arrange chicken in an even layer. Close bag with tie. Cut six 1/2-inch slits in top. Bake about 35 to 40 minutes. Serve over hot pasta.

recipes.title: Sausage Meat Balls
directions: Combine sausage, eggs, bread crumbs and sage; form into small balls.
Brown; pour off fat.
Mix ketchup, sugar, vinegar and soy sauce.
Pour over meat balls.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Meat Balls. Combine sausage, eggs, bread crumbs and sage; form into small balls. Brown; pour off fat. Mix ketchup, sugar, vinegar and soy sauce. Pour over meat balls. Simmer for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Picado
directions: Brown chicken slices in ovenproof pan.
Remove with slotted spoon.
Saute green peppers over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes.
Add chicken back, cook until just done, remove from heat.
Preheat broiler to high.
Top chicken mixture with butter, garlic and cheese.
Place under broiler 6 to 7 minutes, until well browned. Garnish with sliced green onion.
Serve with warm tortillas and Spanish rice.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken Picado. Brown chicken slices in ovenproof pan. Remove with slotted spoon. Saute green peppers over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes. Add chicken back, cook until just done, remove from heat. Preheat broiler to high. Top chicken mixture with butter, garlic and cheese. Place under broiler 6 to 7 minutes, until well browned. Garnish with sliced green onion. Serve with warm tortillas and Spanish rice. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Surprise
ingredients: 2 cans your favorite vegetables (i.e., corn, lima beans, string beans)
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Brown ground beef.
Place in the bottom of a small to medium size glass pan or any casserole dish.
Pour in your vegetables, mix in salt and pepper as needed.
Cover top with mashed potatoes, then sprinkle on paprika.
Cook until bubbly and browned, approximately 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Surprise. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Brown ground beef. Place in the bottom of a small to medium size glass pan or any casserole dish. Pour in your vegetables, mix in salt and pepper as needed. Cover top with mashed potatoes, then sprinkle on paprika. Cook until bubbly and browned, approximately 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Rotini Pasta With Vodka
ingredients: 1 (25 oz.) jar Ragu pasta sauce with mushrooms
directions: In a large pot, bring 5 quarts of water to a boil. Add salt and cook pasta according to package instructions. On low flame in a large skillet, add butter. Bring to simmer but not burn. Remove skillet from flame while adding vodka, then return to flame. Let vodka evaporate, 1 to 2 minutes, then add Ragu sauce. Bring to a simmer and cook until sauce is heated through. Drain pasta. Pour into skillet with sauce and mix until pasta is well coated. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Rotini Pasta With Vodka. In a large pot, bring 5 quarts of water to a boil. Add salt and cook pasta according to package instructions. On low flame in a large skillet, add butter. Bring to simmer but not burn. Remove skillet from flame while adding vodka, then return to flame. Let vodka evaporate, 1 to 2 minutes, then add Ragu sauce. Bring to a simmer and cook until sauce is heated through. Drain pasta. Pour into skillet with sauce and mix until pasta is well coated. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Basic White Sauce
directions: Melt margarine in a skillet; add flour, salt and pepper. Slowly add milk and stir until thickened.
recipes.text: Basic White Sauce. Melt margarine in a skillet; add flour, salt and pepper. Slowly add milk and stir until thickened.

recipes.title: Natalie'S Party Snack
ingredients: 1 round loaf Hawaiian bread (may want 1 extra to cut into cubes for dipping)
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Cut off top of bread and hollow out inside. Save bread for dipping. Put cheese mixture in bread loaf. Put top back on. Wrap loaf in foil twice (heavy foil best). Warm in oven at 400u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Natalie'S Party Snack. Mix all ingredients together. Cut off top of bread and hollow out inside. Save bread for dipping. Put cheese mixture in bread loaf. Put top back on. Wrap loaf in foil twice (heavy foil best). Warm in oven at 400u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
ingredients: 4 c. crushed graham crackers or 1 box vanilla wafers
directions: Place ingredients in 9 x 13-inch baking dish by layering pattern following: cherries, mini chocolate chips, Cool Whip, chopped nuts, pudding, bananas, pudding (mixed as directed) and crust.
Cool overnight before serving.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Place ingredients in 9 x 13-inch baking dish by layering pattern following: cherries, mini chocolate chips, Cool Whip, chopped nuts, pudding, bananas, pudding (mixed as directed) and crust. Cool overnight before serving.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Slice and cook the squash with onion; drain.
Mix flour, milk and cheese and pour over squash.
Top with crumbs.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Slice and cook the squash with onion; drain. Mix flour, milk and cheese and pour over squash. Top with crumbs. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Salad 2
directions: Marinate chicken in teriyaki sauce. Bake or fry chicken until done. Cool. Remove bones and shred chicken into long strips.
recipes.text: Chinese Chicken Salad 2. Marinate chicken in teriyaki sauce. Bake or fry chicken until done. Cool. Remove bones and shred chicken into long strips.

recipes.title: Very Special Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese (room temperature)
2 (1/2 pt.) cultured sour cream (if too thin, increase cream cheese)
2 small cans deveined shrimp, cut in small pieces
3 Tbsp. finely cut onions (more, if desired)
2 small envelopes George Washington concentrate soup (light preferred)
directions: Whip all together with an electric portable beater or hand beater until well mixed and smooth.
Chill before using.
Keeps for a week under refrigeration.
recipes.text: Very Special Shrimp Dip. Whip all together with an electric portable beater or hand beater until well mixed and smooth. Chill before using. Keeps for a week under refrigeration.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
ingredients: 2 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed
directions: Mix ingredients.
Work into flour until stiff, like regular biscuit dough.
Roll and cook until lite brown at 450u00b0.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Biscuits. Mix ingredients. Work into flour until stiff, like regular biscuit dough. Roll and cook until lite brown at 450u00b0.

recipes.title: Creamed Sweetbreads
directions: Rinse and soak the sweetbreads in cold water for 2 hours. Drain and remove any fat attached.

Put the sweetbreads, vegetables, herbs, salt and pepper in a saucepan with water to cover. Simmer gently for about 15 minutes until the sweetbreads are tender. Drain, reserving 1/2 pint of the cooking liquid.
Keep hot.
Put the butter, flour, milk and reserved stock in a saucepan.
Heat, whisking continuously, until the sauce thickens, boils and is smooth. Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes.
Season to taste and add the lemon juice.
Add the sweetbreads to the sauce and simmer gently for 5 to 10 minutes. Garnish with parsley and serve at once with new potatoes and a green vegetable.
recipes.text: Creamed Sweetbreads. Rinse and soak the sweetbreads in cold water for 2 hours. Drain and remove any fat attached. Put the sweetbreads, vegetables, herbs, salt and pepper in a saucepan with water to cover. Simmer gently for about 15 minutes until the sweetbreads are tender. Drain, reserving 1/2 pint of the cooking liquid. Keep hot. Put the butter, flour, milk and reserved stock in a saucepan. Heat, whisking continuously, until the sauce thickens, boils and is smooth. Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes. Season to taste and add the lemon juice. Add the sweetbreads to the sauce and simmer gently for 5 to 10 minutes. Garnish with parsley and serve at once with new potatoes and a green vegetable.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
