ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple in syrup (undrained)
1/2 c. butter or margarine, cut into thin slices
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Spread evenly.
Dump in pie filling; spread into even layer.
Dump dry cake mix into cherry layer; spread evenly.
Sprinkle nuts over cake mix.
Put butter over top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 48 to 53 minutes.
Serve warm or cooled.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread evenly. Dump in pie filling; spread into even layer. Dump dry cake mix into cherry layer; spread evenly. Sprinkle nuts over cake mix. Put butter over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 48 to 53 minutes. Serve warm or cooled.

recipes.title: Turkey Soup(Leftover Turkey)
ingredients: 1/3 c. flour mixed in 1/2 c. cold water
1 1/2 to 2 c. (or more) cooked bite size turkey pieces
directions: Melt butter and saute
onion,
carrots and celery until celery and
onion are limp and transparent.
Add chopped green peppers, apples,
tomato juice, turkey stock, flour and water mixed,
curry powder,
nutmeg, whole cloves, salt and pepper. Simmer until
all vegetables
are done.
It can go for hours, but should simmer
at least
1/2 to 2 hours on low simmer. Remove cloves and add cooked rice and turkey. Heat thoroughly. Makes 8 to 10 generous servings.
recipes.text: Turkey Soup(Leftover Turkey). Melt butter and saute onion, carrots and celery until celery and onion are limp and transparent. Add chopped green peppers, apples, tomato juice, turkey stock, flour and water mixed, curry powder, nutmeg, whole cloves, salt and pepper. Simmer until all vegetables are done. It can go for hours, but should simmer at least 1 1/2 to 2 hours on low simmer. Remove cloves and add cooked rice and turkey. Heat thoroughly. Makes 8 to 10 generous servings.

recipes.title: Chunky Potato Soup
directions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour, stirring until smooth.
Cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk.
Stir in potatoes and next 3 ingredients. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture is thickened and potatoes are done.
Yields 5 cups.
recipes.text: Chunky Potato Soup. Melt butter in heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour, stirring until smooth. Cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk. Stir in potatoes and next 3 ingredients. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture is thickened and potatoes are done. Yields 5 cups.

recipes.title: Buttercream Icing
directions: In medium bowl with electric mixer at medium speed, cream margarine and shortening.
Add vanilla, mixing well.
Gradually add sugar, one cup at a time.
Beat about 5 minutes or until icing appears dry.
Add milk and beat until light and fluffy.
Use immediately or cover with damp cloth.
Store in refrigerator until ready to use.
recipes.text: Buttercream Icing. In medium bowl with electric mixer at medium speed, cream margarine and shortening. Add vanilla, mixing well. Gradually add sugar, one cup at a time. Beat about 5 minutes or until icing appears dry. Add milk and beat until light and fluffy. Use immediately or cover with damp cloth. Store in refrigerator until ready to use.

recipes.title: Betty'S Toffee Bars
directions: Line a cookie sheet with foil and spray well with nonstick spray. Line the cookie sheet with saltine crackers. Boil the sugar and butter until it comes to a rolling boil. Stir well. Pour sugar mixture over saltines. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and spread the chocolate chips evenly over the cookie sheet. Return tray to warm oven just long enough to melt the chips. Add crushed nuts and let the tray cool in the refrigerator for several hours. Break into pieces.
recipes.text: Betty'S Toffee Bars. Line a cookie sheet with foil and spray well with nonstick spray. Line the cookie sheet with saltine crackers. Boil the sugar and butter until it comes to a rolling boil. Stir well. Pour sugar mixture over saltines. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and spread the chocolate chips evenly over the cookie sheet. Return tray to warm oven just long enough to melt the chips. Add crushed nuts and let the tray cool in the refrigerator for several hours. Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Baked Butter Bean Casserole
ingredients: 4 cans Joan of Arc butter beans, drained (keep liquid from 1 can)
directions: Mix tomato soup, butter beans and juice from one can.
Brown hamburger; drain and add to bean mixture.
Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Baked Butter Bean Casserole. Mix tomato soup, butter beans and juice from one can. Brown hamburger; drain and add to bean mixture. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 325u00b0 for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Grand Champion Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 425u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 375u00b0. Bake 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Grand Champion Pumpkin Pie. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 425u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 375u00b0. Bake 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Caramel Filling
directions: Combine in top of double boiler (or in microwave oven) caramels and milk.
Heat until caramels melt, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat.
Stir in margarine, sugar and pecans.
recipes.text: Caramel Filling. Combine in top of double boiler (or in microwave oven) caramels and milk. Heat until caramels melt, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat. Stir in margarine, sugar and pecans.

recipes.title: Creole Shrimp Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill thoroughly.
Sprinkle grated egg yolk over top just before serving.
recipes.text: Creole Shrimp Sauce. Combine all ingredients and chill thoroughly. Sprinkle grated egg yolk over top just before serving.

recipes.title: Nacho Cheese
directions: Spray pan with Pam Release.
Mix last 4 ingredients with wire whip; add cheese.
Melt in double boiler.
recipes.text: Nacho Cheese. Spray pan with Pam Release. Mix last 4 ingredients with wire whip; add cheese. Melt in double boiler.

recipes.title: Fruit Lizzies
ingredients: 1/3 c. grape juice or apple juice
directions: Chop all fruits and nuts.
Then combine with 1/2 cup flour to coat well.
recipes.text: Fruit Lizzies. Chop all fruits and nuts. Then combine with 1/2 cup flour to coat well.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Cream together cream cheese, peanut butter and powdered sugar with a hand mixer.
Fold in Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Cream together cream cheese, peanut butter and powdered sugar with a hand mixer. Fold in Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Peas
directions: Drain peas.
Saute onion in butter.
Add remaining ingredients; heat and serve.
You may put this in a buttered casserole, top with grated Cheddar cheese and bake for 20 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Peas. Drain peas. Saute onion in butter. Add remaining ingredients; heat and serve. You may put this in a buttered casserole, top with grated Cheddar cheese and bake for 20 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
directions: Make at least 8 hours before serving. Serve with chips.
recipes.text: Dill Dip. Make at least 8 hours before serving. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Working Girls Rolls
ingredients: 1 pkg. yeast, dissolved in 2 c. warm water
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Spoon into greased muffin pans (3/4 full).
Bake at 450u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
Store remaining batter in refrigerator, well covered.
recipes.text: Working Girls Rolls. Mix all ingredients well. Spoon into greased muffin pans (3/4 full). Bake at 450u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Store remaining batter in refrigerator, well covered.

recipes.title: Asparagus And Pea Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cut asparagus or fresh asparagus, steamed
1 can LeSueur or small frozen green peas
directions: Saute green onions in butter.
Add garlic cheese and cook until melted.
Add mushroom soup, mushrooms, pimentos and water chestnuts (chopped).
Mix well and cook until mixtures bubbles in large casserole.
Pour drained asparagus and peas.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over top.
Bake 30 minutes or until sauce bubbles.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Asparagus And Pea Casserole. Saute green onions in butter. Add garlic cheese and cook until melted. Add mushroom soup, mushrooms, pimentos and water chestnuts (chopped). Mix well and cook until mixtures bubbles in large casserole. Pour drained asparagus and peas. Spread cheese mixture evenly over top. Bake 30 minutes or until sauce bubbles. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Fig Muffins
ingredients: 1/3 c. canola oil or vegetable oil
1 c. Blue Ribbon Mission or Calimyrna figs, chopped
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Adjust oven rack to above oven center. In a small saucepan, heat water to a rolling boil.
Stir in oat bran and remove from heat.
Continue stirring until smooth and free of lumps.
Set aside to cool for 5 minutes.
Stir milk and oil into oat mixture.
Beat egg whites with sugar just until foamy.
Stir in oat mixture.
Combine flour with baking powder and salt.
Stir into egg white mixture with figs and cranberries. Spoon batter into 12 (2 3/4-inch) muffin tins lined with paper baking cups.
Bake 20 minutes or until lightly brown.
Cool 10 minutes before serving.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Fig Muffins. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Adjust oven rack to above oven center. In a small saucepan, heat water to a rolling boil. Stir in oat bran and remove from heat. Continue stirring until smooth and free of lumps. Set aside to cool for 5 minutes. Stir milk and oil into oat mixture. Beat egg whites with sugar just until foamy. Stir in oat mixture. Combine flour with baking powder and salt. Stir into egg white mixture with figs and cranberries. Spoon batter into 12 (2 3/4-inch) muffin tins lined with paper baking cups. Bake 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Cool 10 minutes before serving. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 14 slices white bread, trim crust and cube
2 lb. mild sausage, cooked and drained
directions: Mix eggs, milk and mustard.
Layer bread, sausage and cheese in 11 x 13-inch pan.
Pour egg and milk mixture over layers.
Let sit overnight in refrigerator.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Mix eggs, milk and mustard. Layer bread, sausage and cheese in 11 x 13-inch pan. Pour egg and milk mixture over layers. Let sit overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Southern Sweet Potato Bread
directions: Grease pan.
Cream butter; add brown sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, sweet potatoes, milk and orange rind.
Beat with mixer until thoroughly combined.
Add flour, nutmeg and allspice to sweet potato mixture with nuts.
Mix thoroughly until smooth.
Turn batter into prepared pan.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.
Let cool in pan for 10 minutes.
Remove to cake rack.
Cool before slicing.
recipes.text: Southern Sweet Potato Bread. Grease pan. Cream butter; add brown sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs, sweet potatoes, milk and orange rind. Beat with mixer until thoroughly combined. Add flour, nutmeg and allspice to sweet potato mixture with nuts. Mix thoroughly until smooth. Turn batter into prepared pan. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes. Remove to cake rack. Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Lady Locks
directions: Cook flour and milk until thick and cool. While cooling, cream shortening, butter or oleo and confectioners sugar. When creamed, add vanilla and marshmallow cream. Add cooled paste and mix well.
recipes.text: Lady Locks. Cook flour and milk until thick and cool. While cooling, cream shortening, butter or oleo and confectioners sugar. When creamed, add vanilla and marshmallow cream. Add cooled paste and mix well.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
directions: Mix butter and sugar. Add eggs, milk and vanilla. Add soda and enough flour for a soft dough. Roll batter with rolling pin until dough is about 1/4-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Cut out center with thimble. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Tea Cakes. Mix butter and sugar. Add eggs, milk and vanilla. Add soda and enough flour for a soft dough. Roll batter with rolling pin until dough is about 1/4-inch thick. Cut with biscuit cutter. Cut out center with thimble. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Sweet Chili
ingredients: 2 (1 lb.) cans kidney beans (remove salt pork)
2 tsp. chili powder or more to taste
directions: Saute the onions in 1 tablespoon of butter.
Add hamburg; fry and drain.
In a large pot add onions and hamburg mixture.
Then add the rest of the ingredients.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 1 to 2 hours or all day.
recipes.text: Mom'S Sweet Chili. Saute the onions in 1 tablespoon of butter. Add hamburg; fry and drain. In a large pot add onions and hamburg mixture. Then add the rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil, then simmer 1 to 2 hours or all day.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Macaroni
directions: Boil macaroni until tender.
While macaroni is still hot, cut up cheese and put it in pan with macaroni.
Cover the pan and let the cheese melt.
Pour cooked ground beef over macaroni.
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Macaroni. Boil macaroni until tender. While macaroni is still hot, cut up cheese and put it in pan with macaroni. Cover the pan and let the cheese melt. Pour cooked ground beef over macaroni.

recipes.title: Frozen Corn
ingredients: 20 c. corn, cut off the cob
directions: Mix together in large roaster.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
Stir often.
Cool and freeze.
recipes.text: Frozen Corn. Mix together in large roaster. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0. Stir often. Cool and freeze.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 good sized chopped onion, cooked in small amount of water until dry and browned
directions: Put tortillas into pan of hot enchilada sauce.
Take out and put a small amount of meat that has been prepared.
Add a small amount of grated cheese.
Roll up; put into a pan and pour enchilada sauce over this.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Put in oven and cook at 325u00b0 for about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Put tortillas into pan of hot enchilada sauce. Take out and put a small amount of meat that has been prepared. Add a small amount of grated cheese. Roll up; put into a pan and pour enchilada sauce over this. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Put in oven and cook at 325u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix and pour over other ingredients.
Chill.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix and pour over other ingredients. Chill.

recipes.title: Deluxe Chocolate Marshmallow Bars
directions: In mixing bowl, cream the butter and sugar; add eggs.
Beat well.
Add vanilla and beat again.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to creamed mixture.
Add nuts and spread in jelly roll pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.
Sprinkle marshmallows over and return to oven for 3 to 4 minutes or until melted.
Using a knife dipped in water, spread marshmallows evenly over crust.
Cool.
recipes.text: Deluxe Chocolate Marshmallow Bars. In mixing bowl, cream the butter and sugar; add eggs. Beat well. Add vanilla and beat again. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Add nuts and spread in jelly roll pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Sprinkle marshmallows over and return to oven for 3 to 4 minutes or until melted. Using a knife dipped in water, spread marshmallows evenly over crust. Cool.

recipes.title: Peanut Clusters
directions: Melt chocolate in top of double broiler over simmering water. Stir until smooth.
Remove from heat and blend in condensed milk and peanuts.
Drop by tsp. on baking sheet.
Cool at room temperature 2-3 hours.
Store in a air-tight container.
recipes.text: Peanut Clusters. Melt chocolate in top of double broiler over simmering water. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat and blend in condensed milk and peanuts. Drop by tsp. on baking sheet. Cool at room temperature 2-3 hours. Store in a air-tight container.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Mix until well blended.
Shape into balls.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Combine all ingredients. Mix until well blended. Shape into balls. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar, cornstarch and salt in a medium saucepan.
Add water, stirring until well blended.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Beat egg yolks and gradually add to mixture and cook until thick.
Remove from heat.
Add butter, lemon rind and juice; stir until butter melts. Pour filling into pastry shell.
Beat egg whites and add sugar and cream of tartar.
Pour over pie.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Lemon Meringue Pie. Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar, cornstarch and salt in a medium saucepan. Add water, stirring until well blended. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Beat egg yolks and gradually add to mixture and cook until thick. Remove from heat. Add butter, lemon rind and juice; stir until butter melts. Pour filling into pastry shell. Beat egg whites and add sugar and cream of tartar. Pour over pie. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
ingredients: cold water to moisten (dough should be very stiff)
directions: Mix flour and salt.
Add eggs and enough water to make stiff dough.
Roll out on floured surface until very thin.
Cut into 1-inch strips.
Have chicken broth boiling and salted to taste. Pinch dumpling strips into small bits and drop into boiling broth. Cook about 10 minutes, then add chicken.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dumplings. Mix flour and salt. Add eggs and enough water to make stiff dough. Roll out on floured surface until very thin. Cut into 1-inch strips. Have chicken broth boiling and salted to taste. Pinch dumpling strips into small bits and drop into boiling broth. Cook about 10 minutes, then add chicken.

recipes.title: Aunt Wilma'S Zucchini Squash Relish
ingredients: 12 c. ground/grated squash (1 med. squash makes about 9 c. grated)
directions: Mix squash, onion, green pepper, and red pepper. Add salt and let stand for 1 hour. Drain and add vinegar, sugar, pepper, mustard seed and turmeric. Bring to boil and cook 10 minutes. Stir occasionally while cooking. Put into jars and seal. Cold pack about 10 minutes. Makes about 8 pints.
recipes.text: Aunt Wilma'S Zucchini Squash Relish. Mix squash, onion, green pepper, and red pepper. Add salt and let stand for 1 hour. Drain and add vinegar, sugar, pepper, mustard seed and turmeric. Bring to boil and cook 10 minutes. Stir occasionally while cooking. Put into jars and seal. Cold pack about 10 minutes. Makes about 8 pints.

recipes.title: Fiesta Tamale Pie
directions: Saute onion and garlic until onion is yellow in the butter and oil.
Add beef and sausage and cook until brown.
Add tomatoes, corn, salt and chili powder; simmer 20 minutes.
Pour into 11 x 7-inch oblong baking dish.
Press olives into mixture.
Mix cornmeal, milk and eggs; spread over meat mixture.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Fiesta Tamale Pie. Saute onion and garlic until onion is yellow in the butter and oil. Add beef and sausage and cook until brown. Add tomatoes, corn, salt and chili powder; simmer 20 minutes. Pour into 11 x 7-inch oblong baking dish. Press olives into mixture. Mix cornmeal, milk and eggs; spread over meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mexican Lasagne
directions: Brown ground beef with onion; drain.
Mix remaining ingredients, except tortillas, in large bowl.
Add ground beef to soup mixture.
Layer mixture with tortillas in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake 35 minutes, until bubbly, at 350u00b0.
May serve with tortilla chips.
Good with Spanish rice.
recipes.text: Mexican Lasagne. Brown ground beef with onion; drain. Mix remaining ingredients, except tortillas, in large bowl. Add ground beef to soup mixture. Layer mixture with tortillas in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake 35 minutes, until bubbly, at 350u00b0. May serve with tortilla chips. Good with Spanish rice.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Cover bread with milk for 5 minutes.
Add sugar, melted butter, salt and vanilla.
Pour into buttered pan.
Set pan in pan of water and bake for 1 hour at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Cover bread with milk for 5 minutes. Add sugar, melted butter, salt and vanilla. Pour into buttered pan. Set pan in pan of water and bake for 1 hour at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Chicken Livers
directions: Chop shallots in skillet.
Saute in the oil until tender. Dredge livers in flour.
Place over shallots until brown.
Cover with orange juice.
Cover and simmer until livers are tender.
recipes.text: Chicken Livers. Chop shallots in skillet. Saute in the oil until tender. Dredge livers in flour. Place over shallots until brown. Cover with orange juice. Cover and simmer until livers are tender.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning.
Drain good.
Mix lettuce, tomato, onion, black olives and 3/4 grated cheese in a large bowl.
Drain.
Drain kidney beans; add beans and meat.
Mix well, then mix in 1/2 bag tortilla chips.
Serve in salad bowls. Top with cheese and sour cream.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Brown ground beef with taco seasoning. Drain good. Mix lettuce, tomato, onion, black olives and 3/4 grated cheese in a large bowl. Drain. Drain kidney beans; add beans and meat. Mix well, then mix in 1/2 bag tortilla chips. Serve in salad bowls. Top with cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Hellmann'S Seven Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 large can green peas, drained or 1 pkg. frozen green peas, cooked and drained
directions: In a large bowl, layer lettuce, celery, onion, pepper and peas.
Sprinkle cheese over peas.
Sprinkle bacon over cheese. Spread mayonnaise on salad, completely sealing salad.
Chill.
Can be tossed before serving.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Hellmann'S Seven Layer Salad. In a large bowl, layer lettuce, celery, onion, pepper and peas. Sprinkle cheese over peas. Sprinkle bacon over cheese. Spread mayonnaise on salad, completely sealing salad. Chill. Can be tossed before serving. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 lb. bacon, cooked and diced or ham or sausage
directions: Use 1 deep-dish pie crust, baked but not brown. Put into crust the meat, cheese and onion. Mix eggs, milk, garlic salt, salt and pepper and pour into crust. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350u00b0 for 15 more minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Quiche. Use 1 deep-dish pie crust, baked but not brown. Put into crust the meat, cheese and onion. Mix eggs, milk, garlic salt, salt and pepper and pour into crust. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350u00b0 for 15 more minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Yokan(Sweet Bean Dessert)
directions: Wash the kanten and tear into small pieces; soak overnight. Add sugar and boil until the kanten is melted.
Turn the heat to medium and add the koshi an and mix well.
Cook over low heat for 45 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour into a 7 x 11-inch pan or larger and cool.
Do not move the pan while cooling because the yokan will be wrinkled.
recipes.text: Yokan(Sweet Bean Dessert). Wash the kanten and tear into small pieces; soak overnight. Add sugar and boil until the kanten is melted. Turn the heat to medium and add the koshi an and mix well. Cook over low heat for 45 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour into a 7 x 11-inch pan or larger and cool. Do not move the pan while cooling because the yokan will be wrinkled.

recipes.title: Squash Bread
directions: Sift first three ingredients together and stir in beaten egg. Add water or milk to make a soft dough.
Round up on lightly floured cloth or board.
Knead lightly.
Roll or pat out 1/2-inch thick.
Cut into strips about 2 x 3-inches.
Slit the center of dough.
Drop in deep fat; brown on one side, then turn over and brown the other.
Serve with pinto beans, stew or syrup.
recipes.text: Squash Bread. Sift first three ingredients together and stir in beaten egg. Add water or milk to make a soft dough. Round up on lightly floured cloth or board. Knead lightly. Roll or pat out 1/2-inch thick. Cut into strips about 2 x 3-inches. Slit the center of dough. Drop in deep fat; brown on one side, then turn over and brown the other. Serve with pinto beans, stew or syrup.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix first four ingredients well.
Add remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chess Pie. Mix first four ingredients well. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (24 to 30 oz.) container small curd cottage cheese
directions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions.
Mix together all remaining ingredients, except Parmesan cheese and spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese.
Using 9 x 11-inch baking dish, pour a small amount of spaghetti sauce on bottom.
Layer with 1/2 lasagna noodles.
Next layer with 1/2 spinach mix.
Next layer with 1/2 package Mozzarella cheese.
Repeat.
End with sauce; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 covered for 45 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Spinach Lasagna. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Mix together all remaining ingredients, except Parmesan cheese and spaghetti sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Using 9 x 11-inch baking dish, pour a small amount of spaghetti sauce on bottom. Layer with 1/2 lasagna noodles. Next layer with 1/2 spinach mix. Next layer with 1/2 package Mozzarella cheese. Repeat. End with sauce; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 covered for 45 minutes. Uncover and continue baking for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, milk and butter in saucepan and bring to a rolling boil.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter and marshmallow.
Mix well.
Stir in flour, mixing well.
Pour into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Mix sugar, milk and butter in saucepan and bring to a rolling boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and marshmallow. Mix well. Stir in flour, mixing well. Pour into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Dirty Cake
directions: Crumble cookies.
Make them into dirt.
Melt butter and put 3/4 cookie crumbs into pan.
Press it down.
Spread butter on top. Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and 1 Cool Whip and pour on top of crumbs.
Mix pudding as directed and pour on top of cream cheese.
Spread other Cool Whip on top.
Take rest of crumbs and spread on top.
recipes.text: Dirty Cake. Crumble cookies. Make them into dirt. Melt butter and put 3/4 cookie crumbs into pan. Press it down. Spread butter on top. Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and 1 Cool Whip and pour on top of crumbs. Mix pudding as directed and pour on top of cream cheese. Spread other Cool Whip on top. Take rest of crumbs and spread on top.

recipes.title: Pork Sum Gum
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. pork, cooked and thinly sliced
directions: In saucepan, combine celery, mushrooms, bouillon, onion, peppers, sherry extract, soy sauce, salt, pepper, ginger and nutmeg.
Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until onions and celery are tender but still crisp.
Add pork and pimentos.
Mix well.
Cook 3 minutes longer or until hot.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Pork Sum Gum. In saucepan, combine celery, mushrooms, bouillon, onion, peppers, sherry extract, soy sauce, salt, pepper, ginger and nutmeg. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until onions and celery are tender but still crisp. Add pork and pimentos. Mix well. Cook 3 minutes longer or until hot. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Cream butter and 1 1/4 cups sugar well.
Add eggs and mix well.
Mix together remaining dry ingredients (except sugar topping) and add alternately with milk.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins. Cream butter and 1 1/4 cups sugar well. Add eggs and mix well. Mix together remaining dry ingredients (except sugar topping) and add alternately with milk.

recipes.title: Fried Mush
directions: Cook cornmeal according to directions.
Serve like oatmeal. Refrigerate leftovers for another meal.
Slice about 1/2-inch thick and heat and brown slightly.
Use as potato substitute.
recipes.text: Fried Mush. Cook cornmeal according to directions. Serve like oatmeal. Refrigerate leftovers for another meal. Slice about 1/2-inch thick and heat and brown slightly. Use as potato substitute.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn Balls
ingredients: 1/2 (15 oz. can) sweetened condensed milk (2/3 c.)
directions: In saucepan, combine butter, sugar and corn syrup. Stir well and bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir in condensed milk and simmer, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a soft ball stage (234u00b0 to 238u00b0). Stir in vanilla.
Pour over popped corn and stir to coat.
Butter hands lightly and shape into popcorn balls, about 3 1/2-inches in diameter.
Makes about 15.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn Balls. In saucepan, combine butter, sugar and corn syrup. Stir well and bring to a boil over medium heat. Stir in condensed milk and simmer, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a soft ball stage (234u00b0 to 238u00b0). Stir in vanilla. Pour over popped corn and stir to coat. Butter hands lightly and shape into popcorn balls, about 3 1/2-inches in diameter. Makes about 15.

recipes.title: Pioneer Coconut Cake
directions: Blend all but last ingredient 3 to 4 minutes.
Fold in coconut.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Pioneer Coconut Cake. Blend all but last ingredient 3 to 4 minutes. Fold in coconut. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb. bacon, fried and broken in small pieces
directions: Mix ingredients. Bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Mix ingredients. Bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Dessert Pizza
ingredients: assorted fruit (your choice, strawberries, blueberries, kiwi, seedless grapes)
directions: Take crescent rolls and spread on pizza pan or baking stone with points to the middle; mold crescents together to make a crust. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned.
Remove and let completely cool.
recipes.text: Dessert Pizza. Take crescent rolls and spread on pizza pan or baking stone with points to the middle; mold crescents together to make a crust. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned. Remove and let completely cool.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until frothy.
Add sugar, oil and vanilla.
Beat until lemon colored.
Stir in zucchini.
Sift remaining ingredients.
Fold into egg-zucchini mixture.
Pour into 3 loaf pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Let cool 10 minutes; remove from pans.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until frothy. Add sugar, oil and vanilla. Beat until lemon colored. Stir in zucchini. Sift remaining ingredients. Fold into egg-zucchini mixture. Pour into 3 loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Let cool 10 minutes; remove from pans.

recipes.title: Reuben Pizza
ingredients: 1 prebaked Italian bread shell crust (14 oz.)
8 oz. thinly sliced corned beef, cut in strips
1 (14 oz.) can sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained
directions: Place the crust on a 14-inch pizza pan; spread with salad dressing. Layer with corned beef and sauerkraut. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Reuben Pizza. Place the crust on a 14-inch pizza pan; spread with salad dressing. Layer with corned beef and sauerkraut. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Crush Doritos in the bottom of a greased dish.
Brown the ground beef.
Drain and spoon into dish of Doritos.
Sprinkle the chopped onion on top of ground beef.
Add 1/2 of the grated cheese. Add the 2 kinds of soups, tomatoes and water.
Take a spatula and run through to mix.
Grate the rest of the cheese on top and bake at 450u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Crush Doritos in the bottom of a greased dish. Brown the ground beef. Drain and spoon into dish of Doritos. Sprinkle the chopped onion on top of ground beef. Add 1/2 of the grated cheese. Add the 2 kinds of soups, tomatoes and water. Take a spatula and run through to mix. Grate the rest of the cheese on top and bake at 450u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Chutney
directions: Add first 7 ingredients together in medium saucepan.
Cook until cranberries pop and split.
Add last 3 ingredients and simmer all together for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cranberry Chutney. Add first 7 ingredients together in medium saucepan. Cook until cranberries pop and split. Add last 3 ingredients and simmer all together for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Chicken Casserole
directions: Place cooked broccoli in a casserole dish.
Place chicken on top.
Combine soup, Miracle Whip and curry powder and pour over broccoli/chicken.
Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly, about 15 minutes. Add cheese and bake until just melted.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Chicken Casserole. Place cooked broccoli in a casserole dish. Place chicken on top. Combine soup, Miracle Whip and curry powder and pour over broccoli/chicken. Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly, about 15 minutes. Add cheese and bake until just melted.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Reserve syrup from pineapple and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid.
Pour in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat, add jello and stir until dissolved.
Add orange sherbet and stir until melted.
Chill until mixture is consistency of unbeaten egg whites, about 20 minutes.
Fold in oranges and pineapple.
You can put oranges on top if you like.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Salad. Reserve syrup from pineapple and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid. Pour in saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, add jello and stir until dissolved. Add orange sherbet and stir until melted. Chill until mixture is consistency of unbeaten egg whites, about 20 minutes. Fold in oranges and pineapple. You can put oranges on top if you like.

recipes.title: Tasty Crackers
directions: Put crackers in a large bowl.
Mix remaining ingredients and add to crackers.
Mix well and enjoy!
recipes.text: Tasty Crackers. Put crackers in a large bowl. Mix remaining ingredients and add to crackers. Mix well and enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Breast In Herbs
directions: Brown chicken in butter.
Place in casserole dish.
Mix other ingredients and pour over cooked chicken.
Bake 325u00b0 for 50 minutes uncovered.
recipes.text: Chicken Breast In Herbs. Brown chicken in butter. Place in casserole dish. Mix other ingredients and pour over cooked chicken. Bake 325u00b0 for 50 minutes uncovered.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
directions: In a large container, stir together all ingredients. Carefully pour into punch bowl.
Lay orange slices on top of punch in bowl.
recipes.text: Fruit Punch. In a large container, stir together all ingredients. Carefully pour into punch bowl. Lay orange slices on top of punch in bowl.

recipes.title: Raspberry Dessert
directions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water.
Add frozen raspberries and lemon juice. Then stir the mixture until it is soft and leave it in the refrigerator until partially set.tMix cream cheese powdered sugar, salt and vanilla.
Gradually blend 12 oz. frozen whipped topping, thawed.
Spread half of this over graham cracker crust. Then 1/2 of raspberries. Alternate. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Raspberry Dessert. Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water. Add frozen raspberries and lemon juice. Then stir the mixture until it is soft and leave it in the refrigerator until partially set.tMix cream cheese powdered sugar, salt and vanilla. Gradually blend 12 oz. frozen whipped topping, thawed. Spread half of this over graham cracker crust. Then 1/2 of raspberries. Alternate. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Beet Salad
directions: Dissolve packages of Jell-O in boiling water and pickle juice. Cool until slightly thickened.
Add remaining ingredients.
Chill until set.
recipes.text: Beet Salad. Dissolve packages of Jell-O in boiling water and pickle juice. Cool until slightly thickened. Add remaining ingredients. Chill until set.

recipes.title: Crispy Shrimp Balls
directions: Combine shrimp with water chestnuts, green onions, ginger, salt, pepper, egg whites, yeast and flour in bowl; mix well. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls.
Coat with bread crumbs.
Heat oil to 400u00b0 in wok.
Deep fry shrimp balls in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.
Yields 20 to 24 small appetizers.
recipes.text: Crispy Shrimp Balls. Combine shrimp with water chestnuts, green onions, ginger, salt, pepper, egg whites, yeast and flour in bowl; mix well. Shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. Coat with bread crumbs. Heat oil to 400u00b0 in wok. Deep fry shrimp balls in hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Yields 20 to 24 small appetizers.

recipes.title: Taco Salad Bowl
ingredients: 2 qt. bite size pieces salad greens
directions: In medium skillet, saute chuck and garlic until meat is browned; drain excess fat.
Add green chilies, tomatoes, salt and pepper; mix well.
Cook over low heat uncovered about 30 minutes. Just before serving, in large chilled salad bowl, arrange lettuce, cheese, corn chips and green onions with cooked meat mixture.
Toss lightly until well combined.
Garnish with chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Taco Salad Bowl. In medium skillet, saute chuck and garlic until meat is browned; drain excess fat. Add green chilies, tomatoes, salt and pepper; mix well. Cook over low heat uncovered about 30 minutes. Just before serving, in large chilled salad bowl, arrange lettuce, cheese, corn chips and green onions with cooked meat mixture. Toss lightly until well combined. Garnish with chopped tomato. Serve immediately. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni; drain.
Add margarine and grated cheese.
In separate bowl, beat eggs; add milk and stir.
Pour over macaroni and mix.
Add salt and pepper.
Pour into large casserole (sprayed with Pam).
Sprinkle top with paprika.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese. Cook macaroni; drain. Add margarine and grated cheese. In separate bowl, beat eggs; add milk and stir. Pour over macaroni and mix. Add salt and pepper. Pour into large casserole (sprayed with Pam). Sprinkle top with paprika. Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Macaroons
directions: Melt chocolate morsels; cool.
Stir in coconut and walnuts.
In a small bowl, combine egg whites and salt.
Beat until soft peaks form.
Gradually add sugar; beat until stiff.
Fold egg whites into chocolate mixture.
Drop by teaspoon 1 inch apart onto brown paper-lined baking sheets.
Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for 18 to 20 minutes.
Yields about 50 cookies.
recipes.text: Chocolate Macaroons. Melt chocolate morsels; cool. Stir in coconut and walnuts. In a small bowl, combine egg whites and salt. Beat until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar; beat until stiff. Fold egg whites into chocolate mixture. Drop by teaspoon 1 inch apart onto brown paper-lined baking sheets. Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for 18 to 20 minutes. Yields about 50 cookies.

recipes.title: "Down The Bay" Salad
directions: Mix vegetables and cheese.
Add chopped eggs.
Toss with enough mayonnaise to coat all ingredients.
(Adjust amount of ingredients to suit individual taste.)
recipes.text: "Down The Bay" Salad. Mix vegetables and cheese. Add chopped eggs. Toss with enough mayonnaise to coat all ingredients. (Adjust amount of ingredients to suit individual taste.)

recipes.title: Biscuits
directions: Set oven at 425u00b0.
Combine flour, salt and baking powder.
Cut in butter with a potato masher (works best) or fork, leaving little cubes in the flour mixture.
Break egg into 1 cup measure, fill cup with milk and beat together.
Pat out on floured board, cut in size desired (a regular drinking glass works well).
Place biscuits on ungreased cookie sheet, touching each other.
Bake until golden (15 minutes or so, I think.)
recipes.text: Biscuits. Set oven at 425u00b0. Combine flour, salt and baking powder. Cut in butter with a potato masher (works best) or fork, leaving little cubes in the flour mixture. Break egg into 1 cup measure, fill cup with milk and beat together. Pat out on floured board, cut in size desired (a regular drinking glass works well). Place biscuits on ungreased cookie sheet, touching each other. Bake until golden (15 minutes or so, I think.)

recipes.title: Low-Fat Cajun Wedges
ingredients: Cajun seasoning or other seasoning, such as paprika
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Scrub potatoes under running water with soft vegetable brush; rinse.
Dry well.
(Do not peel).
Line baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray.
Cut potatoes in half lengthwise, then cut each half lengthwise into 3 wedges.
Place potatoes, skin sides down, in single layer on prepared baking sheet.
Spray potatoes lightly with cooking spray and sprinkle with seasoning.
Bake 25 minutes or until browned and fork-tender.
Garnish as desired.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Cajun Wedges. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Scrub potatoes under running water with soft vegetable brush; rinse. Dry well. (Do not peel). Line baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise, then cut each half lengthwise into 3 wedges. Place potatoes, skin sides down, in single layer on prepared baking sheet. Spray potatoes lightly with cooking spray and sprinkle with seasoning. Bake 25 minutes or until browned and fork-tender. Garnish as desired. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin Bread
directions: In

mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add the pumpkin, orange juice, molasses and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients. Add to the creamed mixture and mix until well blended. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into two greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pans onto wire racks.
recipes.text: Spiced Pumpkin Bread. In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add the pumpkin, orange juice, molasses and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients. Add to the creamed mixture and mix until well blended. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into two greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 65 to 75 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pans onto wire racks.

recipes.title: Carrot Bread
directions: Mix oil with sugar and beat well.
Then add all dry ingredients and beat.
Add carrots and nuts.
Last, add one egg at a time and beat well.
Bake 45 minutes in moderate oven for 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Carrot Bread. Mix oil with sugar and beat well. Then add all dry ingredients and beat. Add carrots and nuts. Last, add one egg at a time and beat well. Bake 45 minutes in moderate oven for 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time.
Flour fruit and combine all ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 250u00b0 about 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake Cookies. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Flour fruit and combine all ingredients. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250u00b0 about 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cabbage
ingredients: 1 c. mild or medium Cheddar cheese, divided
1 c. stuffing mix or bread crumbs
directions: Boil cabbage approximately 15 minutes (do not overcook); drain.
Put half the cabbage into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle half the salt, pepper, sugar and flour, then add half the cheese and margarine.
Repeat layers.
Top with hot milk.
Last, cover with stuffing mix.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes or until topping is well browned.
Yields approximately 6 servings.
recipes.text: Scalloped Cabbage. Boil cabbage approximately 15 minutes (do not overcook); drain. Put half the cabbage into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle half the salt, pepper, sugar and flour, then add half the cheese and margarine. Repeat layers. Top with hot milk. Last, cover with stuffing mix. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes or until topping is well browned. Yields approximately 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
directions: Cook chicken breast; cool and chop fine.
Add remaining ingredients to chicken breasts and mix well.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad. Cook chicken breast; cool and chop fine. Add remaining ingredients to chicken breasts and mix well.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
ingredients: 2 7 oz. cans Crab Meat or imitation Crab
directions: Soften Cream Cheese.
Mix with all ingredients except crab until smooth and creamy.
Stir in crab.
Make a day ahead to give spices time to mix well.
recipes.text: Crab Dip. Soften Cream Cheese. Mix with all ingredients except crab until smooth and creamy. Stir in crab. Make a day ahead to give spices time to mix well.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Prepare mushrooms; set aside.
Finely chop all peppers and onion.
Mix together with oregano, parsley and water.
Fill each mushroom.
Bake at 350u00b0
for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Stuffed Mushrooms. Prepare mushrooms; set aside. Finely chop all peppers and onion. Mix together with oregano, parsley and water. Fill each mushroom. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Ungspankaaka(Oven Pancakes)
directions: Beat eggs; add milk, soft butter, sugar, salt and flour.
Pour into baking pan.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425u00b0.
(This pancake puffs up high so don't have oven rack too close on top.
When I ask my kids what they want for a different dinner, they choose this 100%.)
recipes.text: Ungspankaaka(Oven Pancakes). Beat eggs; add milk, soft butter, sugar, salt and flour. Pour into baking pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425u00b0. (This pancake puffs up high so don't have oven rack too close on top. When I ask my kids what they want for a different dinner, they choose this 100%.)

recipes.title: Sunshine Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake 35 to 45 minutes in a 2-quart baking dish at 350u00b0.
Bake, uncovered.
recipes.text: Sunshine Casserole. Combine all ingredients and bake 35 to 45 minutes in a 2-quart baking dish at 350u00b0. Bake, uncovered.

recipes.title: Easy Pickles
directions: Empty pickles from jar and drain juice.
Slice pickles into desired thickness and return to empty gallon jar.
Pour the pound of sugar on top of the sliced pickles.
Pour entire bottle of Tabasco on top of sugar.
Put lid on the jar and let sit for several days.
You may need to shake the jar occasionally to distribute juices.
These pickles are guaranteed to make any Kittrell student smarter and better looking.
recipes.text: Easy Pickles. Empty pickles from jar and drain juice. Slice pickles into desired thickness and return to empty gallon jar. Pour the pound of sugar on top of the sliced pickles. Pour entire bottle of Tabasco on top of sugar. Put lid on the jar and let sit for several days. You may need to shake the jar occasionally to distribute juices. These pickles are guaranteed to make any Kittrell student smarter and better looking.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Melt 1 stick of butter; add to graham crackers to form crust.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Melt 1 stick of butter; add to graham crackers to form crust.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Potato Salad
ingredients: 8 medium sized potatoes, boiled in jackets
directions: Cook and cool potatoes.
Slice about 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick; layer sliced potatoes in a rectangular dish.
Cover with layer of dressing (sour cream, mayonnaise, horseradish, celery seed and salt).
Sprinkle with onion and parsley, which have been mixed together.
Continue layering in preceding manner until all ingredients are used.
Should be made 8 to 10 hours before serving.
Preferably overnight refrigeration.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Potato Salad. Cook and cool potatoes. Slice about 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick; layer sliced potatoes in a rectangular dish. Cover with layer of dressing (sour cream, mayonnaise, horseradish, celery seed and salt). Sprinkle with onion and parsley, which have been mixed together. Continue layering in preceding manner until all ingredients are used. Should be made 8 to 10 hours before serving. Preferably overnight refrigeration. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Round Steak Casserole
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can French-style green beans, drained
directions: Seasontround
steak
with
salt
and pepper.
Cut into serving
pieces and place in crock-pot with sliced onion which has been separated into rings.
Add potatoes, green beans and garlic. Top
withtsoup
and tomatoes.
Cover and cook on Low for 8
to 10thours
or
High for 4 to 5 hours.
Remove cover during last half hour if too much liquid has collected.
recipes.text: Round Steak Casserole. Seasontround steak with salt and pepper. Cut into serving pieces and place in crock-pot with sliced onion which has been separated into rings. Add potatoes, green beans and garlic. Top withtsoup and tomatoes. Cover and cook on Low for 8 to 10thours or High for 4 to 5 hours. Remove cover during last half hour if too much liquid has collected.

recipes.title: Potato Stuffy
ingredients: 2 pkg. hash browns or 3 lb. diced raw potatoes
directions: Mix all together.
Add 1 c. cheese and crushed cereal on top. Bake 1 hour & 15 minutes at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Potato Stuffy. Mix all together. Add 1 c. cheese and crushed cereal on top. Bake 1 hour & 15 minutes at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients.
For each cup, combine 1/4 cup mix to 3/4 cup boiling water.
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa Mix. Combine all ingredients. For each cup, combine 1/4 cup mix to 3/4 cup boiling water.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Beat egg; add soda to buttermilk and add to egg.
Mix in flour, cornmeal, baking powder and salt.
Add melted shortening. Pour in preheated and oiled skillet.
Bake at 475u00b0 until slightly browned.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Beat egg; add soda to buttermilk and add to egg. Mix in flour, cornmeal, baking powder and salt. Add melted shortening. Pour in preheated and oiled skillet. Bake at 475u00b0 until slightly browned.

recipes.title: Scallops Nicoise
directions: Core and peel tomatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes.
There should be about 3 1/2 cups. Chop the olives. There should be about 3 tablespoons of the green and 1 1/2 tablespoons of the black. Saute the garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes and bring to a boil.
Add olives and capers, salt and pepper.
Cook 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Scallops Nicoise. Core and peel tomatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes. There should be about 3 1/2 cups. Chop the olives. There should be about 3 tablespoons of the green and 1 1/2 tablespoons of the black. Saute the garlic in oil. Add tomatoes and bring to a boil. Add olives and capers, salt and pepper. Cook 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in well-greased tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Vanilla Wafer Cake. Mix all ingredients and bake in well-greased tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Garden Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 to 2 Tbsp. chopped dill or 1 tsp. dried dill
8 oz. elbow macaroni, cooked, rinsed with cold water and drained
directions: In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise, vinegar, dill, salt and pepper. Add elbow macaroni, cucumber, tomatoes and onions.
Toss to coat well.
recipes.text: Garden Macaroni Salad. In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise, vinegar, dill, salt and pepper. Add elbow macaroni, cucumber, tomatoes and onions. Toss to coat well.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Cream together margarine, cream cheese and sugar.
Mix milk, vanilla pudding and Cool Whip.
Add creamed mixture and mix well. Place crushed cookies in bottom of sand bucket, then layer with cream mixture; continue, ending with cookies on top.
Refrigerate overnight or freeze, taking out 1/2 hour before serving.
Decorate with flower and gummy worms.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Cream together margarine, cream cheese and sugar. Mix milk, vanilla pudding and Cool Whip. Add creamed mixture and mix well. Place crushed cookies in bottom of sand bucket, then layer with cream mixture; continue, ending with cookies on top. Refrigerate overnight or freeze, taking out 1/2 hour before serving. Decorate with flower and gummy worms.

recipes.title: Bob Andy Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0f. 180u00b0c. gas mark 4. In a large mixing bowl, combine sugars, flour, cinnamon, cloves and salt. In another bowl beat the eggs, add milk, butter and vanilla. Stir wet ingredients into the dry ingredients then pour into the pie crust. Bake for 45 minutes. The filling will be shaky when you remove it from the oven. The pie puffs up, but levels off as it cools. Serve at room temperature. Serves 8-10.
recipes.text: Bob Andy Pie. Preheat oven to 350u00b0f. 180u00b0c. gas mark 4. In a large mixing bowl, combine sugars, flour, cinnamon, cloves and salt. In another bowl beat the eggs, add milk, butter and vanilla. Stir wet ingredients into the dry ingredients then pour into the pie crust. Bake for 45 minutes. The filling will be shaky when you remove it from the oven. The pie puffs up, but levels off as it cools. Serve at room temperature. Serves 8-10.

recipes.title: Microwave Perfect Corn Muffins
directions: In bowl, stir together flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder and salt; mix thoroughly.
Add egg, milk and oil.
Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Spoon into paper baking cups in custard cups filling each about half full.
Cook 4 at a time on High for 1 1/2 minutes.
Repeat with remaining batter.
Makes 7 to 8 muffins.
recipes.text: Microwave Perfect Corn Muffins. In bowl, stir together flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder and salt; mix thoroughly. Add egg, milk and oil. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Spoon into paper baking cups in custard cups filling each about half full. Cook 4 at a time on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter. Makes 7 to 8 muffins.

recipes.title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Put all together in blender (liquids first).
Blend until thick and smooth.
If you want it thicker add more dry milk.
If thinner, add drop of water and blend.
recipes.text: Sweetened Condensed Milk. Put all together in blender (liquids first). Blend until thick and smooth. If you want it thicker add more dry milk. If thinner, add drop of water and blend.

recipes.title: Strawberry Ice Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 qt. fat free strawberry ice cream
1 extra large ready made reduced fat graham cracker crust
directions: Spoon ice cream into crust.
Top with strawberries.
Slice and serve!
recipes.text: Strawberry Ice Cream Pie. Spoon ice cream into crust. Top with strawberries. Slice and serve!

recipes.title: Orange Clove Ice Cream
directions: Combine cream, milk and cloves in a stainless steel or glass bowl.
Grate the colored zest from the oranges into the bowl and squeeze 1/3 cup juice.
Squeeze 2 tablespoons of juice from the lemon.
Stir sugar and fruit juices into the milk and cream. Continue stirring until the sugar dissolves, 1 or 2 minutes.
Put in freezer.
When mixture starts to freeze around the edge, stir and return to freezer.
Stir once an hour for the next 2 hours and then leave to set, 4 or 5 hours in all.
recipes.text: Orange Clove Ice Cream. Combine cream, milk and cloves in a stainless steel or glass bowl. Grate the colored zest from the oranges into the bowl and squeeze 1/3 cup juice. Squeeze 2 tablespoons of juice from the lemon. Stir sugar and fruit juices into the milk and cream. Continue stirring until the sugar dissolves, 1 or 2 minutes. Put in freezer. When mixture starts to freeze around the edge, stir and return to freezer. Stir once an hour for the next 2 hours and then leave to set, 4 or 5 hours in all.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 small jar apricot and pineapple jam
directions: Put the uncooked chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix the ingredients together and put over the chicken.
Put into the oven at 375u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Chicken. Put the uncooked chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the ingredients together and put over the chicken. Put into the oven at 375u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: 1 medium can San Marcos jalapeno pepper halves
directions: Drain and rinse peppers. Place on paper towel to dry.
recipes.text: Stuffed Jalapenos. Drain and rinse peppers. Place on paper towel to dry.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
ingredients: uncooked or leftover peas or other vegetables
directions: Crumble 1/2 pound ground beef in 2 1/2-quart casserole; add salt to taste.
Add one-half of sliced potatoes, then a layer of peas.
Spread noodles over peas.
Add remaining potatoes.
Salt to taste.
Cover with remaining ground beef.
Pour onion soup over all.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Crumble 1/2 pound ground beef in 2 1/2-quart casserole; add salt to taste. Add one-half of sliced potatoes, then a layer of peas. Spread noodles over peas. Add remaining potatoes. Salt to taste. Cover with remaining ground beef. Pour onion soup over all. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Line 10-inch pan with pastry.
Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 400u00b0. Cook onion in butter until transparent.
Mix with ham.
Beat eggs and egg yolk, light cream and seasonings.
Add to ham mixture. Pour into pastry shell.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Quiche Lorraine. Line 10-inch pan with pastry. Bake 8 to 9 minutes at 400u00b0. Cook onion in butter until transparent. Mix with ham. Beat eggs and egg yolk, light cream and seasonings. Add to ham mixture. Pour into pastry shell. Top with cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Microwave Baked Apples
directions: Place apples in baking dish.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Pour soda over apples.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Microwave on High for 5 minutes.
Let stand for 2 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Low Calorie Microwave Baked Apples. Place apples in baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Pour soda over apples. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on High for 5 minutes. Let stand for 2 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 2 large (12 oz. each) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate baking pieces
directions: In large bowl, beat together on high speed the shortening, butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar until thoroughly combined, about 5 minutes.
Then beat in eggs, one at a time. Beat in vanilla and lemon juice.
In a bowl, stir together baking soda, salt, cinnamon, oats and flour.
Beat dry ingredients into the creamed mixture until well combined; mix in chocolate pieces and nuts.
For each cookie, drop approximately 1/4 cup dough on lightly greased baking sheet 3 inches apart.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 16 to 18 minutes, or until golden brown.
Makes about 3 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Best Chocolate Chip Cookies. In large bowl, beat together on high speed the shortening, butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar until thoroughly combined, about 5 minutes. Then beat in eggs, one at a time. Beat in vanilla and lemon juice. In a bowl, stir together baking soda, salt, cinnamon, oats and flour. Beat dry ingredients into the creamed mixture until well combined; mix in chocolate pieces and nuts. For each cookie, drop approximately 1/4 cup dough on lightly greased baking sheet 3 inches apart. Bake at 350u00b0 for 16 to 18 minutes, or until golden brown. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Lamb Chops
directions: Melt butter; add vinegar and sprinkle of garlic powder.
Pour over lamb chops.
Sear under broiler only until brown on both sides.
Sprinkle with garlic powder and seasoning salt on both sides.
If necessary, transfer to a baking pan.
Add enough water in bottom of pan to avoid sticking.
Cook at 325u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve with mint jelly.
recipes.text: Lamb Chops. Melt butter; add vinegar and sprinkle of garlic powder. Pour over lamb chops. Sear under broiler only until brown on both sides. Sprinkle with garlic powder and seasoning salt on both sides. If necessary, transfer to a baking pan. Add enough water in bottom of pan to avoid sticking. Cook at 325u00b0 for 2 hours. Serve with mint jelly.

recipes.title: Kenyan Stew
directions: Chop vegetables. Place potatoes and carrots in water to prevent darkening. Heat oil in pan which soup will be cooked. Fry onions until brown. Add tomatoes and cook on medium until tender. Add potatoes and carrots (remove from water) to onions and tomatoes. Add water, salt, chili powder and any optional ingredients desired. Simmer 30 minutes. Serve with chapatis or Ugali.
recipes.text: Kenyan Stew. Chop vegetables. Place potatoes and carrots in water to prevent darkening. Heat oil in pan which soup will be cooked. Fry onions until brown. Add tomatoes and cook on medium until tender. Add potatoes and carrots (remove from water) to onions and tomatoes. Add water, salt, chili powder and any optional ingredients desired. Simmer 30 minutes. Serve with chapatis or Ugali.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Cream together the sugars and oleo thoroughly.
Add beaten eggs slowly to sugar mix.
Add the nuts.
Mix together the remaining ingredients and add to the sugar and egg mixture. Shape into 2 rolls and wrap in wax paper.
Place in refrigerator overnight.
(These rolls freeze very well.) Slice thin and bake on greased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 until golden.
recipes.text: Icebox Cookies. Cream together the sugars and oleo thoroughly. Add beaten eggs slowly to sugar mix. Add the nuts. Mix together the remaining ingredients and add to the sugar and egg mixture. Shape into 2 rolls and wrap in wax paper. Place in refrigerator overnight. (These rolls freeze very well.) Slice thin and bake on greased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 until golden.

recipes.title: Hot Sauce For Chicken Wings
directions: Melt butter and mix all together. Pour over cooked chicken wings or can simmer chicken wings in mixture.
recipes.text: Hot Sauce For Chicken Wings. Melt butter and mix all together. Pour over cooked chicken wings or can simmer chicken wings in mixture.

recipes.title: Mirliton Casserole
directions: Peel and cut mirlitons in small cubes.
Cook 25 minutes with garlic, 1/2 of onions, bell peppers and celery.
Saute shrimp and meat with remainder of vegetables in 3 tablespoons oil.
Cook 20 minutes.
Add can of gravy.
Combine with mirliton mixture, chopped tomato and seasonings.
Cook 15 minutes.
Season to taste.
recipes.text: Mirliton Casserole. Peel and cut mirlitons in small cubes. Cook 25 minutes with garlic, 1/2 of onions, bell peppers and celery. Saute shrimp and meat with remainder of vegetables in 3 tablespoons oil. Cook 20 minutes. Add can of gravy. Combine with mirliton mixture, chopped tomato and seasonings. Cook 15 minutes. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Mash potatoes; mix all the ingredients together.
Bring to a boil.
Add butter and serve.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Mash potatoes; mix all the ingredients together. Bring to a boil. Add butter and serve.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding 2
directions: Melt margarine in large pot.
Stir in sugar and rice.
Add milk and vanilla.
Bring to boil then simmer for one hour.
Remove from heat and add eggs, beat each one separately and add.
Put into bowl and sprinkle cinnamon.
Cool for a few hours before serving.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding 2. Melt margarine in large pot. Stir in sugar and rice. Add milk and vanilla. Bring to boil then simmer for one hour. Remove from heat and add eggs, beat each one separately and add. Put into bowl and sprinkle cinnamon. Cool for a few hours before serving.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Cream sugars and butter together.
Add eggs, beaten light. Add vanilla.
Add soda, baking powder, flour and nut meats (if desired).
Mix well.
Form in roll.
Wrap in cloth and chill in refrigerator overnight.
Slice and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Icebox Cookies. Cream sugars and butter together. Add eggs, beaten light. Add vanilla. Add soda, baking powder, flour and nut meats (if desired). Mix well. Form in roll. Wrap in cloth and chill in refrigerator overnight. Slice and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Wine Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt cake pan.
Bake 55 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Wine Cake. Mix all ingredients together until smooth. Pour into greased and floured Bundt cake pan. Bake 55 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Combine first three ingredients. Cook over medium heat until clear.
Remove from heat, add jello.
Cool, then add strawberries and pour into two baked pie shells.
Chill.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Combine first three ingredients. Cook over medium heat until clear. Remove from heat, add jello. Cool, then add strawberries and pour into two baked pie shells. Chill.

recipes.title: Pastor'S Orange Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.
Mix shortening, sugar, and eggs. Stir in orange juice and rind.
Blend dry ingredients, stir in. Drop by rounded teaspoons on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Pastor'S Orange Cookies. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Mix shortening, sugar, and eggs. Stir in orange juice and rind. Blend dry ingredients, stir in. Drop by rounded teaspoons on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn And Pea Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in large container until well blended. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve well chilled.
recipes.text: Corn And Pea Salad. Mix all ingredients in large container until well blended. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve well chilled.

recipes.title: Bacon Cheddar Puffs
directions: Mix all together. Heat broiler and spread on party sized rye or pumpernickel slices and broil about 3 minutes, until browned.
recipes.text: Bacon Cheddar Puffs. Mix all together. Heat broiler and spread on party sized rye or pumpernickel slices and broil about 3 minutes, until browned.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add vanilla, sift dry ingredients together. Mix with chopped fruits and nuts and combine with creamed mixture. Drop by teaspoon on lightly oiled cookie sheet.
Cook 15 minutes at 325u00b0.
When done, cookies should be a light brown.
Makes about 8 dozen small cookies.
This may need to be mixed by hand.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake Cookies. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add vanilla, sift dry ingredients together. Mix with chopped fruits and nuts and combine with creamed mixture. Drop by teaspoon on lightly oiled cookie sheet. Cook 15 minutes at 325u00b0. When done, cookies should be a light brown. Makes about 8 dozen small cookies. This may need to be mixed by hand.

recipes.title: Peach Skillet Pie
directions: Mix ingredients.
Roll out 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured board.
Pat into heavy skillet, letting dough hang over sides. Fill in with fresh peaches.
Sprinkle with mixture of sugar, salt, cinnamon and butter.
Fold extra dough toward center, leaving center uncovered.
Bake 10 minutes at 450u00b0, then 25 minutes at 275u00b0.
recipes.text: Peach Skillet Pie. Mix ingredients. Roll out 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured board. Pat into heavy skillet, letting dough hang over sides. Fill in with fresh peaches. Sprinkle with mixture of sugar, salt, cinnamon and butter. Fold extra dough toward center, leaving center uncovered. Bake 10 minutes at 450u00b0, then 25 minutes at 275u00b0.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: This slaw to be made hot.
Heat sugar, oil, vinegar and salt. Sprinkle the cut up or shredded vegetables into the celery seed. Pour over cut up vegetables the heated sugar, oil, vinegar and salt while still warm.
Let stand until cool, then stir, refrigerate until ready to serve.
This keeps for several days, and is better the second day.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. This slaw to be made hot. Heat sugar, oil, vinegar and salt. Sprinkle the cut up or shredded vegetables into the celery seed. Pour over cut up vegetables the heated sugar, oil, vinegar and salt while still warm. Let stand until cool, then stir, refrigerate until ready to serve. This keeps for several days, and is better the second day.

recipes.title: Asparagus Medley
ingredients: 1/2 lb. fresh asparagus, cut in 2-inch pieces
directions: In wok or skillet, heat oil. Add asparagus, zucchini, onions and celery. Cook, stirring frequently, 4 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender. Add water chestnuts, pimiento, soy sauce, sugar and pepper. Stir until heated through.
recipes.text: Asparagus Medley. In wok or skillet, heat oil. Add asparagus, zucchini, onions and celery. Cook, stirring frequently, 4 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender. Add water chestnuts, pimiento, soy sauce, sugar and pepper. Stir until heated through.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni.
After it gets done, rinse well and set aside. Melt butter in saucepan until melted and liquid.
Blend flour in butter until it becomes a paste.
Add milk to that, stirring constantly until it thickens.
Once thickened, remove from heat. Cut cheese up and place in sauce.
(Note:
If sauce thickens too much, just add a little milk to thin it out.)
Stir cheese into sauce until the cheese starts to melt.
Then add in salt to taste. Get your casserole bowl and layer the bottom of the bowl with the sauce first.
Then add macaroni.
Continue alternating.
The last layer should be the sauce.
Bake at 450 degrees for 45 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese. Cook macaroni. After it gets done, rinse well and set aside. Melt butter in saucepan until melted and liquid. Blend flour in butter until it becomes a paste. Add milk to that, stirring constantly until it thickens. Once thickened, remove from heat. Cut cheese up and place in sauce. (Note: If sauce thickens too much, just add a little milk to thin it out.) Stir cheese into sauce until the cheese starts to melt. Then add in salt to taste. Get your casserole bowl and layer the bottom of the bowl with the sauce first. Then add macaroni. Continue alternating. The last layer should be the sauce. Bake at 450 degrees for 45 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Herbed Pork And Apples
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast with bone (about 6 lb.)
directions: Combine herbs, salt and pepper; rub over roast.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 325u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.
Drain fat.
recipes.text: Herbed Pork And Apples. Combine herbs, salt and pepper; rub over roast. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 325u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Drain fat.

recipes.title: Cherry Torte
ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening (may use butter or margarine)
directions: Cook pudding with milk.
Pour this pudding over cooled crust. Let cool.
Put cherries over top of cooled pudding and put in the refrigerator overnight.
Can be served with whipped cream, ice cream or as is.
recipes.text: Cherry Torte. Cook pudding with milk. Pour this pudding over cooled crust. Let cool. Put cherries over top of cooled pudding and put in the refrigerator overnight. Can be served with whipped cream, ice cream or as is.

recipes.title: Mexican Style Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
directions: Peel potatoes; cut into cubes.
Place in medium saucepan with water; cook until done.
Drain and cool.
Combine oil, vinegar, chili powder and seasoned salt; blend well.
Add all remaining ingredients, except potatoes.
Mix well.
Fold in potatoes. Cover; refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Mexican Style Potato Salad. Peel potatoes; cut into cubes. Place in medium saucepan with water; cook until done. Drain and cool. Combine oil, vinegar, chili powder and seasoned salt; blend well. Add all remaining ingredients, except potatoes. Mix well. Fold in potatoes. Cover; refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Cook water and rice until done.
Drain.
Add milk and butter; cook 1 hour at 350u00b0.
(Add raisins.)
Mix eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Stir into rice; cook 15 more minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Cook water and rice until done. Drain. Add milk and butter; cook 1 hour at 350u00b0. (Add raisins.) Mix eggs, sugar and vanilla. Stir into rice; cook 15 more minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Three Layer Salad
ingredients: nuts or coconut or colored cherries
directions: Spread a layer of Cool Whip on jello.
Mix pudding and spread on Cool Whip.
Decorate with nuts or coconut or colored cherries. Can be used as a dessert.
recipes.text: Three Layer Salad. Spread a layer of Cool Whip on jello. Mix pudding and spread on Cool Whip. Decorate with nuts or coconut or colored cherries. Can be used as a dessert.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Wash cucumbers.
Cut in thin slices.
Peel and slice onions. Combine onions and cucumbers; add salt.
Let stand 2 hours. Drain.
recipes.text: Bread And Butter Pickles. Wash cucumbers. Cut in thin slices. Peel and slice onions. Combine onions and cucumbers; add salt. Let stand 2 hours. Drain.

recipes.title: Monster Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, sugar, brown sugar and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well by hand. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 50 dozen.
recipes.text: Monster Cookies. Cream together butter, sugar, brown sugar and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well by hand. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Makes 50 dozen.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli or 1 bunch fresh chopped broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes (or fresh until almost tender) and chop.
Mix soup, eggs, mayonnaise, cheese and onion.
Add drained broccoli.
Put mixture in a 2-quart casserole.
Top with crushed cheese crackers.
Bake, covered, for 20 minutes at 400u00b0.
Uncover; bake 5 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli for 5 minutes (or fresh until almost tender) and chop. Mix soup, eggs, mayonnaise, cheese and onion. Add drained broccoli. Put mixture in a 2-quart casserole. Top with crushed cheese crackers. Bake, covered, for 20 minutes at 400u00b0. Uncover; bake 5 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Ten-Minute Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: In 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe bowl, stir together sugar and corn syrup.
Microwace on High 4 minutes.
Stir in salted Spanish peanuts.
Microwave on High 3 to 5 minutes, until light brown. Add butter or margarine and vanilla.
Blend well with wooden spoon.
Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes.
Add baking soda.
Stir gently until light and foamy.
Quickly pour and spread on greased cookie sheet.
Let cool 1 hour before breaking into small pieces.
recipes.text: Ten-Minute Microwave Peanut Brittle. In 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe bowl, stir together sugar and corn syrup. Microwace on High 4 minutes. Stir in salted Spanish peanuts. Microwave on High 3 to 5 minutes, until light brown. Add butter or margarine and vanilla. Blend well with wooden spoon. Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes. Add baking soda. Stir gently until light and foamy. Quickly pour and spread on greased cookie sheet. Let cool 1 hour before breaking into small pieces.

recipes.title: Classic Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. Karo light or dark syrup
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients until well blended.
Stir pecans in mix.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes.
Let cool.
Serves 8. Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Classic Pecan Pie. Mix first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir pecans in mix. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Let cool. Serves 8. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: 7-Up Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar.
Add vanilla, then eggs, one at a time.
Stir in flour and 7-UP.
Pour in tube pan and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
recipes.text: 7-Up Pound Cake. Cream butter, Crisco and sugar. Add vanilla, then eggs, one at a time. Stir in flour and 7-UP. Pour in tube pan and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Dirt Dessert
ingredients: 20 oz. Oreo cookies, crushed in food processor
directions: In one bowl, mix 3 1/2 cups milk and pudding.
In separate bowl, mix sugar, margarine, cream cheese and Cool Whip.
Add pudding mixture.
Layer 1/3 cookie crumbs, 1/2 pudding, 1/3 cookie crumbs, 1/2 pudding and 1/3 cookie crumbs.
Can be garnished with gummy worms and plastic flowers.
recipes.text: Dirt Dessert. In one bowl, mix 3 1/2 cups milk and pudding. In separate bowl, mix sugar, margarine, cream cheese and Cool Whip. Add pudding mixture. Layer 1/3 cookie crumbs, 1/2 pudding, 1/3 cookie crumbs, 1/2 pudding and 1/3 cookie crumbs. Can be garnished with gummy worms and plastic flowers.

recipes.title: Salmon Croquettes
directions: Mix all ingredients except oil well.
Heat oil.
Roll croquettes in bread stick forms; put in hot oil.
Brown, then turn until all sides are brown.
Can be served hot or cold.
(These croquettes can be baked if oil is a problem.)
recipes.text: Salmon Croquettes. Mix all ingredients except oil well. Heat oil. Roll croquettes in bread stick forms; put in hot oil. Brown, then turn until all sides are brown. Can be served hot or cold. (These croquettes can be baked if oil is a problem.)

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except cheese and potato chips; turn into shallow buttered casserole.
Combine cheese and potato chips and spread over top.
Bake uncovered at 375u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole. Mix all ingredients except cheese and potato chips; turn into shallow buttered casserole. Combine cheese and potato chips and spread over top. Bake uncovered at 375u00b0 for 20 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Karen'S Nachos
directions: Brown ground turkey with onion and mushrooms; drain.
Spread chips on cookie sheet.
Spoon salsa over chips.
Cut olives in pieces and arrange over salsa.
Put meat mixture over olives. Layer Cheddar and Mozzarella cheeses on top.
Warm under broiler until cheeses are melted.
Serve immediately.
