recipes.text: Karen'S Nachos. Brown ground turkey with onion and mushrooms; drain. Spread chips on cookie sheet. Spoon salsa over chips. Cut olives in pieces and arrange over salsa. Put meat mixture over olives. Layer Cheddar and Mozzarella cheeses on top. Warm under broiler until cheeses are melted. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: several drops (5 to 6) green food coloring
directions: Mix the sweetened condensed milk with the limeade. Add the Cool Whip and food coloring. Stir until completely blended and the color is as you'd like, then pour into pie crust and chill for at least an hour before serving.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. Mix the sweetened condensed milk with the limeade. Add the Cool Whip and food coloring. Stir until completely blended and the color is as you'd like, then pour into pie crust and chill for at least an hour before serving.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
directions: Drain corn.
Saute onion in small amount Wesson oil, add ground beef and cook until no longer red.
Then add all other ingredients and mix well.
Put can of biscuits on top and bake about 20 minutes, or until brown.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Casserole. Drain corn. Saute onion in small amount Wesson oil, add ground beef and cook until no longer red. Then add all other ingredients and mix well. Put can of biscuits on top and bake about 20 minutes, or until brown.

recipes.title: Beef And Cheese Ball
ingredients: 3 pkg. dried smoked beef, chopped fine
directions: Combine 2 packages of beef, onion, cream cheese, Accent and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl.
Mix well and form into a ball. Roll ball in the remaining package of beef that has been chopped. Serve at room temperature.
Makes 1 very large cheese ball or 2 small cheese balls.
Two-thirds of this recipe makes a good size ball for a tray of crackers.
recipes.text: Beef And Cheese Ball. Combine 2 packages of beef, onion, cream cheese, Accent and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl. Mix well and form into a ball. Roll ball in the remaining package of beef that has been chopped. Serve at room temperature. Makes 1 very large cheese ball or 2 small cheese balls. Two-thirds of this recipe makes a good size ball for a tray of crackers.

recipes.title: Grandma Stillson'S Zucchini Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in 2 greased pans.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Grandma Stillson'S Zucchini Bread(Makes 2 Loaves). Mix all ingredients together. Place in 2 greased pans. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Vegetables(Makes 4 Servings)
ingredients: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
directions: In skillet or wok, over medium-high heat, stir-fry broccoli, peppers and scallions in hot oil for 8 minutes or until tender-crisp.
Stir in water chestnuts, steak sauce, soy sauce and lemon juice.
Cook and stir just until heated through.
recipes.text: Stir-Fry Vegetables(Makes 4 Servings). In skillet or wok, over medium-high heat, stir-fry broccoli, peppers and scallions in hot oil for 8 minutes or until tender-crisp. Stir in water chestnuts, steak sauce, soy sauce and lemon juice. Cook and stir just until heated through.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. bag frozen hash browns, thawed
directions: Mix all of the ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Top with 2 cups of corn flakes or crumbled Ritz crackers, soaked in 1/2 cup melted butter.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Mix all of the ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with 2 cups of corn flakes or crumbled Ritz crackers, soaked in 1/2 cup melted butter.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 bag rotini noodles, cook and cool
1 bag chopped broccoli, cook and cool
directions: To cooled noodles and broccoli add shredded cheeses (mixed), cucumber, green pepper, onion, bacon bits or any fresh vegetable you like.
Kidney beans are also great.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. To cooled noodles and broccoli add shredded cheeses (mixed), cucumber, green pepper, onion, bacon bits or any fresh vegetable you like. Kidney beans are also great.

recipes.title: Easy Baked Pork Chops
directions: Brown chops.
Put chops and soup into a covered casserole dish.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Gravy is great over rice.
Can use 2 cans of soup for extra gravy.
recipes.text: Easy Baked Pork Chops. Brown chops. Put chops and soup into a covered casserole dish. Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Gravy is great over rice. Can use 2 cans of soup for extra gravy.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Primavera
ingredients: 1 boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into 1/2-inch strips (about 1 lb.)
1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen vegetables with pasta (Primavera Pasta Accents)
directions: Melt margarine in large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and garlic.
Cook and stir until chicken is no longer pink (3 to 4 minutes).
Add milk and frozen vegetables with pasta. Cover; simmer 4 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Stir before serving.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Quick Chicken Primavera. Melt margarine in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and garlic. Cook and stir until chicken is no longer pink (3 to 4 minutes). Add milk and frozen vegetables with pasta. Cover; simmer 4 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Stir before serving. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups
directions: In small bowl combine cheeses and margarine until well blended. Spread 1/4 of mixture on each ham slice.
Roll up from short side; chill several hours.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups. In small bowl combine cheeses and margarine until well blended. Spread 1/4 of mixture on each ham slice. Roll up from short side; chill several hours.

recipes.title: Popover Pizza
directions: Place cooked sausage in 13x9x2 inch pan.
Pour In sauce and mix.
Top with Mozzarella cheese.
Combine eggs, oil, milk, flour, and salt; beat with mixer until smooth.
Pour over cheese. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Popover Pizza. Place cooked sausage in 13x9x2 inch pan. Pour In sauce and mix. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Combine eggs, oil, milk, flour, and salt; beat with mixer until smooth. Pour over cheese. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Cook until done, about 2 hours, on low heat.
Pour into jars while hot and seal.
recipes.text: Chili Sauce. Mix all ingredients together. Cook until done, about 2 hours, on low heat. Pour into jars while hot and seal.

recipes.title: Cherry Blossom Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and whipped topping.
Mix well.
Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Store in refrigerator.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Cherry Blossom Salad. In a large mixing bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and whipped topping. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Store in refrigerator. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Mrs. Frank Reynold'S Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, salt and cocoa together.
Add eggs; mix well.
Stir in vanilla and milk.
Add melted margarine, then coconut.
Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes, or until firm.
A cup of nuts for each pie may be added, if desired.
recipes.text: Mrs. Frank Reynold'S Chocolate Pie. Mix sugar, salt and cocoa together. Add eggs; mix well. Stir in vanilla and milk. Add melted margarine, then coconut. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for about 40 minutes, or until firm. A cup of nuts for each pie may be added, if desired.

recipes.title: Microwave Swedish Meatballs
directions: Combine beef, eggs, bread crumbs, 1/4 cup milk, onion, parsley, salt, allspice and pepper.
Shape into 1 1/4-inch meatballs.
recipes.text: Microwave Swedish Meatballs. Combine beef, eggs, bread crumbs, 1/4 cup milk, onion, parsley, salt, allspice and pepper. Shape into 1 1/4-inch meatballs.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Combine sugar and cornstarch; add juices.
Bring to boil and boil for 1 minute.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Combine sugar and cornstarch; add juices. Bring to boil and boil for 1 minute.

recipes.title: Baked French Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf French bread, cut into 3/4-inch slices
directions: In saucepan over medium heat, mix and melt brown sugar, butter and corn syrup.
Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam and pour butter and sugar mixture into dish.
Mix eggs, milk and vanilla. Arrange slices of bread in baking dish and pour egg mixture over bread.
Use all of the mixture.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Baked French Toast. In saucepan over medium heat, mix and melt brown sugar, butter and corn syrup. Spray 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam and pour butter and sugar mixture into dish. Mix eggs, milk and vanilla. Arrange slices of bread in baking dish and pour egg mixture over bread. Use all of the mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients; add eggs, oil and buttermilk.
Mix well. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
May store in refrigerator up to 6 weeks.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Mix dry ingredients; add eggs, oil and buttermilk. Mix well. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. May store in refrigerator up to 6 weeks.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, vanilla and beat.
Add milk with 1 cup flour, sifted with baking powder; beat.
Add enough flour to make a stiff dough.
Roll out thin; cut and bake at 350u00b0 until done.
To decorate, sprinkle colored sugar or candies on top before putting in oven.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, vanilla and beat. Add milk with 1 cup flour, sifted with baking powder; beat. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Roll out thin; cut and bake at 350u00b0 until done. To decorate, sprinkle colored sugar or candies on top before putting in oven.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can sliced pineapple (in its own juice)
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.
Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with brown sugar, nuts, coconut and cherries.
Top with pineapple.
Add water to juice to measure specified liquid on cake mix box.
Prepare as directed on package. Spread evenly over fruit mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until test done.
Cool 5 minutes; invert onto large serving dish.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake. Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar, nuts, coconut and cherries. Top with pineapple. Add water to juice to measure specified liquid on cake mix box. Prepare as directed on package. Spread evenly over fruit mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes or until test done. Cool 5 minutes; invert onto large serving dish.

recipes.title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Drain beans well.
Mix all ingredients.
Put salad in flat, low dish.
This salad is better if made the day before serving. It keeps well in refrigerator for 2 weeks.
recipes.text: Three Bean Salad. Drain beans well. Mix all ingredients. Put salad in flat, low dish. This salad is better if made the day before serving. It keeps well in refrigerator for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Crackling Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Pour into a hot greased pan or skillet.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400u00b0 for about 25 minutes, or until brown.
recipes.text: Crackling Bread. Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into a hot greased pan or skillet. Bake in a preheated oven at 400u00b0 for about 25 minutes, or until brown.

recipes.title: Basic Meat Loaf
directions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except tomato sauce, until well mixed.
Put mixture in loaf pan.
Cover with waxed paper and cook at High 15 to 16 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes, covered.
Drain off all juice.
Put meat loaf on serving plate and cover with tomato sauce.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Basic Meat Loaf. In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except tomato sauce, until well mixed. Put mixture in loaf pan. Cover with waxed paper and cook at High 15 to 16 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes, covered. Drain off all juice. Put meat loaf on serving plate and cover with tomato sauce. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Mix ingredients in order given and bake in pie shell at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Mix ingredients in order given and bake in pie shell at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Hot Apple Cider
ingredients: 1/2 c. cinnamon candy (4 oz. Cinnamon Imperials)
directions: Pour apple cider into a coffee percolator.
Put candy and orange slices in percolator basket.
Candy will melt as cider perks.
recipes.text: Hot Apple Cider. Pour apple cider into a coffee percolator. Put candy and orange slices in percolator basket. Candy will melt as cider perks.

recipes.title: Pear Relish
ingredients: 5 hot peppers, seeded out and chopped
directions: Grind and mix all ingredients, except mustard.
Cook 50 minutes.
Add mustard.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Seal in sterilized jars.
recipes.text: Pear Relish. Grind and mix all ingredients, except mustard. Cook 50 minutes. Add mustard. Cook for 10 minutes. Seal in sterilized jars.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Bring water and margarine to a rolling boil.
Add flour; stir vigorously over low heat about 1 minute until mixture forms a ball.
Remove from heat; add eggs and beat until smooth.
Drop dough 3 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.
Cut off tops.
Remove filaments. Fill with vanilla cream pudding.
Drip icing over top.
recipes.text: Cream Puffs. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Bring water and margarine to a rolling boil. Add flour; stir vigorously over low heat about 1 minute until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat; add eggs and beat until smooth. Drop dough 3 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Cut off tops. Remove filaments. Fill with vanilla cream pudding. Drip icing over top.

recipes.title: Aunt Clara'S Homemade Chili
directions: Put meat into pan and brown. Drain off excess fat. Add all the remaining ingredients.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Cook on low for 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Aunt Clara'S Homemade Chili. Put meat into pan and brown. Drain off excess fat. Add all the remaining ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Lobster
directions: Cut halibut into 1-inch squares.

Put water, crab boil and sugar in a Dutch oven. Bring to a slow boil. Drop squares of halibut, 12 pieces at a time, into water. Cook until it floats, about 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from water and put in a bowl.
Now in small (custard cups) cups put melted butter in and serve while hot.
(Dunk halibut in butter.)
Makes 2 servings.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Lobster. Cut halibut into 1-inch squares. Put water, crab boil and sugar in a Dutch oven. Bring to a slow boil. Drop squares of halibut, 12 pieces at a time, into water. Cook until it floats, about 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from water and put in a bowl. Now in small (custard cups) cups put melted butter in and serve while hot. (Dunk halibut in butter.) Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Layered Spinach Salad
ingredients: 2 cans pork and beans in tomato sauce
1 c. Marie's refrigerated sour cream dressing
directions: In 4-quart bowl, layer 1/2 each of spinach, eggs, lettuce, beans, onions and chopped pepper.
Repeat layers.
Spread salad dressing evenly over top.
Cover at least 12 hours.
Garnish.
recipes.text: Layered Spinach Salad. In 4-quart bowl, layer 1/2 each of spinach, eggs, lettuce, beans, onions and chopped pepper. Repeat layers. Spread salad dressing evenly over top. Cover at least 12 hours. Garnish.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepot.
Bring to a boil, then lower heat to simmer.
Simmer for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
Correct seasonings.
Serve hot.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepot. Bring to a boil, then lower heat to simmer. Simmer for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Correct seasonings. Serve hot. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Secret Irish Creme
directions: Blend all ingredients in blender.
Serve chilled.
Makes 2 quarts.
recipes.text: Secret Irish Creme. Blend all ingredients in blender. Serve chilled. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
directions: Saute green pepper and onion in 2 tablespoons butter.
Cut chicken breasts in cubes and add to onion and green pepper.
Cook on medium for 5 to 7 minutes; stir often.
Put all of this into a greased casserole.
Mix Cheez Whiz, sour cream, cream of chicken and taco seasoning.
Stir well until well blended.
Put over chicken.
Crush tortilla chips and top chicken.
Bake 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
Add Cheddar cheese.
Bake 5 more minutes or until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchilada Casserole. Saute green pepper and onion in 2 tablespoons butter. Cut chicken breasts in cubes and add to onion and green pepper. Cook on medium for 5 to 7 minutes; stir often. Put all of this into a greased casserole. Mix Cheez Whiz, sour cream, cream of chicken and taco seasoning. Stir well until well blended. Put over chicken. Crush tortilla chips and top chicken. Bake 40 minutes at 350u00b0. Add Cheddar cheese. Bake 5 more minutes or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Asparagus And Pea Casserole
directions: Put drained asparagus in buttered baking dish.
Chop eggs and put layer over asparagus, then layer of cream cheese and layer of peas. Dot with butter and season with salt and pepper.
Mix milk and soup together and pour over vegetables.
recipes.text: Asparagus And Pea Casserole. Put drained asparagus in buttered baking dish. Chop eggs and put layer over asparagus, then layer of cream cheese and layer of peas. Dot with butter and season with salt and pepper. Mix milk and soup together and pour over vegetables.

recipes.title: Cheesy Buffalo Wings
directions: Melt margarine.
Dip drumstick part of chicken wing into margarine.
Using food processor, make coarse meal out of cheese nips and coat wings.
Spread on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheesy Buffalo Wings. Melt margarine. Dip drumstick part of chicken wing into margarine. Using food processor, make coarse meal out of cheese nips and coat wings. Spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Twists
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease cookie sheet.
Melt margarine. In small bowl, combine sugar and margarine.
Roll biscuits into 9-inch ropes and form circle.
Dip into margarine, then into the sugar/cinnamon mix.
Twist circle into figure 8.
Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Twists. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Melt margarine. In small bowl, combine sugar and margarine. Roll biscuits into 9-inch ropes and form circle. Dip into margarine, then into the sugar/cinnamon mix. Twist circle into figure 8. Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Caramel Squares
ingredients: 1 (8 1/2 or 9 oz.) pkg. cream filled sugar wafer cookies
directions: Cook in the microwave.
recipes.text: Chocolate Caramel Squares. Cook in the microwave.

recipes.title: Sunshine Fudge
directions: Combine marmalade, cream, and corn syrup in blender or food processor.
Process until well blended.
In a large saucepan, combine the sugar and cocoa.
Mix well. Add softened butter along with milk/marmalade mixture.
Mix well.
Bring to a boil and cook until mixture reaches the soft ball stage.
This should take about 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract. Place pan in large pan of cold water and allow to cool before beating.
Beat until mixture thickens and is no longer glossy. This could take up to 20 or 30 minutes.
Drop from a spoon onto wax paper or pour into well-buttered 8 inch square dish or pan.
recipes.text: Sunshine Fudge. Combine marmalade, cream, and corn syrup in blender or food processor. Process until well blended. In a large saucepan, combine the sugar and cocoa. Mix well. Add softened butter along with milk/marmalade mixture. Mix well. Bring to a boil and cook until mixture reaches the soft ball stage. This should take about 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract. Place pan in large pan of cold water and allow to cool before beating. Beat until mixture thickens and is no longer glossy. This could take up to 20 or 30 minutes. Drop from a spoon onto wax paper or pour into well-buttered 8 inch square dish or pan.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Serve with dipping size pieces of King's Hawaiian bread.
recipes.text: Dill Dip. Mix all ingredients well. Serve with dipping size pieces of King's Hawaiian bread.

recipes.title: Zucchini Au Gratin
directions: Heat butter in skillet. Add ingredients, except cheese.
Cover and cook about 15 minutes. Add cheese.
Heat until cheese is melted.
Serves 4 or more.
recipes.text: Zucchini Au Gratin. Heat butter in skillet. Add ingredients, except cheese. Cover and cook about 15 minutes. Add cheese. Heat until cheese is melted. Serves 4 or more.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1/2 c. finely chopped Bermuda or green onions
directions: Brown onions and celery in oil.
Blend in flour and broth. Cook, stirring, until thickened.
Add juice, Worcestershire sauce and seasonings.
Add chicken; heat thoroughly.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Curry. Brown onions and celery in oil. Blend in flour and broth. Cook, stirring, until thickened. Add juice, Worcestershire sauce and seasonings. Add chicken; heat thoroughly. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Turkey Or Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix everything together and bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Turkey Or Chicken Casserole. Mix everything together and bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Creamed Chicken And Biscuits
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 c. shredded mild Cheddar cheese, divided
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease the bottom and sides of an 11 x 7-inch baking dish.
Chop the onion.
Heat margarine in a small nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until melted.
Stir in onion.
Saut until tender.
Combine onion, chicken, soup, sour cream and milk in a medium bowl and mix well.
Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Remove from oven. Sprinkle baked layer with 3/4 cup of the Cheddar cheese.
Arrange biscuits in a single layer over top.
Sprinkle with remaining Cheddar cheese.
Bake until biscuits are golden brown and the sauce is bubbly, about 20 minutes longer.
Serve immediately. Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Creamed Chicken And Biscuits. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease the bottom and sides of an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Chop the onion. Heat margarine in a small nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until melted. Stir in onion. Saut until tender. Combine onion, chicken, soup, sour cream and milk in a medium bowl and mix well. Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle baked layer with 3/4 cup of the Cheddar cheese. Arrange biscuits in a single layer over top. Sprinkle with remaining Cheddar cheese. Bake until biscuits are golden brown and the sauce is bubbly, about 20 minutes longer. Serve immediately. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Garlic Bread
directions: Spray rolls with the cooking spray.
Sprinkle with garlic powder and parsley.
Toast in toaster oven until brown and crunchy.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Quick Garlic Bread. Spray rolls with the cooking spray. Sprinkle with garlic powder and parsley. Toast in toaster oven until brown and crunchy. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Stir Crazy Cake
directions: Combine flour, 1 1/2 cups sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Stir with fork.
Form 3 wells in mixture.
Pour oil in one and vanilla in one.
Pour water or coffee over.
Stir.
Do not beat.
Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle over batter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Stir Crazy Cake. Combine flour, 1 1/2 cups sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Stir with fork. Form 3 wells in mixture. Pour oil in one and vanilla in one. Pour water or coffee over. Stir. Do not beat. Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
ingredients: 2 pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. hot water
directions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients.
Add dissolved yeast and buttermilk.
Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.
Bake at 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Cut shortening into dry ingredients. Add dissolved yeast and buttermilk. Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator. Bake at 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Peanut Clusters
ingredients: 8 ounce vanilla flavored candy coating (finely chopped)
directions: Cover and heat candy coating in heavy saucepan over very low heat until soft, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir until smooth and creamy.
Mix in peanut butter; stir in cereal until well coated.
Stir in peanuts.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto wax paper covered cookie sheet.
Refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour. Makes about 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Clusters. Cover and heat candy coating in heavy saucepan over very low heat until soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir until smooth and creamy. Mix in peanut butter; stir in cereal until well coated. Stir in peanuts. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto wax paper covered cookie sheet. Refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour. Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Cheesy Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Combine cheese, milk, margarine and salt; heat until cheese melts.
Stir in hash browns.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Spread sour cream and bacon bits on top. Continue cooking 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: Cheesy Hash Brown Casserole. Combine cheese, milk, margarine and salt; heat until cheese melts. Stir in hash browns. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Spread sour cream and bacon bits on top. Continue cooking 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Vegetable Cheese Soup
directions: Heat together potatoes, onions, California Blend vegetables and bouillon cube in the water.
Heat until vegetables are tender. Then add the cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup; stir until mixed thoroughly.
Add the Velveeta cheese and cook until desired consistency.
recipes.text: Vegetable Cheese Soup. Heat together potatoes, onions, California Blend vegetables and bouillon cube in the water. Heat until vegetables are tender. Then add the cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and cream of celery soup; stir until mixed thoroughly. Add the Velveeta cheese and cook until desired consistency.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad(Can Be Frozen)
directions: Cream together the cream cheese and sugar.
Add strawberries (thawed and mashed) and blend.
Add crushed pineapple (drained and chopped nuts.
Mix well.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish and refrigerate.
Can be frozen.
recipes.text: Strawberry Salad(Can Be Frozen). Cream together the cream cheese and sugar. Add strawberries (thawed and mashed) and blend. Add crushed pineapple (drained and chopped nuts. Mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish and refrigerate. Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Fruit Delight
ingredients: vanilla wafers or chocolate chip cookies
directions: Start with layer of cookies; crumbled.
Then put the fruit, Cool Whip and repeat.
You may use any fruit that is in season. If you use fresh strawberries, put enough sugar in to make juice.
recipes.text: Fruit Delight. Start with layer of cookies; crumbled. Then put the fruit, Cool Whip and repeat. You may use any fruit that is in season. If you use fresh strawberries, put enough sugar in to make juice.

recipes.title: Hummus
directions: Heat chickpeas; drain and blend in blender with chopped garlic. Add sesame seed oil.
Blend.
Add lemon juice and blend.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with pita bread wedges.
recipes.text: Hummus. Heat chickpeas; drain and blend in blender with chopped garlic. Add sesame seed oil. Blend. Add lemon juice and blend. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with pita bread wedges.

recipes.title: Texas Cheese Dip
directions: Brown ground beef; drain.
Add other ingredients; mix well. Add a few shakes of garlic salt and heat.
recipes.text: Texas Cheese Dip. Brown ground beef; drain. Add other ingredients; mix well. Add a few shakes of garlic salt and heat.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Wash chicken well and dry completely.
Combine preceding mixture except butter.
Melt butter in skillet.
Dip each chicken part in butter and roll in crumb-cheese mixture.
Put in shallow pan.
Dot with butter.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Chicken. Wash chicken well and dry completely. Combine preceding mixture except butter. Melt butter in skillet. Dip each chicken part in butter and roll in crumb-cheese mixture. Put in shallow pan. Dot with butter. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandmomma'S Chess Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Melt butter, sugar and vinegar over low heat.
Allow to boil for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring continuously. Remove from stove and let cool.
In a separate bowl beat eggs well. Add to above mixture.
Beat in meal and vanilla.
Place in uncooked pie crust.
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandmomma'S Chess Pie. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Melt butter, sugar and vinegar over low heat. Allow to boil for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring continuously. Remove from stove and let cool. In a separate bowl beat eggs well. Add to above mixture. Beat in meal and vanilla. Place in uncooked pie crust. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Cabbage Rolls(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 clove garlic, minced or garlic powder (if wanted)
directions: Remove core and blemished cabbage leaves.
Place cabbage in large microwave casserole.
Add some water.
Cover with plastic wrap and cook on High (max power) 6 minutes or less until outer leaves are softened.
Separate leaves and remove and re-cook cabbage until desired amount is done.
Combine all ingredients except tomato sauce thoroughly.
Place mixture onto 6 to 8 large cabbage leaves and wrap tightly.
Line bottom of large casserole with leftover cabbage.
Place cabbage rolls on top.
Dot with butter and cover with tomato sauce.
recipes.text: Cabbage Rolls(Microwave). Remove core and blemished cabbage leaves. Place cabbage in large microwave casserole. Add some water. Cover with plastic wrap and cook on High (max power) 6 minutes or less until outer leaves are softened. Separate leaves and remove and re-cook cabbage until desired amount is done. Combine all ingredients except tomato sauce thoroughly. Place mixture onto 6 to 8 large cabbage leaves and wrap tightly. Line bottom of large casserole with leftover cabbage. Place cabbage rolls on top. Dot with butter and cover with tomato sauce.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can Mandarin oranges with juice
directions: Mix cake, oranges and juice, eggs and oil all together.
Pour in Bundt pan, greased and floured.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Cake. Mix cake, oranges and juice, eggs and oil all together. Pour in Bundt pan, greased and floured. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Microwave broccoli 5 minutes each package on High.
Add cheese and microwave on Medium for 2 1/2 minutes.
Saute onions in butter (microwave on Medium for 2 1/2 minutes).
Add soup and onions. Add stuffing mix (made by directions on package).
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Microwave broccoli 5 minutes each package on High. Add cheese and microwave on Medium for 2 1/2 minutes. Saute onions in butter (microwave on Medium for 2 1/2 minutes). Add soup and onions. Add stuffing mix (made by directions on package). Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients; bring to boil, then cool. Add the flour and sugar. Beat in the eggs, sour cream and soda. Spread in greased and floured 12 x 15-inch jelly pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes, until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Prepare icing immediately; spread on cake while warm.
recipes.text: Texas Sheet Cake. Combine the first 3 ingredients; bring to boil, then cool. Add the flour and sugar. Beat in the eggs, sour cream and soda. Spread in greased and floured 12 x 15-inch jelly pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes, until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Prepare icing immediately; spread on cake while warm.

recipes.title: Mayo Parmesan Bread
directions: Mix and spread on French or Italian bread slices. Place under broiler until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Mayo Parmesan Bread. Mix and spread on French or Italian bread slices. Place under broiler until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions on the box.
Melt margarine in iron skillet on top of melted margarine.
Dot with maraschino cherries.
Pour cake mix on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until tested with toothpick.
Turn upside down on plate to serve.
This cake is larger than a regular plate size. Use a meat platter plate.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake. Mix cake mix according to directions on the box. Melt margarine in iron skillet on top of melted margarine. Dot with maraschino cherries. Pour cake mix on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until tested with toothpick. Turn upside down on plate to serve. This cake is larger than a regular plate size. Use a meat platter plate.

recipes.title: Baked Apples(Serves 4)
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Take a small rectangular Pyrex dish and lightly grease the bottom with a little margarine or butter.
Core the apples all the way through, and peel away the skin from around the top of the apple.
Slice a small piece from the bottom of the apple so that it will stand up straight in the baking pan.
Place the apples in the pan.
Mix the sugar and butter/margarine with the raisins and place in the cored-out cavity of each apple. Place in the oven and bake for approximately 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Apples(Serves 4). Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Take a small rectangular Pyrex dish and lightly grease the bottom with a little margarine or butter. Core the apples all the way through, and peel away the skin from around the top of the apple. Slice a small piece from the bottom of the apple so that it will stand up straight in the baking pan. Place the apples in the pan. Mix the sugar and butter/margarine with the raisins and place in the cored-out cavity of each apple. Place in the oven and bake for approximately 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Herb Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/4 c. green onions and tops, chopped
directions: Peel tomatoes and slice thick.
Mix all ingredients.
Marinate tomatoes overnight.
To serve:
Arrange tomatoes on a serving plate and spoon a small amount of marinade over them.
recipes.text: Herb Tomatoes. Peel tomatoes and slice thick. Mix all ingredients. Marinate tomatoes overnight. To serve: Arrange tomatoes on a serving plate and spoon a small amount of marinade over them.

recipes.title: Turkey Salad
directions: Mix turkey, grapes and nuts together.
Add Kraft salad dressing.
Put on lettuce leaf and garnish with tomato and serve. Makes one or two servings.
recipes.text: Turkey Salad. Mix turkey, grapes and nuts together. Add Kraft salad dressing. Put on lettuce leaf and garnish with tomato and serve. Makes one or two servings.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Place chicken in a large pot and cover with water. Cook until chicken is tender or until fork can be inserted with ease, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Remove chicken from broth. When cool enough to handle, cut into pieces of desired size or leave whole. Cut tortillas into squares. Drop one at a time into boiling broth seasoned to taste with salt and pepper. As tortillas go under the broth, add more until all are in pot. Simmer 5 minutes. Do not stir. TASTY AND EASY!!!!!
recipes.text: Easy Chicken And Dumplings. Place chicken in a large pot and cover with water. Cook until chicken is tender or until fork can be inserted with ease, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Remove chicken from broth. When cool enough to handle, cut into pieces of desired size or leave whole. Cut tortillas into squares. Drop one at a time into boiling broth seasoned to taste with salt and pepper. As tortillas go under the broth, add more until all are in pot. Simmer 5 minutes. Do not stir. TASTY AND EASY!!!!!

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Combine pudding mix, milk, sour cream and Eagle Brand with mixer for 1 to 2 minutes until it begins to thicken.
Add Cool Whip and vanilla; beat until smooth.
Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with vanilla wafers.
Place a layer of bananas over wafers and top with pudding mixture.
Chill.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Combine pudding mix, milk, sour cream and Eagle Brand with mixer for 1 to 2 minutes until it begins to thicken. Add Cool Whip and vanilla; beat until smooth. Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with vanilla wafers. Place a layer of bananas over wafers and top with pudding mixture. Chill.

recipes.title: Raw Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix vinegar, oil, sugar and garlic salt.
Pour over raw vegetables.
Let set overnight.
Keeps for several days.
recipes.text: Raw Vegetable Salad. Mix vinegar, oil, sugar and garlic salt. Pour over raw vegetables. Let set overnight. Keeps for several days.

recipes.title: Hot Milk Cake
directions: Heat milk and margarine (don't boil).
Mix together eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla.
Alternate flour and milk while mixing. Add baking powder last (gently).
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Milk Cake. Heat milk and margarine (don't boil). Mix together eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla. Alternate flour and milk while mixing. Add baking powder last (gently). Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery or mushroom soup
directions: Boil squash and onions until tender.
Add salt to taste. Drain.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Boil squash and onions until tender. Add salt to taste. Drain.

recipes.title: Shrimp Ring
directions: Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water.
Bring soup to boil and dissolve cheese in it.
Dissolve gelatin in soup mixture and let cool.
Add celery, onion and mayonnaise.
Let firm in refrigerator for 5 minutes.
Alternate shrimp and sauce in layers in greased mold and return to refrigerator to firm.
Yields 5 cup mold.
recipes.text: Shrimp Ring. Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water. Bring soup to boil and dissolve cheese in it. Dissolve gelatin in soup mixture and let cool. Add celery, onion and mayonnaise. Let firm in refrigerator for 5 minutes. Alternate shrimp and sauce in layers in greased mold and return to refrigerator to firm. Yields 5 cup mold.

recipes.title: Turkey Or Chicken Chop Suey
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. chopped cooked turkey or chicken
hot cooked rice or Chinese noodles
directions: Cook onion and celery in oil about 5 minutes in electric frypan.
Add next 3 ingredients and 1 1/2 or 2 cups hot water. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.
Add 2 tablespoons soy sauce.
Blend cornstarch and 1/4 cup water.
Add to mixture and cook, stirring until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper and serve on rice with additional soy sauce.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Turkey Or Chicken Chop Suey. Cook onion and celery in oil about 5 minutes in electric frypan. Add next 3 ingredients and 1 1/2 or 2 cups hot water. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Add 2 tablespoons soy sauce. Blend cornstarch and 1/4 cup water. Add to mixture and cook, stirring until thickened. Season with salt and pepper and serve on rice with additional soy sauce. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Cut chicken into serving pieces.
Spray a 6 x 12-inch casserole dish with Pam.
Put rice in dish.
Sprinkle dry onion soup over rice; add water.
Place chicken in single layer, skin side up, on top of rice.
Spoon celery soup, saving 1/2 can for heating over. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Cut chicken into serving pieces. Spray a 6 x 12-inch casserole dish with Pam. Put rice in dish. Sprinkle dry onion soup over rice; add water. Place chicken in single layer, skin side up, on top of rice. Spoon celery soup, saving 1/2 can for heating over. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Spicy Nut Mix
ingredients: 6 c. bite-size shredded corn, rice or wheat cereal
1 (12 oz.) can mixed nuts or peanuts
directions: Preheat oven to 250u00b0.
In large skillet, melt margarine, stir in sugar, cumin, curry, garlic and cayenne pepper.
In large bowl combine cereal, nuts and pretzels.
Add margarine mixture and toss thoroughly.
Turn into shallow baking pan and bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Cool on paper towels.
Makes about 8 cups nut mix.
recipes.text: Spicy Nut Mix. Preheat oven to 250u00b0. In large skillet, melt margarine, stir in sugar, cumin, curry, garlic and cayenne pepper. In large bowl combine cereal, nuts and pretzels. Add margarine mixture and toss thoroughly. Turn into shallow baking pan and bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool on paper towels. Makes about 8 cups nut mix.

recipes.title: Fanny Farmer Fudge
directions: Bring butter, sugar, milk and marshmallows to boil; take off heat.
Add chocolate chips, shaved Hershey milk chocolate bar and nuts.
Stir until all is completely melted.
Pour into greased 10 x 15-inch pan or greased cookie sheet.
Refrigerate until firm enough to cut.
recipes.text: Fanny Farmer Fudge. Bring butter, sugar, milk and marshmallows to boil; take off heat. Add chocolate chips, shaved Hershey milk chocolate bar and nuts. Stir until all is completely melted. Pour into greased 10 x 15-inch pan or greased cookie sheet. Refrigerate until firm enough to cut.

recipes.title: Caramel-Pecan Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped pecans, almonds, walnuts or cashews
directions: In a heavy saucepan combine sugar, brown sugar, light cream and margarine.
Cook over medium-high heat until boiling, stirring constantly to dissolve the sugars.
Reduce heat.
Cook and stir for 5 minutes more or until slightly thickened.
Stir in chopped pecans.
Let stand 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Caramel-Pecan Sauce. In a heavy saucepan combine sugar, brown sugar, light cream and margarine. Cook over medium-high heat until boiling, stirring constantly to dissolve the sugars. Reduce heat. Cook and stir for 5 minutes more or until slightly thickened. Stir in chopped pecans. Let stand 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, peeled and cut into small pieces
3 large carrots, peeled and thinly sliced
directions: Place all ingredients into a stockpot.
Bring to a boil.
Turn down heat to low and let simmer 2 to 4 hours, stirring frequently. Add water if you like your soup thinner.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Place all ingredients into a stockpot. Bring to a boil. Turn down heat to low and let simmer 2 to 4 hours, stirring frequently. Add water if you like your soup thinner.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Mix with hands (does better).
Mix Crisco and sugar; add eggs one at a time.
Add sifted flour and salt.
Add vanilla and lemon. In separate bowl add buttermilk, soda and water, then add to other blended ingredients.
Flour or sugar well-greased Bundt pan (Crisco or margarine).
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300u00b0.
Preheat oven. Test.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pound Cake. Mix with hands (does better). Mix Crisco and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Add sifted flour and salt. Add vanilla and lemon. In separate bowl add buttermilk, soda and water, then add to other blended ingredients. Flour or sugar well-greased Bundt pan (Crisco or margarine). Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300u00b0. Preheat oven. Test.

recipes.title: Hamburg Stroganoff
directions: Mince onions and saute in 3 tablespoons butter (or bacon fat). Add flour; blend well.
Add beef broth and Worcestershire sauce.
recipes.text: Hamburg Stroganoff. Mince onions and saute in 3 tablespoons butter (or bacon fat). Add flour; blend well. Add beef broth and Worcestershire sauce.

recipes.title: Tamale Pie
ingredients: 1 can black or pitted olives, chopped
directions: Bring the water and tomato sauce to boil and add the cornmeal. Cook until thickened. Cook the ground meat with the onions. Add the corn, olives and chili powder. Mix in cornmeal mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Tamale Pie. Bring the water and tomato sauce to boil and add the cornmeal. Cook until thickened. Cook the ground meat with the onions. Add the corn, olives and chili powder. Mix in cornmeal mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef And Noodles
directions: Season roast beef with salt and pepper.
Flour both sides and brown.
Pressure cook until done and able to fork apart, about 1 hour.
(May also use home canned beef.)
Add noodles to boiling broth and meat; cook 7 minutes.
recipes.text: Beef And Noodles. Season roast beef with salt and pepper. Flour both sides and brown. Pressure cook until done and able to fork apart, about 1 hour. (May also use home canned beef.) Add noodles to boiling broth and meat; cook 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Surprise
directions: Drain sweet potatoes.
Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Drop bits of margarine over sweet potatoes.
Sprinkle with brown sugar. Place in Radarange oven; cook 1 minute.
Stir.
Spread marshmallows over top.
Cook 3 additional minutes.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Surprise. Drain sweet potatoes. Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Drop bits of margarine over sweet potatoes. Sprinkle with brown sugar. Place in Radarange oven; cook 1 minute. Stir. Spread marshmallows over top. Cook 3 additional minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice (Minute Maid)
directions: Mix all ingredients in blender and serve.
recipes.text: Orange Julius. Mix all ingredients in blender and serve.

recipes.title: Cheesy Rotini
ingredients: 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can whole tomatoes, undrained and broken up
directions: Prepare rotini according to package directions; drain.
In a large skillet, cook beef, green pepper and onion over medium heat until beef is no longer pink, drain excess fat.
Add tomatoes, bouillon, Worcestershire sauce and pepper.
Simmer for 5 minutes; remove from heat, stir in milk, Ricotta cheese, 1 cup of shredded Cheddar cheese and rotini.
Pour into a 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with remaining Cheddar cheese.
Bake covered in 350u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.
Enjoy!!!!!
recipes.text: Cheesy Rotini. Prepare rotini according to package directions; drain. In a large skillet, cook beef, green pepper and onion over medium heat until beef is no longer pink, drain excess fat. Add tomatoes, bouillon, Worcestershire sauce and pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes; remove from heat, stir in milk, Ricotta cheese, 1 cup of shredded Cheddar cheese and rotini. Pour into a 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with remaining Cheddar cheese. Bake covered in 350u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Enjoy!!!!!

recipes.title: Like Mrs. Field'S Cookies
directions: Cream together the butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Mix together the flour, oatmeal (after measuring, put oatmeal in blender and blend until powder), salt, baking soda and baking powder.
Add dry ingredients to butter mixture.
Mix well, then add chocolate chips, Hershey bar (grated, shaved or cut into small chunks) and nuts.
Place golf ball size cookies 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375u00b0 for 6 minutes. Makes 112 large cookies or 50 very large cookies.
recipes.text: Like Mrs. Field'S Cookies. Cream together the butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla. Mix together the flour, oatmeal (after measuring, put oatmeal in blender and blend until powder), salt, baking soda and baking powder. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture. Mix well, then add chocolate chips, Hershey bar (grated, shaved or cut into small chunks) and nuts. Place golf ball size cookies 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375u00b0 for 6 minutes. Makes 112 large cookies or 50 very large cookies.

recipes.title: Cucumber Summer Salad
directions: Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Chill in refrigerator overnight, letting all the flavorings penetrate the cucumber while tightly covered.
Preferably in a Tupperware bowl. Serve as a side dish with chicken or beef entrees.
recipes.text: Cucumber Summer Salad. Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Chill in refrigerator overnight, letting all the flavorings penetrate the cucumber while tightly covered. Preferably in a Tupperware bowl. Serve as a side dish with chicken or beef entrees.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Stir together first 5 ingredients.
Add milk and half and half.
Stir all together and pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
Add cinnamon on top.
Bake until done in 350u00b0 oven.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Stir together first 5 ingredients. Add milk and half and half. Stir all together and pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Add cinnamon on top. Bake until done in 350u00b0 oven. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Cheese Sauce
directions: Add flour to melted butter.
Add milk and heat on stove for 4 minutes.
Stir.
Add cheese and mix.
Heat on stove again until cheese has melted.
Add onions and salt and pepper if you desire.
recipes.text: Cheese Sauce. Add flour to melted butter. Add milk and heat on stove for 4 minutes. Stir. Add cheese and mix. Heat on stove again until cheese has melted. Add onions and salt and pepper if you desire.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Salad
directions: Mix jello and water, then other ingredients.
Chill until firm.
Add dressing on top of salad.
recipes.text: Coca-Cola Salad. Mix jello and water, then other ingredients. Chill until firm. Add dressing on top of salad.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix
the
first 4 ingredients and bring to a boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add last 4 ingredients.
Stir and put in a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Mix the first 4 ingredients and bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add last 4 ingredients. Stir and put in a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.

recipes.title: French Toast
directions: Preheat a skillet to 325u00b0.
In a large bowl, mix eggs and beat with a fork until mixed well.
Add 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/8 teaspoon pepper and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon.
Beat with fork some more.
Dip bread in mixture, completely covering both sides.
recipes.text: French Toast. Preheat a skillet to 325u00b0. In a large bowl, mix eggs and beat with a fork until mixed well. Add 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/8 teaspoon pepper and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Beat with fork some more. Dip bread in mixture, completely covering both sides.

recipes.title: Ambrosia Dessert Bowl
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.) loaf frozen pound cake, thawed and cubed (about 4 c.)
5 to 6 large navel oranges, peeled and sectioned
directions: Place marshmallows and 1/4 cup cream in the top of a double boiler; heat over boiling water until the marshmallows are melted and mixture is smooth.
Cool completely.
Meanwhile, whip the remaining cream until thick.
Add sugar.
Fold into marshmallow mixture.
Fold in extracts, pineapple and coconut.
Place half of the pound cake cubes in the bottom of a 2 1/2 to 3-quart clear glass bowl.
Top with half of the orange sections.
Top with half of the cream mixture.
Repeat layers.
Sprinkle with almonds. Chill until serving time.
Yield:
10 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Ambrosia Dessert Bowl. Place marshmallows and 1/4 cup cream in the top of a double boiler; heat over boiling water until the marshmallows are melted and mixture is smooth. Cool completely. Meanwhile, whip the remaining cream until thick. Add sugar. Fold into marshmallow mixture. Fold in extracts, pineapple and coconut. Place half of the pound cake cubes in the bottom of a 2 1/2 to 3-quart clear glass bowl. Top with half of the orange sections. Top with half of the cream mixture. Repeat layers. Sprinkle with almonds. Chill until serving time. Yield: 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy.
Add sugar, vanilla and oil; blend well.
Stir in zucchini.
Stir together flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and cinnamon.
Blend into creamed mixture.
Fold in the nuts.
Turn into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 2-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add sugar, vanilla and oil; blend well. Stir in zucchini. Stir together flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and cinnamon. Blend into creamed mixture. Fold in the nuts. Turn into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 2-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ultimate Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients with 1/2 of corned beef and form into ball.
Roll ball into remaining corned beef.
recipes.text: Ultimate Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients with 1/2 of corned beef and form into ball. Roll ball into remaining corned beef.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. strawberry halves in syrup
2 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
directions: Beat cream cheese, strawberries, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in whipped topping.
Spoon in crust and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cream Cheese Pie. Beat cream cheese, strawberries, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Spoon in crust and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Black Walnut Cookies
directions: Cream the butter.
Add sugar and beaten eggs. Sift flour, soda and cream of tartar together. Add and mix thoroughly.
Add chopped nuts.
Chill.
Form into a roll and slice.
Bake on buttered cookie sheet until lightly browned at about 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Black Walnut Cookies. Cream the butter. Add sugar and beaten eggs. Sift flour, soda and cream of tartar together. Add and mix thoroughly. Add chopped nuts. Chill. Form into a roll and slice. Bake on buttered cookie sheet until lightly browned at about 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Raisin Bars
directions: Mix first four ingredients and boil 4 minutes, stirring constantly.
This mixture sticks easily so it needs to be cooked on low heat.
Remove from heat and add raisins and coconut. Mixture may be poured on a layer of graham crackers in a pan and then topped with another layer of crackers.
Pull apart when cold. You may also let mixture cool and spread on crackers like a sandwich.
Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Raisin Bars. Mix first four ingredients and boil 4 minutes, stirring constantly. This mixture sticks easily so it needs to be cooked on low heat. Remove from heat and add raisins and coconut. Mixture may be poured on a layer of graham crackers in a pan and then topped with another layer of crackers. Pull apart when cold. You may also let mixture cool and spread on crackers like a sandwich. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Quick Eclair Cake
directions: Melt margarine.
Add sugar, cocoa and milk.
Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add vanilla and salt. Let cool.
recipes.text: Quick Eclair Cake. Melt margarine. Add sugar, cocoa and milk. Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute. Remove from heat and add vanilla and salt. Let cool.

recipes.title: Lemon-Tarragon Chicken
directions: Flatten or cut the chicken breasts into strips.
Dredge chicken lightly in flour, tarragon , salt and pepper.
Melt a small amount of oleo in pan.
Saute garlic and add chicken, cook for 5 minutes.
Add pimentos, mushrooms and artichokes; simmer about 5 minutes.
Add enough cornstarch and water thickener to make sauce; add juice of 1 lemon.
Serve over rice or noodles.
recipes.text: Lemon-Tarragon Chicken. Flatten or cut the chicken breasts into strips. Dredge chicken lightly in flour, tarragon , salt and pepper. Melt a small amount of oleo in pan. Saute garlic and add chicken, cook for 5 minutes. Add pimentos, mushrooms and artichokes; simmer about 5 minutes. Add enough cornstarch and water thickener to make sauce; add juice of 1 lemon. Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Cheddar Turkey Bake
directions: Prepare rice
according to package; add to rice, minced onion, while
in
boilingtwater.tCombine peas, turkey, soup, milk, mustard
and salt.tMix all ingredients together.
Place in 10 x 6
x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.
Mix crackers and butter and sprinkle onttop
of
casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Cheddar Turkey Bake. Prepare rice according to package; add to rice, minced onion, while in boilingtwater.tCombine peas, turkey, soup, milk, mustard and salt.tMix all ingredients together. Place in 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Mix crackers and butter and sprinkle onttop of casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Forgotten Dessert
directions: Beat egg whites, cream of tartar and salt until stiff. Gradually add sugar and vanilla.
Put in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat oven to 425u00b0.
Place meringue in oven and turn off heat. Leave in oven overnight.
recipes.text: Forgotten Dessert. Beat egg whites, cream of tartar and salt until stiff. Gradually add sugar and vanilla. Put in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat oven to 425u00b0. Place meringue in oven and turn off heat. Leave in oven overnight.

recipes.title: Breakfast Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Trim bread crusts.
Cook sausage in skillet, stirring until brown and crumbly; drain.
Layer 6 slices of bread, sausage, cheese and remaining bread in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine eggs, milk and salt in bowl; beat until smooth.
Pour over layers.
Cover with foil and chill in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Breakfast Bake. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Trim bread crusts. Cook sausage in skillet, stirring until brown and crumbly; drain. Layer 6 slices of bread, sausage, cheese and remaining bread in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine eggs, milk and salt in bowl; beat until smooth. Pour over layers. Cover with foil and chill in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken
directions: The last 4 ingredients may be doubled.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken. The last 4 ingredients may be doubled.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour over chicken.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or longer until cooked.
recipes.text: Teriyaki Chicken. Mix all ingredients together. Pour over chicken. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours or longer until cooked.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Baked Limas
directions: Wash beans with cold water.
Place beans in kettle and cover with water.
After it comes to a boil, put in a pinch of baking soda.
Parboil until not white, about 10 minutes (being careful that skins of beans don't start coming off).
Drain.
Put beans in roasting pan with ham, salt and pepper, small onion (quartered and sliced), brown sugar and water just to cover beans.
Bake until water cooks down a little at 325u00b0.
Add chili sauce; continue baking until beans are tender and sauce slightly thickened.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Baked Limas. Wash beans with cold water. Place beans in kettle and cover with water. After it comes to a boil, put in a pinch of baking soda. Parboil until not white, about 10 minutes (being careful that skins of beans don't start coming off). Drain. Put beans in roasting pan with ham, salt and pepper, small onion (quartered and sliced), brown sugar and water just to cover beans. Bake until water cooks down a little at 325u00b0. Add chili sauce; continue baking until beans are tender and sauce slightly thickened.

recipes.title: Easy Yeast Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water; add remaining ingredients.
Mix well after each addition.
Spoon into muffin tins sprayed with Pam. Bake at 400u00b0 until brown, about 15 minutes.
Refrigerate unused portion.
It will keep about 1 week.
recipes.text: Easy Yeast Rolls. Dissolve yeast in water; add remaining ingredients. Mix well after each addition. Spoon into muffin tins sprayed with Pam. Bake at 400u00b0 until brown, about 15 minutes. Refrigerate unused portion. It will keep about 1 week.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream(Custard Base)
directions: For extra rich ice cream, use all cream and omit milk.
Combine sugar, flour and salt in saucepan.
Slowly stir in hot milk, cook over low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened.
Mix small amount of hot mixture into beaten eggs.
Add to hot mixture and cook 1 minute longer.
Chill in refrigerator.
Add cream and vanilla.
Pour into gallon electric freezer.
Fill freezer about 2/3 full.
Serves 12 to 16.
recipes.text: Vanilla Ice Cream(Custard Base). For extra rich ice cream, use all cream and omit milk. Combine sugar, flour and salt in saucepan. Slowly stir in hot milk, cook over low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened. Mix small amount of hot mixture into beaten eggs. Add to hot mixture and cook 1 minute longer. Chill in refrigerator. Add cream and vanilla. Pour into gallon electric freezer. Fill freezer about 2/3 full. Serves 12 to 16.

recipes.title: Buttercream Frosting
directions: In a large mixing bowl, add 2 boxes of sugar and water; blend at low speed and work up to high speed.
Scrape bowl sides often. Add salt and flavorings.
Beat in Crisco, a little at a time, until all of it has been added.
Gradually add the last pound of sugar.
If the icing is too soft, add more sugar a little at a time.
If it is too stiff, add water a few drops at a time.
recipes.text: Buttercream Frosting. In a large mixing bowl, add 2 boxes of sugar and water; blend at low speed and work up to high speed. Scrape bowl sides often. Add salt and flavorings. Beat in Crisco, a little at a time, until all of it has been added. Gradually add the last pound of sugar. If the icing is too soft, add more sugar a little at a time. If it is too stiff, add water a few drops at a time.

recipes.title: Shrimp Mold
directions: Thaw shrimp.
Melt together cream of mushroom soup and cream cheese.
Dissolve Knox unflavored gelatine in cold water.
Add to cream cheese mixture.
Add celery, green onions, mayonnaise and shrimp.
Mix well.
Put into mold or bowl.
Refrigerate overnight. Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Mold. Thaw shrimp. Melt together cream of mushroom soup and cream cheese. Dissolve Knox unflavored gelatine in cold water. Add to cream cheese mixture. Add celery, green onions, mayonnaise and shrimp. Mix well. Put into mold or bowl. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Sift together flour and baking powder.
Melt butter with 1/2 cup water, chocolate and sugar on low heat until all ingredients are combined.
Remove from heat; transfer to a large mixing bowl. Add sifted dry ingredients to melted mixture; mix thoroughly. Combine buttermilk and baking soda; make sure soda is dissolved. Add to main mixture.
Combine eggs and vanilla; add to main mixture.
Put mixture into greased and floured 8-inch cake pan. Bake in preheated moderate oven for 25 to 35 minutes.
Cool thoroughly, then ice.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Sift together flour and baking powder. Melt butter with 1/2 cup water, chocolate and sugar on low heat until all ingredients are combined. Remove from heat; transfer to a large mixing bowl. Add sifted dry ingredients to melted mixture; mix thoroughly. Combine buttermilk and baking soda; make sure soda is dissolved. Add to main mixture. Combine eggs and vanilla; add to main mixture. Put mixture into greased and floured 8-inch cake pan. Bake in preheated moderate oven for 25 to 35 minutes. Cool thoroughly, then ice.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 250u00b0.
Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of an 8-inch square baking dish.
recipes.text: Cheesecake Squares. Preheat oven to 250u00b0. Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of an 8-inch square baking dish.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 Keebler Ready-Crust graham cracker pie shell
1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese (room temperature)
directions: Put cream cheese into a bowl and whip with mixer, then slowly add 2 cups of milk.
Mix together.
To that, add chocolate pudding.
Beat together, not too long, it will thicken as it sets. Pour into pie crust and top with Cool Whip.
Take block of semi-sweet chocolate and shave with a potato peeler on the top. Do not cover pie.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cream Pie. Put cream cheese into a bowl and whip with mixer, then slowly add 2 cups of milk. Mix together. To that, add chocolate pudding. Beat together, not too long, it will thicken as it sets. Pour into pie crust and top with Cool Whip. Take block of semi-sweet chocolate and shave with a potato peeler on the top. Do not cover pie.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroons
directions: In a bowl, combine flour, coconut and salt.
Add milk and vanilla; mix well (batter will be stiff).
Drop by tablespoonfuls 1 inch apart onto a greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove to a wire rack to cool.
recipes.text: Coconut Macaroons. In a bowl, combine flour, coconut and salt. Add milk and vanilla; mix well (batter will be stiff). Drop by tablespoonfuls 1 inch apart onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove to a wire rack to cool.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix and pour into baking dish.
Top with crackers and margarine.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mixed Vegetable Casserole. Mix and pour into baking dish. Top with crackers and margarine. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Hamburgers
directions: Mix hamburger and salt.
Divide into 12 equal parts.
Flatten each between pieces of waxed paper until about 5 inches in diameter.
Leave each patty on paper.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Divide among 6 patties.
Top each with a patty and press edges together with a fork.
Broil on both sides until brown.
recipes.text: Stuffed Hamburgers. Mix hamburger and salt. Divide into 12 equal parts. Flatten each between pieces of waxed paper until about 5 inches in diameter. Leave each patty on paper. Combine remaining ingredients. Divide among 6 patties. Top each with a patty and press edges together with a fork. Broil on both sides until brown.

recipes.title: Crowd Pleaser Potatoes
ingredients: 10 oz. can cream of chicken soup
1/2 lb. grated Cheddar cheese (2 c., reserve 1/2 c.)
directions: Boil potatoes with bay leaf, not too soft.
Cool.
Peel and grate (on coarse grater).
Add butter to soup, sour cream, Cheddar cheese and green onions.
Add salt and pepper to sauce and mix.
recipes.text: Crowd Pleaser Potatoes. Boil potatoes with bay leaf, not too soft. Cool. Peel and grate (on coarse grater). Add butter to soup, sour cream, Cheddar cheese and green onions. Add salt and pepper to sauce and mix.

recipes.title: Chicken Rub
directions: Mix. Store airtight. Makes 1/3 cup of mix. Use 1 tablespoon of rub per pound of chicken. Great on grill or in the oven.
recipes.text: Chicken Rub. Mix. Store airtight. Makes 1/3 cup of mix. Use 1 tablespoon of rub per pound of chicken. Great on grill or in the oven.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Place in saucepan on low heat.
Bring to slight boil and baste meat.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Place in saucepan on low heat. Bring to slight boil and baste meat.

recipes.title: Marshmallows
directions: In medium saucepan combine granulated sugar, gelatin and salt. Stir in water; heat until sugar is dissolved, then bring just to boiling.
Remove from heat; cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Stir in vanilla.
Transfer to large mixer bowl.
Beat at high speed of electric mixer about 10 minutes or until mixture resembles thick marshmallow cream.
Pour into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool.
With kitchen shears dipped in hot water, cut in 1 1/4-inch squares.
Roll in powdered sugar.
Makes about 6 dozen pieces.
recipes.text: Marshmallows. In medium saucepan combine granulated sugar, gelatin and salt. Stir in water; heat until sugar is dissolved, then bring just to boiling. Remove from heat; cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Stir in vanilla. Transfer to large mixer bowl. Beat at high speed of electric mixer about 10 minutes or until mixture resembles thick marshmallow cream. Pour into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool. With kitchen shears dipped in hot water, cut in 1 1/4-inch squares. Roll in powdered sugar. Makes about 6 dozen pieces.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients with shrimp added last.
Refrigerate overnight to blend flavors.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Mix all ingredients with shrimp added last. Refrigerate overnight to blend flavors. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Heat corn and milk; gradually add egg and seasonings. Add 1 1/4 cups cracker crumbs. Mix well and pour in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining crumbs and melted butter over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn. Heat corn and milk; gradually add egg and seasonings. Add 1 1/4 cups cracker crumbs. Mix well and pour in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining crumbs and melted butter over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Minestrone
directions: In Dutch oven, over medium heat, heat oil.
Add garlic, celery, carrots and onion; cook 10 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in broth, tomatoes and their liquids, water, oregano, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, breaking up tomatoes with spoon.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in beans and macaroni.
Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes longer.
Stir in spinach.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes longer. Serve sprinkled with cheese.
recipes.text: Easy Minestrone. In Dutch oven, over medium heat, heat oil. Add garlic, celery, carrots and onion; cook 10 minutes, stirring often. Stir in broth, tomatoes and their liquids, water, oregano, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, breaking up tomatoes with spoon. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in beans and macaroni. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes longer. Stir in spinach. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes longer. Serve sprinkled with cheese.

recipes.title: Cookies
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl.
Melt almond bark coating in top of double boiler.
Pour over mixture and toss until well coated.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper to cool.
recipes.text: Cookies. Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Melt almond bark coating in top of double boiler. Pour over mixture and toss until well coated. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper to cool.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually.
Cream well; add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition.
Add milk and flour.
Sift with salt and soda, measuring flour after sifting.
Grease and flour tube pan.
Pour well-beaten batter into pan.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until done (toothpick comes out clean).
Cake keeps moist for several days.
Yield:
20 to 30 servings.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pound Cake. Cream butter; add sugar gradually. Cream well; add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition. Add milk and flour. Sift with salt and soda, measuring flour after sifting. Grease and flour tube pan. Pour well-beaten batter into pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until done (toothpick comes out clean). Cake keeps moist for several days. Yield: 20 to 30 servings.

recipes.title: Night Before French Toast
directions: Grease or spray Pam on a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cut bread 1-inch thick and arrange in pan in single layer.
Beat eggs and then rest of ingredients except margarine.
Pour over bread.
Dot margarine on bread.
Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350u00b0, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes or until puffy brown and knife inserted comes out clean.
recipes.text: Night Before French Toast. Grease or spray Pam on a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut bread 1-inch thick and arrange in pan in single layer. Beat eggs and then rest of ingredients except margarine. Pour over bread. Dot margarine on bread. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350u00b0, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes or until puffy brown and knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
In large bowl stir together all ingredients except butter, pumpkin, buttermilk and eggs.
In medium bowl, stir together remaining ingredients.
Add to flour mixture.
Stir until moistened.
Spoon batter into greased 12-cup muffin pan.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Let stand 5 minutes.
Remove from pan. Yield:
1 dozen.
recipes.text: Spiced Pumpkin Muffins. Heat oven to 400u00b0. In large bowl stir together all ingredients except butter, pumpkin, buttermilk and eggs. In medium bowl, stir together remaining ingredients. Add to flour mixture. Stir until moistened. Spoon batter into greased 12-cup muffin pan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned. Let stand 5 minutes. Remove from pan. Yield: 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Butter Balls
directions: Mix sugar, flour and butter together until mix resembles pie dough.
Add vanilla and nuts; mix.
Roll into small balls.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
Roll in powdered sugar while warm.
recipes.text: Butter Balls. Mix sugar, flour and butter together until mix resembles pie dough. Add vanilla and nuts; mix. Roll into small balls. Bake at 275u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
2 cans (5 oz. each) Swanson chunk white chicken, undrained
directions: In 2-quart saucepan, combine soup, water and cheese.
Over low heat, heat until cheese is melted, stirring occasionally.
Add spaghetti, chicken, pepper and parsley.
Heat through, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Chicken Tetrazzini. In 2-quart saucepan, combine soup, water and cheese. Over low heat, heat until cheese is melted, stirring occasionally. Add spaghetti, chicken, pepper and parsley. Heat through, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: John'S School Wheaties Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add eggs, vanilla, flour, coconut, Wheaties and leavening agents.
Make walnut-size balls. Roll in sugar.
Bake at 350u00b0
for 6 minutes, or golden brown on a greased pan.
recipes.text: John'S School Wheaties Cookies. Cream shortening and sugars. Add eggs, vanilla, flour, coconut, Wheaties and leavening agents. Make walnut-size balls. Roll in sugar. Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 minutes, or golden brown on a greased pan.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake(Club Member: Ben Steadman)
directions: Cream butter, cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour 4 times and add gradually. Mix well with vanilla and lemon flavoring. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350u00b0. Check and leave longer if needed.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake(Club Member: Ben Steadman). Cream butter, cream cheese and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour 4 times and add gradually. Mix well with vanilla and lemon flavoring. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350u00b0. Check and leave longer if needed.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Ham Soup
ingredients: 1 garlic bulb or 1/2 depending on your taste
8 hot green or hot red peppers, must be the hot peppers
pinch of nutmeg & pinch of cardamom (optional)
directions: Clean the pumpkin; remove seeds.
Cut the pumpkin into small pieces.
Saute the onions and garlic in the peanut oil, add to the 8 quarts of chicken stock; add the pumpkin, hot diced peppers and ham.
When the pumpkin is tender, mash or puree.
Simmer slowly for 30 minutes more.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Ham Soup. Clean the pumpkin; remove seeds. Cut the pumpkin into small pieces. Saute the onions and garlic in the peanut oil, add to the 8 quarts of chicken stock; add the pumpkin, hot diced peppers and ham. When the pumpkin is tender, mash or puree. Simmer slowly for 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip
directions: Melt cheeses.
Add all ingredients to hot melted cheeses except tomato.
You will need to stir often.
Add tomato and serve hot with chips.
This can be refrigerated for later use.
Then reheat and enjoy.
recipes.text: Cheese Dip. Melt cheeses. Add all ingredients to hot melted cheeses except tomato. You will need to stir often. Add tomato and serve hot with chips. This can be refrigerated for later use. Then reheat and enjoy.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix butter and shortening, then add sugar, egg, flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt.
Add vanilla.
Roll into 1-inch balls; flatten with glass bottom dipped in sugar.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Mix butter and shortening, then add sugar, egg, flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt. Add vanilla. Roll into 1-inch balls; flatten with glass bottom dipped in sugar. Bake at 400u00b0 for 6 to 8 minutes.

recipes.title: John'S Mix-Up
directions: Spread slice of bread with peanut butter.
Slice dill pickle lengthwise; place on peanut butter.
Spread mayonnaise on other slice of bread.
Put slices together and enjoy.
recipes.text: John'S Mix-Up. Spread slice of bread with peanut butter. Slice dill pickle lengthwise; place on peanut butter. Spread mayonnaise on other slice of bread. Put slices together and enjoy.

recipes.title: Creamy Banana Pudding
directions: Combine Eagle Brand milk and milk.
Add pudding mix and beat well.
Chill 5 minutes.
Fold in cream.
Layer pudding, wafers and bananas.
recipes.text: Creamy Banana Pudding. Combine Eagle Brand milk and milk. Add pudding mix and beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in cream. Layer pudding, wafers and bananas.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake according to box in 2 (8-inch) pans.
Mix jello with boiling water, then add frozen berries and cold water.
Stir until mixture thickens.
Make pudding as directed on box.
Split cakes in half.
recipes.text: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake. Bake cake according to box in 2 (8-inch) pans. Mix jello with boiling water, then add frozen berries and cold water. Stir until mixture thickens. Make pudding as directed on box. Split cakes in half.

recipes.title: Great Grandma'S Divinity
directions: Heat sugar, water, syrup and salt. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cook without stirring until mixture reaches hard-ball stage.
recipes.text: Great Grandma'S Divinity. Heat sugar, water, syrup and salt. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Cook without stirring until mixture reaches hard-ball stage.

recipes.title: Yogurt Pie
