directions: Mix yogurt and Cool Whip together.
Fold in pie crust. Refrigerator for 4 hours.
recipes.text: Yogurt Pie. Mix yogurt and Cool Whip together. Fold in pie crust. Refrigerator for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Fried Apple Pies
directions: In large Dutch oven, place frozen apples over low heat. Stir in
1 cup sugar and simmer until done.
Sprinkle cinnamon (use more, if desired) across cooked apples.
Allow to cool to room temperature
so it won't melt the dough while frying.
In large mixing
bowl,
pour
in sifted flour.
Cut in shortening and blend in
milk
to
form dough.
Pinch off golf ball size dough.
Roll on
floured
surface and spoon in cooled apples. Fold and seal. In large electric skillet with hot oil, put in pies.
Brown evenly on both sides.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Fried Apple Pies. In large Dutch oven, place frozen apples over low heat. Stir in 1 cup sugar and simmer until done. Sprinkle cinnamon (use more, if desired) across cooked apples. Allow to cool to room temperature so it won't melt the dough while frying. In large mixing bowl, pour in sifted flour. Cut in shortening and blend in milk to form dough. Pinch off golf ball size dough. Roll on floured surface and spoon in cooled apples. Fold and seal. In large electric skillet with hot oil, put in pies. Brown evenly on both sides.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Combine ingredients and bake for 1 hour or until center is done.
Bake at 350u00b0.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Combine ingredients and bake for 1 hour or until center is done. Bake at 350u00b0. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Loafs
ingredients: 1 pkg yellow cake mix with pudding
directions: Beat first 5 ingredients on high speed for 3 minutes.
Pour half of batter evenly in two loaf pans or 1 Bundt pan.
In small bowl, sir together sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle half of mixture over batter. Pour remaining batter in pans and sprinkle with remaining sugar mixture.
Gently swirl with knife.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tests done.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Loafs. Beat first 5 ingredients on high speed for 3 minutes. Pour half of batter evenly in two loaf pans or 1 Bundt pan. In small bowl, sir together sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle half of mixture over batter. Pour remaining batter in pans and sprinkle with remaining sugar mixture. Gently swirl with knife. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until tests done.

recipes.title: Portuguese Biscuits
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add vanilla.
Add eggs, one at a time, then milk.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt; add slowly to creamed butter mixture.
Mix well; put on board and knead well. Break in pieces and roll in a ring.
Bake on a cookie sheet in a 350u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Portuguese Biscuits. Cream butter and sugar; add vanilla. Add eggs, one at a time, then milk. Sift flour, baking powder and salt; add slowly to creamed butter mixture. Mix well; put on board and knead well. Break in pieces and roll in a ring. Bake on a cookie sheet in a 350u00b0 oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Asparagus And Green Pea Casserole
directions: Combine mushroom soup with peas in casserole dish.
Layer asparagus on top of peas and soup.
Cover with cheese slices. Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake for 30 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Asparagus And Green Pea Casserole. Combine mushroom soup with peas in casserole dish. Layer asparagus on top of peas and soup. Cover with cheese slices. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joe Pocket Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped celery or green pepper
directions: Combine beef, onion and celery in a large skillet.
Cook until meat is browned. Drain off grease.
Add next 8 ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cut pocket bread in half.
Fill each half with 1/3 cup of the meat mixture.
Yields about 8 sandwiches.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joe Pocket Sandwiches. Combine beef, onion and celery in a large skillet. Cook until meat is browned. Drain off grease. Add next 8 ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cut pocket bread in half. Fill each half with 1/3 cup of the meat mixture. Yields about 8 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Aunt Ruby'S Chicken-Asparagus Casserole
directions: Place asparagus in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish.
Slice eggs over asparagus.
Cover with chicken, cut in chunks.
Mix soup, cheese, mayonnaise and lemon juice together.
Spread soup mix over eggs and asparagus.
Crumble crackers and mix crumbs with margarine.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Shake paprika on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Aunt Ruby'S Chicken-Asparagus Casserole. Place asparagus in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish. Slice eggs over asparagus. Cover with chicken, cut in chunks. Mix soup, cheese, mayonnaise and lemon juice together. Spread soup mix over eggs and asparagus. Crumble crackers and mix crumbs with margarine. Sprinkle over casserole. Shake paprika on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Leta'S Cream Cheese Loaf
directions: Mix cake mix, margarine, 1 egg and nuts very well.
Pat in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Leta'S Cream Cheese Loaf. Mix cake mix, margarine, 1 egg and nuts very well. Pat in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Jello Plum Pudding
directions: Dissolve lemon jello in boiling water and while still hot, stir in Grape-Nuts, raisins, walnuts, prunes and citron (all cut fine).
Also add cinnamon and cloves.
Salt to taste.
Mix and let harden in mold.
Turn out on large plate and garnish with holly. Serve with whipped cream or pudding sauce.
recipes.text: Jello Plum Pudding. Dissolve lemon jello in boiling water and while still hot, stir in Grape-Nuts, raisins, walnuts, prunes and citron (all cut fine). Also add cinnamon and cloves. Salt to taste. Mix and let harden in mold. Turn out on large plate and garnish with holly. Serve with whipped cream or pudding sauce.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
directions: Cook zucchini and onions in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; drain.
Mix soup and sour cream.
Stir in carrots; fold in zucchini and onions.
Combine stuffing mix and oleo.
Spread half stuffing mixture in a lightly buttered 12 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish.
Spoon vegetable mixture over stuffing.
Sprinkle remaining stuffing mixture over vegetables.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Cook zucchini and onions in boiling salted water for 5 minutes; drain. Mix soup and sour cream. Stir in carrots; fold in zucchini and onions. Combine stuffing mix and oleo. Spread half stuffing mixture in a lightly buttered 12 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture over stuffing. Sprinkle remaining stuffing mixture over vegetables. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 c. each: broccoli, red and green pepper, celery, carrots and cauliflower
directions: Flatten out crescent rolls on large baking sheet.
Bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
Let cool.
Mix cream cheese, mayo and Italian dressing; mix together and spread on cooled crust.
Chop veggies and spread over cheese mixture.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Put under broiler until cheese melts.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Veggie Pizza. Flatten out crescent rolls on large baking sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0. Let cool. Mix cream cheese, mayo and Italian dressing; mix together and spread on cooled crust. Chop veggies and spread over cheese mixture. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Put under broiler until cheese melts. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Boil eggplants, drain, mash and mix with the 2 well beaten eggs.
Add chopped onion, soup, salt and pepper.
Layer all ingredients with cracker crumbs and grated cheese.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Boil eggplants, drain, mash and mix with the 2 well beaten eggs. Add chopped onion, soup, salt and pepper. Layer all ingredients with cracker crumbs and grated cheese.

recipes.title: Persimmon Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add egg and pulp.
Sift all dry ingredients together and add to mixture.
Add raisins and nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Persimmon Cookies. Cream sugar and shortening. Add egg and pulp. Sift all dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Add raisins and nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
directions: In large skillet fry bacon until crisp.
Remove from pan. Saute onion in 3 tablespoons bacon grease.
Add green pepper and hamburg.
Cook until nearly done.
Add tomatoes and simmer until well done.
Add crumbled bacon.
Combine with rice.
Spoon into Pam sprayed casserole.
Bake at 300u00b0 for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.
Serves about 8.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. In large skillet fry bacon until crisp. Remove from pan. Saute onion in 3 tablespoons bacon grease. Add green pepper and hamburg. Cook until nearly done. Add tomatoes and simmer until well done. Add crumbled bacon. Combine with rice. Spoon into Pam sprayed casserole. Bake at 300u00b0 for 1/2 to 3/4 hour. Serves about 8.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Melt over hot water 1/2 cup peanut butter morsels.
Stir until smooth; set aside.
In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt; set aside.
In large bowl, combine butter and sugar.
Beat until creamy.
Blend in melted morsels.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Alternately blend in flour and milk.
Pour into 2 greased and floured pans.
Bake until crust is golden, 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool and frost.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Melt over hot water 1/2 cup peanut butter morsels. Stir until smooth; set aside. In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt; set aside. In large bowl, combine butter and sugar. Beat until creamy. Blend in melted morsels. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Alternately blend in flour and milk. Pour into 2 greased and floured pans. Bake until crust is golden, 35 to 40 minutes. Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Pumpkin-Cheese Cake Pie
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients; spread on unbaked pie shell.
recipes.text: Pumpkin-Cheese Cake Pie. Mix the first 4 ingredients; spread on unbaked pie shell.

recipes.title: Galumpki-Bobchi'S Recipe
ingredients: 2 c. rice, cooked with 4 1/2 c. water
directions: Kill the cabbage.
That is, cut out the core; put it in a large pot.
Cover with water and boil it just until the leaves are tender enough to peel off, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the rice with the water until absorbed.
Mix egg and spice in a big bowl. Add the meat and rice and mix it all together.
Take a fistful or a big spoonful of the rice mixture.
Put one on each cabbage leaf and fold the leaves over.
Place them, folded side down, in a deep baking pan.
Mix puree with some spices and pour it over.
Bake uncovered at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes, then cover and bake 30 minutes more.
If you wish, you can use green peppers instead of cabbage.
Stuff the peppers with the meat mix and cook the same.
recipes.text: Galumpki-Bobchi'S Recipe. Kill the cabbage. That is, cut out the core; put it in a large pot. Cover with water and boil it just until the leaves are tender enough to peel off, about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the rice with the water until absorbed. Mix egg and spice in a big bowl. Add the meat and rice and mix it all together. Take a fistful or a big spoonful of the rice mixture. Put one on each cabbage leaf and fold the leaves over. Place them, folded side down, in a deep baking pan. Mix puree with some spices and pour it over. Bake uncovered at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes, then cover and bake 30 minutes more. If you wish, you can use green peppers instead of cabbage. Stuff the peppers with the meat mix and cook the same.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Put chicken in baking dish.
Mix in bowl the dressing, preserves, water and onion soup mix.
Pour over chicken and cover with foil.
Cook 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Chicken. Put chicken in baking dish. Mix in bowl the dressing, preserves, water and onion soup mix. Pour over chicken and cover with foil. Cook 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Jean Blanc'S Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Combine ingredients.
Cook over moderate heat, stirring until blended.
Add milk and bring to a boil stirring constantly until thickened.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
Put over ice cream or pound cake, etc.
recipes.text: Jean Blanc'S Hot Fudge Sauce. Combine ingredients. Cook over moderate heat, stirring until blended. Add milk and bring to a boil stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Put over ice cream or pound cake, etc.

recipes.title: Angel Sponge Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 pt. whipped cream or 1 box Dream Whip
directions: Cook milk, sugar and eggs in double boiler for 15 minutes. Set aside.
Dissolve gelatine in water.
Stir gelatine mixture into custard while still hot.
Cool thoroughly.
Add pineapple. Fold in whipped topping.
Crumble angel food in bottom of flat dish and pour custard mixture on top.
Chill 5 to 8 hours.
recipes.text: Angel Sponge Pudding. Cook milk, sugar and eggs in double boiler for 15 minutes. Set aside. Dissolve gelatine in water. Stir gelatine mixture into custard while still hot. Cool thoroughly. Add pineapple. Fold in whipped topping. Crumble angel food in bottom of flat dish and pour custard mixture on top. Chill 5 to 8 hours.

recipes.title: Brian'S Gunsmoken Club Turkey
ingredients: 1 lb. smoke turkey lunch meat shredded/or cuts from a turkey breast
directions: Toast two pieces of wheat bread in toaster to your fixen. Spray some pam on your frying pan and turn on low to medium heat. Place turkey bacon in pan and fry until crisp.
Place shredded turkey on one piece of toast to your fixen.
Put three slices onion on turkey, 1 slice tomato on onions, 3 pieces sliced roman lettuce on top of tomato.
Add plenty of honey mustard on the other piece of toast to your fixen and place 2-3 slices of turkey bacon on top of your goodies then smash you piece of toast loaded with honey mustard on top.
Cut with a knife like a triangle.
What a Sandwich!
Consume and make another one.
recipes.text: Brian'S Gunsmoken Club Turkey. Toast two pieces of wheat bread in toaster to your fixen. Spray some pam on your frying pan and turn on low to medium heat. Place turkey bacon in pan and fry until crisp. Place shredded turkey on one piece of toast to your fixen. Put three slices onion on turkey, 1 slice tomato on onions, 3 pieces sliced roman lettuce on top of tomato. Add plenty of honey mustard on the other piece of toast to your fixen and place 2-3 slices of turkey bacon on top of your goodies then smash you piece of toast loaded with honey mustard on top. Cut with a knife like a triangle. What a Sandwich! Consume and make another one.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Jazz
directions: Mix the ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased baking pan. Sprinkle on top one box yellow cake mix.
Dribble 1 1/2 sticks melted margarine on top of cake mix.
Top with 3/4 cup chopped nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Serve with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Jazz. Mix the ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased baking pan. Sprinkle on top one box yellow cake mix. Dribble 1 1/2 sticks melted margarine on top of cake mix. Top with 3/4 cup chopped nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Serve with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Mix cake mix as directed.
Oil pan; sprinkle coconut on bottom of pan and nuts.
Pour cake batter on top of this.
Melt cream cheese, margarine and sugar together on top of stove.
Stir constantly until dissolved together and pour this on top of cake batter.
Bake for 30 or 35 minutes or until done at 350u00b0.
Makes 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan or 2 (9-inch) layers.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cake. Mix cake mix as directed. Oil pan; sprinkle coconut on bottom of pan and nuts. Pour cake batter on top of this. Melt cream cheese, margarine and sugar together on top of stove. Stir constantly until dissolved together and pour this on top of cake batter. Bake for 30 or 35 minutes or until done at 350u00b0. Makes 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan or 2 (9-inch) layers.

recipes.title: Vegetable Meat Loaf
directions: Mix and form loaf.
Push away from sides of pan or casserole dish.
Pour tomato catsup or tomato juice around or on top of loaf.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Vegetable Meat Loaf. Mix and form loaf. Push away from sides of pan or casserole dish. Pour tomato catsup or tomato juice around or on top of loaf. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Walking Taco Dip-Layered
directions: Spread on 12-inch round plate.
recipes.text: Walking Taco Dip-Layered. Spread on 12-inch round plate.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream oleo; add sugar and eggs, mixing well.
Add dry ingredients alternately with bananas.
Stir in nuts.
Bake in greased loaf pan or tube cake pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream oleo; add sugar and eggs, mixing well. Add dry ingredients alternately with bananas. Stir in nuts. Bake in greased loaf pan or tube cake pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Coconut Crisps
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines Deluxe Yellow Cake Mix
1/2 c. Crisco oil or Puritan oil
Chocolate jimmies, unblanched almond, or red maraschino cherry (if desired for garnish)
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Coconut Crisps. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Crawfish Bread
directions: Slice French bread in half.
In pan, melt margarine, add onion, bell pepper, garlic, saute a few minutes, then add crawfish, parsley and seasoned salt.
Saute for about 10 minutes. Add cheese, stir until cheese is melted.
Spread on French bread. Bake in 400u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes.
Cut into pieces and enjoy.
Shrimp may be substituted for crawfish.
recipes.text: Crawfish Bread. Slice French bread in half. In pan, melt margarine, add onion, bell pepper, garlic, saute a few minutes, then add crawfish, parsley and seasoned salt. Saute for about 10 minutes. Add cheese, stir until cheese is melted. Spread on French bread. Bake in 400u00b0 oven for about 15 minutes. Cut into pieces and enjoy. Shrimp may be substituted for crawfish.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. medium-sized shrimp, cleaned and deveined
1 (28 oz.) can plum tomatoes in puree, broken up
1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and cut in thin strips
directions: Combine lime juice, garlic and shrimp in large bowl. Refrigerate, covered, for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion, oregano, thyme and bay leaf; saute until onion is softened.
Add tomatoes and jalapeno pepper and salt.
Simmer until thickened, about 20 minutes.
Add shrimp.
Cook, covered, about 5 minutes, until shrimp are pink and curled.
Stir in parsley.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Spicy Shrimp. Combine lime juice, garlic and shrimp in large bowl. Refrigerate, covered, for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add onion, oregano, thyme and bay leaf; saute until onion is softened. Add tomatoes and jalapeno pepper and salt. Simmer until thickened, about 20 minutes. Add shrimp. Cook, covered, about 5 minutes, until shrimp are pink and curled. Stir in parsley. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Carrot Bread
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake 1 hour at 375u00b0.
Makes 1 large loaf or 2 small loaves.
recipes.text: Carrot Bread. Mix the first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Bake 1 hour at 375u00b0. Makes 1 large loaf or 2 small loaves.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and Wesson oil.
Add flour and spices; add buttermilk, nuts and prunes.
Last mix well.
Cook in stem pan 60 minutes at 350u00b0 or until done.
recipes.text: Prune Cake. Beat eggs, sugar and Wesson oil. Add flour and spices; add buttermilk, nuts and prunes. Last mix well. Cook in stem pan 60 minutes at 350u00b0 or until done.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Melt margarine.
Mix ingredients well and pour into an unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350u00b0 until done.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Melt margarine. Mix ingredients well and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 until done.

recipes.title: Spicy Pecans
directions: Beat 1 egg until frothy and 1 tablespoon water.
Melt butter in pan; stir a lot.
Add sugar, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves. Put pecans in 1 egg white and coat well, then put them into sugar and spices; cover well.
Place in pan with butter and bake at 250u00b0 until done.
recipes.text: Spicy Pecans. Beat 1 egg until frothy and 1 tablespoon water. Melt butter in pan; stir a lot. Add sugar, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves. Put pecans in 1 egg white and coat well, then put them into sugar and spices; cover well. Place in pan with butter and bake at 250u00b0 until done.

recipes.title: Rodes Punch
directions: Combine Kool-Aid packages with sugar.
Add pineapple juice and water to fill up a 1-gallon container.
Place in freezer overnight.
Remove from freezer 1 hour before serving and let mixture become slushy.
Pour into punch bowl and add chilled ginger ale and 7-Up.
recipes.text: Rodes Punch. Combine Kool-Aid packages with sugar. Add pineapple juice and water to fill up a 1-gallon container. Place in freezer overnight. Remove from freezer 1 hour before serving and let mixture become slushy. Pour into punch bowl and add chilled ginger ale and 7-Up.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs well.
Add Karo syrup, sugar, butter, salt and vanilla.
Place nuts on bottom of crust.
Pour mixture over nuts. Bake at 425u00b0 for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350u00b0 and bake until knife inserted into the center of pie comes out clean, about 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Beat eggs well. Add Karo syrup, sugar, butter, salt and vanilla. Place nuts on bottom of crust. Pour mixture over nuts. Bake at 425u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350u00b0 and bake until knife inserted into the center of pie comes out clean, about 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Manicotti
directions: Cook manicotti shells according to package directions, omitting salt.
Drain and set aside.
Combine the next 8 ingredients.
Cover and cook sauce over low heat for 1 hour.
Cook spinach according to package directions, omitting salt.
Drain; place on paper towels and squeeze until barely moist.
Combine spinach, cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese and nutmeg.
Stuff manicotti shells with spinach mixture; arrange in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish sprayed with cooking spray.
Pour tomato sauce over manicotti.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Spinach Manicotti. Cook manicotti shells according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain and set aside. Combine the next 8 ingredients. Cover and cook sauce over low heat for 1 hour. Cook spinach according to package directions, omitting salt. Drain; place on paper towels and squeeze until barely moist. Combine spinach, cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese and nutmeg. Stuff manicotti shells with spinach mixture; arrange in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish sprayed with cooking spray. Pour tomato sauce over manicotti. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Mexican corn with red pepper
directions: Brown hamburger and onion; drain.
Add other ingredients and put into casserole dish.
Mix Jiffy as directed on box.
Put on top and bake until corn mix is done at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Add other ingredients and put into casserole dish. Mix Jiffy as directed on box. Put on top and bake until corn mix is done at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Make into 1-inch balls.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Hors D'Oeuvres. Make into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Ocean Garden Spaghetti
directions: Drain tuna.
Lightly saute onion, garlic, broccoli, mushrooms and oregano in oil and butter.
Add zucchini and tomatoes until tender-crisp; break up tuna and add to vegetables.
Stir in sour cream to make sauce.
Toss with spaghetti and Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Ocean Garden Spaghetti. Drain tuna. Lightly saute onion, garlic, broccoli, mushrooms and oregano in oil and butter. Add zucchini and tomatoes until tender-crisp; break up tuna and add to vegetables. Stir in sour cream to make sauce. Toss with spaghetti and Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: My Favorite Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Whip crushed bananas until very light. Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and mix, then flour and soda and mix very well.
Add nuts and mix, then bananas.
Turn this mixture into a very well-greased bread pan (glass works better) and bake for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: My Favorite Banana Bread. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Whip crushed bananas until very light. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and mix, then flour and soda and mix very well. Add nuts and mix, then bananas. Turn this mixture into a very well-greased bread pan (glass works better) and bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Kidney Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 regular size cans red kidney beans
directions: In heavy skillet, brown hamburger with garlic and bell pepper; drain off all fat.
Add cheese (reserve 1/2 cup), tomato sauce and brown sugar.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Add kidney beans, drained. Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole; sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Kidney Bean Casserole. In heavy skillet, brown hamburger with garlic and bell pepper; drain off all fat. Add cheese (reserve 1/2 cup), tomato sauce and brown sugar. Simmer 10 minutes. Add kidney beans, drained. Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole; sprinkle with 1/2 cup cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Goody Bars
directions: Mix margarine, German chocolate cake mix and one egg and press into a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Sprinkle with coconut and nuts.
Mix confectioners sugar, 2 eggs and cream cheese and pour over the pressed mixture.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes, until lightly browned.
Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Goody Bars. Mix margarine, German chocolate cake mix and one egg and press into a 9 x 13-inch dish. Sprinkle with coconut and nuts. Mix confectioners sugar, 2 eggs and cream cheese and pour over the pressed mixture. Bake at 325u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes, until lightly browned. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cream Cheese Muffins
directions: Put 2 eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin in mixing bowl.
Beat.
Mix dry ingredients separately and mix.
Add pumpkin mixture all at once and mix only until just moistened.
Divide among 24 muffin cups and keep remainder for top.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cream Cheese Muffins. Put 2 eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin in mixing bowl. Beat. Mix dry ingredients separately and mix. Add pumpkin mixture all at once and mix only until just moistened. Divide among 24 muffin cups and keep remainder for top.

recipes.title: Pimento And Cheese Sauce
directions: Cook the milk, dressing and sugar over low heat until sugar is melted and creamy.
Add the cubed cheese and stir constantly (will stick easy on low heat) until melted and creamy.
Add the pimentos and heat 1 more minute.
Very good while hot as dip for Townhouse crackers.
If too sweet, cut sugar.
Refrigerate overnight and make a delicious sandwich.
recipes.text: Pimento And Cheese Sauce. Cook the milk, dressing and sugar over low heat until sugar is melted and creamy. Add the cubed cheese and stir constantly (will stick easy on low heat) until melted and creamy. Add the pimentos and heat 1 more minute. Very good while hot as dip for Townhouse crackers. If too sweet, cut sugar. Refrigerate overnight and make a delicious sandwich.

recipes.title: No Bake Date Balls
directions: Combine dates, salt, sugar, egg and butter in saucepan.
Mix well.
Cook 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in cereal, walnuts and vanilla.
Roll into balls (butter hands first).
Roll in powdered sugar, if desired.
recipes.text: No Bake Date Balls. Combine dates, salt, sugar, egg and butter in saucepan. Mix well. Cook 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in cereal, walnuts and vanilla. Roll into balls (butter hands first). Roll in powdered sugar, if desired.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Spice Cookies
directions: Mix oil and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.
In separate bowl, mix flour, soda, salt, spices and baking powder. Add dry ingredients to sugar mix.
Add oats and pecans; mix well. Roll into balls.
Put on pan sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Spice Cookies. Mix oil and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. In separate bowl, mix flour, soda, salt, spices and baking powder. Add dry ingredients to sugar mix. Add oats and pecans; mix well. Roll into balls. Put on pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Unpotato Salad(Low Carb)
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into small chunks
directions: Put cauliflower in a microwave-safe casserole dish.
Add 1 Tbsp. water and cover.
Cook in microwave on high for 5 to 7 minutes and let stand, covered, another 3 to 5 minutes.
You want the cauliflower tender, but not mushy.
Drain cooked cauliflower and combine with celery and onion in a large bowl.
Combine mayonnaise, vinegar, salt, Splenda and pepper.
Pour mixture over vegetables and mix well.
Mix in chopped eggs last; only stir lightly to preserve some small chunks of yolk.
Chill and serve. Serves 12.
recipes.text: Unpotato Salad(Low Carb). Put cauliflower in a microwave-safe casserole dish. Add 1 Tbsp. water and cover. Cook in microwave on high for 5 to 7 minutes and let stand, covered, another 3 to 5 minutes. You want the cauliflower tender, but not mushy. Drain cooked cauliflower and combine with celery and onion in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise, vinegar, salt, Splenda and pepper. Pour mixture over vegetables and mix well. Mix in chopped eggs last; only stir lightly to preserve some small chunks of yolk. Chill and serve. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Spring Salad
directions: Cook noodles until tender; drain.
Add celery, onion and dressing.
Salt and pepper to your own taste.
You can add sweet peppers or boiled eggs if you like.
recipes.text: Spring Salad. Cook noodles until tender; drain. Add celery, onion and dressing. Salt and pepper to your own taste. You can add sweet peppers or boiled eggs if you like.

recipes.title: Spice Tea
directions: Let all ingredients come to a boil.
Simmer 10 to 15 minutes; remove cloves.
recipes.text: Spice Tea. Let all ingredients come to a boil. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes; remove cloves.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, cook onion and ginger in butter until soft. Add chicken broth, water, garlic and squash. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
Puree in blender. Add lime juice, salt and pepper. Reheat over low heat.
recipes.text: Butternut Squash Soup. In a large saucepan, cook onion and ginger in butter until soft. Add chicken broth, water, garlic and squash. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Puree in blender. Add lime juice, salt and pepper. Reheat over low heat.

recipes.title: Deviled Crabs
directions: Mix together well.
Place in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.
recipes.text: Deviled Crabs. Mix together well. Place in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Add mashed bananas to butter and sugar. Add eggs and salt. Add soda to sour milk. Vinegar can be added to milk to make it sour, 2 to 3 teaspoons.
Add flour. Nuts may be added, if desired. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
Makes 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Add mashed bananas to butter and sugar. Add eggs and salt. Add soda to sour milk. Vinegar can be added to milk to make it sour, 2 to 3 teaspoons. Add flour. Nuts may be added, if desired. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Toffee Squares
directions: In saucepan, melt margarine over low heat.
Take off heat. Mix sugar, then blend other ingredients in order.
Press in ungreased dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Toffee Squares. In saucepan, melt margarine over low heat. Take off heat. Mix sugar, then blend other ingredients in order. Press in ungreased dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Son-Of-A-Gun-Stew
ingredients: 1 c. all-purpose flour, seasoned with salt, pepper and thyme
6 medium Russet potatoes, cut in 1-inch cubes
directions: Dredge beef in seasoned flour until well coated. In Dutch oven, brown beef in bacon fat. Cover with water and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Add carrots; simmer 30 minutes longer. Add cabbage and cook 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Top stew with cornmeal dumpling if desired.
recipes.text: Son-Of-A-Gun-Stew. Dredge beef in seasoned flour until well coated. In Dutch oven, brown beef in bacon fat. Cover with water and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Add carrots; simmer 30 minutes longer. Add cabbage and cook 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Top stew with cornmeal dumpling if desired.

recipes.title: Soft Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttermilk mixed with 1/2 tsp. baking soda
directions: Cream together the softened margarine, sugar and vanilla.
Add beaten egg and mix well!
In another bowl mix together 1 1/4 cups flour, baking powder and salt.
Add these dry ingredients alternately with the buttermilk mixed with baking soda.
Mix well! Add another 1 1/2 cups flour to make a soft dough.
Chill overnight, covered.
Roll 1/4 inch thick on floured surface.
Cut and sugar.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 minutes.
Store covered to stay soft.
recipes.text: Soft Sugar Cookies. Cream together the softened margarine, sugar and vanilla. Add beaten egg and mix well! In another bowl mix together 1 1/4 cups flour, baking powder and salt. Add these dry ingredients alternately with the buttermilk mixed with baking soda. Mix well! Add another 1 1/2 cups flour to make a soft dough. Chill overnight, covered. Roll 1/4 inch thick on floured surface. Cut and sugar. Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 minutes. Store covered to stay soft.

recipes.title: Stakki Uppi Dinner
directions: *Chicken Gravy:
Gravy is very hot.
Use broth from chicken or Campbell's chicken broth (no milk) or Spice Island chicken base or Franco-American gravy or a combination.
recipes.text: Stakki Uppi Dinner. *Chicken Gravy: Gravy is very hot. Use broth from chicken or Campbell's chicken broth (no milk) or Spice Island chicken base or Franco-American gravy or a combination.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) jar salsa or 1 can chili without beans
directions: Cube and melt cheese in crock-pot or saucepan.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir as needed.
Serve hot with tortilla/taco chips.
recipes.text: Cheese Dip. Cube and melt cheese in crock-pot or saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Stir as needed. Serve hot with tortilla/taco chips.

recipes.title: Mexican Chef Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. Thousand Island or French dressing
directions: Toss lettuce with 8 ounces of Thousand Island or French dressing.
Brown hamburger and drain.
Add kidney beans and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Just before serving, add hamburger mixture to lettuce mixture and serve pronto.
recipes.text: Mexican Chef Salad. Toss lettuce with 8 ounces of Thousand Island or French dressing. Brown hamburger and drain. Add kidney beans and salt. Simmer for 10 minutes. Just before serving, add hamburger mixture to lettuce mixture and serve pronto.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 8 oz. low-fat light cream cheese, softened
directions: Cover chicken breasts with water and bring to a boil. Turn off heat and let set, covered, for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until done. Cut or shred into small pieces. Saute onion in oleo over medium heat until tender. Add green chilies and saute for 2 minutes. Add cream cheese and chicken. Put 1/2 cup chicken mixture in each tortilla and roll up. Place each tortilla seam side down in a greased or sprayed baking dish. Sprinkle cheese evenly over tortillas. Pour whipping cream over all. Bake, uncovered, in 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchiladas. Cover chicken breasts with water and bring to a boil. Turn off heat and let set, covered, for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, until done. Cut or shred into small pieces. Saute onion in oleo over medium heat until tender. Add green chilies and saute for 2 minutes. Add cream cheese and chicken. Put 1/2 cup chicken mixture in each tortilla and roll up. Place each tortilla seam side down in a greased or sprayed baking dish. Sprinkle cheese evenly over tortillas. Pour whipping cream over all. Bake, uncovered, in 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Bill'S Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time; beat well. Add flour 1/3 at a time, alternating with 1/3 of buttermilk.
Add vanilla.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Bill'S Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time; beat well. Add flour 1/3 at a time, alternating with 1/3 of buttermilk. Add vanilla. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients (first 5 listed).
Stir together eggs, oil, buttermilk and add to dry, mixing well.
Pour batter into greased muffin tins.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Raisin Bran Muffins. Mix dry ingredients (first 5 listed). Stir together eggs, oil, buttermilk and add to dry, mixing well. Pour batter into greased muffin tins. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Trout
directions: Fill a 9-inch bowl 1/4 way full with 1/2 mixture of flour and corn meal.
Add salt and pepper.
Roll trout in flour mixture and fry in a thin layer of butter.
Brown on both sides and serve.
recipes.text: Trout. Fill a 9-inch bowl 1/4 way full with 1/2 mixture of flour and corn meal. Add salt and pepper. Roll trout in flour mixture and fry in a thin layer of butter. Brown on both sides and serve.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies
directions: Mix together and marinate 24 hours.
recipes.text: Copper Pennies. Mix together and marinate 24 hours.

recipes.title: Ole' South Crab Cakes
directions: Remove crusts from bread slices.
Break into small pieces and moisten with milk.
Stir in all ingredients except cracker meal. Shape into cakes and roll in cracker meal.
Fry until golden brown. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Ole' South Crab Cakes. Remove crusts from bread slices. Break into small pieces and moisten with milk. Stir in all ingredients except cracker meal. Shape into cakes and roll in cracker meal. Fry until golden brown. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Homemade Granola
ingredients: 1 c. broken cashew nuts or almonds
directions: Combine all dry ingredients except dry fruit in a large mixing bowl.
Combine honey and oil in a large measuring cup.
Pour over ingredients, folding in with a large wooden spoon until well coated.
Pour into a
large roasting pan and bake at 250u00b0 about 1 hour, or until light brown in color, stirring occasionally.
Cool and store in glass jars with tight lid.
recipes.text: Homemade Granola. Combine all dry ingredients except dry fruit in a large mixing bowl. Combine honey and oil in a large measuring cup. Pour over ingredients, folding in with a large wooden spoon until well coated. Pour into a large roasting pan and bake at 250u00b0 about 1 hour, or until light brown in color, stirring occasionally. Cool and store in glass jars with tight lid.

recipes.title: Jello Pie
ingredients: 1 tall can Pet milk, chilled and whipped
1 pkg. lemon jello, dissolved in 1/2 c. boiling water
directions: Let jello cool, then put in graham cracker-lined pie pan.
recipes.text: Jello Pie. Let jello cool, then put in graham cracker-lined pie pan.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Early in day or day ahead, soften vanilla ice cream in refrigerator, about 40 minutes.
Finely chop 1/2 cup walnuts, reserving remaining 1/4 cup for garnish later.
In 9-inch spring-form pan, combine chopped nuts, graham cracker crumbs, 3 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons sugar.
With fingers, press mixture to bottom of pan.
Evenly spread vanilla ice cream on top of crust; freeze until firm, about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Early in day or day ahead, soften vanilla ice cream in refrigerator, about 40 minutes. Finely chop 1/2 cup walnuts, reserving remaining 1/4 cup for garnish later. In 9-inch spring-form pan, combine chopped nuts, graham cracker crumbs, 3 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons sugar. With fingers, press mixture to bottom of pan. Evenly spread vanilla ice cream on top of crust; freeze until firm, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies(Healthy Style)
ingredients: 1/2 c. raisins, soaked in hot water to cover 5 minutes
directions: Drain raisins. Blend dry ingredients. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop on oiled cookie sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 325u00b0. Yields 24 small cookies.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies(Healthy Style). Drain raisins. Blend dry ingredients. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop on oiled cookie sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 325u00b0. Yields 24 small cookies.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream together butter, margarine, cream cheese and sugar. Beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
Add salt and vanilla.
Add eggs, 1 at a time, and beat well after each addition.
Mix in flour.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Cream together butter, margarine, cream cheese and sugar. Beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla. Add eggs, 1 at a time, and beat well after each addition. Mix in flour.

recipes.title: Do Nothing Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients (except Topping) and mix by hand.
Do not use an electric mixer.
Pour into a greased 9 x 12-inch pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350u00b0.
Spread topping over cake while warm.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Do Nothing Cake. Combine all ingredients (except Topping) and mix by hand. Do not use an electric mixer. Pour into a greased 9 x 12-inch pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350u00b0. Spread topping over cake while warm. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Molasses Cake
directions: Mix well.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Molasses Cake. Mix well. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Jane'S Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook syrup, water and sugar to hard ball stage (250u00b0 to 265u00b0). Add peanuts and continue to cook, stirring occasionally until mixture is light brown in color (302u00b0).
Stir in butter, soda and salt.
Pour on greased cookie sheet while still foaming.
Cool slightly and stretch to desired thinness and break into pieces.
recipes.text: Jane'S Peanut Brittle. Cook syrup, water and sugar to hard ball stage (250u00b0 to 265u00b0). Add peanuts and continue to cook, stirring occasionally until mixture is light brown in color (302u00b0). Stir in butter, soda and salt. Pour on greased cookie sheet while still foaming. Cool slightly and stretch to desired thinness and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Amanda'S Karo Popcorn Mixture
directions: Prepare popcorn.
In 3-quart saucepan.
Mix Karo syrup, margarine, water, vinegar, confectioners sugar and cut-up marshmallows.
Stir over low heat until mixture starts to boil. Pour over popcorn.
Toss to coat.
recipes.text: Amanda'S Karo Popcorn Mixture. Prepare popcorn. In 3-quart saucepan. Mix Karo syrup, margarine, water, vinegar, confectioners sugar and cut-up marshmallows. Stir over low heat until mixture starts to boil. Pour over popcorn. Toss to coat.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Salad
directions: Beat butter, egg and powdered sugar.
Add the rest.
Chill.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Salad. Beat butter, egg and powdered sugar. Add the rest. Chill.

recipes.title: Throwed Hot Rolls
directions: Mix 1/2 cup warm water with yeast.
Mix eggs, salt, sugar and shortening with 2 cups warm water.
Add flour to mixture.
Let rise until it doubles in size in large bowl.
Work down.
Make into 3 balls the size of a jack or walnut.
Put into muffin pan and let rise.
Bake at 375u00b0 until brown.
To make sure it browns on both sides, use bottom rack.
recipes.text: Throwed Hot Rolls. Mix 1/2 cup warm water with yeast. Mix eggs, salt, sugar and shortening with 2 cups warm water. Add flour to mixture. Let rise until it doubles in size in large bowl. Work down. Make into 3 balls the size of a jack or walnut. Put into muffin pan and let rise. Bake at 375u00b0 until brown. To make sure it browns on both sides, use bottom rack.

recipes.title: Glazed Sesame Chicken
directions: Brush chicken with corn oil on all sides.
Mix flavor enhancer and salt.
Sprinkle on all sides.
Place on rack in broiler pan on lowest rack in broiler.
Broil 20 minutes, basting with oil twice. Turn and broil about 20 minutes on second side.
Spread marmalade on chicken.
Sprinkle with sesame seed.
Broil about 5 minutes, watching carefully. Turn; spread with marmalade, sprinkle with sesame seed.
Broil about 5 minutes longer or until fork can be inserted with ease.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Glazed Sesame Chicken. Brush chicken with corn oil on all sides. Mix flavor enhancer and salt. Sprinkle on all sides. Place on rack in broiler pan on lowest rack in broiler. Broil 20 minutes, basting with oil twice. Turn and broil about 20 minutes on second side. Spread marmalade on chicken. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Broil about 5 minutes, watching carefully. Turn; spread with marmalade, sprinkle with sesame seed. Broil about 5 minutes longer or until fork can be inserted with ease. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup plus 1/2 can milk
directions: Spray bottom of pan with Pam or I Can't Believe It's Not Butter.
Crumble raw hamburger in bottom of pan.
Add all the other ingredients, layer upon layer.
Put butter on top.
Bake in 10-inch square dish or pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Spray bottom of pan with Pam or I Can't Believe It's Not Butter. Crumble raw hamburger in bottom of pan. Add all the other ingredients, layer upon layer. Put butter on top. Bake in 10-inch square dish or pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apricot Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 Duncan Hines Lemon Supreme cake mix
directions: Mix ingredients with mixer.
Grease and flour tube pan.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apricot Pound Cake. Mix ingredients with mixer. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pineapple Carrot Cake
directions: Place oil, eggs and sugar in a large mixing bowl and beat well.
Stir in flour, soda and cinnamon into egg mixture until well blended.
Fold in vanilla, carrots, pineapple, coconut and nuts, blending well.
Pour batter into a well-greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.
Have the glaze ready to pour over the hot cake.
recipes.text: Pineapple Carrot Cake. Place oil, eggs and sugar in a large mixing bowl and beat well. Stir in flour, soda and cinnamon into egg mixture until well blended. Fold in vanilla, carrots, pineapple, coconut and nuts, blending well. Pour batter into a well-greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Have the glaze ready to pour over the hot cake.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Brown onion in 1/2 stick margarine in skillet.
In large mixing bowl, mix hash browns, cheese, soups, sour cream and salt. Add cooked onion.
Melt 1/2 stick margarine in skillet, then add corn flakes.
Put potato mixture in 3-quart oblong casserole. Sprinkle cornflakes on top and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Brown onion in 1/2 stick margarine in skillet. In large mixing bowl, mix hash browns, cheese, soups, sour cream and salt. Add cooked onion. Melt 1/2 stick margarine in skillet, then add corn flakes. Put potato mixture in 3-quart oblong casserole. Sprinkle cornflakes on top and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Green Bean Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Combine undiluted soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper in 1 1/2 quart casserole.
Stir in green beans and 1/2 can of onions.
Bake at 350 degrees 25 minutes or until hot.
Stir.
Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes more.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Classic Green Bean Bake. Combine undiluted soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper in 1 1/2 quart casserole. Stir in green beans and 1/2 can of onions. Bake at 350 degrees 25 minutes or until hot. Stir. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes more. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Picnic Slaw
directions: Grate cabbages and carrot; chop onions.
Mix in bowl.
Mix remaining ingredients in separate bowl and pour on salad. Refrigerate 1 hour.
recipes.text: Picnic Slaw. Grate cabbages and carrot; chop onions. Mix in bowl. Mix remaining ingredients in separate bowl and pour on salad. Refrigerate 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken
ingredients: chicken, cut into the smallest pieces possible
light or dark soy sauce (1 bottle)
directions: Season chicken with garlic powder and brown.
Place into pot and add the rest of the ingredients.
Then simmer for about 30 minutes.
Then put
your
rice
on
to
cook.
You
can make whatever vegetable you want to stir-fry.
recipes.text: Chinese Chicken. Season chicken with garlic powder and brown. Place into pot and add the rest of the ingredients. Then simmer for about 30 minutes. Then put your rice on to cook. You can make whatever vegetable you want to stir-fry.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 c. chopped walnuts (may use raisins or dates or both, if desired)
directions: Combine with the wet mixture and mix together well.
Pour into two large greased loaf pans. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
Remove from pans and place on wire rack to cool.
May be served warm or cold.
Stores well in freezer.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Combine with the wet mixture and mix together well. Pour into two large greased loaf pans. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from pans and place on wire rack to cool. May be served warm or cold. Stores well in freezer.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 c. buttermilk or enough to cover tomato slices
directions: Slice tomatoes into bowl and cover with buttermilk. Let stand about 5 minutes. Mix flour and salt. Take each tomato slice from milk and dredge in flour mixture. Place slices on wax paper and let stand until flour is moist. Pour enough oil in pan to cover bottom. Heat oil until ready for frying and place slices in pan. Cook until tomatoes are browned on each side. Drain and serve warm.
recipes.text: Fried Green Tomatoes. Slice tomatoes into bowl and cover with buttermilk. Let stand about 5 minutes. Mix flour and salt. Take each tomato slice from milk and dredge in flour mixture. Place slices on wax paper and let stand until flour is moist. Pour enough oil in pan to cover bottom. Heat oil until ready for frying and place slices in pan. Cook until tomatoes are browned on each side. Drain and serve warm.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Blend ingredients; pour into greased and floured loaf pans (2).
Bake in preheated 325u00b0 oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Blend ingredients; pour into greased and floured loaf pans (2). Bake in preheated 325u00b0 oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Easy Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in 1 tablespoon of the butter.
Place meat in
bottom
of
casserole.
Put
rice,
peas, onions and potatoes in layers on top of meat.
recipes.text: Easy Casserole. Brown ground beef in 1 tablespoon of the butter. Place meat in bottom of casserole. Put rice, peas, onions and potatoes in layers on top of meat.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Cheese Boat
ingredients: 1 c. strawberries, cut in half, reserving 4 whole strawberries
8 oz. cheddar cheese, cubed into 1/2 inch cubes
directions: Cut pineapple lengthwise into quarters through green top.
Cut along edges of quarters to remove fruit.
Cut pineapple core off of fruit, and cut fruit into bite-sized pieces.
Place pineapple chunks, halved strawberries and melon balls into a large bowl. Sprinkle with ginger and lime juice; toss.
Stir in cheese.
Spoon fruit mixture into shells.
Sprinkle with almonds.
Spoon yogurt onto each serving, and garnish with whole strawberries.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Cheese Boat. Cut pineapple lengthwise into quarters through green top. Cut along edges of quarters to remove fruit. Cut pineapple core off of fruit, and cut fruit into bite-sized pieces. Place pineapple chunks, halved strawberries and melon balls into a large bowl. Sprinkle with ginger and lime juice; toss. Stir in cheese. Spoon fruit mixture into shells. Sprinkle with almonds. Spoon yogurt onto each serving, and garnish with whole strawberries. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bottle Italian dressing (marinade) (Ken's is best)
directions: Cook pasta according to directions.
While hot, pour entire bottle of dressing over pasta.
Add all other ingredients; mix well.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta according to directions. While hot, pour entire bottle of dressing over pasta. Add all other ingredients; mix well. Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni and drain. Mix milk, butter and eggs well and spray crock-pot with nonstick spray. Put in macaroni. Mix in milk mixture and 2 cups of cheese. Put 1 cup of cheese on top. Cook on low for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese. Cook macaroni and drain. Mix milk, butter and eggs well and spray crock-pot with nonstick spray. Put in macaroni. Mix in milk mixture and 2 cups of cheese. Put 1 cup of cheese on top. Cook on low for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Creole Sauce
ingredients: 32 oz. can crushed tomatoes, drained (reserve liquid)
2 Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed with reserved tomato liquid
directions: Soften onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in butter.
Stir in tomatoes and seasonings.
Cook until boiling.
Stir in cornstarch mixture, cooking just until thickened.
Serve over fluffy white rice.
recipes.text: Creole Sauce. Soften onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in butter. Stir in tomatoes and seasonings. Cook until boiling. Stir in cornstarch mixture, cooking just until thickened. Serve over fluffy white rice.

recipes.title: Onion Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together; add to prepared pie crust.
Add shredded cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes, until center is set.
recipes.text: Onion Pie. Mix all ingredients together; add to prepared pie crust. Add shredded cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes, until center is set.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
directions: Sift flour with baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Combine sugar with eggs, oil, sour cream and vanilla; beat well.
Blend in flour mixture.
Fold in apple and nuts; pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Apple Bread. Sift flour with baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Combine sugar with eggs, oil, sour cream and vanilla; beat well. Blend in flour mixture. Fold in apple and nuts; pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients except butter.
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spoon mixture over melted butter (do not mix together).
Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375u00b0 until brown.
Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cornbread. Mix all ingredients except butter. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon mixture over melted butter (do not mix together). Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375u00b0 until brown. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Jello Buttermilk Salad
directions: Combine pineapple and sugar.
Bring to a boil.
Stir slowly. Remove pan from heat.
Add Jell-O; stir until dissolved.
Cool until thick.
Add buttermilk.
Stir.
Fold in Cool Whip and nuts. Pour into 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Chill until firm.
Cut into serving pieces.
recipes.text: Jello Buttermilk Salad. Combine pineapple and sugar. Bring to a boil. Stir slowly. Remove pan from heat. Add Jell-O; stir until dissolved. Cool until thick. Add buttermilk. Stir. Fold in Cool Whip and nuts. Pour into 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into serving pieces.

recipes.title: Spinach Bacon Salad
ingredients: 4 c. fresh spinach, rinsed and in bite size pieces
directions: In a large bowl, mix spinach, onion, radishes, and 1/2 cup mushrooms.
In a skillet, fry bacon until crisp and remove from skillet.
Add vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper to skillet.
Stir ingredients until sugar is dissolved.
Pour bacon and dressing mixture over salad and toss.
Garnish with remaining mushrooms and eggs.
recipes.text: Spinach Bacon Salad. In a large bowl, mix spinach, onion, radishes, and 1/2 cup mushrooms. In a skillet, fry bacon until crisp and remove from skillet. Add vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper to skillet. Stir ingredients until sugar is dissolved. Pour bacon and dressing mixture over salad and toss. Garnish with remaining mushrooms and eggs.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) cans cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook onion in a skillet with hamburger.
Drain.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spread hamburger.
Place frozen Tater Tots on top of hamburger.
Pour chestnuts on Tater Tots.
Mix soup with 2/3 can water.
Pour over Tater Tots.
Sprinkle with 1/2 of both kinds of cheese.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. Cook onion in a skillet with hamburger. Drain. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spread hamburger. Place frozen Tater Tots on top of hamburger. Pour chestnuts on Tater Tots. Mix soup with 2/3 can water. Pour over Tater Tots. Sprinkle with 1/2 of both kinds of cheese. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: The Best Dressing
directions: Mix Italian dressing mix, vinegar and water together. Add olive oil and mix well.
recipes.text: The Best Dressing. Mix Italian dressing mix, vinegar and water together. Add olive oil and mix well.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix together and pour into an unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until filling is set.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix together and pour into an unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until filling is set.

recipes.title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
ingredients: 2 small boxes or 1 large box strawberry Jell-O
1 (No. 2) can crushed pineapple, drained and save juice
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups hot water.
Add 2 cups cold water. Add remaining ingredients and chill until firm.
recipes.text: Strawberry Congealed Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups hot water. Add 2 cups cold water. Add remaining ingredients and chill until firm.

recipes.title: French Waffles
directions: Cream sugars and margarine.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add vanilla and flour.
Mix.
Put teaspoons on hot waffle iron. Cooking time varies according to your iron.
recipes.text: French Waffles. Cream sugars and margarine. Add eggs and mix well. Add vanilla and flour. Mix. Put teaspoons on hot waffle iron. Cooking time varies according to your iron.

recipes.title: Chicken On The Grill
directions: Mix together all ingredients except chicken.
Prick chicken with fork.
Pour mixture over chicken and marinate overnight. Cook on grill.
recipes.text: Chicken On The Grill. Mix together all ingredients except chicken. Prick chicken with fork. Pour mixture over chicken and marinate overnight. Cook on grill.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wash mushrooms.
Take stems out.
Lay aside.
Chop celery and onion fine.
Put margarine, celery and onion in skillet.
Cook until tender.
Chop stems fine.
Add to skillet.
Simmer 5 minutes. Stir in bread crumbs, sage and poultry seasoning.
Stir well.
Add egg.
Spread thin layer in glass dish.
Stuff the rest into the caps.
Lay in dish.
Put in broiler for 5 to 7 minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Wash mushrooms. Take stems out. Lay aside. Chop celery and onion fine. Put margarine, celery and onion in skillet. Cook until tender. Chop stems fine. Add to skillet. Simmer 5 minutes. Stir in bread crumbs, sage and poultry seasoning. Stir well. Add egg. Spread thin layer in glass dish. Stuff the rest into the caps. Lay in dish. Put in broiler for 5 to 7 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Halushki
ingredients: cabbage, shredded, or home canned kraut
directions: Fry bacon and onion together until onion is transparent.
Place shredded cabbage in skillet with onion and bacon.
Cook noodles in separate pan.
Season to taste with pepper or seasoning of your choice.
Mix all together.
You can put some sour cream or cottage cheese on top at time of serving (mix in or whatever you want). Gives a better taste.
Can be made with sausage or no meat at all for those of you who are meatless Friday folks during Lent.
recipes.text: Halushki. Fry bacon and onion together until onion is transparent. Place shredded cabbage in skillet with onion and bacon. Cook noodles in separate pan. Season to taste with pepper or seasoning of your choice. Mix all together. You can put some sour cream or cottage cheese on top at time of serving (mix in or whatever you want). Gives a better taste. Can be made with sausage or no meat at all for those of you who are meatless Friday folks during Lent.

recipes.title: Rajin Cajun Seafood And Rice
ingredients: 3 pkg. Lipton Cajun red beans and rice mix
1 (16 oz.) can New England clam chowder
1 medium bell pepper, diced and sauteed
directions: Follow directions on red beans and rice mix.
When red beans and rice mixture is ready and thickening, add remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer over low heat 15 to 20 minutes until thickens.
Feeds 8 to 10 people.
recipes.text: Rajin Cajun Seafood And Rice. Follow directions on red beans and rice mix. When red beans and rice mixture is ready and thickening, add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer over low heat 15 to 20 minutes until thickens. Feeds 8 to 10 people.

recipes.title: Braised Cabbage
ingredients: 2 green onions, chopped or 4 stalks chives, chopped
directions: In skillet, heat butter until foamy. Add onions or chives and saute until tender. Add cabbage and carrots. Saute over high heat until tender-crisp, about 4 minutes.
Add salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Braised Cabbage. In skillet, heat butter until foamy. Add onions or chives and saute until tender. Add cabbage and carrots. Saute over high heat until tender-crisp, about 4 minutes. Add salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Shrimp Sauce
directions: Mix and serve. Make only what you are going to use; do not save.
recipes.text: Shrimp Sauce. Mix and serve. Make only what you are going to use; do not save.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni; drain and

make a layer of 1/2 of each ingredient, then make another layer with remaining ingredients. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 1/2 hour or microwave approximately 15 minutes at normal setting, turning dish when half done.
recipes.text: Pizza Casserole. Cook macaroni; drain and make a layer of 1/2 of each ingredient, then make another layer with remaining ingredients. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 1/2 hour or microwave approximately 15 minutes at normal setting, turning dish when half done.

recipes.title: Worry Free Vegetable
directions: *(Celery, carrots, parsnips, green beans, turnip, squash, cauliflower, broccoli.)
recipes.text: Worry Free Vegetable. *(Celery, carrots, parsnips, green beans, turnip, squash, cauliflower, broccoli.)

directions: Mix
water,

sugar,

add sugar, salt and 3 cups

recipes.text: Basic Sweet Dough. Mix water, 1tteaspoon sugar, yeast. Stirtand set aside. Scald milk, pour into large mixing bowl; add sugar, salt and 3 cups flour. Mix with spoon and be sure it is not hotter than 110u00b0 to 115u00b0. Add eggs and yeast mixture. Mix well with spoon. Add margarine, then beat with mixer about 5 minutes. Add 3 more cups flour and mix well with spoon.tTurn onto floured board or pastry cloth. Let rest a short time. Knead about 5 minutes, adding flour only if needed. Let rise in warm place until double in bulk, 1 1/2 or 1 hour. Make into desired shapes. Let rise 1 hour.tBake in 350u00b0 to 400u00b0 oven not more than 18 to 20 minutes. Good luck.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda and salt. Stir in blueberries.
Add milk, egg and butter; mix until batter is moist; do not overbeat.
Spoon batter into greased muffin pans and bake at 400u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Yields 12.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins. In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda and salt. Stir in blueberries. Add milk, egg and butter; mix until batter is moist; do not overbeat. Spoon batter into greased muffin pans and bake at 400u00b0 for 25 minutes. Yields 12.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix and place in a greased pan.
Put chopped nuts on top. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Mix and place in a greased pan. Put chopped nuts on top. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Asparagus-Noodle Casserole
directions: In casserole dish, layer noodles, asparagus and eggs.
Dilute soup with asparagus stock; pour over layers.
Season; top with cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly.
recipes.text: Asparagus-Noodle Casserole. In casserole dish, layer noodles, asparagus and eggs. Dilute soup with asparagus stock; pour over layers. Season; top with cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
ingredients: 2 c. shreds of whole bran cereal
directions: Mix cereal and buttermilk.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Add oil and eggs.
Blend well.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Mix well. Batter can be baked immediately or stored in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
Grease muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. Fill 3/4 full.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes.
Makes 24 to 30 muffins.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Mix cereal and buttermilk. Let stand 5 minutes. Add oil and eggs. Blend well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Mix well. Batter can be baked immediately or stored in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Grease muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. Fill 3/4 full. Bake at 400u00b0 for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 24 to 30 muffins.

recipes.title: Apple Crunch Pie
directions: Set oven to 400u00b0.
Peel apples and dice.
In a bowl, mix apples, 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon.
Put in pie crust.
In another bowl, mix 3/4 cup sugar, 3/4 cup flour and 1/3 stick margarine.
This will be crumbly.
Pour mixture on top of apples, then sprinkle 1 teaspoon of cinnamon over top.
Cook about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Crunch Pie. Set oven to 400u00b0. Peel apples and dice. In a bowl, mix apples, 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon. Put in pie crust. In another bowl, mix 3/4 cup sugar, 3/4 cup flour and 1/3 stick margarine. This will be crumbly. Pour mixture on top of apples, then sprinkle 1 teaspoon of cinnamon over top. Cook about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies(Yield: 60 Large Cookies)
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies(Yield: 60 Large Cookies). 1. Preheat oven to 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Bring to a boil the sugar, syrup and water; boil until it threads.
Add peanuts; boil until brown.
Remove from heat.
Add soda and vanilla, stirring to mix well.
Pour onto greased cookie sheet.
Let cool, then break into pieces.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Bring to a boil the sugar, syrup and water; boil until it threads. Add peanuts; boil until brown. Remove from heat. Add soda and vanilla, stirring to mix well. Pour onto greased cookie sheet. Let cool, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Grease and flour two 9-inch layer pans or a 13 x 9-inch oblong pan.
Cream until fluffy the shortening and sugar.
Beat in eggs; blend in chocolate.
Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Stir in alternately with buttermilk.
recipes.text: Devil'S Food Cake. Grease and flour two 9-inch layer pans or a 13 x 9-inch oblong pan. Cream until fluffy the shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs; blend in chocolate. Sift together flour, soda and salt. Stir in alternately with buttermilk.

recipes.title: Child'S Play Popsicles
directions: Dissolve jello, kool aid and sugar in hot water. Add the cold water and freeze in ice cube trays. After adding ingredients to the ice cube tray, place a piece of plastic wrap over top of the tray and place toothpicks into kool aid for sticks.
recipes.text: Child'S Play Popsicles. Dissolve jello, kool aid and sugar in hot water. Add the cold water and freeze in ice cube trays. After adding ingredients to the ice cube tray, place a piece of plastic wrap over top of the tray and place toothpicks into kool aid for sticks.

recipes.title: Tasty Dried Beef Casserole
ingredients: 10 1/2 oz. can condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Melt butter in saucepan; add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Cut dried beef into small pieces; add to onion mixture and continue cooking until beef is slightly browned. Stir in soup, milk, pepper and paprika. Heat to boiling. Cook macaroni, using unsalted water. Drain, then rinse with cold water and drain again.
Combine macaroni with dried beef sauce. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, in 350u00b0 oven 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Tasty Dried Beef Casserole. Melt butter in saucepan; add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Cut dried beef into small pieces; add to onion mixture and continue cooking until beef is slightly browned. Stir in soup, milk, pepper and paprika. Heat to boiling. Cook macaroni, using unsalted water. Drain, then rinse with cold water and drain again. Combine macaroni with dried beef sauce. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, in 350u00b0 oven 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Lemon Muffins
directions: Mix berries and 2 tablespoons sugar; set aside.
Mix dry ingredients in bowl.
Make a well.
Pour in wet ingredients and add lemon peel.
Mix until barely moist.
Add berries.
Pour into prepared muffin tins.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
Top with melted butter and sugar, if desired.
recipes.text: Blueberry Lemon Muffins. Mix berries and 2 tablespoons sugar; set aside. Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Make a well. Pour in wet ingredients and add lemon peel. Mix until barely moist. Add berries. Pour into prepared muffin tins. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Top with melted butter and sugar, if desired.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. Velveeta cheese, cut in chunks
1 large (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut in chunks
1 onion, cut up, or use dehydrated onion
directions: Combine all ingredients in ovenproof dish.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes, covered.
Stir.
Serve hot with Triscuits or corn chips.
recipes.text: Crab Dip. Combine all ingredients in ovenproof dish. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes, covered. Stir. Serve hot with Triscuits or corn chips.

recipes.title: Quick Nut Bread
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Work in shortening as for biscuits.
Then add egg and egg yolk (well beaten), milk and chopped nuts.
Beat thoroughly and turn into a buttered bread pan.
Let stand, then bake at 400u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick Nut Bread. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Work in shortening as for biscuits. Then add egg and egg yolk (well beaten), milk and chopped nuts. Beat thoroughly and turn into a buttered bread pan. Let stand, then bake at 400u00b0 for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Cornbread Pie
ingredients: 2 pkg. cornbread mix, prepared as on pkg.
directions: Put half of cornbread mixture on bottom of pan.
Add onion and layer of cheese.
Dice potato and add layer of potatoes, then all of the meat.
Add another layer of potatoes, onions and cheese. Top with remaining cornbread.
Bake until cornbread is golden brown.
recipes.text: Cornbread Pie. Put half of cornbread mixture on bottom of pan. Add onion and layer of cheese. Dice potato and add layer of potatoes, then all of the meat. Add another layer of potatoes, onions and cheese. Top with remaining cornbread. Bake until cornbread is golden brown.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Rolls
directions: Slice package of rolls in half.
Place bottom layer back in pan.
Spread ham over bottom layer; sprinkle with cheese.
Place top of rolls in pan.
Mix other ingredients together and spread on top.
Let soak in 10 minutes.
Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
Cool and cut into sections.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Rolls. Slice package of rolls in half. Place bottom layer back in pan. Spread ham over bottom layer; sprinkle with cheese. Place top of rolls in pan. Mix other ingredients together and spread on top. Let soak in 10 minutes. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0. Cool and cut into sections.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Sift dry ingredients together in a large bowl.
Cut in shortening.
Add buttermilk and yeast mixture.
Work dough only until well moistened.
Cover and refrigerate to use as needed.
Bake at 400u00b0 in oven for about 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Sift dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Cut in shortening. Add buttermilk and yeast mixture. Work dough only until well moistened. Cover and refrigerate to use as needed. Bake at 400u00b0 in oven for about 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Picadillo
directions: Chop onion and green pepper.
Saute over medium-high heat with crushed garlic until onion and pepper are tender.
Add hamburger and brown on high heat until meat is cooked through.
Drain off excess fat.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and salt and garlic to taste.
Simmer, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes until mixture is very thick and water is cooked out.
Coarsely chop olives; add to meat and cook for about 5 minutes.
Serve over yellow rice.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Picadillo. Chop onion and green pepper. Saute over medium-high heat with crushed garlic until onion and pepper are tender. Add hamburger and brown on high heat until meat is cooked through. Drain off excess fat. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and salt and garlic to taste. Simmer, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes until mixture is very thick and water is cooked out. Coarsely chop olives; add to meat and cook for about 5 minutes. Serve over yellow rice. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Shocking Dip
directions: Put cream cheese in a bowl; add gelatin and milk.
Beat with a wire whisk until well blended and smooth.
Chill until serving time.
Take out about 15 minutes prior to serving with fruit. Makes 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Shocking Dip. Put cream cheese in a bowl; add gelatin and milk. Beat with a wire whisk until well blended and smooth. Chill until serving time. Take out about 15 minutes prior to serving with fruit. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients for 8 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter bits and marshmallow cream. Beat this until smooth and thick. Pour into an 8 x 8 greased baking dish. Let cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Cook first 3 ingredients for 8 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter bits and marshmallow cream. Beat this until smooth and thick. Pour into an 8 x 8 greased baking dish. Let cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: salt, pepper, garlic salt and soy sauce to taste
directions: Cut fat off pork chops.
Brown in skillet.
Bring to boil the liquid ingredients and pour over pork chops, pepper and onion rings in baking dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Cut fat off pork chops. Brown in skillet. Bring to boil the liquid ingredients and pour over pork chops, pepper and onion rings in baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream margarine; gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, beating well.
Stir in mashed bananas.
Combine flour and nuts to creamed mixture, mixing just until smooth. Spoon into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for one hour or until done.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream margarine; gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy. Add eggs, beating well. Stir in mashed bananas. Combine flour and nuts to creamed mixture, mixing just until smooth. Spoon into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for one hour or until done.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Ham Casserole
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh broccoli or 10 oz. frozen
directions: Cook broccoli.
Cut into 1-inch pieces and place in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Combine ham with parsley, green pepper, eggs, cheese, onion and lemon juice.
Cover broccoli with ham mixture.
Top with cream sauce.
Sprinkle buttered crumbs on top. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.
Serves 5 to 6.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Ham Casserole. Cook broccoli. Cut into 1-inch pieces and place in buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine ham with parsley, green pepper, eggs, cheese, onion and lemon juice. Cover broccoli with ham mixture. Top with cream sauce. Sprinkle buttered crumbs on top. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Serves 5 to 6.

recipes.title: Will'S Butter Thin Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour desired amount onto heated griddle and cook, turning only once.
recipes.text: Will'S Butter Thin Pancakes. Mix all ingredients. Pour desired amount onto heated griddle and cook, turning only once.

recipes.title: Baby Food Cake
ingredients: 1 jar baby food peaches or apricots
1 jar baby food prunes or plums
directions: Combine and mix all ingredients well.
Bake about 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Baby Food Cake. Combine and mix all ingredients well. Bake about 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Banana Split Salad
directions: Mix Eagle Brand and Cool Whip together then mix all other ingredients together.
Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Banana Split Salad. Mix Eagle Brand and Cool Whip together then mix all other ingredients together. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Coconut Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 small box Jell-O cook 'n serve sugar-free vanilla pudding and pie filling
1 pkg. Sweet Pretenders whipped topping mix
directions: Bake pie shell until lightly brown.
Cool.
Mix pie filling, milk and 1/2 to 3/4 cup grated fresh coconut.
Bring to a boil. Pour into cooled pie shell.
Chill.
Mix topping mix according to package directions.
Put desired amount of topping on chilled pie. In ungreased skillet, toast 2 tablespoons grated fresh coconut until golden.
Sprinkle on top of whipped topping.
Chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Coconut Cream Pie. Bake pie shell until lightly brown. Cool. Mix pie filling, milk and 1/2 to 3/4 cup grated fresh coconut. Bring to a boil. Pour into cooled pie shell.
