Chill. Mix topping mix according to package directions. Put desired amount of topping on chilled pie. In ungreased skillet, toast 2 tablespoons grated fresh coconut until golden. Sprinkle on top of whipped topping. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Company Best Pickles
directions: Cover whole cucumbers with boiling water.
Let stand overnight.
Drain.
Repeat this for 3 more days.
recipes.text: Company Best Pickles. Cover whole cucumbers with boiling water. Let stand overnight. Drain. Repeat this for 3 more days.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
ingredients: 1 can milk chocolate or fudge frosting
directions: Mix pudding per box directions.
Add Cool Whip.
Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with layer of graham cracker squares.
Cover crackers with half the pudding mixture.
Repeat the layer.
Top these with one more layer of graham crackers.
Cover the top layer (graham crackers) with your choice of frosting.
Cover with clear wrap and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair Dessert. Mix pudding per box directions. Add Cool Whip. Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with layer of graham cracker squares. Cover crackers with half the pudding mixture. Repeat the layer. Top these with one more layer of graham crackers. Cover the top layer (graham crackers) with your choice of frosting. Cover with clear wrap and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Granola
directions: Plus nuts, rolled grains, dates, etc.
recipes.text: Granola. Plus nuts, rolled grains, dates, etc.

recipes.title: Encharitos
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. pork chops or as much desired (save scraps)
2 to 3 small cans chopped green chiles
2 to 3 cans chopped tomatoes and green chiles
directions: Encharito Sauce:
Cut meat off pork chops and cut up into bite-size pieces.
Boil bones in seasoned water.
Cook pork in small amount of oil and water and season until lightly browned. Add enchilada sauce and equal amount of pork broth or a little more.
Add 1/2 to 1 can of green chiles.
Simmer for a short while, then thicken slightly with cornstarch.
recipes.text: Encharitos. Encharito Sauce: Cut meat off pork chops and cut up into bite-size pieces. Boil bones in seasoned water. Cook pork in small amount of oil and water and season until lightly browned. Add enchilada sauce and equal amount of pork broth or a little more. Add 1/2 to 1 can of green chiles. Simmer for a short while, then thicken slightly with cornstarch.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
directions: Grind onions, potatoes, celery and clams.
Put fat in bottom of heavy pot.
Stir in flour.
Add ground mixture, water and seasonings.
Boil just until vegetables are tender.
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Grind onions, potatoes, celery and clams. Put fat in bottom of heavy pot. Stir in flour. Add ground mixture, water and seasonings. Boil just until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Glaze Sauce For Meat
ingredients: cooked meatballs (or link sausage or pork chops or chicken)
directions: Brown meat in a hot skillet.
Add the juices and honey; cook until meat reduces down and thickens.
Be careful not to let it burn.
(The juice gives it the flavor.)
recipes.text: Glaze Sauce For Meat. Brown meat in a hot skillet. Add the juices and honey; cook until meat reduces down and thickens. Be careful not to let it burn. (The juice gives it the flavor.)

recipes.title: Cheese Crackers
directions: Mix room temperature cheese with softened margarine.
Add sifted flour and pepper.
Mix thoroughly with hands.
Take small pieces of dough and roll into small balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Crackers. Mix room temperature cheese with softened margarine. Add sifted flour and pepper. Mix thoroughly with hands. Take small pieces of dough and roll into small balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Garlic Bundt Loaf
ingredients: 2 loaves frozen white bread dough, thawed
1/3 to 1/2 c. margarine, melted and cooled to lukewarm
1 small onion, chopped (or use dried minced onion)
5 cloves fresh garlic, minced (can use garlic powder)
directions: Cut or snip off pieces of the dough about the size of a walnut. Place half in a greased 10-inch Bundt pan.
Combine the melted butter with rest of the ingredients.
Pour half of this butter mixture over dough in pan.
Add the remaining dough pieces and drizzle the rest of the butter mix over the top.
Cover and let rise until double in size, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown.
Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes before removing.
Bread can be eaten by breaking off pieces or by slicing.
recipes.text: Garlic Bundt Loaf. Cut or snip off pieces of the dough about the size of a walnut. Place half in a greased 10-inch Bundt pan. Combine the melted butter with rest of the ingredients. Pour half of this butter mixture over dough in pan. Add the remaining dough pieces and drizzle the rest of the butter mix over the top. Cover and let rise until double in size, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown. Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes before removing. Bread can be eaten by breaking off pieces or by slicing.

recipes.title: Mary'S Trifle
directions: Layer sliced angel food cake and thawed frozen strawberries. Repeat layer.
recipes.text: Mary'S Trifle. Layer sliced angel food cake and thawed frozen strawberries. Repeat layer.

recipes.title: Layer Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening together. Add eggs and beat well, then add vanilla. Mix baking powder, salt and flour together. Add milk and flour, small amounts at a time of each; do not beat much after putting flour in. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Layer Cake. Cream sugar and shortening together. Add eggs and beat well, then add vanilla. Mix baking powder, salt and flour together. Add milk and flour, small amounts at a time of each; do not beat much after putting flour in. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Unbelievable Easy Fudge
directions: Combine ingredients in microwave safe dish. Cook in microwave for 2 minutes. Stir until all the mixture is mixed together. Pour into a buttered pan. Refrigerate for a few minutes and slice.
recipes.text: Unbelievable Easy Fudge. Combine ingredients in microwave safe dish. Cook in microwave for 2 minutes. Stir until all the mixture is mixed together. Pour into a buttered pan. Refrigerate for a few minutes and slice.

recipes.title: Lasagne Florentine For Microwave
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and drained
directions: Combine spaghetti sauce, tomatoes with liquid and water in bowl.
Stir to blend and break up the tomatoes; set aside. Combine Ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup Mozzarella, egg and garlic powder in bowl; mix well.
Spread 1/3 spaghetti sauce mixture in bottom of microwave-safe baking dish (about 12 x 8 x 2-inch).
Place 3 noodles on top of sauce.
Spread half Ricotta mixture over noodles.
Layer with half of the spinach and 1 cup Mozzarella. Repeat layers (sauce, noodles, Ricotta, spinach and Mozzarella). Cover with the remaining noodles; pour on remaining sauce mixture.
recipes.text: Lasagne Florentine For Microwave. Combine spaghetti sauce, tomatoes with liquid and water in bowl. Stir to blend and break up the tomatoes; set aside. Combine Ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup Mozzarella, egg and garlic powder in bowl; mix well. Spread 1/3 spaghetti sauce mixture in bottom of microwave-safe baking dish (about 12 x 8 x 2-inch). Place 3 noodles on top of sauce. Spread half Ricotta mixture over noodles. Layer with half of the spinach and 1 cup Mozzarella. Repeat layers (sauce, noodles, Ricotta, spinach and Mozzarella). Cover with the remaining noodles; pour on remaining sauce mixture.

recipes.title: Gladys Starr'S Chocolate Frosting
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, milk, syrup and salt together.
Cook on medium heat until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat.
Add margarine and vanilla.
Beat until cool.
recipes.text: Gladys Starr'S Chocolate Frosting. Mix sugar, cocoa, milk, syrup and salt together. Cook on medium heat until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat. Add margarine and vanilla. Beat until cool.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs well.
Blend in oil, sugar, vanilla and zucchini. Add dry ingredients.
Bake in two greased pans at 375u00b0 for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs well. Blend in oil, sugar, vanilla and zucchini. Add dry ingredients. Bake in two greased pans at 375u00b0 for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cranberry Mold
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. strawberry or black raspberry gelatin
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
While liquid is hot, stir in cranberry sauce, pineapple, celery and nuts.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cranberry Mold. Dissolve jello in boiling water. While liquid is hot, stir in cranberry sauce, pineapple, celery and nuts. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Mix all ingredients together and put into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
May be glazed with 1/2 cup lemon juice and 1/2 cup powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Sift together dry ingredients. Mix all ingredients together and put into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour. May be glazed with 1/2 cup lemon juice and 1/2 cup powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Leek, Potato And Tarragon Soup
ingredients: 2 leeks (white and pale green parts only), sliced (about 2 cups)
1/2 lb red-skinned potatoes, unpeeled, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
4 cups low-salt chicken broth or vegetable broth
directions: Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium heat.
Add leeks, onion, garlic and 2 tbsp.
Water.
Cook until leeks are just golden, about 10 minutes.
Add potatoes and both; bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
Mix in tarragon.
(Can be made 1 day ahead.)
Cool slightly.
Cover and refrigerate.
(Rewarm before continuing.) Stir in cream and yogurt.
Season soup to taste with salt and pepper. 4-6 servings.
recipes.text: Leek, Potato And Tarragon Soup. Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium heat. Add leeks, onion, garlic and 2 tbsp. Water. Cook until leeks are just golden, about 10 minutes. Add potatoes and both; bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Mix in tarragon. (Can be made 1 day ahead.) Cool slightly. Cover and refrigerate. (Rewarm before continuing.) Stir in cream and yogurt. Season soup to taste with salt and pepper. 4-6 servings.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Chili Verde
ingredients: 2 to 2 1/2 lb. pork tri tip, cubed
directions: Place cubed tri-tip in crock-pot.
Cover tri-tip with water and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.
Drain water and pour chili verde over tri-tip.
Cover in crock-pot another 30 to 45 minutes. Great over cheese quesadillas.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Chili Verde. Place cubed tri-tip in crock-pot. Cover tri-tip with water and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours. Drain water and pour chili verde over tri-tip. Cover in crock-pot another 30 to 45 minutes. Great over cheese quesadillas.

recipes.title: Poor Boys Hamburger
directions: Follow directions on "cheese and macaroni".
Fry hamburger, broken up in small pieces.
Add garlic and salt while frying. Combine macaroni; stir and serve.
Makes 5 servings.
recipes.text: Poor Boys Hamburger. Follow directions on "cheese and macaroni". Fry hamburger, broken up in small pieces. Add garlic and salt while frying. Combine macaroni; stir and serve. Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Streusel Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Spread apple filling in buttered 9-inch square pan.
In bowl, beat eggs, add condensed milk, melted margarine, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Mix well.
Pour over apple filling.
In medium bowl, combine sugar and flour, cut in cold margarine until crumbly.
Add nuts and oats.
Sprinkle on top. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until set.
Serve warm or cold. Refrigerate leftovers.
Makes 9 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Apple Streusel Cobbler. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Spread apple filling in buttered 9-inch square pan. In bowl, beat eggs, add condensed milk, melted margarine, cinnamon and nutmeg. Mix well. Pour over apple filling. In medium bowl, combine sugar and flour, cut in cold margarine until crumbly. Add nuts and oats. Sprinkle on top. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until set. Serve warm or cold. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 9 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and boil 2 minutes.
Remove from heat. Mix in the peanut butter and oatmeal.
Drop on waxed paper.
recipes.text: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies. Mix first 5 ingredients and boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Mix in the peanut butter and oatmeal. Drop on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Quick Pickled Cucumbers
directions: In a 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish, stir together vinegar, sugar, salt and crushed red pepper. Cut each unpeeled cucumber lengthwise into 6 wedges.
Place in baking dish with marinade. Peel carrot and cut crosswise in half. Cut each half lengthwise into matchstick thin strips.
Place carrots in baking dish with cucumbers. Toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, stirring occasionally.
Makes 16 accompaniment servings.
recipes.text: Quick Pickled Cucumbers. In a 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish, stir together vinegar, sugar, salt and crushed red pepper. Cut each unpeeled cucumber lengthwise into 6 wedges. Place in baking dish with marinade. Peel carrot and cut crosswise in half. Cut each half lengthwise into matchstick thin strips. Place carrots in baking dish with cucumbers. Toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, stirring occasionally. Makes 16 accompaniment servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Orange Cake
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Combine dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.
Stir in extracts.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cakes test done.
Cool for 10 minutes in pans before removing to wire racks to cool completely.
recipes.text: Lemon Orange Cake. In a mixing bowl, cream butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Stir in extracts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until cakes test done. Cool for 10 minutes in pans before removing to wire racks to cool completely.

recipes.title: Black-And-White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 c. dry black beans, soaked or 3 c. canned black turtle beans
1 c. dry navy beans, soaked or 3 c. canned navy beans
directions: Drain the soaked beans and place in separate saucepans.
Cover with water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until tender, 45 to 60 minutes.
Drain beans; rinse under cold water and pat dry.
Combine beans in a large bowl.
Add onion, bell pepper, corn and cilantro (parsley).
Add 2 cups of the Cumin Vinaigrette.
Toss gently to combine.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Black-And-White Bean Salad. Drain the soaked beans and place in separate saucepans. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until tender, 45 to 60 minutes. Drain beans; rinse under cold water and pat dry. Combine beans in a large bowl. Add onion, bell pepper, corn and cilantro (parsley). Add 2 cups of the Cumin Vinaigrette. Toss gently to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Thai-Style Marinade
ingredients: 1 medium jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped*
1 bunch cilantro, rinsed and finely chopped
directions: *Use caution with seeds, they give the heat, and can burn your eyes if you touch them after handling the seeds.
recipes.text: Thai-Style Marinade. *Use caution with seeds, they give the heat, and can burn your eyes if you touch them after handling the seeds.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Dressing
ingredients: 8 slices loaf bread crumbled (place in blender and pulsate)
4 c. chicken broth or enough to make soupy mixture
directions: Melt margarine in large boiler and cook onions and celery for about 10 minutes.
Mix bread crumbs with cornbread crumbs, add cream of chicken soup to celery, onions and chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Pour over bread crumbs, add beaten eggs.
Mix well.
Add salt, poultry seasoning, sage and pepper to taste. Pour into 5 quart crock pot on low for 5 hours or on high setting for 4 hours.
recipes.text: Crock Pot Chicken Dressing. Melt margarine in large boiler and cook onions and celery for about 10 minutes. Mix bread crumbs with cornbread crumbs, add cream of chicken soup to celery, onions and chicken broth and bring to a boil. Pour over bread crumbs, add beaten eggs. Mix well. Add salt, poultry seasoning, sage and pepper to taste. Pour into 5 quart crock pot on low for 5 hours or on high setting for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Wacky Cake
directions: Cake:
Put all together in bowl.
Hand mix well.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Chocolate Wacky Cake. Cake: Put all together in bowl. Hand mix well. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Fettuccine With Clams And Zucchini
ingredients: 2 doz. small littleneck clams (can use 2 cans clams and 1 bottle clam juice)
1 lb. small zucchini, soaked in cold water for 20 minutes
directions: Wash clams in several changes of cold water, rubbing with a stiff brush.
Put the clams in a pot with 1/2 cup of water.
Cover and cook over high heat.
Stir and remove each clam as it opens. (Overcook and they will be tough.)
When all clams are open and out of the pot, pour the liquid into a bowl gently so sand will be left behind.
Remove the clam meat from shells and keep them moist in the bowl of liquid.
When zucchini has soaked, cut off ends and dice into 1/2-inch cubes.
recipes.text: Fettuccine With Clams And Zucchini. Wash clams in several changes of cold water, rubbing with a stiff brush. Put the clams in a pot with 1/2 cup of water. Cover and cook over high heat. Stir and remove each clam as it opens. (Overcook and they will be tough.) When all clams are open and out of the pot, pour the liquid into a bowl gently so sand will be left behind. Remove the clam meat from shells and keep them moist in the bowl of liquid. When zucchini has soaked, cut off ends and dice into 1/2-inch cubes.

recipes.title: Chadwick Island Sauce
directions: In a 2-quart pan, whisk sugar, flour, salt, pepper and mustard.
Whisk in water until smooth.
Whisk in egg yolks and blend.
Add rest of ingredients, except oil; whisk constantly. Cook until thickened (5 minutes).
Do not let boil.
Take off heat and beat in oil.
Store in covered container.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Chadwick Island Sauce. In a 2-quart pan, whisk sugar, flour, salt, pepper and mustard. Whisk in water until smooth. Whisk in egg yolks and blend. Add rest of ingredients, except oil; whisk constantly. Cook until thickened (5 minutes). Do not let boil. Take off heat and beat in oil. Store in covered container. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Busy Day Chicken
directions: Scatter raw rice in bottom of greased casserole.
Lay chicken, skin side up, on top.
Mix soups and water and pour over chicken. Bake 2 hours at 350u00b0.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Busy Day Chicken. Scatter raw rice in bottom of greased casserole. Lay chicken, skin side up, on top. Mix soups and water and pour over chicken. Bake 2 hours at 350u00b0. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Melt margarine; add sugar, cocoa, salt and milk to the margarine. Stir constantly until melted. Bring these ingredients to a full boil. Boil for exactly 1 minute. Remove from heat after 1 minute; add peanut butter.
Stir until melted. Add quick oats. Stir together. Drop by teaspoon onto a sheet of foil.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Melt margarine; add sugar, cocoa, salt and milk to the margarine. Stir constantly until melted. Bring these ingredients to a full boil. Boil for exactly 1 minute. Remove from heat after 1 minute; add peanut butter. Stir until melted. Add quick oats. Stir together. Drop by teaspoon onto a sheet of foil.

recipes.title: Swedish Pineapple Cake
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) can crushed pineapple (do not drain juice)
directions: Put all ingredients in bowl; mix with spoon until all is mixed well.
Put into greased 9 x 13-inch pan (no flour).
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool before icing.
recipes.text: Swedish Pineapple Cake. Put all ingredients in bowl; mix with spoon until all is mixed well. Put into greased 9 x 13-inch pan (no flour). Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool before icing.

recipes.title: Woodward House Tea Cakes
directions: Mix butter with hands; add sugar.
Add 1 cup flour and blend; add another cup flour.
Work until stiff.
Add to 11 x 8-inch pan, ungreased.
Press flat and fork over all of it (you can use a Springerle pin and roll out first).
Bake at 300u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut immediately into small squares.
Do not brown!
recipes.text: Woodward House Tea Cakes. Mix butter with hands; add sugar. Add 1 cup flour and blend; add another cup flour. Work until stiff. Add to 11 x 8-inch pan, ungreased. Press flat and fork over all of it (you can use a Springerle pin and roll out first). Bake at 300u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut immediately into small squares. Do not brown!

recipes.title: 7 Layer Salad
directions: Use a 4-quart plastic container with an airtight lid.
recipes.text: 7 Layer Salad. Use a 4-quart plastic container with an airtight lid.

recipes.title: Pink Lady Cake
directions: Bake as directed on cake mix box in a rectangular box.
recipes.text: Pink Lady Cake. Bake as directed on cake mix box in a rectangular box.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese and dried chipped beef together.
Add garlic salt.
Roll in a ball.
Cover with chopped nuts and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix cream cheese and dried chipped beef together. Add garlic salt. Roll in a ball. Cover with chopped nuts and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
directions: Mix ingredients together in a casserole dish.
Bake for 35 minutes at 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix ingredients together in a casserole dish. Bake for 35 minutes at 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Potato Cheese Chowder
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. American cheese slices, diced
directions: In 3-quart saucepan, melt margarine.
Add potatoes, onion, salt and paprika.
Cook until vegetables are lightly brown and tender.
Add milk and cheese; cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is hot and cheese is melted and smooth.
Spoon into 4 soup bowls and sprinkle with paprika.
Serve with assorted crackers.
recipes.text: Potato Cheese Chowder. In 3-quart saucepan, melt margarine. Add potatoes, onion, salt and paprika. Cook until vegetables are lightly brown and tender. Add milk and cheese; cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is hot and cheese is melted and smooth. Spoon into 4 soup bowls and sprinkle with paprika. Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Jiffy Joes
directions: Crumble meat into casserole dish.
Stir in peppers and onion. Microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until meat loses pink color when stirred.
Drain meat mixture well.
recipes.text: Jiffy Joes. Crumble meat into casserole dish. Stir in peppers and onion. Microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until meat loses pink color when stirred. Drain meat mixture well.

recipes.title: Cabbage With Cheese
directions: Cook cabbage in boiling salted water until tender, about 6 to 9 minutes.
Drain; add cream and cheese.
Place over low heat; stir until cheese melts and coats cabbage.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Cabbage With Cheese. Cook cabbage in boiling salted water until tender, about 6 to 9 minutes. Drain; add cream and cheese. Place over low heat; stir until cheese melts and coats cabbage. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Rice Pudding
directions: Combine all ingredients and place in 2 lightly greased custard cups.
Bake, uncovered, at 325u00b0, stirring every 15 minutes for 1 1/2 hours.
Makes 2 servings.
One serving equals 115 calories.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Rice Pudding. Combine all ingredients and place in 2 lightly greased custard cups. Bake, uncovered, at 325u00b0, stirring every 15 minutes for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 2 servings. One serving equals 115 calories.

recipes.title: Alice Rettke'S Christmas Fudge
ingredients: 1/2 c. dried white figs, stems removed
directions: In saucepan, add sugar, butter, milk and salt; stir until all the sugar is dissolved.
Set aside.
Heavily butter a cookie sheet; evenly spread coconut, pressing it in a little.
Chill in refrigerator while the candy is cooking.
In a large mixing bowl, put the milk chocolate, marshmallow cream, vanilla, semi-sweet chocolate and unsweetened chocolate.
Coarsely chop all fruits and nuts; add to bowl.
recipes.text: Alice Rettke'S Christmas Fudge. In saucepan, add sugar, butter, milk and salt; stir until all the sugar is dissolved. Set aside. Heavily butter a cookie sheet; evenly spread coconut, pressing it in a little. Chill in refrigerator while the candy is cooking. In a large mixing bowl, put the milk chocolate, marshmallow cream, vanilla, semi-sweet chocolate and unsweetened chocolate. Coarsely chop all fruits and nuts; add to bowl.

recipes.title: Summer Squash
ingredients: 2 to 2 1/2 lb. yellow squash, cut up
directions: Cook the squash in small amount of water 5 to 10 minutes; drain.
Combine sour cream, butter, onions, salt and pepper. Place in buttered 1-quart casserole.
Top with crumbs and cheese. Bake 25 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Summer Squash. Cook the squash in small amount of water 5 to 10 minutes; drain. Combine sour cream, butter, onions, salt and pepper. Place in buttered 1-quart casserole. Top with crumbs and cheese. Bake 25 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Sausage Skillet
directions: Cut sausage into bite-size pieces.
Saute sausage and onion in skillet until onion is tender.
Add vegetables, cover and simmer, stirring frequently until vegetables are tender.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over rice or noodles.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Sausage Skillet. Cut sausage into bite-size pieces. Saute sausage and onion in skillet until onion is tender. Add vegetables, cover and simmer, stirring frequently until vegetables are tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve over rice or noodles. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Master Pie Shell
ingredients: 1 cup flour, plus more for rolling
directions: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly, add shortening., then water by spoonsful.
Bake at 475 degrees until lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Master Pie Shell. Mix dry ingredients thoroughly, add shortening., then water by spoonsful. Bake at 475 degrees until lightly browned, about 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Halloween Cookie Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Lightly grease a 12 inch pizza pan. In a large mixer bowl, beat sugar and margarine until creamy. Add egg, water and vanilla. Beat well. In a separate bowl, stir together flour, soda and salt. Add to sugar mixture, beating on low until blended. Stir in peanut butter chips. Spread batter in prepared pan to within 1/2 inch of edge. Bake 11 to 13 minutes or until set. Remove from oven. Sprinkle marshmallows, chocolate chips and nuts over top. Return to oven. Bake 5 to 7 minutes or until marshmallows are lightly browned. Cool completely.
recipes.text: Halloween Cookie Pizza. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Lightly grease a 12 inch pizza pan. In a large mixer bowl, beat sugar and margarine until creamy. Add egg, water and vanilla. Beat well. In a separate bowl, stir together flour, soda and salt. Add to sugar mixture, beating on low until blended. Stir in peanut butter chips. Spread batter in prepared pan to within 1/2 inch of edge. Bake 11 to 13 minutes or until set. Remove from oven. Sprinkle marshmallows, chocolate chips and nuts over top. Return to oven. Bake 5 to 7 minutes or until marshmallows are lightly browned. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. minced fresh ginger or 1 tsp. ground
directions: Wash and peel the eggplant; cut in half lengthwise and remove the seeds.
Mince the water chestnuts and combine with the pork or beef, onion, ginger, sherry, soy sauce, salt and sugar.
Mix well. Stuff each half of the eggplant with the mixture.
Steam for 30 minutes.
Serves 2.
recipes.text: Stuffed Eggplant. Wash and peel the eggplant; cut in half lengthwise and remove the seeds. Mince the water chestnuts and combine with the pork or beef, onion, ginger, sherry, soy sauce, salt and sugar. Mix well. Stuff each half of the eggplant with the mixture. Steam for 30 minutes. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Hoppin John (Peas And Rice)
directions: Boil ham hock and fatback in 5 cups of water for 1 half hour. Add field peas
to the ham hock and fatback.
Boil peas until tender andtkeep adding water until brown gravy appears. Then add rice and
let simmer with top on.
Stir with fork and let cook for 45 minutes.
Season to taste.
recipes.text: Hoppin John (Peas And Rice). Boil ham hock and fatback in 5 cups of water for 1 half hour. Add field peas to the ham hock and fatback. Boil peas until tender andtkeep adding water until brown gravy appears. Then add rice and let simmer with top on. Stir with fork and let cook for 45 minutes. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
directions: Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Nacho Dip. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
directions: In a large saucepan, add drained corn, onion, potatoes, milk, water and carrots.
Heat, then add bouillon cube.
Simmer on medium heat until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Thicken, if desired, with a roux (equal amounts of melted butter and flour).
recipes.text: Corn Chowder. In a large saucepan, add drained corn, onion, potatoes, milk, water and carrots. Heat, then add bouillon cube. Simmer on medium heat until potatoes are tender. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Thicken, if desired, with a roux (equal amounts of melted butter and flour).

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Dessert
directions: Mix all together.
Makes a large bowl.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Dessert. Mix all together. Makes a large bowl.

recipes.title: Cheese Puffs
directions: Hand mix all ingredients.
Spread on muffin halves.
Put in freezer 1/2 hour.
Cut each half into 8 pieces and then freeze until ready to use.
When ready to serve, place uncovered in broiler, 1 or 2 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cheese Puffs. Hand mix all ingredients. Spread on muffin halves. Put in freezer 1/2 hour. Cut each half into 8 pieces and then freeze until ready to use. When ready to serve, place uncovered in broiler, 1 or 2 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Candy Strawberries
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients.
Chill for 30 minutes in refrigerator.
Using small teaspoon, make a roll of mixture long, shaping like a strawberry.
Roll in red sugar; dip top end in green sugar.
Leave on counter to dry out; store in closed container. Keeps good for weeks.
Yields about 80.
recipes.text: Candy Strawberries. Mix the first 4 ingredients. Chill for 30 minutes in refrigerator. Using small teaspoon, make a roll of mixture long, shaping like a strawberry. Roll in red sugar; dip top end in green sugar. Leave on counter to dry out; store in closed container. Keeps good for weeks. Yields about 80.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: grated Swiss cheese or Swiss/Parmesan mixture
directions: Melt butter with oil in large kettle. Add onions. Stir and cook, uncovered, over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add sugar and salt and cook 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle on flour and cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring to brown. In another pan, bring stock to simmer, then pour it over the onions. Add herbs and white wine. Simmer on low heat, partially covered, another 20 to 30 minutes. Add salt and pepper if needed.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. Melt butter with oil in large kettle. Add onions. Stir and cook, uncovered, over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add sugar and salt and cook 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle on flour and cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring to brown. In another pan, bring stock to simmer, then pour it over the onions. Add herbs and white wine. Simmer on low heat, partially covered, another 20 to 30 minutes. Add salt and pepper if needed.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Ham Spread
directions: In bowl, combine pineapple, mayonnaise, brown sugar and mustard.
Add ground ham; mix well.
Spread bread with softened butter. Spread ham mixture on 8 slices of bread, top with lettuce leaves and remaining bread slices.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Ham Spread. In bowl, combine pineapple, mayonnaise, brown sugar and mustard. Add ground ham; mix well. Spread bread with softened butter. Spread ham mixture on 8 slices of bread, top with lettuce leaves and remaining bread slices.

recipes.title: Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut into chunks
directions: Cook chicken bouillon, water, carrots, celery and onion for 20 minutes.
Add potatoes and mixed, frozen vegetables.
Cook 30 minutes.
Add cream of mushroom soup and water.
Add Velveeta cheese.
Heat until cheese melts (do not add any salt).
recipes.text: Cheese Soup. Cook chicken bouillon, water, carrots, celery and onion for 20 minutes. Add potatoes and mixed, frozen vegetables. Cook 30 minutes. Add cream of mushroom soup and water. Add Velveeta cheese. Heat until cheese melts (do not add any salt).

recipes.title: Pennsylvania Dutch Cabbage And Meatballs
directions: Combine hamburger, rice, onion, egg, salt and pepper; mix well. Shape into medium-size meatballs. In large pot, place cabbage, water, tomato sauce, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer. Drop in meatballs; cover and simmer till cabbage is tender and meat is done. Recipe can be doubled or tripled.
recipes.text: Pennsylvania Dutch Cabbage And Meatballs. Combine hamburger, rice, onion, egg, salt and pepper; mix well. Shape into medium-size meatballs. In large pot, place cabbage, water, tomato sauce, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer. Drop in meatballs; cover and simmer till cabbage is tender and meat is done. Recipe can be doubled or tripled.

recipes.title: Oven-Blackened Salmon
ingredients: Old Bay seasoning by McCormick and Co.
directions: Line broiler pan with foil and spray with butter spray. Squeeze the juice of 1/2 lemon over fillets.
Sprinkle top of each fillet generously with Old Bay seasoning and spray lightly with Pam.
Broil 4 inches from heat for 7 minutes.
Turn over and repeat on other side.
recipes.text: Oven-Blackened Salmon. Line broiler pan with foil and spray with butter spray. Squeeze the juice of 1/2 lemon over fillets. Sprinkle top of each fillet generously with Old Bay seasoning and spray lightly with Pam. Broil 4 inches from heat for 7 minutes. Turn over and repeat on other side.

recipes.title: He Man Dish
directions: Cook onions in oleo for a few minutes.
Take out.
Cook ground beef in pan where onions were cooked.
Cook until red is gone.
In 9 x 13-inch pan, put layer of noodles, layer of onions, and sprinkle thyme, Accent, pepper and salt over meat.
Mix milk with mushroom soup.
Pour over meat and noodle mixture.
Before baking, add cheese to top and pour beaten egg over top.
Bake for 30 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: He Man Dish. Cook onions in oleo for a few minutes. Take out. Cook ground beef in pan where onions were cooked. Cook until red is gone. In 9 x 13-inch pan, put layer of noodles, layer of onions, and sprinkle thyme, Accent, pepper and salt over meat. Mix milk with mushroom soup. Pour over meat and noodle mixture. Before baking, add cheese to top and pour beaten egg over top. Bake for 30 minutes in 350u00b0 oven. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Streamlined White Bread
directions: In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water.
Add shortening, sugar, salt and half the flour. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed or 300 strokes.
Scrape sides and bottom often.
recipes.text: Streamlined White Bread. In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water. Add shortening, sugar, salt and half the flour. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed or 300 strokes. Scrape sides and bottom often.

recipes.title: Salami
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Refrigerate in a covered bowl.
The following two mornings, mix the ingredients well and return to refrigerator.
On fourth day, form into rolls, place in pans and bake eight hours at 180u00b0.
An alternative method is to wrap the rolls in foil, prick the foil and boil for 1 hour.
Let the salami set 24 hours before eating.
recipes.text: Salami. Mix all ingredients well. Refrigerate in a covered bowl. The following two mornings, mix the ingredients well and return to refrigerator. On fourth day, form into rolls, place in pans and bake eight hours at 180u00b0. An alternative method is to wrap the rolls in foil, prick the foil and boil for 1 hour. Let the salami set 24 hours before eating.

recipes.title: Biscotti-Italian Dunking Cookies
directions: Beat egg, sugar and anise well.
Add flour, then add almonds. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Spread on oiled wax paper.
When baked, flip over and take wax paper off and cut in strips about 1 inch thick and cut each strip in 4 or 5 pieces.
Put back on pan and bake until toasted well.
recipes.text: Biscotti-Italian Dunking Cookies. Beat egg, sugar and anise well. Add flour, then add almonds. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes. Spread on oiled wax paper. When baked, flip over and take wax paper off and cut in strips about 1 inch thick and cut each strip in 4 or 5 pieces. Put back on pan and bake until toasted well.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In blender or food processor, process oats until coarse flour.
In small bowl, combine ground oats, flour, salt and baking soda; set aside.
In large mixing bowl with electric mixer on high, beat butter and brown sugar until light and creamy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla until well combined. Gradually stir in flour mixture until combined.
Stir in chocolate chips and pecans.
Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown.
Remove to wire rack; cool completely.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In blender or food processor, process oats until coarse flour. In small bowl, combine ground oats, flour, salt and baking soda; set aside. In large mixing bowl with electric mixer on high, beat butter and brown sugar until light and creamy. Beat in eggs and vanilla until well combined. Gradually stir in flour mixture until combined. Stir in chocolate chips and pecans. Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls onto ungreased baking sheets. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown. Remove to wire rack; cool completely.

recipes.title: Bill'S Chili Cheese Crab Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
directions: Let cream cheese reach room temperature. Cream mayonnaise, cream cheese and seasoned salt. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes, onion and crab meat. Mix thoroughly and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.
recipes.text: Bill'S Chili Cheese Crab Dip. Let cream cheese reach room temperature. Cream mayonnaise, cream cheese and seasoned salt. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes, onion and crab meat. Mix thoroughly and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.

recipes.title: Pecan Puffs
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Cream butter and sugar; add salt and vanilla.
Add flour and pecans.
Roll in small balls.
Bake for about 15 minutes.
Roll in powdered sugar while warm.
recipes.text: Pecan Puffs. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Cream butter and sugar; add salt and vanilla. Add flour and pecans. Roll in small balls. Bake for about 15 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

recipes.title: 15 Minute Apple Butter
ingredients: 1 pkg. cinnamon drops or red hots
directions: Cook together apples, sugar and vinegar for 10 minutes.
Add cinnamon drops and cook 5 minutes more.
Pack in hot sterile jars. Makes 5 pints.
recipes.text: 15 Minute Apple Butter. Cook together apples, sugar and vinegar for 10 minutes. Add cinnamon drops and cook 5 minutes more. Pack in hot sterile jars. Makes 5 pints.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. rippled edge lasagna noodles
directions: Brown meat in 3-quart saucepan; add sauce and simmer about 10 minutes.
Cook lasagna according to package directions.

Mix together Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese, eggs, parsley, salt and pepper for filling. Starting with noodles, layer noodles, sauce and cheese, making sure you have cheese to go on top.
Bake covered with aluminum foil at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.
Remove foil, bake for 10 minutes more, until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Brown meat in 3-quart saucepan; add sauce and simmer about 10 minutes. Cook lasagna according to package directions. Mix together Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese, eggs, parsley, salt and pepper for filling. Starting with noodles, layer noodles, sauce and cheese, making sure you have cheese to go on top. Bake covered with aluminum foil at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Remove foil, bake for 10 minutes more, until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Taco Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pkg. taco seasoning, mix with 1 c. water
directions: Wash potatoes and rub with oil.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 1 hour or until soft when pierced with a fork.
Cook ground beef and onion in a large skillet until beef is browned; drain well.
Add seasoning mix and water; reduce heat and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Split tops of potatoes lengthwise and fluff pulp with a fork.
Spoon topping over potatoes.
Top each with 1 tablespoon sour cream.
recipes.text: Taco Baked Potatoes. Wash potatoes and rub with oil. Bake at 400u00b0 for 1 hour or until soft when pierced with a fork. Cook ground beef and onion in a large skillet until beef is browned; drain well. Add seasoning mix and water; reduce heat and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Split tops of potatoes lengthwise and fluff pulp with a fork. Spoon topping over potatoes. Top each with 1 tablespoon sour cream.

recipes.title: Marinated Mushrooms
directions: Clean and boil mushrooms for 15 to 20 minutes; drain.
Cut onion into chunks.
Mix sugar, vinegar, oil, oregano and salt. Combine with mushrooms and onion.
Marinate 24 hours.
Drain before serving.
recipes.text: Marinated Mushrooms. Clean and boil mushrooms for 15 to 20 minutes; drain. Cut onion into chunks. Mix sugar, vinegar, oil, oregano and salt. Combine with mushrooms and onion. Marinate 24 hours. Drain before serving.

recipes.title: Mom'S Chocolate Candy
directions: Pour sugar, margarine, milk mixture over top and mix gently until well mixed.
Spread in buttered pan.
Let stand until hard. Cut into squares.
Makes 5 pounds.
Great for Christmas.
recipes.text: Mom'S Chocolate Candy. Pour sugar, margarine, milk mixture over top and mix gently until well mixed. Spread in buttered pan. Let stand until hard. Cut into squares. Makes 5 pounds. Great for Christmas.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Beat the egg yolks and add 2 cups of milk.
Add to the sugar and flour.
Cook over medium/low heat and stir until as thick as desired, stirring constantly.
Add vanilla.
In a bowl, put a layer of vanilla wafers and layer of sliced bananas; pour cooled sauce over that.
Repeat layers again; last layer should be wafers.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Beat the egg yolks and add 2 cups of milk. Add to the sugar and flour. Cook over medium/low heat and stir until as thick as desired, stirring constantly. Add vanilla. In a bowl, put a layer of vanilla wafers and layer of sliced bananas; pour cooled sauce over that. Repeat layers again; last layer should be wafers.

recipes.title: Barbecued Pork Chops
directions: Mix all ingredients well; bring to boil.
Cook on moderate heat for 10 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour over 8 pork chops in deep bowl and cool.
Can stand overnight.
Arrange chops in shallow baking pan and add sauce.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0.
Baste occasionally.
recipes.text: Barbecued Pork Chops. Mix all ingredients well; bring to boil. Cook on moderate heat for 10 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Pour over 8 pork chops in deep bowl and cool. Can stand overnight. Arrange chops in shallow baking pan and add sauce. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0. Baste occasionally.

recipes.title: Frozen Daiquiri
directions: Mix, stir and freeze for 3 days.
recipes.text: Frozen Daiquiri. Mix, stir and freeze for 3 days.

recipes.title: 1-2-3 Cup Chocolate Pie
directions: Cook pie crust as directed.
Combine flour, sugar, milk and egg yolks in large microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes at a time, stirring after each cycle, until thick.
(It may take as long as 10 minutes.)
After filling starts to thicken, add vanilla, butter and salt; stir well.
Continue to microwave until done.
Add cocoa and mix until well combined.
Pour into pie crusts.
recipes.text: 1-2-3 Cup Chocolate Pie. Cook pie crust as directed. Combine flour, sugar, milk and egg yolks in large microwave-safe bowl. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes at a time, stirring after each cycle, until thick. (It may take as long as 10 minutes.) After filling starts to thicken, add vanilla, butter and salt; stir well. Continue to microwave until done. Add cocoa and mix until well combined. Pour into pie crusts.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Sauce
directions: Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper; drain.
Add all remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Simmer and serve.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Sauce. Brown ground beef, onion and green pepper; drain. Add all remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer and serve.

recipes.title: Parsleyed Potatoes(No Fat)
ingredients: a good sprinkle of Molly McButter
directions: Peel and pare potatoes into small cubes.
Cook until tender and drain.
Add all the ingredients, stirring just until mixed well.
recipes.text: Parsleyed Potatoes(No Fat). Peel and pare potatoes into small cubes. Cook until tender and drain. Add all the ingredients, stirring just until mixed well.

recipes.title: Ravioli Chicken Salad
ingredients: 3 (4 oz.) pkg. lemon herb-flavored skinless boneless chicken breasts
1 (9 oz.) pkg. low-fat cheese-and-garlic flavored ravioli or plain low-fat cheese ravioli
1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped
1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
directions: Cook chicken according to package directions; cut into small pieces and set aside.
recipes.text: Ravioli Chicken Salad. Cook chicken according to package directions; cut into small pieces and set aside.

recipes.title: Brunch Enchiladas
ingredients: few drops bottled hot pepper sauce (optional)
directions: In a bowl, combine ground ham, onions and green pepper.
Place 1/3 cup of the mixture and 3 tablespoons shredded cheese at one end of each tortilla. Roll up. Arrange tortillas, seam side down, in a greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Brunch Enchiladas. In a bowl, combine ground ham, onions and green pepper. Place 1/3 cup of the mixture and 3 tablespoons shredded cheese at one end of each tortilla. Roll up. Arrange tortillas, seam side down, in a greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: French Coconut And Pineapple Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well; pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until set.
Serve with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: French Coconut And Pineapple Pie. Mix all ingredients well; pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until set. Serve with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Pizza Potatoes Casserole
directions: Empty potato slices (and seasoned sauce packet) into an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish.
Heat tomatoes, water and oregano to a boil.
Stir into potatoes.
Arrange pepperoni on top and sprinkle with cheese.
recipes.text: Pizza Potatoes Casserole. Empty potato slices (and seasoned sauce packet) into an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish. Heat tomatoes, water and oregano to a boil. Stir into potatoes. Arrange pepperoni on top and sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Mad Mex Nachos
ingredients: 1 (10 oz) pkg yellow or white corn tortilla chips
directions: Cook sausage until brown and crumbly; drain and keep warm. Place tortilla chips on a baking sheet. Combine refried beans and picante sauce in a sauce pan, heat until warm, stirring occasionally. Spoon bean mixture over chips. Top with sausage, tomatoes, cheese and peppers. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Top with guacamole and sour cream.
recipes.text: Mad Mex Nachos. Cook sausage until brown and crumbly; drain and keep warm. Place tortilla chips on a baking sheet. Combine refried beans and picante sauce in a sauce pan, heat until warm, stirring occasionally. Spoon bean mixture over chips. Top with sausage, tomatoes, cheese and peppers. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Top with guacamole and sour cream.

recipes.title: Peach And Poppy Seed Muffins
ingredients: 2/3 c. pureed peaches (use Junior baby food peaches if you cannot get good fresh peaches)
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease muffin tins for a dozen muffins.
recipes.text: Peach And Poppy Seed Muffins. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease muffin tins for a dozen muffins.

recipes.title: Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 small onion, finely chopped or 1 c. ground onions, drained
1 pt. tangy salad dressing (can be Miracle Whip with mustard added)
directions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.
Serve on bed of lettuce.
recipes.text: Bread Salad. Mix together and refrigerate overnight. Serve on bed of lettuce.

recipes.title: Nanny'S Pineapple Drop Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla and beat.
Stir in flour and salt, then add crushed pineapple.
Drop onto cookie sheets and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Nanny'S Pineapple Drop Cookies. Cream together shortening and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and beat. Stir in flour and salt, then add crushed pineapple. Drop onto cookie sheets and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vinegar Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Simmer until thickened.
Pour into shell and bake until brown.
recipes.text: Vinegar Pie. Mix all ingredients well. Simmer until thickened. Pour into shell and bake until brown.

recipes.title: Moist Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Lightly spray cookie sheet with cooking spray.
In large bowl, mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
In separate bowl, whisk together shortening, applesauce, granulated sugar and brown sugar.
Mix well.
Fold in oats and raisins.
Add flour mixture; stir well.
recipes.text: Moist Oatmeal Cookies. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Lightly spray cookie sheet with cooking spray. In large bowl, mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. In separate bowl, whisk together shortening, applesauce, granulated sugar and brown sugar. Mix well. Fold in oats and raisins. Add flour mixture; stir well.

recipes.title: Peanut Crisps
directions: Lightly butter 13 x 9-inch baking pan; set aside.
In 3-quart saucepan, combine butter, peanut butter and half the chocolate pieces.
Stir constantly over low heat until chocolate melts.
Add marshmallows, stirring until melted.
Stir in cereal and peanuts.
recipes.text: Peanut Crisps. Lightly butter 13 x 9-inch baking pan; set aside. In 3-quart saucepan, combine butter, peanut butter and half the chocolate pieces. Stir constantly over low heat until chocolate melts. Add marshmallows, stirring until melted. Stir in cereal and peanuts.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients; pour into pie shell.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Combine all ingredients; pour into pie shell. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
directions: In a double boiler, combine caramels and 1/3 cup milk.
Melt. Set aside.
Grease and flour pan.
Mix cake mix, butter, 1/3 cup milk and nuts.
Press 1/2 dough in pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 minutes.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips over dough; then spread over with caramel mix.
Crumble rest of dough on caramel.
Cool slightly and then refrigerate at least 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake. In a double boiler, combine caramels and 1/3 cup milk. Melt. Set aside. Grease and flour pan. Mix cake mix, butter, 1/3 cup milk and nuts. Press 1/2 dough in pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 6 minutes. Sprinkle with chocolate chips over dough; then spread over with caramel mix. Crumble rest of dough on caramel. Cool slightly and then refrigerate at least 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Maud'S Chocolate Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, margarine and milk. Bring to a boil.
Stir over medium heat to 238u00b0 or soft ball stage.
recipes.text: Maud'S Chocolate Fudge. Combine sugar, margarine and milk. Bring to a boil. Stir over medium heat to 238u00b0 or soft ball stage.

recipes.title: Fish Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 lb. fillet of sole or orange roughy
directions: Brush fillets with mayonnaise.
Mix cheese and crumbs.
Roll fish in crumb mixture.
Place in baking dish.
Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.
Bake in preheated oven at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until fish is lightly browned and flakes easily with fork.
recipes.text: Fish Au Gratin. Brush fillets with mayonnaise. Mix cheese and crumbs. Roll fish in crumb mixture. Place in baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Bake in preheated oven at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes until fish is lightly browned and flakes easily with fork.

recipes.title: Simply Scrumptious
ingredients: 1 large pkg. partially thawed frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots)
1 can creamed mushroom, chicken or celery soup
1/2 c. Swiss or Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Mix vegetables, soup, sour cream, shredded cheese and 1/2 can French fried onion rings together.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
Sprinkle remaining French fried onion rings on top.
Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until bubbly; serve hot.
recipes.text: Simply Scrumptious. Mix vegetables, soup, sour cream, shredded cheese and 1/2 can French fried onion rings together. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes at 350u00b0. Sprinkle remaining French fried onion rings on top. Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until bubbly; serve hot.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Beat eggs and pour into sugar mixture.
Add syrup, salt and vanilla.
Add nuts.
Stir and pour into unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Cream margarine and sugar. Beat eggs and pour into sugar mixture. Add syrup, salt and vanilla. Add nuts. Stir and pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Souffle
directions: Butter dish; dust with Parmesan cheese.
In blender, add all ingredients; blend at medium until smooth, then at high speed for another 10 to 15 seconds.
Pour into dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes, until brown.
recipes.text: Cheese Souffle. Butter dish; dust with Parmesan cheese. In blender, add all ingredients; blend at medium until smooth, then at high speed for another 10 to 15 seconds. Pour into dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes, until brown.

recipes.title: Pineapple Lemon Punch
directions: Put all this in a gallon jug.
Finish with water
recipes.text: Pineapple Lemon Punch. Put all this in a gallon jug. Finish with water

recipes.title: New Banana Pudding
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) box instant French vanilla pudding
directions: Split Twinkies lengthwise.
Place cream side up in bottom of 15x9x2 pan.
Peel bananas and slice over Twinkies.
Prepare pudding with milk.
Pour over top of bananas.
Spread to cover. Spread Cool Whip over pudding.
Cover and chill 12 servings.
recipes.text: New Banana Pudding. Split Twinkies lengthwise. Place cream side up in bottom of 15x9x2 pan. Peel bananas and slice over Twinkies. Prepare pudding with milk. Pour over top of bananas. Spread to cover. Spread Cool Whip over pudding. Cover and chill 12 servings.

recipes.title: Pot Roast With Vegetables
ingredients: 4 to 5 lb. boneless beef chuck roast
8 small all-purpose potatoes, scrubbed and quartered
8 medium carrots, pared and cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: Season the meat with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in Dutch oven or roaster pan; brown meat.
Add the onions and puree.
Reduce the heat to low; cover and simmer for 2 hours.
Add potatoes and carrots; cover and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes, until vegetables are soft.
Remove meat and vegetables to serving platter.
In small bowl, combine flour with water; stir into pan liquid.
Cook for 2 minutes, until gravy is thickened, stirring constantly.
To serve, put gravy over sliced meat and vegetables.
recipes.text: Pot Roast With Vegetables. Season the meat with salt and pepper. Heat oil in Dutch oven or roaster pan; brown meat. Add the onions and puree. Reduce the heat to low; cover and simmer for 2 hours. Add potatoes and carrots; cover and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes, until vegetables are soft. Remove meat and vegetables to serving platter. In small bowl, combine flour with water; stir into pan liquid. Cook for 2 minutes, until gravy is thickened, stirring constantly. To serve, put gravy over sliced meat and vegetables.

recipes.title: Chili Dip
directions: Spread cream cheese in microwavable dish.
Pour Hormel chili over top of cream cheese.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Microwave on High for 3 minutes or until cheese melts.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Chili Dip. Spread cream cheese in microwavable dish. Pour Hormel chili over top of cream cheese. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Microwave on High for 3 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
ingredients: cinnamon, nutmeg and sugar to taste
directions: Mix together.
Place in pie crust.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until apples are soft.
May use top crust, if desired.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Mix together. Place in pie crust. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until apples are soft. May use top crust, if desired.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Beat first 3 ingredients together.
Add eggs and beat again. Add remaining ingredients.
Place small balls on greased cookie sheets; flatten slightly with fork.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375u00b0.
Makes about 50 large cookies.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Beat first 3 ingredients together. Add eggs and beat again. Add remaining ingredients. Place small balls on greased cookie sheets; flatten slightly with fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375u00b0. Makes about 50 large cookies.

recipes.title: Onion Roasted Potatoes
directions: Cut potatoes into small chunks.
Do not peel.
Place in a plastic bag (I use a clean grocery bag, but check for holes first) and add other ingredients. Shake and use hands on outside of bag until well coated.
Place in large baking pan and bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes until done.
I spray with Pam first. Also, if you use more potatoes and want a more oniony taste, increase oil and use 2 packs soup mix.
recipes.text: Onion Roasted Potatoes. Cut potatoes into small chunks. Do not peel. Place in a plastic bag (I use a clean grocery bag, but check for holes first) and add other ingredients. Shake and use hands on outside of bag until well coated. Place in large baking pan and bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes until done. I spray with Pam first. Also, if you use more potatoes and want a more oniony taste, increase oil and use 2 packs soup mix.

recipes.title: Golden Treasure Pie
directions: Combine pineapple, sugar, cornstarch and water in small saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Blend sugar and butter, flour, cheese, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Slowly add eggs and milk to cheese mixture, beating constantly.
Pour pineapple into crust, spreading evenly.
Gently pour custard over pineapple, being careful not to disturb first layer.
Bake at 425u00b0
for 15 minutes, then at 325u00b0
for 45 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Golden Treasure Pie. Combine pineapple, sugar, cornstarch and water in small saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Blend sugar and butter, flour, cheese, vanilla and salt until smooth. Slowly add eggs and milk to cheese mixture, beating constantly. Pour pineapple into crust, spreading evenly. Gently pour custard over pineapple, being careful not to disturb first layer. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes, then at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Crazy Cake
directions: Sift the flour, cocoa, baking soda, sugar, salt and baking powder into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan.
Make three holes in the mixture and into the first hole put the vanilla, into the second hole put the vinegar and into the third hole put the melted shortening.
Pour the hot water over the whole mixture and mix until smooth.
Bake at 350u00b0 about 30 minutes, or until firm to the touch.
Frost with favorite frosting.
recipes.text: Crazy Cake. Sift the flour, cocoa, baking soda, sugar, salt and baking powder into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan. Make three holes in the mixture and into the first hole put the vanilla, into the second hole put the vinegar and into the third hole put the melted shortening. Pour the hot water over the whole mixture and mix until smooth. Bake at 350u00b0 about 30 minutes, or until firm to the touch. Frost with favorite frosting.

recipes.title: Mexicali Tacos
directions: Brown the hamburger, onion and green pepper.
Add taco seasoning and stir completely.
Add soups.
Cook 10 to 15 minutes. Serve in taco shells with shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese and sour cream.
recipes.text: Mexicali Tacos. Brown the hamburger, onion and green pepper. Add taco seasoning and stir completely. Add soups. Cook 10 to 15 minutes. Serve in taco shells with shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Favorite Corn And  Meat Hot Dish
directions: Brown meat with green pepper, onion and celery.
Let simmer 10 minutes. Drain fat from mixture.
Cook macaroni rings according to directions on package. Drain.
Add to meat mixture with the corn, soup and salt.
Bake in a large casserole 1 hour at 300u00b0.
Serves 15. Garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Favorite Corn And  Meat Hot Dish. Brown meat with green pepper, onion and celery. Let simmer 10 minutes. Drain fat from mixture. Cook macaroni rings according to directions on package. Drain. Add to meat mixture with the corn, soup and salt. Bake in a large casserole 1 hour at 300u00b0. Serves 15. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Magic Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350.
Melt margarine in a 9x13 glass dish. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine.
Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs.
Sprinkle morsels, coconut, and nuts evenly.
Press down lightly.
Bake 25 -30 minutes or until lightly brown.
Allow to cool before cutting into bars.
recipes.text: Magic Bars. Preheat oven to 350. Melt margarine in a 9x13 glass dish. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine. Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Sprinkle morsels, coconut, and nuts evenly. Press down lightly. Bake 25 -30 minutes or until lightly brown. Allow to cool before cutting into bars.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken; do not add salt.
Pick it off the bone; set aside.
Save chicken broth.
Melt margarine; stir into dressing. Save some dressing for top.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken; do not add salt. Pick it off the bone; set aside. Save chicken broth. Melt margarine; stir into dressing. Save some dressing for top.

recipes.title: Summer Waldorf Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 large red apples, cored, coarsely chopped
directions: Cook rice in water with salt according to package directions. When cooking is complete, transfer to shallow pan.
Cover and chill.
Fold whipped topping and sugar into mayonnaise.
Fold topping mixture, celery, apples, raisins and walnuts into chilled rice.
Sprinkle with cinnamon before serving.
recipes.text: Summer Waldorf Rice Salad. Cook rice in water with salt according to package directions. When cooking is complete, transfer to shallow pan. Cover and chill. Fold whipped topping and sugar into mayonnaise. Fold topping mixture, celery, apples, raisins and walnuts into chilled rice. Sprinkle with cinnamon before serving.

recipes.title: Vivian Green'S Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can tomato sauce with bits, divided 2/3 can
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Retain 1/3 can tomato sauce.
Bake in metal pan 1 hour at 425u00b0.
After cooking drain grease and top with sauce.
Cook 10-15 minutes more.
recipes.text: Vivian Green'S Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients. Retain 1/3 can tomato sauce. Bake in metal pan 1 hour at 425u00b0. After cooking drain grease and top with sauce. Cook 10-15 minutes more.

recipes.title: Oatmeal-Sunflower Bread
ingredients: 5 1/2 c. flour (1 c. white, 4 1/2 c. whole wheat)
directions: Pour boiling water over oats and salt; let stand 1 hour. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.
Add yeast to oats after they have stood 1 hour.
Add remaining ingredients in order. Knead in enough flour (any extra should be of whole wheat as there is enough white to allow this bread to be light) to make a smooth velvety dough.
Let rise to twice original size.
Knead down. Shape into 2 loaves, place in oiled bread pans and cover.
Let rise to 2/3 finished size (allowing for 1/3 rise in oven) and bake about 1 hour at 350u00b0.
A delicious sandwich bread.
Try it with mayonnaise and alfalfa sprouts.
recipes.text: Oatmeal-Sunflower Bread. Pour boiling water over oats and salt; let stand 1 hour. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add yeast to oats after they have stood 1 hour. Add remaining ingredients in order. Knead in enough flour (any extra should be of whole wheat as there is enough white to allow this bread to be light) to make a smooth velvety dough. Let rise to twice original size. Knead down. Shape into 2 loaves, place in oiled bread pans and cover. Let rise to 2/3 finished size (allowing for 1/3 rise in oven) and bake about 1 hour at 350u00b0. A delicious sandwich bread. Try it with mayonnaise and alfalfa sprouts.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. chicken thighs or breasts
directions: Sprinkle onion soup in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with rice. Combine water with mushroom soup and pour over rice.
Arrange chicken pieces on top.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover with foil.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Sprinkle onion soup in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with rice. Combine water with mushroom soup and pour over rice. Arrange chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with foil. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Potatoes
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together and put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix corn flakes and butter and put on top.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Potatoes. Mix first 6 ingredients together and put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix corn flakes and butter and put on top.

recipes.title: Spaghetti In Garlic Sauce
directions: Melt together olive oil and butter until warm, not hot.
Saute garlic for 5 minutes.
Add salt, pepper, oregano and parsley. Simmer 5 minutes.
Toss with cooked spaghetti.
recipes.text: Spaghetti In Garlic Sauce. Melt together olive oil and butter until warm, not hot. Saute garlic for 5 minutes. Add salt, pepper, oregano and parsley. Simmer 5 minutes. Toss with cooked spaghetti.

recipes.title: Homemade Sherbet
ingredients: 1 liter bottle orange soda or strawberry soda
directions: Mix and freeze in ice cream freezer.
recipes.text: Homemade Sherbet. Mix and freeze in ice cream freezer.

recipes.title: Hot Turkey Salad
ingredients: 1 6 oz. can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1/2 small green pepper, cut in strips
directions: Brown 1 1/2 pounds hamburger with chopped onions.
Add 1 can grated spam.
Add 1 pound grated cheese (mozzarella works well). Add 1 quart spaghetti sauce.
recipes.text: Hot Turkey Salad. Brown 1 1/2 pounds hamburger with chopped onions. Add 1 can grated spam. Add 1 pound grated cheese (mozzarella works well). Add 1 quart spaghetti sauce.

recipes.title: Popovers
directions: Beat together with rotary beater until smooth.
Pour into well-greased deep muffin cups 3/4 full or oven-glass cups 1/2 full.
Bake 425u00b0 until golden brown for 35 to 45 minutes.
Makes 5 to 9 popovers.
recipes.text: Popovers. Beat together with rotary beater until smooth. Pour into well-greased deep muffin cups 3/4 full or oven-glass cups 1/2 full. Bake 425u00b0 until golden brown for 35 to 45 minutes. Makes 5 to 9 popovers.

recipes.title: Glazed Spice Bars
directions: Combine first 9 ingredients and mix well.
(This can be mixed without a mixer.
Dough will be stiff.)
Pack into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Spread glaze over top while hot.
Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares.
Yields about 48 squares.
recipes.text: Glazed Spice Bars. Combine first 9 ingredients and mix well. (This can be mixed without a mixer. Dough will be stiff.) Pack into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Spread glaze over top while hot. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares. Yields about 48 squares.

recipes.title: Apple Pound Cake
directions: Mix oil, eggs and sugar well.
Sift flour, salt, cinnamon and soda together.
Add vanilla and apples.
Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Apple Pound Cake. Mix oil, eggs and sugar well. Sift flour, salt, cinnamon and soda together. Add vanilla and apples. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines butter cake mix (chocolate)
1 pkg. instant chocolate pudding mix (4 serving size)
directions: Remove a spoonful of cake mix and use to coat the chips and nuts.
Set aside.
Combine cake mix, eggs, oil, water, vanilla, pudding mix and sour cream.
Mix well.
Fold in chocolate chips and nuts.
Turn into a greased 10-inch tube pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tests done.
Cool and frost.
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Chocolate Cake. Remove a spoonful of cake mix and use to coat the chips and nuts. Set aside. Combine cake mix, eggs, oil, water, vanilla, pudding mix and sour cream. Mix well. Fold in chocolate chips and nuts. Turn into a greased 10-inch tube pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: decrusted bread (to cover top of casserole)
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Layer in baking dish the asparagus, peas, onion, soup and cheese.
Melt oleo.
Dip decrusted bread in oleo and place on top of dish.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Layer in baking dish the asparagus, peas, onion, soup and cheese. Melt oleo. Dip decrusted bread in oleo and place on top of dish. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Rings
directions: Melt white sugar, brown sugar, water and margarine in baking dish.
Make enough pastry for 2 pies.
Roll out and sprinkle with cinnamon and salt.
Grate apples onto pastry and roll as for a jelly roll.
Cut into 1 inch rings and lay in baking dish.
Bake for 20 minutes at 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Apple Rings. Melt white sugar, brown sugar, water and margarine in baking dish. Make enough pastry for 2 pies. Roll out and sprinkle with cinnamon and salt. Grate apples onto pastry and roll as for a jelly roll. Cut into 1 inch rings and lay in baking dish. Bake for 20 minutes at 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Yolie'S Wassail
directions: Cook all ingredients except apple cider until thoroughly warmed.
Add apple cider.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Yolie'S Wassail. Cook all ingredients except apple cider until thoroughly warmed. Add apple cider. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Low Sat-Fat Chex Snak Mix
directions: Mix all cereals, pretzels, and nuts together in large bowl. In small bowl or in measuring cup, mix remaining ingredients well. Pour liquid mix over cereal mix and toss to coat cereals well. Place in microwave on 80% power for 4 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes.
Microwave on 100% power for 2 minutes.
Stir.
Let cool. If you are using wheat or bran Chex, wait until last 2 minutes to add these.
recipes.text: Low Sat-Fat Chex Snak Mix. Mix all cereals, pretzels, and nuts together in large bowl. In small bowl or in measuring cup, mix remaining ingredients well. Pour liquid mix over cereal mix and toss to coat cereals well. Place in microwave on 80% power for 4 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. Microwave on 100% power for 2 minutes. Stir. Let cool. If you are using wheat or bran Chex, wait until last 2 minutes to add these.

recipes.title: Freezer Box Cucumbers
directions: Dissolve your sugar in vinegar with salt and celery seed. Pour over your onion and cucumbers; let set an hour.
Then pack away in the freezer.
recipes.text: Freezer Box Cucumbers. Dissolve your sugar in vinegar with salt and celery seed. Pour over your onion and cucumbers; let set an hour. Then pack away in the freezer.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 medium jar maraschino cherries, halved (with juice)
directions: Add all ingredients well. Chill in the refrigerator and serve.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Add all ingredients well. Chill in the refrigerator and serve.

recipes.title: Icebox Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can cut green beans, drained
1 (16 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Combine all vegetables in a large, glass bowl; set aside.
recipes.text: Icebox Vegetable Salad. Combine all vegetables in a large, glass bowl; set aside.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. cinnamon graham crackers (3 pkg. to a 14 oz. box)
directions: Crush graham crackers.
Boil first 3 ingredients for 1 minute. On cookie sheet, sprinkle almonds; pour butter mix over.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Cookies. Crush graham crackers. Boil first 3 ingredients for 1 minute. On cookie sheet, sprinkle almonds; pour butter mix over. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Dressing
ingredients: red pepper, garlic salt and seasoned salt to taste
directions: Saute onions, celery and bell pepper in margarine until golden brown on low
heat.
Add
crabmeat,
soup, green onions and parsley.
Cook 15 to 20 minutes.
Season to taste with red pepper, garlic salt and seasoned salt.
Remove from heat.
Add bread crumbs.
Pour into
buttered 3 quart oblong baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Dressing. Saute onions, celery and bell pepper in margarine until golden brown on low heat. Add crabmeat, soup, green onions and parsley. Cook 15 to 20 minutes. Season to taste with red pepper, garlic salt and seasoned salt. Remove from heat. Add bread crumbs. Pour into buttered 3 quart oblong baking dish. Bake, uncovered, for 40 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Pound Cake(Two Flours)
directions: Cream sugar and Crisco with electric mixer on medium speed. Let eggs reach room temperature.
Add eggs one at a time, creaming well.
Add vanilla, milk and flour.
Blend about 2 minutes at medium speed.
Pour in tube pan and bake 1 hour at 325u00b0 or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Pound Cake(Two Flours). Cream sugar and Crisco with electric mixer on medium speed. Let eggs reach room temperature. Add eggs one at a time, creaming well. Add vanilla, milk and flour. Blend about 2 minutes at medium speed. Pour in tube pan and bake 1 hour at 325u00b0 or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Fruit Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 3/4 c. shortening (can use part butter, if desired)
directions: Mix sugar and gelatin together.
Add shortening and eggs; blend well.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt; add to mixture. Roll out 1/4-inch thick on a floured board.
Cut out with 3-inch cookie cutter.
Place on greased baking sheet and bake for 6 to 8 minutes at 375u00b0.
Makes around 4 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Fruit Sugar Cookies. Mix sugar and gelatin together. Add shortening and eggs; blend well. Sift flour, baking powder and salt; add to mixture. Roll out 1/4-inch thick on a floured board. Cut out with 3-inch cookie cutter. Place on greased baking sheet and bake for 6 to 8 minutes at 375u00b0. Makes around 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Mix all ingredients in large mixer bowl and blend well.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake tests done.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Cake. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Mix all ingredients in large mixer bowl and blend well. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake tests done.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
directions: Mix together grated apples, sugar, eggs and melted butter. Add milk and cinnamon and mix all together.
Pour into unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Mix together grated apples, sugar, eggs and melted butter. Add milk and cinnamon and mix all together. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.

recipes.title: Frozen Cherry Salad
directions: Mix, freeze and serve frozen.
recipes.text: Frozen Cherry Salad. Mix, freeze and serve frozen.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, margarine, sugar, egg yolks and sour cream. Then add flour and beat well.
Slightly beat in egg whites a little at a time.
Do not beat batter again.
Pour in greased tube pan and bake at 300u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Pound Cake. Cream butter, margarine, sugar, egg yolks and sour cream. Then add flour and beat well. Slightly beat in egg whites a little at a time. Do not beat batter again. Pour in greased tube pan and bake at 300u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken And Stuffing Casserole
directions: Put chicken in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish.
Mix soup and milk and pour over chicken.
Stir.
Make stuffing mix according to directions and put this on top of chicken.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chicken And Stuffing Casserole. Put chicken in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix soup and milk and pour over chicken. Stir. Make stuffing mix according to directions and put this on top of chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Pickled Beets
directions: Slice beets.
Add sugar, vinegar and spices.
Cook over medium heat. Bring to slow boil and let cook a few minutes.
Take off and let cool.
recipes.text: Pickled Beets. Slice beets. Add sugar, vinegar and spices. Cook over medium heat. Bring to slow boil and let cook a few minutes. Take off and let cool.

recipes.title: Mountain Chow Chow(5 Gallon Recipe)
directions: Chop cabbage very fine. Chop green tomatoes and hot pepper; mix together with cabbage. Pack in a crock jar (stone jar) tightly. Use 5 cups per layer.
