Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon of canning salt over the first layer. Then add another layer of cabbage mix and canning salt. Pack tightly and continue until the crock jar is full. Place a plate on top of packed cabbage mix. Then place a flint rock on top of the plate and cover with a cloth or a tight cover. Let it "work" for 9 days.
recipes.text: Mountain Chow Chow(5 Gallon Recipe). Chop cabbage very fine. Chop green tomatoes and hot pepper; mix together with cabbage. Pack in a crock jar (stone jar) tightly. Use 5 cups per layer. Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon of canning salt over the first layer. Then add another layer of cabbage mix and canning salt. Pack tightly and continue until the crock jar is full. Place a plate on top of packed cabbage mix. Then place a flint rock on top of the plate and cover with a cloth or a tight cover. Let it "work" for 9 days.

recipes.title: Frenchies Toasties
directions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients until smooth.
Dip the bread into the mixture, one at a time.
In a large frying pan, place 2 teaspoons Puritan oil.
Heat and add the dipped bread. Fry until golden brown on each side on a medium heat.

Place all the slices in the pan, on low heat and cover for about 3 minutes. This will plump up the slices. Serve with whipped cream or canned pie filling, jelly, powdered sugar or syrup. Ice cream can also be used.
These can be frozen and reheated in microwave at a later date if left over.
Makes 8 to 10 slices.
recipes.text: Frenchies Toasties. Mix together the first 5 ingredients until smooth. Dip the bread into the mixture, one at a time. In a large frying pan, place 2 teaspoons Puritan oil. Heat and add the dipped bread. Fry until golden brown on each side on a medium heat. Place all the slices in the pan, on low heat and cover for about 3 minutes. This will plump up the slices. Serve with whipped cream or canned pie filling, jelly, powdered sugar or syrup. Ice cream can also be used. These can be frozen and reheated in microwave at a later date if left over. Makes 8 to 10 slices.

recipes.title: Surprise Cookies
directions: Blend together margarine, sugar, egg and vanilla until light and fluffy.
Add the flour and chopped nuts; beat on low speed until blended thoroughly.
Chill dough in refrigerator for 1 hour. Roll a small piece of dough about the size of a walnut around a kiss.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 minutes.
Roll in powdered sugar after cooled.
recipes.text: Surprise Cookies. Blend together margarine, sugar, egg and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add the flour and chopped nuts; beat on low speed until blended thoroughly. Chill dough in refrigerator for 1 hour. Roll a small piece of dough about the size of a walnut around a kiss. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar after cooled.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cut squash and chop onion; season with salt and margarine. Cook until well done.
Mix all ingredients together and put in a greased casserole dish.
Save enough cheese and crackers to cover top of casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
When solid, cover with reserved cheese and crackers and brown slightly.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cut squash and chop onion; season with salt and margarine. Cook until well done. Mix all ingredients together and put in a greased casserole dish. Save enough cheese and crackers to cover top of casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour. When solid, cover with reserved cheese and crackers and brown slightly.

recipes.title: Roast Beef For 100
ingredients: 3 or 4 (16 oz.) bottles original Italian salad dressing
directions: Use the largest roasting pans available.
Spear roasts with meat fork multiple times.
Put 1 tablespoon of flour into 3 to 4 large Reynolds oven cooking bags and shake (this keeps bag from bursting in oven).
Place roasts in cooking bags; add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour dressing over roasts and tie bags with plastic ties provided with bags.
Refrigerate overnight to marinate meat.
Don't poke holes in bags per the instructions until ready to put roasts in the oven.
Turn meat over at least once or twice during marinating time to get dressing on all sides. Cook in ovens (only at Epworth United Methodist Church) at 325u00b0 for 4 to
4 1/2 hours to insure the meat is tender and juicy. Slice and serve for Wednesday night dinner.
This is the only place and time that I have been able to get this recipe to turn out right.
recipes.text: Roast Beef For 100. Use the largest roasting pans available. Spear roasts with meat fork multiple times. Put 1 tablespoon of flour into 3 to 4 large Reynolds oven cooking bags and shake (this keeps bag from bursting in oven). Place roasts in cooking bags; add salt and pepper to taste. Pour dressing over roasts and tie bags with plastic ties provided with bags. Refrigerate overnight to marinate meat. Don't poke holes in bags per the instructions until ready to put roasts in the oven. Turn meat over at least once or twice during marinating time to get dressing on all sides. Cook in ovens (only at Epworth United Methodist Church) at 325u00b0 for 4 to 4 1/2 hours to insure the meat is tender and juicy. Slice and serve for Wednesday night dinner. This is the only place and time that I have been able to get this recipe to turn out right.

recipes.title: Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 small can diced green chiles or 1 can Rotel
directions: Brown ground beef and drain.
In large pan, combine beef and onion.
Cook until onion is translucent.
Add remainder of ingredients-except tortilla shells.
Simmer until done.
Cut or tear 3 or 4 tortilla shells into small pieces and drop into simmering soup for last 5 minutes of cooking. You may have to add some water during cooking.
This makes a Big Pot of Soup.
recipes.text: Tortilla Soup. Brown ground beef and drain. In large pan, combine beef and onion. Cook until onion is translucent. Add remainder of ingredients-except tortilla shells. Simmer until done. Cut or tear 3 or 4 tortilla shells into small pieces and drop into simmering soup for last 5 minutes of cooking. You may have to add some water during cooking. This makes a Big Pot of Soup.

recipes.title: Jeannine'S Chicken
directions: Mix soup, onion, wine, mushrooms with liquid and lemon juice. Pour chicken pieces in baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.
Pour mixture over chicken.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.
recipes.text: Jeannine'S Chicken. Mix soup, onion, wine, mushrooms with liquid and lemon juice. Pour chicken pieces in baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake at 375u00b0 for 1 hour or until tender.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach (I use baby spinach)
chicken or vegetable canned broth (1 to 2 cans, depends on thickness)
salt, pepper and curry powder to taste
directions: Combine all ingredients listed. Cook until right consistency of your choice. Also can add meat, if desired. Serve with pita bread wedges, slightly toasted.
recipes.text: Butternut Squash Soup. Combine all ingredients listed. Cook until right consistency of your choice. Also can add meat, if desired. Serve with pita bread wedges, slightly toasted.

recipes.title: Microwave Peach Crisp
ingredients: 3 c. fresh sliced peaches or 2 cans, drained
directions: Arrange peaches in 8 x 8-inch microwavable dish.
Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly.
Sprinkle over peaches. Microwave uncovered, on High for 6 minutes.
Rotate dish 1/2 turn. Microwave 4 to 6 minutes longer.
Serve with ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Microwave Peach Crisp. Arrange peaches in 8 x 8-inch microwavable dish. Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches. Microwave uncovered, on High for 6 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn. Microwave 4 to 6 minutes longer. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream, if desired. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar well.
Add shortening and cream.
Add eggs one at a time.
Mix salt with flour.
Add to butter and sugar mixture alternating with milk.
Add flouring.
Bake at 325u00b0 for an hour and a half.
recipes.text: Cold Oven Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar well. Add shortening and cream. Add eggs one at a time. Mix salt with flour. Add to butter and sugar mixture alternating with milk. Add flouring. Bake at 325u00b0 for an hour and a half.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Pour in an unbaked pie crust.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until center is done.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pie. Pour in an unbaked pie crust. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 40 minutes or until center is done.

recipes.title: Cake That Don'T Last
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in a greased and floured Bundt pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Cake That Don'T Last. Combine all ingredients. Bake in a greased and floured Bundt pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Supreme
ingredients: 1 Keebler Ready-Crust graham cracker pie crust
directions: Preheat
oven

juice, 1/4 teaspoon vanilla and salt until well blended. Add
eggs,tone
at

time, mixing well after each addition. Place crust on baking sheet; pour in filling.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until knife inserted in from tbe edge comes out clean.
recipes.text: Cheesecake Supreme. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Combine cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar, lemon juice, 1/4 teaspoon vanilla and salt until well blended. Add eggs,tone at a time, mixing well after each addition. Place crust on baking sheet; pour in filling. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until knife inserted in from tbe edge comes out clean.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn
directions: Pop 1/2 cup of popcorn.
Melt margarine, brown sugar, syrup, molasses and salt; bring to boil and boil for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add baking soda; stir.
Caramel will get very foamy. Pour caramel over popcorn; stir.
Bake on cookie sheet at 250u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Cool and enjoy!
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn. Pop 1/2 cup of popcorn. Melt margarine, brown sugar, syrup, molasses and salt; bring to boil and boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add baking soda; stir. Caramel will get very foamy. Pour caramel over popcorn; stir. Bake on cookie sheet at 250u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool and enjoy!

recipes.title: Sesame Marinade
directions: Brown sesame seed in oil.
Mix ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Marinate overnight.
recipes.text: Sesame Marinade. Brown sesame seed in oil. Mix ingredients in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. or can Spanish rice (can use regular rice)
directions: Brown ground beef as directed on seasoning packet.
Simmer until liquid is almost absorbed.
Use rice as the base, layer in casserole dish.
Next add a layer of meat, beans and cheese.
Heat in 350u00b0 oven until bubbly and cheese melts. Serve with taco sauce and sour cream as desired.
Can be served with a salad and bread as a complete meal.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Brown ground beef as directed on seasoning packet. Simmer until liquid is almost absorbed. Use rice as the base, layer in casserole dish. Next add a layer of meat, beans and cheese. Heat in 350u00b0 oven until bubbly and cheese melts. Serve with taco sauce and sour cream as desired. Can be served with a salad and bread as a complete meal.

recipes.title: Dilled Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/4 c. minced fresh dill (do not use dried)
directions: Boil broccoli briefly until tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain; refresh under cold water and drain again. Place in bowl with other vegetables. Mix sour cream and mayonnaise with dill. Toss with broccoli mixture. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Dilled Broccoli Salad. Boil broccoli briefly until tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain; refresh under cold water and drain again. Place in bowl with other vegetables. Mix sour cream and mayonnaise with dill. Toss with broccoli mixture. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Baked Penne And Sausage, Zucchini And Fontina
directions: In frypan, saute onion until transparent. Add sausage, stirring until browned. Add zucchini until softened. Stir in cream and grated Fontina; season with salt, pepper and oregano. Boil penne pasta until done. Drain and add cream mixture to pasta. Fold together and pour into buttered greased casserole dish.
recipes.text: Baked Penne And Sausage, Zucchini And Fontina. In frypan, saute onion until transparent. Add sausage, stirring until browned. Add zucchini until softened. Stir in cream and grated Fontina; season with salt, pepper and oregano. Boil penne pasta until done. Drain and add cream mixture to pasta. Fold together and pour into buttered greased casserole dish.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp #2
directions: Peel, core, slice, then arrange apples in a shallow baking dish.
Cream butter.
Blend in sugar, flour and cinnamon.
Stir in bran flakes.
Sprinkle mixture over apples.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp #2. Peel, core, slice, then arrange apples in a shallow baking dish. Cream butter. Blend in sugar, flour and cinnamon. Stir in bran flakes. Sprinkle mixture over apples. Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, shortening, brown sugar, and white sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla, beat until light and fluffy.
Sift together flour, salt, and soda, into creamed mixture.
Add chocolate morsels.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 until cookies are brown around the edge, but the centers are not done.
Yields 96 cookies.
recipes.text: Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies. Cream together butter, shortening, brown sugar, and white sugar. Add eggs and vanilla, beat until light and fluffy. Sift together flour, salt, and soda, into creamed mixture. Add chocolate morsels. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 until cookies are brown around the edge, but the centers are not done. Yields 96 cookies.

recipes.title: Orange Salad
directions: Save juice when draining.
Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water; add frozen orange juice and 2 cups juice from pineapple and oranges.
(If not enough juice, add water to make the 2 cups.) Add pineapple and oranges.
Add ginger ale.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Orange Salad. Save juice when draining. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water; add frozen orange juice and 2 cups juice from pineapple and oranges. (If not enough juice, add water to make the 2 cups.) Add pineapple and oranges. Add ginger ale. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chilled Avocado Soup
directions: Peel and pit avocados.
Process the avocados, garlic, green onions, cilantro, jalapenos with juice and Tabasco sauce in a blender or food processor until smooth.
Add sour cream and process again.
Stir in buttermilk and chilled broth.
Taste and add any salt, if desired.
Cover and chill until very cold.
Garnish with a dollop of sour cream and chopped green onion tops.
recipes.text: Chilled Avocado Soup. Peel and pit avocados. Process the avocados, garlic, green onions, cilantro, jalapenos with juice and Tabasco sauce in a blender or food processor until smooth. Add sour cream and process again. Stir in buttermilk and chilled broth. Taste and add any salt, if desired. Cover and chill until very cold. Garnish with a dollop of sour cream and chopped green onion tops.

recipes.title: Venison
directions: Put roast in large pan containing cold water and 1 tablespoon vinegar and soak overnight. Rinse and put in roast pan with oil and onions. Bake at 300u00b0 about 3 hours or until tender. Vegetables can be added about the last hour.
recipes.text: Venison. Put roast in large pan containing cold water and 1 tablespoon vinegar and soak overnight. Rinse and put in roast pan with oil and onions. Bake at 300u00b0 about 3 hours or until tender. Vegetables can be added about the last hour.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Mixture
directions: Sift together twice all ingredients except shortening.
Cut shortening into dry ingredients with 2 knives or pastry blender until mixture resembles cornmeal.
Store in a tight jar or can in refrigerator.
Makes enough mixture for 6 to 8-inch square pan of gingerbread.
The mixture will keep 3 months, as long as shortening stays sweet.
recipes.text: Gingerbread Mixture. Sift together twice all ingredients except shortening. Cut shortening into dry ingredients with 2 knives or pastry blender until mixture resembles cornmeal. Store in a tight jar or can in refrigerator. Makes enough mixture for 6 to 8-inch square pan of gingerbread. The mixture will keep 3 months, as long as shortening stays sweet.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Brown pork chops in shortening.
Remove from skillet and add water and onion soup mix to drippings.
Stir and bring to a boil. Spread rice in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Pour water mixture over rice.
Place browned pork chops on top of rice. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 60 minutes.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Pork Chops And Rice. Brown pork chops in shortening. Remove from skillet and add water and onion soup mix to drippings. Stir and bring to a boil. Spread rice in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Pour water mixture over rice. Place browned pork chops on top of rice. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with foil. Bake at 350u00b0 for 60 minutes. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Crackers
ingredients: Town House, Hi-Ho or Ritz crackers
directions: Melt baking chocolate and paraffin.
Cool slightly.
Spread peanut butter on crackers.
Dip in chocolate, peanut butter side first, then, turn over and dip again.
Drain and place on waxed paper to set.
Makes about 35.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Crackers. Melt baking chocolate and paraffin. Cool slightly. Spread peanut butter on crackers. Dip in chocolate, peanut butter side first, then, turn over and dip again. Drain and place on waxed paper to set. Makes about 35.

recipes.title: Crab And Avocado Salad
directions: Halve the avocados.
Discard the seed; scoop out the flesh, leaving 1/2 inch of flesh as a shell in the avocado skin.
Slice the scooped out flesh.
Combine the mayonnaise with the catsup; add the crabmeat, tossing to coat it.
Add the eggs and sliced avocado; mix well.
Heap into the scooped out shells.
recipes.text: Crab And Avocado Salad. Halve the avocados. Discard the seed; scoop out the flesh, leaving 1/2 inch of flesh as a shell in the avocado skin. Slice the scooped out flesh. Combine the mayonnaise with the catsup; add the crabmeat, tossing to coat it. Add the eggs and sliced avocado; mix well. Heap into the scooped out shells.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 can shrimp or 1 lb. peeled and boiled fresh shrimp
directions: Chop the shrimp into small pieces.
Soften cream cheese and add the onions, salad dressing and lemon juice.
Mix.
Add the shrimp and mix well.
Use a fork to mix with.
Serve with Fritos as this gives the dip the best flavor.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Chop the shrimp into small pieces. Soften cream cheese and add the onions, salad dressing and lemon juice. Mix. Add the shrimp and mix well. Use a fork to mix with. Serve with Fritos as this gives the dip the best flavor.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 large bag tortilla corn chips (taco flavor)
directions: Cook meat and onion.
Mix soup and tomatoes together.
In casserole dish, put beans on bottom.
Meat and onions next.
Corn chips (crush chip first).
Grate cheese on top, then pour on soup and tomato mix on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Cook meat and onion. Mix soup and tomatoes together. In casserole dish, put beans on bottom. Meat and onions next. Corn chips (crush chip first). Grate cheese on top, then pour on soup and tomato mix on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Cookies
directions: Combine cake mix, eggs, oil and lemon juice in a large bowl. Beat at low speed until well blended. Add nuts or coconut.
Shape into 1-inch balls. Bake at 375u00b0 for 6 to 7 minutes until lightly brown. Cool 1 minute on sheet.
Remove to cooling rack. Dust with 10x sugar or frost with 1 cup 10x sugar and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
recipes.text: Lemon Cookies. Combine cake mix, eggs, oil and lemon juice in a large bowl. Beat at low speed until well blended. Add nuts or coconut. Shape into 1-inch balls. Bake at 375u00b0 for 6 to 7 minutes until lightly brown. Cool 1 minute on sheet. Remove to cooling rack. Dust with 10x sugar or frost with 1 cup 10x sugar and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.

recipes.title: Turkey Loaf
directions: Combine celery, onions, mushrooms, shallots, parsley and poultry seasoning.
Saute in bouillon for 5 minutes.
Combine with the remaining ingredients and shape into a loaf.
Place in a 1 1/2-quart loaf pan coated with nonstick cooking spray.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until done.
recipes.text: Turkey Loaf. Combine celery, onions, mushrooms, shallots, parsley and poultry seasoning. Saute in bouillon for 5 minutes. Combine with the remaining ingredients and shape into a loaf. Place in a 1 1/2-quart loaf pan coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours or until done.

recipes.title: Scalloped Winter Vegetables
directions: Cook potatoes, rutabaga and carrots in chicken stock to which has been added the minced garlic, thyme and pepper.
When barely tender, remove from heat.
Melt butter in skillet; stir in flour and cook briefly.
Drain the stock from cooked vegetables, and gradually add stock to butter flour mixture.
Stir and cook until thickened.
Combine with the precooked vegetables and pour into a baking dish.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Scalloped Winter Vegetables. Cook potatoes, rutabaga and carrots in chicken stock to which has been added the minced garlic, thyme and pepper. When barely tender, remove from heat. Melt butter in skillet; stir in flour and cook briefly. Drain the stock from cooked vegetables, and gradually add stock to butter flour mixture. Stir and cook until thickened. Combine with the precooked vegetables and pour into a baking dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can French-style green beans, drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup
directions: Combine all ingredients, except almonds.
Place in a lightly greased 2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with almonds.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Combine all ingredients, except almonds. Place in a lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with almonds.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Stew
directions: Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Check occasionally. Stir, cover and bake until well done.
recipes.text: Easy Beef Stew. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Check occasionally. Stir, cover and bake until well done.

Beat in 1 egg at

Put
in tube pan (grease and flour pan).

recipes.text: 7-Up Pound Cake. Cream the butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in 1 egg at a time. Addtin flour and 7-Up alternately, then add in flavorings. Put in tube pan (grease and flour pan). Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Cook fort1 1/4thours at 325u00b0.tStick with toothpick; if it comes out clean, cake is done.

recipes.title: Chicken With Rice
ingredients: 1/4 c. olive oil or salad oil
1/2 tsp. saffron or 10 drops yellow food coloring
2 cans (7 oz. each) pimiento, drained and chopped (optional)
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Wash chicken pieces and pat dry.
Place chicken, skin side up, in 4 baking pans, 13 x 9-inch.
Brush chicken with oil; season with salt, garlic salt, pepper and paprika.
Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken With Rice. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Wash chicken pieces and pat dry. Place chicken, skin side up, in 4 baking pans, 13 x 9-inch. Brush chicken with oil; season with salt, garlic salt, pepper and paprika. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepper Sauce
directions: You will also need sterilized jars, lids and rings.
recipes.text: Pepper Sauce. You will also need sterilized jars, lids and rings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 2 c. grated (peeled or unpeeled) raw zucchini
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy.
Add oil and sugar and mix well by hand.
Add zucchini and vanilla.
Sift together dry ingredients and add to batter.
Stir in nuts.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add oil and sugar and mix well by hand. Add zucchini and vanilla. Sift together dry ingredients and add to batter. Stir in nuts.

recipes.title: Curry Dip
directions: Chill for at least 2 hours before serving.
Serve with sliced carrots and celery.
Decorate with paprika on top.
recipes.text: Curry Dip. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving. Serve with sliced carrots and celery. Decorate with paprika on top.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Beat margarine and sugar until creamed.
Add beaten eggs to sugar mixture and blend.
Add milk and sweet potatoes and blend. Add vanilla and coconut.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Beat margarine and sugar until creamed. Add beaten eggs to sugar mixture and blend. Add milk and sweet potatoes and blend. Add vanilla and coconut.

recipes.title: Creme De Menthe Cake
directions: Make white cake like the box indicates, except when it calls for 1 1/4 cups water, add 1 cup water and 1/4 cup creme de menthe instead.
When cake is done, poke holes in the cake going at least 1/2 way down with the handle of a wooden spoon.
recipes.text: Creme De Menthe Cake. Make white cake like the box indicates, except when it calls for 1 1/4 cups water, add 1 cup water and 1/4 cup creme de menthe instead. When cake is done, poke holes in the cake going at least 1/2 way down with the handle of a wooden spoon.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Crumble 2 sleeves of crackers in bottom of large casserole dish with 3/4 stick of butter or margarine, melted.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Crumble 2 sleeves of crackers in bottom of large casserole dish with 3/4 stick of butter or margarine, melted.

recipes.title: Apricot Bars
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg and vanilla.
Combine flour and baking powder and add to creamed mixture.
Add coconut and nuts.
Mix well.
Press 2/3 mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread with preserves.
Crumble remaining dough over top.
If mixture isn't crumbly enough, I add some more sugar and flour Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown.
Cool and cut.
recipes.text: Apricot Bars. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Combine flour and baking powder and add to creamed mixture. Add coconut and nuts. Mix well. Press 2/3 mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread with preserves. Crumble remaining dough over top. If mixture isn't crumbly enough, I add some more sugar and flour Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown. Cool and cut.

recipes.title: Venus De Milo Soup
ingredients: 1 medium sauteed onion in butter, chopped
3/4 to 1 lb. lean ground beef, sauteed until red disappears
1 lb. can tomatoes, break up tomatoes
directions: Saute onion.
Add ground beef and saute until red disappears. Transfer to large pan and add rest of ingredients.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Venus De Milo Soup. Saute onion. Add ground beef and saute until red disappears. Transfer to large pan and add rest of ingredients. Simmer covered for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Cook in loaf pan at 325u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Breakfast Bread. Mix all ingredients together. Cook in loaf pan at 325u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix flour, cinnamon, salt, baking powder and dry milk powder. Mix melted shortening, eggs and oatmeal and mix well; add water and vanilla.
Add 1/2 flour mixture; then currants and nuts, then add rest of flour.
Drop on greased baking sheet and bake at 400u00b0 about 10 to 12 minutes.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Mix flour, cinnamon, salt, baking powder and dry milk powder. Mix melted shortening, eggs and oatmeal and mix well; add water and vanilla. Add 1/2 flour mixture; then currants and nuts, then add rest of flour. Drop on greased baking sheet and bake at 400u00b0 about 10 to 12 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken Salad
directions: Boil and dice chicken breasts, cool.
Mix mayonnaise with lemon juice, curry and soya sauce.
Mix with rest of ingredients; chill and top with noodles.
recipes.text: Oriental Chicken Salad. Boil and dice chicken breasts, cool. Mix mayonnaise with lemon juice, curry and soya sauce. Mix with rest of ingredients; chill and top with noodles.

recipes.title: Lasagne
directions: Cut up Mozzarella.
Brown meat, remove fat, add spices, tomatoes and ketchup and simmer 30 minutes.
Cook noodles in boiling salted water with a bit of oil until tender.
Drain and rinse in cold water.
Place 1/2 noodles in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cheese and cover with 1/2 sauce.
Repeat layers. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Cut up Mozzarella. Brown meat, remove fat, add spices, tomatoes and ketchup and simmer 30 minutes. Cook noodles in boiling salted water with a bit of oil until tender. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place 1/2 noodles in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cheese and cover with 1/2 sauce. Repeat layers. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Roast Beef
directions: Flour roast. Brown in butter and pepper. Combine soup, onion mix and wine. Pour over browned roast. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 325u00b0. Saut mushrooms and add to roast last 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Roast Beef. Flour roast. Brown in butter and pepper. Combine soup, onion mix and wine. Pour over browned roast. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 325u00b0. Saut mushrooms and add to roast last 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Soak the oatmeal in the buttermilk at least 1/2 hour.
Beat eggs into oat mixture.
Add honey.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Add oil and mix only until blended.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 large muffins.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Oatmeal Muffins. Soak the oatmeal in the buttermilk at least 1/2 hour. Beat eggs into oat mixture. Add honey. Stir in dry ingredients. Add oil and mix only until blended. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 large muffins.

recipes.title: Sparkling Fruit Punch
directions: Combine orange, lemon, pineapple and apple juices.
Chill for 1 hour.
Then add soda.
Put ice cubes in 4 tall glasses.
Pour mixture over cubes.
recipes.text: Sparkling Fruit Punch. Combine orange, lemon, pineapple and apple juices. Chill for 1 hour. Then add soda. Put ice cubes in 4 tall glasses. Pour mixture over cubes.

recipes.title: Lemon Angel Fluff(Low-Cal)
directions: Break angel food cake in bite size pieces.
Mix pudding following directions.
Use second box if you like a thicker layer. Put crumbled cake in a 13 x 9-inch pan carefully.
Cover all over with pudding.
Top with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate for 2 1/2 hours. Slice like a cake.
recipes.text: Lemon Angel Fluff(Low-Cal). Break angel food cake in bite size pieces. Mix pudding following directions. Use second box if you like a thicker layer. Put crumbled cake in a 13 x 9-inch pan carefully. Cover all over with pudding. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate for 2 1/2 hours. Slice like a cake.
