recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Combine rice, salt and pepper in casserole dish.
Mix onion in soup and pour over rice.
Mix well.
Place chicken over rice. Bake at 400u00b0 for 1 hour.
Last 10 minutes, dot chicken with mayo.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Combine rice, salt and pepper in casserole dish. Mix onion in soup and pour over rice. Mix well. Place chicken over rice. Bake at 400u00b0 for 1 hour. Last 10 minutes, dot chicken with mayo.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) pkg. Ore-Ida hash brown potatoes*
1 c. chopped onion or 2 1/2 Tbsp. dried onion flakes
1 can cream of chicken soup (not diluted)
directions: *Let potatoes thaw about 30 minutes before starting to mix.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. *Let potatoes thaw about 30 minutes before starting to mix.

recipes.title: Mccartney Casserole
directions: Put all ingredients into a classroom.
Mix well, blending marvelous personalities.
Add 3 cups reading, 2 cups Math, 1 cup each:
Religion, Social Studies, Science, Health and Handwriting. Add 1/2 cup each:
Art, P.E., Music, Computers and Learning Center. Bring to a boil; turn off heat and let cool.
Next, add 3 tablespoons free time, 4 tablespoons outside play, 3 teaspoons parties and 2 teaspoons field trips and some wonderful class books written and illustrated by the McCartney Kids.
Put in a 22 x 22 casserole dish and bake for 180 days at full steam.
Sprinkle with laughter and fun.
Serve warm with a pinch of discipline and gallons of love!
recipes.text: Mccartney Casserole. Put all ingredients into a classroom. Mix well, blending marvelous personalities. Add 3 cups reading, 2 cups Math, 1 cup each: Religion, Social Studies, Science, Health and Handwriting. Add 1/2 cup each: Art, P.E., Music, Computers and Learning Center. Bring to a boil; turn off heat and let cool. Next, add 3 tablespoons free time, 4 tablespoons outside play, 3 teaspoons parties and 2 teaspoons field trips and some wonderful class books written and illustrated by the McCartney Kids. Put in a 22 x 22 casserole dish and bake for 180 days at full steam. Sprinkle with laughter and fun. Serve warm with a pinch of discipline and gallons of love!

recipes.title: Apple Dump Cake Lite
ingredients: sprinkle of nutmeg, allspice and cinnamon to taste
1 c. chopped walnuts or pecans (if desired)
directions: Add all ingredients in order into a large baking dish.
Do not stir.
Pour melted oleo over the cake mix.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Do not peek!
You can also spray your dish with Pam so it won't stick.
recipes.text: Apple Dump Cake Lite. Add all ingredients in order into a large baking dish. Do not stir. Pour melted oleo over the cake mix. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Do not peek! You can also spray your dish with Pam so it won't stick.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meat Balls
ingredients: 2 cans tomato soup (I use spaghetti sauce also)
directions: Combine meat, rice, salt, pepper and onions.
Form into balls. Place in a baking dish and enough sauce to cover.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until hamburg and rice are cooked.
recipes.text: Porcupine Meat Balls. Combine meat, rice, salt, pepper and onions. Form into balls. Place in a baking dish and enough sauce to cover. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until hamburg and rice are cooked.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo
directions: Brown flour (without fat, plain).
Add onion and celery and cook until lightly brown.
Add chicken and water.
Cook until chicken is done.
Serve with rice and sprinkle gumbo file in bowl.
recipes.text: Chicken Gumbo. Brown flour (without fat, plain). Add onion and celery and cook until lightly brown. Add chicken and water. Cook until chicken is done. Serve with rice and sprinkle gumbo file in bowl.

recipes.title: 24 Hour Fruit Salad
directions: Put eggs, vinegar and sugar in top of a double boiler and cook until thick, then add butter.
Put in a large bowl to cool.
Whip cream and add to dressing.
Be sure dressing is cool.
Add fruit, well drained, then marshmallows.
Mix well.
Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.
recipes.text: 24 Hour Fruit Salad. Put eggs, vinegar and sugar in top of a double boiler and cook until thick, then add butter. Put in a large bowl to cool. Whip cream and add to dressing. Be sure dressing is cool. Add fruit, well drained, then marshmallows. Mix well. Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Irish Scones
directions: Heat oven to 450u00b0.
Grease cookie sheet with butter.
Combine dry ingredients.
Add water and mix.
Drop 1 spoonful of mixture onto cookie sheet.
Sprinkle with additional sugar.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.
Serve hot.
Makes 12 scones.
recipes.text: Irish Scones. Heat oven to 450u00b0. Grease cookie sheet with butter. Combine dry ingredients. Add water and mix. Drop 1 spoonful of mixture onto cookie sheet. Sprinkle with additional sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown. Serve hot. Makes 12 scones.

recipes.title: Wesleyan Peach Pie
directions: Melt butter.
Add other ingredients.
Mix well.
Place 6 peeled peach halves, cut side down in an unbaked pie shell.
Pour mixture over peaches.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Wesleyan Peach Pie. Melt butter. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Place 6 peeled peach halves, cut side down in an unbaked pie shell. Pour mixture over peaches. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Cheese And Herb Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients together and stir until smooth and creamy or process in blender.
Allow to stand in refrigerator a few hours or overnight to blend flavors.
Makes 1 cup.
recipes.text: Low Calorie Cheese And Herb Dip. Combine all ingredients together and stir until smooth and creamy or process in blender. Allow to stand in refrigerator a few hours or overnight to blend flavors. Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Sausage Skillet
directions: Cut sausage into chunks.
Combine with 3/4 cup converted rice, 1 can celery soup, 3/4 cup water and 1 tablespoon butter in large skillet on medium heat.
Cover and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in peas and mushrooms.
Sprinkle cheese over top.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is done.
recipes.text: Sausage Skillet. Cut sausage into chunks. Combine with 3/4 cup converted rice, 1 can celery soup, 3/4 cup water and 1 tablespoon butter in large skillet on medium heat. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in peas and mushrooms. Sprinkle cheese over top. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is done.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salmon Squares
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can salmon, drained and flaked
directions: Cook macaroni and drain.
Melt butter and stir in flour and salt.
Gradually stir in milk, cooking until thick.
Add a small amount of hot mixture to the slightly beaten eggs and return to hot mixture.
Add cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and salmon.
Turn into a greased 9-inch pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375u00b0.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salmon Squares. Cook macaroni and drain. Melt butter and stir in flour and salt. Gradually stir in milk, cooking until thick. Add a small amount of hot mixture to the slightly beaten eggs and return to hot mixture. Add cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and salmon. Turn into a greased 9-inch pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375u00b0. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Ranch Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 large pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
1 doz. large flour tortillas, do not cook*
directions: *Do not use Aztec flour tortillas (no good).
recipes.text: Ranch Roll-Ups. *Do not use Aztec flour tortillas (no good).

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 roll Ritz crackers, broken into crumbs
directions: Boil chicken and remove from bone.
Tear into small pieces and put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Combine soup and sour cream and pour over chicken.
Cover with cracker crumbs and melted butter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Boil chicken and remove from bone. Tear into small pieces and put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Combine soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Cover with cracker crumbs and melted butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) can unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained
directions: Place chicken in baking dish.
In saucepan, combine cranberry sauce, brown sugar, vinegar and defatted chicken broth.
Mix cornstarch with water until smooth and add to sauce mixture.
Cook sauce until thickened.
Add pineapple chunks to sauce and pour over chicken.
Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.
Uncover. Add green pepper strips and baste with sauce.
Bake, uncovered, for 5 to 10 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Chicken. Place chicken in baking dish. In saucepan, combine cranberry sauce, brown sugar, vinegar and defatted chicken broth. Mix cornstarch with water until smooth and add to sauce mixture. Cook sauce until thickened. Add pineapple chunks to sauce and pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes. Uncover. Add green pepper strips and baste with sauce. Bake, uncovered, for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve over rice. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Berry Banana Smoothie
ingredients: 1 banana, peeled, cut up and frozen
1/4 c. fresh or frozen assorted berries (strawberries, blackberries or raspberries)
directions: Freeze cut up banana in a plastic bag, then use pieces straight from freezer.
In a blender container, combine the frozen banana pieces, desired berries, orange juice and yogurt.
Cover and blend until smooth.
recipes.text: Berry Banana Smoothie. Freeze cut up banana in a plastic bag, then use pieces straight from freezer. In a blender container, combine the frozen banana pieces, desired berries, orange juice and yogurt. Cover and blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
ingredients: 2 small boxes French vanilla instant pudding
Hershey chocolate bars or chocolate frosting
directions: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Line bottom of pan with whole crackers.
Mix pudding and milk; beat at medium speed until thick. Fold in Cool Whip; mix until blended.
Pour 1/2 of pudding mixture over crackers.
Add another layer of crackers then the rest of the pudding mixture.
Top with a layer of whole crackers.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair Cake. Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan. Line bottom of pan with whole crackers. Mix pudding and milk; beat at medium speed until thick. Fold in Cool Whip; mix until blended. Pour 1/2 of pudding mixture over crackers. Add another layer of crackers then the rest of the pudding mixture. Top with a layer of whole crackers.

recipes.title: Ashley'S Scrambled Eggs
directions: Grease frying pan.
In a small bowl, mix eggs, milk, garlic salt and salt.
Pour in pan on stove.
Turn heat on low for 5 to 6 minutes until done.
recipes.text: Ashley'S Scrambled Eggs. Grease frying pan. In a small bowl, mix eggs, milk, garlic salt and salt. Pour in pan on stove. Turn heat on low for 5 to 6 minutes until done.

recipes.title: Crisp Spiced Nuts
ingredients: 3/4 stick (6 Tbsp.) unsalted butter, melted and cooled
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
In a bowl with an electric mixer, beat whites with salt until very foamy and gradually beat in sugar, Worcestershire sauce, paprika and cayenne.
Stir in nuts and butter, combining well, and spread in a large shallow baking pan. Bake nuts in middle of oven, stirring every 10 minutes, until crisp and golden, about 30 to 40 minutes.
Spread nuts on a sheet of foil and cool.
Break up nut clusters.
Nuts may be made 1 week ahead and kept in an airtight container at room temperature. Makes about 4 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Crisp Spiced Nuts. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. In a bowl with an electric mixer, beat whites with salt until very foamy and gradually beat in sugar, Worcestershire sauce, paprika and cayenne. Stir in nuts and butter, combining well, and spread in a large shallow baking pan. Bake nuts in middle of oven, stirring every 10 minutes, until crisp and golden, about 30 to 40 minutes. Spread nuts on a sheet of foil and cool. Break up nut clusters. Nuts may be made 1 week ahead and kept in an airtight container at room temperature. Makes about 4 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Manicotti
directions: Pour 1 to 2 cups of sauce over bottom of large baking dish. Combine rest of ingredients and stuff shells with pastry tube. Pour remaining sauce over shells and top with a little grated Mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake until hot and bubbly at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Manicotti. Pour 1 to 2 cups of sauce over bottom of large baking dish. Combine rest of ingredients and stuff shells with pastry tube. Pour remaining sauce over shells and top with a little grated Mozzarella. Cover with foil and bake until hot and bubbly at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wash and dry mushrooms after removing stems. Cook onion in a small amount of butter or oil until transparent.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Wash and dry mushrooms after removing stems. Cook onion in a small amount of butter or oil until transparent. Set aside.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes Nice And Easy
directions: Drain yams.
Combine yams, pineapple, molasses and brown sugar.
Blend thoroughly until yams and mixture are completely mashed.
Put in casserole dish and cook for 1 hour at 350u00b0 or until potatoes are completely heated.
Remove from oven and put marshmallows on top.
Return to oven and broil for 1 minute until marshmallows are golden brown.
recipes.text: Sweet Potatoes Nice And Easy. Drain yams. Combine yams, pineapple, molasses and brown sugar. Blend thoroughly until yams and mixture are completely mashed. Put in casserole dish and cook for 1 hour at 350u00b0 or until potatoes are completely heated. Remove from oven and put marshmallows on top. Return to oven and broil for 1 minute until marshmallows are golden brown.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil all ingredients to the soft boil stage; when dropped in cold water forms a soft ball.

Remove from heat and add 3 heaping tablespoonfuls of peanut butter and 2 teaspoons vanilla flavoring. Beat until flavoring and peanut butter are completely mixed in. Pour into a buttered pan and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Boil all ingredients to the soft boil stage; when dropped in cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat and add 3 heaping tablespoonfuls of peanut butter and 2 teaspoons vanilla flavoring. Beat until flavoring and peanut butter are completely mixed in. Pour into a buttered pan and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Venison Steak
directions: Hack venison well.
Cut in serving size pieces.
Add milk to eggs.
Dip steak in this mixture.
Mix flour, salt and pepper to your taste.
Now, dip steak in the flour mixture.
Cook until batter on steak turns a golden brown.
Watch carefully and do not overcook.
recipes.text: Venison Steak. Hack venison well. Cut in serving size pieces. Add milk to eggs. Dip steak in this mixture. Mix flour, salt and pepper to your taste. Now, dip steak in the flour mixture. Cook until batter on steak turns a golden brown. Watch carefully and do not overcook.

recipes.title: Jessie'S Bread
directions: Mix desired amount of garlic salt, chili peppers and margarine.
Spread on French bread that has been cut in half lengthwise.
Mix cheese with mayonnaise and spread on bread. Broil until lightly brown and bubbly.
recipes.text: Jessie'S Bread. Mix desired amount of garlic salt, chili peppers and margarine. Spread on French bread that has been cut in half lengthwise. Mix cheese with mayonnaise and spread on bread. Broil until lightly brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Applesauce Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add the cinnamon candies and stir until dissolved.
Add applesauce and stir well.
Put into mold and chill until set.
Sprinkle nuts on top if you wish.
recipes.text: Applesauce Salad. Dissolve jello in hot water. Add the cinnamon candies and stir until dissolved. Add applesauce and stir well. Put into mold and chill until set. Sprinkle nuts on top if you wish.

recipes.title: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops.
Pour all ingredients mixed over pork chops. Cover and bake at 400u00b0 for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops. Brown pork chops. Pour all ingredients mixed over pork chops. Cover and bake at 400u00b0 for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Potatoes Romanoff
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) pkg. frozen southern style hash brown potatoes
1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
directions: Spread potatoes in bottom of 9x13 baking dish and allow to thaw completely (2-3 hours).
In a sauce pan, brown onions in 2 tablespoons of margarine.
Stir in the soups, milk, sour cream, salt and pepper.
Stir and heat until mixture reaches the first hint of a simmer.
Then pour over potatoes and mix well.
Mix corn flake crumbs with melted margarine and spread over potatoes.
Bake uncovered about 50 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 12-15.
ner: frozen southern style hash brown potatoes
recipes.text: Potatoes Romanoff. Spread potatoes in bottom of 9x13 baking dish and allow to thaw completely (2-3 hours). In a sauce pan, brown onions in 2 tablespoons of margarine. Stir in the soups, milk, sour cream, salt and pepper. Stir and heat until mixture reaches the first hint of a simmer. Then pour over potatoes and mix well. Mix corn flake crumbs with melted margarine and spread over potatoes. Bake uncovered about 50 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 12-15.

recipes.title: Zucchini "Apple" Pie
ingredients: 4 c. sliced, peeled zucchini (use large ones)
directions: Toss together zucchini (cooked until tender-crisp and drained) with lemon juice and salt.
Mix in a bowl the sugar, cinnamon, cream of tartar, nutmeg and flour.
Add zucchini and mix well (it will be runny).
Put into a 9-inch unbaked pie crust and dot with butter.
Add top crust and bake at 400u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Zucchini "Apple" Pie. Toss together zucchini (cooked until tender-crisp and drained) with lemon juice and salt. Mix in a bowl the sugar, cinnamon, cream of tartar, nutmeg and flour. Add zucchini and mix well (it will be runny). Put into a 9-inch unbaked pie crust and dot with butter. Add top crust and bake at 400u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Kansas Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 4 medium cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced
directions: In a large bowl combine mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, dill weed and salt.
Mix well.
Add cucumbers and onions, toss to coat.
Cover and chill at least 1 hour.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Kansas Cucumber Salad. In a large bowl combine mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, dill weed and salt. Mix well. Add cucumbers and onions, toss to coat. Cover and chill at least 1 hour. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Easy Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
directions: Bone and skin chicken thighs.
Beat until about 2-inches thick. Put in 1 strip of half fried bacon and strips of cheese to suit your taste.
Roll up; put toothpick in to hold together.
Make dip of egg whites and lemon juice; roll chicken.
Put flour and lemon pepper in bag and shake.
Fry slowly until well done.
recipes.text: Easy Casserole. Bone and skin chicken thighs. Beat until about 2-inches thick. Put in 1 strip of half fried bacon and strips of cheese to suit your taste. Roll up; put toothpick in to hold together. Make dip of egg whites and lemon juice; roll chicken. Put flour and lemon pepper in bag and shake. Fry slowly until well done.

recipes.title: Pork Cutlets(Dinner)
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can Italian plum tomatoes, drained (save juice)
1 (14 1/2 oz.) can low salt chicken broth
directions: Cut pork into cubes.
Heat in olive oil (in Dutch oven) until brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove meat onto plate.
Saute onions in the oil for 12 minutes.
Add garlic; cook 3 minutes. Add tomatoes, meat juices, chicken broth, white wine, thyme and oregano.
Put into casserole and bake, covered, for 1 hour.
Add olives and green beans; stir and cook for another 45 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with hot rolls and a salad.
recipes.text: Pork Cutlets(Dinner). Cut pork into cubes. Heat in olive oil (in Dutch oven) until brown. Using a slotted spoon, remove meat onto plate. Saute onions in the oil for 12 minutes. Add garlic; cook 3 minutes. Add tomatoes, meat juices, chicken broth, white wine, thyme and oregano. Put into casserole and bake, covered, for 1 hour. Add olives and green beans; stir and cook for another 45 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with hot rolls and a salad.

recipes.title: Peach Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Brown bottom pie crust.
Put all mixed ingredients in shell.
Place dabs of butter on peaches. Close with crust.
Foil edges.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Pie. Mix all ingredients together. Brown bottom pie crust. Put all mixed ingredients in shell. Place dabs of butter on peaches. Close with crust. Foil edges. Bake at 425u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients.
Add the cake mix and pudding mix.
Blend together in a large bowl until thoroughly mixed.
Mix until smooth.
Stir in the chocolate chips and cherries.
Pour into a buttered Bundt pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Can be served with powdered sugar sprinkled on top.
recipes.text: Death By Chocolate. Mix the first 4 ingredients. Add the cake mix and pudding mix. Blend together in a large bowl until thoroughly mixed. Mix until smooth. Stir in the chocolate chips and cherries. Pour into a buttered Bundt pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be served with powdered sugar sprinkled on top.

recipes.title: Sinfully Delicious
directions: Crush Oreos cookies using a rolling pin or a food processor and add butter once crushed.
Put mixture in a 13 x 9-inch dish and press into a crust.
Set in freezer for 15 minutes.
Add vanilla ice cream by slicing it and pressing it flat (using spatula and wax paper) over crust.
Pour fudge sauce over ice cream, then add Cool Whip to top it off and sprinkle nuts on top. Cover and put in freezer for at least 15 minutes.
Serves 12.
All ingredients can be altered to fit one's taste (i.e., different ice cream, cookie or topping).
recipes.text: Sinfully Delicious. Crush Oreos cookies using a rolling pin or a food processor and add butter once crushed. Put mixture in a 13 x 9-inch dish and press into a crust. Set in freezer for 15 minutes. Add vanilla ice cream by slicing it and pressing it flat (using spatula and wax paper) over crust. Pour fudge sauce over ice cream, then add Cool Whip to top it off and sprinkle nuts on top. Cover and put in freezer for at least 15 minutes. Serves 12. All ingredients can be altered to fit one's taste (i.e., different ice cream, cookie or topping).

recipes.title: Wild Rice Hot Dish
directions: Wash rice well under hot water.
Brown sausage and onion.
Add all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Wild Rice Hot Dish. Wash rice well under hot water. Brown sausage and onion. Add all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Pear Jello Mold
directions: Beat jello while adding hot water.
Add to cream cheese.
Add cold water and beat.
Add pear syrup.
Arrange pears in jello mold and add jello mixture.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Pear Jello Mold. Beat jello while adding hot water. Add to cream cheese. Add cold water and beat. Add pear syrup. Arrange pears in jello mold and add jello mixture. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole I
ingredients: 4 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced
directions: Wipe chops; brown them in a little oil in frying pan.
Place chops in a large casserole; sprinkle with half the salt and pepper.
Place apples and sweet potatoes in layers on chops and sprinkle with remaining salt and pepper.
Saute onion in the same frying pan where chops were browned.
Add water and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix and pour over chops, apples and potatoes.
Cover and bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours in a moderate 375u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole I. Wipe chops; brown them in a little oil in frying pan. Place chops in a large casserole; sprinkle with half the salt and pepper. Place apples and sweet potatoes in layers on chops and sprinkle with remaining salt and pepper. Saute onion in the same frying pan where chops were browned. Add water and Worcestershire sauce. Mix and pour over chops, apples and potatoes. Cover and bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours in a moderate 375u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Mix meal, flour, sugar, salt and baking powder together.
In another bowl, beat eggs, milk and oil.
Add to corn mixture and stir in peppers, corn, cheese and onions.
Pour into 2 well oiled baking pans (9 x 11-inches) and bake in 425u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until it tests done.
recipes.text: Jalapeno Cornbread. Mix meal, flour, sugar, salt and baking powder together. In another bowl, beat eggs, milk and oil. Add to corn mixture and stir in peppers, corn, cheese and onions. Pour into 2 well oiled baking pans (9 x 11-inches) and bake in 425u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until it tests done.

recipes.title: Pimiento Cheese Spread
directions: Melt cheese in top of double boiler over hot water.
Add other ingredients.
Add finely chopped pickle, if desired.
Mix thoroughly.
recipes.text: Pimiento Cheese Spread. Melt cheese in top of double boiler over hot water. Add other ingredients. Add finely chopped pickle, if desired. Mix thoroughly.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
directions: Saute onions in butter in saucepan until limp.
Add flour, salt, pepper, sugar and garlic.
Cook over medium heat, stirring until mixture is golden brown.
Add parsley and thyme; stir.
Add chicken stock and wine.
Simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with croutons and grated Swiss cheese.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. Saute onions in butter in saucepan until limp. Add flour, salt, pepper, sugar and garlic. Cook over medium heat, stirring until mixture is golden brown. Add parsley and thyme; stir. Add chicken stock and wine. Simmer 45 minutes. Serve with croutons and grated Swiss cheese.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Jam
ingredients: 5 c. green tomatoes, peeled, cored and ground
directions: Mix tomatoes and sugar; boil 15 minutes.
Turn off heat and add jello.
Stir until dissolved.
Put in jars and seal.
Tastes just like raspberry jam.
Delicious!
recipes.text: Green Tomato Jam. Mix tomatoes and sugar; boil 15 minutes. Turn off heat and add jello. Stir until dissolved. Put in jars and seal. Tastes just like raspberry jam. Delicious!

recipes.title: Four Layer Dessert
directions: Mix well.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Four Layer Dessert. Mix well. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Vegetable Beef Soup
ingredients: 16 or 20 oz. bag frozen mixed vegetables
directions: Cut beef in small pieces; brown well in shortening.
Place meat and all other ingredients in crock pot.
Cook on high for 6 hours.
recipes.text: Vegetable Beef Soup. Cut beef in small pieces; brown well in shortening. Place meat and all other ingredients in crock pot. Cook on high for 6 hours.

recipes.title: Shanghai Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb. boneless pork, cut in strips
1/2 lb. boneless veal, cut in strips
directions: Saute onions in shortening.
Remove from pan; brown pork and veal.
Add soy sauce and onion salt.
Pour hot water over meat; simmer for 30 minutes.
Add diced celery; simmer for 15 minutes. Add all vegetables.
Combine cornstarch and water into smooth paste; add to mixture, stirring, until clear.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 to 27 minutes.
Top with onion biscuit topping.
recipes.text: Shanghai Casserole. Saute onions in shortening. Remove from pan; brown pork and veal. Add soy sauce and onion salt. Pour hot water over meat; simmer for 30 minutes. Add diced celery; simmer for 15 minutes. Add all vegetables. Combine cornstarch and water into smooth paste; add to mixture, stirring, until clear. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 to 27 minutes. Top with onion biscuit topping.

recipes.title: "Peg'S" Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) box frozen peas, cooked 3 minutes in boiling water, then drained
directions: Mix lettuce, celery, cooked peas, green peppers and onion in large bowl.
In a small bowl, mix the sour cream, sugar and mayonnaise together.
Add to lettuce mixture and mix well. Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on top.
recipes.text: "Peg'S" Pea Salad. Mix lettuce, celery, cooked peas, green peppers and onion in large bowl. In a small bowl, mix the sour cream, sugar and mayonnaise together. Add to lettuce mixture and mix well. Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on top.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
ingredients: 3 1/2 c. milk (1 can Pet, add milk to make 3 1/2 c.)
directions: Toast bread.
Place in casserole dish 9 x 13-inch (6 slices will fit on one layer.)
Add another layer of toast.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over bread.
Dish should stand for a few minutes to soak.
Set a saucer on top to hold down bread. Put remaining pats of butter on top.
Soak for 3 to 4 hours or refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes or until bread puffs up and is golden brown.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Toast bread. Place in casserole dish 9 x 13-inch (6 slices will fit on one layer.) Add another layer of toast. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over bread. Dish should stand for a few minutes to soak. Set a saucer on top to hold down bread. Put remaining pats of butter on top. Soak for 3 to 4 hours or refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes or until bread puffs up and is golden brown.

recipes.title: Vegetable Quiche Squares
ingredients: 10 oz. thawed and drained broccoli, spinach or mixed veggies
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Shred cheese; mix all ingredients and spread in 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes.
Cool before cutting.
Serve with salad for quick easy dinner.
Great for brunch or showers.
Serves many.
recipes.text: Vegetable Quiche Squares. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Shred cheese; mix all ingredients and spread in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes. Cool before cutting. Serve with salad for quick easy dinner. Great for brunch or showers. Serves many.

recipes.title: Lazy Lady Bar
directions: Melt 1 stick oleo in large pan 10 x 15-inch.
Sprinkle evenly over oleo all ingredients.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Lazy Lady Bar. Melt 1 stick oleo in large pan 10 x 15-inch. Sprinkle evenly over oleo all ingredients. Bake at 325u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Mix and spread on pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Mix and spread on pizza pan or cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Mayonnaise
directions: Beat eggs until foamy in medium size pan.
Stir in sugar, salt and pepper.
Stir in flour until mixture is smooth.
Add milk and stir; add vinegar and mix well.
Put on stove and add boiling water and stir constantly until mixture is boiling good.
Remove from stove and stir in oleo until melted.
Pour into bowl and cover with waxed paper or plastic wrap to keep crust from forming. Cool.
recipes.text: Old Fashion Mayonnaise. Beat eggs until foamy in medium size pan. Stir in sugar, salt and pepper. Stir in flour until mixture is smooth. Add milk and stir; add vinegar and mix well. Put on stove and add boiling water and stir constantly until mixture is boiling good. Remove from stove and stir in oleo until melted. Pour into bowl and cover with waxed paper or plastic wrap to keep crust from forming. Cool.

recipes.title: Baked Corn Casserole
directions: Combine all these ingredients in a casserole dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Baked Corn Casserole. Combine all these ingredients in a casserole dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Barbara'S Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Melt butter and chocolate.
Mix with other ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake 25 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Barbara'S Chocolate Chess Pie. Melt butter and chocolate. Mix with other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 25 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Supreme
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Prepare fettuccine according to package directions; drain.
In a large bowl, blend together next 4 ingredients.
Stir in next 4 ingredients.
Toss fettuccine with shrimp mixture.
Pour into a 3-quart prepared baking dish.
Top with cheese.
Cover, bake in 350u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Fettuccine Supreme. Prepare fettuccine according to package directions; drain. In a large bowl, blend together next 4 ingredients. Stir in next 4 ingredients. Toss fettuccine with shrimp mixture. Pour into a 3-quart prepared baking dish. Top with cheese. Cover, bake in 350u00b0 oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Bring to a boil for 5 minutes the sugar and water. Add the peanut butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Bring to a boil for 5 minutes the sugar and water. Add the peanut butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla.

recipes.title: Shrimp Salad
directions: Mix Miracle Whip, sugar, shrimp and vinegar together.
Add remaining ingredients (can add any other vegetable you like).
recipes.text: Shrimp Salad. Mix Miracle Whip, sugar, shrimp and vinegar together. Add remaining ingredients (can add any other vegetable you like).

recipes.title: Best Cheesecake
directions: Heat oven to 325u00b0.
Grease and flour a 10-inch spring-form pan. With all ingredients at room temperature, mix all in one large bowl until well blended.
Bake for 1 hour.
Turn oven off and open the oven door; leave cake in for 1 more hour.
Chill.
May top with apricot or strawberry preserves.
recipes.text: Best Cheesecake. Heat oven to 325u00b0. Grease and flour a 10-inch spring-form pan. With all ingredients at room temperature, mix all in one large bowl until well blended. Bake for 1 hour. Turn oven off and open the oven door; leave cake in for 1 more hour. Chill. May top with apricot or strawberry preserves.

recipes.title: Cherry-Angel Food Cake
directions: Cut angel cake across in 3 layers. Add cream cheese, sugar and powdered sugar. Mix well. Fold Cool Whip into mixture. Spread between layers and top and side of cake. Spoon pie cherries all over cake. It will run down sides and in center. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cherry-Angel Food Cake. Cut angel cake across in 3 layers. Add cream cheese, sugar and powdered sugar. Mix well. Fold Cool Whip into mixture. Spread between layers and top and side of cake. Spoon pie cherries all over cake. It will run down sides and in center. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 box Uncle Ben's long grain wild rice
directions: Set your oven to 350u00b0.tCook wild rice and add 1 can of cream oftmushroom,
can of celery and 1 can of water;
mix together. Place
intbuttered
x 13-inch casserole.
Layer chicken on top
of rice mixture and sprinkle onion mix on top of chicken. Bake for 2 hours or until done.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Set your oven to 350u00b0.tCook wild rice and add 1 can of cream oftmushroom, 1 can of celery and 1 can of water; mix together. Place intbuttered 9 x 13-inch casserole. Layer chicken on top of rice mixture and sprinkle onion mix on top of chicken. Bake for 2 hours or until done.

recipes.title: Easy Homemade Biscuits
directions: Blend together flour and shortening, add buttermilk.
Stir gently with fork until soft dough forms.
Put on floured pastry cloth and knead gently.
Pat to 1 inch thick.
Place on greased pan.
Bake at 450u00b0 for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Homemade Biscuits. Blend together flour and shortening, add buttermilk. Stir gently with fork until soft dough forms. Put on floured pastry cloth and knead gently. Pat to 1 inch thick. Place on greased pan. Bake at 450u00b0 for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Supreme
ingredients: 1 envelope cream of mushroom soup mix
directions: Sprinkle chicken with paprika and pepper.
In skillet, melt butter.
Add chicken and cook, turning 5 to 7 minutes until browned.
Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Add mushrooms to skillet, 2 to 3 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Supreme. Sprinkle chicken with paprika and pepper. In skillet, melt butter. Add chicken and cook, turning 5 to 7 minutes until browned. Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Add mushrooms to skillet, 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Clam Dip
directions: Mix all together and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Clam Dip. Mix all together and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Pineapple Stuffing(Good With Ham)
directions: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add pineapple and then bread crumbs.
Bake in greased casserole dish at 350u00b0 for about 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Stuffing(Good With Ham). Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add pineapple and then bread crumbs. Bake in greased casserole dish at 350u00b0 for about 60 minutes.

recipes.title: One Pot Cabbage Kielbasa
directions: Slice sausage in 1/4-inch slices. Chop potatoes into 1-inch pieces. Chop cabbage into 2-inch strips. Add 2 tablespoons oil to large frying pan or Dutch oven. Heat, then add potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes; add sausage slices. Cook 2 minutes. Add cabbage and beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1 cup hot water. Add onion and bell pepper and season to taste. Simmer until cabbage is done but not mushy.
recipes.text: One Pot Cabbage Kielbasa. Slice sausage in 1/4-inch slices. Chop potatoes into 1-inch pieces. Chop cabbage into 2-inch strips. Add 2 tablespoons oil to large frying pan or Dutch oven. Heat, then add potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes; add sausage slices. Cook 2 minutes. Add cabbage and beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1 cup hot water. Add onion and bell pepper and season to taste. Simmer until cabbage is done but not mushy.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 1/2 c. Cheddar or Jack cheese (or both)
directions: Boil chicken breasts for 25 minutes.
Cool and remove bones. Cook chopped broccoli for 25 minutes.
Layer broccoli in greased glass pan.
Put chicken breasts on top of broccoli.
Pour mixture of mayonnaise, chicken soup, curry powder and lemon juice on top of chicken breasts.
Sprinkle cheese on top of mixture.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top of cheese.
Bake 25 minutes in a 375u00b0 oven. Enjoy a quick, delicious meal!
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Boil chicken breasts for 25 minutes. Cool and remove bones. Cook chopped broccoli for 25 minutes. Layer broccoli in greased glass pan. Put chicken breasts on top of broccoli. Pour mixture of mayonnaise, chicken soup, curry powder and lemon juice on top of chicken breasts. Sprinkle cheese on top of mixture. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top of cheese. Bake 25 minutes in a 375u00b0 oven. Enjoy a quick, delicious meal! Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Lime Pickles
directions: Soak the first 3 ingredients for 24 hours.
Drain and rinse well, then cover with clear water for 1 hour.
Drain.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Pour mixture over chunked cucumbers and bring to a boil.
Add a little green food coloring for looks.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove from heat and pack in sterilized jars and seal.
recipes.text: Lime Pickles. Soak the first 3 ingredients for 24 hours. Drain and rinse well, then cover with clear water for 1 hour. Drain. Mix remaining ingredients together. Pour mixture over chunked cucumbers and bring to a boil. Add a little green food coloring for looks. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and pack in sterilized jars and seal.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sprinkle Sugar Twin over bananas and stir until dissolved. Beat eggs well and blend into bananas.
Sift dry ingredients; add nuts and coconut and blend into banana mixture until just mixed. Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Lower heat to 300u00b0 and bake approximately another 25 minutes.
Cake should be moist, but springy to touch.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Sprinkle Sugar Twin over bananas and stir until dissolved. Beat eggs well and blend into bananas. Sift dry ingredients; add nuts and coconut and blend into banana mixture until just mixed. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes. Lower heat to 300u00b0 and bake approximately another 25 minutes. Cake should be moist, but springy to touch.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 2 (1 1/2 oz. each) envelopes Italian-style spaghetti sauce with mushrooms mix
2 cloves garlic, crushed or garlic powder
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients.
Add water, sugar, oregano, bay leaf and garlic.
Simmer 1 1/2 to 3 hours.
Yields 10 servings.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Combine the first 6 ingredients. Add water, sugar, oregano, bay leaf and garlic. Simmer 1 1/2 to 3 hours. Yields 10 servings.

recipes.title: Three Day Coconut Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions on box.
Let cool. Slice into
layers.
Mix
sour cream, coconut and sugar in bowl.
Set 1 cup of mixture aside for later use as icing.
Mix Cool
Whip and
1 cup of the remaining mixture, being careful not to stir too much.
Spread between each layer of cake.
Ice the
top
with
the 1 cup of mixture prepared previously.
Put cake in refrigerator for 3 days, then eat.
recipes.text: Three Day Coconut Cake. Mix cake mix according to directions on box. Let cool. Slice into 4 layers. Mix sour cream, coconut and sugar in bowl. Set 1 cup of mixture aside for later use as icing. Mix Cool Whip and 1 cup of the remaining mixture, being careful not to stir too much. Spread between each layer of cake. Ice the top with the 1 cup of mixture prepared previously. Put cake in refrigerator for 3 days, then eat.

recipes.title: Simple Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Combine ingredients and spread on top of breasts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.
An easy way to "sweet and sour" something.
recipes.text: Simple Sweet And Sour Chicken. Combine ingredients and spread on top of breasts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. An easy way to "sweet and sour" something.

recipes.title: Linguine With White Clam Sauce
ingredients: 1 (6 1/2 oz.) can or fresh minced clams
directions: Heat oil in saucepan.
Cook garlic for 2 minutes in oil over medium heat.
Add clam juice, wine and red pepper.
Stir well and simmer, uncovered, for about 20 minutes or until liquid is reduced by 1/3.
Cook linguine according to directions.
Drain.
Place back in pot.
Toss with butter.
Add white clam sauce mixture to linguine and toss.
This recipe can be doubled.
recipes.text: Linguine With White Clam Sauce. Heat oil in saucepan. Cook garlic for 2 minutes in oil over medium heat. Add clam juice, wine and red pepper. Stir well and simmer, uncovered, for about 20 minutes or until liquid is reduced by 1/3. Cook linguine according to directions. Drain. Place back in pot. Toss with butter. Add white clam sauce mixture to linguine and toss. This recipe can be doubled.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Brown ground beef and drain.
Mix all ingredients, except beef, onion and cheese.
Put half of batter on bottom of baking dish.
Add beef, onion and cheese over batter.
Pour other half of batter on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Bread. Brown ground beef and drain. Mix all ingredients, except beef, onion and cheese. Put half of batter on bottom of baking dish. Add beef, onion and cheese over batter. Pour other half of batter on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Best Ever Brownies
directions: Combine cocoa and baking soda; blend in melted butter.
Add boiling water; stir until well blended.
Stir in sugar and eggs and blend.
Add flour, vanilla and salt.
Stir in nuts and chocolate chunks.
Pour in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Best Ever Brownies. Combine cocoa and baking soda; blend in melted butter. Add boiling water; stir until well blended. Stir in sugar and eggs and blend. Add flour, vanilla and salt. Stir in nuts and chocolate chunks. Pour in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Muhlenberg Mud Pie
directions: Heat oven to 325u00b0.
Grease bottom and side of 9-inch pie plate.
Stir together granulated sugar, butter, flour, cocoa, vanilla, salt and eggs in medium bowl.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until edge appears dry and toothpick inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean (center will be moist).
Immediately prick holes in pie with toothpick. Spread 1/4 cup fudge sauce over top.
Cool completely.
Beat heavy cream and powdered sugar in chilled medium bowl with electric mixer on high speed until stiff.
Spread over fudge sauce.
Drizzle with 3 tablespoons fudge sauce.
Cover and refrigerate any remaining pie.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Muhlenberg Mud Pie. Heat oven to 325u00b0. Grease bottom and side of 9-inch pie plate. Stir together granulated sugar, butter, flour, cocoa, vanilla, salt and eggs in medium bowl. Stir in nuts. Pour into pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until edge appears dry and toothpick inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean (center will be moist). Immediately prick holes in pie with toothpick. Spread 1/4 cup fudge sauce over top. Cool completely. Beat heavy cream and powdered sugar in chilled medium bowl with electric mixer on high speed until stiff. Spread over fudge sauce. Drizzle with 3 tablespoons fudge sauce. Cover and refrigerate any remaining pie. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake Iii
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0 (175u00b0C). Grease and flour tube pan.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake Iii. Preheat oven to 350u00b0 (175u00b0C). Grease and flour tube pan.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Muffins
ingredients: 2/3 c. canned or cooked fresh sweet potatoes, well drained
directions: Preheat the oven to 400u00b0.
Grease muffin tins that are 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Puree the sweet potatoes in a food processor or blender.
Cream the butter and sugar.
Beat in the eggs and sweet potatoes.
Sift flour with baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add dry ingredients alternately by hand with the milk and chopped nuts and raisins, mixing just until blended.
Do not overmix.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Muffins. Preheat the oven to 400u00b0. Grease muffin tins that are 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Puree the sweet potatoes in a food processor or blender. Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in the eggs and sweet potatoes. Sift flour with baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Add dry ingredients alternately by hand with the milk and chopped nuts and raisins, mixing just until blended. Do not overmix.

recipes.title: Southern Cornbread
directions: Hand mix meal and egg.
Add buttermilk until thin consistency. Put Crisco and 1 pinch of meal in a skillet.
Cook in oven at 450u00b0 until Crisco melts and meal turns a light golden brown.
Pour 1/2 cup of melted Crisco into cornbread mixture.
Hand mix.
Pour into skillet of melted Crisco.
Cook mixture at 450u00b0 until dark golden brown.
recipes.text: Southern Cornbread. Hand mix meal and egg. Add buttermilk until thin consistency. Put Crisco and 1 pinch of meal in a skillet. Cook in oven at 450u00b0 until Crisco melts and meal turns a light golden brown. Pour 1/2 cup of melted Crisco into cornbread mixture. Hand mix. Pour into skillet of melted Crisco. Cook mixture at 450u00b0 until dark golden brown.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Fudge
directions: Melt chocolate chips in micro-safe bowl in microwave.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan lined with wax paper.
Refrigerate until firm.
Remove from pan; peel off wax paper.
Cut as desired.
Makes about 2 pounds.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Fudge. Melt chocolate chips in micro-safe bowl in microwave. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch pan lined with wax paper. Refrigerate until firm. Remove from pan; peel off wax paper. Cut as desired. Makes about 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Apricot Baby Food Cake
ingredients: 1 can junior size apricot baby food
directions: Combine oil and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Fold in all ingredients, except flour and nuts.
When well mixed, fold in flour and nuts.
Bake in well-greased and floured tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour in a 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Apricot Baby Food Cake. Combine oil and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Fold in all ingredients, except flour and nuts. When well mixed, fold in flour and nuts. Bake in well-greased and floured tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour in a 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Baked Beans With Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 large (53 oz) can pork and beans, drained and rinsed
directions: Squeeze sausage from meat casing into pan and saute with onion and green pepper until meat is browned.
Drain and add drained beans, then mix in ketchup, sugar and mustard.
Pour into 2 qt casserole dish and bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour or more.
recipes.text: Baked Beans With Kielbasa. Squeeze sausage from meat casing into pan and saute with onion and green pepper until meat is browned. Drain and add drained beans, then mix in ketchup, sugar and mustard. Pour into 2 qt casserole dish and bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour or more.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream together and spread on round platter.
Pour taco sauce over cheese mixture evenly.
Shred lettuce and put on top of taco sauce.
Put diced tomatoes on top of lettuce.
Next, put diced onions on top of tomatoes.
Spread shredded cheese on top of onions.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Mix cream cheese and sour cream together and spread on round platter. Pour taco sauce over cheese mixture evenly. Shred lettuce and put on top of taco sauce. Put diced tomatoes on top of lettuce. Next, put diced onions on top of tomatoes. Spread shredded cheese on top of onions.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Spray bottoms and sides of 12 regular-size muffin cups with cooking spray.
(Spray will work better than greasing or using of paper baking cups.)
Beat eggs slightly in medium bowl with fork.
Stir in baking mix, milk and oil just until moistened.
Stir in 3/4 cup of the cheese and the ham.
Divide batter evenly among muffin cups.
Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cheese evenly over tops.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until light golden brown.
Immediately remove from pan.
Serve warm.
Wrap and refrigerate any remaining muffins.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Muffins. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Spray bottoms and sides of 12 regular-size muffin cups with cooking spray. (Spray will work better than greasing or using of paper baking cups.) Beat eggs slightly in medium bowl with fork. Stir in baking mix, milk and oil just until moistened. Stir in 3/4 cup of the cheese and the ham. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cheese evenly over tops. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until light golden brown. Immediately remove from pan. Serve warm. Wrap and refrigerate any remaining muffins.
