recipes.title: Easy Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
directions: Cut peppers in half and remove pulp. Steam peppers in 1 inch of water for 5 minutes, cool. Add Spanish rice and catsup to cooked ground beef. Spoon mixture into peppers. Place in baking pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Stuffed Peppers. Cut peppers in half and remove pulp. Steam peppers in 1 inch of water for 5 minutes, cool. Add Spanish rice and catsup to cooked ground beef. Spoon mixture into peppers. Place in baking pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chinese Sweet And Sour Sauce
directions: Combine sugar, soy sauce, wine, vinegar and ketchup in saucepan.
Bring to boil.
Dissolve cornstarch in water; add to sauce.
Cook over low heat, stirring until sauce has thickened. Yields 1 1/4 cups.
recipes.text: Chinese Sweet And Sour Sauce. Combine sugar, soy sauce, wine, vinegar and ketchup in saucepan. Bring to boil. Dissolve cornstarch in water; add to sauce. Cook over low heat, stirring until sauce has thickened. Yields 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Consomme Stuffing
directions: Saute onion and celery in margarine.
Add mushrooms and nuts. Beat in eggs (mixing them in separate bowl first.) Mix.
Add sauteed mixture and consomme.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Consomme Stuffing. Saute onion and celery in margarine. Add mushrooms and nuts. Beat in eggs (mixing them in separate bowl first.) Mix. Add sauteed mixture and consomme. Mix well.

recipes.title: Date Fruit Cake
directions: Mix fruit and nuts with flour.
Beat eggs; add sugar gradually, then fruit and nuts.
Bake at 200u00b0 to 250u00b0 for 3 hours. Line pan with greased brown paper bag.
recipes.text: Date Fruit Cake. Mix fruit and nuts with flour. Beat eggs; add sugar gradually, then fruit and nuts. Bake at 200u00b0 to 250u00b0 for 3 hours. Line pan with greased brown paper bag.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 2 tsp. lemon extract or almond extract
directions: Do not preheat oven.
Cream butter, shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Add dry ingredients and mix well.
Add milk and extract.
Starting with a cold oven, bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0 in tube pan.
Cool 15 minutes before turning out of pan.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Do not preheat oven. Cream butter, shortening and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add milk and extract. Starting with a cold oven, bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0 in tube pan. Cool 15 minutes before turning out of pan.

recipes.title: Honey "N" Spice Barbecue Chicken
directions: Combine Heinz 57 sauce and honey.
Place chicken on grill or broiler pan.
Brush with melted butter, then 57 sauce-honey mixture.
Grill or broil until chicken is tender.
Turn and baste frequently.
Serves 4 to 5.
recipes.text: Honey "N" Spice Barbecue Chicken. Combine Heinz 57 sauce and honey. Place chicken on grill or broiler pan. Brush with melted butter, then 57 sauce-honey mixture. Grill or broil until chicken is tender. Turn and baste frequently. Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Easy Shrimp Creole
ingredients: 1 can tomato wedges or tomatoes or sauce
garlic salt, Worcestershire, pepper, Creole seasoning and chili powder (seasoning)
directions: Cook bacon. Drain some off. Saute veggies and shrimp. Add tomato soup and other ingredients. When ready to serve, add crumbled up bacon. Serve over rice. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Easy Shrimp Creole. Cook bacon. Drain some off. Saute veggies and shrimp. Add tomato soup and other ingredients. When ready to serve, add crumbled up bacon. Serve over rice. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained well
directions: Mix all ingredients (except 1/4 cup pecans) and refrigerate overnight.
Form into one large ball or 2 small ones and roll balls in chopped pecans.
Serve with crackers or Triscuits.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients (except 1/4 cup pecans) and refrigerate overnight. Form into one large ball or 2 small ones and roll balls in chopped pecans. Serve with crackers or Triscuits.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: carrots or other vegetable, if desired
directions: Arrange chicken on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Place a layer of vegetables, add a layer of mayonnaise, then layer the onions and cheese. The last layer will be the seasoned stuffing. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Arrange chicken on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch dish. Place a layer of vegetables, add a layer of mayonnaise, then layer the onions and cheese. The last layer will be the seasoned stuffing. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Layered Crab Spread
ingredients: 7 to 8 oz. squeezed dry crab meat
directions: Mix well the first 6 ingredients and spread on a flat dish. Pour 1/2 to 2/3 jar of cocktail sauce over the cream cheese mixture.
Sprinkle crab meat on top of sauce and sprinkle chopped parsley on top.
Serve on Ritz crackers.
recipes.text: Layered Crab Spread. Mix well the first 6 ingredients and spread on a flat dish. Pour 1/2 to 2/3 jar of cocktail sauce over the cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle crab meat on top of sauce and sprinkle chopped parsley on top. Serve on Ritz crackers.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Pie
directions: Place in large microwave-safe bowl. Cook ingredients at 3 minute intervals until thick. It will take around 9 or 10 minutes. Whip batter in between each interval. When batter is ready, put into a baked pie shell.
recipes.text: Microwave Chocolate Pie. Place in large microwave-safe bowl. Cook ingredients at 3 minute intervals until thick. It will take around 9 or 10 minutes. Whip batter in between each interval. When batter is ready, put into a baked pie shell.

recipes.title: "Old Fashion Rice Custard With Less Fat"
directions: In double boiler with water in bottom pot, cook rice with 2 cups milk.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Cook until rice is tender and most of the milk evaporated.
Remove from heat; add Butter Buds.
Stir in beaten eggs, sugar, sweetener and vanilla; stir well into the cooked rice.
Add in the rest of the milk.
Pour in a well-sprayed 2-quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes or until firm.
recipes.text: "Old Fashion Rice Custard With Less Fat". In double boiler with water in bottom pot, cook rice with 2 cups milk. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Cook until rice is tender and most of the milk evaporated. Remove from heat; add Butter Buds. Stir in beaten eggs, sugar, sweetener and vanilla; stir well into the cooked rice. Add in the rest of the milk. Pour in a well-sprayed 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes or until firm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crunch Pie
directions: Prepare pudding with 1 cup milk according to package.
Fold in whipped topping.
Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips and cookies into pudding.
Spoon into pie crust.
Sprinkle with remaining cookies. Freeze until firm, 4 hours or overnight.
Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes before serving.
Store leftovers in the freezer.
recipes.text: Chocolate Crunch Pie. Prepare pudding with 1 cup milk according to package. Fold in whipped topping. Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips and cookies into pudding. Spoon into pie crust. Sprinkle with remaining cookies. Freeze until firm, 4 hours or overnight. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes before serving. Store leftovers in the freezer.

recipes.title: Homemade Pancakes(Hot Cakes)
directions: Beat egg, add buttermilk.
Add all dry ingredients.
Add margarine, make sure skillet is hot before dropping batter.
recipes.text: Homemade Pancakes(Hot Cakes). Beat egg, add buttermilk. Add all dry ingredients. Add margarine, make sure skillet is hot before dropping batter.

recipes.title: Rice With Mushrooms And Peas(Riso Con I Funghi E Piselli)
directions: In medium saucepan melt
butter
and
saute onion until tender.
Add rice and mushrooms;
cook
until half of the rice is nicely browned.
Pour in chicken broth and water.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Lower
heat
and
simmer for 15 minutes. Add drained peas and cook an additional 5 to 7 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.
Serve immediately.
This is wonderful served with grilled meats or skewered beef, lamb or shrimp.
recipes.text: Rice With Mushrooms And Peas(Riso Con I Funghi E Piselli). In medium saucepan melt butter and saute onion until tender. Add rice and mushrooms; cook until half of the rice is nicely browned. Pour in chicken broth and water. Add salt and pepper to taste. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Add drained peas and cook an additional 5 to 7 minutes. Makes 4 servings. Serve immediately. This is wonderful served with grilled meats or skewered beef, lamb or shrimp.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Bring stock or water to a boil in large soup kettle.
Add vegetables, tomato soup and seasoning.
Reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender.
Serve with crackers.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Bring stock or water to a boil in large soup kettle. Add vegetables, tomato soup and seasoning. Reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender. Serve with crackers. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sage Tea
directions: In an Earthenware teapot, place tea leaves, sage, mint and sugar.
Stir until sugar is well blended.
Pour in boiling water. Stir again.
Cover and brew 5 to 10 minutes.
Serve in tea glasses with lemon on side.
Makes 4 to 5 teacups
recipes.text: Sage Tea. In an Earthenware teapot, place tea leaves, sage, mint and sugar. Stir until sugar is well blended. Pour in boiling water. Stir again. Cover and brew 5 to 10 minutes. Serve in tea glasses with lemon on side. Makes 4 to 5 teacups

recipes.title: Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles and drain.
Rinse in cold water.
Brown meat and drain.
Add seasonings and tomato sauce; simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and combine cottage cheese, sour cream, onions and lasagna noodles.
Alternate layers of noodles with meat mixture in a greased 2-quart casserole.
Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Cook noodles and drain. Rinse in cold water. Brown meat and drain. Add seasonings and tomato sauce; simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and combine cottage cheese, sour cream, onions and lasagna noodles. Alternate layers of noodles with meat mixture in a greased 2-quart casserole. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, nuggets or canned chicken
directions: Place chicken in flat pyrex baking dish.
Mix soup, chestnuts, sour cream and half of poppy seed.
Pour over chicken; crumble crackers and spread butter over crackers.
Sprinkle the rest of poppy seed.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Place chicken in flat pyrex baking dish. Mix soup, chestnuts, sour cream and half of poppy seed. Pour over chicken; crumble crackers and spread butter over crackers. Sprinkle the rest of poppy seed. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown sausage and ground beef; add other ingredients.
Simmer 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Brown sausage and ground beef; add other ingredients. Simmer 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Caviar
directions: Drain everything and mix in large bowl.
Chop all raw vegetables.
Mix in together.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight, covered.
recipes.text: Texas Caviar. Drain everything and mix in large bowl. Chop all raw vegetables. Mix in together. Let stand in refrigerator overnight, covered.

recipes.title: Macaroni Soup
directions: In pan over medium heat, cook sausage, onion, garlic and oregano until sausage is browned.
Spoon off fat.
Add soup, broth, undrained tomatoes, water and pepper.
heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low.
Cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in macaroni; cook 10 minutes more or until macaroni is tender, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Macaroni Soup. In pan over medium heat, cook sausage, onion, garlic and oregano until sausage is browned. Spoon off fat. Add soup, broth, undrained tomatoes, water and pepper. heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in macaroni; cook 10 minutes more or until macaroni is tender, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Defrost hash browns. Combine next 7 ingredients and mix with hash browns. Put all in 3-quart casserole. Saut corn flakes in butter and sprinkle on top. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for about 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Defrost hash browns. Combine next 7 ingredients and mix with hash browns. Put all in 3-quart casserole. Saut corn flakes in butter and sprinkle on top. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Delight Cobbler
directions: Mix all ingredients, except fruit.
Pour into a baking dish. Pour fruit on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until top is brown.
recipes.text: Fruit Delight Cobbler. Mix all ingredients, except fruit. Pour into a baking dish. Pour fruit on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until top is brown.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown hamburger and onion in pan.
Fry bacon.
Put the rest of ingredients in crock-pot.
Add hamburger, onion and bacon.
Let cook for at least an hour.
recipes.text: Calico Beans. Brown hamburger and onion in pan. Fry bacon. Put the rest of ingredients in crock-pot. Add hamburger, onion and bacon. Let cook for at least an hour.

recipes.title: Hurry Up Chicken
directions: Place chicken in baking dish.
Mix other ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hurry Up Chicken. Place chicken in baking dish. Mix other ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
directions: Mix well.
Push through cookie press, using star wheel.
Put on cookie sheet in long strips.
Bake at 300u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown.
Do not overcook.
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Mix well. Push through cookie press, using star wheel. Put on cookie sheet in long strips. Bake at 300u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Do not overcook.

recipes.title: Yvette'S Bean Dip
directions: Cook hamburger meat with chopped onions.
Drain fat; add 1/2 of taco sauce mix with 1/4 cup water.
Add refried beans and mix. Add chopped tomatoes.
Grate cheese and add 3/4 of it to the mixture.
Cook over medium-low heat and stir until bubbling.
Add remaining cheese on top.
Enjoy!!!
recipes.text: Yvette'S Bean Dip. Cook hamburger meat with chopped onions. Drain fat; add 1/2 of taco sauce mix with 1/4 cup water. Add refried beans and mix. Add chopped tomatoes. Grate cheese and add 3/4 of it to the mixture. Cook over medium-low heat and stir until bubbling. Add remaining cheese on top. Enjoy!!!

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Melt butter in heavy skillet.
Add onion and rice. Simmer until onions are transparent.

Add 1 can consomme and 1 can water. Add mushrooms and bring to a boil.tArrange browned chops in bottom of buttered casserole and pour rice mixture on top.tBake at 350u00b0 for 45-55 minutes.tServes 6.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Melt butter in heavy skillet. Add onion and rice. Simmer until onions are transparent. Add 1 can consomme and 1 can water. Add mushrooms and bring to a boil.tArrange browned chops in bottom of buttered casserole and pour rice mixture on top.tBake at 350u00b0 for 45-55 minutes.tServes 6.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage
ingredients: Gunnoe's Italian sausage links or turkey links
2 green peppers, cut and diced in large chunks
2 medium onions, cut and diced in large chunks
directions: In electric frypan, cover bottom of pan with olive oil.
Brown sausage links on all sides until brown.
Add green peppers, onions and tomatoes.
Cover.
Let simmer until vegetables are tender. Add seasonings to desired taste.
Cook until sausage is done and vegetables are very tender.
recipes.text: Italian Sausage. In electric frypan, cover bottom of pan with olive oil. Brown sausage links on all sides until brown. Add green peppers, onions and tomatoes. Cover. Let simmer until vegetables are tender. Add seasonings to desired taste. Cook until sausage is done and vegetables are very tender.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cookies
ingredients: graham crackers (enough to cover large cookie sheet)
directions: Place graham crackers (broken in halves) on cookie sheet. Sprinkle pecans over crackers.
Melt margarine and butter; stir in sugar until dissolved.
Pour over crackers. Bake 10 to 12 minutes (no longer) at 350u00b0.
Remove from cookie sheet while still very warm.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Cookies. Place graham crackers (broken in halves) on cookie sheet. Sprinkle pecans over crackers. Melt margarine and butter; stir in sugar until dissolved. Pour over crackers. Bake 10 to 12 minutes (no longer) at 350u00b0. Remove from cookie sheet while still very warm.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice Krispies Cookies(From Karen Warriner Scheiding'S 8Th Grade Home Ec Class)
directions: Into a saucepan, put dates, nuts, salt, water and oleo.
Boil 1 minute; cool.
Add Rice Krispies.
Shape by teaspoonful into ball. Roll into coconut.
Place on wax paper.
recipes.text: Coconut Rice Krispies Cookies(From Karen Warriner Scheiding'S 8Th Grade Home Ec Class). Into a saucepan, put dates, nuts, salt, water and oleo. Boil 1 minute; cool. Add Rice Krispies. Shape by teaspoonful into ball. Roll into coconut. Place on wax paper.

recipes.title: Cabbage Patch Stew
directions: Brown beef in hot oil over medium heat.
Add onions, cabbage and celery.
Cook until onions are transparent.
Add water; simmer over low heat 15 minutes.
Add beans, tomatoes, salt, pepper and chili powder.
Simmer over low heat 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cabbage Patch Stew. Brown beef in hot oil over medium heat. Add onions, cabbage and celery. Cook until onions are transparent. Add water; simmer over low heat 15 minutes. Add beans, tomatoes, salt, pepper and chili powder. Simmer over low heat 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 3 oz. semi-sweet chocolate, melted and cooled
directions: Mix peanut butter with powdered sugar and half and half until smooth. Spoon into cooled pie shell.
Beat margarine with sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add egg and beat until very light. Beat in chocolate and spread over peanut butter. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Top with whipped cream and chopped roasted peanuts.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix peanut butter with powdered sugar and half and half until smooth. Spoon into cooled pie shell. Beat margarine with sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add egg and beat until very light. Beat in chocolate and spread over peanut butter. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Top with whipped cream and chopped roasted peanuts.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Chilli
directions: Brown beef until turns slightly brown. (It's better to leave it a little chunky.)
Put in crock-pot along with other ingredients in order listed. Stir once. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Chilli. Brown beef until turns slightly brown. (It's better to leave it a little chunky.) Put in crock-pot along with other ingredients in order listed. Stir once. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh shrimp, cooked and chopped
1 (7 oz.) box pasta shells or spirals, cooked and drained
1/2 c. each: celery, green pepper, carrot, onion, broccoli, tomato and cucumber
1 large bottle Kraft Free Italian salad dressing
directions: Blend ingredients together and let sit in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours for flavors to blend.
If you prefer taste over calorie count, Good Seasons Italian salad dressing from package is better.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Seafood Salad. Blend ingredients together and let sit in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours for flavors to blend. If you prefer taste over calorie count, Good Seasons Italian salad dressing from package is better.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients except apples and last 3 ingredients well. Add apples and stir with spoon.
Pour in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch pan or tube pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Mix all ingredients except apples and last 3 ingredients well. Add apples and stir with spoon. Pour in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch pan or tube pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: Grate cabbage, carrots and onions; set aside.
Add pickle juice, milk and celery seed to mayonnaise; stir well.
Add mixture to cabbage, carrots and onions.
Blend; cover tightly and store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. Grate cabbage, carrots and onions; set aside. Add pickle juice, milk and celery seed to mayonnaise; stir well. Add mixture to cabbage, carrots and onions. Blend; cover tightly and store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 c. soft bread crumbs, mixed with 1 Tbsp. butter
directions: Cook chicken until falls off bones.
Spread the chicken in pieces in the bottom of a large casserole.
Layer with the broccoli.
Mix the next 4 ingredients together and spread on the broccoli.
Top with the cheese.
Add the bread crumbs mixed with butter.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for approximately 1/2 hour or until golden and bubbly.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken until falls off bones. Spread the chicken in pieces in the bottom of a large casserole. Layer with the broccoli. Mix the next 4 ingredients together and spread on the broccoli. Top with the cheese. Add the bread crumbs mixed with butter. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for approximately 1/2 hour or until golden and bubbly.

recipes.title: Butter Brickle Bread
ingredients: 1 pkg. Betty Crocker butter pecan cake mix
1 pkg. jello instant coconut pudding mix
directions: Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Mix 2 minutes. Grease and flour only bottom of pans.
Use 2 large bread pans or 5 small ones.
Small foil pans make 5 loaves.
Line bottom with parchment paper.
Saves time.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes; reduce temperature to 300u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Butter Brickle Bread. Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Mix 2 minutes. Grease and flour only bottom of pans. Use 2 large bread pans or 5 small ones. Small foil pans make 5 loaves. Line bottom with parchment paper. Saves time. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes; reduce temperature to 300u00b0 and bake for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients and place in casserole dish. Cover with cheese and chips.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Combine first 5 ingredients and place in casserole dish. Cover with cheese and chips. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Tiny Pecan Pies
directions: Cream ingredients together.
Divide dough into 24 small balls and press into tiny muffin tins to make crust.
Pour filling into crust.
recipes.text: Tiny Pecan Pies. Cream ingredients together. Divide dough into 24 small balls and press into tiny muffin tins to make crust. Pour filling into crust.

recipes.title: Ozark Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. Pepperidge Farms Herb-Seasoned Stuffing Mix
directions: Combine chicken, rice, lemon juice, celery, onion, mayonnaise, eggs, soup, salt and pepper thoroughly and place in a greased casserole dish.
Mix butter and stuffing mix together and sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Ozark Chicken Casserole. Combine chicken, rice, lemon juice, celery, onion, mayonnaise, eggs, soup, salt and pepper thoroughly and place in a greased casserole dish. Mix butter and stuffing mix together and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sunset Salad
ingredients: 1 c. canned crushed pineapple in juice
directions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water.
Add remaining ingredients.
Chill until thickened, then stir and pour into 6-cup mold or 10 individual molds.
Serve with crisp greens and mayonnaise.
Makes 10 servings.
recipes.text: Sunset Salad. Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Add remaining ingredients. Chill until thickened, then stir and pour into 6-cup mold or 10 individual molds. Serve with crisp greens and mayonnaise. Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown hamburger in pan.
Pour off excess grease.
Add chili mix seasoning, ketchup and barbecue sauce.
Turn on low and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until thoroughly mixed.
Serve with hamburger buns.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. Brown hamburger in pan. Pour off excess grease. Add chili mix seasoning, ketchup and barbecue sauce. Turn on low and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until thoroughly mixed. Serve with hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Quick  Baked Beans
directions: Combine beans, sugar, onion and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour into casserole dish and top with cheese and bacon.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick  Baked Beans. Combine beans, sugar, onion and Worcestershire sauce. Pour into casserole dish and top with cheese and bacon. Bake at 375u00b0 for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Cover bottom of flat, greased baking dish with chipped beef, snipped with kitchen shears. Arrange breasts over chipped beef. Mix soups and sour cream; pour over all.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 275u00b0, uncovered, for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Supreme. Cover bottom of flat, greased baking dish with chipped beef, snipped with kitchen shears. Arrange breasts over chipped beef. Mix soups and sour cream; pour over all. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 275u00b0, uncovered, for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Dressing
directions: Stir ingredients together and mix well.
Cover and chill. Yields one cup.
recipes.text: Creamy Garlic Dressing. Stir ingredients together and mix well. Cover and chill. Yields one cup.

recipes.title: "Zesty" Grilled Pork Chops
ingredients: 3/4 c. Italian or olive oil salad dressing
directions: Clean pork chops.
Sprinkle both sides with garlic powder and lemon pepper.
Place chops in gallon size storage bag.
Pour in salad dressing and shake.
Place in refrigerator at least 2 hours. (Shake about every 15 to 20 minutes.)
Take out; place on medium grill.
Keep turning until done.
recipes.text: "Zesty" Grilled Pork Chops. Clean pork chops. Sprinkle both sides with garlic powder and lemon pepper. Place chops in gallon size storage bag. Pour in salad dressing and shake. Place in refrigerator at least 2 hours. (Shake about every 15 to 20 minutes.) Take out; place on medium grill. Keep turning until done.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Pie
ingredients: 8 thin white crackers, crushed and toasted
directions: Peel and thinly slice onions.
Place in a shallow microwave safe dish; dot with margarine.
Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 3 minutes.
Stir and microwave on high an additional 5 to 7 minutes.
Remove from oven, stir in cheese, pepper and salt.
Cover and let stand 5 minutes.
Top with cracker crumbs, serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Vidalia Onion Pie. Peel and thinly slice onions. Place in a shallow microwave safe dish; dot with margarine. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 3 minutes. Stir and microwave on high an additional 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from oven, stir in cheese, pepper and salt. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Top with cracker crumbs, serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In a large glass bowl, place butter and peanut butter. Microwave on High until butter melts (1 1/2 to 2 minutes).
Stir until blended.
Add remaining ingredients and stir until lumps of sugar disappear.
Microwave on High until softened, but not bubbly (1 to 1 1/2 minutes).
Pour into a buttered 9-inch square metal baking pan.
Cover; refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Makes 36 squares.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Butter Fudge. In a large glass bowl, place butter and peanut butter. Microwave on High until butter melts (1 1/2 to 2 minutes). Stir until blended. Add remaining ingredients and stir until lumps of sugar disappear. Microwave on High until softened, but not bubbly (1 to 1 1/2 minutes). Pour into a buttered 9-inch square metal baking pan. Cover; refrigerate at least 1 hour. Makes 36 squares.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
ingredients: 4 medium tart apples, peeled and sliced
directions: Mix sugar, cinnamon, flour, nutmeg.
Spread over apples.
Place in pie shells and dot half oleo over this.
Cover with unbaked pie shell and dot remaining oleo.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Mix sugar, cinnamon, flour, nutmeg. Spread over apples. Place in pie shells and dot half oleo over this. Cover with unbaked pie shell and dot remaining oleo. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. yellow squash, cooked and drained
directions: Melt butter and mix with stuffing.
Line dish with 1/2 mixture.
Mix other ingredients and spoon on top.
Add rest of stuffing.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Melt butter and mix with stuffing. Line dish with 1/2 mixture. Mix other ingredients and spoon on top. Add rest of stuffing. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pickled Okra
directions: Boil the first five ingredients and pour over okra, pepper, garlic and dill which have been placed in jars.
Seal.
recipes.text: Pickled Okra. Boil the first five ingredients and pour over okra, pepper, garlic and dill which have been placed in jars. Seal.

recipes.title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 450u00b0. In a large plastic bag (or bowl), mix all ingredients. Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated. Spread in shallow pan. Bake for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and brown.
recipes.text: Oven Roasted Potatoes. Preheat oven to 450u00b0. In a large plastic bag (or bowl), mix all ingredients. Close bag and shake until potatoes are evenly coated. Spread in shallow pan. Bake for 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and brown.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix the ground chuck, bell pepper, onion, eggs, flour, Dale sauce and cracker crumbs together.
Shape in loaf.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.
Mix the tomato sauce, ketchup and mustard together; pour over meat loaf.
Continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix the ground chuck, bell pepper, onion, eggs, flour, Dale sauce and cracker crumbs together. Shape in loaf. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes. Mix the tomato sauce, ketchup and mustard together; pour over meat loaf. Continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Cabbage
ingredients: 1 c. chopped onions (can also use green onions or even leeks)
directions: Steam the cabbage until tender, but not limp.
Fry the bacon until crisp and set aside.
Saut the onions in the bacon grease. Add the cabbage to the sauted onions; cover and cook until tender on medium heat.
You may need to add a little water depending on the water content of the cabbage.
Sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Enjoy!
Serves approximately 8.
recipes.text: Fried Cabbage. Steam the cabbage until tender, but not limp. Fry the bacon until crisp and set aside. Saut the onions in the bacon grease. Add the cabbage to the sauted onions; cover and cook until tender on medium heat. You may need to add a little water depending on the water content of the cabbage. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Enjoy! Serves approximately 8.

recipes.title: Heavenly Dirt Flower
directions: Mix everything, except the oreos.
Pour into a "Flower Pot." Top with crushed oreos (take the white filling out of the oreo). Garnish with gummy worms and artificial flower.
Kids really like this.
recipes.text: Heavenly Dirt Flower. Mix everything, except the oreos. Pour into a "Flower Pot." Top with crushed oreos (take the white filling out of the oreo). Garnish with gummy worms and artificial flower. Kids really like this.

recipes.title: Honey-Glazed Baked Pears
ingredients: 1/2 c. whipping cream or half and half
directions: Rinse and peel pears.
Cut into halves.
Remove cores. Lightly grease an ovenproof plate.
Place pear halves on plate, cut side down.
Squeeze juice from lemon.
Melt butter.
Brush pear halves with lemon juice.
Drizzle with
melted butter. Drizzle honey over pears and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Bake at 375u00b0 for about 10 minutes, basting with pan juices from time to time.
Add cream or half and half. Bake another 2 to 4 minutes. Remove from oven and garnish with mint leaves.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Honey-Glazed Baked Pears. Rinse and peel pears. Cut into halves. Remove cores. Lightly grease an ovenproof plate. Place pear halves on plate, cut side down. Squeeze juice from lemon. Melt butter. Brush pear halves with lemon juice. Drizzle with melted butter. Drizzle honey over pears and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 375u00b0 for about 10 minutes, basting with pan juices from time to time. Add cream or half and half. Bake another 2 to 4 minutes. Remove from oven and garnish with mint leaves. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Quick Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Spread on greased and floured cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 until golden.
recipes.text: Quick Peanut Butter Bars. Mix all ingredients. Spread on greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 until golden.

recipes.title: Dave'S Death By Chocolate
ingredients: 2 bags Sensations or 2 boxes Heath bars, crushed
directions: Bake cake as directed.
Cut cooled cake into 3 layers.
Place 1 layer of cake in the bottom of a glass bowl or trifle dish. Spread 1/3 of mousse on cake.
Spread 1/3 of Cool Whip on mousse. Sprinkle with candy.
Repeat this process with other layers. Enjoy!
recipes.text: Dave'S Death By Chocolate. Bake cake as directed. Cut cooled cake into 3 layers. Place 1 layer of cake in the bottom of a glass bowl or trifle dish. Spread 1/3 of mousse on cake. Spread 1/3 of Cool Whip on mousse. Sprinkle with candy. Repeat this process with other layers. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Zucchini Pancakes
directions: Beat eggs, salt, then add zucchini.
Beat again, then mix flour and baking powder.
Heat pan with oil on medium heat on stove or you can use electric skillet at 350u00b0 temperature.
Then drop with spoon in pan and fry until brown that edge, then turn on other side.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pancakes. Beat eggs, salt, then add zucchini. Beat again, then mix flour and baking powder. Heat pan with oil on medium heat on stove or you can use electric skillet at 350u00b0 temperature. Then drop with spoon in pan and fry until brown that edge, then turn on other side.

recipes.title: Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 (3 to 4 lbs) chuck or shoulder roast
directions: Season flour with salt and pepper.
Coat roast with mixture, brown in oil on all sides in dutch oven.
Add water to top of roast.
Add onion soup mix and stir.
Bake in 325 degree oven 2 to 2 1/2 hours depending on size of roast.
Roast is done when it comes apart when pierced with a fork.
recipes.text: Pot Roast. Season flour with salt and pepper. Coat roast with mixture, brown in oil on all sides in dutch oven. Add water to top of roast. Add onion soup mix and stir. Bake in 325 degree oven 2 to 2 1/2 hours depending on size of roast. Roast is done when it comes apart when pierced with a fork.

recipes.title: Cavatini
directions: Brown ground beef and drain.
Put sauce in pan to heat.
Add beef and pepperoni to sauce.
Heat on low.
While it is heating, cook noodles until tender; drain.
Mix noodles and sauce together and pour into baking dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake until hot through and cheese is melted, approximately 15 to 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Cavatini. Brown ground beef and drain. Put sauce in pan to heat. Add beef and pepperoni to sauce. Heat on low. While it is heating, cook noodles until tender; drain. Mix noodles and sauce together and pour into baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake until hot through and cheese is melted, approximately 15 to 20 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Priscilla'S Pear Pickles
directions: Wash, peel and core pears.
Place at once in 1-quart of water with 1 tablespoon vinegar added.
Combine sugar, vinegar and water.
Bring to a boil.
Add spices tied in a cheesecloth. Cover; boil 5 minutes.
Remove spices.
Put pears in hot pint jars.
Add syrup to within 1/2-inch from top of jar.
Make certain pears are covered with syrup.
Adjust lids.
Process in boiling water bath (212u00b0) for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Priscilla'S Pear Pickles. Wash, peel and core pears. Place at once in 1-quart of water with 1 tablespoon vinegar added. Combine sugar, vinegar and water. Bring to a boil. Add spices tied in a cheesecloth. Cover; boil 5 minutes. Remove spices. Put pears in hot pint jars. Add syrup to within 1/2-inch from top of jar. Make certain pears are covered with syrup. Adjust lids. Process in boiling water bath (212u00b0) for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Cranberry Mold
directions: Blend mayonnaise, milk and salt.
Add chicken, celery, parsley, water and gelatine.
Spread on bottom of pan and chill. Take jello and add 1 cup hot water, crushed pineapple and 1/2 cup nuts.
Chill until slightly set.
Pour jello over chicken mixture and chill.
recipes.text: Chicken Cranberry Mold. Blend mayonnaise, milk and salt. Add chicken, celery, parsley, water and gelatine. Spread on bottom of pan and chill. Take jello and add 1 cup hot water, crushed pineapple and 1/2 cup nuts. Chill until slightly set. Pour jello over chicken mixture and chill.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Supreme
directions: Brown hamburger with salt, sugar and pepper. Mix in tomato sauce. Simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Supreme. Brown hamburger with salt, sugar and pepper. Mix in tomato sauce. Simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven-Fried Zucchini Spears
directions: Cut zucchini into halves, then crosswise to get finger lengths.
On wax paper, mix all seasonings.
In small bowl, mix oil and water.
Toss zucchini spears in water mixture, then in crumbs.
Arrange on greased cookie sheet.
Bake in 475u00b0 oven for 7 minutes until brown.
Turn over and bake 3 minutes more.
recipes.text: Oven-Fried Zucchini Spears. Cut zucchini into halves, then crosswise to get finger lengths. On wax paper, mix all seasonings. In small bowl, mix oil and water. Toss zucchini spears in water mixture, then in crumbs. Arrange on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 475u00b0 oven for 7 minutes until brown. Turn over and bake 3 minutes more.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Grease cookie sheet.
Place all ingredients in a large bowl.
Blend 3 minutes.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet and bake at 375u00b0 until cookies are slightly brown, about 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Grease cookie sheet. Place all ingredients in a large bowl. Blend 3 minutes. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet and bake at 375u00b0 until cookies are slightly brown, about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Fingers
directions: Cream sugar and oleo.
Add flour, pecans and vanilla.
Roll out finger length and size.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 until brown, 20 to 25 minutes.
Dust while hot with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Butter Pecan Fingers. Cream sugar and oleo. Add flour, pecans and vanilla. Roll out finger length and size. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 until brown, 20 to 25 minutes. Dust while hot with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: E-Z Pumpkin Muffins
directions: Beat sugar, oil and eggs for 4 minutes.
Fold in pumpkin, nuts and vanilla; mix well.
Fold in dry mixture.
Pour into muffin cups.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: E-Z Pumpkin Muffins. Beat sugar, oil and eggs for 4 minutes. Fold in pumpkin, nuts and vanilla; mix well. Fold in dry mixture. Pour into muffin cups. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Sauerbraten
directions: Place meat in bowl; set aside.
Combine vinegar, water, peppercorns, bay leaves, cloves, salt and pepper in a saucepan. Heat to boiling.
Remove from heat; cool slightly.
Pour mixture over meat; cool.
Cover tightly and put in refrigerator.
Marinate for five days; turn meat once a day.
Remove meat from marinade and drain thoroughly.
Strain and reserve juice.
Using a Dutch oven, brown; add 1 cup marinade, carrots and onions.
Bring rapidly to a boil; cover tightly and simmer about 2 hours, or until tender. Remove meat and add gingersnaps and sugar into liquid in Dutch oven.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
This makes delicious gravy.
recipes.text: Sauerbraten. Place meat in bowl; set aside. Combine vinegar, water, peppercorns, bay leaves, cloves, salt and pepper in a saucepan. Heat to boiling. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Pour mixture over meat; cool. Cover tightly and put in refrigerator. Marinate for five days; turn meat once a day. Remove meat from marinade and drain thoroughly. Strain and reserve juice. Using a Dutch oven, brown; add 1 cup marinade, carrots and onions. Bring rapidly to a boil; cover tightly and simmer about 2 hours, or until tender. Remove meat and add gingersnaps and sugar into liquid in Dutch oven. Simmer for 10 minutes. This makes delicious gravy.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Boil for 6 minutes.
Add peanut butter; beat until cool.
Pour into buttered dish.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Mix all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for 6 minutes. Add peanut butter; beat until cool. Pour into buttered dish.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Spray small Corning Ware dish with nonstick cooking spray.
Pour apple pie filling into dish and sprinkle cinnamon on top of the apples.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Spray small Corning Ware dish with nonstick cooking spray. Pour apple pie filling into dish and sprinkle cinnamon on top of the apples.

recipes.title: Brownie Trifle
directions: Prepare brownie mix and bake according to package directions in 13 x 9-inch pan.
While warm, prick top with a fork and brush with Kahlua, if desired.
Let cool completely and crumble.
Prepare mouse mix according to directions, omit chilling.
recipes.text: Brownie Trifle. Prepare brownie mix and bake according to package directions in 13 x 9-inch pan. While warm, prick top with a fork and brush with Kahlua, if desired. Let cool completely and crumble. Prepare mouse mix according to directions, omit chilling.

recipes.title: Key West Grilled Chicken
directions: Place the chicken in a shallow dish; set aside. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients; mix well and pour over the chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour, turning occasionally.
recipes.text: Key West Grilled Chicken. Place the chicken in a shallow dish; set aside. In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients; mix well and pour over the chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour, turning occasionally.

recipes.title: Glazed Fruit Salad
directions: Drain pineapple, cherries and oranges.
Set aside.
Use juice to cook the pudding.
Cook until pudding thickens.
Cool; pour over fruit.
Gee, it's really good.
(Beautiful.)
recipes.text: Glazed Fruit Salad. Drain pineapple, cherries and oranges. Set aside. Use juice to cook the pudding. Cook until pudding thickens. Cool; pour over fruit. Gee, it's really good. (Beautiful.)

recipes.title: Cheese Crispies
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Combine ingredients with hands until thoroughly mixed.
Form small balls and place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Crispies. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Combine ingredients with hands until thoroughly mixed. Form small balls and place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Carrot Salad. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Tuna Surprise
ingredients: 1 c. solid tuna, drained and cubed
directions: Mix all ingredients and spoon in rolls (hot dog or hamburger). Wrap in foil or place close together in covered ovenware pan. Heat until cheese melts at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes.
If frozen, double time.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Tuna Surprise. Mix all ingredients and spoon in rolls (hot dog or hamburger). Wrap in foil or place close together in covered ovenware pan. Heat until cheese melts at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes. If frozen, double time. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs. Add sugar, oil, zucchini and vanilla.
Mix well. In a separate bowl, combine flour, salt, soda, baking powder and cinnamon and add to mixture.
Stir until well blended.
Add nuts and stir.
Makes 2 loaves.
Bake in 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans at 350u00b0 for 55 minutes.
Cool before taking out of pans.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs. Add sugar, oil, zucchini and vanilla. Mix well. In a separate bowl, combine flour, salt, soda, baking powder and cinnamon and add to mixture. Stir until well blended. Add nuts and stir. Makes 2 loaves. Bake in 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans at 350u00b0 for 55 minutes. Cool before taking out of pans.

recipes.title: Heavenly Squares
directions: Melt till smooth and remove from heat.
Cool and then add 2 1/2 c miniature marshmallows and nuts.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Heavenly Squares. Melt till smooth and remove from heat. Cool and then add 2 1/2 c miniature marshmallows and nuts. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Baked Scallops
ingredients: 1/4 c. dry grated cheese (Romano or Parmesan)
directions: Wash and pat dry scallops; simmer in wine 5 minutes.
Drain and save liquid.
Add mushrooms and shallots; simmer 20 minutes. In shallow baking dish, place scallops; pour mushroom mixture over and top with bread crumbs.
When ready to serve, place pat of butter on top and broil until crisp.
recipes.text: Baked Scallops. Wash and pat dry scallops; simmer in wine 5 minutes. Drain and save liquid. Add mushrooms and shallots; simmer 20 minutes. In shallow baking dish, place scallops; pour mushroom mixture over and top with bread crumbs. When ready to serve, place pat of butter on top and broil until crisp.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into crock-pot that has been sprayed with Pam. Reserve small amount of cheese for top. Cover and cook for 3 hours on low.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into crock-pot that has been sprayed with Pam. Reserve small amount of cheese for top. Cover and cook for 3 hours on low.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad In A Tomato Boat
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients.
Cut tomatoes almost through to make 6 to 8 petals.
Fill with chicken mixture.
Garnish with olives. Sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad In A Tomato Boat. Mix first 6 ingredients. Cut tomatoes almost through to make 6 to 8 petals. Fill with chicken mixture. Garnish with olives. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Zucchini "Spiced Apple" Pickles
ingredients: 14 to 20 c. zucchini, peeled, seeded and sliced
1/2 tsp. oil of cinnamon and oil of cloves
directions: Soak zucchini in cold water and lime overnight.
The next morning, drain and rinse thoroughly in clear, cold water.
In large kettle, bring vinegar and sugar to a boil.
Add the zucchini, cinnamon, cloves and food coloring.
Boil until the zucchini is clear (about 50 minutes).
Pack in sterilized jars. Seal and keep jars in hot water for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini "Spiced Apple" Pickles. Soak zucchini in cold water and lime overnight. The next morning, drain and rinse thoroughly in clear, cold water. In large kettle, bring vinegar and sugar to a boil. Add the zucchini, cinnamon, cloves and food coloring. Boil until the zucchini is clear (about 50 minutes). Pack in sterilized jars. Seal and keep jars in hot water for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Broccoli And Bacon Salad
directions: Cut broccoli into small flowerets and wash thoroughly.
Combine broccoli, onion, and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl.
Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients.
Add to the broccoli mixture, stirring until well coated.
Cover and chill.
Yields 5 cups.
recipes.text: Fresh Broccoli And Bacon Salad. Cut broccoli into small flowerets and wash thoroughly. Combine broccoli, onion, and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients. Add to the broccoli mixture, stirring until well coated. Cover and chill. Yields 5 cups.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Wash tomatoes; slice thin.
Dip in beaten eggs.
Roll in corn meal which has been seasoned to taste.
Place in hot cooking oil until golden brown.
recipes.text: Fried Green Tomatoes. Wash tomatoes; slice thin. Dip in beaten eggs. Roll in corn meal which has been seasoned to taste. Place in hot cooking oil until golden brown.

recipes.title: Grandmother'S Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine eggs, raisins and vanilla; let stand for 1 hour. Thoroughly cream shortening and sugars.
Sift flour, salt, soda and cinnamon into sugar mixture.
Mix well.
Blend in egg mixture and nuts.
Push dough by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes, until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Grandmother'S Oatmeal Cookies. Combine eggs, raisins and vanilla; let stand for 1 hour. Thoroughly cream shortening and sugars. Sift flour, salt, soda and cinnamon into sugar mixture. Mix well. Blend in egg mixture and nuts. Push dough by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes, until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Potato Patties
directions: Chop onion and green pepper. Mix all ingredients except oil. Shape into 6 patties. Brown patties on both sides in just enough oil to keep from sticking.
recipes.text: Potato Patties. Chop onion and green pepper. Mix all ingredients except oil. Shape into 6 patties. Brown patties on both sides in just enough oil to keep from sticking.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Fritters
directions: Combine flour and baking powder; stir well. Add milk, eggs and butter. Stir until smooth. Add bacon and sweet potato, stirring well.
Heat 3 to 4-inches of oil to 375u00b0 in a Dutch oven. Carefully drop batter by rounded tablespoonfuls into hot oil. Cook only a few at a time, turning once.
Fry 2 minutes or until fritters are golden brown. Drain well on paper towels. Serve warm with maple syrup.
Yields about 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Fritters. Combine flour and baking powder; stir well. Add milk, eggs and butter. Stir until smooth. Add bacon and sweet potato, stirring well. Heat 3 to 4-inches of oil to 375u00b0 in a Dutch oven. Carefully drop batter by rounded tablespoonfuls into hot oil. Cook only a few at a time, turning once. Fry 2 minutes or until fritters are golden brown. Drain well on paper towels. Serve warm with maple syrup. Yields about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Crab Linguini
directions: In a skillet combine chicken broth and white wine.
Boil until reduced to 1/3 cup.
Remove from the heat and slowly whisk in half and half and evaporated milk, stirring constantly until blended. Return to the heat and simmer until the mixture is reduced to 1-1/3 cup.
Meanwhile, combine 2 teaspoons softened butter with flour. Slowly whisk into the milk mixture.
Continue stirring until the sauce is thickened and no lumps remain.
Add crab, chopped parsley, chopped green onion, salt, and lemon juice.
Reduce the heat and simmer until the crab is heated through.
Meanwhile, cook linguini according to the package directions.
Toss with 1 tablespoon butter and grated parmesan cheese.
Pour the sauce over the pasta and toss until evenly coated.
recipes.text: Crab Linguini. In a skillet combine chicken broth and white wine. Boil until reduced to 1/3 cup. Remove from the heat and slowly whisk in half and half and evaporated milk, stirring constantly until blended. Return to the heat and simmer until the mixture is reduced to 1-1/3 cup. Meanwhile, combine 2 teaspoons softened butter with flour. Slowly whisk into the milk mixture. Continue stirring until the sauce is thickened and no lumps remain. Add crab, chopped parsley, chopped green onion, salt, and lemon juice. Reduce the heat and simmer until the crab is heated through. Meanwhile, cook linguini according to the package directions. Toss with 1 tablespoon butter and grated parmesan cheese. Pour the sauce over the pasta and toss until evenly coated.

recipes.title: Chicken B L T
ingredients: 3 c. romaine, Boston or iceberg lettuce
directions: Boil breasts.
Reduce to low heat and simmer 8 to 10 minutes until cooked. Remove, cool and cut up.
Boil chicken water.
Add pasta and cook 10 minutes until firm and tender. Drain well. Cook bacon and drain.
Break into small pieces.
Add pasta to dressing. Toss. Add rest of ingredients and toss to mix.
recipes.text: Chicken B L T. Boil breasts. Reduce to low heat and simmer 8 to 10 minutes until cooked. Remove, cool and cut up. Boil chicken water. Add pasta and cook 10 minutes until firm and tender. Drain well. Cook bacon and drain. Break into small pieces. Add pasta to dressing. Toss. Add rest of ingredients and toss to mix.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook and drain broccoli.
Make white sauce with butter, flour, salt,
pepper
and
milk;tremovetfrom heat.
Stir in onions, mayonnaise and beaten eggs.
Carefully stir in broccoli.
Turn into a 2-quart casserole.
Bake casserole in pan of hot
water at 350u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.tSprinkle with cheese during final 15 minutes of baking time.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook and drain broccoli. Make white sauce with butter, flour, salt, pepper and milk;tremovetfrom heat. Stir in onions, mayonnaise and beaten eggs. Carefully stir in broccoli. Turn into a 2-quart casserole. Bake casserole in pan of hot water at 350u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.tSprinkle with cheese during final 15 minutes of baking time.

recipes.title: Jal.  Rice
directions: Cook rice drain well. Add all ingredients. Stir well while rice is hot.
recipes.text: Jal.  Rice. Cook rice drain well. Add all ingredients. Stir well while rice is hot.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
directions: Roll cookies into crumbs (including filling).
Mix with butter and press into pan.
(Reserve some crumbs for top.) Mix pudding, milk and
cream
cheese.
Mix
until

over cookies.
Spread
