Creme topping over top and sprinkle a few cookie crumbs on top.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Oreo Cookie Dessert. Roll cookies into crumbs (including filling). Mix with butter and press into pan. (Reserve some crumbs for top.) Mix pudding, milk and cream cheese. Mix until pudding like; spread over cookies. Spread La Creme topping over top and sprinkle a few cookie crumbs on top. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken And Asparagus
directions: With top of chafing dish set in water pan, heat cream.
Blend flour and butter and stir into hot cream.
Add seasonings, chicken and asparagus.
When very hot, serve on split buttered biscuits. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken And Asparagus. With top of chafing dish set in water pan, heat cream. Blend flour and butter and stir into hot cream. Add seasonings, chicken and asparagus. When very hot, serve on split buttered biscuits. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles Coffee Cake
directions: Mix together the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, milk, margarine and egg.
Pour into a greased and floured 8 or 9-inch square pan.
Sprinkle top heavily with sugar (this gives a crusty top).
Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles Coffee Cake. Mix together the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, milk, margarine and egg. Pour into a greased and floured 8 or 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle top heavily with sugar (this gives a crusty top). Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Sugar Free Banana Bread
ingredients: 3/4 c. frozen unsweetened apple juice concentrate, thawed
directions: Mash bananas.
Mix in egg white, apple juice, melted margarine and vanilla.
Add flour, baking soda and cinnamon; mix well.
Stir in walnuts.
Pour into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan that has been sprayed with nonstick vegetable coating.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Leave in pan for 10 minutes and remove. Cool.
Wrap in plastic wrap overnight so the banana flavor will develop.
recipes.text: Sugar Free Banana Bread. Mash bananas. Mix in egg white, apple juice, melted margarine and vanilla. Add flour, baking soda and cinnamon; mix well. Stir in walnuts. Pour into 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan that has been sprayed with nonstick vegetable coating. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Do not overbake. Leave in pan for 10 minutes and remove. Cool. Wrap in plastic wrap overnight so the banana flavor will develop.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pie
directions: Blend all ingredients; pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pie. Blend all ingredients; pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until firm.

recipes.title: Swiss Potatoes
directions: Melt butter; add half and half.
Pour over hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Swiss cheese.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Swiss Potatoes. Melt butter; add half and half. Pour over hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Swiss cheese. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 large (6 1/2 oz.) can tuna in oil
directions: Cook noodles in salted water; drain.
Coat with butter. Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
In large saucepan, mix soup, milk, onion, pepper and salt.
Cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add tuna; combine with noodles and pour into 2-quart casserole.
Top may be sprinkled with bread crumbs.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Noodle Casserole. Cook noodles in salted water; drain. Coat with butter. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. In large saucepan, mix soup, milk, onion, pepper and salt. Cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently. Add tuna; combine with noodles and pour into 2-quart casserole. Top may be sprinkled with bread crumbs. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Ranch Burgers
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
directions: Add salad dressing mix to ground beef.
Mix well and form into patties.
Cook on grill and enjoy.
recipes.text: Ranch Burgers. Add salad dressing mix to ground beef. Mix well and form into patties. Cook on grill and enjoy.

recipes.title: Carrot Thyme Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, combine the stock and the carrots.
Bring the stock to a boil.
Simmer the carrots, covered for 20 minutes or until they are tender.
recipes.text: Carrot Thyme Soup. In a large saucepan, combine the stock and the carrots. Bring the stock to a boil. Simmer the carrots, covered for 20 minutes or until they are tender.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Dissolve strawberry jello in boiling water.
Add frozen strawberries and crushed pineapple.
Put in berries at once.
Stir until thawed.
Chill slightly.
Pour over creamed cheese mixture. Keep in refrigerator.
Great for dinner parties or potluck dinners.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pretzel Salad. Dissolve strawberry jello in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries and crushed pineapple. Put in berries at once. Stir until thawed. Chill slightly. Pour over creamed cheese mixture. Keep in refrigerator. Great for dinner parties or potluck dinners.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and oil.
Add eggs, well beaten.
Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture.
Mix well.
Make into long roll and refrigerate (wrapped) overnight.
Next day, slice into 1/4-inch slices and bake on greased cookie sheets at 400u00b0 for about 5 minutes or until golden.
Makes about 6 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Cookies. Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs, well beaten. Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture. Mix well. Make into long roll and refrigerate (wrapped) overnight. Next day, slice into 1/4-inch slices and bake on greased cookie sheets at 400u00b0 for about 5 minutes or until golden. Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Easy Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: 1 can mushroom soup, thinned with asparagus juice
directions: Cut asparagus into 1-inch pieces.
Make a layer of asparagus, layer of sliced eggs and a layer of soup, then repeat.
Top with buttered cracker crumbs (melt butter and crumble cracker crumbs in it).
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Asparagus Casserole. Cut asparagus into 1-inch pieces. Make a layer of asparagus, layer of sliced eggs and a layer of soup, then repeat. Top with buttered cracker crumbs (melt butter and crumble cracker crumbs in it). Bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Seafood Sauce
directions: Simmer ingredients for 10 minutes.
Pour over fish.
Cover and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours before cooking.
recipes.text: Seafood Sauce. Simmer ingredients for 10 minutes. Pour over fish. Cover and refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours before cooking.

recipes.title: Skillet Cobbler
ingredients: 1 box yellow or white cake mix
1 can peaches or any fruit in heavy syrup (large)
directions: In a cast-iron skillet, empty can of fruit.
Pour cake mix on top of fruit.
Do not stir.
Slice stick of butter and place over cake mix.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Skillet Cobbler. In a cast-iron skillet, empty can of fruit. Pour cake mix on top of fruit. Do not stir. Slice stick of butter and place over cake mix. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix graham crackers and butter and pour in bottom of pan. Beat remaining ingredients 20 minutes; pour over graham crackers.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix graham crackers and butter and pour in bottom of pan. Beat remaining ingredients 20 minutes; pour over graham crackers.

recipes.title: Marbled Brownies
directions: Soften the cream cheese and butter; beat together.
Add the sugar, eggs, flour and vanilla.
Beat until smooth and set aside. Prepare the cake-like brownie batter as directed on box.
Pour half the brownie batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Pour all the cream cheese mixture over the brownie layer.
Spoon the remaining brownie batter in spots over the top.
Swirl the 2 mixtures together with a knife.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool and frost with chocolate frosting.
recipes.text: Marbled Brownies. Soften the cream cheese and butter; beat together. Add the sugar, eggs, flour and vanilla. Beat until smooth and set aside. Prepare the cake-like brownie batter as directed on box. Pour half the brownie batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour all the cream cheese mixture over the brownie layer. Spoon the remaining brownie batter in spots over the top. Swirl the 2 mixtures together with a knife. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool and frost with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients well and pack in a tube cake pan which has been lined with wax paper.
Place in refrigerator 3 days before serving.
recipes.text: Uncooked Fruit Cake. Mix all ingredients well and pack in a tube cake pan which has been lined with wax paper. Place in refrigerator 3 days before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix together powdered sugar, cream cheese, peanut butter and Cool Whip until smooth.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Top with Cool Whip or pecans.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix together powdered sugar, cream cheese, peanut butter and Cool Whip until smooth. Pour into graham cracker crust. Top with Cool Whip or pecans.

recipes.title: Arroz Con Pollo
directions: Ahead of time:
Boil and debone chicken.
In skillet, heat oil.
Brown rice, onion and green pepper.
Add water, tomato sauce, chicken and spices.
Cover and simmer until water is gone.
recipes.text: Arroz Con Pollo. Ahead of time: Boil and debone chicken. In skillet, heat oil. Brown rice, onion and green pepper. Add water, tomato sauce, chicken and spices. Cover and simmer until water is gone.

recipes.title: Olive Craver'S Chicken Dressing
directions: Pour chicken broth over broken bread and cracker crumbs.
Soak and cool.
Add eggs, celery, parsley and dry ingredients.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown on top and bottom.
recipes.text: Olive Craver'S Chicken Dressing. Pour chicken broth over broken bread and cracker crumbs. Soak and cool. Add eggs, celery, parsley and dry ingredients. Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown on top and bottom.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
directions: Add all ingredients in a large pot.
Cover with water and cook, covered, for 1 hour.
Remove lid and boil down sauce slightly, if desired.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Adobo. Add all ingredients in a large pot. Cover with water and cook, covered, for 1 hour. Remove lid and boil down sauce slightly, if desired. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Black Russian Cake
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) box deep chocolate cake mix
3/4 c. kahlua and creme de cocoa
directions: Combine cake mix, oil, pudding, eggs, coffee and kahlua and creme de cocoa in a large mixing bowl.
Beat about 4 minutes at medium speed.
Spoon into a well-greased Bundt pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.
Remove cake from pan when cool. Punch holes in cake with meat fork and spoon topping over.
recipes.text: Black Russian Cake. Combine cake mix, oil, pudding, eggs, coffee and kahlua and creme de cocoa in a large mixing bowl. Beat about 4 minutes at medium speed. Spoon into a well-greased Bundt pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes. Remove cake from pan when cool. Punch holes in cake with meat fork and spoon topping over.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Brown sausage, celery and onion.
Add remaining ingredients and place in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Casserole. Brown sausage, celery and onion. Add remaining ingredients and place in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Batter For Shrimp Or Fish
directions: Wash, drain and dry shrimp or fish with paper towels.
recipes.text: Batter For Shrimp Or Fish. Wash, drain and dry shrimp or fish with paper towels.

recipes.title: Green Spaghetti
directions: Steam the fresh spinach until just wilted or the frozen until warm.
Put spinach and its liquid into blender.
Add warm broth and liquify.
Stir cheese and milk into puree.
Toss spaghetti with butter, then with green sauce.
recipes.text: Green Spaghetti. Steam the fresh spinach until just wilted or the frozen until warm. Put spinach and its liquid into blender. Add warm broth and liquify. Stir cheese and milk into puree. Toss spaghetti with butter, then with green sauce.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients, then add enough mayonnaise to make it smooth.
Add cayenne pepper to taste.
Remember cayenne gets hotter the longer it sits.
Better if it sits overnight.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Mix first 4 ingredients, then add enough mayonnaise to make it smooth. Add cayenne pepper to taste. Remember cayenne gets hotter the longer it sits. Better if it sits overnight.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients.
Mix together the flour, baking soda and salt; add to first mixture.
Add the chocolate chips and chopped nuts.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Combine the first 5 ingredients. Mix together the flour, baking soda and salt; add to first mixture. Add the chocolate chips and chopped nuts. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Rolls
ingredients: 1 pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water saved from cooked potatoes
directions: Put potatoes through sieve to avoid lumps in potatoes.
Add enough flour to make a soft dough (about 5 cups).
Let rise until double in size.
Make into rolls and bake in a 375u00b0 oven.
This will keep in refrigerator for several days.
recipes.text: Rolls. Put potatoes through sieve to avoid lumps in potatoes. Add enough flour to make a soft dough (about 5 cups). Let rise until double in size. Make into rolls and bake in a 375u00b0 oven. This will keep in refrigerator for several days.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Coffee Cake
directions: Cream butter until soft.
Add sugar and cream until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt together.
Add dry ingredients alternately with the sour cream, beginning and ending with the flour mixture.
Stir in the vanilla.
recipes.text: Yum Yum Coffee Cake. Cream butter until soft. Add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt together. Add dry ingredients alternately with the sour cream, beginning and ending with the flour mixture. Stir in the vanilla.

recipes.title: Crab Meat Dip
ingredients: 16 oz. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened with 1 tsp. milk
directions: Whip together and add meat.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve in chafing dish.
Slivered almonds on top are optional.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Crab Meat Dip. Whip together and add meat. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve in chafing dish. Slivered almonds on top are optional. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: 7-Up Salad
directions: Set cream cheese out until room temperature.
Cook the marshmallows and 7-Up over medium heat until melted; add the lime jello.
Add this mixture slowly to the room temperature cream cheese and beat until smooth.
Add the pineapple and nuts.
Chill until partially set.
Fold in the Cool Whip and beat thoroughly. Pour into mold or serving bowl and chill.
recipes.text: 7-Up Salad. Set cream cheese out until room temperature. Cook the marshmallows and 7-Up over medium heat until melted; add the lime jello. Add this mixture slowly to the room temperature cream cheese and beat until smooth. Add the pineapple and nuts. Chill until partially set. Fold in the Cool Whip and beat thoroughly. Pour into mold or serving bowl and chill.

recipes.title: Noodles And Ham Casserole
directions: Cook medium noodles.
Cube cooked ham.
For sauce, warm mushroom soup.
Mix sour cream and finely minced fresh onion (3 to 5 tablespoons).
Layer the noodles, ham and then sauce.
On top, add chow mein noodles or slivered almonds.
Bake in greased casserole for 30 minutes at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Noodles And Ham Casserole. Cook medium noodles. Cube cooked ham. For sauce, warm mushroom soup. Mix sour cream and finely minced fresh onion (3 to 5 tablespoons). Layer the noodles, ham and then sauce. On top, add chow mein noodles or slivered almonds. Bake in greased casserole for 30 minutes at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Baked Boston Brown Bread
directions: Butter two No. 2 cans. Mix sugar, raisins, soda and salt. Add butter and pour water over all. Simmer for 5 minutes and cool. Add egg and flour to mixture. Blend. Pour into cans. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Baked Boston Brown Bread. Butter two No. 2 cans. Mix sugar, raisins, soda and salt. Add butter and pour water over all. Simmer for 5 minutes and cool. Add egg and flour to mixture. Blend. Pour into cans. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Country Cabbage And Sausage
directions: Wash cabbage and cut into eight sections.
Put cabbage in a pot, add enough water to cover cabbage.
Cook it until tender. Add salt, sugar and grease.
Boil hard for
5 to 10 minutes. Reduce heat and simmer until liquid is low.
Add sausage that has been cut into 3-inch pieces and cook 5 to 10 minutes on medium heat.
recipes.text: Country Cabbage And Sausage. Wash cabbage and cut into eight sections. Put cabbage in a pot, add enough water to cover cabbage. Cook it until tender. Add salt, sugar and grease. Boil hard for 5 to 10 minutes. Reduce heat and simmer until liquid is low. Add sausage that has been cut into 3-inch pieces and cook 5 to 10 minutes on medium heat.

recipes.title: Six Layer Dinner
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes (16 oz.) or 1 can tomato bisque soup (half diluted) or 1 can tomato rice soup (half diluted) or 1 can tomato soup (half diluted)
directions: Layer vegetables, starting with potatoes, then layer carrots, meat, onions, rice, celery and keep in layers.
Pour tomatoes or soup over all.
Season each layer with salt,
pepper and butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Six Layer Dinner. Layer vegetables, starting with potatoes, then layer carrots, meat, onions, rice, celery and keep in layers. Pour tomatoes or soup over all. Season each layer with salt, pepper and butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Swiss Chicken Cutlets
directions: Cut each cheese in half.
Place one half on top of each cutlet.
Starting with a short end, tightly roll up cutlets, jelly roll style.
Tie securely with string.
On waxed paper, combine flour and pepper.
Mix well.
Add cutlets, tossed gently to coat.
recipes.text: Swiss Chicken Cutlets. Cut each cheese in half. Place one half on top of each cutlet. Starting with a short end, tightly roll up cutlets, jelly roll style. Tie securely with string. On waxed paper, combine flour and pepper. Mix well. Add cutlets, tossed gently to coat.

recipes.title: Savory Baked Spaghetti(Serves 6)
directions: Slowly cook onions and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add hamburg; cook, stirring occasionally, until meat loses red color.
Stir in salt, pepper and tomatoes (put tomatoes through sieve or squash with hands.)
Simmer covered 30 minutes.
Add chili powder and water.
Start oven to 325u00b0.
Break half of uncooked spaghetti in greased casserole.
Pour half of sauce over spaghetti.
Sprinkle with half of cheese.
Break in rest of spaghetti; add rest of sauce and sprinkle with remainder of cheese.
Bake covered 35 minutes.
Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer or until brown.
recipes.text: Savory Baked Spaghetti(Serves 6). Slowly cook onions and garlic in oil 5 minutes. Add hamburg; cook, stirring occasionally, until meat loses red color. Stir in salt, pepper and tomatoes (put tomatoes through sieve or squash with hands.) Simmer covered 30 minutes. Add chili powder and water. Start oven to 325u00b0. Break half of uncooked spaghetti in greased casserole. Pour half of sauce over spaghetti. Sprinkle with half of cheese. Break in rest of spaghetti; add rest of sauce and sprinkle with remainder of cheese. Bake covered 35 minutes. Uncover; bake 15 minutes longer or until brown.

recipes.title: Choc-Chip Banana Bread
directions: Combine 1 Tbsp. flour with the chocolate chips, set aside. Mix remaining ingredients. Fold floured chocolate chips into mixture. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Choc-Chip Banana Bread. Combine 1 Tbsp. flour with the chocolate chips, set aside. Mix remaining ingredients. Fold floured chocolate chips into mixture. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dinner Rolls
directions: Mix yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in 1/2 cup warm water.
Let rise until cup is full.
Scald milk; cream together butter and sugar, then beaten eggs and salt.
Add milk with flour and beat after each addition.
Add yeast and beat well again.
Turn out on floured board and knead until satiny.
Place in greased bowl; cover and set in warm place to rise until double in bulk (about 1 to 1 1/2 hours).
Knead again and cut into rolls.
Let rise again until ready to bake.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven until golden brown.
recipes.text: Dinner Rolls. Mix yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in 1/2 cup warm water. Let rise until cup is full. Scald milk; cream together butter and sugar, then beaten eggs and salt. Add milk with flour and beat after each addition. Add yeast and beat well again. Turn out on floured board and knead until satiny. Place in greased bowl; cover and set in warm place to rise until double in bulk (about 1 to 1 1/2 hours). Knead again and cut into rolls. Let rise again until ready to bake. Bake in 350u00b0 oven until golden brown.

recipes.title: Pepper Jelly
directions: Put peppers all in blender and liquify.
Strain and use juice only.
Add juice, vinegar and 6 cups sugar.
Bring to boil; remove from heat and skim top.
Return to heat and add Certo and red or green food coloring.
Bring to hard boil for 1 minute.
Jar and seal.
recipes.text: Pepper Jelly. Put peppers all in blender and liquify. Strain and use juice only. Add juice, vinegar and 6 cups sugar. Bring to boil; remove from heat and skim top. Return to heat and add Certo and red or green food coloring. Bring to hard boil for 1 minute. Jar and seal.

recipes.title: Chicken Bundles
directions: Boil chicken (or do in crock-pot) and debone.
Cut in bite-size pieces.
Add cream cheese and half of melted butter. Mix well, then spread on crescent rolls; fold.
Roll in bread crumbs which have been mixed with remaining half of butter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Bundles. Boil chicken (or do in crock-pot) and debone. Cut in bite-size pieces. Add cream cheese and half of melted butter. Mix well, then spread on crescent rolls; fold. Roll in bread crumbs which have been mixed with remaining half of butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Raisin Cream Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour and salt.
Add eggs and sour cream; cook until thick.
Add raisins, nuts and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour into baked pie crust.
Top with meringue.
recipes.text: Raisin Cream Pie. Combine sugar, flour and salt. Add eggs and sour cream; cook until thick. Add raisins, nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into baked pie crust. Top with meringue.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, pudding and eggs thoroughly.
Pour in 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Sprinkle with butterscotch chips or brown sugar and nuts on top of batter and bake as directed on box.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Cake. Mix cake mix, pudding and eggs thoroughly. Pour in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with butterscotch chips or brown sugar and nuts on top of batter and bake as directed on box.

recipes.title: Pretzel Jello Mold
directions: Mix pretzels, butter, 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
Cool.
recipes.text: Pretzel Jello Mold. Mix pretzels, butter, 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes in 350u00b0 oven. Cool.

recipes.title: Coconut Pudding Pie
directions: Bake pie shell.
Prepare dessert topping mix as directed on package.
Fold in pudding and 1 cup of the coconut.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Sprinkle with remaining coconut.
Chill at least 2 hours or until set.
Stir in orange juice with jam.
Serve with pie as topping.
recipes.text: Coconut Pudding Pie. Bake pie shell. Prepare dessert topping mix as directed on package. Fold in pudding and 1 cup of the coconut. Pour into baked pie shell. Sprinkle with remaining coconut. Chill at least 2 hours or until set. Stir in orange juice with jam. Serve with pie as topping.

recipes.title: Santa Fe Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, pounded thin and flat
directions: Place ham and cheese on flattened chicken breast and roll up. Place rolled chicken breast into chili shell and secure with toothpick.
Place stuffed chilies into buttered baking dish.
Pour liquids over stuffed chilies and bake 45 minutes to an hour at 350u00b0.
Serve over rice.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Santa Fe Chicken. Place ham and cheese on flattened chicken breast and roll up. Place rolled chicken breast into chili shell and secure with toothpick. Place stuffed chilies into buttered baking dish. Pour liquids over stuffed chilies and bake 45 minutes to an hour at 350u00b0. Serve over rice. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Chicken Tofu
directions: Brown chicken with 1 tablespoon oil. Add sugar, salt, water and shoyu. Simmer until chicken is tender (30 minutes). Add green onions and tofu. Flip the pot in upward movement (with lid) to mix.
Yields 3 or 4 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Tofu. Brown chicken with 1 tablespoon oil. Add sugar, salt, water and shoyu. Simmer until chicken is tender (30 minutes). Add green onions and tofu. Flip the pot in upward movement (with lid) to mix. Yields 3 or 4 servings.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Macaroni
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. macaroni, cooked and drained
1/2 to 3/4 stick melted butter or margarine
directions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot.
Mix well.
Cook on low 4 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Macaroni. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. Mix well. Cook on low 4 hours.

recipes.title: Chili Burgers(Diabetic Recipe)
directions: Brown hamburger and onions in a pan. Drain fat, add soup and chili powder. Stir and simmer for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chili Burgers(Diabetic Recipe). Brown hamburger and onions in a pan. Drain fat, add soup and chili powder. Stir and simmer for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Boiled Fish
directions: Use a two-gallon pot.
Fill 3/4 full of water.
Add two large potatoes and about 1/2 cup salt.
Bring water to boil.
Add a fatty fish such as trout.
Cook until done (fork easily penetrates flesh).
Season and serve.
Larger fish are best prepared by this method.
Allow 2 lb. fish for every 2 potatoes.
recipes.text: Boiled Fish. Use a two-gallon pot. Fill 3/4 full of water. Add two large potatoes and about 1/2 cup salt. Bring water to boil. Add a fatty fish such as trout. Cook until done (fork easily penetrates flesh). Season and serve. Larger fish are best prepared by this method. Allow 2 lb. fish for every 2 potatoes.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Cook vegetables. Drain and mix all together. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Mixed Vegetable Casserole. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Cook vegetables. Drain and mix all together. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Beer Bread
directions: Pour all ingredients except butter into loaf pan and mix well. Pour butter over top and bake at 375u00b0 for 35 minutes.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Beer Bread. Pour all ingredients except butter into loaf pan and mix well. Pour butter over top and bake at 375u00b0 for 35 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Ham Puffs
directions: Combine
butter, cheese, ham and seasonings.
Add flour and shape into small balls.
Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.
Yield:
50 puffs.
(Freezes well.)
recipes.text: Ham Puffs. Combine butter, cheese, ham and seasonings. Add flour and shape into small balls. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Yield: 50 puffs. (Freezes well.)

recipes.title: Cherry Dessert
directions: Add the sugar first to the cream cheese and beat in one egg at a time.
Beat until smooth, then pour over the crust.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven and pour over it 1 can of cherry or blueberry pie filling mix.
Top with whipped cream if you wish.
recipes.text: Cherry Dessert. Add the sugar first to the cream cheese and beat in one egg at a time. Beat until smooth, then pour over the crust. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and pour over it 1 can of cherry or blueberry pie filling mix. Top with whipped cream if you wish.

recipes.title: Southern Biscuits
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients.
Cut in shortening; rub by hand until crumbly.
Pour buttermilk into flour mixture and knead 3 to 4 times.
Roll dough to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick.
Fold over and cut into 2 to 3-inch biscuits.
Bake in a 400u00b0 oven until very lightly browned.
recipes.text: Southern Biscuits. Mix the first 4 ingredients. Cut in shortening; rub by hand until crumbly. Pour buttermilk into flour mixture and knead 3 to 4 times. Roll dough to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Fold over and cut into 2 to 3-inch biscuits. Bake in a 400u00b0 oven until very lightly browned.

recipes.title: Cantaloupe Pie
directions: Cut melon in half; remove the seeds and peel.
Cut into chunks and place in container of electric blender; process until smooth. Combine 1/2 cup melon puree and cream cheese in container of an electric blender; process until smooth.
Add to remaining melon puree; set aside.
Combine sugar, gelatin and orange juice in a small saucepan; let stand 2 minutes.
Cook over low heat, stirring until sugar and gelatin dissolve.
Slowly add to melon mixture, stirring well.
Pour into chilled crust; chill until firm. Garnish pie with a dollop of whipped cream and cantaloupe balls, if desired.
recipes.text: Cantaloupe Pie. Cut melon in half; remove the seeds and peel. Cut into chunks and place in container of electric blender; process until smooth. Combine 1/2 cup melon puree and cream cheese in container of an electric blender; process until smooth. Add to remaining melon puree; set aside. Combine sugar, gelatin and orange juice in a small saucepan; let stand 2 minutes. Cook over low heat, stirring until sugar and gelatin dissolve. Slowly add to melon mixture, stirring well. Pour into chilled crust; chill until firm. Garnish pie with a dollop of whipped cream and cantaloupe balls, if desired.

recipes.title: Diet Nibble Mix
directions: Pop the popcorn without oil.
Combine with next 2 ingredients and bake in 300u00b0 oven for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with butter. Combine cheese and dressing mix.
Sprinkle this over mixture. Makes 9 cups.
One-half cup servings contain 57 calories, 2 gm. protein, 9 gm. carbohydrates and 2 gm. fat.
recipes.text: Diet Nibble Mix. Pop the popcorn without oil. Combine with next 2 ingredients and bake in 300u00b0 oven for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with butter. Combine cheese and dressing mix. Sprinkle this over mixture. Makes 9 cups. One-half cup servings contain 57 calories, 2 gm. protein, 9 gm. carbohydrates and 2 gm. fat.

recipes.title: Garden Coleslaw
directions: Combine first four ingredients well.
In salad dressing jar combine remaining items.
Shake very well.
Pour over vegetables. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Garden Coleslaw. Combine first four ingredients well. In salad dressing jar combine remaining items. Shake very well. Pour over vegetables. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Caramels
directions: Boil all together except 1 cup cream, nuts and vanilla.
Boil 30 minutes.
Add second cup of cream and boil to firm ball (248u00b0 on candy thermometer).
Remove from heat; add vanilla and nuts and pour into well buttered cookie sheet.
Cook in a heavy pan and stir.
A pressure cooker kettle works well.
recipes.text: Caramels. Boil all together except 1 cup cream, nuts and vanilla. Boil 30 minutes. Add second cup of cream and boil to firm ball (248u00b0 on candy thermometer). Remove from heat; add vanilla and nuts and pour into well buttered cookie sheet. Cook in a heavy pan and stir. A pressure cooker kettle works well.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Use a greased dish.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Use a greased dish.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing For Tossed Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients together and pour over tossed salad.
recipes.text: Salad Dressing For Tossed Salad. Combine all ingredients together and pour over tossed salad.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Cook and stir meat, onion and pepper until meat is brown and onion is tender.
Stir in remaining ingredients except spaghetti and cheese.
Cover and simmer on low heat; stir often.
Cook spaghetti and pour sauce over it.
Top with cheese.
Serve with salad and crusty rolls or French or Italian bread.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Cook and stir meat, onion and pepper until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except spaghetti and cheese. Cover and simmer on low heat; stir often. Cook spaghetti and pour sauce over it. Top with cheese. Serve with salad and crusty rolls or French or Italian bread.

recipes.title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients in a medium mixing bowl; blend thoroughly.
Spread mixture evenly in a glass loaf dish.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave at power level "High" for 18 to 20 minutes or until center is no longer pink when fork or knife is inserted.
Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Cheesy Meat Loaf. Combine all ingredients in a medium mixing bowl; blend thoroughly. Spread mixture evenly in a glass loaf dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at power level "High" for 18 to 20 minutes or until center is no longer pink when fork or knife is inserted. Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Fudge Krispies
ingredients: 1 (11 1/2 oz.) pkg. Nestle chocolate chip morsels
directions: Combine morsels, butter and corn syrup in medium saucepan. Melt and smooth.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla extract and sugar.
Add Rice Krispies; mix until well coated.
Spread evenly in a baking pan.
Chill until firm.
Cut into small square pieces. Enjoy.
recipes.text: Fudge Krispies. Combine morsels, butter and corn syrup in medium saucepan. Melt and smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla extract and sugar. Add Rice Krispies; mix until well coated. Spread evenly in a baking pan. Chill until firm. Cut into small square pieces. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. chicken stock or 2 c. water with 2 chicken bouillon cubes (warm)
directions: Line bottom of pan with chicken; spread can of soup on chicken.
Mix 1 stick of margarine in warm chicken stock.
Mix stuffing mix with liquid.
Put on top of chicken in pan.
Make sure dressing mix is moist.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes, until brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Line bottom of pan with chicken; spread can of soup on chicken. Mix 1 stick of margarine in warm chicken stock. Mix stuffing mix with liquid. Put on top of chicken in pan. Make sure dressing mix is moist. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes, until brown.

recipes.title: Pot Roast
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and cut in half
directions: Coat roast with flour.
Add oil to hot pan, preferably a dutch oven.
Brown roast on all sides in hot pan on top of stove. Remove from pan and drain off any remaining oil.
Add meat back to pan along with seasonings, 1/2 c broth and wine.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
Add vegetables to pot and continue to bake for about 60 minutes or until meat reaches desired doneness. Check pot occasionally to make sure there is
1/2 to 1 inch of liquid in pan; add additional broth if necessary.
recipes.text: Pot Roast. Coat roast with flour. Add oil to hot pan, preferably a dutch oven. Brown roast on all sides in hot pan on top of stove. Remove from pan and drain off any remaining oil. Add meat back to pan along with seasonings, 1/2 c broth and wine. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Add vegetables to pot and continue to bake for about 60 minutes or until meat reaches desired doneness. Check pot occasionally to make sure there is 1/2 to 1 inch of liquid in pan; add additional broth if necessary.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Ornaments
directions: Mix together dry ingredients in plastic bag.
Add applesauce, one tablespoon at a time.
Dough will seem dry, but will form a ball.
Pat a small amount on cutting board 1/4-inch thick.
Cut with cookie cutter.
Cut a small piece of wire and bend to form a "U" shape.
Insert into top of shape.
Let air dry for 1 or 2 days. Makes about 20 small ornaments.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Ornaments. Mix together dry ingredients in plastic bag. Add applesauce, one tablespoon at a time. Dough will seem dry, but will form a ball. Pat a small amount on cutting board 1/4-inch thick. Cut with cookie cutter. Cut a small piece of wire and bend to form a "U" shape. Insert into top of shape. Let air dry for 1 or 2 days. Makes about 20 small ornaments.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and margarine together.
Beat eggs.
Add remaining ingredients, including chocolate mixture, to beaten eggs. Mix well.
Bake in a 13 x 9 pan at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Brownies. Melt chocolate and margarine together. Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients, including chocolate mixture, to beaten eggs. Mix well. Bake in a 13 x 9 pan at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Soup(Made With Watkins Cream For Soup And Sauces)
ingredients: Watkins cream for soup and sauces
directions: Use enough water to cover potatoes, onion and celery.
Cover and boil until done (do not drain water).
Make sauces from the directions on Watkins can of cream.
Mix together and serve hot.
recipes.text: Potato Soup(Made With Watkins Cream For Soup And Sauces). Use enough water to cover potatoes, onion and celery. Cover and boil until done (do not drain water). Make sauces from the directions on Watkins can of cream. Mix together and serve hot.

recipes.title: The Ultimate Rice Pudding...Raisins Optional
directions: Rinse rice and cook in 6 cups of milk. Add salt. At low boil, simmer 20 minutes. Add sugar. Simmer until mixture thickens. Blend eggs in 1/2 cup milk. Add egg/milk mixture and vanilla to rice. Bring to a boil. Add cream. Return to boil. Remove from heat. Stir in raisins. Add spice to taste. Cool and refrigerate.
recipes.text: The Ultimate Rice Pudding...Raisins Optional. Rinse rice and cook in 6 cups of milk. Add salt. At low boil, simmer 20 minutes. Add sugar. Simmer until mixture thickens. Blend eggs in 1/2 cup milk. Add egg/milk mixture and vanilla to rice. Bring to a boil. Add cream. Return to boil. Remove from heat. Stir in raisins. Add spice to taste. Cool and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Color Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Color Cookies. Mix ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch of broccoli or 2 pkg. broccoli florets
1/2 tsp. Mrs. Dash seasoning or to taste
directions: Cook pasta to slightly firm and let cool slightly.
Mix vegetables and seasoning together and then add to pasta.
Toss together, then add dressing.
Toss until everything is coated with dressing.
Put in the refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta to slightly firm and let cool slightly. Mix vegetables and seasoning together and then add to pasta. Toss together, then add dressing. Toss until everything is coated with dressing. Put in the refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Company Vegetables
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas and carrots (mixed)
1 or 2 (10 oz.) cans water chestnuts, sliced
3 Tbsp. sherry (this may be reduced to 1 Tbsp. or omitted)
directions: Cook frozen vegetables according to directions on packages. Drain.
Combine with other ingredients in buttered 2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
Stir 2 or 3 times while baking.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Company Vegetables. Cook frozen vegetables according to directions on packages. Drain. Combine with other ingredients in buttered 2-quart casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. Stir 2 or 3 times while baking. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Jill'S Pride Of Iowa Cookies
directions: Use a large bowl; beat eggs, then add sugars and butter.
Mix well by hand.
Add flour, soda, baking powder and vanilla.
Stir in oatmeal, nuts and chips.

glass baking dish. Crumble oat mixture over apples. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Mexican Lasagne
directions: Cook ground meat, zucchini, onion and peppers in a large skillet until meat is browned and vegetables are tender.
Drain excess fat.
Add tomato sauce, picante sauce, pinto beans, bouillon granules, cumin, salt and oregano.
Simmer, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Lightly spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with nonstick Pam spray.
Arrange as follows:
1/3 meat sauce, 3 lasagne noodles, 1/2 cheese, 1/3 meat, all sour cream, remaining noodles and remaining meat sauce.
Cover loosely with foil and bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and olives. Return to oven until cheese melts.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Potato Soup
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Wash potatoes; pierce several times with fork.
Bake 1 hour or until done.
Cut in halves lengthwise, scoop out pulp; discard jackets.
Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Add flour; cook until smooth, stirring constantly.
Cook for 1 minute longer.
Add milk gradually; cook over medium heat until thickened and bubbly, stirring constantly.
Add potato pulp, salt, pepper, 2 tablespoons green onions, 1/2 cup bacon and 1 cup cheese. Cook until heated through.
Stir in sour cream.
Serve topped with remaining green onions, bacon and cheese.
Yield:
6 to 8 servings.

Combine sugar, cinnamon and pudding.
Sprinkle over the balls.
Drizzle the melted oleo over all.

ner: cream of celery soup or cream of mushroom soup

Set aside.

Spoon high into ladyfinger crust.

recipes.title: Rutabaga Au Gratin
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a saucepan.
Add water to cover and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 12 to 15 minutes.
Melt butter in saucepan, add flour and milk until thickened and bubbly.
Add salt, pepper and cheese until it melts.
Stir in drained turnips and put in a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart glass casserole.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Rutabaga Au Gratin. Combine first 3 ingredients in a saucepan. Add water to cover and bring to a boil. Simmer for 12 to 15 minutes. Melt butter in saucepan, add flour and milk until thickened and bubbly. Add salt, pepper and cheese until it melts. Stir in drained turnips and put in a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart glass casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Put cleaned berries into pie shell.
Mix other ingredients and cook until thick.
Pour over berries using fork to make sure berries are coated.
Cool and top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Pie. Put cleaned berries into pie shell. Mix other ingredients and cook until thick. Pour over berries using fork to make sure berries are coated. Cool and top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix meats together.
Add bread crumbs, then milk.
Add all other ingredients, except catsup, flour and water.
Shape into a loaf.
Put loaf into a greased pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.
Remove from oven.
Add flour to pan, stirring to mix with fat.
Add water; mix.
Pour catsup over top of loaf.
Return to oven for gravy to thicken.
Serve with mashed potatoes or rice. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix meats together. Add bread crumbs, then milk. Add all other ingredients, except catsup, flour and water. Shape into a loaf. Put loaf into a greased pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Remove from oven. Add flour to pan, stirring to mix with fat. Add water; mix. Pour catsup over top of loaf. Return to oven for gravy to thicken. Serve with mashed potatoes or rice. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Lemon Fruit Sauce(To Serve Over Fresh Fruit)
ingredients: 1/2 c. Farm Rich or Farm Rich Light
directions: Mix all together and serve over fresh fruit.
Delicious.
recipes.text: Lemon Fruit Sauce(To Serve Over Fresh Fruit). Mix all together and serve over fresh fruit. Delicious.

recipes.title: Nana'S Pretzel Salad
directions: First Layer:
Mix and press into dish, butter, sugar and pretzels.
recipes.text: Nana'S Pretzel Salad. First Layer: Mix and press into dish, butter, sugar and pretzels.

recipes.title: Bean Soup
directions: Soak beans overnight.
Combine all other ingredients and cook until beans are tender, approximately 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Bean Soup. Soak beans overnight. Combine all other ingredients and cook until beans are tender, approximately 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Shrimp Chowder
directions: Cook the first 4 ingredients in salt water until tender.
Add shrimp.
Cook 10 minutes.
Add cheese; stir until melted.
Soup should be thick and creamy.
Thin with milk if necessary.
recipes.text: Shrimp Chowder. Cook the first 4 ingredients in salt water until tender. Add shrimp. Cook 10 minutes. Add cheese; stir until melted. Soup should be thick and creamy. Thin with milk if necessary.

recipes.title: Quick Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all together and refrigerate for several hours.
recipes.text: Quick Fruit Salad. Mix all together and refrigerate for several hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cookie Bites
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Melt over hot water the chocolate bars; stir until smooth.
Remove from heat; cool 5 minutes.
In small bowl, beat eggs and salt at high speed until thickened, 3 minutes. Add brown sugar and beat at high speed until thick, about 5 minutes.
Beat in cooled chocolate and vanilla until smooth.
Drop onto greased pan.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes; cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cookie Bites. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Melt over hot water the chocolate bars; stir until smooth. Remove from heat; cool 5 minutes. In small bowl, beat eggs and salt at high speed until thickened, 3 minutes. Add brown sugar and beat at high speed until thick, about 5 minutes. Beat in cooled chocolate and vanilla until smooth. Drop onto greased pan. Bake 8 to 10 minutes; cool.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
directions: Saut the onion and carrots in the oil.
Add the water and chicken bouillon cubes until cubes are dissolved (about 15 minutes).
Add the noodles.
Cook until noodles are tender.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese Soup. Saut the onion and carrots in the oil. Add the water and chicken bouillon cubes until cubes are dissolved (about 15 minutes). Add the noodles. Cook until noodles are tender.

recipes.title: Pot Roast Of Beef
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. brisket, rump or pot roast
1/2 c. water or beef consomme/beef bouillon
directions: Pare potatoes and carrots; slice both thinly.
Slice onion. Put vegetables in bottom of crock-pot.
Add seasoning and meat to crock-pot.
Add liquid.
Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours).
recipes.text: Pot Roast Of Beef. Pare potatoes and carrots; slice both thinly. Slice onion. Put vegetables in bottom of crock-pot. Add seasoning and meat to crock-pot. Add liquid. Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours).

recipes.title: Crunchy Chinese Cole Slaw
ingredients: 2 pkg. chicken flavor Top Ramen soup mix (save flavor packet for dressing)
directions: Break up uncooked noodles.
Combine with all ingredients and cabbage.
Toss together.
Add dressing.
Toss well and chill.
recipes.text: Crunchy Chinese Cole Slaw. Break up uncooked noodles. Combine with all ingredients and cabbage. Toss together. Add dressing. Toss well and chill.

recipes.title: Shrimp Cocktail
directions: Mix the ketchup and cognac and slowly add the cream until the mixture is a pale pink.
Mix in the paprika.
Add the shrimp and mushrooms.
Serve in cocktail glasses with a slice of lemon.
recipes.text: Shrimp Cocktail. Mix the ketchup and cognac and slowly add the cream until the mixture is a pale pink. Mix in the paprika. Add the shrimp and mushrooms. Serve in cocktail glasses with a slice of lemon.

recipes.title: Maryland Crab Cakes
directions: Remove cartilage from crab meat.
In a bowl, mix bread crumbs, egg, mayonnaise, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper together well.
Pour mixture over crab meat and fold in lightly but thoroughly.
Form into six cakes.
Saute in butter for 3 minutes or until golden brown, turning once.
recipes.text: Maryland Crab Cakes. Remove cartilage from crab meat. In a bowl, mix bread crumbs, egg, mayonnaise, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper together well. Pour mixture over crab meat and fold in lightly but thoroughly. Form into six cakes. Saute in butter for 3 minutes or until golden brown, turning once.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Heat sugar, cornstarch and water.
Cook until clear.
Remove from heat.
Add gelatin and stir well.
Line shell with berries. Pour cooked mixture over strawberries.
Chill 2 to 3 hours.
Serve with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Heat sugar, cornstarch and water. Cook until clear. Remove from heat. Add gelatin and stir well. Line shell with berries. Pour cooked mixture over strawberries. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Serve with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Salsa Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinned chicken breasts, cut in strips
16 oz. thick and chunky salsa (mild or hot)
directions: In skillet, saute chicken in hot oil over medium heat, about 10 minutes or until browned evenly.
recipes.text: Salsa Chicken. In skillet, saute chicken in hot oil over medium heat, about 10 minutes or until browned evenly.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce
directions: Rinse and de-stem all cranberries.
Place in pan.
Cover with cover.
Simmer slowly until softened.
Add sugar as cranberries cook.
recipes.text: Cranberry Sauce. Rinse and de-stem all cranberries. Place in pan. Cover with cover. Simmer slowly until softened. Add sugar as cranberries cook.

recipes.title: Microwave-Mexican Casserole
directions: Combine ground beef, onion and green pepper in 2-quart casserole. Cover and cook on High 2 1/2 minutes.
Stir.
Cook on High 2 1/2 more minutes. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Stir to mix. Cover and cook on High 5 minutes.
Stir. Cook on 80% (reheat) 5 minutes. Stir. Sprinkle broken taco chips on top.
Leave cover off.
Microwave on 80% (reheat) 1 1/2 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Microwave-Mexican Casserole. Combine ground beef, onion and green pepper in 2-quart casserole. Cover and cook on High 2 1/2 minutes. Stir. Cook on High 2 1/2 more minutes. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Stir to mix. Cover and cook on High 5 minutes. Stir. Cook on 80% (reheat) 5 minutes. Stir. Sprinkle broken taco chips on top. Leave cover off. Microwave on 80% (reheat) 1 1/2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Garden Bean Salad
directions: Drain all cans of beans; place in large bowl.
Add green pepper, celery, pimentos and green onions; set aside.
Bring remaining ingredients to a boil in a heavy saucepan; boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and immediately pour over vegetables. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Garden Bean Salad. Drain all cans of beans; place in large bowl. Add green pepper, celery, pimentos and green onions; set aside. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil in a heavy saucepan; boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and immediately pour over vegetables. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Sift meal, baking powder and salt together.
Mix water and milk and stir into dry ingredients.
Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes, then drop by teaspoons into deep Crisco heated to 365u00b0 or until bread crumb browns.
Fry until brown (3 to 5 minutes).
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Sift meal, baking powder and salt together. Mix water and milk and stir into dry ingredients. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes, then drop by teaspoons into deep Crisco heated to 365u00b0 or until bread crumb browns. Fry until brown (3 to 5 minutes).

recipes.title: Casserole Kielbasa
directions: Cook kielbasa slightly; cut into slices about 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick, and place in crock-pot.
Add barbecue sauce and pineapple. Simmer for several hours.
recipes.text: Casserole Kielbasa. Cook kielbasa slightly; cut into slices about 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick, and place in crock-pot. Add barbecue sauce and pineapple. Simmer for several hours.

recipes.title: Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Brown ground beef and onion.
Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle in 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt.
Pat meat mixture into medium casserole dish.
Put in can green beans (drained).
Spread undiluted tomato soup over beans.
Beat egg into mashed potatoes. Spread potatoes over top of casserole, making edges touch sides of dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Shepherd'S Pie. Brown ground beef and onion. Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle in 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt. Pat meat mixture into medium casserole dish. Put in can green beans (drained). Spread undiluted tomato soup over beans. Beat egg into mashed potatoes. Spread potatoes over top of casserole, making edges touch sides of dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Drizzle Berry Pie
directions: Combine softened cream cheese, sugar and vanilla (use blender), mixing until well blended.
Blend in 1/2 cup chocolate pieces, melted, and then add egg.
recipes.text: Drizzle Berry Pie. Combine softened cream cheese, sugar and vanilla (use blender), mixing until well blended. Blend in 1/2 cup chocolate pieces, melted, and then add egg.

recipes.title: Banana Split Pie
ingredients: 1 small pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Mix pudding by directions on box.
Spread on cracker crust. Layer bananas, pineapple, Cool Whip, cherries and pecans.
May also serve with Hershey's liquid syrup, dribbled on top.
recipes.text: Banana Split Pie. Mix pudding by directions on box. Spread on cracker crust. Layer bananas, pineapple, Cool Whip, cherries and pecans. May also serve with Hershey's liquid syrup, dribbled on top.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. cake flour, measured before sifting, then sifted twice
directions: Cream butter or margarine, sugar and eggs.
Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring; add to first mixture.
Mix salt and vanilla to buttermilk.
Add alternately with flour to first mixture.
When well mixed next with a spoon (not mixer), add baking soda and vinegar.
Mix in well.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream butter or margarine, sugar and eggs. Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring; add to first mixture. Mix salt and vanilla to buttermilk. Add alternately with flour to first mixture. When well mixed next with a spoon (not mixer), add baking soda and vinegar. Mix in well. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts or 2 (12 1/2 oz.) cans white chicken
2 cans cream of chicken soup (Healthy Request)
directions: Stew chicken. Remove all bones, skin and fat.
Cut up.
Grease casserole dish.
Mix together beans, water chestnuts and almonds. Combine soup, mayonnaise, curry and lemon juice to make a sauce. Stir together and heat slightly.
Put chicken mixture in dish. Pour heated
sauce over chicken mixture and top with crushed potato chips.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Stew chicken. Remove all bones, skin and fat. Cut up. Grease casserole dish. Mix together beans, water chestnuts and almonds. Combine soup, mayonnaise, curry and lemon juice to make a sauce. Stir together and heat slightly. Put chicken mixture in dish. Pour heated sauce over chicken mixture and top with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Corn Souffle
directions: Drain whole kernel corn.
Mix both cans of corn, butter, milk, flour and sugar.
Beat eggs until light.
Add to corn mixture. Turn into greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 until center is firm.
recipes.text: Corn Souffle. Drain whole kernel corn. Mix both cans of corn, butter, milk, flour and sugar. Beat eggs until light. Add to corn mixture. Turn into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350u00b0 until center is firm.

recipes.title: Easy Yeast Hot Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water.
Add shortening, salt and sugar. Alternate, adding milk and flour.
Knead dough until smooth.
Make rolls and place on greased cake pan.
Let rise and bake at 425u00b0 until golden brown.
recipes.text: Easy Yeast Hot Rolls. Dissolve yeast in water. Add shortening, salt and sugar. Alternate, adding milk and flour. Knead dough until smooth. Make rolls and place on greased cake pan. Let rise and bake at 425u00b0 until golden brown.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Sift flour with next 4 ingredients. Cut in butter with 2 knives or pastry blender, until mixture resembles coarse corn meal.
Stir in raisins.
Mix vinegar and milk.
Make a well in center of flour mixture.
Add liquid all at once.
Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened.
Turn out onto a lightly floured board.
Knead gently 8 to 10 times. Shape into a ball.
Place in a greased 8-inch pie plate.
Make an "X" on top with a knife and brush with a little milk for glaze. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Lower temperature to 375u00b0 and bake 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Irish Soda Bread. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Sift flour with next 4 ingredients. Cut in butter with 2 knives or pastry blender, until mixture resembles coarse corn meal. Stir in raisins. Mix vinegar and milk. Make a well in center of flour mixture. Add liquid all at once. Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn out onto a lightly floured board. Knead gently 8 to 10 times. Shape into a ball. Place in a greased 8-inch pie plate. Make an "X" on top with a knife and brush with a little milk for glaze. Bake at 400u00b0 for 15 minutes. Lower temperature to 375u00b0 and bake 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Party Ham Delights
ingredients: 3 (15 oz.) pkg. Pepperidge Farm party rolls
1 lb. sliced Swiss cheese or favorite cheese
directions: Slice
rolls
through
middle (horizontal).
They slice better iftthey are partially frozen.
Do not pull apart until ready to serve.
Mix onion, margarine, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and poppy
seed.
Spread on cut surfaces of bread.
Put ham on bottom half
of bread, then cheese on top of ham.tPut top half of bread on.
Wrap in aluminum foil.
Cook or freeze. Bake at 350u00b0
until cheese is melted when ready to enjoy with friends.tCut into sections depending on appetite size.
recipes.text: Party Ham Delights. Slice rolls through middle (horizontal). They slice better iftthey are partially frozen. Do not pull apart until ready to serve. Mix onion, margarine, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and poppy seed. Spread on cut surfaces of bread. Put ham on bottom half of bread, then cheese on top of ham.tPut top half of bread on. Wrap in aluminum foil. Cook or freeze. Bake at 350u00b0 until cheese is melted when ready to enjoy with friends.tCut into sections depending on appetite size.

recipes.title: French Vanilla Brickle Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, pudding, condensed milk, eggs and butter for 2 minutes.
Fold in brickle chips.
Pour into Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50-60 minutes.
Cool 25 minutes in pan.
Remove from pan and place on cooling rack.
Drizzle glaze (recipe to follow) over the cooled cake.
Sprinkle reserved brickle chips on top of glaze.
Cake will be heavy and will sink when cooled.
recipes.text: French Vanilla Brickle Cake. Mix cake mix, pudding, condensed milk, eggs and butter for 2 minutes. Fold in brickle chips. Pour into Bundt or tube pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50-60 minutes. Cool 25 minutes in pan. Remove from pan and place on cooling rack. Drizzle glaze (recipe to follow) over the cooled cake. Sprinkle reserved brickle chips on top of glaze. Cake will be heavy and will sink when cooled.

recipes.title: Mennonite Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine egg, oil, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon in a large bowl. Stir in zucchini.
In another bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt.
Add first mixture to second until all ingredients are moist.
Pour batter into greased loaf pan and bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.
Let cool on wire rack before removing from pan.
recipes.text: Mennonite Zucchini Bread. Combine egg, oil, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon in a large bowl. Stir in zucchini. In another bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt. Add first mixture to second until all ingredients are moist. Pour batter into greased loaf pan and bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Let cool on wire rack before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Oktoberfest Ribs
directions: Drain the sauerkraut and mix in the caraway seed.
Peel the onions and cut in half; core and cut the apples in wedges.

Next, layer the ingredients in a large Dutch oven in this order: sauerkraut mixture, onions, apples, brown sugar and the ribs. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently for 2 or 3 hours until ribs are tender.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Oktoberfest Ribs. Drain the sauerkraut and mix in the caraway seed. Peel the onions and cut in half; core and cut the apples in wedges. Next, layer the ingredients in a large Dutch oven in this order: sauerkraut mixture, onions, apples, brown sugar and the ribs. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently for 2 or 3 hours until ribs are tender. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Nugget Candy
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. crushed vanilla wafer crumbs (1/2 lb.)
directions: Melt chocolate chips and Pet evaporated milk.
Remove from heat.
Add crushed vanilla wafer crumbs, powdered sugar, finely cut pecans and vanilla.
Mix well; let stand at room temperature 30 minutes.
Shape into balls or logs, 1 1/2-inches long, 1/2-inch across.
Roll in 3/4 cup pecans.
Roll in 1/2 cup sifted powdered sugar.
Chill 1 hour.
Makes 48 balls.
recipes.text: Chocolate Nugget Candy. Melt chocolate chips and Pet evaporated milk. Remove from heat. Add crushed vanilla wafer crumbs, powdered sugar, finely cut pecans and vanilla. Mix well; let stand at room temperature 30 minutes. Shape into balls or logs, 1 1/2-inches long, 1/2-inch across. Roll in 3/4 cup pecans. Roll in 1/2 cup sifted powdered sugar. Chill 1 hour. Makes 48 balls.

recipes.title: Chicken And Wild Rice
ingredients: 4 c. chicken breasts, cooked and cut in pieces
2 pkg. Uncle Ben's long grain wild rice
directions: Cook chicken breasts and cut into pieces and add lemon juice. Add mayonnaise, soup, water chestnuts, pimentos, onions, mushrooms, salt and pepper.
Mix thoroughly and put into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Sprinkle the top with paprika.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Serves 10.
recipes.text: Chicken And Wild Rice. Cook chicken breasts and cut into pieces and add lemon juice. Add mayonnaise, soup, water chestnuts, pimentos, onions, mushrooms, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly and put into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle the top with paprika. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, except Ritz crackers.
Cook until bubbles.
Top with crumbled Ritz crackers.
Brown 20 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Veg-All Casserole. Mix all ingredients, except Ritz crackers. Cook until bubbles. Top with crumbled Ritz crackers. Brown 20 minutes in a 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Holiday Cider
ingredients: 64 oz. apple cider or apple juice
directions: Pour cider or juice and red hots in large pan on stove. Bring to boil, stirring occasionally until red hots are melted. Remove from heat and serve in a clear glass punch bowl for a festive look.
Serve warm.
Reheat as needed.
recipes.text: Holiday Cider. Pour cider or juice and red hots in large pan on stove. Bring to boil, stirring occasionally until red hots are melted. Remove from heat and serve in a clear glass punch bowl for a festive look. Serve warm. Reheat as needed.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Cream Gelatin Salad
ingredients: 1/3 c. each: chopped celery and nuts
directions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in 1 cup of boiling water.
Add cranberry sauce and chill until thickened, but not firm.
Add remaining ingredients and chill until firm.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Cream Gelatin Salad. Dissolve gelatin and sugar in 1 cup of boiling water. Add cranberry sauce and chill until thickened, but not firm. Add remaining ingredients and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Recipe For A Home
directions: Cream friendship and thoughtfulness with a pinch of tenderness.
Mix lightly loyalty, faith, hope and charity.
Add gaiety, song and laughter.
Moisten with tears of heartfelt sympathy.
Bake in a good natured pan and serve repeatedly.
recipes.text: Recipe For A Home. Cream friendship and thoughtfulness with a pinch of tenderness. Mix lightly loyalty, faith, hope and charity. Add gaiety, song and laughter. Moisten with tears of heartfelt sympathy. Bake in a good natured pan and serve repeatedly.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 4 oz.) can sliced pineapple, drained
1 1/2 c. cake flour or 1 1/3 c. plain flour
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Melt butter in heavy 10-inch skillet or square pan (9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch).
Sprinkle brown sugar over butter evenly.
Arrange pineapple on butter-sugar coating.
Decorate with pecan halves and maraschino cherries, if desired.
Measure flour by dip-level-pour method or by sifting.
Stir all dry ingredients together.
Add shortening, milk, egg and flavoring; beat for 2 minutes on medium speed.
Scrape sides of bowl constantly.
Beat another 2 minutes.
Pour batter over fruit.
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes.
Turn immediately onto serving plate.
Leave pan over cake for a few minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Melt butter in heavy 10-inch skillet or square pan (9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch). Sprinkle brown sugar over butter evenly. Arrange pineapple on butter-sugar coating. Decorate with pecan halves and maraschino cherries, if desired. Measure flour by dip-level-pour method or by sifting. Stir all dry ingredients together. Add shortening, milk, egg and flavoring; beat for 2 minutes on medium speed. Scrape sides of bowl constantly. Beat another 2 minutes. Pour batter over fruit. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes. Turn immediately onto serving plate. Leave pan over cake for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
directions: Crush 20 Oreo cookies and place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt margarine and
chocolate.
Keep on low heat and add
eggs.
Stir until thick.
Add powdered sugar (on heat) and beat well by hand.
Pour mixture on cookies and freeze at least one hour.
Soften ice cream.
Stir in creme de menthe.
Pour over chocolate layer.
Crush 5 more cookies. Sprinkle on top and freeze overnight (at least).
recipes.text: Oreo Cookie Dessert. Crush 20 Oreo cookies and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt margarine and chocolate. Keep on low heat and add eggs. Stir until thick. Add powdered sugar (on heat) and beat well by hand. Pour mixture on cookies and freeze at least one hour. Soften ice cream. Stir in creme de menthe. Pour over chocolate layer. Crush 5 more cookies. Sprinkle on top and freeze overnight (at least).

recipes.title: Pot Pie And Biscuit Dough
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
Rub in Crisco a little at a time with a fork.
Add milk slowly and mix to a soft dough.
Roll out on lightly floured board to 1/2-inch thick, for biscuits, thinner for pot pie.
Cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake at 450u00b0 for about 10 to 15 minutes.
Yields 24 biscuits.
recipes.text: Pot Pie And Biscuit Dough. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together. Rub in Crisco a little at a time with a fork. Add milk slowly and mix to a soft dough. Roll out on lightly floured board to 1/2-inch thick, for biscuits, thinner for pot pie. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 450u00b0 for about 10 to 15 minutes. Yields 24 biscuits.

recipes.title: Diabetic Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add buttermilk.
Add dry ingredients.
Add orange juice and vanilla.
Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Diabetic Cookies. Cream sugar and margarine. Add buttermilk. Add dry ingredients. Add orange juice and vanilla. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Vegetable Dip
directions: Put all ingredients in blender and blend 4 minutes; refrigerate overnight.
Cut up fresh vegetables to dip in.
recipes.text: Green Vegetable Dip. Put all ingredients in blender and blend 4 minutes; refrigerate overnight. Cut up fresh vegetables to dip in.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Combine ingredients in the order given, folding in the beaten egg white last.
Place mixture in a well-greased pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Salmon Loaf. Combine ingredients in the order given, folding in the beaten egg white last. Place mixture in a well-greased pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Combine salt and cucumbers; let stand 5 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Bread And Butter Pickles. Combine salt and cucumbers; let stand 5 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Skillet Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 2 lb. uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined
2/3 c. herb and garlic marinade with lemon juice
1/4 c. chopped green onions and tops
directions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil. Add shrimp and marinade. Cook, stirring often, until shrimp turns pink. Stir in green onions. Turn heat off. Serve over hot cooked rice or your favorite pasta.
recipes.text: Skillet Shrimp Scampi. In a large nonstick skillet, heat oil. Add shrimp and marinade. Cook, stirring often, until shrimp turns pink. Stir in green onions. Turn heat off. Serve over hot cooked rice or your favorite pasta.

recipes.title: Picadillo Dip
directions: Mix meats together by hand, put into a large pan and barely cover with water.
Add salt and pepper.
Stir meat until well blended.
Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and cook 15 minutes longer.
Serve hot in a chafing dish with chips.
Freezes well.
It disappears so quickly that you need to double recipe.
recipes.text: Picadillo Dip. Mix meats together by hand, put into a large pan and barely cover with water. Add salt and pepper. Stir meat until well blended. Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and cook 15 minutes longer. Serve hot in a chafing dish with chips. Freezes well. It disappears so quickly that you need to double recipe.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Corn
ingredients: 1 medium pkg. frozen whole kernel corn (do not thaw)
1 small (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut into small chunks
directions: Place all ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Cook slowly over LOW heat on burner, stirring frequently, until cheese melts and all is hot. Do not add any liquid. It makes its own. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Corn. Place all ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Cook slowly over LOW heat on burner, stirring frequently, until cheese melts and all is hot. Do not add any liquid. It makes its own. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 4 or 5 chicken breasts, remove skin and debone
salt, pepper, garlic clove and lemon
directions: Pound chicken breasts until thin; dredge in flour.
Saute in pan with a bit of olive oil.
Add half of lemon and garlic.
Saute until light brown.
Remove from pan.
Glaze pan with white wine. Return chicken to pan and add broth and squeeze on the remaining lemon.
Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Chicken. Pound chicken breasts until thin; dredge in flour. Saute in pan with a bit of olive oil. Add half of lemon and garlic. Saute until light brown. Remove from pan. Glaze pan with white wine. Return chicken to pan and add broth and squeeze on the remaining lemon. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandmother'S Applesauce Bread
directions: Combine shortening, sugar and eggs.
Sift together flour, salt, baking powder, soda and spices.
Add to sugar mixture.
Fold in applesauce and nuts.
Grease and flour loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Grandmother'S Applesauce Bread. Combine shortening, sugar and eggs. Sift together flour, salt, baking powder, soda and spices. Add to sugar mixture. Fold in applesauce and nuts. Grease and flour loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Almond Brickle Cookies
ingredients: 1 box butter golden cake mix or one with pudding in mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 8 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Almond Brickle Cookies. Mix all ingredients together. Drop from teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Grate cheese finely.
Combine cheese, butter and flour with your hands until well mixed.
Form into 1-inch rolls.
Place in refrigerator overnight.
Slice thin and bake on ungreased cookie sheets.
Start baking at 375u00b0, but lower to 350u00b0 and watch carefully as they burn.
recipes.text: Cheese Wafers. Grate cheese finely. Combine cheese, butter and flour with your hands until well mixed. Form into 1-inch rolls. Place in refrigerator overnight. Slice thin and bake on ungreased cookie sheets. Start baking at 375u00b0, but lower to 350u00b0 and watch carefully as they burn.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
directions: Heat tortilla in hot oil to which chili powder has been added. Drain any liquid from chili.
Spread chili on tortillas. Sprinkle on onion and cheese and roll tortilla.
Put in baking dish and pour remainder of chili, cheese and onion on top.
Heat in 300u00b0 oven about 20 to 30 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Heat tortilla in hot oil to which chili powder has been added. Drain any liquid from chili. Spread chili on tortillas. Sprinkle on onion and cheese and roll tortilla. Put in baking dish and pour remainder of chili, cheese and onion on top. Heat in 300u00b0 oven about 20 to 30 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
ingredients: 1 can ready to spread chocolate frosting
directions: Mix dry pudding mix and powdered sugar.
Add milk.
Mix until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Place a layer of whole graham crackers in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Add a layer of pudding mix. Repeat the layers of crackers and then pudding mix.
Last, add a layer of crackers and top with a can of chocolate frosting.
Let set in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair Cake. Mix dry pudding mix and powdered sugar. Add milk. Mix until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Place a layer of whole graham crackers in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Add a layer of pudding mix. Repeat the layers of crackers and then pudding mix. Last, add a layer of crackers and top with a can of chocolate frosting. Let set in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Chicken-In-A-Garden
ingredients: 3 green bell peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 (6 oz.) pkg. frozen snow peas, thawed and drained
directions: Rinse chicken and pat dry.
Cut into 1-inch pieces.
Combine with marinade in bowl.
Let stand for 20 minutes.
Pour oil into preheated wok, coating well.
Heat on medium-high (350u00b0) for 2 minutes.
Add green peppers.
Stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add scallions, celery and snow peas.
Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Remove vegetables with slotted spoon.
Add chicken.
Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Combine soy sauce and cornstarch in bowl.
Stir in water, instant bouillon and ginger.
Add to wok with stir-fried vegetables and tomatoes.
Cook over low heat (225u00b0) for 3 minutes or until thick and bubbly.
Serve over hot, cooked rice.
Yield: 8 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken-In-A-Garden. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Cut into 1-inch pieces. Combine with marinade in bowl. Let stand for 20 minutes. Pour oil into preheated wok, coating well. Heat on medium-high (350u00b0) for 2 minutes. Add green peppers. Stir-fry for 4 minutes. Add scallions, celery and snow peas. Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Remove vegetables with slotted spoon. Add chicken. Stir-fry for 3 minutes. Combine soy sauce and cornstarch in bowl. Stir in water, instant bouillon and ginger. Add to wok with stir-fried vegetables and tomatoes. Cook over low heat (225u00b0) for 3 minutes or until thick and bubbly. Serve over hot, cooked rice. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together with a fork and press into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan (greased).
With a mixer, mix together rest of ingredients.
Pour this topping on top of cake mixture. Sprinkle with nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly brown.
When cool, cut into squares.
recipes.text: Coffee Cake. Mix first 3 ingredients together with a fork and press into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan (greased). With a mixer, mix together rest of ingredients. Pour this topping on top of cake mixture. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly brown. When cool, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Cheese-Radish-Orange Appetizer
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. part-skim milk Mozzarella cheese
directions: Cut cheese in 3/4-inch cubes.
Alternate on toothpicks with a radish slice and mandarin orange wedge.
Makes about 50, about 17 calories each.
recipes.text: Cheese-Radish-Orange Appetizer. Cut cheese in 3/4-inch cubes. Alternate on toothpicks with a radish slice and mandarin orange wedge. Makes about 50, about 17 calories each.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Pineapple Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) cans crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
2 (8 oz.) pkg. Neufchatel (low-fat) cream cheese, softened
2 (8 oz.) cartons lite Cool Whip, thawed
directions: Drain pineapple.
Reserve juice.
Combine 1 cup pineapple juice and Jell-O in saucepan; stir.
Cook over medium heat approximately 3 minutes, stirring.
Remove from heat and place in refrigerator to cool.
Drain Mandarin oranges.
Mix cream cheese and Ricotta cheese until smooth.
Add Equal; mix well.
Add cooled Jell-O mixture; blend until smooth.
Add well-drained pineapple and oranges.
Blend until smooth.
Add Cool Whip; blend until smooth.
Spoon into crusts.
Chill overnight or at least 6 hours.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Pineapple Cheesecake. Drain pineapple. Reserve juice. Combine 1 cup pineapple juice and Jell-O in saucepan; stir. Cook over medium heat approximately 3 minutes, stirring. Remove from heat and place in refrigerator to cool. Drain Mandarin oranges. Mix cream cheese and Ricotta cheese until smooth. Add Equal; mix well. Add cooled Jell-O mixture; blend until smooth. Add well-drained pineapple and oranges. Blend until smooth. Add Cool Whip; blend until smooth. Spoon into crusts. Chill overnight or at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: Banana Caramel Pie
directions: Put condensed milk in shallow pie pan (glass).
Cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes until thick and caramelized.
(Cover with foil.
Set in shallow casserole pan filled with 1/4 water.)
Bake at 425u00b0. Add hot water to dish as needed.
Set aside.
