recipes.text: Banana Caramel Pie. Put condensed milk in shallow pie pan (glass). Cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes until thick and caramelized. (Cover with foil. Set in shallow casserole pan filled with 1/4 water.) Bake at 425u00b0. Add hot water to dish as needed. Set aside.

recipes.title: Bob'S Refried Beans
ingredients: 4 c. red beans, drained and mashed
directions: Saute onions in black iron skillet.
Add drained and mashed red
beans, picante sauce and Tony's Creole seasoning.
Heat and stir on medium fire for 15 minutes.
Serve as a side dish with fajitas.
This is good on tortillas with lettuce, onion, sauce and cheese as a bean fajita.
Low-fat dish.
recipes.text: Bob'S Refried Beans. Saute onions in black iron skillet. Add drained and mashed red beans, picante sauce and Tony's Creole seasoning. Heat and stir on medium fire for 15 minutes. Serve as a side dish with fajitas. This is good on tortillas with lettuce, onion, sauce and cheese as a bean fajita. Low-fat dish.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift together the first 8 ingredients.
Add eggs, oil, pumpkin and water and mix with beater.
Add nuts and dates.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Sift together the first 8 ingredients. Add eggs, oil, pumpkin and water and mix with beater. Add nuts and dates. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Oysters Rockefeller
ingredients: 1/3 c. finely chopped fennel bulb or celery
several drops bottled hot pepper sauce
1/2 c. seasoned or plain, fine, dry bread crumbs
directions: You will also need rock salt or crumbled foil.
recipes.text: Oysters Rockefeller. You will also need rock salt or crumbled foil.

recipes.title: Gouie Chocolate Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed.
When cake is done, punch holes all over top of cake with a fork.
Drizzle the Eagle Brand milk over top. Pour jar of caramel sauce over top of milk; spread.
Sprinkle top with nuts (optional).
Spread a small amount of Cool Whip on top. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Gouie Chocolate Cake. Bake cake as directed. When cake is done, punch holes all over top of cake with a fork. Drizzle the Eagle Brand milk over top. Pour jar of caramel sauce over top of milk; spread. Sprinkle top with nuts (optional). Spread a small amount of Cool Whip on top. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Milk Chocolate Brownies
directions: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add sugar, flour, cocoa, salt, eggs and vanilla; mix well.
Stir in coconut.
Turn into greased pan. Bake in moderate oven at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Milk Chocolate Brownies. Melt butter in saucepan. Add sugar, flour, cocoa, salt, eggs and vanilla; mix well. Stir in coconut. Turn into greased pan. Bake in moderate oven at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Rich'S Favorite Uncooked Fondant
directions: Blend all ingredients but syrup; mix in sugar.
Knead until blended.
Divide and add tint with food coloring if desired. Shape into balls.
Yields 1 1/3 pounds.
recipes.text: Rich'S Favorite Uncooked Fondant. Blend all ingredients but syrup; mix in sugar. Knead until blended. Divide and add tint with food coloring if desired. Shape into balls. Yields 1 1/3 pounds.

recipes.title: Easy Lasagna
ingredients: 2 c. small curd cottage cheese or Ricotta cheese
directions: Brown meat and drain.
Add spaghetti sauce, water, salt, seasoning and sugar.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a 9 x 13-inch dish, layer 1/3 of sauce, 1/2 of noodles, 1 cup cottage cheese and 1/3 of Mozzarella cheese.
Repeat layers, ending with sauce.
Add remaining Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.
Remove foil and let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Freezes very well.
recipes.text: Easy Lasagna. Brown meat and drain. Add spaghetti sauce, water, salt, seasoning and sugar. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. In a 9 x 13-inch dish, layer 1/3 of sauce, 1/2 of noodles, 1 cup cottage cheese and 1/3 of Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers, ending with sauce. Add remaining Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Remove foil and let stand 10 minutes before serving. Freezes very well.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 can condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2 Tbsp. each: minced onions and lemon juice
1 (3 1/2 oz.) can fried onion rings, slightly crushed
directions: Discard skin and bones from chicken.
Cut into 1-inch pieces. Mix chicken with remaining ingredients, except cheese and onion rings.
Turn into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan or casserole.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle onions over all and bake 15 minutes longer.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Discard skin and bones from chicken. Cut into 1-inch pieces. Mix chicken with remaining ingredients, except cheese and onion rings. Turn into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan or casserole. Top with cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Sprinkle onions over all and bake 15 minutes longer. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Mix sugar, molasses, syrup, water and salt. Cook over medium heat. Stir constantly until mixture boils. When small amount gets hard when dropped in cold water, remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Pour over popped corn and form balls.
recipes.text: Popcorn Balls. Mix sugar, molasses, syrup, water and salt. Cook over medium heat. Stir constantly until mixture boils. When small amount gets hard when dropped in cold water, remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Pour over popped corn and form balls.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
directions: Cook and drain hamburger.
Mix in dry ingredients.
Add water. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Stirring as needed.
Brown tortillas on both sides.
Fill with filling.
Roll and lay in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with cheese and onions.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Cook and drain hamburger. Mix in dry ingredients. Add water. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Stirring as needed. Brown tortillas on both sides. Fill with filling. Roll and lay in 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with cheese and onions. Bake at 350u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes until cheese melts.

recipes.title: String Bean Delight
directions: Cook beans with garlic; drain.
Mix beans and sour cream and pepper.
Pour into baking dish.
Melt butter and add bread crumbs. Mix well.
Sprinkle over beans and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until crumbs are golden brown.
recipes.text: String Bean Delight. Cook beans with garlic; drain. Mix beans and sour cream and pepper. Pour into baking dish. Melt butter and add bread crumbs. Mix well. Sprinkle over beans and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes or until crumbs are golden brown.

recipes.title: Hair Stimulant
directions: Mix and use on hair and scalp each night.
Taken from a medical book with a copyright date of 1911.
Writer claims this treatment stopped her hair from coming out.
recipes.text: Hair Stimulant. Mix and use on hair and scalp each night. Taken from a medical book with a copyright date of 1911. Writer claims this treatment stopped her hair from coming out.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
directions: In a wok or deep skillet on medium heat, fry ground beef until light brown.
Add onion and carrots. Cook about 5 minutes.
Add cooked rice, green peas, soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Mix thoroughly.
Cook another 5 minutes.
Transfer into serving dish. Beat eggs and fry in medium-hot pan, moving side to side to make a thin layer.
Remove from pan; dice and sprinkle on top of rice. Garnish with chopped scallions.
recipes.text: Fried Rice. In a wok or deep skillet on medium heat, fry ground beef until light brown. Add onion and carrots. Cook about 5 minutes. Add cooked rice, green peas, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. Cook another 5 minutes. Transfer into serving dish. Beat eggs and fry in medium-hot pan, moving side to side to make a thin layer. Remove from pan; dice and sprinkle on top of rice. Garnish with chopped scallions.

recipes.title: Frosty Strawberry Squares
ingredients: 1 pt. strawberries or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, partially thawed
directions: Stir together flour, brown sugar, nuts and butter.
Spread in shallow pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Combine egg whites, sugar, berries and lemon juice.
Beat at high speed to stiff peaks (about 10 minutes).
Fold in Cool Whip.
Spoon over baked crust and freeze 6 hours or overnight.
Cut into squares.
Makes 24.
recipes.text: Frosty Strawberry Squares. Stir together flour, brown sugar, nuts and butter. Spread in shallow pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Combine egg whites, sugar, berries and lemon juice. Beat at high speed to stiff peaks (about 10 minutes). Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon over baked crust and freeze 6 hours or overnight. Cut into squares. Makes 24.

recipes.title: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cook sugar, cocoa, Pet milk and butter for 5 minutes.
Add oats and cook 3 minutes.
Add flavoring and beat unti creamy. Drop on wax paper.
recipes.text: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies. Cook sugar, cocoa, Pet milk and butter for 5 minutes. Add oats and cook 3 minutes. Add flavoring and beat unti creamy. Drop on wax paper.

recipes.title: Oven Barbecue Chicken
directions: In a glass baking dish, bake chicken at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes; drain off grease.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Return to oven and bake
an additional 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Oven Barbecue Chicken. In a glass baking dish, bake chicken at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes; drain off grease. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Return to oven and bake an additional 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Banana-Strawberry Parfait
ingredients: 1 pt. fresh strawberries, halved if large
directions: In a food processor or blender, combine the bananas, brown sugar, lime juice, tequila, cinnamon and cloves. Puree until smooth.
In 6 parfait glasses or glass dessert dishes, layer berries with banana puree.
Cover and refrigerate until slightly chilled before serving.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Banana-Strawberry Parfait. In a food processor or blender, combine the bananas, brown sugar, lime juice, tequila, cinnamon and cloves. Puree until smooth. In 6 parfait glasses or glass dessert dishes, layer berries with banana puree. Cover and refrigerate until slightly chilled before serving. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Date Squares
directions: Mix and sift flour, baking soda and salt; add brown sugar and rolled oats and mix well.
Cut butter into flour mixture until well blended.
Press one half of butter mixture on sides and bottom of greased 9-inch square pan.
Cover with date mixture and sprinkle remaining butter mixture on top.
Bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven about 30 minutes.
When cool, cut into squares and remove from pan.
Yields 25 squares.
recipes.text: Date Squares. Mix and sift flour, baking soda and salt; add brown sugar and rolled oats and mix well. Cut butter into flour mixture until well blended. Press one half of butter mixture on sides and bottom of greased 9-inch square pan. Cover with date mixture and sprinkle remaining butter mixture on top. Bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven about 30 minutes. When cool, cut into squares and remove from pan. Yields 25 squares.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Pat onto cookie sheet or pizza pan.
Make crust around edge of pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Pat onto cookie sheet or pizza pan. Make crust around edge of pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Bavarian Prune Plum Dumplings
directions: Slit and pit plums.
Place a cube of sugar in center of each plum.
Combine flour, cottage cheese, melted butter, eggs, salt and starch.
Beat until smooth.
Chill dough 1 hour.
Divide dough into 12 portions and wrap around each plum, sealing well.
Cook covered in boiling water for 10 minutes.
Drain.
Pour melted butter over dumplings or sour cream, if you like it.
Serve hot with roast pork, beef or pot roast.
recipes.text: Bavarian Prune Plum Dumplings. Slit and pit plums. Place a cube of sugar in center of each plum. Combine flour, cottage cheese, melted butter, eggs, salt and starch. Beat until smooth. Chill dough 1 hour. Divide dough into 12 portions and wrap around each plum, sealing well. Cook covered in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain. Pour melted butter over dumplings or sour cream, if you like it. Serve hot with roast pork, beef or pot roast.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix well peanut butter, cream cheese and sugar. Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours. Before serving, top with remaining Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix well peanut butter, cream cheese and sugar. Fold in 1/2 of Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours. Before serving, top with remaining Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Magic Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0 (325u00b0 if glass dish).
In 13 x 9-inch baking dish, melt butter in pan in oven.
Sprinkle crumbs over butter.
Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs.
Top evenly with remaining ingredients (chips, the coconut, then chips, then nuts).
Press down gently.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly golden.
Cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Magic Cookies. Preheat oven to 350u00b0 (325u00b0 if glass dish). In 13 x 9-inch baking dish, melt butter in pan in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour Eagle Brand milk evenly over crumbs. Top evenly with remaining ingredients (chips, the coconut, then chips, then nuts). Press down gently. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly golden. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Yummy Green Beans
directions: String the beans; wash well and boil rapidly in salted water uncovered until barely tender and firm (taste them to make sure). Drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking.
Pat dry. Melt butter and add garlic; cook gently until softened.
Do not brown.
Pour over beans and taste for seasoning.
May be made ahead.
To reheat, put in microwave for 2 minutes on High or heat in saucepan over low heat.
recipes.text: Yummy Green Beans. String the beans; wash well and boil rapidly in salted water uncovered until barely tender and firm (taste them to make sure). Drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking. Pat dry. Melt butter and add garlic; cook gently until softened. Do not brown. Pour over beans and taste for seasoning. May be made ahead. To reheat, put in microwave for 2 minutes on High or heat in saucepan over low heat.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Asparagus Soup
directions: Blend together in blender and heat.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Asparagus Soup. Blend together in blender and heat.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
directions: Clean, wash and dry the chicken.
Grind or chop onions, garlic and ginger.
Heat the oil and fry the onion, garlic and ginger until golden brown.
Add chicken pieces, salt and all the spices and fry for 10 to 12 minutes, until the oil leaves the side of the pan.
Add about 2 cups water and simmer on slow fire until chicken is cooked and gravy is thick.
Sprinkle some coriander leaves and serve with white rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Curry. Clean, wash and dry the chicken. Grind or chop onions, garlic and ginger. Heat the oil and fry the onion, garlic and ginger until golden brown. Add chicken pieces, salt and all the spices and fry for 10 to 12 minutes, until the oil leaves the side of the pan. Add about 2 cups water and simmer on slow fire until chicken is cooked and gravy is thick. Sprinkle some coriander leaves and serve with white rice.

recipes.title: Gone All Day Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. beef chuck, fat trimmed and cut into 1 or 2-inch cubes
directions: Mix together soup, water and flour until smooth.
Combine remaining ingredients in covered roasting pan or Dutch oven.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours.
recipes.text: Gone All Day Stew. Mix together soup, water and flour until smooth. Combine remaining ingredients in covered roasting pan or Dutch oven. Bake at 275u00b0 for 4 to 5 hours.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Combine the cukes, onion and salt; let stand 3 hours in cold water.
Drain.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Let come to a boil.
Put into airtight sterilized jars.
recipes.text: Bread And Butter Pickles. Combine the cukes, onion and salt; let stand 3 hours in cold water. Drain. Add the remaining ingredients. Let come to a boil. Put into airtight sterilized jars.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, salt and cinnamon in large mixing bowl.
Add eggs and oil, stirring just to moisten (do not beat).
Stir in vanilla, pineapple, bananas and pecans.
Spoon into 3 floured 9-inch cake pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done with toothpick test.
Cook in pan for 10 minutes.
Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, salt and cinnamon in large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil, stirring just to moisten (do not beat). Stir in vanilla, pineapple, bananas and pecans. Spoon into 3 floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done with toothpick test. Cook in pan for 10 minutes. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Put rice in bottom of pan and lay chicken parts on top.
Mix sherry, mushroom soup and celery soup.
Pour over rice and chicken.
Sprinkle dry onion soup on top and bake at 350u00b0 for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Supreme. Put rice in bottom of pan and lay chicken parts on top. Mix sherry, mushroom soup and celery soup. Pour over rice and chicken. Sprinkle dry onion soup on top and bake at 350u00b0 for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
ingredients: 1 small bottle liquid red food coloring
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour two 9 1/2 x 2-inch round pans.
Mix together eggs, oil, sugar, food color and vinegar. Combine flour, baking powder and baking soda in a bowl.
Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk to egg/sugar mixture.
Add almond and vanilla extract last.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 60 minutes or until tests done.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour two 9 1/2 x 2-inch round pans. Mix together eggs, oil, sugar, food color and vinegar. Combine flour, baking powder and baking soda in a bowl. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk to egg/sugar mixture. Add almond and vanilla extract last. Bake at 350u00b0 for 60 minutes or until tests done.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Pork Chops And Beans
directions: Put pork and beans in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle brown sugar and very little barbecue sauce.
Then put pork chops on top.
Put a little barbecue sauce on them.
Bake at 350u00b0 in preheated oven for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Pork Chops And Beans. Put pork and beans in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle brown sugar and very little barbecue sauce. Then put pork chops on top. Put a little barbecue sauce on them. Bake at 350u00b0 in preheated oven for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pastry For One 9-Inch Pie
directions: Cut shortening into flour and salt until particles are small pea size.
Sprinkle in water tossing with a fork until all flour is moistened and pastry almost cleans inside of bowl.
One or 2 tablespoons more water may be added, if necessary.
Roll dough in a ball and flatten round on lightly floured cloth board.
Roll pastry 2 inches larger than inverted pie plate with cloth covered rolling pin.
Fold pastry in quarters and place in a pie plate. Unfold and ease into plate.
Press firmly into plate.
recipes.text: Pastry For One 9-Inch Pie. Cut shortening into flour and salt until particles are small pea size. Sprinkle in water tossing with a fork until all flour is moistened and pastry almost cleans inside of bowl. One or 2 tablespoons more water may be added, if necessary. Roll dough in a ball and flatten round on lightly floured cloth board. Roll pastry 2 inches larger than inverted pie plate with cloth covered rolling pin. Fold pastry in quarters and place in a pie plate. Unfold and ease into plate. Press firmly into plate.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Bring water, onion and butter to a boil.
Add broccoli; bring to a boil again.
Remove from heat; add rice.
Cover and let stand for 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Place in a casserole; bake about 1 hour at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Bring water, onion and butter to a boil. Add broccoli; bring to a boil again. Remove from heat; add rice. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Place in a casserole; bake about 1 hour at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Corn Dressing
directions: Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Mix all ingredients and bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Can add sausage.
recipes.text: Corn Dressing. Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix all ingredients and bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes. Can add sausage.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts Diane
directions: Place chicken breasts between 2 slices of waxed paper and pound with mallet.
Sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil and butter in large skillet.
Cook chicken over high heat for 4 minutes on each side.
Add green onions, lime, brandy, parsley and mustard to pan; cook 15 seconds.
Whisking constantly, add broth and remaining oil and butter.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts Diane. Place chicken breasts between 2 slices of waxed paper and pound with mallet. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon oil and butter in large skillet. Cook chicken over high heat for 4 minutes on each side. Add green onions, lime, brandy, parsley and mustard to pan; cook 15 seconds. Whisking constantly, add broth and remaining oil and butter. Pour sauce over chicken. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients; bring to a boil.
Boil for 3 minutes after margarine melts.
Refrigerate.
Use on anything you like with sauce.
Very tasty on meat or fried chicken.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Combine all ingredients; bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes after margarine melts. Refrigerate. Use on anything you like with sauce. Very tasty on meat or fried chicken.

recipes.title: Cornbread
directions: Mix dry ingredients in large bowl. Beat egg in small bowl and add other liquids. Add liquids to dry ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350 approximately 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cornbread. Mix dry ingredients in large bowl. Beat egg in small bowl and add other liquids. Add liquids to dry ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350 approximately 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown the hamburger meat, then drain it.
Stir in chicken soup, then mushroom soup, stirring well to mix.
Add the enchilada sauce.
Heat mixture, stirring to mix and heat through.
Layer Dorito chips in the bottom of casserole dish.
Pour the meat mixture over chips; put cheese on top.
Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until bubbly around the sides in a 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Enchilada Casserole. Brown the hamburger meat, then drain it. Stir in chicken soup, then mushroom soup, stirring well to mix. Add the enchilada sauce. Heat mixture, stirring to mix and heat through. Layer Dorito chips in the bottom of casserole dish. Pour the meat mixture over chips; put cheese on top. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until bubbly around the sides in a 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttered bread crumbs, seasoned with a dash of pepper
directions: Combine all ingredients except buttered bread crumbs.
Place in a well-greased casserole.
Top with bread crumbs and sprinkle with sesame seed.
Bake at 250u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Combine all ingredients except buttered bread crumbs. Place in a well-greased casserole. Top with bread crumbs and sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 250u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: No Salt Seasoning
directions: Combine all ingredients in a small jar with a shaker top and use in place of salt.
recipes.text: No Salt Seasoning. Combine all ingredients in a small jar with a shaker top and use in place of salt.

recipes.title: Baked Wheaty Chicken
ingredients: 8 pieces fryer chicken (2 legs, 2 thighs, 2 breasts, 2 wings or your choice)
crumbs made from wheat bread (about 3 c.)
1 pod garlic or more to your taste
directions: Wash chicken and pat dry.
Mix crumbs and add seasonings in medium size bowl.
Melt oleo in medium size bowl.
Dip chicken in oleo and roll in the crumbs and place in baking dish.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.
If not brown on top, place under broiler for a few minutes.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Baked Wheaty Chicken. Wash chicken and pat dry. Mix crumbs and add seasonings in medium size bowl. Melt oleo in medium size bowl. Dip chicken in oleo and roll in the crumbs and place in baking dish. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes. If not brown on top, place under broiler for a few minutes. Serve immediately. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Almond-Apple Crisp(Low-Fat)
ingredients: 6 c. sliced, unpared, tart eating apples (about 4 medium)
directions: Heat oven to 375u00b0.
Mix water and almond extract.
Toss with apples in a 1 1/2-quart casserole, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
Mix remaining ingredients, except Yogurt Topping, until crumbly.
Sprinkle over apples.
Bake until top is golden brown and apples are tender, about 30 minutes.
Serve warm with Yogurt Topping.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Almond-Apple Crisp(Low-Fat). Heat oven to 375u00b0. Mix water and almond extract. Toss with apples in a 1 1/2-quart casserole, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Mix remaining ingredients, except Yogurt Topping, until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake until top is golden brown and apples are tender, about 30 minutes. Serve warm with Yogurt Topping. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 6 to 8 green onion tops or minced onion
directions: Combine all ingredients except pecans.
When well mixed, shape into a ball and roll in the chopped pecans.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Combine all ingredients except pecans. When well mixed, shape into a ball and roll in the chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Company Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes; slice potatoes almost through at 1/4-inch intervals.
Put in baking dish greased with butter.
Sprinkle salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder over sliced potatoes. Bake until done (about 30 minutes).
Sprinkle cheese on top and return to oven to melt.
Serve hot.
Sprinkle parsley over the potatoes.
recipes.text: Company Potatoes. Peel potatoes; slice potatoes almost through at 1/4-inch intervals. Put in baking dish greased with butter. Sprinkle salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder over sliced potatoes. Bake until done (about 30 minutes). Sprinkle cheese on top and return to oven to melt. Serve hot. Sprinkle parsley over the potatoes.

recipes.title: Elegant Chicken
directions: Wrap each breast in slice of beef, then bacon strip.
Place on a lightly greased oven dish.
Mix soup and sour cream and cover chicken with mixture.
Dust with paprika.
Bake 3 hours at 275u00b0. Mixture will curdle if baked at too high temperature.
recipes.text: Elegant Chicken. Wrap each breast in slice of beef, then bacon strip. Place on a lightly greased oven dish. Mix soup and sour cream and cover chicken with mixture. Dust with paprika. Bake 3 hours at 275u00b0. Mixture will curdle if baked at too high temperature.

recipes.title: Homemade Chicken Soup(With A Little Help From Campbell'S)
directions: Boil chicken breasts for approximately 15 minutes.
Remove chicken from pan and boil rice in broth.
When rice is done, add cans of soup, celery, pepper and parsley.
Pick chicken apart and toss in pan.
Use milk to thin out if necessary.
Stir a lot while cooking.
Serve with a loaf of bread.
You can make this in 30 minutes and there'll be enough to serve at least 2 people.
recipes.text: Homemade Chicken Soup(With A Little Help From Campbell'S). Boil chicken breasts for approximately 15 minutes. Remove chicken from pan and boil rice in broth. When rice is done, add cans of soup, celery, pepper and parsley. Pick chicken apart and toss in pan. Use milk to thin out if necessary. Stir a lot while cooking. Serve with a loaf of bread. You can make this in 30 minutes and there'll be enough to serve at least 2 people.

recipes.title: Hot Ham And Cheese Sandwiches
directions: Mix first four ingredients.
Spread this mixture on both sides of hamburger bun.
Layer with meat and cheese.
Wrap in foil. Bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
Makes 9 to 10 sandwiches.
recipes.text: Hot Ham And Cheese Sandwiches. Mix first four ingredients. Spread this mixture on both sides of hamburger bun. Layer with meat and cheese. Wrap in foil. Bake 15 minutes at 350u00b0. Makes 9 to 10 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
ingredients: extra serving graham cracker pie crust
directions: Mix can of lemonade, Cool Whip, condensed milk and lemon juice together with beater.
Pour in graham cracker pie crust and chill 1 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Lemon Pie. Mix can of lemonade, Cool Whip, condensed milk and lemon juice together with beater. Pour in graham cracker pie crust and chill 1 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Parmesan Fried Chicken
directions: Mix flour, parmesan cheese and pepper together.
Dip each chicken breast into egg white then dredge in flour mixture.
Heat oil in skillet and cook chicken on each side for 5 to 6 minutes, or until done.
recipes.text: Parmesan Fried Chicken. Mix flour, parmesan cheese and pepper together. Dip each chicken breast into egg white then dredge in flour mixture. Heat oil in skillet and cook chicken on each side for 5 to 6 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Mushroom Rice
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can mushroom stems and pieces
directions: Saute onion and mushroom stems and pieces in oleo.
Add 1 1/2 cups rice and brown the rice, stirring often over medium heat.
Add the beef consomme and cook on low until all liquid is cooked out, about 30 minutes.
If cooked on top of stove, cover to cook.
(I use a nonstick electric skillet.)
Also, an iron skillet may be used.
You can also put the iron skillet, uncovered, in the oven at 350u00b0 and cook until liquid is gone, about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mushroom Rice. Saute onion and mushroom stems and pieces in oleo. Add 1 1/2 cups rice and brown the rice, stirring often over medium heat. Add the beef consomme and cook on low until all liquid is cooked out, about 30 minutes. If cooked on top of stove, cover to cook. (I use a nonstick electric skillet.) Also, an iron skillet may be used. You can also put the iron skillet, uncovered, in the oven at 350u00b0 and cook until liquid is gone, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Pralines
ingredients: 1 pkg. graham crackers (1/3 of 16 oz. box)
directions: Separate crackers; arrange on cookie sheet.
Melt butter; add sugar and pecans.
Bring to boil and cook for 3 minutes; spread mixture over crackers.
Bake at 300u00b0 for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Pralines. Separate crackers; arrange on cookie sheet. Melt butter; add sugar and pecans. Bring to boil and cook for 3 minutes; spread mixture over crackers. Bake at 300u00b0 for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Fiesta Bites
ingredients: 1 small jar green olives with pimento
1 small can green chilies (whole or chopped)
directions: Layer tortilla and mixture ending up with tortilla on top. Refrigerate before serving and cut on a diagonal.
recipes.text: Fiesta Bites. Layer tortilla and mixture ending up with tortilla on top. Refrigerate before serving and cut on a diagonal.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
ingredients: 2 c. cooked chicken, cut in small pieces
directions: Mix all together and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning, put in 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Before baking, top with 3 cups Rice Krispies sauteed in 3 tablespoons butter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Supreme. Mix all together and refrigerate overnight. Next morning, put in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Before baking, top with 3 cups Rice Krispies sauteed in 3 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Fabulously Fantasy Fudge
directions: Heat chocolate and milk in saucepan over low heat, stirring until chocolate is melted.
Remove from heat; blend in vanilla and salt.
Spread in buttered 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.
Chill until firm, then cut.
Recipe can be doubled in 8-inch square pan.
recipes.text: Fabulously Fantasy Fudge. Heat chocolate and milk in saucepan over low heat, stirring until chocolate is melted. Remove from heat; blend in vanilla and salt. Spread in buttered 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Chill until firm, then cut. Recipe can be doubled in 8-inch square pan.

recipes.title: Bobby Knight Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow or white cake mix
directions: Mix cake mix, oil, eggs, water, cream of coconut and coconut. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
After baking, while warm, put holes in cake.
Pour remaining cream of coconut. Let cool.
Add 1 cup coconut and Cool Whip, then ice. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Bobby Knight Cake. Mix cake mix, oil, eggs, water, cream of coconut and coconut. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan. After baking, while warm, put holes in cake. Pour remaining cream of coconut. Let cool. Add 1 cup coconut and Cool Whip, then ice. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Kevin'S Mexican Dip
directions: Brown beef, then add seasoning mix.
Stir in water to desired consistency (1/2 cup).
Let mixture simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile spread cream cheese in bottom of casserole dish.
Top with meat mix with beans mixed in.
Top this layer with chopped green chilies.
Finish by adding both layers of cheeses.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is entirely melted and mixture is bubbly.
Garnish with sliced black olives.
Serve hot with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Kevin'S Mexican Dip. Brown beef, then add seasoning mix. Stir in water to desired consistency (1/2 cup). Let mixture simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile spread cream cheese in bottom of casserole dish. Top with meat mix with beans mixed in. Top this layer with chopped green chilies. Finish by adding both layers of cheeses. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is entirely melted and mixture is bubbly. Garnish with sliced black olives. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Fruit Short Cakes
directions: Follow biscuit mix directions.
Add sugar and egg.
Drop by rounded doubled spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
(Spread dough to shape and flatten slightly.)
Bake at 450u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until golden.
Cool slightly.
Cut into halves.
Spoon fruit over bottom half.
Cover with biscuit top.
Spoon on more fruit.
Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Fruit Short Cakes. Follow biscuit mix directions. Add sugar and egg. Drop by rounded doubled spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. (Spread dough to shape and flatten slightly.) Bake at 450u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes until golden. Cool slightly. Cut into halves. Spoon fruit over bottom half. Cover with biscuit top. Spoon on more fruit. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Incredible Quiche
directions: In blender jar, put eggs, milk, butter and biscuit mix. Blend until well mixed, then pour into greased glass pie plate. Add cheese and push down with fork.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30-40 minutes. Let set a few minutes before slicing.
recipes.text: Incredible Quiche. In blender jar, put eggs, milk, butter and biscuit mix. Blend until well mixed, then pour into greased glass pie plate. Add cheese and push down with fork. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30-40 minutes. Let set a few minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Friendship Cake
ingredients: 16 oz. can sliced peaches and its juices
20 oz. can chunk pineapple and its juices
3 boxes Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
directions: Day 1:
Pour one pint starter into glass gallon jar or ceramic crock.
Add sliced peaches and its juices.
Cut slice into four pieces.
Add 2 1/2 cups sugar.
Stir once every day for 10 days. Cover juice with plate or saucer.
Leave the mixture sitting out at room temperature.
recipes.text: Friendship Cake. Day 1: Pour one pint starter into glass gallon jar or ceramic crock. Add sliced peaches and its juices. Cut slice into four pieces. Add 2 1/2 cups sugar. Stir once every day for 10 days. Cover juice with plate or saucer. Leave the mixture sitting out at room temperature.

recipes.title: Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 6 slices Swiss cheese (reserve 2 slices for top)
directions: In large bowl, mix croutons with melted butter.
Add hot water and sauerkraut.
Stir. Grease large casserole dish.
Begin layering with crouton mixture, sliced beef and Swiss cheese, ending with croutons on top.
Bake, covered, at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven and lay remaining cheese slices on top. Bake an additional 10 minutes, uncovered.
Serve with Thousand Island dressing or mustard.
recipes.text: Reuben Casserole. In large bowl, mix croutons with melted butter. Add hot water and sauerkraut. Stir. Grease large casserole dish. Begin layering with crouton mixture, sliced beef and Swiss cheese, ending with croutons on top. Bake, covered, at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and lay remaining cheese slices on top. Bake an additional 10 minutes, uncovered. Serve with Thousand Island dressing or mustard.

recipes.title: Peaches 'N Cream Punch(A Great Non-Alcoholic Punch)
directions: In a blender container, combine undrained peach slices, pineapple juice, egg, ice cubes, lemon juice and vanilla.
Cover and blend until smooth.
Stir in cream.
Slowly pour in carbonated water (stir in an up and down motion).
Pour into chilled glasses. Makes about 8 servings.
recipes.text: Peaches 'N Cream Punch(A Great Non-Alcoholic Punch). In a blender container, combine undrained peach slices, pineapple juice, egg, ice cubes, lemon juice and vanilla. Cover and blend until smooth. Stir in cream. Slowly pour in carbonated water (stir in an up and down motion). Pour into chilled glasses. Makes about 8 servings.

recipes.title: Marinated Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh mushroom buttons or slices
directions: Wash mushrooms and put in large pot.
Add vinegar and salt; boil 10 minutes.
Drain thoroughly.
Put remaining ingredients into a large jar; add mushrooms and shake to coat well. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Marinated Mushrooms. Wash mushrooms and put in large pot. Add vinegar and salt; boil 10 minutes. Drain thoroughly. Put remaining ingredients into a large jar; add mushrooms and shake to coat well. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Mock Liver Pate
directions: Mash liverwurst with a fork.
Mix in garlic salt, basil and onion.
Flatten bottom after shaping into a ball. Frost ball with cream cheese and sprinkle with parsley or nuts.
It is best to make this the night before so seasonings can blend.
Very good.
recipes.text: Mock Liver Pate. Mash liverwurst with a fork. Mix in garlic salt, basil and onion. Flatten bottom after shaping into a ball. Frost ball with cream cheese and sprinkle with parsley or nuts. It is best to make this the night before so seasonings can blend. Very good.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Cook sausage in a medium skillet until browned; drain.
Set aside.
Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles.
Place triangles with elongated points toward center in a greased 12-inch pizza pan.
Press bottom and sides to form a crust; seal perforations. Spoon sausage over dough; sprinkle with hash brown potatoes and Cheddar cheese.
Combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper; pour over sausage mixture.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake 5 more minutes.
Garnish with pimento and fresh oregano, if desired.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Breakfast Pizza. Cook sausage in a medium skillet until browned; drain. Set aside. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place triangles with elongated points toward center in a greased 12-inch pizza pan. Press bottom and sides to form a crust; seal perforations. Spoon sausage over dough; sprinkle with hash brown potatoes and Cheddar cheese. Combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper; pour over sausage mixture. Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake 5 more minutes. Garnish with pimento and fresh oregano, if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Make cake mix into two 9-inch layers and cool. Place 1 layer in bottom of punch bowl. Layer 1/2 each cherry pie filling, pudding, pineapple, banana (one) and whipped topping. Repeat layers and garnish with coconut and/or pecans and cherries.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Make cake mix into two 9-inch layers and cool. Place 1 layer in bottom of punch bowl. Layer 1/2 each cherry pie filling, pudding, pineapple, banana (one) and whipped topping. Repeat layers and garnish with coconut and/or pecans and cherries.

recipes.title: Cream Kisses From India
ingredients: a little milk to mix, if necessary
directions: Preheat oven to 250u00b0.
Cream Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add essence to the cream mixture.
Add flour and mix. Add milk, if necessary.
Cut into any shape or pipe through a nozzle and bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Cream it out with nozzle.
recipes.text: Cream Kisses From India. Preheat oven to 250u00b0. Cream Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add essence to the cream mixture. Add flour and mix. Add milk, if necessary. Cut into any shape or pipe through a nozzle and bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cream it out with nozzle.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Sift flour, cocoa, soda and salt 3 times.
Add mayonnaise, water and vanilla.
Mix well.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Cake. Sift flour, cocoa, soda and salt 3 times. Add mayonnaise, water and vanilla. Mix well. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
ingredients: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. instant French vanilla pudding mix
directions: Butter 9 x 13-inch dish.
Line bottom with single layer of whole crackers.
Prepare pudding, using cold milk.
Add Cool Whip to pudding.
Pour half over crackers.
Add another layer of crackers.
Add remaining pudding and final layer of crackers on top.
Cover with frosting and refrigerate overnight up to 2 days before serving.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair Dessert. Butter 9 x 13-inch dish. Line bottom with single layer of whole crackers. Prepare pudding, using cold milk. Add Cool Whip to pudding. Pour half over crackers. Add another layer of crackers. Add remaining pudding and final layer of crackers on top. Cover with frosting and refrigerate overnight up to 2 days before serving.

recipes.title: Mexican Soup
directions: Brown onions with ground meat. Drain off all fat. Add in all other ingredients and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve over favorite tortilla chips. Can garnish with grated cheese.
recipes.text: Mexican Soup. Brown onions with ground meat. Drain off all fat. Add in all other ingredients and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve over favorite tortilla chips. Can garnish with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion until tender.
Drain well.
Add butter and mix well.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Place in buttered casserole dish and top with a thin layer of cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook squash and onion until tender. Drain well. Add butter and mix well. Fold in remaining ingredients. Place in buttered casserole dish and top with a thin layer of cracker crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Vegetable Puffs
ingredients: 1 c. grated fresh corn or canned whole kernel
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Drop by teaspoonful into hot fat and cook until brown.
Drain on absorbent paper.
Makes 8 puffs.
recipes.text: Vegetable Puffs. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonful into hot fat and cook until brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes 8 puffs.

recipes.title: No-Peek Chicken
directions: Combine soup with 2 cups of water and rice in a baking dish. Place chicken parts on top of mixture; sprinkle onion soup over all.
Bake for 2 hours at 300u00b0.
Don't peek.
(Pork chops can be used instead of chicken.)
recipes.text: No-Peek Chicken. Combine soup with 2 cups of water and rice in a baking dish. Place chicken parts on top of mixture; sprinkle onion soup over all. Bake for 2 hours at 300u00b0. Don't peek. (Pork chops can be used instead of chicken.)

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Saute celery and onion in butter until soft.
Add chicken soup, celery soup, olives, salt, pepper and chicken.
Put spaghetti in large amount of salted boiling water.
Let return to rolling boil.
Cover and remove from stove; let stand for 20 minutes without opening.
Drain spaghetti; add chicken mixture, mixing well.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Saute celery and onion in butter until soft. Add chicken soup, celery soup, olives, salt, pepper and chicken. Put spaghetti in large amount of salted boiling water. Let return to rolling boil. Cover and remove from stove; let stand for 20 minutes without opening. Drain spaghetti; add chicken mixture, mixing well.

recipes.title: Cucumber-Onion Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Add thinly sliced cucumbers and onions.
Use celery seed and white pepper to taste (use freely though).
Make ahead and chill at least the day before.
Keeps well in fridge.
recipes.text: Cucumber-Onion Salad. Mix ingredients together. Add thinly sliced cucumbers and onions. Use celery seed and white pepper to taste (use freely though). Make ahead and chill at least the day before. Keeps well in fridge.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Soup
directions: Cook spaghetti, hamburg and vegetables, each separately until tender.
Combine and cold pack 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Soup. Cook spaghetti, hamburg and vegetables, each separately until tender. Combine and cold pack 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Lit'L Smokies
directions: Mix jelly and mustard in heated crock pot until well blended. Add smokies.
Serve when heated through.
recipes.text: Lit'L Smokies. Mix jelly and mustard in heated crock pot until well blended. Add smokies. Serve when heated through.

recipes.title: 5 Minute Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, cream and butter.
Let boil for 5 minutes on medium heat.
Remove from heat and add the peanut butter chips, marshmallow cream, nuts, peanut butter and vanilla.
Stir as quickly as possible, then spread on 2 buttered platters.
recipes.text: 5 Minute Peanut Butter Fudge. Combine sugar, cream and butter. Let boil for 5 minutes on medium heat. Remove from heat and add the peanut butter chips, marshmallow cream, nuts, peanut butter and vanilla. Stir as quickly as possible, then spread on 2 buttered platters.

recipes.title: Lemon Pasta Salad
directions: Cut bell peppers into strips and saute in lightly oiled skillet.
Remove and add almonds, stirring over high heat 30 seconds.
Remove peel from lemon using grater and set aside.
Cut off white pith; discard.
Cut lemon into 1/4-inch slices.
Into hot oiled skillet, add leeks, lemon peel, lemon slices, capers, salt and pepper.
Stir and toss until vegetables are tender-crisp. Remove from heat and discard lemon slices.
Stir in almond and bell pepper slices.
Cover and refrigerate.
Cook pasta; drain and rinse in cold water.
Combine with veggies.
recipes.text: Lemon Pasta Salad. Cut bell peppers into strips and saute in lightly oiled skillet. Remove and add almonds, stirring over high heat 30 seconds. Remove peel from lemon using grater and set aside. Cut off white pith; discard. Cut lemon into 1/4-inch slices. Into hot oiled skillet, add leeks, lemon peel, lemon slices, capers, salt and pepper. Stir and toss until vegetables are tender-crisp. Remove from heat and discard lemon slices. Stir in almond and bell pepper slices. Cover and refrigerate. Cook pasta; drain and rinse in cold water. Combine with veggies.

recipes.title: Small Cheese Pies
directions: You will also need midget cupcake holders.
recipes.text: Small Cheese Pies. You will also need midget cupcake holders.

recipes.title: Cranberry Fluff Salad
directions: Grind cranberries.
Pour 2 cups sugar over cranberries; let set overnight.
Fold in Cool Whip, marshmallows and pecans.
recipes.text: Cranberry Fluff Salad. Grind cranberries. Pour 2 cups sugar over cranberries; let set overnight. Fold in Cool Whip, marshmallows and pecans.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Thaw and drain squash.
Cook.
Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350u00b0 until warm throughout.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Thaw and drain squash. Cook. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350u00b0 until warm throughout.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair
ingredients: 3 c. milk (2 if you use skim or 1%)
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients.
Layer:
graham crackers, pudding, graham crackers, pudding, graham crackers and chocolate icing.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair. Mix first 3 ingredients. Layer: graham crackers, pudding, graham crackers, pudding, graham crackers and chocolate icing.

recipes.title: Nabisco Pie
directions: In 9 x 13-inch pan, layer 3/4 crushed wafers, all berries and Cool Whip.
Top with remaining wafers.
recipes.text: Nabisco Pie. In 9 x 13-inch pan, layer 3/4 crushed wafers, all berries and Cool Whip. Top with remaining wafers.

recipes.title: Dipsy Devil Dip
directions: In 2-quart dish, put cheese. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Serve with raw vegetables such as cauliflower, carrots, cucumbers or bell peppers. Serves 10.
recipes.text: Dipsy Devil Dip. In 2-quart dish, put cheese. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Serve with raw vegetables such as cauliflower, carrots, cucumbers or bell peppers. Serves 10.

recipes.title: State Line Dip
directions: Crumble, brown and drain sausage.
Melt cheeses.
Combine all ingredients.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: State Line Dip. Crumble, brown and drain sausage. Melt cheeses. Combine all ingredients. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Lemon
ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon flavor cake mix (not pudding in mix)
2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut into chunks (room temperature)
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix butter and 1 egg in large bowl with electric mixer until crumbly.
Press in bottom of prepared pan.
Bake for 8 minutes and remove from oven.
recipes.text: Cheesecake Lemon. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix butter and 1 egg in large bowl with electric mixer until crumbly. Press in bottom of prepared pan. Bake for 8 minutes and remove from oven.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: Mix all together and let set 5 to 6 hours or overnight in refrigerator.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown in greased muffin tin.
Makes 5 to 6 dozen.
Batter will keep in refrigerator for 5 to 6 weeks and can be baked fresh, as needed.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Mix all together and let set 5 to 6 hours or overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown in greased muffin tin. Makes 5 to 6 dozen. Batter will keep in refrigerator for 5 to 6 weeks and can be baked fresh, as needed.

recipes.title: Pickled Peaches
directions: Choose ripe, but firm, cling peaches.
Peel.
Make a syrup of sugar, vinegar and spices.
Boil 5 minutes.
Drop peaches into syrup and simmer for about 15 minutes or until tender.
Pack into clean, hot jars.
Pour syrup over peaches and seal.
Yields 4 pints.
recipes.text: Pickled Peaches. Choose ripe, but firm, cling peaches. Peel. Make a syrup of sugar, vinegar and spices. Boil 5 minutes. Drop peaches into syrup and simmer for about 15 minutes or until tender. Pack into clean, hot jars. Pour syrup over peaches and seal. Yields 4 pints.

recipes.title: Barbecued Meatballs
directions: To make meatballs, combine beef, evaporated milk, oats, cracker crumbs, eggs, onion, garlic powder, salt, pepper and chili powder.
Shape into walnut size balls.
Place meatballs in a single layer on wax paper lined cookie sheet.
Freeze until solid. Store frozen meatballs in freezer bags until ready to cook.
recipes.text: Barbecued Meatballs. To make meatballs, combine beef, evaporated milk, oats, cracker crumbs, eggs, onion, garlic powder, salt, pepper and chili powder. Shape into walnut size balls. Place meatballs in a single layer on wax paper lined cookie sheet. Freeze until solid. Store frozen meatballs in freezer bags until ready to cook.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Bring to a boil the margarine, water and cocoa.
Pour into a large mixing bowl and add the flour, sugar and salt.
Beat these ingredients well, then add the eggs, sour cream and soda.
Beat well and pour into a large greased cooking sheet (11 1/2 x 18-inch).
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400u00b0.
While cake bakes, make icing.
recipes.text: Texas Sheet Cake. Bring to a boil the margarine, water and cocoa. Pour into a large mixing bowl and add the flour, sugar and salt. Beat these ingredients well, then add the eggs, sour cream and soda. Beat well and pour into a large greased cooking sheet (11 1/2 x 18-inch). Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400u00b0. While cake bakes, make icing.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small boxes Jell-O (strawberry, cherry, etc.)
1/2 c. nuts or more if you want
1 c. cold water (use drained juice with cold water to make 1 c.)
directions: Mix Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water.
Put can of cranberries into Jell-O and melt.
Add cold water.
Pour into bowl; let set some in refrigerator, then add nuts and drained fruit cocktail. Mix.
If not set enough, stir again later.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Mix Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water. Put can of cranberries into Jell-O and melt. Add cold water. Pour into bowl; let set some in refrigerator, then add nuts and drained fruit cocktail. Mix. If not set enough, stir again later.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy.
Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla.
Mix lightly, then add nuts and dry ingredients just until blended.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour in greased, floured pans. Remove from pans to prevent sticking.
Cool on racks.
Makes 2 loaves.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla. Mix lightly, then add nuts and dry ingredients just until blended. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour in greased, floured pans. Remove from pans to prevent sticking. Cool on racks. Makes 2 loaves. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Jello Salad(Low-Fat)
directions: Follow instructions on jello box.
Add other ingredients. Refrigerate until set.
Great.
recipes.text: Jello Salad(Low-Fat). Follow instructions on jello box. Add other ingredients. Refrigerate until set. Great.

recipes.title: Easy Frozen Dessert
ingredients: 1 can pie filling (cherry, peach or strawberry)
directions: Mix and freeze in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Easy Frozen Dessert. Mix and freeze in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 uncooked chicken, cut up, or meaty parts of 2 chickens
directions: Wash and place chicken in large shallow baking dish.
Sprinkle rice over the chicken (uncooked).
Add soups and water and bake 1 1/2 hours in 350u00b0 oven.
Serves 5 to 6 people.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Casserole. Wash and place chicken in large shallow baking dish. Sprinkle rice over the chicken (uncooked). Add soups and water and bake 1 1/2 hours in 350u00b0 oven. Serves 5 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Hummus
ingredients: 1 large clove garlic, finely minced (or more if desired)
directions: Mix all ingredients except bread in a blender or a food processor until smooth, adding water until a desirable consistency is reached.
Makes hors d'oeuvres for 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Hummus. Mix all ingredients except bread in a blender or a food processor until smooth, adding water until a desirable consistency is reached. Makes hors d'oeuvres for 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients. Pour into buttered dish.
Mix the brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa.
Sprinkle over batter. Pour over all the boiling water.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Fudge Pudding Cake. Combine first 7 ingredients. Pour into buttered dish. Mix the brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa. Sprinkle over batter. Pour over all the boiling water. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Jello Jigglers
ingredients: 4 regular (4 oz.) pkg. or 2 large (8 oz.) pkg. Jell-O brand gelatin (any flavor)
2 1/2 c. boiling water or apple juice
directions: Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water or juice.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Chill until firm, about 3 hours.
To unmold, dip pan in water (warm) for about 15 seconds.
(I usually do not do this.
I just cut into squares and remove with spatula.)
recipes.text: Jello Jigglers. Completely dissolve gelatin in boiling water or juice. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill until firm, about 3 hours. To unmold, dip pan in water (warm) for about 15 seconds. (I usually do not do this. I just cut into squares and remove with spatula.)

recipes.title: Brian'S Favorite Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. boneless chicken breasts, pounded thin
1 1/2 c. flour, seasoned with salt and pepper
1 large jar roasted red peppers (I roast my own, but jarred work just as well)
directions: Dredge each chicken breasts in the seasoned flour. Shake off excess. Fry in olive oil until golden. Keep chicken warm in a 250u00b0 oven while preparing sauce.
recipes.text: Brian'S Favorite Chicken. Dredge each chicken breasts in the seasoned flour. Shake off excess. Fry in olive oil until golden. Keep chicken warm in a 250u00b0 oven while preparing sauce.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni as directed on package.
Make a sauce by melting butter in saucepan; add flour.
When bubbling, gradually add the milk.
Stir until thickened.
Add grated cheese and stir until cheese is melted.
Salt and pepper to taste; mix with the macaroni.
Put in baking dish and bake at 350u00b0 until done.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese. Cook macaroni as directed on package. Make a sauce by melting butter in saucepan; add flour. When bubbling, gradually add the milk. Stir until thickened. Add grated cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Salt and pepper to taste; mix with the macaroni. Put in baking dish and bake at 350u00b0 until done.

recipes.title: Black Bean Burgers
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
directions: Place beans in large bowl. Partially mash with a fork. Stir in bread crumbs and next 6 ingredients. Divide mixture into 4 equal portions and shape into patty.
recipes.text: Black Bean Burgers. Place beans in large bowl. Partially mash with a fork. Stir in bread crumbs and next 6 ingredients. Divide mixture into 4 equal portions and shape into patty.

recipes.title: Beet Pickles
directions: Add sugar and spice to vinegar and water; simmer for 15 minutes, then add prepared beets in jar and fill with liquid to cover beets and seal.
recipes.text: Beet Pickles. Add sugar and spice to vinegar and water; simmer for 15 minutes, then add prepared beets in jar and fill with liquid to cover beets and seal.

recipes.title: Brussels Sprouts With Pecans
directions: Cut a cross in the end of each sprout for more even cooking. Cook in boiling water for 5 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain well.
In a deep skillet over low heat, stir sugar and butter until sugar dissolves.
Add sprouts and pecans; toss until well glazed.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Brussels Sprouts With Pecans. Cut a cross in the end of each sprout for more even cooking. Cook in boiling water for 5 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain well. In a deep skillet over low heat, stir sugar and butter until sugar dissolves. Add sprouts and pecans; toss until well glazed. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Spiced Tomato And Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 3/4 lb. plum tomatoes, seeded and thinly sliced into strips
1 large green bell pepper, thinly sliced
1 jalapeno chili, seeded and thinly sliced
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl.
Add salt; toss.
Let mixture stand 1 hour.
Rinse cabbage mixture thoroughly to remove excess salt.
Drain.
Return to bowl.
Combine all remaining ingredients in heavy medium saucepan.
Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves and mixture is hot; do not boil.
Pour dressing over cabbage and mix to coat.
Let slaw stand 1 hour.
(Can be prepared up to 2 days ahead.
Cover and refrigerate.)
Drain slaw before serving.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Spiced Tomato And Cabbage Slaw. Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Add salt; toss. Let mixture stand 1 hour. Rinse cabbage mixture thoroughly to remove excess salt. Drain. Return to bowl. Combine all remaining ingredients in heavy medium saucepan. Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves and mixture is hot; do not boil. Pour dressing over cabbage and mix to coat. Let slaw stand 1 hour. (Can be prepared up to 2 days ahead. Cover and refrigerate.) Drain slaw before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Country Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
directions: Combine potatoes, onion and ham in a lightly greased crock-pot. In a small bowl, combine the gravy mix, soup and water. Whisk until combined. Pour gravy mixture over the potatoes. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours or on high 3 to 4 hours. Top with cheese during last 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Country Scalloped Potatoes And Ham. Combine potatoes, onion and ham in a lightly greased crock-pot. In a small bowl, combine the gravy mix, soup and water. Whisk until combined. Pour gravy mixture over the potatoes. Cover and cook on low 7 to 9 hours or on high 3 to 4 hours. Top with cheese during last 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
directions: Mix all together.
Add enough flour to make dough so it can be rolled out like biscuits.
Cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven until golden brown.
recipes.text: Tea Cakes. Mix all together. Add enough flour to make dough so it can be rolled out like biscuits. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake in 350u00b0 oven until golden brown.

recipes.title: Sharon'S Scalloped Chicken
directions: Mix
together
all
ingredients except for the soup and cheese.
Put
in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Before baking, spread cream
of
mushroom
soup
on
top.
Bake
at 300u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle
with grated cheese, then bake 10 minutes more.
This can be made the day before and refrigerated overnight.
recipes.text: Sharon'S Scalloped Chicken. Mix together all ingredients except for the soup and cheese. Put in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Before baking, spread cream of mushroom soup on top. Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 hour. Sprinkle with grated cheese, then bake 10 minutes more. This can be made the day before and refrigerated overnight.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn Souffle
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Heat corn and milk; gradually stir in egg.
Add all remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle buttered cracker crumbs over top.
Bake for 20 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn Souffle. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Heat corn and milk; gradually stir in egg. Add all remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle buttered cracker crumbs over top. Bake for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Put the peanut butter in the bowl and sugar, butter, 2 cups of flour, mix oil, vanilla.
Then stir and put in a pan.
When through, put it in the oven and bake at 350u00b0.
When cookies are through, put on a nice dish.
They'll be ready to serve.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Put the peanut butter in the bowl and sugar, butter, 2 cups of flour, mix oil, vanilla. Then stir and put in a pan. When through, put it in the oven and bake at 350u00b0. When cookies are through, put on a nice dish. They'll be ready to serve.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bars
directions: Mix in order given.
Bake in 380u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes. (Line bottom of square pan with wax paper; grease pan.) After removing from oven, let stay in pan 5 minutes.
Then cut in finger lengths.
Turn over on board or wax paper.
Remove wax paper from bottom and cool.
Roll each piece in confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Date Nut Bars. Mix in order given. Bake in 380u00b0 oven 25 to 30 minutes. (Line bottom of square pan with wax paper; grease pan.) After removing from oven, let stay in pan 5 minutes. Then cut in finger lengths. Turn over on board or wax paper. Remove wax paper from bottom and cool. Roll each piece in confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pie Deluxe
directions: Mix ingredients and cook slowly until like jelly.
Pour into a baked pie shell and cover with meringue and brown.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Pie Deluxe. Mix ingredients and cook slowly until like jelly. Pour into a baked pie shell and cover with meringue and brown.

recipes.title: Freezer Slaw
directions: Mix vinegar and salt in pan and bring to a boil.
Cool for 1/2 hour.
Mix all other ingredients together and pour cooled liquid over it.
Let stand 1/2 hour.
Put into containers and freeze.
recipes.text: Freezer Slaw. Mix vinegar and salt in pan and bring to a boil. Cool for 1/2 hour. Mix all other ingredients together and pour cooled liquid over it. Let stand 1/2 hour. Put into containers and freeze.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Skin and cut up chicken.
Put in pot; cover with water and boil for 2 hours.
Debone chicken.
Saute celery, carrots and onions.
Pour into chicken pot.
Bring to boil and add noodles. Add salt, pepper and herbs to taste.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Soup. Skin and cut up chicken. Put in pot; cover with water and boil for 2 hours. Debone chicken. Saute celery, carrots and onions. Pour into chicken pot. Bring to boil and add noodles. Add salt, pepper and herbs to taste.

recipes.title: Glazed Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 3 large fresh jalapeos, seeded and coarsely chopped
1/2 c. plus 3 Tbsp. coarsely chopped cilantro
4 oz. Pepper Jack cheese, shredded (about 1 c.)
directions: In a blender, combine the fresh jalapeos with 1/2 cup of the cilantro, the garlic, lime juice, water, 1/2 teaspoon of the ground cumin and a generous pinch of salt. Puree the jalapeo-cumin sauce until smooth.
recipes.text: Glazed Pork Tenderloin. In a blender, combine the fresh jalapeos with 1/2 cup of the cilantro, the garlic, lime juice, water, 1/2 teaspoon of the ground cumin and a generous pinch of salt. Puree the jalapeo-cumin sauce until smooth.

recipes.title: Cheese Snacks
directions: Heat oven to 450u00b0 (hot).
Blend thoroughly with fork the Bisquick, cheese, mayonnaise and milk.
Shape into 1/2-inch balls. Roll in mixture of parsley and onion.
Bake on greased baking sheet for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes about 30.
recipes.text: Cheese Snacks. Heat oven to 450u00b0 (hot). Blend thoroughly with fork the Bisquick, cheese, mayonnaise and milk. Shape into 1/2-inch balls. Roll in mixture of parsley and onion. Bake on greased baking sheet for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 30.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
ingredients: small amount of oil (to saute meat)
directions: Brown beef in oil.
When thoroughly browned, saute garlic and onion until onion is translucent.
Add beef broth, tomato sauce, peppercorns, cloves and bay leaves.
Simmer until meat is tender. After simmering 1/2 hour, add wine and simmer for another half hour or until meat is tender.
Then add the potatoes, carrots and celery.
Cook until vegetables are tender.
recipes.text: Beef Stew. Brown beef in oil. When thoroughly browned, saute garlic and onion until onion is translucent. Add beef broth, tomato sauce, peppercorns, cloves and bay leaves. Simmer until meat is tender. After simmering 1/2 hour, add wine and simmer for another half hour or until meat is tender. Then add the potatoes, carrots and celery. Cook until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Toffee Cookies
directions: Place graham crackers on a vegetable-sprayed jelly roll pan in a single layer.
Boil margarine and sugar 3 minutes.
Pour evenly over crackers. Sprinkle with chopped nuts.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 12 minutes.
Watch closely so they don't burn.
Let cool a few minutes before loosening, then cool on a wire rack.
Store when cool in a covered container.
recipes.text: Toffee Cookies. Place graham crackers on a vegetable-sprayed jelly roll pan in a single layer. Boil margarine and sugar 3 minutes. Pour evenly over crackers. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Bake at 325u00b0 for 12 minutes. Watch closely so they don't burn. Let cool a few minutes before loosening, then cool on a wire rack. Store when cool in a covered container.

recipes.title: Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 red pepper, stemmed, seeded and chopped
directions: Soak beans overnight; drain.
Combine beans, water and 1/4 teaspoon of the cayenne.
Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until beans are tender (about 1 hour).
Drain.
Rinse until water runs clear and beans are cool.
Drain well.
recipes.text: Black Bean Salad. Soak beans overnight; drain. Combine beans, water and 1/4 teaspoon of the cayenne. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until beans are tender (about 1 hour). Drain. Rinse until water runs clear and beans are cool. Drain well.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Peel and dice potatoes.
Add onion.
Put in boiler; cover with water.
Add butter, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook 30 minutes on medium.
Add soup; reduce heat to low and continue to cook 15 to 20 minutes.
You may need to add a small amount of water.
(You can also add a can of cheese broccoli soup.)
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Peel and dice potatoes. Add onion. Put in boiler; cover with water. Add butter, salt and pepper. Cover and cook 30 minutes on medium. Add soup; reduce heat to low and continue to cook 15 to 20 minutes. You may need to add a small amount of water. (You can also add a can of cheese broccoli soup.)

recipes.title: Citrus Salad
ingredients: 3 oranges, sliced - take pith out & discard white
Squeeze 1 lemon, save juice & pulp - remove seed
directions: Slice oranges; take pith out and discard white.
Squeeze lemon, remove seed.
Retain pulp.
Mix all ingredients together and chill.
recipes.text: Citrus Salad. Slice oranges; take pith out and discard white. Squeeze lemon, remove seed. Retain pulp. Mix all ingredients together and chill.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 3 lb. ground meat, browned and drained
1/2 c. chopped onion and bell pepper
directions: Brown meat, onion and bell pepper.
Drain.
Stir in seasoning package of Ragu and set aside.
Boil noodles until tender.
Drain.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Brown meat, onion and bell pepper. Drain. Stir in seasoning package of Ragu and set aside. Boil noodles until tender. Drain.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Melt cheese in soup.
Alternate layers of soup mixture, eggs and asparagus.
Crumble crackers or onion rings.
Melt a little butter and pour over cracker crumbs.
Grease or spray pan.
Cook until it bubbles.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Melt cheese in soup. Alternate layers of soup mixture, eggs and asparagus. Crumble crackers or onion rings. Melt a little butter and pour over cracker crumbs. Grease or spray pan. Cook until it bubbles.

recipes.title: She Crab Soup
directions: Bring entire mixture to a slow boil.
Cook slowly to avoid sticking.
Just before serving, add 1/4 cup sherry.
recipes.text: She Crab Soup. Bring entire mixture to a slow boil. Cook slowly to avoid sticking. Just before serving, add 1/4 cup sherry.

recipes.title: Baked Pork And Beans
directions: Brown bacon and onion; add to beans.
Mix all together.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Baked Pork And Beans. Brown bacon and onion; add to beans. Mix all together. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Bring butter, sugar, milk and cocoa to a boil for 1/2 minute. Add remaining ingredients and stir well.
Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.
Let stand to set.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Bring butter, sugar, milk and cocoa to a boil for 1/2 minute. Add remaining ingredients and stir well. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper. Let stand to set.

recipes.title: Dutch Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Make into loaf.
Bake in oven at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Dutch Meat Loaf. Mix ingredients together. Make into loaf. Bake in oven at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: New Potatoes In Dill Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 tub (8 oz.) spreadable Philadelphia chive and onion cream cheese spread
directions: Cut potatoes into quarters; place in a large saucepan, and cover with water.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium, and cook 15 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Mix cream cheese, milk and green pepper in a large microwavable bowl.
Microwave on high 40 to 50 seconds, or until cream cheese is melted; stir until well blended.
Stir in fresh dill.
Add drained potatoes; toss lightly to coat.
Makes 16 servings, about 1/2 cup each.
(Cover and refrigerate any leftovers.
Serve as a cold potato salad, stirring in a small amount of milk to thin, if necessary.)
recipes.text: New Potatoes In Dill Cream Sauce. Cut potatoes into quarters; place in a large saucepan, and cover with water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium, and cook 15 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Mix cream cheese, milk and green pepper in a large microwavable bowl. Microwave on high 40 to 50 seconds, or until cream cheese is melted; stir until well blended. Stir in fresh dill. Add drained potatoes; toss lightly to coat. Makes 16 servings, about 1/2 cup each. (Cover and refrigerate any leftovers. Serve as a cold potato salad, stirring in a small amount of milk to thin, if necessary.)

recipes.title: Ginger-Broiled Fish
directions: Preheat broiler for 5 minutes.
Arrange fish in a single layer in a well oiled preheated pan.
Combine all ingredients except fish.
Pour sauce over fish and broil 10 to 12 minutes about 2 inches from the heat, turning once and basting several times. Fish is done when it flakes easily with a fork.
recipes.text: Ginger-Broiled Fish. Preheat broiler for 5 minutes. Arrange fish in a single layer in a well oiled preheated pan. Combine all ingredients except fish. Pour sauce over fish and broil 10 to 12 minutes about 2 inches from the heat, turning once and basting several times. Fish is done when it flakes easily with a fork.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Breakfast Bar
directions: Mix together.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes in rectangle pan. Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Breakfast Bar. Mix together. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes in rectangle pan. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Tiger Butter Candy
directions: Melt chocolate and peanut butter in double boiler.
Pour on wax paper on cookie sheet.
Put chocolate chips in and mix until melted.
Chill.
recipes.text: Tiger Butter Candy. Melt chocolate and peanut butter in double boiler. Pour on wax paper on cookie sheet. Put chocolate chips in and mix until melted. Chill.

recipes.title: Baked Seafood Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb. fresh crabmeat or 1/2 lb. scallops
directions: Combine all ingredients except potato chips.
Place into greased casserole.
Cover with chips and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Seafood Casserole. Combine all ingredients except potato chips. Place into greased casserole. Cover with chips and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350u00b0. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Impossible
directions: Mix
for 5 minutes.
Grease pan good.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Impossible. Mix for 5 minutes. Grease pan good. Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Mango Cream Cheese Dessert
directions: Mix flour and sugar.
Cut in butter.
Press into pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Mango Cream Cheese Dessert. Mix flour and sugar. Cut in butter. Press into pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 370u00b0.
Save 1/2 cup Mozzarella and 1/2 cup pizza sauce for topping later.
Mix remaining cheese, pizza sauce and other ingredients.
recipes.text: Pizza Meat Loaf. Preheat oven to 370u00b0. Save 1/2 cup Mozzarella and 1/2 cup pizza sauce for topping later. Mix remaining cheese, pizza sauce and other ingredients.

recipes.title: Brown Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Place large pan of boiling water on lower rack of oven for steam.
Grease four bread pans.
Bring 3 cups of raisins to boil.
Cook 5 minutes.
Drain and cool.
recipes.text: Brown Bread. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Place large pan of boiling water on lower rack of oven for steam. Grease four bread pans. Bring 3 cups of raisins to boil. Cook 5 minutes. Drain and cool.

recipes.title: Devil'S Food Cake
ingredients: 3 whole eggs and 1 egg yolk (save the white of fourth egg for icing)
4 sq. baking chocolate, melted in 1 c. hot water
directions: Beat margarine and sugar.
Add eggs (3 whole eggs and egg yolk of fourth egg).
Add flour and salt.
Mix the milk, vinegar and baking soda well; add to cake batter.
Add vanilla.
Pour into greased tube pan; bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0.
Ice with Seven-Minute Icing.
recipes.text: Devil'S Food Cake. Beat margarine and sugar. Add eggs (3 whole eggs and egg yolk of fourth egg). Add flour and salt. Mix the milk, vinegar and baking soda well; add to cake batter. Add vanilla. Pour into greased tube pan; bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0. Ice with Seven-Minute Icing.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Sandwiches
directions: Beat cream cheese and salad dressing together.
Add olive juice and refrigerate until thickens.
Stir in olives and nuts. Serve on dark rye bread.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Sandwiches. Beat cream cheese and salad dressing together. Add olive juice and refrigerate until thickens. Stir in olives and nuts. Serve on dark rye bread.

recipes.title: Beef Chow Mein
directions: Brown ground beef and drain. Cook onion and celery in water until celery is tender; drain. Mix all ingredients together except noodles. Place mixture into a glass 9 x 13-inch casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0. Cover with chow mein noodles and bake 15 minutes more.
recipes.text: Beef Chow Mein. Brown ground beef and drain. Cook onion and celery in water until celery is tender; drain. Mix all ingredients together except noodles. Place mixture into a glass 9 x 13-inch casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0. Cover with chow mein noodles and bake 15 minutes more.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. Tabasco sauce (I omit this as it makes it too tart for us)
directions: Grate both cheeses.
Combine all ingredients and mix well.
recipes.text: Cheddar Cheese Spread. Grate both cheeses. Combine all ingredients and mix well.

recipes.title: Breakfast Egg Dish
ingredients: 8 oz. Smokie links, cut up or ham or browned sausage
directions: The night before, grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Put broken bread into baking dish.
Add the Smokie links or ham or browned sausage and shredded cheese.
Mix the eggs, milk, dry mustard and salt together and pour over the bread.
Let set all night in refrigerator.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Egg Dish. The night before, grease 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Put broken bread into baking dish. Add the Smokie links or ham or browned sausage and shredded cheese.
