Mix the eggs, milk, dry mustard and salt together and pour over the bread. Let set all night in refrigerator. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Ruth'S Fudge
ingredients: 2 large plain Hershey chocolate bars, broken in small pieces
directions: Boil 4 1/2 minutes; pour over first ingredients.
Mix well. Add nuts; spread on greased cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Ruth'S Fudge. Boil 4 1/2 minutes; pour over first ingredients. Mix well. Add nuts; spread on greased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Cheese Filled Jumbo Shells
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) box San Giorgio jumbo shells
directions: Cook jumbo shells according to package directions for about 10 minutes.
Drain well.
(Cool in a single layer on wax paper or aluminum foil to prevent sticking together.)
Mix together cheeses, eggs, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper.
Fill each shell with about 2 tablespoons cheese mixture.
Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Place the shells, open side down, in a single layer in the pan.
Cover with about 2 cups of the sauce.
Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Bake, covered, with aluminum foil at 350u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Heat remaining sauce and serve with shells.
Fills about 36 shells.
recipes.text: Cheese Filled Jumbo Shells. Cook jumbo shells according to package directions for about 10 minutes. Drain well. (Cool in a single layer on wax paper or aluminum foil to prevent sticking together.) Mix together cheeses, eggs, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper. Fill each shell with about 2 tablespoons cheese mixture. Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Place the shells, open side down, in a single layer in the pan. Cover with about 2 cups of the sauce. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. Bake, covered, with aluminum foil at 350u00b0 for about 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Heat remaining sauce and serve with shells. Fills about 36 shells.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
ingredients: 1 baked 10-inch pastry shell or 2 baked (7 1/2-inch) pastry shells
directions: Mix milk
with
gelatin.
Place
over low heat and stir until gelatin
dissolves.
Stir
in egg yolks and brown sugar. Continue stirring
until brown sugar dissolves.
Mix pumpkin, sour
cream, cinnamon,
cloves,
nutmeg
and
salt.
Stir
in gelatin mixture. Whip egg whites, gradually adding granulated sugar,
until
stiff peaks
form.
Fold into pumpkin mixture. Pour into cooled pastry shell.
Chill 3 hours or longer before cutting.
Serve with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie. Mix milk with gelatin. Place over low heat and stir until gelatin dissolves. Stir in egg yolks and brown sugar. Continue stirring until brown sugar dissolves. Mix pumpkin, sour cream, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and salt. Stir in gelatin mixture. Whip egg whites, gradually adding granulated sugar, until stiff peaks form. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Pour into cooled pastry shell. Chill 3 hours or longer before cutting. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Libby'S Brownies
ingredients: black walnuts to taste (at least 1/2 c.)
directions: Mix well, then either add about 1 teaspoon instant coffee or enough brewed coffee to make mixture thick enough to spread.
If using instant coffee granules, add enough hot water to mix until ready to spread.
Makes enough for about 6 people or can double this recipe.
recipes.text: Libby'S Brownies. Mix well, then either add about 1 teaspoon instant coffee or enough brewed coffee to make mixture thick enough to spread. If using instant coffee granules, add enough hot water to mix until ready to spread. Makes enough for about 6 people or can double this recipe.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Torte
ingredients: butter brickle chips or Heath chips
directions: Cream together cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Put on top of cooled crust.
Beat together pudding and milk and put on top of cream cheese layer.
Cover with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle on butter brickle chips or Heath chips.
recipes.text: Butter Pecan Torte. Cream together cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Put on top of cooled crust. Beat together pudding and milk and put on top of cream cheese layer. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle on butter brickle chips or Heath chips.

recipes.title: Hot Milk Cake
directions: Beat eggs.
Add sugar, beat thoroughly.
Add flour and baking powder; beat until smooth.
Heat milk and butter, but do not boil. Add to mixture, a little at a time, beating all the time.
Flavor with vanilla or lemon.
Bake in layers or a mold at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes.
Check when smell.
Makes 3 layer cake.
recipes.text: Hot Milk Cake. Beat eggs. Add sugar, beat thoroughly. Add flour and baking powder; beat until smooth. Heat milk and butter, but do not boil. Add to mixture, a little at a time, beating all the time. Flavor with vanilla or lemon. Bake in layers or a mold at 350u00b0 for about 30 minutes. Check when smell. Makes 3 layer cake.

recipes.title: Go-Go-Go Scotch Fudge
directions: Combine morsels and peanut butter in the top of double boiler. Place over hot (not boiling) water, stir until butterscotch melts and mixture is smooth.
Remove from water.
Add milk.
Stir until well blended.
Add black walnuts.
Turn into foil lined 8-inch square pan.
Chill until firm.
Cut in 1-inch squares.
Store in covered containers, if they last long enough.
recipes.text: Go-Go-Go Scotch Fudge. Combine morsels and peanut butter in the top of double boiler. Place over hot (not boiling) water, stir until butterscotch melts and mixture is smooth. Remove from water. Add milk. Stir until well blended. Add black walnuts. Turn into foil lined 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm. Cut in 1-inch squares. Store in covered containers, if they last long enough.

recipes.title: Pear Cake
ingredients: allspice, nutmeg and cinnamon to taste
directions: Beat eggs, add sugar, oil and vanilla; mix well.
Add combined flour, salt, soda and spices.
Stir in pears and pecans.
Pour into 10 x 14-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pear Cake. Beat eggs, add sugar, oil and vanilla; mix well. Add combined flour, salt, soda and spices. Stir in pears and pecans. Pour into 10 x 14-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Canned Corn
directions: Cut corn from cob; do not scrape cob.
Put into pint jars. Shake lightly, but do not pack.
Add enough cold water to cover corn, then 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice to each jar.
Seal and cook in hot water bath for 3 hours.
After reaches boiling point, do not boil at high temperature.
If using quart jars, use 1 teaspoon lemon juice per can.
recipes.text: Canned Corn. Cut corn from cob; do not scrape cob. Put into pint jars. Shake lightly, but do not pack. Add enough cold water to cover corn, then 1/2 teaspoon fresh lemon juice to each jar. Seal and cook in hot water bath for 3 hours. After reaches boiling point, do not boil at high temperature. If using quart jars, use 1 teaspoon lemon juice per can.

recipes.title: Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Cook beef, onion and celery in a large skillet until meat is brown.
Drain drippings.
Stir in soup, thyme and salt.
Spoon meat mixture into a greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Spread potatoes over meat mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle cheese over top.
Return to oven. Bake for 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: Shepherd'S Pie. Cook beef, onion and celery in a large skillet until meat is brown. Drain drippings. Stir in soup, thyme and salt. Spoon meat mixture into a greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Spread potatoes over meat mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle cheese over top. Return to oven. Bake for 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Summer Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 oz. capellini or other thin spaghetti
3 large ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped (about 2 c.)
5 oil-cured black olives, pitted and finely chopped
1 small hot chili pepper, seeded, deribbed and finely chopped (optional)
directions: Put the chopped tomatoes in a strainer set over a large bowl; place the bowl in the refrigerator and let the tomatoes drain for at least 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Summer Spaghetti. Put the chopped tomatoes in a strainer set over a large bowl; place the bowl in the refrigerator and let the tomatoes drain for at least 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Apricot Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup
directions: Bring to a boil the Jell-O, pineapple and sugar; let cool. Mix buttermilk and Cool Whip; pour pineapple mixture into Cool Whip mixture; mix well.
Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Apricot Fruit Salad. Bring to a boil the Jell-O, pineapple and sugar; let cool. Mix buttermilk and Cool Whip; pour pineapple mixture into Cool Whip mixture; mix well. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Blend powdered sugar and cocoa in mixing bowl.
Without stirring, add
milk and butter.
Cook in microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Remove bowl and stir just to mix ingredients.
Add vanilla
and
nuts
and stir until blended.
Pour into greased container
and place in freezer for 20 minutes or refrigerator for 1 hour.
Cut and serve.
recipes.text: Microwave Fudge. Blend powdered sugar and cocoa in mixing bowl. Without stirring, add milk and butter. Cook in microwave on High for 2 minutes. Remove bowl and stir just to mix ingredients. Add vanilla and nuts and stir until blended. Pour into greased container and place in freezer for 20 minutes or refrigerator for 1 hour. Cut and serve.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix together first 3 ingredients and spread on round platter (at least 12-inches in diameter).
Arrange remaining ingredients on top of sour cream mixture in order given.
Arrange Doritos chips around edge of platter and serve with dip.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Mix together first 3 ingredients and spread on round platter (at least 12-inches in diameter). Arrange remaining ingredients on top of sour cream mixture in order given. Arrange Doritos chips around edge of platter and serve with dip.

recipes.title: Jezebel Dip
directions: Mix thoroughly together the first 4 ingredients.
Store in refrigerator indefinitely.
When ready to serve, pour generous amount over an 8 ounce block of cream cheese and serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Jezebel Dip. Mix thoroughly together the first 4 ingredients. Store in refrigerator indefinitely. When ready to serve, pour generous amount over an 8 ounce block of cream cheese and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Raspberry Salad
directions: Blend cream cheese and sugar.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Spread over crust and seal around top edge.
Mix together Jell-O and hot water.
Add frozen raspberries.
Pour onto cheese layer and chill.
recipes.text: Raspberry Salad. Blend cream cheese and sugar. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread over crust and seal around top edge. Mix together Jell-O and hot water. Add frozen raspberries. Pour onto cheese layer and chill.

recipes.title: Squash Pickles
directions: Place squash, onions and pepper in layers.
Salt as if for cooking.
Let stand 1 hour, then drain.
Heat other ingredients and pour over squash.
Bring to a boil. Seal in hot jars.
recipes.text: Squash Pickles. Place squash, onions and pepper in layers. Salt as if for cooking. Let stand 1 hour, then drain. Heat other ingredients and pour over squash. Bring to a boil. Seal in hot jars.

recipes.title: Pizza Sauce With Pizza Dough Recipe
directions: Mix sausage and tomato sauce together and place over pizza dough.
To each pizza, add oregano, garlic salt and pinch of red pepper.
Mix 2 pounds Mozzarella cheese.
Put 2 tablespoons olive oil on top of pizza.
recipes.text: Pizza Sauce With Pizza Dough Recipe. Mix sausage and tomato sauce together and place over pizza dough. To each pizza, add oregano, garlic salt and pinch of red pepper. Mix 2 pounds Mozzarella cheese. Put 2 tablespoons olive oil on top of pizza.

recipes.title: Beet Borscht *
directions: Saute onion and celery in 1 tablespoon butter.

Place sauteed onion and celery in large pot with 1 grated beet, garlic, tomatoes with juice, potatoes, stock, water, pepper, parsley and salt. Bring to boil; lower heat immediately and simmer, uncovered, 45 minutes.
Strain out vegetables; puree in food processor and return to soup.
Saute grated beets and carrots in 1 tablespoon butter; add to soup and simmer 15 minutes.
Do not boil, as this will turn red beet color brown.
Saute cabbage in 1 tablespoon or more butter for 5 minutes; add to soup and simmer 15 minutes more. Add lemon juice.
Taste for salt and pepper.
Serve hot with sour cream.
recipes.text: Beet Borscht *. Saute onion and celery in 1 tablespoon butter. Place sauteed onion and celery in large pot with 1 grated beet, garlic, tomatoes with juice, potatoes, stock, water, pepper, parsley and salt. Bring to boil; lower heat immediately and simmer, uncovered, 45 minutes. Strain out vegetables; puree in food processor and return to soup. Saute grated beets and carrots in 1 tablespoon butter; add to soup and simmer 15 minutes. Do not boil, as this will turn red beet color brown. Saute cabbage in 1 tablespoon or more butter for 5 minutes; add to soup and simmer 15 minutes more. Add lemon juice. Taste for salt and pepper. Serve hot with sour cream.

recipes.title: Semi-Sweet Frosted Brownies For A Crowd
directions: Melt 4 squares of chocolate, being careful not to burn.
Set aside to cool.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, to butter mixture, beating well after each.
Blend in cooled unsweetened chocolate and vanilla.
recipes.text: Semi-Sweet Frosted Brownies For A Crowd. Melt 4 squares of chocolate, being careful not to burn. Set aside to cool. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, to butter mixture, beating well after each. Blend in cooled unsweetened chocolate and vanilla.

recipes.title: Eggplant Manicotti
directions: Peel eggplant, cut in half lengthwise.
Slice into thin long slices (1/8-inch thick).
In heavy skillet, saute each slice in olive oil over medium heat, turning only once and cooking just until eggplant becomes limp enough to roll.
Cool and drain slices on paper towel.
Combine the remaining ingredients, except tomato sauce.
Spread each eggplant slice with a thin layer of cheese mixture.
Roll each slice and place seam side down in buttered casserole dish.
Pour tomato sauce over top.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until bubbly.
Yield: 10 servings.
recipes.text: Eggplant Manicotti. Peel eggplant, cut in half lengthwise. Slice into thin long slices (1/8-inch thick). In heavy skillet, saute each slice in olive oil over medium heat, turning only once and cooking just until eggplant becomes limp enough to roll. Cool and drain slices on paper towel. Combine the remaining ingredients, except tomato sauce. Spread each eggplant slice with a thin layer of cheese mixture. Roll each slice and place seam side down in buttered casserole dish. Pour tomato sauce over top. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 25 minutes or until bubbly. Yield: 10 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Boil beans for 2 minutes.
Cover and let stand 1 hour.
Drain and rinse beans.
Cover with 2 quarts water in a pot.
Bring to boiling.
Simmer 40 minutes.
Drain, leaving about 1/2 cup liquid with beans.
Add all ingredients.
Stir, cover and bake at 300u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Boil beans for 2 minutes. Cover and let stand 1 hour. Drain and rinse beans. Cover with 2 quarts water in a pot. Bring to boiling. Simmer 40 minutes. Drain, leaving about 1/2 cup liquid with beans. Add all ingredients. Stir, cover and bake at 300u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Magic Blackberry Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
In a 2-quart baking dish, melt butter in oven.
Remove from oven.
In a separate bowl, mix flour and 1 cup sugar until well blended.
Add milk and mix until blended. Pour this mixture over butter, but do not stir.
Pour blackberries over this mixture, but do not stir.
Sprinkle 3/4 cup sugar over berries, but do not stir.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes. It should be brown when done.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Magic Blackberry Cobbler. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. In a 2-quart baking dish, melt butter in oven. Remove from oven. In a separate bowl, mix flour and 1 cup sugar until well blended. Add milk and mix until blended. Pour this mixture over butter, but do not stir. Pour blackberries over this mixture, but do not stir. Sprinkle 3/4 cup sugar over berries, but do not stir. Bake, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes. It should be brown when done. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Marinated Black-Eyed Peas
directions: Rinse peas with cold water and drain well.
Add chopped celery and onion.
Combine oil, vinegar, cayenne pepper and mayonnaise. Pour over peas.
Stir gently.
Chill in refrigerator several hours or overnight.
At serving time, add diced tomato.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Marinated Black-Eyed Peas. Rinse peas with cold water and drain well. Add chopped celery and onion. Combine oil, vinegar, cayenne pepper and mayonnaise. Pour over peas. Stir gently. Chill in refrigerator several hours or overnight. At serving time, add diced tomato. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Roquefort Dressing
directions: Blend all ingredients until creamy.
Let set up at least 3 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Roquefort Dressing. Blend all ingredients until creamy. Let set up at least 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
directions: Combine and refrigerate several hours.
Serve with fresh vegetables or bread.
recipes.text: Shrimp And Spinach Dip. Combine and refrigerate several hours. Serve with fresh vegetables or bread.

recipes.title: Lasagna Roll-Ups
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Spray pan with nonstick spray.
In bowl, combine cheeses, eggs and spices.
Mix well.
Take cooked noodles and spread cheese in middle and fill.
Roll noodles and place in dish.
Spoon sauce over noodles and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes and garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Lasagna Roll-Ups. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Spray pan with nonstick spray. In bowl, combine cheeses, eggs and spices. Mix well. Take cooked noodles and spread cheese in middle and fill. Roll noodles and place in dish. Spoon sauce over noodles and sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes and garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Shrimp Victoria
directions: Saute shrimp and onion in butter in electric skillet for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and saute 5+ more minutes.
Add flour and seasonings.
Stir in sour cream.
Be sure to cook on low at least 10 minutes.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Shrimp Victoria. Saute shrimp and onion in butter in electric skillet for 10 minutes. Add mushrooms and saute 5+ more minutes. Add flour and seasonings. Stir in sour cream. Be sure to cook on low at least 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef; drain.
Crush Fritos.
Mix ground beef while hot with chili beans and hominy.
Mix in Fritos and cheese. Put into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish and bake at 300u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Casserole. Brown ground beef; drain. Crush Fritos. Mix ground beef while hot with chili beans and hominy. Mix in Fritos and cheese. Put into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish and bake at 300u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sundae Brownie Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375u00b0.
Bake crust 10 minutes.
In large bowl, beat eggs.
Stir in sugar and butter.
Stir together flour, cocoa and salt; add to butter mixture.
Stir in vanilla, chocolate chips, peanut butter chips and nuts.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve warm or cool with ice cream.
recipes.text: Sundae Brownie Pie. Heat oven to 375u00b0. Bake crust 10 minutes. In large bowl, beat eggs. Stir in sugar and butter. Stir together flour, cocoa and salt; add to butter mixture. Stir in vanilla, chocolate chips, peanut butter chips and nuts. Pour into pie crust. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm or cool with ice cream.

recipes.title: Quick Fluffy Frosting
ingredients: 1 pkg. instant pudding and pie filling, any flavor (4 serving size)
directions: Pour milk into a deep narrow bowl; add whipped topping mix and pudding mix.
Beat until well-blended, using low speed. Gradually increase beating speed to high and whip until mixture forms soft peaks, 4 to 6 minutes.
Makes enough to frost 2 layer 9-inch cake.
Store frosted cake in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Quick Fluffy Frosting. Pour milk into a deep narrow bowl; add whipped topping mix and pudding mix. Beat until well-blended, using low speed. Gradually increase beating speed to high and whip until mixture forms soft peaks, 4 to 6 minutes. Makes enough to frost 2 layer 9-inch cake. Store frosted cake in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Asparagus, Petits Pois And Mushroom Casserole
directions: Drain asparagus and arrange half of it in a buttered 6-cup casserole.
In a bowl, mix gently the peas, soup, mushrooms and cheese.
Spoon 1/2 the mixture into casserole.
Add remainder of asparagus; top with remaining mixture.
Toss crumbs with butter and sprinkle on top of casserole.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until crumbs are browned.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Asparagus, Petits Pois And Mushroom Casserole. Drain asparagus and arrange half of it in a buttered 6-cup casserole. In a bowl, mix gently the peas, soup, mushrooms and cheese. Spoon 1/2 the mixture into casserole. Add remainder of asparagus; top with remaining mixture. Toss crumbs with butter and sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for about 30 minutes or until crumbs are browned. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Microwave Brown Rice
directions: Brown rice in margarine.
Pour in microwave casserole dish. Pour in soup.
Microwave 23 minutes on 50%, covered.
recipes.text: Microwave Brown Rice. Brown rice in margarine. Pour in microwave casserole dish. Pour in soup. Microwave 23 minutes on 50%, covered.

recipes.title: Dutch Spinach Salad
ingredients: 6 c. fresh spinach, torn into bite-sized pieces
directions: Place spinach and onion in a large serving bowl.
Set aside. In a skillet, saute bacon until crisp.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vinegar, sugar, salt and black pepper.
Bring to the boiling point.
Slowly pour hot dressing over spinach and onion.
Toss and serve at once.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Dutch Spinach Salad. Place spinach and onion in a large serving bowl. Set aside. In a skillet, saute bacon until crisp. Remove from heat. Stir in vinegar, sugar, salt and black pepper. Bring to the boiling point. Slowly pour hot dressing over spinach and onion. Toss and serve at once. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Easy Eggnog Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 (4-serving size) pkg. instant vanilla flavor pudding and pie filling mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In large mixing bowl, combine cake mix, Borden's eggnog and oil.
Beat on low speed until moistened. Add eggs and nutmeg; beat on medium-high speed 4 minutes.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch fluted or tube pan.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan.
Cool completely. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, if desired.
recipes.text: Easy Eggnog Pound Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In large mixing bowl, combine cake mix, Borden's eggnog and oil. Beat on low speed until moistened. Add eggs and nutmeg; beat on medium-high speed 4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch fluted or tube pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan. Cool completely. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, if desired.

recipes.title: Apple Dessert
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together and press in bottom of 8 x 10-inch pan that has been sprayed with Pam.
Peel and slice apples.
Combine sugar, flour and cinnamon.
Stir into apple slices until well coated.
Arrange apple slices in pan.
Sprinkle leftover sugar mixture over apples.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 60 minutes or until apples are done.
Remove from oven.
Prepare 1 package instant vanilla pudding and pour over hot apples. Refrigerate.
Serve with whipped topping.
recipes.text: Apple Dessert. Mix the first 3 ingredients together and press in bottom of 8 x 10-inch pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Peel and slice apples. Combine sugar, flour and cinnamon. Stir into apple slices until well coated. Arrange apple slices in pan. Sprinkle leftover sugar mixture over apples. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 60 minutes or until apples are done. Remove from oven. Prepare 1 package instant vanilla pudding and pour over hot apples. Refrigerate. Serve with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Cherry Cake
directions: Mix the dry ingredients (first 4) and set aside.
Mix other ingredients.
Mix all together.
Pour into greased loaf pan and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Cake. Mix the dry ingredients (first 4) and set aside. Mix other ingredients. Mix all together. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Remove crust from bread and cube.
Fry bacon and crumble.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer bread, cheese and bacon.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Remove crust from bread and cube. Fry bacon and crumble. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer bread, cheese and bacon.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Crunch Top Cake
directions: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.
Mix cake mix, pudding and eggs.
Pour into prepared pan. Evenly sprinkle butterscotch chips on top. Then sprinkle chopped walnuts over butterscotch.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Crunch Top Cake. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Mix cake mix, pudding and eggs. Pour into prepared pan. Evenly sprinkle butterscotch chips on top. Then sprinkle chopped walnuts over butterscotch. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Bread
directions: Combine
first 6 ingredients and set aside.
Beat eggs, sugar, oil
and
vanillatuntil creamy.
Stir in potatoes and raisins. Add
dry ingredients, stirring only until moistened. Pour into
2 well-greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Bread. Combine first 6 ingredients and set aside. Beat eggs, sugar, oil and vanillatuntil creamy. Stir in potatoes and raisins. Add dry ingredients, stirring only until moistened. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Red Cabbage
directions: Combine all ingredients and cover pan tightly; steam until cabbage is tender, approximately 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Red Cabbage. Combine all ingredients and cover pan tightly; steam until cabbage is tender, approximately 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients; set aside.
Combine oil, eggs and sugar in a large bowl.
Use electric mixer and mix well. Gradually add dry ingredients to creamed mixture, stirring just until all ingredients are moistened.
Stir in strawberries.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Combine first 4 ingredients; set aside. Combine oil, eggs and sugar in a large bowl. Use electric mixer and mix well. Gradually add dry ingredients to creamed mixture, stirring just until all ingredients are moistened. Stir in strawberries.

recipes.title: Italian Bean Soup
ingredients: 1/2 small head cabbage, cored and cut into 1-inch pieces (4 c.)
1 c. 15 Bean Soup, discarding the seasoning packet
1 c. dry lentils, rinsed and drained
directions: In a large saucepan, cook carrots, celery and onion in hot olive oil about 5 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Stir in water, cabbage, lentils, tomato puree, sugar, salt, oregano and pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until lentils are very soft.
Ladle into bowls.
Makes 5 main-dish servings.
recipes.text: Italian Bean Soup. In a large saucepan, cook carrots, celery and onion in hot olive oil about 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir in water, cabbage, lentils, tomato puree, sugar, salt, oregano and pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until lentils are very soft. Ladle into bowls. Makes 5 main-dish servings.

recipes.title: Yellow Cake Dessert
directions: Mix the cake mix according to package directions. Bake on a cookie sheet pan (12 x 17 or 12 x 18-inch).
Let cake cool.
Mix the pudding according to directions and whip until thick.
Pour over cooled cake.
Have the cream cheese at room temperature and mix with the pineapple.
Whip.
Pour over pudding layer.
Spread the Cool Whip over the cake and sprinkle with coconut.
Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Yellow Cake Dessert. Mix the cake mix according to package directions. Bake on a cookie sheet pan (12 x 17 or 12 x 18-inch). Let cake cool. Mix the pudding according to directions and whip until thick. Pour over cooled cake. Have the cream cheese at room temperature and mix with the pineapple. Whip. Pour over pudding layer. Spread the Cool Whip over the cake and sprinkle with coconut. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Reuben Spread
directions: Mix together in a 9 x 13 inch pan and bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes.
Use as a spread for party rye bread.
recipes.text: Reuben Spread. Mix together in a 9 x 13 inch pan and bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes. Use as a spread for party rye bread.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Heat oven to 450u00b0, then cut down to 350u00b0 to bake.
Mix together all ingredients and bake in unbaked pie shell for 35 minutes.
Top of pie should be a golden brown.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Heat oven to 450u00b0, then cut down to 350u00b0 to bake. Mix together all ingredients and bake in unbaked pie shell for 35 minutes. Top of pie should be a golden brown.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Preheat oven to 425u00b0.
Dip chicken into 1/2 cup buttermilk, then roll chicken in mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place chicken in pan, breast side down.
Bake 30 minutes uncovered.
Turn chicken and bake for 15 minutes more.
Turn chicken again and pour mixture of 1 cup buttermilk and mushroom soup over chicken, baking 15 minutes more. Remove chicken to platter and serve with pan gravy.
I have used crushed Ritz crackers instead of flour, and it gives a somewhat richer flavor.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Chicken. Preheat oven to 425u00b0. Dip chicken into 1/2 cup buttermilk, then roll chicken in mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken in pan, breast side down. Bake 30 minutes uncovered. Turn chicken and bake for 15 minutes more. Turn chicken again and pour mixture of 1 cup buttermilk and mushroom soup over chicken, baking 15 minutes more. Remove chicken to platter and serve with pan gravy. I have used crushed Ritz crackers instead of flour, and it gives a somewhat richer flavor.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli.
Mix chicken, soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice; pour over broccoli.
Cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
You may add cheese, if you prefer.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Cook broccoli. Mix chicken, soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice; pour over broccoli. Cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. You may add cheese, if you prefer.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Melt butter and drain sweet potatoes.
Mix all ingredients, except coconut.
Blend well.
Place in 1-quart casserole and bake at 400u00b0 for 35 minutes.
Add coconut to top of casserole, return to oven to brown.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Melt butter and drain sweet potatoes. Mix all ingredients, except coconut. Blend well. Place in 1-quart casserole and bake at 400u00b0 for 35 minutes. Add coconut to top of casserole, return to oven to brown.

recipes.title: Summer Lasagna
directions: Combine tomato sauce, onion, basil, salt, pepper and oregano in a small mixing bowl; set aside.
In medium bowl, combine Ricotta, Mozzarella and parsley; set aside.
Peel zucchini and cut off ends.
Slice zucchini lengthwise into strips.
Arrange strips in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave at High for 6 to 8 minutes, or until fork-tender, rearranging after half the time.
Drain liquid; place zucchini on paper towels to absorb excess moisture.
Cool slightly.
recipes.text: Summer Lasagna. Combine tomato sauce, onion, basil, salt, pepper and oregano in a small mixing bowl; set aside. In medium bowl, combine Ricotta, Mozzarella and parsley; set aside. Peel zucchini and cut off ends. Slice zucchini lengthwise into strips. Arrange strips in an 8 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High for 6 to 8 minutes, or until fork-tender, rearranging after half the time. Drain liquid; place zucchini on paper towels to absorb excess moisture. Cool slightly.

recipes.title: Creamed Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 can (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of chicken soup
1 can (8 oz.) sliced water chestnuts, drained
directions: Cut
cucumbers
lengthwise
into
halves; remove seeds. Cut each
half
into
1/2-inch
slices.
Mix cucumbers, soup, water chestnuts
and milk in 3 quart saucepan.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until cucumbers are tender, about 6 minutes.
Stir in dill weed and pimento.
recipes.text: Creamed Cucumbers. Cut cucumbers lengthwise into halves; remove seeds. Cut each half into 1/2-inch slices. Mix cucumbers, soup, water chestnuts and milk in 3 quart saucepan. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until cucumbers are tender, about 6 minutes. Stir in dill weed and pimento.

recipes.title: Country Style Cabbage Rolls
directions: Steam cabbage to loosen leaves. Mix ground beef, onion, salt and uncooked rice. Make small balls and wrap in cabbage leaves. Pour tomato juice in cooker and add the rolls. Bring to a boil. Add tomato sauce and 2 c. water. Cook on medium heat for 45 minutes. Turn heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Country Style Cabbage Rolls. Steam cabbage to loosen leaves. Mix ground beef, onion, salt and uncooked rice. Make small balls and wrap in cabbage leaves. Pour tomato juice in cooker and add the rolls. Bring to a boil. Add tomato sauce and 2 c. water. Cook on medium heat for 45 minutes. Turn heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Yam Casserole
directions: Boil potatoes in jackets until tender but firm.
Peel, slice bananas crosswise.
Pour lemon juice over sliced bananas.
Butter a casserole.
Alternate layers of sweet potatoes and bananas. Sprinkle each layer with sugar; dot with butter.
Add pecans to top layer of sugar.
Bake until potatoes and bananas are soft and top of dish is lightly browned.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Yam Casserole. Boil potatoes in jackets until tender but firm. Peel, slice bananas crosswise. Pour lemon juice over sliced bananas. Butter a casserole. Alternate layers of sweet potatoes and bananas. Sprinkle each layer with sugar; dot with butter. Add pecans to top layer of sugar. Bake until potatoes and bananas are soft and top of dish is lightly browned. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Dessert
directions: Mix together pecans, flour and melted margarine.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0 until brown.
Mix sugar, cream cheese, salt and vanilla, beating until fluffy.
Add Cool Whip; spread over cooled crust and top with pie filling.
recipes.text: Blueberry Dessert. Mix together pecans, flour and melted margarine. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0 until brown. Mix sugar, cream cheese, salt and vanilla, beating until fluffy. Add Cool Whip; spread over cooled crust and top with pie filling.

recipes.title: Special K Bars
directions: Heat Karo syrup and sugar just long enough to melt the sugar. Add peanut butter and pour over Special K cereal.
Pat into a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Melt package of chocolate chips and frost.
recipes.text: Special K Bars. Heat Karo syrup and sugar just long enough to melt the sugar. Add peanut butter and pour over Special K cereal. Pat into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Melt package of chocolate chips and frost.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 green pepper or jalapeno, seeded and chopped
directions: Boil salt, vinegar, sugar, oil and celery seed.
Pour boiling liquid over vegetables.
Refrigerate, stirring occasionally. Serve well chilled.
recipes.text: Cucumber Salad. Boil salt, vinegar, sugar, oil and celery seed. Pour boiling liquid over vegetables. Refrigerate, stirring occasionally. Serve well chilled.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken With Gravy
ingredients: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
directions: Place chicken in a large flat dish.
Pour buttermilk over. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Combine flour, salt and pepper in a double-strength paper bag.
Drain chicken pieces.
Toss one at a time in flour mixture.
Shake off excess.
Place on waxed paper for 15 minutes to dry.
Heat 1/8 to 1/4 inch of oil in a large skillet.
Fry chicken until brown on all sides.
Cover and simmer, turning occasionally for 40 to 45 minutes or until juices are clear and chicken is tender.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Fried Chicken With Gravy. Place chicken in a large flat dish. Pour buttermilk over. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Combine flour, salt and pepper in a double-strength paper bag. Drain chicken pieces. Toss one at a time in flour mixture. Shake off excess. Place on waxed paper for 15 minutes to dry. Heat 1/8 to 1/4 inch of oil in a large skillet. Fry chicken until brown on all sides. Cover and simmer, turning occasionally for 40 to 45 minutes or until juices are clear and chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Orange Juice-Lious
directions: Put ingredients into blender in order listed.
Blend 30 seconds.
Makes 3 cups.
recipes.text: Orange Juice-Lious. Put ingredients into blender in order listed. Blend 30 seconds. Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Cook shells; drain.
Cool in a single layer on wax paper. Combine all other ingredients.
Fill each shell with 2 tablespoons cheese mixture.
Spread bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish with thin layer of sauce.
Place shells in pan; cover with sauce and remaining Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
Makes 36 shells.
recipes.text: Stuffed Shells. Cook shells; drain. Cool in a single layer on wax paper. Combine all other ingredients. Fill each shell with 2 tablespoons cheese mixture. Spread bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish with thin layer of sauce. Place shells in pan; cover with sauce and remaining Parmesan cheese, if desired. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Makes 36 shells.

recipes.title: Meat Balls
directions: Combine ingredients and form in balls.
Pour barbecue sauce over and cook at 400u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Meat Balls. Combine ingredients and form in balls. Pour barbecue sauce over and cook at 400u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sharp'S Barbecue Sauce
directions: Makes enough sauce to do 25 fryers.
Baste fryers with sauce each time you turn.
Keeps well in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Sharp'S Barbecue Sauce. Makes enough sauce to do 25 fryers. Baste fryers with sauce each time you turn. Keeps well in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter; add sugar gradually, beating all the time.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.
Add vanilla and flour gradually.
Bake in ungreased tube pan.
Start in cold oven.
Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 hour (approximate).
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream butter; add sugar gradually, beating all the time. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each. Add vanilla and flour gradually. Bake in ungreased tube pan. Start in cold oven. Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 hour (approximate).

recipes.title: Crunchy Peanut Butter Chews
directions: In a small bowl, combine cereal and coconut; set aside.
In a 2-quart saucepan, combine peanut butter, margarine and marshmallows; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, just until marshmallows are melted.
Remove from heat.
Stir in cereal and coconut.
Quickly drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.
Cool completely.
Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Crunchy Peanut Butter Chews. In a small bowl, combine cereal and coconut; set aside. In a 2-quart saucepan, combine peanut butter, margarine and marshmallows; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, just until marshmallows are melted. Remove from heat. Stir in cereal and coconut. Quickly drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Cool completely. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Tortilla Soup
directions: Saute onions, peppers and garlics in oil in a large dutch oven until tend; add next 9 ingredients and chicken.
Bring to a boil; cover and reduce heat, simmer 1 hour.
Add tortillas and simmer 5 minutes.
Top with cheese in bowls.
recipes.text: Tortilla Soup. Saute onions, peppers and garlics in oil in a large dutch oven until tend; add next 9 ingredients and chicken. Bring to a boil; cover and reduce heat, simmer 1 hour. Add tortillas and simmer 5 minutes. Top with cheese in bowls.

recipes.title: Greek Walnut Cake
directions: Beat yolks, add sugar and beat.
Mix other ingredients; add to eggs.
Add vanilla.
Fold in beaten egg whites and turn into greased tube pan.
Bake at 325u00b0 for about 45 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Greek Walnut Cake. Beat yolks, add sugar and beat. Mix other ingredients; add to eggs. Add vanilla. Fold in beaten egg whites and turn into greased tube pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for about 45 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 5 c. cooked chicken, chopped (reserve chicken broth)
directions: Mix chicken and pimentos.
Brown celery, pepper and onion in oleo.
Combine with chicken mixture; mix well.
Cook rice in chicken broth until tender.
Place in layers in casserole dish the rice, mushroom soup and chicken mixture on top.
Bake 1 hour at 300u00b0 or until bubbly.
Serves 18 to 20.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Mix chicken and pimentos. Brown celery, pepper and onion in oleo. Combine with chicken mixture; mix well. Cook rice in chicken broth until tender. Place in layers in casserole dish the rice, mushroom soup and chicken mixture on top. Bake 1 hour at 300u00b0 or until bubbly. Serves 18 to 20.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Place potatoes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Season with salt and pepper.

In a bowl, add minced onions and mix together sour cream and cream of chicken soup; mix these items together. Pour soup mixture over potatoes; sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and butter that you have cut into cubes.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until all is completely warm and cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Place potatoes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Season with salt and pepper. In a bowl, add minced onions and mix together sour cream and cream of chicken soup; mix these items together. Pour soup mixture over potatoes; sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and butter that you have cut into cubes. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until all is completely warm and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
directions: Cut margarine and cheese in flour.
Add water and mix well. Put in cookie press or roll thin and cut into thin strips.
Bake at 375u00b0 for about 10 minutes.
Cool on rack.
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Cut margarine and cheese in flour. Add water and mix well. Put in cookie press or roll thin and cut into thin strips. Bake at 375u00b0 for about 10 minutes. Cool on rack.

recipes.title: Texas Creamy Pralines
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients; cook in double boiler.
Stir constantly; cook until balls are formed when dripped into a cup of cold water, or until it reaches the soft ball stage on a candy thermometer.
This will take about 15 minutes.
Remove from heat. Add margarine, vanilla and pecans; beat until it is cool and stiff enough to keep its shape when dropped on wax paper.
This may take 15 to 20 minutes of beating.
recipes.text: Texas Creamy Pralines. Mix the first 4 ingredients; cook in double boiler. Stir constantly; cook until balls are formed when dripped into a cup of cold water, or until it reaches the soft ball stage on a candy thermometer. This will take about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Add margarine, vanilla and pecans; beat until it is cool and stiff enough to keep its shape when dropped on wax paper. This may take 15 to 20 minutes of beating.

recipes.title: Applesauce Fruit Cake
directions: Mix together hot applesauce, shortening and sugar.
Heat over low heat until shortening is melted (best to let stand overnight). Sift together all dry ingredients; add to applesauce mixture. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 300u00b0 to 350u00b0.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Applesauce Fruit Cake. Mix together hot applesauce, shortening and sugar. Heat over low heat until shortening is melted (best to let stand overnight). Sift together all dry ingredients; add to applesauce mixture. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 300u00b0 to 350u00b0. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Patriotic Punch
ingredients: 1 qt. prepared Kool-Aid Blue Moon Berry or Kool Aid Twists Ice Blue Raspberry Lemonade flavor soft drink mix
Kool-Aid Tropical Punch flavor sugar sweetened soft drink mix (or any red flavor)
2 c. chilled orange or pineapple juice
1 (1 liter) bottle club soda or seltzer, chilled
directions: Pour berry mix into 3 plastic ice trays and freeze, 3 hours or overnight, until frozen.
recipes.text: Patriotic Punch. Pour berry mix into 3 plastic ice trays and freeze, 3 hours or overnight, until frozen.

recipes.title: Zucchini Parmesan
directions: Heat oil in large skillet.
Add zucchini, onion, parsley, garlic, salt, pepper, oregano and rosemary.
Saute mixture over medium heat, stir often until zucchini is tender (20 minutes).
recipes.text: Zucchini Parmesan. Heat oil in large skillet. Add zucchini, onion, parsley, garlic, salt, pepper, oregano and rosemary. Saute mixture over medium heat, stir often until zucchini is tender (20 minutes).

recipes.title: Gingerbread Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda, baking powder, salt, ginger, and cinnamon.
Cream shortening; add sugar gradually.
Beat until light.
Add egg and vanilla.
Add molasses and coffee, then sifted dry ingredients; mix well.
Chill.
Roll out on lightly floured board to thickness desired.
Cut with cookie cutter.
Place about 1 inch apart on greased baking sheet.
(Pam or vegetable spray works well.)
Bake in hot oven at 400u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Thinner cookies may not take as long to bake.
recipes.text: Gingerbread Cookies. Sift together flour, soda, baking powder, salt, ginger, and cinnamon. Cream shortening; add sugar gradually. Beat until light. Add egg and vanilla. Add molasses and coffee, then sifted dry ingredients; mix well. Chill. Roll out on lightly floured board to thickness desired. Cut with cookie cutter. Place about 1 inch apart on greased baking sheet. (Pam or vegetable spray works well.) Bake in hot oven at 400u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Thinner cookies may not take as long to bake.

recipes.title: Dream Pie
directions: Mix flour, margarine and nuts; press in bottom of oblong pan and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 325u00b0.
Cool.
Melt cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip.
Pour over crust.
Spread pie filling on top. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Dream Pie. Mix flour, margarine and nuts; press in bottom of oblong pan and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 325u00b0. Cool. Melt cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip. Pour over crust. Spread pie filling on top. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Potatoes And Spam Casserole
directions: Slice potatoes in pan.
Add onions and Spam.
Combine soup, milk, water, salt and pepper.
Pour over potatoes and meat.
Bake until potatoes are tender or about 45 minutes.
Place cheese on top.
Heat until melted.
recipes.text: Potatoes And Spam Casserole. Slice potatoes in pan. Add onions and Spam. Combine soup, milk, water, salt and pepper. Pour over potatoes and meat. Bake until potatoes are tender or about 45 minutes. Place cheese on top. Heat until melted.

recipes.title: Dill Weed Dip For Vegetables
directions: Mix all together if using dill seed, keep refrigerated a couple hours longer.
Serve with all vegetables.
recipes.text: Dill Weed Dip For Vegetables. Mix all together if using dill seed, keep refrigerated a couple hours longer. Serve with all vegetables.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 medium pepper, cut into 1 inch squares
directions: In skillet over medium heat, in hot oil, cook onions, celery, carrot and pepper until tender-crisp, stirring often.
Remove veggies to bowl.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Teriyaki. In skillet over medium heat, in hot oil, cook onions, celery, carrot and pepper until tender-crisp, stirring often. Remove veggies to bowl.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Quickies
directions: Blend all ingredients with wooden spoon until thoroughly blended.
Shape teaspoonfuls of dough into balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet, about 2-inches apart.
Flatten to 1/4-inch thick with a fork.
Bake in a 375u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.
Makes about 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Quickies. Blend all ingredients with wooden spoon until thoroughly blended. Shape teaspoonfuls of dough into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet, about 2-inches apart. Flatten to 1/4-inch thick with a fork. Bake in a 375u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Impossible Ham And Swiss Pie
ingredients: cooked turkey, sausage, broccoli or spinach can be substituted for ham
directions: Spray 9-inch pie plate with Pam.
Sprinkle in meat, cheese and onion. Blend rest of ingredients (lumpy).
Pour over meat, cheese and onions.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Impossible Ham And Swiss Pie. Spray 9-inch pie plate with Pam. Sprinkle in meat, cheese and onion. Blend rest of ingredients (lumpy). Pour over meat, cheese and onions. Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Jello
directions: Make jello as directed, except use the juice from the oranges to make up most of the cold liquid and fill the rest with cold water.
Add ice cream to jello mixture and dissolve.
Chill until firm.
Add can of drained oranges and 1/2 to 2/3 miniature marshmallows.
Mix and place in mold or bowl.
Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Jello. Make jello as directed, except use the juice from the oranges to make up most of the cold liquid and fill the rest with cold water. Add ice cream to jello mixture and dissolve. Chill until firm. Add can of drained oranges and 1/2 to 2/3 miniature marshmallows. Mix and place in mold or bowl. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Braunschweiger Ball
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, room temperature
directions: Beat until smooth.
Ice meat mixture.
Can decorate with chopped nuts, dried onions or anyway you desire.
Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Braunschweiger Ball. Beat until smooth. Ice meat mixture. Can decorate with chopped nuts, dried onions or anyway you desire. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Easy Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Put 2 sticks of margarine in 9x13 inch pan and melt in oven.
Mix milk, 1 c. sugar, salt, flour, and baking powder together.
Pour over melted margarine.
Put 2-4 cups of fruit on top of batter.
Sprinkle with 1 c. sugar.
Add 1 c. water.
Bake until dough rises to top and browns, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Easy Cobbler. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Put 2 sticks of margarine in 9x13 inch pan and melt in oven. Mix milk, 1 c. sugar, salt, flour, and baking powder together. Pour over melted margarine. Put 2-4 cups of fruit on top of batter. Sprinkle with 1 c. sugar. Add 1 c. water. Bake until dough rises to top and browns, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dump It Cake
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple (drain a little)
1 (21 oz.) can peach or cherry pie filling
directions: Spread pineapple on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put pie filling on top of pineapple layer.
Sprinkle dry cake mix on top of fruit.
Sprinkle nuts on top of cake mix.
Cut butter into 6 slices lengthwise.
Place the 12 slices of butter on top of the nuts.
Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0.
Serve with whipped cream, if desired.
recipes.text: Dump It Cake. Spread pineapple on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put pie filling on top of pineapple layer. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top of fruit. Sprinkle nuts on top of cake mix. Cut butter into 6 slices lengthwise. Place the 12 slices of butter on top of the nuts. Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0. Serve with whipped cream, if desired.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all fruit well.
Save only the pineapple juice.
Combine juice with vanilla pudding mix.
Beat 2 minutes until smooth.
Add Cool Whip.
Fold in fruit.
Decorate top with cherries.
Delicious with Lemon Lightning Cake.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Drain all fruit well. Save only the pineapple juice. Combine juice with vanilla pudding mix. Beat 2 minutes until smooth. Add Cool Whip. Fold in fruit. Decorate top with cherries. Delicious with Lemon Lightning Cake.

recipes.title: Snickers Dessert (Or Salad)
directions: Mix ingredients and chill.
recipes.text: Snickers Dessert (Or Salad). Mix ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Combine 1/2 cup of sugar and flour.
Stir in egg yolks and milk.
Cook slowly over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, layer vanilla wafers and sliced bananas.
Pour custard over layers.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Combine 1/2 cup of sugar and flour. Stir in egg yolks and milk. Cook slowly over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. In a 2-quart casserole dish, layer vanilla wafers and sliced bananas. Pour custard over layers.

recipes.title: Funnel Cake
directions: Heat oil in iron skillet until very hot.
Pour batter in stream, overlapping to connect the batter.
Fry until golden; turn over and cook the other side.
Drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar or cinnamon and powdered sugar mix.
recipes.text: Funnel Cake. Heat oil in iron skillet until very hot. Pour batter in stream, overlapping to connect the batter. Fry until golden; turn over and cook the other side. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with powdered sugar or cinnamon and powdered sugar mix.

recipes.title: Linguini Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) bottle Kraft Zesty Italian dressing
directions: Toss with 1/2 bottle Salad Supreme seasoning.
Let stand overnight.
recipes.text: Linguini Salad. Toss with 1/2 bottle Salad Supreme seasoning. Let stand overnight.

recipes.title: Clam Casserole
ingredients: 2 (51 oz.) cans cream of mushroom soup
2 (51 oz.) cans cream of celery soup
20 (51 oz.) cans minced clams or chopped, drained all but 1 can
directions: Use juice from 1 can clams.
Put in 18 x 25 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 300u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Clam Casserole. Use juice from 1 can clams. Put in 18 x 25 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 300u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Hoppin' John(Creole Black-Eyed Peas)
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can tomatoes, drained and chopped
directions: Cook bacon in skillet until crisp.
Remove bacon, keeping drippings in pan.
Saute onion, peppers and celery in drippings until tender.
recipes.text: Hoppin' John(Creole Black-Eyed Peas). Cook bacon in skillet until crisp. Remove bacon, keeping drippings in pan. Saute onion, peppers and celery in drippings until tender.

recipes.title: Mini Cheese Cakes
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
directions: Line muffin tin with foil liners.
Place 1 wafer in the bottom of each liner.
Mix the cream cheese, vanilla and sugar at medium speed.
Add eggs; mix well.
Pour into foil liners over the wafer 3/4 full.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Remove from pan when cool.
Chill.
Top with fruit.
recipes.text: Mini Cheese Cakes. Line muffin tin with foil liners. Place 1 wafer in the bottom of each liner. Mix the cream cheese, vanilla and sugar at medium speed. Add eggs; mix well. Pour into foil liners over the wafer 3/4 full. Bake at 325u00b0 for 25 minutes. Remove from pan when cool. Chill. Top with fruit.

recipes.title: Popcorn Cake
directions: In a saucepan, combine margarine, oil and marshmallows.
Stir until mixed well.
Cool slightly and pour over popcorn and peanuts.
Add M&M's last.
Press into greased pan and refrigerate 1 hour.
recipes.text: Popcorn Cake. In a saucepan, combine margarine, oil and marshmallows. Stir until mixed well. Cool slightly and pour over popcorn and peanuts. Add M&M's last. Press into greased pan and refrigerate 1 hour.

recipes.title: Blue Ribbon Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine pumpkin, sugar, spices and flour in a bowl.
Add eggs; mix well, then add milk and vanilla.
Mix well and pour in unbaked pie shell.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Blue Ribbon Pumpkin Pie. Combine pumpkin, sugar, spices and flour in a bowl. Add eggs; mix well, then add milk and vanilla. Mix well and pour in unbaked pie shell. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: 4 Layer Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Mix flour, butter and pecans. Press in dish. Bake 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.
recipes.text: 4 Layer Pie. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Mix flour, butter and pecans. Press in dish. Bake 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Butter casserole (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Set oven at 350u00b0.
Saute green onions lightly.
Add soup and milk.
Mix. Remove from stove. Layer half the potatoes in casserole, then all the cheese, then another layer of potatoes.
Pour soup mixture over all.
Cover with aluminum foil for 1 hour.
Uncover and cook 30 more minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Butter casserole (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Set oven at 350u00b0. Saute green onions lightly. Add soup and milk. Mix. Remove from stove. Layer half the potatoes in casserole, then all the cheese, then another layer of potatoes. Pour soup mixture over all. Cover with aluminum foil for 1 hour. Uncover and cook 30 more minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Mama'S Beef Stroganoff
directions: Melt butter in pan.
Brown meat.
When brown, push to side. Add onions and mushrooms; cook about 5 minutes.
Add beef broth. Combine flour and sour cream in separate bowl; add to pan.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cook about 1 hour, or until tender.
Serve over rice or noodles.
recipes.text: Mama'S Beef Stroganoff. Melt butter in pan. Brown meat. When brown, push to side. Add onions and mushrooms; cook about 5 minutes. Add beef broth. Combine flour and sour cream in separate bowl; add to pan. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook about 1 hour, or until tender. Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Quick Stroganoff
directions: Cook onions in oil.
Add meat and brown lightly.
Add salt, pepper and garlic salt.
Cook 10 minutes; add mushrooms and simmer 10 minutes.
Just before serving, add sour cream and reheat. Serve over noodles or rice.
recipes.text: Quick Stroganoff. Cook onions in oil. Add meat and brown lightly. Add salt, pepper and garlic salt. Cook 10 minutes; add mushrooms and simmer 10 minutes. Just before serving, add sour cream and reheat. Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Casino brand natural Swiss cheese
1/2 c. (2 oz.) Kraft grated Parmesan cheese
directions: In a large bowl, combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; mix well.
Gradually add water and 2 tablespoons of margarine; mix until soft dough forms.
Combine Swiss and Parmesan cheeses; reserve 1/4 cup.
Add remaining cheese mixture, egg and 1 cup flour to dough; mix well.
recipes.text: Cheese Bread. In a large bowl, combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; mix well. Gradually add water and 2 tablespoons of margarine; mix until soft dough forms. Combine Swiss and Parmesan cheeses; reserve 1/4 cup. Add remaining cheese mixture, egg and 1 cup flour to dough; mix well.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
directions: Cook chicken until it falls apart. Dice up celery and pickles. Remove chicken from bones and chop into small pieces. Combine chicken, celery and pickles together. Mix mayonnaise and vinegar together. Stir mixture into chicken until moist. Chill.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad. Cook chicken until it falls apart. Dice up celery and pickles. Remove chicken from bones and chop into small pieces. Combine chicken, celery and pickles together. Mix mayonnaise and vinegar together. Stir mixture into chicken until moist. Chill.

recipes.title: Pea Casserole
directions: Melt oleo; add chopped onion and celery. Simmer until tender. When mixture is tender, add peas, pimento, cream of mushroom soup and water chestnuts. Mix all together and put in casserole. Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pea Casserole. Melt oleo; add chopped onion and celery. Simmer until tender. When mixture is tender, add peas, pimento, cream of mushroom soup and water chestnuts. Mix all together and put in casserole. Top with Pepperidge Farm dressing. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crustless Vegetable Pie
directions: Saute first 4 ingredients 10 minutes.
Add tomatoes.
Cover; simmer 20 minutes.
Beat eggs, seasonings and 1/4 cup cheese.
Add vegetables.
Pour half of the mixture into greased 10-inch pie pan.
Top with 1/4 cup cheese.
Layer remaining mixture and cheese on top.
Top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until set.
Serves 5 to 6.
recipes.text: Crustless Vegetable Pie. Saute first 4 ingredients 10 minutes. Add tomatoes. Cover; simmer 20 minutes. Beat eggs, seasonings and 1/4 cup cheese. Add vegetables. Pour half of the mixture into greased 10-inch pie pan. Top with 1/4 cup cheese. Layer remaining mixture and cheese on top. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until set. Serves 5 to 6.

recipes.title: Hamburger Soup
directions: Saute ground beef in a large pot. Drain and rinse the beef. Wipe the pot dry and return the beef to the pot.
Chop the potatoes (preferably leaving the skin on), onion, celery, carrots and green beans.
Add to the pot along with crushed tomatoes, bouillon and water.
Simmer until carrots are tender.
Add sugar. Melt the margarine in a small bowl in the microwave.
Add flour and stir with a fork.
Add to the soup to thicken it.
Simmer for about half an hour.
recipes.text: Hamburger Soup. Saute ground beef in a large pot. Drain and rinse the beef. Wipe the pot dry and return the beef to the pot. Chop the potatoes (preferably leaving the skin on), onion, celery, carrots and green beans. Add to the pot along with crushed tomatoes, bouillon and water. Simmer until carrots are tender. Add sugar. Melt the margarine in a small bowl in the microwave. Add flour and stir with a fork. Add to the soup to thicken it. Simmer for about half an hour.

recipes.title: Silver Cleaner
ingredients: 4 to 5 inch square aluminum foil, crumpled
directions: In 2 cup measuring cup microwave water on High until boils, approximately 2 to 3 minutes.
Add salt, baking soda and foil. Dip flatware into mixture and watch tarnish disappear.
Wash flatware in soapy water, rinse and dry.
Makes 1 cup.
recipes.text: Silver Cleaner. In 2 cup measuring cup microwave water on High until boils, approximately 2 to 3 minutes. Add salt, baking soda and foil. Dip flatware into mixture and watch tarnish disappear. Wash flatware in soapy water, rinse and dry. Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 1/2 oz.) cans cream of chicken soup
directions: In a bowl, combine milk, soup, cheese and chicken.
Spread half the mixture in a 13 x 9-inch buttered casserole dish.
Lay cooked broccoli crossways and top with remaining chicken mixture. Combine crumbs with butter and spread over casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole. In a bowl, combine milk, soup, cheese and chicken. Spread half the mixture in a 13 x 9-inch buttered casserole dish. Lay cooked broccoli crossways and top with remaining chicken mixture. Combine crumbs with butter and spread over casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Frozen Salad
directions: Mix all together and place in 9 x 13 inch pan. Cover and place in freezer overnight or up to 3 days. When ready to use, let sit for awhile to slightly thaw. Cut into squares to serve. Looks nice sitting on a large lettuce leaf. Some like to let it thaw completely, but I like mine mostly frozen.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Frozen Salad. Mix all together and place in 9 x 13 inch pan. Cover and place in freezer overnight or up to 3 days. When ready to use, let sit for awhile to slightly thaw. Cut into squares to serve. Looks nice sitting on a large lettuce leaf. Some like to let it thaw completely, but I like mine mostly frozen.

recipes.title: Sukiyaki
ingredients: 5 large green onions, diagonally sliced into 1-inch pieces
1 (8 oz.) can sliced bamboo shoots, drained
1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
directions: Trim excess fat from steak.
Partially freeze steak; slice across the grain into thin strips and set aside.
Dissolve bouillon cube in water; stir in water.
Stir in soy sauce and sugar and set aside.
recipes.text: Sukiyaki. Trim excess fat from steak. Partially freeze steak; slice across the grain into thin strips and set aside. Dissolve bouillon cube in water; stir in water. Stir in soy sauce and sugar and set aside.

recipes.title: Apple Bread Pudding
directions: Mix well all the ingredients.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Apple Bread Pudding. Mix well all the ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Twice Baked Squash
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, crisp, crumbled and drained
directions: Cut squash in half.
Remove and discard seeds.
Place squash, cut side down, in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until tender.
Remove squash pulp, leaving a 1/4-inch shell.
In a large mixing bowl, combine squash pulp, spinach, 1/2 cup cheese, eggs, oleo, bacon, green onion, salt and red pepper.
Fill the squash shells with squash mixture. Combine remaining cheese and bread crumbs and sprinkle on top of squash.
Place in baking pan.* Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Twice Baked Squash. Cut squash in half. Remove and discard seeds. Place squash, cut side down, in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 60 minutes until tender. Remove squash pulp, leaving a 1/4-inch shell. In a large mixing bowl, combine squash pulp, spinach, 1/2 cup cheese, eggs, oleo, bacon, green onion, salt and red pepper. Fill the squash shells with squash mixture. Combine remaining cheese and bread crumbs and sprinkle on top of squash. Place in baking pan.* Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Persimmon Pudding
directions: In large bowl, put persimmons, which have been pressed through a colander.
Then add milk, eggs and dry ingredients. Bake in a shallow pan about 20 minutes at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Persimmon Pudding. In large bowl, put persimmons, which have been pressed through a colander. Then add milk, eggs and dry ingredients. Bake in a shallow pan about 20 minutes at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Baking Powder Biscuits
directions: Sift together the dry ingredients.
Add shortening.
Cut into dry mixture until mealy.
Add water (use more if softer dough is desired).
Mix well.
Let rest 10 minutes.
Roll out on floured board and cut. Serves 50.
recipes.text: Baking Powder Biscuits. Sift together the dry ingredients. Add shortening. Cut into dry mixture until mealy. Add water (use more if softer dough is desired). Mix well. Let rest 10 minutes. Roll out on floured board and cut. Serves 50.

recipes.title: Fry Bread
directions: Preparation time 20 minutes.
Resting time 30 minutes.
Cooking time 4 minutes per batch.
Yield:
10 to 12 pieces.
recipes.text: Fry Bread. Preparation time 20 minutes. Resting time 30 minutes. Cooking time 4 minutes per batch. Yield: 10 to 12 pieces.

recipes.title: Southwest Chicken
directions: Heat the oven to 350u00b0.
Place the chicken breast and pineapple juice in the roasting bag.
Bake in the oven for 1 hour.
Take the cooked chicken breasts out of the roasting bag and place on a cookie sheet.
Put 1 slice of Provolone cheese on each chicken breast and sprinkle Cheddar cheese on each one.
Place them in oven long enough for the cheese to melt.
recipes.text: Southwest Chicken. Heat the oven to 350u00b0. Place the chicken breast and pineapple juice in the roasting bag. Bake in the oven for 1 hour. Take the cooked chicken breasts out of the roasting bag and place on a cookie sheet. Put 1 slice of Provolone cheese on each chicken breast and sprinkle Cheddar cheese on each one. Place them in oven long enough for the cheese to melt.

recipes.title: Cheese Rice Krispies
directions: Mash flour and oleo together.
Add cheese, salt and seasoning.
Add Rice Krispies.
Form into small balls.
Bake 18 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Cheese Rice Krispies. Mash flour and oleo together. Add cheese, salt and seasoning. Add Rice Krispies. Form into small balls. Bake 18 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Vanilla Pudding
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Add milk.
Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes.
Scoop out 1 cup hot mix and stir into egg yolks.
Add back into pudding and cook 2 more minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla.
recipes.text: Vanilla Pudding. Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt. Add milk. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes. Scoop out 1 cup hot mix and stir into egg yolks. Add back into pudding and cook 2 more minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. frozen hash brown potatoes (32 oz.)
directions: Prepare 9 x 13-inch pan, greased.
Pour potatoes, then chopped onion in pan; mix them up a little.
Melt oleo and pour half over potatoes and onion in the pan.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Prepare 9 x 13-inch pan, greased. Pour potatoes, then chopped onion in pan; mix them up a little. Melt oleo and pour half over potatoes and onion in the pan.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit.
Mix ingredients together and let gel.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Drain fruit. Mix ingredients together and let gel.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Eggs
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in order listed.
Form into egg shapes.
Melt Hershey bar and chocolate morsels in a double boiler. Dip eggs in the chocolate.
Place on waxed paper until set.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Eggs. Mix first 5 ingredients in order listed. Form into egg shapes. Melt Hershey bar and chocolate morsels in a double boiler. Dip eggs in the chocolate. Place on waxed paper until set.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. chicken broth, skim off most fat
directions: Cook potato in broth. Add vegetables, soup and chicken.

Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Add chicken mixture. Mix Bisquick and milk thoroughly (in separate bowl). Pour on top of casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes or until topping is brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Cook potato in broth. Add vegetables, soup and chicken. Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Add chicken mixture. Mix Bisquick and milk thoroughly (in separate bowl). Pour on top of casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes or until topping is brown.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Finely
chop the onion, cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix all ingredients with the cooked spaghetti.
Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Salad. Finely chop the onion, cucumber and tomatoes. Mix all ingredients with the cooked spaghetti. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Zucchini Brownies
directions: Cream together oleo, butter, oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla, then add flour, cocoa, baking soda and cinnamon.
Add 1/2 cup sour milk and mix with creamed ingredients.
Add 2 cups shredded zucchini and 1 cup chopped nuts.
Pour into lightly greased long cake pan and sprinkle 12 ounce bag of chocolate chips on top. Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Brownies. Cream together oleo, butter, oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla, then add flour, cocoa, baking soda and cinnamon. Add 1/2 cup sour milk and mix with creamed ingredients. Add 2 cups shredded zucchini and 1 cup chopped nuts. Pour into lightly greased long cake pan and sprinkle 12 ounce bag of chocolate chips on top. Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Sherbet
directions: Pour ingredients in ice cream freezer and freeze.
recipes.text: Orange Sherbet. Pour ingredients in ice cream freezer and freeze.

recipes.title: Cool Whip Pie
directions: Mix softened cream cheese, sugar and pineapple, using mixer. Add pecans.
Fold in Cool Whip and beat.
Pile mixture into 2 crusts and cover.
Refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Cool Whip Pie. Mix softened cream cheese, sugar and pineapple, using mixer. Add pecans. Fold in Cool Whip and beat. Pile mixture into 2 crusts and cover. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Scalloped Chicken
ingredients: 2 c. crouton stuffing or Pepperidge dressing
1/2 c. celery, cooked in 1 1/2 or 2 c. broth for 10 minutes
directions: Cook chicken thoroughly and cut in small pieces.
Make white sauce with butter, flour and milk.
Add 1 can cream of mushroom soup, broth and celery.
Spread layer of croutettes in bottom of baking dish.
Add pieces of chicken and then the cream sauce.
Top with croutettes.
Bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Scalloped Chicken. Cook chicken thoroughly and cut in small pieces. Make white sauce with butter, flour and milk. Add 1 can cream of mushroom soup, broth and celery. Spread layer of croutettes in bottom of baking dish. Add pieces of chicken and then the cream sauce. Top with croutettes. Bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed and bake; cool slightly.
Pierce cake with fork and drizzle Kahlua over cake.
Prepare mousse in large bowl.
Break cake into pieces; layer cake pieces, mousse, crushed candy and whipped topping 1/3 at a time in large glass bowl.
Shave milk chocolate bar over top.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Death By Chocolate. Prepare cake mix as directed and bake; cool slightly. Pierce cake with fork and drizzle Kahlua over cake. Prepare mousse in large bowl. Break cake into pieces; layer cake pieces, mousse, crushed candy and whipped topping 1/3 at a time in large glass bowl. Shave milk chocolate bar over top. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Two By Four Soup
directions: Brown meat and drain.
Melt Velveeta cheese and add Rotel. Add meat to mixture and a can of water.
Let ingredients simmer. When soup is warm throughout, add cans of minestrone soup.tReheat soup.
Pour over fritos.
Serves 8.
(Cut in half for fewer people.)
recipes.text: Two By Four Soup. Brown meat and drain. Melt Velveeta cheese and add Rotel. Add meat to mixture and a can of water. Let ingredients simmer. When soup is warm throughout, add cans of minestrone soup.tReheat soup. Pour over fritos. Serves 8. (Cut in half for fewer people.)

recipes.title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Blend chipped beef in the blender or food processor until the beef is a crumbly mixture.
Mix with the mixer the cream cheese, milk, mayonnaise, mustard and 3 tablespoons of the chipped beef. Refrigerate the cream cheese mixture overnight.
Form in a ball and roll in the remaining chipped beef.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball. Blend chipped beef in the blender or food processor until the beef is a crumbly mixture. Mix with the mixer the cream cheese, milk, mayonnaise, mustard and 3 tablespoons of the chipped beef. Refrigerate the cream cheese mixture overnight. Form in a ball and roll in the remaining chipped beef. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Bake
directions: Saute ground beef with onion.
Layer ground beef with green beans and Tater Tots in baking dish. Combine soup and milk and beat with an egg beater.
Pour over casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Bake. Saute ground beef with onion. Layer ground beef with green beans and Tater Tots in baking dish. Combine soup and milk and beat with an egg beater. Pour over casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Peach Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 1/2 qt. peach puree, made in blender
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Follow directions on hand or electric freezer.
Let stand after it is churned and packed well for 2 to 3 hours before serving.
Yield:
1 gallon.
recipes.text: Peach Ice Cream. Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly. Follow directions on hand or electric freezer. Let stand after it is churned and packed well for 2 to 3 hours before serving. Yield: 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix well by hand. Pack firmly in a loaf pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for one hour.
Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well by hand. Pack firmly in a loaf pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for one hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: John Wayne'S Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. Monterey Jack cheese, coarsely grated
directions: Beat egg yolks with milk and flour and season with salt and pepper.
Beat egg whites until they stand in peaks.
Fold these into egg yolk mixture.
In a deep, well-buttered casserole, mix shredded cheese with chilies.
Pour egg mixture over chilies and ooze it through.
Place in a preheated oven and bake 30 minutes. Remove from oven and place on top of sliced tomatoes or canned tomatoes.
Return to oven and bake another 30 minutes.
recipes.text: John Wayne'S Cheese Casserole. Beat egg yolks with milk and flour and season with salt and pepper. Beat egg whites until they stand in peaks. Fold these into egg yolk mixture. In a deep, well-buttered casserole, mix shredded cheese with chilies. Pour egg mixture over chilies and ooze it through. Place in a preheated oven and bake 30 minutes. Remove from oven and place on top of sliced tomatoes or canned tomatoes. Return to oven and bake another 30 minutes.

recipes.title: No Bake Cheese Cake
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs and margarine.
Press 2/3 of mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: No Bake Cheese Cake. Mix graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Press 2/3 of mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook rice and broccoli according to package directions.
Saute onion and celery in butter.
Mix all ingredients together; place in buttered casserole dish.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook rice and broccoli according to package directions. Saute onion and celery in butter. Mix all ingredients together; place in buttered casserole dish. Bake at 325u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger with onion; drain well.
Add soups, seasonings and green chilies.
Layer into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Start bottom layer with tortillas, layer of hamburger mixture and continue to layer with tortillas, ending with tortillas as last layer.
Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350u00b0
