for 30 to 40 minutes.
For extra zip, add some picante sauce.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Brown hamburger with onion; drain well. Add soups, seasonings and green chilies. Layer into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Start bottom layer with tortillas, layer of hamburger mixture and continue to layer with tortillas, ending with tortillas as last layer. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. For extra zip, add some picante sauce.

recipes.title: Pepperoni And Cheese Crescent
directions: Separate dough into triangles.
Pat out each triangle.
Place 3 pepperoni slices slightly overlapping on the center of triangle. Top with cheese.
Roll starting with short side of triangle. Place point side down on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 14 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Pepperoni And Cheese Crescent. Separate dough into triangles. Pat out each triangle. Place 3 pepperoni slices slightly overlapping on the center of triangle. Top with cheese. Roll starting with short side of triangle. Place point side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 14 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Russian Salad
directions: Mix 1 cup hot water with gelatin and pineapple and let cool. Add whipping cream, cream cheese and mayonnaise to gelatin.
Mix well.
Refrigerate for about 30 minutes until it begins to gel.
recipes.text: Russian Salad. Mix 1 cup hot water with gelatin and pineapple and let cool. Add whipping cream, cream cheese and mayonnaise to gelatin. Mix well. Refrigerate for about 30 minutes until it begins to gel.

recipes.title: Peppermint Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 bag peppermint crunch (find at bake shop)
directions: Stir together.
Spread thinly onto wax papered cookie sheet. Put in freezer for 5 minutes.
Hand break into pieces.
Store in covered container.
recipes.text: Peppermint Crunch. Stir together. Spread thinly onto wax papered cookie sheet. Put in freezer for 5 minutes. Hand break into pieces. Store in covered container.

recipes.title: Cheese Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. broccoli spears, partially thawed
1 (2.8 oz.) can French fried onion rings
directions: Grease a
2-quart
casserole dish and lay broccoli flat along the bottom.
Sprinkle
half
of the shredded cheese over the broccoli.
Pour
the
cream
of
mushroom
soup
over
the cheese. Sprinkle with half of the can of onion rings and then the rest of the cheese.
Drip the French dressing all over the top of the casserole.tTop
with
thetremaining onion rings. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.tServes 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Cheese Broccoli Casserole. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish and lay broccoli flat along the bottom. Sprinkle half of the shredded cheese over the broccoli. Pour the cream of mushroom soup over the cheese. Sprinkle with half of the can of onion rings and then the rest of the cheese. Drip the French dressing all over the top of the casserole.tTop with thetremaining onion rings. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.tServes 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Pecan Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter until smooth.
Add 2 eggs at a time.
Blend until smooth.
Add sugar gradually; blend thoroughly.
Fill sugar box 3/4 full with all-purpose flour.
Add gradually and cream to butter mixture.
Add vanilla; blend and add pecans and fold into mixture.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325u00b0 for 1 hour. Could take 1 1/4 hours according to oven.
Top will crack as most pound cakes do.
recipes.text: Pecan Pound Cake. Cream butter until smooth. Add 2 eggs at a time. Blend until smooth. Add sugar gradually; blend thoroughly. Fill sugar box 3/4 full with all-purpose flour. Add gradually and cream to butter mixture. Add vanilla; blend and add pecans and fold into mixture. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325u00b0 for 1 hour. Could take 1 1/4 hours according to oven. Top will crack as most pound cakes do.

recipes.title: Braunschweiger Pate
directions: Mix all the ingredients together.
Should be pudding consistency.
If too dry, add more Miracle Whip.
Spread on cracker or cocktail rye bread.
recipes.text: Braunschweiger Pate. Mix all the ingredients together. Should be pudding consistency. If too dry, add more Miracle Whip. Spread on cracker or cocktail rye bread.

recipes.title: Liver And Onions
directions: Have liver sliced to 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick.
Cook and stir onions and margarine in a 10-inch skillet until tender.
Remove from skillet and keep warm.
Heat 1/4 cup shortening in same skillet until melted.
Coat liver slices with flour.
Fry liver in shortening over medium heat until brown, 2 or 3 minutes on each side.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Add the onions during last minute of cooking to heat through.
Makes 5 servings.
recipes.text: Liver And Onions. Have liver sliced to 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick. Cook and stir onions and margarine in a 10-inch skillet until tender. Remove from skillet and keep warm. Heat 1/4 cup shortening in same skillet until melted. Coat liver slices with flour. Fry liver in shortening over medium heat until brown, 2 or 3 minutes on each side. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add the onions during last minute of cooking to heat through. Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Holiday Wreaths
directions: Lightly grease a large sheet of waxed paper and two small spoons.
Melt together margarine and marshmallows; stir until smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in cornflakes.
Working quickly with prepared spoons, drop small mounds of cornflake mixture onto waxed paper.
With lightly greased fingers, quickly form cornflake mounds into wreaths with a hole in the center.
Decorate with red-hot candies.
Makes 24 wreaths.
recipes.text: Holiday Wreaths. Lightly grease a large sheet of waxed paper and two small spoons. Melt together margarine and marshmallows; stir until smooth. Remove from heat and stir in cornflakes. Working quickly with prepared spoons, drop small mounds of cornflake mixture onto waxed paper. With lightly greased fingers, quickly form cornflake mounds into wreaths with a hole in the center. Decorate with red-hot candies. Makes 24 wreaths.

recipes.title: Wine Cookies
directions: Mix oil, sugar, wine and vanilla.
Add flour and baking powder.
Break off pieces; make long strips.
Fold strip in half and twist.
Roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Wine Cookies. Mix oil, sugar, wine and vanilla. Add flour and baking powder. Break off pieces; make long strips. Fold strip in half and twist. Roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemonade Balls
directions: Mix and roll into 1-inch balls. Freeze. Serve as needed.
recipes.text: Lemonade Balls. Mix and roll into 1-inch balls. Freeze. Serve as needed.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Finger Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 pkg. Pepperidge Farm rolls or something equal in a tin pan
directions: Blend butter, Worcestershire sauce, onion and mustard.
Spread on split rolls. Add ham and cheese.
Replace top.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in a
400u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
May be frozen before baking for future use.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Finger Sandwiches. Blend butter, Worcestershire sauce, onion and mustard. Spread on split rolls. Add ham and cheese. Replace top. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake in a 400u00b0 oven for 10 to 12 minutes. May be frozen before baking for future use.

recipes.title: Ham And Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cook frozen vegetables and ham until done.
Mix all ingredients well and place in baking dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Ham And Vegetable Casserole. Cook frozen vegetables and ham until done. Mix all ingredients well and place in baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Lasagne
ingredients: 1 1/2 jars Ragu thick and zesty (1 large and 1 small)
directions: Cook noodles. Brown hamburger meat, sausage, green pepper and onion.
Drain.
Add sauce and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
In a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex, put 1 layer of noodles.
Pour meat sauce and cheese.
Repeat 2 more times. End up with cheese on top. I add more cheese. Cook 30 minutes at 300u00b0. Serve with garlic bread and fresh veggies and dip.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Cook noodles. Brown hamburger meat, sausage, green pepper and onion. Drain. Add sauce and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. In a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex, put 1 layer of noodles. Pour meat sauce and cheese. Repeat 2 more times. End up with cheese on top. I add more cheese. Cook 30 minutes at 300u00b0. Serve with garlic bread and fresh veggies and dip.

recipes.title: Quick Shrimp Creole
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh shrimp, cleaned and cooked
directions: Heat oil and cook onion, garlic, green pepper and celery, slowly about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and water.
Simmer about 10 minutes.
Add shrimp and heat thoroughly.
Serve over hot rice.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Quick Shrimp Creole. Heat oil and cook onion, garlic, green pepper and celery, slowly about 5 minutes. Stir in tomato sauce and water. Simmer about 10 minutes. Add shrimp and heat thoroughly. Serve over hot rice. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mona'S Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, saving some crumbs for top.
Slice or spoon ice cream and layer it on top; as it softens, spread around so it's even.
Top with crumbs.
Freeze.
Cut into individual servings.
recipes.text: Mona'S Ice Cream Dessert. Mix first 5 ingredients. Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, saving some crumbs for top. Slice or spoon ice cream and layer it on top; as it softens, spread around so it's even. Top with crumbs. Freeze. Cut into individual servings.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
ingredients: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
directions: Saute hamburger meat and onion together.
Place in crock-pot. Add other ingredients and cook on high until hot.
Reduce heat to low and cook 8 hours.
Add water, if needed.
recipes.text: Taco Soup. Saute hamburger meat and onion together. Place in crock-pot. Add other ingredients and cook on high until hot. Reduce heat to low and cook 8 hours. Add water, if needed.

recipes.title: Noble Grand'S Chili
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. red or white wine vinegar
1 large green pepper, seeded and chopped
directions: Have the shredded Cheddar, chopped green onion and tortilla chips ready.
In a microwavable bowl, brown meat.
Add onions; brown.
Add all ingredients, except the last 3; simmer until bubbly and well combined.
Serve hot with remaining ingredients. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Noble Grand'S Chili. Have the shredded Cheddar, chopped green onion and tortilla chips ready. In a microwavable bowl, brown meat. Add onions; brown. Add all ingredients, except the last 3; simmer until bubbly and well combined. Serve hot with remaining ingredients. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Stone Soup
ingredients: 1 pkg. carrots, peeled and cut in coins
directions: Read the story Stone Soup, where some weary travelers make soup with a stone and some offerings from some townspeople. Brown meat in oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add vegetables and cover with water.
Cook for 2 to 3 hours.
Don't forget to add a clean stone!!
Serves 25 hungry first graders.
recipes.text: Stone Soup. Read the story Stone Soup, where some weary travelers make soup with a stone and some offerings from some townspeople. Brown meat in oil. Season with salt and pepper. Add vegetables and cover with water. Cook for 2 to 3 hours. Don't forget to add a clean stone!! Serves 25 hungry first graders.

recipes.title: Sawdust Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cold water.
Add pineapple and bananas.
recipes.text: Sawdust Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cold water. Add pineapple and bananas.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in covered
Tupperware dish.
Let set in refrigerator for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Honey Mustard Dip. Mix all ingredients together. Put in covered Tupperware dish. Let set in refrigerator for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Cook-Out Potatoes
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.
Peel and slice potatoes thin and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Put potatoes on large piece of foil.
Slice onion thin and put on potatoes.
Sprinkle with crumbled bacon.
Cut cheese in small cubes and dot over potato mixture.
Dot potatoes with butter.
Wrap tightly in foil and seal edges.
Cover over hot coals for 1 hour. Turn several times during cooking.
recipes.text: Cook-Out Potatoes. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Peel and slice potatoes thin and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Put potatoes on large piece of foil. Slice onion thin and put on potatoes. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon. Cut cheese in small cubes and dot over potato mixture. Dot potatoes with butter. Wrap tightly in foil and seal edges. Cover over hot coals for 1 hour. Turn several times during cooking.

recipes.title: Pineapple Scalloped
directions: Dissolve sugar in pineapple juice.
Add remaining ingredients. Mix in bowl; let absorb.
Place mixture in lightly buttered dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.
This can be eaten hot or cold; also good reheated.
recipes.text: Pineapple Scalloped. Dissolve sugar in pineapple juice. Add remaining ingredients. Mix in bowl; let absorb. Place mixture in lightly buttered dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes. This can be eaten hot or cold; also good reheated.

recipes.title: Pimento Soup
directions: Place pimento in blender, reserving a few strips for garnish. Add onion and cream and blend on high about 30 seconds.
Remove from blender and chill.
Chill consomme separately.
Ten minutes before serving, add consomme to pimento mix and stir well.
Leave a few lumps of consomme to add texture.
Garnish each serving with 1 or 2 strips pimento.
recipes.text: Pimento Soup. Place pimento in blender, reserving a few strips for garnish. Add onion and cream and blend on high about 30 seconds. Remove from blender and chill. Chill consomme separately. Ten minutes before serving, add consomme to pimento mix and stir well. Leave a few lumps of consomme to add texture. Garnish each serving with 1 or 2 strips pimento.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 3 or 4 small cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced
1 c. whipping cream or sour cream (1/2 pt.)
6 Tbsp. olive oil or salad oil
1 Tbsp. each: chopped capers, minced parsley and chopped pimiento
1/8 tsp. each: dry mustard and pepper
directions: Cut apart the cauliflower carefully, keeping the flowerets fairly large.
Drop into boiling, salted water.
Boil 4 to 5 minutes, until just slightly tender.
Pour into a colander and cool in running cold water.
Drain well and reassemble by arranging top-side-down in a bowl (one about the same shape on the bottom as the cauliflower).
Combine the oil, vinegar, capers, parsley, pimiento, onion, salt, mustard and pepper; spoon over the cauliflower.
Cover bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Cucumber Salad. Cut apart the cauliflower carefully, keeping the flowerets fairly large. Drop into boiling, salted water. Boil 4 to 5 minutes, until just slightly tender. Pour into a colander and cool in running cold water. Drain well and reassemble by arranging top-side-down in a bowl (one about the same shape on the bottom as the cauliflower). Combine the oil, vinegar, capers, parsley, pimiento, onion, salt, mustard and pepper; spoon over the cauliflower. Cover bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Cheese Bars
directions: Beat with spoon the melted butter and egg.
Add cake mix and mix until gooey.
Put into 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
recipes.text: Cheese Bars. Beat with spoon the melted butter and egg. Add cake mix and mix until gooey. Put into 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk and vanilla.
Grease and flour tube pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pound Cake. Cream butter, Crisco and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk and vanilla. Grease and flour tube pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Dice fruit and chop nuts; set aside.
In very large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks and blend.
Sift dry ingredients and add to fruit and nuts. Blend.
Gradually add liquids.
Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry.
Fold into batter.
Turn into lined and greased pan (large tube pan).
Bake until tests done.
Place a pan of hot water on rack underneath cake during baking period.
Cool 30 minutes before removing from pan.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 2 hours and 15 minutes.
Makes 7 1/2 pound cake.
recipes.text: White Fruit Cake. Dice fruit and chop nuts; set aside. In very large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks and blend. Sift dry ingredients and add to fruit and nuts. Blend. Gradually add liquids. Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Fold into batter. Turn into lined and greased pan (large tube pan). Bake until tests done. Place a pan of hot water on rack underneath cake during baking period. Cool 30 minutes before removing from pan. Bake at 275u00b0 for 2 hours and 15 minutes. Makes 7 1/2 pound cake.

recipes.title: Smothered Steak (Crockpot Meal)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs. chuck or round steak, cut into 1-inch strips
1 (4 oz.) can mushrooms, drained (can use fresh)
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen french style green beans
directions: Place steak strips, flour salt and pepper in crockpot. Stir well to coat steak. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Then turn to low for 8 hours or high for 5 hours. Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Smothered Steak (Crockpot Meal). Place steak strips, flour salt and pepper in crockpot. Stir well to coat steak. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour. Then turn to low for 8 hours or high for 5 hours. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Set aside. Let foam. Sift flour and salt. Cut in butter. Add eggs and blend. Add yeast mixture. Knead on floured board about 5 minutes. Divide into 4 parts. Let rise. Roll out each piece. Spread with Solo poppy seed filling. Roll up and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Rolls. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Set aside. Let foam. Sift flour and salt. Cut in butter. Add eggs and blend. Add yeast mixture. Knead on floured board about 5 minutes. Divide into 4 parts. Let rise. Roll out each piece. Spread with Solo poppy seed filling. Roll up and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham And Chicken In Noodle Soup(4 Servings)
ingredients: 1/4 slices ham, cut into thin strips 2-inches long
12 fresh snow peas, strung and parboiled in salt water and cut into thin strips
1/2 tsp. Chinese rice wine or sherry
directions: Sprinkle the chicken wings with the wine, salt and pepper. Steam for 20 minutes.
Cut the meat into thin strips or tear it into shreds with your hands.
Heat the stock and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the noodles in a generous amount of water. Drain and place in a warmed tureen or individual deep soup bowls. Pour the hot soup over the noodles.
Arrange the chicken, ham and snow peas on top and sprinkle with the green onion.
recipes.text: Ham And Chicken In Noodle Soup(4 Servings). Sprinkle the chicken wings with the wine, salt and pepper. Steam for 20 minutes. Cut the meat into thin strips or tear it into shreds with your hands. Heat the stock and season with salt and pepper. Cook the noodles in a generous amount of water. Drain and place in a warmed tureen or individual deep soup bowls. Pour the hot soup over the noodles. Arrange the chicken, ham and snow peas on top and sprinkle with the green onion.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook noodles in boiling salt water.
Saute green pepper and onion in small amount of butter until both are tender.
Alternate layers in medium-size casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Cook noodles in boiling salt water. Saute green pepper and onion in small amount of butter until both are tender. Alternate layers in medium-size casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baklava
directions: Mix nuts, zwieback, cinnamon, cloves and sugar.
Butter 13 x 10-inch pan.
Place 1 sheet of filo dough in pan and then butter sheet with pastry brush.
Continue until you have 7 to 8 sheets layered.
Spread nut mixture evenly over layered dough, then continue to cover mixture with 1 sheet of filo dough at a time, buttering each sheet as it is placed on top.
Continue until all pastry sheets are used.
Cut into serving pieces.
Pour remaining melted butter over pastry.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown.
Pour syrup over baklava while hot.
Let cool before serving.
recipes.text: Baklava. Mix nuts, zwieback, cinnamon, cloves and sugar. Butter 13 x 10-inch pan. Place 1 sheet of filo dough in pan and then butter sheet with pastry brush. Continue until you have 7 to 8 sheets layered. Spread nut mixture evenly over layered dough, then continue to cover mixture with 1 sheet of filo dough at a time, buttering each sheet as it is placed on top. Continue until all pastry sheets are used. Cut into serving pieces. Pour remaining melted butter over pastry. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Pour syrup over baklava while hot. Let cool before serving.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Ala King
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (3 oz.) can sliced mushrooms with liquid
directions: Cook onion in margarine until tender, but not brown.
Blend in softened cream cheese, mushroom soup and pepper.
Stir in chicken and sliced mushrooms with liquid.
Heat to boiling. Add green pepper and pimento.
Serve over hot biscuits.
recipes.text: Quick Chicken Ala King. Cook onion in margarine until tender, but not brown. Blend in softened cream cheese, mushroom soup and pepper. Stir in chicken and sliced mushrooms with liquid. Heat to boiling. Add green pepper and pimento. Serve over hot biscuits.

recipes.title: Create "A" Cookie
ingredients: 1 pkg. miniature Reese's peanut butter cups
directions: Spread icing slightly thick on top of chocolate chip cookie. Unwrap peanut butter cup and place upside-down in bottom center of cookie.
Arrange 4 to 5 candy corn above peanut butter cup with small ends touching the peanut butter cup.
Draw two beady eyes and a beak on top of peanut butter cup.
Now enjoy the most tasty "turkey" cookie ever.
recipes.text: Create "A" Cookie. Spread icing slightly thick on top of chocolate chip cookie. Unwrap peanut butter cup and place upside-down in bottom center of cookie. Arrange 4 to 5 candy corn above peanut butter cup with small ends touching the peanut butter cup. Draw two beady eyes and a beak on top of peanut butter cup. Now enjoy the most tasty "turkey" cookie ever.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. olive oil or melted butter
1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese, divided
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In a large bowl, toss the hot spaghetti with the olive oil.
In a small bowl, combine the eggs and the 1/2 cup of Parmesan cheese.
Stir into the spaghetti.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In a large bowl, toss the hot spaghetti with the olive oil. In a small bowl, combine the eggs and the 1/2 cup of Parmesan cheese. Stir into the spaghetti.

recipes.title: Frosted Cauliflower
directions: Steam cauliflower until fork tender.
Mix mayonnaise, mustard and cheese.
Heat 2 minutes on full power in microwave.
Pour over cauliflower and serve hot.
recipes.text: Frosted Cauliflower. Steam cauliflower until fork tender. Mix mayonnaise, mustard and cheese. Heat 2 minutes on full power in microwave. Pour over cauliflower and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
directions: Cut cake mix, margarine and egg together until mixture is soft like dough.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Beat together powdered sugar, cream cheese and eggs until smooth.
Pour over pressed mixture and bake at 350u00b0
for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chess Cake. Cut cake mix, margarine and egg together until mixture is soft like dough. Press into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Beat together powdered sugar, cream cheese and eggs until smooth. Pour over pressed mixture and bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lb. mushrooms, rinse and gently twist stems out of caps
directions: Squish soup mix, sausage and cheese together.
Form into balls and place in caps of mushrooms.
Cook at 350u00b0 for about 20 minutes.
Delicious.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Squish soup mix, sausage and cheese together. Form into balls and place in caps of mushrooms. Cook at 350u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Delicious.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
ingredients: 1 can crescent rolls (I use angel biscuits)
3/4 c. orange juice (I have used cranberry and pineapple juice)
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Peel and core apples.
Cut each apple into 8 equal pieces.
Open rolls and lay out flat.
You will have 8 pieces.
Cut each piece longways in half, making 16 pieces. Melt butter in a 10-inch pan.
Roll apple slices in dough pieces, starting with narrowest end.
Lay in pan, seam side down. Sprinkle sugar, which has been mixed with cinnamon, over wrapped apples.
Toss in some raisins, if desired.
Pour orange juice over all, then bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Apple Dumplings. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Peel and core apples. Cut each apple into 8 equal pieces. Open rolls and lay out flat. You will have 8 pieces. Cut each piece longways in half, making 16 pieces. Melt butter in a 10-inch pan. Roll apple slices in dough pieces, starting with narrowest end. Lay in pan, seam side down. Sprinkle sugar, which has been mixed with cinnamon, over wrapped apples. Toss in some raisins, if desired. Pour orange juice over all, then bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Rancho Baked Beans
directions: Bake 30 minutes at 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Rancho Baked Beans. Bake 30 minutes at 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Easy Corn Fritters
directions: Mix all together and drop by tablespoons in deep hot oil.
By deep frying, they will not absorb much oil. Drain on paper towel.
recipes.text: Easy Corn Fritters. Mix all together and drop by tablespoons in deep hot oil. By deep frying, they will not absorb much oil. Drain on paper towel.

recipes.title: Melt In Your Mouth Sugar Cookies
directions: Combine butter, oil and sugar in large mixing bowl; beat well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Stir in vanilla.
Add flour, baking soda and cream of tartar.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Flatten with bottom of a glass dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool on wire racks.
Makes 6 to 7 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Melt In Your Mouth Sugar Cookies. Combine butter, oil and sugar in large mixing bowl; beat well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Add flour, baking soda and cream of tartar. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Flatten with bottom of a glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on wire racks. Makes 6 to 7 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Grease and flour tube pan. Pour mixture into pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Mix all ingredients together. Grease and flour tube pan. Pour mixture into pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fast And Easy Whole Wheat Bread
directions: Stir 2 teaspoons honey into 2/3 cup lukewarm water.
Sprinkle yeast over mixture.
Set aside for 10 minutes.
Combine 3 tablespoons honey with 2/3 cup warm water and combine with yeast mixture.
Stir into flour.
Add salt, wheat germ and 1 1/3 cups warm water.
Dough will be sticky.
Pour dough into a nonstick loaf pan.
Smooth top with wet spatula.
Allow to raise to top of pan. Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes on a rack, then turn out of pan.
Cool before slicing.
recipes.text: Fast And Easy Whole Wheat Bread. Stir 2 teaspoons honey into 2/3 cup lukewarm water. Sprinkle yeast over mixture. Set aside for 10 minutes. Combine 3 tablespoons honey with 2/3 cup warm water and combine with yeast mixture. Stir into flour. Add salt, wheat germ and 1 1/3 cups warm water. Dough will be sticky. Pour dough into a nonstick loaf pan. Smooth top with wet spatula. Allow to raise to top of pan. Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes on a rack, then turn out of pan. Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies
directions: Cut onions and peppers in thin slices; mix with cooked sliced carrots.
Mix all other ingredients and add to carrots.
Let stand overnight (marinate).
Serve chilled.
recipes.text: Copper Pennies. Cut onions and peppers in thin slices; mix with cooked sliced carrots. Mix all other ingredients and add to carrots. Let stand overnight (marinate). Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Fried Pickles
directions: Drain pickles, then spread on paper towels to soak up excess moisture. Combine buttermilk and hot sauce. In a separate bowl combine flour and cornmeal. Dip pickles in buttermilk mixture, then dredge in flour mixture, evenly coating. Drop into hot oil in batches, turning until all sides are golden brown and crisp. Drain on paper towels and season with salt. Best served hot.
recipes.text: Fried Pickles. Drain pickles, then spread on paper towels to soak up excess moisture. Combine buttermilk and hot sauce. In a separate bowl combine flour and cornmeal. Dip pickles in buttermilk mixture, then dredge in flour mixture, evenly coating. Drop into hot oil in batches, turning until all sides are golden brown and crisp. Drain on paper towels and season with salt. Best served hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: cooked chicken breasts or whole fryer, deboned and cut up
directions: Place cooked broccoli in bottom of 3-quart casserole.
Cover with chicken.
Combine rest of ingredients and pour over chicken. Then sprinkle another 1/4 pound of grated cheese over top and cover with buttered Pepperidge Farm crumbs.
Bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Casserole. Place cooked broccoli in bottom of 3-quart casserole. Cover with chicken. Combine rest of ingredients and pour over chicken. Then sprinkle another 1/4 pound of grated cheese over top and cover with buttered Pepperidge Farm crumbs. Bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix corn, flour, sugar and salt together.
Combine eggs, melted oleo and milk and mix with corn mixture.
Pour into greased casserole and place in pan of water in 350u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours. Stir corn mixture twice in the first 30 minutes.
It is done when a silver knife inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Mix corn, flour, sugar and salt together. Combine eggs, melted oleo and milk and mix with corn mixture. Pour into greased casserole and place in pan of water in 350u00b0 oven for 1 1/4 hours. Stir corn mixture twice in the first 30 minutes. It is done when a silver knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cheesy Lime Gelatin Salad
directions: Bring to boil pineapple with juice, sugar and Jell-O.
Add cold water.
When partially set add shredded cheese.
Add whipped topping and chopped pecans.
recipes.text: Cheesy Lime Gelatin Salad. Bring to boil pineapple with juice, sugar and Jell-O. Add cold water. When partially set add shredded cheese. Add whipped topping and chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Homemade Wine
directions: You will need 1-gallon glass jar.
recipes.text: Homemade Wine. You will need 1-gallon glass jar.

recipes.title: Tighanites(Fritters)
directions: Sift flour, baking powder
andtsugar.tBeat
egg
with milk; stir into flour mixture.
Heat
cups
oil
in a large frying pan.
When oil is hot, drop in batter from large spoon. Cook fritters until golden brown
on one side, then turn over. Drain on kitchen paper
towel.
Serve
at
once
with
sugar, cinnamon or honey and cinnamon.
recipes.text: Tighanites(Fritters). Sift flour, baking powder andtsugar.tBeat egg with milk; stir into flour mixture. Heat 2 cups oil in a large frying pan. When oil is hot, drop in batter from large spoon. Cook fritters until golden brown on one side, then turn over. Drain on kitchen paper towel. Serve at once with sugar, cinnamon or honey and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Pizza
directions: Tack a apple. Put a stick in some wer.
Get some soger from some wer.
Put in a big bolw.
Put some weter in with it.
Bol the soger and weter.
Now dip the apple in the bolw.
Take it out of the bolw.
Put it in the ferig.
Lat it sat in the ferig for 3 1/2 days.
But put some fowol on it.
Then you can eat it.
recipes.text: Pizza. Tack a apple. Put a stick in some wer. Get some soger from some wer. Put in a big bolw. Put some weter in with it. Bol the soger and weter. Now dip the apple in the bolw. Take it out of the bolw. Put it in the ferig. Lat it sat in the ferig for 3 1/2 days. But put some fowol on it. Then you can eat it.

recipes.title: Shrimp Ball
directions: Chop shrimp.
Combine all items and mix well.
Shape into a ball and sprinkle.
recipes.text: Shrimp Ball. Chop shrimp. Combine all items and mix well. Shape into a ball and sprinkle.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Wash kidney beans.
Place tomatoes with juice, beans, spices, and bouillon cubes in a large pot.
Bring to a boil.
Brown ground beef and sausage.
Drain.
Add onions, bell pepper, and meat to the pot.
Maintain the boil until the chili is at the desired thickness. The beans will soften when the chili is done.
recipes.text: Chili. Wash kidney beans. Place tomatoes with juice, beans, spices, and bouillon cubes in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Brown ground beef and sausage. Drain. Add onions, bell pepper, and meat to the pot. Maintain the boil until the chili is at the desired thickness. The beans will soften when the chili is done.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 box white or yellow cake mix
directions: May substitute apple pie filling and spice cake mix.
Or may substitute can of drained pie cherries.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. May substitute apple pie filling and spice cake mix. Or may substitute can of drained pie cherries.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Broccoli Slaw
ingredients: 1 c. Hidden Valley Ranch low-fat coleslaw dressing
directions: Mix together broccoli slaw mix and low-fat coleslaw dressing. Best if chilled before serving.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Broccoli Slaw. Mix together broccoli slaw mix and low-fat coleslaw dressing. Best if chilled before serving.

recipes.title: Lentil Nut Loaf Or Patties
directions: Blend oats until fine and put in mixing bowl with chopped nuts or seeds.
Blend smooth remaining ingredients.
Mix all together. Let set for 10 minutes.
Place in Pammed loaf pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes or shape into patties and bake 30 minutes.
Turn patties over and bake 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: Lentil Nut Loaf Or Patties. Blend oats until fine and put in mixing bowl with chopped nuts or seeds. Blend smooth remaining ingredients. Mix all together. Let set for 10 minutes. Place in Pammed loaf pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes or shape into patties and bake 30 minutes. Turn patties over and bake 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Orange Angel Food(Mrs. Carmichael'S Recipe)
directions: Separate eggs.
Beat yolks until foamy, then add half of the sugar and beat again.
Add orange juice and grated rind.
Beat whites and add the cream of tartar.
Add rest of sugar to whites. Add yolks to whites and fold in flour.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in a moderate oven.
recipes.text: Orange Angel Food(Mrs. Carmichael'S Recipe). Separate eggs. Beat yolks until foamy, then add half of the sugar and beat again. Add orange juice and grated rind. Beat whites and add the cream of tartar. Add rest of sugar to whites. Add yolks to whites and fold in flour. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: Peach Meringues
ingredients: 4 large peaches, peeled, halved and pitted
2 Tbsp. brandy or creme de cassis
directions: Place peaches in a 9-inch pie plate.
Fill center of each with 1 teaspoon jelly.
Sprinkle with brandy.
Set aside.
Beat eggs in small bowl to soft peaks.
Gradually beat in sugar until stiff, but not dry, peaks form.
Beat in almond extract.
Spread equal amounts of meringue over each peach, twirling to make a decorative swirl.
Bake in preheated oven at
425u00b0 for 10 minutes, until lightly golden.
Makes 4 servings.
Each contains 159 calories, 3 protein, 15 g fat, 37 carb., 30 mg sodium and 0 cholesterol. Exchanges: 2 1/2 fruit, 1/4 lean meat.
recipes.text: Peach Meringues. Place peaches in a 9-inch pie plate. Fill center of each with 1 teaspoon jelly. Sprinkle with brandy. Set aside. Beat eggs in small bowl to soft peaks. Gradually beat in sugar until stiff, but not dry, peaks form. Beat in almond extract. Spread equal amounts of meringue over each peach, twirling to make a decorative swirl. Bake in preheated oven at 425u00b0 for 10 minutes, until lightly golden. Makes 4 servings. Each contains 159 calories, 3 protein, 15 g fat, 37 carb., 30 mg sodium and 0 cholesterol. Exchanges: 2 1/2 fruit, 1/4 lean meat.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
directions: Add all ingredients to blender.
Mix until ice cubes are crushed.
recipes.text: Orange Julius. Add all ingredients to blender. Mix until ice cubes are crushed.

recipes.title: Quick Rolls
directions: Mix well. Spoon into muffin pans. Let rise 35 to 40 minuites before baking. Bake at 350u00b0 until golden brown. Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Quick Rolls. Mix well. Spoon into muffin pans. Let rise 35 to 40 minuites before baking. Bake at 350u00b0 until golden brown. Will keep up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Raisin Pie
directions: Place a heaping cup of raisins in enough water to cover; simmer gently for about 3 minutes.
Drain and cool.
Mix sugar, flour and cinnamon.
Add margarine and egg.
Spread the raisins in the pie crust.
Gently spread mixture over raisins.
Bake at 325u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Raisin Pie. Place a heaping cup of raisins in enough water to cover; simmer gently for about 3 minutes. Drain and cool. Mix sugar, flour and cinnamon. Add margarine and egg. Spread the raisins in the pie crust. Gently spread mixture over raisins. Bake at 325u00b0 for about 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or shrimp soup
directions: Cook broccoli; drain well.
Put in greased casserole.
Heat soup and cream cheese until cheese is melted.
Mix well.
Pour over broccoli and mix.
Heat in oven at 350u00b0 until hot and bubbly. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli; drain well. Put in greased casserole. Heat soup and cream cheese until cheese is melted. Mix well. Pour over broccoli and mix. Heat in oven at 350u00b0 until hot and bubbly. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Bean Soup Supreme
directions: Soak overnight navy beans.
Drain and add water, red pepper pod, bay leaves and a ham bone.
Bring to boil and reduce heat, cooking slowly for 2 1/2 hours.
Discard ham bone, pepper pod and bay leaves and add remaining ingredients.
Return to boil and reduce heat, cooking slowly for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Bean Soup Supreme. Soak overnight navy beans. Drain and add water, red pepper pod, bay leaves and a ham bone. Bring to boil and reduce heat, cooking slowly for 2 1/2 hours. Discard ham bone, pepper pod and bay leaves and add remaining ingredients. Return to boil and reduce heat, cooking slowly for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Betty H'S Chocolate Cake
directions: Cook chocolate pudding.
Cool for 5 minutes.
Combine with dry German chocolate cake mix.
Mix by hand.
Pour into lightly greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
It will be thick.
Leave it a little lumpy in the pan.
Sprinkle chocolate chips on top with nuts.
Cool completely, then put powdered sugar in strainer to decorate.
recipes.text: Betty H'S Chocolate Cake. Cook chocolate pudding. Cool for 5 minutes. Combine with dry German chocolate cake mix. Mix by hand. Pour into lightly greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. It will be thick. Leave it a little lumpy in the pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top with nuts. Cool completely, then put powdered sugar in strainer to decorate.

recipes.title: Double Delicious Pie
directions: Cook pudding according to directions, only adding the chocolate chips and butter as the pudding cooks.
Pour into crust. When completely cool, add topping.
recipes.text: Double Delicious Pie. Cook pudding according to directions, only adding the chocolate chips and butter as the pudding cooks. Pour into crust. When completely cool, add topping.

recipes.title: No Bake Fruit Pie
ingredients: 1 large can peaches, cut up, or 1 large can fruit cocktail
directions: Open cans of fruit and drain for 30 minutes to remove juice. Mix, after drained, the fruit and lemon juice.
Mix well.
Add Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip.
Pour ingredients into graham cracker crusts.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: No Bake Fruit Pie. Open cans of fruit and drain for 30 minutes to remove juice. Mix, after drained, the fruit and lemon juice. Mix well. Add Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip. Pour ingredients into graham cracker crusts. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. Cheddar cheese or a combination Jack and Cheddar
directions: Saute onions, and garlic if you wish, in a little water until they are transparent.
Place these in a bowl.
Cook in a small amount of water and watch while cooking so that there is little liquid left.
Do not drain, the little juice has a lot of flavor and good stuff.
In the same pan, cook the meat until it is done; do not overcook.
Add salt and pepper if you wish.
Put the onions in and a few tablespoons of a combination of the sauces.
I use about half as much tomato sauce to the enchilada sauce because I want it to have the flavor but, not to hot.
So, you decide what combination you would like.
Dice the olives and grate the cheese. Heat the sauce.
Dip the tortillas, one at a time, in the hot sauce and line the 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Put half of the meat and onions on top of the tortillas, grated cheese on top of the meat and a few tablespoons of sauce on the cheese.
Dip more tortillas and place another layer on top of the first.
Cut tortillas before dipping when you want to cover a small area, such as corners. Continue with the layers of meat, cheese and sauce.
Sprinkle the olives on the top or put them inside.
I have also used drained canned corn along with the meat.
This is optional.
Also I use the white corn tortillas.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes, covered.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Saute onions, and garlic if you wish, in a little water until they are transparent. Place these in a bowl. Cook in a small amount of water and watch while cooking so that there is little liquid left. Do not drain, the little juice has a lot of flavor and good stuff. In the same pan, cook the meat until it is done; do not overcook. Add salt and pepper if you wish. Put the onions in and a few tablespoons of a combination of the sauces. I use about half as much tomato sauce to the enchilada sauce because I want it to have the flavor but, not to hot. So, you decide what combination you would like. Dice the olives and grate the cheese. Heat the sauce. Dip the tortillas, one at a time, in the hot sauce and line the 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Put half of the meat and onions on top of the tortillas, grated cheese on top of the meat and a few tablespoons of sauce on the cheese. Dip more tortillas and place another layer on top of the first. Cut tortillas before dipping when you want to cover a small area, such as corners. Continue with the layers of meat, cheese and sauce. Sprinkle the olives on the top or put them inside. I have also used drained canned corn along with the meat. This is optional. Also I use the white corn tortillas. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes, covered.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 small jar olives, sliced (green or black or both)
directions: Mix ingredients and shape into a ball.
Roll in chopped pecans or walnuts.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix ingredients and shape into a ball. Roll in chopped pecans or walnuts.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Sandwiches
directions: Pound breast halves.
Combine soy sauce and next 4 ingredients, mixing well.
Pour over chicken and let stand 30 minutes.
Grill over hot coals 30 minutes, turning and basting with marinade every 5 minutes. Add cheese slices to chicken about 5 minutes before done.
Serve with lettuce and tomato on rolls.
recipes.text: Grilled Chicken Sandwiches. Pound breast halves. Combine soy sauce and next 4 ingredients, mixing well. Pour over chicken and let stand 30 minutes. Grill over hot coals 30 minutes, turning and basting with marinade every 5 minutes. Add cheese slices to chicken about 5 minutes before done. Serve with lettuce and tomato on rolls.

recipes.title: 7-Layer Heartburn Dip
ingredients: sliced jalapeno peppers (hot as you desire)
directions: Mix beans and taco sauce together.
Spread on large glass dish.
Spread sour cream on top of beans.
Spread jalapeno peppers on next.
Spread sliced or chopped olives next.
Spread scallions or onions next.
Spread chopped tomatoes next.
Spread cheese (grated or chopped) on top! It is a little runny at first. It will thicken as it cools.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350u00b0. Serve with corn chips to dip into this mess!!
recipes.text: 7-Layer Heartburn Dip. Mix beans and taco sauce together. Spread on large glass dish. Spread sour cream on top of beans. Spread jalapeno peppers on next. Spread sliced or chopped olives next. Spread scallions or onions next. Spread chopped tomatoes next. Spread cheese (grated or chopped) on top! It is a little runny at first. It will thicken as it cools. Bake for 20 minutes at 350u00b0. Serve with corn chips to dip into this mess!!

recipes.title: Chili Pie
directions: Brown ground chuck.
Drain.
Put chuck, seasoning, tomato sauce, corn, chili with beans, onions and peppers in pot.
Heat until bubbling.
Pour heated ingredients into baking dish. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese evenly over ingredients.
Mix egg and milk with cornbread mix.
Pour over cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until cornbread is done.
recipes.text: Chili Pie. Brown ground chuck. Drain. Put chuck, seasoning, tomato sauce, corn, chili with beans, onions and peppers in pot. Heat until bubbling. Pour heated ingredients into baking dish. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese evenly over ingredients. Mix egg and milk with cornbread mix. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes or until cornbread is done.

recipes.title: Yogurt-Sesame Chicken
ingredients: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) broiler-fryer, cut up and skinned
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl; set aside. Combine yogurt and honey.
Dip each piece of chicken in yogurt mixture.
Dredge in cornflakes mixture.
Place chicken in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Drizzle with butter.
Bake uncovered at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and golden brown.
Yield:
4 servings.
recipes.text: Yogurt-Sesame Chicken. Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl; set aside. Combine yogurt and honey. Dip each piece of chicken in yogurt mixture. Dredge in cornflakes mixture. Place chicken in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Drizzle with butter. Bake uncovered at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and golden brown. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Souffle
ingredients: 3 cups sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Pour into a greased 13 x 9 baking dish.
Cover with topping mixture.
Bake at 350 for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Souffle. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 baking dish. Cover with topping mixture. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: 'Coon
directions: Clean raccoon.
Place in water with salt and parboil.
Put in baking container raccoon seasoned with salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 500u00b0 for one hour.
Serve two days after cooking for better flavor (taste).
recipes.text: 'Coon. Clean raccoon. Place in water with salt and parboil. Put in baking container raccoon seasoned with salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 500u00b0 for one hour. Serve two days after cooking for better flavor (taste).

recipes.title: Party Ham Casserole
directions: Mix butter, flour and milk; stir constantly until thickened. Add cheese; cook slowly until melted.
Arrange potatoes in greased casserole; cover with beans.
Add ham, then pour sauce on top. Melt 2 tablespoons butter and mix with bread crumbs.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Party Ham Casserole. Mix butter, flour and milk; stir constantly until thickened. Add cheese; cook slowly until melted. Arrange potatoes in greased casserole; cover with beans. Add ham, then pour sauce on top. Melt 2 tablespoons butter and mix with bread crumbs. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole #2
directions: Place hash browns in oblong dish.
Mix cheese, onions, chicken soup, salt, 1/2 stick melted butter and sour cream together and pour over hash browns.
About 5 to 10 minutes before it is done, pour 2 cups of corn flakes over the top and drizzle 1/2 stick melted butter over the top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole #2. Place hash browns in oblong dish. Mix cheese, onions, chicken soup, salt, 1/2 stick melted butter and sour cream together and pour over hash browns. About 5 to 10 minutes before it is done, pour 2 cups of corn flakes over the top and drizzle 1/2 stick melted butter over the top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Lasagna
directions: Brown and drain beef.
Boil noodles.
Add beef and spaghetti sauce.
Layer beef and sauce, cottage cheese, noodles, Mozzarella cheese, beef and sauce, cottage cheese, noodles and Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Brown and drain beef. Boil noodles. Add beef and spaghetti sauce. Layer beef and sauce, cottage cheese, noodles, Mozzarella cheese, beef and sauce, cottage cheese, noodles and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Put sugar, butter, milk and vanilla in a large saucepan.
Stir and bring to a boil over medium heat; simmer for 10 minutes, stirring constantly to avoid sticking.
Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until melted and marshmallow cream and stir.
Add nuts; pour into a large buttered baking dish.
Let cool.
Makes three pounds.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Put sugar, butter, milk and vanilla in a large saucepan. Stir and bring to a boil over medium heat; simmer for 10 minutes, stirring constantly to avoid sticking. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until melted and marshmallow cream and stir. Add nuts; pour into a large buttered baking dish. Let cool. Makes three pounds.

recipes.title: Sugar And Eggless Fruit Cake
directions: Crush graham crackers.
Put milk in top of double boiler; add marshmallows and heat until marshmallows are melted.
Drain cherries; cut in halves and add all the fruit and nuts to the crushed crackers.
Pour the milk and marshmallow mixture over the cracker mixture.
This is really an icebox cake but I baked mine one hour in a slow oven (250u00b0) as it gives the nut meats a toasted flavor.
Be sure to mix well and bake in a greased, paper lined loaf pan.
recipes.text: Sugar And Eggless Fruit Cake. Crush graham crackers. Put milk in top of double boiler; add marshmallows and heat until marshmallows are melted. Drain cherries; cut in halves and add all the fruit and nuts to the crushed crackers. Pour the milk and marshmallow mixture over the cracker mixture. This is really an icebox cake but I baked mine one hour in a slow oven (250u00b0) as it gives the nut meats a toasted flavor. Be sure to mix well and bake in a greased, paper lined loaf pan.

recipes.title: Egg Casserole
ingredients: 6 slices bread, cubed (leave crust on bread)
directions: Cook sausage.
Crumble and drain real well.
Beat eggs, milk, mustard and salt together. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.
Add cubed bread on top.
Sprinkle sausage on top.
Sprinkle cheese on top and soak overnight or 6 hours.
Cover dish with foil.
Leave one corner of foil slightly lifted for steam to get out.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 55 minutes.
Eggs shouldn't be runny (bake 5 minutes longer if necessary).
Cut in squares for serving. Leftovers are excellent.
recipes.text: Egg Casserole. Cook sausage. Crumble and drain real well. Beat eggs, milk, mustard and salt together. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Add cubed bread on top. Sprinkle sausage on top. Sprinkle cheese on top and soak overnight or 6 hours. Cover dish with foil. Leave one corner of foil slightly lifted for steam to get out. Bake at 375u00b0 for 55 minutes. Eggs shouldn't be runny (bake 5 minutes longer if necessary). Cut in squares for serving. Leftovers are excellent.

recipes.title: Meatballs Lasagna Style
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In a bowl combine meat, egg, onion and pepper.
Mix to blend.
Shape into small balls.
Place meatballs in a greased 8-inch square pan.
Spoon cottage cheese around meatballs and spoon sauce over all.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Meatballs Lasagna Style. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In a bowl combine meat, egg, onion and pepper. Mix to blend. Shape into small balls. Place meatballs in a greased 8-inch square pan. Spoon cottage cheese around meatballs and spoon sauce over all. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanish Cakes
directions: Sift plain all-purpose flour into bowl.
Make hole in flour and mix with hand as biscuit dough.
Roll out and cut.
Bake on cookie sheet at 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Spanish Cakes. Sift plain all-purpose flour into bowl. Make hole in flour and mix with hand as biscuit dough. Roll out and cut. Bake on cookie sheet at 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Mix as for any cake, adding rhubarb and nuts last.
Top before baking with additional 1/3 cup brown sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.
Serve slightly warm.
Top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cake. Mix as for any cake, adding rhubarb and nuts last. Top before baking with additional 1/3 cup brown sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes. Serve slightly warm. Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Garden Goulash
directions: Heat iron skillet with 1 tablespoon oil.
Add garlic and onion, cook 1 minute.
Add rest of vegetables.
Stir vegetables frequently and saute 5 to 10 minutes until cooked to your liking.
recipes.text: Garden Goulash. Heat iron skillet with 1 tablespoon oil. Add garlic and onion, cook 1 minute. Add rest of vegetables. Stir vegetables frequently and saute 5 to 10 minutes until cooked to your liking.

recipes.title: Self-Crust Pumpkin Pie
directions: Stir first 3 ingredients until well blended.
Mix all ingredients together and pour in 2 pie plates sprayed with Pam. Bake at 400u00b0 until well brown.
recipes.text: Self-Crust Pumpkin Pie. Stir first 3 ingredients until well blended. Mix all ingredients together and pour in 2 pie plates sprayed with Pam. Bake at 400u00b0 until well brown.

recipes.title: Baked Ham
directions: Preheat oven at 300u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Wrap ham in tinfoil; place in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Spread sliced pineapple over top.
Place in oven; cook for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven; pour Coke over top of ham, rewrap, place back in oven and cook for 1 1/2 hours more.
Then remove from oven; place on platter.
Slice and serve.
recipes.text: Baked Ham. Preheat oven at 300u00b0 for 15 minutes. Wrap ham in tinfoil; place in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Spread sliced pineapple over top. Place in oven; cook for 30 minutes. Remove from oven; pour Coke over top of ham, rewrap, place back in oven and cook for 1 1/2 hours more. Then remove from oven; place on platter. Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Sizzle Cakes
directions: Mix all into batter.
Use a paper funnel and pour into hot oil in swirling design.
Turn only once; place on paper towels.
While hot, dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Sizzle Cakes. Mix all into batter. Use a paper funnel and pour into hot oil in swirling design. Turn only once; place on paper towels. While hot, dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
directions: In a large bowl, measure all ingredients except oats.
With mixer at low speed, beat ingredients until blended.
Stir in oats. Drop dough about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a preheated 350u00b0 oven until golden brown. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies. In a large bowl, measure all ingredients except oats. With mixer at low speed, beat ingredients until blended. Stir in oats. Drop dough about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a preheated 350u00b0 oven until golden brown. Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: White Trash
directions: Melt morsels and margarine together.
Add peanut butter and blend well.
Pour cereal into mixture and coat cereal well.
Put mix into small white trash bag and add powdered sugar.
Shake.
recipes.text: White Trash. Melt morsels and margarine together. Add peanut butter and blend well. Pour cereal into mixture and coat cereal well. Put mix into small white trash bag and add powdered sugar. Shake.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chews
directions: Cream together shortening, peanut butter and both sugars until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla and eggs.
Beat well.
Mix in flour, stirring only until blended.
Add coconut, if desired. (Batter will be thick.)
Spread evenly in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until done.
Cool and cut in bars.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Chews. Cream together shortening, peanut butter and both sugars until light and fluffy. Add vanilla and eggs. Beat well. Mix in flour, stirring only until blended. Add coconut, if desired. (Batter will be thick.) Spread evenly in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes until done. Cool and cut in bars.

recipes.title: Ugly Duckling Cake
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can fruit cocktail juice and all
directions: Blend all ingredients, except brown sugar and nuts.
Beat 4 minutes. Bake in cake pan.
Sprinkle on top mixture of sugar and nuts.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Spoon Hot Butter Glaze over hot cake.
recipes.text: Ugly Duckling Cake. Blend all ingredients, except brown sugar and nuts. Beat 4 minutes. Bake in cake pan. Sprinkle on top mixture of sugar and nuts. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes. Cool in pan for 15 minutes. Spoon Hot Butter Glaze over hot cake.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix shortening and sugars well.
Add vanilla.
Beat and add eggs.
Add flour and baking soda; then add chips.
Batter should barely stick to finger.
Drop on ungreased pan and bake at 325u00b0 for 8 to 11 minutes, until golden brown.
They will not look done (this keeps them soft).
For variety, add other flavored chips.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Mix shortening and sugars well. Add vanilla. Beat and add eggs. Add flour and baking soda; then add chips. Batter should barely stick to finger. Drop on ungreased pan and bake at 325u00b0 for 8 to 11 minutes, until golden brown. They will not look done (this keeps them soft). For variety, add other flavored chips.

recipes.title: Super Carrot Cake
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together.
Then add other ingredients. Mix well by hand then pour into greased, floured pan and bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours or until cake shrinks from side of pan. Makes a huge cake.
Very delicious.
recipes.text: Super Carrot Cake. Mix all dry ingredients together. Then add other ingredients. Mix well by hand then pour into greased, floured pan and bake at 350u00b0 for about 1 1/2 hours or until cake shrinks from side of pan. Makes a huge cake. Very delicious.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato or 2 medium sweet potatoes, grated
directions: Put in nuts and coconut to keep sweet potatoes from turning dark.
Put in milk as soon as you grate.
Mix together.
Cook for 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Put in nuts and coconut to keep sweet potatoes from turning dark. Put in milk as soon as you grate. Mix together. Cook for 45 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Peach Delight
directions: Cook tapioca in 1 quart water until soft.
Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water.
Combine all ingredients and pour into dish. Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Peach Delight. Cook tapioca in 1 quart water until soft. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Combine all ingredients and pour into dish. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Jack'S Quiche
directions: Saute bacon and onion.
Beat together eggs, cream, salt, nutmeg, pepper and sugar.
Grate cheese.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes or at 300u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Jack'S Quiche. Saute bacon and onion. Beat together eggs, cream, salt, nutmeg, pepper and sugar. Grate cheese. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes or at 300u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Torte(Hasselnott Torte)
directions: Blend flour, baking powder and grated nuts together and set aside.
Beat eggs until thick and pale.
Gradually blend in sugar. Gently fold nut-flour mixture into the egg mixture.
Turn batter into 2 (8-inch) greased cake pans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done.
Invert pans and let layers hang until cool.
Remove from pans.
Fill with 1 cup sweetened whipped cream.
Sprinkle top of torte with confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Hazelnut Torte(Hasselnott Torte). Blend flour, baking powder and grated nuts together and set aside. Beat eggs until thick and pale. Gradually blend in sugar. Gently fold nut-flour mixture into the egg mixture. Turn batter into 2 (8-inch) greased cake pans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes or until done. Invert pans and let layers hang until cool. Remove from pans. Fill with 1 cup sweetened whipped cream. Sprinkle top of torte with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Spicy Hot Chipped Beef Dip
directions: Mix all the ingredients together until well blended.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Spicy Hot Chipped Beef Dip. Mix all the ingredients together until well blended. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Marinated Duck
directions: Cut ducks in half lengthwise.
Place in plastic bag in shallow pan.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over duck.
Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator, turning occasionally.
recipes.text: Marinated Duck. Cut ducks in half lengthwise. Place in plastic bag in shallow pan. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over duck. Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator, turning occasionally.

recipes.title: Hot Herb Bread
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients.
Slice French bread and brush mixture between slices (save 1 tablespoon).
Wrap bread in foil, leaving top open.
Brush remaining mixture on bread and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Heat in oven at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Hot Herb Bread. Combine first 6 ingredients. Slice French bread and brush mixture between slices (save 1 tablespoon). Wrap bread in foil, leaving top open. Brush remaining mixture on bread and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Heat in oven at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Golden Punch(Serves 100)
directions: Mix sugar and water.
Heat to dissolve sugar.
Mix juices and extracts in water and sugar mixture together and freeze until almost time to serve.
Can leave frozen up to 3 months.
Remove 1 hour before.
Thaw and add ginger ale until it makes a slush. Excellent wedding punch.
Serves 100.
recipes.text: Golden Punch(Serves 100). Mix sugar and water. Heat to dissolve sugar. Mix juices and extracts in water and sugar mixture together and freeze until almost time to serve. Can leave frozen up to 3 months. Remove 1 hour before. Thaw and add ginger ale until it makes a slush. Excellent wedding punch. Serves 100.

recipes.title: Polish Kraut
directions: Cut sausage into pieces.
Put all ingredients into skillet. Cook until onion is done.
recipes.text: Polish Kraut. Cut sausage into pieces. Put all ingredients into skillet. Cook until onion is done.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Melt butter
in baking dish.
Beat eggs and sugar until creamy, add milk, vanilla, flour and corn.tPour melted butter into mixture.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Melt butter in baking dish. Beat eggs and sugar until creamy, add milk, vanilla, flour and corn.tPour melted butter into mixture. Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Louisiana Gumbo
ingredients: chicken, goose, duck or smoked sausage
directions: In a large gumbo pot, make a roux with oil and flour.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until roux is dark caramel color.
Remove from fire and add remaining ingredients, except for 1/2 cup green onions, file and rice.
Boil about 2 hours or until meat is tender and gumbo has thickened.
In the last 15 minutes of boiling, add the rest of the green onions.
Remove from fire and add file.
Serve over hot rice in gumbo bowls.
recipes.text: Louisiana Gumbo. In a large gumbo pot, make a roux with oil and flour. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until roux is dark caramel color. Remove from fire and add remaining ingredients, except for 1/2 cup green onions, file and rice. Boil about 2 hours or until meat is tender and gumbo has thickened. In the last 15 minutes of boiling, add the rest of the green onions. Remove from fire and add file. Serve over hot rice in gumbo bowls.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add pineapple, then all other ingredients.
Pour in mold.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Dissolve jello in hot water. Add pineapple, then all other ingredients. Pour in mold.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie(Makes 3 Pies)
ingredients: 2 sticks Land O Lakes butter, melted
directions: Mix on medium.
Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie(Makes 3 Pies). Mix on medium. Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Pickled Salad
directions: Cut carrots, cauliflower and zucchini in 1-inch chunks; blanch 3 to 4 minutes.
Put piece of apple and some chopped parsley in each jar.
Add 5 cucumbers, 4 tomatoes, pieces of cauliflower, pieces of carrot and zucchini, 5 onions, 1 clove garlic, pieces of pepper and pieces of celery.
Fill to 1/2 inch from top.
On top, put chopped parsley and 1 bay leaf.
recipes.text: Pickled Salad. Cut carrots, cauliflower and zucchini in 1-inch chunks; blanch 3 to 4 minutes. Put piece of apple and some chopped parsley in each jar. Add 5 cucumbers, 4 tomatoes, pieces of cauliflower, pieces of carrot and zucchini, 5 onions, 1 clove garlic, pieces of pepper and pieces of celery. Fill to 1/2 inch from top. On top, put chopped parsley and 1 bay leaf.

recipes.title: "Philly" Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) roll refrigerated sugar slice-and-bake cookies
directions: Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices.
Arrange cookie slices, slightly overlapping, on aluminum foil-covered 14-inch pizza pan. Press edges to seal.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool. Remove from foil onto plate.
recipes.text: "Philly" Fruit Pizza. Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices. Arrange cookie slices, slightly overlapping, on aluminum foil-covered 14-inch pizza pan. Press edges to seal. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool. Remove from foil onto plate.

recipes.title: Nutty Blue Cheese Veggie Dip
directions: In a medium, combine mayo, sour cream, blue cheese, onions and bouillon. Mix well. Stir in nuts, cover and chill. Stir before serving. Serve with vegetables.
recipes.text: Nutty Blue Cheese Veggie Dip. In a medium, combine mayo, sour cream, blue cheese, onions and bouillon. Mix well. Stir in nuts, cover and chill. Stir before serving. Serve with vegetables.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dish
ingredients: 1 large pkg. frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots)
directions: Cook package of frozen vegetables until half done and drain. Add celery, onion, cheese and mayonnaise.
Stir well and then add water chestnuts.
Crumble Ritz crackers on top.
Dot with melted butter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dish. Cook package of frozen vegetables until half done and drain. Add celery, onion, cheese and mayonnaise. Stir well and then add water chestnuts. Crumble Ritz crackers on top. Dot with melted butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Toffee Pecan Bars
directions: Set oven to 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Toffee Pecan Bars. Set oven to 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Dessert
directions: Wash and cut rhubarb and fill a greased cake pan half full of rhubarb.
Sprinkle sugar over rhubarb, then sprinkle dry package Jell-O over sugar.
Spread dry yellow cake mix on top of Jell-O. Pour 1 1/2 cups water over the top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until rhubarb is done.
Cool and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Dessert. Wash and cut rhubarb and fill a greased cake pan half full of rhubarb. Sprinkle sugar over rhubarb, then sprinkle dry package Jell-O over sugar. Spread dry yellow cake mix on top of Jell-O. Pour 1 1/2 cups water over the top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until rhubarb is done. Cool and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Meat Spaghetti
ingredients: 3 lb. ground round or ground chuck
1 1/2 (10 oz.) pkg. vermicelli or thin spaghetti
directions: Cook together ground round or ground chuck and onions (stir enough to keep granular) until onions are clear and meat is brown. Add salt, black pepper, oregano, chili powder, tomatoes, Ro-Tel chilies and tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Cook vermicelli or thin spaghetti until done.
recipes.text: Meat Spaghetti. Cook together ground round or ground chuck and onions (stir enough to keep granular) until onions are clear and meat is brown. Add salt, black pepper, oregano, chili powder, tomatoes, Ro-Tel chilies and tomatoes and tomato sauce. Cook vermicelli or thin spaghetti until done.

recipes.title: 5-Cup Salad
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange sections, drained
directions: Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: 5-Cup Salad. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: In a small bowl, put 1/2 cup milk and Knox gelatine (set aside).
recipes.text: Homemade Ice Cream. In a small bowl, put 1/2 cup milk and Knox gelatine (set aside).

recipes.title: Peach Smash
ingredients: 1/4 c. frozen pineapple juice concentrate, thawed
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in electric blender container; process until smooth.
Gradually add enough ice cubes to make 5 cups in blender; process until mixture is smooth and thickened. Serve immediately.
Yields 5 cups.
recipes.text: Peach Smash. Combine first 5 ingredients in electric blender container; process until smooth. Gradually add enough ice cubes to make 5 cups in blender; process until mixture is smooth and thickened. Serve immediately. Yields 5 cups.

recipes.title: Bacon And Cream Cheese Egg Spread(Makes 2 Cups)
directions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients and spread on your favorite sandwich spread.
recipes.text: Bacon And Cream Cheese Egg Spread(Makes 2 Cups). Thoroughly mix all ingredients and spread on your favorite sandwich spread.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: In large bowl, combine milk and water.
Add pudding mix.
Beat until blended.
Chill for 5 minutes.
Spoon pudding mixture into whipped cream mixture.
Alternate layers of pudding, banana and wafers.
Chill.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. In large bowl, combine milk and water. Add pudding mix. Beat until blended. Chill for 5 minutes. Spoon pudding mixture into whipped cream mixture. Alternate layers of pudding, banana and wafers. Chill.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1/2 c. prepared double strength Hidden Valley Ranch dressing (1 pkg.; add 1/2 c. mayonnaise and 1/2 c. milk)
16 oz. shredded Cheddar cheese (set at room temperature for 1 hour)
6 oz. cream cheese (set at room temperature for 1 hour)
directions: Mix dressing and cream cheese.
Beat with mixer.
Add Cheddar and blend.
Cover and freeze for 30 minutes.
Shape into ball. Roll in pecans.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Hidden Valley Ranch Cheese Ball. Mix dressing and cream cheese. Beat with mixer. Add Cheddar and blend. Cover and freeze for 30 minutes. Shape into ball. Roll in pecans. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Date Nut Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and set aside.
In a medium bowl, stir together flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; set aside.
In another medium bowl, combine 1/3 cup sugar, chocolate and walnuts; set aside.
In a large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed, cream shortening and remaining 1 cup of sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla at low speed.
Alternately stir in flour mixture and water, just until blended.
Stir in dates.
recipes.text: Chocolate Date Nut Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and set aside. In a medium bowl, stir together flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; set aside. In another medium bowl, combine 1/3 cup sugar, chocolate and walnuts; set aside. In a large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed, cream shortening and remaining 1 cup of sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla at low speed. Alternately stir in flour mixture and water, just until blended. Stir in dates.

recipes.title: Almond Toffee
directions: Melt butter in large, heavy saucepan.
Add granulated sugar and salt.
Bring to boiling foam over medium-high heat, stirring constantly.
Turn heat to low; stir for 5 minutes.
Add almonds and return to medium-high heat, still stirring.
Boil until almonds split (you'll hear them pop).
Turn heat to low for another 5 minutes.
Pour into sheet pan and sprinkle chocolate bits over the hot toffee.
Allow to melt and spread evenly over all.
Sprinkle with sliced almonds.
Allow to cool completely, then turn out onto clean surface and break into pieces.
recipes.text: Almond Toffee. Melt butter in large, heavy saucepan. Add granulated sugar and salt. Bring to boiling foam over medium-high heat, stirring constantly. Turn heat to low; stir for 5 minutes. Add almonds and return to medium-high heat, still stirring. Boil until almonds split (you'll hear them pop). Turn heat to low for another 5 minutes. Pour into sheet pan and sprinkle chocolate bits over the hot toffee. Allow to melt and spread evenly over all. Sprinkle with sliced almonds. Allow to cool completely, then turn out onto clean surface and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Quick Macaroni, Beef And Tomato Meal
ingredients: chunks of American cheese or Velveeta or grated Parmesan cheese
directions: Brown meat and onion together.
Add seasonings; drain excess fat.
Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Return to pan.
Add meat-onion-seasoning mixture.
Stir in tomato soup and tomato sauce; heat well.
Mix in cheese chunks or sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top.
recipes.text: Quick Macaroni, Beef And Tomato Meal. Brown meat and onion together. Add seasonings; drain excess fat. Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Return to pan. Add meat-onion-seasoning mixture. Stir in tomato soup and tomato sauce; heat well. Mix in cheese chunks or sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, sliced or chopped
directions: Layer rice, then water chestnuts, then chicken in baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients, except cheese, and pour over layers. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Rice Casserole. Layer rice, then water chestnuts, then chicken in baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients, except cheese, and pour over layers. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 6 to 8 large Granny Smith apples, peel and slice thin
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Place sliced apples into greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with the 1/4 cup sugar.
In a bowl, mix Bisquick, 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon until crumbly.
Sprinkle mixture over fruit.
Dot the whole top with pats of butter.
Bake about 45 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Place sliced apples into greased baking dish. Sprinkle with the 1/4 cup sugar. In a bowl, mix Bisquick, 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon until crumbly. Sprinkle mixture over fruit. Dot the whole top with pats of butter. Bake about 45 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Put hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan, then cut up margarine and put on top of hash browns, then cut up cheese on top.
Mix soup and milk together and pour over top.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Cheesy Potatoes. Put hash browns in a 9 x 13-inch pan, then cut up margarine and put on top of hash browns, then cut up cheese on top. Mix soup and milk together and pour over top. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Cake
directions: Cook raisins in 2 cups water for 15 minutes.
Add 1 cup cold water, melted lard, soda, sugar, cinnamon, salt and flour; mix well.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Cake. Cook raisins in 2 cups water for 15 minutes. Add 1 cup cold water, melted lard, soda, sugar, cinnamon, salt and flour; mix well. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Mix together flour and sugar.
Bring to a rapid boil the butter, oil, water and cocoa.
Pour over flour mixture and blend well.
Stir in eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, soda and buttermilk. Pour batter into ungreased cookie sheet with narrow rim.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sheet Cake. Mix together flour and sugar. Bring to a rapid boil the butter, oil, water and cocoa. Pour over flour mixture and blend well. Stir in eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, soda and buttermilk. Pour batter into ungreased cookie sheet with narrow rim. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Cheese Cake
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese (lite or regular), softened
1 ready to use graham cracker crumb crust (6 oz. or 9-inch)
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer or blender.
Add eggs; mix well.
Pour into crust. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set.
Cool, then refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.
Then add favorite topping (cherry, pineapple, blueberry).
recipes.text: Easy Cheese Cake. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer or blender. Add eggs; mix well. Pour into crust.
