Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool, then refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Then add favorite topping (cherry, pineapple, blueberry).

recipes.title: Hamburger Roll-Ups
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Make biscuit dough (see Bisquick package). Roll out 1/4-inch thick into a rectangle, 18 x 8-inches.
Lightly brown onion in hot fat.
Stir in round steak and brown.
Mix in Bisquick, salt and pepper.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Cook until thick.
Cool. Roll up dough like jelly roll, beginning with wide side. Seal ends. Cut into 1 1/2-inch slices.
Place cut side down on greased baking sheet.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve hot with Quick Mushroom Sauce.
recipes.text: Hamburger Roll-Ups. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Make biscuit dough (see Bisquick package). Roll out 1/4-inch thick into a rectangle, 18 x 8-inches. Lightly brown onion in hot fat. Stir in round steak and brown. Mix in Bisquick, salt and pepper. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Cook until thick. Cool. Roll up dough like jelly roll, beginning with wide side. Seal ends. Cut into 1 1/2-inch slices. Place cut side down on greased baking sheet. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Serve hot with Quick Mushroom Sauce.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Pour 1/2 box of cake mix in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour in pie filling.
Lightly mix together.
Pour remaining half of cake mix on top.
Add butter pats all over top and sprinkle with pecans. Cover with foil and bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cobbler. Pour 1/2 box of cake mix in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour in pie filling. Lightly mix together. Pour remaining half of cake mix on top. Add butter pats all over top and sprinkle with pecans. Cover with foil and bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes. Uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
directions: Add sugar, oleo and flour to beaten eggs.
Beat well and stir in pineapple and coconut.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes, then at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Coconut Pie. Add sugar, oleo and flour to beaten eggs. Beat well and stir in pineapple and coconut. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 minutes, then at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chinese Meatballs
directions: Combine all ingredients, except gravy and water chestnuts. Brown, then simmer in canned mushroom gravy.
Add sliced water chestnuts.
Serve.
recipes.text: Chinese Meatballs. Combine all ingredients, except gravy and water chestnuts. Brown, then simmer in canned mushroom gravy. Add sliced water chestnuts. Serve.

recipes.title: Garden Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 or 2 green onions, finely cut up
seasoned pepper and salt to taste
directions: To chilled macaroni, add all the ingredients.
Mix well. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Garden Macaroni Salad. To chilled macaroni, add all the ingredients. Mix well. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Wild Rice
ingredients: 6 oz. Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice
6 oz. jar sliced mushrooms with juice
directions: Saute onion in margarine until translucent.
Add rice and cook lightly.
Add mushrooms and juice, consomme and water.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes.
Pour in casserole dish and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Wild Rice. Saute onion in margarine until translucent. Add rice and cook lightly. Add mushrooms and juice, consomme and water. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Pour in casserole dish and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Date Nut Loaf
directions: Combine eggs, sugar and oil.
Beat well; add dry ingredients and mix well.
Fold in dates and pecans.
Place in greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake 2 hours and 15 minutes at 300u00b0 (start cake in cool oven).
Makes 1 (3 pound) cake.
recipes.text: Date Nut Loaf. Combine eggs, sugar and oil. Beat well; add dry ingredients and mix well. Fold in dates and pecans. Place in greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake 2 hours and 15 minutes at 300u00b0 (start cake in cool oven). Makes 1 (3 pound) cake.

recipes.title: Pear Relish
directions: Grind pears using coarse blade and drain off excess juice. Grind peppers and onions.
Combine all ingredients, bring to boil and boil 20 minutes or until done.
Pack into standard canning jars and seal.
Process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Pear Relish. Grind pears using coarse blade and drain off excess juice. Grind peppers and onions. Combine all ingredients, bring to boil and boil 20 minutes or until done. Pack into standard canning jars and seal. Process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and sliced
directions: Combine jello with boiling water in large container. Stir until dissolved. Fold in all at once the berries with juice, drained pineapple, bananas and nuts. Turn half of mixture into a large bowl or casserole dish. Refrigerate until firm. Spread on layer of sour cream. Gently spoon on remainder of strawberry mixture. Refrigerate. Use 13 x 9 pan.
recipes.text: Strawberry Salad. Combine jello with boiling water in large container. Stir until dissolved. Fold in all at once the berries with juice, drained pineapple, bananas and nuts. Turn half of mixture into a large bowl or casserole dish. Refrigerate until firm. Spread on layer of sour cream. Gently spoon on remainder of strawberry mixture. Refrigerate. Use 13 x 9 pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore(6 Servings)
directions: Coat chicken pieces with flour; brown in large skillet in 1/4 cup oil.
Remove chicken; set aside.
Saute onion, green pepper and garlic in skillet until transparent.
Add tomato sauce, water, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper.
Add chicken; cover and cook over low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add mushrooms; cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes, or until sauce is at desired consistency.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore(6 Servings). Coat chicken pieces with flour; brown in large skillet in 1/4 cup oil. Remove chicken; set aside. Saute onion, green pepper and garlic in skillet until transparent. Add tomato sauce, water, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper. Add chicken; cover and cook over low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add mushrooms; cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes, or until sauce is at desired consistency.

recipes.title: Garlic Roasted Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 tsp. minced fresh garlic or garlic powder
directions: Heat oven to 425u00b0.
Cut potatoes in wedges (with jacket on). Boil 8 to 12 minutes in a saucepan.
Melt margarine (in a long baking dish); stir in remaining ingredients.
Add potatoes; coat with margarine mixture on both sides.
Bake 10 minutes; turn potatoes and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until lightly brown.
recipes.text: Garlic Roasted Potato Wedges. Heat oven to 425u00b0. Cut potatoes in wedges (with jacket on). Boil 8 to 12 minutes in a saucepan. Melt margarine (in a long baking dish); stir in remaining ingredients. Add potatoes; coat with margarine mixture on both sides. Bake 10 minutes; turn potatoes and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until lightly brown.

recipes.title: Orange Fruit Salad
directions: Dissolve jello, sugar and water.
Add pineapple.
Cool.
Stir in remaining ingredients and chill until firm.
recipes.text: Orange Fruit Salad. Dissolve jello, sugar and water. Add pineapple. Cool. Stir in remaining ingredients and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in 2 tablespoons lukewarm water.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Sift dry ingredients together in a bowl.
Cut in shortening with pastry blender until crumbly.
Add yeast to milk. Mix well.
Add to flour mixture, stirring slowly with a fork.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Dissolve yeast in 2 tablespoons lukewarm water. Let stand 5 minutes. Sift dry ingredients together in a bowl. Cut in shortening with pastry blender until crumbly. Add yeast to milk. Mix well. Add to flour mixture, stirring slowly with a fork.

recipes.title: Garlic Skillet Potatoes
ingredients: 4 large red potatoes, cut into thin wedges
directions: In a large skillet, heat oil. Add potatoes, onion and garlic powder with parsley, seasoned salt, pepper and sugar and cook, uncovered, over medium heat 25 to 30 minutes, until potatoes are tender and browned. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with steak, scrambled or omelets.
recipes.text: Garlic Skillet Potatoes. In a large skillet, heat oil. Add potatoes, onion and garlic powder with parsley, seasoned salt, pepper and sugar and cook, uncovered, over medium heat 25 to 30 minutes, until potatoes are tender and browned. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with steak, scrambled or omelets.

recipes.title: Carrot Puffs
ingredients: 1 lb. carrots, peeled and cut in 1-inch pieces
directions: Grease an 8-inch square dish.
Boil carrots in salted water, uncovered; simmer for 20 minutes or until tender.
Drain carrots. Put oleo, eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder and vanilla in blender.
Add carrots, a few at a time, and puree.
Pour into prepared baking dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
May be made day ahead of time and refrigerated.
Bring to room temperature before cooking.
recipes.text: Carrot Puffs. Grease an 8-inch square dish. Boil carrots in salted water, uncovered; simmer for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain carrots. Put oleo, eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder and vanilla in blender. Add carrots, a few at a time, and puree. Pour into prepared baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until firm. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. May be made day ahead of time and refrigerated. Bring to room temperature before cooking.

recipes.title: Tracy And Greg'S Best Blonde Brownies
directions: Combine sugars and butter in medium boiler.
Stir on low heat until butter is melted.
Cool.
Add eggs, flour, salt, vanilla and nuts.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle chocolate drops over top.
Bake about 35 minutes at 325u00b0.
Cool. Cut in squares.
Do not overbake.
Yield: 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Tracy And Greg'S Best Blonde Brownies. Combine sugars and butter in medium boiler. Stir on low heat until butter is melted. Cool. Add eggs, flour, salt, vanilla and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle chocolate drops over top. Bake about 35 minutes at 325u00b0. Cool. Cut in squares. Do not overbake. Yield: 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Blackberry Cobbler
directions: Prepare soft dough.
Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Blend in shortening until mixture resembles cornmeal. Stir in milk to make a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls of dough over hot fruit filling.
recipes.text: Blackberry Cobbler. Prepare soft dough. Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Blend in shortening until mixture resembles cornmeal. Stir in milk to make a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls of dough over hot fruit filling.

recipes.title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Mix
all
ingredients
and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: French Coconut Pie. Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Potatoes(Serves 8)
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash browns (Southern style)
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Mix together hash browns, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, cheese, onions, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup melted butter. Spread mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Combine the remaining melted butter and crushed cornflakes and top mixture evenly.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Oven Baked Potatoes(Serves 8). Mix together hash browns, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, cheese, onions, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup melted butter. Spread mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine the remaining melted butter and crushed cornflakes and top mixture evenly. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix flour, sugar and eggs.
Add vanilla, milk and salt.
Mix well, then add corn.
Put in an 8-inch square buttered dish.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 45 minutes.
(May be doubled; use a 13 x 9-inch dish!)
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Mix flour, sugar and eggs. Add vanilla, milk and salt. Mix well, then add corn. Put in an 8-inch square buttered dish. Bake at 400u00b0 for 45 minutes. (May be doubled; use a 13 x 9-inch dish!)

recipes.title: Tasti-Little B'S
directions: Brown round and sausage until well cooked.
Drain meat on paper toweling and put back into frying pan.
Add all seasonings and blend well.
Add shredded cheese and warm until all cheese has melted.
Remove from heat and place approximately 1 tablespoon meat mixture onto each party rye slice.
Place each party rye slice onto cookie sheet and broil until hot and bubbly.
Serve immediately. (These appetizers will freeze up nicely for approximately 2 to 3 weeks before broiling.)
recipes.text: Tasti-Little B'S. Brown round and sausage until well cooked. Drain meat on paper toweling and put back into frying pan. Add all seasonings and blend well. Add shredded cheese and warm until all cheese has melted. Remove from heat and place approximately 1 tablespoon meat mixture onto each party rye slice. Place each party rye slice onto cookie sheet and broil until hot and bubbly. Serve immediately. (These appetizers will freeze up nicely for approximately 2 to 3 weeks before broiling.)

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Beat eggs with milk.
Grease a deep baking dish.
Add eggs and milk mixture, corn, green pepper and chopped ham.
Season to taste.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes, or until center is firm. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Beat eggs with milk. Grease a deep baking dish. Add eggs and milk mixture, corn, green pepper and chopped ham. Season to taste. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes, or until center is firm. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: In a small bowl, mix sour cream and cream cheese.
In a glass casserole dish, layer meat, cheese, dressing, lettuce, tomatoes and jalapeno peppers, if desired.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. In a small bowl, mix sour cream and cream cheese. In a glass casserole dish, layer meat, cheese, dressing, lettuce, tomatoes and jalapeno peppers, if desired.

recipes.title: Super Duper Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter, melted with 4 oz. chocolate
directions: Melt butter with chocolate; cool.
Add sugar and vanilla and blend thoroughly.
Add eggs one at a time and beat well.
Add dry ingredients and nuts and mix thoroughly.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Form into balls the size of a walnut.
Roll in powdered sugar and bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Super Duper Cookies. Melt butter with chocolate; cool. Add sugar and vanilla and blend thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time and beat well. Add dry ingredients and nuts and mix thoroughly. Chill several hours or overnight. Form into balls the size of a walnut. Roll in powdered sugar and bake on a greased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese and sour cream.
Add package of onion soup mix.
Blend in onion, pepper and corned beef.
Let set 12 hours. (The longer it sets the better the flavor.)
recipes.text: Corned Beef Dip. Mix cream cheese and sour cream. Add package of onion soup mix. Blend in onion, pepper and corned beef. Let set 12 hours. (The longer it sets the better the flavor.)

recipes.title: French Fried Onion Rings
directions: Sift flour and salt together.
Add remaining ingredients, except onions.
Beat until smooth and well blended.
Dip onion rings into batter.
Fry in deep cooking oil (375u00b0) until golden brown.
recipes.text: French Fried Onion Rings. Sift flour and salt together. Add remaining ingredients, except onions. Beat until smooth and well blended. Dip onion rings into batter. Fry in deep cooking oil (375u00b0) until golden brown.

recipes.title: Spicy Oyster Crackers
directions: Mix together and bake in pan 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Spicy Oyster Crackers. Mix together and bake in pan 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Eggs
directions: Mix
first
3 ingredients in saucepan and cook to 250u00b0, stirring.
Beat
egg
whites
to
peaks
and
then beat in hot syrup, slowly.
Add coconut.
If it seems dry, add a few drops of water.
Drop on a greased cookie sheet,
cool
andtform in eggs. Coat with melted chocolate chips.
recipes.text: Coconut Eggs. Mix first 3 ingredients in saucepan and cook to 250u00b0, stirring. Beat egg whites to peaks and then beat in hot syrup, slowly. Add coconut. If it seems dry, add a few drops of water. Drop on a greased cookie sheet, cool andtform in eggs. Coat with melted chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Layered Spinach - Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb. spinach, torn in bite sized pieces
1 small head lettuce, torn in small pieces
directions: Layer first 8 ingredients in order listed in a large salad bowl.
Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and salad dressing mix. Mix well.
Spread over top of salad, sealing to edge of bowl. Cover tightly and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. "Yum-yum."
recipes.text: Layered Spinach - Lettuce Salad. Layer first 8 ingredients in order listed in a large salad bowl. Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and salad dressing mix. Mix well. Spread over top of salad, sealing to edge of bowl. Cover tightly and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. "Yum-yum."

recipes.title: Chicken Tandoori
directions: Mix all ingredients and spread over chicken.
Marinate at least 12 hours.
Bake for 45 minutes at 425u00b0. Also may be cooked on an outdoor grill.
recipes.text: Chicken Tandoori. Mix all ingredients and spread over chicken. Marinate at least 12 hours. Bake for 45 minutes at 425u00b0. Also may be cooked on an outdoor grill.

recipes.title: Hearty Chicken Bake(This Recipe Aims To Please!)
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, drained and thawed
1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
In medium bowl, combine mashed potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions; mix thoroughly.
Spoon potato mixture into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Spread potatoes across bottom and up sides to form shell.
recipes.text: Hearty Chicken Bake(This Recipe Aims To Please!). Preheat oven to 375u00b0. In medium bowl, combine mashed potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can French fried onions; mix thoroughly. Spoon potato mixture into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spread potatoes across bottom and up sides to form shell.

recipes.title: Tomato Refresher
directions: Mix all ingredients except ice.
Serve over ice.
Garnish each serving with celery stick if desired.
Makes 6 servings (about 1 cup each).
recipes.text: Tomato Refresher. Mix all ingredients except ice. Serve over ice. Garnish each serving with celery stick if desired. Makes 6 servings (about 1 cup each).

recipes.title: Banana Burritos
ingredients: whipped cream and toasted pecans or fresh berries
directions: Peel and cut bananas in half lengthwise.
Brush with lime juice.
Set aside.
In dry medium skillet, soften tortillas one at a time over medium heat, by turning over 2 to 3 times until warm and limp.
Keep warm.
Spread 1 tablespoon apricot preserves over each tortilla.
Place a banana half across lower third of tortilla.
Sprinkle with cinnamon; roll up.
Lay seam side down on plate.
In heavy skillet, heat oil and butter over medium heat. Put tortillas in hot oil.
Brown lightly.
Serve with dollop of whipped cream and nuts or berries.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Banana Burritos. Peel and cut bananas in half lengthwise. Brush with lime juice. Set aside. In dry medium skillet, soften tortillas one at a time over medium heat, by turning over 2 to 3 times until warm and limp. Keep warm. Spread 1 tablespoon apricot preserves over each tortilla. Place a banana half across lower third of tortilla. Sprinkle with cinnamon; roll up. Lay seam side down on plate. In heavy skillet, heat oil and butter over medium heat. Put tortillas in hot oil. Brown lightly. Serve with dollop of whipped cream and nuts or berries. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cherry Crunch
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 5 oz.) can cherry pie filling
1 pkg. Duncan Hines white deluxe cake mix
1/2 c. (1 stick) melted butter or margarine
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan.
Sprinkle with lemon juice.
Combine dry cake mix, nuts and melted butter (mixture will be crumbly).
Sprinkle mixture over pie filling.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cherry Crunch. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Spread pie filling in bottom of 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry cake mix, nuts and melted butter (mixture will be crumbly). Sprinkle mixture over pie filling. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour in baking dish. Refrigerate until jello sets.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Pour in baking dish. Refrigerate until jello sets.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Cream 3/4 cup sugar and butter.
Add egg and vanilla.
Stir in mixture of flour, salt, baking soda and cream of tartar.
In another bowl, combine 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon.
Chill dough to form balls easily.
Shape dough in 1-inch balls and roll in sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles. Cream 3/4 cup sugar and butter. Add egg and vanilla. Stir in mixture of flour, salt, baking soda and cream of tartar. In another bowl, combine 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Chill dough to form balls easily. Shape dough in 1-inch balls and roll in sugar-cinnamon mixture. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Shirley'S Pizza Soup(Makes 4 Servings)
directions: In saucepan, heat oil and stir-fry onions, green pepper and mushrooms until soft, not browned.
Add tomatoes (squished up a little so they are not whole, but bite sized chunks), beef broth, pepperoni and basil.
Cook until heated through.
Ladle into 4 ovenproof bowls.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
Broil until cheese is bubbly or microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Aunt Shirley'S Pizza Soup(Makes 4 Servings). In saucepan, heat oil and stir-fry onions, green pepper and mushrooms until soft, not browned. Add tomatoes (squished up a little so they are not whole, but bite sized chunks), beef broth, pepperoni and basil. Cook until heated through. Ladle into 4 ovenproof bowls. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Broil until cheese is bubbly or microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mint Meltaways(Candy)
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. hot water or warm cream
directions: Melt butter; add water.
Drop flavoring into mixture plus coloring.
Pour over sugar.
Press in molds.
Let stand 24 hours in open air to set.
recipes.text: Mint Meltaways(Candy). Melt butter; add water. Drop flavoring into mixture plus coloring. Pour over sugar. Press in molds. Let stand 24 hours in open air to set.

recipes.title: Best Ever Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients well.
Store in airtight containers. Use all of it this winter.
Will taste "yucky" next season.
recipes.text: Best Ever Hot Chocolate Mix. Combine all ingredients well. Store in airtight containers. Use all of it this winter. Will taste "yucky" next season.

recipes.title: Dirt Pudding
directions: Mix cream cheese, butter & confectioners sugar on low speed. Add cool whip and pudding.
Gradually pour in milk while blending. Add vanilla and continue to blend until pudding is smooth.
Crush cookies.
Layer cookies and pudding in bowl.
Top with remaining oreos.
Add flowers, gummy worms, etc. for decorations.
Serve chilled.
recipes.text: Dirt Pudding. Mix cream cheese, butter & confectioners sugar on low speed. Add cool whip and pudding. Gradually pour in milk while blending. Add vanilla and continue to blend until pudding is smooth. Crush cookies. Layer cookies and pudding in bowl. Top with remaining oreos. Add flowers, gummy worms, etc. for decorations. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Stew
directions: Put all ingredients in crock-pot, cook on low for 3 to 4 hours.
Cook on high for 1 to 2 hours more.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Stew. Put all ingredients in crock-pot, cook on low for 3 to 4 hours. Cook on high for 1 to 2 hours more. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Meringue Nest With Raspberry Sorbet
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. cream of tartar (add to egg whites)
directions: Whip first 4 ingredients together gradually adding in sugar. Beat with mixer until stiff peaks form.
Using an ice cream scoop, place meringue balls 1 inch apart on parchment paper on cookie sheet.
Using the back of ice cream scoop, make an indent, making the meringue resemble nests.
Bake in 275u00b0 oven for 1 hour.
Turn off oven and let dry in oven.
Serve nest with one scoop of raspberry sherbet in nest with fresh fruit sprinkled over.
recipes.text: Meringue Nest With Raspberry Sorbet. Whip first 4 ingredients together gradually adding in sugar. Beat with mixer until stiff peaks form. Using an ice cream scoop, place meringue balls 1 inch apart on parchment paper on cookie sheet. Using the back of ice cream scoop, make an indent, making the meringue resemble nests. Bake in 275u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Turn off oven and let dry in oven. Serve nest with one scoop of raspberry sherbet in nest with fresh fruit sprinkled over.

recipes.title: Biscuit Pudding
directions: One 10 count can biscuits baked according to package directions and crumbled may be used for crumbled biscuits.
recipes.text: Biscuit Pudding. One 10 count can biscuits baked according to package directions and crumbled may be used for crumbled biscuits.

recipes.title: Tomato-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans tomato soup (3 makes it moister)
directions: Fry hamburger and drain.
Slice potatoes.
Take potatoes and "layer" them on a buttered roaster or casserole dish; cover the bottom of the pan with potatoes.
Next, put some of the hamburger on top of the potatoes.
Take some of the diced onion and sprinkle over the hamburger.
Next, take some "uncooked" Minute rice and sprinkle over the onions.
Repeat this process again.
Should have 2 layers of each now.
Pour the tomato soup over all and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or so.
If potatoes are done when poked, then remove and enjoy.
Great with lettuce salad and bread.
Very filling.
To insure against any burning, add also 1 to 1 1/2 cans of cold water on top of tomato soup.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Tomato-Rice Casserole. Fry hamburger and drain. Slice potatoes. Take potatoes and "layer" them on a buttered roaster or casserole dish; cover the bottom of the pan with potatoes. Next, put some of the hamburger on top of the potatoes. Take some of the diced onion and sprinkle over the hamburger. Next, take some "uncooked" Minute rice and sprinkle over the onions. Repeat this process again. Should have 2 layers of each now. Pour the tomato soup over all and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or so. If potatoes are done when poked, then remove and enjoy. Great with lettuce salad and bread. Very filling. To insure against any burning, add also 1 to 1 1/2 cans of cold water on top of tomato soup. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. Hidden Valley Ranch milk recipe original Ranch salad dressing mix (dry mix)
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients.
Spread mixture on bread slices. Broil until puffed and golden (about 3 to 4 minutes).
Great served with salad or soup.
recipes.text: Hidden Valley Ranch Cheese Puffs. Mix the first 3 ingredients. Spread mixture on bread slices. Broil until puffed and golden (about 3 to 4 minutes). Great served with salad or soup.

recipes.title: Double-Quick Rolls
directions: In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water.
Stir in sugar, half of the flour and salt.
Beat until smooth.
Add egg and shortening.
Beat in rest of flour until smooth.
Scrape down sides; cover.
Let rise in warm place about 30 minutes.
Stir down batter; spoon into 12 greased, large muffin cups, filling half full.
Let rise in warm place until dough reaches top.
Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12.
recipes.text: Double-Quick Rolls. In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water. Stir in sugar, half of the flour and salt. Beat until smooth. Add egg and shortening. Beat in rest of flour until smooth. Scrape down sides; cover. Let rise in warm place about 30 minutes. Stir down batter; spoon into 12 greased, large muffin cups, filling half full. Let rise in warm place until dough reaches top. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Bread
directions: Soften the yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.
In a large bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups boiling water, oats, molasses, shortening and salt.
Cool a few minutes.
Stir in 2 cups flour; add eggs and beat well.
Stir in yeast; beat well.
Add remaining flour.
Mix until smooth.
Grease top lightly.
Cover and put in refrigerator 2 hours.
Turn out on well floured surface; shape into 2 loaves. Place in greased pans.
Cover; let rise in warm place about 2 hours.
Bake at 375u00b0 for about 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Bread. Soften the yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. In a large bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups boiling water, oats, molasses, shortening and salt. Cool a few minutes. Stir in 2 cups flour; add eggs and beat well. Stir in yeast; beat well. Add remaining flour. Mix until smooth. Grease top lightly. Cover and put in refrigerator 2 hours. Turn out on well floured surface; shape into 2 loaves. Place in greased pans. Cover; let rise in warm place about 2 hours. Bake at 375u00b0 for about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Syrian Rice
directions: *Can be found in pasta section of grocery.
recipes.text: Syrian Rice. *Can be found in pasta section of grocery.

recipes.title: Tuna Burgers
directions: Mix tuna and soup together.
Season with salt and pepper. Spread on bread to make a sandwich.
Toast sandwich on both sides in the oven.
recipes.text: Tuna Burgers. Mix tuna and soup together. Season with salt and pepper. Spread on bread to make a sandwich. Toast sandwich on both sides in the oven.

recipes.title: Tomato Parmesan Dressing
directions: Blend all in blender.
Makes 3/4 cup, or 10 calories per tablespoon.
recipes.text: Tomato Parmesan Dressing. Blend all in blender. Makes 3/4 cup, or 10 calories per tablespoon.

recipes.title: Shrimp Salad Delight
directions: Chop shrimp into small pieces. Chop onion into fine pieces. Combine all ingredients together. Chill.
recipes.text: Shrimp Salad Delight. Chop shrimp into small pieces. Chop onion into fine pieces. Combine all ingredients together. Chill.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute broccoli and onion in butter on low heat.
Add Cheez Whiz and soup; stir until mixed.
Add rice.
Add mushrooms.
Put in a casserole dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Saute broccoli and onion in butter on low heat. Add Cheez Whiz and soup; stir until mixed. Add rice. Add mushrooms. Put in a casserole dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
directions: Cook bacon in a 9-inch cast-iron frying pan until crisp. Remove bacon; crumble and set aside.
Drain and save drippings. Put 1 teaspoon back in pan and set in oven at 400u00b0 while mixing other ingredients.
Beat eggs in large mixing bowl; stir in milk, 3 tablespoons drippings, meal and all other ingredients, including bacon chips.
Remove the pan from oven; pour batter in pan and put a tablespoon of the bacon drippings over top.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 minutes or until brown.
If you don't want this hot, omit 1 pepper.
recipes.text: Jalapeno Corn Bread. Cook bacon in a 9-inch cast-iron frying pan until crisp. Remove bacon; crumble and set aside. Drain and save drippings. Put 1 teaspoon back in pan and set in oven at 400u00b0 while mixing other ingredients. Beat eggs in large mixing bowl; stir in milk, 3 tablespoons drippings, meal and all other ingredients, including bacon chips. Remove the pan from oven; pour batter in pan and put a tablespoon of the bacon drippings over top. Bake at 400u00b0 for 35 minutes or until brown. If you don't want this hot, omit 1 pepper.

recipes.title: No Bake Caramel Cookies
directions: Put caramels in top of double boiler with 4 tablespoons milk; melt and let cool slightly, then add Rice Krispies, coconut and chopped nuts.
Mix well; roll into balls, flatten and roll in powdered sugar.
recipes.text: No Bake Caramel Cookies. Put caramels in top of double boiler with 4 tablespoons milk; melt and let cool slightly, then add Rice Krispies, coconut and chopped nuts. Mix well; roll into balls, flatten and roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: A Meal-In-One Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans soup (Cheddar cheese, celery or onion)
directions: Place meat in bottom of casserole dish.
Thinly slice onion and pepper and place on top of meat.
Spread undiluted soup on top of pepper.
Add potato tots to cover top.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: A Meal-In-One Casserole. Place meat in bottom of casserole dish. Thinly slice onion and pepper and place on top of meat. Spread undiluted soup on top of pepper. Add potato tots to cover top. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Truffles
directions: Put the cheese, chopped nuts, confectioners sugar and cocoa powder in the mixing bowl; stir until everything is well mixed. Now roll the mixture in the palms of your hands.
You can make them bigger if you like.
Spread the sprinkles on the work surface and carefully roll the truffles in them.
Then put each one in a paper candy cup.
recipes.text: Chocolate Truffles. Put the cheese, chopped nuts, confectioners sugar and cocoa powder in the mixing bowl; stir until everything is well mixed. Now roll the mixture in the palms of your hands. You can make them bigger if you like. Spread the sprinkles on the work surface and carefully roll the truffles in them. Then put each one in a paper candy cup.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Cut up and boil chicken until tender.
Stir in cream of chicken soup and turmeric and cook about 5 or 10 more minutes. Put flour in bowl and make a hole in center.
Stir in water slowly until 2/3 of flour is mixed in a heavy ball, then make 3 balls and roll each out on a floured board and cut into dumplings.
Turn fire on low and drop dumplings in; cook only 5 or 6 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dumplings. Cut up and boil chicken until tender. Stir in cream of chicken soup and turmeric and cook about 5 or 10 more minutes. Put flour in bowl and make a hole in center. Stir in water slowly until 2/3 of flour is mixed in a heavy ball, then make 3 balls and roll each out on a floured board and cut into dumplings. Turn fire on low and drop dumplings in; cook only 5 or 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Cole Slaw
directions: Bring salad oil, sugar and vinegar to a boil and while hot, pour over cabbage mixture.
Do not stir until cold.
Cover and put in refrigerator.
Keeps for days.
recipes.text: Swedish Cole Slaw. Bring salad oil, sugar and vinegar to a boil and while hot, pour over cabbage mixture. Do not stir until cold. Cover and put in refrigerator. Keeps for days.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1/4 c. Kraft creamy Italian dressing with sour cream
directions: Have cream cheese at room temperature.
Cut chipped beef into small pieces and mix into softened cheese.
Add dressing and stir well.
Form into a ball and roll into chopped pecans, until covered.
Refrigerate until set before serving.
Serve with your favorite crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Have cream cheese at room temperature. Cut chipped beef into small pieces and mix into softened cheese. Add dressing and stir well. Form into a ball and roll into chopped pecans, until covered. Refrigerate until set before serving. Serve with your favorite crackers.

recipes.title: Pecan  Tarts
directions: Cream margarine and cream cheese; add flour. Blend and refrigerate for about 1 hour. Shape into small tart pans like crust. Mix egg, brown sugar and salt. Spoon into tart crust. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Can freeze.
recipes.text: Pecan  Tarts. Cream margarine and cream cheese; add flour. Blend and refrigerate for about 1 hour. Shape into small tart pans like crust. Mix egg, brown sugar and salt. Spoon into tart crust. Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Can freeze.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Boys
directions: Cream shortening and sugar, add molasses and egg; mix.
Sift dry ingredients and add to mix.
Chill dough.
Roll out and cut with cookie cutters.
Bake at 350 degrees for 8 - 10 minutes or until done.
Cool and frost.
recipes.text: Gingerbread Boys. Cream shortening and sugar, add molasses and egg; mix. Sift dry ingredients and add to mix. Chill dough. Roll out and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 - 10 minutes or until done. Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix sugar, baking powder and flour.
Add eggs and beat well. Add balance of ingredients.
Pour into pastry shells and bake at 375u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Mix sugar, baking powder and flour. Add eggs and beat well. Add balance of ingredients. Pour into pastry shells and bake at 375u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sourdough Biscuits
directions: Combine yeast and water.
Stir until yeast is completely dissolved.
Add remaining ingredients.
Beat until well blended. Turn out onto a well-floured board.
Knead 10 minutes or until elastic and smooth.
Place in a greased bowl.
Refrigerate until needed.
(Keeps for a week.)
To bake, roll out, cut and place in a preheated 450u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Sourdough Biscuits. Combine yeast and water. Stir until yeast is completely dissolved. Add remaining ingredients. Beat until well blended. Turn out onto a well-floured board. Knead 10 minutes or until elastic and smooth. Place in a greased bowl. Refrigerate until needed. (Keeps for a week.) To bake, roll out, cut and place in a preheated 450u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: In 3-quart container, heat olive oil.
Saute onion and green pepper.
Set aside.
Brown meat; drain and add to onion mixture. Mix thoroughly.
Crush tomatoes.
Remove pulp.
Add to mixture. Add tomato paste, water and all seasonings.
Bring to slow boil. Be careful not to burn.
Lower heat and allow to cook down about 1-inch from top of container or until sauce thickens to your liking.
Makes about 6 cups.
Serve over hot pasta.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. In 3-quart container, heat olive oil. Saute onion and green pepper. Set aside. Brown meat; drain and add to onion mixture. Mix thoroughly. Crush tomatoes. Remove pulp. Add to mixture. Add tomato paste, water and all seasonings. Bring to slow boil. Be careful not to burn. Lower heat and allow to cook down about 1-inch from top of container or until sauce thickens to your liking. Makes about 6 cups. Serve over hot pasta.

recipes.title: Frozen Fudge Delight
directions: Crumble cookies and put in pie plate.
Mix in butter and press down.
Freeze for about 30 minutes.
Mix ice cream for about 20 seconds.
Mix peanut butter and Heath bar into ice cream.
Put on cookie sheet. Freeze for about 4 hours.
recipes.text: Frozen Fudge Delight. Crumble cookies and put in pie plate. Mix in butter and press down. Freeze for about 30 minutes. Mix ice cream for about 20 seconds. Mix peanut butter and Heath bar into ice cream. Put on cookie sheet. Freeze for about 4 hours.

recipes.title: Easy Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen Southern-style hash browns
1/2 c. chopped red or green bell pepper
directions: Add potatoes to 1-quart of boiling water; return to a boil. Cover.
Cook 2 minutes or until tender; drain.
Add remaining ingredients to potatoes; mix well.
Season to taste.
Refrigerate. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Potato Salad. Add potatoes to 1-quart of boiling water; return to a boil. Cover. Cook 2 minutes or until tender; drain. Add remaining ingredients to potatoes; mix well. Season to taste. Refrigerate. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chips And Chetchup
directions: Put chips on plate.
Squirt ketchup on plate but be sure not to let the two touch.
Dip chips in Chetchup and eat.
recipes.text: Chips And Chetchup. Put chips on plate. Squirt ketchup on plate but be sure not to let the two touch. Dip chips in Chetchup and eat.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Sift together flour, soda, sugar, cocoa and salt.
Blend together water and mayonnaise.
Mix liquid into dry ingredients gradually, beating until smooth.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mayonnaise Cake. Sift together flour, soda, sugar, cocoa and salt. Blend together water and mayonnaise. Mix liquid into dry ingredients gradually, beating until smooth. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Brown the hamburger in a 2-quart or bigger cooking pot. Halfway through the browning process, add the diced onion, salt and pepper to taste and 1 to 2 tablespoons of chili powder.
Drain if needed.
Add the cans of kidney beans, juice and all.
Add tomato juice.
Cook on medium heat until it starts to boil.
Stir often.
Turn down to low heat and simmer for at least 1 hour.
You can add more chili powder if you like it hotter.
This is always better the next day.
recipes.text: Chili. Brown the hamburger in a 2-quart or bigger cooking pot. Halfway through the browning process, add the diced onion, salt and pepper to taste and 1 to 2 tablespoons of chili powder. Drain if needed. Add the cans of kidney beans, juice and all. Add tomato juice. Cook on medium heat until it starts to boil. Stir often. Turn down to low heat and simmer for at least 1 hour. You can add more chili powder if you like it hotter. This is always better the next day.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sauce
directions: Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat.
Add cocoa and mix well.
Add one can of sweetened condensed milk and cook over very low heat, stirring constantly.
May store in refrigerator for several weeks.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sauce. Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat. Add cocoa and mix well. Add one can of sweetened condensed milk and cook over very low heat, stirring constantly. May store in refrigerator for several weeks.

recipes.title: Chinese Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Melt chips and peanut butter in top of double boiler over hot water.
Remove from heat and stir in noodles and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chinese Peanut Butter Candy. Melt chips and peanut butter in top of double boiler over hot water. Remove from heat and stir in noodles and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. onion flakes or 1 small onion
directions: Stuff the green pepper with the tuna mixture and place in shallow baking dish.
Pour the 1/2 cup tomato juice over the stuffed pepper.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Stuff the green pepper with the tuna mixture and place in shallow baking dish. Pour the 1/2 cup tomato juice over the stuffed pepper. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pear Relish
directions: Grind pears, peppers and onions. Mix vinegar, sugar, spices and teaspoon of salt. Mix all together; bring to boil for 30 minutes. Put in clean jars while still hot.
recipes.text: Pear Relish. Grind pears, peppers and onions. Mix vinegar, sugar, spices and teaspoon of salt. Mix all together; bring to boil for 30 minutes. Put in clean jars while still hot.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Rice Krispies
directions: Heat
to boil the sugar and syrup.
Mix all ingredients and pat into two 9 x 13-inch pans.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Rice Krispies. Heat to boil the sugar and syrup. Mix all ingredients and pat into two 9 x 13-inch pans.

recipes.title: Beef Brisket
directions: Using at least a tablespoon of each salt, rub into both sides of roast.
Place meat in heavy plastic Ziploc bag.
Pour half bottle of liquid smoke; Ziploc it.
Keep turned at least 4 times during 24 hour period.
Refrigerate during 24 hours.
Drain meat, place in baking dish pouring approximately 1/4 bottle Worcestershire sauce over meat.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 5 hours.
Slice diagonally to serve.
recipes.text: Beef Brisket. Using at least a tablespoon of each salt, rub into both sides of roast. Place meat in heavy plastic Ziploc bag. Pour half bottle of liquid smoke; Ziploc it. Keep turned at least 4 times during 24 hour period. Refrigerate during 24 hours. Drain meat, place in baking dish pouring approximately 1/4 bottle Worcestershire sauce over meat. Cover with foil. Bake at 275u00b0 for 5 hours. Slice diagonally to serve.

recipes.title: Apricot Nectar Cake
directions: Mix sugar and oil, add eggs one at a time, beat well after each. Add cake mix and nectar. Cook at 325u00b0 for 1 hour in greased stem pan. When cake cools turn out on plate and add the following glaze; 1/3 c. lemon juice, 1 1/2 - 2 c. powdered sugar. Heat until smooth and pour over cake while hot. Prick cake with fork before pouring glaze on cake.
recipes.text: Apricot Nectar Cake. Mix sugar and oil, add eggs one at a time, beat well after each. Add cake mix and nectar. Cook at 325u00b0 for 1 hour in greased stem pan. When cake cools turn out on plate and add the following glaze; 1/3 c. lemon juice, 1 1/2 - 2 c. powdered sugar. Heat until smooth and pour over cake while hot. Prick cake with fork before pouring glaze on cake.

recipes.title: Baby Ruth Drop Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 Baby Ruth bars (large), cut into small pieces
directions: Cream butter and sugar until smooth.
Beat in eggs.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Chill.
Drop by half teaspoons on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Baby Ruth Drop Cookies. Cream butter and sugar until smooth. Beat in eggs. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill. Drop by half teaspoons on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Kielbasa
directions: Mix ingredients and simmer 1 hour.
recipes.text: Kielbasa. Mix ingredients and simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Purple Cow Salad
directions: Drain juice from fruit; add enough water to juice to make 2 cups.
Heat this mixture and dissolve the Jell-O in the mixture. Add 1 cup of cold water; let stand in refrigerator until syrupy. Save out 1/2 cup.
Add fruit to the rest and let set until firm. Whip 1 package of Dream Whip; add to the 1/2 cup of reserved Jell-O.
Spread on top of salad.
Sprinkle with nuts.
recipes.text: Purple Cow Salad. Drain juice from fruit; add enough water to juice to make 2 cups. Heat this mixture and dissolve the Jell-O in the mixture. Add 1 cup of cold water; let stand in refrigerator until syrupy. Save out 1/2 cup. Add fruit to the rest and let set until firm. Whip 1 package of Dream Whip; add to the 1/2 cup of reserved Jell-O. Spread on top of salad. Sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Fat-Free White Sauce
directions: Bring milk and salt to boil.
Add the cream of rice and stir 1 minute.
Remove from heat, cover and let stand 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
recipes.text: Fat-Free White Sauce. Bring milk and salt to boil. Add the cream of rice and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 5 minutes. Blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Chinese Green Beans
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. each soy sauce and water
1 tsp. each cornstarch and brown sugar
1 tsp. each minced garlic and ginger root
directions: Place beans in a large pot and steam 6 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Cool under running water; drain.
Mix soy sauce, water, cornstarch, sugar, sesame oil and red pepper in bowl until blended.
Heat oil in pot or wok.
Add beans and stir-fry 3 minutes or until beans are very hot and begin to char in spots. Add garlic and ginger root.
Continue stir-frying several minutes more.
Pour in soy sauce mixture.
Toss beans constantly until evenly coated and glazed.
recipes.text: Chinese Green Beans. Place beans in a large pot and steam 6 minutes or until crisp-tender. Cool under running water; drain. Mix soy sauce, water, cornstarch, sugar, sesame oil and red pepper in bowl until blended. Heat oil in pot or wok. Add beans and stir-fry 3 minutes or until beans are very hot and begin to char in spots. Add garlic and ginger root. Continue stir-frying several minutes more. Pour in soy sauce mixture. Toss beans constantly until evenly coated and glazed.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa well.
Add milk and bring to a boil.
Turn heat to low and let simmer until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat and cool slightly.
Add butter or margarine and vanilla.
Beat until thick.
Pour in buttered pan. Let cool.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge. Mix sugar and cocoa well. Add milk and bring to a boil. Turn heat to low and let simmer until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Add butter or margarine and vanilla. Beat until thick. Pour in buttered pan. Let cool. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Spanish Pork Chops
directions: Mix water, vinegar and sugar until dissolved.
Place pork chops in baking dish.
Pour mix over chops.
Add 1 tablespoon ketchup on each chop.
Add onion slices on each chop.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Spanish Pork Chops. Mix water, vinegar and sugar until dissolved. Place pork chops in baking dish. Pour mix over chops. Add 1 tablespoon ketchup on each chop. Add onion slices on each chop. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Buttons And Bowknots
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Cut shortening into flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, baking powder, nutmeg, salt and cinnamon until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Stir in egg and just enough milk so dough leaves sides of bowl.
Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead lightly 10 times.
Roll 1/2-inch thick.
Cut with floured doughnut cutter.
Hold opposite end of each ring and twist to form figure 8.
Place bowknots and buttons (holes) on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Dip into margarine, then into sugar.
recipes.text: Buttons And Bowknots. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Cut shortening into flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, baking powder, nutmeg, salt and cinnamon until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in egg and just enough milk so dough leaves sides of bowl. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Knead lightly 10 times. Roll 1/2-inch thick. Cut with floured doughnut cutter. Hold opposite end of each ring and twist to form figure 8. Place bowknots and buttons (holes) on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Dip into margarine, then into sugar.

recipes.title: Quick Southwestern Pizza
directions: Move oven rack to lowest position.
Heat oven to 450u00b0.
Grease cookie sheet or 12-inch pizza pan.
Mix baking mix and water; beat vigorously for 20 strokes.
Turn onto floured surface; knead about 60 times or until no longer sticky.
Press onto pan.
Mix chicken and salsa.
Sprinkle crust with 1 cup cheese.
Top with onion, chicken mixture and pepper.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until crust is brown and cheese is bubbly.
recipes.text: Quick Southwestern Pizza. Move oven rack to lowest position. Heat oven to 450u00b0. Grease cookie sheet or 12-inch pizza pan. Mix baking mix and water; beat vigorously for 20 strokes. Turn onto floured surface; knead about 60 times or until no longer sticky. Press onto pan. Mix chicken and salsa. Sprinkle crust with 1 cup cheese. Top with onion, chicken mixture and pepper. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until crust is brown and cheese is bubbly.

recipes.title: Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. lemon jello, prepared with 1 c. boiling water and cooled
directions: Crust:
Combine graham cracker crumbs, 2 tablespoons sugar, cinnamon and margarine into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Cheesecake. Crust: Combine graham cracker crumbs, 2 tablespoons sugar, cinnamon and margarine into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Petite Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can refrigerated quick crescent rolls
directions: Separate dough into 4 rectangles; firmly press perforations to seal.
Spread with cream cheese.
Sprinkle with ham, pressing lightly.
Roll up, starting at short end.
Seal edges.
Cut each roll into four slices.
Place, cut side down, on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten slightly.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Petite Pinwheels. Separate dough into 4 rectangles; firmly press perforations to seal. Spread with cream cheese. Sprinkle with ham, pressing lightly. Roll up, starting at short end. Seal edges. Cut each roll into four slices. Place, cut side down, on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten slightly. Bake at 375u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Toasted Almond Party Spread
directions: Combine and mix well.
Spread in 9-inch pie or quiche dish. Bake 15 minutes.
Stir after 8 minutes.
Garnish with additional almonds.
Serve with crackers.
Heat oven to 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Toasted Almond Party Spread. Combine and mix well. Spread in 9-inch pie or quiche dish. Bake 15 minutes. Stir after 8 minutes. Garnish with additional almonds. Serve with crackers. Heat oven to 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Cook butter, salt, brown sugar and 1/2 cup white corn syrup until butter is melted.
Boil 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; add 1/4 teaspoon vanilla.
Beat well.
Add 1/2 teaspoon soda.
Beat well.
Pour over corn in large bowl; mix well.
Add pecans or peanuts.
Spread this on 2 cookie sheets. Bake at 250u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Stir every 15 minutes to coat popcorn.
May be frozen if any leftover.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Cook butter, salt, brown sugar and 1/2 cup white corn syrup until butter is melted. Boil 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; add 1/4 teaspoon vanilla. Beat well. Add 1/2 teaspoon soda. Beat well. Pour over corn in large bowl; mix well. Add pecans or peanuts. Spread this on 2 cookie sheets. Bake at 250u00b0 for 45 minutes. Stir every 15 minutes to coat popcorn. May be frozen if any leftover.

recipes.title: English Monkey
directions: Soak crumbs in scalded milk for a minute or two.
Over low heat, stir in salt and cheese.
Heat and stir until melted. Remove from heat and stir in egg.
Return to heat and stir 1 minute.
Serves 2 or 3.
Good with crackers.
Kids like this for lunch.
recipes.text: English Monkey. Soak crumbs in scalded milk for a minute or two. Over low heat, stir in salt and cheese. Heat and stir until melted. Remove from heat and stir in egg. Return to heat and stir 1 minute. Serves 2 or 3. Good with crackers. Kids like this for lunch.

recipes.title: No-Peek Skillet Chicken
ingredients: 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can whole peeled tomatoes, undrained and chopped
directions: In 12-inch skillet, heat oil over medium high; brown chicken. Drain.
Stir in tomatoes, mushrooms and garlic.
Combine with soup mix.
Reduce heat to low and simmer 45 minutes.
Serve over hot noodles.
recipes.text: No-Peek Skillet Chicken. In 12-inch skillet, heat oil over medium high; brown chicken. Drain. Stir in tomatoes, mushrooms and garlic. Combine with soup mix. Reduce heat to low and simmer 45 minutes. Serve over hot noodles.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
directions: Make cake according to package.
Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. While cake bakes, put pineapple and sugar in saucepan.
Bring to boil and boil gently until it thickens a little, about 5 minutes. When cake is baked, immediately pour pineapple mixture over cake. Make up vanilla pudding according to package directions.
Cool cake.
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Cake. Make cake according to package. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. While cake bakes, put pineapple and sugar in saucepan. Bring to boil and boil gently until it thickens a little, about 5 minutes. When cake is baked, immediately pour pineapple mixture over cake. Make up vanilla pudding according to package directions. Cool cake.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice With Beef
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. oregano, chili powder and pepper
directions: Heat butter in frying pan over medium heat.
Add rice and saute along with onion and garlic until golden. Add meat and cook, stirring, until meat is browned and crumbly.
Add tomatoes and then liquid, mushroom sauce, tomato sauce, mushrooms and their liquid, oregano, chili powder, pepper and salt.
Mix well.
Cover and simmer over low heat, stirring once or twice for 1 hour or until rice is tender.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice With Beef. Heat butter in frying pan over medium heat. Add rice and saute along with onion and garlic until golden. Add meat and cook, stirring, until meat is browned and crumbly. Add tomatoes and then liquid, mushroom sauce, tomato sauce, mushrooms and their liquid, oregano, chili powder, pepper and salt. Mix well. Cover and simmer over low heat, stirring once or twice for 1 hour or until rice is tender. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
ingredients: 2/3 to 3/4 c. sugar (larger amount for tart apples)
directions: Sift flour and salt.
Cut shortening in mixture the size of small peas.
Add ice water; mix until a small ball.
Roll on floured board.
Bake at 450u00b0 for 15 minutes, then turn down to 325u00b0 for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Sift flour and salt. Cut shortening in mixture the size of small peas. Add ice water; mix until a small ball. Roll on floured board. Bake at 450u00b0 for 15 minutes, then turn down to 325u00b0 for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Nut Torte
directions: Beat the eggs.
Add nuts, sugar and bread crumbs.
Place in desired greased pan and bake for 45 minutes in a hot oven at 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Nut Torte. Beat the eggs. Add nuts, sugar and bread crumbs. Place in desired greased pan and bake for 45 minutes in a hot oven at 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad #2
directions: Dice or slice celery, onion and pepper.
Place in layers in mixing bowl.
Sprinkle salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste.
Mix sugar, vinegar and oil together.
Pour over vegetables and let stand overnight in refrigerator.
Stir gently the next morning. This will keep several weeks in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad #2. Dice or slice celery, onion and pepper. Place in layers in mixing bowl. Sprinkle salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste. Mix sugar, vinegar and oil together. Pour over vegetables and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Stir gently the next morning. This will keep several weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Fruit Shake
ingredients: 1 whole banana, peeled, cut into about 8 pieces and freeze the night before
directions: Put all ingredients in blender and mix until fully blended. This refreshing breakfast shake can be made with bananas, strawberries, peaches, cantaloupe or just about any fruit that you enjoy.
Be sure to freeze fruit the night before.
recipes.text: Fruit Shake. Put all ingredients in blender and mix until fully blended. This refreshing breakfast shake can be made with bananas, strawberries, peaches, cantaloupe or just about any fruit that you enjoy. Be sure to freeze fruit the night before.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Cook broccoli in microwave for 5 minutes.
Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch pan and mix with other ingredients.
Pour back into pan and bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown.
Be sure and grease pan well.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cornbread. Cook broccoli in microwave for 5 minutes. Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch pan and mix with other ingredients. Pour back into pan and bake at 400u00b0 for 30 minutes or until brown. Be sure and grease pan well.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients. Beat eggs. Add sugar, vanilla and oil.
Mix well.
Stir in grated zucchini. Add dry ingredients and blend. Stir in nuts. Bake in two greased loaf pans, 9 1/2 x 5 1/2-inch, at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Sift together dry ingredients. Beat eggs. Add sugar, vanilla and oil. Mix well. Stir in grated zucchini. Add dry ingredients and blend. Stir in nuts. Bake in two greased loaf pans, 9 1/2 x 5 1/2-inch, at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix chicken and cheese.
Place this mixture on crescent dinner rolls and roll up.
Arrange in casserole.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix chicken and cheese. Place this mixture on crescent dinner rolls and roll up. Arrange in casserole.

recipes.title: Seashell Salad
directions: Cook pasta till tender, drain, and cool.
Add cucumbers, onion, green pepper and pimentos, in large bowl.
In medium bowl mix soup sugar, oil, vinegar.
Pour 1 cup of dressing over pasta mixture.
Refrigerate overnight.
Add rest of dressing and toss before serving.
recipes.text: Seashell Salad. Cook pasta till tender, drain, and cool. Add cucumbers, onion, green pepper and pimentos, in large bowl. In medium bowl mix soup sugar, oil, vinegar. Pour 1 cup of dressing over pasta mixture. Refrigerate overnight. Add rest of dressing and toss before serving.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: In a 2 1/2-quart saucepan, heat brown sugar, corn syrup, oleo, cream of tartar and salt to boiling to 260u00b0.
Cook 5 minutes or more.
Remove from heat.
Stir in baking soda thoroughly and pour over popped corn.
Stir gently.
Bake in a preheated oven at 200u00b0 for 1 hour.
Stir 2 or 3 times.
Put on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. In a 2 1/2-quart saucepan, heat brown sugar, corn syrup, oleo, cream of tartar and salt to boiling to 260u00b0. Cook 5 minutes or more. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda thoroughly and pour over popped corn. Stir gently. Bake in a preheated oven at 200u00b0 for 1 hour. Stir 2 or 3 times. Put on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Ham And Red-Eye Gravy
directions: Fry ham slices slowly and be careful not to overcook.
Remove from pan.
Make gravy in pan the ham was fried in.
Pour in a small amount of coffee, right from the pot.
Add a little water and bring to a boil.
recipes.text: Ham And Red-Eye Gravy. Fry ham slices slowly and be careful not to overcook. Remove from pan. Make gravy in pan the ham was fried in. Pour in a small amount of coffee, right from the pot. Add a little water and bring to a boil.

recipes.title: Cherry Crisp
directions: Put cherry pie filling in bottom of 8-inch square cake pan. Mix oats, brown sugar and flour with butter.
Sprinkle over cherry filling; add nuts.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Crisp. Put cherry pie filling in bottom of 8-inch square cake pan. Mix oats, brown sugar and flour with butter. Sprinkle over cherry filling; add nuts. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Warm German-Style Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes; cool. Remove skins of potatoes and slice. Cut bacon in small pieces and saute until crisp. Remove bacon from fat and place on potatoes. Add flour to bacon fat and then sugar and vinegar. Cook until slightly thickened. Add onion, green pepper, celery, salt and pepper to the potatoes. Pour hot mixture over the potatoes; mix well. Salad can be kept warm in a very low oven. Garnish with sliced hard-cooked eggs. Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Warm German-Style Potato Salad. Cook potatoes; cool. Remove skins of potatoes and slice. Cut bacon in small pieces and saute until crisp. Remove bacon from fat and place on potatoes. Add flour to bacon fat and then sugar and vinegar. Cook until slightly thickened. Add onion, green pepper, celery, salt and pepper to the potatoes. Pour hot mixture over the potatoes; mix well. Salad can be kept warm in a very low oven. Garnish with sliced hard-cooked eggs. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender while holding the lid on. Blend 30 seconds.
recipes.text: Orange Julius. Combine all ingredients in a blender while holding the lid on. Blend 30 seconds.

recipes.title: Christmas Eve Pecans
directions: Beat egg white until foamy.
Add pecans and stir gently until coated.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Christmas Eve Pecans. Beat egg white until foamy. Add pecans and stir gently until coated. Set aside.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 large sweet white onion, chopped fine
directions: Layer cabbage and onion in large bowl. Pour sugar on top and do not stir. In a small sauce pan, combine vegetable oil, vinegar, celery seed, pepper and salt; bring to a boil. Pour hot mixture over cabbage and again, do not stir. Let stand 1 hour, then cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Stir before serving. This keep up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Old Fashion Cole Slaw. Layer cabbage and onion in large bowl. Pour sugar on top and do not stir. In a small sauce pan, combine vegetable oil, vinegar, celery seed, pepper and salt; bring to a boil. Pour hot mixture over cabbage and again, do not stir. Let stand 1 hour, then cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. Stir before serving. This keep up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Diet Veggie Soup
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, cut in small pieces
4 large carrots, cut in small pieces
directions: Cook about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Diet Veggie Soup. Cook about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Burnt Sugar Cake
directions: Cream together sugar and butter; add this to the eggs.
Sift together three times flour and baking powder.
Add alternately with milk, then add burnt sugar and maple flavoring.
Stir well. Bake in 3 layers.
recipes.text: Burnt Sugar Cake. Cream together sugar and butter; add this to the eggs. Sift together three times flour and baking powder. Add alternately with milk, then add burnt sugar and maple flavoring. Stir well. Bake in 3 layers.

recipes.title: Sonora Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until cooked, then shred the meat.
Mix soups, chili, taco sauce, milk and onion.
Layer everything, ending with cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Serve with a Mexican rice, salad and cold beer!
recipes.text: Sonora Chicken Casserole. Boil chicken until cooked, then shred the meat. Mix soups, chili, taco sauce, milk and onion. Layer everything, ending with cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes, uncovered. Serve with a Mexican rice, salad and cold beer!

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix flour with baking soda.
Combine butter, both sugars and the pudding mix in a large bowl.
Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs.
Gradually add flour mixture.
Stir in oats and raisins.
Batter will be stiff.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet, about 2-inches apart.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter, both sugars and the pudding mix in a large bowl. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in oats and raisins. Batter will be stiff. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet, about 2-inches apart. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Cook celery and onion in butter until tender.
Add remaining ingredients except parsley and noodles.
Simmer 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf.
Add noodles and parsley.
Cook 10 minutes or longer until noodles are tender.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Soup. Cook celery and onion in butter until tender. Add remaining ingredients except parsley and noodles. Simmer 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Add noodles and parsley. Cook 10 minutes or longer until noodles are tender.

recipes.title: Mexican Tortilla Breakfast
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can stewed tomatoes, chopped (reserve juice)
directions: Cut sausage links into 1/4-inch pieces and brown in skillet on medium heat.
Remove and drain.
In skillet, saute onion, green pepper and celery until tender.
Stir in chili powder, oregano, salt, sugar and juice from tomatoes.
Add tomatoes and sausage. Mix well.
Simmer, uncovered, to thicken.
recipes.text: Mexican Tortilla Breakfast. Cut sausage links into 1/4-inch pieces and brown in skillet on medium heat. Remove and drain. In skillet, saute onion, green pepper and celery until tender. Stir in chili powder, oregano, salt, sugar and juice from tomatoes. Add tomatoes and sausage. Mix well. Simmer, uncovered, to thicken.

recipes.title: Deluxe Brownies(This Is The Ultimate Brownie, If You Like Them Rich And Moist.)
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Melt margarine; mix with cocoa and oil. In separate bowl, beat sugar, vanilla and eggs on high speed for 5 minutes.
Beat in chocolate mixture on low speed.
Stir in nuts. Spread in a greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
Bake just until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan (40 to 45 minutes).
Cool. Cut in 2-inch squares.
recipes.text: Deluxe Brownies(This Is The Ultimate Brownie, If You Like Them Rich And Moist.). Heat oven to 350u00b0. Melt margarine; mix with cocoa and oil. In separate bowl, beat sugar, vanilla and eggs on high speed for 5 minutes. Beat in chocolate mixture on low speed. Stir in nuts. Spread in a greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake just until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan (40 to 45 minutes). Cool. Cut in 2-inch squares.

recipes.title: Chocolate Syrup Icing
directions: Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil.
Cook for 2 minutes.
This icing is so delicious served warm over a yellow cake.
This is my family's favorite dessert.
recipes.text: Chocolate Syrup Icing. Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. Cook for 2 minutes. This icing is so delicious served warm over a yellow cake. This is my family's favorite dessert.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cabbage
directions: Chop cabbage and boil 10 minutes until tender.
Drain and combine with cheese soup.
Crush crackers and mix with melted oleo.
Place cabbage mixture in casserole and top with buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
Especially good served with baked ham and tossed green salad and rye rolls.
recipes.text: Scalloped Cabbage. Chop cabbage and boil 10 minutes until tender. Drain and combine with cheese soup. Crush crackers and mix with melted oleo. Place cabbage mixture in casserole and top with buttered crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Especially good served with baked ham and tossed green salad and rye rolls.

recipes.title: Candied Yams
directions: Put potatoes (washed and peeled) into large skillet.
Add butter and sugar.
Stirring mixture, cook on low heat, making sure sugar melts to form syrup.
recipes.text: Candied Yams. Put potatoes (washed and peeled) into large skillet. Add butter and sugar. Stirring mixture, cook on low heat, making sure sugar melts to form syrup.

recipes.title: English Trifle
directions: Break the
cake
into
small
pieces in the bottom of a glass bowl.
Make
up the jello using the syrup from the fruit cocktail. Add
the
fruit to the cake and pour the jello over the top;
mix slightly just to moisten the cake and refrigerate.
Make
up
the pudding and add on top of the jello layer. Top with Cool Whip and garnish with nuts and cherries.
recipes.text: English Trifle. Break the cake into small pieces in the bottom of a glass bowl. Make up the jello using the syrup from the fruit cocktail. Add the fruit to the cake and pour the jello over the top; mix slightly just to moisten the cake and refrigerate. Make up the pudding and add on top of the jello layer. Top with Cool Whip and garnish with nuts and cherries.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
directions: Mix eggs, brown sugar and 1 1/2 cups milk in blender.
Blend until sugar is dissolved.
Add pecans and vanilla into blender. Chop pecans for a few seconds.
Add the mixture from the blender into the freezer can with the Eagle Brand and Milnot.
Fill the can with the rest of your milk.
Freeze as normal.
recipes.text: Butter Pecan Ice Cream. Mix eggs, brown sugar and 1 1/2 cups milk in blender. Blend until sugar is dissolved. Add pecans and vanilla into blender. Chop pecans for a few seconds. Add the mixture from the blender into the freezer can with the Eagle Brand and Milnot. Fill the can with the rest of your milk. Freeze as normal.

recipes.title: Punch
ingredients: 1 large can frozen lemonade (do not add water)
directions: Mix everything and serve.
Have everything chilled and add ice as needed.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix everything and serve. Have everything chilled and add ice as needed.

recipes.title: Scramble Party Mix
directions: Mix and bake in a large roasting pan, uncovered, at 250u00b0 for 2 hours.
Stir every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Scramble Party Mix. Mix and bake in a large roasting pan, uncovered, at 250u00b0 for 2 hours. Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Glazed Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Place flour, salt, shortening, nutmeg, granulated sugar and orange rind in bowl.
Add egg yolks and butter.
Incorporate well with pastry blender.
Add cream and pinch dough to incorporate.
Roll on floured surface until about 1/4-inch thick.
Dust with more flour, if needed.
Using assorted cookie cutters, cut shapes and place on buttered cookie sheet. Bake 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Glazed Cookies. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Place flour, salt, shortening, nutmeg, granulated sugar and orange rind in bowl. Add egg yolks and butter. Incorporate well with pastry blender. Add cream and pinch dough to incorporate. Roll on floured surface until about 1/4-inch thick. Dust with more flour, if needed. Using assorted cookie cutters, cut shapes and place on buttered cookie sheet. Bake 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Olen
ingredients: 8 chicken breasts, seasoned and cooked in broth
1 doz. small corn tortillas, cut in 2-inch pieces
directions: Cut cooked chicken in small pieces. Mix all ingredients, except cheese and tortillas. Add 1/2 of cheese. Pour chicken broth in casserole. Layer tortillas and chicken mix. Top with rest of cheese. Top with foil. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 300u00b0.
recipes.text: Chicken Olen. Cut cooked chicken in small pieces. Mix all ingredients, except cheese and tortillas. Add 1/2 of cheese. Pour chicken broth in casserole. Layer tortillas and chicken mix. Top with rest of cheese. Top with foil. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 300u00b0.

recipes.title: Fire And Velvet Zinger
ingredients: 8 oz. elbow macaroni or small bow ties
directions: In a large skillet, brown the sausage, onion and pepper.
Add tomatoes, uncooked macaroni, sour cream, milk, sugar, salt and chili powder.
Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until the macaroni is tender. It should still be a little saucy and soupy. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Fire And Velvet Zinger. In a large skillet, brown the sausage, onion and pepper. Add tomatoes, uncooked macaroni, sour cream, milk, sugar, salt and chili powder. Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until the macaroni is tender. It should still be a little saucy and soupy. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Rice Meat Balls
directions: Combine rice with beef, egg, onion, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup tomato juice. Mix lightly. Shape mixture into 18 balls.
Place in skillet. Add sugar to remaining 2 cups tomato juice. Pour juice over meat balls in skillet. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer and cover 15 minutes, basting occasionally.
recipes.text: Rice Meat Balls. Combine rice with beef, egg, onion, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup tomato juice. Mix lightly. Shape mixture into 18 balls. Place in skillet. Add sugar to remaining 2 cups tomato juice. Pour juice over meat balls in skillet. Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer and cover 15 minutes, basting occasionally.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 medium chopped onion or 1 1/2 Tbsp. onion flakes
directions: Cook broccoli and drain well.
Place broccoli on flat 8 1/2 x 11 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch Pyrex dish.
Mix all other ingredients except crackers and pour over broccoli.
Mix well.
Melt 1 stick margarine.
Mix in cracker crumbs and sprinkle atop casserole. Bake for 30 minutes on 350u00b0 until hot and bubbly.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli and drain well. Place broccoli on flat 8 1/2 x 11 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch Pyrex dish. Mix all other ingredients except crackers and pour over broccoli. Mix well. Melt 1 stick margarine. Mix in cracker crumbs and sprinkle atop casserole. Bake for 30 minutes on 350u00b0 until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 1 large pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
directions: Mix 1/2 of the margarine with all other ingredients. Top with rest of margarine and bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Mix 1/2 of the margarine with all other ingredients. Top with rest of margarine and bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheesy Vegetable Enchiladas
directions: Cook in oil peppers, carrot, half of onions, chili powder, garlic, until tender.
Add beans, corn, tomato; heat through. Place 1/3 cup of mixture in tortillas, then 3 teaspoons cheese, and roll.
Place seam down in baking dish.
Continue with remainder. To enchiladas with onions, salsa and any remaining (or additional) cheese.
Bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serve with sour cream, if desired.
recipes.text: Cheesy Vegetable Enchiladas. Cook in oil peppers, carrot, half of onions, chili powder, garlic, until tender. Add beans, corn, tomato; heat through. Place 1/3 cup of mixture in tortillas, then 3 teaspoons cheese, and roll. Place seam down in baking dish. Continue with remainder. To enchiladas with onions, salsa and any remaining (or additional) cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350u00b0. Serve with sour cream, if desired.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Appetizers
ingredients: 1 jar Old English Cheddar cheese spread
directions: Combine all ingredients and spread on English muffins.
This amount will usually do for a package of English muffins.
This can be frozen for later use.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Appetizers. Combine all ingredients and spread on English muffins. This amount will usually do for a package of English muffins. This can be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Sweet Pickles
directions: Soak in lime water for 12 hours.
Rinse in clear water.
Soak in salt water 4 hours. Soak in plain water 2 hours.
Boil in alum water 5 minutes.
Drain all water out.
Add sugar, vinegar and spices.
Cook 15 minutes.
Let cool.
Put in jars and seal.
recipes.text: Sweet Pickles. Soak in lime water for 12 hours. Rinse in clear water. Soak in salt water 4 hours. Soak in plain water 2 hours. Boil in alum water 5 minutes. Drain all water out. Add sugar, vinegar and spices. Cook 15 minutes. Let cool. Put in jars and seal.

recipes.title: Italian Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown the hamburger.
Drain the grease, then put the Italian tomato soup and brown sugar and chili powder.
Cook until hot. Taste to see if you need more seasoning.
Then turn the heat down to low and put the cheese on top.
Cover and let the cheese melt. Then put on the buns.
recipes.text: Italian Sloppy Joes. Brown the hamburger. Drain the grease, then put the Italian tomato soup and brown sugar and chili powder. Cook until hot. Taste to see if you need more seasoning. Then turn the heat down to low and put the cheese on top. Cover and let the cheese melt. Then put on the buns.

recipes.title: Sauce For Cobblers
directions: Mix flour and sugar. Add enough milk to make consistency of pancake batter. Add to water. Cook until thickens (not very thick) and add butter. Especially good with blackberry cobbler.
