recipes.text: Sauce For Cobblers. Mix flour and sugar. Add enough milk to make consistency of pancake batter. Add to water. Cook until thickens (not very thick) and add butter. Especially good with blackberry cobbler.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
ingredients: 1 c. yellow cornmeal (House Autry stone ground plain)
directions: Mix meal, flour and salt together.
Mix milk until the meal mixture is paste consistency.
Then add water until dripping consistency.
Drop by tablespoon in deep fryer of grease and cook until golden brown.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix meal, flour and salt together. Mix milk until the meal mixture is paste consistency. Then add water until dripping consistency. Drop by tablespoon in deep fryer of grease and cook until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cherry Pudding
directions: Mix
ingredients
together; add cherries last.tBake in 9-inch pan at 375u00b0 about 40 minutes. Serve with milk.
recipes.text: Cherry Pudding. Mix ingredients together; add cherries last.tBake in 9-inch pan at 375u00b0 about 40 minutes. Serve with milk.

recipes.title: Okra And Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, broken in small pieces
2 c. fresh okra, cut into 1 inch pieces (can be frozen)
directions: Cook bacon slightly. Saute onion with bacon until tender. Add tomatoes, chicken broth, sugar, and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes. Add okra and simmer 20 more minutes.
recipes.text: Okra And Tomatoes. Cook bacon slightly. Saute onion with bacon until tender. Add tomatoes, chicken broth, sugar, and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes. Add okra and simmer 20 more minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 can white tuna in spring water
directions: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender; drain.
Drain water from tuna.
Place all ingredients in a casserole.
Salt and pepper to taste and mix well.
Top with buttered 1/2-inch squares of bread.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Noodle Casserole. Cook noodles in boiling water until tender; drain. Drain water from tuna. Place all ingredients in a casserole. Salt and pepper to taste and mix well. Top with buttered 1/2-inch squares of bread. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossoms
directions: Cream together the shortening, sugar, peanut butter and brown sugar. Add the egg and vanilla. Beat well and blend in the flour, soda and salt. Shape into balls of 1 teaspoon each.
Place on greased cookie sheets.
Bake 10 minutes at 325u00b0.
Remove from oven and top with Hershey's Kiss, pressing down firmly. Bake 2 to 5 minutes more.
recipes.text: Peanut Blossoms. Cream together the shortening, sugar, peanut butter and brown sugar. Add the egg and vanilla. Beat well and blend in the flour, soda and salt. Shape into balls of 1 teaspoon each. Place on greased cookie sheets. Bake 10 minutes at 325u00b0. Remove from oven and top with Hershey's Kiss, pressing down firmly. Bake 2 to 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Broccoli Quiche Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli in microwave according to package directions. Dice green pepper and onion.
Beat eggs.
Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into casserole dish.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Bake at 325u00b0 until lightly browned, approximately 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Quiche Casserole. Cook broccoli in microwave according to package directions. Dice green pepper and onion. Beat eggs. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake at 325u00b0 until lightly browned, approximately 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
ingredients: 1 large can mandarin oranges, drained well
1 medium can crushed pineapple, drained well
directions: Mix the drained fruits together and then add condensed sweetened milk and then Cool
Whip.
Pour into a cooled graham cracker crust and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Mix the drained fruits together and then add condensed sweetened milk and then Cool Whip. Pour into a cooled graham cracker crust and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Place all ingredients into mixing bowl; combine thoroughly. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle the topping ingredients.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Place all ingredients into mixing bowl; combine thoroughly. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle the topping ingredients.

recipes.title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: garlic and salt to taste (I don't add either)
directions: Dice cheese into microwave safe dish and melt.
Add drained tomatoes smashed into chunks and peppers stir in and microwave for 1-1/2 minutes longer so everything can be mixed easily.
Serve with corn chips to dip or serve by pouring the cheese over a serving dish of corn chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Cheese Dip. Dice cheese into microwave safe dish and melt. Add drained tomatoes smashed into chunks and peppers stir in and microwave for 1-1/2 minutes longer so everything can be mixed easily. Serve with corn chips to dip or serve by pouring the cheese over a serving dish of corn chips.

recipes.title: Irish Strawberry Dessert Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour 2 loaf pans (9 x 5-inch).
In medium bowl, stir thawed strawberries, eggs and oil. In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, baking soda, salt and nuts.
Add strawberry mixture and stir until blended well. Pour into pans.
Bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: Irish Strawberry Dessert Loaf. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans (9 x 5-inch). In medium bowl, stir thawed strawberries, eggs and oil. In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, baking soda, salt and nuts. Add strawberry mixture and stir until blended well. Pour into pans. Bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apple Marmalade
ingredients: 6 medium apples, peeled, cored and coarsely chopped (6 c.)
directions: Quarter unpeeled orange; remove seeds and thinly slice.
In an 8 to 10-quart kettle or Dutch oven, combine the first 3 ingredients and 2 cups water.
Bring to boiling.
Reduce heat; simmer until apples are tender.
Add sugar.
Bring to full rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Cook and stir until thickened and clear.
Remove from heat.
Skim off foam.
Pour at once into hot, sterilized jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace.
Adjust lids. Process in boiling water bath (half pints) for 15 minutes.
Makes 6 half pints.
recipes.text: Apple Marmalade. Quarter unpeeled orange; remove seeds and thinly slice. In an 8 to 10-quart kettle or Dutch oven, combine the first 3 ingredients and 2 cups water. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer until apples are tender. Add sugar. Bring to full rolling boil, stirring constantly. Cook and stir until thickened and clear. Remove from heat. Skim off foam. Pour at once into hot, sterilized jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace. Adjust lids. Process in boiling water bath (half pints) for 15 minutes. Makes 6 half pints.

recipes.title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Cream shortening; add sugars and eggs.
Mix thoroughly.
Add crushed corn flakes, oats, vanilla and coconut.
Add dry ingredients (flour, salt, soda and baking powder) which have been sifted together.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 about 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Ranger Cookies. Cream shortening; add sugars and eggs. Mix thoroughly. Add crushed corn flakes, oats, vanilla and coconut. Add dry ingredients (flour, salt, soda and baking powder) which have been sifted together. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 about 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Line bottom of greased and floured cake pan with chopped pecans.
Mix cake mix as directions indicate.
Pour over pecans. Mix together the butter, sugar and cream cheese.
Drop this mixture by teaspoonfuls on cake.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Frost with chocolate frosting.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake. Line bottom of greased and floured cake pan with chopped pecans. Mix cake mix as directions indicate. Pour over pecans. Mix together the butter, sugar and cream cheese. Drop this mixture by teaspoonfuls on cake. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Frost with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Chinese Marinated Vegetables
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can French-style green beans, drained
1 (12 oz.) can white Shoe Peg corn, drained
1 (6 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
directions: Mix vinegar, oil, sugar, salt and pepper together and let stand.
recipes.text: Chinese Marinated Vegetables. Mix vinegar, oil, sugar, salt and pepper together and let stand.

recipes.title: Big Burger
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients for dough.
Press 1/2 dough into pie tin.
Save other 1/2 dough.
Mix next 7 ingredients for filling. Pour filling into pie tin.
Roll out rest of dough in circle for top.
Place on top of pie and seal edges.
Mix last 3 ingredients and sprinkle on top.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Big Burger. Mix first 4 ingredients for dough. Press 1/2 dough into pie tin. Save other 1/2 dough. Mix next 7 ingredients for filling. Pour filling into pie tin. Roll out rest of dough in circle for top. Place on top of pie and seal edges. Mix last 3 ingredients and sprinkle on top. Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Truffle Cheesecake
ingredients: 3 packages, 8 oz. each, cream cheese, softened
8 squares Baker's Semi-Sweet chocolate, melted, slightly cooled
directions: Mix crumbs and 2 Tbsp. butter. Press onto bottom of greased 9 inch spring form pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 10 minutes. Mix cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing on low speed after each addition, just until blended. Blend in melted chocolate and liqueur. Pour over crust. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until center is almost set. Run knife or metal spatula around rim or pan to loosen cake. Cool before removing rim of pan. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Chocolate Truffle Cheesecake. Mix crumbs and 2 Tbsp. butter. Press onto bottom of greased 9 inch spring form pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 10 minutes. Mix cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing on low speed after each addition, just until blended. Blend in melted chocolate and liqueur. Pour over crust. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until center is almost set. Run knife or metal spatula around rim or pan to loosen cake. Cool before removing rim of pan. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh(Crushed Wheat, Tomato, Mint And Parsley Salad)
directions: Place the bulgur in a bowl or pan.
Pour in enough cold water to cover it completely.
Let it soak for 10 minutes.
Drain in a sieve lined with a double thickness of dampened cheesecloth.
Wrap the bulgur in the cheesecloth and squeeze until dry.
Place bulgur into a deep bowl.
Add the tomatoes, parsley, onions, lemon juice and salt.
Toss gently but thoroughly together with fork.
Just before serving, stir in olive oil and mint.
Serve on lettuce leaf.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Tabbouleh(Crushed Wheat, Tomato, Mint And Parsley Salad). Place the bulgur in a bowl or pan. Pour in enough cold water to cover it completely. Let it soak for 10 minutes. Drain in a sieve lined with a double thickness of dampened cheesecloth. Wrap the bulgur in the cheesecloth and squeeze until dry. Place bulgur into a deep bowl. Add the tomatoes, parsley, onions, lemon juice and salt. Toss gently but thoroughly together with fork. Just before serving, stir in olive oil and mint. Serve on lettuce leaf. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Tomato-Veggie Soup
directions: Cook the hamburger with part of the onion soup package. Season to taste with Parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, celery seed and garlic. Combine all ingredients and let simmer about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Hamburger-Tomato-Veggie Soup. Cook the hamburger with part of the onion soup package. Season to taste with Parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, celery seed and garlic. Combine all ingredients and let simmer about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Skillet Pork Chops And Potatoes
ingredients: salt, pepper and Johnny's season salt
directions: Season the pork chops with the salt, pepper and season salt. Brown chops, then add the soup, spooning on top of chops.
Add the water, cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Peel the potatoes and slice on top of chops and soup. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until potatoes are done.
recipes.text: Skillet Pork Chops And Potatoes. Season the pork chops with the salt, pepper and season salt. Brown chops, then add the soup, spooning on top of chops. Add the water, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Peel the potatoes and slice on top of chops and soup. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with chopped parsley. Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until potatoes are done.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Supreme
directions: Combine chicken, celery, grapes, almonds, parsley, salt and mayonnaise; mix well.
Serve on lettuce, avocado half or in scooped out tomato or pineapple half.
Garnish with olives and chicken slices.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad Supreme. Combine chicken, celery, grapes, almonds, parsley, salt and mayonnaise; mix well. Serve on lettuce, avocado half or in scooped out tomato or pineapple half. Garnish with olives and chicken slices.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
directions: Spread pie filling in oblong pan.
Layer pineapple over pie filling, sprinkle cake mix over top then layer coconut and pecans. Add butter and bake at 350 degrees until golden brown.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Spread pie filling in oblong pan. Layer pineapple over pie filling, sprinkle cake mix over top then layer coconut and pecans. Add butter and bake at 350 degrees until golden brown.

recipes.title: Carrot And Apple Cake
directions: *For lo-fat variety replace the oil with 1 cup applesauce.
recipes.text: Carrot And Apple Cake. *For lo-fat variety replace the oil with 1 cup applesauce.

recipes.title: Oreo Delight
directions: Mix the cookies and margarine together and press into a 9
x 13-inch
pan.
Freeze
until hard.tSpread the ice cream (soften) over
the frozen crust.
Freeze again.
Now make the sauce.
recipes.text: Oreo Delight. Mix the cookies and margarine together and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Freeze until hard.tSpread the ice cream (soften) over the frozen crust. Freeze again. Now make the sauce.

recipes.title: Orange Truffles
ingredients: 1 can Pillsbury double Dutch chocolate frosting
1/4 c. orange flavored liquor or 1 tsp. orange extract
directions: Melt the chocolate chips in a medium saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; remove from the heat.
Stir in the orange liquor and frosting. Blend well.
Refrigerate for 1 or 2 hours or until firm.
recipes.text: Orange Truffles. Melt the chocolate chips in a medium saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; remove from the heat. Stir in the orange liquor and frosting. Blend well. Refrigerate for 1 or 2 hours or until firm.

recipes.title: Arroz Con Pollo Burrito
directions: Combine chicken, taco spices and 3/4 cup water in large skillet.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat.
Simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Remove chicken mixture; set aside.
In same skillet, saute rice in hot oil until golden.
Add remaining 2 1/2 cups water, tomato sauce and lemon pepper seasoning.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat.
Cover; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in chicken mixture, tomato and onion.
Blend well.
Heat 5 minutes.
Place 1/2 cup filling on each tortilla.
Fold in sides; roll to enclose filling. Place burritos, seam side down on baking sheet.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Heat in 350u00b0 oven 5 minutes to melt cheese.
recipes.text: Arroz Con Pollo Burrito. Combine chicken, taco spices and 3/4 cup water in large skillet. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Remove chicken mixture; set aside. In same skillet, saute rice in hot oil until golden. Add remaining 2 1/2 cups water, tomato sauce and lemon pepper seasoning. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover; simmer 20 minutes. Stir in chicken mixture, tomato and onion. Blend well. Heat 5 minutes. Place 1/2 cup filling on each tortilla. Fold in sides; roll to enclose filling. Place burritos, seam side down on baking sheet. Sprinkle with cheese. Heat in 350u00b0 oven 5 minutes to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato And Cream Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 can French fried onion rings (on top)
directions: Drain a can of sweet potatoes.
Roll potatoes in mixture of flour and white sugar.
Make syrup of brown sugar, butter and a little water. Bring to a boil and pour over potatoes.
Place in a 325u00b0 oven just long enough until all is hot.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato And Cream Cheese Casserole. Drain a can of sweet potatoes. Roll potatoes in mixture of flour and white sugar. Make syrup of brown sugar, butter and a little water. Bring to a boil and pour over potatoes. Place in a 325u00b0 oven just long enough until all is hot.

recipes.title: Janice'S Chicken(Crock-Pot)
directions: Place place chicken breasts (boneless) in crock-pot which has been brushed with melted butter and sprinkle with dry Italian dressing.
Cook 5 to 6 hours on low.
Drain broth from chicken and use 1/4 cup to make sauce.
Use the rest to make rice.
recipes.text: Janice'S Chicken(Crock-Pot). Place place chicken breasts (boneless) in crock-pot which has been brushed with melted butter and sprinkle with dry Italian dressing. Cook 5 to 6 hours on low. Drain broth from chicken and use 1/4 cup to make sauce. Use the rest to make rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
directions: Mix pudding and milk on low speed until blended.
Add pumpkin, spice and 1/2 of Cool Whip.
Pour into pie shell.
Chill until set.
Garnish with rest of Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Instant Pumpkin Chiffon Pie. Mix pudding and milk on low speed until blended. Add pumpkin, spice and 1/2 of Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell. Chill until set. Garnish with rest of Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Grapefruit Slush
directions: Boil sugar and water for 10 minutes.
Add lemon juice and cool.
Add canned grapefruit that has been broken up into bite-size (or smaller) pieces.
Should be kind of mushy.
Place in freezer tray and stir once or twice while freezing.
Allow about 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Grapefruit Slush. Boil sugar and water for 10 minutes. Add lemon juice and cool. Add canned grapefruit that has been broken up into bite-size (or smaller) pieces. Should be kind of mushy. Place in freezer tray and stir once or twice while freezing. Allow about 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Snack Wraps
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) cans Pillsbury Quick Crescent Dinner Rolls
4 hot dogs; cut into 16 pieces (2 times lengthwise and then in half)
several slices cheese, cut like the hot dogs
directions: Heat oven to 375u00b0.
Separate dough into 8 triangles.
Cut triangles in half lengthwise.
Place hot dog on shortest side of each triangle.
Place cheese on hot dog; roll up, starting at shortest side of triangle and rolling to opposite point.
Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with catsup and mustard.
Makes 32 snacks.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Snack Wraps. Heat oven to 375u00b0. Separate dough into 8 triangles. Cut triangles in half lengthwise. Place hot dog on shortest side of each triangle. Place cheese on hot dog; roll up, starting at shortest side of triangle and rolling to opposite point. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with catsup and mustard. Makes 32 snacks.

recipes.title: Easy Lasagna
directions: Brown ground beef and onion.
Drain.
Add sauce and simmer. Add cottage cheese.
Boil noodles and drain.
Layer sauce, noodles and Mozzarella cheese until used up.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes uncovered.
recipes.text: Easy Lasagna. Brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Add sauce and simmer. Add cottage cheese. Boil noodles and drain. Layer sauce, noodles and Mozzarella cheese until used up. Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes uncovered.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Surprise
ingredients: 1 (2 layer) white or yellow cake mix
directions: Bring to a boil the rhubarb, water and sugar.
Remove from heat.
Add marshmallows.
Add jello to rhubarb.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Surprise. Bring to a boil the rhubarb, water and sugar. Remove from heat. Add marshmallows. Add jello to rhubarb.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 cooked whole boneless chicken breasts, diced**
1 can diced tomatoes with/green chiles (like Rotel brand), divided
1 can cream of mushroom condensed soup**
8 large soft tortillas, corn or flour
1 clove diced fresh garlic, if desired
2 Tbsp. diced fresh basil, if desired
1/2 to 1 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese**
directions: Prepare enchiladas:
In a large bowl, mix together diced chicken, diced cheese, 1/2 can diced tomatoes, half of the chopped onion, condensed soup and fresh herbs.
Spoon 1/8 of the mixture onto each tortilla and roll up, turning sides in if desired.
Place in a 9x13-inch baking pan.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchiladas. Prepare enchiladas: In a large bowl, mix together diced chicken, diced cheese, 1/2 can diced tomatoes, half of the chopped onion, condensed soup and fresh herbs. Spoon 1/8 of the mixture onto each tortilla and roll up, turning sides in if desired. Place in a 9x13-inch baking pan.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Top with onions.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Mix first 4 ingredients. Top with onions. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Tudie'S Salad
ingredients: 1 container cream style low-fat cottage cheese
directions: Mix the first three ingredients together.
Sprinkle the dry jello powder over the top.
Mix all together.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Tudie'S Salad. Mix the first three ingredients together. Sprinkle the dry jello powder over the top. Mix all together. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Shirley'S Beans(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol)
ingredients: 1 or 2 Tbsp. brown sugar or honey (optional)
directions: Soak beans overnight; drain and cover with fresh water.
Bring beans to boil; reduce heat.
Add onion, jalapeno, brown sugar, chili powder, salt, red pepper and garlic.
Cook for about 1 hour. While cooking, cut carrots into very small bite size pieces.
Cook for 30 minutes more.
Remove garlic toes and serve over steamed rice.
I also add 1 link of Healthy Choice smoked sausage (chopped) when I add the carrots.
Makes a very healthy, tasty meal.
recipes.text: Shirley'S Beans(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol). Soak beans overnight; drain and cover with fresh water. Bring beans to boil; reduce heat. Add onion, jalapeno, brown sugar, chili powder, salt, red pepper and garlic. Cook for about 1 hour. While cooking, cut carrots into very small bite size pieces. Cook for 30 minutes more. Remove garlic toes and serve over steamed rice. I also add 1 link of Healthy Choice smoked sausage (chopped) when I add the carrots. Makes a very healthy, tasty meal.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter-Maple Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
Press with a fork, making crisscross design.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until light golden brown.
Cool 1 minute.
Remove from cookie sheets.
Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter-Maple Cookies. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls and place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Press with a fork, making crisscross design. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until light golden brown. Cool 1 minute. Remove from cookie sheets. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Betty'S Monkey Rolls
directions: Spray a tube pan with Crisco. Cut each biscuit in three then layer them in the prepared tube pan. Combine other ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over biscuits and bake in preheated 375u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Betty'S Monkey Rolls. Spray a tube pan with Crisco. Cut each biscuit in three then layer them in the prepared tube pan. Combine other ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over biscuits and bake in preheated 375u00b0 oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cube Steaks
ingredients: 1/2 can of milk (use the soup can)
directions: Sear the cube steaks in a frying pan. Do not cook thoroughly. Mix the ingredients in a bowl and pour over the meat. Cook over a low heat while turning the meat to finish cooking and sauce thickens.
recipes.text: Cube Steaks. Sear the cube steaks in a frying pan. Do not cook thoroughly. Mix the ingredients in a bowl and pour over the meat. Cook over a low heat while turning the meat to finish cooking and sauce thickens.

recipes.title: Chicken Vegetable Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in 3-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Vegetable Casserole. Combine all ingredients in 3-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Layer Angel Food
ingredients: 1 regular size pkg. lemon pudding mix
directions: Mix, bake and cool cake as directed on label. Slice cake into 3 layers. Cook pudding according to package directions for pie filling. Spread pudding between layers and on top of the cake. Prepare whipped topping according to directions. Spread on sides of cake. Chill for at least 3 hours before serving to allow pudding to set. Store in refrigerator. Makes 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Lemon Layer Angel Food. Mix, bake and cool cake as directed on label. Slice cake into 3 layers. Cook pudding according to package directions for pie filling. Spread pudding between layers and on top of the cake. Prepare whipped topping according to directions. Spread on sides of cake. Chill for at least 3 hours before serving to allow pudding to set. Store in refrigerator. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Sauce
directions: Mix thoroughly and serve warm.
Serve with broccoli, artichokes, asparagus, etc.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Sauce. Mix thoroughly and serve warm. Serve with broccoli, artichokes, asparagus, etc.

recipes.title: Oat Bran Fruit Muffins
ingredients: 1 c. uncooked oat bran cereal (fine grain)
directions: In large mixing bowl combine oat bran, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
Mix thoroughly; set aside. In small bowl, lightly beat egg with a fork; stir in milk, salad oil and grated orange peel.
Pour all at once into flour mixture; stir just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Fold in apple. Fill 15 greased (with Pam) medium size muffin cups 1/2 full.
Bake in preheated 400u00b0 oven until done, about 20 minutes.
Yields 15 muffins, 110 calories each.
recipes.text: Oat Bran Fruit Muffins. In large mixing bowl combine oat bran, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. Mix thoroughly; set aside. In small bowl, lightly beat egg with a fork; stir in milk, salad oil and grated orange peel. Pour all at once into flour mixture; stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in apple. Fill 15 greased (with Pam) medium size muffin cups 1/2 full. Bake in preheated 400u00b0 oven until done, about 20 minutes. Yields 15 muffins, 110 calories each.

recipes.title: Cheese Coffeecake
directions: Scald milk and water and let cool.
Crumble in 1/2 large cake of yeast; set aside.
Mix together flour, margarine, salt and 4 beaten egg yolks.
Add yeast mixture (dough will be sticky).
recipes.text: Cheese Coffeecake. Scald milk and water and let cool. Crumble in 1/2 large cake of yeast; set aside. Mix together flour, margarine, salt and 4 beaten egg yolks. Add yeast mixture (dough will be sticky).

recipes.title: Blackberry Cake
directions: Mix together shortening, sugar, unbeaten eggs and vanilla. Let stand for shortening to soften slightly.
Sift flour once. Measure and sift onto waxed paper or into another bowl with salt, soda, spices and cocoa. Scoop up with sifter and sift 2 or 3 times to mix ingredients.
recipes.text: Blackberry Cake. Mix together shortening, sugar, unbeaten eggs and vanilla. Let stand for shortening to soften slightly. Sift flour once. Measure and sift onto waxed paper or into another bowl with salt, soda, spices and cocoa. Scoop up with sifter and sift 2 or 3 times to mix ingredients.

recipes.title: Peppers And Steak
directions: Fry steak and onion in frying pan until brown a little.
Put in green peppers; put in tomato sauce and 1 cup water and cook until done.
recipes.text: Peppers And Steak. Fry steak and onion in frying pan until brown a little. Put in green peppers; put in tomato sauce and 1 cup water and cook until done.

recipes.title: Easy Punch
directions: Empty ingredients into a gallon jar.
Fill the remainder with water and mix well.
recipes.text: Easy Punch. Empty ingredients into a gallon jar. Fill the remainder with water and mix well.

recipes.title: Hershey'S Syrup Brownies
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and baking soda, alternating with syrup.
Blend in vanilla and nuts.
Bake in a greased 9 inch square pan at 350u00b0 for 40-45 minutes.
Frost and cut into squares while warm.
Make frosting by heating together the margarine, syrup, vanilla and confectioners sugar, stirring until smooth.
recipes.text: Hershey'S Syrup Brownies. Cream together margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add flour and baking soda, alternating with syrup. Blend in vanilla and nuts. Bake in a greased 9 inch square pan at 350u00b0 for 40-45 minutes. Frost and cut into squares while warm. Make frosting by heating together the margarine, syrup, vanilla and confectioners sugar, stirring until smooth.

recipes.title: King'S Cake
directions: Cream the fat and gradually add sugar and vanilla sugar, the eggs and the flavoring.
Mix and sieve the flour and the baking powder to the creamed mixture; add milk.
The consistency should be firm, do not use too much milk.
Fold in the washed raisins and candied lemon peel.
Grease an oblong cake tin and line with paper.
Fill the mixture into the prepared tin.
Place low in the oven.
Bake in moderate oven (375u00b0 to 400u00b0) for 80 to 100 minutes.
recipes.text: King'S Cake. Cream the fat and gradually add sugar and vanilla sugar, the eggs and the flavoring. Mix and sieve the flour and the baking powder to the creamed mixture; add milk. The consistency should be firm, do not use too much milk. Fold in the washed raisins and candied lemon peel. Grease an oblong cake tin and line with paper. Fill the mixture into the prepared tin. Place low in the oven. Bake in moderate oven (375u00b0 to 400u00b0) for 80 to 100 minutes.

recipes.title: Bridal Punch
directions: Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in hot water. Add cold water and stir. When served, add 2 liter ginger ale.
recipes.text: Bridal Punch. Dissolve Kool-Aid and sugar in hot water. Add cold water and stir. When served, add 2 liter ginger ale.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts, cooked and shredded
2 to 3 c. fresh broccoli, cut up, lightly steamed and drained
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Combine all ingredients in large bowl except bread crumbs, butter and cheese.
Mix bread crumbs and butter in a small bowl.
Pour contents of large bowl into greased, 2-quart casserole.

Sprinkle with bread crumbs and then cheese. Bake, covered, at 350u00b0 until heated through (30 minutes to 1 hour), then remove lid and cook for an additional 10 minutes. Serve over rice or in pastry shells.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Curried Chicken And Broccoli Casserole. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Combine all ingredients in large bowl except bread crumbs, butter and cheese. Mix bread crumbs and butter in a small bowl. Pour contents of large bowl into greased, 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and then cheese. Bake, covered, at 350u00b0 until heated through (30 minutes to 1 hour), then remove lid and cook for an additional 10 minutes. Serve over rice or in pastry shells. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Ham Roll-Up
directions: Spread cream cheese on slices of ham.
Lay green onions along the edge of ham.
Roll.
Chill until cream cheese is firm, then slice.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Ham Roll-Up. Spread cream cheese on slices of ham. Lay green onions along the edge of ham. Roll. Chill until cream cheese is firm, then slice. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Ramen Slaw
ingredients: 1 pkg chicken ramen noodles, crumbled dry (reserved seasoning)
directions: Toss together cabbage, onion, sesame seeds, and dry Ramen noodles. Mix water, oil, sugar, vinegar and ramen seasoning to make dressing.
Pour dressing over cabbage mixture; toss. Sprinkle with almonds. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Ramen Slaw. Toss together cabbage, onion, sesame seeds, and dry Ramen noodles. Mix water, oil, sugar, vinegar and ramen seasoning to make dressing. Pour dressing over cabbage mixture; toss. Sprinkle with almonds. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Corn Relish
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen whole kernel corn
1/4 c. chopped green or sweet red pepper
directions: Cook corn according to package directions; drain.
In a saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch.
Stir in vinegar and water. Stir in corn, celery, pepper, pimiento, onion, turmeric, mustard, and salt.
Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir for 2 minutes more.
Cool.
Cover and store in the refrigerator up to 4 weeks.
Serve with beef, pork, or poultry.
Makes about 2 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Corn Relish. Cook corn according to package directions; drain. In a saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch. Stir in vinegar and water. Stir in corn, celery, pepper, pimiento, onion, turmeric, mustard, and salt. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir for 2 minutes more. Cool. Cover and store in the refrigerator up to 4 weeks. Serve with beef, pork, or poultry. Makes about 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Creamy Rice And Vegetables
ingredients: 2 c. Birds Eye farm fresh broccoli, cauliflower and carrots
directions: Bring vegetables, milk, garlic salt and basil to a boil in a large saucepan.
Stir in rice and cheese; cover.
Remove from heat.
Let stand 10 minutes or until milk is absorbed.
recipes.text: Creamy Rice And Vegetables. Bring vegetables, milk, garlic salt and basil to a boil in a large saucepan. Stir in rice and cheese; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes or until milk is absorbed.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
directions: To corn, add beaten eggs, sugar, seasoning, melted butter and scalded milk.
Turn into buttered casserole and bake at 350u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until firm.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn. To corn, add beaten eggs, sugar, seasoning, melted butter and scalded milk. Turn into buttered casserole and bake at 350u00b0 for about 45 minutes or until firm.

recipes.title: Easy Almond Bars
directions: Combine flour, sugar, margarine, eggs, baking powder, almond extract and salt.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and almonds.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Almond Bars. Combine flour, sugar, margarine, eggs, baking powder, almond extract and salt. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and almonds. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: French Breakfast Puffs
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix together 1/2 c. sugar and cinnamon; set aside.
Mix shortening, 1/2 c. sugar and egg. Measure flour by dip-level-pour method.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg; stir into shortening and sugar mixture, alternately with milk.
Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.
Remove from oven and immediately roll in melted butter, then the cinnamon sugar mix.
recipes.text: French Breakfast Puffs. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Mix together 1/2 c. sugar and cinnamon; set aside. Mix shortening, 1/2 c. sugar and egg. Measure flour by dip-level-pour method. Mix flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg; stir into shortening and sugar mixture, alternately with milk. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown. Remove from oven and immediately roll in melted butter, then the cinnamon sugar mix.

recipes.title: Fruit Dessert
directions: Drain mandarin oranges well; mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Fruit Dessert. Drain mandarin oranges well; mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Potato Cheese Soup
directions: Cover and cook.
Mash this mixture when tender.
Thicken mixture with 2 tablespoons flour mixed in small amount of water, stirring fast, and simmer.
Add 1/2 pound Velveeta cheese.
Simmer until melted.
Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/4 cups of milk.
recipes.text: Potato Cheese Soup. Cover and cook. Mash this mixture when tender. Thicken mixture with 2 tablespoons flour mixed in small amount of water, stirring fast, and simmer. Add 1/2 pound Velveeta cheese. Simmer until melted. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/4 cups of milk.

recipes.title: Susie'S Appetizer
directions: Brown meats together; drain, then pat with paper towels. In large bowl, mix in cheese until melted, then add remaining ingredients. Put on rye bread. Place on cookie sheet and freeze.
recipes.text: Susie'S Appetizer. Brown meats together; drain, then pat with paper towels. In large bowl, mix in cheese until melted, then add remaining ingredients. Put on rye bread. Place on cookie sheet and freeze.

recipes.title: Cocktail Franks
directions: Brown onion.
Add grape jelly; blend well.
Add chili sauce; simmer with franks for about 30 minutes.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Cocktail Franks. Brown onion. Add grape jelly; blend well. Add chili sauce; simmer with franks for about 30 minutes. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Fudge Pie
directions: Mix cocoa, flour, sugar, eggs and vanilla together.
Add melted margarine.
Pour into pie shell, unbaked.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Fudge Pie. Mix cocoa, flour, sugar, eggs and vanilla together. Add melted margarine. Pour into pie shell, unbaked. Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Western Pound Cake
directions: *Sift the flour 3 times, then measure sugar box full of flour.
recipes.text: Western Pound Cake. *Sift the flour 3 times, then measure sugar box full of flour.

recipes.title: Danish-Style New Potatoes
directions: In a medium size heavy saucepan, bring 3 cups unsalted water to a boil. Add the potatoes and simmer, partially covered, for 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Drain and cool for 10 minutes; peel off the skins and set aside. Put the 1/4 cup water and the brown sugar into a 10-inch skillet over moderate heat; bring to a simmer and cook, stirring until the sugar has dissolved, about 2 minutes.
Add the margarine and continue to cook, stirring until it has melted, about 1 minute. Add the potatoes and toss until heated through, about 2 minutes longer. Sprinkle with the dill. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Danish-Style New Potatoes. In a medium size heavy saucepan, bring 3 cups unsalted water to a boil. Add the potatoes and simmer, partially covered, for 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Drain and cool for 10 minutes; peel off the skins and set aside. Put the 1/4 cup water and the brown sugar into a 10-inch skillet over moderate heat; bring to a simmer and cook, stirring until the sugar has dissolved, about 2 minutes. Add the margarine and continue to cook, stirring until it has melted, about 1 minute. Add the potatoes and toss until heated through, about 2 minutes longer. Sprinkle with the dill. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Blueberry Dessert
directions: To make crust, combine first three ingredients.
Press into 7 x 11-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Blueberry Dessert. To make crust, combine first three ingredients. Press into 7 x 11-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding Supreme
directions: Cream the cheese until smooth.
Stir in Eagle Brand and pudding mix.
Fold in half of the whipped topping.
Layer in a dish the pudding, cookies and bananas.
Top with remaining topping.
Chill.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding Supreme. Cream the cheese until smooth. Stir in Eagle Brand and pudding mix. Fold in half of the whipped topping. Layer in a dish the pudding, cookies and bananas. Top with remaining topping. Chill.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies
ingredients: 2 lb. carrots, pared and sliced into thin slices
1 medium green pepper, in thin strips
1 can undiluted tomato soup or 5 1/2 oz. tomato juice
3/4 c. cider vinegar or 1 c. red wine vinegar
directions: Simmer carrots in a little water until barely tender.
Drain. Turn into a large bowl and mix in the onion and pepper strips. Combine the remaining ingredients.
Mix into the vegetables and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
May be served as a vegetable or relish.
Will keep up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Copper Pennies. Simmer carrots in a little water until barely tender. Drain. Turn into a large bowl and mix in the onion and pepper strips. Combine the remaining ingredients. Mix into the vegetables and marinate overnight in the refrigerator. May be served as a vegetable or relish. Will keep up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Broils
directions: Mix all ingredients except toast.
Spread on Melba toast. Broil on top rack until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Swiss Cheese Broils. Mix all ingredients except toast. Spread on Melba toast. Broil on top rack until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Aunt Ruth'S Dumplings
directions: Cook chicken (have water covering it while cooking).
Add Crisco to 3/4 cup hot broth.
Mix with flour, a little at a time, and add egg.
It will take more flour to get dough dry.
recipes.text: Aunt Ruth'S Dumplings. Cook chicken (have water covering it while cooking). Add Crisco to 3/4 cup hot broth. Mix with flour, a little at a time, and add egg. It will take more flour to get dough dry.

recipes.title: Glazed Fresh Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 6 c. fresh strawberries, washed and hulled (about 1 1/2 qt.)
directions: Mash enough berries to measure 1 cup.
Blend sugar and cornstarch in saucepan.
Stir in water and crushed berries.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and boils.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Add a few drops of red food coloring, if desired.
Cool.
recipes.text: Glazed Fresh Strawberry Pie. Mash enough berries to measure 1 cup. Blend sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Stir in water and crushed berries. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Add a few drops of red food coloring, if desired. Cool.

recipes.title: Biscuit Topped Italian Casserole
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Grease 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Biscuit Topped Italian Casserole. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Grease 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Hello Dolly Cookies
directions: Melt butter in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle in layers: graham crackers, coconut, chocolate chips and nuts, then pour Eagle Brand milk over top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Hello Dolly Cookies. Melt butter in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle in layers: graham crackers, coconut, chocolate chips and nuts, then pour Eagle Brand milk over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Fruit Bowl Supreme
ingredients: 1 can mandarin orange sections, well drained
1 can crushed pineapple in syrup, well drained
directions: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Chill about 1 hour. Serve as dessert or as a salad.
recipes.text: Fruit Bowl Supreme. Combine all ingredients, mixing well. Chill about 1 hour. Serve as dessert or as a salad.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
directions: Mix powdered sugar, oleo and peanut butter together.
Form into 1-inch balls and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Buckeyes. Mix powdered sugar, oleo and peanut butter together. Form into 1-inch balls and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar and oil, then add egg and pumpkin. Mix well. Then add dry ingredients. Add orange juice and nuts. Bake at 350 degrees. Will make two 9 x 13 cakes or a pound cake.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix sugar and oil, then add egg and pumpkin. Mix well. Then add dry ingredients. Add orange juice and nuts. Bake at 350 degrees. Will make two 9 x 13 cakes or a pound cake.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix cocoa and sugar in big bowl.
Melt butter in milk in large pot.
Add cocoa and sugar.
Let this come to a rolling boil.
Add vanilla.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter until melted.
Add oatmeal slowly until mixture is thick.
Spoon balls onto wax paper.
Set until firm.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Mix cocoa and sugar in big bowl. Melt butter in milk in large pot. Add cocoa and sugar. Let this come to a rolling boil. Add vanilla. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter until melted. Add oatmeal slowly until mixture is thick. Spoon balls onto wax paper. Set until firm.

recipes.title: Noodles Con Carne
directions: Brown meat in skillet.
Add onion, beans, and noodles; then add tomatoes, salt, pepper and chili powder.
Cover and bring to boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes.
Top with cheese.
recipes.text: Noodles Con Carne. Brown meat in skillet. Add onion, beans, and noodles; then add tomatoes, salt, pepper and chili powder. Cover and bring to boil. Simmer for 25 minutes. Top with cheese.

recipes.title: Impossible Broccoli Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400u00b0.
Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate.
Rinse broccoli under running cold water to thaw.
Drain thoroughly.
Mix broccoli, 2 cups of the cheese and the onion in plate.
Beat milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper until smooth (on high speed in mixer for 1 minute).
Pour into pie plate.
Bake until knife comes out clean, about 25 to 30 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake just enough for cheese to melt.
Garnish with tomato slices if desired.
Makes 6 servings (405 calories per serving).
recipes.text: Impossible Broccoli Pie. Heat oven to 400u00b0. Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Rinse broccoli under running cold water to thaw. Drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli, 2 cups of the cheese and the onion in plate. Beat milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper until smooth (on high speed in mixer for 1 minute). Pour into pie plate. Bake until knife comes out clean, about 25 to 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake just enough for cheese to melt. Garnish with tomato slices if desired. Makes 6 servings (405 calories per serving).

recipes.title: Tamale Beef Tangle
ingredients: 1 (29 oz.) can hominy (yellow), drained and chopped or 1 can Niblets corn and 1 (15 oz.) can hominy
1 large can tamales or 2 (15 oz.) cans, crumbled
directions: Brown beef; add onions and cook until browned.
Add all ingredients, except cheese and chips.
Mix well and pour into baking dish.
Cover with cheese and bake in 325u00b0 to 350u00b0 oven 35 minutes.
Sprinkle chips over top and bake 10 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Tamale Beef Tangle. Brown beef; add onions and cook until browned. Add all ingredients, except cheese and chips. Mix well and pour into baking dish. Cover with cheese and bake in 325u00b0 to 350u00b0 oven 35 minutes. Sprinkle chips over top and bake 10 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 c. green and red pepper strips
1 (8 oz.) can chunk pineapple in juice
directions: Cook and stir chicken in hot oil in large skillet until browned.
Add peppers; cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes.
Stir cornstarch and soy sauce in small bowl.
Add soy sauce mixture, pineapple in juice, vinegar, sugar, ginger and garlic powder to skillet; bring to a boil.
Serve chicken mixture over hot rice.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Chicken. Cook and stir chicken in hot oil in large skillet until browned. Add peppers; cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes. Stir cornstarch and soy sauce in small bowl. Add soy sauce mixture, pineapple in juice, vinegar, sugar, ginger and garlic powder to skillet; bring to a boil. Serve chicken mixture over hot rice.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Put sugar cookies in a pan very close together so they will bake together and form one crust.
Bake according to directions. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla together and put on top of cookies.
Mix fruit and glaze together and put on rest of cake. Chill 30 minutes to an hour before serving.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Put sugar cookies in a pan very close together so they will bake together and form one crust. Bake according to directions. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla together and put on top of cookies. Mix fruit and glaze together and put on rest of cake. Chill 30 minutes to an hour before serving.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Roll in small balls (about the size of a grape).
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until lightly browned.
When cool, roll in powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Mexican Wedding Cookies. Mix all ingredients. Roll in small balls (about the size of a grape). Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes until lightly browned. When cool, roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts In Cooking Sherry
directions: Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish; do not overlap.
Cover with mushrooms.
Combine undiluted soup with sherry and sour cream which have been blended.
Pour over chicken, completely covering. Sprinkle with paprika and Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts In Cooking Sherry. Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish; do not overlap. Cover with mushrooms. Combine undiluted soup with sherry and sour cream which have been blended. Pour over chicken, completely covering. Sprinkle with paprika and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Penna. Dutch Potato Filling
directions: Cook potatoes and mash them.
Dice bread.
In 1/2 butter, fry onions, celery and parsley.
When finished frying, add milk.
Add mashed potatoes, sugar, salt and pepper.
Add eggs.
Beat together all ingredients.
Mixture should be a bit runny; if not, add more milk.
Put in casserole (2 large and 1 small).
Store until ready to use.
When ready to use, brown in 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 60 minutes.
Before browning, crisscross top of casserole with fork and top with pats of butter.
recipes.text: Penna. Dutch Potato Filling. Cook potatoes and mash them. Dice bread. In 1/2 butter, fry onions, celery and parsley. When finished frying, add milk. Add mashed potatoes, sugar, salt and pepper. Add eggs. Beat together all ingredients. Mixture should be a bit runny; if not, add more milk. Put in casserole (2 large and 1 small). Store until ready to use. When ready to use, brown in 350u00b0 oven for 30 to 60 minutes. Before browning, crisscross top of casserole with fork and top with pats of butter.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Pie
directions: Brown ground beef, onion, salt and pepper.
Place in bottom of greased, heavy pie pan.
Stoneware or Pyrex is okay. Add cheese.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Pie. Brown ground beef, onion, salt and pepper. Place in bottom of greased, heavy pie pan. Stoneware or Pyrex is okay. Add cheese.

recipes.title: Chez Basic Favorite Indian Curry Base
ingredients: 2/3 c. dry white wine Neufchatel or Cote
directions: *Or use 2 cups grated domestic Swiss cheese.
recipes.text: Chez Basic Favorite Indian Curry Base. *Or use 2 cups grated domestic Swiss cheese.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Bars
ingredients: 1/3 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
In medium bowl, combine first 4 dry ingredients.
Pour in butter or margarine; toss with a fork.
Pat mixture evenly into prepared pan.
Bake for 15 minutes.
In mixer bowl, beat the cream cheese, sugar and lemon peel until smooth.
Add eggs, beating well.
Pour over baked crust.
Bake for 25 minutes; cool 5 minutes.
In bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Spoon over cheesecake, spreading evenly.
Bake for 5 to 7 minutes.
Cool; refrigerate at least 30 minutes.
Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Cheesecake Bars. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. In medium bowl, combine first 4 dry ingredients. Pour in butter or margarine; toss with a fork. Pat mixture evenly into prepared pan. Bake for 15 minutes. In mixer bowl, beat the cream cheese, sugar and lemon peel until smooth. Add eggs, beating well. Pour over baked crust. Bake for 25 minutes; cool 5 minutes. In bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Spoon over cheesecake, spreading evenly. Bake for 5 to 7 minutes. Cool; refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Beat milk and peanut butter.
Add Bisquick and vanilla.
Mix well.
Make 1-inch balls.
Roll in sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased sheet.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375u00b0.
Squish Kisses on top when removed from oven.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies. Beat milk and peanut butter. Add Bisquick and vanilla. Mix well. Make 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased sheet. Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375u00b0. Squish Kisses on top when removed from oven.

recipes.title: Crazy Crust Apple Or Cherry Pie
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. apple pie spice or cinnamon
directions: Tip:
Mincemeat pie filling can also be used if you desire.
recipes.text: Crazy Crust Apple Or Cherry Pie. Tip: Mincemeat pie filling can also be used if you desire.

recipes.title: Chinese Cole Slaw
directions: Mix cole slaw, onions, sunflower seeds, almonds, and noodles, set aside. Mix oil, sugar, vinegar, seasoning packet together and refrigerate 1/2 hour. Pour dressing over salad and serve.
recipes.text: Chinese Cole Slaw. Mix cole slaw, onions, sunflower seeds, almonds, and noodles, set aside. Mix oil, sugar, vinegar, seasoning packet together and refrigerate 1/2 hour. Pour dressing over salad and serve.

recipes.title: Sloppy Burgers
directions: Cook ground beef and onion in skillet until brown.
Remove from heat and drain fat.
Return to heat and add barbecue sauce. Simmer about 15 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Sloppy Burgers. Cook ground beef and onion in skillet until brown. Remove from heat and drain fat. Return to heat and add barbecue sauce. Simmer about 15 minutes. Serve on hamburger buns. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
ingredients: 3 slices bread, trimmed of crusts and barely moistened with water
directions: Cook onion, green pepper and celery in 1/2 stick margarine. Beat eggs with mayonnaise, mustard, bread and parsley.
Season with Old Bay seasoning.
Combine all ingredients with only a dash of cayenne pepper.
Fry in margarine with 2 tablespoons of cooking oil added to prevent margarine from browning.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Cook onion, green pepper and celery in 1/2 stick margarine. Beat eggs with mayonnaise, mustard, bread and parsley. Season with Old Bay seasoning. Combine all ingredients with only a dash of cayenne pepper. Fry in margarine with 2 tablespoons of cooking oil added to prevent margarine from browning.

recipes.title: Homestyle Barbecue Sauce
directions: Whisk all ingredients together until smooth.
Brush on meats, turning frequently, during last 20 minutes of cooking.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
Great on chicken or pork.
recipes.text: Homestyle Barbecue Sauce. Whisk all ingredients together until smooth. Brush on meats, turning frequently, during last 20 minutes of cooking. Makes 1 1/2 cups. Great on chicken or pork.

recipes.title: Poor Man Steak
directions: Cut up potatoes on bottom of casserole dish.
Cut onion up next.
Put mushroom soup on top of this.
Put flattened-out hamburger on top.
Cook in 475u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Poor Man Steak. Cut up potatoes on bottom of casserole dish. Cut onion up next. Put mushroom soup on top of this. Put flattened-out hamburger on top. Cook in 475u00b0 oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Barbecue Biscuit Cups
directions: Brown beef; drain fat.
Add salt and barbecue sauce; simmer gently about 15 minutes.
Grease 10 muffin cups.
Place 1 biscuit in each cup, shaping with fingers to fit muffin cup.
Spoon meat mixture into biscuit cups, filling about 3/4 full.
Sprinkle top with cheese.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecue Biscuit Cups. Brown beef; drain fat. Add salt and barbecue sauce; simmer gently about 15 minutes. Grease 10 muffin cups. Place 1 biscuit in each cup, shaping with fingers to fit muffin cup. Spoon meat mixture into biscuit cups, filling about 3/4 full. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Put diced apples in large mixing bowl; add unbeaten eggs and stir until well blended.
Add salad oil and mix again.
Combine dry ingredients and add to apple mixture.
Fold together until all dry ingredients are gone.
Add vanilla and nuts.
This will be very thick.
Pour into greased 9 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch baking dish. Bake for 1 hour at 325u00b0; if glass pan is used, bake at 300u00b0.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Put diced apples in large mixing bowl; add unbeaten eggs and stir until well blended. Add salad oil and mix again. Combine dry ingredients and add to apple mixture. Fold together until all dry ingredients are gone. Add vanilla and nuts. This will be very thick. Pour into greased 9 1/2 x 11 1/2-inch baking dish. Bake for 1 hour at 325u00b0; if glass pan is used, bake at 300u00b0.

recipes.title: Mexican Hot Mouth
ingredients: 2 lb. ground hamburger or ground chuck
directions: In a large skillet, brown the meat and onion. Drain well.
In a large baking dish or an ovenproof skillet, add meat, corn, beans, water, taco seasoning and salsa.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Top with cheese when done.
Serves 6.
Add additional salsa, if needed.
recipes.text: Mexican Hot Mouth. In a large skillet, brown the meat and onion. Drain well. In a large baking dish or an ovenproof skillet, add meat, corn, beans, water, taco seasoning and salsa. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Top with cheese when done. Serves 6. Add additional salsa, if needed.

recipes.title: Governor'S Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix and bake in greased casserole at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Last 15 minutes top with potato chips or buttered bread crumbs and brown.
recipes.text: Governor'S Chicken Casserole. Mix and bake in greased casserole at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Last 15 minutes top with potato chips or buttered bread crumbs and brown.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 small can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Stir together.
Bake about 1 hour at 400u00b0 in sprayed pan. This is a good basic recipe that can be added with other ingredients which are very tasty.
Grated cheese adds a different flavor.
Let your taste buds run wild.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Stir together. Bake about 1 hour at 400u00b0 in sprayed pan. This is a good basic recipe that can be added with other ingredients which are very tasty. Grated cheese adds a different flavor. Let your taste buds run wild.

recipes.title: Ruby'S Biscuits
directions: Sift flour, sugar and baking powder together.
Cut shortening into flour mixture.
Mix in buttermilk with a fork until just moistened.
Form a large ball.
Put on a floured surface and knead a few times.
Roll out about 3/4 inch biscuit center.
Place on a greased baking sheet with sides of biscuits touching.
Bake at 450u00b0 about 15 minutes, until brown.
recipes.text: Ruby'S Biscuits. Sift flour, sugar and baking powder together. Cut shortening into flour mixture. Mix in buttermilk with a fork until just moistened. Form a large ball. Put on a floured surface and knead a few times. Roll out about 3/4 inch biscuit center. Place on a greased baking sheet with sides of biscuits touching. Bake at 450u00b0 about 15 minutes, until brown.

recipes.title: Three Cheese Chicken Bake
directions: Cook and drain the noodles.
To make the sauce, melt the butter or margarine and cook the onions and green pepper for 2 minutes.
Add the soup, milk, drained mushrooms, basil and pimento.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and layer in this order: 1/2 of the noodles, 1/2 of the cottage cheese, 1/2 of the chicken, 1/2 of the American cheese, 1/2 of the Parmesan cheese and 1/2 of the sauce.
Repeat.
Save a little of the Parmesan cheese to sprinkle over the top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered.
Let set for 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Three Cheese Chicken Bake. Cook and drain the noodles. To make the sauce, melt the butter or margarine and cook the onions and green pepper for 2 minutes. Add the soup, milk, drained mushrooms, basil and pimento. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and layer in this order: 1/2 of the noodles, 1/2 of the cottage cheese, 1/2 of the chicken, 1/2 of the American cheese, 1/2 of the Parmesan cheese and 1/2 of the sauce. Repeat. Save a little of the Parmesan cheese to sprinkle over the top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes uncovered. Let set for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pork Loin And Cabbage Kraut
directions: Bake pork loin 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
Cut slit in center top of loin just enough for kraut to seep into.
Put whole can on top. Bake 15 minutes.
Serve.
recipes.text: Pork Loin And Cabbage Kraut. Bake pork loin 45 minutes at 350u00b0. Cut slit in center top of loin just enough for kraut to seep into. Put whole can on top. Bake 15 minutes. Serve.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Toss all ingredients together.
Just before serving, add taco chips and a large bottle of Catalina salad dressing.
If not served immediately, wait to add taco chips and dressing so that chips do not get soggy.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Toss all ingredients together. Just before serving, add taco chips and a large bottle of Catalina salad dressing. If not served immediately, wait to add taco chips and dressing so that chips do not get soggy.

recipes.title: Mexican Succotash
ingredients: 1 lb. zucchini, quartered and sliced 1/2-inch thick
1 pt. cherry tomatoes or 1 (28 oz.) can plum tomatoes, drained and quartered
fresh ground black pepper to taste
directions: In large skillet that has a cover.
Saute onion in margarine until soft.
recipes.text: Mexican Succotash. In large skillet that has a cover. Saute onion in margarine until soft.

recipes.title: Peach Crisp
directions: Slice and pit peaches; spread into a large baking dish.
Put over top of peaches 1/2 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons water.
In a bowl, put Bisquick, cinnamon and 1 cup sugar.
In a separate small bowl, beat egg.
Mix egg into Bisquick mix and toss around until crumbly.
Pour that over top of peaches and pour melted butter over that.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Crisp. Slice and pit peaches; spread into a large baking dish. Put over top of peaches 1/2 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons water. In a bowl, put Bisquick, cinnamon and 1 cup sugar. In a separate small bowl, beat egg. Mix egg into Bisquick mix and toss around until crumbly. Pour that over top of peaches and pour melted butter over that. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Good Beans
ingredients: 1 large can pork and beans (remove pork)
directions: Brown hamburger with onion.
Add pork and beans, ketchup, barbecue sauce and brown sugar.
Cook on top of stove until warmed.
recipes.text: Good Beans. Brown hamburger with onion. Add pork and beans, ketchup, barbecue sauce and brown sugar. Cook on top of stove until warmed.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
ingredients: 7 to 8 lb. Irish potatoes, peeled and cut into squares
1 (16 oz.) pkg. carrots, cut into 1-inch chunks
directions: Trim fat from meat and cut into small chunks. Place in a large stew pot and cover with water about 2-inches above the meat.
Add salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil over high heat.
Cook until blood is cooked out of meat.
Skim foam from top of pot.
This will leave a good rich stock covering the meat.
Add next four ingredients to pot and cover with tomato juice.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cover.
Simmer for 3 to 4 hours.
Add tomato juice as needed so that stew will be soupy.
The slower cooked, the better.
Feeds 12 hungry people!
recipes.text: Beef Stew. Trim fat from meat and cut into small chunks. Place in a large stew pot and cover with water about 2-inches above the meat. Add salt and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until blood is cooked out of meat. Skim foam from top of pot. This will leave a good rich stock covering the meat. Add next four ingredients to pot and cover with tomato juice. Salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 3 to 4 hours. Add tomato juice as needed so that stew will be soupy. The slower cooked, the better. Feeds 12 hungry people!

recipes.title: Lasagne
directions: Brown meat; skim off excess fat.
Add garlic, parsley, salt, tomatoes and tomato paste.
Simmer uncovered 45 minutes.
Cook noodles in salted water until tender; rinse with cold water.
Let set.
Combine cottage cheese, eggs, salt and pepper.
Mix well. Line bottom of pan/dish with half of noodles.
Spread half the meat mixture.
Cover with Mozzarella slices.
Repeat layering.
Pour remainder of meat mixture over all and sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake 30 minutes at 400u00b0.
Let set 30 minutes before serving 12.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Brown meat; skim off excess fat. Add garlic, parsley, salt, tomatoes and tomato paste. Simmer uncovered 45 minutes. Cook noodles in salted water until tender; rinse with cold water. Let set. Combine cottage cheese, eggs, salt and pepper. Mix well. Line bottom of pan/dish with half of noodles. Spread half the meat mixture. Cover with Mozzarella slices. Repeat layering. Pour remainder of meat mixture over all and sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake 30 minutes at 400u00b0. Let set 30 minutes before serving 12.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix and roll into balls.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix and roll into balls. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown.

directions: Mix sugar, salt and cornstarch in top of double boiler. Blend in milk

recipes.text: Chocolate Cream Pie. Mix sugar, salt and cornstarch in top of double boiler. Blend in milk and cut up chocolate. Cook over direct heat, stirring constantly, untiltmixture thickens and boils. Set over boiling water andtcook 5 minutes. Remove. Beat egg yolks slightly and beat into them a little of the hot mixture. Blend with mixture in double boiler. Place again over boiling water.tCook 5 minutes more. Stir to keep mixture smooth. Cool. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with whipped cream or meringue.

recipes.title: Delicate Mint Candies
ingredients: ready to use tubes of decorating gel
directions: In a large bowl, blend corn syrup, butter and vanilla and peppermint extracts.
Add confectioners sugar; mix well.
recipes.text: Delicate Mint Candies. In a large bowl, blend corn syrup, butter and vanilla and peppermint extracts. Add confectioners sugar; mix well.

recipes.title: Mom'S Apple Pie
directions: Roll out crust and place in bottom of pie pan.
Layer apples and sugar mixture until pie is heaped high with apples.
Dot with butter and put top crust on this.
Poke holes in top crust.
Bake at 375u00b0 until done.
recipes.text: Mom'S Apple Pie. Roll out crust and place in bottom of pie pan. Layer apples and sugar mixture until pie is heaped high with apples. Dot with butter and put top crust on this. Poke holes in top crust. Bake at 375u00b0 until done.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix well and cook until thickens the first 5 ingredients, then add butter, vanilla and coconut.
Beat well.
Pour into prebaked 9-inch pie shell.
Cover with meringue or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Mix well and cook until thickens the first 5 ingredients, then add butter, vanilla and coconut. Beat well. Pour into prebaked 9-inch pie shell. Cover with meringue or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Peach Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. instant pudding mix (vanilla or coconut)
directions: Mix peaches, sugar and fruit protector; set aside.
Mix cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil; beat 2 minutes.
Drain peaches.
Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Put half the batter in pan.
Place peaches on batter; add rest of batter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.
Cool 15 minutes before removing from pan.
When cool, frost.
recipes.text: Peach Cake. Mix peaches, sugar and fruit protector; set aside. Mix cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil; beat 2 minutes. Drain peaches. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Put half the batter in pan. Place peaches on batter; add rest of batter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes. Cool 15 minutes before removing from pan. When cool, frost.

recipes.title: Lemon Crumb Squares
directions: Mix milk, lemon juice and rind.
Set aside.
Cream brown sugar and butter.
Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture.
Add oatmeal.
Mixture will be crumbly.
Press half the crumb mixture into an 8 x 12-inch baking dish to form crust. Spread milk mixture over crust.
Crumble remaining mixture over top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Lemon Crumb Squares. Mix milk, lemon juice and rind. Set aside. Cream brown sugar and butter. Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture. Add oatmeal. Mixture will be crumbly. Press half the crumb mixture into an 8 x 12-inch baking dish to form crust. Spread milk mixture over crust. Crumble remaining mixture over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Acilian Meat Roll
ingredients: 3/4 c. soft bread crumbs (1 slice bread)
directions: Combine eggs, crumbs, juice, parsley, oregano, salt, pepper and garlic.
Add beef; mix well.
On wax paper or foil, pat meat to a 12 x 10-inch rectangle.
Arrange ham atop of meat, leaving a small margin around edges.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over ham.
Starting from short end, carefully roll meat, using paper to lift.
Seal edges and ends.
recipes.text: Acilian Meat Roll. Combine eggs, crumbs, juice, parsley, oregano, salt, pepper and garlic. Add beef; mix well. On wax paper or foil, pat meat to a 12 x 10-inch rectangle. Arrange ham atop of meat, leaving a small margin around edges. Sprinkle shredded cheese over ham. Starting from short end, carefully roll meat, using paper to lift. Seal edges and ends.

recipes.title: Sausage Cheese Biscuits
ingredients: 1 pkg. Cracker Barrel sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Grate cheese in large bowl.
Mix above ingredients thoroughly with hands.
Shape into balls and bake at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.
Can be frozen and reheated.
recipes.text: Sausage Cheese Biscuits. Grate cheese in large bowl. Mix above ingredients thoroughly with hands. Shape into balls and bake at 375u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown. Can be frozen and reheated.

recipes.title: Royal Holiday Spiced Punch
ingredients: 1 (24 oz.) bottle white or purple grape juice, chilled
directions: In a saucepan, combine water, sugar and spices.
Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes.
Chill; remove spices.
To serve in punch bowl, combine all ingredients.
For garnish, float lemon cartwheel slice in punch, if desired.
Makes about 12 cups (Sixteen 6 ounce servings).
recipes.text: Royal Holiday Spiced Punch. In a saucepan, combine water, sugar and spices. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes. Chill; remove spices. To serve in punch bowl, combine all ingredients. For garnish, float lemon cartwheel slice in punch, if desired. Makes about 12 cups (Sixteen 6 ounce servings).

recipes.title: Tanner'S Quiche(Serves 80)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. butter or margarine, soften to spread
directions: Trim and butter the bread.
Line pans with bread butter side down.
Crisp fry bacon and them crumble.
Cook chorizo and drain off fat and oil.
Drain on paper towel.
Layer cheese, and bacon/chorizo over bread.
Beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Pour over mixture into each pan.
Let stand overnight.
Bake the next morning at 350u00b0 for one hour.
It may take longer to cook if not a room temperature when placed in the oven.
recipes.text: Tanner'S Quiche(Serves 80). Trim and butter the bread. Line pans with bread butter side down. Crisp fry bacon and them crumble. Cook chorizo and drain off fat and oil. Drain on paper towel. Layer cheese, and bacon/chorizo over bread. Beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Pour over mixture into each pan. Let stand overnight. Bake the next morning at 350u00b0 for one hour. It may take longer to cook if not a room temperature when placed in the oven.

recipes.title: Dilled Onion Rings
directions: Combine all ingredients except onions.
Bring to a boil and pour over onion rings in a deep bowl.
Keep pushing onions down into sauce.
Cool and store in refrigerator.
Great with any kind of sandwich.
recipes.text: Dilled Onion Rings. Combine all ingredients except onions. Bring to a boil and pour over onion rings in a deep bowl. Keep pushing onions down into sauce. Cool and store in refrigerator. Great with any kind of sandwich.

recipes.title: Angel Food Delight
ingredients: 1 pkg. instant banana cream or vanilla pudding
directions: Mix pudding according to directions on box.
Tear cake into small pieces.
Arrange evenly in 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Spread pudding over cake.
Spread Cool Whip over pudding.
Carefully spread pie filling evenly over Cool Whip.
Keep refrigerated.
It gets better the longer it sits.
recipes.text: Angel Food Delight. Mix pudding according to directions on box. Tear cake into small pieces. Arrange evenly in 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spread pudding over cake. Spread Cool Whip over pudding. Carefully spread pie filling evenly over Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated. It gets better the longer it sits.

recipes.title: Healthy Choice Crab Dip
ingredients: 1/2 c. non-fat yogurt or sour cream
1 (8 oz.) pkg. Healthy Choice fat-free cream cheese, softened
1 c. (4 oz.) Healthy Choice fat-free shredded Cheddar cheese
directions: Combine yogurt, mayonnaise, cream cheese and seasonings.
Mix well.
Then, stir in Cheddar cheese and crab.
Cover and chill 2 hours.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Serve with crackers, bread sticks or vegetables.
Makes approximately 20 servings.
A 3 tablespoon serving equals 44 calories and less than 1 gram fat.
recipes.text: Healthy Choice Crab Dip. Combine yogurt, mayonnaise, cream cheese and seasonings. Mix well. Then, stir in Cheddar cheese and crab. Cover and chill 2 hours. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve with crackers, bread sticks or vegetables. Makes approximately 20 servings. A 3 tablespoon serving equals 44 calories and less than 1 gram fat.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 - 8 oz pkg. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Fry hamburger, drain then add seasoning and mix.
Mix with beans, hot sauce, lettuce and cheese.
When ready to serve add the rest.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Fry hamburger, drain then add seasoning and mix. Mix with beans, hot sauce, lettuce and cheese. When ready to serve add the rest.

recipes.title: Another Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Soften cream cheese in microwave; add to Jell-O.
Whisk to break up and melt cream cheese completely.
Add cold water.
Put into refrigerator until almost set.
Add pineapple and nuts.
Chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Another Jello Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Soften cream cheese in microwave; add to Jell-O. Whisk to break up and melt cream cheese completely. Add cold water. Put into refrigerator until almost set. Add pineapple and nuts. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Bake in large tube pan at 275u00b0 for two hours.
Cool on wire rack.
Turn onto serving plate.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Yields 16 servings.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Bake in large tube pan at 275u00b0 for two hours. Cool on wire rack. Turn onto serving plate. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Yields 16 servings.

recipes.title: Cinnamon-And-Spice Trail Mix
ingredients: 4 c. spoon sized Shredded Wheat biscuits
directions: Heat butter and honey in large skillet over medium heat until butter is melted.
Stir in cereal, tossing to coat well.
Cook, stirring often, for about 5 minutes or until cereal is toasted. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes.
Combine sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg in large bowl.
Add cereal and toss to coat well.
Stir in dried fruits.
Cool, then store in airtight container.
Makes 5 cups.
recipes.text: Cinnamon-And-Spice Trail Mix. Heat butter and honey in large skillet over medium heat until butter is melted. Stir in cereal, tossing to coat well. Cook, stirring often, for about 5 minutes or until cereal is toasted. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes. Combine sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg in large bowl. Add cereal and toss to coat well. Stir in dried fruits. Cool, then store in airtight container. Makes 5 cups.

recipes.title: Soft And Chewy Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. dark brown sugar, firmly packed
directions: Preheat oven to 300u00b0.
In medium bowl, combine flour, soda and salt.
In large bowl, blend sugars using an electric mixer set at medium speed.
Add butter and mix to a firm, grainy paste, scraping the sides of the bowl.
Add eggs, peanut butter and vanilla.
Beat at medium speed until light and fluffy.
Add flour and mix at low speed until just mixed.
Do not overmix.
recipes.text: Soft And Chewy Peanut Butter Cookies. Preheat oven to 300u00b0. In medium bowl, combine flour, soda and salt. In large bowl, blend sugars using an electric mixer set at medium speed. Add butter and mix to a firm, grainy paste, scraping the sides of the bowl. Add eggs, peanut butter and vanilla. Beat at medium speed until light and fluffy. Add flour and mix at low speed until just mixed. Do not overmix.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Combine cream cheese, marshmallow cream and juice only from cherries. Mix very well.
Good, served over fruits or as a fruit dip.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Combine cream cheese, marshmallow cream and juice only from cherries. Mix very well. Good, served over fruits or as a fruit dip.

recipes.title: Liqueur
directions: Remove all white from mandarin peel and discard.
Finely chop peel, mix with cinnamon and coriander.
Pour the brandy over this mixture, mix thoroughly.
Store in covered bottle for two months. Filter and bottle.
recipes.text: Liqueur. Remove all white from mandarin peel and discard. Finely chop peel, mix with cinnamon and coriander. Pour the brandy over this mixture, mix thoroughly. Store in covered bottle for two months. Filter and bottle.

recipes.title: Dad'S Famous Italian Potato Salad(Aka:  Potato Salad To Die For)
ingredients: 1/3 c. Italian salad dressing (oil and vinegar, not creamy)
directions: Cook scrubbed potatoes in lightly salted water until done. Drain and cook until you can handle them.
recipes.text: Dad'S Famous Italian Potato Salad(Aka:  Potato Salad To Die For). Cook scrubbed potatoes in lightly salted water until done. Drain and cook until you can handle them.

recipes.title: Drop Biscuits
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in bowl.
Add oil; mix with fork until crumbly.
Stir in milk until ingredients are moistened.
Drop by tablespoonfuls onto greased baking pan.
Bake at 450u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown.
Makes about 12 biscuits.
