recipes.text: Drop Biscuits. Combine flour, baking powder and salt in bowl. Add oil; mix with fork until crumbly. Stir in milk until ingredients are moistened. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto greased baking pan. Bake at 450u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown. Makes about 12 biscuits.

recipes.title: Creamy Banana Pudding
directions: Slice bananas and dip in lemon juice.
In large bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk and water.
Add pudding, mix and beat well.
Chill 5 minutes.
Fold in whipped cream.
Layer in a bowl:
vanilla wafers, bananas and pudding.
Layer twice.
recipes.text: Creamy Banana Pudding. Slice bananas and dip in lemon juice. In large bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk and water. Add pudding, mix and beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Layer in a bowl: vanilla wafers, bananas and pudding. Layer twice.

recipes.title: Quick Meatless Lasagna
directions: Mix Ricotta, 1/2 of the Mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan together.
Layer 1/4 of sauce, 3 noodles, 1/3 Ricotta in 13 x 9-inch dish.
Repeat layers twice, ending with sauce.
Top with remaining Mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 55 minutes.
Stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Quick Meatless Lasagna. Mix Ricotta, 1/2 of the Mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan together. Layer 1/4 of sauce, 3 noodles, 1/3 Ricotta in 13 x 9-inch dish. Repeat layers twice, ending with sauce. Top with remaining Mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 55 minutes. Stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cinnamon And Nut Pastry
ingredients: 1/2 (11 oz. size) pkg. pie crust mix
directions: Preheat oven to 425u00b0.
Prepare pastry for one crust pie as directed, except roll into rectangle 14 x 8-inch.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Spread with margarine.
Mix nuts, brown sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle lengthwise over half of the rectangle.
Moisten edges with water.
Fold rectangle lengthwise in half.
Press edges together to seal.
Flute.
Prick top of pastry in several places with fork.
Brush with egg white.
Bake 9 to 11 minutes.
Cut into slices.
recipes.text: Cinnamon And Nut Pastry. Preheat oven to 425u00b0. Prepare pastry for one crust pie as directed, except roll into rectangle 14 x 8-inch. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Spread with margarine. Mix nuts, brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle lengthwise over half of the rectangle. Moisten edges with water. Fold rectangle lengthwise in half. Press edges together to seal. Flute. Prick top of pastry in several places with fork. Brush with egg white. Bake 9 to 11 minutes. Cut into slices.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs and rest of ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 325u00b0 and bake until done (20 to 25 minutes).
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Beat eggs and rest of ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325u00b0 and bake until done (20 to 25 minutes).

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add 1 egg at a time. Cream and add sour cream, then flour. Bake at 350u00b0 about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Cake. Cream butter and sugar; add 1 egg at a time. Cream and add sour cream, then flour. Bake at 350u00b0 about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Date Cookies
directions: Stuff dates with nuts.
Cream shortening and sugar until light; beat in egg.
Sift dry ingredients.
Add alternately with sour cream to creamed mixture.
Stir in dates.
Drop onto greased cookie sheet (a date per cookie).
Bake in 375u00b0 oven.
Watch closely; do not overbrown.
Cool.
Top with Golden Frosting. Makes 5 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Stuffed Date Cookies. Stuff dates with nuts. Cream shortening and sugar until light; beat in egg. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately with sour cream to creamed mixture. Stir in dates. Drop onto greased cookie sheet (a date per cookie). Bake in 375u00b0 oven. Watch closely; do not overbrown. Cool. Top with Golden Frosting. Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Marinate overnight.
Stir in bacon before serving.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Marinate overnight. Stir in bacon before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
directions: Mix all together in bowl.
Pour into 1 deep dish graham cracker shell.
recipes.text: Lemon Pie. Mix all together in bowl. Pour into 1 deep dish graham cracker shell.

recipes.title: Tomato Yogurt Soup
directions: Put tomatoes and cucumber in blender; puree.
Pour into large bowl; leave half in blender.
Add yogurt and season; mix.
Stir into tomato mixture; heat until warm.
recipes.text: Tomato Yogurt Soup. Put tomatoes and cucumber in blender; puree. Pour into large bowl; leave half in blender. Add yogurt and season; mix. Stir into tomato mixture; heat until warm.

recipes.title: Potato Chowder
directions: Fry bacon bits until crisp and drain fat.
Combine all ingredients, except milk, in crock-pot.
Add water to cover.
Cook on high for 2 hours, then switch to low for 4 hours (automatic 5 hours).
Before serving, stir in milk and heat.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Potato Chowder. Fry bacon bits until crisp and drain fat. Combine all ingredients, except milk, in crock-pot. Add water to cover. Cook on high for 2 hours, then switch to low for 4 hours (automatic 5 hours). Before serving, stir in milk and heat. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
directions: Spread out rolls on a large cookie sheet.
Bake according to package directions.
Mix sour cream, dressing mix, mayonnaise and cream cheese, using mixer to blend well.
Spread onto cooled crust and top with veggies (about 1 1/2 cups of 4 kinds).
Suggestions are broccoli, green peppers, cauliflower, tomatoes, carrots, celery, bacon bits, olives, pepperoni, etc.
Top with cheese and pat down firmly so that when serving, it does not fall apart when picked up.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Spread out rolls on a large cookie sheet. Bake according to package directions. Mix sour cream, dressing mix, mayonnaise and cream cheese, using mixer to blend well. Spread onto cooled crust and top with veggies (about 1 1/2 cups of 4 kinds). Suggestions are broccoli, green peppers, cauliflower, tomatoes, carrots, celery, bacon bits, olives, pepperoni, etc. Top with cheese and pat down firmly so that when serving, it does not fall apart when picked up.

recipes.title: German Style Bratwurst And Sauerkraut
ingredients: 32 oz. jar or can sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained
1/2 c. apple juice or dry white wine
1 lb. Bob Evans Farms Bratwurst (5 links)
directions: Cook bacon in large skillet over medium high heat until crisp.
Remove bacon; drain and crumble on paper towel, set aside. Drain off all but 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet.
Add onion and garlic to dripping; cook over medium heat until tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in sauerkraut, potatoes, 1 1/2 cups of water, juice, brown sugar, bouillon, caraway and dried bay leaf. Add remaining water if necessary to cover potatoes.
Bring to boil over high heat.
recipes.text: German Style Bratwurst And Sauerkraut. Cook bacon in large skillet over medium high heat until crisp. Remove bacon; drain and crumble on paper towel, set aside. Drain off all but 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet. Add onion and garlic to dripping; cook over medium heat until tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in sauerkraut, potatoes, 1 1/2 cups of water, juice, brown sugar, bouillon, caraway and dried bay leaf. Add remaining water if necessary to cover potatoes. Bring to boil over high heat.

recipes.title: Kielbasa And Kraut
ingredients: 1 large can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed
1/2 c. dry white wine or water
directions: Saute onion slightly.
Put all ingredients in large casserole and mix well.
Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours in 325u00b0 oven, stirring occasionally.
Add more liquid if too thick.
recipes.text: Kielbasa And Kraut. Saute onion slightly. Put all ingredients in large casserole and mix well. Cover and bake for 1 1/2 hours in 325u00b0 oven, stirring occasionally. Add more liquid if too thick.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix all of the ingredients and pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 400u00b0 until done.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Mix all of the ingredients and pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 400u00b0 until done.

recipes.title: Cowboys Beans
directions: Cut up onions and brown in pan.
Cube bacon and fry brown hamburger also.
Mix all ingredients.
Bake in casserole about 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Cowboys Beans. Cut up onions and brown in pan. Cube bacon and fry brown hamburger also. Mix all ingredients. Bake in casserole about 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or ground turkey
directions: Brown meat in large frying pan.
Drain fat.
Add celery, tomatoes, tomato paste, water, seasonings, green pepper, bouillon and rice.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Put mixture into 3-quart baking dish.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 35 minutes.
Add water or tomato juice if necessary.
Stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. Brown meat in large frying pan. Drain fat. Add celery, tomatoes, tomato paste, water, seasonings, green pepper, bouillon and rice. Simmer 10 minutes. Put mixture into 3-quart baking dish. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 35 minutes. Add water or tomato juice if necessary. Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 Head lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
directions: Layer lettuce, celery, green pepper, onion, carrot and peas in the order listed. In a 9 x 13-inch dish. Spread with the mayonnaise, sealing to the edges. Sprinkle with the sugar, cheese and bacon. Chill tightly covered for 8-10 hours.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Salad. Layer lettuce, celery, green pepper, onion, carrot and peas in the order listed. In a 9 x 13-inch dish. Spread with the mayonnaise, sealing to the edges. Sprinkle with the sugar, cheese and bacon. Chill tightly covered for 8-10 hours.

recipes.title: No Sugar Fruit Cookies
directions: Combine dry ingredients.
Cut in butter and stir in pineapple juice, orange rind, vanilla and egg.
Add fruits and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon, 2-inches apart, on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: No Sugar Fruit Cookies. Combine dry ingredients. Cut in butter and stir in pineapple juice, orange rind, vanilla and egg. Add fruits and nuts. Drop by teaspoon, 2-inches apart, on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Easy Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large onion, cut in small chunks
directions: Spray baking dish with Pam.
Cut unpeeled potatoes into 1 1/2-inch chunks.
Arrange in single layer with onion chunks tucked in between.
Melt butter with garlic.
Remove garlic.
Drizzle butter over potatoes.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and celery seed.
recipes.text: Easy Baked Potatoes. Spray baking dish with Pam. Cut unpeeled potatoes into 1 1/2-inch chunks. Arrange in single layer with onion chunks tucked in between. Melt butter with garlic. Remove garlic. Drizzle butter over potatoes. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and celery seed.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained
directions: Mix all together the first 4 ingredients.
Pour into a flat pan.
Sprinkle the Pepperidge Farm dressing on top.
Pour the melted butter or oleo on top; heat for 1/2 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Spinach Casserole. Mix all together the first 4 ingredients. Pour into a flat pan. Sprinkle the Pepperidge Farm dressing on top. Pour the melted butter or oleo on top; heat for 1/2 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Carrot Souffle
directions: Combine mashed carrots with rest of ingredients.
Mix well. Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.
Spread topping over carrots and return to oven for about 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Souffle. Combine mashed carrots with rest of ingredients. Mix well. Bake in a 325u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Spread topping over carrots and return to oven for about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Broiled Eggplant
ingredients: 2 small eggplant or 1 large, cut into 4 lengthwise slices
directions: Make crisscross cuts in inside surface.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Mix a crushed clove of garlic with about 1/4 cup olive oil; brush over eggplant.
Sprinkle lightly with mixture of fine dry bread crumbs and grated Parmesan cheese.
Drizzle with a little more oil.
Place in greased broiler pan and broil, very, very slowly until golden on top and eggplant is tender.
Takes 10 to 20 minutes depending on thickness of vegetable.
No need to turn eggplant.
recipes.text: Broiled Eggplant. Make crisscross cuts in inside surface. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix a crushed clove of garlic with about 1/4 cup olive oil; brush over eggplant. Sprinkle lightly with mixture of fine dry bread crumbs and grated Parmesan cheese. Drizzle with a little more oil. Place in greased broiler pan and broil, very, very slowly until golden on top and eggplant is tender. Takes 10 to 20 minutes depending on thickness of vegetable. No need to turn eggplant.

recipes.title: Light French Toast
directions: Beat eggs in bowl.
Add milk, sugar and liquid sweetener.
Mix well.
Dip bread in mixture.
Cook over stove in skillet sprayed with nonstick spray at medium-high heat until done on both sides. Serve with lo-cal syrup.
recipes.text: Light French Toast. Beat eggs in bowl. Add milk, sugar and liquid sweetener. Mix well. Dip bread in mixture. Cook over stove in skillet sprayed with nonstick spray at medium-high heat until done on both sides. Serve with lo-cal syrup.

recipes.title: Garlic-Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 can flat anchovies, drained, finely chopped and mashed
1/2 c. light olive or vegetable oil
directions: Place red and white cabbage in separate bowls.
Mix together the garlic and anchovies.
Add vinegar, oil, salt and pepper; stir well (do not mix in food processor).
Divide this mixture evenly between the two bowls of cabbage.
recipes.text: Garlic-Cabbage Salad. Place red and white cabbage in separate bowls. Mix together the garlic and anchovies. Add vinegar, oil, salt and pepper; stir well (do not mix in food processor). Divide this mixture evenly between the two bowls of cabbage.

recipes.title: Provencale Fresh Tomato Relish
directions: Use tomatoes held at room temperature until fully ripe.
Dice tomatoes and set aside.
In small bowl, combine vinegar, mustard, water and salt.
Add onion, capers and tomatoes; mix well.
Cover and refrigerate.
Serve with or on chicken, fish or meat.
recipes.text: Provencale Fresh Tomato Relish. Use tomatoes held at room temperature until fully ripe. Dice tomatoes and set aside. In small bowl, combine vinegar, mustard, water and salt. Add onion, capers and tomatoes; mix well. Cover and refrigerate. Serve with or on chicken, fish or meat.

recipes.title: Cabbage Slaw Dressing
directions: Mix all together in blender.
recipes.text: Cabbage Slaw Dressing. Mix all together in blender.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Dissolve sugar and flour in cold milk.
Add beaten egg yolks. Let boil 5 minutes.
Let cool and pour over vanilla wafers and sliced bananas which have been put in layers in Pyrex bowl.
Add topping.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Dissolve sugar and flour in cold milk. Add beaten egg yolks. Let boil 5 minutes. Let cool and pour over vanilla wafers and sliced bananas which have been put in layers in Pyrex bowl. Add topping.

recipes.title: Smothered Southern Fried Steak
directions: Season meat with seasoned salt and lemon pepper.
Roll meat in milk, then in flour.
Fry until done.
Pour tomatoes and water over steak.
Simmer over low heat until tender.
Add sugar to tomatoes.
recipes.text: Smothered Southern Fried Steak. Season meat with seasoned salt and lemon pepper. Roll meat in milk, then in flour. Fry until done. Pour tomatoes and water over steak. Simmer over low heat until tender. Add sugar to tomatoes.

recipes.title: Mother'S Marble Cobbler
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients.
Pour into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch buttered dish.
Top with cherries and 1/4 cup sugar.
Cover with boiling water.
Bake at 300u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mother'S Marble Cobbler. Mix first 7 ingredients. Pour into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch buttered dish. Top with cherries and 1/4 cup sugar. Cover with boiling water. Bake at 300u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Bake
ingredients: 6 to 7 slices bread, broken into pieces
directions: Mix eggs, milk, salt and mustard.
Pour over bread, ham and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Breakfast Bake. Mix eggs, milk, salt and mustard. Pour over bread, ham and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Pecan Crispies
directions: Mix all ingredients in bowl until well blended.
Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet.
Bake at 320u00b0.
recipes.text: Pecan Crispies. Mix all ingredients in bowl until well blended. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet. Bake at 320u00b0.

recipes.title: Amazing Coconut Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients except coconut in blender.
Cover and blend on low speed for 3 minutes.
Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.
Let stand 5 minutes, then sprinkle with coconut.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Amazing Coconut Pie. Combine all ingredients except coconut in blender. Cover and blend on low speed for 3 minutes. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan. Let stand 5 minutes, then sprinkle with coconut. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemon Pie
directions: Stir lemonade into condensed milk. Fold in Cool Whip and spoon into baked pie shell. Freeze. (Limeade may be substituted for lemonade.)
recipes.text: Frozen Lemon Pie. Stir lemonade into condensed milk. Fold in Cool Whip and spoon into baked pie shell. Freeze. (Limeade may be substituted for lemonade.)

recipes.title: Mexican Pile-On
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. tortilla chips or Fritos
directions: Crush
chips into small pieces.
Cook rice according to package directions.
To
serve, layer on a dinner plate in the order ingredients are
listed
using
2/3 cup of chips and 2/3 cup chili
per person.tRemaining ingredients are used according to taste.
May
be served in flour tortilla shell.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Mexican Pile-On. Crush chips into small pieces. Cook rice according to package directions. To serve, layer on a dinner plate in the order ingredients are listed using 2/3 cup of chips and 2/3 cup chili per person.tRemaining ingredients are used according to taste. May be served in flour tortilla shell. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cajun Rice
directions: Cook rice according to directions on box.
Completely cover sausage with water and cook until done.
Combine rest of ingredients with rice, sausage and water.
Put in baking dish. Water should almost cover entire mixture.
Add more if needed. Cover.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cajun Rice. Cook rice according to directions on box. Completely cover sausage with water and cook until done. Combine rest of ingredients with rice, sausage and water. Put in baking dish. Water should almost cover entire mixture. Add more if needed. Cover. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rotel Chicken
directions: Boil chicken breasts. Take cooked chicken and set aside to cool. Cook vermicelli in chicken broth, then drain. Saute onions and peppers in margarine. Set aside. Chop chicken and Velveeta. Add to vermicelli. Add onions, peppers, mushrooms and peas. Mix well. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Rotel Chicken. Boil chicken breasts. Take cooked chicken and set aside to cool. Cook vermicelli in chicken broth, then drain. Saute onions and peppers in margarine. Set aside. Chop chicken and Velveeta. Add to vermicelli. Add onions, peppers, mushrooms and peas. Mix well. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Dainties
directions: Combine butter and cream cheese; then add sugar and extract and cream until fluffy.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and add to butter/cheese/sugar mixture.
Beat until just mixed, cover and chill dough.
Roll into balls.
Roll in crushed walnuts and put on ungreased cookie sheet.
Then press 1/2 glaced cherry in top of each cookie.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until slightly browned.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Dainties. Combine butter and cream cheese; then add sugar and extract and cream until fluffy. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and add to butter/cheese/sugar mixture. Beat until just mixed, cover and chill dough. Roll into balls. Roll in crushed walnuts and put on ungreased cookie sheet. Then press 1/2 glaced cherry in top of each cookie. Bake at 350u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes or until slightly browned.

recipes.title: Those Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes in jacket the night before using.
Do not overcook.
Cool and refrigerate.
Next day, peel, shred (do not grate) into shallow baking dish (7 x 12 x 2-inch).
Arrange lightly in dish.
Add salt and cheese.
Pour cream over potatoes.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown. These can be prepared early in the day.
Cover and refrigerate, then pour over cream just before putting in oven.
recipes.text: Those Potatoes. Cook potatoes in jacket the night before using. Do not overcook. Cool and refrigerate. Next day, peel, shred (do not grate) into shallow baking dish (7 x 12 x 2-inch). Arrange lightly in dish. Add salt and cheese. Pour cream over potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until brown. These can be prepared early in the day. Cover and refrigerate, then pour over cream just before putting in oven.

recipes.title: Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix all the ingredients in an airtight container. When ready to serve, mix 1/3 cup mix with 1 cup boiling water.
recipes.text: Cocoa Mix. Mix all the ingredients in an airtight container. When ready to serve, mix 1/3 cup mix with 1 cup boiling water.

recipes.title: Easy Rice Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Easy Rice Pudding. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 c. sour cream or Dannon's vanilla yogurt
2 to 4 Tbsp. lemon juice to taste
directions: Mix chicken, soup, sour cream and lemon juice.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover with crushed crackers; sprinkle with poppy seed and drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Chicken. Mix chicken, soup, sour cream and lemon juice. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with crushed crackers; sprinkle with poppy seed and drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Rolls(Chilled)
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add milk, Crisco, salt, mashed potato and eggs.
Gradually add flour.
Chill dough 1 to 2 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Potato Rolls(Chilled). Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add milk, Crisco, salt, mashed potato and eggs. Gradually add flour. Chill dough 1 to 2 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Snowcapped Raspberry Bars
directions: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
Blend in flour.
Press mixture evenly into bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 12 minutes.
Remove from oven and immediately spread on jam.
Beat egg whites until foamy, add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time.
Continue beating until stiff.
Fold in coconut and half the walnuts, spread over jam.
Sprinkle with remaining walnuts and return to oven for 20 minutes longer.
Cool before cutting into squares.
recipes.text: Snowcapped Raspberry Bars. Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in flour. Press mixture evenly into bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 12 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately spread on jam. Beat egg whites until foamy, add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time. Continue beating until stiff. Fold in coconut and half the walnuts, spread over jam. Sprinkle with remaining walnuts and return to oven for 20 minutes longer. Cool before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Sugarless Drop Cookies
directions: Add prunes, dates and raisins to water.
Boil for 6 minutes. Cool.
Add eggs, flour, baking soda and salt.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 22 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugarless Drop Cookies. Add prunes, dates and raisins to water. Boil for 6 minutes. Cool. Add eggs, flour, baking soda and salt. Bake at 350u00b0 for 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn-Rice Casserole
directions: Cook rice by package directions; add the stick of oleo.
Mix corn and soup with rice.
Add onion.
Mix well.
Pour mixture into casserole dish.
Cover top with cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 to 30 minutes (until cheese melts).
recipes.text: Corn-Rice Casserole. Cook rice by package directions; add the stick of oleo. Mix corn and soup with rice. Add onion. Mix well. Pour mixture into casserole dish. Cover top with cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for about 20 to 30 minutes (until cheese melts).

recipes.title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Cut the baked potatoes in half.
Delicately scoop out the insides, leaving the skins whole.
Mix the potatoes with cheese, egg, deviled ham and seasonings.
Mix in the cream until fluffy. Scoop the mixture back into the skins and bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 12 to 17 minutes.
recipes.text: Twice Baked Potatoes. Cut the baked potatoes in half. Delicately scoop out the insides, leaving the skins whole. Mix the potatoes with cheese, egg, deviled ham and seasonings. Mix in the cream until fluffy. Scoop the mixture back into the skins and bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 12 to 17 minutes.

recipes.title: Nestle Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt chocolate bits, milk and sugar in double boiler.
Add egg yolks.
Cook until mixed and slightly thickened.
Add butter. Cool.
Fold in stiff beaten egg whites. Then fold in cream (1/2 pint), which has been beaten and slightly sweetened. Pour into baked pie shell.
Allow to set in refrigerator.
Top with pecans, whipped cream and more broken pieces and a small amount of shaved bitter chocolate.
This makes 1 large pie or 2 small ones.
recipes.text: Nestle Chocolate Pie. Melt chocolate bits, milk and sugar in double boiler. Add egg yolks. Cook until mixed and slightly thickened. Add butter. Cool. Fold in stiff beaten egg whites. Then fold in cream (1/2 pint), which has been beaten and slightly sweetened. Pour into baked pie shell. Allow to set in refrigerator. Top with pecans, whipped cream and more broken pieces and a small amount of shaved bitter chocolate. This makes 1 large pie or 2 small ones.

recipes.title: Mexican Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 c. seasoned, fine, dry bread crumbs
bell pepper and pimento for garnish
directions: In a medium saucepan, combine mushrooms, zucchini, onion, wine or water and 1/4 cup of water.
Cover and let vegetables steam over medium heat until tender.
Drain off liquid and add catsup and mustard; set aside.
recipes.text: Mexican Meat Loaf. In a medium saucepan, combine mushrooms, zucchini, onion, wine or water and 1/4 cup of water. Cover and let vegetables steam over medium heat until tender. Drain off liquid and add catsup and mustard; set aside.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
directions: Mix all together.
Mold into 1 large loaf or 2 small ones. Bake at 300u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Ham Loaf. Mix all together. Mold into 1 large loaf or 2 small ones. Bake at 300u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Lacy Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Melt butter in a bowl.
Cool. Put oatmeal and sugar in with butter; add egg.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drop by 1/2 teaspoonful on foil.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cookies will spread out flat.
Let cool on foil before removing.
recipes.text: Lacy Oatmeal Cookies. Melt butter in a bowl. Cool. Put oatmeal and sugar in with butter; add egg. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by 1/2 teaspoonful on foil. Bake at 375u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Cookies will spread out flat. Let cool on foil before removing.

recipes.title: Bok Choy Sensational Salad
directions: Wash, core, and chop the bok choy and onions into bite-size pieces.
Chill after drying.
recipes.text: Bok Choy Sensational Salad. Wash, core, and chop the bok choy and onions into bite-size pieces. Chill after drying.

recipes.title: Party Punch
ingredients: 1 small can frozen orange juice concentrate
1 small can frozen lime juice concentrate
1 small can frozen fruit punch concentrate
1 small can frozen pink lemonade concentrate
directions: Empty
pineapple
juice
into
a gallon container.
Add frozen juices
one
at
a time.
Add sugar and Kool-Aid flavor packet. Finally add enough water to make a gallon mixture and stir well. Serve
in
combination
with
ginger ale for a refreshing party drink!
recipes.text: Party Punch. Empty pineapple juice into a gallon container. Add frozen juices one at a time. Add sugar and Kool-Aid flavor packet. Finally add enough water to make a gallon mixture and stir well. Serve in combination with ginger ale for a refreshing party drink!

recipes.title: Lazy Man'S Pie
ingredients: 1 large can peaches in heavy syrup or other canned fruit
directions: Melt margarine in 2-liter casserole dish in 350u00b0 oven.
Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, milk and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Pour this over the melted margarine.
Drop on top of this the cut-up peaches or fruit of choice along with syrup.
Bake until crust rises through fruit and browns.
recipes.text: Lazy Man'S Pie. Melt margarine in 2-liter casserole dish in 350u00b0 oven. Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, milk and cinnamon in a small bowl. Pour this over the melted margarine. Drop on top of this the cut-up peaches or fruit of choice along with syrup. Bake until crust rises through fruit and browns.

recipes.title: Coconut Cheese Pie
directions: Spread or rub butter into pie pan.
Spread 1 1/3 cups coconut and mash to make a pie shell.
Mix remainder of ingredients together and pour into pie shell.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Cheese Pie. Spread or rub butter into pie pan. Spread 1 1/3 cups coconut and mash to make a pie shell. Mix remainder of ingredients together and pour into pie shell. Bake at 325u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Boil sugar, water, cornstarch and strawberry Jell-O together until thick.
Set aside to cool.
Cook pie shell and cool.
Put whole or sliced strawberries into cooled pie shell and pour cooled filling on top of berries.
Top with Cool Whip.
Makes 1 pie.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Boil sugar, water, cornstarch and strawberry Jell-O together until thick. Set aside to cool. Cook pie shell and cool. Put whole or sliced strawberries into cooled pie shell and pour cooled filling on top of berries. Top with Cool Whip. Makes 1 pie.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. pkg. medium egg noodles, cooked and drained
directions: In a 2-quart casserole dish, combine cooked noodles with all ingredients, except the onion rings.
Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle dried onion rings on top and bake for 5 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. In a 2-quart casserole dish, combine cooked noodles with all ingredients, except the onion rings. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle dried onion rings on top and bake for 5 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Cut margarine over unbaked pie shell; add pecans.
Beat eggs, sugar,
flour
andtsyrup well.
Add vanilla.
Pour over margarine and pecans.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 3/4 hour.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Cut margarine over unbaked pie shell; add pecans. Beat eggs, sugar, flour andtsyrup well. Add vanilla. Pour over margarine and pecans. Bake at 325u00b0 for 3/4 hour.

recipes.title: Yummy No-Fail Pecan Pie
directions: *Or purchase in dairy section of store.
recipes.text: Yummy No-Fail Pecan Pie. *Or purchase in dairy section of store.

recipes.title: Ratatouille(Ra-Ta-Tooey)
directions: Cut everything into bite size pieces.
In large covered pot, first cook tomatoes (with juice) and onion until onion is soft. Add zucchini, eggplant and green pepper.
Cook for approximately 15 minutes.
Do not let eggplant and zucchini become mushy!
Can be served hot or cold.
If cold, add a dab of sour cream on top. Good anytime of year, but excellent with fresh summer produce!
recipes.text: Ratatouille(Ra-Ta-Tooey). Cut everything into bite size pieces. In large covered pot, first cook tomatoes (with juice) and onion until onion is soft. Add zucchini, eggplant and green pepper. Cook for approximately 15 minutes. Do not let eggplant and zucchini become mushy! Can be served hot or cold. If cold, add a dab of sour cream on top. Good anytime of year, but excellent with fresh summer produce!

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Add nuts.
Pour into greased pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Use one large loaf pan or two small.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix all ingredients well. Add nuts. Pour into greased pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Use one large loaf pan or two small.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix sugar and cooking oil.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each one.
Add vanilla and dry ingredients to egg mixture alternately with carrots.
Add nuts.
Beat well.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 X 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Mix sugar and cooking oil. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each one. Add vanilla and dry ingredients to egg mixture alternately with carrots. Add nuts. Beat well. Pour into a greased and floured 9 X 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.

recipes.title: Caramels
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Combine in
heavy pot with wooden spoon.
Cook over low heat until 250u00b0 on candy thermometer.
Take off stove and stir in 2 teaspoons
vanilla.
Pour in greased pan, 9 x 13-inches. Cool and cut into pieces; wrap in waxed paper.
Hard to cut if too cold.
recipes.text: Caramels. Combine in heavy pot with wooden spoon. Cook over low heat until 250u00b0 on candy thermometer. Take off stove and stir in 2 teaspoons vanilla. Pour in greased pan, 9 x 13-inches. Cool and cut into pieces; wrap in waxed paper. Hard to cut if too cold.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Put 1/3 cup mix in cup.
Add hot water.
recipes.text: Hot Chocolate Mix. Mix all ingredients together. Put 1/3 cup mix in cup. Add hot water.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Mix cream of chicken soup, celery soup and water in pan that you will bake it in.
Sprinkle Minute rice over soup mixture.
Add cup-up chicken.
Sprinkle onion soup over chicken.
Cover with tin foil and bake at 325u00b0 for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. Mix cream of chicken soup, celery soup and water in pan that you will bake it in. Sprinkle Minute rice over soup mixture. Add cup-up chicken. Sprinkle onion soup over chicken. Cover with tin foil and bake at 325u00b0 for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Russian Tea Mix
ingredients: 1/2 c. Lipton tea mix (okay to use lemon type)
directions: Mix and store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Russian Tea Mix. Mix and store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Mix; pour into 3 cake pans and bake according to box directions.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Cake. Mix; pour into 3 cake pans and bake according to box directions.

recipes.title: Brussels Sprouts In Blue Cheese Sauce
directions: Cook Brussels sprouts as directed on package.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add flour and salt, mixing until smooth.
Cook over low heat about 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Add 1 cup milk, stirring until well blended.
Return to heat and stir until mixture begins to thicken.
Add 1 cup milk; bring to boil and cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
recipes.text: Brussels Sprouts In Blue Cheese Sauce. Cook Brussels sprouts as directed on package. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and salt, mixing until smooth. Cook over low heat about 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup milk, stirring until well blended. Return to heat and stir until mixture begins to thicken. Add 1 cup milk; bring to boil and cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly.

recipes.title: Hot Pepper Butter
directions: Remove seed from peppers and chop fine in food processor.
Set aside.
Place in large deep pan the salt, sugar, mustard and vinegar.
Boil 15 minutes.
Mix flour and water in a bowl.
Add to vinegar mixture and stir.
Add peppers.
Cook until thick, about 5 minutes.
Put pepper butter in jot jars and seal, but not tight. Place in water bath 5 to 10 minutes, then retighten ring again. Makes about 8 pints.
recipes.text: Hot Pepper Butter. Remove seed from peppers and chop fine in food processor. Set aside. Place in large deep pan the salt, sugar, mustard and vinegar. Boil 15 minutes. Mix flour and water in a bowl. Add to vinegar mixture and stir. Add peppers. Cook until thick, about 5 minutes. Put pepper butter in jot jars and seal, but not tight. Place in water bath 5 to 10 minutes, then retighten ring again. Makes about 8 pints.

recipes.title: Grilled Stuffed Iowa Pork Chops
directions: Have butcher cut pocket in pork chops.
Fill mixture in pocket.
Insert toothpicks to hold pocket together.
Combine butter, parsley, lemon juice, wine and salt.
Place chops on grill.
Cook about 7 minutes on each side, basting frequently with sauce.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Grilled Stuffed Iowa Pork Chops. Have butcher cut pocket in pork chops. Fill mixture in pocket. Insert toothpicks to hold pocket together. Combine butter, parsley, lemon juice, wine and salt. Place chops on grill. Cook about 7 minutes on each side, basting frequently with sauce. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water. Add juice from blueberries and pineapple. Chill until it begins to thicken. Add fruits and nuts. Chill until set. Whip cream cheese, sour cream and sugar. Spread on top and sprinkle with nuts.
recipes.text: Blueberry Salad. Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water. Add juice from blueberries and pineapple. Chill until it begins to thicken. Add fruits and nuts. Chill until set. Whip cream cheese, sour cream and sugar. Spread on top and sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
directions: Trim fat and bone from meat; cut into 4 to 6 serving pieces. Grease large skillet lightly with fat from meat.
Brown thoroughly on one side; turn and season with remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Push meat to one side.
Add onions and cook and stir until tender. Stir in broth, soy sauce and garlic.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Blend cornstarch with water; stir gradually into meat mixture. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Add tomatoes.
Heat thoroughly.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Pepper Steak. Trim fat and bone from meat; cut into 4 to 6 serving pieces. Grease large skillet lightly with fat from meat. Brown thoroughly on one side; turn and season with remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Push meat to one side. Add onions and cook and stir until tender. Stir in broth, soy sauce and garlic. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Blend cornstarch with water; stir gradually into meat mixture. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens. Boil and stir 1 minute. Add tomatoes. Heat thoroughly. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Apple Salad Dressing
directions: Blend together and cook sugar, flour and salt.
In cup beat egg and add cream; then add vinegar and mustard.
Mix all of the ingredients together and cook until clear.
Dice up several apples and pour dressing over them.
Pecans may be added.
recipes.text: Apple Salad Dressing. Blend together and cook sugar, flour and salt. In cup beat egg and add cream; then add vinegar and mustard. Mix all of the ingredients together and cook until clear. Dice up several apples and pour dressing over them. Pecans may be added.

recipes.title: Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. grated extra sharp Cheddar cheese
2 pkg. dry yeast plus 1 tsp. sugar, dissolved in 3/4 c. warm water (105~ to 115~)
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients and scald; remove from heat. Add cheese and stir until melted.
Cool to lukewarm; add eggs and yeast mixture.
Beat in 3 cups of flour; allow mixture to rise in a warm place (85u00b0) for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Bread. Combine the first 4 ingredients and scald; remove from heat. Add cheese and stir until melted. Cool to lukewarm; add eggs and yeast mixture. Beat in 3 cups of flour; allow mixture to rise in a warm place (85u00b0) for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse
directions: In a small bowl, sprinkle gelatin over cold water.
Stir.
Set aside a few minutes to soften.
Add boiling water and stir until gelatin is completely dissolved.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mousse. In a small bowl, sprinkle gelatin over cold water. Stir. Set aside a few minutes to soften. Add boiling water and stir until gelatin is completely dissolved.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Cream oleo, oil and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and sour milk (1/2 cup milk with 2 teaspoons vinegar).
Sift in remaining ingredients except zucchini.
Stir in zucchini.
Pour into a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Zucchini Cake. Cream oleo, oil and sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and sour milk (1/2 cup milk with 2 teaspoons vinegar). Sift in remaining ingredients except zucchini. Stir in zucchini. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Delight
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
1 c. pineapple pie filling or 1 can crushed pineapple, drained
directions: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake cake mix for 15 minutes.
Remove
from
oven.
Mixtpudding,
milktand
cream cheese.
Spread on the top of cake.
Spread pie filling on the top of puddingtmixture and top with Cool Whip and nuts if you like.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Delight. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake cake mix for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Mixtpudding, milktand cream cheese. Spread on the top of cake. Spread pie filling on the top of puddingtmixture and top with Cool Whip and nuts if you like.

recipes.title: Mosaic Bean Souphouston, Texas
directions: Combine in large bowl.
Measure out 2 c. gift packages.
If you can't find all the beans, substitute another variety.
To each package add a separately wrapped packet of:
1 1/4 tsp. salt, 1/2 tsp. pepper, 1 bay leaf, 1/4 tsp.
cumin and 1/4 tsp. ground cayenne.
recipes.text: Mosaic Bean Souphouston, Texas. Combine in large bowl. Measure out 2 c. gift packages. If you can't find all the beans, substitute another variety. To each package add a separately wrapped packet of: 1 1/4 tsp. salt, 1/2 tsp. pepper, 1 bay leaf, 1/4 tsp. cumin and 1/4 tsp. ground cayenne.

recipes.title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. hot or mild sausage, cooked and drained
directions: On bottom of casserole,
layer bread, cheese and sausage.
Beat eggs; add 2 1/4 cups milk and mustard.
Pour this over the top.
Next, mix
1/2 cup milk with soup; pour on top. Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours, until set.
recipes.text: Sausage-Egg Casserole. On bottom of casserole, layer bread, cheese and sausage. Beat eggs; add 2 1/4 cups milk and mustard. Pour this over the top. Next, mix 1/2 cup milk with soup; pour on top. Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours, until set.

recipes.title: Leche Flan
directions: Mix egg yolks, evaporated milk and condensed milk together on leche flan pan.
On separate cooking pan, heat sugar until it melts and then add to mixture in leche flan pan.
Cook in a steamer for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Leche Flan. Mix egg yolks, evaporated milk and condensed milk together on leche flan pan. On separate cooking pan, heat sugar until it melts and then add to mixture in leche flan pan. Cook in a steamer for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Beef Salami
directions: Mix well divide in half make two rolls wrap in wax paper.
Let stand in fridge. 24 hours.
Unwrap and cook on rack for 1 hour at 325 degrees.
recipes.text: Beef Salami. Mix well divide in half make two rolls wrap in wax paper. Let stand in fridge. 24 hours. Unwrap and cook on rack for 1 hour at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: Yesterday Cake
directions: Melt the margarine; mix in the egg, sugar, pineapple and Cool Whip.
Mix well.
Add the pecans and mix again.
Line a dish with the vanilla wafers and pour mixture over the vanilla wafers. Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Yesterday Cake. Melt the margarine; mix in the egg, sugar, pineapple and Cool Whip. Mix well. Add the pecans and mix again. Line a dish with the vanilla wafers and pour mixture over the vanilla wafers. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Put into an 8 to 9-inch pan and bake at 350u00b0 until lightly brown.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Put into an 8 to 9-inch pan and bake at 350u00b0 until lightly brown. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Pizza Dog
directions: Boil hot dog until almost done.
Slice down the middle and add 2 to 3 teaspoons of sauce.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake in preheated 325u00b0 oven until cheese is melted.
Remove tomato sauce from can and refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Pizza Dog. Boil hot dog until almost done. Slice down the middle and add 2 to 3 teaspoons of sauce. Sprinkle with cheese and bake in preheated 325u00b0 oven until cheese is melted. Remove tomato sauce from can and refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Grease and flour pan.
Suggest shortening and butter be softened.
Mix well.
Beat 1 egg at a time.
Add flavorings.
Add flour and milk.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Grease and flour pan. Suggest shortening and butter be softened. Mix well. Beat 1 egg at a time. Add flavorings. Add flour and milk. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Patio Beans
ingredients: 2 (15 oz.) cans kidney beans with juice
directions: Mix together and bake for 1 hour at 375u00b0 or 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Patio Beans. Mix together and bake for 1 hour at 375u00b0 or 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Logs
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients thoroughly by hand; form into balls. Place on wax paper.
Melt chocolate chips and paraffin wax.
Dip in chocolate; place on wax paper to dry.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Logs. Mix first 4 ingredients thoroughly by hand; form into balls. Place on wax paper. Melt chocolate chips and paraffin wax. Dip in chocolate; place on wax paper to dry.

recipes.title: "That Cake"
directions: Combine the eggs, oil, water, Dream Whip, pudding, cake mix and vanilla and beat on medium speed with an electric mixer for 7 minutes. Set aside.
Mix together the cinnamon, sugar and walnuts to make the streusel.
In well-greased and floured Bundt pan, pour 1/3 of the cake batter.
Top this with 1/3 of the streusel mixture. Repeat this process 2 more times.
Marbelize and bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool 15 minutes and remove from the pan. Sprinkle with powdered sugar or serve plain.
recipes.text: "That Cake". Combine the eggs, oil, water, Dream Whip, pudding, cake mix and vanilla and beat on medium speed with an electric mixer for 7 minutes. Set aside. Mix together the cinnamon, sugar and walnuts to make the streusel. In well-greased and floured Bundt pan, pour 1/3 of the cake batter. Top this with 1/3 of the streusel mixture. Repeat this process 2 more times. Marbelize and bake at 350u00b0 for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool 15 minutes and remove from the pan. Sprinkle with powdered sugar or serve plain.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Cheesecake
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended.
Add eggs; mix until blended. Pour into crust.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set.
Refrigerate 3 hours.
Spread fruit topping over cheesecake.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Cheesecake. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs; mix until blended. Pour into crust. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Refrigerate 3 hours. Spread fruit topping over cheesecake.

recipes.title: Radiatore Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 (46 oz.) cans low salt chicken broth
1 small red pepper, seeded and diced
directions: Bring chicken broth to a boil.
Add remaining ingredients except Radiatore.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer until chicken is no longer pink and carrots are tender.
Meanwhile, cook Radiatore according to package instructions, approximately 10 to 12 minutes. Take care not to overcook.
Drain pasta; add to soup and serve immediately.
recipes.text: Radiatore Chicken Soup. Bring chicken broth to a boil. Add remaining ingredients except Radiatore. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until chicken is no longer pink and carrots are tender. Meanwhile, cook Radiatore according to package instructions, approximately 10 to 12 minutes. Take care not to overcook. Drain pasta; add to soup and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Priest'S Lunch
directions: Combine all ingredients with 2 1/2 consomme cans of water in deep casserole.
Cover tightly.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Priest'S Lunch. Combine all ingredients with 2 1/2 consomme cans of water in deep casserole. Cover tightly. Bake at 350u00b0 for 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Amy'S K. Balls
directions: Heat Karo and sugar.
When it starts to bubble, take off heat and add peanut butter and mix.
Pour over the cereal and mix. When cool, shape into balls and put on wax paper.
recipes.text: Amy'S K. Balls. Heat Karo and sugar. When it starts to bubble, take off heat and add peanut butter and mix. Pour over the cereal and mix. When cool, shape into balls and put on wax paper.

recipes.title: Peanut Candy
directions: Combine all ingredients in heavy saucepan, except peanuts. Cook until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Stir constantly to prevent scorching.
Turn onto a buttered baking sheet or wax paper.
When cool, cut into small squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Candy. Combine all ingredients in heavy saucepan, except peanuts. Cook until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Stir constantly to prevent scorching. Turn onto a buttered baking sheet or wax paper. When cool, cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Mother'S Punch
directions: Mix altogether and serve with a pretty ice ring.
Serves 75 to 80.
recipes.text: Mother'S Punch. Mix altogether and serve with a pretty ice ring. Serves 75 to 80.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bonbon
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together and roll into balls. Refrigerate 2 hours.
Dip in chocolate mix consisting of the chocolate chips and paraffin melted in a double boiler.
Put on cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil.
Put in refrigerator or freezer. (May be put in container in freezer until ready to use.)
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bonbon. Mix the first 3 ingredients together and roll into balls. Refrigerate 2 hours. Dip in chocolate mix consisting of the chocolate chips and paraffin melted in a double boiler. Put on cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil. Put in refrigerator or freezer. (May be put in container in freezer until ready to use.)

recipes.title: First Quarter Gusto
directions: Dump Wolf Brand chili (no beans) into medium saucepan (do not scrape grease from can).
Add corn, jalapenos, onion (chopped) and cheese.
Put crushed tortilla chips into big bowl.
Pour hot mixture over chips. Enjoy with cold beers and good game. Begin Rolaids at half time if consumed during first quarter.
recipes.text: First Quarter Gusto. Dump Wolf Brand chili (no beans) into medium saucepan (do not scrape grease from can). Add corn, jalapenos, onion (chopped) and cheese. Put crushed tortilla chips into big bowl. Pour hot mixture over chips. Enjoy with cold beers and good game. Begin Rolaids at half time if consumed during first quarter.

recipes.title: Steak And Gravy
directions: Put the steak and soup in a slow cooker and cook on high all day.
Stir occasionally to keep from sticking.
When done, the steak is very tender and makes its own gravy.
recipes.text: Steak And Gravy. Put the steak and soup in a slow cooker and cook on high all day. Stir occasionally to keep from sticking. When done, the steak is very tender and makes its own gravy.

recipes.title: Apple Taffy Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed or chunk pineapple
directions: Combine first the juice from pineapple (reserve pineapple on side), 1/2 cup sugar, flour, cider vinegar and beaten egg .
Mix together in saucepan; heat on stove until thick.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Taffy Salad. Combine first the juice from pineapple (reserve pineapple on side), 1/2 cup sugar, flour, cider vinegar and beaten egg . Mix together in saucepan; heat on stove until thick. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mac-Apple Dips
directions: Mix all together and chill.
Cut apples before serving.
Also yummy with veggies.
recipes.text: Mac-Apple Dips. Mix all together and chill. Cut apples before serving. Also yummy with veggies.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. each vanilla, almond and lemon extract
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix on medium speed until well blended and smooth (approximately 6 minutes).
Pour into a tube pan and bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
Take cake out of pan and continue cooling on a wire rack.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix on medium speed until well blended and smooth (approximately 6 minutes). Pour into a tube pan and bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes. Take cake out of pan and continue cooling on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Angie'S Fried Turkey
directions: Mix together in jar; will cover a few turkeys.
Marinate turkey with these dried ingredients liberally and let sit overnight for best results.
Cook domestic turkey 4 minutes per pound at 350u00b0.
Cook wild turkey 3 minutes per pound at 300u00b0.
recipes.text: Angie'S Fried Turkey. Mix together in jar; will cover a few turkeys. Marinate turkey with these dried ingredients liberally and let sit overnight for best results. Cook domestic turkey 4 minutes per pound at 350u00b0. Cook wild turkey 3 minutes per pound at 300u00b0.

recipes.title: Barbecued Hamburgers
directions: Mix all ingredients and shape into patties.
Brown quickly on both sides.
Cover with barbecue sauce and bake in oven at 325u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecued Hamburgers. Mix all ingredients and shape into patties. Brown quickly on both sides. Cover with barbecue sauce and bake in oven at 325u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt together and beat oleo and chocolate. Beat all ingredients together in greased pie plate. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Pie. Melt together and beat oleo and chocolate. Beat all ingredients together in greased pie plate. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Potato Pizza
ingredients: 1 c. frozen loose hash browns, thawed
directions: In skillet, cook
sausage
until
browned; drain excess fat. Separate crescent dough
into
8 triangles.
Place in an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan.tPress
over
bottom and up sides to form a crust, seal perforations.
Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes.
Top with cheese (Cheddar).
recipes.text: Sausage Potato Pizza. In skillet, cook sausage until browned; drain excess fat. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles. Place in an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan.tPress over bottom and up sides to form a crust, seal perforations. Spoon sausage over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes. Top with cheese (Cheddar).

recipes.title: Icebox Fruit Cake
directions: Melt marshmallows in hot milk.
Stir all other ingredients into hot milk and marshmallows.
Crush cookies real fine, put in loaf pan and chill 10 to 12 hours.
I always save out a few pecans and cherries to decorate the top of the fruitcake by halving a few cherries, add a half cherry and a pecan half and keep it going until it is covered on top.
It is a good one and very easy to make.
recipes.text: Icebox Fruit Cake. Melt marshmallows in hot milk. Stir all other ingredients into hot milk and marshmallows. Crush cookies real fine, put in loaf pan and chill 10 to 12 hours. I always save out a few pecans and cherries to decorate the top of the fruitcake by halving a few cherries, add a half cherry and a pecan half and keep it going until it is covered on top. It is a good one and very easy to make.

recipes.title: Peanut Rolls
directions: Beat egg yolks; add 3/4 cup sugar and salt; beat 5 minutes, then add water.
In separate bowl, beat egg whites until stiff and add remaining 3/4 cup sugar.
Stir with egg yolk mixture and fold in flour and baking powder.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven in 9 x 13-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Rolls. Beat egg yolks; add 3/4 cup sugar and salt; beat 5 minutes, then add water. In separate bowl, beat egg whites until stiff and add remaining 3/4 cup sugar. Stir with egg yolk mixture and fold in flour and baking powder. Bake in 350u00b0 oven in 9 x 13-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix flour and sugar. Bring to a boil the cocoa, oleo, oil and water.
Pour cocoa mixture over flour and sugar and mix well by hand. Add buttermilk, vanilla and eggs. Pour mixture in pan, greased and dusted with flour. Bake 35 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Mix flour and sugar. Bring to a boil the cocoa, oleo, oil and water. Pour cocoa mixture over flour and sugar and mix well by hand. Add buttermilk, vanilla and eggs. Pour mixture in pan, greased and dusted with flour. Bake 35 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Clams In Black Bean Sauce(Recipe For One Pound Of Clams; May Use For Any Shellfish.)
directions: Rinse clams thoroughly.
Place in 5 cups of water and bring to a boil.
As soon as clams start to open, remove from stove and set aside and drain.
Prepare black beans by soaking in warm water and mashing it.
Heat oil; add garlic and black bean.
Add broth, sugar, oyster sauce, shoyu, salt and ajinomoto.
Make cornstarch paste by adding water to the cornstarch.
Add to sauce to thicken.
recipes.text: Clams In Black Bean Sauce(Recipe For One Pound Of Clams; May Use For Any Shellfish.). Rinse clams thoroughly. Place in 5 cups of water and bring to a boil. As soon as clams start to open, remove from stove and set aside and drain. Prepare black beans by soaking in warm water and mashing it. Heat oil; add garlic and black bean. Add broth, sugar, oyster sauce, shoyu, salt and ajinomoto. Make cornstarch paste by adding water to the cornstarch. Add to sauce to thicken.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Put meat in blender and chop fine.
Roll in nuts (pecans).
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Put meat in blender and chop fine. Roll in nuts (pecans).

recipes.title: Winterspice Potpourri(Not Edible)
ingredients: 1 c. broken soft stick cinnamon (hard sticks are less fragrant)
3 Tbsp. dried orange peel (save and dry orange peels)
directions: Mix all ingredients together and store in airtight container. Shake before using.
To scent your home, simmer 2 heaping tablespoons in 4 to 6 cups water for 30 to 60 minutes.
Blend can be refrigerated and used again.
recipes.text: Winterspice Potpourri(Not Edible). Mix all ingredients together and store in airtight container. Shake before using. To scent your home, simmer 2 heaping tablespoons in 4 to 6 cups water for 30 to 60 minutes. Blend can be refrigerated and used again.

recipes.title: Whiskey Pound Cake
ingredients: 2 sticks butter or 1 stick butter and 1 stick margarine
directions: Use tube pan and spray with Baker's Joy or grease and flour.
recipes.text: Whiskey Pound Cake. Use tube pan and spray with Baker's Joy or grease and flour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bacon Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. whipping cream and 1 c. half and half or 1 3/4 c. half and half
1 pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed (1/2 pkg. per quiche)
directions: Fry bacon until crisp (6 slices per quiche).
Blot real well. Crumble.
Blot broccoli real well to get out moisture.
recipes.text: Broccoli Bacon Quiche. Fry bacon until crisp (6 slices per quiche). Blot real well. Crumble. Blot broccoli real well to get out moisture.

recipes.title: Creamy Apple Dip
directions: Mix together until creamy.
Great with Granny Smith apples!
recipes.text: Creamy Apple Dip. Mix together until creamy. Great with Granny Smith apples!

recipes.title: Aunt B'S No Bake Cheese Cake
directions: Mix jello and water; cool.
Cream the cheese, sugar and vanilla together.
Add the cooled jello and fold in the Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crusts.
May add a little yellow food coloring to mixture before pouring it into pie crusts.
May also top finished cheese cake with fruit topping.
recipes.text: Aunt B'S No Bake Cheese Cake. Mix jello and water; cool. Cream the cheese, sugar and vanilla together. Add the cooled jello and fold in the Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crusts. May add a little yellow food coloring to mixture before pouring it into pie crusts. May also top finished cheese cake with fruit topping.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken With Rice
ingredients: 1 fryer, cut up or 4 to 5 chicken breasts
1 small can stewed tomatoes or 1 small can tomato sauce
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper;tbrown
in
oil. Remove from pan.tAdd onion, peppers,
tomatoes,tred
pepper flakes and garlic in skillet.tStir in broth and
bring
to
a boil.
Add rice.
Place rice mixture in bottom of
9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with chicken pieces.
Bake covered 1
hour
or until done at 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken With Rice. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper;tbrown in oil. Remove from pan.tAdd onion, peppers, tomatoes,tred pepper flakes and garlic in skillet.tStir in broth and bring to a boil. Add rice. Place rice mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with chicken pieces. Bake covered 1 hour or until done at 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Technicolor Casserole(Aka Chicken Spectacular)
ingredients: 3 c. cooked chicken or Swanson canned chicken chunks
1 pkg. Uncle Ben's combination wild and white rice, cooked
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into a 2 1/2 to 3-quart casserole. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 6 to 8.
To freeze, do not cook prior to freezing.
recipes.text: Technicolor Casserole(Aka Chicken Spectacular). Mix all ingredients. Pour into a 2 1/2 to 3-quart casserole. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 6 to 8. To freeze, do not cook prior to freezing.

recipes.title: Judy'S Granny Cake
directions: Mix sugar, flour, soda and salt together.
Add eggs and pineapple.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread on brown sugar and pecans.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Judy'S Granny Cake. Mix sugar, flour, soda and salt together. Add eggs and pineapple. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread on brown sugar and pecans. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained
directions: Mix and chill.
Shape into balls 3/4 to 1-inch in diameter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
(Can freeze, thaw and cook.)
recipes.text: Spinach Balls. Mix and chill. Shape into balls 3/4 to 1-inch in diameter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. (Can freeze, thaw and cook.)

recipes.title: Strawberry Nut Salad
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen sliced strawberries (partially frozen)
directions: In large container, combine gelatin with boiling water.
Stir until dissolved; then fold in all at once strawberries with juice, pineapple, bananas and nuts.
Pour half mixture into long dish; refrigerate until firm.
Keep the other half over warm water to keep it from congealing.
Spread sour cream over firm Jell-O then spoon the other half of mixture over sour cream.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until firm.
Makes 12 to 15 servings.
recipes.text: Strawberry Nut Salad. In large container, combine gelatin with boiling water. Stir until dissolved; then fold in all at once strawberries with juice, pineapple, bananas and nuts. Pour half mixture into long dish; refrigerate until firm. Keep the other half over warm water to keep it from congealing. Spread sour cream over firm Jell-O then spoon the other half of mixture over sour cream. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until firm. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Crisco Icing
directions: Cook milk and flour over low heat, stirring constantly, until real firm.
Put in refrigerator.
Mix together butter, Crisco, sugar and vanilla; beat until real fine.
Add mixture from refrigerator.
Beat with mixture until whipping cream consistency.
recipes.text: Crisco Icing. Cook milk and flour over low heat, stirring constantly, until real firm. Put in refrigerator. Mix together butter, Crisco, sugar and vanilla; beat until real fine. Add mixture from refrigerator. Beat with mixture until whipping cream consistency.

recipes.title: Dibi'S Chicken And Rice
directions: Put rice in bottom of large, flat, greased casserole dish. Place chicken breasts on rice.
Combine cream soups and water. Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle dry soup mix over top.
Cover.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Dibi'S Chicken And Rice. Put rice in bottom of large, flat, greased casserole dish. Place chicken breasts on rice. Combine cream soups and water. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle dry soup mix over top. Cover. Bake at 350u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Thousand Island Dressing
directions: In a small mixing bowl, combine all ingredients and stir to blend.
Refrigerate until needed for serving.
recipes.text: Thousand Island Dressing. In a small mixing bowl, combine all ingredients and stir to blend. Refrigerate until needed for serving.

recipes.title: Fresh Fruit Pie
directions: Blend cornstarch with 3 tablespoons pineapple juice drained from canned pineapple.
Add remaining juice and pineapple; heat until thickened.
Layer banana slices, peach slices, blueberries and strawberries, leaving some strawberries and blueberries for garnish.
Pour thickened pineapple over fruit; garnish with reserved fruit and, if used, nuts.
Serve cold.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Fresh Fruit Pie. Blend cornstarch with 3 tablespoons pineapple juice drained from canned pineapple. Add remaining juice and pineapple; heat until thickened. Layer banana slices, peach slices, blueberries and strawberries, leaving some strawberries and blueberries for garnish. Pour thickened pineapple over fruit; garnish with reserved fruit and, if used, nuts. Serve cold. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Mixed Fruit Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Cream cheese and 1st preserves with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip with electric mixer on low speed.
Spread this mixture evenly over graham cracker crust. Arrange fruit attractively on this layer.
Heat currant jelly until melted; stir in almond flavoring.
Brush this mixture evenly over the fruit.
Serve immediately or chill for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mixed Fruit Cream Cheese Pie. Cream cheese and 1st preserves with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip with electric mixer on low speed. Spread this mixture evenly over graham cracker crust. Arrange fruit attractively on this layer. Heat currant jelly until melted; stir in almond flavoring. Brush this mixture evenly over the fruit. Serve immediately or chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger in skillet.
Add chopped onion, when hamburger is just browned and continue to cook about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Mix with all other ingredients.
Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Bake covered with foil for 30 minutes.
If you want it brown, uncover and broil for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Brown hamburger in skillet. Add chopped onion, when hamburger is just browned and continue to cook about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Mix with all other ingredients. Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake covered with foil for 30 minutes. If you want it brown, uncover and broil for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Press firmly into ungreased 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.
Bake for about 1 hour.
Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
recipes.text: Prize Winning Meat Loaf. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Press firmly into ungreased 8 x 4-inch loaf pan. Bake for about 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Cool Orange Salad
directions: Whip jello into cottage cheese until jello dissolves.
Add drained oranges.
Store in refrigerator as you would cottage cheese.
recipes.text: Cool Orange Salad. Whip jello into cottage cheese until jello dissolves. Add drained oranges. Store in refrigerator as you would cottage cheese.

recipes.title: Mexican Soup Ole
ingredients: 2 (14 1/2 oz. each) cans stewed tomatoes (Mexican style)
1/2 lb. ground beef or ground turkey, browned
1 (15 1/2 oz.) can garbanzo beans, drained, rinsed and drained
1 (2 1/4 oz.) can black olives, sliced and drained
directions: Place stewed tomatoes in food processor to a puree.
Pour into a large saucepan and add broth, meat, corn, garbanzo beans, olives and oregano.
Bring just to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Serves 4.
Cooking time is 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Soup Ole. Place stewed tomatoes in food processor to a puree. Pour into a large saucepan and add broth, meat, corn, garbanzo beans, olives and oregano. Bring just to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Serves 4. Cooking time is 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamed Peas
directions: Prepare frozen peas according to package; drain.
Keep warm. In a pot, cook green onion in butter for 5 minutes.
Blend in remaining ingredients, except cream.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and cook slowly for 10 minutes.
Add cream; cook until heated.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Creamed Peas. Prepare frozen peas according to package; drain. Keep warm. In a pot, cook green onion in butter for 5 minutes. Blend in remaining ingredients, except cream. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and cook slowly for 10 minutes. Add cream; cook until heated. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken And Spinach Salad
directions: Shred chicken in strips about 2 inches long.
Arrange on spinach leaves on individual plates, alternating with apple, orange and onion rings.
Sprinkle apple slices with lemon juice to prevent darkening.
recipes.text: Chicken And Spinach Salad. Shred chicken in strips about 2 inches long. Arrange on spinach leaves on individual plates, alternating with apple, orange and onion rings. Sprinkle apple slices with lemon juice to prevent darkening.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine and bake 1 hour at 350u00b0 in 3 small pans that have been greased and floured.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Combine and bake 1 hour at 350u00b0 in 3 small pans that have been greased and floured.

recipes.title: Chicken Breast Casserole
directions: Dab a 9 1/2 x 11-inch glass dish generously with 1/4 cup of margarine.
In separate bowl, mix soups, water and onions together.
Pour half the soup mixture into greased glass dish. Top with chicken.
Salt and pepper lightly.
Top with remaining soup mixture.
Cover and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Breast Casserole. Dab a 9 1/2 x 11-inch glass dish generously with 1/4 cup of margarine. In separate bowl, mix soups, water and onions together. Pour half the soup mixture into greased glass dish. Top with chicken. Salt and pepper lightly. Top with remaining soup mixture. Cover and bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Saute beef and onions in butter until brown.
Add flour and seasonings.
Cook five minutes.
Add soup and simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream.
Heat, but do not boil.
Serve over warm noodles.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Saute beef and onions in butter until brown. Add flour and seasonings. Cook five minutes. Add soup and simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat, but do not boil. Serve over warm noodles.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in oleo.
Add soup, milk and cheese; heat until cheese is melted.
Fold in rice and broccoli (thawed enough to pull apart).
recipes.text: Broccoli-Rice Casserole. Saute onion and celery in oleo. Add soup, milk and cheese; heat until cheese is melted. Fold in rice and broccoli (thawed enough to pull apart).

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together with blender on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour into uncooked pie shell and bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour or until top turns golden brown and pie "sets."
recipes.text: Lemon Chess Pie. Mix all ingredients together with blender on medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into uncooked pie shell and bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour or until top turns golden brown and pie "sets."

recipes.title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Brown ground beef and onions until all red is gone from meat. Stir in flour, salts, pepper and mushroom pieces.
Cook over medium heat 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in soups and simmer 10 minutes, stirring often.
Add sour cream and heat thoroughly.
Serve over cooked and drained wide egg noodles (amount desired for your family).
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff. Brown ground beef and onions until all red is gone from meat. Stir in flour, salts, pepper and mushroom pieces. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in soups and simmer 10 minutes, stirring often. Add sour cream and heat thoroughly. Serve over cooked and drained wide egg noodles (amount desired for your family). Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Grits
directions: Cook water, milk, salt and grits until thick.
Add cheese, eggs and butter; pour in baking dish.
Put corn flakes on top; dot with butter.
Cook 60 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Grits. Cook water, milk, salt and grits until thick. Add cheese, eggs and butter; pour in baking dish. Put corn flakes on top; dot with butter. Cook 60 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Mock Apple Pie
ingredients: 36 Ritz crackers, coarsely broken (about 1 3/4 c. crumbs)
directions: In saucepan, bring water, sugar and cream of tartar to a boil; simmer for 15 minutes.
Add lemon juice and rind.
Remove from heat and let cool to lukewarm.
Roll out pastry and line pie plate.
Place crackers in crust.
Pour syrup over crackers; do not stir.
Dot with margarine.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Add top crust and seal edges.
Slit top crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake in a 425u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until crust is golden.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Mock Apple Pie. In saucepan, bring water, sugar and cream of tartar to a boil; simmer for 15 minutes. Add lemon juice and rind. Remove from heat and let cool to lukewarm. Roll out pastry and line pie plate. Place crackers in crust. Pour syrup over crackers; do not stir. Dot with margarine. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Add top crust and seal edges. Slit top crust to allow steam to escape. Bake in a 425u00b0 oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until crust is golden. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Johnnycake
directions: Preheat the
oven to 375u00b0.
Grease a 9-inch baking pan. Sift flour,
corn meal, baking powder and salt together.
Beat the egg and add the sugar.tWarm the milk slightly with honey, stirring thoroughly.
Add
the
sugar,
milk and cooking oil. Mix thoroughly.
Combine with the dry ingredients gradually to avoid lumps.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Serve while hot.
recipes.text: Johnnycake. Preheat the oven to 375u00b0. Grease a 9-inch baking pan. Sift flour, corn meal, baking powder and salt together. Beat the egg and add the sugar.tWarm the milk slightly with honey, stirring thoroughly. Add the sugar, milk and cooking oil. Mix thoroughly. Combine with the dry ingredients gradually to avoid lumps. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Serve while hot.

recipes.title: Polynesian Ham
directions: Place sliced ham on cookie sheet.
Place sliced pineapple on top of ham.
Pour juice over ham.
Place in oven for 20 to 30 minutes.
Take out; let cool for about 10 minutes.
Roll ham up; put pineapple and cherry on with toothpick.
Place back in oven for 10 minutes.
Using about 12 to 15 pieces of ham will serve 6 to 7 people.
recipes.text: Polynesian Ham. Place sliced ham on cookie sheet. Place sliced pineapple on top of ham. Pour juice over ham. Place in oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Take out; let cool for about 10 minutes. Roll ham up; put pineapple and cherry on with toothpick. Place back in oven for 10 minutes. Using about 12 to 15 pieces of ham will serve 6 to 7 people.

recipes.title: Pickles
directions: Pour off juice from pickles.
Slice or cut into chunks and return to jar.
Heat until hot the sugar, vinegar, mustard seed and celery seed.
Pour over pickles.
Shake.
Let stand for 24 hours.
recipes.text: Pickles. Pour off juice from pickles. Slice or cut into chunks and return to jar. Heat until hot the sugar, vinegar, mustard seed and celery seed. Pour over pickles. Shake. Let stand for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Turkey Dressing
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter.
Add more onion and broth, if desired.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Turkey Dressing. Saute onion and celery in butter. Add more onion and broth, if desired. Bake at 400u00b0 for 25 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Cranberry Punch
directions: In a 2-quart microproof casserole, combine juices, spices and sugar.
Cook, covered, on High for 9 to 11 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil.
Strain and garnish with orange slices. Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Hot Cranberry Punch. In a 2-quart microproof casserole, combine juices, spices and sugar. Cook, covered, on High for 9 to 11 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil. Strain and garnish with orange slices. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cold Peach Soup
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. frozen orange juice or 3/4 c. regular juice
2 Tbsp. Triple Sec, Curacao or something of your choice (optional)
2 Tbsp. sour cream and fresh grated nutmeg (sprinkled on top for garnish)
directions: Put all ingredients (except sour cream and nutmeg) into a blender or food processor and blend until smooth.
Then garnish with sour cream and nutmeg.
recipes.text: Cold Peach Soup. Put all ingredients (except sour cream and nutmeg) into a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Then garnish with sour cream and nutmeg.

recipes.title: Spiced Pecans
directions: In a saucepan, heat all ingredients except pecans.
Let it boil 5 minutes.
Add pecans.
Pour on cookie sheet. Cool and separate.
recipes.text: Spiced Pecans. In a saucepan, heat all ingredients except pecans. Let it boil 5 minutes. Add pecans. Pour on cookie sheet. Cool and separate.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 jar Roka Blue or jalapeno cheese
directions: Mix ingredients.
Make into ball or balls.
Roll in chopped nuts and parsley flakes if desired.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix ingredients. Make into ball or balls. Roll in chopped nuts and parsley flakes if desired.

recipes.title: Sweet Muffins
