directions: Combine all dry ingredients and add egg, milk, and vanilla. Combine all ingredients until just moistened.
Place into greased muffin pans and bake at 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Muffins. Combine all dry ingredients and add egg, milk, and vanilla. Combine all ingredients until just moistened. Place into greased muffin pans and bake at 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Black Beans And Rice
directions: Soak beans in water for 6 hours; drain.
Or for faster preparation, bring beans to a simmer; turn off and let sit for 1 hour, then drain.
Saute until tender the oil, onion, green pepper and garlic.
Add to drained beans.
Cover beans with water, just barely.
Add bouillon cubes, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper and wine vinegar.
Lamb shanks or pork can be added now (optional).
recipes.text: Black Beans And Rice. Soak beans in water for 6 hours; drain. Or for faster preparation, bring beans to a simmer; turn off and let sit for 1 hour, then drain. Saute until tender the oil, onion, green pepper and garlic. Add to drained beans. Cover beans with water, just barely. Add bouillon cubes, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper and wine vinegar. Lamb shanks or pork can be added now (optional).

recipes.title: Ham Delights
ingredients: 3 pkg. Pepperidge Farm rolls (20 per pkg.)
directions: Mix first seven ingredients together.
Split rolls open. Spread mixture on rolls.
Place rolls back in trays.
Wrap in foil.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Ham Delights. Mix first seven ingredients together. Split rolls open. Spread mixture on rolls. Place rolls back in trays. Wrap in foil. Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Cream Soup
directions: In a large saucepan, combine potatoes, 1 cup water, celery, carrots, onion, parsley flakes, bouillon cube, salt and pepper. Mix well.
Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
recipes.text: Golden Cream Soup. In a large saucepan, combine potatoes, 1 cup water, celery, carrots, onion, parsley flakes, bouillon cube, salt and pepper. Mix well. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Cheese Tarts
ingredients: 1 pkg. graham cracker crumbs, finely crushed
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and eggs with mixer until smooth. Grease well very small size muffin pan with butter.
Put graham cracker crumbs in pan and pat down.
Tap out excess crumbs.
Put cheese mixture into each cup, filling each cup.
Bake at 300u00b0 for about 12 to 14 minutes until they rise.
Cool completely in refrigerator.
Mix sour cream, vanilla and powdered sugar. Carefully remove tart from pan and spoon small amount of mixture on top.
Spoon cherry filling on top.
May be frozen or refrigerated.
Makes approximately 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Cheese Tarts. Mix cream cheese, sugar and eggs with mixer until smooth. Grease well very small size muffin pan with butter. Put graham cracker crumbs in pan and pat down. Tap out excess crumbs. Put cheese mixture into each cup, filling each cup. Bake at 300u00b0 for about 12 to 14 minutes until they rise. Cool completely in refrigerator. Mix sour cream, vanilla and powdered sugar. Carefully remove tart from pan and spoon small amount of mixture on top. Spoon cherry filling on top. May be frozen or refrigerated. Makes approximately 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Candied Bacon
directions: Cut bacon in half.
Shake a few pieces at a time in a bag with brown sugar.
Place bacon on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes.
Remove with tongs and place on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Candied Bacon. Cut bacon in half. Shake a few pieces at a time in a bag with brown sugar. Place bacon on a cookie sheet. Bake at 400u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove with tongs and place on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Zesty Dressing
directions: In a pint jar with tight fitting lid, add oil, vinegar, ketchup, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, salt, sugar, paprika, pepper, celery, salt and garlic.
Cover and shake well. Refrigerate.
Shake thoroughly before each use.
Serve over greens or vegetables.
recipes.text: Zesty Dressing. In a pint jar with tight fitting lid, add oil, vinegar, ketchup, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, salt, sugar, paprika, pepper, celery, salt and garlic. Cover and shake well. Refrigerate. Shake thoroughly before each use. Serve over greens or vegetables.

recipes.title: Crunchy Chews
ingredients: 1 c. peanuts or choice of nuts
directions: Mix corn syrup and sugar in large saucepan.
Bring to full boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Quickly stir in peanut butter.
Add nuts and cereal.
Stir in evenly.
Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cut squares while cool.
recipes.text: Crunchy Chews. Mix corn syrup and sugar in large saucepan. Bring to full boil, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Quickly stir in peanut butter. Add nuts and cereal. Stir in evenly. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cut squares while cool.

recipes.title: Oven Green Beans
directions: Place beans in 9 x 13 pan. Drizzle with oil and remaining ingredients. Stir to coat. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes. Stir midway.
recipes.text: Oven Green Beans. Place beans in 9 x 13 pan. Drizzle with oil and remaining ingredients. Stir to coat. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes. Stir midway.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 c. chopped peanut butter cup candies (Reese's cups)
directions: Pour half and half into large bowl and add pie filling.
Beat with wire whisk; let stand 5 minutes.
Fold in Cool Whip and chopped candy.
Freeze for 6 hours or overnight.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Chocolate Pie. Pour half and half into large bowl and add pie filling. Beat with wire whisk; let stand 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip and chopped candy. Freeze for 6 hours or overnight. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Barley Soup
directions: Peel and dice the carrots, celery and potatoes.
Cut the leeks and cabbage leaves into fine strips.
Saute the vegetables and soup bone in the butter.
Add the barley.
After a few minutes, pour in the bouillon.
Stick the onion with the clove and add to the soup, along with the bacon.
Simmer for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the soup bone and onion from the soup.
Mix the egg with the cream; add to the soup.
Heat, but do not boil.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Barley Soup. Peel and dice the carrots, celery and potatoes. Cut the leeks and cabbage leaves into fine strips. Saute the vegetables and soup bone in the butter. Add the barley. After a few minutes, pour in the bouillon. Stick the onion with the clove and add to the soup, along with the bacon. Simmer for 2 1/2 hours. Remove the soup bone and onion from the soup. Mix the egg with the cream; add to the soup. Heat, but do not boil. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meat Loaf(Delicious)
directions: Mix together first 7 items.
Heat brown sugar, vinegar and tomato paste until blended.
Pour 1/2 of this mixture into the meat ingredients.
Form into loaf pan.
Frost meat loaf with remaining tomato sauce.
Bake 1 1/4 hours at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Meat Loaf(Delicious). Mix together first 7 items. Heat brown sugar, vinegar and tomato paste until blended. Pour 1/2 of this mixture into the meat ingredients. Form into loaf pan. Frost meat loaf with remaining tomato sauce. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Cream eggs, butter and sugar.
Add all other ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake in well greased tube or Bundt pan 2 - 3 hours at 300 degrees.
recipes.text: White Fruit Cake. Cream eggs, butter and sugar. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Bake in well greased tube or Bundt pan 2 - 3 hours at 300 degrees.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
directions: Brown ground beef.
Mix in green chilies and refried beans. Add taco seasoning mix to your taste.
Layer sour cream over meat mixture.
Top with chopped tomato, lettuce, cheese and black olives.
Dip with taco chips.
recipes.text: Bean Dip. Brown ground beef. Mix in green chilies and refried beans. Add taco seasoning mix to your taste. Layer sour cream over meat mixture. Top with chopped tomato, lettuce, cheese and black olives. Dip with taco chips.

recipes.title: Play Dough
directions: Mix ingredients together and cook over medium heat until it forms a ball.
Take out on wax paper and knead it well.
Great for big and little people to play with.
recipes.text: Play Dough. Mix ingredients together and cook over medium heat until it forms a ball. Take out on wax paper and knead it well. Great for big and little people to play with.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix hash browns with cheese, sour cream, soup, butter and onions.
Top with crushed corn flakes.
Sprinkle melted butter on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Can be made a day before serving.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Mix hash browns with cheese, sour cream, soup, butter and onions. Top with crushed corn flakes. Sprinkle melted butter on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be made a day before serving.

recipes.title: Homemade Noodles
directions: Drop eggs into bowl with flour and pinch of salt.
Mix, using fingers.
Add cold water and knead.
Let rest 30 minutes.
Using 1/4 of dough, roll out and let dry for 30 minutes.
Cut into desired strips.
Repeat.
Cook in boiling water.
recipes.text: Homemade Noodles. Drop eggs into bowl with flour and pinch of salt. Mix, using fingers. Add cold water and knead. Let rest 30 minutes. Using 1/4 of dough, roll out and let dry for 30 minutes. Cut into desired strips. Repeat. Cook in boiling water.

recipes.title: Tammy Murray'S Etouffee
directions: Saute veggies in butter.
When clear, add tomato sauce.
Cook until condensed to a paste, about 20 to 30 minutes, then add crawfish, soup, green onion and parsley.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Add Tony's to taste.
recipes.text: Tammy Murray'S Etouffee. Saute veggies in butter. When clear, add tomato sauce. Cook until condensed to a paste, about 20 to 30 minutes, then add crawfish, soup, green onion and parsley. Simmer 20 minutes. Add Tony's to taste.

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf(Sweet, Good And Easy)
directions: Melt butter in pan.
Saute onions until limp.
Add rice and cook 1 minute.
Pour in stock, add salt and pepper.
Bring to boil and
turn
to
simmer
and cover with lid.
Simmer 23 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice Pilaf(Sweet, Good And Easy). Melt butter in pan. Saute onions until limp. Add rice and cook 1 minute. Pour in stock, add salt and pepper. Bring to boil and turn to simmer and cover with lid. Simmer 23 minutes.

recipes.title: Lennie'S Chicken And Rice
directions: In a rectangular casserole dish mix all ingredients, except chicken.
Place enough raw chicken pieces over rice to cover casserole dish.
Place pats of butter over chicken.
Seal casserole dish with aluminum foil.
Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0 or until rice absorbs liquid.
recipes.text: Lennie'S Chicken And Rice. In a rectangular casserole dish mix all ingredients, except chicken. Place enough raw chicken pieces over rice to cover casserole dish. Place pats of butter over chicken. Seal casserole dish with aluminum foil. Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0 or until rice absorbs liquid.

recipes.title: Cheese Candy
directions: Toast pecans slightly.
Melt cream cheese in a double boiler; add sugar and pecans.
Mix together well.
Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper.
recipes.text: Cheese Candy. Toast pecans slightly. Melt cream cheese in a double boiler; add sugar and pecans. Mix together well. Drop by spoonful onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Fry ground beef and onion; drain off fat.
Add chili, garlic, cumin, salt and pepper.
Mix lettuce, tomatoes and cucumbers; then mix Fritos and cheese.
Serve with chunky salsa or Ranch dressing.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Fry ground beef and onion; drain off fat. Add chili, garlic, cumin, salt and pepper. Mix lettuce, tomatoes and cucumbers; then mix Fritos and cheese. Serve with chunky salsa or Ranch dressing.

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken
directions: Salt and pepper cut up chicken.
Place in pan in single layer. Bring the ingredients to a boil and pour over chicken.
Bake in 300u00b0 oven for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Barbecue Chicken. Salt and pepper cut up chicken. Place in pan in single layer. Bring the ingredients to a boil and pour over chicken. Bake in 300u00b0 oven for 3 hours.

recipes.title: "Rice" Pudding
directions: After rice has cooked, mix all the ingredients.
Bake in 400u00b0 oven 45 minutes or until middle is firm.
recipes.text: "Rice" Pudding. After rice has cooked, mix all the ingredients. Bake in 400u00b0 oven 45 minutes or until middle is firm.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs. Combine peanut butter, vanilla and flour to mixture. Roll cookies into a ball and mash with a fork for a crisscross pattern. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten eggs. Combine peanut butter, vanilla and flour to mixture. Roll cookies into a ball and mash with a fork for a crisscross pattern. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Place tuna in bottom of casserole dish.
Bring to a boil the following until thick:
salt, pepper, butter, milk and flour. Stir cheese into the mixture.
Cook until the cheese melts.
Pour the mixture over the tuna, then sprinkle
bread crumbs on top. Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Place tuna in bottom of casserole dish. Bring to a boil the following until thick: salt, pepper, butter, milk and flour. Stir cheese into the mixture. Cook until the cheese melts. Pour the mixture over the tuna, then sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 375u00b0 for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Chocolate Chip Brown Sugar Drop Cookies
directions: Cream together with electric mixer, shortening and sugar; add eggs and mix well. By hand add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk.
Add vanilla and chocolate chips.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Mom'S Chocolate Chip Brown Sugar Drop Cookies. Cream together with electric mixer, shortening and sugar; add eggs and mix well. By hand add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla and chocolate chips. Bake at 375u00b0 for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
ingredients: 2 c. vanilla or graham cracker crumbs
directions: Mix crumbs and 1 stick oleo (melted) and press into long cake pan. Beat powdered sugar, eggs and 1 stick oleo on high speed for 15 minutes. Pour over crumbs. Split bananas lengthwise and place over mixture. Drain pineapple well and spread over bananas. Spread Cool Whip. Sprinkle chopped pecans and cherries over Cool Whip. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix crumbs and 1 stick oleo (melted) and press into long cake pan. Beat powdered sugar, eggs and 1 stick oleo on high speed for 15 minutes. Pour over crumbs. Split bananas lengthwise and place over mixture. Drain pineapple well and spread over bananas. Spread Cool Whip. Sprinkle chopped pecans and cherries over Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Candied Cucumber Rings
ingredients: 2 gal. cucumbers, peeled, seeded and cut into rings
directions: Combine cucumbers, lime and 8 1/2 quarts of water in a large container; let stand for 24 hours.
Drain, then rinse in clear water.
Cover with water; let stand for 3 hours, then drain.
recipes.text: Candied Cucumber Rings. Combine cucumbers, lime and 8 1/2 quarts of water in a large container; let stand for 24 hours. Drain, then rinse in clear water. Cover with water; let stand for 3 hours, then drain.

recipes.title: Rice, Cheese, Chili Casserole
directions: Steam rice, then mix all ingredients together.
Sprinkle top with some grated cheese.
Put in shallow Pyrex baking dish, baking 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Rice, Cheese, Chili Casserole. Steam rice, then mix all ingredients together. Sprinkle top with some grated cheese. Put in shallow Pyrex baking dish, baking 45 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Microwave Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine sugar and eggs in large mixing bowl.
Add oil and zucchini; mix well.
Add remaining ingredients; blend well.
Pour into large microwave Bundt pan.
Microwave on High for 4 minutes; rotate dish.
Microwave on High for 4 to 6 minutes longer or until bread begins to pull away from sides.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before turning out of
pan.
Frost if desired.
recipes.text: Microwave Zucchini Bread. Combine sugar and eggs in large mixing bowl. Add oil and zucchini; mix well. Add remaining ingredients; blend well. Pour into large microwave Bundt pan. Microwave on High for 4 minutes; rotate dish. Microwave on High for 4 to 6 minutes longer or until bread begins to pull away from sides. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before turning out of pan. Frost if desired.

recipes.title: Relish
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can white Shoepeg corn, drained
1 (16 oz.) can French-cut green beans, drained
directions: Heat to boiling the oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
Pour over vegetables and let set overnight.
Will keep in refrigerator 8 to 10 weeks.
recipes.text: Relish. Heat to boiling the oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables and let set overnight. Will keep in refrigerator 8 to 10 weeks.

recipes.title: Old Settler'S Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients and simmer.
Works well on low in crock-pot.
recipes.text: Old Settler'S Beans. Combine all ingredients and simmer. Works well on low in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Yam 'N Apple Creation
directions: Parboil yams, peel and cut into pieces.
Peel apples and dice. Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan.
Add boiling water and butter.
Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Butter casserole dish and place yams and apples in casserole in layers.
Pour sauce over.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Yam 'N Apple Creation. Parboil yams, peel and cut into pieces. Peel apples and dice. Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan. Add boiling water and butter. Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Butter casserole dish and place yams and apples in casserole in layers. Pour sauce over. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Saucepan Brownies
ingredients: 2 sq. unsweetened chocolate or 6 leveled off Tbsp. cocoa, plus 2 Tbsp. shortening
directions: Melt shortening and cocoa.
Then add sugar, eggs (one at a time) plus salt and vanilla.
Then add nuts and flour. Cook at 325u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Saucepan Brownies. Melt shortening and cocoa. Then add sugar, eggs (one at a time) plus salt and vanilla. Then add nuts and flour. Cook at 325u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth. If sugar doesn't seem to want to dissolve, place small bowl in larger bowl of hot water and continue mixing. Makes 14 ounces.
recipes.text: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk. Mix all ingredients together until smooth. If sugar doesn't seem to want to dissolve, place small bowl in larger bowl of hot water and continue mixing. Makes 14 ounces.

recipes.title: Coconut Balls
directions: Melt butter and pour over nuts. In a large bowl, mix coconut, sugar, milk and vanilla. Add butter and nuts and mix well. Shape into balls and chill for about 3 hours.
recipes.text: Coconut Balls. Melt butter and pour over nuts. In a large bowl, mix coconut, sugar, milk and vanilla. Add butter and nuts and mix well. Shape into balls and chill for about 3 hours.

recipes.title: Mimi'S Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown meat, onions and garlic.
Drain.
Return to stockpot. Add tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Add oregano, thyme and Italian seasoning.
Simmer and let marinate several hours with lid on. Serve over angel hair pasta.
Add a salad and garlic bread for an awesome meal!
recipes.text: Mimi'S Spaghetti Sauce. Brown meat, onions and garlic. Drain. Return to stockpot. Add tomatoes and tomato sauce. Add oregano, thyme and Italian seasoning. Simmer and let marinate several hours with lid on. Serve over angel hair pasta. Add a salad and garlic bread for an awesome meal!

recipes.title: Best Ever Fudge
directions: Mix sugar and milk in a large saucepan; let boil 6 minutes only!
Mix other ingredients in a large pan or bowl; pour hot mixture over it.
Stir well, but do not beat.
Pour into buttered pans and let cool.
This makes 5 pounds of super-delish fudge.
recipes.text: Best Ever Fudge. Mix sugar and milk in a large saucepan; let boil 6 minutes only! Mix other ingredients in a large pan or bowl; pour hot mixture over it. Stir well, but do not beat. Pour into buttered pans and let cool. This makes 5 pounds of super-delish fudge.

recipes.title: Cherry-Pineapple Dessert
directions: Cook together until thick the cherries, sugar, pineapple and tapioca.
Then mix together remaining ingredients.
Sprinkle half this mixture in a baking dish.
Pour in cherry mixture and place remainder of crumb mixture on top of filling.
Bake 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Cherry-Pineapple Dessert. Cook together until thick the cherries, sugar, pineapple and tapioca. Then mix together remaining ingredients. Sprinkle half this mixture in a baking dish. Pour in cherry mixture and place remainder of crumb mixture on top of filling. Bake 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain.
Add next six ingredients; mix well.
Place in baking dish and bake at 325u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Yield:
6 servings.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain. Add next six ingredients; mix well. Place in baking dish and bake at 325u00b0 for 30 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Steak Kebabs
ingredients: 12 oz. boneless sirloin, trimmed and cut into 1-inch cubes
1 green pepper, cored, seeded and cut into 8 squares
directions: In a shallow glass dish, combine soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic, lemon peel and red pepper.
Mix well.
Add beef; stir to coat.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Preheat broiler.
Remove beef from marinade and discard marinade. Using 4 (10-inch) metal skewers, alternately thread beef, tomato, mushrooms and pepper.
Place on broiler pan.
Broil 2-inches from heat, turning 2 or 3 times, until meat is medium-rare and vegetables are lightly brown, about 10 minutes.
Makes 4 kebabs.
recipes.text: Steak Kebabs. In a shallow glass dish, combine soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic, lemon peel and red pepper. Mix well. Add beef; stir to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours. Preheat broiler. Remove beef from marinade and discard marinade. Using 4 (10-inch) metal skewers, alternately thread beef, tomato, mushrooms and pepper. Place on broiler pan. Broil 2-inches from heat, turning 2 or 3 times, until meat is medium-rare and vegetables are lightly brown, about 10 minutes. Makes 4 kebabs.

recipes.title: Cheddar Olive Filled Cheese Balls
directions: Mix milk and flour.
Mix by hand and knead.
Pinch piece and cover drained dried stuffed olives.
Makes 25.
Bake 15 minutes at 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Cheddar Olive Filled Cheese Balls. Mix milk and flour. Mix by hand and knead. Pinch piece and cover drained dried stuffed olives. Makes 25. Bake 15 minutes at 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Anniversary Pound Cake
directions: Grease and flour bottom of a 10-inch tube pan. Cream the butter, shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.
Sift flour and salt into baking powder and cocoa. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and vanilla, beating after each addition.
Pour in pan.
Bake at 325u00b0 for
1 hour to 1 hour and 30 minutes.
Cool in pan 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Anniversary Pound Cake. Grease and flour bottom of a 10-inch tube pan. Cream the butter, shortening and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each. Sift flour and salt into baking powder and cocoa. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and vanilla, beating after each addition. Pour in pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour to 1 hour and 30 minutes. Cool in pan 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: In skillet, brown meat with pepper and onion; pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve on buns.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. In skillet, brown meat with pepper and onion; pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Kris Kringle Cookies
directions: Mix as for any cake.
Put soda in buttermilk.
Put cherries in last.
Bake at 275u00b0 until light brown.
recipes.text: Kris Kringle Cookies. Mix as for any cake. Put soda in buttermilk. Put cherries in last. Bake at 275u00b0 until light brown.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
directions: Pour all ingredients by layers into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong pan.
Do not mix.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Pour all ingredients by layers into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong pan. Do not mix. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruitcake
directions: Combine dates, pecans, red and green cherries and pineapple in large bowl; set aside.
Combine dry ingredients; add to fruit mixture, stirring well.
Stir in eggs and vanilla.
Spoon batter into a greased and brown paper lined 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 250u00b0 for 2 hours or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool cake completely in pan; then remove from pan and remove brown paper.
recipes.text: Fruitcake. Combine dates, pecans, red and green cherries and pineapple in large bowl; set aside. Combine dry ingredients; add to fruit mixture, stirring well. Stir in eggs and vanilla. Spoon batter into a greased and brown paper lined 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 250u00b0 for 2 hours or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool cake completely in pan; then remove from pan and remove brown paper.

recipes.title: Mock Apple Pie(No Apples Needed)
directions: Prepare crust by spreading with Crisco and taking a fork to prick crusts.
Break Ritz crackers coarsely into pie shell.
recipes.text: Mock Apple Pie(No Apples Needed). Prepare crust by spreading with Crisco and taking a fork to prick crusts. Break Ritz crackers coarsely into pie shell.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 1 large can sliced peaches (using syrup in can)
directions: In an oblong pan, spread sliced peaches.
Add dry cake mix to top of peaches, using fork to break up any lumps.
Add pats of butter all over top until you use the whole stick.
Put in oven at 350u00b0 until golden brown on top.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. In an oblong pan, spread sliced peaches. Add dry cake mix to top of peaches, using fork to break up any lumps. Add pats of butter all over top until you use the whole stick. Put in oven at 350u00b0 until golden brown on top.

recipes.title: White Nut Fudge
ingredients: 1/4 c. chopped red and green candied cherries
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan.
Bring to a boil slowly, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Boil without stirring over medium heat to 236u00b0 on candy thermometer or until a little mixture dropped into cold water forms a soft ball.
Remove from heat and let stand 15 minutes.
Do not stir; add flavoring.
Beat until mixture starts to lose its gloss (about 8 minutes).
Stir in the candied cherries and walnuts and quickly pour into greased (with butter) shallow pan; cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: White Nut Fudge. Combine first 5 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil slowly, stirring until sugar dissolves. Boil without stirring over medium heat to 236u00b0 on candy thermometer or until a little mixture dropped into cold water forms a soft ball. Remove from heat and let stand 15 minutes. Do not stir; add flavoring. Beat until mixture starts to lose its gloss (about 8 minutes). Stir in the candied cherries and walnuts and quickly pour into greased (with butter) shallow pan; cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Grilled Salmon With Fresh Dill Sauce
directions: Season the salmon with a generous sprinkling of lemon pepper seasoning.
Place on grill and cook until tender. I use the George Forman grill and it usually takes about 4 minutes. The amount of time can vary due to the thickness of the salmon.
recipes.text: Grilled Salmon With Fresh Dill Sauce. Season the salmon with a generous sprinkling of lemon pepper seasoning. Place on grill and cook until tender. I use the George Forman grill and it usually takes about 4 minutes. The amount of time can vary due to the thickness of the salmon.

recipes.title: New Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. small new red potatoes, cooked and quartered
directions: Combine the mayonnaise, mustard, dill weed, salt and pepper. Mix potatoes and onion; add sauce gently to coat.
Serve warm or cold.
Makes 4 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: New Potato Salad. Combine the mayonnaise, mustard, dill weed, salt and pepper. Mix potatoes and onion; add sauce gently to coat. Serve warm or cold. Makes 4 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Easy Tamale Pie
directions: Cook together butter, onions and green peppers until softened, not brown, then brown ground meat, stirring to break up. Add all ingredients together and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Easy Tamale Pie. Cook together butter, onions and green peppers until softened, not brown, then brown ground meat, stirring to break up. Add all ingredients together and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Campfire Coffee
directions: Heat 2 quarts cold water to boiling.
Mix coffee, 3 tablespoons water and egg.
Pour water over coffee mix in coffee pot.
Heat just to boiling.
Cover.
Let stand 12 minutes at grill's edge.
recipes.text: Campfire Coffee. Heat 2 quarts cold water to boiling. Mix coffee, 3 tablespoons water and egg. Pour water over coffee mix in coffee pot. Heat just to boiling. Cover. Let stand 12 minutes at grill's edge.

recipes.title: Mustard Salmon
directions: Mix mayonnaise and mustard.
Spread over salmon fillet (can use sole, flounder) and broil 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Mustard Salmon. Mix mayonnaise and mustard. Spread over salmon fillet (can use sole, flounder) and broil 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bake
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. (large) or 1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing
directions: Cook broccoli; drain well.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, eggs and onion; add to broccoli and put in casserole.
Sprinkle grated cheese over top.
Melt butter or margarine and add to stuffing. Sprinkle on top of cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Bake. Cook broccoli; drain well. Combine soup, mayonnaise, eggs and onion; add to broccoli and put in casserole. Sprinkle grated cheese over top. Melt butter or margarine and add to stuffing. Sprinkle on top of cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Walnut Pie
directions: Mix and pour into pie shells.
Don't preheat oven.
Bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serve warm with ice cream or top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Walnut Pie. Mix and pour into pie shells. Don't preheat oven. Bake 45 minutes at 350u00b0. Serve warm with ice cream or top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
directions: Drain all canned vegetables.
Add to canned vegetables the pimento, chopped celery and green onions.
recipes.text: Marinated Vegetable Salad. Drain all canned vegetables. Add to canned vegetables the pimento, chopped celery and green onions.

recipes.title: Ione'S Boiled Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 c. vinegar, diluted with 2 Tbsp. cold water
directions: Mix all dry ingredients.
Add eggs (slightly beaten), butter, milk and diluted vinegar, the latter very slowly while beating constantly.
Cook in double boiler until thick, then cool.
Can thin with cream.
Use this in your potato salad.
recipes.text: Ione'S Boiled Salad Dressing. Mix all dry ingredients. Add eggs (slightly beaten), butter, milk and diluted vinegar, the latter very slowly while beating constantly. Cook in double boiler until thick, then cool. Can thin with cream. Use this in your potato salad.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Let cheese get soft.
Mix both cheeses thoroughly by hand. Add rest of ingredients.
Shape into a ball.
Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of nuts.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Let cheese get soft. Mix both cheeses thoroughly by hand. Add rest of ingredients. Shape into a ball. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of nuts.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs one at a time with a dash of salt in last egg. Add flour alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Mix well. Put in four cake pans lined with wax paper. Bake at 350u00b0 until done. Cool about ten minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Cream butter and sugar, add eggs one at a time with a dash of salt in last egg. Add flour alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Mix well. Put in four cake pans lined with wax paper. Bake at 350u00b0 until done. Cool about ten minutes.

recipes.title: Red Raspberry Or Strawberry Glaze Pie
directions: Cook berries, water, sugar and cornstarch until thick and clear.
Cool.
Pour half of sauce in baked pie shell.
Add rest of berries and rest of sauce on top of berries.
Cool.
Serve with whipped topping if desired.
recipes.text: Red Raspberry Or Strawberry Glaze Pie. Cook berries, water, sugar and cornstarch until thick and clear. Cool. Pour half of sauce in baked pie shell. Add rest of berries and rest of sauce on top of berries. Cool. Serve with whipped topping if desired.

recipes.title: Fruit And Juice Gelatin
directions: Mix together 1/4 cup juice and gelatin in a bowl.
Measure another 1/4 cup juice, boil it, then add hot juice to the mixture and stir until gelatin is dissolved.
Add remaining juice and stir.
Put in refrigerator to set.
After gelatin begins to set a little, add the sliced fruit and return gelatin to refrigerator until firm.
Makes 4 servings, only 96 calories per serving.
recipes.text: Fruit And Juice Gelatin. Mix together 1/4 cup juice and gelatin in a bowl. Measure another 1/4 cup juice, boil it, then add hot juice to the mixture and stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add remaining juice and stir. Put in refrigerator to set. After gelatin begins to set a little, add the sliced fruit and return gelatin to refrigerator until firm. Makes 4 servings, only 96 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Fancy Tuna
directions: Mix all the ingredients together.
Fill small egg rolls.
Wrap tinfoil tightly around rolls.
Store overnight or several hours in refrigerator.
Heat 30 minutes at 250u00b0.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Fancy Tuna. Mix all the ingredients together. Fill small egg rolls. Wrap tinfoil tightly around rolls. Store overnight or several hours in refrigerator. Heat 30 minutes at 250u00b0. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Quick Peach Pie(Club Member: Jason Baldwin)
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In a bowl, mix flour and sugar. Add milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add peaches and stir. Pour this mixture into baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 until it browns, about an hour.
recipes.text: Quick Peach Pie(Club Member: Jason Baldwin). Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In a bowl, mix flour and sugar. Add milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add peaches and stir. Pour this mixture into baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 until it browns, about an hour.

recipes.title: Barbecue
directions: Roast and shred into fine pieces the 2 pound roast.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cook 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecue. Roast and shred into fine pieces the 2 pound roast. Add remaining ingredients. Cook 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Summer Squash-Zucchini Casserole
directions: Slice squash; boil with onion in small amount of water for 10 minutes; drain.
Mix together the carrot, sour cream, soup and 1/2 package croutons, then fold in squash mixture.
Melt butter.
Mix all ingredients; place in buttered casserole.
Top with remaining croutons.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Summer Squash-Zucchini Casserole. Slice squash; boil with onion in small amount of water for 10 minutes; drain. Mix together the carrot, sour cream, soup and 1/2 package croutons, then fold in squash mixture. Melt butter. Mix all ingredients; place in buttered casserole. Top with remaining croutons. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Celery And Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix mustard, salad dressing, vinegar and seasonings.
Add to the chopped cabbage and celery.
Makes 4 servings.
Chopped chives may be sprinkled over the salad, if desired.
recipes.text: Celery And Cabbage Slaw. Mix mustard, salad dressing, vinegar and seasonings. Add to the chopped cabbage and celery. Makes 4 servings. Chopped chives may be sprinkled over the salad, if desired.

recipes.title: Apple Pork Chops
directions: In medium saucepan, heat water and margarine to full boil. Remove from heat; add milk and potato flakes.
Stir to desired consistency.
Stir in cheese; set aside.
recipes.text: Apple Pork Chops. In medium saucepan, heat water and margarine to full boil. Remove from heat; add milk and potato flakes. Stir to desired consistency. Stir in cheese; set aside.

recipes.title: Potato Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cubed Kraft American cheese (If you use Velveeta, use less)
directions: Boil the first 6 ingredients over low heat for 10 minutes. Add potatoes.
When potatoes are well cooked, add cheese.
When cheese is melted, add milk.
Do not boil after milk is added.
If you want it thinner, add more milk.
If you want it thicker, use instant mashed potato flakes, not flour.
recipes.text: Potato Cheese Soup. Boil the first 6 ingredients over low heat for 10 minutes. Add potatoes. When potatoes are well cooked, add cheese. When cheese is melted, add milk. Do not boil after milk is added. If you want it thinner, add more milk. If you want it thicker, use instant mashed potato flakes, not flour.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Chill for 5 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Mix all ingredients well. Chill for 5 hours before serving.

recipes.title: "Ms. Faye'S" Mexican Magic
ingredients: tortilla chips, broken into small pieces
directions: Brown meat with onion. Add soup, beans, taco seasoning, Ro-Tel and water. Simmer at least 15 minutes. Line pan or dish with broken chips. Add layer of meat mixture and layer of cheese; keep layering chips and meat, ending with cheese on top. Bake at 325u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbles. Can add last layer of cheese after it's done.
recipes.text: "Ms. Faye'S" Mexican Magic. Brown meat with onion. Add soup, beans, taco seasoning, Ro-Tel and water. Simmer at least 15 minutes. Line pan or dish with broken chips. Add layer of meat mixture and layer of cheese; keep layering chips and meat, ending with cheese on top. Bake at 325u00b0 for 20 minutes or until bubbles. Can add last layer of cheese after it's done.

recipes.title: Fried Cabbage
directions: Fry bacon until crisp and remove from pan.
Place shredded cabbage in hot bacon oil.
Add salt and pepper.
Cook until tender.
Add sugar and cook 10 more minutes on medium high.
recipes.text: Fried Cabbage. Fry bacon until crisp and remove from pan. Place shredded cabbage in hot bacon oil. Add salt and pepper. Cook until tender. Add sugar and cook 10 more minutes on medium high.

recipes.title: Quick Minestrone Soup
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can mixed vegetables or 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, drained
2 c. cooked pasta shells (1 c. uncooked)
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
directions: Heat vegetable oil in large pan.
Add onion and garlic; heat 2 minutes.
Stir in vegetable juice; bring to boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Add mixed vegetables, pasta and spinach.
Cover; simmer 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheese before serving.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Quick Minestrone Soup. Heat vegetable oil in large pan. Add onion and garlic; heat 2 minutes. Stir in vegetable juice; bring to boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Add mixed vegetables, pasta and spinach. Cover; simmer 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese before serving. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chile Tostado Pie
ingredients: 1 (19 oz.) can Wolf Brand chili without beans
directions: Grease a 14-inch round pizza pan.
Place tortillas; spread chili evenly over tortillas to edges.
Bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese; continue baking for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Top with lettuce, remaining cheese, tomato, avocado and olives.
Cut into wedges. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chile Tostado Pie. Grease a 14-inch round pizza pan. Place tortillas; spread chili evenly over tortillas to edges. Bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese; continue baking for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Top with lettuce, remaining cheese, tomato, avocado and olives. Cut into wedges. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
ingredients: 1 c. "100% bran" ready to eat cereal
directions: Thoroughly cream together sugar and shortening. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well. Add flour, salt and buttermilk, mixing until smooth.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Bran Muffins. Thoroughly cream together sugar and shortening. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well. Add flour, salt and buttermilk, mixing until smooth.

recipes.title: E - Z Cheesy Potatoes
ingredients: 8 medium potatoes, cubed with skins on and cooked
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Put into greased pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes covered with foil, then uncover and bake another 30 minutes.
If desired, cover with crushed corn flakes.
recipes.text: E - Z Cheesy Potatoes. Mix ingredients together. Put into greased pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes covered with foil, then uncover and bake another 30 minutes. If desired, cover with crushed corn flakes.

recipes.title: Walnut-Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1/4 c. walnut oil or salad oil
1 1/2 c. halved strawberries or red seedless grapes
directions: In screw-top jar, put oil, honey, vinegar, wine, ginger and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Cover and shake well.
Chill.
recipes.text: Walnut-Romaine Salad. In screw-top jar, put oil, honey, vinegar, wine, ginger and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and shake well. Chill.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Grease muffin pans well.
Sift flour with baking powder and salt; set aside.
In a large bowl, cream the butter with sugar with electric mixer until soft and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each until well blended.
With fork, mash 1/2 cup of blueberries and stir into mixture.
Add rest of whole blueberries, mixing in gently.
Fill pans about 3/4 full. Sprinkle each with sugar.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.
Let cool in pans for 1/2 hour before removing.
Yields 18 muffins in 2 1/2-inch pans or 12 muffins in 3-inch pans.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins. Grease muffin pans well. Sift flour with baking powder and salt; set aside. In a large bowl, cream the butter with sugar with electric mixer until soft and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each until well blended. With fork, mash 1/2 cup of blueberries and stir into mixture. Add rest of whole blueberries, mixing in gently. Fill pans about 3/4 full. Sprinkle each with sugar. Bake at 375u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Let cool in pans for 1/2 hour before removing. Yields 18 muffins in 2 1/2-inch pans or 12 muffins in 3-inch pans.

recipes.title: Hungarian Meat Goulash
directions: Cube meat and set aside.
Chop onion fine.
Put in large Dutch oven with 2 tablespoons margarine.
When onion is browned, add meat, salt, pepper and paprika.
Let it all brown until juice comes from it.
Then add 3 to 4 cups of water, plus bouillon cubes.
Cover and simmer for 3 hours.
Stir now and then.
recipes.text: Hungarian Meat Goulash. Cube meat and set aside. Chop onion fine. Put in large Dutch oven with 2 tablespoons margarine. When onion is browned, add meat, salt, pepper and paprika. Let it all brown until juice comes from it. Then add 3 to 4 cups of water, plus bouillon cubes. Cover and simmer for 3 hours. Stir now and then.

recipes.title: Stuffed Celery
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; mix well.
Spoon into celery pieces.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight.
Yield:
2 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Stuffed Celery. Combine first 6 ingredients; mix well. Spoon into celery pieces. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight. Yield: 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix oleo, oil and sugar well.
Add eggs, vanilla, baking soda, cream of tartar and flour.
Roll into balls and flatten with fork on greased cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Mix oleo, oil and sugar well. Add eggs, vanilla, baking soda, cream of tartar and flour. Roll into balls and flatten with fork on greased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa Mix
ingredients: 10 3/4 c. instant nonfat dry powdered milk
1 (16 oz.) container instant cocoa mix (for milk)
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa Mix. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Sally'S Lemon Squares
directions: Combine cake mix, oil and 1 egg until crumbly.
Reserve 1 cup. Press remainder of mix into 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Cream together cream cheese, lemon juice and 1 egg.
Spread over baked crust and crumble reserved 1 cup of mix over top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Sally'S Lemon Squares. Combine cake mix, oil and 1 egg until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup. Press remainder of mix into 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cream together cream cheese, lemon juice and 1 egg. Spread over baked crust and crumble reserved 1 cup of mix over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Pickles
ingredients: 3/4 c. hot peppers or to taste
directions: Put chopped tomatoes, onions and peppers in large pan.
Pour remaining ingredients over tomatoes and bring to a boil.
Boil for 2 minutes.
Fill sterile jars and seal.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Pickles. Put chopped tomatoes, onions and peppers in large pan. Pour remaining ingredients over tomatoes and bring to a boil. Boil for 2 minutes. Fill sterile jars and seal.

recipes.title: Beef Tip
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. onion flakes or minced onion
directions: Cream the cream cheese and milk; stir in beef, then blend in pepper, garlic salt, sour cream and onion flakes.
Place in a square baking dish.
To prepare topping, saute pecans in butter and salt.
Pour over beef and cheese mixture.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Beef Tip. Cream the cream cheese and milk; stir in beef, then blend in pepper, garlic salt, sour cream and onion flakes. Place in a square baking dish. To prepare topping, saute pecans in butter and salt. Pour over beef and cheese mixture. Bake for 20 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Vinegar Pie
directions: Beat egg yolks until light and lemon colored.
Sift together the sugar, cornstarch and salt; stir into the beaten egg yolks. Add water gradually.
Add vinegar.
Place pan over hot water and cook until mixture thickens.
Put in pie shell.
recipes.text: Vinegar Pie. Beat egg yolks until light and lemon colored. Sift together the sugar, cornstarch and salt; stir into the beaten egg yolks. Add water gradually. Add vinegar. Place pan over hot water and cook until mixture thickens. Put in pie shell.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
directions: Mix peanut butter, butter and confectioners sugar until smooth.
Form into small balls and refrigerate.
Melt chocolate and wax together.
Dip cold balls until 2/3 covered.
Let dry on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Buckeyes. Mix peanut butter, butter and confectioners sugar until smooth. Form into small balls and refrigerate. Melt chocolate and wax together. Dip cold balls until 2/3 covered. Let dry on waxed paper.

recipes.title: All Together Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill before serving.
recipes.text: All Together Fruit Salad. Combine all ingredients and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Persimmon Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. sugar or 1/2 white and 1/2 brown
directions: Cream shortening and sugar or sugars, then add eggs and pulp. Mix flour, salt and soda along with spices.
Add to liquid ingredients, then add nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until done.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Persimmon Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar or sugars, then add eggs and pulp. Mix flour, salt and soda along with spices. Add to liquid ingredients, then add nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 15 minutes or until done. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Beat eggs. Add sugar, oil and vanilla. Blend well. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Bake at 350u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Beat eggs. Add sugar, oil and vanilla. Blend well. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Bake at 350u00b0 for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Christmas Steamed Pecan Cakes
directions: Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl; add egg yolks and beat well.
In separate bowl, combine pecans and raisins and mix in about 1 cup of flour to coat.
Add baking powder and salt to remaining flour.
Gradually add flour to creamed sugars, butter and egg mixture, a cup at a time.
Alternate with lemon extract until all flour and extract have been used.
Then mix in pecans and raisins; stir well.
(May take two mixing bowls to mix properly.) Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Fold into batter mixture.
recipes.text: Christmas Steamed Pecan Cakes. Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl; add egg yolks and beat well. In separate bowl, combine pecans and raisins and mix in about 1 cup of flour to coat. Add baking powder and salt to remaining flour. Gradually add flour to creamed sugars, butter and egg mixture, a cup at a time. Alternate with lemon extract until all flour and extract have been used. Then mix in pecans and raisins; stir well. (May take two mixing bowls to mix properly.) Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into batter mixture.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. fryer or 4 chicken breasts
directions: Boil chicken until tender with onion and celery leaves.
Cool and debone chicken.
Discard onion and celery leaves.
Place chicken in large casserole dish.
Combine rest of ingredients and pour over top of chicken.
Let stand overnight.
(Will freeze well).
Cook, covered, 30 minutes at 350u00b0 and uncovered 15 minutes.
May serve out of dish or excellent if served in the Pepperidge Farm Puff Pastry Shells.
recipes.text: Chicken Supreme. Boil chicken until tender with onion and celery leaves. Cool and debone chicken. Discard onion and celery leaves. Place chicken in large casserole dish. Combine rest of ingredients and pour over top of chicken. Let stand overnight. (Will freeze well). Cook, covered, 30 minutes at 350u00b0 and uncovered 15 minutes. May serve out of dish or excellent if served in the Pepperidge Farm Puff Pastry Shells.

recipes.title: Tuna Loaf
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of celery soup
directions: Mix all ingredients well into a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Tuna Loaf. Mix all ingredients well into a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Beat sugar, oil and eggs.
Add pineapple and mix together carrots, flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.
Then add to liquid mixture and beat again.
Grease and flour pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Beat sugar, oil and eggs. Add pineapple and mix together carrots, flour, soda, salt and cinnamon. Then add to liquid mixture and beat again. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Goldwater Beans
directions: Cook beans fast for 1 1/2 hours.
Brown meat and add onion, bell pepper, seasonings and green chilies. Cook until mixed well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add to beans. Stir in tomatoes and simmer for 4 to 6 hours.
recipes.text: Goldwater Beans. Cook beans fast for 1 1/2 hours. Brown meat and add onion, bell pepper, seasonings and green chilies. Cook until mixed well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add to beans. Stir in tomatoes and simmer for 4 to 6 hours.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad(6 Servings)
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese and bacon.
Place in ungreased casserole.
Sprinkle cheese over top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Remove from oven and top with bacon.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad(6 Servings). Combine all ingredients except cheese and bacon. Place in ungreased casserole. Sprinkle cheese over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and top with bacon.

recipes.title: Peppy Lasagna
ingredients: 3 c. Ricotta or cream cottage cheese
directions: In skillet, cook sausage, ground beef, onions, celery and carrots until meat is lightly browned.
Drain off excess fat. Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, oregano and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Simmer, uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cook lasagna by package directions, drain.
Combine ricotta, Parmesan, eggs, parsley and remaining 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Place half the noodles in a greased baking dish.
Spread with half the cheese filling, add half the Mozzarella and half the meat sauce. Repeat layers.
Bake uncovered in 375u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.
Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving.
Cut into squares to serve.
Freezes well.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Peppy Lasagna. In skillet, cook sausage, ground beef, onions, celery and carrots until meat is lightly browned. Drain off excess fat. Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, oregano and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Simmer, uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cook lasagna by package directions, drain. Combine ricotta, Parmesan, eggs, parsley and remaining 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Place half the noodles in a greased baking dish. Spread with half the cheese filling, add half the Mozzarella and half the meat sauce. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered in 375u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving. Cut into squares to serve. Freezes well. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Jelly Meatballs
directions: Mix hamburger, eggs and soup mix.
Make into meatballs.
Put in a baking dish.
Mix chili sauce and grape jelly.
Pour over meatballs.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Jelly Meatballs. Mix hamburger, eggs and soup mix. Make into meatballs. Put in a baking dish. Mix chili sauce and grape jelly. Pour over meatballs. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Arrange chicken in baking dish.
Mix Miracle Whip, Parmesan cheese and oregano, then spoon over chicken.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Parmesan Chicken. Arrange chicken in baking dish. Mix Miracle Whip, Parmesan cheese and oregano, then spoon over chicken. Bake at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. cleaned and boiled shrimp, chopped
1 dill pickle, finely chopped (substitute sweet if preferred)
directions: Mix all ingredients and store in a covered bowl in the refrigerator until ready to serve. The flavors will blend better if the salad is made one day, stored in the refrigerator overnight and then served the next day. If the salad is stored overnight, the macaroni may soak up your mayonnaise and dry out your salad. If this happens simply add a small amount of mayonnaise to moisten your salad.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Shrimp And Macaroni Salad. Mix all ingredients and store in a covered bowl in the refrigerator until ready to serve. The flavors will blend better if the salad is made one day, stored in the refrigerator overnight and then served the next day. If the salad is stored overnight, the macaroni may soak up your mayonnaise and dry out your salad. If this happens simply add a small amount of mayonnaise to moisten your salad. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Rolled Christmas Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients in order.
Cream together first four ingredients. Mix together the dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.
recipes.text: Rolled Christmas Cookies. Mix ingredients in order. Cream together first four ingredients. Mix together the dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.

recipes.title: Shells And Vegetables Italiano
ingredients: 1 (3 1/4 oz.) can pitted ripe olives, halved
directions: Prepare shells and cheese as directed on package.
Toss shells and cheese with remaining ingredients.
Serve immediately or chill.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Shells And Vegetables Italiano. Prepare shells and cheese as directed on package. Toss shells and cheese with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately or chill. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Scotch Shortbread Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 lb. soft butter (real butter works best)
directions: Mix the butter and sugar with a fork.
Add a little of the flour.
Turn the mixture out onto a board or a table and work the rest of the flour in with your hands.
Break off a small piece at a time and roll into a small ball.
Place balls 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Mash flat with a fork pressed crosswise. Bake at 250u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.
The cookie will be very light in color.
They are rich, but not too sweet and very, very good.
recipes.text: Scotch Shortbread Cookies. Mix the butter and sugar with a fork. Add a little of the flour. Turn the mixture out onto a board or a table and work the rest of the flour in with your hands. Break off a small piece at a time and roll into a small ball. Place balls 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Mash flat with a fork pressed crosswise. Bake at 250u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes. The cookie will be very light in color. They are rich, but not too sweet and very, very good.

recipes.title: Apple Crunch
directions: Preheat over to 350u00b0.
Place apples in 1 1/2 qt. casserole dish.
Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples. Combine flour, brown sugar, and butter.
Spread mixture over sugared apples.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until top is golden brown.
recipes.text: Apple Crunch. Preheat over to 350u00b0. Place apples in 1 1/2 qt. casserole dish. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples. Combine flour, brown sugar, and butter. Spread mixture over sugared apples. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 50 minutes or until top is golden brown.

recipes.title: Beer Batter Bread
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except butter.
Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350u00b0.
Take out bread; pour 1 stick melted butter over top.
Return to oven; bake 15 more minutes.
Slice and serve immediately.
This is a one-step recipe.
All alcohol is cooked out.
recipes.text: Beer Batter Bread. Mix together all ingredients, except butter. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350u00b0. Take out bread; pour 1 stick melted butter over top. Return to oven; bake 15 more minutes. Slice and serve immediately. This is a one-step recipe. All alcohol is cooked out.

recipes.title: Orange Pound Cake(Diabetic)
directions: Coat bottom of 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray.
Dust with 1 teaspoon flour.
Combine flour and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl.
Combine orange rind, juice and oil.
Add to flour mix.
Beat until smooth.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold 1/3 of egg whites into batter.
Fold in remaining egg whites.
Pour into greased pan.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour.
Cool in pan 10 minutes.
Then cool on wire rack.
recipes.text: Orange Pound Cake(Diabetic). Coat bottom of 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Dust with 1 teaspoon flour. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Combine orange rind, juice and oil. Add to flour mix. Beat until smooth. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold 1/3 of egg whites into batter. Fold in remaining egg whites. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Then cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.
Fry in a little oil until golden brown.
recipes.text: Pancakes. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Fry in a little oil until golden brown.

recipes.title: Lush
ingredients: 8 oz. Cool Whip or 1/2 (10 to 12 oz.) container Cool Whip
directions: Melt butter and mix with flour and nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Mix and beat cream cheese and confectioners sugar.
Add Cool Whip and mix well.
Spread on top of cooled crust.
recipes.text: Lush. Melt butter and mix with flour and nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix and beat cream cheese and confectioners sugar. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Spread on top of cooled crust.

recipes.title: Hopping John
directions: Saute ham, onion and hot pepper sauce in oil over moderate heat for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until onion is soft but not browned. Add remaining ingredients.
Heat.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Hopping John. Saute ham, onion and hot pepper sauce in oil over moderate heat for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until onion is soft but not browned. Add remaining ingredients. Heat. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Richmond Goulash (1930)
ingredients: 1 lb. round steak, ground, or lean hamburger
directions: Stir minced onion in an iron frying pan with meat.
As it cooks, pour off any fat.
Add soup and water.
Cook until done (about 5 minutes).
Pour over toast or an English muffin.
recipes.text: Richmond Goulash (1930). Stir minced onion in an iron frying pan with meat. As it cooks, pour off any fat. Add soup and water. Cook until done (about 5 minutes). Pour over toast or an English muffin.

recipes.title: Sugar Tortillas
directions: Stir dry ingredients together.
Work in shortening thoroughly. Add water slowly until dough is formed.
Cover and let rest for 15 minutes.
Divide into balls and roll into thin rounds.
Cook on hot griddle until done on both sides.
recipes.text: Sugar Tortillas. Stir dry ingredients together. Work in shortening thoroughly. Add water slowly until dough is formed. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes. Divide into balls and roll into thin rounds. Cook on hot griddle until done on both sides.

recipes.title: Beef Tips And Noodles
directions: In 2-quart casserole dish, add meat, soups and 1 cup soda. Stir, then cover.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 4 hours.
Cook noodles, add butter, salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Beef Tips And Noodles. In 2-quart casserole dish, add meat, soups and 1 cup soda. Stir, then cover. Bake at 275u00b0 for 4 hours. Cook noodles, add butter, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole
directions: Fry chicken breasts until tender.
Dice in small pieces.
Mix sour cream and both soups together.
Place diced chicken in casserole dish.
Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Crumble crackers over top of mixture.
Sprinkle poppy seed over crackers, then pour melted over top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole. Fry chicken breasts until tender. Dice in small pieces. Mix sour cream and both soups together. Place diced chicken in casserole dish. Pour soup mixture over chicken. Crumble crackers over top of mixture. Sprinkle poppy seed over crackers, then pour melted over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Cut or mash artichoke hearts. Add green chili peppers; mix well. Then add mayonnaise and Parmesan cheese; mix thoroughly. Place in baking dish. Put in the oven at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes (or until cheese is melted). Enjoy!
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Cut or mash artichoke hearts. Add green chili peppers; mix well. Then add mayonnaise and Parmesan cheese; mix thoroughly. Place in baking dish. Put in the oven at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes (or until cheese is melted). Enjoy!

recipes.title: Kaylene'S Cookies
directions: Mix eggs and 3/4 of the Cool Whip.
Mix in half of cake mix. Blend well.
Blend in remaining cake mix; batter will become very sticky.
recipes.text: Kaylene'S Cookies. Mix eggs and 3/4 of the Cool Whip. Mix in half of cake mix. Blend well. Blend in remaining cake mix; batter will become very sticky.

recipes.title: Icebox Rolls(No Kneading)
directions: To the 2 cups boiling water, add 1/2 cup sugar, shortening and salt.
Let the mixture cool to lukewarm.
Soften the yeast cakes in 1/4 cup lukewarm water.
Add 1 teaspoon sugar to the yeast. Stir this mixture into the first one.
Add eggs and 4 cups flour. Beat well.
Stir in 4 more cups of flour and mix well.
Cover the bowl and put in the refrigerator for 1/2 hour.
Remove from the refrigerator and shape into a roll.
Place in a round pan and let rise 1 to 2 hours, until double in size.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Icebox Rolls(No Kneading). To the 2 cups boiling water, add 1/2 cup sugar, shortening and salt. Let the mixture cool to lukewarm. Soften the yeast cakes in 1/4 cup lukewarm water. Add 1 teaspoon sugar to the yeast. Stir this mixture into the first one. Add eggs and 4 cups flour. Beat well. Stir in 4 more cups of flour and mix well. Cover the bowl and put in the refrigerator for 1/2 hour. Remove from the refrigerator and shape into a roll. Place in a round pan and let rise 1 to 2 hours, until double in size. Bake at 425u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach And Feta Cheese Quiche
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, defrosted
3 Tbsp. fresh grated Parmesan or Romano cheese
directions: Drain the spinach and squeeze out as much moisture as possible, it should be fairly dry.
Mix the eggs, cream and milk.
Add the salt, pepper, lemon juice and parsley.
Stir in spinach and Feta cheese.
Fill the quiche crust, and place the Parmesan or Romano cheese on top.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes, or until knife inserted in the center comes out dry.
Cool for 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Spinach And Feta Cheese Quiche. Drain the spinach and squeeze out as much moisture as possible, it should be fairly dry. Mix the eggs, cream and milk. Add the salt, pepper, lemon juice and parsley. Stir in spinach and Feta cheese. Fill the quiche crust, and place the Parmesan or Romano cheese on top. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes, or until knife inserted in the center comes out dry. Cool for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad No. 2
directions: Grind together cranberries and orange.
Add sugar; mix jello and hot water.
Cool and then add to first 3 ingredients.
Add celery, nuts and apples.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad No. 2. Grind together cranberries and orange. Add sugar; mix jello and hot water. Cool and then add to first 3 ingredients. Add celery, nuts and apples. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Crunchy Birthday Cookies
directions: Cream the butter. Add sugar, egg and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to creamed mixture. Fold in corn flakes, oats, coconut and nuts.
Roll in small balls and place about 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Crunchy Birthday Cookies. Cream the butter. Add sugar, egg and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to creamed mixture. Fold in corn flakes, oats, coconut and nuts. Roll in small balls and place about 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 5 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmigiana
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Take all the fat off of the chicken. Place one piece of chicken in bread crumbs and then in the eggs and back into the bread crumbs.
Repeat with each chicken.
Fry chicken in the frying pan and let oil soak out from the chicken in a large baking pan.
Put some spaghetti sauce over the chicken.
Add some cheese to the top of the sauce.
Add more sauce over the cheese and then more cheese over that.
Bake for twenty minutes, until cheese is melted.
Let cool.
It's ready to serve.
recipes.text: Chicken Parmigiana. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Take all the fat off of the chicken. Place one piece of chicken in bread crumbs and then in the eggs and back into the bread crumbs. Repeat with each chicken. Fry chicken in the frying pan and let oil soak out from the chicken in a large baking pan. Put some spaghetti sauce over the chicken. Add some cheese to the top of the sauce. Add more sauce over the cheese and then more cheese over that. Bake for twenty minutes, until cheese is melted. Let cool. It's ready to serve.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, milk and margarine in a 4 to 5-quart pan.
Bring to a full boil and allow to boil 5 minutes.
Place candy bars (broken into pieces), chocolate bits, Marshmallow Creme and pecans in a large mixing bowl.
Add hot syrup.
Stir until well mixed. Pour into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.
Makes 5 pounds.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Fudge. Combine sugar, milk and margarine in a 4 to 5-quart pan. Bring to a full boil and allow to boil 5 minutes. Place candy bars (broken into pieces), chocolate bits, Marshmallow Creme and pecans in a large mixing bowl. Add hot syrup. Stir until well mixed. Pour into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Makes 5 pounds.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
directions: Boil hamburger meat, salt, potato and 1 cup of onions, then mash.
Soft fry tortillas and roll with meat mixture, cheese and onion.
Mix enchilada sauce, mushroom soup and 1 can of water. Pour over rolled stuffed tortillas.
Top with leftover cheese and onions.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Boil hamburger meat, salt, potato and 1 cup of onions, then mash. Soft fry tortillas and roll with meat mixture, cheese and onion. Mix enchilada sauce, mushroom soup and 1 can of water. Pour over rolled stuffed tortillas. Top with leftover cheese and onions. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until thick.
Add oil and sugar.
Sift and add the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Stir in zucchini, pineapple, raisins and nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until thick. Add oil and sugar. Sift and add the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir in zucchini, pineapple, raisins and nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Pilot'S Grill Cheese Spread
ingredients: dash of Tabasco sauce, garlic salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce
directions: Finely chop green pepper, onions and pimento.
Mix together with the remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Pilot'S Grill Cheese Spread. Finely chop green pepper, onions and pimento. Mix together with the remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Gooey Cake
directions: First Layer:
Mix cake mix, melted butter and chopped pecans. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Gooey Cake. First Layer: Mix cake mix, melted butter and chopped pecans. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Christmas Tree Wreath Cookies
directions: Melt margarine and marshmallows in double boiler. Add food coloring and cornflakes. Drop one teaspoonful at a time on wax paper. Shape with spoon into round and flat shape.
Decorate with red hots.
recipes.text: Christmas Tree Wreath Cookies. Melt margarine and marshmallows in double boiler. Add food coloring and cornflakes. Drop one teaspoonful at a time on wax paper. Shape with spoon into round and flat shape. Decorate with red hots.

recipes.title: Pecan Tarts
ingredients: 1 large (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened
directions: Blend together cream cheese and 1 cup of margarine.
Add flour, then chill for 1 hour.
Shape into 4 dozen (1-inch) balls.
In small muffin tins, place ball in each and work around tin.
recipes.text: Pecan Tarts. Blend together cream cheese and 1 cup of margarine. Add flour, then chill for 1 hour. Shape into 4 dozen (1-inch) balls. In small muffin tins, place ball in each and work around tin.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn Balls
ingredients: 8 c. popped corn (about 1/2 c. unpopped corn)
directions: Put popped corn in large bowl and set aside.
Combine sugars, corn syrup, water, vinegar, and salt in a 2 qt. saucepan.
Heat to boiling over medium-high heat, stirring frequently.
Stirring constantly after it comes to a boil, continue to cook until it reaches 260 degrees on a candy thermometer.
Reduce heat and stir in butter.
Pour syrup in thin streams over corn in bowl.
Stir corn to coat with syrup.
Cool slightly, butter hands, shape into balls, and place on waxed paper.
Yields 12 balls.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn Balls. Put popped corn in large bowl and set aside. Combine sugars, corn syrup, water, vinegar, and salt in a 2 qt. saucepan. Heat to boiling over medium-high heat, stirring frequently. Stirring constantly after it comes to a boil, continue to cook until it reaches 260 degrees on a candy thermometer. Reduce heat and stir in butter. Pour syrup in thin streams over corn in bowl. Stir corn to coat with syrup. Cool slightly, butter hands, shape into balls, and place on waxed paper. Yields 12 balls.

recipes.title: Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cooked, boned and cubed with stock reserved
directions: Saut garlic and onion. Broil tomatoes on all sides until skin begins to char. Peel and pure in blender with garlic and onion, adding 1/4 cup stock if needed. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large pan over high heat. Add pure; cook and stir 2 minutes. Lower heat; cook and stir 5 to 10 minutes more, until pure thickens a bit and changes color. Add remaining chicken stock, epazote, cilantro, cubed chicken, salt and pepper to taste and cook 15 minutes or so. Add tortilla chips. May garnish with Feta cheese (this is yummy) or Cheddar, lime juice (this adds some zip) and chopped avocados.
Serves 6. Can freeze, without tortilla chips and avocado. Can do ahead.
recipes.text: Tortilla Soup. Saut garlic and onion. Broil tomatoes on all sides until skin begins to char. Peel and pure in blender with garlic and onion, adding 1/4 cup stock if needed. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large pan over high heat. Add pure; cook and stir 2 minutes. Lower heat; cook and stir 5 to 10 minutes more, until pure thickens a bit and changes color. Add remaining chicken stock, epazote, cilantro, cubed chicken, salt and pepper to taste and cook 15 minutes or so. Add tortilla chips. May garnish with Feta cheese (this is yummy) or Cheddar, lime juice (this adds some zip) and chopped avocados. Serves 6. Can freeze, without tortilla chips and avocado. Can do ahead.

recipes.title: Beef And Lima Bean Dinner
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in a large skillet, stirring often to crumble beef; drain.
Stir in lima beans and barbecue sauce; heat until bubbly.
Spoon meat mixture into a lightly greased shallow 2-quart casserole; sprinkle with cheese.
Separate each biscuit into 2 halves, making 10 biscuit rounds.
Place rounds on top of casserole, overlapping edges if necessary.
Bake, uncovered at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Beef And Lima Bean Dinner. Brown ground beef and onion in a large skillet, stirring often to crumble beef; drain. Stir in lima beans and barbecue sauce; heat until bubbly. Spoon meat mixture into a lightly greased shallow 2-quart casserole; sprinkle with cheese. Separate each biscuit into 2 halves, making 10 biscuit rounds. Place rounds on top of casserole, overlapping edges if necessary. Bake, uncovered at 375u00b0 for 25 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all together and fry.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix all together and fry.

recipes.title: Banana-Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well.
Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture alternately with banana, beating well after each addition.
Stir in walnuts.
Pour into well-greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Bake about 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Banana-Nut Bread. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture alternately with banana, beating well after each addition. Stir in walnuts. Pour into well-greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake about 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad Supreme
directions: Mix fruits together.
Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar together; mix well and chill.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad Supreme. Mix fruits together. Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar together; mix well and chill.

recipes.title: Howard'S Panocha
directions: Combine sugar, salt, corn syrup, butter and milk.
Cook in heavy saucepan, stirring until sugar dissolves to soft ball stage (238u00b0).
Cool at room temperature without stirring until lukewarm (110u00b0).
Add
vanilla.
Beat
until mixture holds its shape and loses gloss.
Add nuts and quickly spread in greased pan.
Cool and eat and get fat!!
recipes.text: Howard'S Panocha. Combine sugar, salt, corn syrup, butter and milk. Cook in heavy saucepan, stirring until sugar dissolves to soft ball stage (238u00b0). Cool at room temperature without stirring until lukewarm (110u00b0). Add vanilla. Beat until mixture holds its shape and loses gloss. Add nuts and quickly spread in greased pan. Cool and eat and get fat!!

recipes.title: Zucchini Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Saute zucchini and onions until golden brown and tender.
In large bowl, beat together egg white and milk.
Stir in muffin mix and blend until smooth.
Fold in zucchini and onions with 1/2 of the cheese.
Pour into 9-inch pie plate sprayed with nonstick spray.
Bake 30 minutes until golden brown.
Melt remaining cheese on top.
Cool.
Serve with Olive Spread.
recipes.text: Zucchini Corn Bread. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Saute zucchini and onions until golden brown and tender. In large bowl, beat together egg white and milk. Stir in muffin mix and blend until smooth. Fold in zucchini and onions with 1/2 of the cheese. Pour into 9-inch pie plate sprayed with nonstick spray. Bake 30 minutes until golden brown. Melt remaining cheese on top. Cool. Serve with Olive Spread.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew *
ingredients: salt and pepper to taste (red and black pepper)
directions: Have chicken well done and boned.
Beans, corn and tomatoes can be fresh or canned.
Mix all ingredients together, including the chicken gravy and cook slowly until well done.
The sugar should be added just before coming off the stove, as it may make the stew stick to bottom of pan.
Should make about 6 quarts.
recipes.text: Brunswick Stew *. Have chicken well done and boned. Beans, corn and tomatoes can be fresh or canned. Mix all ingredients together, including the chicken gravy and cook slowly until well done. The sugar should be added just before coming off the stove, as it may make the stew stick to bottom of pan. Should make about 6 quarts.

recipes.title: Almond Cake
directions: Butter bottom and sides of a 10-inch tube pan.
Press almonds into butter on both bottom and sides.
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar.
recipes.text: Almond Cake. Butter bottom and sides of a 10-inch tube pan. Press almonds into butter on both bottom and sides. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar.

recipes.title: Marinated Mushrooms
