directions: If mushrooms are very small, leave on stems; if large, remove stems and save for some other dish. Cook mushrooms in boiling salted water for 10 minutes; drain well.
recipes.text: Marinated Mushrooms. If mushrooms are very small, leave on stems; if large, remove stems and save for some other dish. Cook mushrooms in boiling salted water for 10 minutes; drain well.

recipes.title: Thousand Island Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill overnight in order for all the flavors to meld together.
recipes.text: Thousand Island Dressing. Mix all ingredients and chill overnight in order for all the flavors to meld together.

recipes.title: Salmonettes
directions: Drain salmon, reserving 1/4 cup liquid.
Put salmon into a mixing bowl, breaking it apart well with a fork, then add the flour and slightly beaten egg.
Add pepper, if desired, then mix well.
Add the baking powder to the reserved liquid.
Beat well with fork until foamy.
Pour this into the salmon mixture; stir until blended.
recipes.text: Salmonettes. Drain salmon, reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Put salmon into a mixing bowl, breaking it apart well with a fork, then add the flour and slightly beaten egg. Add pepper, if desired, then mix well. Add the baking powder to the reserved liquid. Beat well with fork until foamy. Pour this into the salmon mixture; stir until blended.

recipes.title: Upside-Down Pizza
ingredients: garlic powder, basil and oregano to taste
1 1/2 c. vegetables (onions, peppers, mushrooms, olives or pepperoni slices)
directions: Brown meat, celery and spices.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch sprayed pan. Top with vegetables and/or pepperoni slices.
Pour pizza sauce on top. Top with cheese.
Unfold crescent rolls and place them flat on top. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Upside-Down Pizza. Brown meat, celery and spices. Pour into 9 x 13-inch sprayed pan. Top with vegetables and/or pepperoni slices. Pour pizza sauce on top. Top with cheese. Unfold crescent rolls and place them flat on top. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Cheesy Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Spread mixture on the English muffins.
Cut into fourths or eighths and bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly.
May be frozen before baking.
recipes.text: Cheesy Hors D'Oeuvres. Spread mixture on the English muffins. Cut into fourths or eighths and bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly. May be frozen before baking.

recipes.title: Lemon Crumb Pie
directions: Cover the bread crumbs with the water; leave for 20 minutes. Add the egg yolks (slightly beaten), juice and rind of lemon, butter, salt and sugar.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour filling into unbaked pie shell.
Bake 30 minutes in 400u00b0 oven.
Cool and cover with sweetened whipped cream.
recipes.text: Lemon Crumb Pie. Cover the bread crumbs with the water; leave for 20 minutes. Add the egg yolks (slightly beaten), juice and rind of lemon, butter, salt and sugar. Mix thoroughly. Pour filling into unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 minutes in 400u00b0 oven. Cool and cover with sweetened whipped cream.

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
directions: Fill jars with any size cucumbers.
In each jar, put a flower of dill and a grape leaf.
Cover with boiling solution of other ingredients.
recipes.text: Dill Pickles. Fill jars with any size cucumbers. In each jar, put a flower of dill and a grape leaf. Cover with boiling solution of other ingredients.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook and drain broccoli; add all of remaining ingredients except stuffing mix.
Place into casserole dish.
Sprinkle with stuffing mix.
Bake at 350u00b0
for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook and drain broccoli; add all of remaining ingredients except stuffing mix. Place into casserole dish. Sprinkle with stuffing mix. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Cooler
directions: Pour 1/4 cup cranberry juice over ice in each of 6 glasses; stir in 1/2 cup wine.
Garnish with orange slice.
Makes 6 servings (about 3/4 cup each).
recipes.text: Cranberry Cooler. Pour 1/4 cup cranberry juice over ice in each of 6 glasses; stir in 1/2 cup wine. Garnish with orange slice. Makes 6 servings (about 3/4 cup each).

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Mix well sugar and syrup.
Microwave 4 minutes on High.
Add peanuts and stir well.
Microwave 3 1/2 minutes on High.
Add butter or oleo and vanilla.
Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High.
Add baking soda and stir gently.
It will foam up.
Pour on a buttered cookie pan and let cool.
Break up and enjoy.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Brittle. Mix well sugar and syrup. Microwave 4 minutes on High. Add peanuts and stir well. Microwave 3 1/2 minutes on High. Add butter or oleo and vanilla. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High. Add baking soda and stir gently. It will foam up. Pour on a buttered cookie pan and let cool. Break up and enjoy.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple. Reserve 6 tablespoons juice. Combine sugar and flour and stir in reserved juice. Add cheese to pineapple chunks, mixing well. Pour mixture in greased casserole dish. Combine melted butter and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over pineapple mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. This is good with baked ham.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Drain pineapple. Reserve 6 tablespoons juice. Combine sugar and flour and stir in reserved juice. Add cheese to pineapple chunks, mixing well. Pour mixture in greased casserole dish. Combine melted butter and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over pineapple mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 30 minutes. This is good with baked ham.

recipes.title: Bear Biscuits
directions: Separate 4 biscuits into eighths.
Leave 6 biscuits whole. Round small dough pieces into small ears and nose.
Press firmly into whole biscuits.
Press raisins into face for eyes and end of nose.
Add 1/4 of cherry to each ear.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 400u00b0 until golden brown.
Enjoy with honey of course!
recipes.text: Bear Biscuits. Separate 4 biscuits into eighths. Leave 6 biscuits whole. Round small dough pieces into small ears and nose. Press firmly into whole biscuits. Press raisins into face for eyes and end of nose. Add 1/4 of cherry to each ear. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 400u00b0 until golden brown. Enjoy with honey of course!

recipes.title: Sad Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Light Crust buttermilk biscuit mix
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
If desired, when cake is done sprinkle top with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Sad Cake. Mix all ingredients and bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes. If desired, when cake is done sprinkle top with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: *Spinach With Rice
ingredients: 1 pkg. fresh spinach or 10 oz. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed
directions: Saute the onion in heated oil until golden. Add the remaining ingredients and cook over low heat until done, about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: *Spinach With Rice. Saute the onion in heated oil until golden. Add the remaining ingredients and cook over low heat until done, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamed Cabbage(Stuet Kaal)
directions: Cut cabbage medium fine and boil in salted water until barely tender.
Melt butter in saucepan and stir in flour to a smooth paste.
Pour in milk, a little at a time, stirring constantly. Boil 5 to 6 minutes and salt to taste.
Grate nutmeg into sauce and add drained cabbage.
Stir and heat thoroughly.
recipes.text: Creamed Cabbage(Stuet Kaal). Cut cabbage medium fine and boil in salted water until barely tender. Melt butter in saucepan and stir in flour to a smooth paste. Pour in milk, a little at a time, stirring constantly. Boil 5 to 6 minutes and salt to taste. Grate nutmeg into sauce and add drained cabbage. Stir and heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes With Shrimp
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
1/2 c. finely chopped green onions or scallions
directions: Pick over the crab to remove any cartilage or shell.
Leave the lumps as large as possible.
Shell and devein the shrimp.
Put the shrimp in a food processor or blender and add the egg, cream, salt and pepper.
Blend as finely as possible.
Pour and scrape the mixture into a mixing bowl.
Add the crab, green onions, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce.
Blend gently but thoroughly.
Shape the mixture into 10 cakes.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes With Shrimp. Pick over the crab to remove any cartilage or shell. Leave the lumps as large as possible. Shell and devein the shrimp. Put the shrimp in a food processor or blender and add the egg, cream, salt and pepper. Blend as finely as possible. Pour and scrape the mixture into a mixing bowl. Add the crab, green onions, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco sauce. Blend gently but thoroughly. Shape the mixture into 10 cakes.

recipes.title: String Bean Oregonal
directions: Cook string beans as desired (boil, steam, microwave, etc.); set aside.
In a large saucepan over low heat, heat butter and oil.
Add the crushed garlic and peppercorns.
Add remaining ingredients except the cheese.
Mix well and heat until it just begins to bubble.
Remove from heat.
Add beans, mixing thoroughly.
Place on a warm serving dish.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the string beans and serve.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: String Bean Oregonal. Cook string beans as desired (boil, steam, microwave, etc.); set aside. In a large saucepan over low heat, heat butter and oil. Add the crushed garlic and peppercorns. Add remaining ingredients except the cheese. Mix well and heat until it just begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Add beans, mixing thoroughly. Place on a warm serving dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the string beans and serve. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Michigan Pea And Peanut Salad
ingredients: 20 oz. bag frozen peas, thawed but not cooked
directions: Mix all ingredients and add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve chilled.
recipes.text: Michigan Pea And Peanut Salad. Mix all ingredients and add salt and pepper to taste. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Fried Crappie Fillets
directions: Drain fish fillets on thick paper towels to drain.
Dip fish intmeal
mixture.tDeep
fry
in
peanut oil until fish floats and
is
golden
brown.
Put paper towels in bottom of paper grocery
bag
and put fried fish on paper towels.
Fold top
of bag down.
Fish will drain and will not get soggy, but will stay warm.
recipes.text: Fried Crappie Fillets. Drain fish fillets on thick paper towels to drain. Dip fish intmeal mixture.tDeep fry in peanut oil until fish floats and is golden brown. Put paper towels in bottom of paper grocery bag and put fried fish on paper towels. Fold top of bag down. Fish will drain and will not get soggy, but will stay warm.

recipes.title: Vinegar Pie Pastry By Aunt Nuvelle
directions: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar and
salt with pastry blender (or two knives used scissor fashion).
Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
recipes.text: Vinegar Pie Pastry By Aunt Nuvelle. In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar and salt with pastry blender (or two knives used scissor fashion). Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

recipes.title: Fish With Yellow Rice And Hollandaise Sauce
directions: Prepare rice as directed on bag; place in oblong baking dish when cooked. Prepare Hollandaise Sauce as directed on package. Place fish fillets on top of yellow rice; pour all Hollandaise Sauce over fillets. Bake 15 minutes in 350u00b0 oven and serve.
recipes.text: Fish With Yellow Rice And Hollandaise Sauce. Prepare rice as directed on bag; place in oblong baking dish when cooked. Prepare Hollandaise Sauce as directed on package. Place fish fillets on top of yellow rice; pour all Hollandaise Sauce over fillets. Bake 15 minutes in 350u00b0 oven and serve.

recipes.title: Honey Bun Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Mix first four ingredients by hand. Pour half of the batter into a greased 13 x 9 inch pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle half over batter. Add rest of batter and sprinkle remaining sugar and cinnamon over top. Use fork and swirl through batter. Bake for 35 minutes. Mix powdered sugar, vanilla and milk. Spread over cake as soon as it comes out of the oven. You may pierce the cake with a fork to let icing to be absorbed.
recipes.text: Honey Bun Cake. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Mix first four ingredients by hand. Pour half of the batter into a greased 13 x 9 inch pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle half over batter. Add rest of batter and sprinkle remaining sugar and cinnamon over top. Use fork and swirl through batter. Bake for 35 minutes. Mix powdered sugar, vanilla and milk. Spread over cake as soon as it comes out of the oven. You may pierce the cake with a fork to let icing to be absorbed.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or celery soup
directions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper.
Brown on both sides in skillet.
Layer vegetables in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour soup over vegetables.
Remove chops from skillet; set aside. Remove fat from skillet and add water to rinse and scrape particles from bottom of skillet.
Pour this over vegetables. Sprinkle with thyme.
Place pork chops on top.
Lay piece of foil over top and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Remove foil long enough to let chops brown or firm up on tops.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Brown on both sides in skillet. Layer vegetables in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Pour soup over vegetables. Remove chops from skillet; set aside. Remove fat from skillet and add water to rinse and scrape particles from bottom of skillet. Pour this over vegetables. Sprinkle with thyme. Place pork chops on top. Lay piece of foil over top and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove foil long enough to let chops brown or firm up on tops.

recipes.title: Dump It Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dump applesauce and pineapple into pan.
On top of this spread the package of dry yellow cake, do not stir.
Melt butter, pour on top of cake mix.
Sprinkle nuts over batter.
Do not stir.
recipes.text: Dump It Cake. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dump applesauce and pineapple into pan. On top of this spread the package of dry yellow cake, do not stir. Melt butter, pour on top of cake mix. Sprinkle nuts over batter. Do not stir.

recipes.title: Peppermint Hot Chocolate
directions: Combine 1/2 cup hot milk with chocolate peppermint patties, stirring well.
Add pinch of salt and remaining hot milk.
Heat to simmering.
Do not boil.
Add cream.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Peppermint Hot Chocolate. Combine 1/2 cup hot milk with chocolate peppermint patties, stirring well. Add pinch of salt and remaining hot milk. Heat to simmering. Do not boil. Add cream. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Creamed Eggs
directions: Peel and chop eggs.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add flour and seasoning; stir until well blended.
Add milk, stirring constantly.
Cook until smooth.
Add eggs to hot sauce.
Serve on toast.
recipes.text: Creamed Eggs. Peel and chop eggs. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and seasoning; stir until well blended. Add milk, stirring constantly. Cook until smooth. Add eggs to hot sauce. Serve on toast.

recipes.title: Biscuits With Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops in pan or on barbecue.
Mix all other ingredients together in large bowl.
Tear biscuits in pieces and mix with liquid.
Pour over pork chops and cook at 375u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Biscuits With Pork Chops. Brown pork chops in pan or on barbecue. Mix all other ingredients together in large bowl. Tear biscuits in pieces and mix with liquid. Pour over pork chops and cook at 375u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef
directions: Mix and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook chuck roast, rump or etc. until tender.
Tear meat into bite size pieces, then add to sauce. Simmer a few minutes.
Serve on buns.
You can freeze the sauce and add meat when needed.
recipes.text: Barbecue Beef. Mix and simmer 15 minutes. Cook chuck roast, rump or etc. until tender. Tear meat into bite size pieces, then add to sauce. Simmer a few minutes. Serve on buns. You can freeze the sauce and add meat when needed.

recipes.title: Chinese Chews
directions: In a saucepan, melt the margarine until it is hot.
Add the other ingredients in order named, mixing well.
Pour batter into rectangular cake pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Chinese Chews. In a saucepan, melt the margarine until it is hot. Add the other ingredients in order named, mixing well. Pour batter into rectangular cake pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 large can tomato soup (26 oz.) or 3 small cans
1 1/2 large cream cheese, softened (beat to remove lumps)
garlic powder and basil to taste
directions: If too thick, add V-8 juice. Simmer 1 hour. Makes a crock-pot full.
recipes.text: Tomato Soup. If too thick, add V-8 juice. Simmer 1 hour. Makes a crock-pot full.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pudding Dessert
ingredients: 1 (6 serving size) pkg. chocolate instant pudding
directions: Combine crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and butter; mix well.
Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Chill 15 minutes.
Combine cream cheese, remaining sugar and 2 tablespoons of milk in medium bowl.
With electric mixer at medium speed, beat until smooth. Fold in 1 3/4 cups of the Cool Whip.
Spread over crust.
Layer with pecans.
Pour remaining milk into bowl.
Add pudding mix. Mix with electric mixer on low speed until well blended or 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour over pecan layer in pan.
Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding.
Chill several hours or may freeze.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pudding Dessert. Combine crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and butter; mix well. Press firmly into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill 15 minutes. Combine cream cheese, remaining sugar and 2 tablespoons of milk in medium bowl. With electric mixer at medium speed, beat until smooth. Fold in 1 3/4 cups of the Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Layer with pecans. Pour remaining milk into bowl. Add pudding mix. Mix with electric mixer on low speed until well blended or 1 to 2 minutes. Pour over pecan layer in pan. Spread remaining Cool Whip over pudding. Chill several hours or may freeze.

recipes.title: Crab Rangoon(Appetizer)
directions: Blend crab meat with cream cheese and seasoning.
Put 1/2 teaspoon of mixture in center of wonton skin.
Moisten edge of skin with beaten egg white.
Fold square into triangle and twist to seal.
Fry in oil heated to 375u00b0.
recipes.text: Crab Rangoon(Appetizer). Blend crab meat with cream cheese and seasoning. Put 1/2 teaspoon of mixture in center of wonton skin. Moisten edge of skin with beaten egg white. Fold square into triangle and twist to seal. Fry in oil heated to 375u00b0.

recipes.title: Au Gratin Pineapple Casserole
directions: Combine sugar, flour, cheese and pineapple juice.
Bring to a boil.
Pour over the pineapple. Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly.
Top with cracker crumbs.
recipes.text: Au Gratin Pineapple Casserole. Combine sugar, flour, cheese and pineapple juice. Bring to a boil. Pour over the pineapple. Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly. Top with cracker crumbs.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Mix together the flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and salt. Add the mayonnaise, warm water and vanilla. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Cake. Mix together the flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and salt. Add the mayonnaise, warm water and vanilla. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Trim pork of all fat.
Season chops.
Mix soup, sauce and seasonings.
Heat on low until dissolved.
Place 4 chops in casserole dish.
Pour half the sauce over chops.
Place remaining chops and pour rest of sauce on top.
Cover dish and bake at 350 degrees for 1-1/2 hours or until meat is tender.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Trim pork of all fat. Season chops. Mix soup, sauce and seasonings. Heat on low until dissolved. Place 4 chops in casserole dish. Pour half the sauce over chops. Place remaining chops and pour rest of sauce on top. Cover dish and bake at 350 degrees for 1-1/2 hours or until meat is tender.

recipes.title: Creamed Tuna On Toast
directions: Melt butter in skillet.
Saute onion and celery.
Add tuna, Cheddar cheese, milk, salt, pepper and garlic.
Simmer until well mixed, about 15 minutes.
Serve over toast.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Creamed Tuna On Toast. Melt butter in skillet. Saute onion and celery. Add tuna, Cheddar cheese, milk, salt, pepper and garlic. Simmer until well mixed, about 15 minutes. Serve over toast. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
directions: Spread cream cheese in a disposable pizza pan.
Top with chili sauce.
Top with crab dip.
May also substitute shrimp for crabmeat.
Serve with Wheat Thins.
recipes.text: Crab Dip. Spread cream cheese in a disposable pizza pan. Top with chili sauce. Top with crab dip. May also substitute shrimp for crabmeat. Serve with Wheat Thins.

recipes.title: Peach Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Cream butter and sugar together until light
and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing after each. Combine flour, soda and salt in a separate bowl; set aside. Combine sour cream and peaches.
Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream-peach mixture and creamed butter-sugar ingredients.
Stir in extracts.
Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan.
Bake for 70 to 80 minutes or until nicely browned and an inserted toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from pan to cooling rack.
Dust with confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Peach Pound Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, mixing after each. Combine flour, soda and salt in a separate bowl; set aside. Combine sour cream and peaches. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream-peach mixture and creamed butter-sugar ingredients. Stir in extracts. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan. Bake for 70 to 80 minutes or until nicely browned and an inserted toothpick comes out clean. Remove from pan to cooling rack. Dust with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Dip
directions: Mix!
Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly.
Serve with bagel crisps or pita chips.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Dip. Mix! Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly. Serve with bagel crisps or pita chips.

recipes.title: Shrimper'S Delight
directions: Split fresh shrimp in half from the head to the top of the tail.

Place shrimp on a cookie sheet with peeling side down. Sprinkle garlic salt, Season-All and salt on fresh shrimp. Sprinkle self-rising flour lightly over the top of the seasoning. Pour melted butter over the top.
Bake at 500u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serve hot in shells.
recipes.text: Shrimper'S Delight. Split fresh shrimp in half from the head to the top of the tail. Place shrimp on a cookie sheet with peeling side down. Sprinkle garlic salt, Season-All and salt on fresh shrimp. Sprinkle self-rising flour lightly over the top of the seasoning. Pour melted butter over the top. Bake at 500u00b0 for 10 minutes. Serve hot in shells.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Combine
flour,
salt,tcream
of
tartar, baking soda, sugar and
corn
meal.
Cut
in 3/4 cup shortening.
Add milk slowly; mix
well,tthen add well beaten egg.
Bake in an 8 x 8-inch pan at 425u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Combine flour, salt,tcream of tartar, baking soda, sugar and corn meal. Cut in 3/4 cup shortening. Add milk slowly; mix well,tthen add well beaten egg. Bake in an 8 x 8-inch pan at 425u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Cake
directions: In an oblong pan, place all ingredients except chocolate chips.
Mix together and then add chips.
Stir in chips.
Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until top springs back.
Cool and serve topped with ice cream or whipped cream.
Store in fridge, covered.
recipes.text: Triple Chocolate Cake. In an oblong pan, place all ingredients except chocolate chips. Mix together and then add chips. Stir in chips. Bake in a 350u00b0 oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until top springs back. Cool and serve topped with ice cream or whipped cream. Store in fridge, covered.

recipes.title: Breakfast Tomorrow
directions: Butter 11 x 9-inch glass pan.
Place cubes of bread in dish. Cover with cooked sausage.
Beat the eggs, half and half, salt and pepper, then pour over the sausage and bread.
Top with cheese. Cover with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate overnight.
Cook at 400u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Tomorrow. Butter 11 x 9-inch glass pan. Place cubes of bread in dish. Cover with cooked sausage. Beat the eggs, half and half, salt and pepper, then pour over the sausage and bread. Top with cheese. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate overnight. Cook at 400u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
directions: Spread bean dip in a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Spread guacamole dip on bean dip.
Sprinkle remaining ingredients on top of dips.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Dip. Spread bean dip in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Spread guacamole dip on bean dip. Sprinkle remaining ingredients on top of dips. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch, jello and water. Cook until thick and clear, stirring constantly.
Cool completely.
Add berries. Pour into a 9-inch pie shell.
Top with whipped topping.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Pie. Combine sugar, cornstarch, jello and water. Cook until thick and clear, stirring constantly. Cool completely. Add berries. Pour into a 9-inch pie shell. Top with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar thoroughly.
Blend in drained fruit cup.
Stir in 3/4 of Cool Whip.
Top with remaining Cool Whip.
Garnish with cherries and nuts (if desired).
Chill and serve with meal or as dessert.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Salad. Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar thoroughly. Blend in drained fruit cup. Stir in 3/4 of Cool Whip. Top with remaining Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries and nuts (if desired). Chill and serve with meal or as dessert.

recipes.title: Pear Salad
directions: Drain juice off pears and heat.
Mash pears and cream cheese with fork.
Add hot pear juice to Jell-O, cream cheese and mashed pears.
Set aside and prepare Dream Whip as directed.
Add this to mixture, then nuts.
Chill.
recipes.text: Pear Salad. Drain juice off pears and heat. Mash pears and cream cheese with fork. Add hot pear juice to Jell-O, cream cheese and mashed pears. Set aside and prepare Dream Whip as directed. Add this to mixture, then nuts. Chill.

recipes.title: Pink Devil'S Sandwich Spread
directions: Blend.
Let set in refrigerator for better flavor.
recipes.text: Pink Devil'S Sandwich Spread. Blend. Let set in refrigerator for better flavor.

recipes.title: Buttery Pasta With Shrimp
directions: Use
your
favorite meat loaf mixture and your favorite bread stuffing
(homemade
or Stove Top).
On a piece of waxed paper, pat
out
meat
loaf mixture in a rectangle to 1/4-inch thick. Spread
stuffing
over
top; roll as you would a jelly roll. Carefully
place on a baking sheet; bake as you would a regular meat loaf.
recipes.text: Buttery Pasta With Shrimp. Use your favorite meat loaf mixture and your favorite bread stuffing (homemade or Stove Top). On a piece of waxed paper, pat out meat loaf mixture in a rectangle to 1/4-inch thick. Spread stuffing over top; roll as you would a jelly roll. Carefully place on a baking sheet; bake as you would a regular meat loaf.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Chicken With Orange
directions: Brown chicken under broiler.
Place in dish; sprinkle with paprika.
Place onion slices on top.
Combine orange juice, brown sugar, parsley, soy sauce, ginger, water and sherry; pour over chicken and onions.
Cover and simmer until tender, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Approximately 195 calories per serving.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Chicken With Orange. Brown chicken under broiler. Place in dish; sprinkle with paprika. Place onion slices on top. Combine orange juice, brown sugar, parsley, soy sauce, ginger, water and sherry; pour over chicken and onions. Cover and simmer until tender, about 35 to 40 minutes. Approximately 195 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Cheese Quiche Squares
ingredients: 1- 4 oz. can chopped green chilies, drained
10 oz. monterey jack cheese, shredded (about 2 1/2 c.)
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.
Stir flour, baking powder, salt together; stir into eggs.
Add remaining ingredients and blend well.
Pour into greased 13x9 pan.
Bake about 45 min. until set. Let cool 15 min.; cut into squares.
Yield:
24-2 in. squares.
recipes.text: Cheese Quiche Squares. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Stir flour, baking powder, salt together; stir into eggs. Add remaining ingredients and blend well. Pour into greased 13x9 pan. Bake about 45 min. until set. Let cool 15 min.; cut into squares. Yield: 24-2 in. squares.

recipes.title: Caramel Icing
directions: Mix brown sugar, cream, caramel flavoring and butter in saucepan over medium heat.
When all ingredients are dissolved and start to boil, mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup water.
Add to mixture when thickened.
Take off heat.
Spread on cake.
recipes.text: Caramel Icing. Mix brown sugar, cream, caramel flavoring and butter in saucepan over medium heat. When all ingredients are dissolved and start to boil, mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup water. Add to mixture when thickened. Take off heat. Spread on cake.

recipes.title: Crullers
directions: Beat eggs; add cream and milk.
Sift dry ingredients and combine with liquid using just enough flour that can be rolled but still soft.
Mix well and let stand for 2 hours.
Turn out on floured board and roll to 3/4-inch thick.
Cut into strips, 6-inches by 1-inch.
Fry in deep fat fryer at 360u00b0 until brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Crullers. Beat eggs; add cream and milk. Sift dry ingredients and combine with liquid using just enough flour that can be rolled but still soft. Mix well and let stand for 2 hours. Turn out on floured board and roll to 3/4-inch thick. Cut into strips, 6-inches by 1-inch. Fry in deep fat fryer at 360u00b0 until brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Seasoned Rice
ingredients: 1/4 lb. diced salt pork, ham or smoked pork butt
directions: Cook salt pork, onion, tomato and garlic in vegetable oil over medium heat.
Stir frequently until onion is tender, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Stir in rice and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in boiling water. Reduce heat to low.
Simmer.
Cover 10 minutes.
Remove cover and cool, stirring frequently until liquid is absorbed and rice is fluffy, 15 to 18 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Seasoned Rice. Cook salt pork, onion, tomato and garlic in vegetable oil over medium heat. Stir frequently until onion is tender, about 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in rice and cook 5 minutes. Stir in boiling water. Reduce heat to low. Simmer. Cover 10 minutes. Remove cover and cool, stirring frequently until liquid is absorbed and rice is fluffy, 15 to 18 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Quiche
ingredients: 1 (24 oz.) frozen shredded hash browns, thawed (I use Ore-Ida Cheddar cheese)
1 c. shredded hot pepper cheese (can cut if too spicy)
1 c. diced cooked ham (or diced Smoky links or sausage)
directions: Grease sides and bottom of 9-inch pie plate. Press hash browns into pie plate to form crust.
Brush with melted butter and bake for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle ham, onions, mushrooms and cheeses over crust.
Beat cream, eggs and salt and pour over cheeses.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
Can be frozen.
I brown crust, add ingredients and then freeze before baking.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Quiche. Grease sides and bottom of 9-inch pie plate. Press hash browns into pie plate to form crust. Brush with melted butter and bake for 25 minutes. Sprinkle ham, onions, mushrooms and cheeses over crust. Beat cream, eggs and salt and pour over cheeses. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Can be frozen. I brown crust, add ingredients and then freeze before baking.

recipes.title: Texas Ranger Cookies
directions: Cream sugars and shortening; add eggs, vanilla and salt.
Sift flour, soda and baking powder.
Add to creamed mixture, then add oats, cereal, nuts and coconut.
Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Drop by teaspoonfuls or roll in balls.
Bake for 12 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Texas Ranger Cookies. Cream sugars and shortening; add eggs, vanilla and salt. Sift flour, soda and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture, then add oats, cereal, nuts and coconut. Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Drop by teaspoonfuls or roll in balls. Bake for 12 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Tangy Cheese Ball
directions: Having cream cheese at room temperature, combine cheese, sauces, garlic powder and 1/2 cup chopped nuts.
Mix well.
Form into ball; roll in remainder of chopped nuts.
Serve with assorted crackers.
recipes.text: Tangy Cheese Ball. Having cream cheese at room temperature, combine cheese, sauces, garlic powder and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Mix well. Form into ball; roll in remainder of chopped nuts. Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Wash, peel and slice potatoes.
Place potatoes and onions in saucepan with milk.
Bring to boil and gently simmer about 10 minutes, stirring several times to prevent sticking.
Generously butter a baking dish.
Put half of potatoes and onions in bottom. Sprinkle half of cheese over potatoes.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Put rest of potatoes over cheese, then follow with rest of cheese, salt and pepper.
Pour enough hot milk over cheese that you can see surface of milk through the potatoes.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Wash, peel and slice potatoes. Place potatoes and onions in saucepan with milk. Bring to boil and gently simmer about 10 minutes, stirring several times to prevent sticking. Generously butter a baking dish. Put half of potatoes and onions in bottom. Sprinkle half of cheese over potatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Put rest of potatoes over cheese, then follow with rest of cheese, salt and pepper. Pour enough hot milk over cheese that you can see surface of milk through the potatoes. Bake at 375u00b0 for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Delight
directions: Boil chicken.
Bone chicken.
Use 1/2 of stuffing in the bottom of a baking dish.
Pour chicken broth over stuffing to moisten stuffing.
Spread chicken on top of stuffing.
recipes.text: Chicken Delight. Boil chicken. Bone chicken. Use 1/2 of stuffing in the bottom of a baking dish. Pour chicken broth over stuffing to moisten stuffing. Spread chicken on top of stuffing.

recipes.title: Tangy Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 medium bunch broccoli, cut into flowerets
4 c. loosely packed fresh spinach leaves, chopped
1/2 lb. thin sliced bacon, cooked crisply and crumbled
directions: Mix dressing, sugar and vinegar in large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly.
Refrigerate.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Tangy Broccoli Salad. Mix dressing, sugar and vinegar in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Refrigerate. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Micro Chicken Livers
directions: Place butter in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Heat in microwave oven on Full power for 30 to 45 seconds or until melted.
Coat liver in flour.
Arrange in melted butter.
Cook in microwave oven on Full power for 5 1/2 to 6 1/2 minutes or until livers are no longer pink.
recipes.text: Micro Chicken Livers. Place butter in a 2-quart casserole dish. Heat in microwave oven on Full power for 30 to 45 seconds or until melted. Coat liver in flour. Arrange in melted butter. Cook in microwave oven on Full power for 5 1/2 to 6 1/2 minutes or until livers are no longer pink.

recipes.title: Chicken Dip
directions: Cream all ingredients together then refrigerate.
recipes.text: Chicken Dip. Cream all ingredients together then refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Mix all together and drop onto cookie sheet with teaspoon. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cookies. Mix all together and drop onto cookie sheet with teaspoon. Bake at 375u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Cake And Frosting
directions: Melt chocolate in boiling water and cool.
Cream oleo and sugar until fluffy.
Add egg yolks one at a time and beat well. Add melted chocolate and vanilla.
Mix well.
Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture. Beat well until smooth.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and coconut.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
Makes a three layer cake.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Cake And Frosting. Melt chocolate in boiling water and cool. Cream oleo and sugar until fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time and beat well. Add melted chocolate and vanilla. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture. Beat well until smooth. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and coconut. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes a three layer cake.

recipes.title: Bob'S Basic Oat-Bran Muffins
ingredients: 1/4 c. brown sugar, honey or molasses
directions: Preheat oven to 425u00b0.
In a large bowl, combine all ingredients.
Line muffin pans with paper baking cups or spray with Pam.
Fill 3/4 full with batter.
Bake 15 to 17 minutes. Makes 12 regular or 24 small muffins.
recipes.text: Bob'S Basic Oat-Bran Muffins. Preheat oven to 425u00b0. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients. Line muffin pans with paper baking cups or spray with Pam. Fill 3/4 full with batter. Bake 15 to 17 minutes. Makes 12 regular or 24 small muffins.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Popcorn Bars
directions: Place popcorn in a large bowl; set aside in a sauce pan over medium heat, bring sugar and corn syrup to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil for 1 minute.
Remove from the heat.
Stir in peanut butter and vanilla:
mix well.
Pour over popcorn and mix until well coated.
Press into a buttered 13 x 9 x 2 pan.
Cool slightly before cutting.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Popcorn Bars. Place popcorn in a large bowl; set aside in a sauce pan over medium heat, bring sugar and corn syrup to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from the heat. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla: mix well. Pour over popcorn and mix until well coated. Press into a buttered 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Cool slightly before cutting.

recipes.title: Boy'S Skillet Macaroni And Beef
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
directions: Cook the ground beef, onion, bell pepper, salt, tomato sauce, water and Worcestershire sauce.
Add elbow macaroni and simmer until macaroni is tender.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Boy'S Skillet Macaroni And Beef. Cook the ground beef, onion, bell pepper, salt, tomato sauce, water and Worcestershire sauce. Add elbow macaroni and simmer until macaroni is tender. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Caramel Candy Bars
directions: Heat caramels and milk in 2-quart casserole on Medium in microwave until smooth. Stir often. Mix flour, oats, brown sugar, soda, salt and egg. Cut in butter with pastry blender until crumbly. Press half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Drizzle with caramel mixture. Sprinkle remaining crumbly mixture over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Caramel Candy Bars. Heat caramels and milk in 2-quart casserole on Medium in microwave until smooth. Stir often. Mix flour, oats, brown sugar, soda, salt and egg. Cut in butter with pastry blender until crumbly. Press half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Drizzle with caramel mixture. Sprinkle remaining crumbly mixture over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Carrot-Pear Soup
ingredients: 1 medium potato, peeled and cut in 1-inch pieces
2 pears, peeled, cored and cut in 1-inch pieces
directions: Heat butter in large pot.
Add onion, garlic and celery; saute until softened, about 10 minutes.
Add carrot, potato, pear, bay leaf and chicken broth.
Cover and bring to boil.
Lower heat; simmer 40 minutes.
Remove bay leaf.
Working in batches, whirl soup mixture in blender or food processor until smooth puree. Season with pepper.
recipes.text: Carrot-Pear Soup. Heat butter in large pot. Add onion, garlic and celery; saute until softened, about 10 minutes. Add carrot, potato, pear, bay leaf and chicken broth. Cover and bring to boil. Lower heat; simmer 40 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Working in batches, whirl soup mixture in blender or food processor until smooth puree. Season with pepper.

recipes.title: Zucchini Souffle
directions: Mix in order.
Put in greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Souffle. Mix in order. Put in greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cathead Biscuits
directions: Mix flour, mayonnaise and buttermilk.
Beat in sweet milk until biscuits are of dropping consistency, too sticky to roll, but stiff enough to sit up.
Drop by big spoonfuls on greased griddle or baking sheets and bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven until brown.
recipes.text: Cathead Biscuits. Mix flour, mayonnaise and buttermilk. Beat in sweet milk until biscuits are of dropping consistency, too sticky to roll, but stiff enough to sit up. Drop by big spoonfuls on greased griddle or baking sheets and bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven until brown.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Carrot Salad
directions: Cook carrots until fork-tender and cool.
Add the other ingredients and chill overnight.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Carrot Salad. Cook carrots until fork-tender and cool. Add the other ingredients and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Master Mix
directions: Sift dry ingredients together 3 times into large bowl.
Cut in shortening until crumbly.
Store in airtight container at room temperature.
Yields 13 cups mix.
recipes.text: Master Mix. Sift dry ingredients together 3 times into large bowl. Cut in shortening until crumbly. Store in airtight container at room temperature. Yields 13 cups mix.

recipes.title: Jette'S Mother'S Coffeecake
directions: Dissolve yeast in water.
Beat egg yolks thoroughly, then beat in milk and yeast mixture.
In a large bowl or food processor, combine 3 cups flour, 1/4 cup sugar and salt.
Cut in butter until particles are fine.
Stir in yeast mixture and lemon peel.
Cover and let stand 30 minutes.
Stir in about 1/4 cup flour or enough to make a soft dough.
Turn out on a floured board and knead (adding flour only if necessary to prevent sticking) until smooth and satiny.
Place in greased bowl, cover tightly and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight.
After removing from refrigerator, let stand at room temperature to warm (or press with hands to warm and soften). Roll into a 20 x 16-inch rectangle.
Stir together egg whites, nuts and remaining cup of sugar.
Spread on dough.
Starting at lengthwise edge nearest you, roll as for jelly roll.
Grease Bundt pan, then carefully lift roll and place, seam side up, in prepared pan, adjusting to fit and overlapping ends to join.
Cover and let stand 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a rich golden brown.
(Start to check after 30 minutes and when top begins to turn golden, cover loosely with foil for remainder of baking time.)
Cool in pan 10 minutes, then gently loosen at edges and around center tube.
Turn out on wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, sifted.
Makes 18 slices.
This sounds time-consuming to prepare, but it is very easy and very delicious.
recipes.text: Jette'S Mother'S Coffeecake. Dissolve yeast in water. Beat egg yolks thoroughly, then beat in milk and yeast mixture. In a large bowl or food processor, combine 3 cups flour, 1/4 cup sugar and salt. Cut in butter until particles are fine. Stir in yeast mixture and lemon peel. Cover and let stand 30 minutes. Stir in about 1/4 cup flour or enough to make a soft dough. Turn out on a floured board and knead (adding flour only if necessary to prevent sticking) until smooth and satiny. Place in greased bowl, cover tightly and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight. After removing from refrigerator, let stand at room temperature to warm (or press with hands to warm and soften). Roll into a 20 x 16-inch rectangle. Stir together egg whites, nuts and remaining cup of sugar. Spread on dough. Starting at lengthwise edge nearest you, roll as for jelly roll. Grease Bundt pan, then carefully lift roll and place, seam side up, in prepared pan, adjusting to fit and overlapping ends to join. Cover and let stand 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a rich golden brown. (Start to check after 30 minutes and when top begins to turn golden, cover loosely with foil for remainder of baking time.) Cool in pan 10 minutes, then gently loosen at edges and around center tube. Turn out on wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar, sifted. Makes 18 slices. This sounds time-consuming to prepare, but it is very easy and very delicious.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Mash potatoes (keep them stiff).
Season to taste with salt and pepper (Krazy salt works best).
Add other ingredients and mix well.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cheesy Potatoes. Mash potatoes (keep them stiff). Season to taste with salt and pepper (Krazy salt works best). Add other ingredients and mix well. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Layered Pudding Dessert
directions: Combine and press into a 9 x 12-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
Let cool.
(It looks flaky and the edges pull away slightly when done.)
Only press into the bottom of pan.
recipes.text: Layered Pudding Dessert. Combine and press into a 9 x 12-inch cake pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Let cool. (It looks flaky and the edges pull away slightly when done.) Only press into the bottom of pan.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 c. shredded Cheddar cheese or more *
directions: Brown hamburger with taco seasoning as directed on package. Set aside to cool.
Mix cream cheese with sour cream.
Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Cover with hamburger mix. Put a layer of shredded lettuce on top of burger mix.
Mix tomato with salsa.
Layer over lettuce.
Cover salsa with shredded cheese.
Microwave or place in a 375u00b0 oven until cheese melts. Serve at once with nacho chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Brown hamburger with taco seasoning as directed on package. Set aside to cool. Mix cream cheese with sour cream. Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Cover with hamburger mix. Put a layer of shredded lettuce on top of burger mix. Mix tomato with salsa. Layer over lettuce. Cover salsa with shredded cheese. Microwave or place in a 375u00b0 oven until cheese melts. Serve at once with nacho chips.

recipes.title: Linguini
directions: Cook noodles until done; drain.
Rinse in cool water.
Cut up cucumbers, tomatoes and onions (as many as you want).
Add to noodles.
Pour Italian dressing over the first mixture.
Sprinkle Salad Supreme over top.
Keep in refrigeration until ready to eat.
recipes.text: Linguini. Cook noodles until done; drain. Rinse in cool water. Cut up cucumbers, tomatoes and onions (as many as you want). Add to noodles. Pour Italian dressing over the first mixture. Sprinkle Salad Supreme over top. Keep in refrigeration until ready to eat.

recipes.title: Chili Cheese Log
directions: Beat the chili seasoning, cream cheese and salsa.
Shape.
Top with chopped nuts and Monterey Jack cheese.
Chill until firm. Serve with assorted crackers and vegetables.
recipes.text: Chili Cheese Log. Beat the chili seasoning, cream cheese and salsa. Shape. Top with chopped nuts and Monterey Jack cheese. Chill until firm. Serve with assorted crackers and vegetables.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole(Diet)
directions: Combine and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole(Diet). Combine and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Bonbons
ingredients: 1 c. finely crushed vanilla wafer crumbs
1/2 c. finely chopped walnuts or pecans
directions: Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over simmering water. Off heat, stir in remaining ingredients, except dredging sugar, in order listed.
As mixture stiffens, use hands to blend well. Shape into 1-inch balls; roll in confectioners sugar.
Let ripen 1 to 2 days before serving.
Makes 2 dozen.
Each bonbon contains about 95 calories.
recipes.text: No-Bake Chocolate Bonbons. Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over simmering water. Off heat, stir in remaining ingredients, except dredging sugar, in order listed. As mixture stiffens, use hands to blend well. Shape into 1-inch balls; roll in confectioners sugar. Let ripen 1 to 2 days before serving. Makes 2 dozen. Each bonbon contains about 95 calories.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Clusters
directions: Melt butterscotch in top of double boiler.
Add peanuts and noodles.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper and allow to cool.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Clusters. Melt butterscotch in top of double boiler. Add peanuts and noodles. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper and allow to cool.

recipes.title: 3 Month Salad
ingredients: 2 medium heads cabbage shredded or chopped
directions: Sprinkle salt over cabbage and cover with water.
Let stand for 2 hours.
Drain.
Mix together with cabbage 1 bunch of celery, cut fine and 3 green peppers cut fine.
recipes.text: 3 Month Salad. Sprinkle salt over cabbage and cover with water. Let stand for 2 hours. Drain. Mix together with cabbage 1 bunch of celery, cut fine and 3 green peppers cut fine.

recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Pie
directions: Line deep pie plate with 9-inch pie crust.
Grate 1/2 pound Swiss cheese. Dredge cheese with 1 tablespoon flour.
Spread cheese evenly on pie crust.
Mix eggs with milk and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour mixture over cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes in preheated 425u00b0 oven.
Reduce heat to 325u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer.
Serve hot.
For variety, you can add crumbled bacon, minced precooked chicken or very finely chopped precooked vegetables to cheese pie.
recipes.text: Swiss Cheese Pie. Line deep pie plate with 9-inch pie crust. Grate 1/2 pound Swiss cheese. Dredge cheese with 1 tablespoon flour. Spread cheese evenly on pie crust. Mix eggs with milk and season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour mixture over cheese. Bake for 15 minutes in preheated 425u00b0 oven. Reduce heat to 325u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer. Serve hot. For variety, you can add crumbled bacon, minced precooked chicken or very finely chopped precooked vegetables to cheese pie.

recipes.title: Noodle Pudding
directions: Prepare noodles as directed on box.
Drain noodles thoroughly and add butter while hot.
In large bowl, beat eggs and add noodles, vanilla, sugar, pineapple and cinnamon.
Mix thoroughly.
recipes.text: Noodle Pudding. Prepare noodles as directed on box. Drain noodles thoroughly and add butter while hot. In large bowl, beat eggs and add noodles, vanilla, sugar, pineapple and cinnamon. Mix thoroughly.

recipes.title: Greasepaint
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients in a dish.
This is the white greasepaint.
Set aside half of the white greasepaint.
Divide the rest into 3 equal parts.
Put each part in a separate dish.
Mix a different shade of food coloring into each part.
Lightly spread cold cream or shortening on your face.
Use a tissue to wipe off any extra.
Use fingers to spread on white greasepaint over entire face.
Spread in one direction.
Keep away from eyes.
Use paintbrush to apply colored paint.
To take off, use baby oil on a tissue.
recipes.text: Greasepaint. Mix the first 3 ingredients in a dish. This is the white greasepaint. Set aside half of the white greasepaint. Divide the rest into 3 equal parts. Put each part in a separate dish. Mix a different shade of food coloring into each part. Lightly spread cold cream or shortening on your face. Use a tissue to wipe off any extra. Use fingers to spread on white greasepaint over entire face. Spread in one direction. Keep away from eyes. Use paintbrush to apply colored paint. To take off, use baby oil on a tissue.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Cool 10 minutes before removing.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Cream the brown sugar and Crisco together.
Add the eggs, almond, flour, salt, cream of tartar and baking soda; mix well. Add chopped nuts.
Shape into long rolls.
Wrap in waxed paper; chill dough for 1 hour.
Slice thin.
Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Icebox Cookies. Cream the brown sugar and Crisco together. Add the eggs, almond, flour, salt, cream of tartar and baking soda; mix well. Add chopped nuts. Shape into long rolls. Wrap in waxed paper; chill dough for 1 hour. Slice thin. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: non-nutritive sweetener equivalent to 3/4 c. sugar
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Cream margarine; mix in sweetener, water and vanilla extract.
To this mixture add the beaten egg. Sift flour, baking soda and salt together.
Stir into mixture. Mix in chocolate bits and nuts.
Drop by spoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake from 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Cream margarine; mix in sweetener, water and vanilla extract. To this mixture add the beaten egg. Sift flour, baking soda and salt together. Stir into mixture. Mix in chocolate bits and nuts. Drop by spoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake from 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Barley Casserole
ingredients: 1 can chicken broth + water or mushroom juice to equal 2 c.
directions: Saute barley and onion in butter until barley is light brown. Add other ingredients.
Stir well and pour into greased dish. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour, adding water if needed.
Or microwave on High for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Barley Casserole. Saute barley and onion in butter until barley is light brown. Add other ingredients. Stir well and pour into greased dish. Cover and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour, adding water if needed. Or microwave on High for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Washugal
directions: Stir-fry kielbasa in skillet with a little oil on high. Peel potatoes and shred them. Add them to kielbasa and lower heat to medium. Cover skillet and cook about ten minutes. Flip mixture over and cook for 4-5 minutes. Take 6 eggs and mix up in bowl. Pour over potato and kielbasa mixture. Then cook the mixture like scrambled eggs. Use shredded cheese to sprinkle over mixture (I use Cheddar cheese). Put lid back on until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Washugal. Stir-fry kielbasa in skillet with a little oil on high. Peel potatoes and shred them. Add them to kielbasa and lower heat to medium. Cover skillet and cook about ten minutes. Flip mixture over and cook for 4-5 minutes. Take 6 eggs and mix up in bowl. Pour over potato and kielbasa mixture. Then cook the mixture like scrambled eggs. Use shredded cheese to sprinkle over mixture (I use Cheddar cheese). Put lid back on until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
Great for dinner or for a picnic.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Great for dinner or for a picnic.

recipes.title: Heart Smart Baked Chicken
ingredients: 6 to 8 chicken breasts, deboned and skinned
1/2 c. margarine, melted (I use squeeze margarine)
directions: Mix together oatmeal, Parmesan cheese, salt, pepper and paprika.
Place oatmeal mixture in shallow dish.
In a separate shallow dish, mix garlic and milk.
Place chicken, one piece at a time, in oatmeal mixture, then dip in milk mixture and again in oatmeal mixture.
Place chicken in a large shallow baking dish and drizzle with margarine.
Bake at 325u00b0 for about 1 hour or until fork can be inserted with ease.
recipes.text: Heart Smart Baked Chicken. Mix together oatmeal, Parmesan cheese, salt, pepper and paprika. Place oatmeal mixture in shallow dish. In a separate shallow dish, mix garlic and milk. Place chicken, one piece at a time, in oatmeal mixture, then dip in milk mixture and again in oatmeal mixture. Place chicken in a large shallow baking dish and drizzle with margarine. Bake at 325u00b0 for about 1 hour or until fork can be inserted with ease.

recipes.title: Tenderizing Marinade
directions: Brown meat in oil.
Add rest of ingredients (pour liquids over, shake on seasonings).
This is a tenderizing marinade; bake meat, covered, slowly for a long time, depending on the quantity. Add water if needed.
Juice may be made into gravy by adding 1/2 cup water mixed with
1 tablespoon cornstarch and simmering.
recipes.text: Tenderizing Marinade. Brown meat in oil. Add rest of ingredients (pour liquids over, shake on seasonings). This is a tenderizing marinade; bake meat, covered, slowly for a long time, depending on the quantity. Add water if needed. Juice may be made into gravy by adding 1/2 cup water mixed with 1 tablespoon cornstarch and simmering.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Sift flour, soda and salt together; cream butter and sugar. Add well-beaten eggs.
Mash bananas with fork and add sour milk; add alternately with the flour to the butter mixture.
When well blended, pour in bread pan (buttered), 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inches.
Bake in preheated oven (350u00b0) for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Sift flour, soda and salt together; cream butter and sugar. Add well-beaten eggs. Mash bananas with fork and add sour milk; add alternately with the flour to the butter mixture. When well blended, pour in bread pan (buttered), 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inches. Bake in preheated oven (350u00b0) for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cookies
ingredients: 1 box cake mix (lemon, spice, chocolate or orange)
directions: Fold whipped topping, beaten egg and vanilla together.
Add cake mix and stir well.
Put confectioners sugar in separate bowl. Drop cookie mixture in by the teaspoon.
Coat each lightly with sugar.
Put on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
When done, edges are lightly brown and the top has "earthquake" lines!
Yields 5 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cookies. Fold whipped topping, beaten egg and vanilla together. Add cake mix and stir well. Put confectioners sugar in separate bowl. Drop cookie mixture in by the teaspoon. Coat each lightly with sugar. Put on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 15 to 20 minutes. When done, edges are lightly brown and the top has "earthquake" lines! Yields 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad Plate
directions: Prepare Curried Cottage Cheese and Lemonade Dressing.
Have all the ingredients, except banana, chilled.
Just before serving, slice banana and dip slices into fruit juice or syrup to prevent darkening.
Arrange fruit on lettuce leaves, with Curried Cottage Cheese in center of platter.
Serve Lemonade Dressing on side or drizzle over fruit.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad Plate. Prepare Curried Cottage Cheese and Lemonade Dressing. Have all the ingredients, except banana, chilled. Just before serving, slice banana and dip slices into fruit juice or syrup to prevent darkening. Arrange fruit on lettuce leaves, with Curried Cottage Cheese in center of platter. Serve Lemonade Dressing on side or drizzle over fruit.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Salad
ingredients: 6 to 7 oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Salad. Mix first 3 ingredients together. Fold in remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake and crumble it into 1 to 2-inch pieces.
Put layer of cake in the bottom of a punch bowl.
Make pudding and pour over cake.
Sprinkle about 1/3 of the coconut on top of the pudding. Sprinkle about 1/3 pecans on top of coconut.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Bake cake and crumble it into 1 to 2-inch pieces. Put layer of cake in the bottom of a punch bowl. Make pudding and pour over cake. Sprinkle about 1/3 of the coconut on top of the pudding. Sprinkle about 1/3 pecans on top of coconut.

recipes.title: Cracklin' Bread
directions: Mix the ingredients and bake in medium tins, corn stick pan or baking pan.
This is a Georgia Agrirama recipe.
recipes.text: Cracklin' Bread. Mix the ingredients and bake in medium tins, corn stick pan or baking pan. This is a Georgia Agrirama recipe.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Casserole
directions: Combine beef and onions in skillet; cook until meat is lightly brown.
Drain.
Add salt and pepper.
Stir in catsup and tomato sauce.
Heat thoroughly.
Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole or a 9 x 12-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place sliced cheese over hamburger mixture.
Top with biscuits.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes, or until biscuits are golden brown.
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Casserole. Combine beef and onions in skillet; cook until meat is lightly brown. Drain. Add salt and pepper. Stir in catsup and tomato sauce. Heat thoroughly. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole or a 9 x 12-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan. Place sliced cheese over hamburger mixture. Top with biscuits. Bake at 425u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes, or until biscuits are golden brown.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 7 oz. shell macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, milk, bouillon and garlic powder.
Mix well and set aside.
In a 4 or 5-quart bowl, layer salad greens, macaroni, peas, tomatoes and mushrooms.
Stir dressing and spread evenly over salad.
Top with bacon bits. Cover and chill for 6 hours or overnight.
Toss to serve.
Makes 11 cups.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Vegetable Salad. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, milk, bouillon and garlic powder. Mix well and set aside. In a 4 or 5-quart bowl, layer salad greens, macaroni, peas, tomatoes and mushrooms. Stir dressing and spread evenly over salad. Top with bacon bits. Cover and chill for 6 hours or overnight. Toss to serve. Makes 11 cups.

recipes.title: Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. fresh dill or 1 tsp. dried dill seed
6 c. cut up fresh vegetables, cooked crisp-tender (such as cauliflower, broccoli, carrots and onion)
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In a small saucepan, combine first 3 ingredients. Gradually stir in milk. Add oleo, stirring constantly; bring to boil over medium heat. Stir in next 3 ingredients. Toss with vegetables. Turn into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with topping. Bake 20 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Vegetable Medley. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In a small saucepan, combine first 3 ingredients. Gradually stir in milk. Add oleo, stirring constantly; bring to boil over medium heat. Stir in next 3 ingredients. Toss with vegetables. Turn into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with topping. Bake 20 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Roquefort Log
directions: Combine cheeses. Blend in next 4 ingredients. Shape into a log about 1 1/2-inches in diameter. Roll in chopped (blended) nuts mixed with parsley and 1 teaspoon paprika. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Roquefort Log. Combine cheeses. Blend in next 4 ingredients. Shape into a log about 1 1/2-inches in diameter. Roll in chopped (blended) nuts mixed with parsley and 1 teaspoon paprika. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Frozen Chocolate Crunchy
directions: Combine cookie crumbs and 1/4 cup melted margarine.
Mix well in a bowl.
Press mixture into a rectangular dish.
Freeze until firm.
Spread softened ice cream over cookie crust and return to freezer.
Melt 1/4 cup margarine with chocolate squares over low heat.
Add sugar, salt, vanilla and evaporated milk.
Cook 4 to 5 minutes until thickens.
Cool sauce and pour over ice cream. Sprinkle with pecans.
Freeze, covered, until served.
recipes.text: Frozen Chocolate Crunchy. Combine cookie crumbs and 1/4 cup melted margarine. Mix well in a bowl. Press mixture into a rectangular dish. Freeze until firm. Spread softened ice cream over cookie crust and return to freezer. Melt 1/4 cup margarine with chocolate squares over low heat. Add sugar, salt, vanilla and evaporated milk. Cook 4 to 5 minutes until thickens. Cool sauce and pour over ice cream. Sprinkle with pecans. Freeze, covered, until served.

recipes.title: Harvest Pie
directions: Make crust according to package directions.
Bake 5 minutes at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Harvest Pie. Make crust according to package directions. Bake 5 minutes at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Cut hard-boiled eggs in two.
Put yolks in bowl and mash with vinegar, sugar, pepper, salt and dry mustard.
Pack mixture back into eggs and sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Deviled Eggs. Cut hard-boiled eggs in two. Put yolks in bowl and mash with vinegar, sugar, pepper, salt and dry mustard. Pack mixture back into eggs and sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Brunch Egg Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, cooked, drained and crumbled
directions: Melt 1/4 cup butter in heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour.
Stir until smooth.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk and half and half.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly.
Add cheese and herbs, stirring until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Brunch Egg Casserole. Melt 1/4 cup butter in heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour. Stir until smooth. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk and half and half. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly. Add cheese and herbs, stirring until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Sheep Herder'S Pie
directions: Brown
ground
beef
with
taco
seasoning
mix.
Drain excess fat,
if
needed.
Add
corn, about 1/3 cup if desired, and mix it with ground beef.
Put meat in a small Dutch oven. Prepare enough mashed potatoes to cover meat (1 to 2-inches). Bake at
350u00b0 until
it
bubbles and potatoes start to brown. Scoop out portions and sprinkle with cheese.
recipes.text: Sheep Herder'S Pie. Brown ground beef with taco seasoning mix. Drain excess fat, if needed. Add corn, about 1/3 cup if desired, and mix it with ground beef. Put meat in a small Dutch oven. Prepare enough mashed potatoes to cover meat (1 to 2-inches). Bake at 350u00b0 until it bubbles and potatoes start to brown. Scoop out portions and sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine sugar, oil, eggs, water and pumpkin.
Mix in mixer. Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.
Add to pumpkin mixture and mix well.
Add pecans and raisins.
Pour into greased large Bundt pan or four 1 pound greased coffee cans.
Bake 1 hour in 350u00b0 oven.
Cool 15 or 20 minutes, then remove from pan.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Combine sugar, oil, eggs, water and pumpkin. Mix in mixer. Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Add to pumpkin mixture and mix well. Add pecans and raisins. Pour into greased large Bundt pan or four 1 pound greased coffee cans. Bake 1 hour in 350u00b0 oven. Cool 15 or 20 minutes, then remove from pan.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Slowly boil white sugar, brown sugar and milk until mixture makes a soft ball when dropped in cold water.
Remove from heat and add butter, vanilla, Marshmallow Fluff and peanut butter. Stir until creamy and pour in greased pan.
When cool, cut into squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Slowly boil white sugar, brown sugar and milk until mixture makes a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat and add butter, vanilla, Marshmallow Fluff and peanut butter. Stir until creamy and pour in greased pan. When cool, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Toll House Pie
directions: In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy; add flour and sugar. Beat until well blended.
Blend in melted room temperature butter; stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 325u00b0 for one hour.
Serve warm with ice cream.
This recipe will serve 7 people.
recipes.text: Toll House Pie. In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy; add flour and sugar. Beat until well blended. Blend in melted room temperature butter; stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325u00b0 for one hour. Serve warm with ice cream. This recipe will serve 7 people.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 2 (3 oz. each) pkg. cherry or raspberry jello
directions: Drain pineapple and cranberries; save the juice.
Mix jello with 1 cup of boiling water.
Add 1 cup pineapple and cranberry juice.
Mix together and stir in cranberries, pineapple and pecans.
Chill.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Drain pineapple and cranberries; save the juice. Mix jello with 1 cup of boiling water. Add 1 cup pineapple and cranberry juice. Mix together and stir in cranberries, pineapple and pecans. Chill.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
ingredients: 3 lb. young frying chicken, cut up as for frying
directions: Salt and roll chicken in flour.
Put melted butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place chicken in pan and cover with milk.
Bake until tender, turning so that it browns on both sides.
You'll find this is a change and delicious.
Makes its own gravy.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Chicken. Salt and roll chicken in flour. Put melted butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken in pan and cover with milk. Bake until tender, turning so that it browns on both sides. You'll find this is a change and delicious. Makes its own gravy. Bake at 400u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli Corn Bake
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. broccoli, cooked and drained
directions: Mix corn, broccoli, 1/2 cup crackers, 2 tablespoons butter, egg, onion, salt and pepper.
Turn into 1-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with a mixture of remaining crackers and butter.
Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Corn Bake. Mix corn, broccoli, 1/2 cup crackers, 2 tablespoons butter, egg, onion, salt and pepper. Turn into 1-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with a mixture of remaining crackers and butter. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: American Chow Mein
ingredients: 1 can mushroom soup or 1 can cream of chicken soup
directions: Boil, bone and dice the chicken.
Add all of the ingredients and mix well.
Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: American Chow Mein. Boil, bone and dice the chicken. Add all of the ingredients and mix well. Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Heath Candy Bars
directions: Line a large cookie sheet with foil, well buttered.
Place crackers on foil.
Bring margarine and sugar to a boil.
Boil 3 minutes.
Pour over crackers.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 7 minutes.
Remove from oven; sprinkle with chips.
Spread evenly when melted. Sprinkle with nuts.
Cut or break apart when cool.
recipes.text: Heath Candy Bars. Line a large cookie sheet with foil, well buttered. Place crackers on foil. Bring margarine and sugar to a boil. Boil 3 minutes. Pour over crackers. Bake at 375u00b0 for 7 minutes. Remove from oven; sprinkle with chips. Spread evenly when melted. Sprinkle with nuts. Cut or break apart when cool.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift together flour and sugar.
Cut in shortening.
Mix yeast with warm water until dissolved.
Add buttermilk to yeast.
Add mixture to flour.
Mix lightly until moistened.
Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake at 450u00b0 for about 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Sift together flour and sugar. Cut in shortening. Mix yeast with warm water until dissolved. Add buttermilk to yeast. Add mixture to flour. Mix lightly until moistened. Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with biscuit cutter. Bake at 450u00b0 for about 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Oh, My Darling Sugar Cookies(Author: Janet Culver)
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Bake 12 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Oh, My Darling Sugar Cookies(Author: Janet Culver). Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Bake 12 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Spanish Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tsp. garlic salt or 1/2 tsp. garlic powder
directions: Place potatoes, onions and margarine in electric skillet. Saute or lightly brown, then add tomato and spices to taste. Add tomato sauce and water and simmer.
When potatoes are done, sprinkle grated cheese over top.
Cover until cheese is melted and serve.
recipes.text: Spanish Scalloped Potatoes. Place potatoes, onions and margarine in electric skillet. Saute or lightly brown, then add tomato and spices to taste. Add tomato sauce and water and simmer. When potatoes are done, sprinkle grated cheese over top. Cover until cheese is melted and serve.

recipes.title: Pasta Pronto
ingredients: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
directions: Place tomatoes, oil and garlic in frying pan.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Heat on medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add basil and white wine to pan; heat 3 more minutes.
Cook pasta according to directions and drain well.
Stir sauce in pan and pour over penne.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Pasta Pronto. Place tomatoes, oil and garlic in frying pan. Add salt and pepper to taste. Heat on medium heat for 5 minutes. Add basil and white wine to pan; heat 3 more minutes. Cook pasta according to directions and drain well. Stir sauce in pan and pour over penne. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Orange Salad Supreme
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple, reserve juice
directions: Mix jello with the hot water and cold water.
Add drained, crushed pineapple.
Pour in 10 x 13 x 2-inch pan and jell in refrigerator.
Blend cream cheese and Cool Whip.
Spread over jelled layer.
Add enough water to reserved pineapple juice to make 1 cup.
Add lemon juice, sugar, flour and eggs.
Cook until thickened.
Cool.
Spread on top of Cool Whip mixture.
recipes.text: Orange Salad Supreme. Mix jello with the hot water and cold water. Add drained, crushed pineapple. Pour in 10 x 13 x 2-inch pan and jell in refrigerator. Blend cream cheese and Cool Whip. Spread over jelled layer. Add enough water to reserved pineapple juice to make 1 cup. Add lemon juice, sugar, flour and eggs. Cook until thickened. Cool. Spread on top of Cool Whip mixture.

recipes.title: Beginner'S Punch
ingredients: 1 (2-liter) bottle Mello Yellow or Mountain Dew
directions: Mix and chill before serving.
recipes.text: Beginner'S Punch. Mix and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies
ingredients: 2 lb. carrots, scrape, slice thin, cook, drain and cool
directions: Bring soup and other ingredients to a boil.
Pour over carrots and other vegetables.
This will keep for several weeks, if stored covered in the refrigerator.
Can be reheated or served cold.
recipes.text: Copper Pennies. Bring soup and other ingredients to a boil. Pour over carrots and other vegetables. This will keep for several weeks, if stored covered in the refrigerator. Can be reheated or served cold.

recipes.title: Padua Bean Casserole
directions: Brown meat.
Add chili powder, garlic salt and onion.
Blend together refried beans and enchilada sauce.
Add to meat mixture. Add corn chips.
Place in casserole and top with extra corn chips and Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly.
recipes.text: Padua Bean Casserole. Brown meat. Add chili powder, garlic salt and onion. Blend together refried beans and enchilada sauce. Add to meat mixture. Add corn chips. Place in casserole and top with extra corn chips and Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 until bubbly.

recipes.title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add vanilla and extracts.
Beat egg yolks.
Sift flour and baking powder.
Add into the mixture.
Beat egg whites and mix into batter.
Add 1/3 cup brandy.
Bake at 275u00b0 for 2 hours.
Temperature can be raised to 300u00b0.
Makes 4 loaves.
recipes.text: White Fruit Cake. Cream butter and sugar; add vanilla and extracts. Beat egg yolks. Sift flour and baking powder. Add into the mixture. Beat egg whites and mix into batter. Add 1/3 cup brandy. Bake at 275u00b0 for 2 hours. Temperature can be raised to 300u00b0. Makes 4 loaves.

recipes.title: Potato Chowder
ingredients: 1/4 lb. bacon, cut in small pieces
1 red bell pepper, diced, or 1/2 lb. tomatoes
directions: In pan over medium heat, brown bacon; pour off fat.
Add white and green parts of onions (reserve 1/2 cup of dark tops).
Cook and stir 1 minute.
Add broth and potatoes.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Add carrots; cook 5 minutes more.
Add bell pepper, zucchini, corn and thyme; cook until tender.
Add turkey or chicken and reserved onion tops.
Mix milk with cornstarch; add to pot.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Potato Chowder. In pan over medium heat, brown bacon; pour off fat. Add white and green parts of onions (reserve 1/2 cup of dark tops). Cook and stir 1 minute. Add broth and potatoes. Cover and cook for 15 minutes. Add carrots; cook 5 minutes more. Add bell pepper, zucchini, corn and thyme; cook until tender. Add turkey or chicken and reserved onion tops. Mix milk with cornstarch; add to pot. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bon Bons
ingredients: 6 squares chocolate or white chocolate candy coating, melted
directions: In a large bowl, beat peanut butter, margarine, vanilla and salt until fluffy. Gradually beat in Eagle Brand milk and then sugar until smooth. Shape into 1 inch balls and place on a baking sheet.
Chill until firm.
Dip bon bons in melted chocolate using a toothpick.
Place on baking sheets lined with wax paper and chill until firm.
Store in refrigerator or room temperature. Makes 1 1/2 doz.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bon Bons. In a large bowl, beat peanut butter, margarine, vanilla and salt until fluffy. Gradually beat in Eagle Brand milk and then sugar until smooth. Shape into 1 inch balls and place on a baking sheet. Chill until firm. Dip bon bons in melted chocolate using a toothpick. Place on baking sheets lined with wax paper and chill until firm. Store in refrigerator or room temperature. Makes 1 1/2 doz.

recipes.title: Three Bean Relish Salad
directions: In a medium bowl, beat together oil, vinegar, onion, garlic and spices, using a fork.
Add beans and pimentos.
Mix carefully. Cover and chill until serving time.
recipes.text: Three Bean Relish Salad. In a medium bowl, beat together oil, vinegar, onion, garlic and spices, using a fork. Add beans and pimentos. Mix carefully. Cover and chill until serving time.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
directions: Cube and dredge with seasoned flour the beef chuck.
Brown in deep well cooker, using "high" speed in the fat.
Add water.
Cover cooker.
When boiling, turn switch to "low."
After 1 1/2 hours, add all other ingredients.
Turn switch to "high" until steaming, then speed 6 until vegetables are tender.
Remove vegetables and meat from stock.
Mix 1/4 cup flour with 1/2 cup cold water and thicken stock.
Combine.
Time:
2 hours.
Yield:
6 servings.
