recipes.text: Beef Stew. Cube and dredge with seasoned flour the beef chuck. Brown in deep well cooker, using "high" speed in the fat. Add water. Cover cooker. When boiling, turn switch to "low." After 1 1/2 hours, add all other ingredients. Turn switch to "high" until steaming, then speed 6 until vegetables are tender. Remove vegetables and meat from stock. Mix 1/4 cup flour with 1/2 cup cold water and thicken stock. Combine. Time: 2 hours. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Boston Cream Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour 2 round cake pans.
Melt butter.
Add remaining ingredients into bowl.
Now, add butter and mix with mixer on medium speed until smooth.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool before adding filling.
recipes.text: Boston Cream Cake. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour 2 round cake pans. Melt butter. Add remaining ingredients into bowl. Now, add butter and mix with mixer on medium speed until smooth. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool before adding filling.

recipes.title: Fried Corn
ingredients: sugar, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Over a big bowl, cut the kernels off the ears of corn.
Gently scrape the knife against the cobs to get the milky liquid to drip into bowl.
Melt butter and bacon grease over medium heat in large skillet (cast-iron is best).
Stir in corn.
Simmer 8 to 10 minutes until tender.
Stir frequently.
If corn seems to be drying out, add a bit of hot water to keep it moist.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Fried Corn. Over a big bowl, cut the kernels off the ears of corn. Gently scrape the knife against the cobs to get the milky liquid to drip into bowl. Melt butter and bacon grease over medium heat in large skillet (cast-iron is best). Stir in corn. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes until tender. Stir frequently. If corn seems to be drying out, add a bit of hot water to keep it moist. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Layered Vegetable And Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. Green Giant frozen sweet peas (16 oz. pkg.), thawed and drained
8 oz. fresh or frozen shrimp, thawed and drained
2 slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled
directions: In 8-inch square (1 1/2-quart) baking dish or medium bowl, layer lettuce and onion.
In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream and sugar; blend well.
Spoon half of mixture evenly over onion.
Layer celery, bell pepper, peas and shrimp over mayonnaise mixture.
Spread remaining mayonnaise mixture over top; sprinkle with cheese and bacon.
Cover; refrigerate at least 8 hours.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Layered Vegetable And Shrimp Salad. In 8-inch square (1 1/2-quart) baking dish or medium bowl, layer lettuce and onion. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream and sugar; blend well. Spoon half of mixture evenly over onion. Layer celery, bell pepper, peas and shrimp over mayonnaise mixture. Spread remaining mayonnaise mixture over top; sprinkle with cheese and bacon. Cover; refrigerate at least 8 hours. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chewy Oat Snack Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan.
On low heat, stir milk, chocolate chips and 3 tablespoons margarine until melted.
Stir in 1 cup nuts and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Set aside; keep warm.
recipes.text: Chewy Oat Snack Bars. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan. On low heat, stir milk, chocolate chips and 3 tablespoons margarine until melted. Stir in 1 cup nuts and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Set aside; keep warm.

recipes.title: Raspberry And Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
directions: Spray bottom and sides of a 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan with nonstick cooking spray.
In a large bowl, combine flour and 1/2 cup sugar.
Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Measure and set aside 1 cup of these crumbs.
To remaining crumb mixture, add baking powder, baking soda, salt, sour cream, 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla, almond extract and 2 egg whites; blend well. Spread batter over bottom and up sides of pan.
Batter should be about 1/4-inch thick on sides.
recipes.text: Raspberry And Cream Cheese Coffee Cake. Spray bottom and sides of a 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan with nonstick cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine flour and 1/2 cup sugar. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Measure and set aside 1 cup of these crumbs. To remaining crumb mixture, add baking powder, baking soda, salt, sour cream, 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla, almond extract and 2 egg whites; blend well. Spread batter over bottom and up sides of pan. Batter should be about 1/4-inch thick on sides.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta; drain.
Steam vegetables until crunchy.
Saute slightly broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, green beans and mushrooms.
Mix zucchini, black olives and red onion with creamy Italian dressing.
Salt to taste.
Let set overnight.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta; drain. Steam vegetables until crunchy. Saute slightly broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, green beans and mushrooms. Mix zucchini, black olives and red onion with creamy Italian dressing. Salt to taste. Let set overnight.

recipes.title: Chocolate Caramel Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on box.
Punch holes in cake and pour syrup and milk into holes.
Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Chocolate Caramel Cake. Bake cake according to directions on box. Punch holes in cake and pour syrup and milk into holes. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate.
Keeps several days.
recipes.text: Cherry Salad. Drain pineapple and mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate. Keeps several days.

recipes.title: Chocolate Filled Cupcakes
directions: Cream the first 5 ingredients and add chocolate chips. Mix remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Batter will be thin.
Fill cupcakes 1/2 full.
Fill with a teaspoon of cream cheese mixture. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chocolate Filled Cupcakes. Cream the first 5 ingredients and add chocolate chips. Mix remaining ingredients. Mix well. Batter will be thin. Fill cupcakes 1/2 full. Fill with a teaspoon of cream cheese mixture. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Six Layer Lettuce Salad
directions: Layer in 8 x 10 pan: 1. Lettuce broken into bite size pieces. 2. Onions (diced). 3. Frozen peas. 4. Spread on mayonnaise mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar. 5. Sprinkle on cheese and Farmland bacon which has been crumbled. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Six Layer Lettuce Salad. Layer in 8 x 10 pan: 1. Lettuce broken into bite size pieces. 2. Onions (diced). 3. Frozen peas. 4. Spread on mayonnaise mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar. 5. Sprinkle on cheese and Farmland bacon which has been crumbled. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Appetizer For Summer Picnic
directions: Dice vegetables.
Blend remaining ingredients.
Add 2 slices cubed bread (no crust).
Let stand overnight.
Serve in small cups to drink.
recipes.text: Appetizer For Summer Picnic. Dice vegetables. Blend remaining ingredients. Add 2 slices cubed bread (no crust). Let stand overnight. Serve in small cups to drink.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix dry ingredients and cut in butter until very fine.
Stir in yeast mixture and enough buttermilk to make a soft dough.
Turn out on a floured board and knead a few times for a smooth dough.
Roll dough 1/2-inch thick and use cutter of your choice.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Cook in preheated oven at 400u00b0 for about 15 minutes.
Makes about 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix dry ingredients and cut in butter until very fine. Stir in yeast mixture and enough buttermilk to make a soft dough. Turn out on a floured board and knead a few times for a smooth dough. Roll dough 1/2-inch thick and use cutter of your choice. Place on greased cookie sheet. Cook in preheated oven at 400u00b0 for about 15 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Roll out with rolling pin.
Cut into desired shapes.
Batter may be colored, if desired.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Mix ingredients together. Roll out with rolling pin. Cut into desired shapes. Batter may be colored, if desired. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Calzone
ingredients: 2 c. shredded Mozzarella and Cheddar cheese blend
directions: Heat oven to 375u00b0. Lightly grease 12-inch pizza pan. Unroll 1 can of dough and place in greased pan. Starting at center, press out dough with hands to edge of pan. Spread a single layer of pepperoni over dough and then sprinkle shredded cheese over pepperoni. Unroll remaining can of dough and press out dough on work surface to form 12-inch round. Fold dough in half and place over cheese. Unfold. Press outside edges to seal. Cut several slits in top crust. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crust is deep golden brown. Cut pizza calzone into wedges and serve with a side of warm pizza sauce for dipping.
recipes.text: Pepperoni Calzone. Heat oven to 375u00b0. Lightly grease 12-inch pizza pan. Unroll 1 can of dough and place in greased pan. Starting at center, press out dough with hands to edge of pan. Spread a single layer of pepperoni over dough and then sprinkle shredded cheese over pepperoni. Unroll remaining can of dough and press out dough on work surface to form 12-inch round. Fold dough in half and place over cheese. Unfold. Press outside edges to seal. Cut several slits in top crust. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes or until crust is deep golden brown. Cut pizza calzone into wedges and serve with a side of warm pizza sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Sausage Spaghetti Spirals
directions: Cook sausage & green pepper over medium heat until meat is no longer pink. Drain. Stir in pasta & spaghetti sauce. Mix well. Transfer to a greased 13 X 9 X 2 baking dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5-10 minutes longer until cheese is melted. Serves 10.
recipes.text: Sausage Spaghetti Spirals. Cook sausage & green pepper over medium heat until meat is no longer pink. Drain. Stir in pasta & spaghetti sauce. Mix well. Transfer to a greased 13 X 9 X 2 baking dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5-10 minutes longer until cheese is melted. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Holiday Potatoes(10 To 12 Servings)
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup
directions: Preheat the oven to 350u00b0.
In a large bowl, mix together the potatoes, 1 cup of the Cheddar cheese, the soups, onion, sour cream and melted butter.
Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
recipes.text: Holiday Potatoes(10 To 12 Servings). Preheat the oven to 350u00b0. In a large bowl, mix together the potatoes, 1 cup of the Cheddar cheese, the soups, onion, sour cream and melted butter. Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.

recipes.title: Microwave Banana Pudding
directions: Mix well the flour and water. Add egg yolks, sugar and milk. Microwave approximately 9 minutes (or until thick) on High. Remove and add butter and vanilla. Layer bottom of dish with vanilla wafers, layer of sliced bananas, 1/2 pudding, another layer of bananas and remainder of pudding. Top with vanilla wafers.
recipes.text: Microwave Banana Pudding. Mix well the flour and water. Add egg yolks, sugar and milk. Microwave approximately 9 minutes (or until thick) on High. Remove and add butter and vanilla. Layer bottom of dish with vanilla wafers, layer of sliced bananas, 1/2 pudding, another layer of bananas and remainder of pudding. Top with vanilla wafers.

recipes.title: Chili Burritos
directions: Heat chili on medium until it bubbles.
Fill tortilla with chili and cheese.
Fold ends of tortilla up about 1 1/2 inches and roll into a burrito.
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, onions, cheese, sour cream and salsa.
Serve with a fork!!!
recipes.text: Chili Burritos. Heat chili on medium until it bubbles. Fill tortilla with chili and cheese. Fold ends of tortilla up about 1 1/2 inches and roll into a burrito. Top with lettuce, tomatoes, onions, cheese, sour cream and salsa. Serve with a fork!!!

recipes.title: Bette'S Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix everything together except for sour cream.
Pour 1/2 of mixture in large pyrex dish and let chill.
Spread sour cream over layer.
Pour remainder of mixture on top. Chill.
recipes.text: Bette'S Strawberry Salad. Mix everything together except for sour cream. Pour 1/2 of mixture in large pyrex dish and let chill. Spread sour cream over layer. Pour remainder of mixture on top. Chill.

recipes.title: Hardee'S Biscuits
directions: Sift flour, soda, baking powder and sugar.
Cut in shortening and add buttermilk; roll out biscuits and place on baking sheet. Bake in hot oven at 450u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.
This recipe will serve 7 people.
recipes.text: Hardee'S Biscuits. Sift flour, soda, baking powder and sugar. Cut in shortening and add buttermilk; roll out biscuits and place on baking sheet. Bake in hot oven at 450u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown. This recipe will serve 7 people.

recipes.title: Chews
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and flour.
Beat well.
Bake in ungreased pan, 8 x 13-inch, at 300u00b0 for 45 minutes. These will rise and then "fall".
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Chews. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and flour. Beat well. Bake in ungreased pan, 8 x 13-inch, at 300u00b0 for 45 minutes. These will rise and then "fall". Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Reuben Sandwiches For 2
directions: Butter bread on opposite side.
Spoon on Thousand Island dressing; place Swiss cheese, sauerkraut and corned beef on bread. Sandwich and grill on top of stove in a skillet.
recipes.text: Reuben Sandwiches For 2. Butter bread on opposite side. Spoon on Thousand Island dressing; place Swiss cheese, sauerkraut and corned beef on bread. Sandwich and grill on top of stove in a skillet.

recipes.title: Layered Lettuce Salad
directions: In 9 x 13-inch pan layer the veggies.
Cover with mayonnaise with sugar mixed in.
Cover completely, especially edges. Sprinkle finely grated cheese on top.
recipes.text: Layered Lettuce Salad. In 9 x 13-inch pan layer the veggies. Cover with mayonnaise with sugar mixed in. Cover completely, especially edges. Sprinkle finely grated cheese on top.

recipes.title: Company Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can sliced French-style green beans
1 can condensed cream of celery soup (undiluted)
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Combine corn, green beans, soup, cheese, sour cream, celery, onion and green pepper in greased 2-quart casserole.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Blend cracker crumbs and butter; sprinkle over casserole.
Bake an additional 10 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Company Vegetable Casserole. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Combine corn, green beans, soup, cheese, sour cream, celery, onion and green pepper in greased 2-quart casserole. Bake for 30 minutes. Blend cracker crumbs and butter; sprinkle over casserole. Bake an additional 10 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
ingredients: 3 c. cooked and mashed sweet potatoes
directions: Combine
all ingredients, except pie crusts, in a large mixing bowl.
Beat
with
an
electric
mixer until smooth and creamy. Pour in pie crusts and bake at 375u00b0 for 70 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie. Combine all ingredients, except pie crusts, in a large mixing bowl. Beat with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Pour in pie crusts and bake at 375u00b0 for 70 minutes.

recipes.title: No Peek Stew
ingredients: 1 soup can water or 1 soup can Burgundy wine
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Place in crock-pot.
Cook on low for 8 hours.
Serve over hot noodles or bake in casserole for 2 to 3 hours at 350u00b0 to 375u00b0.
Do not lift lid.
recipes.text: No Peek Stew. Mix ingredients together. Place in crock-pot. Cook on low for 8 hours. Serve over hot noodles or bake in casserole for 2 to 3 hours at 350u00b0 to 375u00b0. Do not lift lid.

recipes.title: Lemon Batter Fish
directions: In
medium
bowl, mix flour, water, 1/3 cup lemon juice, egg, baking powder, salt and sugar to make batter.
Dip fish in extra lemon juice; coat with flour then the batter.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Lemon Batter Fish. In medium bowl, mix flour, water, 1/3 cup lemon juice, egg, baking powder, salt and sugar to make batter. Dip fish in extra lemon juice; coat with flour then the batter. Fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pineapple Macadamia Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple tidbits, drained or 1 lb. candied pineapple
directions: Cook over medium heat. Spoon over cooled cake.
recipes.text: Pineapple Macadamia Cake. Cook over medium heat. Spoon over cooled cake.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
ingredients: chicken breast or cut up fryer
seasoned salt and pepper to taste
directions: Salt and pepper chicken.
Dip in melted margarine; coat chicken with flour.
Put in baking pan lined with foil.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour, or until done.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Chicken. Salt and pepper chicken. Dip in melted margarine; coat chicken with flour. Put in baking pan lined with foil. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour, or until done.

recipes.title: Russian Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
In a deep glass casserole, layer potatoes, butter, onions, "globs" of sour cream, salt, pepper, potatoes, onions etc.
For the top, seal the whole area with a heavy layer of sour cream, making sure there are no cracks in the sour cream.
Bake in the oven for 30 to 45 minutes until everything is "bubbling" and the edges of the top layer become slightly brown.
Sprinkle top with paprika and serve hot.
recipes.text: Russian Potatoes. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. In a deep glass casserole, layer potatoes, butter, onions, "globs" of sour cream, salt, pepper, potatoes, onions etc. For the top, seal the whole area with a heavy layer of sour cream, making sure there are no cracks in the sour cream. Bake in the oven for 30 to 45 minutes until everything is "bubbling" and the edges of the top layer become slightly brown. Sprinkle top with paprika and serve hot.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Raisin Bread
directions: Combine milk and 1/4 cup butter, stirring until butter melts. Cool mixture to 105u00b0 to 115u00b0.
Combine 2 cups flour, 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon sugar, salt and yeast.
Gradually add milk mixture to dry ingredients, mixing at low speed of electric mixer.
Beat 2 minutes on medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally.
Add 3/4 cup flour; beat at medium-high speed 2 minutes.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough (2 1/2 to 3 cups); stir in raisins.
Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic (about 7 minutes).
recipes.text: Cinnamon Raisin Bread. Combine milk and 1/4 cup butter, stirring until butter melts. Cool mixture to 105u00b0 to 115u00b0. Combine 2 cups flour, 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon sugar, salt and yeast. Gradually add milk mixture to dry ingredients, mixing at low speed of electric mixer. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally. Add 3/4 cup flour; beat at medium-high speed 2 minutes. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough (2 1/2 to 3 cups); stir in raisins. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic (about 7 minutes).

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown the ground beef and drain.
Add beans, ketchup, chili powder, oregano, salt and pepper.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Brown the ground beef and drain. Add beans, ketchup, chili powder, oregano, salt and pepper. Set aside.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding according to package directions.
Add Eagle Brand milk, sour cream and Cool Whip.
Prepare banana pudding as usual.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Mix pudding according to package directions. Add Eagle Brand milk, sour cream and Cool Whip. Prepare banana pudding as usual.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
ingredients: 2 c. flour or enough to handle
directions: Roll into small balls and bake in hot oven (400u00b0 to 425u00b0) for about 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Gingersnaps. Roll into small balls and bake in hot oven (400u00b0 to 425u00b0) for about 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Mem'S Pea Soup
directions: Soak peas overnight in cold water.
Next morning, drain and put peas in a large pan.
Add ham bone, diced onion and carrot.
Cover ingredients with water and add salt, pepper and hominy (drain and rinse hominy before adding to soup).
Bring to a boil and reduce heat to simmer until peas and carrot are cooked.
While soup is cooking, be sure that your ingredients are just covered with water. Usually takes about 1 1/2 hours.
About 15 minutes before soup is done, add the rice.
recipes.text: Mem'S Pea Soup. Soak peas overnight in cold water. Next morning, drain and put peas in a large pan. Add ham bone, diced onion and carrot. Cover ingredients with water and add salt, pepper and hominy (drain and rinse hominy before adding to soup). Bring to a boil and reduce heat to simmer until peas and carrot are cooked. While soup is cooking, be sure that your ingredients are just covered with water. Usually takes about 1 1/2 hours. About 15 minutes before soup is done, add the rice.

recipes.title: Dropped Tea Cakes
directions: Cream butter and sugar, beating well at medium speed of electric mixer; add eggs, beating well.
Combine flour, baking powder, soda and nutmeg.
Add to mixture alternating with buttermilk, mixing well.
Stir in vanilla.
Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly brown.
Remove to racks to cool.
recipes.text: Dropped Tea Cakes. Cream butter and sugar, beating well at medium speed of electric mixer; add eggs, beating well. Combine flour, baking powder, soda and nutmeg. Add to mixture alternating with buttermilk, mixing well. Stir in vanilla. Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly brown. Remove to racks to cool.

recipes.title: Fruit Turnovers
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Mix baking mix, sugar, margarine and milk until a soft dough forms.
Form dough into balls with hands. Lightly flour cutting board.
Knead dough 8 to 10 times.
Divide dough in half.
Flatten dough with palm of hand.
Roll into a rectangle, 12 x 8-inch.
Cut into six 4-inch squares.
Place squares on ungreased cookie sheet.
Place 1 tablespoon pie filling in corner of each square.
Fold opposite corner over.
Press edges with floured fork to seal.
Prick tops.
Repeat with remaining half of dough.
Bake until brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
Heat remaining filling.
Spoon over warm turnovers or sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Turnovers may also be made by rolling each half of the dough in a circle.
Use a small dessert bowl as an outline for the turnovers.
recipes.text: Fruit Turnovers. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Mix baking mix, sugar, margarine and milk until a soft dough forms. Form dough into balls with hands. Lightly flour cutting board. Knead dough 8 to 10 times. Divide dough in half. Flatten dough with palm of hand. Roll into a rectangle, 12 x 8-inch. Cut into six 4-inch squares. Place squares on ungreased cookie sheet. Place 1 tablespoon pie filling in corner of each square. Fold opposite corner over. Press edges with floured fork to seal. Prick tops. Repeat with remaining half of dough. Bake until brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Heat remaining filling. Spoon over warm turnovers or sprinkle with powdered sugar. Turnovers may also be made by rolling each half of the dough in a circle. Use a small dessert bowl as an outline for the turnovers.

recipes.title: Christmas Salad
directions: Dissolve lime jello in 1 cup water.
Place in top double boiler and add cut up marshmallows.
Stir until marshmallows are almost dissolved.
Then add pineapple after this is removed from heat.
Blend cream cheese and add to mixture.
Store in refrigerator until cool.
When cold, fold in whipped cream.
Pour into pan and let stand until firm.
Dissolve cherry jello in 2 cups water.
Cool, but do not allow to jell.
Pour over other mixture and let set.
recipes.text: Christmas Salad. Dissolve lime jello in 1 cup water. Place in top double boiler and add cut up marshmallows. Stir until marshmallows are almost dissolved. Then add pineapple after this is removed from heat. Blend cream cheese and add to mixture. Store in refrigerator until cool. When cold, fold in whipped cream. Pour into pan and let stand until firm. Dissolve cherry jello in 2 cups water. Cool, but do not allow to jell. Pour over other mixture and let set.

recipes.title: Kahlua
directions: Simmer uncovered for 2 hours.
Cool completely.
Add 2 teaspoons vanilla
and 2 cups vodka.
Store in sealed bottles.
recipes.text: Kahlua. Simmer uncovered for 2 hours. Cool completely. Add 2 teaspoons vanilla and 2 cups vodka. Store in sealed bottles.

recipes.title: Greek Salad(Salata)
directions: Toss lightly.
Garnish with Feta cheese and olives.
recipes.text: Greek Salad(Salata). Toss lightly. Garnish with Feta cheese and olives.

recipes.title: Leg Of Lamb
directions: Make slit in the leg of lamb and put garlic pieces inside. Season outside of lamb with salt, pepper and paprika.
In bottom of pan, put sliced onions and mixture of water and tomato juice. Cook 3 1/2 hours in 325u00b0 oven.
After first 1 1/2 hours, mix brown sugar and ketchup together and spread over meat; do not baste, sauce will form gravy.
recipes.text: Leg Of Lamb. Make slit in the leg of lamb and put garlic pieces inside. Season outside of lamb with salt, pepper and paprika. In bottom of pan, put sliced onions and mixture of water and tomato juice. Cook 3 1/2 hours in 325u00b0 oven. After first 1 1/2 hours, mix brown sugar and ketchup together and spread over meat; do not baste, sauce will form gravy.

recipes.title: Classic Cheese Cake
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, 1/3 cup sugar and melted margarine. Press into bottom and up the sides of a spring-form pan.
recipes.text: Classic Cheese Cake. Mix graham cracker crumbs, 1/3 cup sugar and melted margarine. Press into bottom and up the sides of a spring-form pan.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Dressing
directions: Cook box of dressing.
Spread dressing in 9-inch square size pan.
Cook broccoli and lay on top.
Mix soup with milk.
Pour on top.
Slice Cheddar cheese on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 about 1 hour or until cheese starts to turn brown.
You can make a larger size pan, just use more of everything.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese Dressing. Cook box of dressing. Spread dressing in 9-inch square size pan. Cook broccoli and lay on top. Mix soup with milk. Pour on top. Slice Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350u00b0 about 1 hour or until cheese starts to turn brown. You can make a larger size pan, just use more of everything.

recipes.title: German Pancake
directions: Preheat oven to 425u00b0, then melt butter in a 10-inch skillet in oven.
Mix flour, milk and eggs with electric beater for 45 seconds.
Pour into skillet.
Put back in oven and bake.
Take out when done and sprinkle with powdered sugar and lemon juice.
Cut into sections, then spread with jelly, if desired.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425u00b0.
recipes.text: German Pancake. Preheat oven to 425u00b0, then melt butter in a 10-inch skillet in oven. Mix flour, milk and eggs with electric beater for 45 seconds. Pour into skillet. Put back in oven and bake. Take out when done and sprinkle with powdered sugar and lemon juice. Cut into sections, then spread with jelly, if desired. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425u00b0.

recipes.title: Donna'S Sweet Potato Balls
directions: Cream together, then roll around marshmallows (large ones). Then roll in coconut. Place on baking sheet and bake in a 375u00b0 oven until marshmallows swell.
recipes.text: Donna'S Sweet Potato Balls. Cream together, then roll around marshmallows (large ones). Then roll in coconut. Place on baking sheet and bake in a 375u00b0 oven until marshmallows swell.

recipes.title: 14 Day Pickles
directions: First Day:
Wash cucumbers and pack tightly in gallon jar. Cover with boiling water to which salt has been added.
Let stand for 24 hours.
recipes.text: 14 Day Pickles. First Day: Wash cucumbers and pack tightly in gallon jar. Cover with boiling water to which salt has been added. Let stand for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill overnight and serve.
recipes.text: Three Bean Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Chill overnight and serve.

recipes.title: Meatballs 'N Rice
directions: Shape ground beef into meatballs.
Brown in melted butter in skillet. Add salt, spaghetti sauce and water. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Move meatballs to the side of the skillet. Bring liquid to a boil and stir in rice. Cover and remove from heat. Allow to stand 5 minutes. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Meatballs 'N Rice. Shape ground beef into meatballs. Brown in melted butter in skillet. Add salt, spaghetti sauce and water. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Move meatballs to the side of the skillet. Bring liquid to a boil and stir in rice. Cover and remove from heat. Allow to stand 5 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, salt and Crisco together until smooth.
Add milk that has been mixed with the vinegar.
Knead together and separate into 4 balls.
Roll out each ball for 1 crust.
Fill with favorite fruit filling.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes, 375u00b0 for 50 minutes.
Makes four crusts.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Mix flour, salt and Crisco together until smooth. Add milk that has been mixed with the vinegar. Knead together and separate into 4 balls. Roll out each ball for 1 crust. Fill with favorite fruit filling. Bake at 400u00b0 for 10 minutes, 375u00b0 for 50 minutes. Makes four crusts.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels
directions: Preheat oven to 425u00b0.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add salt and sugar.
Line cookie sheet with foil (shiny side up).
Blend in flour.
Sprinkle flour on counter and knead dough.
Cut into small pieces and roll into an 18-inch rope.
Shape into pretzels and place on cookie sheet.
Brush with egg and sprinkle with salt. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Soft Pretzels. Preheat oven to 425u00b0. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add salt and sugar. Line cookie sheet with foil (shiny side up). Blend in flour. Sprinkle flour on counter and knead dough. Cut into small pieces and roll into an 18-inch rope. Shape into pretzels and place on cookie sheet. Brush with egg and sprinkle with salt. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Quaker Oats Meat Loaf
directions: Basically combine all ingredients until well mixed.
(An electric mixer is very useful.)
Form into either a loaf pan or other pan.
Bake at 350u00b0F for about an hour.
recipes.text: Quaker Oats Meat Loaf. Basically combine all ingredients until well mixed. (An electric mixer is very useful.) Form into either a loaf pan or other pan. Bake at 350u00b0F for about an hour.

recipes.title: Martha Washington Candy
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together.
Cool in refrigerator before rolling into small balls.
Dip in chocolate.
recipes.text: Martha Washington Candy. Mix first 5 ingredients together. Cool in refrigerator before rolling into small balls. Dip in chocolate.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
directions: Preheat oven to 375u00b0.
Grease an 8-inch square baking dish; set aside.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, in large bowl, combine soup, milk, Parmesan and pepper. Stir in chicken and spinach.
Drain spaghetti; place in bottom of baking dish.
Pour chicken mixture over top of spaghetti; stir until well combined.
Bake, covered for 50 to 60 minutes, until bubbly.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken Tetrazzini. Preheat oven to 375u00b0. Grease an 8-inch square baking dish; set aside. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, in large bowl, combine soup, milk, Parmesan and pepper. Stir in chicken and spinach. Drain spaghetti; place in bottom of baking dish. Pour chicken mixture over top of spaghetti; stir until well combined. Bake, covered for 50 to 60 minutes, until bubbly. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Lazy Person Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can pie filling (cherry or strawberry)
directions: Spread pineapple (undrained) in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread pie filling on top of pineapple.
Spread dry cake mix on top of pie filling.
Top with nuts.
Slice margarine in thin slices and put on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes until brown.
recipes.text: Lazy Person Cake. Spread pineapple (undrained) in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread pie filling on top of pineapple. Spread dry cake mix on top of pie filling. Top with nuts. Slice margarine in thin slices and put on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 to 55 minutes until brown.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain. Add 1/2 stick margarine and cubed cheese. Mix lightly.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Melt 1/2 stick margarine and add crumbled crackers.
Pour over top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli and drain. Add 1/2 stick margarine and cubed cheese. Mix lightly. Pour into greased casserole dish. Melt 1/2 stick margarine and add crumbled crackers. Pour over top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili
ingredients: 1/2 lb. raw ground turkey meat, thawed if frozen
1 Tbsp. chili powder or to taste
1/2 can (20 oz.) kidney beans (1 c. approximately)
directions: Saute the onion and garlic in the oil in a medium-size saucepan until tender, about 2 minutes.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring, until all signs of pink have disappeared and meat starts to brown slightly.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, chili powder, flour, cumin, ginger, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Stir in the beans and reheat.
recipes.text: Turkey Chili. Saute the onion and garlic in the oil in a medium-size saucepan until tender, about 2 minutes. Add the turkey and cook, stirring, until all signs of pink have disappeared and meat starts to brown slightly. Add the tomatoes with their juice, chili powder, flour, cumin, ginger, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Stir in the beans and reheat.

recipes.title: Apricot Nectar Cake
directions: Beat eggs.
Add oil, apricot nectar and lemon Jell-O.
Add cake mix; beat until smooth.
Pour into tube or Bundt pan; bake for 50 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Apricot Nectar Cake. Beat eggs. Add oil, apricot nectar and lemon Jell-O. Add cake mix; beat until smooth. Pour into tube or Bundt pan; bake for 50 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Boil sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa for 3 minutes.
After boiling, add salt, oatmeal and nuts.
Stir.
Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.
Allow time for cookies to harden.
recipes.text: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies. Boil sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa for 3 minutes. After boiling, add salt, oatmeal and nuts. Stir. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Allow time for cookies to harden.

recipes.title: Artichoke Chicken With Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 3 whole chicken breasts, split and skinned
1 (14 oz.) can artichokes, drained and halved
directions: Brown chicken in hot vegetable oil in large skillet.
Add carrots. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms, artichokes, scallions, water chestnuts, thyme and pepper.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Artichoke Chicken With Water Chestnuts. Brown chicken in hot vegetable oil in large skillet. Add carrots. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add mushrooms, artichokes, scallions, water chestnuts, thyme and pepper. Cover and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Liver Pate
directions: Chop celery and onions.
Saute liver, celery, onions, and margarine.
Take out with slotted spoon.
Add eggs and chop until smooth, can use blender to get smooth.
recipes.text: Liver Pate. Chop celery and onions. Saute liver, celery, onions, and margarine. Take out with slotted spoon. Add eggs and chop until smooth, can use blender to get smooth.

recipes.title: Crunchy Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Boil sugar, Karo syrup and water together very, very slowly until it reaches 300 degrees. Spread 4 cups Jiffy peanut butter in a large pan.
Pour syrup over peanut butter and stir with wooden spoons as fast as possible.
Work up into a ball - pull out until it looks like a rope and cut with scissors.
Work with half a ball at a time.
recipes.text: Crunchy Peanut Butter Candy. Boil sugar, Karo syrup and water together very, very slowly until it reaches 300 degrees. Spread 4 cups Jiffy peanut butter in a large pan. Pour syrup over peanut butter and stir with wooden spoons as fast as possible. Work up into a ball - pull out until it looks like a rope and cut with scissors. Work with half a ball at a time.

recipes.title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar together.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with buttermilk.
Add flavoring and coconut.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Pound Cake. Cream shortening and sugar together. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with buttermilk. Add flavoring and coconut. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes, cut up
2 Tbsp. basil or to taste (more for sweeter)
1 to 2 tsp. garlic or to taste
directions: Simmer onions in oil; brown some.
Pour in tomato paste and brown (7 to 8 minutes), stirring constantly.
Add rest of ingredients and simmer for 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Tomato Sauce. Simmer onions in oil; brown some. Pour in tomato paste and brown (7 to 8 minutes), stirring constantly. Add rest of ingredients and simmer for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
ingredients: 1/2 c. mild vinegar or 6 Tbsp. vinegar and 4 Tbsp. cream
directions: Cook and stir all ingredients except beets.
When thick and clear, add the beets.
Place pan over hot water for about 30 minutes.
Just before serving, heat again and add 2 tablespoons butter.
recipes.text: Harvard Beets. Cook and stir all ingredients except beets. When thick and clear, add the beets. Place pan over hot water for about 30 minutes. Just before serving, heat again and add 2 tablespoons butter.

recipes.title: Squash Salad
ingredients: 1 bottle Zesty Italian dressing or just Italian Wish-Bone dressing
directions: Mix all vegetables together.
Pour dressing over.
Mix well. Cheese may be added just before serving.
This will keep several days in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Squash Salad. Mix all vegetables together. Pour dressing over. Mix well. Cheese may be added just before serving. This will keep several days in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Potato Pancakes(From Germany)
ingredients: 8 small potatoes, peeled, shredded and grated
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pat into small patties.
Fry in hot oil on both sides until golden brown.
Serve with applesauce, bratwurst sausage and red cabbage for a German meal.
recipes.text: Potato Pancakes(From Germany). Mix all ingredients. Pat into small patties. Fry in hot oil on both sides until golden brown. Serve with applesauce, bratwurst sausage and red cabbage for a German meal.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
Cut in shortening; add milk and mix to a smooth dough.
Turn onto floured surface; divide into 6 portions.
Roll each portion large enough to cover 1 apple.
Place an apple on each piece of pastry.
Mix sugar and cinnamon together.
Spoon some of this mixture into each core cavity.
Moisten edges of pastry and bring up over the apple; seal edges.
Place on greased baking sheet or in shallow pan. Bake at 350u00b0 or until apples are tender and pastry is lightly browned.
Remove from baking sheet.
Serve warm with milk or cream.
recipes.text: Apple Dumplings. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together. Cut in shortening; add milk and mix to a smooth dough. Turn onto floured surface; divide into 6 portions. Roll each portion large enough to cover 1 apple. Place an apple on each piece of pastry. Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Spoon some of this mixture into each core cavity. Moisten edges of pastry and bring up over the apple; seal edges. Place on greased baking sheet or in shallow pan. Bake at 350u00b0 or until apples are tender and pastry is lightly browned. Remove from baking sheet. Serve warm with milk or cream.

recipes.title: Salted Peanut Chews
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury Plus yellow cake mix
directions: Mix ingredients together in a bowl.
Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake in oven at 350u00b0 for 12 to 18 minutes or until light brown.
recipes.text: Salted Peanut Chews. Mix ingredients together in a bowl. Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in oven at 350u00b0 for 12 to 18 minutes or until light brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Macaroni Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni; drain and combine all other ingredients.
Pour in baking dish.
Cover and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes, then top with buttered bread crumbs, seasoned with Lawry's garlic salt. Brown for about 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Macaroni Casserole. Cook macaroni; drain and combine all other ingredients. Pour in baking dish. Cover and bake in 350u00b0 oven for 20 minutes, then top with buttered bread crumbs, seasoned with Lawry's garlic salt. Brown for about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) container part skim Ricotta cheese
directions: Heat oven to 300u00b0.
Sprinkle bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan with granola cereal.
In large mixing bowl, with electric mixer on low speed, beat cream cheese until smooth and creamy.
Beat in Ricotta cheese.
Add sugar, eggs and vanilla and beat until blended.
Add pumpkin, cornstarch, cinnamon and nutmeg and beat until smooth.
Pour batter into spring-form pan over cereal.
Bake 1 1/2 hours or until center is just starting to set.
Turn off oven and leave cheesecake in oven with door slightly ajar for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cheesecake. Heat oven to 300u00b0. Sprinkle bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan with granola cereal. In large mixing bowl, with electric mixer on low speed, beat cream cheese until smooth and creamy. Beat in Ricotta cheese. Add sugar, eggs and vanilla and beat until blended. Add pumpkin, cornstarch, cinnamon and nutmeg and beat until smooth. Pour batter into spring-form pan over cereal. Bake 1 1/2 hours or until center is just starting to set. Turn off oven and leave cheesecake in oven with door slightly ajar for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
directions: Mix all dry ingredients.
In a small bowl, mix sour cream and egg yolks.
Combine all ingredients and cook in double boiler until thick.
Pour into pie shell.
Top with your favorite meringue.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Raisin Pie. Mix all dry ingredients. In a small bowl, mix sour cream and egg yolks. Combine all ingredients and cook in double boiler until thick. Pour into pie shell. Top with your favorite meringue.

recipes.title: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
directions: Wrap bacon around water chestnuts and broil until bacon is crispy.
Add tomato sauce, brown sugar and some Worcestershire sauce to taste.
Put in crock-pot and simmer for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts. Wrap bacon around water chestnuts and broil until bacon is crispy. Add tomato sauce, brown sugar and some Worcestershire sauce to taste. Put in crock-pot and simmer for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Hot German Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 small carton mayonnaise (fill sour cream carton)
1 bunch green onions, chopped (tops and all)
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Place in baking dish that has been sprayed with Pam.
Cover with foil and bake at 300u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot German Potato Salad. Mix all ingredients. Place in baking dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Cover with foil and bake at 300u00b0 for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
directions: In a bowl, combine the first 11 ingredients and mix well. Transfer to a greased 1 qt. baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350u00b0 for 30-35 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn. In a bowl, combine the first 11 ingredients and mix well. Transfer to a greased 1 qt. baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350u00b0 for 30-35 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Rice Meatballs
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. tomato sauce or 2 (8 oz.) cans and 1/2 c. water
directions: Mix all ingredients together with 1/2 cup tomato sauce.
Shape into balls.
Put in skillet and pour remaining 2 cups tomato sauce over meatballs.
Bring to boil.
Reduce and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice Meatballs. Mix all ingredients together with 1/2 cup tomato sauce. Shape into balls. Put in skillet and pour remaining 2 cups tomato sauce over meatballs. Bring to boil. Reduce and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Cook sugar, milk and Karo until ball forms.
Remove from heat, then add vanilla, butter or margarine and peanut butter.
Beat and pour into buttered 8 x 8-inch pan.
Cool.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Cook sugar, milk and Karo until ball forms. Remove from heat, then add vanilla, butter or margarine and peanut butter. Beat and pour into buttered 8 x 8-inch pan. Cool.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Shred the lettuce.
Slice small the green pepper, onion and tomatoes.
Brown hamburger and drain.
Drain the kidney beans. Smash the Doritos into tiny pieces.
Mix all ingredients.
Pour bottle of dressing on right before serving.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Shred the lettuce. Slice small the green pepper, onion and tomatoes. Brown hamburger and drain. Drain the kidney beans. Smash the Doritos into tiny pieces. Mix all ingredients. Pour bottle of dressing on right before serving.

recipes.title: Jello Delight
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) containers frozen raspberries or strawberries with juice
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add berries and juice. Pour into bowl you will be serving it in.
Refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Jello Delight. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add berries and juice. Pour into bowl you will be serving it in. Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Miss May Craver'S Taffy
directions: Combine ingredients and boil until it will crack on a toothpick when placed in cold water, like ice.
Place on a greased platter or marble slab and let cool until a dent can be made in it when pressed with a finger.
Gather in a lump and pull with fingertips until light and porous.
Roll
in long, thin strips and cut in 1-inch pieces.
recipes.text: Miss May Craver'S Taffy. Combine ingredients and boil until it will crack on a toothpick when placed in cold water, like ice. Place on a greased platter or marble slab and let cool until a dent can be made in it when pressed with a finger. Gather in a lump and pull with fingertips until light and porous. Roll in long, thin strips and cut in 1-inch pieces.

recipes.title: Carrots Delight
directions: Combine carrots, onion and 1 tablespoon butter in glass dish. Microwave, covered, on High for 12 minutes or until carrots are tender.
Mix parsley flakes, lemon rind, salt, sugar and pepper in small bowl.
Add to carrots.
Add remaining 1 tablespoon butter; mix well.
Microwave, covered, on High for 2 minutes longer. Yield:
6 servings.
recipes.text: Carrots Delight. Combine carrots, onion and 1 tablespoon butter in glass dish. Microwave, covered, on High for 12 minutes or until carrots are tender. Mix parsley flakes, lemon rind, salt, sugar and pepper in small bowl. Add to carrots. Add remaining 1 tablespoon butter; mix well. Microwave, covered, on High for 2 minutes longer. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix together.
For hot chocolate, mix 3 tablespoons to 1 cup hot water.
recipes.text: Hot Chocolate Mix. Mix together. For hot chocolate, mix 3 tablespoons to 1 cup hot water.

recipes.title: Sneaky Petes
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) cans or 1 (12 oz.) can frozen orange juice
2 (6 oz.) cans or 1 (12 oz.) can frozen lemonade
directions: Mix in blender orange juice, lemonade, sugar and some 7-Up into the juice mixture.
Pour in large bowl.
Add rest of 7-Up, cranberry juice and vodka or gin.
Mix and then pour into large plastic container with cover.
Place in refrigerator for at least 12 hours.
Pour 7-Up or ginger ale over mixture.
recipes.text: Sneaky Petes. Mix in blender orange juice, lemonade, sugar and some 7-Up into the juice mixture. Pour in large bowl. Add rest of 7-Up, cranberry juice and vodka or gin. Mix and then pour into large plastic container with cover. Place in refrigerator for at least 12 hours. Pour 7-Up or ginger ale over mixture.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Put bread on bottom of oblong casserole dish.
Layer sausage and cheese over bread.
Mix eggs with other ingredients and pour on top.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes a wonderful breakfast for company.
recipes.text: Sausage Casserole. Put bread on bottom of oblong casserole dish. Layer sausage and cheese over bread. Mix eggs with other ingredients and pour on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Makes a wonderful breakfast for company.

recipes.title: Cukes And Onions
directions: Put a layer of cukes and a layer of onions.
Sprinkle a little dill weed over.
Repeat layers.
Bring remaining ingredients to a boil and pour over cukes and onions.
Chill.
recipes.text: Cukes And Onions. Put a layer of cukes and a layer of onions. Sprinkle a little dill weed over. Repeat layers. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil and pour over cukes and onions. Chill.

recipes.title: Easy Vichyssoise
ingredients: 2 chicken bouillon cubes or 2 tsp. bouillon granules
directions: Combine water, parsley and bouillon in saucepan.
Cover and bring to boiling.
Stir until bouillon is dissolved.
Remove from heat.
Add cream.
Stir in potatoes.
Cool to room temperature. Put mixture in blender.
Add onion and cream cheese.
Blend at high speed until smooth.
Chill thoroughly.
Serve in chilled bowls.
Garnish with chives.
A great dish for hot weather!
recipes.text: Easy Vichyssoise. Combine water, parsley and bouillon in saucepan. Cover and bring to boiling. Stir until bouillon is dissolved. Remove from heat. Add cream. Stir in potatoes. Cool to room temperature. Put mixture in blender. Add onion and cream cheese. Blend at high speed until smooth. Chill thoroughly. Serve in chilled bowls. Garnish with chives. A great dish for hot weather!

recipes.title: Brisket
directions: Put in pan. Mix all ingredients together and smooth over meat. Pour barbecue sauce (your choice of barbecue sauce) over all. Cover with foil tightly. Bake at 250u00b0 for 7 hours.
recipes.text: Brisket. Put in pan. Mix all ingredients together and smooth over meat. Pour barbecue sauce (your choice of barbecue sauce) over all. Cover with foil tightly. Bake at 250u00b0 for 7 hours.

recipes.title: Mom'S Liver Mush
directions: Cook liver until tender.
Cool and crumble into small pieces. Bring to a boil and add sage.
Reduce heat.
Mix well 1 cup meal and 1/3 cup flour and add to liver.
Cook slowly stirring constantly until mush thickens.
Pour into a bowl and cool.
Slice and flour each piece.
Fry in hot oil.
recipes.text: Mom'S Liver Mush. Cook liver until tender. Cool and crumble into small pieces. Bring to a boil and add sage. Reduce heat. Mix well 1 cup meal and 1/3 cup flour and add to liver. Cook slowly stirring constantly until mush thickens. Pour into a bowl and cool. Slice and flour each piece. Fry in hot oil.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Popcorn
directions: Pour chocolate over popped corn and peanuts.
Mix until well coated.
Cool and break up.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Popcorn. Pour chocolate over popped corn and peanuts. Mix until well coated. Cool and break up.

recipes.title: Dressing(For Salads)
directions: Mix together.
Pour amount needed over lettuce salad.
Store unused amount in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Dressing(For Salads). Mix together. Pour amount needed over lettuce salad. Store unused amount in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
directions: Cut off top of bell peppers; remove seeds.
Precook peppers in boiling, salted water for 5 minutes; drain.
(Omit precooking for crisper peppers.)
Sprinkle inside of peppers with salt.
Brown the ground beef and onion; drain well.
Add tomato sauce, rice, water, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, garlic and chili powder.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cheese.
Stuff the peppers with this mixture.
Place in baking dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Bell Peppers. Cut off top of bell peppers; remove seeds. Precook peppers in boiling, salted water for 5 minutes; drain. (Omit precooking for crisper peppers.) Sprinkle inside of peppers with salt. Brown the ground beef and onion; drain well. Add tomato sauce, rice, water, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, garlic and chili powder. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cheese. Stuff the peppers with this mixture. Place in baking dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff Ala Hershey
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. beef (either rump or sirloin tip), cut in 1-inch cubes
3 c. cooked noodles (1 1/2 c. dry), washed in cold water after cooked and thoroughly drained
directions: Shake beef cubes in sack with flour until all are evenly floured.
Brown cubed meat in butter or melted beef fat.
When all sides are lightly browned, add sliced onion and garlic clove. Continue to brown, stirring to keep from sticking.
When onion is transparent, add beef broth.
Cover and simmer until meat is tender to fork.
Salt and pepper to taste before broth is added.
Fold in sour cream and reheat, but do not allow to boil.
Then noodles may be added to the hot meat mixture and allowed to stand, uncovered, until cool.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff Ala Hershey. Shake beef cubes in sack with flour until all are evenly floured. Brown cubed meat in butter or melted beef fat. When all sides are lightly browned, add sliced onion and garlic clove. Continue to brown, stirring to keep from sticking. When onion is transparent, add beef broth. Cover and simmer until meat is tender to fork. Salt and pepper to taste before broth is added. Fold in sour cream and reheat, but do not allow to boil. Then noodles may be added to the hot meat mixture and allowed to stand, uncovered, until cool.

recipes.title: Margaret'S Pecan Pie And Crust
directions: Combine all ingredients, except pie shell.
Mix well.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 40 minutes, or until brown.
recipes.text: Margaret'S Pecan Pie And Crust. Combine all ingredients, except pie shell. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 40 minutes, or until brown.

recipes.title: Cranberry Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cranberry sauce; stir to dissolve.
Add crushed pineapple and juice.
Mix well.
Add nuts. Mix again.
Pour into mold and set in refrigerator to jell.
When ready to serve, mix together cream cheese (room temperature and creamed) and sour cream.
Spread over top of the unmolded jello.
recipes.text: Cranberry Jello Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cranberry sauce; stir to dissolve. Add crushed pineapple and juice. Mix well. Add nuts. Mix again. Pour into mold and set in refrigerator to jell. When ready to serve, mix together cream cheese (room temperature and creamed) and sour cream. Spread over top of the unmolded jello.

recipes.title: Country Style Corn Chowder
ingredients: 1 bag frozen white corn or 2 cans white corn, drained
directions: Fry diced bacon until brown and crisp.
Remove bacon from pan and set aside.
Saute onion and potatoes in bacon drippings.
Add corn, broth (herbal brand okay) and seasonings.
Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Then stir in whipping cream and bacon. Heat through and serve.
recipes.text: Country Style Corn Chowder. Fry diced bacon until brown and crisp. Remove bacon from pan and set aside. Saute onion and potatoes in bacon drippings. Add corn, broth (herbal brand okay) and seasonings. Simmer until vegetables are tender. Then stir in whipping cream and bacon. Heat through and serve.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Drain sauerkraut; chop.
Place into mixing bowl.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Store in refrigerator.
Keeps indefinitely.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Drain sauerkraut; chop. Place into mixing bowl. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Store in refrigerator. Keeps indefinitely.

recipes.title: Fudge Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. flour (if plain, add 1/2 tsp. salt)
directions: Mix
all
ingredients
together and turn into a greased pie plate.
Bake
at
350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Test center with toothpick.
If
pie
is
done, pick will come out clean. The pie is chewy like brownies.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Fudge Pie. Mix all ingredients together and turn into a greased pie plate. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Test center with toothpick. If pie is done, pick will come out clean. The pie is chewy like brownies. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Chocolate Milk Pound Cake
directions: Soften butter and Crisco.
Add sugar and beat well. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour and baking powder together.
Add flour and cocoa.
Mix well.
Pour in chocolate milk, a little at a time. Add vanilla.
Place in cold oven and bake at 325u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Chocolate Milk Pound Cake. Soften butter and Crisco. Add sugar and beat well. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add flour and cocoa. Mix well. Pour in chocolate milk, a little at a time. Add vanilla. Place in cold oven and bake at 325u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Tomato Aspic
directions: In a clear glass bowl, add 2 cups boiling V-8 juice to jello. Stir until dissolved.
Add 2 cups of cold V-8 and stir.
Let set in refrigerator until cool.
Add onions, celery, olives and shrimp. Place in refrigerator until set up.
Place dollop of mayo in center of set up aspic and sprinkle with paprika and pinch of parsley.
recipes.text: Tomato Aspic. In a clear glass bowl, add 2 cups boiling V-8 juice to jello. Stir until dissolved. Add 2 cups of cold V-8 and stir. Let set in refrigerator until cool. Add onions, celery, olives and shrimp. Place in refrigerator until set up. Place dollop of mayo in center of set up aspic and sprinkle with paprika and pinch of parsley.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) box macaroni, cook 6 minutes and drain
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour in crock-pot (which has been greased with 2 tablespoons of butter).
Cut several thin slices of cheese and place on top of mixture.
Cook 3 1/2 hours on slow.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese. Mix all ingredients together and pour in crock-pot (which has been greased with 2 tablespoons of butter). Cut several thin slices of cheese and place on top of mixture. Cook 3 1/2 hours on slow.

recipes.title: Cucumber Mold
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water adding grated onion.
Dissolve gelatin in cold water, then add to Jell-O.
Add the softened cream cheese to gelatin mix while hot whisking to blend.
Whisk in mayonnaise then Tabasco and salt.
Stir in grated cucumbers.
(Use only tender flesh; seeds and rind can be tough and bitter.)
Spray mold.
Pour mixture and allow to gel in refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Cucumber Mold. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water adding grated onion. Dissolve gelatin in cold water, then add to Jell-O. Add the softened cream cheese to gelatin mix while hot whisking to blend. Whisk in mayonnaise then Tabasco and salt. Stir in grated cucumbers. (Use only tender flesh; seeds and rind can be tough and bitter.) Spray mold. Pour mixture and allow to gel in refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Paprika Chicken
directions: Brown chicken slightly in fat.
Add onion and saute until tender.
Add paprika, garlic and water.
Arrange pepper rings and tomatoes on top.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Mix flour to paste with a little sour cream, then add to remaining cream.
Then pour over the chicken.
Bring to boil.
Remove from heat.
Serve with noodles.
recipes.text: Paprika Chicken. Brown chicken slightly in fat. Add onion and saute until tender. Add paprika, garlic and water. Arrange pepper rings and tomatoes on top. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Mix flour to paste with a little sour cream, then add to remaining cream. Then pour over the chicken. Bring to boil. Remove from heat. Serve with noodles.

recipes.title: Icebox Cake
directions: Line pan with vanilla wafers, then put a layer of bananas, layer of pineapple, layer of coconut and layer of pecans.
Take juice from pineapple, butter, sugar and eggs, cook this 3 or 4 minutes, then pour over the layers and refrigerate until well chilled.
Serve it with whipped cream.
Makes about 10 nice servings.
recipes.text: Icebox Cake. Line pan with vanilla wafers, then put a layer of bananas, layer of pineapple, layer of coconut and layer of pecans. Take juice from pineapple, butter, sugar and eggs, cook this 3 or 4 minutes, then pour over the layers and refrigerate until well chilled. Serve it with whipped cream. Makes about 10 nice servings.

recipes.title: Mock Crab Cakes
directions: Combine all ingredients; fry into patties.
Serve with tartar sauce.
recipes.text: Mock Crab Cakes. Combine all ingredients; fry into patties. Serve with tartar sauce.

recipes.title: Potato Rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Soften yeast in water (110u00b0).
Combine potatoes, shortening, sugar, salt and hot milk.
Cool to lukewarm.
recipes.text: Potato Rolls. Preheat oven to 400u00b0. Soften yeast in water (110u00b0). Combine potatoes, shortening, sugar, salt and hot milk. Cool to lukewarm.

recipes.title: Sundae Cake
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) jar Hershey's hot fudge (not chocolate syrup, may be 16 oz.)
directions: Make German chocolate cake. Cool completely. Make holes on top of the cake with a toothpick. Pour Eagle Brand milk slowly over the cake; let it soak in. Warm the jar of Hershey's hot fudge in the microwave oven just enough to pour easily. Spread the hot fudge over the top of the cake. Cool completely. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate until set.
Crush the Heath bars and sprinkle over the Cool Whip. Refrigerate. This keeps well for several days, gets better each day.
recipes.text: Sundae Cake. Make German chocolate cake. Cool completely. Make holes on top of the cake with a toothpick. Pour Eagle Brand milk slowly over the cake; let it soak in. Warm the jar of Hershey's hot fudge in the microwave oven just enough to pour easily. Spread the hot fudge over the top of the cake. Cool completely. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate until set. Crush the Heath bars and sprinkle over the Cool Whip. Refrigerate. This keeps well for several days, gets better each day.

recipes.title: Pecan Spice Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease 8-inch square baking pan.
Sift the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spices together into a large mixing bowl.
Place butter in a large mixing bowl and cream until soft.
Gradually beat in the sugar and eggs.
Stir in pecans.
Add the flour mixture alternately with molasses and milk, beating well after each addition.
Spoon into pan.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Pecan Spice Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease 8-inch square baking pan. Sift the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spices together into a large mixing bowl. Place butter in a large mixing bowl and cream until soft. Gradually beat in the sugar and eggs. Stir in pecans. Add the flour mixture alternately with molasses and milk, beating well after each addition. Spoon into pan. Bake 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Parmesan
ingredients: 4 or 5 small zucchini, thinly sliced (about 3 c.)
directions: Mix zucchini, butter or margarine and seasonings in a skillet. Cover and cook slowly for 5 minutes.
Uncover and continue cooking, turning slices, until barely tender, about 5 minutes more. Sprinkle with cheese while hot.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Zucchini Parmesan. Mix zucchini, butter or margarine and seasonings in a skillet. Cover and cook slowly for 5 minutes. Uncover and continue cooking, turning slices, until barely tender, about 5 minutes more. Sprinkle with cheese while hot. Serves 4.

recipes.title: S.B.N.'S Apple Cake
directions: Boil for 3 minutes.
Pour over cake and let cool.
recipes.text: S.B.N.'S Apple Cake. Boil for 3 minutes. Pour over cake and let cool.

recipes.title: Garden Vegetable Bake
directions: Layer sliced vegetables in buttered casserole.
Sprinkle oil over top and season with salt and pepper.
Cover tightly with foil.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes.
Should be firm, not mushy.
recipes.text: Garden Vegetable Bake. Layer sliced vegetables in buttered casserole. Sprinkle oil over top and season with salt and pepper. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Should be firm, not mushy.

recipes.title: Stuffed Zucchini Boats
directions: Steam whole zucchini 15 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Cool slightly; slice lengthwise.
Scoop out pulp, leaving 1/4-inch shell.
Chop pulp and set pulp and shells aside.
recipes.text: Stuffed Zucchini Boats. Steam whole zucchini 15 minutes or until crisp-tender. Cool slightly; slice lengthwise. Scoop out pulp, leaving 1/4-inch shell. Chop pulp and set pulp and shells aside.

recipes.title: Pink Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients together; add ice.
May pour over crushed ice.
recipes.text: Pink Punch. Mix all ingredients together; add ice. May pour over crushed ice.

recipes.title: Country Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
directions: Note:
I always add lots of pecans (chopped).
recipes.text: Country Cookies. Note: I always add lots of pecans (chopped).

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 300u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 300u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Pecans
directions: Cook sugar, milk, cinnamon and water over medium heat until it forms a soft ball in cold water.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
Pour onto waxed paper and separate.
recipes.text: Spiced Pecans. Cook sugar, milk, cinnamon and water over medium heat until it forms a soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Pour onto waxed paper and separate.

recipes.title: Spinach - Creamed
directions: Cook spinach with water just until thawed and completely separated.
Drain and discard water.
Add margarine.
Stir until melted, over medium heat.
Mix flour into sour cream.
Add to spinach and stir well, until bubbly.
Simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Season and serve.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Spinach - Creamed. Cook spinach with water just until thawed and completely separated. Drain and discard water. Add margarine. Stir until melted, over medium heat. Mix flour into sour cream. Add to spinach and stir well, until bubbly. Simmer 3 to 5 minutes. Season and serve. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Mincemeat(Splendid Way To Salvage Green Tomatoes)
directions: Core and quarter tomatoes and apples; put through food chopper with raisins.
Combine all ingredients in large saucepan.
Simmer 2 hours, stirring frequently.
Pack at once in hot pint jars. Adjust lids.
Process in boiling water bath (212u00b0) for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Mincemeat(Splendid Way To Salvage Green Tomatoes). Core and quarter tomatoes and apples; put through food chopper with raisins. Combine all ingredients in large saucepan. Simmer 2 hours, stirring frequently. Pack at once in hot pint jars. Adjust lids. Process in boiling water bath (212u00b0) for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Chicken And Stuffing
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. top-of-stove cornbread stuffing mix
directions: Place chicken quarters in shallow baking pan. On piece of foil large enough to cover the pan, rub a tablespoon of margarine and sprinkle with 1/2 of soup mix.

Rub chicken with another tablespoon of margarine and sprinkle with remaining soup mix. Drain liquid from cranberry sauce and drizzle over chicken. Reserve 1 cup of cranberry sauce and spread remaining cranberry sauce over chicken.
Cover with prepared foil.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 40 minutes.
In large bowl, mix together hot water, seasoning packet from stuffing and remaining 2 tablespoons margarine, stirring until margarine melts.
Stir in stuffing crumbs until moistened; mix in 1 cup cranberry sauce.
Remove foil from pan and reserve.
Push chicken aside and add stuffing mix in 4 mounds. Drizzle pan drippings over stuffing.
Sprinkle chicken with celery salt, pepper and almonds.
Bake, uncovered, about 20 minutes, until a fork inserts easily.
Remove browned soup mix from foil and sprinkle over chicken and dressing.
Yield:
4 servings.
recipes.text: Cranberry Chicken And Stuffing. Place chicken quarters in shallow baking pan. On piece of foil large enough to cover the pan, rub a tablespoon of margarine and sprinkle with 1/2 of soup mix. Rub chicken with another tablespoon of margarine and sprinkle with remaining soup mix. Drain liquid from cranberry sauce and drizzle over chicken. Reserve 1 cup of cranberry sauce and spread remaining cranberry sauce over chicken. Cover with prepared foil. Bake in 350u00b0 oven for 40 minutes. In large bowl, mix together hot water, seasoning packet from stuffing and remaining 2 tablespoons margarine, stirring until margarine melts. Stir in stuffing crumbs until moistened; mix in 1 cup cranberry sauce. Remove foil from pan and reserve. Push chicken aside and add stuffing mix in 4 mounds. Drizzle pan drippings over stuffing. Sprinkle chicken with celery salt, pepper and almonds. Bake, uncovered, about 20 minutes, until a fork inserts easily. Remove browned soup mix from foil and sprinkle over chicken and dressing. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Tennessee State Cookies
directions: Combine butter and sugars.
Add egg, milk and vanilla.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add flour, oats, raisins and nuts.
Drop on cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Tennessee State Cookies. Combine butter and sugars. Add egg, milk and vanilla. Beat until light and fluffy. Add flour, oats, raisins and nuts. Drop on cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Persimmon Bread
directions: Thoroughly beat together pulp, sugar and eggs.
Add dry ingredients, then cooking oil.
Bake in square pan or 2 small loaf pans at 350u00b0 for about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Persimmon Bread. Thoroughly beat together pulp, sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients, then cooking oil. Bake in square pan or 2 small loaf pans at 350u00b0 for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water.
Stir until dissolved.
Add cranberry sauce.
Stir until most of it has melted.
Cool until it starts to jell.
Add apples, celery and nuts.
Chill.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water. Stir until dissolved. Add cranberry sauce. Stir until most of it has melted. Cool until it starts to jell. Add apples, celery and nuts. Chill.

recipes.title: Cavatini
ingredients: 1 pkg. each egg noodles and twister noodles
directions: Brown ground chuck; drain grease.
Add pepper, onion, mushrooms and spices.
Cook a couple of minutes before adding Prego sauce.
After adding sauce, let simmer approximately 20 minutes.
Cook noodles to desired tenderness.
Add twisters about 3 minutes before egg noodles.
In a large casserole dish, layer noodles, sauce, Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Cavatini. Brown ground chuck; drain grease. Add pepper, onion, mushrooms and spices. Cook a couple of minutes before adding Prego sauce. After adding sauce, let simmer approximately 20 minutes. Cook noodles to desired tenderness. Add twisters about 3 minutes before egg noodles. In a large casserole dish, layer noodles, sauce, Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni on top. Bake at 350u00b0 until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Fire And Ice Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 medium green pepper, cut into strips
directions: Mix vinegar, water and all seasonings together.
Pour over vegetables.
Colorful and tasty salad.
recipes.text: Fire And Ice Tomatoes. Mix vinegar, water and all seasonings together. Pour over vegetables. Colorful and tasty salad.

recipes.title: Easy Carrot Cake
directions: Beat eggs slightly.
Add sugar, oil and carrots.
Sift dry ingredients together and add to other mix.
Bake in 3 layers for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Easy Carrot Cake. Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar, oil and carrots. Sift dry ingredients together and add to other mix. Bake in 3 layers for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Milky Way Homemade Ice Cream
ingredients: 5 or 6 Milky Way candy bars, cut up and melted
directions: Mix all ingredients; pour in freezer.
Add enough homogenized milk to finish filling freezer.
If using electric freezer, leave in freezer until freezer stops running.
recipes.text: Milky Way Homemade Ice Cream. Mix all ingredients; pour in freezer. Add enough homogenized milk to finish filling freezer. If using electric freezer, leave in freezer until freezer stops running.

recipes.title: Aunt Reta'S Datenut Bread
directions: Sprinkle baking soda over dates. Pour boiling water over dates, add margarine. Let cool. Mix together all other ingredients. Add to date mixture. mix well. Turn into well greased loaf pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45-50 min. Test with toothpick before removing from oven. Serve with butter or whipped cream cheese.
recipes.text: Aunt Reta'S Datenut Bread. Sprinkle baking soda over dates. Pour boiling water over dates, add margarine. Let cool. Mix together all other ingredients. Add to date mixture. mix well. Turn into well greased loaf pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45-50 min. Test with toothpick before removing from oven. Serve with butter or whipped cream cheese.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix together the green beans and soup. Add 1/2 can onions and mix in.
Put in oven for 30 minutes at 375u00b0.
Remove, put rest of onions on top, then serve.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Mix together the green beans and soup. Add 1/2 can onions and mix in. Put in oven for 30 minutes at 375u00b0. Remove, put rest of onions on top, then serve.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Roll into ball and roll in nuts.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Ball. Mix ingredients together. Roll into ball and roll in nuts.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Chicken Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut in 2-inch pieces
directions: Saute chicken, onion, pepper and garlic in melted butter.
Add rice.
Cook 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, their liquid, parsley, basil and pepper sauce.
Bring to a boil and add chicken broth.
Simmer 15 minutes, covered.
Add shrimp and peas.
Cook, covered, for 3 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Shrimp And Chicken Jambalaya. Saute chicken, onion, pepper and garlic in melted butter. Add rice. Cook 3 minutes. Add tomatoes, their liquid, parsley, basil and pepper sauce. Bring to a boil and add chicken broth. Simmer 15 minutes, covered. Add shrimp and peas. Cook, covered, for 3 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Mystery Sandwich
directions: Put first 4 ingredients through food chopper.
Combine with mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Mystery Sandwich. Put first 4 ingredients through food chopper. Combine with mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Spiced Orange Mold
directions: Drain liquid from oranges into small pan.
Add sugar, water and spices.
Boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Place jello into bowl and pour hot liquid through strainer into jello.
Stir until dissolved.
Add fruit, orange juice and lemon juice.
Spoon into molds.
recipes.text: Spiced Orange Mold. Drain liquid from oranges into small pan. Add sugar, water and spices. Boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Place jello into bowl and pour hot liquid through strainer into jello. Stir until dissolved. Add fruit, orange juice and lemon juice. Spoon into molds.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Mexican Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 large bag shredded, low-fat Monterey Jack cheese
directions: Pour picante sauce into Pyrex dish and place chicken in the sauce.
Turn chicken over and bake for about 35 or 40 minutes. Turn chicken over again and cover with Monterey Jack cheese.
Bake for another 15 or 20 minutes.
Cheese will melt and mix with picante sauce for a gravy-like mixture.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Mexican Chicken And Rice. Pour picante sauce into Pyrex dish and place chicken in the sauce. Turn chicken over and bake for about 35 or 40 minutes. Turn chicken over again and cover with Monterey Jack cheese. Bake for another 15 or 20 minutes. Cheese will melt and mix with picante sauce for a gravy-like mixture.

recipes.title: Cream Pie
ingredients: 4 eggs, separated (reserve egg whites for meringue)
1/3 c. cocoa or 1 can coconut or 4 to 6 medium bananas (if using bananas, use vanilla wafers to layer baking dish as crust)
directions: Combine cornstarch, milk and sugar and cook over medium heat until mixture begins to thicken.
Add a small portion of mixture to egg yolks.
Beat and add back to mixture.
When completely thickened, remove from fire and add salt and vanilla.
recipes.text: Cream Pie. Combine cornstarch, milk and sugar and cook over medium heat until mixture begins to thicken. Add a small portion of mixture to egg yolks. Beat and add back to mixture. When completely thickened, remove from fire and add salt and vanilla.

recipes.title: Summertime Punch With Ice Wreath
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
directions: A Day Ahead:
In medium bowl, mix 3 cups raspberry-cranberry drink and 2 cups water.
Pour 3 1/2 cups of this drink mixture into 6-cup ring mold; freeze.
Refrigerate the remaining 1 1/2 cups. Cut a continuous 1-inch wide strip of peel from each lemon and lime; reserve peels.
Squeeze juice from lemons and limes to equal 1/4 cup each.
Refrigerate to use in punch later.
Trim white membrane from lemon-lime peel strips.
Form each strip into a rose by rolling it tightly, skin side out, around finger; secure with a toothpick.
Cover; refrigerate.
recipes.text: Summertime Punch With Ice Wreath. A Day Ahead: In medium bowl, mix 3 cups raspberry-cranberry drink and 2 cups water. Pour 3 1/2 cups of this drink mixture into 6-cup ring mold; freeze.
