Refrigerate the remaining 1 1/2 cups. Cut a continuous 1-inch wide strip of peel from each lemon and lime; reserve peels. Squeeze juice from lemons and limes to equal 1/4 cup each. Refrigerate to use in punch later. Trim white membrane from lemon-lime peel strips. Form each strip into a rose by rolling it tightly, skin side out, around finger; secure with a toothpick. Cover; refrigerate.

recipes.title: Coconut Crisp Delight
directions: Melt butter. Mix the flour, coconut, almonds and brown sugar. Press into 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes until golden brown. Set aside and cool in pan baked in.
recipes.text: Coconut Crisp Delight. Melt butter. Mix the flour, coconut, almonds and brown sugar. Press into 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes until golden brown. Set aside and cool in pan baked in.

recipes.title: Cherry Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Grease and flour pan (oblong).
Put dry ingredients into bowl. Add eggs and oil.
Mix. Add orange juice and vanilla. Mix again. Batter will be thick.
Spread with a spoon.
Pour half the batter into pan. Add cherries and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Pour remaining batter.
Spread with spoon and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake 1/2 hour at 350u00b0. Reduce heat to 325u00b0.
Bake 40 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Cherry Cake. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Grease and flour pan (oblong). Put dry ingredients into bowl. Add eggs and oil. Mix. Add orange juice and vanilla. Mix again. Batter will be thick. Spread with a spoon. Pour half the batter into pan. Add cherries and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Pour remaining batter. Spread with spoon and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake 1/2 hour at 350u00b0. Reduce heat to 325u00b0. Bake 40 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Nora June Truitt'S Egg Bread
directions: Mix together.
Beat well; pour in greased pan.
Bake in hot oven until brown.
recipes.text: Nora June Truitt'S Egg Bread. Mix together. Beat well; pour in greased pan. Bake in hot oven until brown.

recipes.title: Adult Strawberry Flips
directions: Blend the strawberries on high speed until pureed.
Put the eggs, lemon juice, sugar and vodka in blender to blend with berries, 15 to 20 seconds.
Pour into tall glasses over cracked ice.
Should serve 8.
recipes.text: Adult Strawberry Flips. Blend the strawberries on high speed until pureed. Put the eggs, lemon juice, sugar and vodka in blender to blend with berries, 15 to 20 seconds. Pour into tall glasses over cracked ice. Should serve 8.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 large loaves or 3 small ones.
Cool in pans for 20 minutes before taking out of pans.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Combine all ingredients; mix well. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Makes 2 large loaves or 3 small ones. Cool in pans for 20 minutes before taking out of pans.

recipes.title: Cranberry Pork Roast
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. boneless rolled pork loin roast
directions: Place roast in slow cooker. In a medium bowl, mash cranberry sauce. Stir in sugar, mustard and cloves. Pour over roast. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or until tender. Remove roast and keep warm. Skim fat. Measure 2 cups of the liquid (add water if needed) and pour into saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat. Combine cornstarch and cold water to make a paste. Stir into a gravy. Cook and stir until thickened. Season with salt.
recipes.text: Cranberry Pork Roast. Place roast in slow cooker. In a medium bowl, mash cranberry sauce. Stir in sugar, mustard and cloves. Pour over roast. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or until tender. Remove roast and keep warm. Skim fat. Measure 2 cups of the liquid (add water if needed) and pour into saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat. Combine cornstarch and cold water to make a paste. Stir into a gravy. Cook and stir until thickened. Season with salt.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces*
1 pkg. Birds Eye sugar snap stir-fry vegetable mix
directions: Mix together in a bowl.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes to marinate.
recipes.text: Chicken Stir-Fry. Mix together in a bowl. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to marinate.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed
chopped fresh dill weed or crumbled dry dill weed to taste
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill.
Nice in hollowed out head of red cabbage.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Combine all ingredients and chill. Nice in hollowed out head of red cabbage.

recipes.title: Cherry Cobbler
directions: Beat butter, sugar and egg with electric mixer.
Blend in flour, salt, baking powder and milk.
Pour cherries into greased, shallow baking dish.
Sprinkle with butter, tapioca and lemon juice.
Spoon batter on top of cherries.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.
Serve warm with milk or cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Cherry Cobbler. Beat butter, sugar and egg with electric mixer. Blend in flour, salt, baking powder and milk. Pour cherries into greased, shallow baking dish. Sprinkle with butter, tapioca and lemon juice. Spoon batter on top of cherries. Bake at 375u00b0 for 30 to 35 minutes or until done. Serve warm with milk or cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Spinach Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Mix all together and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Spinach Cottage Cheese Salad. Mix all together and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Creme Meringue
directions: Beat eggs and salt until they peak.
Gradually add Marshmallow Creme.
recipes.text: Marshmallow Creme Meringue. Beat eggs and salt until they peak. Gradually add Marshmallow Creme.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 pkg. mixed frozen vegetables with little onions
directions: Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot or simmer several hours. (May add 1 can of water.)
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Beef Stew. Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot or simmer several hours. (May add 1 can of water.)

recipes.title: German Pecan Brittles
directions: Cream
shortening
in a large mixing bowl; gradually add sugar, beating well.
Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each
addition.
Sift
together
flour, baking powder, soda and salt in
a
medium mixing bowl; add cereal and pecans, stirring to coat
well.
Stir
flour
mixture
and
vanilla into creamed mixture,
mixing
well.
Drop
dough
by
teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto greased and floured cookie sheets.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes and cool on wire racks.
Yields 11 dozen.
recipes.text: German Pecan Brittles. Cream shortening in a large mixing bowl; gradually add sugar, beating well. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt in a medium mixing bowl; add cereal and pecans, stirring to coat well. Stir flour mixture and vanilla into creamed mixture, mixing well. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto greased and floured cookie sheets. Bake at 325u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes and cool on wire racks. Yields 11 dozen.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. whole kernel corn (use a whole can)
directions: Put dry ingredients together.
Blend milk and egg.
Add gradually to dry ingredients.
Stir in corn.
Drop by tablespoons (or like pancakes from cup) into hot fat.
Fry 2 to 5 minutes until brown. Drain on paper.
recipes.text: Corn Fritters. Put dry ingredients together. Blend milk and egg. Add gradually to dry ingredients. Stir in corn. Drop by tablespoons (or like pancakes from cup) into hot fat. Fry 2 to 5 minutes until brown. Drain on paper.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Prepare rice according to directions. Cook chopped onion in margarine until tender.
Remove from heat and add flour.
Drain mushrooms, saving the liquid.
Add sherry and enough chicken broth to measure 1 1/2 cups. Gradually stir into flour mixture.

Add light cream. Cook until mixture thickens. Add the wild rice, mushrooms, chicken, diced pimiento, parsley, salt and pepper. Place in a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup slivered almonds. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Chicken Rice Casserole. Prepare rice according to directions. Cook chopped onion in margarine until tender. Remove from heat and add flour. Drain mushrooms, saving the liquid. Add sherry and enough chicken broth to measure 1 1/2 cups. Gradually stir into flour mixture. Add light cream. Cook until mixture thickens. Add the wild rice, mushrooms, chicken, diced pimiento, parsley, salt and pepper. Place in a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup slivered almonds. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Breakfast-In-A-Dish
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Prepare bacon in skillet over medium heat; drain.
In large saucepan or stockpot, combine hash brown patties, bouillon cubes and water.
Cover and place over medium-low heat until patties are thawed and crumbled.
Remove from heat.
Add bacon, margarine, cheese, celery, onion, salt and pepper.
Mix ingredients together until margarine and cheese have melted.
Gradually add egg substitute to mixture, stirring constantly.
Pour mixture into a 2 quart casserole dish.
Bake 1 hour or until mixture is firmly set in center.
recipes.text: Breakfast-In-A-Dish. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Prepare bacon in skillet over medium heat; drain. In large saucepan or stockpot, combine hash brown patties, bouillon cubes and water. Cover and place over medium-low heat until patties are thawed and crumbled. Remove from heat. Add bacon, margarine, cheese, celery, onion, salt and pepper. Mix ingredients together until margarine and cheese have melted. Gradually add egg substitute to mixture, stirring constantly. Pour mixture into a 2 quart casserole dish. Bake 1 hour or until mixture is firmly set in center.

recipes.title: Fried Apples
ingredients: 6 to 8 apples, peeled, sliced and cored
directions: Melt butter in frying pan.
Add apple slices.
Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar over apples.
Cover and cook over medium heat. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
When apples are soft, remove from pan and serve.
recipes.text: Fried Apples. Melt butter in frying pan. Add apple slices. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar over apples. Cover and cook over medium heat. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. When apples are soft, remove from pan and serve.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. skinned, boned chicken breasts, cut into strips
directions: Saute chicken, onion and garlic in margarine until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in cornstarch; cook 1 minute longer.
Add broth, carrot, lemon juice, peas and salt; boil 5 minutes.
Stir in rice.
Cover and remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Fluff with fork.
Serve with lemon wedges. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Lemon Chicken. Saute chicken, onion and garlic in margarine until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in cornstarch; cook 1 minute longer. Add broth, carrot, lemon juice, peas and salt; boil 5 minutes. Stir in rice. Cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. Serve with lemon wedges. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Icebox Cake
directions: Mix Jell-O pudding according to directions on box.
Layer graham crackers and pudding in standard size cake pan.
recipes.text: Icebox Cake. Mix Jell-O pudding according to directions on box. Layer graham crackers and pudding in standard size cake pan.

recipes.title: Pickled Bananas (Relish)
directions: Boil bananas in their skins until tender, about 12 minutes. Remove skins.
Prepare pickle by combining lime juice, onion, chives, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Slice bananas and add them to juice, coating well.
Cover bowl and let stand at least 2 hours, tossing bananas in mix every 30 minutes.
Before serving, peel, core and chop cucumbers and garnish relish with cucumbers.
recipes.text: Pickled Bananas (Relish). Boil bananas in their skins until tender, about 12 minutes. Remove skins. Prepare pickle by combining lime juice, onion, chives, salt and pepper in a bowl. Slice bananas and add them to juice, coating well. Cover bowl and let stand at least 2 hours, tossing bananas in mix every 30 minutes. Before serving, peel, core and chop cucumbers and garnish relish with cucumbers.

recipes.title: Lemon Fluff
directions: Blend together flour, margarine and coconut.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Fluff. Blend together flour, margarine and coconut. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange-Glazed Carrots
ingredients: 5 medium carrots, scraped and cut into diagonal slices
directions: Combine carrot slices, water and salt in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes or just until tender (do not drain).
Combine orange juice, sugar, cornstarch, margarine, and ginger, stirring until well blended.
Pour over carrot slices in saucepan.
recipes.text: Orange-Glazed Carrots. Combine carrot slices, water and salt in a medium saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes or just until tender (do not drain). Combine orange juice, sugar, cornstarch, margarine, and ginger, stirring until well blended. Pour over carrot slices in saucepan.

recipes.title: Onion Cake
directions: In skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
Drain bacon; discard pan drippings.
In same skillet, cook onions in margarine until tender.
Cool.
In mixing bowl, combine sour cream, flour, salt and eggs.
Stir in bacon and onions; set aside.
recipes.text: Onion Cake. In skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Drain bacon; discard pan drippings. In same skillet, cook onions in margarine until tender. Cool. In mixing bowl, combine sour cream, flour, salt and eggs. Stir in bacon and onions; set aside.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple; mix juice, flour, sugar and butter and cook until mixture coats spoon.
Add pineapple, nuts and cheese.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole pan.
Melt 4 tablespoons butter.
Add 1 cup crushed Ritz crackers and 1/4 cup chopped nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple Casserole. Drain pineapple; mix juice, flour, sugar and butter and cook until mixture coats spoon. Add pineapple, nuts and cheese. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole pan. Melt 4 tablespoons butter. Add 1 cup crushed Ritz crackers and 1/4 cup chopped nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Homemade Lye Soap
ingredients: 4 lb. hog fat, grease or fat meat scraps
directions: Note:
Always make soap before the new moon.
recipes.text: Homemade Lye Soap. Note: Always make soap before the new moon.

recipes.title: Pecan Delight Muffins *
directions: With fork, beat eggs and add sugar and butter.
Stir in flour, vanilla and nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 about 25 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Pecan Delight Muffins *. With fork, beat eggs and add sugar and butter. Stir in flour, vanilla and nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 about 25 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Layer Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 medium solid head lettuce, cut fine
1 large pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
directions: Chop pepper, celery and onions.
Layer first five ingredients in casserole dish, starting with lettuce.
Spread peas over chopped vegetables.
recipes.text: Layer Lettuce Salad. Chop pepper, celery and onions. Layer first five ingredients in casserole dish, starting with lettuce. Spread peas over chopped vegetables.

recipes.title: Szoradi'S Play Dough(Not For Human Consumption)
directions: Mix water, flour, salt, oil, cream and tartar and food coloring together.
Stir constantly over medium heat until the dough becomes the consistency of mashed potatoes.
Let dough cool.
recipes.text: Szoradi'S Play Dough(Not For Human Consumption). Mix water, flour, salt, oil, cream and tartar and food coloring together. Stir constantly over medium heat until the dough becomes the consistency of mashed potatoes. Let dough cool.

recipes.title: California Guacamole
directions: Scoop the avocado from the shells, leaving about a 1/8 inch rim.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the empty shell halves and pulp.
Mash the pulp and combine with remaining ingredients to make the filling.
Return the filling to the shells.
Serve with chips.
recipes.text: California Guacamole. Scoop the avocado from the shells, leaving about a 1/8 inch rim. Squeeze the lemon juice over the empty shell halves and pulp. Mash the pulp and combine with remaining ingredients to make the filling. Return the filling to the shells. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Tasty Pork Chops
directions: Salt and pepper chops.
Spread mustard on both sides and flour.
Brown chops in hot grease.
Drain off grease and lower temperature to simmer.
Add 2 cans of chicken and rice soup and 1 can of water.
Cook for 45 minutes on low heat.
recipes.text: Tasty Pork Chops. Salt and pepper chops. Spread mustard on both sides and flour. Brown chops in hot grease. Drain off grease and lower temperature to simmer. Add 2 cans of chicken and rice soup and 1 can of water. Cook for 45 minutes on low heat.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Wash shrimp and set aside.
Saute onion and celery in butter. Add tomato paste and cream. Stir constantly so cream doesn't curdle. Add remaining ingredients except shrimp.
When mixture is hot, add shrimp and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve hot in pastry shells.
recipes.text: Shrimp Creole. Wash shrimp and set aside. Saute onion and celery in butter. Add tomato paste and cream. Stir constantly so cream doesn't curdle. Add remaining ingredients except shrimp. When mixture is hot, add shrimp and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot in pastry shells.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Mix pudding with 2 1/2 cups of milk.
Separately, mix sugar, margarine and cream cheese together.
Combine with pudding.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Line bottom of new flowerpot with foil.
Using a food processor, put Oreos in, a few at a time, until fine with the appearance of dirt.
Begin layers with Oreos, pudding mix, etc., ending with Oreos on top.
Can garnish with silk flowers for centerpiece.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Mix pudding with 2 1/2 cups of milk. Separately, mix sugar, margarine and cream cheese together. Combine with pudding. Fold in Cool Whip. Line bottom of new flowerpot with foil. Using a food processor, put Oreos in, a few at a time, until fine with the appearance of dirt. Begin layers with Oreos, pudding mix, etc., ending with Oreos on top. Can garnish with silk flowers for centerpiece.

recipes.title: Sue'S Antipasto Salad
directions: Dice or chop all of the ingredients, except macaroni.
Add to cooked macaroni.
recipes.text: Sue'S Antipasto Salad. Dice or chop all of the ingredients, except macaroni. Add to cooked macaroni.

recipes.title: "Mom'S Punch"
directions: Mix Kool-Aid, lemonade, sugar and water.
Add pineapple juice and frozen orange juice.
Right before serving, add orange sherbet, then slowly pour in Sprite, causing sherbet to froth. Makes 1 punch bowl full.
recipes.text: "Mom'S Punch". Mix Kool-Aid, lemonade, sugar and water. Add pineapple juice and frozen orange juice. Right before serving, add orange sherbet, then slowly pour in Sprite, causing sherbet to froth. Makes 1 punch bowl full.

recipes.title: Chow-Chow
directions: Combine vegetables and mix with salt.
Cover; let stand overnight and drain.
Mix mustard with a little vinegar in kettle. Add remaining vinegar, sugar and spices.
Simmer 20 minutes. Add vegetables and simmer 10 minutes.
Continue simmering while packing one hot sterilized jar at a time.
Fill to within 1/8-inch from jar top.
Make sure liquid covers vegetables.
Seal each jar at once.
Process in boiling water bath (212u00b0F) for 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 pints.
Use relish within 6 months.
recipes.text: Chow-Chow. Combine vegetables and mix with salt. Cover; let stand overnight and drain. Mix mustard with a little vinegar in kettle. Add remaining vinegar, sugar and spices. Simmer 20 minutes. Add vegetables and simmer 10 minutes. Continue simmering while packing one hot sterilized jar at a time. Fill to within 1/8-inch from jar top. Make sure liquid covers vegetables. Seal each jar at once. Process in boiling water bath (212u00b0F) for 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 pints. Use relish within 6 months.

recipes.title: Cornbread Muffins
directions: Sift corn meal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt together. Beat egg lightly and add oil and milk. Add dry ingredients to liquid and stir well. Pour batter into muffin pans, approximately 2/3 full. Bake in a 400u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Cornbread Muffins. Sift corn meal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt together. Beat egg lightly and add oil and milk. Add dry ingredients to liquid and stir well. Pour batter into muffin pans, approximately 2/3 full. Bake in a 400u00b0 oven for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pockets Of Reuben
ingredients: 4 pita pocket breads (white or whole wheat)
directions: Combine milk and mayonnaise.
Blend well.
Add remaining ingredients, except bread.
Mix lightly.
Cut breads in half crosswise.
Open each half to form pocket.
Spoon filling into pockets.
Arrange upright in baking pan or for microwaving, on glass serving tray.
Cover with foil and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or microwave on High, uncovered, for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes or until filling is heated, rotating plate once.
recipes.text: Pockets Of Reuben. Combine milk and mayonnaise. Blend well. Add remaining ingredients, except bread. Mix lightly. Cut breads in half crosswise. Open each half to form pocket. Spoon filling into pockets. Arrange upright in baking pan or for microwaving, on glass serving tray. Cover with foil and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or microwave on High, uncovered, for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes or until filling is heated, rotating plate once.

recipes.title: Orange Apples
directions: Cut the apples into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Prepare bread cubes with melted 1/2 stick butter and brown sugar.
Sprinkle bread over the apples equally.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Orange Apples. Cut the apples into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Prepare bread cubes with melted 1/2 stick butter and brown sugar. Sprinkle bread over the apples equally. Set aside.

recipes.title: Chicken (Turkey) Crunch Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 c. cooked chicken or turkey
1 c. sliced fresh or canned mushrooms
1 can undiluted cream of chicken soup
directions: In large bowl mix everything but topping.
Place mixture in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
recipes.text: Chicken (Turkey) Crunch Casserole. In large bowl mix everything but topping. Place mixture in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.

recipes.title: Eleanore Alborano'S Microwave Scalloped Potatoes
directions: In a 4-cup glass measure, melt butter in microwave 1 minute on High.
Stir in flour.
Gradually add milk, salt and pepper.
Stir until smooth.
Heat 6 to 7 minutes on power level 7 until sauce is smooth, stirring twice.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, mix the potatoes and onion.
Add sauce.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Slice a cut in the plastic.
Microwave on power 7 for 35 minutes.
Makes about 6 servings.
recipes.text: Eleanore Alborano'S Microwave Scalloped Potatoes. In a 4-cup glass measure, melt butter in microwave 1 minute on High. Stir in flour. Gradually add milk, salt and pepper. Stir until smooth. Heat 6 to 7 minutes on power level 7 until sauce is smooth, stirring twice. In a 2-quart casserole dish, mix the potatoes and onion. Add sauce. Cover with plastic wrap. Slice a cut in the plastic. Microwave on power 7 for 35 minutes. Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. light brown sugar, packed tight
4 slices soft white bread, well buttered and cut in cubes
directions: Put sugar in top of double boiler with 1 tablespoon butter. Add the cubed bread (buttered). Combine eggs, milk, salt and vanilla, separately and beat well. Pour over bread in double boiler but do not stir. Cook over hot boiling water for 1 hour. The brown sugar and butter makes a delicious sauce.
No other sweetening is needed. Serve with whipped cream, if you wish. Makes 4 or 5 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Bread Pudding. Put sugar in top of double boiler with 1 tablespoon butter. Add the cubed bread (buttered). Combine eggs, milk, salt and vanilla, separately and beat well. Pour over bread in double boiler but do not stir. Cook over hot boiling water for 1 hour. The brown sugar and butter makes a delicious sauce. No other sweetening is needed. Serve with whipped cream, if you wish. Makes 4 or 5 servings.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Saute onions and celery.
Mix soup, water and corn.
Add onions and celery.
Add cream cheese and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Add shrimp last few minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Saute onions and celery. Mix soup, water and corn. Add onions and celery. Add cream cheese and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Add shrimp last few minutes.

recipes.title: Dishpan Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
If dough is very stiff, add a small amount of milk.
The dough should look dry but should still hold together.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Dishpan Cookies. Mix all ingredients together. If dough is very stiff, add a small amount of milk. The dough should look dry but should still hold together. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Tamale Pie
directions: Brown beef. Add onion, green pepper and celery.
Cook 10 minutes.
Add sauce, corn and chili mix to the cooked mixture. Pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix corn bread as directed on package. Spread over top of mixture. Bake at 400u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Grate or sprinkle your favorite cheese over top.
Put back in oven to melt cheese.
recipes.text: Hot Tamale Pie. Brown beef. Add onion, green pepper and celery. Cook 10 minutes. Add sauce, corn and chili mix to the cooked mixture. Pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix corn bread as directed on package. Spread over top of mixture. Bake at 400u00b0 for 45 minutes. Grate or sprinkle your favorite cheese over top. Put back in oven to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Trifle
ingredients: 3 to 4 c. crumbled spice cake or gingerbread
4 (3.4 oz.) pkg. instant butterscotch pudding mix
directions: Set aside 1/4 to 1/2 cup cake crumbs for garnish.
Divide remaining crumbs into 4 portions.
Sprinkle 1 portion into bottom of trifle bowl or 3-quart serving bowl.
In mixing bowl, combine pumpkin, spices, milk and pudding; mix until smooth.
Spoon half into trifle bowl over cake crumbs.
Layer with second portion of cake crumbs.
Whip cream until stiff.
Spoon half over cake crumbs.
Sprinkle third portion of crumbs.
Top with remaining pumpkin mixture; then last portion of crumbs and remaining whipped cream.
Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top.
Garnish with cherries. Cover and chill.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Trifle. Set aside 1/4 to 1/2 cup cake crumbs for garnish. Divide remaining crumbs into 4 portions. Sprinkle 1 portion into bottom of trifle bowl or 3-quart serving bowl. In mixing bowl, combine pumpkin, spices, milk and pudding; mix until smooth. Spoon half into trifle bowl over cake crumbs. Layer with second portion of cake crumbs. Whip cream until stiff. Spoon half over cake crumbs. Sprinkle third portion of crumbs. Top with remaining pumpkin mixture; then last portion of crumbs and remaining whipped cream. Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top. Garnish with cherries. Cover and chill.

recipes.title: Fried Green Beans
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. Crisco or 1/2 Crisco and 1/2 margarine
1/2 c. flour or a little more
directions: Drain green beans well.
Add to medium hot skillet with the Crisco.
Sprinkle flour
over
top of beans.
Add salt and pepper. Turn
easy,
so as to not break beans.
Let flour get brown and crisp
over
beans.
Fry only until beans and flour are hot and most of flour is brown.
recipes.text: Fried Green Beans. Drain green beans well. Add to medium hot skillet with the Crisco. Sprinkle flour over top of beans. Add salt and pepper. Turn easy, so as to not break beans. Let flour get brown and crisp over beans. Fry only until beans and flour are hot and most of flour is brown.

recipes.title: Lunch Box Surprises(Child-Approved)
directions: When school starts in the fall, make the transition easier for your kids, especially the younger ones, with special lunch box surprises.
It's a nice treat to continue throughout the year, too!
recipes.text: Lunch Box Surprises(Child-Approved). When school starts in the fall, make the transition easier for your kids, especially the younger ones, with special lunch box surprises. It's a nice treat to continue throughout the year, too!

recipes.title: Easy Lemon Chicken Appetizers
directions: In a large skillet, brown chicken in oil.
Pour off fat.
Add gravy, lemon juice, crushed thyme and vegetables to skillet. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until done.
Spoon into pastry shells and serve.
recipes.text: Easy Lemon Chicken Appetizers. In a large skillet, brown chicken in oil. Pour off fat. Add gravy, lemon juice, crushed thyme and vegetables to skillet. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until done. Spoon into pastry shells and serve.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can unsweetened frozen orange juice, thawed
directions: Finely crush crackers; add butter and sugar.
Press mixture into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish.
Reserve some crumbs for garnish. Blend orange juice and milk in a bowl.
Stir in Cool Whip and oranges.
Fold in, do not beat.
Pour mixture over crumb crust. Top with reserved crumbs.
Refrigerate before serving.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Salad. Finely crush crackers; add butter and sugar. Press mixture into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish. Reserve some crumbs for garnish. Blend orange juice and milk in a bowl. Stir in Cool Whip and oranges. Fold in, do not beat. Pour mixture over crumb crust. Top with reserved crumbs. Refrigerate before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. milk, mixed with 1/2 tsp. vinegar
directions: In large bowl, combine sugars, margarine and vegetable oil. Beat until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Add vanilla and soured milk; beat until smooth.
Sift flour, cocoa, baking soda, allspice and cinnamon together and add gradually to mixture, beating until smooth.
Fold in zucchini, chocolate bits and nuts.
Beat until well incorporated.
recipes.text: Chocolate Zucchini Cake. In large bowl, combine sugars, margarine and vegetable oil. Beat until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Add vanilla and soured milk; beat until smooth. Sift flour, cocoa, baking soda, allspice and cinnamon together and add gradually to mixture, beating until smooth. Fold in zucchini, chocolate bits and nuts. Beat until well incorporated.

recipes.title: Delicious Zucchini Casserole
directions: Cook zucchini in salted water until tender. Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Delicious Zucchini Casserole. Cook zucchini in salted water until tender. Preheat oven to 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix together.
Form balls the size of walnuts and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix together. Form balls the size of walnuts and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Sunday Corn Bread
directions: Mix well. Bake in 9-inch pan or skillet about 40 minutes or until golden brown. Bake at 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Sunday Corn Bread. Mix well. Bake in 9-inch pan or skillet about 40 minutes or until golden brown. Bake at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Combine sugar, butter, cocoa and milk.
Boil for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and oats. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Combine sugar, butter, cocoa and milk. Boil for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and oats. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0 in greased casserole dish, covered with foil.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Combine. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350u00b0 in greased casserole dish, covered with foil.

recipes.title: Lemon Torte
directions: This dessert has 4 layers. For the first layer, combine oleo, flour and chopped nuts.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.
recipes.text: Lemon Torte. This dessert has 4 layers. For the first layer, combine oleo, flour and chopped nuts. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Hunks
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and vanilla.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Drop and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Hunks. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and vanilla. Mix in remaining ingredients. Drop and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Deluxe Banana Nut Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients 3 times.
Blend sugar and butter.
Beat in eggs and bananas.
Gradually add dry ingredients, mixing well after each addition.
Add vanilla and lemon juice and beat 2 minutes longer.
Fold in nuts, 3/4 by hand.
Pour batter in a greased pan.
Sprinkle remaining nuts on top of loaf and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Deluxe Banana Nut Bread. Sift dry ingredients 3 times. Blend sugar and butter. Beat in eggs and bananas. Gradually add dry ingredients, mixing well after each addition. Add vanilla and lemon juice and beat 2 minutes longer. Fold in nuts, 3/4 by hand. Pour batter in a greased pan. Sprinkle remaining nuts on top of loaf and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Cheddar Corn Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. plain yogurt or sour cream
directions: In a bowl, combine the corn bread mix, eggs, milk and yogurt until blended.
Stir in corn and cheese.
Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 18 to 22 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
Cut into squares.
Serve warm.
Yield: 12 servings.
recipes.text: Cheddar Corn Bread. In a bowl, combine the corn bread mix, eggs, milk and yogurt until blended. Stir in corn and cheese. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 400u00b0 for 18 to 22 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cut into squares. Serve warm. Yield: 12 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Swiss Rye Bread
directions: Set aside 1 cup flour.
recipes.text: Easy Swiss Rye Bread. Set aside 1 cup flour.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix together well; roll into small balls.
Place in baking pan.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix together well; roll into small balls. Place in baking pan. Bake at 375u00b0 for 13 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Macaroons
directions: Melt milk and chocolate; add coconut and vanilla.
Drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 12 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chocolate Macaroons. Melt milk and chocolate; add coconut and vanilla. Drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 12 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Fish
ingredients: paprika, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Fork blend egg and oil together.
Dip fish first into the egg mixture, then lightly in crumbs.
Spray nonstick cooking spray onto baking dish.
Arrange fish in single layer.
Salt, pepper and paprika to taste.
Bake in preheated oven at 475u00b0 for 10 minutes, without turning.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Fish. Fork blend egg and oil together. Dip fish first into the egg mixture, then lightly in crumbs. Spray nonstick cooking spray onto baking dish. Arrange fish in single layer. Salt, pepper and paprika to taste. Bake in preheated oven at 475u00b0 for 10 minutes, without turning.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
directions: Unroll canned rolls and press flat on cookie sheet.
Bake at 400u00b0 for about 10 minutes, until crust is all brown.
Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth; add dressing mix to mixture. Spread mixture on crust.
Top with sliced or chopped vegetables. Add grated cheese last.
recipes.text: Veggie Pizza. Unroll canned rolls and press flat on cookie sheet. Bake at 400u00b0 for about 10 minutes, until crust is all brown. Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth; add dressing mix to mixture. Spread mixture on crust. Top with sliced or chopped vegetables. Add grated cheese last.

recipes.title: Calamity
directions: Fry bacon and drain on paper towel. Fry potatoes, onion and green pepper in excess bacon grease. When potatoes are ready, add eggs and spices. Cook until eggs are done. Sprinkle bacon on top and serve.
recipes.text: Calamity. Fry bacon and drain on paper towel. Fry potatoes, onion and green pepper in excess bacon grease. When potatoes are ready, add eggs and spices. Cook until eggs are done. Sprinkle bacon on top and serve.

recipes.title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 red onion, sliced and rings separated
directions: Combine first five ingredients and set aside.
Combine oil and next five ingredients, whisking until dressing homogenizes.
Pour over vegetables and toss to coat well.
With a slotted spoon, mound on Boston lettuce or curly endive.
Garnish with chopped pimento.
This also looks pretty in a crystal bowl with the pimento mixed into the salad.
recipes.text: Cauliflower And Broccoli Salad. Combine first five ingredients and set aside. Combine oil and next five ingredients, whisking until dressing homogenizes. Pour over vegetables and toss to coat well. With a slotted spoon, mound on Boston lettuce or curly endive. Garnish with chopped pimento. This also looks pretty in a crystal bowl with the pimento mixed into the salad.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine sugar with milk.
Cook to soft ball stage.
Remove from heat.
Quickly add marshmallow cream, peanut butter and vanilla.
Combine until mixed well.
Pour into 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan and cool.
recipes.text: Easy Peanut Butter Fudge. Combine sugar with milk. Cook to soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Quickly add marshmallow cream, peanut butter and vanilla. Combine until mixed well. Pour into 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan and cool.

recipes.title: Minnie'S Applesauce Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients together into large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Put into greased and floured pan. Bake at 375u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Minnie'S Applesauce Cake. Sift dry ingredients together into large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Put into greased and floured pan. Bake at 375u00b0 for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Scramble
directions: Pour pretzels, dry cereal and nuts into a large roaster. Heat butter, sauce and salt
in sauce pan over low heat.
Pour over dry mixture and mix well.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Stir occasionally.
Drain on paper towel until cool.
Store in tins.
Indefinite shelf life.
recipes.text: Scramble. Pour pretzels, dry cereal and nuts into a large roaster. Heat butter, sauce and salt in sauce pan over low heat. Pour over dry mixture and mix well. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Stir occasionally. Drain on paper towel until cool. Store in tins. Indefinite shelf life.

recipes.title: Marinated Shrimp
directions: If a
large amount of shrimp is used, other ingredients will need to be increased or doubled.
Keep everything refrigerated while waiting for flavors to mix and marinate shrimp.
recipes.text: Marinated Shrimp. If a large amount of shrimp is used, other ingredients will need to be increased or doubled. Keep everything refrigerated while waiting for flavors to mix and marinate shrimp.

recipes.title: Northern Potato Salad
directions: Boil eggs and potatoes.
Let cool and peel.
Then cut up potatoes in medium size cubes and cut eggs into very small pieces. Then cut celery into small pieces.
Slice radishes very thin. Put all of these together and add salt, pepper, paprika, mustard, vinegar and Miracle Whip.
Mix together.
Chill 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 12.
recipes.text: Northern Potato Salad. Boil eggs and potatoes. Let cool and peel. Then cut up potatoes in medium size cubes and cut eggs into very small pieces. Then cut celery into small pieces. Slice radishes very thin. Put all of these together and add salt, pepper, paprika, mustard, vinegar and Miracle Whip. Mix together. Chill 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 12.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
directions: Mix flour and baking soda. Combine butter, sugars, pudding mix, and vanilla in a large mixing bowl. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs; add flour mixture then stir in chips and nuts. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies. Mix flour and baking soda. Combine butter, sugars, pudding mix, and vanilla in a large mixing bowl. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs; add flour mixture then stir in chips and nuts. Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Defrost hash brown patties and crumble them in 9 x 13-inch pan, about 3/4 to 1-inch deep.
Brown the sausage and spread over the hash browns.
Grate or shred the cheese and spread over sausage.
Beat eggs with milk and pour over cheese layer.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 400u00b0 until bubbly, about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Defrost hash brown patties and crumble them in 9 x 13-inch pan, about 3/4 to 1-inch deep. Brown the sausage and spread over the hash browns. Grate or shred the cheese and spread over sausage. Beat eggs with milk and pour over cheese layer. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 400u00b0 until bubbly, about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cut up and cook a pack of boneless chicken breast. Use all low fat soups and cheese to cut fat grams and calories. Add all ingredients together. Let simmer for few minutes. Serve with bread and salad. Can be frozen.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Cut up and cook a pack of boneless chicken breast. Use all low fat soups and cheese to cut fat grams and calories. Add all ingredients together. Let simmer for few minutes. Serve with bread and salad. Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Five Pound Fudge
ingredients: 1 (13 oz.) bar sweet or milk chocolate, grated
directions: Combine in heavy 4-quart saucepan butter, sugar and evaporated milk.
Boil 5 1/2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add marshmallow cream, chocolate and vanilla.
Beat well until mixed.
Add walnuts, coarsely chopped.
Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool until firm and cut.
Makes 5 pounds of fudge that never fails.
recipes.text: Five Pound Fudge. Combine in heavy 4-quart saucepan butter, sugar and evaporated milk. Boil 5 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and add marshmallow cream, chocolate and vanilla. Beat well until mixed. Add walnuts, coarsely chopped. Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool until firm and cut. Makes 5 pounds of fudge that never fails.

recipes.title: Peach Apricot Cobbler(Makes 8 Servings)
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
In a medium saucepan, mix together sugar and cornstarch.
Stir in 1/2 cup each of reserved peach and apricot juices.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens, 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in butter, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add peaches and apricots.
Spoon fruit mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
recipes.text: Peach Apricot Cobbler(Makes 8 Servings). Preheat oven to 400u00b0. In a medium saucepan, mix together sugar and cornstarch. Stir in 1/2 cup each of reserved peach and apricot juices. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens, 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in butter, cinnamon and nutmeg. Add peaches and apricots. Spoon fruit mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.

recipes.title: Pecan Roll
directions: Crumble vanilla wafers real fine and mix all ingredients together.
Roll in wax paper and refrigerate.
Slice as needed.
recipes.text: Pecan Roll. Crumble vanilla wafers real fine and mix all ingredients together. Roll in wax paper and refrigerate. Slice as needed.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Cream Bagel Spread
directions: Combine cream cheese and white chocolate into a small bowl. Stir in chocolate chips.
recipes.text: Chocolate-Cream Bagel Spread. Combine cream cheese and white chocolate into a small bowl. Stir in chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Buffet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
directions: Combine all ingredients except potatoes.
Heat until cheese is melted and all ingredients are mixed together.
Pour over potatoes and blend.
Pour the mixed ingredients into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour until bubbly.
Use as a side dish or add ham for a main dish.
recipes.text: Buffet Potato Casserole. Combine all ingredients except potatoes. Heat until cheese is melted and all ingredients are mixed together. Pour over potatoes and blend. Pour the mixed ingredients into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour until bubbly. Use as a side dish or add ham for a main dish.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Chop chicken; add onion, cheese, chicken noodle soup, cream of mushroom soup, Rice-A-Roni plus seasoning packet in rice and 1/2 cup broth.
Mix well.
Pour in casserole dish and bake for 1 hour at 325u00b0.
Top with can of onion rings (optional).
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Chop chicken; add onion, cheese, chicken noodle soup, cream of mushroom soup, Rice-A-Roni plus seasoning packet in rice and 1/2 cup broth. Mix well. Pour in casserole dish and bake for 1 hour at 325u00b0. Top with can of onion rings (optional).

recipes.title: Sausage Bread
directions: Fry sausage until done, (drain), roll out dough.
recipes.text: Sausage Bread. Fry sausage until done, (drain), roll out dough.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding mix with milk until smooth and thickened.
Stir in Eagle Brand milk and whipped topping.
Add lemon juice.
Layer bananas with vanilla wafers in large bowl.
Pour pudding mixture over all.
Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Mix pudding mix with milk until smooth and thickened. Stir in Eagle Brand milk and whipped topping. Add lemon juice. Layer bananas with vanilla wafers in large bowl. Pour pudding mixture over all. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free, Fat-Free Lemon Icebox Pie
ingredients: 1 regular pkg. sugar-free vanilla instant pudding mix
directions: Mix all of this together with the help of a mixer, then fold in 1/2 tub of lite Cool Whip.
Mix good and put into graham cracker pie crust.
Chill.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free, Fat-Free Lemon Icebox Pie. Mix all of this together with the help of a mixer, then fold in 1/2 tub of lite Cool Whip. Mix good and put into graham cracker pie crust. Chill.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Jelly(You Would Think It Is Raspberry By Taste And Appearance.)
ingredients: 5 c. green chopped tomatoes, chopped fine
6 oz. jello (raspberry is best, but any flavor is O.K.)
directions: Boil the chopped tomatoes and sugar for 30 minutes until mush. Add the jello; mix well.
Pour into jars.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Jelly(You Would Think It Is Raspberry By Taste And Appearance.). Boil the chopped tomatoes and sugar for 30 minutes until mush. Add the jello; mix well. Pour into jars.

recipes.title: Green Chili Cornbread
directions: In small bowl combine first 6 ingredients and cumin. Mix well. In medium bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Set aside.
Beat egg yolk in separate bowl until frothy.
Stir in warm water and oil.
Mix yolk mixture into dry ingredients.
Beat vigorously for 30 seconds.
Fold cornmeal mixture into egg whites with whisk.
Add corn and chili. Pour into 8 x 2-inch baking pan and sprinkle lightly with additional cornmeal.
Bake 20 minutes at 425u00b0.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Green Chili Cornbread. In small bowl combine first 6 ingredients and cumin. Mix well. In medium bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Set aside. Beat egg yolk in separate bowl until frothy. Stir in warm water and oil. Mix yolk mixture into dry ingredients. Beat vigorously for 30 seconds. Fold cornmeal mixture into egg whites with whisk. Add corn and chili. Pour into 8 x 2-inch baking pan and sprinkle lightly with additional cornmeal. Bake 20 minutes at 425u00b0. Serve warm.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 qt. beef and chicken broth combined
directions: Peel, wash and thinly slice onions.
Saute in butter and oil over low heat, uncovered.
Sprinkle with salt.
Cook for 20 or 30 minutes, stirring occasionally (until golden brown).
Sprinkle and stir in flour and allow to cook slowly for 2 or 3 minutes while stirring.
Add the onion mixture to beef and chicken broth. Simmer partially uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes.
While soup is cooking prepare bread.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. Peel, wash and thinly slice onions. Saute in butter and oil over low heat, uncovered. Sprinkle with salt. Cook for 20 or 30 minutes, stirring occasionally (until golden brown). Sprinkle and stir in flour and allow to cook slowly for 2 or 3 minutes while stirring. Add the onion mixture to beef and chicken broth. Simmer partially uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes. While soup is cooking prepare bread.

recipes.title: Homemade Noodles
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. half and half or Milnot
directions: Combine ingredients and form into a ball.
Do not knead. Divide into 2 parts.
Roll each part on lightly floured surface until thin.
Dry 10 minutes.
Cut into strips of desired width and length.
Have seasoned broth ready and bring to a boil.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Pieces of chicken or other meat may be added if you like.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Homemade Noodles. Combine ingredients and form into a ball. Do not knead. Divide into 2 parts. Roll each part on lightly floured surface until thin. Dry 10 minutes. Cut into strips of desired width and length. Have seasoned broth ready and bring to a boil. Add noodles and cook until tender. Pieces of chicken or other meat may be added if you like. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Cream Corn
directions: Shuck and silk corn.
Cut corn off cob and scrape cob.
Place water and sugar in large saucepan.
Add corn and simmer for 20 minutes.
Ready to serve.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Cream Corn. Shuck and silk corn. Cut corn off cob and scrape cob. Place water and sugar in large saucepan. Add corn and simmer for 20 minutes. Ready to serve.

recipes.title: Ham And Potato Casserole
directions: Mix the sour cream, soup, milk, parsley and 1 cup of the cheese together.
Salt and pepper ham and potatoes.
Add to the sour cream mixture.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Ham And Potato Casserole. Mix the sour cream, soup, milk, parsley and 1 cup of the cheese together. Salt and pepper ham and potatoes. Add to the sour cream mixture. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Monterey Bake
directions: Combine rice, sour cream, milk, salt, green chilies and 1/2 cup cheese.
Mix well.
Spoon into a buttered, shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Monterey Bake. Combine rice, sour cream, milk, salt, green chilies and 1/2 cup cheese. Mix well. Spoon into a buttered, shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Tartar Sauce. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Salad
directions: Combine
the first 8 ingredients.
Mix together the soups, salad dressing and Amaretto.
Combine with chicken mixture.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Salad. Combine the first 8 ingredients. Mix together the soups, salad dressing and Amaretto. Combine with chicken mixture.

recipes.title: Cranberry Nut Bread
directions: Cream sugar and oil together.
Add eggs and cranberry sauce. Mix well.
Sift together the dry ingredients.
Add dry ingredients alternately with water.
Pour into two well-greased and floured loaf pans.
(I use the small pans, and it will make 7 loaves.) Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done.
Let stand 10 minutes before removing from pan.
recipes.text: Cranberry Nut Bread. Cream sugar and oil together. Add eggs and cranberry sauce. Mix well. Sift together the dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients alternately with water. Pour into two well-greased and floured loaf pans. (I use the small pans, and it will make 7 loaves.) Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until tests done. Let stand 10 minutes before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Hello Dollies
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Layer ingredients in order.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Hello Dollies. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer ingredients in order. Bake at 325u00b0 for 20 minutes. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Out-Of-This-World Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.
Combine eggs, shortening, sugar, softened yeast, remaining warm water, salt and 2 1/2 cups flour; beat until smooth.
Add enough remaining flour to make soft dough.
Cover; allow to rise until double.
Punch down and place in refrigerator overnight.
Three hours before baking, roll out as desired.
Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen rolls.
recipes.text: Out-Of-This-World Rolls. Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Combine eggs, shortening, sugar, softened yeast, remaining warm water, salt and 2 1/2 cups flour; beat until smooth. Add enough remaining flour to make soft dough. Cover; allow to rise until double. Punch down and place in refrigerator overnight. Three hours before baking, roll out as desired. Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen rolls.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained
directions: Cook and drain lima beans and broccoli. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Put in a casserole bowl. Crush 2 1/2 cups Rice Chex and sprinkle on top. Melt 1 stick of butter. Pour over the top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or so.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Cook and drain lima beans and broccoli. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Put in a casserole bowl. Crush 2 1/2 cups Rice Chex and sprinkle on top. Melt 1 stick of butter. Pour over the top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or so.

recipes.title: Chicken Delight
directions: Season chicken after it is cut up. Fry until brown. Place chicken in a casserole dish. Put the bread crumbs over the chicken. Put the can of cream of chicken soup and a can of water into a bowl and mix very well. Pour over chicken and bread crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Delight. Season chicken after it is cut up. Fry until brown. Place chicken in a casserole dish. Put the bread crumbs over the chicken. Put the can of cream of chicken soup and a can of water into a bowl and mix very well. Pour over chicken and bread crumbs. Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.

recipes.title: 1015 Surprise Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. grated Swiss cheese, divided use
3/4 c. light cream or half and half
1 c. crushed saltine crackers, divided use
directions: Melt 1/4 cup butter in large skillet and saute onions until tender.
Place half the onions in 1 1/2-quart deep dish pie pan. Sprinkle 1 cup Swiss cheese and 1/2 cup cracker crumbs over onions.
Repeat layers of onions and cheese.
recipes.text: 1015 Surprise Casserole. Melt 1/4 cup butter in large skillet and saute onions until tender. Place half the onions in 1 1/2-quart deep dish pie pan. Sprinkle 1 cup Swiss cheese and 1/2 cup cracker crumbs over onions. Repeat layers of onions and cheese.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill in covered container.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Chill in covered container.

recipes.title: John'S Homemade Pizza
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Stir in remaining ingredients. Beat vigorously and then knead.
Let the dough rest for 5 minutes. Then pat and spread the dough on a lightly greased cookie sheet or pizza pan.
Spread with your favorite pizza sauce and toppings. Bake at 425u00b0 about 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: John'S Homemade Pizza. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in remaining ingredients. Beat vigorously and then knead. Let the dough rest for 5 minutes. Then pat and spread the dough on a lightly greased cookie sheet or pizza pan. Spread with your favorite pizza sauce and toppings. Bake at 425u00b0 about 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
directions: Melt butter in boiling water in saucepan.
Turn heat low and add flour and salt all at once, stirring vigorously, until mixture leaves sides of pan in a smooth, compact mass.
Remove from heat. Quickly beat in eggs, one at a time, beating mixture until smooth and stiff.
Drop by heaping tablespoons 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet, shaping into rounds with point in center, using a wet spoon.
Bake at 450u00b0 for 5 minutes, then at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Fill with whipped cream or pudding.
recipes.text: Cream Puffs. Melt butter in boiling water in saucepan. Turn heat low and add flour and salt all at once, stirring vigorously, until mixture leaves sides of pan in a smooth, compact mass. Remove from heat. Quickly beat in eggs, one at a time, beating mixture until smooth and stiff. Drop by heaping tablespoons 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet, shaping into rounds with point in center, using a wet spoon. Bake at 450u00b0 for 5 minutes, then at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes. Fill with whipped cream or pudding.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook chopped broccoli for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Add and mix with broccoli all the listed ingredients.
Cover with Pepperidge Farm herb dressing/stuffing.
Dot with butter.
Bake uncovered at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook chopped broccoli for 5 minutes. Drain. Add and mix with broccoli all the listed ingredients. Cover with Pepperidge Farm herb dressing/stuffing. Dot with butter. Bake uncovered at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Lime Pickles
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Soak overnight in large crock. Rinse and put in clean water for 3 hours.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Soak in mixture overnight.
Boil for 30 minutes. Seal in jars.
recipes.text: Lime Pickles. Combine first 3 ingredients. Soak overnight in large crock. Rinse and put in clean water for 3 hours. Combine remaining ingredients. Soak in mixture overnight. Boil for 30 minutes. Seal in jars.

recipes.title: Instant Spice Tea
directions: Mix together.
Add 4 to 6 teaspoons to a cup of very hot water.
recipes.text: Instant Spice Tea. Mix together. Add 4 to 6 teaspoons to a cup of very hot water.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ground beef or pork sausage
directions: In Dutch oven cook ground beef or sausage, onion, green pepper and garlic until meat is browned and vegetables are tender.
Drain off fat.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, brown sugar, oregano, basil, thyme, bay leaf, 2 cups water and 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil; reduce heat.
Simmer, uncovered, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until desired consistency, stirring occasionally.
Remove bay leaf.
Serve with spaghetti.
Use grated Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. In Dutch oven cook ground beef or sausage, onion, green pepper and garlic until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain off fat. Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, brown sugar, oregano, basil, thyme, bay leaf, 2 cups water and 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until desired consistency, stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaf. Serve with spaghetti. Use grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: German Style Beans
directions: Heat oven to 375u00b0.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in pan.
Crumble bacon and set aside.
Saute onion in drippings until tender.
Combine all ingredients in 3-quart casserole.
Bake 30 minutes or until heated through.
recipes.text: German Style Beans. Heat oven to 375u00b0. Fry bacon until crisp. Reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in pan. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute onion in drippings until tender. Combine all ingredients in 3-quart casserole. Bake 30 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Take Along Baked Beans
ingredients: 6 Bacon Slices, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
directions: Cook bacon, onion rings and green pepper until tender; drain. Combine all ingredients in a 2 qt. casserole.
recipes.text: Take Along Baked Beans. Cook bacon, onion rings and green pepper until tender; drain. Combine all ingredients in a 2 qt. casserole.

recipes.title: Beef Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients together; shape into patties.
recipes.text: Beef Patties. Mix all ingredients together; shape into patties.

recipes.title: Lima Beans In Sour Cream
directions: Soak beans overnight.
Drain.
Cover with fresh water and cook until tender.
Mix rest of ingredients adding sour cream last. One tablespoon molasses may be added.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated for several days.
recipes.text: Lima Beans In Sour Cream. Soak beans overnight. Drain. Cover with fresh water and cook until tender. Mix rest of ingredients adding sour cream last. One tablespoon molasses may be added. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated for several days.

recipes.title: Brunch Recipe
directions: Put first 3 ingredients in an 8 x 13-inch pan.
Blend together eggs, milk and dry mustard.
Pour on top of bread mixture.
(Can be mixed the night before and kept refrigerated.)
recipes.text: Brunch Recipe. Put first 3 ingredients in an 8 x 13-inch pan. Blend together eggs, milk and dry mustard. Pour on top of bread mixture. (Can be mixed the night before and kept refrigerated.)

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Into a large bowl, measure all the ingredients.
With mixer at medium speed, beat until well mixed, occasionally scraping bowl. Shape dough into ball; wrap with waxed paper.
Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours until easy to handle.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Into a large bowl, measure all the ingredients. With mixer at medium speed, beat until well mixed, occasionally scraping bowl. Shape dough into ball; wrap with waxed paper. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours until easy to handle.

recipes.title: Mike'S Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 to 3/4 lb. raw shrimp, cut into bite size pieces
directions: Wipe mushrooms off with paper towel to clean.
Scoop out inside of mushroom (everything) and reserve it.
Create a hollow. Chop up insides of mushrooms; mix with bread crumbs, melted butter, 3/4 of the cut up shrimp and salt and pepper.
(A few more bread crumbs may be needed to form a solid ball.)
Form into ball and gently press into hollow of mushroom.
Place a few reserved shrimp (whole) on top of a few mushrooms.
Place in baking pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes or until whole shrimp turn pink.
recipes.text: Mike'S Stuffed Mushrooms. Wipe mushrooms off with paper towel to clean. Scoop out inside of mushroom (everything) and reserve it. Create a hollow. Chop up insides of mushrooms; mix with bread crumbs, melted butter, 3/4 of the cut up shrimp and salt and pepper. (A few more bread crumbs may be needed to form a solid ball.) Form into ball and gently press into hollow of mushroom. Place a few reserved shrimp (whole) on top of a few mushrooms. Place in baking pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 25 minutes or until whole shrimp turn pink.

recipes.title: Five Cup Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruits, mix all except marshmallows.
Chill until serving time.
Stir in marshmallows just before serving.
recipes.text: Five Cup Fruit Salad. Drain fruits, mix all except marshmallows. Chill until serving time. Stir in marshmallows just before serving.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Cream together margaine, vanilla, and sugars.
Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon.
Add to first mixture and mix thoroughly.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Drop on greased cookie sheets by teaspoonfuls.
Bake at 350 F till light brown.
recipes.text: Cowboy Cookies. Cream together margaine, vanilla, and sugars. Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon. Add to first mixture and mix thoroughly. Fold in remaining ingredients. Drop on greased cookie sheets by teaspoonfuls. Bake at 350 F till light brown.

recipes.title: Oklahoma Fruit Pie
directions: Mix well and pour in an unbaked pie shell.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 300u00b0.
Cool, then top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Oklahoma Fruit Pie. Mix well and pour in an unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 300u00b0. Cool, then top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Potato Wedges
directions: Preheat oven to 425u00b0.
In a small saucepan over low heat, melt butter.
Remove from heat and stir in catsup, mustard, paprika and salt until well mixed.
Cut each potato into 4 wedges.
Slash each wedge crosswise at 1/4-inch intervals, but do not cut through skin.
recipes.text: Potato Wedges. Preheat oven to 425u00b0. In a small saucepan over low heat, melt butter. Remove from heat and stir in catsup, mustard, paprika and salt until well mixed. Cut each potato into 4 wedges. Slash each wedge crosswise at 1/4-inch intervals, but do not cut through skin.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Boil cabbage and onions until done; drain.
Melt cheese and half stick margarine.
Pour on cabbage; stir well.
Put in dish and pour other half butter over cabbage.
Crumble crackers on top. Cook until good and hot and cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Boil cabbage and onions until done; drain. Melt cheese and half stick margarine. Pour on cabbage; stir well. Put in dish and pour other half butter over cabbage. Crumble crackers on top. Cook until good and hot and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes(Plain)
directions: Flavor to taste.
Roll thin and bake in a low oven (275u00b0 to 300u00b0).
recipes.text: Tea Cakes(Plain). Flavor to taste. Roll thin and bake in a low oven (275u00b0 to 300u00b0).

recipes.title: Deluxe Potato Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except margarine and cornflakes in a casserole dish.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
Sprinkle cornflakes on top of casserole and pour melted margarine over top.
Place in oven again and bake an additional 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Deluxe Potato Casserole. Combine all ingredients except margarine and cornflakes in a casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0. Sprinkle cornflakes on top of casserole and pour melted margarine over top. Place in oven again and bake an additional 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
directions: Cut steak in small strips.
Sprinkle with tenderizer and let stand 10 minutes.
Place in foil.
Sprinkle with salt, garlic salt and pepper.
Sprinkle dry gravy mix over steak.
Add onion and green pepper.
Dot with butter.
Wrap with foil.
Bake for 20 minutes in hot oven at 425u00b0.
Turn oven down to 350u00b0 and bake for 1 hour longer.
recipes.text: Pepper Steak. Cut steak in small strips. Sprinkle with tenderizer and let stand 10 minutes. Place in foil. Sprinkle with salt, garlic salt and pepper. Sprinkle dry gravy mix over steak. Add onion and green pepper. Dot with butter. Wrap with foil. Bake for 20 minutes in hot oven at 425u00b0. Turn oven down to 350u00b0 and bake for 1 hour longer.

recipes.title: Orange Balls
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can thawed and undiluted frozen orange juice concentrate
directions: Crush vanilla wafers.
Add remaining ingredients except coconut.
Form into balls.
Chill until firm.
Balls may be rolled in the flaked coconut immediately after shaping, if desired.
Makes 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Orange Balls. Crush vanilla wafers. Add remaining ingredients except coconut. Form into balls. Chill until firm. Balls may be rolled in the flaked coconut immediately after shaping, if desired. Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Corn Soup
ingredients: 10 ears corn (sweet, white corn the best), cooked and cut off the ears
directions: Cook chicken slowly in water and add salt 30 minutes before straining broth. Remove chicken from bones. Add the remaining ingredients to strained broth and chicken, and cook until tender.
recipes.text: Chicken Corn Soup. Cook chicken slowly in water and add salt 30 minutes before straining broth. Remove chicken from bones. Add the remaining ingredients to strained broth and chicken, and cook until tender.

recipes.title: Scandinavian Salad
directions: Drain vegetables.
Mix other ingredients.
Will keep in refrigerator.
Chill for at least 6 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Scandinavian Salad. Drain vegetables. Mix other ingredients. Will keep in refrigerator. Chill for at least 6 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar together well.
Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour gradually and blend alternating with milk when adding each cup of flour.
Pour cake into a tube pan and bake at 350u00b0 until done.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar together well. Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour gradually and blend alternating with milk when adding each cup of flour. Pour cake into a tube pan and bake at 350u00b0 until done.

recipes.title: Edna'S Buttermilk Fudge
directions: Let buttermilk and soda sit in black iron skillet for 15 minutes.
Add the sugar, butter and syrup and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and stir to keep from sticking.
When it reaches soft ball stage, add nuts.
Stir until well mixed and pour into buttered dish.
Cut when cool.
recipes.text: Edna'S Buttermilk Fudge. Let buttermilk and soda sit in black iron skillet for 15 minutes. Add the sugar, butter and syrup and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and stir to keep from sticking. When it reaches soft ball stage, add nuts. Stir until well mixed and pour into buttered dish. Cut when cool.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Custard
directions: Combine eggs, sweetener and pumpkin.
Blend well.
Add salt, spices and milk; mix well.
Pour into 8-inch pie pan.
Bake in a moderate 350u00b0 oven 50 to 60 minutes or until done.
Cut and serve like pie pieces, although it has no pastry crust.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Custard. Combine eggs, sweetener and pumpkin. Blend well. Add salt, spices and milk; mix well. Pour into 8-inch pie pan. Bake in a moderate 350u00b0 oven 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Cut and serve like pie pieces, although it has no pastry crust.

recipes.title: Peanut Cluster
directions: Melt in oven. Turn oven to 325u00b0 to warm. Then turn down to 200u00b0 before melting, stirring a few times. Remove from oven and add 15 ounces salted Spanish peanuts and 3 cups Rice Krispies. Spoon onto wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Cluster. Melt in oven. Turn oven to 325u00b0 to warm. Then turn down to 200u00b0 before melting, stirring a few times. Remove from oven and add 15 ounces salted Spanish peanuts and 3 cups Rice Krispies. Spoon onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash And Garlic
directions: Peel and chop butternut squash into medium-size pieces. Add canola oil to the bottom of a skillet or wok. When hot, add squash. Place a cover on the pan for a few minutes. Remove cover and continue sauteing until squash is fork-tender. Add minced garlic and saute until garlic changes color. Remove from the heat and smash the squash mixture lightly.
recipes.text: Butternut Squash And Garlic. Peel and chop butternut squash into medium-size pieces. Add canola oil to the bottom of a skillet or wok. When hot, add squash. Place a cover on the pan for a few minutes. Remove cover and continue sauteing until squash is fork-tender. Add minced garlic and saute until garlic changes color. Remove from the heat and smash the squash mixture lightly.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage until
tender.
Combine other ingredients, except cracker crumbs,
with drained cabbage.
Sprinkle garlic salt on top and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Cook cabbage until tender. Combine other ingredients, except cracker crumbs, with drained cabbage. Sprinkle garlic salt on top and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Date Cake With Chocolate(From A Little League Mother)
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together; mix well and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix melted margarine, 1 1/4 cups of sugar and eggs.
Add salt, 3/4 teaspoon
soda and flour which have been sifted; mix well.
Add date
mixture. Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle on top of mixture 1/2 cup of sugar, chocolate chips and nuts.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
A great potluck or picnic cake.
It needs no frosting.
recipes.text: Date Cake With Chocolate(From A Little League Mother). Mix the first 3 ingredients together; mix well and set aside. In a medium bowl, mix melted margarine, 1 1/4 cups of sugar and eggs. Add salt, 3/4 teaspoon soda and flour which have been sifted; mix well. Add date mixture. Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on top of mixture 1/2 cup of sugar, chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 325u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes. A great potluck or picnic cake. It needs no frosting.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Cook cake according to box directions.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Cake. Cook cake according to box directions.

recipes.title: Fruit Snow
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) cans frozen grape juice or fruit punch concentrate, thawed
12 oz. canned frozen apple juice concentrate, thawed
32 oz. bottle (4 c.) lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
directions: In a 2-quart nonmetal container, combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Cover and freeze.
To serve as snow cones, scoop frozen mixture into 5 ounce drink cups or spoon into dessert dishes. Yields 14 (1/2 cup).
recipes.text: Fruit Snow. In a 2-quart nonmetal container, combine all ingredients. Mix well. Cover and freeze. To serve as snow cones, scoop frozen mixture into 5 ounce drink cups or spoon into dessert dishes. Yields 14 (1/2 cup).

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. diced chicken, turkey or tuna
directions: Tear bread into pieces.
Put in bottom of baking dish.
Mix next five ingredients.
Put over bread.
Add bread for top.
Beat eggs and milk.
Pour over bread.
Cover with foil and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Remove from oven and spread 1 can mushroom soup over it.
Top with cheese and bake for 15 minutes without foil.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Tear bread into pieces. Put in bottom of baking dish. Mix next five ingredients. Put over bread. Add bread for top. Beat eggs and milk. Pour over bread. Cover with foil and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Remove from oven and spread 1 can mushroom soup over it. Top with cheese and bake for 15 minutes without foil.

recipes.title: Fruit And Cheese(Usa)
directions: Peel and slice apples, cut cheese into 1/2-inch strips. Alternate cheese and apples around the outside of a round serving plate.
Place crackers in center of plate.
recipes.text: Fruit And Cheese(Usa). Peel and slice apples, cut cheese into 1/2-inch strips. Alternate cheese and apples around the outside of a round serving plate. Place crackers in center of plate.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Sauce
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, flour and salt in a small saucepan.
Slowly add 1 cup boiling water and 1 tablespoon butter.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens.
Remove from heat. Add vanilla.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge Sauce. Mix sugar, cocoa, flour and salt in a small saucepan. Slowly add 1 cup boiling water and 1 tablespoon butter. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens. Remove from heat. Add vanilla.

recipes.title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine milk, butter and sugar, bringing to a 1 minute boil. Remove from stove, immediately adding oats, cocoa, vanilla and peanut butter.
Stir until mixture is thick.
Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper and let set.
recipes.text: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies. Combine milk, butter and sugar, bringing to a 1 minute boil. Remove from stove, immediately adding oats, cocoa, vanilla and peanut butter. Stir until mixture is thick. Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper and let set.

recipes.title: Blueberry Sauce
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch and nutmeg.
Gradually stir in boiling water.
Cook and stir until mixture thickens and boils.
Cook 2 minutes more.
Add fresh blueberries; return to boiling.
Remove from heat.
Stir in lemon juice; cool.
Makes 3 cups.
Serve over pancakes or ice cream.
May be doubled.
recipes.text: Blueberry Sauce. In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch and nutmeg. Gradually stir in boiling water. Cook and stir until mixture thickens and boils. Cook 2 minutes more. Add fresh blueberries; return to boiling. Remove from heat. Stir in lemon juice; cool. Makes 3 cups. Serve over pancakes or ice cream. May be doubled.

recipes.title: Never Fail Escalloped Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 small box Jiffy corn muffin mix
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in casserole dish for 1 hour at 350u00b0.
Excellent.
recipes.text: Never Fail Escalloped Corn Casserole. Combine all ingredients. Bake in casserole dish for 1 hour at 350u00b0. Excellent.

recipes.title: Jewish Apple Cake
directions: Grease and flour a 9-inch tube pan.
Slice apples.
Mix with 4 teaspoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.
Beat eggs.
Gradually beat in sugar, then oil. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Add to beaten mixture in small amounts, alternating with oil and orange juice. Pour 1/4 of batter into pan.
Arrange 1/3 of apples on top. Sprinkle with 1/3 of cinnamon mixture. Repeat layers using 1/4 of batter each time and half of the remaining apples.
Make last layer batter.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Jewish Apple Cake. Grease and flour a 9-inch tube pan. Slice apples. Mix with 4 teaspoons sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon. Beat eggs. Gradually beat in sugar, then oil. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Add to beaten mixture in small amounts, alternating with oil and orange juice. Pour 1/4 of batter into pan. Arrange 1/3 of apples on top. Sprinkle with 1/3 of cinnamon mixture. Repeat layers using 1/4 of batter each time and half of the remaining apples. Make last layer batter. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bar Classics
directions: In a medium bowl, stir together graham cracker crumbs, confectioners sugar, peanut butter and melted butter.
Press firmly into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt chocolate chips over a double boiler or in the microwave, stirring occasionally. Spread melted chocolate over the crumb crust.
Chill for about 5 minutes, then cut into bars before the chocolate is completely set, then chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bar Classics. In a medium bowl, stir together graham cracker crumbs, confectioners sugar, peanut butter and melted butter. Press firmly into the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate chips over a double boiler or in the microwave, stirring occasionally. Spread melted chocolate over the crumb crust. Chill for about 5 minutes, then cut into bars before the chocolate is completely set, then chill until ready to serve.
