recipes.title: Fudge
directions: Cook over medium heat until boiling.
Test by dropping a spoonful of mixture into cold water.
If soft balls forms, fudge is done.
Pour into nonstick pan.
recipes.text: Fudge. Cook over medium heat until boiling. Test by dropping a spoonful of mixture into cold water. If soft balls forms, fudge is done. Pour into nonstick pan.

recipes.title: Easy Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a canner or large pot.
Place, uncovered, in a 350u00b0 oven for 6 hours.
This need not be checked during cooking.
Can or freeze.
Makes 10 quarts.
recipes.text: Easy Spaghetti Sauce. Combine all ingredients in a canner or large pot. Place, uncovered, in a 350u00b0 oven for 6 hours. This need not be checked during cooking. Can or freeze. Makes 10 quarts.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Chop onion and pepper.
In large electric frypan or skillet, fry onion and pepper in a small amount of oil.
Add stewed tomatoes and vegeburger, stirring constantly to brown vegeburger. Add tomato paste and beans.
Cook until well heated.
Season with garlic salt and onion powder to taste.
Serve on top of Fritos with lettuce, cheese, tomato and sour cream and don't forget the hot sauce.
recipes.text: Chili. Chop onion and pepper. In large electric frypan or skillet, fry onion and pepper in a small amount of oil. Add stewed tomatoes and vegeburger, stirring constantly to brown vegeburger. Add tomato paste and beans. Cook until well heated. Season with garlic salt and onion powder to taste. Serve on top of Fritos with lettuce, cheese, tomato and sour cream and don't forget the hot sauce.

recipes.title: O'Mama'S "Medicinal" Hot Toddy
directions: At the onset of cold or flu, put patient in bed under lots of covers.
Put lemon juice in tall mug.
Add honey and whiskey.
Fill mug with boiling water.
Stir well and have patient drink while very hot!
recipes.text: O'Mama'S "Medicinal" Hot Toddy. At the onset of cold or flu, put patient in bed under lots of covers. Put lemon juice in tall mug. Add honey and whiskey. Fill mug with boiling water. Stir well and have patient drink while very hot!

recipes.title: Cheesecake
directions: Crust:
Melt butter in a 9-inch glass pie plate by covering with wax paper and microwaving 45 seconds, or until melted.
Stir cracker crumbs and sugar into butter; press mixture against sides and bottom of pie plate.
Microwave on High 1 minute, rotating after 30 seconds.
recipes.text: Cheesecake. Crust: Melt butter in a 9-inch glass pie plate by covering with wax paper and microwaving 45 seconds, or until melted. Stir cracker crumbs and sugar into butter; press mixture against sides and bottom of pie plate. Microwave on High 1 minute, rotating after 30 seconds.

recipes.title: Rose Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; stir in wine, strawberries and undrained pineapple.
Pour half of mixture into an 8-cup mold; refrigerate until set.
Spread sour cream over top.
Spoon or carefully pour remaining gelatin mixture over top.
Refrigerate until set.
Unmold onto salad greens.
Serves 10.
recipes.text: Rose Strawberry Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; stir in wine, strawberries and undrained pineapple. Pour half of mixture into an 8-cup mold; refrigerate until set. Spread sour cream over top. Spoon or carefully pour remaining gelatin mixture over top. Refrigerate until set. Unmold onto salad greens. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Corn Tamale Treat
directions: Saute onion
in
margarine.
Add
tamales, mixing well. Stir intcorn;
add salt.
Spoon into 1-quart (greased) casserole and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Corn Tamale Treat. Saute onion in margarine. Add tamales, mixing well. Stir intcorn; add salt. Spoon into 1-quart (greased) casserole and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Black Forest Cake
ingredients: 1 box devil's food cake mix, mixed as directed
directions: Bake cake as directed in two 8-inch layers. Let cool. Frost with chocolate frosting. Put cherry pie filling on top of cake.
recipes.text: Black Forest Cake. Bake cake as directed in two 8-inch layers. Let cool. Frost with chocolate frosting. Put cherry pie filling on top of cake.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Use a 1 gallon glass container.
Boil celery seed, salt, vinegar and sugar; let cool.
Add onions, pepper, pimentos and garlic.
As cucumbers are ready, slice and put in jar; stir twice daily.
No need to change or add to solution.
You can start eating after 3 days.
Will keep for months.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Pickles. Use a 1 gallon glass container. Boil celery seed, salt, vinegar and sugar; let cool. Add onions, pepper, pimentos and garlic. As cucumbers are ready, slice and put in jar; stir twice daily. No need to change or add to solution. You can start eating after 3 days. Will keep for months.

recipes.title: Breast Of Chicken On Rice
directions: Blend
mushroom
soup
and
milk.
(Keep 1/2 cup of the mixture.) Stir together all ingredients except chicken and 1/2 of the onion soup mix.
Pour into ungreased 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Arrange
the
chicken
breasts on top of mixture.
Pour the remaining blend of mushroom soup and milk over the chicken and sprinkle
with
remaining onion soup mix.
Cover.
Bake 1 hour in 350u00b0 oven.tRemove, cover and bake 15 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Breast Of Chicken On Rice. Blend mushroom soup and milk. (Keep 1/2 cup of the mixture.) Stir together all ingredients except chicken and 1/2 of the onion soup mix. Pour into ungreased 2 1/2 quart baking dish. Arrange the chicken breasts on top of mixture. Pour the remaining blend of mushroom soup and milk over the chicken and sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix. Cover. Bake 1 hour in 350u00b0 oven.tRemove, cover and bake 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Granny'S Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb. chuck roast, cut into 1-inch pieces
3 large potatoes, peeled and cut in large pieces
directions: Brown the chuck roast squares in iron skillet. When browned, pour in 2 cups water to release browned from bottom of pan. Pour into 4-quart pressure cooker and cook for 15 minutes. Set aside to let pressure cool down in cooker. Remove top of pressure cooker after cooled. Put in potatoes, carrots and onion soup mix. Add 2 quarts of water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and boil for 20 minutes. Top with Bisquick Dumplings.
recipes.text: Granny'S Beef Stew. Brown the chuck roast squares in iron skillet. When browned, pour in 2 cups water to release browned from bottom of pan. Pour into 4-quart pressure cooker and cook for 15 minutes. Set aside to let pressure cool down in cooker. Remove top of pressure cooker after cooled. Put in potatoes, carrots and onion soup mix. Add 2 quarts of water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and boil for 20 minutes. Top with Bisquick Dumplings.

recipes.title: Velvet Salad
directions: Combine jello and hot water in double boiler; cut up marshmallows.
Add to jello to dissolve.
Add cream cheese.
Let stand to congeal, then add the last 3 ingredients and pour into long baking dish.
Let stand 1/2 hour and pour 2 boxes raspberry jello which has started to congeal on top of lemon jello mixture.
recipes.text: Velvet Salad. Combine jello and hot water in double boiler; cut up marshmallows. Add to jello to dissolve. Add cream cheese. Let stand to congeal, then add the last 3 ingredients and pour into long baking dish. Let stand 1/2 hour and pour 2 boxes raspberry jello which has started to congeal on top of lemon jello mixture.

recipes.title: Honey Crackle
directions: Melt butter on low heat, add sugar and honey; stir until melted, then let it boil slowly for 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from fire, add vanilla.
Pour over popcorn, mix well and spread in large oiled pan and put it in 250u00b0 oven for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Honey Crackle. Melt butter on low heat, add sugar and honey; stir until melted, then let it boil slowly for 5 minutes without stirring. Remove from fire, add vanilla. Pour over popcorn, mix well and spread in large oiled pan and put it in 250u00b0 oven for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Percolator Punch
directions: Put spices in basket of coffeepot.
Into bottom of coffeepot, put juices, water and brown sugar and perk as you would coffee. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Spiced Percolator Punch. Put spices in basket of coffeepot. Into bottom of coffeepot, put juices, water and brown sugar and perk as you would coffee. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
directions: Blend together and chill.
Good with any fresh vegetable tray.
recipes.text: Dill Dip. Blend together and chill. Good with any fresh vegetable tray.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix (original)
directions: Mix in blender; chill at least 6 hours before serving.
Great dip for raw vegetables.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Mix in blender; chill at least 6 hours before serving. Great dip for raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Chocolate Shot Cookies(Makes 3 Dozen)
directions: Cream butter, add sugar gradually and cream until fluffy.
Add vanilla, flour sifted with soda and rolled oats.
Mix thoroughly. Chill dough in refrigerator for about one-half hour.
Shape into rolls 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Coat each roll of dough with chocolate shot.
Slice about 3/8-inch thick and place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake in a slow oven (325u00b0) for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Shot Cookies(Makes 3 Dozen). Cream butter, add sugar gradually and cream until fluffy. Add vanilla, flour sifted with soda and rolled oats. Mix thoroughly. Chill dough in refrigerator for about one-half hour. Shape into rolls 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Coat each roll of dough with chocolate shot. Slice about 3/8-inch thick and place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in a slow oven (325u00b0) for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Wedding Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. butter (butter works better than margarine)
directions: Cream the butter and 1/2 cup of sugar until light and fluffy. Add water and vanilla.
Gradually add flour and nuts.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls.
Bake 10 minutes.
Cool for 10 minutes.
Roll in powdered sugar.
When completely cool, roll again in powdered sugar.
Yields 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Wedding Cookies. Cream the butter and 1/2 cup of sugar until light and fluffy. Add water and vanilla. Gradually add flour and nuts. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Bake 10 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar. When completely cool, roll again in powdered sugar. Yields 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Parsnips
directions: Peel and halve parsnips.
Boil for about 5 minutes and drain. Allow to cool for a few minutes so not too hot to handle.
Combine equal portions of flour and grated Parmesan cheese.
Roll cooled parsnips in flour and cheese mixture.
Coat bottom of baking pan with a small amount of oil.
Place parsnips in pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Parsnips. Peel and halve parsnips. Boil for about 5 minutes and drain. Allow to cool for a few minutes so not too hot to handle. Combine equal portions of flour and grated Parmesan cheese. Roll cooled parsnips in flour and cheese mixture. Coat bottom of baking pan with a small amount of oil. Place parsnips in pan and bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ruby Champagne Punch
ingredients: 2 envelopes (1.8 oz. each) or 1/2 c. lemon flavored ice tea mix
1 (6 oz.) can frozen red tropical fruit punch, thawed
directions: In punch bowl, combine lemon flavored iced tea mix, peach nectar, Rose wine, water and fruit punch; chill.
Just before serving, add pink champagne and ice mold.
Makes about 25 (5 ounce) servings.
recipes.text: Ruby Champagne Punch. In punch bowl, combine lemon flavored iced tea mix, peach nectar, Rose wine, water and fruit punch; chill. Just before serving, add pink champagne and ice mold. Makes about 25 (5 ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs.
Add dry ingredients. Cool dough 3 to 4 hours.
Roll out.
Cut out.
Decorate with sprinkles.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Christmas Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Add dry ingredients. Cool dough 3 to 4 hours. Roll out. Cut out. Decorate with sprinkles. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Cheese Cake
ingredients: 1 c. pie filling or fresh fruit
directions: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla and beat until well blended and smooth.
Add egg whites and beat on low until well blended.
Spray a 9-inch cake or pie pan with Pam. Sprinkle pan with graham cracker crumbs.
Pour cream cheese mixture into pan.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Let cool on rack and then refrigerate.
When chilled, cover cake with fruit pie filling or fresh fruit.
Serves 10.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Fat-Free Cheese Cake. Combine cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla and beat until well blended and smooth. Add egg whites and beat on low until well blended. Spray a 9-inch cake or pie pan with Pam. Sprinkle pan with graham cracker crumbs. Pour cream cheese mixture into pan. Bake at 325u00b0 for 45 minutes. Let cool on rack and then refrigerate. When chilled, cover cake with fruit pie filling or fresh fruit. Serves 10. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Marbled Pumpkin Cheesecake
ingredients: 1/4 c. (4 Tbsp.) melted unsalted butter or margarine
directions: Combine gingersnap and graham cracker crumbs with powdered sugar and butter.
Toss to mix.
Press evenly onto bottom of 8-inch spring-form pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 5 minutes.
Cool.
In mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth.
Gradually beat in sugar and beat until light.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Transfer 1 cup mixture to separate bowl and blend in pumpkin, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and liqueur.
Pour half of pumpkin mixture into prepared crust.
Top with half of cream cheese mixture.
Repeat layers using remaining pumpkin and cream cheese mixtures.
Using table knife, cut through layers with uplifting motion in 4 to 5 places to create marble effect.
Place on bake sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Without opening oven door, let cake stand in turned-off oven 1 hour.
Remove from oven and cool, then chill.
Yields about 12 servings.
recipes.text: Marbled Pumpkin Cheesecake. Combine gingersnap and graham cracker crumbs with powdered sugar and butter. Toss to mix. Press evenly onto bottom of 8-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 350u00b0 for 5 minutes. Cool. In mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar and beat until light. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Transfer 1 cup mixture to separate bowl and blend in pumpkin, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and liqueur. Pour half of pumpkin mixture into prepared crust. Top with half of cream cheese mixture. Repeat layers using remaining pumpkin and cream cheese mixtures. Using table knife, cut through layers with uplifting motion in 4 to 5 places to create marble effect. Place on bake sheet and bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes. Without opening oven door, let cake stand in turned-off oven 1 hour. Remove from oven and cool, then chill. Yields about 12 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: In a well-buttered pan, place chopped apples into 1-inch deep. Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Dot with butter.
Mix ingredients together.
Mix into crumbles and spread over apples. Bake until golden brown in medium oven at 350u00b0.
Serve warm or cold with ice cream, whipped cream, sauce or plain.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. In a well-buttered pan, place chopped apples into 1-inch deep. Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg. Dot with butter. Mix ingredients together. Mix into crumbles and spread over apples. Bake until golden brown in medium oven at 350u00b0. Serve warm or cold with ice cream, whipped cream, sauce or plain.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Beat eggs well.
Mix flour and sugar together and add to eggs. Add melted butter and beat well.
Stir in buttermilk and vanilla. Pour mixture into pie crust.
Bake at 325u00b0 until firm in center, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Beat eggs well. Mix flour and sugar together and add to eggs. Add melted butter and beat well. Stir in buttermilk and vanilla. Pour mixture into pie crust. Bake at 325u00b0 until firm in center, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Place chicken in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle onion over chicken.
Slice cheese over chicken completely.
Place mushrooms over cheese; crumble Doritos over mushrooms.
Blend soups and tomatoes together and pour over chips.
You may want to top this off with a little more cheese on top.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Place chicken in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle onion over chicken. Slice cheese over chicken completely. Place mushrooms over cheese; crumble Doritos over mushrooms. Blend soups and tomatoes together and pour over chips. You may want to top this off with a little more cheese on top. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Instant Russian Tea
directions: Make up dry and keep for individual cups of tea, hot or cold. Use 2 to 3tteaspoons
pertcup.
(Sugar may be omitted and added to cup per individual taste.)
recipes.text: Instant Russian Tea. Make up dry and keep for individual cups of tea, hot or cold. Use 2 to 3tteaspoons pertcup. (Sugar may be omitted and added to cup per individual taste.)

recipes.title: Pineapple Delight(Makes 2)
directions: Melt butter.
Beat eggs.
Mix sugar, butter and eggs well. Add pineapple and Cool Whip.
Beat until it is fluffed up.
Take bowl and put layer of wafers, then filling.
Repeat as desired. End with layer of filling.
recipes.text: Pineapple Delight(Makes 2). Melt butter. Beat eggs. Mix sugar, butter and eggs well. Add pineapple and Cool Whip. Beat until it is fluffed up. Take bowl and put layer of wafers, then filling. Repeat as desired. End with layer of filling.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Fudge
directions: Mix sugar, butter, cocoa and milk together in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla.
Mix well.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Fudge. Mix sugar, butter, cocoa and milk together in saucepan and bring to a boil. Add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla. Mix well. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Mary Kilgore'S Ginger Cakes
directions: Mix in order written here.
Use enough flour so it will make dough that you can roll out.
Pinch off piece of dough and roll out in 6-inch ovals and bake.
recipes.text: Mary Kilgore'S Ginger Cakes. Mix in order written here. Use enough flour so it will make dough that you can roll out. Pinch off piece of dough and roll out in 6-inch ovals and bake.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Cookies
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa. Add milk and melted butter in large saucepan. Bring to a boil and let boil 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and stir in. Add oatmeal. Stir and drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls. Let cool. Makes approximately 2 dozen.
recipes.text: No-Bake Chocolate Cookies. Mix sugar and cocoa. Add milk and melted butter in large saucepan. Bring to a boil and let boil 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and stir in. Add oatmeal. Stir and drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls. Let cool. Makes approximately 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Easy Cocoa
directions: Use 2 tablespoons of
mix to 6 ounces of hot water or can add mix to taste.
recipes.text: Easy Cocoa. Use 2 tablespoons of mix to 6 ounces of hot water or can add mix to taste.

recipes.title: Curried Fruit
directions: Combine butter, brown sugar and curry powder.
Mix well. Drain fruit and arrange in a shallow baking dish.
Cover with mixture of butter, brown sugar and curry.
Bake in a preheated 325u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Curried Fruit. Combine butter, brown sugar and curry powder. Mix well. Drain fruit and arrange in a shallow baking dish. Cover with mixture of butter, brown sugar and curry. Bake in a preheated 325u00b0 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Bacon And Cheese Panada
directions: Partially fry bacon and drain.
Beat eggs with soup, milk, salt and pepper.
Fold in bread crumbs and cheese.
Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake in medium oven (350u00b0) for 45 minutes.
Ten minutes before casserole is done, arrange bacon slices on top.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Bacon And Cheese Panada. Partially fry bacon and drain. Beat eggs with soup, milk, salt and pepper. Fold in bread crumbs and cheese. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake in medium oven (350u00b0) for 45 minutes. Ten minutes before casserole is done, arrange bacon slices on top. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Microwave 3-In-1 Dip
directions: Mix in 1-quart bowl all ingredients in microwave on High for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Stir frequently. Serve hot or cold on chips or crackers.
recipes.text: Microwave 3-In-1 Dip. Mix in 1-quart bowl all ingredients in microwave on High for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Stir frequently. Serve hot or cold on chips or crackers.

recipes.title: White Fruit Cake
directions: Prepare and chop nuts.
Cut up fruit and mix with enough flour to keep it from sticking together.
Cream butter, add sugar and beat well.
Add eggs, 1 at a time, beat well after adding each egg. Add flour and orange juice alternately.
Add coconut, fruit and nuts.
Bake in large greased tubed pan at 250u00b0 to 275u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: White Fruit Cake. Prepare and chop nuts. Cut up fruit and mix with enough flour to keep it from sticking together. Cream butter, add sugar and beat well. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beat well after adding each egg. Add flour and orange juice alternately. Add coconut, fruit and nuts. Bake in large greased tubed pan at 250u00b0 to 275u00b0 for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Onion Smothered Steak
directions: Trim excess fat from meat.
Combine flour, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/8 tsp. pepper; pound into meat.
Cut in serving size pieces. Brown in hot shortening; drain off fat.
Top with onion; stir in 1 cup water and remaining ingredients.
Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer, covered, 1 hour.
Remove bay leaf.
recipes.text: Onion Smothered Steak. Trim excess fat from meat. Combine flour, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/8 tsp. pepper; pound into meat. Cut in serving size pieces. Brown in hot shortening; drain off fat. Top with onion; stir in 1 cup water and remaining ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer, covered, 1 hour. Remove bay leaf.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
directions: Cook carrots until tender, then cool.
Mix oil, sugar and vinegar together.
Add all ingredients together and mix well.
Let stand 24 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Carrot Salad. Cook carrots until tender, then cool. Mix oil, sugar and vinegar together. Add all ingredients together and mix well. Let stand 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Apple Pudding-N-Pie
directions: Grease a pie plate with butter and fill it with thinly sliced apples.
Mix 1/2 cup of sugar and the cinnamon and sprinkle over the apples.
Dot with 1 tablespoon of butter.
recipes.text: Apple Pudding-N-Pie. Grease a pie plate with butter and fill it with thinly sliced apples. Mix 1/2 cup of sugar and the cinnamon and sprinkle over the apples. Dot with 1 tablespoon of butter.

recipes.title: Berry'S Chocolate Applesauce Cake
directions: Sift first 6 ingredients together and set aside.
Place applesauce in saucepan and bring to a boil; add chocolate and butter, stirring until melted.
Add applesauce mixture to dry mixture.
Add raisins, baking powder and salt.
Mix well and then add vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour into greased and floured pan. Choose either tube pan or layer pans.
Bake in a tube pan at 325u00b0 for 1 hour; bake in layers pans at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Berry'S Chocolate Applesauce Cake. Sift first 6 ingredients together and set aside. Place applesauce in saucepan and bring to a boil; add chocolate and butter, stirring until melted. Add applesauce mixture to dry mixture. Add raisins, baking powder and salt. Mix well and then add vanilla. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured pan. Choose either tube pan or layer pans. Bake in a tube pan at 325u00b0 for 1 hour; bake in layers pans at 375u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Reese Cup Cake
directions: In saucepan combine 1 cup butter, 1/4 cup cocoa, water and sugar.
Heat, don't boil.
Let cool.
Add flour, baking powder, 1 teaspoon vanilla and eggs; beat for 3 minutes.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool.
Spread thin layer of peanut butter on top of cake.
recipes.text: Reese Cup Cake. In saucepan combine 1 cup butter, 1/4 cup cocoa, water and sugar. Heat, don't boil. Let cool. Add flour, baking powder, 1 teaspoon vanilla and eggs; beat for 3 minutes. Bake at 350u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool. Spread thin layer of peanut butter on top of cake.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix together.
Roll into small balls and place on ungreased sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes.
Makes 30 to 40 balls.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix together. Roll into small balls and place on ungreased sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 15 minutes. Makes 30 to 40 balls.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O in large bowl with boiling water.
Dissolve completely.
Pour in bag of marshmallows.
Stir in drained pineapple and mix well.
Put in refrigerator until starts to set. Take out and stir in Cool Whip.
Put back in refrigerator to finish setting.
recipes.text: Jello Salad. Mix Jell-O in large bowl with boiling water. Dissolve completely. Pour in bag of marshmallows. Stir in drained pineapple and mix well. Put in refrigerator until starts to set. Take out and stir in Cool Whip. Put back in refrigerator to finish setting.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Pie
directions: Mix lemon juice with the can of Eagle Brand milk.
When thick, add Mandarin oranges, well drained.
Whip cream and powdered sugar; spread over the filling.
Sprinkle lightly with wafer crumbs and chill.
Line pie pan with vanilla wafers.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Pie. Mix lemon juice with the can of Eagle Brand milk. When thick, add Mandarin oranges, well drained. Whip cream and powdered sugar; spread over the filling. Sprinkle lightly with wafer crumbs and chill. Line pie pan with vanilla wafers.

recipes.title: Mindy'S Mom'S Broccoli-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli or 1 large fresh head
directions: Cook rice and broccoli by directions on the package.
Grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix all ingredients together and put into casserole dish and top with cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Mindy'S Mom'S Broccoli-Rice Casserole. Cook rice and broccoli by directions on the package. Grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix all ingredients together and put into casserole dish and top with cheese. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Tedee'S Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 to 6 potatoes, peeled and sliced thin
directions: Spread mustard on one side of pork chops.
Flour both sides of chops. Brown in skillet. Add soup and potatoes.
Add enough water to cover chops and potatoes (about 2 cans). Simmer for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Tedee'S Pork Chops. Spread mustard on one side of pork chops. Flour both sides of chops. Brown in skillet. Add soup and potatoes. Add enough water to cover chops and potatoes (about 2 cans). Simmer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mom'S Light Lemony Cheesecake
directions: Dissolve Jell-O with water.
Let set until it starts to thicken.
Beat cream cheese and sugar together.
Add this to Jell-O.
Beat and set aside.
Beat Milnot and vanilla.
This will start to thicken, then add lemon and cream cheese mixture.
Beat well.
Pour over vanilla wafer crust.
recipes.text: Mom'S Light Lemony Cheesecake. Dissolve Jell-O with water. Let set until it starts to thicken. Beat cream cheese and sugar together. Add this to Jell-O. Beat and set aside. Beat Milnot and vanilla. This will start to thicken, then add lemon and cream cheese mixture. Beat well. Pour over vanilla wafer crust.

recipes.title: Pecan Butter Balls
directions: Mix; roll in balls.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Pecan Butter Balls. Mix; roll in balls. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Casserole With A Modern Twist
directions: Microwave potatoes until almost done; meanwhile dice onion, green pepper, chop cabbage, slice sausage and dice tomatoes. Spray nonstick skillet, add 2 tablespoons of olive or salad oil, onion and green pepper.
Saute until onion is soft.
Dice potatoes.
Add to skillet.
Fry as for homefries, stirring to brown.
Add sausage, tomatoes, cabbage and wine. Season to taste with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Cook until cabbage is tender-crisp, stirring frequently.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Casserole With A Modern Twist. Microwave potatoes until almost done; meanwhile dice onion, green pepper, chop cabbage, slice sausage and dice tomatoes. Spray nonstick skillet, add 2 tablespoons of olive or salad oil, onion and green pepper. Saute until onion is soft. Dice potatoes. Add to skillet. Fry as for homefries, stirring to brown. Add sausage, tomatoes, cabbage and wine. Season to taste with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Cook until cabbage is tender-crisp, stirring frequently. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Mix the sugar and cinnamon together in a large bowl.
(You want it to be more of brownish color.)
Melt the butter in another bowl. Cut each biscuit into fourths. Dip each piece into the melted butter, then the sugar/cinnamon mixture.
Place into a Bundt pan.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together in a large bowl. (You want it to be more of brownish color.) Melt the butter in another bowl. Cut each biscuit into fourths. Dip each piece into the melted butter, then the sugar/cinnamon mixture. Place into a Bundt pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Cream margarine and oil; add sugar.
Beat until smooth.
Add egg yolks; beat well.
Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture, alternately with buttermilk.
Add coconut and nuts.
Fold in egg whites that have been stiffly beaten.
Bake at 350u00b0 in 3 layers until done.
Cool and frost.
recipes.text: Italian Cream Cake. Cream margarine and oil; add sugar. Beat until smooth. Add egg yolks; beat well. Combine flour and soda; add to creamed mixture, alternately with buttermilk. Add coconut and nuts. Fold in egg whites that have been stiffly beaten. Bake at 350u00b0 in 3 layers until done. Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Microwave Squash Casserole(Cooking Time:  6 To 7 Minutes)
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. margarine, melted in microwave oven
directions: Melt margarine in 1 1/2-quart round casserole dish.
Stir in squash, beaten egg, pepper, onion and bread crumbs.
Cook in microwave on Medium to High 6 to 7 minutes.
Sprinkle grated cheese over top.
Cook approximately one more minute until cheese melts.
Yield:
4 servings.
recipes.text: Microwave Squash Casserole(Cooking Time:  6 To 7 Minutes). Melt margarine in 1 1/2-quart round casserole dish. Stir in squash, beaten egg, pepper, onion and bread crumbs. Cook in microwave on Medium to High 6 to 7 minutes. Sprinkle grated cheese over top. Cook approximately one more minute until cheese melts. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Whimsies
directions: Bring sugar, milk and butter to full boil.
Allow to cook about 1/2 to 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter until melted.
Add oatmeal.
Drop tablespoons of mixture on wax paper until hard.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Whimsies. Bring sugar, milk and butter to full boil. Allow to cook about 1/2 to 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter until melted. Add oatmeal. Drop tablespoons of mixture on wax paper until hard.

recipes.title: Hot Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple and place in bottom of 2-quart casserole.
Mix cheese, sugar, flour and Ritz crackers (which are crumbled coarsely) and sprinkle over pineapple.
Melt margarine and drizzle over casserole.
Bake, uncovered, 20 minutes at 325u00b0.
recipes.text: Hot Pineapple Casserole. Drain pineapple and place in bottom of 2-quart casserole. Mix cheese, sugar, flour and Ritz crackers (which are crumbled coarsely) and sprinkle over pineapple. Melt margarine and drizzle over casserole. Bake, uncovered, 20 minutes at 325u00b0.

recipes.title: Gourmet Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes in their skins until tender.
Let cool, then peel off skins and shred potatoes in shredder.
Mix with soft butter, sour cream and shredded Cheddar cheese.
Stir all together with onion.
Put mixture in a long, glass pan.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Gourmet Potatoes. Boil potatoes in their skins until tender. Let cool, then peel off skins and shred potatoes in shredder. Mix with soft butter, sour cream and shredded Cheddar cheese. Stir all together with onion. Put mixture in a long, glass pan. Bake at 400u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Sear meat.
Drain off fat.
Add tomato sauce and beer.
Stir in all ingredients except flour.
Cover pot and simmer 30 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Stir flour into warm water to make a thick flowable paste.
Add to chili.
Simmer additional 15 to 20 minutes.
If desired, add beans now.
recipes.text: Chili. Sear meat. Drain off fat. Add tomato sauce and beer. Stir in all ingredients except flour. Cover pot and simmer 30 minutes. Stir occasionally. Stir flour into warm water to make a thick flowable paste. Add to chili. Simmer additional 15 to 20 minutes. If desired, add beans now.

recipes.title: Macaroni-Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Separate egg yolks; mash and chill.
Chop egg whites.
Put in large bowl with macaroni and potatoes.
Stir in salt and vinegar. Chill overnight.
Add egg yolks and remaining ingredients.
Gently mix into macaroni mixture.
Chill.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Macaroni-Potato Salad. Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain. Separate egg yolks; mash and chill. Chop egg whites. Put in large bowl with macaroni and potatoes. Stir in salt and vinegar. Chill overnight. Add egg yolks and remaining ingredients. Gently mix into macaroni mixture. Chill. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Punch
directions: Mix these ingredients, then add pineapple can full of water. You can also put in frozen strawberries.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix these ingredients, then add pineapple can full of water. You can also put in frozen strawberries.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook
broccolituntil tender;
drain and layer a casserole dish
withtbroccoli.
Then
placetcheesetslicestover broccoli. Spread
cracker
crumbs over cheese.
Slice 1 stick of butter over crackers and bake for about 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccolituntil tender; drain and layer a casserole dish withtbroccoli. Then placetcheesetslicestover broccoli. Spread cracker crumbs over cheese. Slice 1 stick of butter over crackers and bake for about 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Nog Bread
ingredients: 1 c. dairy egg nog (do not use canned egg nog)
directions: Grease bottom of loaf pan.
Beat eggs in large bowl.
Add sugar, egg nog, butter, rum and vanilla.
Blend well.
Add rest of ingredients and stir until moist.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
recipes.text: Egg Nog Bread. Grease bottom of loaf pan. Beat eggs in large bowl. Add sugar, egg nog, butter, rum and vanilla. Blend well. Add rest of ingredients and stir until moist. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Layer Cake
ingredients: 1 (10-inch) angel food, sponge or chiffon cake
1 (3 1/2 oz.) can flaked or shredded coconut
directions: Cut cake lengthwise into 3 layers.
Spread ice cream between layers.
Place cake in freezer to harden.
Whip cream; add sugar and vanilla.
Use to frost top and sides of cake.
Cover with coconut; return to freezer until whipped cream is hard.
Wrap in freezer paper; freeze.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Layer Cake. Cut cake lengthwise into 3 layers. Spread ice cream between layers. Place cake in freezer to harden. Whip cream; add sugar and vanilla. Use to frost top and sides of cake. Cover with coconut; return to freezer until whipped cream is hard. Wrap in freezer paper; freeze.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Combine sauerkraut and vegetables.
Combine other ingredients and pour over sauerkraut mixture.
Stir until all vegetables are coated.
Chill before serving.
Keep in refrigerator; it improves with age.
Especially good served with pinto beans and cornbread.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Combine sauerkraut and vegetables. Combine other ingredients and pour over sauerkraut mixture. Stir until all vegetables are coated. Chill before serving. Keep in refrigerator; it improves with age. Especially good served with pinto beans and cornbread.

recipes.title: Zucchini Relish
directions: Mix zucchini, onion and salt and let stand overnight. Rinse with cold water; drain and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add peppers. Mix remaining ingredients in a large kettle and simmer 10 minutes. Add the zucchini mixture and boil 10 minutes more. Seal in sterilized jars. Makes 7 to 8 pints.
recipes.text: Zucchini Relish. Mix zucchini, onion and salt and let stand overnight. Rinse with cold water; drain and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add peppers. Mix remaining ingredients in a large kettle and simmer 10 minutes. Add the zucchini mixture and boil 10 minutes more. Seal in sterilized jars. Makes 7 to 8 pints.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Boil chicken until tender.
Bone and skin and chop to bite-size.
Place in a 2-quart saucepan.
Add onion, sage, 1 stick oleo, salt and pepper.
Let boil 5 to 8 minutes.
Add enough water to make 2 quarts.
In a large container, crumble corn bread and eggs.
Mix well and pour in a large roast pan.
Cut 1 stick oleo in slices over top.
Have your dressing pretty juicy or will be too dry when baked.
I taste mine to see if it needs more sage. You may want to add more seasoning.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour (when it gets golden brown on top).
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing. Boil chicken until tender. Bone and skin and chop to bite-size. Place in a 2-quart saucepan. Add onion, sage, 1 stick oleo, salt and pepper. Let boil 5 to 8 minutes. Add enough water to make 2 quarts. In a large container, crumble corn bread and eggs. Mix well and pour in a large roast pan. Cut 1 stick oleo in slices over top. Have your dressing pretty juicy or will be too dry when baked. I taste mine to see if it needs more sage. You may want to add more seasoning. Bake at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes to 1 hour (when it gets golden brown on top).

recipes.title: Mushroom Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or ground turkey
directions: In small bowl, mix mushroom soup with 1/2 cup water.
In large bowl, combine 1/4 cup soup mixture with remaining ingredients. Shape into meatballs; brown in shortening in frypan.
Or, place in glass 12 x 8-inch pan, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 5 minutes, turning dish once.
Drain fat.
Pour remaining soup mixture over and simmer 30 minutes, covered, in frypan or return to microwave for 3 more minutes.
recipes.text: Mushroom Meatballs. In small bowl, mix mushroom soup with 1/2 cup water. In large bowl, combine 1/4 cup soup mixture with remaining ingredients. Shape into meatballs; brown in shortening in frypan. Or, place in glass 12 x 8-inch pan, cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 5 minutes, turning dish once. Drain fat. Pour remaining soup mixture over and simmer 30 minutes, covered, in frypan or return to microwave for 3 more minutes.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf(Serves 30 To 35 People)
directions: Combine ingredients and bake in 3 or 4 large baking pans in a moderate oven 1 1/2 to 2 hours until done.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf(Serves 30 To 35 People). Combine ingredients and bake in 3 or 4 large baking pans in a moderate oven 1 1/2 to 2 hours until done.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
directions: Mix all ingredients in a medium-sized bowl; transfer to casserole.
Heat in oven at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Spread on crackers (super with Triscuits!).
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Mix all ingredients in a medium-sized bowl; transfer to casserole. Heat in oven at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Spread on crackers (super with Triscuits!).

recipes.title: Old South Barbecue Sauce And Chicken
directions: In oblong baking dish, arrange chicken, skin side up.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Spoon off fat.
Spoon soup mixture over chicken.
Reduce heat to 350u00b0.
Bake 25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.
Stir sauce before serving.
recipes.text: Old South Barbecue Sauce And Chicken. In oblong baking dish, arrange chicken, skin side up. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes. Spoon off fat. Spoon soup mixture over chicken. Reduce heat to 350u00b0. Bake 25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Stir sauce before serving.

recipes.title: Milky Way Cake
directions: Melt candy bars and 1 stick oleo. Set aside.
Cream sugar and 1 stick oleo.
Add eggs, flour, buttermilk and soda.
Add melted candy, oleo mixture and pecans.
Bake in angel food cake pan at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Milky Way Cake. Melt candy bars and 1 stick oleo. Set aside. Cream sugar and 1 stick oleo. Add eggs, flour, buttermilk and soda. Add melted candy, oleo mixture and pecans. Bake in angel food cake pan at 325u00b0 for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes, then peel and cut up.
Cut cucumber, eggs and onion.
Add oil and vinegar, salt and pepper and bacon bits.
Mix all ingredients together.
Let set for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: German Potato Salad. Boil potatoes, then peel and cut up. Cut cucumber, eggs and onion. Add oil and vinegar, salt and pepper and bacon bits. Mix all ingredients together. Let set for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Potato Topping
ingredients: 2 c. prepared Hidden Valley Ranch dressing or Good Seasons creamy style dressing mix
directions: Put the first 4 ingredients in a food processor; blend until vegetables are diced very fine.
Add this mixture to dressing mix. Mix together and chill.
Make ahead of time to allow flavors to marinate.
recipes.text: Baked Potato Topping. Put the first 4 ingredients in a food processor; blend until vegetables are diced very fine. Add this mixture to dressing mix. Mix together and chill. Make ahead of time to allow flavors to marinate.

recipes.title: Soda Cracker Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff, adding sugar slowly.
In separate bowl, mix rest of ingredients.
Fold into egg whites.
Pour into deep buttered pie plate.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 30 minutes.
Cool.
Top with whipped cream and sliced peaches, drained thawed strawberries or any other kind of fruit.
recipes.text: Soda Cracker Pie. Beat egg whites until stiff, adding sugar slowly. In separate bowl, mix rest of ingredients. Fold into egg whites. Pour into deep buttered pie plate. Bake at 325u00b0 for 30 minutes. Cool. Top with whipped cream and sliced peaches, drained thawed strawberries or any other kind of fruit.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb. chicken or turkey breast, skinned, boned and cut into small pieces
1/2 tsp. finely minced ginger or 1 tsp. powdered ginger
directions: Heat broth to boiling in large soup pot; add all ingredients. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Uncover and bring to boil; add vermicelli and cook over medium-high heat for 15 minutes.
Skim off any foamy particles.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Chinese Chicken Noodle Soup. Heat broth to boiling in large soup pot; add all ingredients. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Uncover and bring to boil; add vermicelli and cook over medium-high heat for 15 minutes. Skim off any foamy particles. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Tuna-Mac Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Serve on bed of lettuce.
recipes.text: Tuna-Mac Salad. Mix all ingredients. Serve on bed of lettuce.

recipes.title: Bacon Wraps
directions: Cut uncooked bacon in half.
Cut crust off bread and cut bread slices in half.
Spread undiluted soup on top of bread slices. Roll bread.
Place half piece of bacon around each rolled up bread and secure with toothpick.
Place on broiler pan and bake for 2 hours at 225u00b0.
recipes.text: Bacon Wraps. Cut uncooked bacon in half. Cut crust off bread and cut bread slices in half. Spread undiluted soup on top of bread slices. Roll bread. Place half piece of bacon around each rolled up bread and secure with toothpick. Place on broiler pan and bake for 2 hours at 225u00b0.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Pecan Pie
directions: Combine milk, butter and chocolate morsels in a small saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring constantly until chocolate melts.
Remove from heat.
Combine eggs, sugar, flour, salt, vanilla and pecans; stir in chocolate mixture.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 375u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate-Pecan Pie. Combine milk, butter and chocolate morsels in a small saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring constantly until chocolate melts. Remove from heat. Combine eggs, sugar, flour, salt, vanilla and pecans; stir in chocolate mixture. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 375u00b0 for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Roughneck Rolls
directions: Combine warm water and sugar in a bowl; add yeast and let stand. Let yeast come to top of water, then add shortening. Add flour and salt; mix well and place in greased bowl. Let dough rise to twice the original size, then roll out on floured board to 3/4 inch thickness. Cut rolls and place in greased pan; let rise. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown. Butter tops and serve. Makes 18 rolls.
recipes.text: Roughneck Rolls. Combine warm water and sugar in a bowl; add yeast and let stand. Let yeast come to top of water, then add shortening. Add flour and salt; mix well and place in greased bowl. Let dough rise to twice the original size, then roll out on floured board to 3/4 inch thickness. Cut rolls and place in greased pan; let rise. Bake at 400u00b0 for 20 minutes or until brown. Butter tops and serve. Makes 18 rolls.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
directions: Melt margarine in nonstick pan. Scramble egg in mixture with onions, peas and carrots.
Add cold cooked rice.
Dilute soy sauce with the water.
Pour over mixture.
Cook until heated completely.
recipes.text: Fried Rice. Melt margarine in nonstick pan. Scramble egg in mixture with onions, peas and carrots. Add cold cooked rice. Dilute soy sauce with the water. Pour over mixture. Cook until heated completely.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients; beat well.
Bake in prepared tube pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Mix all ingredients; beat well. Bake in prepared tube pan at 350u00b0 for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: No Knead Oatmeal Bread(2 Loaves)
directions: Can add 1/3 cup of wheat germ when flour is added.
recipes.text: No Knead Oatmeal Bread(2 Loaves). Can add 1/3 cup of wheat germ when flour is added.

recipes.title: Peach Custard Pie
directions: Peel and slice peaches and place in crust.
Mix sugar and flour.
Add beaten eggs, melted margarine and flavoring.
Pour over peaches.
Bake at 350u00b0 until custard is thick and crust is brown.
recipes.text: Peach Custard Pie. Peel and slice peaches and place in crust. Mix sugar and flour. Add beaten eggs, melted margarine and flavoring. Pour over peaches. Bake at 350u00b0 until custard is thick and crust is brown.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.
Beat until fluffy.
Make a paste with cocoa and vinegar.
Add butter mixture.
Sift flour, salt and soda together.
Add buttermilk and cake coloring.
Add vanilla.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 35 minutes in 2 (9-inch) greased and floured cake pans.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream butter, sugar and eggs. Beat until fluffy. Make a paste with cocoa and vinegar. Add butter mixture. Sift flour, salt and soda together. Add buttermilk and cake coloring. Add vanilla. Bake at 325u00b0 for 35 minutes in 2 (9-inch) greased and floured cake pans.

recipes.title: Presidential Enchiladas
directions: Remove seeds from chilies and chop them.
In large skillet, heat small amount of oil.
Add chilies and garlic and saute. Drain and break up tomatoes.
Reserve 1/2 cup liquid.
Add tomatoes, onion, 1 teaspoon salt, oregano and reserved tomato liquid to the chilies and garlic.
Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until thick.
Remove from the skillet and set aside. Combine the chicken with the sour cream, grated Cheddar and 1 teaspoon salt.
Heat 1/3 cup oil; dip tortillas in oil until they become limp.
Drain well on paper towels.
recipes.text: Presidential Enchiladas. Remove seeds from chilies and chop them. In large skillet, heat small amount of oil. Add chilies and garlic and saute. Drain and break up tomatoes. Reserve 1/2 cup liquid. Add tomatoes, onion, 1 teaspoon salt, oregano and reserved tomato liquid to the chilies and garlic. Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until thick. Remove from the skillet and set aside. Combine the chicken with the sour cream, grated Cheddar and 1 teaspoon salt. Heat 1/3 cup oil; dip tortillas in oil until they become limp. Drain well on paper towels.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. raisins, 2 c. coconut or 2 c. chocolate chips
directions: Mix together the Crisco, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla. Sift together and add flour, baking soda and salt.
Add oatmeal and raisins or coconut or chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 5 to 6 dozen medium-sized cookies.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Mix together the Crisco, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla. Sift together and add flour, baking soda and salt. Add oatmeal and raisins or coconut or chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 5 to 6 dozen medium-sized cookies.

recipes.title: Picante Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese (optional)
directions: Cook onions and garlic in butter in saucepan until onions are tender. Add tomato juice, broth and water; simmer for 30 minutes. Add cheese and croutons to your bowl of soup.
recipes.text: Picante Onion Soup. Cook onions and garlic in butter in saucepan until onions are tender. Add tomato juice, broth and water; simmer for 30 minutes. Add cheese and croutons to your bowl of soup.

recipes.title: Cherry Chiffon Gelatin Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Divide jello mixture into 2 equal parts.
After jello starts to thicken, add Bing cherries to 1/2 of the mixture.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan; let set.
Fold whipped topping into other 1/2 of jello mixture.
Pour this over fruited layer after it has set.
Refrigerate overnight until completely set.
Serves 24.
recipes.text: Cherry Chiffon Gelatin Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Divide jello mixture into 2 equal parts. After jello starts to thicken, add Bing cherries to 1/2 of the mixture. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan; let set. Fold whipped topping into other 1/2 of jello mixture. Pour this over fruited layer after it has set. Refrigerate overnight until completely set. Serves 24.

recipes.title: Autumn Soup(Microwave Recipe)
ingredients: 3 tomatoes, cut into eighths and sliced in half
directions: Mix ground beef, onion and celery in 5-quart casserole dish. Microwave at High (100%) until ground beef loses its pink color, 5 to 7 minutes, stirring after half of cooking time.
recipes.text: Autumn Soup(Microwave Recipe). Mix ground beef, onion and celery in 5-quart casserole dish. Microwave at High (100%) until ground beef loses its pink color, 5 to 7 minutes, stirring after half of cooking time.

recipes.title: Venus De Milo Soup
ingredients: 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can stewed tomatoes, cut up
directions: In a large pot, brown hamburger.
Add chicken broth, water, soup mix and celery.
Boil 20 minutes.
Add stewed tomatoes and frozen mixed vegetables and boil 15 minutes.
Add pasta and boil until pasta is done.
recipes.text: Venus De Milo Soup. In a large pot, brown hamburger. Add chicken broth, water, soup mix and celery. Boil 20 minutes. Add stewed tomatoes and frozen mixed vegetables and boil 15 minutes. Add pasta and boil until pasta is done.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
ingredients: your choice of vegetables (rice, potatoes, celery or pasta)
your choice of meat (beef, pork, hamburger or ham)
directions: Wash, then simmer lentils.
Along with the lentils, simmer vegetables and meat for about a half hour.
(This is an old Pennsylvania Dutch recipe.)
recipes.text: Lentil Soup. Wash, then simmer lentils. Along with the lentils, simmer vegetables and meat for about a half hour. (This is an old Pennsylvania Dutch recipe.)

recipes.title: Pear Honey
directions: Slice pears and put through a food chopper.
Add pineapple, lemon juice and sugar.
Cook for 20 minutes.
Pour into sterilized jars and place in a hot water bath, boiling, for 10 minutes. Makes 4 pints.
recipes.text: Pear Honey. Slice pears and put through a food chopper. Add pineapple, lemon juice and sugar. Cook for 20 minutes. Pour into sterilized jars and place in a hot water bath, boiling, for 10 minutes. Makes 4 pints.

recipes.title: Mic'S Mints
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan.
When melted, remove from heat and slowly mix in the sugar, flavor and color.
When it is a nice ball, remove from pan and shape as desired.
Smaller pieces are better due to the richness of the mint.
Makes about 1 pound of candy.
recipes.text: Mic'S Mints. Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan. When melted, remove from heat and slowly mix in the sugar, flavor and color. When it is a nice ball, remove from pan and shape as desired. Smaller pieces are better due to the richness of the mint. Makes about 1 pound of candy.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Beat oil and egg.
Add oats and orange juice.
Add dry ingredients.
Fold in berries.
Bake 400u00b0 10 -12 minutes.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins. Beat oil and egg. Add oats and orange juice. Add dry ingredients. Fold in berries. Bake 400u00b0 10 -12 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Combine melted margarine with crushed pretzels.
Place in baking dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pretzel Salad. Combine melted margarine with crushed pretzels. Place in baking dish and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Fruit And Tea Punch
directions: Combine sugar, lemon juice and orange juice in punch bowl. Mix until sugar is dissolved.
Stir in pineapple juice and tea. Serve over crushed ice in tall glasses.
recipes.text: Fruit And Tea Punch. Combine sugar, lemon juice and orange juice in punch bowl. Mix until sugar is dissolved. Stir in pineapple juice and tea. Serve over crushed ice in tall glasses.

recipes.title: Kosher Dill
directions: Wash cucumbers well and let stand overnight in cold water. Pack in jars and add to each jar, the first 6 ingredients. Combine apple vinegar, salt and water.
Boil and pour over cucumbers.
Seal.
recipes.text: Kosher Dill. Wash cucumbers well and let stand overnight in cold water. Pack in jars and add to each jar, the first 6 ingredients. Combine apple vinegar, salt and water. Boil and pour over cucumbers. Seal.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can fruit cocktail with juice
1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
directions: Mix fruit cocktail, pineapple and pudding together and chill 10 minutes.
Add the marshmallows, Cool Whip, nuts and coconut. Top with cherries and oranges.
recipes.text: Pistachio Salad. Mix fruit cocktail, pineapple and pudding together and chill 10 minutes. Add the marshmallows, Cool Whip, nuts and coconut. Top with cherries and oranges.

recipes.title: Artichoke Spread
directions: Drain and chop artichoke hearts.
Add sour cream and parmesan cheese.
Mix thoroughly.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Artichoke Spread. Drain and chop artichoke hearts. Add sour cream and parmesan cheese. Mix thoroughly. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Fresh Salsa
directions: Combine vinegar, salt, garlic and hot pepper sauce.
Let stand for 10 minutes.
Chop tomatoes.
Add to vinegar mixture.
Stir in peppers and olives.
recipes.text: Fresh Salsa. Combine vinegar, salt, garlic and hot pepper sauce. Let stand for 10 minutes. Chop tomatoes. Add to vinegar mixture. Stir in peppers and olives.

recipes.title: Crustless Quiche
directions: Melt margarine in pan and stir in flour; cook.
Add cream cheese to flour and margarine mixture after it cools a little bit. Beat the eggs; add the milk and blend.
Then add all the rest of the ingredients to the eggs and milk.
recipes.text: Crustless Quiche. Melt margarine in pan and stir in flour; cook. Add cream cheese to flour and margarine mixture after it cools a little bit. Beat the eggs; add the milk and blend. Then add all the rest of the ingredients to the eggs and milk.

recipes.title: Lebkucken
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. baking soda, dissolved in 1 c. hot water
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Let stand 4 days. Roll out. Cut with cookie cutters. Brush with egg white. Decorate with extra candied peel. Bake in 350u00b0 oven until light brown.
recipes.text: Lebkucken. Mix all ingredients together. Let stand 4 days. Roll out. Cut with cookie cutters. Brush with egg white. Decorate with extra candied peel. Bake in 350u00b0 oven until light brown.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 tsp. garlic salt, powder or juice
directions: Mix all ingredients together until sugar is dissolved.
(The recipe will make sauce for up to 3 pounds of chicken wings.) Remove tips from wings and cut wings in two pieces.
Marinate chicken wings in refrigerator for 3 hours or overnight.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Chinese Chicken Wings. Mix all ingredients together until sugar is dissolved. (The recipe will make sauce for up to 3 pounds of chicken wings.) Remove tips from wings and cut wings in two pieces. Marinate chicken wings in refrigerator for 3 hours or overnight. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Puddin' Fruit Salad
directions: Mix pudding as directed on box.
Add fruit and chill.
Good potluck dish.
recipes.text: Puddin' Fruit Salad. Mix pudding as directed on box. Add fruit and chill. Good potluck dish.

recipes.title: Cheese Ring With Strawberry Preserves
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) extra sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Combine first seven ingredients and mix well.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup pecans in an oiled ring mold and press cheese mixture into mold.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Cheese Ring With Strawberry Preserves. Combine first seven ingredients and mix well. Sprinkle 1/4 cup pecans in an oiled ring mold and press cheese mixture into mold. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Jello Salad
ingredients: 2 lime sugar-free jello, dissolved with 1/4 c. water
2 pkg. whipped topping, made according to directions (Feather Lite)
directions: Combine all and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Low Calorie Jello Salad. Combine all and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Press crescent rolls into bottom of 14-inch pizza pan or jelly roll pan.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 400u00b0 until golden; cool.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Press crescent rolls into bottom of 14-inch pizza pan or jelly roll pan. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 400u00b0 until golden; cool.

recipes.title: Watermelon Pickles
ingredients: 2 lb. watermelon rinds, sliced in strips or 1-inch chunks
1/4 c. pickling salt, dissolved in 1 c. water
directions: Combine rinds and salt solution.
Cover and soak overnight. Drain and rinse well.
Cook rinds in water until tender.
Drain. Mix remaining ingredients in deep stainless steel pot and bring to boil, making sure all sugar is dissolved.
Add rinds and remove from heat immediately. Fill sterile jars 1 1/2-inches from top with rinds.
Pour syrup mixture over to 1/2-inch from top.
Seal and process in hot water bath 5 minutes.
Remove and cool.
Check for sealing before storage.
Makes approximately 4 pints.
recipes.text: Watermelon Pickles. Combine rinds and salt solution. Cover and soak overnight. Drain and rinse well. Cook rinds in water until tender. Drain. Mix remaining ingredients in deep stainless steel pot and bring to boil, making sure all sugar is dissolved. Add rinds and remove from heat immediately. Fill sterile jars 1 1/2-inches from top with rinds. Pour syrup mixture over to 1/2-inch from top. Seal and process in hot water bath 5 minutes. Remove and cool. Check for sealing before storage. Makes approximately 4 pints.

recipes.title: Coke Salad
directions: Mix cherries, sugar and water; bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and add cherry jello.
Mix in the next 3 ingredients.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and let chill until firm.
recipes.text: Coke Salad. Mix cherries, sugar and water; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add cherry jello. Mix in the next 3 ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and let chill until firm.

recipes.title: Best Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Grease and flour 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Combine all ingredients into large bowl and mix well.
Transfer to prepared pan.
Bake until top is golden brown and splits slightly, about 1 hour and 20 minutes (start checking after 1 hour).
Can be served warm.
Makes 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Best Banana Bread. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Grease and flour 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Combine all ingredients into large bowl and mix well. Transfer to prepared pan. Bake until top is golden brown and splits slightly, about 1 hour and 20 minutes (start checking after 1 hour). Can be served warm. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Black Forest Mini Cheesecakes
directions: Heat oven to 325u00b0.
Line muffin pans with foil laminated baking cups.
Place one vanilla wafer on bottom of each cup.
In large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth.
Add sugar, cocoa and flour; blend well.
Add eggs; beat well.
Stir in sour cream and almond extract.
Fill each prepared cup almost full with cheese mixture.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until set.
Remove from oven; cool 5 to 10 minutes.
Spread heaping teaspoonful of sour cream topping on each cup.
Cool completely.
Refrigerate.
Garnish with dollop of cherry pie filling just before serving.
Makes 1 1/2 to 2 dozen cheesecakes.
recipes.text: Black Forest Mini Cheesecakes. Heat oven to 325u00b0. Line muffin pans with foil laminated baking cups. Place one vanilla wafer on bottom of each cup. In large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar, cocoa and flour; blend well. Add eggs; beat well. Stir in sour cream and almond extract. Fill each prepared cup almost full with cheese mixture. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until set. Remove from oven; cool 5 to 10 minutes. Spread heaping teaspoonful of sour cream topping on each cup. Cool completely. Refrigerate. Garnish with dollop of cherry pie filling just before serving. Makes 1 1/2 to 2 dozen cheesecakes.

recipes.title: Chicken Onion Scallop
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients.
Add 1 1/2 cups of the onions. Make gravy with 1 1/4 cups milk.
Stir into mixture.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes.
Top with remaining onions and bake 5 more minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Onion Scallop. Combine first 7 ingredients. Add 1 1/2 cups of the onions. Make gravy with 1 1/4 cups milk. Stir into mixture. Bake at 350u00b0 for 20 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 more minutes.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Heat them well in oven.
Add French fried onion rings to top and bake until bubbling.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Heat them well in oven. Add French fried onion rings to top and bake until bubbling.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Drain beans; add soup and mix.
Top with onions and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Drain beans; add soup and mix. Top with onions and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Pineapple Lemon Pie
directions: In saucepan, mix Jell-O, pineapple and sugar. Heat until Jell-O melts and just begins to bubble; let cool. Beat evaporated milk and lemon juice until stiff. Fold into Jell-O mixture, then pour into baked pie shell. Chill until set firm.
recipes.text: Pineapple Lemon Pie. In saucepan, mix Jell-O, pineapple and sugar. Heat until Jell-O melts and just begins to bubble; let cool. Beat evaporated milk and lemon juice until stiff. Fold into Jell-O mixture, then pour into baked pie shell. Chill until set firm.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
directions: In saucepan, melt butter, chocolate chips and peanut butter. In large bowl, empty Crispix cereal.
Pour peanut butter mixture over Crispix and mix well.
Put powdered sugar in large paper grocery sack.
Put coated Crispix into bag; close the bag tightly and shake until Crispix is well coated.
After mixture is well coated, lay flat on cookie sheet to dry.
recipes.text: Puppy Chow. In saucepan, melt butter, chocolate chips and peanut butter. In large bowl, empty Crispix cereal. Pour peanut butter mixture over Crispix and mix well. Put powdered sugar in large paper grocery sack. Put coated Crispix into bag; close the bag tightly and shake until Crispix is well coated. After mixture is well coated, lay flat on cookie sheet to dry.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Open chicken breast to make a pocket.
Place 1 slice ham and 1 slice Swiss cheese in each pocket.
Roll up and secure with toothpicks.
Melt margarine in a flat pan.
Mix crumbs and seasonings in a separate dish.
Roll chicken in margarine, then in crumbs.
Place in buttered baking dish.
Store in refrigerator for several hours.
Bake uncovered 40 minutes at 400u00b0.
recipes.text: Chicken Cordon Bleu. Open chicken breast to make a pocket. Place 1 slice ham and 1 slice Swiss cheese in each pocket. Roll up and secure with toothpicks. Melt margarine in a flat pan. Mix crumbs and seasonings in a separate dish. Roll chicken in margarine, then in crumbs. Place in buttered baking dish. Store in refrigerator for several hours. Bake uncovered 40 minutes at 400u00b0.

recipes.title: Lemon Honey Turkey
directions: In a small bowl, combine the first 4 ingredients. Place tenderloins in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Brush with half the sauce. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until a meat thermometer reads 170u00b0, basting occasionally with remaining sauce. Remove turkey to a plate and keep warm. Transfer drippings to a small saucepan. Combine cornstarch and water until smooth. Stir in drippings. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes or until thickened. Stir in browning sauce, if desired. Serve sauce over turkey. Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Lemon Honey Turkey. In a small bowl, combine the first 4 ingredients. Place tenderloins in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray. Brush with half the sauce. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes or until a meat thermometer reads 170u00b0, basting occasionally with remaining sauce. Remove turkey to a plate and keep warm. Transfer drippings to a small saucepan. Combine cornstarch and water until smooth. Stir in drippings. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes or until thickened. Stir in browning sauce, if desired. Serve sauce over turkey. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Party Rolls
directions: Melt margarine; add poppy seed and Worcestershire.
Pour over rolls.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven approximately 5 to 10 minutes, until cheese begins to melt.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Party Rolls. Melt margarine; add poppy seed and Worcestershire. Pour over rolls. Bake in 350u00b0 oven approximately 5 to 10 minutes, until cheese begins to melt.

recipes.title: How To Boil Water
directions: Put water in the tea kettle or pan and place on the burner on the stove.
Turn the burner to high.
At first it will seem that nothing is happening.
The water will just set there.
However, soon you will observe small bubbles on the bottom of the pan (inside). Then the bubbles will increase in number, become larger and begin to rise to the surface.
Now, we're getting somewhere!
Soon there will be more and more bubbles that rise to the surface faster and faster where they pop with amazing alacrity.
recipes.text: How To Boil Water. Put water in the tea kettle or pan and place on the burner on the stove. Turn the burner to high. At first it will seem that nothing is happening. The water will just set there. However, soon you will observe small bubbles on the bottom of the pan (inside). Then the bubbles will increase in number, become larger and begin to rise to the surface. Now, we're getting somewhere! Soon there will be more and more bubbles that rise to the surface faster and faster where they pop with amazing alacrity.

recipes.title: Angel Delight
ingredients: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. instant vanilla or lemon pudding mix
directions: Make cake; cool and rip into pieces.
Make pudding and stir until thick.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Fill a bowl with 1/3 cake pieces. Top with 1/3 pudding and 1/2 strawberries.
Layer again.
Slice kiwi.
Do one more layer and layer it with the fanciest berries and kiwi.
Put dollop of Cool Whip on top.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.
This is so delicious.
recipes.text: Angel Delight. Make cake; cool and rip into pieces. Make pudding and stir until thick. Fold in Cool Whip. Fill a bowl with 1/3 cake pieces. Top with 1/3 pudding and 1/2 strawberries. Layer again. Slice kiwi. Do one more layer and layer it with the fanciest berries and kiwi. Put dollop of Cool Whip on top. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving. This is so delicious.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cornflakes
directions: Bring Karo and sugar to a boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until blended.
Stir in cornflakes.
Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cornflakes. Bring Karo and sugar to a boil, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until blended. Stir in cornflakes. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

recipes.title: Poncho'S Chicken
ingredients: onion salt, garlic salt, oregano, salt and pepper (optional)
1 pkg. fresh white mushrooms, each cut into 4 to 6 pieces
directions: Boil the chicken with some onions, garlic, salt, oregano (and a little pepper) for seasoning. Remove chicken from broth and shred it. In a large skillet, melt 1/4 pound butter. Add the soy sauce and teriyaki sauce and saut the mushrooms until cooked. Add the chicken (with medium-high heat) until chicken is brown.
recipes.text: Poncho'S Chicken. Boil the chicken with some onions, garlic, salt, oregano (and a little pepper) for seasoning. Remove chicken from broth and shred it. In a large skillet, melt 1/4 pound butter. Add the soy sauce and teriyaki sauce and saut the mushrooms until cooked. Add the chicken (with medium-high heat) until chicken is brown.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients; bring to a boil.
Simmer for 45 minutes. Refrigerate any remaining sauce.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients; bring to a boil. Simmer for 45 minutes. Refrigerate any remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Kissing Cake
directions: Mix together hot water, dates and baking soda.
Let stand until cool.
Cream together shortening and sugar.
Add vanilla and eggs.
Mix well.
Add flour.
Mix thoroughly.
Add date mixture. Spoon half batter into a greased angel food pan.
Top with half of the nuts and kisses.
Add the rest of the batter.
Add remaining nuts.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Increase heat to 375u00b0 for 15 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Kissing Cake. Mix together hot water, dates and baking soda. Let stand until cool. Cream together shortening and sugar. Add vanilla and eggs. Mix well. Add flour. Mix thoroughly. Add date mixture. Spoon half batter into a greased angel food pan. Top with half of the nuts and kisses. Add the rest of the batter. Add remaining nuts. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Increase heat to 375u00b0 for 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Easy Paella
ingredients: 1/2 lb. medium shrimp, shelled and deveined
directions: Drain clams, reserving liquid.
Add enough water to clam liquid to make 1 1/4 cups; set aside.
In a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat, in hot oil, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on all sides.
Remove chicken; set aside.
Reduce heat to medium.
In hot drippings, cook onions, rice and garlic until rice is lightly browned, stirring often.
Add reserved clam liquid, broth, turmeric, pepper and chicken.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover; simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear.
Stir in clams, peas and shrimp.
Cover 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and opaque.
Serve with lemon.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Paella. Drain clams, reserving liquid. Add enough water to clam liquid to make 1 1/4 cups; set aside. In a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat, in hot oil, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on all sides. Remove chicken; set aside. Reduce heat to medium. In hot drippings, cook onions, rice and garlic until rice is lightly browned, stirring often. Add reserved clam liquid, broth, turmeric, pepper and chicken. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear. Stir in clams, peas and shrimp. Cover 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and opaque. Serve with lemon. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
directions: Cream shortening; gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed of electric mixer.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Tea Cakes. Cream shortening; gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed of electric mixer. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.

recipes.title: Scotch Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cook raisins and water for 5 minutes; drain and measure 3 tablespoons of juice.
Combine with soda.
Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs.
Stir in oats, salt and raisins that have been drained.
Add juice/soda mixture and stir into flour.
Drop on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Scotch Oatmeal Cookies. Cook raisins and water for 5 minutes; drain and measure 3 tablespoons of juice. Combine with soda. Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs. Stir in oats, salt and raisins that have been drained. Add juice/soda mixture and stir into flour. Drop on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart and bake at 350u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 4 c. sliced apples (Granny Smith's are best)
directions: Grease casserole dish; add apples, water and lemon juice which has been mixed with spices.
Work together sugar, salt, flour and butter until crumbly.
Spread over apples.
Bake (at about 350u00b0) uncovered until apples are tender.
Serve warm plain or with whipped cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Grease casserole dish; add apples, water and lemon juice which has been mixed with spices. Work together sugar, salt, flour and butter until crumbly. Spread over apples. Bake (at about 350u00b0) uncovered until apples are tender. Serve warm plain or with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Creamed Sweet Potatoes
directions: Mix potatoes, sugar, salt, eggs, oleo milk and vanilla. Pour into a casserole dish.
recipes.text: Creamed Sweet Potatoes. Mix potatoes, sugar, salt, eggs, oleo milk and vanilla. Pour into a casserole dish.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Parmesan
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Mix dry ingredients in bowl.
Coat chicken with mix.
(There will be mix left in bowl, save it.)
Coat baking pan with no-stick spray.
Pour water in pan.
Arrange chicken (meaty side up).
Bake for 30 minutes.
Remove chicken. Pour wine over chicken evenly.
Cover with foil.
Bake for 15 minutes on 325u00b0.
Remove foil from pan.
Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Parmesan. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Mix dry ingredients in bowl. Coat chicken with mix. (There will be mix left in bowl, save it.) Coat baking pan with no-stick spray. Pour water in pan. Arrange chicken (meaty side up). Bake for 30 minutes. Remove chicken. Pour wine over chicken evenly. Cover with foil. Bake for 15 minutes on 325u00b0. Remove foil from pan. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Dry Peaches
ingredients: 2 gal. peaches, peelings on and sliced thin
directions: Pour sugar over peaches.
Let set 3 hours or overnight.
Pour vinegar over them. Cook very slowly until they are dry. Stir constantly.
Pack in hot jars and seal.
recipes.text: Dry Peaches. Pour sugar over peaches. Let set 3 hours or overnight. Pour vinegar over them. Cook very slowly until they are dry. Stir constantly. Pack in hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Magic Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Shape into a loaf.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Magic Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Shape into a loaf. Bake at 350u00b0 for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Margie'S Corn Chow
directions: Combine all ingredients and let stand 5 minutes.
Cook for 20 minutes.
Place in cans and seal.
recipes.text: Margie'S Corn Chow. Combine all ingredients and let stand 5 minutes. Cook for 20 minutes. Place in cans and seal.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
ingredients: 2 large instant chocolate pudding boxes (follow directions)
directions: Layer brownies, pudding, Heath bars, caramel and Cool Whip. Sprinkle nuts on top.
recipes.text: Death By Chocolate. Layer brownies, pudding, Heath bars, caramel and Cool Whip. Sprinkle nuts on top.

recipes.title: Creamy Tacos
directions: Simmer all until cheese melts.
Cook hamburger and drain.
Add into cheese mixture.
Add 1/2 pint whipping cream.
Stir well. Serve with chips, lettuce, tomatoes, shredded cheese, green onions, picante sauce, guacamole and anything else to give it Mexican taste.
recipes.text: Creamy Tacos. Simmer all until cheese melts. Cook hamburger and drain. Add into cheese mixture. Add 1/2 pint whipping cream. Stir well. Serve with chips, lettuce, tomatoes, shredded cheese, green onions, picante sauce, guacamole and anything else to give it Mexican taste.

recipes.title: Mary'S Flour Tortillas
directions: Mix flour, salt and baking powder into Crisco.
Cream until like meal. Add very hot water, as hot as you can stand to work with.
Mix with your fingers until all flour is mixed.
Roll into ball and let rest 10 minutes. Separate into 10 to 12 small balls and roll into tortilla shape, about 6 to 7-inches across. Be careful not to work in too much flour.
Cook on ungreased iron skillet.
recipes.text: Mary'S Flour Tortillas. Mix flour, salt and baking powder into Crisco. Cream until like meal. Add very hot water, as hot as you can stand to work with. Mix with your fingers until all flour is mixed. Roll into ball and let rest 10 minutes. Separate into 10 to 12 small balls and roll into tortilla shape, about 6 to 7-inches across. Be careful not to work in too much flour. Cook on ungreased iron skillet.

recipes.title: Hamburger Hot Dish
