directions: Brown meat in pan with onion.
Add celery, do not overcook, celery should be crunchy.
Drain off excess fat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in casserole at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes.
Yield: 6 servings.
Carbohydrate 24 g, protein 15 g, fat 27 g, calories 399.
One serving = 2 meat low-fat exchange, 1 bread starch exchange, 1 vegetable exchange, 4 fat exchange.
recipes.text: Hamburger Hot Dish. Brown meat in pan with onion. Add celery, do not overcook, celery should be crunchy. Drain off excess fat. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in casserole at 375u00b0 for 45 minutes. Yield: 6 servings. Carbohydrate 24 g, protein 15 g, fat 27 g, calories 399. One serving = 2 meat low-fat exchange, 1 bread starch exchange, 1 vegetable exchange, 4 fat exchange.

recipes.title: Amazing Coconut Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350u00b0.
Combine all ingredients but coconut in blender.
Cover and blend on low speed 3 minutes.
Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with coconut.
Bake 40 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Amazing Coconut Pie. Heat oven to 350u00b0. Combine all ingredients but coconut in blender. Cover and blend on low speed 3 minutes. Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate. Let stand 5 minutes. Sprinkle with coconut. Bake 40 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can pineapple chunks in heavy syrup
directions: Drain pineapple. Save syrup.
In skillet, brown chicken parts in shortening.
Pour off fat.
Add syrup, broth, vinegar, sugar, soy and garlic.
Cover and cook on low heat for 40 minutes.
Add green pepper and pineapple chunks.
Cook 5 minutes more or until done.
Stir occasionally.
Combine cornstarch and water; gradually stir into sauce.
Cook, stirring, until thickened.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Chicken. Drain pineapple. Save syrup. In skillet, brown chicken parts in shortening. Pour off fat. Add syrup, broth, vinegar, sugar, soy and garlic. Cover and cook on low heat for 40 minutes. Add green pepper and pineapple chunks. Cook 5 minutes more or until done. Stir occasionally. Combine cornstarch and water; gradually stir into sauce. Cook, stirring, until thickened.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Stir ground cranberries, sugar, marshmallows and let set out of refrigerator overnight.
Next morning, add apples, peeled and diced, pineapple and nuts.
Fold in Dream whip.
Refrigerate and serve.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Stir ground cranberries, sugar, marshmallows and let set out of refrigerator overnight. Next morning, add apples, peeled and diced, pineapple and nuts. Fold in Dream whip. Refrigerate and serve.

recipes.title: Pete'S Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix and pour in gallon jar.
Finish filling with vinegar. Stir.
recipes.text: Pete'S Barbecue Sauce. Mix and pour in gallon jar. Finish filling with vinegar. Stir.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients well; pour into a 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Serve with chunky salsa if desired.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Mix all ingredients well; pour into a 11 x 7 inch baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1 hour or until done. Serve with chunky salsa if desired.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 medium cabbage, shredded on thick side
directions: In pot, put cabbage, onion, bay leaves, catsup and kielbasa. Fill with water about 1-inch over ingredients.
Cook until cabbage is done (not soft).
Serve as is or over boiled cut up potatoes.
recipes.text: Cabbage And Kielbasa. In pot, put cabbage, onion, bay leaves, catsup and kielbasa. Fill with water about 1-inch over ingredients. Cook until cabbage is done (not soft). Serve as is or over boiled cut up potatoes.

recipes.title: Deedee'S Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients together.
Mix wet ingredients together. Combine and pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Great topped with homemade whipped cream or ice cream.
(Double ingredients.
Make two pies; freeze one.)
recipes.text: Deedee'S Chocolate Chess Pie. Mix dry ingredients together. Mix wet ingredients together. Combine and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350u00b0 for 35 minutes. Great topped with homemade whipped cream or ice cream. (Double ingredients. Make two pies; freeze one.)

recipes.title: Banana Breakfast Drink
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth. Serve at once in chilled glass.
recipes.text: Banana Breakfast Drink. Combine all ingredients in a blender. Blend until smooth. Serve at once in chilled glass.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Place fruit in bottom of a 9 x 9-inch pan.
In a medium bowl, mix dry ingredients; cut in margarine.
Mix in egg with fork. Sprinkle over fruit.
Bake 25 minutes at 425u00b0.
recipes.text: Fruit Cobbler. Place fruit in bottom of a 9 x 9-inch pan. In a medium bowl, mix dry ingredients; cut in margarine. Mix in egg with fork. Sprinkle over fruit. Bake 25 minutes at 425u00b0.

recipes.title: No Bake Fudge
directions: Melt margarine.
Combine sugar and all remaining ingredients. Spray pan with Pam.
Pour mixture in pan.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Cut into squares for serving.
recipes.text: No Bake Fudge. Melt margarine. Combine sugar and all remaining ingredients. Spray pan with Pam. Pour mixture in pan. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Cut into squares for serving.

recipes.title: Sachertorte
ingredients: 5 oz. sweet chocolate, broken in small chunks
directions: Melt chocolate in top of a double boiler.
Add butter, stirring until melted.
Add egg yolks, beating constantly.
Add sugar and beat until well mixed.
Cool.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold in chocolate mixture and flour alternately.
Pour into a greased 8 inch square pan lined with greased waxed paper. Bake in a preheated 325u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Remove from pan.
Cool.
Melt jam in hot water.
Spread on top of cake.
Let stand 20 minutes and then decorate with frosting.
recipes.text: Sachertorte. Melt chocolate in top of a double boiler. Add butter, stirring until melted. Add egg yolks, beating constantly. Add sugar and beat until well mixed. Cool. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in chocolate mixture and flour alternately. Pour into a greased 8 inch square pan lined with greased waxed paper. Bake in a preheated 325u00b0 oven for 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from pan. Cool. Melt jam in hot water. Spread on top of cake. Let stand 20 minutes and then decorate with frosting.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Dip
directions: Blend ingredients and serve with fruit.
recipes.text: Easy Fruit Dip. Blend ingredients and serve with fruit.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake(Club Member: Jason Baldwin)
directions: Sift flour and cocoa together. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. To this mixture, add flour mixture and milk alternately a little at a time until all is used. Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured large tube pan for 1 hour and 40 minutes. Do not open oven during cooking.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pound Cake(Club Member: Jason Baldwin). Sift flour and cocoa together. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. To this mixture, add flour mixture and milk alternately a little at a time until all is used. Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured large tube pan for 1 hour and 40 minutes. Do not open oven during cooking.

recipes.title: Real Fudge Cake
ingredients: 4 sq. baking chocolate, melted and cooled
directions: Do not preheat oven.
recipes.text: Real Fudge Cake. Do not preheat oven.

recipes.title: Baked Lima Beans
ingredients: salt and pepper to your liking
directions: Cook beans until done.
Add all other ingredients together but the bacon.
Put bacon on top and bake at 400u00b0, until dark and thick, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Baked Lima Beans. Cook beans until done. Add all other ingredients together but the bacon. Put bacon on top and bake at 400u00b0, until dark and thick, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coconut Cake
directions: Mix together sour cream, coconut and sugar.
Refrigerate. Make up cake mix as directed on box.
Makes 2 (9-inch) layers. Cool and split layers, making 4 layers in all.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Coconut Cake. Mix together sour cream, coconut and sugar. Refrigerate. Make up cake mix as directed on box. Makes 2 (9-inch) layers. Cool and split layers, making 4 layers in all.

recipes.title: Linguini Salad
directions: Cook pasta; dice onion, cucumber and tomatoes.
Add to linguini.
Add Salad Supreme; add dressing.
Mix together and chill 2 hours.
recipes.text: Linguini Salad. Cook pasta; dice onion, cucumber and tomatoes. Add to linguini. Add Salad Supreme; add dressing. Mix together and chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Glazed Acorn Squash
directions: Cut squash into 1-inch crosswise slices.
Remove seed and stringy fibers from center.
Arrange slices in 12 x 8 x 2-inch glass baking dish.
Cover tightly with plastic wrap.
Microwave at High setting for 6 minutes.
Turn squash over and rearrange slices.
Cover tightly and microwave at High setting 6 minutes more, or until tender.
Drain squash.
recipes.text: Glazed Acorn Squash. Cut squash into 1-inch crosswise slices. Remove seed and stringy fibers from center. Arrange slices in 12 x 8 x 2-inch glass baking dish. Cover tightly with plastic wrap. Microwave at High setting for 6 minutes. Turn squash over and rearrange slices. Cover tightly and microwave at High setting 6 minutes more, or until tender. Drain squash.

recipes.title: Sorry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.
recipes.text: Sorry Salad. Mix all ingredients together and chill.

recipes.title: Purple Cow
directions: You will need a blender, scoop, measuring cup and spoons and 2 glasses and straws.
recipes.text: Purple Cow. You will need a blender, scoop, measuring cup and spoons and 2 glasses and straws.

recipes.title: Italian Dressing
directions: Shake all ingredients in tightly covered jar.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours to blend flavors.
Shake before serving.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Italian Dressing. Shake all ingredients in tightly covered jar. Refrigerate at least 2 hours to blend flavors. Shake before serving. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 2 small or 1 large pkg. strawberry gelatin
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add frozen strawberries to gelatin mixture; stir as they dissolve.
Add pineapple and bananas.
Place 1/2 of mixture in dish; chill until firm.
Spread sour cream over chilled layer.
Add remaining strawberry mixture; chill until firm.
If not using promptly, banana slices should be dipped in lemon juice to prevent darkening.
NutraSweet gelatin may be used.
recipes.text: Strawberry Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries to gelatin mixture; stir as they dissolve. Add pineapple and bananas. Place 1/2 of mixture in dish; chill until firm. Spread sour cream over chilled layer. Add remaining strawberry mixture; chill until firm. If not using promptly, banana slices should be dipped in lemon juice to prevent darkening. NutraSweet gelatin may be used.

recipes.title: Quick Shortcake
directions: Melt butter.
Take biscuits and dip in the butter and then in sugar.
Put on baking pan and bake at 400u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until brown.
Pour strawberries or other fruit over these.
This is delicious.
recipes.text: Quick Shortcake. Melt butter. Take biscuits and dip in the butter and then in sugar. Put on baking pan and bake at 400u00b0 for about 10 minutes or until brown. Pour strawberries or other fruit over these. This is delicious.

recipes.title: Ham Quiche
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chilies, drained
directions: Preheat oven to 425u00b0.
Grease a 12-inch pizza pan.
Combine biscuit mix and water; mix until soft dough forms.
Knead on floured board until it can be handled.
Press into pan.
Spread ham, green chilies and olives over crust.
Mix eggs, sour cream, cheese, onions, salt and pepper.
Pour over ham.
Bake for 25 minutes or until set.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Ham Quiche. Preheat oven to 425u00b0. Grease a 12-inch pizza pan. Combine biscuit mix and water; mix until soft dough forms. Knead on floured board until it can be handled. Press into pan. Spread ham, green chilies and olives over crust. Mix eggs, sour cream, cheese, onions, salt and pepper. Pour over ham. Bake for 25 minutes or until set. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: South Seas Chicken And Bananas
ingredients: 3/4 c. butter or margarine, melted and divided
sliced kiwi fruit and star fruit (optional)
directions: In a food processor or blender, blend the lemon juice, condensed milk, milk, coconut and cardamom until smooth.
Pour into a bowl.
Dip bananas into milk mixture.
Roll in cornflake crumbs and set aside.
Dip chicken into remaining milk mixture. Roll in the remaining cornflake crumbs and place in 2 greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pans.
Drizzle with 1/2 cup of the melted butter.
Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 1 hour.
Arrange bananas over the chicken.
Drizzle with remaining butter.
Bake 15 minutes longer or until chicken juices run clear.
Garnish with kiwi and star fruit, if desired.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: South Seas Chicken And Bananas. In a food processor or blender, blend the lemon juice, condensed milk, milk, coconut and cardamom until smooth. Pour into a bowl. Dip bananas into milk mixture. Roll in cornflake crumbs and set aside. Dip chicken into remaining milk mixture. Roll in the remaining cornflake crumbs and place in 2 greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pans. Drizzle with 1/2 cup of the melted butter. Bake, uncovered, at 350u00b0 for 1 hour. Arrange bananas over the chicken. Drizzle with remaining butter. Bake 15 minutes longer or until chicken juices run clear. Garnish with kiwi and star fruit, if desired. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Holiday Punch
ingredients: 1 qt. Cold Duck or 1 qt. cranberry juice
directions: Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl, floating strawberries on top.
recipes.text: Holiday Punch. Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl, floating strawberries on top.

recipes.title: Aunt Nettie'S Persimmon Pudding
directions: Mix together and add enough flour to make the consistency of a cake batter.
Bake until done.
recipes.text: Aunt Nettie'S Persimmon Pudding. Mix together and add enough flour to make the consistency of a cake batter. Bake until done.

recipes.title: Belly Busters
directions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Add remaining ingredients together.
Warm until cheese bubbles.
Let meat mixture cool.
Put 1 tablespoon in bottom corner of wrapper, fold up, then fold edges into the middle.
Roll over once, then dab with water.
Wet top edge until it sticks.
Deep fry until golden brown.
Eat them until your belly busts.
Reheat leftovers at 425u00b0 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Belly Busters. Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Add remaining ingredients together. Warm until cheese bubbles. Let meat mixture cool. Put 1 tablespoon in bottom corner of wrapper, fold up, then fold edges into the middle. Roll over once, then dab with water. Wet top edge until it sticks. Deep fry until golden brown. Eat them until your belly busts. Reheat leftovers at 425u00b0 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey-Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 turkey carcass from roasted or smoked turkey
3/4 c. instant rice or 1 1/2 c. cooked regular rice
directions: Simmer turkey bones about 45 minutes.
Remove, chop and set aside any meat.
Add celery, onion, parsley, curry powder and cayenne pepper to the stock and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes.
Add instant or cooked rice.
Taste for seasoning.
Thicken with cornstarch, mixed with a little cold water, if desired.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Turkey-Rice Soup. Simmer turkey bones about 45 minutes. Remove, chop and set aside any meat. Add celery, onion, parsley, curry powder and cayenne pepper to the stock and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes. Add instant or cooked rice. Taste for seasoning. Thicken with cornstarch, mixed with a little cold water, if desired. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Frosty Sours
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in container of electric blender; process until smooth. Gradually add ice, processing until mixture reaches desired consistency.
Yield:
about 4 cups.
recipes.text: Frosty Sours. Combine first 3 ingredients in container of electric blender; process until smooth. Gradually add ice, processing until mixture reaches desired consistency. Yield: about 4 cups.

recipes.title: Creamy Orange Dip
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. grated orange rind
directions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.
Stir until smooth. Cover and chill thoroughly.
Serve with fresh fruit or unsalted crackers.
recipes.text: Creamy Orange Dip. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Stir until smooth. Cover and chill thoroughly. Serve with fresh fruit or unsalted crackers.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Bake at 425u00b0 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 425u00b0 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 small can cream of chicken soup
directions: Parboil broccoli cuts and set aside.
Cook rice as indicated on box.
Add cream of chicken soup and milk to rice and broccoli, then stir in Cheez Whiz.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour.
If adding chicken, parboil before adding to mixture.
Also cut up in small pieces.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Cheese Casserole. Parboil broccoli cuts and set aside. Cook rice as indicated on box. Add cream of chicken soup and milk to rice and broccoli, then stir in Cheez Whiz. Bake at 350u00b0 for 1/2 hour. If adding chicken, parboil before adding to mixture. Also cut up in small pieces. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Orange Sweet Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 350u00b0.
Cook and cut potatoes in pieces or can be mashed.
Mix and simmer over low heat until slightly thickened. Place potatoes in casserole dish and cover with sauce.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Orange Sweet Potatoes. Preheat oven to 350u00b0. Cook and cut potatoes in pieces or can be mashed. Mix and simmer over low heat until slightly thickened. Place potatoes in casserole dish and cover with sauce. Bake for 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Crab - Shrimp Mold
ingredients: 2 (4 1/2 oz.) cans shrimp or crab, drained and rinsed
directions: Heat 1 can tomato soup.
Dissolve Knox gelatine in cold water. Add gelatine to soup; remove from heat.
Beat in cream cheese until well blended.
Add mayonnaise.
Stir in onion, celery and green pepper, then shrimp or crab.
Pour into mold and refrigerate overnight.
Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges.
recipes.text: Crab - Shrimp Mold. Heat 1 can tomato soup. Dissolve Knox gelatine in cold water. Add gelatine to soup; remove from heat. Beat in cream cheese until well blended. Add mayonnaise. Stir in onion, celery and green pepper, then shrimp or crab. Pour into mold and refrigerate overnight. Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can Pastene ground, peeled tomatoes
directions: Chop onion, garlic and pepper into small pieces.
Add olive oil into large saucepan (medium heat).
Lightly brown the onion, garlic and pepper in the olive oil.
Add canned tomatoes, tomato paste and water.
Heat on medium until paste is combined with tomatoes and water.
Add remaining ingredients.
Reduce heat to low.
Let simmer lightly for six hours.
If adding meatballs, do so after 2 hours.
recipes.text: Pasta Sauce. Chop onion, garlic and pepper into small pieces. Add olive oil into large saucepan (medium heat). Lightly brown the onion, garlic and pepper in the olive oil. Add canned tomatoes, tomato paste and water. Heat on medium until paste is combined with tomatoes and water. Add remaining ingredients. Reduce heat to low. Let simmer lightly for six hours. If adding meatballs, do so after 2 hours.

recipes.title: Beet Pickles
directions: Recipe can be halved.
Recipe takes 5 days.
Do not refrigerate while doing this recipe.
recipes.text: Beet Pickles. Recipe can be halved. Recipe takes 5 days. Do not refrigerate while doing this recipe.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Party Mix
directions: Mix together peanuts, pretzels, Rice Chex, Corn Chex and Wheat Chex.
Melt white chocolate bark.
Pour over other ingredients. Pour out on wax paper.
Let cool.
Break into pieces.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Party Mix. Mix together peanuts, pretzels, Rice Chex, Corn Chex and Wheat Chex. Melt white chocolate bark. Pour over other ingredients. Pour out on wax paper. Let cool. Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Soak bread in milk and eggs.
Mix other ingredients. Put cereal or crackers on top, crushed.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter over top.
Bake at 350u00b0 until it bubbles good.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Soak bread in milk and eggs. Mix other ingredients. Put cereal or crackers on top, crushed. Melt 2 tablespoons butter over top. Bake at 350u00b0 until it bubbles good.

recipes.title: Bean Hot Dish
ingredients: 1 large can lima or butter beans
directions: Drain and mix beans together.
Place into baking dish.
Cover beans with remaining ingredients.
Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0.
If using crock-pot, cook for 3 hours.
Dried beans may be used after soaking.
recipes.text: Bean Hot Dish. Drain and mix beans together. Place into baking dish. Cover beans with remaining ingredients. Bake for 1 hour at 350u00b0. If using crock-pot, cook for 3 hours. Dried beans may be used after soaking.

recipes.title: Sand Tarts
directions: Cut butter into flour and sugar mixture.
Add ice water and nuts.
Work up well.
Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet.
Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes.
Roll into powdered sugar while hot.
recipes.text: Sand Tarts. Cut butter into flour and sugar mixture. Add ice water and nuts. Work up well. Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet. Bake at 350u00b0 for 10 to 12 minutes. Roll into powdered sugar while hot.

recipes.title: Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
directions: Roll out pie shell. Mix rhubarb, strawberries, sugar, minute tapioca, lemon juice, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt together and place in pie shell. Top pie with crust, cut steam vents. Bake at 425u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Strawberry Rhubarb Pie. Roll out pie shell. Mix rhubarb, strawberries, sugar, minute tapioca, lemon juice, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt together and place in pie shell. Top pie with crust, cut steam vents. Bake at 425u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
directions: Combine all ingredients; shape into 1-inch balls.
Place on nonstick cookie sheet; bake for 15 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Meatballs. Combine all ingredients; shape into 1-inch balls. Place on nonstick cookie sheet; bake for 15 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: English Pea Salad
directions: Combine vegetable oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil and pour over vegetables.
Cover and chill 24 hours.
recipes.text: English Pea Salad. Combine vegetable oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and pour over vegetables. Cover and chill 24 hours.

recipes.title: Danish Apple Pastry
directions: Blend flour, Crisco (cut as pie dough).
Put 2 egg yolks into a measuring cup and add enough milk to make 1 cup.
Pour milk and egg mixture over flour and Crisco to make dough.
Divide dough in half. Roll between wax paper or Saran Wrap.
Place 1/2 of dough in a jelly roll pan or a cookie sheet.
Layer cornflakes on bottom. Peel apples and slice.
Put apples on dough.
Mix 1 cup of sugar and cinnamon on top of the apples.
Place second half of dough on top.
Beat 2 egg whites until frothy and spread on top of dough. Bake at 375u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes.
Make a glaze of powdered sugar and milk and drizzle on top of pastry.
recipes.text: Danish Apple Pastry. Blend flour, Crisco (cut as pie dough). Put 2 egg yolks into a measuring cup and add enough milk to make 1 cup. Pour milk and egg mixture over flour and Crisco to make dough. Divide dough in half. Roll between wax paper or Saran Wrap. Place 1/2 of dough in a jelly roll pan or a cookie sheet. Layer cornflakes on bottom. Peel apples and slice. Put apples on dough. Mix 1 cup of sugar and cinnamon on top of the apples. Place second half of dough on top. Beat 2 egg whites until frothy and spread on top of dough. Bake at 375u00b0 for 55 to 60 minutes. Make a glaze of powdered sugar and milk and drizzle on top of pastry.

recipes.title: Swedish Rice Pudding
directions: Boil rice and salt in water.
Warm milk and canned milk; stir into cooked rice and add pudding, sugar, egg and raisins.
Bring to a boil and add vanilla and cinnamon.
Can be served either cool or warm.
recipes.text: Swedish Rice Pudding. Boil rice and salt in water. Warm milk and canned milk; stir into cooked rice and add pudding, sugar, egg and raisins. Bring to a boil and add vanilla and cinnamon. Can be served either cool or warm.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries and apples together.
Mix fruit, sugar and nuts together.
Dissolve jello in hot water.
Pour over fruit mixture.
Mix well and place in refrigerator until well set.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Grind cranberries and apples together. Mix fruit, sugar and nuts together. Dissolve jello in hot water. Pour over fruit mixture. Mix well and place in refrigerator until well set.

recipes.title: Norwegian Blotkake(Wet Cake)
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries (fresh strawberries, raspberries or kiwi may be substituted for frozen berries)
directions: Beat eggs and sugar until light or pale yellow in color. Combine flour and baking powder; stir in slowly (add gradually). Stir in almond extract.
Pour batter into a 9-inch buttered and floured spring-form pan.
Bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 30 minutes.
Set aside to cool.
recipes.text: Norwegian Blotkake(Wet Cake). Beat eggs and sugar until light or pale yellow in color. Combine flour and baking powder; stir in slowly (add gradually). Stir in almond extract. Pour batter into a 9-inch buttered and floured spring-form pan. Bake in preheated 350u00b0 oven for 30 minutes. Set aside to cool.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Mix salad dressing and Italian dressing.
Stir pasta and vegetables into dressing.
Chill.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Mix salad dressing and Italian dressing. Stir pasta and vegetables into dressing. Chill.

recipes.title: King Ranch Chicken
directions: Pour broth over Fritos to wilt them.
Next, mix all together and put grated cheese on top and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until browned and ingredients are done.
recipes.text: King Ranch Chicken. Pour broth over Fritos to wilt them. Next, mix all together and put grated cheese on top and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes or until browned and ingredients are done.

recipes.title: Cranberry Nut Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients and cut in shortening until like coarse cornmeal.
Combine juice and rind with egg.
Mix at high speed until foamy and add to dry mix.
Mix just enough to dampen. Carefully fold in chopped nuts and cranberries.
Spread in loaf pan, corners and sides a little higher than center.
Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0 or until toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from pan to cool.
Tastes better if stored a couple of days.
recipes.text: Cranberry Nut Bread. Sift dry ingredients and cut in shortening until like coarse cornmeal. Combine juice and rind with egg. Mix at high speed until foamy and add to dry mix. Mix just enough to dampen. Carefully fold in chopped nuts and cranberries. Spread in loaf pan, corners and sides a little higher than center. Bake 1 hour at 350u00b0 or until toothpick comes out clean. Remove from pan to cool. Tastes better if stored a couple of days.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole(Start This Dish Up To 4 Hours Ahead!)
directions: In a bowl, mix zucchini with salt; let stand 15 minutes. Drain and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Combine zucchini, eggs, flour, 1/2 cup cheese and herbs.
Spread evenly in a shallow greased 3-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350u00b0 until set in center when touched, about 15 minutes.
Use or let stand up to 4 hours.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole(Start This Dish Up To 4 Hours Ahead!). In a bowl, mix zucchini with salt; let stand 15 minutes. Drain and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Combine zucchini, eggs, flour, 1/2 cup cheese and herbs. Spread evenly in a shallow greased 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 350u00b0 until set in center when touched, about 15 minutes. Use or let stand up to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Paul Newman Cake
ingredients: 16 oz. butterscotch caramel ice cream topping
directions: Bake cake mix as directed on package.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Let cool.
With the end of the handle of a wooden spoon, poke holes in cake.
Pour sweetened condensed milk over, then pour ice cream topping over it.
Spread with whipped topping.
Crush candy bars before unwrapping, then unwrap and sprinkle on top of whipped topping.
recipes.text: Paul Newman Cake. Bake cake mix as directed on package. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Let cool. With the end of the handle of a wooden spoon, poke holes in cake. Pour sweetened condensed milk over, then pour ice cream topping over it. Spread with whipped topping. Crush candy bars before unwrapping, then unwrap and sprinkle on top of whipped topping.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
directions: Heat oven to 425u00b0.
Prepare pastry.
Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pastry-lined pie pan.
Beat eggs slightly; beat in remaining ingredients.
Pour cream mixture into pie pan.
Bake 15 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 300u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Makes 6 main dish servings; 8 appetizer servings.
recipes.text: Quiche Lorraine. Heat oven to 425u00b0. Prepare pastry. Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pastry-lined pie pan. Beat eggs slightly; beat in remaining ingredients. Pour cream mixture into pie pan. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300u00b0 and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 main dish servings; 8 appetizer servings.

recipes.title: Quick Oats Soup(Lebanon)
directions: Saute onion in oil.
Add meat and saute for a while.
Add water, salt and pepper; bring to boil.
Reduce heat.
Cook until the meat is done.
Add tomato soup, oats and cilantro.
Stir well. Let cook for 15 minutes.
It is done!
Some lemon juice with the soup makes it taste better.
Makes enough for 8 people.
recipes.text: Quick Oats Soup(Lebanon). Saute onion in oil. Add meat and saute for a while. Add water, salt and pepper; bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cook until the meat is done. Add tomato soup, oats and cilantro. Stir well. Let cook for 15 minutes. It is done! Some lemon juice with the soup makes it taste better. Makes enough for 8 people.

recipes.title: Double Lemon Cake
directions: Mix together and bake 40 minutes in 350u00b0 oven.
Remove from oven and while hot, prick with fork all over cake and spoon on carefully a mixture of lemon juice, powdered sugar and 2 tablespoons oil.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Double Lemon Cake. Mix together and bake 40 minutes in 350u00b0 oven. Remove from oven and while hot, prick with fork all over cake and spoon on carefully a mixture of lemon juice, powdered sugar and 2 tablespoons oil. Mix well.

recipes.title: Marinated London Broil
ingredients: 1 lb. flank steak, about 1 inch thick
directions: In a flat glass baking dish combine the garlic, ginger, allspice, thyme, mustard, bay leaf and Worcestershire.
Add the meat and rub the marinade over the surface.
Marinate for 1/2 hour, turning the meat once.
Grill meat until done, 8 minutes on each side for rare.
Carve into thin slices and serve.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Marinated London Broil. In a flat glass baking dish combine the garlic, ginger, allspice, thyme, mustard, bay leaf and Worcestershire. Add the meat and rub the marinade over the surface. Marinate for 1/2 hour, turning the meat once. Grill meat until done, 8 minutes on each side for rare. Carve into thin slices and serve. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Bobby'S Favorite Chocolate Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cocoa, flour and egg yolks. Mix in milk gradually.
Add salt and cook until thick, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add vanilla and butter.
Pour into shell.
recipes.text: Bobby'S Favorite Chocolate Pie. Combine sugar, cocoa, flour and egg yolks. Mix in milk gradually. Add salt and cook until thick, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add vanilla and butter. Pour into shell.

recipes.title: Fettucini And Clam Sauce
directions: Saute garlic in margarine until brown and remove.
Add soup, milk, cheese and parsley.
Heat through.
Add drained clams and heat.
Do not boil.
Serve over hot, cooked fettucini.
recipes.text: Fettucini And Clam Sauce. Saute garlic in margarine until brown and remove. Add soup, milk, cheese and parsley. Heat through. Add drained clams and heat. Do not boil. Serve over hot, cooked fettucini.

recipes.title: Strawberry Soup
directions: Using blender at medium speed, blend all ingredients, except 3 strawberries, until smooth.
Cover and chill.
To serve, garnish soup with remaining 3 slices strawberries.
Makes 3 (1 cup) servings.
recipes.text: Strawberry Soup. Using blender at medium speed, blend all ingredients, except 3 strawberries, until smooth. Cover and chill. To serve, garnish soup with remaining 3 slices strawberries. Makes 3 (1 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Fried Squash Cakes
ingredients: 4 medium yellow squash, boiled whole, thoroughly drained and chopped until chunky
directions: Mix all together as you would potato cakes and drop by large spoonfuls in hot oil and margarine, mixed.
Fry slowly until golden brown. Turn as cakes brown.
Makes 8 medium cakes.
recipes.text: Fried Squash Cakes. Mix all together as you would potato cakes and drop by large spoonfuls in hot oil and margarine, mixed. Fry slowly until golden brown. Turn as cakes brown. Makes 8 medium cakes.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Pour in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 300u00b0.
While cake is warm, add frosting.
recipes.text: Prune Cake. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Pour in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 300u00b0. While cake is warm, add frosting.

recipes.title: Crullers (Liste)
directions: Beat yolks, salt, sugar, cream and liquor.
Add flour; knead dough until ready to roll out (let stand for 1/2 hour).
Add a little flour if needed to knead.
recipes.text: Crullers (Liste). Beat yolks, salt, sugar, cream and liquor. Add flour; knead dough until ready to roll out (let stand for 1/2 hour). Add a little flour if needed to knead.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Put cottage cheese in bowl and mix in dry jello.
Drain pineapple and add to cottage cheese and jello.
Fold in Cool Whip. Put in serving bowl and chill.
recipes.text: Lime Jello Salad. Put cottage cheese in bowl and mix in dry jello. Drain pineapple and add to cottage cheese and jello. Fold in Cool Whip. Put in serving bowl and chill.

recipes.title: Honey-Peanut Butter Cup Cookies
ingredients: 10 oz. peanut butter cups, cut up
directions: Mix butter, peanut butter, honey, brown sugar, vanilla and eggs until smooth and creamy.
Add dry ingredients until mixed. Dough will not be stiff.
Mix in cut up peanut butter cups and chips.
Refrigerate dough 2 hours.
Preheat oven to 325u00b0.
Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.
Mmmm goood!
recipes.text: Honey-Peanut Butter Cup Cookies. Mix butter, peanut butter, honey, brown sugar, vanilla and eggs until smooth and creamy. Add dry ingredients until mixed. Dough will not be stiff. Mix in cut up peanut butter cups and chips. Refrigerate dough 2 hours. Preheat oven to 325u00b0. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies. Mmmm goood!

recipes.title: Raspberry Christmas Slush
ingredients: 2 cans raspberry or cran-raspberry frozen concentrate
directions: Heat water and sugar until dissolved.
Add juices and freeze. Take from freezer an hour before serving to soften.
Mix with ginger ale or 7-Up.
recipes.text: Raspberry Christmas Slush. Heat water and sugar until dissolved. Add juices and freeze. Take from freezer an hour before serving to soften. Mix with ginger ale or 7-Up.

recipes.title: Creepy Crawley Spiders
directions: You mix all marshmallows. Then you melt chocolate until melted completely. Pour chocolate over the marshmallows. Then you drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper to make 24 clusters. Then for each marshmallow you cut 8 short pieces of licorice. Then you stick licorice for legs while it is wet or assorted candy for eyes while wet. Then you let stand at room temperature or put in the refrigerator in airtight container.
recipes.text: Creepy Crawley Spiders. You mix all marshmallows. Then you melt chocolate until melted completely. Pour chocolate over the marshmallows. Then you drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper to make 24 clusters. Then for each marshmallow you cut 8 short pieces of licorice. Then you stick licorice for legs while it is wet or assorted candy for eyes while wet. Then you let stand at room temperature or put in the refrigerator in airtight container.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. bread crumbs or crushed saltines
directions: Peel and cube eggplant.
Cook in 3/4 cup water until tender. Drain; add to other ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350u00b0.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Peel and cube eggplant. Cook in 3/4 cup water until tender. Drain; add to other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into greased baking dish. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350u00b0.

recipes.title: Party Rye
directions: Fry hamburger, sausage and cayenne pepper.
Drain grease. Combine cheese and oregano; mix well.
Place on party rye bread and place on cookie sheet.
Bake 15 minutes at 300u00b0.
recipes.text: Party Rye. Fry hamburger, sausage and cayenne pepper. Drain grease. Combine cheese and oregano; mix well. Place on party rye bread and place on cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 300u00b0.

recipes.title: Ritz Cracker Dessert
ingredients: 1 qt. plus 1 c. butter pecan ice cream
directions: Soften ice cream.
Melt oleo.
Add cracker crumbs and chopped nuts.
Spread half of mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat pudding, coconut, flavoring and milk until thick.
Fold in ice cream.
Put on top of crumbs in pan.
Spread
with Cool Whip. Cover with remaining crumb mixture.
Refrigerate.
Can be made night before and covered with Saran Wrap.
You may use instant coconut cream pudding and omit the coconut and flavoring.
recipes.text: Ritz Cracker Dessert. Soften ice cream. Melt oleo. Add cracker crumbs and chopped nuts. Spread half of mixture in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat pudding, coconut, flavoring and milk until thick. Fold in ice cream. Put on top of crumbs in pan. Spread with Cool Whip. Cover with remaining crumb mixture. Refrigerate. Can be made night before and covered with Saran Wrap. You may use instant coconut cream pudding and omit the coconut and flavoring.

recipes.title: Green Pea Casserole Supreme
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
directions: Melt margarine and add green pepper, onion and celery.
Cook until tender.
Add next 5 ingredients and mix well.
Put in casserole.
Sprinkle crumbs on top and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Pea Casserole Supreme. Melt margarine and add green pepper, onion and celery. Cook until tender. Add next 5 ingredients and mix well. Put in casserole. Sprinkle crumbs on top and bake at 350u00b0 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: 7-Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, fried and crumbled or 1/2 bottle Bac*Os
directions: In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass pan, cover bottom 1 1/4-inches deep with lettuce.
Sprinkle salt, pepper and sugar; layer bacon, eggs, frozen peas and rest of lettuce.
Sprinkle salt, pepper and sugar. Layer onions, mayo and cheese.
Sprinkle top with paprika.
recipes.text: 7-Layer Salad. In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass pan, cover bottom 1 1/4-inches deep with lettuce. Sprinkle salt, pepper and sugar; layer bacon, eggs, frozen peas and rest of lettuce. Sprinkle salt, pepper and sugar. Layer onions, mayo and cheese. Sprinkle top with paprika.

recipes.title: A Good Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine milk and lemon juice.
Beat until mixed well.
Add Cool Whip, bananas, marshmallows and pineapple. Mix all together and refrigerate.
recipes.text: A Good Salad. In a large bowl, combine milk and lemon juice. Beat until mixed well. Add Cool Whip, bananas, marshmallows and pineapple. Mix all together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can cream of potato soup or cream of celery or cream of chicken
margarine, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Peel
and
slice
potatoes
totapproximately
1/4-inch thick. Rub
margarine
around
the inside of the bowl.
Layer all ingredients,
starting
with
potatoes and ending with the cheese. Layer
potatoes,
onions, ham, cheese, etc.
Pour the soup over the top and cook in a slow oven until done (approximately 325u00b0 for 1 hour).
ner: cream of potato soup or cream of celery
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Peel and slice potatoes totapproximately 1/4-inch thick. Rub margarine around the inside of the bowl. Layer all ingredients, starting with potatoes and ending with the cheese. Layer potatoes, onions, ham, cheese, etc. Pour the soup over the top and cook in a slow oven until done (approximately 325u00b0 for 1 hour).

recipes.title: Banana-Nut Bread
directions: Cream sugar and oil in bowl until light and fluffy, add eggs 1
at a time, beating after each addition.tMix bananas. Dissolve soda
in
buttermilk.
Add to creamed mixture alternately
with sifted
flour
and salt, beating well after each addition.tAdd nuts and vanilla.
Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 hour or until bread is brown.
recipes.text: Banana-Nut Bread. Cream sugar and oil in bowl until light and fluffy, add eggs 1 at a time, beating after each addition.tMix bananas. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sifted flour and salt, beating well after each addition.tAdd nuts and vanilla. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 300u00b0 for 1 hour or until bread is brown.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
directions: Heat water and oil in saucepan to a rolling boil.
Add flour sifted with salt all at once and stir vigorously.
As soon as mixed remove from heat.
Cool and mix in unbeaten eggs, one at a time.
Add baking powder and mix.
Place large spoonfuls on greased pan.
Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Cream Puffs. Heat water and oil in saucepan to a rolling boil. Add flour sifted with salt all at once and stir vigorously. As soon as mixed remove from heat. Cool and mix in unbeaten eggs, one at a time. Add baking powder and mix. Place large spoonfuls on greased pan. Bake at 400u00b0 for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Never Soggy Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, Crisco and salt together until crumbly.
Beat egg, add water to beaten egg, beat, then add vinegar.
Add the egg-water-vinegar mixture to flour-Crisco-salt mixture.
Mix well, roll into size crust required.
Makes 3 single pie crusts.
Bake according to directions of your pie recipe.
recipes.text: Never Soggy Pie Crust. Mix flour, Crisco and salt together until crumbly. Beat egg, add water to beaten egg, beat, then add vinegar. Add the egg-water-vinegar mixture to flour-Crisco-salt mixture. Mix well, roll into size crust required. Makes 3 single pie crusts. Bake according to directions of your pie recipe.

recipes.title: Eclair Cake
directions: Boil water and oleo or heat in microwave until oleo melts. Add flour and mix together.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Spread onto a greased cookie sheet and bake at 400u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Slit bubbles in dough after baking.
Cool.
recipes.text: Eclair Cake. Boil water and oleo or heat in microwave until oleo melts. Add flour and mix together. Add eggs, one at a time. Spread onto a greased cookie sheet and bake at 400u00b0 for about 20 minutes. Slit bubbles in dough after baking. Cool.

recipes.title: Tortilla Appetizer Wedges
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. minced red or green jalapeno peppers
directions: In a medium bowl, combine cream cheese and sour cream.
Mix well.
Stir in chilies, onions and jalapenos.
Season with salt and pepper (or a little salsa for color).

Spread one tortilla with about 1/4 cup of mixture; top with another tortilla. Continue spreading and stacking until stack is 4 tortillas high; top with the 5th tortilla that has not been spread with cheese mixture.
Make another stack with the remaining 5 tortillas.
Wrap each stack in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Cut each stack into 18 wedges.
Arrange pinwheel fashion around a dish of salsa or picante.
Makes 36 appetizer servings.
recipes.text: Tortilla Appetizer Wedges. In a medium bowl, combine cream cheese and sour cream. Mix well. Stir in chilies, onions and jalapenos. Season with salt and pepper (or a little salsa for color). Spread one tortilla with about 1/4 cup of mixture; top with another tortilla. Continue spreading and stacking until stack is 4 tortillas high; top with the 5th tortilla that has not been spread with cheese mixture. Make another stack with the remaining 5 tortillas. Wrap each stack in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Cut each stack into 18 wedges. Arrange pinwheel fashion around a dish of salsa or picante. Makes 36 appetizer servings.

recipes.title: Mustard Dip
directions: Mix together the mustard and vinegar; let stand overnight. Cook in top of double boiler until thick.
recipes.text: Mustard Dip. Mix together the mustard and vinegar; let stand overnight. Cook in top of double boiler until thick.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Mix eggs and sugar, then
blend
in
all other ingredients. Bake in a greased and floured
8 x 8-inch pan.
Bake at 350u00b0 until done.
Makes one pan only.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Brownies. Mix eggs and sugar, then blend in all other ingredients. Bake in a greased and floured 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350u00b0 until done. Makes one pan only.

recipes.title: Maple Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly.
Add the next 5 ingredients.
Stir in pecans; pour into pie shell.
Bake for 55 minutes at 350u00b0.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Maple Pecan Pie. Beat eggs slightly. Add the next 5 ingredients. Stir in pecans; pour into pie shell. Bake for 55 minutes at 350u00b0. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Mother'S Spice Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. baking soda, dissolved in buttermilk
directions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl; mix well.
Bake in 350u00b0 oven.
May bake in a Bundt pan.
Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Mother'S Spice Cake. Combine all ingredients in large bowl; mix well. Bake in 350u00b0 oven. May bake in a Bundt pan. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix in order given, adding cheese last.
Bake in casserole dish at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix in order given, adding cheese last. Bake in casserole dish at 350u00b0 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza
directions: Cook at about 350u00b0 until dough is crisp.
Then wait until cheese bubbles.
recipes.text: Pizza. Cook at about 350u00b0 until dough is crisp. Then wait until cheese bubbles.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 c. coarsely chopped Chinese parsley (cilantro)
1 Tbsp. oyster sauce or soy sauce
1/2 tsp. dry mustard mixed with 1 tsp. water
directions: Bone and shred chicken.
Add oyster sauce, mustard, sugar and sesame oil.
Mix well by tossing.
Add lettuce, Chinese parsley, green onions, celery and snow peas to chicken and toss well.
Add chopped peanuts and sesame seed.
Add a few teaspoons rice wine vinegar and another teaspoon or two or more of sesame oil until desired flavor is achieved.
recipes.text: Chinese Chicken Salad. Bone and shred chicken. Add oyster sauce, mustard, sugar and sesame oil. Mix well by tossing. Add lettuce, Chinese parsley, green onions, celery and snow peas to chicken and toss well. Add chopped peanuts and sesame seed. Add a few teaspoons rice wine vinegar and another teaspoon or two or more of sesame oil until desired flavor is achieved.

recipes.title: No Bake Drop Cookies
directions: Combine in large saucepan first 4 ingredients; bring to rolling boil and cook 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.
Add next 3 ingredients and mix well.
Drop by spoonful on wax paper.
recipes.text: No Bake Drop Cookies. Combine in large saucepan first 4 ingredients; bring to rolling boil and cook 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Add next 3 ingredients and mix well. Drop by spoonful on wax paper.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 c. ground beef or 1/2 c. beef and 1/2 c. breakfast sausage
2 c. stale bread, softened in milk
seasoned salt and pepper to taste
directions: Scoop inside pulp from tomatoes and turn upside down to drain. Fry onion to light brown in butter, add pulp and meat.
Cook until almost all water is out of tomatoes.
Squeeze out all surplus milk in bread and measure 1 1/2 cups.
Add this to meat mixture, add egg and garlic, salt, pepper, oregano and basil leaf. Mix all ingredients well and cook until almost dry.
Stuff tomato shells with this dressing and sprinkle top with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350u00b0 for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Mix together Cool Whip and box of jello.
Drain oranges and pineapple.
Add to mixture.
Stir well.
Add marshmallows. Refrigerate and serve.
recipes.text: Pistachio Salad. Mix together Cool Whip and box of jello. Drain oranges and pineapple. Add to mixture. Stir well. Add marshmallows. Refrigerate and serve.

recipes.title: Quick Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 c. stewed tomatoes or tomato sauce
chopped vegetables: green bell pepper, onion, zucchini, squash, etc.
directions: Preheat oven to 400u00b0.
Brown hamburger in skillet, drain off fat.
Add taco seasoning and chopped vegetables.
Place tomato sauce or stewed tomatoes (with juice) on the bread.
Place ground beef and/or vegetable mixture on the bread.
Place cheese on top of the filling.
Bake for 15 minutes.

Place tomato sauce or stewed tomatoes (with juice) on the bread. Place ground beef and/or vegetable mixture on the bread. Place cheese on top of the filling. Bake for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 stalk fresh lemon grass (1 Tbsp.) or 1 tsp. lemon, shredded
1 1/2 lb. chicken, cut into bite size pieces
3 medium sweet potatoes, julienne strips (4 c.)
directions: Add oil to wok and preheat (high).
Add onion, garlic and lemon.
Stir-fry 1 minute.
Remove mixture.
Stir-fry chicken (half at a time) for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove.
Set aside 1 tablespoon of oil in wok.
Add sweet potatoes and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add carrots.
In small bowl, stir water, brown sugar, curry, sesame oil, salt and pepper.
Stir into wok.
Boil.
Reduce heat.
Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
Stir onion mix, chicken and coconut milk in wok. Cook over medium heat until done.
recipes.text: Chicken Curry. Add oil to wok and preheat (high). Add onion, garlic and lemon. Stir-fry 1 minute. Remove mixture. Stir-fry chicken (half at a time) for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove. recipes.title: Crab Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 4 large chicken breasts, halved, skinned and boned
directions: Place 1 chicken piece, bone side up, between waxed paper. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and Accent.
Pound chicken lightly and set aside.
recipes.text: Crab Stuffed Chicken. Place 1 chicken piece, bone side up, between waxed paper. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and Accent. Pound chicken lightly and set aside.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread 2
directions: Optional:
One-half cup bran may be substituted for 1 cup flour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread 2. Optional: One-half cup bran may be substituted for 1 cup flour.

recipes.title: Sauce For Baked Ham
directions: Put jelly in glass bowl in microwave for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add mustard.
Heat until hot.
Serve hot with sliced, baked ham.
recipes.text: Sauce For Baked Ham. Put jelly in glass bowl in microwave for 1 to 2 minutes. Add mustard. Heat until hot. Serve hot with sliced, baked ham.

recipes.title: Bull Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugars, vanilla and eggs together.
Add rest of ingredients.
Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.
recipes.text: Bull Chip Cookies. Cream butter, sugars, vanilla and eggs together. Add rest of ingredients. Bake at 350u00b0 until brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing crumbs (must be Pepperidge Farm)
directions: Combine stuffing crumbs and butter; set aside.
Place chicken in shallow, ungreased baking dish.
Top with cheese, soup, water and crumbs.
Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 325u00b0, uncovered.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Combine stuffing crumbs and butter; set aside. Place chicken in shallow, ungreased baking dish. Top with cheese, soup, water and crumbs. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 325u00b0, uncovered.

recipes.title: Marinade For Flank Steak
directions: Blend all ingredients.
Pour over scored flank steaks day or two before serving.
Turn occasionally.
Cook over hot charcoal. Slice into thin diagonal strips.
Marinade may be stored in refrigerator for several weeks.
recipes.text: Marinade For Flank Steak. Blend all ingredients. Pour over scored flank steaks day or two before serving. Turn occasionally. Cook over hot charcoal. Slice into thin diagonal strips. Marinade may be stored in refrigerator for several weeks.

recipes.title: Chicken Delight
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, boned, split and skinned
2 c. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix, crumbled
directions: Arrange split chicken breasts in oblong pan.
Place Swiss cheese on tops.
Pour chicken soup that has been mixed with sherry over this.
Sprinkle stuffing on top.
Drizzle melted butter on the top.
Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours (uncovered).
recipes.text: Chicken Delight. Arrange split chicken breasts in oblong pan. Place Swiss cheese on tops. Pour chicken soup that has been mixed with sherry over this. Sprinkle stuffing on top. Drizzle melted butter on the top. Bake at 325u00b0 for 1 to 1 1/2 hours (uncovered).

recipes.title: Navajo Tacos
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen chili (such as Johnson(R)), thawed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
2 cups all-purpose flour (such as Blue Bird(R))
1/2 cup hot water, or as needed
directions: Place pinto beans in a bowl and cover with room-temperature water. Let soak, about 8 hours. Drain.
Transfer drained beans to a large pot; pour in 6 cups water. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally and adding water if the level gets below 1 inch, until beans are tender, about 1 hour.
Stir thawed chili, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper into the pot. Continue cooking over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until beans are soft, about 1 hour more.
Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. Pour in hot water gradually, 1/2 cup at a time, and knead until dough is soft but not sticky. Let dough rest, covered, about 30 minutes.
Pinch off a piece of dough the size of a tennis ball; flatten out into a round on a floured surface. Repeat with remaining dough.

Melt lard in a large saucepan or deep-fryer over high heat. Gently lower dough into hot lard and fry, rotating with a fork, until evenly browned, 15 to 20 seconds. Flip dough and fry until second side is golden brown, 15 to 20 seconds more. Drain fry bread on paper towels. Repeat with remaining dough.
Place 1 fry bread on a plate. Cover with chili beans and top with Cheddar cheese, tomatoes, onions, and lettuce.

recipes.title: Sous Vide Burgers
directions: Pour water to the fill line of a sous vide cooker (such as SousVide Supreme(R)) to make the water bath. Preheat to 134 degrees F (57 degrees C).

Mix garlic, chives, paprika, salt, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper thoroughly into the ground beef. Form mixture into 2 patties and press into 2 chef's rings. Place into a food-grade cooking pouch and vacuum-seal.
Submerge the pouch in the water bath and cook until no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and oil the grate thoroughly.
Remove patties from the pouch and chef's rings. Pat dry with paper towels.
Grill patties until surfaces are lightly charred with grill marks, 30 to 45 seconds per side.
Place patties on burger buns and top with lettuce, tomato, Monterey Jack cheese, ketchup, and mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease one 9x5x3 inch loaf pan.
Put softened cheese, butter, and sugar in mixing bowl. Cream together well. Beat in eggs one at a time until blended. Mix in pumpkin.

In another bowl combine flour, soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, cloves, and walnuts. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Pour all at once over batter. Stir just enough to moisten. Turn into greased 9x5x3 inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 60-70 minutes until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in pan. Remove to rack to finish cooling.

Cool 10 minutes in pan. Remove to rack to finish cooling.

recipes.title: Best Keto Bread
directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a silicone loaf pan with cooking spray.
Whisk eggs in a bowl until smooth and creamy, about 3 minutes. Add melted butter and olive oil; mix until well combined.
Combine almond flour, baking powder, xanthan gum, and salt in a separate bowl; mix well. Add gradually to the egg mixture, mixing well until a thick batter is formed.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sichuan Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 cucumbers - peeled, seeded, and cut into 2-inch strips
directions: Heat a dry skillet over medium heat. Add red chile peppers; cook and stir until fragrant, about 5 minutes. Let cool and transfer to a spice grinder; pulse until coarsely ground.
Mix ground chile peppers, soy sauce, spring onion, sesame oil, hot chile oil, brown sugar, garlic, black vinegar, and sesame seeds together in a bowl to make dressing.
Place cucumbers on a serving plate. Pour dressing on top and toss well. Let sit before serving, about 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Fall In Love (With) Guacamole
ingredients: 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or more to taste (optional)
directions: Mash avocados, sea salt, garlic powder, and lime juice in a bowl using a fork.
Mix onion, tomatoes, and cilantro into avocado mixture; season with cayenne pepper.
recipes.text: Fall In Love (With) Guacamole. Mash avocados, sea salt, garlic powder, and lime juice in a bowl using a fork. Mix onion, tomatoes, and cilantro into avocado mixture; season with cayenne pepper.

recipes.title: Angela'S Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (1 ounce) package dry Ranch-style dressing mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil.
Place potatoes and water in baking dish and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour.
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt together processed cheese food and butter. Stir in dry ranch-style dressing mix and milk.
Pour the processed cheese food mixture over potatoes. Return to oven, reseal and continue cooking 30 minutes, until potatoes are tender and processed cheese food mixture is bubbly.
recipes.text: Angela'S Potatoes. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil. Place potatoes and water in baking dish and cover with aluminum foil. Bake in the preheated oven 1 hour. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt together processed cheese food and butter. Stir in dry ranch-style dressing mix and milk. Pour the processed cheese food mixture over potatoes. Return to oven, reseal and continue cooking 30 minutes, until potatoes are tender and processed cheese food mixture is bubbly.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Mondongo
ingredients: 3 pounds beef tripe, trimmed of fat and cut into cubes
8 ounces sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
directions: Combine tripe and lemon juice in a large bowl. Let sit, about 10 minutes.

Transfer tripe and lemon juice to a large pot. Cover with 2 inches of water. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, about 10 minutes. Drain and rinse tripe.
Return tripe to the pot. Cover with 2 quarts beef broth, adding water as needed. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and cook until tender, about 2 hours.
Stir remaining beef stock, cassava, potatoes, yams, pumpkin, sweet potatoes, tomato sauce, sofrito, and corn into the pot. Cook until tender, about 20 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Thai Soup
ingredients: 3 lemongrass stalks, bottom two-thirds of tender inner bulbs only, thinly sliced
1 (4 inch) piece fresh ginger root, chopped
2 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
1 lime, cut into wedges, for serving
1 fresh jalapeno pepper, sliced into rings
directions: Stir lemon grass, garlic, and ginger together in a large stock pot over medium-high heat. Stir in chicken broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Strain chicken broth and set aside. Discard lemon grass, garlic, and ginger.
Heat vegetable oil in a large soup pot over medium heat; Stir in chicken; cook and stir for 5 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms and cook for 5 more minutes.
Stir in red curry paste, fish sauce, and lime juice until combined. Stir in chicken broth and coconut milk; return to a simmer and cook on low for 15 to 20 minutes.
Skim off any excess oil and fat that rises to the top and discard.
Stir red onion into the chicken mixture; cook and stir until onion softens, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and add about 1/2 the cilantro.
Serve with plates of cilantro, lime wedges, and fresh sliced jalapenos.

recipes.title: Chef John'S Gingersnap Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup white sugar, or as needed for rolling cookies
directions: Whisk 2 cups plus 2 tablespoons flour, ground ginger, cinnamon, baking soda, salt, cloves, black pepper, and cayenne together in a large mixing bowl until thoroughly mixed.

Cream together butter and 2/3 cup sugar in a separate bowl until pale yellow and creamy, about 2 minutes. Add candied ginger, molasses, vanilla, and egg. Whisk mixture until well blended. Add dry ingredients to butter/sugar mixture and stir just until the flour disappears. Cover dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Pour 1/2 cup white sugar in a shallow dish for rolling cookies.

Scoop out about 1 1/2 teaspoons dough with a small scoop or teaspoon. Form dough into balls and roll in white sugar. Place cookies on prepared baking sheet. Slightly flatten cookies to about 1/4 inch thick; sprinkle with a pinch more sugar.
Bake in preheated oven until cookies are your desired crispiness or chewiness, 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Refried Black Beans
ingredients: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, drained and liquid reserved
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Mix black beans, refried black beans, 1/2 of the reserved liquid, Mexican cheese, and garlic together in an 8-inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling, about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Refried Black Beans. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Mix black beans, refried black beans, 1/2 of the reserved liquid, Mexican cheese, and garlic together in an 8-inch baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Wings With Yellow Rice
ingredients: 1 (10.75 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
water, or as needed to cover
1 (10 ounce) package saffron rice (such as Mahatma(R))
directions: Place turkey wings, cream of mushroom soup, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and seasoned salt into a 6-quart slow cooker. Pour in enough water to cover; stir ingredients. Cook on High for 6 hours or on Low for 8 hours.
Stir rice into mixture; continue to cook until rice is tender, 15 to 20 more minutes.
recipes.text: Turkey Wings With Yellow Rice. Place turkey wings, cream of mushroom soup, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and seasoned salt into a 6-quart slow cooker. Pour in enough water to cover; stir ingredients. Cook on High for 6 hours or on Low for 8 hours. Stir rice into mixture; continue to cook until rice is tender, 15 to 20 more minutes.

recipes.title: Instant Pot® Steel-Cut Oats
directions: Combine water and oats in an electric pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot(R)). Close and lock the lid. Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 3 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, 10 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Instant Pot® Steel-Cut Oats. Combine water and oats in an electric pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot(R)). Close and lock the lid. Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, 10 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Linda'S Enchiladas (Revised)
ingredients: 1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chile peppers
2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend, divided
directions: Place chicken in a large skillet and pour in enough water to cover; add Parmesan cheese and 2 chopped cloves of garlic. Bring water to a boil and cook until chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 28 minutes. Remove skillet from heat, reserving 1/2 cup water mixture from the skillet. Transfer chicken to a work surface and shred using 2 forks.

Combine onion, green chile peppers, and 1 chopped clove of garlic in a pot; add cream cheese and 1 cup Mexican cheese blend. Cook and stir mixture over medium heat until cream cheese is melted, 3 to 4 minutes. Slowly pour the reserved 1/2 cup water mixture from chicken over cream cheese mixture, while continuously stirring until mixture is smooth. Remove pot from heat and stir shredded chicken into cream cheese sauce.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Heat oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Place tortillas in the hot oil, working in batches, until warmed, about 30 seconds per side. Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons cream cheese-chicken sauce down the center of each warmed tortilla; roll tortilla around filling.
Pour enough green enchilada sauce to cover the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Arrange filled tortillas in the enchilada sauce. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over filled tortillas.
Mix sour cream and milk together in a bowl until thin enough to pour. Pour sour cream mixture over filled tortillas; top with remaining Mexican cheese blend.
Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and cheese is melted and bubbling, 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Treasure Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
In a small bowl mix cracker crumbs, flour and baking powder.
In a large mixing bowl, beat condensed milk and margarine until smooth.
Add cracker crumb mixture and blend well. Stir in coconut, chocolate chips, and pecans.
Drop by rounded teaspoon on a cookie sheet sprayed with non-stick spray. Bake 9-10 minutes or until lightly browned. Store loosely covered at room temperature.
recipes.text: Treasure Cookies. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). In a small bowl mix cracker crumbs, flour and baking powder. In a large mixing bowl, beat condensed milk and margarine until smooth. Add cracker crumb mixture and blend well. Stir in coconut, chocolate chips, and pecans. Drop by rounded teaspoon on a cookie sheet sprayed with non-stick spray. Bake 9-10 minutes or until lightly browned. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

recipes.title: Savory Southwestern Waffles
ingredients: 2 green chile peppers, seeded and minced, or more to taste
directions: Preheat waffle iron according to manufacturer's instructions.

Beat egg whites in a large bowl until fluffy. Fold in milk, butter, and honey. Add cornmeal, flour, baking powder, and salt, stirring slowly until batter is smooth. Fold in corn and green chile peppers.
Scoop some batter onto waffle iron; cook until golden brown and crisp or until waffle iron stops steaming, 3 to 4 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter.

Scoop some batter onto waffle iron; cook until golden brown and crisp or until waffle iron stops steaming, 3 to 4 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter.

recipes.title: Praline Strips
ingredients: 16 graham crackers, or more as needed
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C).
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and cover bottom of pan with graham crackers.
Bring butter, margarine, and brown sugar to a boil for 2 minutes. Add pecans and vanilla.
Pour brown sugar-pecan mixture over crackers; spread evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Cut while warm or break into small pieces.
recipes.text: Praline Strips. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and cover bottom of pan with graham crackers. Bring butter, margarine, and brown sugar to a boil for 2 minutes. Add pecans and vanilla. Pour brown sugar-pecan mixture over crackers; spread evenly. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Cut while warm or break into small pieces.

recipes.title: Creamy Smoked Paprika Sauce
directions: Mix yogurt, mayonnaise, and lime juice in a bowl. Add paprika, capers, oregano, cumin, dill, and cayenne pepper; stir until evenly mixed.
recipes.text: Creamy Smoked Paprika Sauce. Mix yogurt, mayonnaise, and lime juice in a bowl. Add paprika, capers, oregano, cumin, dill, and cayenne pepper; stir until evenly mixed.

recipes.title: Cream Of Coconut Pie
ingredients: 8 ounces sweetened cream of coconut (such as Coco Lopez(R))
directions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9-inch pie plate.

Combine sugar, flour, and salt in a bowl. Add butter and coconut extract. Add eggs 1 at a time, mixing well after each addition. Add cream of coconut and milk. Add shredded coconut. Pour mixture into the prepared pie plate.
Bake in the preheated oven until set, 45 to 50 minutes.
Chill completely before serving, at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pineapple Mango Habanero Jam
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds fresh mangos, cut into chunks
1 pound fresh pineapple, cut into chunks
4 habanero chiles - stemmed, halved, and seeded
directions: Combine mangos, pineapple, and cider vinegar in a stockpot over medium-high heat. Bring to a a simmer; mash mangos and pineapple to a chunky consistency with a potato masher. Stir in sugar until dissolved.

Stir liquid pectin and habanero chile halves into the stockpot. Bring to a rolling boil, stirring frequently. Cook, stirring frequently, until jam thickens, about 2 minutes more. Remove chile halves. Discard 6 chile halves; chop 2 halves and stir back into the stockpot.
Sterilize 8 half-pint jars and lids in boiling water for at least 5 minutes.

Ladle hot jam into hot, sterilized jars, filling to within 1/4 inch of the top. Run a clean knife around the insides of the jars to remove any air bubbles. Wipe the rims of the jars with a moist paper towel to remove any food residue. Top with lids and screw on rings.

Place a rack in the bottom of a large stockpot and fill halfway with water. Bring to a boil and lower jars into the boiling water using a holder, spacing them 2 inches apart. Pour in more boiling water to cover jars by at least 1 inch. Bring the water to a rolling boil, cover the pot, and process for 10 minutes.

Remove the jars from the stockpot and place onto a cloth-covered or wood surface, several inches apart, until cool, about 8 hours. Press the top of each lid with a finger, ensuring that the seal is tight (lid does not move up or down at all).

recipes.title: Spicy Vegetarian Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
salt and ground black pepper to taste
4 large green bell peppers - tops, seeds, and membranes removed (tops reserved)
1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir onion, poblano chile pepper, jalapeno pepper, and garlic in the hot oil until onion and peppers are softened, 5 to 6 minutes. Stir rice into onion mixture; cook until rice is lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes.

Stir vegetable broth, tomatoes with green chile peppers, and corn into the rice mixture; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until broth is absorbed, 7 to 10 minutes. Season rice mixture with salt and pepper; stir in 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese and cilantro. Remove from heat and cool slightly.
Place the tops back onto each green bell pepper; wrap each pepper loosely with aluminum foil.

Bake wrapped peppers in the preheated oven until softened, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove peppers from oven and lower oven's temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Cool peppers completely, about 20 minutes.

Stand green bell peppers upright in an 8x8-inch baking dish. Use the aluminum foil from earlier to 'nest' the peppers if necessary. Fill each pepper with rice mixture and top with panko bread crumbs and remaining Monterey Jack cheese. Place tops back onto each green bell pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Instant Pot® Mexican-Style Meatballs And Quinoa
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) can Mexican-style hot tomato sauce (such as Goya(R))
directions: Mix veal, eggs, minced red onion, 3/4 cup cotija cheese, 1/4 cup cilantro, bread crumbs, milk, cumin, chipotle, salt, pepper, and garlic powder together in a bowl. Form mixture into about 20 walnut-sized balls.

Heat a multi-functional electric pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot(R)) on Saute setting. Pour in oil. Saute red onion slices and jalapeno pepper until starting to soften, about 5 minutes. Add quinoa and stir. Pour in broth and 1/2 of the tomato sauce. Mix well. Add meatballs to the pot and pour remaining tomato sauce on top.
Close and lock the lid. Select medium pressure on Manual mode according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 10 minutes. Allow 8 to 10 minutes for pressure to build.

Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, 10 to 40 minutes. Serve meatballs over the stewed tomatoes and quinoa. Top with remaining cotija cheese and cilantro.

recipes.title: Garlic Lover'S Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded Italian cheese blend, or to taste
directions: Stir water, kosher salt, and sugar together until the salt and sugar dissolve completely into a brine.
Put chicken breasts in a large resealable plastic bag; pour brine into the bag with the chicken. Squeeze air from the bag and seal. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 13x9x2-inch baking dish.
Mix Parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, parsley, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl; spread about 1/3 of the mixture into the bottom of the prepared baking dish.
Remove chicken from the brine, shake off excess liquid, and pat dry. Discard remaining brine.
Coat chicken with olive oil. Arrange chicken atop the Parmesan cheese layer in the baking dish. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan cheese mixture over the chicken.
Mix garlic, margarine, and lemon juice together in a small bowl; drizzle over chicken.

Cook chicken breasts until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 25-30 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Switch oven to broil. Sprinkle cheese over the chicken breasts.
Heat oven's broiler. Cook chicken under the broiler until the cheese is melted and golden brown, about 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Scallops With Oranges And Vanilla Beurre Blanc
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped inner celery leaves, or to taste
directions: Bring wine, orange juice, and shallot to a boil in a small saucepan. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, until about 2 tablespoons of liquid remains, about 10 minutes. Add cream; simmer until mixture is almost evaporated, 1 to 2 minutes more.
Whisk in 8 tablespoons cold butter, 1 tablespoon at a time, until incorporated. Remove from heat. Strain and discard shallot, then whisk in vanilla.
Rinse scallops and pat dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Heat oil and remaining 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add scallops; cook, turning once, until browned and opaque, 3 to 5 minutes total. Transfer to a serving platter.
Top scallops with the orange sauce, orange sections, and celery leaves.

recipes.title: Creamy Zucchini Soup
directions: Melt the butter and heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Mix in the onion, and cook 5 minutes. Mix in the zucchini and tofu. Season with red pepper flakes and oregano. Continue to cook and stir 10 minutes, until zucchini is tender.
Pour the vegetable stock into the skillet. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 35 minutes.
In a blender, process the soup and cottage cheese until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to serve.

recipes.title: Easy Caramel Custard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hot water, or as needed
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Mix 1 tablespoon water into 1/4 cup sugar in a heavy saucepan over medium heat until sugar is completely moistened. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until the sugar and water form a golden brown syrup, about 5 minutes. Do not stir. Remove from heat and let boiling subside. Carefully stir 1 tablespoon hot water into caramel syrup.

Whisk milk and 5 tablespoons sugar together in a saucepan over low heat; heat just until warmed and sugar has dissolved. Remove from heat and whisk eggs into milk mixture. Pour caramel syrup into an 8x8-inch baking dish. Pour egg-milk mixture over syrup. Place pan into a larger baking dish and pour enough water into outer pan to reach about 1/2 inch up the sides of the inner pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until custard has set, about 45 minutes. Let cool for about 10 minutes; chill in refrigerator before serving.
